name: FLT3 mutant resistance to lestaurtinib, ponatinib and tamatinib

name: Kinase inhibitor resistance of ERBB2 kinase-domain mutants

name: Endocannabinoid retrograde synaptic signaling via diacylglycerol hydrolysis

name: Keratan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthesis

name: Keratan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern keratan sulfate synthesis (including CHST6 deficiency), distinct from confusables on other GAGs or mucopolysaccharidosis degradation.

name: Error-prone translesion DNA synthesis

name: Error-prone translesion synthesis by REV1 and polymerase kappa
rationale: All members describe mutagenic lesion bypass by REV1 and POLK, distinguishing the theme from error-free POLH bypass, gap-filling repair and replicative DNA synthesis confusables.

name: Error-prone translesion synthesis by POLK and REV1
rationale: All members are error-prone translesion synthesis, which distinguishes it from the error-free POLH, replication and base-excision confusables.

name: Leloir pathway galactose catabolism and galactosemias
rationale: All members concern the Leloir pathway and its GALT/GALM deficiencies, distinguishing it from fructose, pentose and gluconeogenesis confusables.

name: Leloir pathway galactose catabolism and galactosemias
rationale: All members concern the Leloir galactose pathway and its GALT/GALM deficiencies, distinct from confusables on fructose, pentose or alditol metabolism.

rationale: All members concern the Leloir pathway and GALT/GALM deficiencies, distinct from fructose, pentose or gluconeogenic confusables.

name: Purine nucleobase salvage by HPRT1
rationale: All members are HPRT1-mediated salvage of hypoxanthine/guanine to IMP/GMP, distinct from nucleoside salvage and purine catabolism confusables.

name: Purine nucleobase salvage to IMP

name: HPRT1-mediated purine nucleobase salvage

name: Rho GTPase regulation of cytokinesis

qualifier: ligand binding, isoforms and activating mutants of FGFR1-4
name: FGFR ligand binding, downstream cascades and activating mutants

qualifier: FGFR1-4 ligand activation and FRS/SHC/PLCG/PI3K cascades
name: FGFR1–4 ligand activation and downstream signaling cascades

qualifier: FGFR1-4 ligand activation and downstream cascades
name: FGFR1-4 ligand activation and downstream signalling cascades

name: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of KIT and PDGFR mutants

name: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of KIT and PDGFR mutants

name: KIT and PDGFR mutant resistance to tyrosine kinase inhibitors
rationale: All members describe KIT or PDGFR mutants binding or resisting TKIs, versus FLT3/ALK resistance and KIT mutant signalling neighbours.

name: Mucopolysaccharidoses of chondroitin/dermatan, keratan and hyaluronan degradation
rationale: All members are GAG catabolism or its lysosomal storage defects; unlike the Sanfilippo-centred confusables, the theme spans CS/DS, keratan sulfate and hyaluronan as well as heparan sulfate.

name: Non-Sanfilippo mucopolysaccharidoses and lysosomal glycosaminoglycan degradation

name: Mucopolysaccharidoses and lysosomal chondroitin, keratan, heparan sulfate degradation

core: phenotypic switching of vascular smooth muscle cells

name: Phenotypic switching of vascular associated smooth muscle cells
rationale: Every member regulates the contractile-to-synthetic switch of vascular smooth muscle cells or one of its component behaviours; the confusables are cardiac and striated muscle growth, aortic morphogenesis, endothelial activation and vascular wound healing, none of which appear here.

core: vascular smooth muscle cell phenotypic switching
name: Vascular associated smooth muscle cell phenotypic switching
rationale: Members are the bidirectional controls on vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration, apoptosis and de/differentiation, i.e. phenotypic switching, distinct from cardiac and skeletal muscle growth, aortic morphogenesis and endothelial or vessel-remodelling confusables.

name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching, proliferation and migration
rationale: All members regulate vascular smooth muscle cell phenotype (switching, dedifferentiation, proliferation, migration, apoptosis), distinguishing them from cardiac muscle growth, aortic development and vascular remodeling confusables.

name: Opsin-mediated phototransduction and light detection

name: Opsin-mediated visual phototransduction and light detection
rationale: Members are opsins, phototransduction activation/recovery, its disease variants and light detection, distinct from retinoid-cycle and photoreceptor-development confusables.

name: Opsin-mediated phototransduction and light detection
rationale: Members concern opsins, activation and recovery of the phototransduction cascade, cone opsin defects and light responses, distinguishing it from retinoid-cycle and photoreceptor development neighbours.

qualifier: de novo CDP pathways and cardiolipin remodeling
name: De novo glycerophospholipid synthesis and cardiolipin remodeling

name: De novo phospholipid synthesis including cardiolipin and its remodeling

name: CDP-pathway glycerophospholipid and cardiolipin biosynthesis
rationale: Members are de novo synthesis of PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin via CDP-choline and CDP-diacylglycerol, plus cardiolipin/PG remodeling; confusables are phospholipid catabolism and transfer, PA/triglyceride synthesis, or general acyl-chain remodeling.

qualifier: resolvins, protectins and maresins from DHA, DPA and EPA
name: Resolvin, protectin and maresin biosynthesis
rationale: All members synthesize docosanoid/EPA-derived pro-resolving mediators (resolvins, protectins, maresins), unlike confusables built on arachidonate-derived lipoxins, HETEs and leukotrienes.

qualifier: from DHA, EPA and DPA (resolvins, protectins, maresins)
name: Resolvin, protectin and maresin biosynthesis from DHA/EPA/DPA

qualifier: resolvins, protectins and maresins from non-arachidonate PUFAs
name: Resolvin, protectin and maresin biosynthesis
rationale: All members synthesize resolvins, protectins, maresins or related oxo-derivatives from EPA, DHA and DPA, whereas the confusables cover arachidonate-derived lipoxins, HETEs and leukotriene catabolism.

core: Neutral and imino amino acid transport

core: Neutral and imino amino acid transport
name: Neutral and imino acid transport in Hartnup and iminoglycinuria
rationale: Members cover proline, glycine and tryptophan transporters (SLC6A19, SLC6A20, SLC36A2) and their diseases, unlike oligopeptide, cystine or cationic amino acid transport confusables.

qualifier: imino acid/glycine transporters and Hartnup, iminoglycinuria
name: Neutral and imino acid transport in Hartnup and iminoglycinuria
rationale: Members are proline, glycine and tryptophan plasma-membrane transport by SLC6A19/SLC6A20/SLC36A2 and their diseases, unlike cystine, hexose or peptide transport confusables.

name: MHC class I antigen processing and cross-presentation

core: MHC class I antigen processing and presentation

core: MHC class I antigen processing and presentation
name: MHC class I antigen presentation and cross-presentation

qualifier: ECM assembly, collagen and myofibroblast control

name: Regulation of fibrotic connective tissue replacement and ECM assembly
rationale: Members regulate connective tissue replacement, ECM assembly, collagen metabolism, myofibroblast differentiation, fibroblast apoptosis and TGF-beta responses; confusables add fibroblast migration, miRNA processing or elastin/MMP turnover.

qualifier: rostrocaudal somite patterning and axis elongation

qualifier: segmentation clock and posterior axis elongation

name: Cardiomyocyte depolarization and His-Purkinje conduction

name: Cardiomyocyte depolarization and AV-His-Purkinje conduction

name: Cardiac depolarization and AV node-His-Purkinje conduction

name: ER quality-control retention, demannosylation and retrotranslocation

name: Centrosome cohesion, positioning and microtubule nucleation-anchoring

name: Cytokinetic furrow and spindle midzone assembly

qualifier: spindle midzone and actomyosin contractile ring

name: Cytokinetic contractile ring and spindle midzone assembly

qualifier: electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis

qualifier: electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis
name: Mitochondrial respiratory electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis
rationale: All members describe operation of the respiratory chain and ATP synthesis, unlike neighbours on respiratory complex assembly, membrane insertion and mitochondrial translation.

qualifier: electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis
name: Respiratory electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis
rationale: Members are the mitochondrial electron transport chain (ubiquinol to oxygen) and chemiosmotic ATP formation, whereas confusables concern assembly of respiratory complexes and mitochondrial translation.

name: MITF-M regulation and its non-pigmentation target programs
rationale: All members concern MITF-M regulation and its target genes for proliferation, invasion, metabolism, DNA repair and lysosomes, while confusables center on pigmentation, melanin and PAX3/CDH1 transcription.

name: MITF-M regulation of non-pigmentation target genes
rationale: Every member is MITF-M regulation or its targets for proliferation, DNA repair, invasion, metabolism and lysosomes, while confusables hold the pigmentation/melanin arm or other transcriptional regulators.

name: MITF-M activity and non-pigmentation target gene programs

core: Mycobacterium tuberculosis subversion of host defenses

core: Mycobacterium tuberculosis manipulation of host cell

qualifier: membrane cargo targeting into the cilium

qualifier: BBSome and ARL GTPase membrane cargo delivery
name: Ciliary cargo targeting via BBSome and ARL GTPases
rationale: Members deliver membrane cargo and receptors into cilia (BBSome, VxPx, myristoylated proteins, ARL13B-INPP5E); confusables cover intraflagellar transport, cilium assembly/disassembly or photoreceptor outer segments.

name: Targeting of membrane cargo and receptors to cilia
rationale: Members concern delivery of membrane proteins and receptors into cilia (VxPx, myristoylated, BBSome, ARL13B-INPP5E), distinct from the intraflagellar transport, basal body and photoreceptor neighbours.

name: Endocannabinoid synthesis, degradation and retrograde synaptic signaling

qualifier: 2-AG and anandamide turnover with retrograde lipid signaling

name: Endocannabinoid synthesis, degradation and retrograde synaptic signaling

name: Vitamin D metabolism and hydroxylase deficiency disorders

name: Vitamin D activation, catabolism and receptor signaling

name: Monoamine neurotransmitter degradation by MAO and COMT

qualifier: enzymatic degradation of dopamine and serotonin
name: Enzymatic degradation of dopamine, serotonin and other monoamines
rationale: All members describe oxidative deamination and methylation-based breakdown of biogenic amines, separating the theme from confusables on monoamine transport, reuptake and biosynthesis.

name: Cobalamin-dependent methylmalonyl-CoA mutase in propionate catabolism

name: Cobalamin metabolism and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase deficiencies

qualifier: methylmalonyl-CoA mutase pathway and methylmalonic aciduria

rationale: All members concern purine/pyrimidine nucleotide, nucleoside and base synthesis, salvage, degradation, transport or nucleoside-analogue drug handling, unlike confusables on creatine, folate/methionine or amino acid metabolism.

qualifier: purine and pyrimidine synthesis, salvage, catabolism and transport
name: Purine and pyrimidine synthesis, salvage, catabolism and transport
rationale: Members span de novo, salvage, interconversion, catabolism and nucleoside transport of purines and pyrimidines (including nucleoside-analogue drugs), whereas confusables cover amino acid, methionine/folate or creatine metabolism.

qualifier: purine and pyrimidine synthesis, salvage, catabolism and transport
name: Purine and pyrimidine nucleotide synthesis, salvage, catabolism and transport
rationale: Nearly all members concern de novo synthesis, salvage, degradation, interconversion or transport of purine/pyrimidine nucleotides and nucleoside analogue drugs, unlike confusables on one-carbon/methionine, amino acid or creatine metabolism.

qualifier: recombination, cohesion and chromosome segregation including female meiosis
name: Meiotic recombination, cohesion and chromosome segregation
rationale: All members are meiotic events (DSB formation, strand invasion, synapsis, chiasmata, meiotic cohesion, spindle positioning, polar body extrusion, meiotic checkpoints); unlike mitotic cohesion/condensation, germline epigenetic and DNA-repair confusables it spans the full meiotic chromosome programme.

name: Meiotic recombination, synapsis and chromosome segregation
rationale: All members concern meiotic divisions (DSB formation, strand invasion, chiasmata, synaptonemal complex, meiotic cohesion, spindle and checkpoint control), distinguishing them from mitotic spindle/cohesion and germline epigenetic/MZT confusables.

name: Meiotic recombination, synapsis and chromosome segregation
rationale: Nearly all members are meiotic DNA break formation, recombination, synaptonemal complex, cohesion, spindle and segregation steps; confusables are germline piRNA/zygotic programs, general DNA repair, or mitotic spindle and cohesion.

qualifier: sulfated GAG chains and their congenital defects
name: Sulfated glycosaminoglycan biosynthesis and congenital defects
rationale: All members concern synthesis of chondroitin, dermatan, heparan and keratan sulfate chains and linkage region, or inherited enzyme defects therein; confusables involve O-mannose, O-fucose glycosylation or sulfate transporters.

qualifier: sulfated chains with their inherited enzyme defects
name: Sulfated glycosaminoglycan biosynthesis and its inherited defects
rationale: Members cover linkage-region, chondroitin, dermatan, heparan and keratan sulfate synthesis and the congenital disorders of those enzymes, separating them from Notch O-glycosylation, cartilage sulfate transport and dystroglycan glycosylation neighbours.

name: Glycosaminoglycan chain biosynthesis and its congenital defects
rationale: Members are chondroitin, dermatan, heparan and keratan sulfate chain and linkage-region synthesis plus the inherited glycosyltransferase/sulfotransferase defects in them; confusables center on sulfate/nucleotide-sugar transporter defects, Notch O-glycosylation and dystroglycan glycosylation.

qualifier: protein and RNA import, cristae organization
name: Mitochondrial protein and RNA import, processing and cristae organization
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial protein and RNA/tRNA import, presequence processing and degradation, calcium import, fusion and cristae/outer membrane organization; distinct from respiratory-complex assembly (C1), mitophagy/fission dynamics (C2, C3) and inner-membrane insertion (C4).

name: Mitochondrial import, protein processing and membrane organization
rationale: Members cover import of proteins, RNA and calcium into mitochondria, presequence processing and degradation of mitochondrial proteins, and cristae/outer membrane organization, distinct from respiratory-chain assembly and from fission/mitophagy confusables.

name: Mitochondrial import, protein processing and membrane organization
rationale: Members cover import of proteins, RNA and calcium into mitochondria, mitochondrial protein processing and degradation, and cristae/outer membrane organization, unlike confusables centred on respiratory complex assembly or fission/mitophagy.

name: Mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation and ketone body metabolism
rationale: Members are successive acyl-CoA chain-shortening steps of mitochondrial beta-oxidation and ketone body synthesis/utilization, distinguishing them from carnitine shuttle and branched-chain amino acid catabolism neighbours.

qualifier: with ketone body synthesis and utilization
name: Mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation and ketone body metabolism
rationale: Members are acyl-CoA dehydrogenase beta-oxidation steps and ketogenesis/ketolysis, lacking the carnitine shuttle and branched-chain catabolism of the confusables.

name: Mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation and ketone body metabolism
rationale: Members are the stepwise beta-oxidation of acyl-CoAs from palmitoyl to acetyl-CoA plus ketone body synthesis and utilization, whereas confusables cover the carnitine shuttle, peroxisomal steps or branched-chain amino acid/PDH metabolism.

qualifier: biosynthesis, vesicular loading and transporter reuptake
name: Catecholamine synthesis with monoamine vesicular loading and reuptake
rationale: Members cover dopamine/norepinephrine synthesis, vesicular loading, release and SLC6 reuptake of catecholamines and serotonin, distinct from confusables on monoamine degradation, serotonin synthesis or vesicle acidification.

name: Catecholamine biosynthesis and monoamine transporter reuptake
rationale: Members cover dopamine/catecholamine synthesis, vesicular loading and SLC6 transporter reuptake of norepinephrine, dopamine and serotonin with their transporter defects, while confusables add serotonin synthesis or MAO/COMT degradation.

qualifier: synthesis, vesicular loading and plasma-membrane reuptake
name: Catecholamine synthesis, vesicular loading and plasma-membrane reuptake
rationale: Members cover dopamine/norepinephrine synthesis, vesicular loading, release and SLC6 transporter reuptake (including DAT/NET defects), whereas confusables cover MAO/COMT degradation and serotonin synthesis.

core: Dietary sugar digestion and hexose transport
name: Dietary sugar digestion and hexose transmembrane transport
rationale: Members cover disaccharide digestion, intestinal hexose absorption and SLC2/SLC5 hexose-transporter defects, distinguishing the theme from urate transport, galactose/fructose catabolism and glycoside transport confusables.

core: Dietary carbohydrate digestion and hexose transport
name: Carbohydrate digestion and hexose transmembrane transport
rationale: Members cover disaccharide digestion, intestinal hexose absorption and glucose/galactose/fructose transporters and their defects, distinguishing it from galactose/fructose catabolism and urate-transport confusables.

qualifier: disaccharide digestion and hexose transmembrane transport
name: Disaccharide metabolism and hexose transmembrane transport
rationale: Members cover carbohydrate digestion, disaccharide catabolism/lactose synthesis and hexose transport including SGLT/GLUT defects; confusables instead feature galactose/fructose catabolism, urate transport or glycoside transport.

qualifier: complex/hybrid N-glycan and mucin-type O-glycan, not fucosylation
name: Golgi N-glycan maturation and mucin-type O-glycan elongation
rationale: Members cover mannose trimming, complex/hybrid N-glycan branching, polylactosamine and sialylation, and O-GalNAc initiation/termination, unlike early ER N-glycosylation and fucose/blood-group confusables.

qualifier: complex N-glycan maturation and mucin-type O-glycosylation
name: Golgi N-glycan maturation and mucin-type O-glycan synthesis
rationale: Members are complex/hybrid N-glycan trimming and antenna elongation, GalNAc-type O-glycosylation and its disorders, sialylation and polyLacNAc; these separate it from fucose/blood-group neighbours and ER N-glycan processing.

name: Golgi N-glycan maturation and mucin-type O-glycosylation
rationale: Members cover mannose trimming to hybrid/complex N-glycans, antennae elongation, sialylation and poly-LacNAc, and GalNAc-initiated O-glycan synthesis with its GALNT/C1GALT1C1 defects; these separate it from ER N-glycan processing and fucose/blood-group antigen confusables.

core: lysosomal glycosaminoglycan degradation blocked in mucopolysaccharidosis
qualifier: Hurler, Hunter, Morquio, Maroteaux-Lamy and Sly forms, excluding the Sanfilippo and Natowicz enzymes
name: Non-Sanfilippo mucopolysaccharidoses blocking glycosaminoglycan degradation
rationale: Each member is a specific mucopolysaccharidosis entry in which a sulfatase or exoglycosidase deficiency halts chondroitin/dermatan, heparan, keratan or hyaluronan breakdown; the confusables are defined by the Sanfilippo (MPS III) and Natowicz (MPS IX) steps and the generic substrate-degradation pathways, none of which belong to this theme.

core: mucopolysaccharidoses from lysosomal glycosaminoglycan degradation defects
name: Mucopolysaccharidoses blocking chondroitin, dermatan and keratan sulfate catabolism
rationale: Every member is a mucopolysaccharidosis caused by a missing lysosomal enzyme step in glycosaminoglycan breakdown, and the theme holds the types with chondroitin/dermatan, keratan or hyaluronan blocks rather than the heparan-only Sanfilippo types or the normal degradation routes in the confusables.

qualifier: dermatan or keratan sulfate storage types (I, II, IV, VI, VII)
name: Mucopolysaccharidoses with dermatan or keratan sulfate storage
rationale: All members are MPS types I, II, IV, VI and VII, which store dermatan or keratan sulfate, whereas confusables carry the heparan-only Sanfilippo (MPS III) or hyaluronan MPS IX entries and generic GAG catabolism.

core: Defective DNA glycosylases in base excision repair
name: Defective MUTYH, OGG1 and NTHL1 glycosylases in base excision repair
rationale: All members describe disease-variant MUTYH, OGG1 or NTHL1 glycosylase defects and glycosylase displacement by APEX1, distinct from NEIL defects, normal glycosylase recognition and downstream gap-filling confusables.

qualifier: defective OGG1, MUTYH and NTHL1 variants
name: Defective OGG1, MUTYH and NTHL1 glycosylases in base excision repair
rationale: Seven of eight members are disease-variant defects of the oxidative-lesion glycosylases OGG1, MUTYH and NTHL1 (plus APEX1 handoff), distinguishing it from confusables on normal lesion recognition, AP-site processing or alkylation repair.

name: Defective oxidative-damage DNA glycosylases in base excision repair
rationale: Members are defects of OGG1, MUTYH and NTHL1 substrate binding, processing or localization plus APEX1 displacement of glycosylases, distinct from confusables on downstream AP-site resolution, NEIL glycosylases and alkylation repair.

qualifier: acrosome assembly, capacitation, acrosome reaction, zona pellucida penetration
name: Sperm acrosome assembly, acrosome reaction and zona pellucida penetration
rationale: All members concern acrosome biogenesis, capacitation and the acrosome-dependent binding and penetration of the egg coat, unlike sperm motility, germ cell development or the maternal-zygotic transition in confusables.

qualifier: capacitation, acrosome reaction and zona penetration
name: Sperm capacitation, acrosome reaction and zona pellucida penetration
rationale: All members concern sperm capacitation, acrosome formation/exocytosis and zona/cumulus binding at fertilization, unlike sperm motility, spermatogenesis and maternal-to-zygotic transition confusables.

qualifier: capacitation, acrosome reaction and zona penetration
name: Sperm capacitation, acrosome reaction and zona pellucida penetration
rationale: All members concern sperm capacitation, acrosome biogenesis/exocytosis and binding/penetration of cumulus and zona pellucida, unlike sperm motility, germ cell or maternal-to-zygotic neighbours.

name: Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium and CO2 transport
rationale: Members describe Rh/RHAG glycoproteins, their biosynthesis and defect, and the ammonium and CO2 transport they mediate; confusables are erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange and peptide transport.

name: Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium and carbon dioxide transport
rationale: Members concern Rh-family membrane proteins, their biosynthesis and deficiency, and the ammonium/CO2 transmembrane transport they mediate, distinguishing them from erythrocyte oxygen exchange and peptide-transport neighbours.

name: Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium and CO2 transport
rationale: Members concern Rh-family (RHAG) proteins, Rh blood group synthesis and ammonium/CO2 membrane transport; confusables are erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange and peptide transporters, lacking the Rhesus ammonium channel.

name: Cancer-associated TGF-beta receptor and SMAD mutant signaling
rationale: Seven of eight members are cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3/4 (plus TCF7L2 mutants), distinguishing it from RUNX3, Hippo, mismatch repair and TGFBR3 neighbours.

name: Cancer mutants of TGF-beta receptor and SMAD signaling
rationale: Seven of eight members are cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3/4 (plus TCF7L2 mutants), distinguishing it from Hippo/YAP, RUNX3, mismatch-repair and TGFBR3/activin confusables.

name: Cancer mutants of TGF-beta receptors and SMADs
rationale: All members are cancer signaling mutants, seven of eight being TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3/4 mutants (plus TCF7L2), which separates it from normal TGF-beta/activin, Hippo, mismatch-repair and RUNX3 confusables.

name: Lipoylation-dependent 2-oxoglutarate/2-oxoadipate dehydrogenase and glycine cleavage
rationale: Members are protein lipoylation and the lipoamide/DLD-dependent OGDH, OADH and glycine cleavage systems, distinct from confusables centred on PDH/BCKDH, the wider TCA cycle or GABA/lysine catabolism.

name: Lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase and glycine cleavage complexes
rationale: Members share protein lipoylation and the DLD-containing OGDH, OADH and glycine cleavage complexes, unlike neighbours on BCKDH/PDH, GABA metabolism or the wider TCA cycle.

name: Lipoylated 2-oxoglutarate/2-oxoadipate dehydrogenase and glycine cleavage complexes
rationale: Members are protein lipoylation and the lipoylated, DLD-sharing OGDH, OADH and glycine cleavage complexes, distinct from confusables centered on BCKDH/PDH, GABA/lysine metabolism or the wider TCA cycle.

name: Androgen and estrogen biosynthesis and metabolism
rationale: All members concern androgen and estrogen synthesis, regulation of testosterone production, androgen catabolism and aromatase (CYP19A1) deficiency; confusables are glucocorticoid/mineralocorticoid synthesis and adrenal CYP enzyme defects.

name: Androgen and estrogen biosynthesis and metabolism
rationale: All members concern androgen and estrogen synthesis or androgen catabolism, including aromatase excess, distinguishing them from glucocorticoid/mineralocorticoid synthesis and adrenal CYP defect confusables.

name: Androgen and estrogen biosynthesis and metabolism
rationale: Members are androgen and estrogen synthesis, testosterone regulation, androgen catabolism and aromatase (CYP19A1) deficiency; confusables are adrenal glucocorticoid/mineralocorticoid synthesis and their CYP defects.

core: cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation and survival with regenerative and hypertrophic growth
qualifier: cell-level cardiac muscle growth control, not chamber morphogenesis, fibroblast responses or skeletal myogenesis
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, survival and regenerative growth
rationale: Each member regulates how cardiac muscle cells and myoblasts proliferate, differentiate, resist apoptosis, hypertrophy under stress or regenerate tissue; the confusables are chamber and trabecular morphogenesis, cardiac fibroblast and fibrosis biology, skeletal muscle myogenesis, or sarcomere organization and cardiac adaptation terms absent here.

qualifier: regenerative and stress-induced growth of existing myocardium
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, survival and regenerative growth
rationale: Members are the bidirectional controls on cardiac muscle cell number, survival and hypertrophic or regenerative growth, distinct from cardiac fibroblast and fibrosis, chamber morphogenesis, sarcomere adaptation and skeletal myogenesis confusables.

qualifier: proliferation, survival, stress hypertrophy and regeneration
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, hypertrophy and regeneration
rationale: All members regulate cardiac muscle cell proliferation, differentiation, growth, apoptosis, stress hypertrophy or regeneration, distinguishing them from cardiac fibroblast, heart morphogenesis and skeletal myogenesis confusables.

core: Innate sensing of bacterial cell-wall lipids
name: TLR2/TLR4 sensing of bacterial lipopolysaccharide and lipopeptides
rationale: Members concern detection of LPS (LBP-CD14 transfer), diacyl lipopeptides and lipoteichoic acid via TLR4/TLR2, which separates it from NOD/peptidoglycan sensing and broader monocyte inflammatory confusables.

name: TLR2/TLR4 sensing of bacterial lipopolysaccharide and lipopeptides
rationale: Members cover detection of LPS (LBP-CD14 transfer), lipoteichoic acid and diacyl lipopeptides through TLR4 and TLR2 signaling, distinguishing it from NOD/peptidoglycan sensing and generic myeloid inflammatory modules.

core: Innate recognition of bacterial cell-wall lipids
qualifier: TLR2/TLR4 sensing of LPS, lipopeptides and lipoteichoic acid
name: TLR2/TLR4 detection of bacterial lipopolysaccharide and lipopeptides
rationale: Members concern detection of LPS, diacyl lipopeptide and lipoteichoic acid via CD14/TLR2/TLR4 with resulting inflammatory leukocyte chemotaxis; confusables cover NOD-like peptidoglycan sensing or generic myeloid TLR modules.

name: Psychostimulant response and reward-conditioned behavior
rationale: Members are cocaine, amphetamine and alkaloid responses, DARPP-32 signaling, conditioned place preference and operant conditioning; confusables cover dopamine receptor signaling, neuropeptide/opioid signaling or social and ethanol behaviors.

name: Addictive drug responses and reward-based conditioning
rationale: Members are cellular and behavioral responses to cocaine, amphetamine and opiate-type alkaloids, DARPP-32 signaling and operant/place-preference learning, whereas confusables cover dopamine receptor signaling, neuropeptides or other innate behaviors.

name: Drug-of-abuse response and reward conditioning
rationale: Members are cocaine, amphetamine and isoquinoline alkaloid responses, conditioned place preference, operant conditioning and DARPP-32; neighbours are dopamine receptor signaling, opioid neuropeptides or general behaviours.

qualifier: regulation of TLR7, TLR8 and TLR9
name: Regulation of endosomal TLR7, TLR8 and TLR9 signaling
rationale: Every member concerns signaling or regulation of the endosomal nucleic-acid-sensing TLR7/8/9 receptors (including SLC15A4-TASL-IRF5 and TLR8-BAFF), whereas the confusables centre on cytosolic sensors and type I interferon production.

core: Endosomal TLR7, TLR8 and TLR9 signaling
qualifier: regulation of receptor signaling rather than interferon output
name: Endosomal TLR7, TLR8 and TLR9 signaling regulation
rationale: Every member concerns signaling or regulation of the endosomal nucleic-acid sensing TLR7/8/9 receptors (including SLC15A4:TASL-IRF5 and TLR8-BAFF), whereas confusables centre on type I interferon production, RIG-I/MDA5 or cGAS-STING.

name: Endosomal TLR7, TLR8 and TLR9 signaling
rationale: Every member concerns signaling by the endosomal nucleic-acid-sensing TLR7/8/9 (including SLC15A4:TASL-IRF5 activation), while confusables are cytosolic RIG-I/cGAS-STING type I interferon pathways.

name: Inositol phosphate and plasma membrane/Golgi phosphoinositide synthesis
rationale: Members cover PIP synthesis at plasma membrane and Golgi plus cytosolic inositol phosphate metabolism; confusables involve ER/endosomal PIPs, lipid transfer or Golgi traffic.

qualifier: plasma membrane and Golgi PIPs with cytosolic inositol phosphates
name: Plasma membrane/Golgi phosphoinositide and inositol phosphate metabolism
rationale: Members describe PIP synthesis at the plasma membrane and Golgi and cytosolic IP3/IP4 to inositol interconversion, whereas confusables cover ER/endosomal PIP synthesis and lipid transfer.

name: Inositol phosphate and plasma membrane/Golgi phosphoinositide synthesis
rationale: Members are inositol phosphate metabolism and PIP synthesis at the plasma membrane and Golgi, distinguishing it from confusables on ER or endosomal PIP synthesis and Golgi membrane traffic.

name: Melanin pigment synthesis and pigment granule localization
rationale: All members concern melanin production (MITF-M pigmentation genes, melanin biosynthesis, SLC24A5 albinism, secondary-metabolite regulation) or pigment granule positioning, unlike confusables centred on UV/melanocyte proliferation, melanosome biogenesis, lysosomal acidification or non-pigment MITF-M targets.

qualifier: melanin synthesis and pigment granule localization
name: Melanin pigment synthesis and granule localization
rationale: All members concern melanin production, its MITF-driven and metabolic regulation, its albinism defect, or pigment granule positioning, unlike confusables centred on melanosome assembly, lysosomal acidification, other MITF programmes or UV-driven melanocyte proliferation.

name: Melanin biosynthesis and pigment granule localization
rationale: All members concern making melanin (melanin synthesis, MITF-M pigmentation genes, OCA6, secondary-metabolite regulation) or positioning pigment granules, unlike confusables centred on melanosome assembly, other MITF-M programs, organelle acidification or UV/melanocyte proliferation.

name: Keratan sulfate synthesis, degradation and inherited defects
rationale: All members concern keratan sulfate biosynthesis, degradation and disorders of its enzymes, distinguishing it from other glycosaminoglycan and dystroglycan glycosylation confusables.

name: Keratan sulfate metabolism and its inherited defects
rationale: All members concern keratan sulfate biosynthesis, degradation or defective enzymes of its synthesis, distinguishing them from chondroitin, dermatan and heparan sulfate and dystroglycan glycosylation confusables.

name: Keratan sulfate proteoglycan metabolism and its inherited defects
rationale: All members concern keratan sulfate biosynthesis, degradation or defects in its galactosyl-, sialyl- and sulfotransferases, distinguishing the theme from dystroglycan O-mannosylation, chondroitin/dermatan/heparan sulfate synthesis and mucopolysaccharidosis confusables.

core: TAK1 complex activation in toll-like receptor signaling
name: TRAF6-mediated TAK1 activation downstream of toll-like receptors
rationale: Members describe TRAF6-, IRAK2- and TRIF-dependent TAK1/IKK activation within TLR signaling, distinct from TRIF-mediated cell death, IRAK1-IKK recruitment and JNK confusables.

qualifier: TAK1 complex activation via TRAF6, IRAK2 and TRIF
name: TLR-induced TAK1 complex activation via TRAF6, IRAK2 and TRIF
rationale: Members are TLR adaptor steps activating the TAK1 (and IKK) complex through TRAF6, IRAK2 and TRIF, unlike confusables on TLR regulation, TRIF-mediated cell death or IRAK1-IKK recruitment.

name: Toll-like receptor TRAF6/TRIF-driven TAK1 complex activation
rationale: Members describe TLR-induced TAK1 (and RIP1-IKK) activation via TRAF6, IRAK2 and TRIF, unlike confusables on JNK cascades, IRAK1-IKK/NF-kB regulation or TLR3/4-induced cell death and cytokines.

qualifier: visceral organ asymmetry via ciliary flow
name: Left-right axis specification and visceral organ asymmetry
rationale: All members concern establishing left/right asymmetry, including liver, pancreas and gut laterality and cilium-driven flow, which the endoderm, lateral mesoderm and motile-cilium assembly confusables lack.

name: Left-right axis specification and visceral organ asymmetry
rationale: All members concern establishing left-right asymmetry, including nodal cilium movement and liver, pancreas and gut laterality, unlike gastrulation, mesoderm or motile cilium assembly confusables.

name: Left-right axis specification and visceral organ asymmetry
rationale: All members concern establishing left/right asymmetry, including liver, pancreas and gut laterality, distinct from germ-layer or motile cilium assembly confusables.

name: Estrogen and progesterone receptor transcriptional signaling
rationale: Members concern estrogen/estradiol responses, estrogen receptor-dependent transcription and progesterone receptor signaling, distinguishing the theme from androgen receptor and mammary development neighbours.

name: Estrogen and progesterone receptor signaling
rationale: Members are estrogen/estradiol responses, estrogen-dependent transcription and progesterone receptor signaling (with TFAP2 growth-factor regulation), whereas the confusables center on androgen receptor or mammary development.

name: Estrogen and progesterone receptor signaling
rationale: Members describe cellular responses to estrogen/estradiol, estrogen-dependent gene expression and progesterone receptor signaling, distinguishing the theme from androgen-receptor and mammary-development confusables.

name: Apoptotic nuclear dismantling and DNA fragmentation
rationale: Members concern execution-phase DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation and nuclear lamina breakdown, unlike confusables on mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilisation and apoptosome activation.

name: Apoptotic nuclear dismantling and DNA fragmentation
rationale: Members concern execution-phase DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation and lamina breakdown, unlike the mitochondrial/apoptosome initiation confusables.

name: Apoptotic execution: nuclear lamina breakdown and DNA fragmentation
rationale: Members describe late apoptotic nuclear events (lamina breakdown, chromatin condensation, DNA fragmentation) and their regulation, unlike confusables centred on mitochondrial BCL-2 family activation and apoptosome caspase activation.

qualifier: aminoacylation and wobble modification for fidelity
name: tRNA aminoacylation and wobble modification for decoding fidelity
rationale: Members cover cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation and wobble-position modifications supporting translational fidelity, distinct from confusables on mitochondrial translation, tRNA methylation and mitochondrial RNA processing.

name: tRNA aminoacylation and wobble modification for translational fidelity
rationale: Members are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging and wobble-base tRNA modifications, unlike neighbours on mitochondrial RNA processing, translation and tRNA methylation.

qualifier: cytosolic and mitochondrial, with wobble modification
name: tRNA aminoacylation and wobble modification for translational fidelity
rationale: Members are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging and wobble-position tRNA modifications supporting decoding fidelity, while confusables concern mitochondrial translation, RNA processing or tRNA methylation/pseudouridylation.

core: RNA polymerase II pausing and elongation
name: Cellular RNA polymerase II pausing and elongation
rationale: All members concern RNA Pol II promoter clearance, promoter-proximal pausing and elongation complex formation in host genes, distinguishing them from HIV/Tat elongation and transcription-initiation confusables.

core: RNA polymerase II promoter clearance and elongation
name: Cellular RNA polymerase II promoter clearance, pausing and elongation
rationale: Members cover Pol II pre-transcription events, promoter clearance, pausing and elongation complex formation on host genes, whereas confusables are HIV/Tat-specific elongation or initiation and promoter opening.

qualifier: promoter clearance, pausing and elongation entry
name: RNA polymerase II promoter clearance, pausing and elongation entry
rationale: All members concern the cellular Pol II transition from promoter clearance through pausing to elongation-complex formation; confusables cover initiation/promoter escape or HIV-specific elongation.

core: Plasma membrane solute and ion transporters
name: Plasma membrane SLC solute and ion transporters
rationale: Members are broad transcriptional modules of plasma-membrane SLC and ion transporters, whereas confusables are specific organic ion, amino acid, urate and hexose transport processes.

name: Plasma membrane SLC transporter co-expression signatures
rationale: All members are co-expression modules enriched for plasma membrane SLC and ion transporters, whereas confusables are specific transport reactions for amino acids, urate or organic ions.

qualifier: co-expressed gene modules rather than specific transport reactions
name: Plasma membrane SLC transporter co-expression modules
rationale: All members are transcriptional modules enriched for plasma-membrane SLC and ion transporters, whereas confusables are specific organic cation, urate or amino acid transport processes.

name: Hox gene cluster expression
rationale: All six members are Hox cluster gene-expression sets, with no neural plate, somitogenesis or RUNX1 programmes found in the confusables.

name: Hox gene cluster co-expression
rationale: All six members are Hox gene cluster expression modules, distinct from confusables on hindbrain HOX activation, neural plate, somitogenesis or RUNX1 transcription.

name: Hox gene clusters
rationale: All six members are Hox cluster gene sets, unlike confusables on somitogenesis, hindbrain patterning or RUNX1 transcription.

name: NGF-TRKA signaling through PLC-gamma1, STAT3 and retrograde transport
rationale: All members describe NGF activation of TRKA and its PLC-gamma1, STAT3 and retrograde signaling branches, while confusables cover NTRK3, p75NTR, or TRKA ERK5/PI3K/CREB branches.

name: NGF-TRKA signaling via PLC-gamma1, STAT3 and retrograde transport
rationale: All members describe NGF activation of TRKA and its PLC-gamma1, STAT3 and retrograde signaling arms, distinguishing it from confusables covering FRS2/ARMS, ERK5, CREB, p75NTR or NTRK3 branches.

name: NGF–TRKA signaling via PLC-gamma1, STAT3 and retrograde transport
rationale: All members are NGF/TRKA signaling outputs, specifically PLC-gamma1, STAT3 and retrograde signaling; confusables hold other NGF branches (FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, CREB, p75NTR) or NTRK3.

name: Nitric oxide synthase activity and NO-cGMP signal transduction
rationale: All members concern NO synthase regulation and NO-mediated cGMP signal transduction, lacking the smooth muscle contraction and blood pressure outputs of the confusables.

name: Nitric oxide synthase regulation and NO-cGMP signal transduction
rationale: All members are NO synthase regulation or NO/NO-cGMP signal transduction, whereas confusables concern vascular smooth muscle contraction and blood pressure outcomes.

name: Nitric oxide synthase regulation and NO-cGMP signaling
rationale: All members concern nitric oxide synthase activity and NO-cGMP signal transduction, whereas confusables are about vascular smooth muscle tone and blood pressure outputs.

name: Cellular osmotic response and epithelial sodium-chloride transport
rationale: Members concern osmosensing, hypo- and hyperosmotic responses and transepithelial chloride and renal sodium transport, while confusables centre on cation-chloride cotransporter diseases, potassium handling or aldosterone/salt responses.

qualifier: with renal and transepithelial salt transport
name: Osmotic stress sensing and transepithelial salt transport
rationale: Members combine osmosensory signalling, hypo- and hyperosmotic responses and renal sodium/transepithelial chloride transport, whereas confusables focus on specific cation-chloride cotransporters, potassium channels or sodium transporter regulation.

qualifier: renal sodium and transepithelial chloride transport
name: Osmotic stress response and renal sodium-chloride transport
rationale: Members are hypo/hyperosmotic and osmosensory responses plus renal sodium and transepithelial chloride transport, while confusables centre on potassium handling, SLC12/SLC9 disorders or aldosterone/salt responses.

name: Glucose-activated ChREBP metabolic gene transcription
rationale: Members describe transcriptional responses to glucose/carbon source, including PP2A dephosphorylation and activation of ChREBP; this glucose-activation arm separates it from adipogenesis, LXR/SREBP and PKA/AMPK inhibitory confusables.

name: Glucose-induced transcription via ChREBP activation
rationale: All members concern glucose-driven transcriptional activation through ChREBP (including its PP2A dephosphorylation), unlike confusables on AMPK/PKA inhibition of ChREBP, lipogenic nuclear receptors and adipogenesis.

name: Glucose-sensing ChREBP transcriptional activation
rationale: All members describe transcriptional activation by glucose/carbon source via ChREBP and PP2A dephosphorylation, distinct from lipid nuclear receptor (C1-C3) and PKA/AMPK inhibitory (C4) confusables.

name: mTORC1 regulation by amino acids and energy status
rationale: All members concern mTORC1 activation and its control by amino acids and LKB1-AMPK energy sensing, whereas confusables are amino acid transport or p53 metabolic targets.

name: Nutrient and energy regulation of mTORC1 signaling
rationale: All members concern mTORC1 activation by amino acids and its LKB1-AMPK energy control, unlike confusables on amino-acid transport or mTORC1/p53 metabolic outputs.

qualifier: amino acid and LKB1-AMPK energy sensing
name: Amino acid and energy sensing upstream of mTORC1
rationale: All four members concern activation of mTORC1 signaling and its control by amino acids and LKB1-AMPK energy status, unlike confusables on amino acid and peptide transporters or mTORC1/p53 metabolic gene programs.

name: Hippo signaling and cell density sensing
rationale: Members are Hippo pathway signaling and its regulation plus detection of cell density, while confusables are adherens junction, apical polarity and EMT terms.

name: Hippo signaling and cell density sensing
rationale: Members are Hippo pathway signaling and its positive/negative regulation plus detection of cell density, whereas confusables are adherens-junction and EMT themes.

name: Hippo signaling and cell density sensing
rationale: All members are Hippo pathway signaling and its regulation plus detection of cell density, distinct from the adherens junction and polarity confusables.
