rationale: Members cover CD3/ZAP-70 proximal TCR events, CD28 costimulatory branches and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition, unlike downstream TCR/IL-2 or B cell receptor neighbours.

qualifier: CDKN2A p16INK4A and p14ARF loss of function
name: Senescence evasion via CDKN2A p16INK4A and p14ARF loss
rationale: Members describe disease variants where defective p16INK4A-CDK4/6 binding, p14ARF loss or TP53 tetramerization loss lets cells escape oncogene/oxidative-stress senescence or apoptosis, unlike confusables on RB1 mutants, normal TP53 regulation or senescence itself.

core: cancer evasion of senescence and apoptosis
name: Cancer senescence evasion via CDKN2A or TP53 loss
rationale: All members are cancer-associated defects in p16INK4A, p14ARF or TP53 that allow escape from oncogene- or oxidative-stress-induced senescence or apoptosis, unlike confusables describing normal senescence, TP53 regulation or RB1/CDK4/6 G1/S control.

qualifier: p16INK4A, p14ARF and TP53 defects evading senescence
name: Cancer evasion of senescence via CDKN2A and TP53 loss
rationale: All members describe cancer-associated p16INK4A, p14ARF or TP53 defects that let cells escape oncogene- or oxidative stress-induced senescence and apoptosis, whereas confusables cover normal senescence, TP53 regulation or RB1 defects.

name: Responses to pesticides, dioxin and endocrine-disrupting chemicals
rationale: Members are cellular responses to xenobiotic environmental chemicals (insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, TCDD, bisphenol A, genistein) with aryl hydrocarbon receptor signalling, unlike confusables about xenobiotic metabolism, metal ions or vitamins.

qualifier: pesticides, dioxin and endocrine-active compounds, AhR signaling
name: Response to pesticides, dioxins and endocrine-disrupting xenobiotics
rationale: Members are cellular responses to herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, TCDD, bisphenol A and genistein plus AhR signaling, distinguishing the theme from xenobiotic-metabolism, metal-ion and vitamin neighbours.

qualifier: pesticides, dioxin and endocrine disruptors via aryl hydrocarbon receptor
name: Responses to pesticides, dioxin and endocrine-disrupting organic chemicals
rationale: Members are responses to fungicides, herbicides, insecticides, TCDD, bisphenol A and genistein plus AhR signalling, distinct from neighbours on xenobiotic enzymatic metabolism, vitamins or heavy-metal ions.

name: Nuclear pore complex turnover and inositol phosphate transport
rationale: Members are NPC assembly, disassembly, reformation and TPR plus inositol phosphate shuttling through the pore, distinguishing it from protein/RNA nucleocytoplasmic transport and nuclear envelope reformation confusables.

name: Nuclear pore complex dynamics and inositol phosphate nucleocytoplasmic transport
rationale: Members cover NPC assembly, disassembly and postmitotic reformation plus inositol phosphate transport through the pore, which the nuclear-envelope and protein/RNA-export confusables lack.

name: Nuclear pore complex turnover and inositol phosphate transport
rationale: Members cover nuclear pore complex assembly, mitotic disassembly and reformation, and nucleocytoplasmic transport of inositol phosphates, which confusables on nuclear envelope, protein/RNA export or Rev transport lack.

qualifier: segment patterning and comma/S-shaped body morphogenesis
name: Nephron patterning and comma/S-shaped body morphogenesis
rationale: Members share nephron proximal-distal patterning and comma- and S-shaped body to tubule morphogenesis, distinct from confusables on nephric duct, metanephric mesenchyme/MET, renal vesicle or ureter development.

name: Nephron patterning and comma/S-shaped body morphogenesis
rationale: Members are nephron proximal-distal patterning and comma- and S-shaped body and tubule morphogenesis, unlike confusables on nephric duct, mesenchymal-epithelial transition, renal vesicle or ureteric bud formation.

qualifier: proximal-distal patterning and comma/S-shaped body morphogenesis
name: Nephron proximal-distal patterning and S-shaped body morphogenesis
rationale: Members share nephron patterning and tubule morphogenesis through comma- and S-shaped body stages, unlike confusables on intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct, renal vesicle/MET or ureteric bud development.

qualifier: potassium channels and inherited SLC12 disorders
name: Cation-chloride cotransporters, potassium channels and inherited defects
rationale: Members are SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters, their Bartter/Gitelman/ACCPN defects, potassium channels and anion homeostasis, distinct from sodium-transport regulation, osmosensing, magnesium paracellular and SLC26 anion-exchange confusables.

name: SLC12 cation-chloride cotransport and potassium channel defects
rationale: Members concern SLC12 cation-coupled chloride cotransporters, their Gitelman/Bartter/ACCPN defects and potassium channels, distinct from magnesium paracellular, renal sodium regulation and SLC26 anion-exchange confusables.

qualifier: SLC12 family, potassium channels and inherited defects
name: Cation-chloride cotransporters, potassium channels and inherited defects
rationale: Members are SLC12 cation-coupled chloride cotransporters with their Bartter, Gitelman and ACCPN defects, potassium channels and anion homeostasis, distinct from renal sodium/osmotic regulation, paracellular magnesium and SLC26 anion-exchange neighbours.

name: Neutral amino acid plasma membrane transport
rationale: All members are transmembrane transport of neutral amino acids (glutamine, leucine, isoleucine, phenylalanine, alanine), unlike peptide, cationic amino acid or organic ion transport confusables.

qualifier: neutral amino acids across the plasma membrane
name: Neutral amino acid transport across the plasma membrane
rationale: All members are transport of neutral amino acids (glutamine, leucine, isoleucine, alanine, phenylalanine), unlike cationic amino acid, oligopeptide and organic cation/xenobiotic transport confusables.

name: Neutral amino acid transmembrane transport
rationale: All members transport neutral amino acids (leucine, isoleucine, phenylalanine, alanine, glutamine), unlike cationic amino acid, peptide or organic cation/xenobiotic transport confusables.

name: Endothelial eNOS trafficking and VEGFR2-driven vascular permeability
rationale: All three members concern endothelial eNOS localization and VEGFR2-eNOS permeability signalling, unlike confusables on NO-cGMP signalling or vascular smooth muscle tone.

name: Endothelial eNOS trafficking and vascular permeability
rationale: Members concern NOSTRIN/NOSIP-mediated eNOS trafficking and VEGFR2-driven permeability in endothelium, whereas confusables cover NO-cGMP signaling and vascular smooth muscle tone.

name: Endothelial eNOS trafficking and VEGFR2-driven permeability
rationale: All three members concern endothelial eNOS localization (NOSIP, NOSTRIN) and VEGFR2-mediated permeability; confusables cover NO-cGMP signaling or vascular smooth muscle tone.

name: Regulation of synaptic neurotransmitter release and reuptake
rationale: All three members regulate how much neurotransmitter is released or cleared at synapses; confusables are specific catecholamine transporters or synaptic vesicle cycle machinery.

qualifier: reduced release, enhanced uptake, spontaneous transmission
name: Limiting synaptic neurotransmitter availability and spontaneous release
rationale: The three members reduce neurotransmitter secretion, enhance its uptake or tune spontaneous transmission, distinct from confusables on synaptic vesicle cycling or catecholamine-specific transporters.

core: Presynaptic neurotransmitter release and reuptake regulation
name: Regulation of neurotransmitter release, reuptake and spontaneous transmission
rationale: All three members modulate synaptic neurotransmitter availability (secretion, uptake, spontaneous release), unlike confusables on catecholamine transporters or synaptic vesicle recycling.

name: Immediate-early genes induced by growth factors and TNF
rationale: The three gene sets share the immediate-early transcriptional program (NR4A, FOS/JUN, EGR, growth arrest genes) induced by growth factors and TNF, distinct from UV-response, senescence, MAPK-phosphatase and myeloid inflammation confusables.

name: Immediate-early gene induction by TNF and growth factors
rationale: All three gene sets capture rapid stimulus-induced immediate-early genes (NR4A, NF-kB targets, growth arrest genes), unlike confusables about MAPK feedback, UV response, senescence or myeloid inflammatory cytokines.

name: Immediate-early gene response to growth factors and TNF
rationale: The three gene-set members (TNF-via-NF-kB, growth-factor-induced NR4A, growth arrest) share the rapid immediate-early stress/growth-factor transcriptional program, unlike the myeloid cytokine, UV, MAPK-phosphatase feedback and senescence confusables.

name: Intestinal epithelial cell development and barrier structure maintenance
rationale: Members concern development and structural maintenance of the differentiated gut epithelium (adhesion, lineage factors), unlike confusables on antimicrobial defense or HNF4-driven absorptive brush-border programmes.

name: Intestinal epithelial barrier development and maintenance
rationale: All members concern development and structural maintenance of the intestinal epithelial sheet, whereas confusables cover antimicrobial defense and HNF4-driven absorptive enterocyte programs.

name: Intestinal epithelial differentiation and structural maintenance
rationale: All members describe intestinal epithelial cell development and maintenance, while confusables emphasise antimicrobial defense or HNF-driven absorptive epithelium identity.

name: Phospholipase C-gamma signaling downstream of FGF receptors
rationale: All three members are PLC-mediated cascades from FGFR1, FGFR3 and FGFR4; neighbours hold the FRS, SHC, PI3K and ligand-binding branches of FGFR signalling.

name: FGF receptor phospholipase C signaling cascade
rationale: All three members are the PLC-mediated cascade downstream of FGFR1, FGFR3 and FGFR4; unlike FRS-, SHC- and PI3K-branch neighbours, it is the PLC branch.

name: Phospholipase C-gamma cascade downstream of FGF receptors
rationale: All three members are the PLC-gamma branch of FGFR1/3/4 signaling, distinguishing it from confusables built on PI3K, SHC and FRS2 branches or ligand binding.

name: Bidirectional regulation of apoptotic mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization
rationale: All members positively or negatively regulate apoptotic MOMP and cytochrome c release, while confusables name BH3-only, BAX/BAK, apoptosome or oxidative-stress triggers.

core: Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization in apoptosis
name: Bidirectional regulation of mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization in apoptosis
rationale: All three members regulate MOMP and cytochrome c release in both directions, whereas neighbours describe oxidative-stress apoptosis, BH3-only activation, BAX/BAK oligomerization or apoptosome events.

name: Regulation of mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization in apoptosis
rationale: All members positively or negatively regulate apoptotic MOMP and cytochrome c release, whereas neighbours describe specific BCL-2 family, apoptosome or oxidative stress events.

qualifier: downstream of mitochondrial apoptotic factor release
name: Apoptosome-mediated caspase activation after mitochondrial factor release
rationale: All three members cover cytochrome c/apoptotic factor release and apoptosome-driven caspase activation, whereas the confusables cover the upstream BCL-2 family/BH3-only control of outer membrane permeabilization.

name: Apoptosome-mediated caspase activation after mitochondrial factor release
rationale: All members cover release of apoptotic factors from mitochondria and apoptosome-driven caspase activation, whereas the confusables cover the upstream BCL-2/BH3-only control of outer membrane permeabilization.

core: Mitochondrial apoptosis downstream of cytochrome c release
name: Apoptosome-mediated caspase activation after mitochondrial factor release
rationale: All members cover the post-release step of intrinsic apoptosis (apoptotic factor release, apoptosome regulation and caspase cleavage), whereas the confusables cover upstream BCL-2 family, BH3-only and MOMP control.

qualifier: generic, not tied to a specific amino acid
name: Generic L-amino acid metabolism and catabolism
rationale: All three members are obsolete umbrella terms for alpha/L-amino acid metabolism and catabolism, distinguished from confusables only by lacking any specific amino acid such as phenylalanine, tyrosine, proline or glycine.

qualifier: generic L-alpha-amino acid metabolism and catabolism
name: General L-alpha-amino acid metabolism and catabolism
rationale: All three (obsolete) members are generic alpha/L-amino acid metabolic and catabolic terms, broader than the specific tyrosine, phenylalanine and proline/glycine confusables.

name: General L-alpha-amino acid metabolism and catabolism
rationale: All three members are generic (obsolete) L-/alpha-amino acid metabolic and catabolic terms, unlike confusables naming specific amino acids such as tyrosine, phenylalanine or proline.

qualifier: adrenal and gonadal steroidogenic enzymes and their defects
name: Adrenal and gonadal steroidogenesis and its enzyme defects
rationale: Members span corticosteroid, androgen, estrogen and progestin synthesis, its regulation and steroidogenic CYP enzyme deficiencies, while confusables concern vitamin D/retinoid CYPs or glucocorticoid secretion and response.

qualifier: adrenal and gonadal, with its regulation
name: Adrenal and gonadal steroidogenesis and its regulation
rationale: Members cover synthesis and control of pregnenolone, gluco-/mineralocorticoids, androgens and estrogens and their CYP enzyme defects, unlike confusables about vitamin D/retinoid metabolism or cortisol secretion and response.

qualifier: adrenal and gonadal steroidogenic CYP pathways
name: Adrenal and gonadal steroid hormone biosynthesis
rationale: Members are corticosteroid, androgen, estrogen and progestin synthesis and its regulation, including steroidogenic CYP enzyme defects, distinguishing them from vitamin A/D/K metabolic CYPs and from cortisol secretion/response confusables.

qualifier: definitive endoderm and early gut morphogenesis
name: Gastrulation, definitive endoderm formation and early gut morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover primitive streak, EMT and germ layer formation, endoderm specification and foregut/hindgut morphogenesis with pluripotency factors, distinguishing it from cardiac mesoderm and pancreatic lineage confusables.

qualifier: endoderm specification and primitive gut morphogenesis
name: Gastrulation, endoderm specification and primitive gut morphogenesis
rationale: Members span primitive streak, gastrulation EMT and mesoderm migration, pluripotency factor control, definitive endoderm specification and fore/hindgut morphogenesis; the endoderm/gut component separates it from cardiac mesoderm and pancreatic lineage confusables.

qualifier: endoderm and early gut tube morphogenesis
name: Gastrulation, germ layer formation and early gut morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover primitive streak, EMT and cell migration at gastrulation, mesendoderm/endoderm specification, lateral mesoderm and foregut/hindgut morphogenesis; confusables are pancreatic lineage or cardiac mesoderm programmes.

qualifier: beta-common (IL-3, IL-5) and gamma-chain (IL-2, IL-7, IL-9) receptors
name: Beta-common and gamma-chain cytokine receptor signalling
rationale: Members are IL-3/IL-5 (beta-common) and IL-2/IL-7/IL-9 (gamma-chain) signalling plus G-CSF signal termination, distinguishing it from IL-2/STAT5 hallmark, IL-15/IL-21 NK and FLT3/STAT5 confusables.

name: IL-2/7/9 and IL-3/5 family cytokine receptor signaling
rationale: All members are class I cytokine receptor signalling for IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-3, IL-5 (and G-CSF inactivation); confusables add IL-15/IL-21, FLT3 or T cell IL-2-STAT5 members and lack the IL-3/IL-5 arm.

name: IL-3, IL-5, IL-7 and IL-9 hematopoietic cytokine signalling
rationale: All members are class I cytokine receptor signalling (IL-2/3/5/7/9, G-CSF shutoff); the IL-3/IL-5/IL-9 and G-CSF members separate it from confusables focused on IL-2-STAT5 T cell, FLT3-STAT5 or IL-15/IL-21 NK signalling.

name: Mitochondrial protease protein processing and uniporter calcium regulation
rationale: Members are mitochondrial presequence processing and protein catabolism plus SMDT1/MCU calcium uptake regulation, unlike confusables on protein import, cristae formation or respiratory chain assembly.

name: Mitochondrial protein processing, degradation and calcium uptake regulation
rationale: Members are mitochondrial peptidase processing and protein degradation including SMDT1 processing that tunes mitochondrial calcium import, distinct from confusables on protein import, cristae formation and respiratory chain assembly.

qualifier: SMDT1 processing and mitochondrial calcium uptake
name: Mitochondrial presequence processing, protein degradation and calcium uptake
rationale: Members share mitochondrial protein processing/proteolysis, including SMDT1 maturation tied to mitochondrial calcium import; confusables cover protein import, cristae formation or respiratory chain assembly.

name: Mucin-type O-glycosylation and sialylated LacNAc chain extension
rationale: Members cover GALNT/C1GALT1C1-dependent O-GalNAc glycosylation, LacNAc antenna elongation and sialic acid capping, distinct from fucose/blood-group and early N-glycan processing confusables.

name: Mucin-type O-glycosylation and terminal glycan elongation
rationale: Members cover GalNAc-initiated O-glycan synthesis and its defects plus antenna elongation, poly-LacNAc and sialylation, unlike fucosylation/blood group and N-glycan trimming confusables.

name: Mucin-type O-glycosylation and sialylated glycan elongation
rationale: Members cover GALNT/C1GALT1C1-initiated mucin-type O-glycan synthesis and its disorders plus antenna/poly-LacNAc elongation and sialic acid capping, whereas confusables are fucosylation/blood-group antigens and N-glycan core trimming.

name: TRKA signalling through FRS2/ARMS to CREB transcription
rationale: Members are NGF/TRKA adaptor (FRS2, ARMS) activation feeding ERK5 and p38 to CREB-driven transcription, unlike TRKA PLC-gamma/STAT3 or NTRK2/NTRK3 neighbours.

qualifier: FRS2/ARMS adaptors to MAPKs and CREB
name: TRKA signalling via FRS2/ARMS to MAPKs and CREB transcription
rationale: Members are TRKA downstream events through FRS2 and ARMS to ERK5, p38 and CREB-driven transcription; neighbours cover TRKB/TRKC signalling and TRKA activation via PLC-gamma and STAT3.

qualifier: adaptor-mediated MAPK and CREB transcription arm
name: NGF–TRKA adaptor signalling to ERK5, p38 and CREB
rationale: Members describe TRKA signalling via FRS2/ARMS adaptors to ERK5, p38 and CREB-driven transcription, unlike neighbours on TRKB/TRKC signalling or TRKA activation, PLC-gamma, STAT3 and retrograde signalling.

qualifier: very long-chain and essential polyunsaturated (linoleic/alpha-linolenic) fatty acids
name: Elongation of very long-chain and essential polyunsaturated fatty acids
rationale: All members concern biosynthetic elongation of saturated very long-chain acyl-CoAs or linoleic/alpha-linolenic acid metabolism, whereas confusables centre on peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation or ether lipid and wax synthesis.

qualifier: essential linoleic and alpha-linolenic acid metabolism
name: Fatty acid elongation and essential fatty acid metabolism
rationale: All members concern chain elongation of saturated, long- and very-long-chain fatty acids or metabolism of the essential omega-6/omega-3 fatty acids, which the peroxisomal oxidation and ether-lipid confusables lack.

core: Long- and very-long-chain fatty acid elongation
qualifier: including essential omega-3/omega-6 fatty acid metabolism
name: Very-long-chain fatty acid elongation and essential PUFA metabolism
rationale: All members concern elongation/synthesis of long and very-long-chain fatty acyl chains, including linoleic and alpha-linolenic acid metabolism, which distinguishes the theme from ether-lipid/wax (C1) and peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation neighbours (C2-C4).

qualifier: Golgi mannose trimming and antenna elongation
name: Golgi N-glycan trimming and antenna elongation
rationale: All members describe Golgi processing of N-glycans from Man5 trimming through hybrid/complex synthesis, antenna elongation, poly-LacNAc and sialylation, distinguishing it from O-glycan confusables and from early ER N-glycan processing.

qualifier: Golgi trimming to complex and hybrid glycans with antenna elongation and sialylation
name: Golgi N-glycan maturation to complex and hybrid glycans
rationale: All members are Golgi steps of N-glycan maturation (mannose trimming, complex/hybrid branching, LacNAc elongation, sialylation), distinct from early ER N-glycan processing and O-glycan confusables.

qualifier: Golgi hybrid/complex maturation and antenna elongation
name: Golgi N-glycan maturation and antenna elongation
rationale: All members describe Golgi trimming of Man9 to Man5, hybrid/complex branch reactions and antenna extension (poly-LacNAc, sialylation), distinguishing it from O-glycan confusables and from early ER N-glycan processing.

name: Sodium import regulation in aldosterone and renin-angiotensin control
rationale: Members regulate cellular sodium (and coupled proton) transport in aldosterone and renal renin-angiotensin contexts, whereas confusables emphasise calcium/potassium transport or angiotensin-driven blood pressure and volume.

name: Aldosterone response and negative regulation of sodium import
rationale: Members concern aldosterone response and restraint of sodium import/transport in the kidney, unlike confusables centred on calcium/potassium transport, positive sodium transport, or angiotensin and blood-pressure control.

name: Aldosterone-responsive renal sodium import regulation
rationale: Members concern control of plasma-membrane sodium import (with associated pH effects) in response to aldosterone and renal renin-angiotensin signals, whereas confusables emphasize angiotensin pressor signaling, potassium transport or calcium channel regulation.

name: Receptor tyrosine kinase autophosphorylation and ERK1/2 activation
rationale: Members share receptor tyrosine autophosphorylation feeding downstream ERK1/2 signaling, distinct from confusables on PDGFR regulation, PI3K/AKT and FGFR PI3K/PLC cascades.

name: Receptor tyrosine kinase autophosphorylation and ERK1/2 activation
rationale: Members share receptor tyrosine autophosphorylation, downstream signal transduction and ERK1/2 cascade activation, distinguishing the theme from PDGF-receptor regulation, PI3K/AKT and FGFR PLC/PI3K confusables.

name: Receptor tyrosine kinase autophosphorylation and ERK activation
rationale: Members cover tyrosine autophosphorylation, downstream signal transduction and positive regulation of the ERK1/2 cascade, whereas confusables are defined by PI3K/AKT, FGFR PLC cascades or PDGF receptor regulation.

qualifier: platelet degranulation with inhibition of fibrinolysis
name: Platelet degranulation and inhibition of fibrinolysis
rationale: Members combine platelet activation/degranulation with negative regulation of fibrinolysis and plasminogen activation, whereas confusables cover coagulation cascade, platelet receptor signaling or integrin/matrix adhesion.

qualifier: inhibition of fibrinolysis and plasminogen activation
name: Platelet activation and antifibrinolytic control of plasminogen activation
rationale: Members combine platelet activation/degranulation with negative regulation of fibrinolysis and plasminogen activation, which separates the theme from coagulation-cascade, platelet-aggregation and ECM confusables.

name: Platelet activation with inhibition of fibrinolysis
rationale: Members combine platelet activation/degranulation with negative regulation of plasminogen activation and fibrinolysis (clot stabilisation); confusables cover platelet activation, coagulation cascade or matrix adhesion without the antifibrinolytic arm.

qualifier: transferrin cycle and endosomal iron export
name: Transferrin-mediated iron uptake and endosomal recycling
rationale: Members describe the transferrin endocytic cycle and DMT1 (SLC11A2)-dependent iron release, distinct from confusables on general iron homeostasis, heme scavenging or copper/manganese transport.

name: Transferrin-mediated iron uptake and endosomal recycling
rationale: All three members concern the transferrin cycle and endosomal iron export via SLC11A2, whereas confusables cover heme scavenging, plasma-membrane iron import, copper/manganese handling or systemic iron homeostasis.

qualifier: receptor endocytosis, recycling and endosomal iron export
name: Transferrin-mediated iron uptake and recycling
rationale: The three members describe transferrin endocytosis/recycling and the endosomal DMT1 iron transport step it feeds, setting the theme apart from confusables on plasma-membrane iron import, heme scavenging and copper/manganese handling.

core: Dendritic cell-driven CD4 T cell activation
name: Myeloid dendritic cell activation and CD4 T cell stimulation
rationale: All members describe activation at the dendritic cell-CD4 T cell interface (DC activation, MHC contact, CD4 proliferation), whereas confusables emphasise negative regulation, Treg differentiation or surface signatures.

qualifier: positive regulation of CD4 T cell activation by myeloid dendritic cells
name: Dendritic cell-driven CD4 T cell activation and proliferation
rationale: The three members link myeloid dendritic cell activation, TCR-MHC contact on antigen-presenting cells and CD4 alpha-beta T cell proliferation, the positive side of APC-T cell interaction, whereas confusables describe negative regulation of T cells, regulatory T cell differentiation or surface signatures.

name: Dendritic cell antigen presentation driving CD4 T cell proliferation
rationale: Members link myeloid dendritic cell activation and TCR-MHC contact to positive regulation of CD4 alpha-beta T cell proliferation, whereas confusables are negative regulation of T cell responses, Treg differentiation or cell-surface signatures.

name: Cardiomyocyte ion homeostasis and excitation-contraction coupling
rationale: Members concern cardiac membrane potential, ion homeostasis and calcium-release control of contraction, distinct from conduction-system, Na/Ca exchanger and contractile-force confusables.

qualifier: membrane potential and sarcoplasmic calcium release
name: Cardiomyocyte membrane potential and sarcoplasmic calcium release
rationale: The three members concern ion homeostasis setting cardiac membrane potential and calcium-release-driven contraction, distinguishing the theme from conduction, inotropy/heart rate, NCX and SA-node pacemaker neighbours.

name: Cardiomyocyte ion homeostasis, membrane potential and calcium release
rationale: Members concern ion homeostasis, cardiac muscle membrane potential and sarcoplasmic calcium release in contraction, distinct from contractile force, conduction and SA node neighbours.

name: CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding of nascent actin and tubulin
rationale: All members describe CCT/TRiC binding and folding of newly synthesised proteins, notably actin and tubulin, distinguishing it from aggrephagy, general refolding and ER folding confusables.

qualifier: CCT/TRiC folding of actin and tubulin
name: CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding of nascent actin and tubulin
rationale: All three members are CCT/TRiC chaperonin binding and folding of newly made proteins (actin, tubulin), distinct from generic or ER folding and from aggrephagy confusables.

qualifier: CCT/TRiC folding of actin and tubulin
name: CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding of actin and tubulin
rationale: All three members are CCT/TRiC chaperonin actions on nascent actin, tubulin and other targets, distinct from aggrephagy and general/ER folding confusables.

name: Deoxyribonucleoside monophosphate and deoxyribonucleoside breakdown
rationale: Members concern turnover of dCMP, dGMP and 2'-deoxyribonucleosides, unlike confusables on dNTP biosynthesis/salvage or ribonucleotide and nucleobase catabolism.

name: Deoxyribonucleotide and deoxyribonucleoside catabolism
rationale: Members concern breakdown of deoxyribonucleotides (dCMP, dGMP) and deoxyribonucleosides across purines and pyrimidines, unlike confusables limited to purine or pyrimidine metabolism or ribonucleotide catabolism.

name: Deoxyribonucleotide and deoxyribonucleoside breakdown
rationale: Members are catabolism/turnover of deoxyribonucleosides and deoxynucleoside monophosphates, unlike confusables on deoxynucleotide biosynthesis/salvage or ribonucleotide purine and pyrimidine catabolism.

qualifier: arrest and recovery of paused polymerase
name: HIV-1 RNA polymerase II pausing and elongation recovery
rationale: All three members describe arrest and recovery of paused Pol II on the HIV template, while confusables cover elongation complex formation or generic Pol II initiation and elongation.

name: Pausing and arrest recovery of HIV transcription elongation
rationale: All three members describe pausing or arrest and recovery of HIV elongation (with or without Tat), whereas confusables cover elongation complex formation, initiation or generic Pol II elongation.

name: HIV-1 elongation arrest, pausing and recovery
rationale: All three members describe arrest/pausing and recovery of HIV elongating Pol II (with or without Tat), whereas confusables cover host Pol II initiation and elongation, capping, or formation of the HIV elongation complex.

qualifier: morphogenesis of chambers, valves, septa and outflow tract
name: Heart morphogenesis of chambers, valves, septa and outflow tract
rationale: Members cover broad cardiac morphogenesis including myocardium, valves, septa, outflow tract, conduction system and coronary vessels, unlike neighbours on electrical coupling, vascular endothelial development or cardiomyocyte proliferation/regeneration.

qualifier: chamber, valve, septum and outflow tract morphogenesis
name: Cardiac chamber, valve, septum and outflow tract morphogenesis
rationale: Members span the morphogenesis of heart chambers, valves, septa, endocardial cushions, outflow tract and conduction system, unlike endothelial/vasculogenesis, gap junction conduction or cardiomyocyte proliferation neighbours.

qualifier: chambers, septa, valves and cushions, outflow tract vessels and conduction system
name: Cardiac chamber, septum, valve and conduction system morphogenesis
rationale: The members span the structural build of the heart - ventricular and atrial myocardium, septation, valve and endocardial cushion formation with its EMT, outflow tract and great vessel morphogenesis, and conduction system development - whereas the confusables are endothelial/vasculogenic identity, electrical coupling, or postnatal cardiomyocyte proliferation and hypertrophy.

name: Urea cycle, its inborn errors and arginine-ornithine transport
rationale: All members cover ammonia detoxification through the urea cycle (enzymes, NAGS/CPS1/OTC/ASS1/ASL/ARG1 deficiencies, citrulline/arginine/ornithine metabolism) and cationic amino acid transport (SLC25A15, SLC7A7), distinct from the proline and glutamate/glutamine neighbours.

qualifier: including inborn errors of cycle enzymes and transporters
name: Urea cycle and arginine-ornithine metabolism, including inborn errors
rationale: All members cover urea cycle enzymes, their inherited deficiencies, arginine/ornithine/citrulline metabolism and transport and ammonium handling, whereas confusables centre on glutamate, glutamine, aspartate and proline metabolism.

qualifier: arginine, ornithine and citrulline metabolism and transport
name: Urea cycle and arginine-ornithine metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover urea cycle enzymes and their deficiencies, ammonium handling, and arginine/ornithine/citrulline/lysine synthesis and transport, whereas confusables centre on glutamate, glutamine, proline and aspartate metabolism.

qualifier: with glial activation and tau tangle regulation
name: Amyloid-beta production and clearance with glial activation control
rationale: Members centre on Alzheimer-associated amyloid-beta/APP formation, fibrillization and clearance together with regulation of microglial and astrocyte activation and neurofibrillary tangles, while confusables are microglial differentiation/cytotoxicity or lipoprotein signaling without amyloid processes.

core: Amyloid-beta and APP processing and clearance
name: Amyloid-beta and APP handling with glial activation control
rationale: Most members regulate amyloid-beta formation, fibrillization, clearance and APP metabolism together with astrocyte/microglial activation and tangle assembly, unlike confusables about microglial differentiation, cytotoxicity or lipoprotein signalling.

name: Amyloid-beta formation, clearance and glial activation regulation
rationale: Members centre on APP processing, amyloid fibril/tangle formation and amyloid-beta clearance together with microglial/astrocyte activation and glial survival, while confusables are microglial differentiation, cytotoxicity and lipoprotein responses without amyloid handling.

name: P450 epoxygenase/hydroxylase and 12-lipoxygenase fatty acid oxygenation
rationale: Members cover cytochrome P450 epoxygenase and omega-hydroxylase products (EET, HETE) and 12-lipoxygenase hepoxilins, unlike confusables centered on 5-lipoxygenase leukotrienes or unrelated CYP-defect diseases.

qualifier: 12-lipoxygenase/hepoxilin and cytochrome P450 epoxygenase and omega-hydroxylase routes
name: 12-lipoxygenase and cytochrome P450 oxygenation of polyunsaturated fatty acids
rationale: Members cover 12-LOX/hepoxilin, epoxygenase (EET) and omega-hydroxylase (HETE) metabolism of arachidonic/linoleic acid including epidermal-barrier defects, unlike confusables on 5/15-LOX leukotrienes or other CYP disorders.

name: Eicosanoid synthesis by P450 oxygenases and 12-lipoxygenase-hepoxilin route
rationale: Members concern oxygenation of arachidonic/linoleic acid to HETEs, EETs, 12-HETE derivatives and hepoxilins (including skin-barrier CYP4F22/SLC27A4 defects); C1/C4 lack the P450 epoxygenase/hydroxylase branch and C2/C3 are leukotriene-focused without 12-LOX/hepoxilins.

name: Heme biosynthesis and iron-sulfur cluster assembly

rationale: Members concern renin-angiotensin regulation of blood volume, renal sodium excretion and arterial pressure, plus angiotensinogen-to-angiotensin conversion and bradykinin/neuropeptide catabolism that the aldosterone, natriuretic and vasopressin confusables lack.

name: Renin-angiotensin blood pressure control and vasoactive peptide processing
rationale: Members describe angiotensin generation and signaling regulating blood pressure, blood volume and renal sodium excretion, plus bradykinin and neuropeptide catabolism; the angiotensin/peptide processing distinguishes it from vasopressin water handling, natriuretic cGMP and aldosterone confusables.

name: Renin-angiotensin peptide processing and blood pressure control
rationale: Members concern angiotensin generation and signalling, bradykinin/neuropeptide catabolism and renin-angiotensin control of blood pressure, volume and sodium excretion; confusables cover glomerular filtration, vasopressin water balance, natriuretic cGMP or aldosterone.

name: tRNA aminoacylation and anticodon modification for translational fidelity
rationale: Members are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging, translational fidelity and anticodon-loop (wobble, t6A) modifications; neighbours carry mitochondrial translation, wybutosine/diphthamide or methylation/pseudouridylation.

qualifier: t6A and wobble modification for fidelity
name: tRNA aminoacylation and anticodon modification for translational fidelity
rationale: Members are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation and t6A/wobble anticodon modifications supporting translational fidelity; unlike hydroxylation/wybutosine, tRNA methylation/processing and mitochondrial translation neighbours, it adds t6A modification and fidelity.

name: tRNA charging and anticodon modification for translational fidelity
rationale: Members are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation plus wobble/t6A anticodon modifications serving translational fidelity, which the wybutosine, pseudouridine/methylation and mitochondrial translation confusables lack.

qualifier: p53 death-gene transcription and PUMA/NOXA BH3-only activation
name: p53 death-gene transcription and PUMA/NOXA mitochondrial apoptosis
rationale: Members are p53 transcription of apoptotic genes plus PUMA/NOXA activation, BH3-only inhibition of BCL-2 and cytochrome c release; confusables cover BAX/BAK/BAD/BID activation and apoptosome steps or GO p53 regulation terms.

qualifier: PUMA/NOXA BH3-only inhibition of BCL-2, cytochrome c release
name: p53-driven apoptosis via PUMA/NOXA BH3-only proteins
rationale: Members link p53 transcription of death genes to PUMA/NOXA activation, BCL-2 inactivation and cytochrome c release, distinct from GO p53-regulation confusables and BAX/BAK/apoptosome execution confusables.

qualifier: p53 pro-apoptotic targets and BH3-only proteins
name: p53 pro-apoptotic targets and BH3-only cytochrome c release
rationale: Members are p53 transcription of death genes and PUMA/NOXA BH3-only inactivation of BCL-2 driving cytochrome c release, unlike BAX/BAK-apoptosome confusables and GO p53-class regulation confusables.

name: Endosome, phagosome and autophagosome fusion with lysosomes
rationale: All members concern delivery of endocytic, phagocytic or autophagic compartments into lysosomes by fusion (SARS-CoV-2 targets autophagosome-lysosome fusion), unlike confusables about autophagosome assembly, selective autophagy or Golgi-to-lysosome biogenesis.

qualifier: endosome, phagosome and autophagosome cargo routes
name: Lysosome fusion with endosomes, phagosomes and autophagosomes
rationale: All members concern late endocytic, phagocytic or autophagic compartments fusing with or delivering to the lysosome/vacuole, unlike confusables centred on autophagosome assembly regulation, selective autophagy or Golgi-to-lysosome biogenesis.

name: Endosome, phagosome and autophagosome fusion with lysosomes
rationale: All members describe delivery of endocytic, phagocytic or autophagic compartments into lysosomes by membrane fusion; unlike the autophagosome-assembly confusables it includes phagosome and endosomal fusion, and unlike the Golgi-lysosome confusable it is about fusion rather than vesicle biogenesis.

name: Ryanodine receptor control of ER calcium release
rationale: Members regulate release and sequestration of ER/SR calcium via ryanodine-sensitive channels including skeletal muscle contraction, unlike store-operated entry and cardiac contraction confusables.

core: Regulation of intracellular calcium store release
name: Regulation of ER/SR calcium store release and sequestration
rationale: Members regulate release of sequestered calcium (including ryanodine receptors) and ER calcium content; confusables cover store-operated entry or cardiac contraction and calcium extrusion.

core: Regulation of intracellular store calcium release
name: Ryanodine receptor control of sarco/endoplasmic reticulum calcium release
rationale: Members regulate release of sequestered calcium from ER/SR via ryanodine-sensitive channels including in skeletal muscle contraction, whereas confusables concern cardiac calcium handling or store-operated calcium entry.

name: Activin signaling and gonadotropin secretion
rationale: Members are activin pathway regulation (follistatin, TGFBR3) and promotion of FSH and LH secretion, whereas neighbours concern Sertoli/follicle biology or TGFBR3 roles in other ligands.

name: Activin signalling regulation and pituitary gonadotropin secretion
rationale: Members cover activin signalling and its modulation by follistatin and TGFBR3 plus positive regulation of FSH and LH secretion, separating it from TGFBR3-general, ovarian follicle and Sertoli cell confusables.

name: Activin signaling regulation and gonadotropin secretion
rationale: Members concern activin signalling and its modulation by follistatin and TGFBR3 together with FSH/LH release, unlike confusables about other TGFBR3 ligands or gonadal development.

name: FGFR1c–Klotho and PTH phosphate signaling in bone mineralization
rationale: Members are FGFR1c–Klotho (FGF23 receptor) activation and FGFR-MAPK signaling, responses to phosphate and parathyroid hormone, and positive bone mineralization, whereas confusables concern phosphate transporters and their diseases.

name: FGFR1c–Klotho and PTH phosphate signaling in bone mineralization
rationale: Members link FGFR1c–Klotho (FGF23) signaling, PTH and phosphate responses to positive regulation of bone mineralization, unlike confusables on phosphate transporters and tooth mineralization.

qualifier: phosphate and PTH response, bone mineralization
name: FGFR1c-Klotho signaling in phosphate and bone mineralization control
rationale: Members concern FGFR1c/Klotho signaling, responses to phosphate and PTH and promotion of bone mineralization; neighbours concern phosphate transporter defects and ectopic or dental mineralization.

qualifier: snRNA cap hypermethylation and nucleocytoplasmic transport
name: Spliceosomal snRNP biogenesis and nucleocytoplasmic snRNA transport
rationale: Members cover snRNA transport, cap hypermethylation, snRNP assembly and spliceosome function, which separates the theme from snRNA transcription/splicing-step and mRNA 3'-end processing or decay neighbours.

name: Spliceosomal snRNP biogenesis via snRNA export and cap hypermethylation
rationale: Members cover snRNA transport, cap hypermethylation and snRNP assembly feeding the spliceosome; neighbours cover snRNA transcription, splice-site recognition and mRNA 3'-end processing or decay.

name: Spliceosomal snRNP assembly, cap hypermethylation and transport
rationale: Members cover snRNP assembly, snRNA cap trimethylation and nuclear transport feeding the spliceosome, whereas neighbours concern snRNA transcription and splice-site recognition, mRNA decapping/decay or 3'-end processing.

name: Flippase-mediated aminophospholipid translocation and membrane trafficking
rationale: Members are aminophospholipid flipping and phospholipid transport regulation with ATP11B/TMEM30A flippase trafficking modules, unlike ABC floppase, scramblase and ER-Golgi lipid transfer confusables.

name: Aminophospholipid flippase translocation across membrane bilayers
rationale: Members are aminophospholipid translocation, its regulation and flippase-centred trafficking modules, unlike confusables on ER-Golgi lipid transfer, bile ABC transporters or calcium-activated scrambling.

name: P4-ATPase flippase translocation of aminophospholipids
rationale: Members concern aminophospholipid translocation and its regulation, with both modules centred on P4-ATPase/TMEM30A flippases, unlike ABC transporter, ER-Golgi lipid transfer and scramblase confusables.

name: UDP-sugar transport and UDP-glucuronate formation
rationale: Members cover formation of UDP-glucuronate and transport of UDP-sugars into secretory organelles, unlike confusables on UDP-GlcNAc synthesis, PAPS, SLC35 disease variants or N-glycan processing.

name: Nucleotide sugar transport and UDP-glucuronate formation
rationale: All three members provide activated UDP-sugars (UDP-GlcNAc transport, nucleotide sugar transport, UDP-glucuronate formation), unlike confusables on SLC35 disease, PAPS, N-glycan processing or UDP-GlcNAc biosynthesis.

name: Nucleotide sugar transport and UDP-glucuronate formation
rationale: All three members provide activated nucleotide sugars (UDP-GlcNAc and nucleotide sugar transport, UDP-glucuronate formation), unlike confusables on SLC35 transport defects, UDP-GlcNAc synthesis, N-glycan processing or PAPS.

name: Protein-DNA crosslink repair and replication-stress drug response
rationale: Members concern repair of covalent protein-DNA adducts and responses to camptothecin and hydroxyurea, distinct from neighbours on DNA topology, ADP-ribosylation, interstrand crosslinks and double-strand break repair.

name: Protein-DNA crosslink repair and replication-stress drug response
rationale: Members concern repair of covalent protein-DNA adducts and responses to camptothecin and hydroxyurea, distinct from confusables on double-strand break repair, Fanconi crosslink repair and DNA topology.

name: Responses to replication-blocking drugs and DNA-protein crosslinks
rationale: All three members concern repair of protein-DNA adducts such as trapped topoisomerase (camptothecin) and hydroxyurea-induced replication stress, distinct from ADP-ribosylation, Fanconi and double-strand break confusables.

name: Transcriptional response to UV radiation
rationale: All members are UV-B or UV-induced/repressed gene responses, while confusables concern UV-damage excision repair, NF-kB stress responses or oxidative stress.

qualifier: UV-induced gene expression rather than excision repair
name: UV-induced gene expression response
rationale: All three members are the cellular response to UV light (up- and down-regulated UV gene sets and UV-B response), lacking the nucleotide excision repair and pyrimidine-dimer repair that define the DNA-repair confusable.

name: Transcriptional and cellular response to UV irradiation
rationale: Members are UV-induced and UV-repressed gene programmes plus cellular response to UV-B, distinct from the confusable nucleotide-excision repair of UV damage and from TNF/NF-kB stress programmes.

name: Forebrain patterning and anterior pituitary development
rationale: All three members concern forebrain dorsoventral patterning/morphogenesis and adenohypophysis development, unlike confusables about hindbrain/neural plate, spinal cord, neuroblast division or cortical migration.

name: Forebrain dorsoventral patterning, morphogenesis and adenohypophysis development
rationale: All three members concern early forebrain/ventral diencephalic patterning and morphogenesis including the anterior pituitary, distinct from cortical migration, spinal cord patterning, neural plate and neuroblast division neighbours.

name: Forebrain dorsoventral patterning and adenohypophysis development
rationale: All three members concern early forebrain shaping (morphogenesis, D/V patterning, anterior pituitary), unlike confusables about cortical migration, neural plate/hindbrain, progenitor division or spinal cord patterning.

qualifier: with Golgi GDP-fucose/CMP-sialic acid transporter defects
name: GDP-fucose synthesis and Golgi GDP-fucose/CMP-sialic acid transport defects
rationale: Members are GDP-fucose biosynthesis and the SLC35C1/SLC35A1 transporter disorders; confusables cover other nucleotide sugars (UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-Gal) or downstream fucosylation and blood groups.

core: GDP-fucose and sugar-donor supply for Golgi glycosylation
name: GDP-fucose synthesis and fucose/sialic acid donor transporter CDGs
rationale: Members are GDP-fucose synthesis plus congenital glycosylation disorders of the Golgi GDP-fucose (SLC35C1) and CMP-sialic acid (SLC35A1) transporters, which the broader nucleotide-sugar confusables lack or dilute.

core: GDP-fucose and CMP-sialic acid supply for glycosylation
name: GDP-fucose synthesis and fucose/sialic acid nucleotide-sugar transport defects
rationale: Members are GDP-fucose biosynthesis plus CDGs from the Golgi GDP-fucose (SLC35C1) and CMP-sialic acid (SLC35A1) transporters, unlike confusables with other SLC35 defects or blood-group fucosylation.

qualifier: sodium-phosphate transport in bone and tooth
name: Sodium-phosphate transport and bone and tooth mineralization
rationale: Members cover Na+/Pi cotransport and its disorders, FGF-Klotho/PTH regulation and bone, dentin and enamel mineralization, distinct from vitamin D, bicarbonate/pH and odontogenesis neighbours.

name: Phosphate transport and homeostasis in bone and tooth mineralization
rationale: Members cover Na+/Pi cotransporters and their defects, FGF23-Klotho/PTH phosphate regulation and bone, enamel and dentin mineralization, unlike confusables on bicarbonate/anion transport, vitamin D or odontogenesis.

name: Phosphate homeostasis and bone, tooth and ectopic mineralization
rationale: Members cover Na+/Pi transporters and their disorders, PTH and Klotho-FGFR control of phosphate, and bone, enamel, dentin and ectopic mineralization; distinct from vitamin D, odontogenesis and bicarbonate/anion transport confusables.

name: Renal urate and cystine solute carrier transport
rationale: Members are SLC transporter and plasma-membrane transporter modules centred on urate (SLC22A12, SLC2A9) and cystine (SLC3A1/SLC7A9) handling, which separates the theme from neutral amino acid, hexose and organic cation transport confusables.

name: Renal epithelial urate and cystine transport
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane SLC carriers in kidney/liver epithelia, centred on urate (SLC2A9, SLC22A12) and cystine (SLC3A1, SLC7A9) transport and their reabsorption disorders, which distinguishes it from organic cation, hexose and neutral amino acid transport confusables.

name: Renal tubular urate and cystine transport
rationale: Members are SLC transporter modules and their diseases centred on urate (SLC22A12, SLC2A9) and cystine (SLC3A1, SLC7A9) handling, distinguishing it from organic cation, hexose and neutral amino acid transport neighbours.

qualifier: TRAF3/TRAF6 to IRF and NF-kB, and viral antagonism
name: RIG-I-like receptor signaling via TRAFs and viral antagonism
rationale: Members cover RLR signalling through TRAF3/TRAF6 and FADD/RIP1 to IRF7/NF-kB plus viral modulation by RSV and SARS-CoVs, unlike confusables on IRF3/TBK1 interferon induction or ISG effector responses.

qualifier: via TRAF3/TRAF6 and its viral antagonism
name: RIG-I-like receptor signaling via TRAF3/TRAF6 and viral antagonism
rationale: Members cover RLR signaling to IRF and NF-κB through TRAF3/TRAF6, its negative regulators and RSV/SARS-CoV modulation, whereas confusables address ISG effector responses, dsRNA sensing or TBK1-IRF3 and IFN production.

name: RIG-I-like receptor signalling via TRAF3/TRAF6 and viral evasion
rationale: Members describe RLR signalling to IRF and NF-kB through TRAF3/TRAF6 and its modulation by SARS-CoV and RSV, whereas confusables emphasise interferon production, ISG effectors or TBK1-IRF3 regulation.

name: Trans-synaptic adhesion organizing excitatory synapse assembly
rationale: Members are synaptic adhesion molecules (neurexins/neuroligins, SALMs, RPTPs) and pre/postsynaptic membrane assembly with PSD-95 and NMDA receptor clustering, unlike confusables involving inhibitory synapse and GABA receptor clustering.

name: Trans-synaptic adhesion-driven excitatory synapse membrane assembly
rationale: Members concern neurexin/neuroligin, SALM and receptor PTP adhesion organizing pre- and postsynaptic membranes with PSD-95 and NMDA receptor clustering, distinguishing them from inhibitory/GABA synapse and synaptic potential neighbours.

name: Trans-synaptic adhesion molecules driving excitatory synapse membrane assembly
rationale: Members are synaptic adhesion families and the pre/postsynaptic membrane assembly and NMDA/PSD-95 clustering they drive, distinct from neighbours on inhibitory synapse clustering and synaptic potential regulation.

qualifier: transcription and translation initiation to termination
name: Mitochondrial transcription and translation initiation, elongation, termination

rationale: Members are mitochondrial transcription and translation initiation, elongation, termination and ribosome quality control, distinct from neighbours on tRNA aminoacylation, mtDNA replication and mitochondrial RNA processing or ribosome assembly.

name: Mitochondrial transcription and translation initiation, elongation, termination
rationale: Members are the initiation, elongation and termination steps of mitochondrial transcription and translation plus ribosome quality control, whereas confusables cover mtDNA replication, RNA processing/modification, ribosome assembly or tRNA charging.

name: Inositol pyrophosphate and nuclear phosphoinositide metabolism
rationale: Members are cytosolic inositol pyrophosphate synthesis, diphosphoinositol and diadenosine polyphosphate hydrolysis and nuclear IP/PIP synthesis, unlike PTEN/AKT, ER-lumen IP and nucleotide interconversion neighbours.

core: Inositol pyrophosphate and nuclear phosphoinositide metabolism
name: Inositol pyrophosphate, nuclear phosphoinositide and polyphosphate hydrolysis
rationale: Members cover diphosphoinositol and diadenosine polyphosphate turnover, pyrophosphate hydrolysis and nuclear PIP/IP synthesis, distinguishing it from PTEN/AKT, nucleotide interconversion and inositol transport confusables.

qualifier: with nuclear phosphoinositides and polyphosphate hydrolysis
name: Inositol pyrophosphate and nuclear phosphoinositide turnover
rationale: Members cover cytosolic inositol pyrophosphate synthesis, diphosphoinositol and diadenosine polyphosphate hydrolysis, and nuclear IP/PIP synthesis with PI5P-TP53 signaling, unlike confusables on nucleotide interconversion, ER-lumen IP synthesis or PTEN/AKT signaling.

core: Class I cytokine receptor JAK-STAT signaling
qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptors
name: Growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptor JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: All members are growth hormone, prolactin or leptin receptor signalling, distinguishing it from body-growth/IGF, thyroid hormone, GPCR growth-hormone-secretion and erythropoietin/thrombopoietin confusables.

qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptors
name: Growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptor JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: All members are growth hormone, prolactin or leptin receptor signaling via JAK-STAT, distinct from erythropoietin/thrombopoietin, thyroid hormone and somatic growth regulation neighbours.

core: Class I cytokine receptor JAK-STAT signalling
name: Growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptor JAK-STAT signalling
rationale: All members are GH, prolactin or leptin receptor signalling, distinguished from thyroid/growth regulation (C1-C3) and erythropoietin/thrombopoietin (C4) neighbours by prolactin and leptin.

qualifier: Rac GTPases, WAVE/WASP and Arp2/3 lamellipodia
name: Rac GTPase signaling to Arp2/3-driven lamellipodium formation
rationale: Members are RAC1/2/3 GTPase cycles and their activation of WASP/WAVE, Arp2/3 nucleation and lamellipodium assembly, distinguishing them from CDC42/RHOG GTPase confusables and from actin-motility confusables lacking the Rac cycles.

name: RAC GTPase activation of WAVE-Arp2/3 lamellipodium formation
rationale: Members are the RAC1/2/3 GTPase cycles and their WASP/WAVE-Arp2/3 output driving lamellipodia, distinct from CDC42/RHOG cycles and broader motility/ruffle regulation in confusables.

name: Alditol and glycerol metabolism with fructose biosynthesis
rationale: Members concern polyol (alditol) and glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate metabolism and fructose formation, unlike confusables on fructose catabolism disorders, pentoses, glycerolipid synthesis or the pentose phosphate shunt.

name: Glycerol and alditol metabolism with fructose synthesis
rationale: Members are glycerol, glycerol-3-phosphate and alditol metabolism plus fructose biosynthesis, distinguishing it from pentose phosphate, fructose catabolism and acylglycerol synthesis confusables.

name: Alditol and glycerol metabolism with polyol-pathway fructose synthesis
rationale: Members are alditol, glycerol and glycerol-3-phosphate metabolism plus fructose biosynthesis, unlike confusables on fructose catabolism, pentoses or acylglycerol synthesis.

qualifier: KIT, FLT3, PDGFR, ALK, FGFR and inhibitor resistance
name: Oncogenic KIT/FLT3/PDGFR/ALK/FGFR mutants and kinase-inhibitor resistance
rationale: All members are cancer mutants, fusions or amplifications of KIT, FLT3, PDGFR, ALK/LTK and FGFR and their TKI binding or resistance, separating it from ERBB2/EGFR mutants and normal FLT3/EPO signaling neighbours.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase mutants and inhibitor resistance
qualifier: KIT, PDGFR, FLT3, ALK and FGFR
name: Oncogenic KIT/PDGFR/FLT3/ALK/FGFR mutants and kinase inhibitor resistance
rationale: Members describe signalling by mutant, fused or amplified KIT, PDGFR, FLT3, ALK, LTK and FGFR kinases and their TKI binding and resistance, distinct from normal FLT3/EPO/STAT5 cytokine signalling and ERBB2/EGFR cancer variant confusables.

qualifier: KIT, FLT3, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR with inhibitor resistance
name: Oncogenic KIT/FLT3/PDGFR/ALK/FGFR mutants and kinase inhibitor resistance
rationale: Members are cancer mutants, fusions and amplifications of KIT, FLT3, PDGFR, ALK/LTK and FGFR and their TKI binding or resistance, distinguishing them from ERBB2 mutant and normal EPO/FLT3 signalling confusables.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism

qualifier: de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism
name: Pyrimidine nucleotide and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, salvage and catabolism
rationale: Members cover pyrimidine de novo synthesis, salvage and breakdown plus deoxyribonucleotide synthesis and turnover, distinguishing it from confusables centred on purine ribonucleotide synthesis, purine deoxynucleoside defects or NDP/NTP interconversion.

name: Pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, salvage and catabolism
rationale: Members span de novo synthesis, salvage and breakdown of pyrimidine nucleotides plus deoxyribonucleotide (including dAMP/dGMP) metabolism, separating the theme from confusables on nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion, purine ribonucleotide synthesis and purine deoxynucleoside catabolism.

qualifier: efflux, reverse transport and foam cell restraint
name: Cholesterol efflux, reverse transport and foam cell restraint
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, reverse cholesterol transport, uptake and storage with LXR control and foam-cell restraint, unlike confusables on SREBP-driven synthesis or HDL/LDL particle assembly and remodelling.

qualifier: regulation of efflux and reverse cholesterol transport
name: Regulation of cellular cholesterol efflux and reverse cholesterol transport
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, reverse transport, storage, foam cell formation and biosynthesis, distinguishing it from SREBP-driven synthesis, HDL assembly/ABCA1 and lipoprotein remodelling themes.

core: Cholesterol efflux and reverse cholesterol transport
qualifier: LXR-regulated, limiting storage and foam cell formation
name: Regulation of cholesterol efflux, storage and reverse transport
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, storage, reverse transport and sterol homeostasis (including LXR targets and foam cell inhibition), while confusables centre on HDL particle assembly/remodeling or SREBP-driven biosynthesis.

name: Bile acid synthesis from cholesterol and enterohepatic recycling
rationale: Members cover cholesterol-to-bile acid synthesis routes, bile acid transport, recycling and nuclear-receptor signalling, distinguishing it from intestinal lipid absorption, ABC transporter defects and peroxisomal oxidation confusables.

qualifier: synthesis from cholesterol, recycling and signalling
name: Bile acid synthesis from cholesterol, enterohepatic recycling and signalling
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis routes from cholesterol, CTX defect, LXR-regulated homeostasis, transport, recycling and signalling, distinct from confusables on ABC transporter defects, intestinal absorption and vitamin E/oxysterol disorders.

qualifier: synthesis from cholesterol, enterohepatic recycling and receptor signalling
name: Bile acid synthesis, enterohepatic recycling and signalling
rationale: All members concern bile acid synthesis from cholesterol (7alpha/24/27-hydroxylation routes, CYP8B1, CYP27A1 defect), bile acid transport and recycling, and LXR/bile acid signalling, distinguished from confusables on peroxisomal oxidation, ABC-transporter cholestasis and intestinal lipid absorption, and CYP spastic paraplegias.

core: Fucose metabolism and fucosylated glycan synthesis
qualifier: blood-group antigens and sulfated selectin ligands
name: Fucose metabolism for blood-group antigens and selectin ligands

qualifier: blood-group antigens and sulfated selectin ligands
name: Fucosylated blood-group glycans and sulfated selectin ligands
rationale: Members share GDP-fucose metabolism, ABO/Lewis antigen synthesis and tyrosine sulfation supporting selectin-mediated leukocyte rolling and stem cell homing, unlike the nucleotide-sugar transporter and O/N-glycan confusables.

qualifier: blood-group antigens and tyrosine-sulfated selectin ligands
name: Fucosylated blood-group glycans and sulfated selectin ligands
rationale: Members concern GDP-fucose supply, ABO/Lewis fucosylated oligosaccharides and protein tyrosine sulfation that together build selectin ligands for leukocyte rolling and stem-cell homing, unlike the CDG nucleotide-sugar transporter and O/N-glycan elongation neighbours.

qualifier: axial mesoderm, notochord and floor plate

qualifier: notochord and floor plate in neural patterning
name: Notochord-floor plate midline formation in early neural patterning

qualifier: notochord, floor plate and neural plate
name: Notochord, floor plate and early neural plate development
rationale: Members concern axial mesoderm/notochord, ventral midline floor plate and neural fold/plate patterning, distinct from confusables on left-right asymmetry, neural plate border or spinal cord neuron specification.

name: Rho activation by G alpha 12/13 receptors and Sema4D-plexin-B

name: Rho activation by Galpha12/13 GPCRs and Sema4D-plexin-B
rationale: Members concern Rho activation via G12/13-coupled receptors and Sema4D/RND1 plexin-B signaling, unlike Sema3A axon-repulsion neighbours.

rationale: Members converge on RhoA activation through G12/13-coupled GPCRs and Sema4D/plexin-B (with RND1), while confusables are Sema3A/plexin-A axon repulsion or other Rho-family cycles.

rationale: Members cover nuclear membrane disassembly, lamina depolymerization and envelope reassembly with protein/pore localization to the envelope, unlike confusables on NPC assembly, nucleocytoplasmic transport or ESCRT-III sealing and abscission.

name: Mitotic nuclear envelope and lamina disassembly and reformation

qualifier: nuclear lamina depolymerization and envelope reformation
name: Mitotic nuclear envelope and lamina disassembly and reformation
rationale: Members cover mitotic nuclear membrane disassembly, lamina depolymerization, envelope reassembly and protein/pore localization to the envelope, distinguished from ESCRT-III sealing, abscission and nuclear pore complex assembly/transport confusables.

rationale: Members are EMT, collagen/TGF-beta, ECM and mechanoresponsive fibroblast modules with focal adhesion assembly, whereas confusables emphasize fibronectin/integrin interactions, migration or resident stromal fibroblast signatures without the EMT program.

name: AP-1 immediate-early transcriptional response
rationale: Members are AP-1 activation and network, immediate-early growth-factor-induced and TNF-NFkB-induced gene programs, distinct from UV/p38, JNK kinase activation and ARE-mediated mRNA decay confusables.

name: AP-1 and NR4A immediate-early gene response
rationale: Members are immediate-early stimulus-induced transcription programmes (AP-1 activation and network, NR4A growth-factor-induced module, TNF-NF-kB targets, growth arrest genes), distinct from confusables on ARE-mediated mRNA decay, UV/PI3K responses and upstream JNK/p38 kinase activation.

name: AP-1 immediate-early gene transcriptional response
rationale: Members are AP-1 activation and network, NR4A-enriched growth-factor-induced genes and TNF/NF-kB-induced early response, distinguished from confusables on PI3K/UV/p38 signalling, upstream JNK/TAK1 kinases or mRNA decay.

qualifier: laminin, anchoring fibril and collagen trimerization
name: Basement membrane laminin and anchoring fibril assembly
rationale: Members are laminin and integrin interactions, collagen trimerization, anchoring fibril formation and basement membrane regulation; the laminin/anchoring fibril focus distinguishes it from the fibronectin, elastic fibre and collagen crosslinking neighbours.

qualifier: laminin, collagen trimer and anchoring fibril
name: Basement membrane laminin, collagen and anchoring fibril organization
rationale: Members concern basement membrane construction via laminin and integrin interactions, collagen trimerization and anchoring fibrils, unlike fibrillar/elastic ECM, collagen crosslinking or VWF confusables.

qualifier: laminin-integrin interactions and anchoring fibril collagen
name: Basement membrane laminin-integrin interactions and anchoring fibrils

core: Viral life cycle in the host cell
qualifier: attachment, entry, protein maturation and assembly
name: Viral attachment, entry, protein maturation and virion assembly
rationale: Members cover entry, protein processing and assembly of coronaviruses, dengue, influenza, RSV and HIV, distinguishing them from host antiviral restriction and SARS-CoV-1 PDZ-targeting neighbours.

core: Viral life cycle in host cells
qualifier: attachment, entry, protein maturation and virion assembly
name: Viral attachment, entry, protein maturation and virion assembly
rationale: Members are entry, protein processing, assembly and release steps of SARS-CoV, dengue, RSV, influenza and HIV, versus host restriction and PDZ-targeting confusables.

core: Viral replication cycle in host cells
qualifier: attachment, entry, protein maturation and assembly
name: Viral attachment, entry, protein maturation and assembly
rationale: Members span receptor-mediated entry, viral protein maturation and virion assembly for coronaviruses, dengue, influenza, RSV and HIV, whereas confusables lack entry or maturation steps or concern host restriction of viruses.

name: Cobalamin uptake, transport, metabolism and inherited defects
rationale: Every member concerns vitamin B12: dietary uptake, plasma transport, intracellular processing to cofactors (propionyl-CoA catabolism) and the gene defects causing B12 disorders; confusables are folate/methionine or other B-vitamin metabolism.

name: Cobalamin absorption, transport and metabolism with inherited defects
rationale: Every member is vitamin B12 uptake, transport, intracellular processing or a monogenic cobalamin disorder, unlike confusables covering other B vitamins (C1) or folate/methionine metabolism (C2-C4).

name: Cobalamin uptake, transport, metabolism and inherited deficiency disorders
rationale: All members concern vitamin B12 absorption, transport, intracellular processing and their genetic defects, distinguishing it from thiamin/riboflavin and folate-methionine confusables.

qualifier: Rho and CDC42 subfamilies with formin and IQGAP effectors
name: Rho and CDC42 subfamily GTPase cycles and effectors
rationale: Members are RHOA-D, CDC42, RHOJ/U/V, RHOG and RAC3 GTPase cycles and formin/IQGAP activation, distinguishing it from RND and RAC1/2-WAVE confusables.

qualifier: RHO- and CDC42-subfamily GTPases with formin and IQGAP effectors
name: RHO- and CDC42-family GTPase cycles via formins and IQGAPs
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles of RHOA-D, CDC42, RHOJ/U/V, RHOG and RAC3 with formin and IQGAP effectors and focal adhesion disassembly, unlike RAC1/RAC2-WAVE lamellipodia or RND neighbours.

name: Rho GTPase cycles with formin and IQGAP effectors

qualifier: alpha-2 Gi/Gz-coupled inhibition of adenylate cyclase
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic inhibition of adenylate cyclase
rationale: All members are adrenoceptor responses to adrenaline and noradrenaline that act by inhibiting adenylate cyclase through Gi/Gz and so damp insulin and catecholamine secretion, unlike confusables covering cAMP/PKA generally or beta-adrenergic cardiac and vascular output.

qualifier: Gi/Gz coupling that lowers adenylyl cyclase and restrains catecholamine release
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz suppression of cyclase and catecholamine release
rationale: Every member is alpha-2/Gz adrenergic signalling that inhibits adenylyl cyclase and damps epinephrine, norepinephrine or insulin secretion, whereas the confusables cover generic cAMP/PKA handling, cardiac stimulation and vascular tone.

core: inhibitory adrenergic receptor signalling that suppresses adenylate cyclase
qualifier: alpha-2 autoreceptor restraint of catecholamine and insulin release
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic inhibition of adenylate cyclase and catecholamine release
rationale: All members are alpha-2/Gi-Gz adrenergic signalling events that lower cAMP and damp epinephrine, norepinephrine or insulin secretion, which separates them from confusables covering general cAMP/PKA second-messenger machinery or the cardiac and vascular effector responses to catecholamines.

qualifier: with DREAM/p107-p130 repression of cell cycle genes
name: G2/M transition with DREAM-repressed cell cycle gene expression
rationale: Members cover cyclin B/CDK1, PLK and G2/M checkpoint events plus DREAM/RBL1-RBL2 control of E2F targets, unlike G1/S E2F programs (C1, C2, C4) or p53-driven G2 arrest (C3).

name: G2/M transition control with DREAM-mediated cell-cycle gene repression
rationale: Members cover G2 phase, cyclin B-CDK1, PLK and G2/M checkpoint events plus DREAM/p107-p130 repression of E2F targets, which C1 (p53 G2 arrest) lacks and which separates it from E2F G1/S confusables.

name: G2/M transition and DREAM-repressed cell-cycle gene transcription
rationale: Members cover G2 phase, cyclin B/CDK1 and PLK events, the G2/M checkpoint and DREAM/p107/p130 control of E2F targets, unlike G1/S E2F activation or TP53-driven arrest neighbours.

name: Left-right asymmetry determination via nodal signalling

name: Left-right asymmetry of visceral organs via Nodal signalling

name: Left-right asymmetry determination by Nodal signaling
rationale: Members cover left-right axis specification in organs and lateral mesoderm with nodal cilium movement and Nodal signaling regulation, distinguishing it from motile-cilia, gastrulation and ligand-sequestration confusables.

name: Mast cell degranulation via FcεRI calcium mobilization
rationale: Members concern mast cell activation, degranulation, histamine release and type I hypersensitivity driven by FcεRI/LAT2 calcium signaling, while confusables cover FcεRI MAPK/NF-kB branches or eosinophil/Th2 immunity.

name: Mast cell activation, degranulation and FcεRI calcium mobilization
rationale: All members concern mast cell differentiation, activation, degranulation and histamine release in type I hypersensitivity, and FcεRI calcium mobilization separates it from FcεRI MAPK/NF-kB and eosinophil/Th2 neighbours.

name: Mast cell degranulation and FcεRI calcium mobilization
rationale: All members concern mast cell differentiation, activation, histamine release and FcεRI/LAT2 calcium mobilization in type I hypersensitivity, distinct from FcεRI MAPK/NF-kB cytokine and Th2/eosinophil confusables.

name: Glucagon-PKA signaling and regulation of gluconeogenesis

name: Glucagon-PKA signaling and gluconeogenesis control

qualifier: commissural and retinal ganglion cell axons

qualifier: commissural and retinal ganglion cell axons, SLIT-ROBO repulsion

name: ER tubular network shaping, membrane fusion and positioning

qualifier: Sema4D and RND1 in cell migration

name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta formation and clearance
rationale: Members concern microglial differentiation, activation and cytotoxicity together with APP/amyloid-beta production, fibril formation and clearance and tau tangles, while confusables centre on apoptotic cell engulfment, DAP12 or oxidised-LDL signalling.

name: Mitotic kinase signaling in spindle assembly and checkpoint

qualifier: PLK1 and Aurora A-driven mitotic entry
name: PLK1/Aurora A-driven mitotic entry and spindle checkpoint

qualifier: RAS GTPase regulation by GEFs and GAPs
name: RAS GTPase regulation and RAF activation
rationale: Members span SOS/GAP control of RAS, RAS/GAP disease mutants and RAF activation, differing from neighbours on ERK feedback inactivation and BRAF/RAF1 oncogenic mutants.

qualifier: myocyte depolarization and gap-junction electrical coupling
name: Cardiac depolarization and gap-junction electrical coupling in conduction

qualifier: depolarization and gap junction electrical coupling

rationale: Members cover phase 0 depolarization and gap-junction electrical coupling propagating the impulse through AV node, His-Purkinje and atrial/ventricular myocytes, unlike confusables centred on SA node HCN pacemaking, repolarization phases or conduction system development.

name: Axo-dendritic microtubule transport of mitochondria and vesicles

qualifier: in neurons: mitochondria, dense-core and synaptic vesicles
name: Neuronal microtubule transport of mitochondria and synaptic cargo

qualifier: neuronal cargo: mitochondria, dense core and synaptic vesicles

qualifier: CDC42 subfamily and RHOD with formin and IQGAP effectors
name: CDC42-subfamily and RHOD GTPase cycles via formins, IQGAPs

qualifier: CDC42 subfamily and RHOD with formin and IQGAP effectors, no RND

qualifier: CDC42-related GTPases with formin and IQGAP effectors
name: CDC42-related Rho GTPase cycles and formin/IQGAP effectors

name: eNOS-derived nitric oxide signaling via cGMP

name: eNOS-derived nitric oxide synthesis and NO-cGMP signaling
rationale: All members concern NO production by NOS and its cGMP signalling, whereas confusables cover downstream smooth muscle/blood pressure physiology, eNOS trafficking or renal guanylyl cyclase signalling.

name: Nitric oxide synthase activation and NO-cGMP signaling
rationale: All members concern NOS activation, NO production and NO-cGMP signaling, whereas confusables cover downstream vascular smooth muscle tone, blood pressure, renal effects or eNOS trafficking.

qualifier: restraint of meiosis I phase transitions
name: Meiotic checkpoint control of meiosis I phase transitions
rationale: All members regulate (mostly negatively) meiotic phase transitions, G2/MI entry and chromosome separation, whereas confusables concern chiasma, cohesion, chromosome alignment and oocyte spindle mechanics.

name: Checkpoint control of meiotic cell cycle phase transitions
rationale: All members regulate progression through meiosis (G2/MI entry, metaphase/anaphase transition, checkpoint signaling, restraint of nuclear division and chromosome separation), whereas confusables cover the mechanics of meiotic cohesion, chiasma, spindle and chromosome segregation.

qualifier: checkpoint restraint of meiotic phase transitions
name: Meiotic checkpoints restraining meiotic phase transitions
rationale: All members regulate (mostly negatively) meiotic progression - G2/MI, metaphase/anaphase, chromosome separation and nuclear division via checkpoint signalling - whereas neighbours concern chiasma, cohesion, chromosome alignment and female meiotic spindles.

name: Microtubule organelle transport and endosome/lysosome size regulation
rationale: Members concern plus-end microtubule transport and distribution of mitochondria, synaptic vesicles and organelles plus endosome/lysosome size control, separating it from the neuronal cargo, tubulin-modification and lysosome-fusion confusables.

name: Microtubule organelle transport, mitochondrial distribution and endolysosome size
rationale: Members concern plus-end-directed microtubule transport of mitochondria and vesicles and endosome/lysosome size control, distinguishing it from neuronal cargo, tubulin-modification and lysosome-fusion confusables.

name: Plus-end organelle and mitochondrial transport with endolysosome size control
rationale: Members share microtubule-directed positioning of organelles, notably mitochondria and synaptic vesicles, plus endosome/lysosome size control, unlike the dense-core-vesicle, autophagy-fusion and tubulin-modification confusables.

core: Centriole and primary cilium cycle regulation
qualifier: basal body anchoring, cilium assembly/disassembly and centriole duplication
name: Centriole duplication and primary cilium assembly-disassembly regulation
rationale: Members regulate centriole elongation, centrosome duplication, basal body docking and cilium assembly or disassembly, unlike confusables on intraflagellar transport, mitotic spindle centrosomes or MTOC anchoring.

qualifier: basal body docking and cilium disassembly
name: Centriole and primary cilium assembly/disassembly regulation
rationale: Members regulate centriole duplication/elongation, basal body anchoring and primary cilium assembly and disassembly, unlike confusables on mitotic spindle/centrosome, intraflagellar transport or MTOC anchoring.

name: Centriole and basal body control of cilium assembly and disassembly
rationale: Members link centrosome/centriole duplication and basal body docking to cilium assembly and disassembly, unlike confusables on intraflagellar transport, MTOC organization or mitotic spindles.

name: MHC class I antigen presentation and HIV Nef/Vpu immune evasion

name: MHC class I antigen presentation and its subversion by HIV
rationale: Members are class I processing, loading and cross-presentation plus Nef/Vpu downregulation of MHC I, CD4, CD8 and CD28, distinguishing it from proteasome, MHC class II and PD-L1 confusables.

name: MHC class I presentation, cross-presentation and HIV Nef/Vpu evasion
rationale: Members cover class I peptide loading, proteasomal processing and cross-presentation plus HIV Nef/Vpu downregulation of MHC-I, CD4, CD8 and CD28; class I focus and viral evasion separate it from class II, proteasome and PD-L1 confusables.

name: Glutamate, aspartate and GABA reuptake and metabolism

name: Glutamate, aspartate and GABA reuptake and homeostasis

qualifier: glutamate and aspartate plasma membrane uptake
name: Glutamate, aspartate and GABA reuptake and homeostasis

qualifier: cytosolic/nuclear rRNA, tRNA and snRNA via snoRNPs
name: Pseudouridylation and methylation of nuclear rRNA, tRNA and snRNA

name: RNA methylation and pseudouridylation with snoRNP assembly

name: Neurexin-neuroligin excitatory postsynapse assembly and EPSP regulation

name: Neurexin–neuroligin excitatory synapse assembly and EPSP regulation

name: LTB4 and lipoxin metabolism with eicosanoid omega-oxidation

qualifier: lipoxin and leukotriene B4 synthesis and omega-oxidative inactivation
name: Lipoxin and leukotriene B4 formation and omega-oxidative inactivation

name: Leukotriene B4 and lipoxin formation and omega-oxidative inactivation

name: Adiponectin regulation of glucose import and insulin sensitivity
rationale: Members concern adiponectin secretion and signaling with regulation of glucose import and insulin responsiveness, distinguishing it from GLUT4-translocation, insulin-receptor and fatty acid confusables.

name: Adiponectin signaling and regulation of glucose uptake

name: Adiponectin and insulin regulation of glucose import

name: Notch target gene transcription via NOTCH3 and NOTCH4

name: Notch target transcription via NOTCH3 and NOTCH4
