rationale: Members cover homocysteine-to-cysteine transsulfuration, cysteine and serine catabolism and hydrogen sulfide oxidation; sulfide oxidation separates it from selenium, glutathione and choline confusables.

name: Transsulfuration and sulfide oxidation in sulfur amino acid catabolism
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration of homocysteine to cysteine, cysteine catabolism and H2S oxidation to sulfate, distinguishing it from selenium, glutathione and choline/carnitine confusables.

qualifier: transcription factor and RNA-binding protein targets
name: SUMO conjugation-deconjugation cycle and transcription factor SUMOylation
rationale: Members cover SUMO processing, E1/E2 transfer, desumoylation and SUMOylation of transcription factors and RNA-binding proteins, while confusables are SUMOylation of DNA repair, replication and nuclear envelope targets.

qualifier: SUMOylation of transcription factors and RNA-binding proteins
name: SUMO conjugation cycle and SUMOylation of transcription factors
rationale: Members are SUMO maturation, E1/E2 transfer, desumoylation and SUMOylation of transcription factors and RNA-binding proteins, while confusables are SUMOylation of DNA repair, replication, nuclear envelope or chromatin targets.

qualifier: SUMO processing, E1/E2 transfer and deconjugation
name: SUMO processing, E1-E2 conjugation and desumoylation
rationale: Members are the core SUMO maturation, E1/E2 transfer, desumoylation and SUMOylation of transcription factors and RNA-binding proteins, while confusables are substrate-class SUMOylation sets.

name: Axon regeneration and collateral sprouting
rationale: Members regulate regenerative and collateral axon sprouting after or without injury, as opposed to the neighbours' developmental axon guidance and growth-signalling pathways.

name: Axon collateral sprouting and regeneration
rationale: Members regulate collateral sprouting and regeneration of axons, versus confusables about netrin/semaphorin axon guidance and growth-inhibitory signalling.

name: Axon regeneration and collateral sprouting
rationale: All members concern regrowth or sprouting of existing axons after injury or in its absence, while confusables cover developmental axon guidance and semaphorin/netrin repulsion.

name: Pre-rRNA synthesis and processing by spacer cleavage
rationale: Members are 5'-ETS, ITS1 and ITS2 cleavages and 5'-end processing of the tricistronic pre-rRNA plus Pol I rRNA transcription activation, unlike the Pol I/III elongation-termination and ribosome biogenesis regulation confusables.

qualifier: Pol I transcription and spacer endonucleolytic cleavage
name: Pre-rRNA transcription and endonucleolytic spacer cleavage
rationale: Members are endonucleolytic cleavages in 5'-ETS, ITS1 and ITS2 of the tricistronic pre-rRNA plus Pol I rRNA transcription activation, unlike confusables on Pol I/III elongation and termination or general ribosome biogenesis.

qualifier: ETS/ITS spacer endonucleolytic cleavage with Pol I rRNA transcription
name: Pre-rRNA spacer cleavage and Pol I rRNA transcription
rationale: Members are endonucleolytic cleavages of the tricistronic precursor plus positive Pol I transcription, distinct from Pol I/III elongation-termination or ribosome assembly confusables.

core: T cell receptor signaling and activation
name: T cell activation signaling and activation-induced cell death
rationale: All members concern activated T cells (TCR signaling modules, allograft rejection, Fas-regulated activation-induced death), distinguishing the theme from death-receptor apoptosis confusables that lack T cell signaling and from T helper/Treg differentiation confusables that lack AICD.

name: T cell signaling and Fas-regulated activation-induced death
rationale: Members cover T cell activation signaling (including allograft rejection) and its Fas-controlled activation-induced death, unlike confusables centred on Th/Treg regulation or general death-receptor apoptosis.

name: T cell signaling and activation-induced cell death
rationale: All members concern T cell receptor signaling and its alloimmune or Fas-mediated activation-induced death outcome, setting the theme apart from the Treg/Th-differentiation confusables (C1, C2) and the generic death-receptor apoptosis confusables (C3, C4).

qualifier: interferon-alpha effector arm (OAS, IP-10) rather than IRF3-driven interferon induction
name: Cellular antiviral response with interferon-alpha effector induction
rationale: All members describe the cell-intrinsic antiviral response from DNA sensing to interferon-alpha-induced effectors such as OAS and IP-10, whereas confusables centre on IRF3-mediated type I interferon induction, RIG-I/MDA5 or negative cGAS-STING regulation.

name: Interferon-alpha antiviral effector response and cytosolic DNA sensing
rationale: All members concern innate antiviral defence (virus response, DNA sensing, IFN-alpha response, OAS, IP-10), and the IFN-alpha/OAS effector arm separates it from confusables centred on IRF3-driven IFN-beta induction and its negative regulation.

name: Interferon-alpha and OAS innate antiviral response
rationale: All members describe innate antiviral defence (virus and cytosolic DNA sensing, IP-10, IFN-alpha response, OAS), and the IFN-alpha/OAS effector arm distinguishes it from confusables centred on IRF3-driven type I IFN induction, RIG-I/MDA5 or cGAS-STING regulation.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription under MYC control
name: rRNA transcription and ribosome biogenesis under MYC control
rationale: Members cover Pol I rRNA transcription and its chromatin regulation, rRNA processing, ribosome assembly/export and MYC target programmes, unlike confusables on Pol III transcription or translation initiation.

qualifier: MYC-driven RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription and its chromatin control
name: MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis and rRNA gene transcription
rationale: Members cover Pol I rRNA transcription and its epigenetic regulation, rRNA processing, 5S transcription and MYC target programmes, distinguishing the theme from Pol III tRNA transcription and translation-initiation neighbours.

qualifier: MYC-driven RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription and rDNA chromatin control
name: MYC-driven polymerase I rRNA transcription and ribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members span Pol I initiation-to-termination, rDNA chromatin regulation (NoRC, SIRT1, B-WICH), rRNA processing and MYC targets, whereas confusables concern Pol III tRNA transcription, translation initiation or small-subunit export.

core: Glutamate and GABA plasma membrane reuptake
name: Excitatory amino acid and GABA reuptake, GABA metabolism
rationale: Members span glutamate/aspartate and GABA plasma-membrane uptake (including SLC1A transporter disorders) plus GABA synthesis and degradation, unlike the glycinergic, vesicular-loading and cholinergic confusables.

core: Amino acid neurotransmitter transport and metabolism
name: Excitatory amino acid and GABA transport and metabolism
rationale: Members cover glutamate/aspartate reuptake and homeostasis (including SLC1/SLC17A8 disorders) plus GABA synthesis, degradation, secretion and reuptake, unlike glycinergic, vesicular-loading or cholinergic confusables.

core: Glutamate and GABA uptake and metabolism
name: Glutamate and GABA neurotransmitter uptake and metabolism
rationale: Members are glutamate/aspartate and GABA transport, reuptake, synthesis and degradation plus SLC1/SLC17A8 transporter defects, distinguishing it from glycinergic and cholinergic neurotransmission confusables.

name: Intestinal dietary lipid absorption and chylomicron assembly
rationale: Members all concern digestion and intestinal absorption of dietary lipid and sterols and the assembly of nascent chylomicrons and VLDL, whereas confusables cover remodelling, clearance and efflux of circulating lipoprotein particles.

core: dietary lipid uptake and triglyceride-rich lipoprotein assembly
qualifier: intestinal absorption and sterol entry control, not circulating particle remodelling
name: Intestinal dietary lipid absorption and triglyceride-rich lipoprotein assembly
rationale: All members cover digestion and intestinal absorption of dietary lipid and sterols and the assembly of chylomicrons and VLDL that carry them, while the confusables are plasma lipoprotein remodelling, clearance and efflux themes.

core: dietary lipid digestion, intestinal absorption and lipoprotein assembly
qualifier: enterocyte sterol handling and chylomicron/VLDL secretion
name: Dietary lipid digestion, intestinal absorption and lipoprotein particle assembly
rationale: Every member concerns uptake of dietary lipid and sterol across the gut and packaging of it into secreted lipoprotein particles, whereas the confusables concern circulating lipoprotein remodelling and clearance, lipase complexes and cholesterol efflux regulation.

qualifier: positive and negative selection and self-tolerance
name: Thymocyte selection, survival and self-tolerance in thymus
rationale: Members cover positive and negative thymic selection, thymocyte proliferation, apoptosis, migration and self-tolerance; confusables concern bone marrow hematopoiesis and B cell progenitors.

name: Thymic T cell selection and thymocyte development
rationale: Members are thymocyte selection, self-tolerance, migration, survival, proliferation and alpha-beta/gamma-delta differentiation in the thymus, distinguishing the theme from bone-marrow hematopoietic and B cell confusables.

qualifier: positive and negative selection and self-tolerance
name: Thymic T cell selection and thymocyte development
rationale: Members are thymocyte proliferation, survival, migration, differentiation and positive/negative selection; neighbours concern bone marrow hematopoiesis and B cell differentiation.

name: Platelet adhesion and activation via GPVI and GPIb-IX-V
rationale: All members concern platelet activation and aggregation, with collagen/GPVI and GPIb-IX-V adhesion signalling distinguishing it from ADP/thrombin GPCR and VWF/degranulation confusables.

qualifier: collagen/VWF adhesion receptors GPVI and GPIb-IX-V
name: Adhesion-receptor platelet activation via GPVI and GPIb-IX-V
rationale: All members concern platelet activation, adhesion and aggregation; adhesion-receptor (collagen GPVI, GPIb-IX-V) signalling distinguishes it from soluble-agonist GPCR (ADP, thrombin, thromboxane) and VWF-variant/degranulation confusables.

name: Collagen receptor-driven platelet adhesion and aggregation
rationale: Members cover platelet adhesion to collagen, GPVI and GPIb-IX-V signaling and aggregation control, unlike confusables on VWF defects/degranulation or ADP, thrombin and thromboxane GPCR signaling.

core: Viral host cell entry and life cycle
name: Dengue and RSV host entry and viral life cycle
rationale: Members promote viral attachment, entry, transport and assembly with dengue and RSV entry modules, distinguishing it from influenza/HIV entry, host restriction and viral protein maturation confusables.

qualifier: dengue and RSV attachment, entry and assembly
name: Enveloped RNA virus attachment, entry and dengue virion assembly
rationale: Members concern host-cell entry and promotion of the viral life cycle, exemplified by dengue and RSV, unlike viral protein maturation, influenza endocytic entry and host restriction confusables.

qualifier: Dengue and RSV attachment and entry
name: Dengue and RSV attachment, entry and life cycle promotion
rationale: Members cover virus attachment, entry, transport and assembly for Dengue and RSV plus positive regulation of viral entry and life cycle, unlike confusables on host restriction, influenza/HIV endocytic entry or viral protein maturation.

name: Lung epithelial cell differentiation and saccular maturation
rationale: Members are late lung development steps (type I/II pneumocyte, secretory and bronchial epithelium differentiation, saccule development, plus perinatal ductus closure), distinct from surfactant metabolism and branching/mesenchymal growth confusables.

name: Perinatal lung epithelial differentiation and saccular maturation
rationale: Members concern differentiation of pneumocytes, secretory and bronchial epithelium and saccule development plus perinatal ductus closure, unlike confusables on lung branching and mesenchyme or surfactant metabolism.

name: Perinatal lung maturation and epithelial cell differentiation
rationale: Members concern saccular-stage lung and perinatal events (pneumocyte, secretory and bronchial epithelial differentiation, ductus arteriosus closure), distinguishing it from surfactant-disease and branching/mesenchymal lung neighbours.

qualifier: ISG15 conjugation and host blockade of viral invasion and release
name: ISG15 and interferon-stimulated restriction of viral entry and release
rationale: Members share ISG15-mediated and IFN-alpha-induced antiviral effector activity, and uniquely include host suppression of viral invasion and release, whereas confusables carry OAS/PKR, IFN signaling regulation or generic ubiquitination.

name: ISG15-mediated interferon-stimulated antiviral restriction
rationale: Members are ISG15 conjugation and IFN-alpha-induced host restriction of viral invasion and release, distinguished from confusables on broad type I IFN signatures, OAS/PKR responses or ubiquitin chain formation.

qualifier: ISG15-mediated restriction of viral invasion and release
name: ISG15 and interferon-stimulated restriction of viral spread
rationale: Members share IFN-alpha-stimulated antiviral effectors, notably ISG15 conjugation, that suppress viral invasion and release, unlike confusables dominated by IFN signatures, OAS/PKR and IFN signaling regulation, or generic ubiquitination.

name: 5- and 15-lipoxygenase products including lipoxins
rationale: Members describe 5-HETE, 15-HETE and lipoxin biosynthesis, distinct from omega-3 resolvins/protectins, 12-LOX hepoxilins and leukotriene confusables.

name: 5- and 15-lipoxygenase production of HETEs and lipoxins
rationale: Members are 5-HETE and 15-HETE derivative synthesis converging on lipoxin biosynthesis, unlike confusables on omega-3 resolvins, 12-LOX hepoxilins and leukotriene synthesis/catabolism.

name: 5- and 15-lipoxygenase-derived lipoxin biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover 5- and 15-HETE synthesis and lipoxin formation, unlike 12-lipoxygenase hepoxilin, omega-3 resolvin and leukotriene confusables.

qualifier: V-ATPase and carbonic anhydrase-driven, Golgi and lysosome
name: V-ATPase and carbonic anhydrase-driven Golgi and lysosomal acidification
rationale: Members cover V-ATPase assembly, proton transport, CO2 hydration and Golgi/lysosomal pH reduction, unlike confusables on lysosomal pH elevation, bicarbonate transporters, pigmentation and phospholipid scrambling.

qualifier: V-ATPase and carbonic anhydrase in Golgi and lysosome
name: V-ATPase and carbonic anhydrase-driven Golgi and lysosome acidification
rationale: Members cover V-ATPase assembly, proton transport, carbonic anhydrase CO2 hydration and Golgi/lysosomal pH reduction, unlike confusables on lysosomal pH elevation, phospholipid scrambling, pigmentation or bicarbonate transport.

name: V-ATPase-driven lysosomal and Golgi lumen acidification
rationale: Members cover V-ATPase assembly, proton transport and acidification of lysosomal and Golgi lumens, whereas confusables add endosomal and synaptic vesicle acidification, lysosomal pH elevation, pigmentation or bicarbonate transport.

qualifier: bidirectional control of VEGF/FGF production and endothelial responses
name: Bidirectional regulation of sprouting angiogenesis and VEGF/FGF production
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulation of sprouting angiogenesis, endothelial proliferation, migration, chemotaxis and apoptosis, VEGF/FGF production and VEGFR signaling and vascular wound healing, distinguishing it from Tie2, VEGFR2 ligand-binding and vessel remodeling confusables.

name: Sprouting angiogenesis regulation via VEGF production and responsiveness
rationale: Members are bidirectional regulators of sprouting angiogenesis, endothelial proliferation, migration and apoptosis and VEGF/FGF production and signalling, unlike Tie2, VEGFR ligand-binding, lymphangiogenesis and remodeling confusables.

name: Regulation of sprouting angiogenesis and angiogenic factor production
rationale: Members positively and negatively regulate endothelial sprouting, proliferation, migration and VEGF/FGF/TGF-beta2 production, whereas confusables centre on Tie2, VEGF-receptor binding and VEGFR2 signaling.

name: Resolvin, protectin and maresin pro-resolving mediator biosynthesis
rationale: Members are biosynthesis routes for resolvins, protectins, maresins and their HETE precursors, whereas confusables cover lipoxins, leukotrienes and hepoxilins.

name: Lipoxygenase-derived resolvin, protectin and maresin biosynthesis
rationale: Members are lipoxygenase products of PUFAs, chiefly omega-3 resolvins, protectins and maresins, whereas neighbours concern lipoxins, hepoxilins and leukotriene catabolism.

name: Resolvin, protectin and maresin pro-resolving mediator biosynthesis
rationale: Members are biosynthesis of resolvins, protectins, maresins and related HETE/oxo-PUFA mediators, distinct from lipoxin, leukotriene and hepoxilin confusables.

name: Stalled ribosome rescue and ribosome-associated quality control
rationale: Members cover rescue of stalled ribosomes, no-go and non-stop mRNA decay and RQC degradation of nascent peptides, distinguishing it from NMD/termination, stress granule and degron confusables.

qualifier: stalled ribosome rescue with no-go and non-stop decay
name: Stalled ribosome rescue and no-go/non-stop mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover dissociation of stalled ribosomes on no-go and non-stop mRNAs, RQC nascent-peptide degradation and associated mRNA decay, unlike confusables centred on nonsense-mediated decay, stress granules or degron pathways.

qualifier: stalled ribosome rescue with no-go and non-stop decay
name: Stalled ribosome rescue with no-go and non-stop decay
rationale: Members cover rescue and splitting of stalled ribosomes, no-go/non-stop mRNA decay and RQC nascent-peptide degradation, unlike confusables on nonsense-mediated decay, termination, degron pathways or stress granules.

qualifier: inner and middle ear, hair cell fate
name: Inner and middle ear morphogenesis and hair cell specification
rationale: All members concern formation of the otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canals, middle ear, vestibulocochlear nerve and auditory hair cell fate; this ear focus separates it from neighbours on olfactory, eye and other cranial sensory development.

qualifier: inner/middle ear morphogenesis and sensory hair cell fate
name: Inner and middle ear morphogenesis and hair cell fate
rationale: Members build the otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canals, middle ear and auditory nerve and specify hair cells, unlike confusables covering outer ear, eye, nose or cranial nerves.

qualifier: inner ear sensory hair cell specification
name: Ear morphogenesis and inner ear hair cell specification
rationale: Members are otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canal, middle ear and vestibulocochlear nerve formation plus auditory receptor cell fate, which separates it from cranial ganglion, olfactory and eye development confusables.

name: MicroRNA biogenesis and silencing by deadenylation-dependent mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover miRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and miRNA silencing through poly(A) shortening, P-body assembly and mRNA decay, distinguishing them from siRNA, miRNA-turnover and translation-repression confusables.

name: miRNA biogenesis and silencing by deadenylation-dependent mRNA decay
rationale: Members span miRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and miRNA-directed mRNA destabilization via poly(A) shortening and P-bodies, unlike confusables about miRNA turnover, siRNA processing or translational repression of specific transcripts.

name: MicroRNA silencing through deadenylation-dependent mRNA decay
rationale: Members span miRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and silencing by poly(A) shortening, deadenylation-dependent decay and P-body assembly, unlike confusables about miRNA turnover, siRNA processing or translational repression of specific targets.

qualifier: ER chaperone gene induction by ATF6, XBP1, ATF4, CREB3
name: UPR transcription factor induction of ER chaperone genes
rationale: All members are ER stress-activated transcription factors driving chaperone and stress genes, unlike confusables on ER stress apoptosis, IRE1/PERK regulation, SREBP or the integrated/mitochondrial stress response.

qualifier: ATF6, XBP1, ATF4 and CREB3 chaperone induction
name: Unfolded protein response transcription factors inducing chaperone genes
rationale: Members are ER-stress transcription factors (ATF6, XBP1, ATF4, CREB3) activating chaperone genes, unlike confusables on translational stress control, IRE1/PERK regulation, apoptosis and SREBP.

qualifier: transcriptional activation of ER chaperone genes
name: UPR transcription factor activation of ER chaperone genes
rationale: Members are ATF6, XBP1, ATF4 and CREB3 activation of chaperone genes under ER stress, unlike confusables on UPR branch regulation, SREBP or integrated stress response.

name: Cellular senescence with Polycomb silencing and SASP
rationale: Members concern oncogene-induced senescence, cell cycle exit, the secretory phenotype and Polycomb (BMI1) repression, distinguishing them from heterochromatin-foci and stress-induced senescence confusables.

name: Senescence arrest with Polycomb silencing and secretory phenotype
rationale: Members describe oncogene-induced senescence, proliferative arrest, Polycomb-mediated repression and the SASP, distinguishing the theme from heterochromatin-focus and stress-induced senescence confusables.

qualifier: SASP and Polycomb cell cycle silencing
name: Oncogene-induced senescence, SASP and Polycomb cell cycle silencing
rationale: Members cover promotion of senescence, oncogene-induced arrest, the SASP and Polycomb/AP-2 control of cell cycle genes, distinguishing it from stress-induced, replicative and SAHF-heterochromatin senescence confusables.

qualifier: pharyngeal pouch derivatives, palate and spleen
name: Pharyngeal pouch organ, palate and spleen development
rationale: Members are development of thyroid, parathyroid and thymus (pharyngeal pouch derivatives), hard and soft palate and spleen, unlike the forebrain, limb, neural plate and outflow-tract confusables.

name: Pharyngeal gland, palate and spleen development
rationale: Members are development of the palate, the pharyngeal-derived thymus, thyroid and parathyroid glands, and the spleen, unlike confusables on forebrain, limb, outflow tract or neural plate patterning.

core: Organogenesis of pharyngeal and craniofacial derivatives
qualifier: thymus, thyroid, parathyroid, palate and spleen
name: Pharyngeal gland, palate and spleen organogenesis
rationale: Members are development of pharyngeal-pouch glands (thymus, thyroid, parathyroid), the palate and spleen, distinct from neural, limb and outflow-tract development confusables.

qualifier: calcium sensing and store-operated calcium entry
name: Calcium ion sensing and store-operated calcium entry
rationale: Members concern detecting and responding to calcium and activating store-operated and voltage-gated calcium influx, distinct from confusables on cytosolic calcium removal, Na/Ca exchange and ER/ryanodine calcium release.

name: Store-operated calcium entry and calcium sensing
rationale: Members concern store-operated channel activation, calcium detection and response, and calcium channel activity, while confusables address Na/Ca exchange, ER/ryanodine release and mitochondrial calcium.

name: Calcium sensing and store-operated calcium entry
rationale: Members concern detection of and response to calcium, store-operated and voltage-gated calcium channel activation, whereas confusables emphasise calcium extrusion, Na/Ca exchange or ryanodine-receptor release.

core: Caspase-8 and RIPK1 cell death signaling
name: Caspase-8–RIPK1 cell death including TRIF-induced necroptosis
rationale: Members cover caspase-8 dimerization, c-FLIP and inhibition, TRAIL, RIPK1 necrosis and TLR3/TRIF-induced death, distinguishing them from FasL/BID extrinsic apoptosis, TBK1-IRF3 activation or necroptosis regulation terms.

core: Caspase-8 and RIPK1 cell death signaling
qualifier: apoptosis versus necroptosis, including TLR3-TRIF and viral modulation
name: Caspase-8/RIPK1 control of apoptosis versus necroptosis
rationale: Members cover procaspase-8 dimerization, c-FLIP and CASP8 inhibition, TRAIL, TRIF/TLR3-induced death and RIPK1 necroptosis, which separates them from Fas/BID extrinsic apoptosis and TBK1-IRF3 confusables.

qualifier: switch between apoptosis and necroptosis via RIPK1/TRIF
name: Caspase-8/RIPK1 switch between apoptosis and necroptosis
rationale: Members cover procaspase-8 dimerisation, c-FLIP and CASP8 inhibition, TRIF/TLR3 and RIPK1 necroptosis, unlike confusables about Fas/BID extrinsic apoptosis or TBK1-IRF3 signalling.

name: Dendrite arborization and postsynaptic actin structural remodeling
rationale: All members concern dendrite branching and actin-based postsynaptic/spine structure; dendrite arborization and postsynaptic density maintenance distinguish it from the filopodium/RHOF and synaptic plasticity/translation confusables.

qualifier: dendrite branching and postsynaptic density maintenance
name: Dendrite branching and postsynaptic actin structural plasticity
rationale: All members concern structural remodeling of dendrites and the actin-based postsynapse; unlike confusables (filopodia, RHOF/EPHB, NMDAR-RAC1, synaptic translation) the theme adds dendrite arborization and postsynaptic density structure maintenance.

name: Postsynaptic actin remodeling and dendrite arborization
rationale: All members concern structural organization of dendrites and the postsynapse (spines, PSD, postsynaptic actin, arborization), distinguished from confusables by PSD maintenance, postsynapse assembly and arborization rather than NMDAR-RAC1, filopodia or receptor trafficking.

name: Ephrin and L1CAM signaling in axon guidance and fasciculation
rationale: Members cover ephrin repulsion, L1 signaling/recycling, DCC attraction and RAC1 activation in axon guidance, distinct from netrin-repulsion and Robo-Slit confusables.

qualifier: ephrin and L1 with RAC1 activation and fasciculation
name: Ephrin and L1 signalling in axon guidance and fasciculation
rationale: Members are ephrin receptor signalling and repulsion, L1 signalling and recycling, DCC attraction, RAC1 activation and axonal fasciculation, whereas confusables are dominated by netrin repulsion, ROBO-SLIT or RHO GTPase filopodium control.

name: Ephrin and L1 signalling in axon guidance and fasciculation
rationale: Members combine EPH-ephrin repulsion and growth cone collapse, L1 signalling/recycling, DCC attraction, RAC1 activation and axonal fasciculation, whereas confusables centre on netrin/ROBO-SLIT signalling or filopodium regulation.

qualifier: heme B via protoporphyrinogen IX, supporting hemoglobin
name: Heme B biosynthesis via protoporphyrinogen IX
rationale: All members concern porphyrin/heme B synthesis and its regulation for hemoglobin, including mitochondrial heme-pathway transporters; confusables add heme A synthesis, iron-sulfur clusters, or heme/iron uptake.

name: Heme B biosynthesis via protoporphyrinogen and its regulation
rationale: Members cover heme B and protoporphyrinogen IX synthesis, mitochondrial heme-related ABC transport and regulation of tetrapyrrole and hemoglobin synthesis; this separates it from heme uptake/iron handling, iron-sulfur cluster assembly and heme A synthesis confusables.

qualifier: heme B via protoporphyrin with mitochondrial transport
name: Heme B biosynthesis via protoporphyrin and mitochondrial transport
rationale: Members cover protoporphyrinogen IX and heme B synthesis, mitochondrial ABC transporters and positive control of tetrapyrrole/hemoglobin synthesis, lacking the heme A and Fe-S cluster content of neighbours.

name: Extracellular restraint of Nodal signaling by ligand sequestration
rationale: Members describe extracellular ligand/BMP sequestration and negative regulation of Nodal, including its role in lateral mesoderm left/right asymmetry; C1 covers intracellular BMP/TGF-beta/SMAD regulation and C4 organ laterality.

qualifier: ligand sequestration; lateral mesoderm left/right asymmetry
name: Extracellular ligand sequestration limiting nodal signaling
rationale: Members concern extracellular sequestration of BMP/nodal ligands and negative regulation of nodal in lateral mesoderm asymmetry, unlike confusables centred on organ laterality, BMP/TGF-beta SMAD signaling, somitogenesis or endothelium.

core: Extracellular ligand sequestration restraining Nodal signaling
name: Extracellular ligand sequestration restraining Nodal signaling in left-right patterning
rationale: Members describe extracellular trapping of ligands (BMP, Nodal) that negatively regulates Nodal signaling and lateral-mesoderm left-right asymmetry, unlike the broader BMP/TGF-beta SMAD, organ-asymmetry, somitogenesis and endothelial confusables.

name: Purine ribonucleoside catabolism via inosine
rationale: AMP/IMP/inosine catabolism, ADA and PNP defects and allantoin formation all describe ribonucleoside purine breakdown, unlike the deoxyribonucleotide and salvage confusables.

qualifier: ribonucleotides and ribonucleosides (AMP, IMP, inosine) toward allantoin
name: Purine ribonucleotide and ribonucleoside catabolism
rationale: All members concern degradation of ribo-purines (AMP, IMP, inosine, adenosine/guanosine via ADA and PNP, onward to allantoin), distinguishing the theme from deoxyribonucleotide-metabolism and purine-salvage confusables.

name: Purine ribonucleotide and nucleoside degradation to allantoin
rationale: All members cover breakdown of AMP/IMP and (deoxy)adenosine/inosine via ADA and PNP toward allantoin, whereas confusables cover deoxyribonucleotide/pyrimidine catabolism or purine salvage.

qualifier: sperm tail axoneme, manchette and mitochondrial sheath
name: Spermatogenic assembly of sperm tail structures
rationale: Members concern building sperm-specific structures during spermatogenesis (manchette, axoneme central apparatus, mitochondrial sheath, Sertoli barrier), distinct from confusables on motile cilia dynein arms, sperm motility regulation or tubulin modification.

name: Spermatid axoneme, manchette and mitochondrial sheath assembly
rationale: Members build spermatid structures (axoneme, central apparatus, manchette, mitochondrial sheath) with Sertoli barrier support, unlike confusables on sperm motility regulation, tubulin modification or motile cilia dynein arms.

name: Spermiogenic assembly of axoneme, manchette and mitochondrial sheath
rationale: Members build spermatid structures (axoneme, central apparatus, manchette, mitochondrial sheath) plus the Sertoli barrier, whereas confusables cover sperm motility, dynein arms and motile cilia, or tubulin modification.

name: Fructose and alditol metabolism with inherited fructose disorders
rationale: Members cover fructose catabolism, polyol (alditol) synthesis and breakdown, and essential fructosuria and hereditary fructose intolerance, unlike confusables on gluconeogenesis, glycolysis, glycerol or pentose metabolism.

qualifier: fructose catabolism disorders and alditol metabolism
name: Fructose catabolism and polyol metabolism
rationale: Members are fructose catabolism and its inborn errors (essential fructosuria, hereditary fructose intolerance) plus alditol (sugar alcohol) synthesis and breakdown; confusables cover glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, pentose/glucuronate or glycerol metabolism instead.

name: Fructose and polyol metabolism and its inherited disorders
rationale: Members cover fructose catabolism with essential fructosuria and hereditary fructose intolerance plus alditol synthesis/breakdown, unlike pentose, gluconeogenic and glycerol confusables.

qualifier: nucleic-acid sensing and type I interferon induction
name: Nucleic-acid sensing and type I interferon antiviral response
rationale: Members span endosomal TLR7/8/9/3, RIG-I/MDA5, cGAS-STING and AIM2 sensing driving type I/III interferon and ISG responses, broader than confusables restricted to host viral restriction, IFN-alpha signatures or TRIF/TAK1 signalling.

core: Antiviral innate immunity and interferon response
qualifier: nucleic acid sensing via RLR, endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING
name: Viral nucleic acid sensing and type I/III interferon response
rationale: Members span RIG-I/MDA5, TLR3/7/8/9 and cGAS-STING/AIM2 sensing, TBK1/IRF3/IRF7 activation, type I/III interferon production and ISG responses (ISG15, OAS, PKR) incl. HSE deficiencies and viral modulation; confusables instead focus on host restriction of viral life cycle steps or TRIF/IKK signalling and lack the sensor-to-interferon axis.

qualifier: nucleic acid sensing by TLRs, RIG-I and cGAS-STING
name: Nucleic acid sensor-driven type I interferon antiviral response
rationale: Members cover innate antiviral nucleic-acid sensing (TLR3/7/8/9, RIG-I/MDA5, cGAS-STING, AIM2) and type I/III interferon production and response, distinguishing it from virus-host interaction, T-cell and TRIF/TAK1 confusables.

name: Gonad development and hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal hormone signalling
rationale: Members span testis/ovary differentiation, follicle growth, ovulation and luteinization driven by gonadotropins, activin, AMH and progesterone, which distinguishes it from confusables about genital tract morphogenesis, sperm function or meiotic/germline chromatin.

name: Gonad development and gonadotropin–activin endocrine regulation
rationale: Members span ovarian follicle and testis development, sex determination and oocyte maturation together with gonadotropin, activin/AMH, progesterone and prolactin signalling, unlike neighbours about fertilization, genital tract morphogenesis or meiosis and germline epigenetics.

name: Gonad development and gonadotropin-regulated ovarian follicle cycle

rationale: Members trace early kidney development (intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct, ureteric bud, metanephric mesenchyme-to-epithelium, renal vesicle, comma and S-shaped bodies), while confusables cover distal tubule, collecting duct, ureter or kidney size control.

name: Insulin receptor signaling to glucose uptake and glycogen synthesis
rationale: Members span insulin receptor/IRS/AKT2 signaling, receptor recycling, GLUT4 translocation, glucose import, glycogen synthesis and adiponectin effects; this insulin-anabolic focus distinguishes it from glucagon, glycogenolysis and ChREBP/gluconeogenesis neighbours.

name: Insulin and adiponectin signaling to glucose uptake and glycogen
rationale: Members span insulin receptor/IRS/AKT2 signalling, GLUT4 translocation, glucose import, glycogen synthesis and adiponectin, unlike glucagon/ChREBP/gluconeogenesis or RHOQ confusables.

core: Insulin receptor signaling to glucose uptake and glycogen
name: Insulin receptor-AKT2 signaling to GLUT4 glucose uptake and glycogen
rationale: Members cover insulin receptor/IRS activation, AKT2, GLUT4 translocation, glucose import, glycogen synthesis and adiponectin, unlike glucagon/gluconeogenesis, glycogenolysis/glucokinase or insulin catabolism confusables.

core: DNA double-strand break sensing and repair
name: Double-strand break sensing, NHEJ and repair pathway choice
rationale: All members concern detecting DSBs (ATM signalling, chromatin remodelling, ADP-ribosylation) and choosing/executing end joining versus HR, unlike confusables centred on BRCA1/BRCA2 defects, resection and HR strand exchange.

core: DNA double-strand break sensing and repair pathway choice
qualifier: nonhomologous end joining and its regulation
name: Double-strand break sensing and end-joining repair regulation
rationale: All members concern detecting double-strand breaks (ATM recruitment, PARP-type ADP-ribosylation, chromatin remodeling) and regulating NHEJ versus HR; unlike the confusables it lacks BRCA1/BRCA2 defect and HR resection/strand-invasion steps and centres on end joining.

core: DNA double-strand break signalling and repair pathway choice
qualifier: break-site chromatin remodelling and ADP-ribosylation regulating NHEJ versus HR
name: Break-site chromatin signalling regulating NHEJ versus homologous recombination
rationale: All members concern sensing and signalling at double-strand breaks and the positive/negative regulation of NHEJ and HR; unlike the confusables (broad HR/BRCA defect and resection sets) it carries break-site chromatin remodelling, ADP-ribosylation and protein recruitment to breaks.

qualifier: biogenesis, RISC assembly and miRNA turnover
name: Small RNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and miRNA turnover
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA processing, RISC assembly, silencing and target-directed miRNA decay, unlike confusables on miRNA control of specific transcripts or deadenylation.

qualifier: miRNA/siRNA biogenesis, turnover and RISC assembly
name: Small RNA biogenesis, turnover and RISC-mediated silencing
rationale: Members cover miRNA and siRNA processing, miRNA degradation, RISC assembly and silencing by mRNA destabilization or translational repression, unlike confusables on specific miRNA-regulated transcripts or deadenylation-dependent decay.

qualifier: miRNA and siRNA biogenesis and RISC
name: miRNA and siRNA biogenesis and RISC-mediated silencing
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA processing and its regulation, RISC assembly, miRNA turnover and silencing by mRNA destabilization or translational inhibition, whereas confusables add deadenylation-dependent decay or target-specific miRNA regulation of individual transcripts.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase fusions and mutants
name: Oncogenic FGFR, PDGFR and ALK/LTK fusions and mutants
rationale: All members describe cancer-associated fusions, amplifications, translocations or mutants of FGFR1-3, PDGFRA/B and ALK/LTK kinases, distinguishing them from the EGFR/ERBB2 and KIT/drug-resistance confusables.

qualifier: FGFR, PDGFR and ALK/LTK fusions and amplifications
name: Oncogenic FGFR, PDGFR and ALK/LTK fusions and amplifications
rationale: All members are cancer-associated FGFR1-3, PDGFRA/B, ALK or LTK fusions, amplifications or mutants, distinguishing it from confusables on KIT and drug-resistant mutants or EGFR/ERBB2 variants.

qualifier: FGFR, PDGFR and ALK/LTK fusions and amplifications
name: Oncogenic FGFR, PDGFR and ALK/LTK kinase fusions
rationale: All members are cancer-associated fusions, amplifications or mutants of FGFR, PDGFR and ALK-family kinases, distinct from the KIT/TKI-resistance, EGFR/ERBB2 and FLT3 confusables.

core: staged specification of pancreatic progenitors toward endocrine and exocrine lineages
qualifier: progenitor-stage transcriptional programmes and neuroendocrine fate, not endoderm formation or mature islet hormone secretion
name: Pancreatic progenitor staging and endocrine lineage specification
rationale: Members are successive pancreatic progenitor states (early bud, branching, NEUROG3+ endocrine-committed, mid-progenitor) plus the cell fates they generate and the related neuroendocrine and adrenal programmes; the confusables are definitive endoderm and foregut specification or mature beta-cell insulin and incretin function.

name: Pancreatic progenitor lineage specification and neuroendocrine differentiation
rationale: Members are the staged transcriptional programmes that take pancreatic bud precursors to endocrine and exocrine fates plus related neuroendocrine and adrenal differentiation, not the hormone secretion, definitive endoderm or urogenital development of the confusables.

name: Pancreatic progenitor lineages and neuroendocrine differentiation
rationale: Members describe pancreatic progenitor gene regulation, endocrine (NEUROG3+, alpha cell) and exocrine development plus neuroendocrine/adrenal differentiation, unlike confusables on beta-cell secretion, definitive endoderm or gonad development.

qualifier: positive regulation of IL-4, IL-5, IL-13
name: Th2 polarization promoting IL-4, IL-5 and IL-13 signaling
rationale: Members cover Th2 differentiation, positive regulation of IL-4/IL-5/IL-13 production and IL-4/IL-13 signalling, distinct from confusables on eosinophils, negative regulation of type 2 cytokines or IL-33.

qualifier: Th2 differentiation and IL-4, IL-5, IL-13 induction
name: Th2 cell differentiation and IL-4, IL-5, IL-13 induction
rationale: Members cover Th2 differentiation, positive regulation of IL-4, IL-5 and IL-13 production and IL-4/IL-13 signalling with mast cell activation, unlike confusables on eosinophils, negative regulation and IgE switching, or IL-33.

name: Th2 cell differentiation, cytokine production and IL-4/IL-13 signaling
rationale: Members promote Th2 differentiation and IL-4/5/13 production and IL-4/IL-13 signaling, distinguishing the theme from eosinophil, IL-33 and negative-regulation confusables.

qualifier: SOS and MRAS-SHOC2 driven RAF activation
name: Ras-to-RAF activation via SOS and MRAS-SHOC2
rationale: Members cover Ras activation and its relay to RAF, MEK and RSK, distinguished by SOS signalling and MRAS-SHOC2 RAF activation rather than the ERK feedback inactivation or RAS GAP content of the confusables.

name: RAS-family GTPase activation of RAF-MAPK signaling
rationale: Members cover SOS, MRAS-SHOC2, RIT/RIN and RAF/MEK/RSK activation, distinguishing them from neighbours about RAS GAPs and ERK negative feedback.

qualifier: SOS and MRAS-SHOC2 driven RAF activation
name: RAS-RAF-MAPK activation via SOS and MRAS-SHOC2
rationale: Members describe activating RAS signaling to RAF, MEK, RSK and p38 (SOS, MRAS-SHOC2, MAP2K mutants), whereas confusables emphasise GAP-mediated RAS inactivation and ERK negative feedback.

name: Glycolysis to lactate and its fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control
rationale: Members are glucose catabolism through hexokinase and fructose bisphosphates to lactate, with fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation; confusables address pentose phosphate regulation, glucagon signalling or glycogen.

qualifier: fermentation to lactate and fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation
name: Glucose glycolysis to lactate with fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation
rationale: Members cover hexokinase-initiated glucose catabolism, fructose bisphosphate metabolism and lactate fermentation, distinguishing the theme from glycogen/glucagon, gluconeogenesis and pentose-phosphate regulation confusables.

name: Glucose glycolysis to lactate with fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control
rationale: Members cover hexokinase-initiated glycolysis, fructose bisphosphate metabolism, lactate fermentation and its fructose 2,6-bisphosphate regulation, unlike confusables centred on glycogen, glucagon/PKA or pentose-phosphate regulation.

name: Necroptosis signalling and its viral modulation
rationale: Members are RIPK1-mediated necroptosis and its regulation including pathogen modulation, distinguishing it from caspase-8 extrinsic apoptosis and apoptotic execution confusables.

name: Necroptosis signaling and its microbial modulation
rationale: Members are necroptotic signaling and its regulation, including microbial and SARS-CoV-1 modulation of RIPK1 necrosis, distinct from death-receptor caspase-8 apoptosis and apoptotic execution neighbours.

name: Necroptotic cell death and its microbial modulation
rationale: Members are necroptotic signalling and its positive/negative regulation, including microbial and SARS-CoV-1 effects on RIPK1-mediated death, whereas confusables centre on apoptotic execution or death-receptor/caspase-8 signalling.

qualifier: Aurora A and NEK kinases, centrosome separation
name: Aurora A and NEK kinases in mitotic entry
rationale: Members concern AURKA regulation, NEK9/6/7 activation and mitotic centrosome separation, unlike confusables about spindle/PLK1, APC/C metaphase-anaphase control or chromosome condensation.

qualifier: Aurora A and NEK kinases at centrosome separation
name: Aurora A and NEK kinases in mitotic centrosome separation
rationale: Members concern early-mitosis regulation of Aurora A (PHLDA1, FBXL7), NEK9/6/7 activation and centrosome separation, unlike confusables on spindle assembly, APC/C or chromosome condensation.

qualifier: Aurora A and NEK kinases at centrosome separation
name: Aurora A and NEK kinase control of centrosome separation
rationale: Members concern Aurora A regulation (PHLDA1, FBXL7), NEK9/6/7 activation and centrosome separation at mitotic entry, unlike spindle, APC/C or chromosome condensation confusables.

name: Hematopoiesis toward primitive and definitive erythrocytes
rationale: All members concern blood cell formation with emphasis on primitive and definitive erythrocyte differentiation, which the stem-cell homeostasis confusables lack, while the theme lacks the heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport of the erythroid-metabolism confusable.

core: Erythroid commitment of hematopoietic stem cells
name: Hematopoietic stem cell commitment to primitive and definitive erythropoiesis
rationale: Members concern erythrocyte differentiation (primitive, definitive, its promotion) and restraint of HSC differentiation in hemopoiesis, whereas confusables address HSC self-renewal/homeostasis or heme and late red-cell maturation.

name: Hematopoietic differentiation toward primitive and definitive erythrocytes
rationale: Members concern hemopoiesis and stem cell differentiation control steering to primitive and definitive erythrocytes, unlike confusables centred on heme/late erythroid biology or HSC homeostasis and proliferation.

name: Regulation of miRNA transcription and processing
rationale: All members regulate miRNA transcription or pri-/pre-miRNA processing, upstream of the RISC silencing, miRNA decay and target-translation content in confusables.

name: Regulation of miRNA transcription and processing
rationale: All members regulate miRNA transcription, primary/precursor processing or metabolism, unlike confusables on miRNA silencing effects, target-directed miRNA decay or TGF-beta signalling.

name: Regulation of miRNA transcription and processing
rationale: All members regulate miRNA transcription, pri/pre-miRNA processing or metabolism, unlike confusables on miRNA silencing, target-directed miRNA decay or TGF-beta signaling.

qualifier: mtDNA replication, transcription and mitoribosome translation
name: Mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription and translation
rationale: Members span mtDNA replication/repair, mitochondrial transcription, mRNA stability and mitoribosome assembly/translation, whereas confusables focus on mitochondrial and nuclear tRNA processing and RNA import.

name: Mitochondrial genome replication, transcription and translation
rationale: Members span mtDNA replication/repair, mitochondrial transcription, mRNA stability, mitoribosome assembly and translation, while confusables add mitochondrial tRNA processing and RNA import.

name: Mitochondrial genome replication, transcription and translation
rationale: Members span mtDNA replication and repair, mitochondrial transcription, mRNA stability, mitoribosome assembly and translation, whereas confusables focus on mitochondrial tRNA processing and RNA import.

core: Transition and heavy metal transport and homeostasis
qualifier: zinc, copper, manganese and cadmium, not iron
name: Zinc, copper and manganese transport and cadmium detoxification
rationale: Members cover SLC39/SLC30 zinc transport, copper, manganese, cobalt and cadmium transport, metallothionein binding and detoxification, distinguishing them from confusables built on MTF1 metal-response transcription or iron and heme handling.

core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
qualifier: zinc, copper, manganese and cadmium rather than iron
name: Zinc, copper, manganese and cadmium transport and homeostasis
rationale: All members concern transport, homeostasis or detoxification of zinc, copper, manganese, cadmium or cobalt (SLC30/SLC39, metallothioneins), distinguishing it from iron/heme handling and MTF1-driven metal-response confusables.

core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
name: Zinc, copper and manganese ion transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members cover transmembrane transport, homeostasis and detoxification of zinc (SLC39/SLC30), copper, manganese, cadmium and cobalt, distinguishing them from iron/heme-handling and MTF1 metal-response confusables.

qualifier: ammonia detoxification and inherited enzyme deficiencies
name: Urea cycle ammonia detoxification and its inborn errors
rationale: Members are urea cycle reactions, intermediates (citrulline, ornithine, arginine, aspartate), ammonium homeostasis and the urea cycle enzyme deficiencies, unlike confusables on cationic amino acid transport or glutamate/glutamine metabolism.

name: Urea cycle ammonia detoxification and inherited enzyme defects
rationale: Members are urea cycle steps, arginine/citrulline/ornithine metabolism, ammonium homeostasis and CPS1/OTC/ASS1/ASL/ARG1/NAGS deficiencies, which the glutamate/aspartate and cationic amino acid transport neighbours lack.

qualifier: ammonium homeostasis and inherited enzyme defects
name: Urea cycle, ammonium homeostasis and inherited urea cycle disorders
rationale: Members are urea cycle reactions, arginine/citrulline/ornithine metabolism, ammonium handling and the urea cycle enzyme deficiencies; confusables cover glutamate/glutamine/proline metabolism or cationic amino acid transport.

name: Translesion synthesis and PCNA-dependent DNA polymerization
rationale: Members are polymerase-driven DNA synthesis steps in replication (priming, elongation, switching, flap removal), translesion bypass and NER gap filling, distinguished from confusables on base-excision gap filling, telomere C-strand synthesis, hypermutation or NER incision.

name: PCNA-dependent DNA synthesis in replication and translesion bypass
rationale: Members are DNA synthesis steps (priming, elongation, polymerase switching, flap removal, translesion polymerases, NER gap filling), distinct from base-excision gap filling, telomere C-strand synthesis and NER incision in the confusables.

name: Translesion synthesis and replicative polymerase switching
rationale: Members are translesion polymerases (POLH, POLK, POLI, REV1) and PCNA-based replicative synthesis/gap filling, distinguished from base-excision, telomere C-strand and NER incision themes.

qualifier: lens, anterior segment and hyaloid vessel regression
name: Camera-type eye morphogenesis including lens and hyaloid regression
rationale: Members concern whole-eye structures (optic cup, lens, cornea, iris, eyelid, pigmentation) and developmental apoptosis including hyaloid vessel regression, unlike confusables on retinal neuron and photoreceptor differentiation.

name: Camera-type eye morphogenesis and anterior segment development
rationale: Members are eye, lens, iris, cornea, eyelid and hyaloid vascular development and remodeling, whereas confusables concern photoreceptor and retinal neuron differentiation, optic nerve and lacrimal gland.

name: Camera-type eye morphogenesis, lens and anterior segment
rationale: Members are eye morphogenesis of lens, iris, cornea, eyelid and optic cup with hyaloid regression and retinal cell death, unlike photoreceptor or optic nerve confusables.

qualifier: NTRK2 (TrkB) activated by BDNF, NT-3 and NT-4
name: BDNF-NTRK2 (TrkB) neurotrophin receptor signaling
rationale: All members are TrkB activation by its ligands and its downstream RAS, PI3K, PLCG1, FRS2, CDK5 and RAC1 branches, unlike confusables built on TRKA, NTRK3 or NMDA-driven synaptic plasticity.

name: Neurotrophin signaling via TRKB receptor
rationale: All members describe BDNF/NT-3/NT-4 activation of NTRK2 (TRKB) and its PI3K, RAS, PLCG1, FRS2 and RAC1 effectors, distinguishing it from TRKA and TRKC signalling and NMDAR-driven synaptic plasticity confusables.

name: TrkB (NTRK2) neurotrophin receptor signaling
rationale: Members are BDNF/NTF3/NTF4 activation of NTRK2 and its downstream PLCG1, PI3K, RAS, RAC1 and CDK5 branches, distinguishing it from NTRK3 and TRKA/NGF themes and from postsynaptic plasticity.

name: Vasopressin- and aquaporin-mediated water homeostasis
rationale: Members concern vasopressin signalling (including AVP receptor defects in diabetes insipidus), aquaporin water transport and renal water reabsorption, unlike confusables on renin-angiotensin/sodium handling, osmotic stress responses or aquaglyceroporin glycerol/urea transport.

name: Vasopressin-aquaporin control of renal water balance
rationale: Members concern vasopressin receptors, aquaporin water channels and renal water reabsorption, distinguishing them from sodium/osmotic handling, renin-angiotensin and aquaglyceroporin glycerol/urea transport in confusables.

name: Vasopressin and aquaporin-mediated water homeostasis
rationale: All members concern vasopressin signalling, its receptors and defects, aquaporin water transport and renal water retention, unlike confusables on renin-angiotensin, sodium/osmotic handling or aquaglyceroporin glycerol/urea transport.

name: Epithelial adherens junctions and apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members cover adherens junction assembly and maintenance, calcium-dependent epithelial adhesion and apical-basal polarity, whereas confusables emphasise EMT, desmosomes or CDH1 processing.

name: Adherens junction assembly and epithelial apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members concern calcium-dependent adherens junction assembly and maintenance tied to apical-basal polarity and apical constriction; confusables cover EMT, cadherin processing or desmosomes.

name: Epithelial adherens junctions and apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members cover adherens junction assembly/maintenance, calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion and apical-basal polarity with apical constriction, distinguishing it from desmosome, CDH1 turnover and EMT neighbours.

name: Muscarinic acetylcholine and serotonin receptor signalling
rationale: All members are muscarinic acetylcholine or serotonin receptor signalling routes, distinguishing the theme from nicotinic, tachykinin and histamine confusables.

name: Serotonin and muscarinic acetylcholine receptor signaling
rationale: Members are serotonin receptor and muscarinic acetylcholine receptor signalling via adenylate cyclase or PLC, distinct from histamine, tachykinin, PDE and nicotinic confusables.

name: Muscarinic acetylcholine and serotonin receptor signalling
rationale: All members are muscarinic acetylcholine or serotonin receptor signalling pathways, unlike nicotinic, histamine, tachykinin or cAMP-degradation neighbours.

qualifier: mRNA stability, rRNA modification and mitoribosome assembly
name: Mitochondrial mRNA stability, rRNA modification and mitoribosome assembly
rationale: Members regulate mitochondrial mRNA modification and decay, rRNA modification, ribosome assembly and translation, distinguishing them from mitochondrial tRNA processing, pseudouridylation and mtDNA transcription neighbours.

name: Mitochondrial mRNA turnover and mitoribosome assembly
rationale: Members regulate mitochondrial mRNA stability, decay and modification, rRNA modification and mitoribosome assembly, unlike confusables on mitochondrial tRNA processing, pseudouridylation or mtDNA transcription and replication.

name: Mitochondrial mRNA turnover and mitoribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members concern mitochondrial mRNA stability, modification and decay, rRNA modification, mitoribosome assembly and translation, whereas confusables cover mitochondrial tRNA processing, mtDNA replication/transcription or pseudouridylation.

core: Early embryo lineage specification and implantation
name: Peri-implantation embryo lineages and trophoblast giant cell endoreduplication
rationale: Members cover trophectoderm, inner cell mass and primordial germ cell specification with decidualization and endoreduplicating trophoblast giant cells, versus confusables on placental labyrinth development or later germ cell biology.

qualifier: trophoblast giant cells, endoreduplication and decidualization
name: Peri-implantation lineages and trophoblast giant cell endoreduplication
rationale: Members specify early embryonic lineages (trophectoderm, inner cell mass, primordial germ cells) and implantation-site cells (endoreduplicating giant trophoblast, decidua), unlike confusables on labyrinth/chorionic placenta or germ-cell maintenance.

name: Peri-implantation lineage specification, trophoblast giant cells and decidualization
rationale: Members cover the earliest embryonic lineage decisions (inner cell mass, trophectoderm, primordial germ cells) and implantation-stage trophoblast giant cell endoreduplication and decidualization, unlike neighbours focused on germ-line maintenance or labyrinthine placenta development.

qualifier: interactions, trafficking, degradation and signaling rather than transcription or junction assembly
name: E-cadherin and cadherin-11 protein interactions and turnover
rationale: Members concern CDH1/CDH11 at the protein level (trafficking, degradation, homotypic binding, CDH11-STAT3 signaling, E-cadherin-mediated Listeria entry), whereas confusables cover cadherin gene transcription or adherens junction assembly.

name: E-cadherin turnover and trafficking and cadherin-11 signaling
rationale: Members concern post-translational handling of CDH1 (degradation, trafficking, Listeria InlA entry, indole-3-carbinol response) and CDH11 interactions/STAT3 signaling, whereas confusables cover cadherin gene transcription, EMT or adherens junction assembly.

qualifier: E-cadherin and cadherin-11 turnover, trafficking and signaling
name: E-cadherin and cadherin-11 protein turnover and signaling
rationale: Members concern CDH1 degradation, processing, trafficking and pathogen use, and CDH11 interactions and STAT3 signaling, at protein level rather than the junction assembly or transcriptional control of the confusables.

qualifier: carbon dioxide hydration and pH control
name: Bicarbonate transport and CO2 hydration in pH control
rationale: All members concern bicarbonate transport (incl. SLC4 defects in renal tubular acidosis) and CO2 hydration/pH, distinguishing it from proton-pump acidification and phosphate/SLC26 anion confusables.

name: SLC4 bicarbonate transport and CO2 hydration
rationale: All members involve bicarbonate generation or transport for pH control (carbonic anhydrase, SLC4A1/SLC4A4 and their renal tubular acidosis defects), unlike SLC26, phosphate or V-ATPase acidification confusables.

name: SLC4 bicarbonate transport and CO2 hydration
rationale: Members concern bicarbonate handling via SLC4 transporters (and their acidosis-causing defects) and carbonic-anhydrase CO2 hydration, unlike confusables on organelle acidification, SLC26 anion exchange or phosphate transport.

qualifier: primary cilium intraflagellar transport and cargo targeting
name: Primary cilium assembly, intraflagellar transport and cargo targeting
rationale: Members concern ciliogenesis, IFT, BBSome/ARL13B cargo targeting, transition zone and basal body docking with centriole control, distinguishing the theme from photoreceptor, motile multiciliated and centrosome-positioning neighbours.

qualifier: intraflagellar transport and ciliary cargo targeting
name: Primary cilium assembly and intraciliary cargo trafficking
rationale: Members concern IFT, BBSome/ARL13B/VxPx cargo targeting, transition zone and basal body docking plus cilium assembly/disassembly control, unlike confusables on motile/multiciliated cilia, photoreceptors or centrosome organisation.

qualifier: primary cilium cargo targeting and centriole elongation
name: Primary cilium assembly, disassembly and intraflagellar cargo transport
rationale: Members cover ciliogenesis, intraflagellar transport, ciliary membrane cargo targeting, basal body anchoring and centriole elongation, distinguishing them from photoreceptor, motile multiciliated and centrosome-organization confusables.

qualifier: multivesicular body, exosome and viral budding
name: ESCRT membrane scission for multivesicular bodies, exosomes, viral budding
rationale: All members involve ESCRT machinery budding membranes away from the cytosol, in MVB formation, exosome release, HIV/viral budding and nuclear envelope sealing, unlike autophagy, ubiquitin endocytosis or cytokinesis confusables.

qualifier: multivesicular body, exosome and viral budding
name: ESCRT-mediated membrane fission in MVBs, exosomes and viral budding
rationale: All members involve ESCRT-driven membrane fission (MVB/exosome biogenesis, HIV/viral budding, nuclear envelope sealing), unlike receptor-downregulation, autophagy or cytokinetic-abscission confusables.

name: ESCRT-mediated membrane scission in viral budding and exosome biogenesis
rationale: Members are ESCRT machinery acts (MVB formation, viral/HIV budding, exosome assembly, nuclear envelope sealing), unlike confusables on cytokinetic abscission, receptor downregulation or autophagy.

qualifier: phospholipase A2 arachidonate release and fever
name: Phospholipase A2 arachidonate release and prostaglandin production control
rationale: Members are the release of arachidonate by phospholipase A2 and the positive and negative regulation of prostaglandin synthesis and secretion with their fever and prostaglandin E responses, whereas confusables are the cyclooxygenase reactions themselves or leukotriene and lipoxin branches.

core: regulated arachidonate release and prostaglandin output
qualifier: phospholipase A2 activation and prostaglandin response including fever, not the cyclooxygenase or lipoxygenase enzymology
name: Phospholipase A2 arachidonate release and prostaglandin output control
rationale: Members concern PLA2-driven liberation and secretion of arachidonate and the up- and down-regulation of prostaglandin synthesis and response (including fever), while the confusables are the COX and prostaglandin/thromboxane synthetic steps, leukotriene and lipoxin branches, and prostanoid receptors.

core: phospholipase A2 arachidonate release and regulation of prostaglandin output
qualifier: prostaglandin E responses and fever generation, excluding the leukotriene branch and cyclooxygenase chemistry
name: Regulated arachidonate release and prostaglandin output in fever
rationale: Members cover mobilisation of arachidonate from membrane phospholipid and the up- and down-regulation of prostaglandin synthesis, secretion and response including fever, unlike confusables that carry leukotriene and lipoxin synthesis and receptors or the cyclooxygenase and prostanoid receptor reactions themselves.

name: Xenobiotic and steroid metabolism with aflatoxin detoxification
rationale: Members share xenobiotic and steroid biotransformation with sulfonation, and the theme uniquely carries mycotoxin, polyketide and aflatoxin detoxification absent from the flavonoid or CYP/drug-conjugation confusables.

name: Mycotoxin and xenobiotic detoxification with steroid metabolism
rationale: Members are aflatoxin/mycotoxin/polyketide and toxin catabolism plus xenobiotic and steroid metabolism, sulfonation; mycotoxin terms separate it from drug-ADME and flavonoid confusables.

name: Xenobiotic and steroid metabolism with aflatoxin/mycotoxin detoxification
rationale: Members cover xenobiotic, steroid and sulfonation metabolism, distinguished by aflatoxin/mycotoxin and polyketide detoxification from flavone-glycoside and aromatic amine/drug confusables.

qualifier: complexes I, III and ATP synthase with inner-membrane insertion
name: Inner-membrane insertion and assembly of OXPHOS complexes I, III, V
rationale: Members are assembly of complex I, complex III and ATP synthase and protein insertion into the inner membrane, unlike confusables about complex IV, electron transport, Fe-S clusters or import/cristae.

qualifier: complexes I, III and ATP synthase
name: Mitochondrial complex I, III and ATP synthase assembly
rationale: Members are assembly of complex I, complex III and ATP synthase with inner-membrane protein insertion, whereas confusables add complex IV, electron transport, Fe-S clusters and protein import.

qualifier: complexes I, III and ATP synthase
name: Respiratory complex I, III and ATP synthase assembly
rationale: Members are assembly of complex I, complex III and ATP synthase with inner-membrane protein insertion, distinguishing the theme from complex IV assembly, Fe-S clusters and mitochondrial import confusables.

qualifier: positive regulation in skeletal muscle regeneration
name: Promotion of myoblast differentiation and fusion in muscle regeneration
rationale: All members positively regulate myoblast differentiation, fusion and satellite cell-driven skeletal muscle regeneration, whereas confusables carry negative regulation, proliferation, commitment and atrophy.

qualifier: promotion of differentiation, fusion and regeneration
name: Promotion of myoblast differentiation, fusion and muscle regeneration
rationale: All members positively regulate myoblast differentiation, fusion or satellite-cell-driven regeneration; confusables include negative regulation, proliferation, migration, fate commitment or atrophy.

qualifier: positive regulation and satellite cell activation
name: Positive regulation of myoblast differentiation and muscle regeneration
rationale: All members promote myoblast differentiation, fusion or skeletal muscle regeneration via satellite cell activation, whereas confusables cover negative regulation, proliferation, fate commitment, migration or atrophy.

qualifier: factor VIII, IX and V defects
name: Factor VIII, IX and V defects in coagulation amplification
rationale: Members are intrinsic-pathway amplification and defective F8, F9 and FV variants, whereas neighbours add initiation, fibrin formation, fibrinolysis, VWF or FXII/kallikrein components.

qualifier: factor VIII, IX and V defects
name: Intrinsic coagulation amplification and factor VIII/IX/V defects
rationale: Members are intrinsic pathway amplification and variants of factors VIII, IX and V, distinguishing it from confusables containing initiation, fibrin formation, fibrinolysis, VWF and contact-system members.

qualifier: inherited factor VIII, IX and V variant defects
name: Factor VIII, IX and V variant defects in coagulation amplification
rationale: Nearly all members are disease variants of factors VIII, IX and V (hemophilia A/B-type and FV defects) within the intrinsic pathway and cascade amplification, distinct from confusables adding initiation, fibrin formation, fibrinolysis, contact-system or VWF defects.

name: TLR-triggered TAK1/IKK activation of canonical NF-kappaB
rationale: Members describe IRAK/TRAF6/TRIF/RIP1-mediated TAK1 and IKK complex activation downstream of Toll-like receptors leading to canonical NF-kappaB, distinct from noncanonical NF-kappaB and TBK1-IRF3/7 confusables.

name: TLR-driven TAK1/IKK activation of canonical NF-kappaB
rationale: Members describe TRIF/IRAK/TRAF6/RIP1-mediated TAK1 and IKK activation leading to canonical NF-kappaB, distinguishing it from non-canonical NF-kappaB and TBK1-IRF3/7 or TLR3 cell-death confusables.

core: Canonical NF-kB activation by toll-like receptors
name: TLR-induced TAK1 and IKK activation driving canonical NF-kB
rationale: Members describe IRAK1/2-, TRAF6- and RIP1/TICAM1-mediated TAK1 and IKK recruitment leading to canonical NF-kB, unlike confusables on non-canonical NF-kB or TBK1/IRF3/IRF7 interferon arms.

core: Cancer-associated TGF-beta receptor and SMAD mutants
name: Cancer TGF-beta receptor and SMAD mutants and betaglycan regulation
rationale: Members are oncogenic TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3/4 mutants plus TGFBR3 (betaglycan) regulation, distinct from activin, RUNX3/Hippo and normal TGF-beta pathway confusables.

core: TGF-beta receptor and SMAD cancer mutants
name: TGF-beta receptor/SMAD cancer mutants and betaglycan co-receptor regulation
rationale: Members are cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3/4 plus TGFBR3 co-receptor control, distinct from wild-type TGF-beta, RUNX3/Hippo and activin confusables.

qualifier: cancer mutants and TGFBR3 co-receptor regulation
name: Cancer TGF-beta receptor and SMAD mutants, TGFBR3 co-receptor regulation
rationale: Members are cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3/4 plus TGFBR3 regulation, distinct from confusables on RUNX3/Hippo, activin/AMH and normal SMAD transcriptional signaling.

name: Retinol and retinal conversion to retinoic acid
