qualifier: glycogen, hexose and pentose pathways with inborn errors
name: Glycogen, hexose and pentose metabolism with inborn errors
rationale: Members span glycogen synthesis/breakdown, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, fructose, galactose and pentose phosphate metabolism with their inherited enzyme deficiencies, unlike confusables on hexose transport and digestion, glucagon signalling or aminosugar and glycan metabolism.

name: Golgi N- and O-glycan processing and terminal epitope synthesis
rationale: Members build and cap protein glycans (N-glycan trimming/branching, GalNAc O-glycosylation, sialylation, fucosylation, ABO/Lewis antigens, selectin ligands), whereas confusables cover nucleotide-sugar donor synthesis and transport.

qualifier: N- and O-glycan antennae, blood group antigens
name: N- and O-glycan elongation and terminal capping
rationale: Members build and cap protein-linked glycans (complex/hybrid N-glycans, O-GalNAc glycans, sialylation, fucosylation, ABO/Lewis antigens, poly-LacNAc), whereas confusables cover nucleotide-sugar donor synthesis and transport.

name: Golgi N-glycan processing and mucin-type O-glycan synthesis
rationale: Members cover N-glycan trimming and hybrid/complex elongation, GalNAc O-glycosylation (GALNT, C1GALT1C1 defects) and terminal sialyl/fucosyl/blood-group capping; confusables concern nucleotide-sugar precursor synthesis, sugar transport or sulfation.

name: Vasopressin-aquaporin water reabsorption and glycerol/urea transport
rationale: Members share vasopressin-regulated, aquaporin-mediated water handling plus aquaporin glycerol/urea transport, which distinguishes it from renin-angiotensin and sodium/chloride osmoregulation confusables.

qualifier: aquaporin water, urea and glycerol transport
name: Vasopressin and aquaporin-mediated water, urea and glycerol transport
rationale: Members concern vasopressin signalling, renal water reabsorption and aquaporin/urea/glycerol channels, distinct from confusables on renin-angiotensin and sodium/osmotic regulation.

qualifier: vasopressin-regulated renal water reabsorption and glycerol/urea transport
name: Vasopressin–aquaporin water reabsorption and aquaglyceroporin solute transport
rationale: All members concern aquaporin-mediated water, glycerol and urea transport and its vasopressin control of renal water reabsorption and urine volume, distinguished from confusables on sodium/chloride transport, osmotic stress and the renin-angiotensin system.

name: Th2-driven eosinophil activation and recruitment
rationale: Members link Th2 differentiation and IL-5 production to eosinophil activation, chemotaxis and mast cell activation, distinguishing them from granulocyte differentiation and IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 confusables.

qualifier: Th2-driven IL-5 production and eosinophil recruitment
name: Th2-driven IL-5 production and eosinophil recruitment and activation
rationale: Members link Th2 differentiation and IL-5 production to eosinophil chemotaxis, activation and effector function, unlike the IL-4/IL-13 signalling and granulocyte differentiation confusables.

qualifier: Th2 promotion with eosinophil migration and activation
name: Th2 cell promotion and eosinophil migration and activation
rationale: Members combine positive regulation of Th2 differentiation/IL-5 with eosinophil chemotaxis, activation and immunity, whereas confusables cover negative Th2 regulation, IL-4/13/33 signalling or granulocyte differentiation.

qualifier: centred on androgen receptor and prostate
name: Sex-steroid receptor response centred on androgen and prostate
rationale: Members are steroid hormone receptor responses (androgen and estrogen hallmarks, HSP90 receptor chaperoning) with an androgen/AR-prostate focus, distinguishing them from confusables centred on estrogen/progesterone receptor signaling or RUNX2 bone regulation.

name: Androgen receptor-led sex steroid transcriptional response
rationale: Members are androgen and estrogen response programs, steroid receptor chaperoning and prostate epithelial AR signaling, with the androgen/prostate component distinguishing the theme from estrogen- and RUNX2-centred neighbours.

name: Androgen receptor signaling and sex steroid response
rationale: Members are androgen and estrogen response programs centred on AR signaling (testosterone response, KLK2/3, prostate epithelium, HSP90-SHR cycle), which the estrogen-receptor-focused confusables lack.

qualifier: CNS and PNS myelin formation/maintenance with axon calibre
name: CNS and PNS myelin formation, maintenance and axon calibre
rationale: Members cover central and peripheral myelin formation and maintenance, Schwann cell myelination initiation, oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation and neurofilament-based axon diameter; confusables are node of Ranvier assembly, gliosis or oligodendrocyte differentiation control.

qualifier: myelin formation and maintenance with axon caliber control
name: Myelin formation and maintenance with axon caliber control
rationale: Members are CNS and PNS myelin formation and maintenance, Schwann cell myelination initiation, oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation, axon diameter and neurofilament organization, whereas confusables carry gliosis, glial proliferation or nodal/paranodal assembly.

qualifier: central and peripheral formation, maintenance, axon caliber
name: Central and peripheral myelin formation and maintenance, axon caliber
rationale: Members are CNS and PNS myelin formation and maintenance, Schwann cell initiation, OPC proliferation and neurofilament-set axon diameter; confusables are glial proliferation/gliosis or node-of-Ranvier assembly.

name: NOTCH1 intracellular signaling and oncogenic constitutive mutants
rationale: Every member concerns NOTCH1 ICD signaling to the nucleus, including HD/PEST/translocation mutants and FBXW7 loss, whereas confusables cover NOTCH2-4 and generic Notch transcription.

name: NOTCH1 intracellular signaling and oncogenic activating mutants
rationale: Members are NOTCH1 activation, NICD1 nuclear signaling and constitutive signaling by HD/PEST, translocation and FBXW7-loss mutants, distinguishing it from NOTCH2-4 and generic Notch target confusables.

name: NOTCH1 intracellular signaling and constitutively active cancer mutants
rationale: All members concern NOTCH1 NICD signaling and its oncogenic HD/PEST, translocation and FBXW7-loss activation, distinguishing it from NOTCH2–4 and generic Notch target themes.

qualifier: APC/C phosphorylation-driven activation and Cdc20/Cdh1 targets
name: APC/C activation and Cdc20/Cdh1 substrate degradation in mitosis
rationale: Members cover phosphorylation-driven APC/C activation and Cdc20/Cdh1 degradation of cyclin A, Nek2A and late-mitotic targets controlling mitotic exit, whereas confusables emphasize cyclin B/securin degradation, APC/C inhibition and Emi1.

name: Phosphorylation-activated APC/C degradation driving mitotic exit
rationale: Members concern APC/C phosphorylation and activation and its degradation of Nek2A, cyclin A and Cdc20 during mitotic exit; confusables center on cyclin B/securin at metaphase-anaphase, APC/C inhibition or Emi1/Cdc6 control.

qualifier: APC/C phosphorylation and Cdc20/Cdh1 substrate turnover
name: APC/C phosphorylation and Cdc20/Cdh1 substrate turnover at mitotic exit
rationale: Members describe APC/C activation by phosphorylation and APC/C-Cdc20/Cdh1 degradation of Nek2A, cyclin A and Cdc20 during mitotic exit, distinct from confusables on cyclin B/securin degradation, Emi1 or APC/C inhibition.

name: Methylation of rRNA and tRNA
rationale: Members are rRNA base and 2'-O-methylation, tRNA and guanine-N7 methylation with their regulation, whereas confusables centre on pseudouridylation, aminoacylation, mitochondrial RNA modification or rRNA cleavage.

name: tRNA and rRNA methylation
rationale: Members are tRNA, rRNA and guanine-N7 methylation events, separating the theme from confusables on rRNA processing, pseudouridylation, tRNA aminoacylation or wobble modification.

name: Ribosomal and transfer RNA methylation
rationale: Members are rRNA 2'-O and base methylation, tRNA and guanine-N7 methylation and related rRNA/tRNA metabolism regulation, while neighbours centre on rRNA cleavage, pseudouridylation, aminoacylation or mitochondrial RNA modification.

name: CRH-corticosterone driven behavioral stress and drinking responses
rationale: Members are behavioural stress, fear, CRH and corticosterone responses with drinking and ethanol behaviour; confusables are hormone secretion, social behaviours or neuropeptide signalling.

qualifier: fear, CRH and corticosterone, and ethanol drinking
name: Behavioral stress, fear and ethanol drinking responses
rationale: Members are behavioral and hormonal (CRH, corticosterone) responses to stress, fear and immobilization plus ethanol-related and drinking behavior; this distinguishes it from glucocorticoid/ACTH secretion confusables, social/mating behavior and neuropeptide signaling confusables.

name: Stress hormone–driven behavior: fear, adaptation and ethanol drinking
rationale: Members are behavioural stress responses to CRH and corticosterone including fear, immobilisation stress and drinking/ethanol behaviour, versus HPA hormone-secretion and mating/parental behaviour neighbours.

core: RNA virus life cycle in host cells
qualifier: coronavirus, influenza, RSV and dengue entry, replication, translation and assembly
name: RNA virus entry, genome replication, protein maturation and assembly
rationale: Members cover RNA virus attachment, entry, genome replication, viral translation, protein maturation and assembly plus host translational countermeasures; confusables concern retroviral reverse transcription and integration or herpesvirus latency.

core: Viral life cycle in host cells
qualifier: RNA viruses (coronaviruses, dengue, influenza, RSV) rather than retroviral integration
name: RNA virus entry, genome replication, translation and assembly
rationale: Members span attachment/entry, genome replication, viral translation, protein maturation, assembly and host restriction for SARS-CoV, dengue, influenza and RSV; confusables are HIV reverse transcription/integration and herpesvirus latency.

core: Viral life cycle in host cells
qualifier: RNA virus entry, translation, replication and assembly, without reverse transcription or integration
name: RNA virus entry, translation, genome replication and assembly
rationale: Members span attachment/entry, viral translation, genome replication, protein maturation and virion assembly for coronaviruses, dengue, RSV, influenza and HIV structural proteins plus host restriction; confusables are defined by reverse transcription, integration, HCMV and latency.

name: Plasma lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, clearance and cholesterol homeostasis
rationale: Members cover chylomicron/VLDL/LDL/HDL assembly, remodeling and receptor clearance with SREBP/LXR and ABC-transporter cholesterol control; confusables are bile acid synthesis/signaling and vitamin E transport.

name: Lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, clearance and cholesterol homeostasis
rationale: Members cover chylomicron/VLDL/LDL/HDL assembly, remodeling and clearance with LXR/SREBP sterol control, versus confusables on bile acids and vitamin E.

qualifier: assembly, remodeling and clearance with cholesterol homeostasis
name: Lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, clearance and cellular cholesterol homeostasis
rationale: Members span chylomicron/VLDL/LDL/HDL assembly, remodeling and receptor-mediated clearance, ABC-transporter efflux and SREBP/LXR control of cellular cholesterol; confusables are vitamin E transport or bile acid synthesis and signaling.

qualifier: sarcoplasmic reticulum release, reuptake and store-operated entry
name: Intracellular calcium release, reuptake and entry in muscle
rationale: Members regulate cytosolic and SR calcium via ryanodine receptors, SERCA, Na/Ca exchange and store-operated entry to control cardiac and skeletal contraction, while confusables concern fibre-type switching, action potentials or gap-junction conduction.

qualifier: sarcoplasmic reticulum cycling and store-operated entry
name: Muscle sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling and store-operated entry
rationale: Members concern ryanodine-receptor release, SR/ER calcium uptake, sodium/calcium exchange and store-operated entry controlling cardiac and skeletal contraction, which confusables about fiber type, gap junctions or action potentials lack.

qualifier: sarcoplasmic reticulum and cytosolic calcium cycling
name: Sarcoplasmic and cytosolic calcium cycling in striated muscle
rationale: Members cover ryanodine-receptor release, SR calcium uptake, store-operated entry, Na/Ca exchange and their control of cardiac and skeletal contraction, whereas confusables emphasise chemical regulation of heart contraction, potassium/action potential control or gap-junction conduction.

core: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism and its inborn errors
name: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism and biotin-dependent organic acidemias
rationale: Members are mitochondrial leucine/isoleucine/valine breakdown and its defects (MSUD, isovaleric acidemia, carboxylase and biotin disorders), distinct from PDH/OGDH, lipoylation and lysine catabolism confusables.

name: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism, biotin carboxylases and organic acidemias
rationale: Members cover leucine, valine and isoleucine breakdown via BCKDH and its MSUD defects, biotin-dependent carboxylase deficiencies and related organic acidurias, unlike confusables on PDH/OGDH, lipoylation and lysine catabolism.

name: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism, biotin cofactor and organic acidemias
rationale: Members cover leucine/valine/isoleucine breakdown via BCKDH, its MSUD and organic acidemia defects and biotin-dependent carboxylase deficiencies, which the PDH/OGDH, lipoylation and CoA confusables lack.

qualifier: COPI retrograde, endosome-Golgi and Golgi-lysosome routes
name: COPI, endosome-Golgi and Golgi-lysosome vesicle trafficking
rationale: Members share Golgi vesicle budding and COPI traffic, endosome-to-Golgi retrograde transport and Golgi-to-lysosome/endosome sorting, unlike confusables on COPII ER export, Golgi structural organization or plasma-membrane recycling.

name: COPI Golgi traffic and TGN-endosome-lysosome sorting
rationale: Members are COPI budding, intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic plus TGN/endosome/lysosome sorting and secretion, unlike confusables on COPII ER export, Golgi structural organization or endocytic recycling.

qualifier: COPI retrograde transport and TGN-endolysosomal sorting
name: COPI and TGN-endolysosome vesicle traffic through the Golgi
rationale: Members share Golgi-centred vesicle budding and transport, including COPI Golgi-to-ER and intra-Golgi traffic, TGN-to-lysosome sorting and endosome-to-Golgi retrieval, unlike confusables on endocytic recycling, Golgi structure/reassembly or COPII ER export.

name: Sulfur amino acid catabolism with B6 and molybdenum cofactors
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration, cysteine and sulfide catabolism plus vitamin B6 activation and molybdenum cofactor synthesis that serve it, unlike confusables on BH4/phenylalanine, serine/proline or selenium metabolism.

name: Transsulfuration and sulfur catabolism with B6 and molybdenum cofactors
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration, cysteine, sulfide and alkanesulfonate catabolism together with PLP (vitamin B6) and molybdenum cofactor biosynthesis, unlike serine/proline, BH4 or selenium confusables.

name: Sulfur amino acid catabolism with PLP and molybdenum cofactors
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration, cysteine and sulfide catabolism and the vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactors these enzymes require, unlike confusables on tetrahydrobiopterin, selenium, or serine and proline metabolism.

name: TNFR1-NF-kappaB signalling regulation by linear polyubiquitination
rationale: Members regulate canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB and transcription factor activity downstream of TNFR1, with linear ubiquitination, distinguishing it from deubiquitinase, SUMO, IKK-recruitment and NIK-driven confusables.

name: TNFR1-induced canonical NF-kappaB signalling and linear ubiquitination
rationale: Members concern TNFR1 signalling and positive/negative control of NF-kappaB transcription factor activity via linear ubiquitin, distinct from confusables on DUBs, non-canonical NIK signalling or TLR/RIP1 IKK recruitment.

qualifier: downstream of TNFR1, via linear polyubiquitination
name: TNFR1-driven NF-kappaB regulation and linear polyubiquitination
rationale: All members regulate NF-kappaB/transcription factor activity, with TNFR1 signaling and linear ubiquitination setting it apart from deubiquitination/SUMO neighbours and TLR- or non-canonical NIK-driven NF-kappaB neighbours.

name: E2F-controlled origin licensing and replication initiation
rationale: Members cover origin licensing (ORC, CDC6, pre-RC), replication initiation and its checkpoint under E2F control, unlike confusables centred on general cell-cycle or G1/S transcription.

core: DNA replication origin licensing and initiation
qualifier: under E2F transcriptional and ATR checkpoint control
name: E2F-controlled origin licensing and DNA replication initiation
rationale: Members describe ORC/CDC6 pre-replicative complex assembly and activation, replication initiation and its checkpoint/ATR control together with E2F regulation, while confusables are broader cell-cycle and G1/S transcription modules or intra-S damage checkpoints.

name: Replication origin licensing and E2F-regulated replication initiation
rationale: Members cover ORC/CDC6 pre-replicative complex assembly and activation, E2F control and ATR replication checkpoint, distinct from confusables on general cell-cycle/E2F transcription modules, G1/S transcription or intra-S damage checkpoints.

name: Peroxisomal fatty acyl-CoA beta-oxidation
rationale: Members concern peroxisomal beta-oxidation of very-long-chain, branched and medium-chain acyl-CoAs (ALD, TYSND1, fission), distinguishing it from alpha-oxidation, fatty acid elongation/plasmalogen and NAD neighbours.

name: Peroxisomal beta-oxidation of very-long- and branched-chain fatty acids
rationale: Members cover acyl-CoA oxidase beta-oxidation of VLCFA and pristanoyl-CoA, ABCD1, TYSND1 and peroxisome fission with medium-chain products, lacking the alpha-oxidation, ether-lipid and fatty acid elongation members of the confusables.

name: Peroxisomal beta-oxidation of very-long-chain and branched fatty acids
rationale: Members concern acyl-CoA oxidase-driven beta-oxidation of very-long-chain and pristanoyl acyl-CoAs, ABCD1, TYSND1 and peroxisome fission, distinct from alpha-oxidation, VLCFA synthesis and plasmalogen confusables.

qualifier: MTF1-metallothionein; zinc, copper and other heavy metals
name: MTF1-metallothionein response to zinc, copper and heavy metals
rationale: Members are responses to zinc, copper, manganese, iron, cobalt, lead, mercury and selenium plus MTF1 and metallothionein metal binding; this separates the theme from cadmium-specific detoxification and ROS/HMOX1 confusables.

qualifier: metallothionein and MTF1-mediated, broad metal range
name: Metallothionein and MTF1 response to diverse metal ions
rationale: All members are responses to metal ions (Zn, Cu, Mn, Fe, Co, Pb, Hg, Se) centred on MTF1-induced metallothioneins; confusables are cadmium-specific detoxification or HMOX1/reactive-oxygen redox responses.

qualifier: metallothionein and MTF1, multiple non-cadmium metals
name: Metallothionein and MTF1 response to multiple metal ions
rationale: All members are responses to zinc, copper, lead, mercury, cobalt, manganese, iron or selenium centred on MTF1 and metallothioneins, unlike neighbours built on cadmium detoxification or oxidative-stress/HMOX1 responses.

core: Oxidized LDL signalling and foam cell formation
name: Oxidized LDL signalling, foam cell formation and phospholipid catabolism
rationale: Members concern cellular responses to oxidized lipoproteins, cholesterol storage and foam cell differentiation plus phosphatidylcholine breakdown, unlike confusables on HDL/LDL assembly, clearance, efflux or scavenger receptors.

qualifier: macrophage foam cell formation and phospholipid catabolism
name: Oxidized LDL response, foam cell formation and phospholipid catabolism
rationale: Members link oxidized LDL signalling to foam cell differentiation, cholesterol storage and phosphatidylcholine breakdown, unlike confusables about lipoprotein assembly, remodelling, clearance and cholesterol efflux or scavenger receptor families.

name: Oxidized lipoprotein signaling and macrophage foam cell formation
rationale: Members concern oxidized LDL/lipoprotein signalling, phosphatidylcholine catabolism, cholesterol storage and foam cell differentiation, distinct from confusables on scavenger receptor classes, lipoprotein clearance/remodelling and cholesterol efflux.

name: Classical RHO and CDC42-subfamily GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are RHOA/B/C, CDC42, RHOJ and RHOG GTPase cycles and Gbeta-gamma-CDC42 signalling, separating it from atypical RHO/RND and RAC confusables.

name: RHOA/B/C and CDC42-subfamily GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are RHOA, RHOB, RHOC, CDC42, RHOG and RHOJ GTPase cycles and CDC42 signaling, distinguishing it from RAC, RHOD/F and RHOU/V/RND confusables.

name: RHOA/B/C and CDC42-subfamily GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are activation cycles of RHOA, RHOB, RHOC, CDC42, RHOJ and RHOG, distinguishing it from confusables built on RAC, RHOD/F, RHOU/V or RND GTPases and their effectors.

core: Mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation
name: Wnt/BMP-driven mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members are MSC proliferation/differentiation with Wnt and a BMP morphogen module, without the osteoblast and bone formation terms that define the confusables.

core: Mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation
name: Wnt/BMP-driven mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members cover mesenchymal stem cell proliferation/differentiation with Wnt and a BMP-SMAD mesenchymal module, whereas confusables are committed osteoblast, bone and tendon development.

core: Mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation
name: Morphogen-driven mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members pair positive regulation of mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation with BMP/Wnt morphogen signalling, whereas confusables concern committed osteoblast, bone and tendon development.

qualifier: positive regulation via VEGF and growth factor production
name: Positive regulation of VEGF production and sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Members promote VEGF production/signalling, TGF-beta2 production and endothelial migration and proliferation in sprouting angiogenesis; the growth factor production arm and positive direction separate it from the negative-regulation and generic angiogenesis neighbours.

qualifier: via VEGF production and VEGFR signaling
name: Positive regulation of sprouting angiogenesis via VEGF production
rationale: All members positively drive endothelial sprouting through growth factor (VEGF, TGF-beta2) production and VEGFR signaling, unlike confusables centred on Tie2, endothelial apoptosis or negative regulation.

name: VEGF and TGF-beta2 production driving sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: All members promote endothelial sprouting angiogenesis through growth factor production and VEGF receptor signalling; unlike the angiogenesis, Tie2 and endothelial proliferation confusables, the theme centres on inducing VEGF and TGF-beta2 production.

name: Striated muscle excitation-contraction coupling, cardiac conduction and calcium handling
rationale: Members span cardiac action potential phases, conduction and gap junctions, ion channels and sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release/uptake controlling contraction, unlike cAMP/adrenergic, K+ homeostasis and muscle growth confusables.

qualifier: action potential, conduction and sarcoplasmic calcium handling
name: Cardiac action potential, conduction and calcium-handling contraction coupling
rationale: Members span cardiac action potential phases and channels, SA/AV/His-Purkinje conduction, gap junctions, and SR/store-operated calcium release and reuptake controlling contraction, unlike confusables on non-cardiac K+ channels, sarcomere/myogenesis, hypertrophy or cAMP signalling.

qualifier: cardiac electrical conduction and calcium handling
name: Cardiac electrical conduction and calcium-handling excitation-contraction coupling
rationale: Members span cardiac action potential phases and channels, conduction system and gap junctions, heart rate and SR/store-operated calcium handling controlling contraction, unlike cAMP/adrenergic, K2P ion homeostasis, hypertrophy and myofibril confusables.

core: MHC class I and II antigen processing and presentation
name: MHC class I and II antigen presentation, including HIV evasion
rationale: Members span peptide loading, cross-presentation and proteasomal antigen processing for MHC I and II plus Nef/Vpu downregulation of MHC-I/CD4, unlike confusables centred on DC surface/CD1 lipid presentation or proteasome assembly.

qualifier: peptide loading, cross-presentation and HIV Nef/Vpu downregulation
name: MHC peptide antigen presentation and its HIV Nef subversion
rationale: Members span MHC class I/II peptide processing, loading and cross-presentation plus Nef/Vpu-driven downregulation of MHC-I, CD4 and CD8, distinguishing it from CD1 lipid presentation and proteasome-assembly confusables.

core: MHC class I and II antigen processing and presentation
qualifier: cross-presentation and HIV Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation
name: MHC class I and II antigen presentation and HIV evasion
rationale: Members span peptide loading on MHC I and II, cross-presentation and proteasomal antigen processing plus HIV Nef/Vpu downregulation of MHC I, CD4 and CD8, unlike confusables limited to proteasome assembly or DC/CD1 lipid presentation.

qualifier: antibacterial and antifungal killing and agglutination
name: Antibacterial and antifungal innate killing and agglutination
rationale: Members concern host killing, agglutination, metal sequestration and neutrophil cytotoxicity against bacteria and fungi, while confusables center on defensins and antimicrobial peptide production.

qualifier: neutrophil killing, metal sequestration and microbial cytolysis
name: Antimicrobial effector defense via neutrophil killing and metal sequestration
rationale: Members are effector antibacterial/antifungal defense in mucosa: neutrophil killing, metal sequestration, bacterial agglutination and cytolysis; neighbours center on defensins and antimicrobial peptide production.

name: Innate antibacterial and antifungal killing, agglutination and cytolysis
rationale: Members concern host killing, lysis and agglutination of bacteria and fungi (neutrophil killing, metal sequestration, mucosal defense, peptidoglycan handling), whereas confusables centre on defensins and antimicrobial peptide production.

name: p14ARF–p53–p21 axis and its cancer defects
rationale: Members concern TP53 expression, co-factors and p21-driven G1 arrest plus their loss through p14ARF or TP53 tetramerization defects, whereas confusables cover p16INK4A defects or p53 phosphorylation, degradation and DNA-repair targets.

qualifier: p14ARF loss and TP53 inactivation in cancer
name: p14ARF-p53-p21 G1 arrest axis and its cancer defects
rationale: Members describe p53 expression/co-factor regulation driving p21 and G1 arrest together with its cancer defects via p14ARF loss and TP53 tetramerization loss, distinguishing it from p53 phosphorylation/degradation, p53 apoptosis and p16INK4A-defect neighbours.

qualifier: p14ARF defects and p53 loss in cancer
name: p14ARF-p53-p21 tumour-suppressor axis and its cancer defects
rationale: Members concern TP53 regulation driving p21 and G1 arrest and its cancer failure through p14ARF defects or loss of TP53 tetramerization, unlike neighbours built on p16INK4A defects, p53 phosphorylation/degradation or p53-driven apoptosis.

qualifier: ISG15 conjugation and control of viral replication
name: Interferon-stimulated ISG15 and host control of viral replication
rationale: Members combine the interferon-alpha/ISG15 conjugation programme with host processes that perturb viral genome replication, protein levels and release, whereas confusables are type I interferon signalling/OAS/PKR without the viral-replication terms or viral life-cycle terms without ISG15.

qualifier: ISG15 and host suppression of viral replication
name: ISG15 and interferon-stimulated host restriction of viral replication
rationale: Members share interferon-alpha-induced antiviral effectors that limit viral entry, replication and release, with ISG15 conjugation distinguishing it from neighbouring OAS/PKR and type I IFN signature themes.

name: ISG15-driven interferon-stimulated restriction of viral replication
rationale: Members combine ISG15 conjugation and interferon-alpha-stimulated antiviral effectors with host control of viral genome replication, protein levels, invasion and release; C2 lacks the ISG15/IFN arm and C1, C3, C4 are type I IFN signalling without the viral life-cycle restriction terms.

qualifier: SOS activation, GAP inactivation and oncogenic RAS/NF1 mutants
name: RAS GTPase regulation by SOS and GAPs, including oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members cover RAS activation by SHC/SOS, inactivation by GAPs and RAS/GAP/NF1 mutants, upstream of the RAF/MAPK, p38 and ERK-feedback confusables.

qualifier: activity control by SOS and GAPs
name: RAS GTPase activity control by SOS and GAPs
rationale: Members cover RAS activation by SOS/SHC and inactivation by GAPs including NF1 and GAP/RAS mutants, whereas confusables concern downstream RAF/MAPK and ERK regulation.

qualifier: SOS-mediated exchange and GAP/NF1 control, including oncogenic mutants
name: RAS GTPase cycle control by SOS and GAPs
rationale: Members centre on RAS loading by SOS/SHC and inactivation by GAPs/NF1 and their mutants, upstream of the RAF, RSK and ERK-feedback content in confusables.

core: Fc receptor and SIRP immunoreceptor signaling
name: Fc receptor and SIRP tuning of antibody-mediated phagocyte responses
rationale: Members are inhibitory/stimulatory Fc receptor and SIRP signaling regulating phagocytosis, neutrophil and B cell activation and humoral immunity, distinct from FcgR effector/hypersensitivity and neutrophil degranulation confusables.

name: Fc receptor and SIRP tuning of phagocyte and B-cell activation
rationale: Members are Fc receptor inhibitory/stimulatory and SIRP signaling that set thresholds for phagocytosis, neutrophil and B cell activation and antibody responses, unlike the ADCC/hypersensitivity and myeloid activation confusables.

core: Fc receptor and SIRP immunoreceptor signaling
qualifier: inhibitory restraint of phagocytes and B cells
name: Inhibitory and activating Fc receptor and SIRP signaling
rationale: Members are Fc receptor stimulatory/inhibitory signaling, SIRP interactions and negative regulation of phagocytosis, neutrophil activation and BCR signaling; these immunoreceptor regulators distinguish it from FCGR-ADCC/hypersensitivity and degranulation neighbours.

qualifier: optic nerve and ganglion cell axons
name: Embryonic eye morphogenesis including optic nerve formation
rationale: Members cover morphogenesis of optic cup, retina, iris, eyelid and optic nerve with ganglion cell axon guidance, unlike confusables on lens, photoreceptors or inner ear.

qualifier: optic nerve and retinal ganglion cell axon guidance
name: Eye morphogenesis with optic nerve and retinal axon guidance
rationale: Members are eye morphogenesis (optic cup, retina, iris, eyelid, pigmentation) plus optic nerve formation and RGC axon guidance, which the lens/cornea/photoreceptor confusables lack; the ear confusable has a different organ.

qualifier: optic cup, optic nerve and ganglion-cell axons
name: Eye morphogenesis and retinal ganglion cell axon guidance
rationale: All members describe camera-type eye morphogenesis (optic cup, retina, iris, eyelid, pigmentation), with optic nerve and RGC axon guidance distinguishing it from lens/cornea, photoreceptor and inner-ear confusables.

name: Sperm motility, mitochondrial sheath and Sertoli barrier formation
rationale: Members concern flagellar sperm motility, sperm mitochondrial sheath organisation and the Sertoli cell barrier, distinct from fertilization/acrosome, germ-cell, axoneme and motile-cilia confusables.

name: Sperm flagellar motility and mitochondrial sheath assembly
rationale: Members concern sperm motility, cilium beating and sperm mitochondrial sheath organization (plus Sertoli barrier), unlike confusables on acrosome/fertilization, germ cell development, axoneme assembly or airway motile cilia.

name: Sperm motility, mitochondrial sheath and Sertoli barrier
rationale: Members are sperm flagellar motility and cilium movement, sperm mitochondrial sheath organisation and Sertoli cell barrier, distinct from germ cell, axoneme assembly, motile cilia and fertilisation confusables.

name: RNA virus genome replication and host translation subversion
rationale: Members describe influenza, coronavirus and RSV RNA synthesis, RNP assembly and hijacking of host translation and antiviral sensors, unlike confusables dominated by HIV reverse transcription/integration and HCMV.

core: RNA virus genome replication and viral mRNA translation
name: Influenza, RSV and coronavirus RNA replication and translation
rationale: Members describe genome replication, transcription, vRNP handling and host translation takeover by influenza, RSV and SARS coronaviruses, unlike confusables on HIV/HCMV DNA-stage events or translational frameshifting.

core: Viral genome replication and gene expression
name: RNA virus genome replication and viral gene expression
rationale: Members describe replication, transcription, translation and RNP assembly of influenza, coronaviruses and RSV and their manipulation of host translation, unlike confusables on retroviral DNA integration, herpesvirus events and translational frameshifting.

name: Neuropeptide GPCR signaling in sleep, stress and social behavior
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide/opioid/orexin/relaxin GPCR signaling with sleep-wake, stress, mating, parental and aggressive behaviors, beyond confusables focused on feeding, psychostimulant responses or HPA hormone secretion.

qualifier: controlling sleep, stress and innate behaviors
name: Neuropeptide signaling controlling sleep, stress and innate behaviors
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide/opioid/orexin GPCR signaling with sleep-wake, stress, mating, parental, aggression and ingestive behaviors, versus confusables on drug reward, HPA hormone secretion or feeding alone.

qualifier: sleep, stress and social/reproductive behavior via neuropeptide GPCRs
name: Neuropeptide GPCR control of sleep, stress and social behavior

qualifier: nicotinate salvage route, not de novo from tryptophan
name: Nicotinate-derived NAD+ salvage, turnover and NADP+ synthesis
rationale: Members concern nicotinate/pyridine nucleotide salvage, NAD+ breakdown and transport and NADP+ formation, distinct from the tryptophan-kynurenine de novo NAD confusable and the CoA/nucleotide confusables.

name: NAD(P) metabolism via nicotinate salvage
rationale: Members concern nicotinate metabolism, pyridine nucleotide salvage, NADP synthesis, NAD transport and catabolism, distinct from the tryptophan de novo NAD route and from CoA or adenine nucleotide confusables.

name: NAD(P)+ metabolism via nicotinate salvage
rationale: Members concern pyridine nucleotide salvage from nicotinate, NADP+ synthesis, NAD+ breakdown and transport, unlike the tryptophan de novo NAD, CoA and nucleotide-interconversion neighbours.

name: Lymphocyte cytokine suppression with Treg differentiation restraint
rationale: Members suppress IL-2, IL-21, IL-6 and TNF-superfamily production while limiting Treg differentiation and favoring activated T cell proliferation, unlike innate IL-1/TLR suppression or Treg-promoting T cell inhibition confusables.

core: Suppression of T cell-associated cytokine production
name: Suppression of IL-2/IL-21/IL-6 production and regulatory T cell differentiation
rationale: Members negatively regulate IL-2, IL-21, IL-6 and TNF-superfamily cytokine production and Treg differentiation (with activated T cell proliferation), distinct from IL-10/IL-12, TLR/NF-kB and Treg-promoting confusables.

qualifier: T cell cytokines and regulatory T cell differentiation
name: Suppression of T cell cytokines and regulatory T cell differentiation
rationale: Members inhibit IL-2, IL-21, IL-6 and TNF-family cytokine production and Treg differentiation while promoting activated T cell proliferation, unlike confusables centered on innate inflammatory signaling, IL-10/IL-12 or negative T cell responses.

name: Glutamate reuptake and intracellular glutamate homeostasis
rationale: All members concern glutamate uptake by glutamate transporters (astrocytic SLC1A3, SLC17A8 defects) and glutamate homeostasis, unlike the aspartate-transport and GABA/glycine confusables.

name: Glutamate transporters, reuptake and astrocytic glutamate-glutamine cycling
rationale: All members concern glutamate transporters (EAAT1/SLC1A3, VGLUT3/SLC17A8), glutamate reuptake and intracellular glutamate homeostasis, distinguishing it from aspartate transport and GABA/glycine neurotransmitter confusables.

name: Neuronal and astrocytic glutamate transport
rationale: All members concern glutamate reuptake, transport and homeostasis including glutamate transporter disorders; confusables concern GABA/glycine transmission or aspartate transport.

name: Brainstem and pons development with respiratory control
rationale: Members cover hindbrain/brainstem and pons development and maturation plus neural control of respiration, distinct from cranial nerve, cerebellar/forebrain and spinal cord confusables.

name: Hindbrain and brainstem development, including respiratory control
rationale: Members cover hindbrain, pons and brainstem development and maturation with neural control of respiration, while confusables concern cranial nerves, spinal cord patterning or cerebellar development.

name: Brainstem and pons development with neural respiratory control
rationale: Members cover hindbrain/brainstem/pons development and maturation plus neural regulation of breathing, unlike confusables on cerebellum, spinal cord patterning or cranial nerves.

qualifier: interneuron tangential migration and neuron-type specification
name: Forebrain neuron specification and interneuron tangential migration
rationale: Members cover forebrain-specific neuron development (cortical regionalization, GABAergic interneuron and olfactory precursor migration, pyramidal and thalamic development), distinct from hindbrain/cerebellar, cortical layering and retinal/pituitary confusables.

name: Forebrain patterning and tangential interneuron migration
rationale: Members are cortical/olfactory interneuron tangential migration, cortex regionalization, thalamus and pyramidal neuron development, distinct from confusables on cerebellar, hindbrain, retinal or radial migration processes.

name: Forebrain neuron specification and tangential interneuron migration
rationale: Members concern cortical/thalamic regionalization, neuron-type commitment, pyramidal neuron development and tangential migration of cortical and olfactory bulb interneurons, unlike cerebellar, retinal and hindbrain confusables.

qualifier: intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and ureteric bud formation
name: Nephric duct and ureteric bud induction from intermediate mesoderm
rationale: Members trace intermediate mesoderm to nephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching, unlike confusables on nephron tubule morphogenesis or ureteric bud elongation and ureter development.

qualifier: intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and ureteric bud induction
name: Intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and ureteric bud formation
rationale: Members cover intermediate mesoderm and nephric duct formation and ureteric bud induction/branching, earlier than the nephron morphogenesis and ureter elongation confusables.

name: Intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and ureteric bud induction
rationale: Members trace kidney origin from intermediate mesoderm to nephric duct and ureteric bud formation/branching, unlike confusables focused on later nephron or ureter morphogenesis.

qualifier: downstream PLCG1, RAS and FRS2/3 branches
name: BDNF–TRKB signaling through PLCG1, RAS and FRS2/3
rationale: All members are BDNF-activated NTRK2 signaling; confusables cover the PI3K, CDK5, RAC1 branches, NTF3/NTRK3 or downstream CREB/ERK5 events instead.

qualifier: via FRS2/3, PLCgamma1 and RAS adaptors
name: BDNF-TRKB signaling through FRS2, PLCgamma and RAS
rationale: All members are BDNF activation of NTRK2 and its FRS2/FRS3, PLCG1 and RAS branches; confusables carry the PI3K, CDK5, RAC1, NTF3 or NTRK3 branches instead.

qualifier: via PLCgamma1, RAS and FRS2/3 adaptors
name: BDNF-TRKB signaling through PLCgamma1, RAS and FRS2/3
rationale: All members are BDNF-activated NTRK2 signaling through PLCG1, RAS and FRS2/FRS3; confusables add CDK5, PI3K, RAC1 branches, NTF3 ligand or NTRK3.

core: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation and elongation
qualifier: promoter escape and pausing, including HIV-1 Tat
name: RNA polymerase II initiation and pausing, including HIV-1 Tat
rationale: Members cover Pol II preinitiation, promoter escape, CTD phosphorylation and capping, promoter-proximal pausing and early elongation, much of it in the HIV Tat context; Pol II specificity separates it from the Pol I/III rRNA confusables and its initiation/pausing focus from the chromatin and translation confusables.

core: RNA polymerase II initiation and early elongation
name: Host and HIV Tat-driven RNA polymerase II initiation and elongation
rationale: Members cover Pol II pre-initiation, promoter escape, capping, pausing and elongation of host and HIV transcripts; neighbours carry Pol I/III and rRNA transcription.

core: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation and elongation
qualifier: promoter escape, pausing and HIV Tat-driven elongation
name: RNA polymerase II initiation, pausing and elongation, including HIV
rationale: Members cover Pol II pre-initiation, promoter escape, capping, pausing and elongation complex formation, much of it in HIV Tat-dependent form; confusables concern Pol I/III rRNA transcription, translational elongation or nuclear organization.

qualifier: collagen/VWF adhesion and agonist receptor signaling
name: Platelet adhesion, agonist-receptor activation and degranulation
rationale: Members span platelet adhesion via GPVI and VWF-GPIb, thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signaling and degranulation, unlike confusables on the plasma coagulation cascade or integrin/cytoskeletal and G12/13 modules.

name: Platelet activation via VWF, collagen and agonist receptors
rationale: Members cover platelet adhesion through VWF-GPIb and GPVI-collagen, activation by ADP, thrombin, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptors, and degranulation, unlike the coagulation-factor and cytoskeletal or G12/13 confusables.

qualifier: adhesion receptors, agonist receptor signaling and degranulation
name: Platelet adhesion, agonist receptor activation and degranulation
rationale: Members span VWF/GPIb and GPVI collagen adhesion, thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signaling and granule release, unlike confusables on the coagulation protease cascade, G12/13-Rho signaling or integrin-cytoskeleton modules.

name: Cardiac conduction system depolarization and electrical coupling
rationale: Members cover SA/AV node and His-Purkinje depolarization, phase 0, HCN channels and gap-junction coupling, while confusables concern repolarization phases, potassium channels or conduction system development.

name: Cardiac pacemaker depolarization and electrical coupling in conduction system
rationale: Members cover SA/AV node and His-Purkinje depolarization, HCN channels and gap-junction electrical coupling, whereas confusables cover conduction system development or repolarization phases and potassium channels.

name: Cardiac conduction system depolarization and gap junction electrical coupling
rationale: Members concern depolarization in SA/AV node, His-Purkinje and myocytes, HCN channels and gap-junction coupling; confusables cover repolarization potassium currents or conduction-system development.

name: Recombination-dependent DNA repair synthesis and strand invasion
rationale: Members concern homology-directed repair (strand invasion, break-induced replication, SDSA, sister chromatid exchange, cross-link repair) and associated repair DNA synthesis; this distinguishes it from NHEJ/DSB-sensing neighbours and checkpoint/cell-division neighbours.

qualifier: strand invasion and repair DNA synthesis
name: Recombinational DNA repair by strand invasion and repair synthesis
rationale: Members are homologous recombination-type repair routes (SDSA, BIR, sister chromatid exchange, crosslink repair) with strand invasion and repair synthesis, versus NHEJ/DSB-sensing or checkpoint confusables.

qualifier: strand invasion and repair DNA synthesis
name: Recombinational DNA repair by strand invasion and repair synthesis
rationale: Members concern strand invasion, SDSA, break-induced replication, sister chromatid exchange, cross-link repair and repair synthesis, unlike confusables on checkpoints, NHEJ or DSB sensing.

name: K48/K11 deubiquitination by OTU proteases and PKR signaling
rationale: Members are OTU-family K48/K11 deubiquitination and its regulation plus PKR-linked kinase inhibition, the latter absent from the K63/USP/metalloprotease DUB confusables.

name: OTU deubiquitinase K48/K11 chain removal and PKR signaling
rationale: Members concern OTU-family removal of K48/K11 ubiquitin chains and its regulation, plus PKR kinase signaling, which is what separates it from K63/USP/metalloprotease deubiquitinase confusables.

name: OTU deubiquitinase K48/K11 chain removal and PKR signaling
rationale: Members are OTU-family K48/K11 deubiquitination and its regulation plus PKR signaling and kinase restraint; PKR is what separates it from USP/metalloprotease/K63 confusables.

name: Heme scavenging and transferrin-mediated iron uptake
rationale: All members concern acquiring iron in bound form, via plasma heme scavenging/heme transport or transferrin endocytosis with DMT1 (SLC11A2) endosomal export, distinguishing it from confusables about free iron ion import, copper/manganese or cadmium handling.

name: Heme and transferrin-bound iron uptake
rationale: All members concern iron delivery via heme scavenging/transport or transferrin endocytosis (with DMT1 defect), unlike confusables about free iron, cadmium, copper or manganese ion transport.

name: Transferrin- and heme-mediated iron acquisition
rationale: Members are transferrin endocytosis/recycling, DMT1 defects and heme scavenging/transport, whereas the confusables concern free iron ion import, cadmium or copper/manganese handling.

name: Cold and diet-induced thermogenesis via fatty acid uncoupling
rationale: Members cover cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis with fatty acid transport, the fatty acid cycling uncoupling model and N-acyl amino acid uncouplers, unlike carnitine/beta-oxidation, glycerol transport and lipolysis confusables.

name: Cold and diet-induced thermogenesis via fatty acid uncoupling
rationale: Members concern cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis with fatty acid cycling, fatty acid transport and N-acyl amino acid uncouplers, unlike glycerol transport, carnitine/beta-oxidation and lipolysis confusables.

name: Adaptive thermogenesis and fatty acid uncoupling
rationale: Members cover cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis, the UCP fatty acid cycling model, fatty acid transport and thermogenic N-acyl amino acid metabolism, whereas confusables are carnitine shuttle, lipolysis and glycerol transport.

qualifier: antral growth through ovulation and luteinization
name: Ovarian follicle development, ovulation and luteinization
rationale: All members describe ovarian follicle progression from antral growth to ovulation and corpus luteum formation, unlike neighbours about progesterone and luteolysis, testis and meiosis, or oocyte maturation.

name: Ovarian follicle maturation, ovulation and luteinization
rationale: All members cover female gonad follicle growth through ovulation and luteinization, unlike neighbours focused on oocyte meiosis, testis development, progesterone/luteolysis or gonadotropin secretion.

name: Antral follicle growth, ovulation and luteinization
rationale: All members describe late ovarian follicle maturation through ovulation and luteinization, distinct from confusables centred on male gonad/gonadotropins, oocyte meiotic maturation, or progesterone synthesis and luteolysis.

qualifier: restraint by KIR and MHC class Ib recognition
name: NK cell cytotoxicity checked by KIR-MHC class Ib recognition
rationale: Members combine granzyme killing and NK degranulation with KIR, MHC class Ib presentation and protection from NK killing, versus confusables on NK activation, cytokine production and cell signatures.

qualifier: KIR and MHC class Ib control, target protection
name: KIR and MHC class Ib control of NK cytotoxicity
rationale: Members concern NK degranulation, granzyme killing, protection from NK cytotoxicity, MHC class Ib presentation and the KIR cluster, the KIR/tolerance arm separating it from NK activation and T cell cytotoxicity confusables.

qualifier: KIR and MHC class Ib self-recognition
name: NK cell cytotoxicity controlled by KIR/MHC class Ib recognition
rationale: Members concern NK degranulation and granzyme killing, protection from NK killing, KIR genes and MHC class Ib presentation and tolerance, whereas confusables emphasize NK activation, cytokine production and generic NK/T cell signatures.

core: monoamine neurotransmitter synthesis, membrane and vesicular transport, and enzymatic degradation
qualifier: serotonin, dopamine and noradrenaline handling, excluding cofactor synthesis and adrenergic neuron development
name: Monoamine neurotransmitter synthesis, transport and oxidative degradation
rationale: All members are steps in the life cycle of biogenic amine transmitters - biosynthesis, SLC6-mediated uptake and vesicular loading, release, and MAO/COMT breakdown, including the transporter and MAOA disease entries; the confusables instead add tetrahydrobiopterin cofactor synthesis, adrenal and noradrenergic neuron development, or GABA reuptake.

qualifier: catecholamine and serotonin synthesis with MAO/COMT degradation and SLC6 transport
name: Monoamine neurotransmitter biosynthesis, degradation and reuptake transport
rationale: All members handle dopamine, norepinephrine, serotonin or histamine as chemical substrate (synthesis, oxidative degradation, vesicular loading, plasma-membrane reuptake), unlike confusables about adrenergic tissue development, tetrahydrobiopterin supply or GABA transport.

name: Monoamine neurotransmitter synthesis, reuptake and degradation
rationale: Members span catecholamine/serotonin biosynthesis, SLC6 transporter uptake and vesicle loading, and MAO/COMT degradation, while confusables focus on BH4 cofactor synthesis, epinephrine/adrenal development or GABA transport.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism with inborn errors
name: Purine de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism
rationale: All members concern purine (IMP/AMP/GMP, PRPP, adenosine/guanine) synthesis, salvage or breakdown and their enzyme defects, unlike confusables on pyrimidine metabolism or nucleoside triphosphate/thiopurine catabolism.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism with inborn errors
name: Purine de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism with inborn errors
rationale: All members are purine (deoxy)nucleotide synthesis via PRPP/IMP, salvage, degradation to allantoin and HPRT/APRT/PNP/ADA deficiencies, distinguishing it from pyrimidine and nucleoside-triphosphate hydrolysis confusables.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism
name: Purine nucleotide de novo synthesis, salvage and catabolism
rationale: Members span de novo IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis, PRPP, purine salvage and its enzyme defects and catabolism to allantoin, lacking the pyrimidine and NUDT/thiopurine content of confusables.

qualifier: ER store release and store-operated entry, membrane potential, non-cardiac
name: Cytosolic Ca2+ control by ER release and store-operated entry
rationale: Members regulate cytosolic Ca2+ through sequestered-store release, ryanodine channels, store-operated entry, exchangers and resting potential (incl. skeletal T-tubules), while confusables are framed around cardiac contraction and SERCA/heart-rate regulation.

qualifier: ER store release and store-operated entry, non-cardiac
name: ER calcium store release and cytosolic calcium homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate sequestered calcium release, store-operated entry, Na/Ca exchange and cytosolic calcium levels generally, while every confusable adds cardiac-specific contraction and SR pump regulation.

qualifier: ER calcium release and store-operated entry
name: Cytosolic calcium regulation via ER release and store-operated entry
rationale: Members regulate cytosolic Ca2+ through ER/SR release and sequestration, store-operated entry, exchangers and membrane potential (including skeletal muscle excitation-contraction), lacking the cardiac contraction and heart-rate content of the confusables.

qualifier: lysosomal fusion of autophagosomes and late endosomes
name: Autophagosome formation, maturation and lysosomal fusion
rationale: Members regulate autophagosome assembly and maturation and fusion of autophagosomes, late endosomes and MVBs with lysosomes, distinguishing it from selective autophagy (mitophagy, pexophagy) and phagosome fusion confusables.

qualifier: autophagosome assembly, maturation and lysosomal fusion
name: Autophagosome assembly, maturation and lysosomal fusion
rationale: Members regulate autophagosome assembly and maturation and its fusion with lysosomes (including late endosome/MVB fusion), distinct from selective mitophagy/pexophagy and phagosome fusion confusables.

qualifier: autophagosome assembly, maturation and lysosomal fusion
name: Autophagosome assembly, maturation and lysosome fusion
rationale: Members regulate autophagosome formation and maturation and late endosome/MVB/autophagosome fusion with lysosomes, unlike confusables on selective autophagy (mitophagy, pexophagy) or phagosome fusion.

core: NK and NKT cell expansion and differentiation
name: IL-15 and IL-21-driven NK and NKT cell expansion
rationale: Members are IL-15/IL-21 signaling and NK/NKT cell proliferation, differentiation and activation; the NKT cell regulation terms and the IL-15/IL-21 pairing separate it from confusables built on IL-2/7 or IL-10/12/23/27 signaling.

qualifier: NK and NKT cell activation and expansion
name: IL-15/IL-21 signaling driving NK and NKT cell expansion
rationale: All members concern IL-15/IL-21 common-gamma-chain signaling and the NK/NKT cell activation, differentiation and proliferation it drives, whereas confusables centre on IL-10/IL-12/IL-23, IL-2/IL-7 or NF-kB myeloid activation without the NKT-specific terms.

qualifier: NK and NKT cell differentiation and proliferation
name: IL-15/IL-21 driven NK and NKT cell development
rationale: Members are IL-15/IL-21 cytokine signaling and the NK/NKT cell differentiation, proliferation and activation it drives; the NKT cell terms separate it from IL-2/7, IL-10/12/23/27 and TNF-inflammatory cytokine neighbours.

qualifier: MHC class I and II induction
name: Type II interferon signaling and MHC induction
rationale: Members are IFN-gamma signaling, its regulation and response including induced MHC class I/II biosynthesis, distinguishing it from type I/III interferon, Th1 differentiation and antigen-presentation confusables.

qualifier: MHC class I and II induction
name: Interferon-gamma signaling and MHC class I/II induction
rationale: Members are IFN-gamma receptor signaling, its regulation and response, and IFN-gamma-driven MHC upregulation, distinguishing it from Th1 differentiation and type I/III interferon confusables.

name: Interferon-gamma signaling, its regulation and MHC induction
rationale: All members concern type II interferon signaling, its positive/negative regulation and MHC class I/II induction; confusables are type I/III interferon or IL-12/Th1 differentiation.

qualifier: transcription elongation, termination and pre-rRNA spacer cleavage
name: rRNA transcription elongation, termination and spacer cleavage
rationale: Members are Pol I (and 5S Pol III) rRNA elongation/termination plus ETS/ITS endonucleolytic pre-rRNA cleavage, distinct from confusables on Pol I initiation/chromatin regulation, MYC-driven biogenesis or Pol III termination.

core: rRNA transcription and early pre-rRNA processing
qualifier: Pol I elongation/termination and ETS/ITS endonucleolytic cleavage
name: rRNA transcription elongation, termination and early pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Members span Pol I elongation/termination, 5S rRNA transcription by Pol III and early 5'-ETS/ITS1/ITS2 cleavages, unlike confusables centred on Pol I initiation and chromatin control, Pol III elongation or MYC-driven ribosome assembly.

qualifier: Pol I elongation/termination and early spacer cleavage
name: rRNA transcription elongation-termination and pre-rRNA spacer cleavage
rationale: All members concern rRNA synthesis by Pol I (plus 5S by Pol III) elongation/termination and ETS/ITS1/ITS2 endonucleolytic cleavage, unlike confusables focused on Pol I initiation/regulation, Pol III machinery or late ribosome assembly.

name: Myeloid proinflammatory chemokine and cytokine production
rationale: Members concern inflammatory cytokine/chemokine output by myeloid and dendritic cells and its regulation (IL-8, MCP-1, chronic inflammation), whereas confusables emphasise monocyte recruitment and adhesion or NF-kB-driven lymphocyte activation.

name: Myeloid proinflammatory cytokine and chemokine production
rationale: Members are inflammatory cytokine/chemokine signatures of myeloid and dendritic cells and regulation of IL-8/MCP-1 production and chronic inflammation; confusables instead centre on monocyte activation, chemotaxis and extravasation or lymphocyte/NF-kB activation modules.

qualifier: with restraint of IL-8 and MCP-1 production
name: Myeloid proinflammatory chemokine response and IL-8/MCP-1 restraint
rationale: Members describe inflammatory cytokine and chemokine output of myeloid and dendritic cells and its regulation (IL-8, MCP-1, chronic inflammation), distinguishing it from monocyte activation/chemotaxis/extravasation themes and from lymphocyte TNF/IL-23/NF-kB activation modules.

name: CD4 T cell differentiation toward Treg and Th1 fates
rationale: Members promote Treg (FOXP3/RUNX1) and Th1 differentiation and restrain Th17 commitment, while confusables concern T cell suppression, AICD or Th1 effector cytokines.

qualifier: Th1 and regulatory T cell fates, restraint of Th17
name: CD4 T cell differentiation toward Th1 and Treg fates
rationale: Members promote Th1 and FOXP3 regulatory T cell differentiation and restrain Th17 commitment, all CD4 lineage choices, whereas confusables describe negative regulation of T cell activation and cytokines or Th1 effector cytokine output.

name: CD4 T cell fate choice favoring Treg and Th1 differentiation
rationale: Members regulate differentiation of naive CD4 T cells toward Treg and Th1 fates while restraining Th17 commitment, unlike confusables on negative regulation of T cell activation or Th1 effector cytokines.

qualifier: canonical destruction complex, non-canonical calcium branch, ligand secretion
name: Canonical and non-canonical Wnt signaling including ligand secretion
rationale: Members span the beta-catenin destruction complex and its cancer mutants, Wnt/Ca2+ signaling and Wnt ligand biogenesis, lacking the Notch, Hedgehog, Norrin-vascular or Hippo content of confusables.

qualifier: canonical destruction complex, noncanonical calcium branch and ligand secretion
name: Canonical and noncanonical Wnt signaling including ligand secretion
rationale: All members are Wnt signaling, from PORCN-dependent ligand secretion through the beta-catenin destruction complex and its cancer mutants to the Wnt/Ca2+ branch, distinguishing it from Notch/Hedgehog, Norrin-FZD4 vascular and Hippo confusables.

qualifier: canonical and non-canonical, with ligand secretion
name: Canonical and non-canonical Wnt signaling and ligand secretion
rationale: All members concern Wnt signaling (beta-catenin destruction complex and its oncogenic mutants, Ca2+ branch, ligand biogenesis), distinguishing them from Norrin/FZD4, Notch, Hedgehog and Hippo confusables.

name: Sister chromatid cohesion, chromosome condensation and CENP-A deposition
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading, establishment and resolution of cohesion, chromosome condensation and CENP-A chromatin assembly, unlike spindle, meiotic recombination and nucleosome assembly confusables.

name: Sister chromatid cohesion, condensation and centromeric CENP-A deposition
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading and resolution, mitotic and meiotic chromosome condensation and CENP-A deposition, unlike confusables on meiotic recombination, spindle assembly or nucleosome assembly.

name: Sister chromatid cohesion, chromosome condensation and CENP-A deposition
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading/resolution, chromosome condensation and CENP-A nucleosome deposition, distinct from spindle, meiotic recombination or general nucleosome assembly confusables.

name: Dopamine receptor signalling in locomotion and reward learning
rationale: Members cover D1/D2-type dopamine receptor signalling, DARPP-32, dopamine secretion and locomotor/conditioning behaviour; confusables emphasize cocaine, ethanol, opioid or neuropeptide responses.

name: Dopamine receptor signalling in reward and locomotor behaviour
rationale: Members are dopamine receptor coupling to cyclase, PLC and arrestin, dopaminergic transmission and associated conditioning, locomotion and stimulant responses, unlike confusables centred on cocaine, ethanol, opioid or neuropeptide signalling.

qualifier: in reward, conditioning and locomotor behavior
name: Dopamine receptor signaling in reward and locomotor behavior
rationale: Members are D1/D2-class dopamine receptor signaling (adenylate cyclase, PLC, beta-arrestin, DARPP-32), dopaminergic transmission and dopamine-dependent conditioning, locomotion and psychostimulant responses, lacking the cocaine, opioid, neuropeptide and ethanol pathways of the confusables.

name: Lipid droplet biogenesis, turnover and adipocyte triglyceride storage
rationale: Members cover lipid droplet formation, fusion and lipophagy, triglyceride storage and adipogenesis, unlike LXR lipogenesis, fatty acid oxidation or triglyceride synthesis confusables.

core: Lipid droplet dynamics and triglyceride storage
name: Lipid droplet triglyceride storage and adipocyte lipid homeostasis
rationale: Members cover lipid droplet formation, fusion, disassembly and lipophagy, triglyceride storage and phospholipid regulation in adipogenesis, versus confusables on triglyceride synthesis, catabolism or fatty acid oxidation.

core: Lipid droplet dynamics and triglyceride storage
name: Adipocyte lipid droplet formation, triglyceride storage and lipophagy
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation, fusion and breakdown by lipophagy, triglyceride and phospholipid storage regulation and adipogenesis, distinguishing it from LXR, lipolysis, beta-oxidation and glycerolipid synthesis confusables.

name: Chaperone-mediated protein folding including CCT/TriC tubulin folding
rationale: All members concern chaperone-assisted folding and assembly, centred on prefoldin-CCT/TriC folding of tubulin and actin, without the telomerase/Cajal body or tubulin modification content of the confusables.

name: Chaperone-mediated protein folding and refolding
rationale: All members concern chaperonin (CCT/TriC, prefoldin) and chaperone folding of actin, tubulin and ER proteins, unlike neighbours centred on tubulin modification or telomerase assembly.

name: Chaperonin and chaperone-mediated protein folding and refolding
rationale: All members concern chaperone-assisted folding (CCT/TRiC of actin and tubulin, prefoldin, ER folding, refolding, inclusion-body suppression), distinct from confusables built on tubulin modification, telomerase/Cajal body or RHOBTB2 cycles.

core: Postsynaptic actin remodeling in structural plasticity
name: Postsynaptic actin remodeling, synaptic plasticity and dendrite arborization
rationale: Members share postsynaptic cytoskeletal and structural regulation of synapses and dendrites, with NMDAR-driven RAC1 activation, PSD maintenance and dendrite arborization distinguishing it from filopodium/EPHB and BDNF/NTRK2 confusables.

name: Postsynaptic structural plasticity and dendrite arborization
rationale: Members cover postsynaptic density and actin organisation, structural plasticity and dendrite branching, distinct from confusables on filopodia, spine formation, BDNF-TRK and EPHB signalling.

name: Postsynaptic actin remodeling, structural plasticity and dendrite arborization
rationale: Members concern postsynaptic actin organization, PSD maintenance, synapse structural plasticity, local translation and dendrite arborization; confusables emphasize filopodia and RHO GTPase cytoskeleton, spine maturation, or BDNF/TRK signaling.

qualifier: granulocyte lineage (neutrophil, eosinophil, mast) and G-CSF/GM-CSF signaling
name: Granulocyte lineage differentiation and G-CSF/GM-CSF signaling
rationale: Members concern myeloid progenitor commitment to neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell fates with G-CSF/GM-CSF signaling, unlike monocyte/macrophage M-CSF or RUNX-target neighbours.

qualifier: neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell commitment
name: Granulocyte, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation
rationale: Members drive myeloid progenitors toward neutrophils, eosinophils and mast cells via G-CSF/GM-CSF, RUNX1 and retinoid programmes, distinguishing it from monocyte/macrophage, negative-regulation and promyelocyte confusables.

qualifier: G-CSF/GM-CSF-driven neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell
name: G-CSF/GM-CSF-driven granulocyte, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover G-CSF/GM-CSF signalling, transcriptional and retinoid control of granulopoiesis and neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation; confusables cover M-CSF/macrophage-monocyte fate, RUNX targets or negative regulation of granulopoiesis.

core: Inositol phosphate signaling and PI3K/AKT restraint
qualifier: inositol polyphosphate synthesis and post-transcriptional PTEN control
name: Inositol polyphosphate synthesis and PTEN restraint of PI3K/AKT
rationale: Members combine nuclear/cytosolic inositol phosphate and pyrophosphate synthesis with ceRNA/lncRNA control of PTEN and negative regulation of PI3K/AKT and IGF signaling, unlike confusables on AKT targets, PTEN localization/stability or pyrophosphate hydrolysis.

name: Inositol phosphate signaling and PTEN-mediated PI3K/AKT restraint
rationale: Members combine nuclear inositol/pyrophosphate synthesis and PI5P signaling with PTEN control (ceRNAs, loss of function) and negative regulation of PI3K/AKT and IGF1R, while confusables emphasise AKT targets and PTEN stability or pyrophosphate hydrolysis.

qualifier: PTEN control and inositol pyrophosphate synthesis
name: Phosphoinositide signaling: PTEN control and inositol pyrophosphate synthesis
rationale: Members combine PTEN/PI3K-AKT restraint (PTEN loss, ceRNA/lncRNA control, IGF1R inhibition) with inositol phosphate, pyrophosphate and nuclear PIP synthesis; confusables have only one of these halves plus AKT targets or pyrophosphate hydrolysis.

qualifier: FRS/SHC-to-MAPK arm via FGFR1, FGFR3 and FGFR4
name: FRS/SHC-mediated MAPK signaling by FGFR1, FGFR3 and FGFR4
rationale: Members are FGFR1/3/4 ligand binding and FRS2- and SHC-mediated MAPK cascades, lacking the PI3K/PLCgamma arms, FGFR2-specific events and Sprouty/FGFRL1 feedback that define the neighbours.

qualifier: FGFR1, FGFR3 and FGFR4 via FRS2 and SHC
name: FGFR1, FGFR3 and FGFR4 FRS2/SHC-mediated MAPK signaling
rationale: All members are FGF receptor activation and FRS/SHC cascades to MAPK for FGFR1/3/4 (including FGFR3 isoforms and betaKlotho-FGFR4), unlike neighbours dominated by FGFR2, PI3K/PLCgamma cascades or negative feedback.

qualifier: SHC/FRS2 cascades of FGFR1/3/4, FGFR3 ligand binding
name: FGFR1/3/4 SHC and FRS adaptor signaling to MAPK

name: APOBEC and ADAR nucleic acid deamination editing
