core: Nucleic acid deamination editing in antiviral defense
qualifier: ADAR adenosine-to-inosine editing alongside APOBEC cytidine deamination
name: Adenosine and cytidine deamination editing in antiviral defense
rationale: All members concern deaminase-based base editing (ADAR A-to-I, APOBEC C-to-U) and its use against viral nucleic acids; the ADAR editosome arm separates it from HIV-entry, DNA-demethylation and somatic-hypermutation neighbours.

qualifier: RNA editing (C-to-U and A-to-I) plus antiviral restriction
name: APOBEC/ADAR deaminase RNA editing and antiviral restriction
rationale: All members concern cytidine or adenosine deamination by APOBEC or ADAR enzymes, in nucleic-acid editing or in restricting viral and foreign nucleic acids; the ADAR adenosine-to-inosine editing members separate it from the APOBEC3G/HIV, DNA-demethylation and antibody-diversification confusables.

qualifier: ADP, thrombin, prostanoid and collagen GPVI receptors
name: Platelet activation through ADP, thrombin, prostanoid and collagen receptors
rationale: Members are agonist receptor pathways that set platelet activation (P2Y1/P2Y12, PARs, TP, prostacyclin receptor, GPVI, LDL sensitisation), while confusables emphasise G12/13-Rho signalling, degranulation or adhesion and coagulation.

qualifier: agonist and prostanoid receptors (P2Y, PAR, TP, IP, GPVI)
name: Platelet agonist and prostanoid receptor signalling
rationale: Members are receptor-level platelet signalling by ADP, thrombin, thromboxane, prostacyclin, collagen (GPVI) and LDL, whereas confusables emphasise G12/13-Rho and Rap1 effectors, degranulation, adhesion or coagulation.

qualifier: thrombin, ADP, prostanoid and GPVI receptors
name: Platelet thrombin, ADP, prostanoid and GPVI receptor signalling
rationale: Members are platelet receptor pathways (PAR thrombin, P2Y1/P2Y12, thromboxane/prostacyclin, GPVI, LDL sensitization), unlike confusables on G12/13-Rho, Rap1, adhesion or degranulation.

name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil chemotaxis and its regulation
rationale: Members concern formyl peptide receptor signaling, neutrophil recruitment and positive/negative regulation of granulocyte chemotaxis, unlike degranulation, extravasation or chemokine-production confusables.

name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil recruitment and chemotaxis
rationale: Members regulate neutrophil and granulocyte chemotaxis, recruitment and apoptosis via formyl peptide GPCRs, unlike confusables on degranulation, chemokine production or extravasation.

name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil chemotaxis and recruitment
rationale: Members concern positive and negative regulation of neutrophil chemotaxis, recruitment and apoptosis via formyl peptide receptors, unlike confusables on extravasation, degranulation or chemokine production.

name: Oncogene-induced senescence and senescent heterochromatin formation
rationale: Members are oncogene-induced senescence, its control in both directions, and the heterochromatin formation and G0 entry that enforce the arrest, whereas confusables add the secretory phenotype, oxidative-stress and replicative senescence, or defects that let cells evade senescence.

qualifier: heterochromatin-based proliferative arrest, not secretory phenotype or oxidative-stress senescence
name: Oncogene-induced senescence with heterochromatin-mediated proliferative arrest
rationale: All members concern entry into and control of oncogene-induced senescence and the senescence-associated heterochromatin that locks the arrest, while the confusables add the secretory phenotype, oxidative-stress and replicative senescence, and p16/p14ARF evasion.

core: oncogene-induced senescence with chromatin-based proliferative arrest
qualifier: senescence-associated heterochromatin foci and blocked G0 to G1 re-entry
name: Oncogene-induced senescence with senescence-associated heterochromatin formation
rationale: Members tie oncogene-triggered senescence to heterochromatin formation and the cell cycle exit it enforces, unlike confusables that add the secretory phenotype, oxidative-stress and replicative senescence, or p16INK4A/p14ARF defects that let cells evade senescence.

name: Glutathione degradation and transport in gamma-glutamyl cycle
rationale: Members cover glutathione catabolism (GGT1, OPLAH, ACY1 defects) and glutathione/cystine transport, distinct from glutathione synthesis and cystinuria/renal transporter confusables.

name: Glutathione degradation, gamma-glutamyl cycle and cystine transport
rationale: Members cover glutathione catabolism via GGT1, OPLAH and ACY1 and glutathione/cystine transport, distinct from neighbours about glutathione synthesis or cystinuria transporters.

qualifier: gamma-glutamyl cycle inborn errors and cystine transport
name: Glutathione breakdown and gamma-glutamyl cycle inborn errors
rationale: Members cover glutathione degradation and transport, cystine uptake and GGT1/OPLAH/ACY1 deficiencies, distinguishing it from glutathione synthesis, cystinuria transport and ferroptosis confusables.

qualifier: lineage commitment and terminal red cell maturation
name: Erythroid commitment and terminal red cell differentiation
rationale: Members are erythrocyte differentiation terms and blood modules for erythroid-megakaryocytic commitment and late erythroid membrane remodeling; confusables instead emphasise heme/oxygen transport, megakaryocyte development or primitive/definitive erythropoiesis.

qualifier: terminal maturation and red cell membrane assembly
name: Erythroid lineage differentiation and red cell membrane maturation
rationale: Members concern erythroid commitment (TAL1-GFI1B) and late erythroid maturation with membrane skeleton and surface assembly; confusables cover heme/oxygen transport, megakaryocyte development or primitive/definitive hematopoiesis.

qualifier: transcriptional programme and terminal membrane maturation
name: Erythroid differentiation: transcriptional control and terminal red cell maturation
rationale: Members describe erythroid commitment and its transcriptional regulation through late membrane/cytoskeletal maturation of red cells, whereas neighbours emphasise heme synthesis, primitive/definitive erythropoiesis or megakaryocytes.

qualifier: adhesion and polarity, without costimulatory GTPase signalling
name: T cell adhesion, polarity and immunological synapse formation
rationale: All members concern T cell polarisation, raft localisation, aggregation and adhesion at the immunological synapse; unlike confusables built around CD28-Vav1, Rho GTPase and second-messenger signalling, this theme carries the T cell surface, adhesion and migration members.

core: T cell immunological synapse formation and polarization
qualifier: adhesion, aggregation and surface signature rather than Vav/Rho GTPase signaling
name: T cell immunological synapse, polarity and adhesion
rationale: All members concern T cell/leukocyte contact formation (rafts, synapse, polarity, adhesion, aggregation, surface markers); unlike the confusables it lacks CD28-Vav1, Rho GTPase and second-messenger signaling and instead carries adhesion and T cell surface signatures.

core: T cell immunological synapse, adhesion and polarity
qualifier: T cell surface and activation signatures
name: T cell synapse formation, adhesion and surface signature
rationale: All members concern T lymphocyte adhesion, polarization, raft localization and synapse formation; unlike the confusables (Vav1/CORO1A-DEF6 second-messenger signaling) it carries T cell surface and leukocyte activation/migration signatures rather than downstream signaling.

name: Tight junction paracellular transport and magnesium homeostasis
rationale: Members combine tight junction adhesion and paracellular transport with magnesium transport and homeostasis, reflecting paracellular cation (magnesium) flux; the magnesium focus separates it from chloride cotransporter, aquaporin and sodium/potassium transport confusables.

name: Tight junction paracellular magnesium transport
rationale: Members combine magnesium transport and homeostasis with tight-junction adhesion and paracellular transport, distinguishing it from sodium/potassium/chloride transport and aquaporin/inositol confusables.

name: Paracellular magnesium transport via tight junctions
rationale: Members combine magnesium transport and homeostasis with tight junction, claudin-type calcium-independent adhesion and paracellular transport, which no confusable shares.

name: Liver X receptor-driven lipogenesis and triglyceride homeostasis
rationale: Members cover triglyceride synthesis and fatty acid/triglyceride homeostasis including LXR (NR1H2/3) lipogenic and lipolytic gene control, whereas confusables centre on lipid droplet dynamics, lipophagy and triglyceride catabolism.

name: LXR-regulated triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis
rationale: Members concern triglyceride/fatty acid balance and VLDL remodelling, with LXR (NR1H2/3) gene regulation distinguishing it from the lipid droplet and lipophagy confusables.

name: LXR-regulated triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate triglyceride and fatty acid balance, including NR1H2/NR1H3 (LXR) control of lipogenesis and adipose lipolysis genes, whereas confusables centre on lipid droplet dynamics, lipophagy and triglyceride catabolism.

core: Cellular response to nitrosative and peroxide stress
name: Cellular response to nitrosative stress and peroxides
rationale: All members are responses to nitric oxide/reactive nitrogen species or hydrogen peroxide/hydroperoxides, without the apoptosis-regulation, ROS detoxification or hypoxia/ischemia content of the confusables.

core: Cellular response to oxidative and nitrosative stress
name: Cellular response to peroxides and reactive nitrogen species
rationale: All members are responses to hydrogen peroxide/hydroperoxides or nitric oxide and reactive nitrogen species, unlike confusables about stress-induced apoptosis, hypoxia/ischemia or ROS detoxification enzymes.

core: Cellular response to peroxides and reactive nitrogen species
name: Cellular response to peroxides and reactive nitrogen species
rationale: All members are responses to hydrogen peroxide/hydroperoxides or nitric oxide/nitrosative stress, unlike confusables about oxidative-stress apoptosis regulation, hypoxia/ischemia or ROS detoxification enzymes.

name: Hedgehog precursor autoprocessing, lipidation and release
rationale: Members describe Hedgehog autoproteolysis, HHAT palmitoylation, ERAD of mutants and Hh-Np release, distinct from Notch and Wnt ligand processing or generic protein lipidation.

name: Hedgehog precursor autoprocessing and ligand release
rationale: Members concern Hedgehog self-cleavage, lipid modification, secretion and ERAD of mutants, distinguishing it from Notch glycosylation, RAS lipidation and Wnt biogenesis confusables.

name: Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing, lipidation and release
rationale: Members concern Hh autoproteolytic processing, HHAT palmitoylation, release from secreting cells and ERAD of processing mutants, distinguishing it from Notch glycosylation, Wnt secretion and RAS lipidation confusables.

qualifier: negative regulation of myoblast proliferation and differentiation
name: Negative regulation of myoblast proliferation and myogenic differentiation
rationale: Every member is negative regulation of muscle development, myoblast proliferation or myoblast/myotube differentiation, unlike confusables on positive myogenesis, atrophy or satellite cells.

qualifier: negative regulation of myoblast proliferation and differentiation
name: Inhibition of myoblast proliferation and muscle differentiation
rationale: All members are negative regulation of muscle development at myoblast proliferation, myoblast/myotube differentiation and tissue/organ level, distinguishing them from confusables about positive myogenesis, satellite-cell maintenance or muscle atrophy.

name: Negative regulation of myoblast differentiation and muscle development
rationale: All members inhibit myoblast proliferation/differentiation or muscle tissue/organ development, distinct from confusables on positive myogenesis, satellite cells or muscle atrophy.

name: Cobalamin absorption and transport and inherited defects
rationale: Members cover intestinal uptake and plasma/cellular transport of vitamin B12 and CBLIF, TCN2, ABCD4 defects; confusables concern intracellular cobalamin metabolism and MMA disorders.

name: Cobalamin absorption and transport, including inherited defects
rationale: Members cover intrinsic-factor uptake into enterocytes, transcobalamin carriage and lysosomal export with their deficiencies, distinguishing them from intracellular cobalamin metabolism and methylmalonic acidemia neighbours.

name: Cobalamin uptake and transport and their inherited defects
rationale: Members are dietary cobalamin uptake, plasma transport and lysosomal export and the CBLIF, TCN2 and ABCD4 defects; confusables are intracellular cobalamin metabolism and methylmalonic acidemia defects.

core: Presynaptic membrane potential and channel modulation
name: AMPA/kainate receptor activation and presynaptic G-protein channel modulation
rationale: Members combine ionotropic AMPA/kainate receptor activation with G-protein (GIRK, Gbeta-gamma calcium channel) control of presynaptic potential; the AMPA/kainate members are what the nicotinic, GABA and presynaptic-release confusables lack.

qualifier: AMPA/kainate receptors and G beta-gamma presynaptic channel modulation
name: AMPA/kainate receptor activation and G beta-gamma presynaptic modulation
rationale: Members are ionotropic AMPA/kainate receptor activation plus G beta-gamma gating of GIRK and voltage-gated calcium channels and presynaptic potential, whereas confusables centre on GABA, nicotinic receptors or vesicle exocytosis.

name: Ionotropic glutamate receptor activation and presynaptic G-protein channel modulation
rationale: Members are AMPA and kainate receptor activation together with Gbeta/gamma gating of calcium and potassium channels at the presynapse, while confusables share only the presynaptic part and add nicotinic or GABAergic terms.

qualifier: EPO, TPO, IL-3/IL-5 and FLT3 to STAT5
name: Hematopoietic EPO, TPO, IL-3/IL-5 and FLT3 receptor signaling
rationale: Members share hematopoietic receptor signaling to STAT5, PI3K and RAS via EPO, TPO, IL-3, IL-5 and FLT3 (incl. oncogenic fusions); distinct from PDGFRA, FLT3 drug-resistance and IL-2/7/9 confusables.

qualifier: EPO, TPO, IL-3/IL-5 and FLT3 to STAT5
name: EPO, TPO, IL-3/IL-5 and FLT3 receptor signaling
rationale: Members are erythropoietin, thrombopoietin, IL-3/IL-5, G-CSF and FLT3 (including oncogenic fusions) signaling to STAT5, PI3K and RAS with CBL regulation; confusables are gamma-chain interleukins, PDGFR mutants or FLT3 inhibitor resistance.

qualifier: EPO, TPO, IL-3/IL-5 and FLT3 via STAT5
name: EPO, TPO, IL-3/IL-5 and FLT3 signaling to STAT5
rationale: Members are EPO, TPO, IL-3, IL-5, G-CSF and FLT3 (incl. fusion) signalling via STAT5, PI3K and RAS, unlike PDGFR, common-gamma-chain or FLT3-inhibitor-resistance confusables.

qualifier: second heart field, cardiac neural crest, outflow tract and great arteries
name: Second heart field and outflow tract-great artery morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover second heart field specification, cardiac neural crest migration, outflow tract septation and pharyngeal arch, pulmonary and coronary artery morphogenesis, unlike valve, atrial, chamber-myocardium and conduction neighbours.

qualifier: second heart field, outflow tract and great arteries
name: Second heart field, outflow tract and great artery morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern second heart field specification, heart tube patterning, neural crest-dependent outflow tract septation and pharyngeal, pulmonary and coronary artery morphogenesis, unlike valve, atrial or conduction system confusables.

qualifier: second heart field, outflow tract and pharyngeal arteries
name: Second heart field, outflow tract and pharyngeal artery morphogenesis
rationale: Members describe heart tube formation, second heart field specification, neural crest-driven outflow tract septation and pharyngeal arch, pulmonary and coronary artery morphogenesis; confusables centre on atria, valves, trabeculae and conduction system.

qualifier: EPO, TPO and FLT3 to STAT5
name: EPO, TPO and FLT3 receptor signaling to STAT5
rationale: Members are erythropoietin, thrombopoietin, FLT3 and G-CSF receptor signalling via STAT5 and CBL; confusables cover IL-3/IL-5, PDGFR or TKI-resistant mutants.

qualifier: EPO, TPO and FLT3 to STAT5, with CBL attenuation
name: EPO, TPO and FLT3 receptor signaling to STAT5
rationale: Members are erythropoietin, thrombopoietin and FLT3 (including oncogenic ITD/fusion and CBL-mutant) signaling to STAT5, PI3K, RAS and PLCG and its negative regulation, plus G-CSF inactivation and FGFR1 fusion signaling; EPO/TPO terms separate it from FLT3 drug-resistance and IL-3/IL-5 confusables, and FLT3/STAT5 from the PDGFR/ALK/FGFR oncogenic confusables.

qualifier: EPO, TPO and FLT3 to STAT5
name: EPO, TPO and FLT3 receptor signaling to STAT5
rationale: Members are erythropoietin, thrombopoietin and FLT3 signalling to STAT5, RAS, PI3K and PLCG with CBL negative regulation, versus IL-3/IL-5, FLT3-TKI-resistance and oncogenic RTK-fusion neighbours.

name: Pyrimidine nucleotide de novo synthesis and catabolism
rationale: Members span de novo pyrimidine/UTP synthesis and (deoxy)pyrimidine nucleotide catabolism, unlike confusables centred on salvage/dNTP synthesis, purine synthesis or NTP sanitization.

name: Pyrimidine de novo synthesis and (deoxy)nucleotide catabolism
rationale: Members span de novo pyrimidine and UDP/UTP synthesis with catabolism of pyrimidine bases and deoxynucleotides, distinguishing it from pyrimidine salvage/dNTP synthesis and purine-focused neighbours.

name: De novo pyrimidine synthesis and pyrimidine nucleotide catabolism
rationale: Members are de novo pyrimidine/UTP synthesis plus pyrimidine and deoxynucleotide catabolism, distinct from purine de novo synthesis, deoxynucleotide biosynthesis/salvage and NTP-hydrolysis confusables.

name: CNS myelination, oligodendrocyte development and glial reactivity
rationale: Members cover CNS myelin formation and maintenance, oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation and differentiation, and gliosis; the oligodendrocyte/CNS focus separates it from Schwann cell, node and axon-regeneration confusables.

name: CNS myelination, oligodendrocyte development and reactive gliosis
rationale: Members share CNS glial biology: oligodendrocyte proliferation/differentiation, myelin formation and maintenance and reactive gliosis, distinct from Schwann cell/PNS myelination and axon regeneration confusables.

name: Oligodendrocyte development and central nervous system myelination
rationale: Members cover oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation and differentiation, CNS myelin formation and maintenance and glial responses, unlike confusables on Schwann cell myelination, nodes or axon regeneration.

core: Lymphocyte homing and lymphoid tissue development
qualifier: B cells and S1P receptor signalling
name: B-lymphocyte homing and secondary lymphoid tissue development
rationale: Members cover lymphocyte migration into lymphoid organs, lymph node/MALT/GALT development, B cell chemotaxis, marginal zone B cells and S1P receptor signalling, whereas confusables emphasise T cell, dendritic cell and CXCR4 chemotaxis.

qualifier: with lymphoid and mucosal tissue development
name: Lymphocyte homing and lymphoid tissue development, including gut mucosa
rationale: Members cover S1P- and receptor-guided lymphocyte migration and lymph node, GALT and MALT development; the mucosal lymphoid members distinguish it from T cell and dendritic cell chemotaxis confusables.

core: Lymphoid organ development and lymphocyte homing
qualifier: mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue and B cells
name: Mucosal and secondary lymphoid tissue development and B cell homing
rationale: Members cover lymph node and MALT/GALT development, marginal zone B cell differentiation, B cell chemotaxis, S1P signaling and lymphocyte entry into lymphoid organs, distinguishing the theme from T cell and dendritic cell chemokine-migration confusables.

name: HIF-mediated oxygen sensing and hypoxic gene regulation
rationale: Members centre on oxygen-dependent HIF-alpha hydroxylation and HIF target expression, distinguishing it from glycolytic enzyme, mTORC1/p53 metabolic and NRF2 confusables.

name: HIF-mediated oxygen sensing and hypoxic transcriptional response
rationale: Members are HIF-alpha prolyl hydroxylation, HIF-1alpha target regulation, BACH1 and hypoxia/glycolysis gene programmes, lacking the glycolytic enzyme, erythroid and NFE2L2 members of its confusables.

qualifier: oxygen sensing and glycolytic gene induction
name: Oxygen-sensing HIF hypoxia response and glycolytic gene induction
rationale: Members are HIF-alpha prolyl hydroxylation, HIF-1 target regulation and the hypoxia/glycolysis programmes, distinguishing the theme from NRF2, glycolytic enzyme and mTORC1/p53 metabolic confusables.

qualifier: production, impaired clearance and LTP suppression
name: Amyloid-beta production, impaired clearance and synaptic plasticity suppression
rationale: Members concern increased amyloid-beta formation via ectodomain shedding, reduced clearance, cellular response and LTP inhibition, distinguishing it from glial activation and amyloid fibril/clearance-promoting neighbours.

name: Amyloid-beta generation, retention and LTP suppression
rationale: Members promote amyloid-beta formation via ectodomain proteolysis, impede its clearance and suppress LTP, unlike neighbours on microglial activation, Abeta clearance or fibril formation.

qualifier: APP ectodomain shedding and synaptic plasticity impairment
name: Amyloid-beta production, accumulation and synaptic plasticity impairment
rationale: Members concern amyloid-beta generation via membrane protein ectodomain proteolysis, reduced clearance, cellular response to amyloid-beta and suppressed LTP; the neighbours instead emphasise microglial/astrocyte activation, tangles or amyloid clearance.

name: Sour taste and pH-sensing ion channels
rationale: All members concern sensing of acid/pH (sour taste, acidic pH response, TRP and alkaline-activated TALK channels), distinguishing it from other taste/olfaction themes, from the other K2P channel families, and from CFTR anion transport.

name: Sour taste and acid sensing by ion channels
rationale: Members concern sensing of acidic/alkaline pH by TRP and TALK channels and sour taste, which separates them from other-taste/smell, CFTR and other two-pore K+ channel themes.

name: pH-sensing channels in sour taste
rationale: All members concern proton/pH-sensing cation and K2P channels and sour taste; unlike confusables it lacks other taste/olfactory modalities, CFTR anion transport and the remaining K2P channel families.

name: Polarized epithelial protein delivery to apical and basolateral surfaces
rationale: Members concern apical protein localization, apical surface genes, basolateral secretion, Golgi-to-plasma-membrane transport and anion transport regulation; polarized surface delivery distinguishes it from confusables centred on CFTR disease, bile-lipid flippases or exocyst/GLUT4 translocation.

name: Polarized apical and basolateral protein delivery in epithelia
rationale: Members concern apical localization, basolateral secretion and Golgi-to-plasma-membrane transport in polarized epithelia, unlike CFTR/lipid-flippase or exocyst/GLUT4 neighbours.

name: Polarized apical surface protein trafficking in epithelia
rationale: Members are Golgi-to-plasma membrane transport, apical localization, basolateral secretion and anion transport in polarized epithelia; the apical surface members distinguish it from CFTR-, exocyst/GLUT4- and lipid-flippase confusables.

qualifier: E2F transcription, origin licensing and APC/C-mediated exit
name: Cell cycle progression via E2F, origin licensing and APC/C
rationale: Members concern cell cycle phase transitions: RB/E2F G1/S transcription, pre-replicative complex assembly, G2/M checkpoints and APC/C-driven mitotic exit, lacking the spindle, cohesion, cytokinesis and meiosis machinery of the largest confusable and extending well beyond the p53/DNA-damage confusables.

qualifier: E2F-driven transitions, checkpoints and replication licensing
name: Cell cycle transitions, checkpoints and E2F-driven replication licensing
rationale: Members cover E2F/RB G1/S transcription, origin licensing and replication initiation, CDK and APC/C-controlled phase transitions and DNA damage checkpoints, plus proliferation modules; they lack the chromosome segregation, spindle, cytokinesis and meiosis content of the largest confusable.

qualifier: E2F-RB G1/S control, replication licensing and APC/C regulation
name: Cell cycle transitions via E2F-RB, replication licensing and APC/C
rationale: Members cover E2F/RB-driven G1/S transcription, origin licensing and replication initiation, checkpoints and APC/C-controlled mitotic exit; the closest confusable instead centres on mitotic/meiotic chromosome and spindle mechanics.

qualifier: MITF-M control and pigment organelle biogenesis
name: MITF-driven melanocyte programme and pigment organelle biogenesis
rationale: Members cover MITF-M target genes, melanin synthesis, melanosome and related-organelle (dense granule) biogenesis and eye pigmentation, distinct from keratinocyte, intestinal epithelium and UV-response confusables.

name: MITF-driven melanocyte pigmentation and melanosome biogenesis
rationale: Members concern MITF-M target programmes, melanin synthesis, melanosome and related granule biogenesis and light/UV-A responses, unlike intestinal-epithelium and keratinocyte confusables.

name: MITF-driven melanocyte pigmentation and melanosome biogenesis
rationale: Members are MITF-M target programmes, melanin synthesis, melanosome and related-organelle (dense granule) biogenesis, pigment granule transport and eye pigmentation, distinguishing it from keratinocyte/epidermal, UV-response and intestinal epithelial neighbours.

qualifier: death receptor caspase-8 apoptosis and RIPK1 necroptosis
name: Death receptor caspase-8 apoptosis and RIPK1 necroptosis
rationale: Members are Fas/TRAIL/TLR3-TRIF death signaling via caspase-8, c-FLIP and BID plus RIPK1 necroptosis, unlike confusables on intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis, execution-phase DNA fragmentation or T cell/hepatocyte apoptosis regulation.

name: Death receptor caspase-8 signaling to apoptosis and necroptosis
rationale: Members cover Fas/TRAIL/TLR3-TRIF death signalling through caspase-8, c-FLIP and BID plus RIPK-dependent necroptosis, distinguishing it from mitochondrial intrinsic apoptosis, execution-phase DNA fragmentation and tissue-specific apoptosis confusables.

name: Caspase-8-controlled death receptor apoptosis and necroptosis
rationale: Members are Fas/TRAIL/TLR3-TRIF death signaling through procaspase-8, c-FLIP and BID or RIPK1 necroptosis, distinguishing it from execution-phase, mitochondrial and T-cell apoptosis confusables.

qualifier: TGFBR3 coreceptor control and cancer receptor/SMAD mutants
name: TGF-beta/activin signaling via TGFBR3 and cancer mutants
rationale: Members are TGF-beta superfamily receptor signaling (TGFBR3 regulation, activin, AMH) and cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMADs; confusables are RUNX3/Hippo, MET or SMAD transcriptional downregulation.

name: TGF-beta and activin receptor cancer mutants and betaglycan regulation
rationale: Members are TGFBR/SMAD cancer mutants, TGFBR3 (betaglycan) control of TGF-beta/activin/FGF2, follistatin antagonism and AMH signaling; activin and betaglycan terms distinguish it from RUNX3/downregulation (C1), Hippo (C2) and canonical SMAD (C3) confusables.

qualifier: TGFBR3 co-receptor, activin branch and cancer mutants
name: TGF-beta/activin receptor signaling, TGFBR3 co-receptor and cancer mutants
rationale: Members are TGF-beta, activin and AMH receptor signaling with TGFBR3 regulation and cancer-associated receptor/SMAD mutants, distinguishing it from SMAD-downregulation, RUNX3/Hippo and MET confusables.

name: Cobalamin absorption, transport and intracellular processing
rationale: Members span dietary cobalamin uptake, plasma transport, cellular uptake and processing and their inherited defects; confusables are other B vitamins or downstream methylmalonyl/propionyl-CoA defects.

qualifier: dietary uptake, plasma transport and intracellular processing
name: Cobalamin absorption, transport and intracellular processing
rationale: Members are cobalamin uptake (CBLIF, cubam), TCN2/CD320 transport, ABCD4/MMACHC/MMADHC processing and their deficiency diseases; confusables are other B-vitamin metabolism or downstream methylmalonyl/propionyl-CoA defects.

qualifier: including inherited absorption and processing defects
name: Cobalamin uptake, transport and cofactor processing
rationale: Members cover dietary B12 absorption (CBLIF, cubilin/amnionless), plasma transport and cellular uptake (TCN2, CD320) and intracellular processing (MMACHC, MMADHC, ABCD4) with their defects, distinguishing it from methylmalonyl-CoA mutase/propionyl-CoA and other B-vitamin themes.

name: Meiosis I homologous recombination and synapsis
rationale: All members concern meiotic prophase I DSB formation, recombination, synaptonemal complex and its checkpoint, whereas confusables cover cohesion/condensation, meiotic chromosome segregation and spindle, or germline epigenetics.

name: Meiotic prophase I recombination and synapsis
rationale: Members are meiotic double-strand break formation, strand invasion, synaptonemal complex and prophase checkpoints, unlike confusables on meiotic segregation, mitotic spindle, cohesion and germline epigenetics.

name: Meiotic prophase I recombination and synapsis
rationale: Members are meiotic DSB formation, strand invasion, recombination, synaptonemal complex and prophase checkpoints, distinct from confusables on cohesion, meiotic segregation, germline epigenetics or mitosis.

qualifier: KATP channels, incretins and fatty acid receptors
name: Insulin secretion control by KATP channels, incretins and fatty acids
rationale: Members regulate glucose-stimulated insulin secretion via KATP channels, GLP-1/GIP, FFAR1 fatty acid signaling and acetylcholine; confusables add adrenergic inhibition, glucagon or insulin processing instead.

qualifier: KATP channels, incretins (GLP-1, GIP), fatty acid receptors and acetylcholine
name: KATP, incretin and fatty-acid control of insulin secretion
rationale: Members are beta-cell insulin secretion regulators: KATP channels and their disorders, GLP-1/GIP incretins, FFAR1 and fatty acid metabolism, acetylcholine; confusables add insulin processing or glucagon/adrenergic inhibition instead.

qualifier: KATP channels, incretins and fatty acid receptors
name: KATP-, incretin- and fatty acid-regulated beta-cell insulin secretion
rationale: Members regulate glucose-stimulated insulin secretion through KATP channels (ABCC8/9), GLP-1/GIP, FFAR1 fatty acid signaling and acetylcholine; confusables center on glucagon, somatostatin, adrenergic inhibition or insulin processing.

name: Early metanephric development via mesenchyme-to-epithelium conversion
rationale: All members concern early metanephros formation (mesenchyme maintenance and differentiation, renal vesicle, tubule epithelium, ureteric bud/nephric duct), unlike confusables about later nephron segment morphogenesis, kidney size restraint or ureteric bud induction.

qualifier: metanephric mesenchyme epithelialization and tubule formation
name: Metanephric mesenchyme epithelialization and early nephron tubule formation
rationale: Members cover metanephric mesenchyme maintenance, differentiation and mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition into renal vesicles and tubules (with nephric duct and ureteric bud elongation), unlike neighbours focused on nephron segment patterning, ureteric bud induction or negative regulation of kidney growth.

name: Early metanephric development via mesenchyme-to-epithelial tubule formation
rationale: All members concern early metanephric kidney formation (nephric duct, ureteric bud elongation, renal vesicle, metanephric mesenchyme), distinguished from confusables (ureteric bud induction, S-shaped body/segment patterning, negative growth control) by mesenchymal maintenance, MET and tubule epithelial differentiation.

qualifier: reduced VEGF and FGF production and endothelial apoptosis
name: Endothelial growth restraint via reduced VEGF and FGF production
rationale: Members limit endothelial proliferation, tube formation and FGF chemotaxis, suppress VEGF and FGF production and promote endothelial apoptosis, whereas confusables concern sprouting angiogenesis promotion or VEGFR signalling inhibition.

name: Angiostatic suppression of VEGF/FGF production and endothelial survival
rationale: Members restrain angiogenesis by lowering VEGF and FGF production and endothelial proliferation and promoting endothelial apoptosis/activation, unlike confusables about sprouting angiogenesis signalling, its positive regulation or vascular remodelling.

qualifier: suppressing VEGF/FGF production and endothelial growth
name: Anti-angiogenic suppression of VEGF/FGF production and endothelial growth
rationale: Members restrain angiogenesis by lowering VEGF/FGF production, FGF chemotaxis and endothelial proliferation while promoting endothelial apoptosis and activation, unlike pro-angiogenic, VEGFR-signalling or vascular remodelling confusables.

name: Nucleosome assembly including centromeric CENP-A deposition
rationale: All members concern loading histones/nucleosomes onto chromatin, with CENP-A deposition at centromeres distinguishing it from chromosome condensation and histone acetylation confusables.

name: Nucleosome assembly including centromeric CENP-A deposition
rationale: All members concern loading of histones or proteins onto chromatin, notably CENP-A nucleosome deposition at centromeres, unlike the histone acetylation, chromatin disassembly and chromosome condensation confusables.

name: Nucleosome assembly with centromeric CENP-A deposition

rationale: Members concern lipoxygenase-derived HETEs and lipoxins, leukotriene B4 omega-oxidation/catabolism and ether-lipid PAF metabolism, unlike confusables on cysteinyl leukotrienes, receptors or P450 epoxygenase products.

qualifier: lipoxygenase products, lipoxins, LTB4 inactivation, PAF
name: Lipoxygenase-derived eicosanoid and platelet-activating factor metabolism
rationale: Members cover synthesis and catabolism of lipoxygenase-derived eicosanoids (5-/15-HETE, lipoxins, LTB4) plus PAF/ether lipid turnover, distinct from cysteinyl-leukotriene signalling and cytochrome P450 HETE/EET confusables.

qualifier: palmitoylation, Hedgehog autoprocessing, RAS C-terminal processing
name: Protein palmitoylation, Hedgehog autoprocessing and RAS C-terminal processing
rationale: Members concern cysteine palmitoylation/depalmitoylation and lipidation, Hedgehog autoproteolysis and palmitoylation, and RAS C-terminal processing; confusables instead carry GPI anchoring, Wnt/PORCN acylation and geranylgeranylation.

qualifier: Hedgehog autoprocessing/palmitoylation and RAS C-terminal processing
name: Protein lipidation and processing of Hedgehog and RAS
rationale: Members share lipid modification (palmitoylation, depalmitoylation, N-terminal lipidation) and self-processing of Hedgehog plus RAS C-terminal processing, which separates them from Wnt/PORCN, GPI-anchor and geranylgeranylation confusables.

name: Protein lipidation and autoprocessing of Hedgehog and Ras
rationale: Members concern cysteine palmitoylation/depalmitoylation, C-terminal processing and autoproteolysis exemplified by Hedgehog and RAS maturation, distinguishing it from Wnt/PORCN, geranylgeranylation and GPI-anchor confusables.

name: Zinc transport and homeostasis with cadmium detoxification
rationale: Members are SLC30/SLC39 zinc influx, efflux and homeostasis plus cadmium transport and detoxification; confusables concern manganese, copper, iron or metallothionein responses.

name: Zinc and cadmium transmembrane transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members are zinc influx/efflux (SLC39/SLC30), zinc homeostasis and starvation, plus cadmium transport and detoxification; confusables concern copper, manganese, iron or metallothionein/MTF1 responses.

qualifier: ZIP/ZnT (SLC39/SLC30) zinc homeostasis and cadmium detoxification
name: ZIP/ZnT zinc transport and cadmium uptake and detoxification
rationale: All members concern zinc import/efflux and homeostasis by ZIP/ZnT carriers and transport/response to cadmium; confusables instead cover manganese, copper, iron or metallothionein/MTF1 responses.

name: NRF2 regulation and target gene transcription
rationale: Every member concerns NFE2L2 expression, degradation or its target gene classes, distinguishing it from confusables on UPR/FOXO stress responses, ROS detoxification or p53 metabolic regulation.

qualifier: NFE2L2 regulation and target gene classes
name: NFE2L2-driven transcription and its regulation
rationale: Every member concerns NFE2L2 (NRF2) target genes or its expression/degradation, distinguishing it from p53, ER-stress/FOXO and ROS-detoxification confusables.

name: NRF2 target gene transcription and NRF2 turnover
rationale: Every member is NFE2L2-regulated transcription of antioxidant, metabolic, ER-stress and inflammatory genes or regulation of NFE2L2 itself, unlike neighbours on ROS detoxification, FOXO/UPR stress responses or p53 metabolism.

qualifier: osmosensory responses with sodium and potassium transport
name: Osmosensory responses and sodium/potassium transport regulation
rationale: Members combine hypo/hyperosmotic and osmosensory responses with regulation of Na+, K+ and transepithelial Cl- transport, distinguishing them from cation-chloride cotransporter disease, salt-stress and aldosterone neighbours.

core: Cellular sodium and potassium transport regulation
name: Osmotic stress response and sodium/potassium transport regulation
rationale: Members combine osmosensing responses with regulation of Na+/K+ (and Cl-) transmembrane and renal transport, distinct from confusables on salt stress/water homeostasis, aldosterone, or cation-chloride cotransporters and K+ channels.

qualifier: in osmosensing and cell volume responses
name: Osmosensing and sodium/potassium transport regulation
rationale: Members regulate Na+, K+ and Cl- transport (including renal and transepithelial) alongside hypo- and hyperosmotic responses, separating the theme from potassium channel/cotransporter-defect and aldosterone confusables (no osmosensing) and from a salt-stress confusable lacking Na+/K+ transport regulation.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell homeostasis and bone marrow cell numbers
rationale: All members regulate HSC self-renewal, proliferation, differentiation or survival in bone marrow; confusables instead centre on thymocytes, general stem-cell/LIF maintenance or lineage-specific differentiation blocks.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell maintenance and bone marrow cellularity
rationale: All members concern HSC homeostasis, proliferation and differentiation and bone marrow cell number, proliferation and apoptosis, distinguishing it from neighbours about stem cell division/LIF, lineage-restricting differentiation or thymic T cell development.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell and bone marrow cell number homeostasis
rationale: All members regulate HSC proliferation, differentiation and survival in bone marrow; bone-marrow proliferation/apoptosis and tissue cell-number homeostasis separate it from general stem cell, thymic and myeloid-lineage confusables.

name: Suppression of TLR2/TLR4-driven inflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members negatively regulate TLR2/TLR4/LPS signalling and IL-6, IL-1beta and TNF production; the TLR/LPS arm separates it from confusables on IL-10/IL-12, T-cell or NF-kappaB regulation.

core: Negative regulation of inflammatory cytokine production
name: Suppression of TLR2/TLR4 signaling and proinflammatory cytokine production
rationale: All members negatively regulate LPS/TLR2/TLR4 signaling or IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNF production, unlike confusables centred on IL-10/IL-12, NF-kappaB/TNF signaling or T cell responses.

name: Negative regulation of TLR2/4-LPS proinflammatory cytokine output
rationale: Members dampen TLR2/4 and LPS signalling and IL-1b, IL-6 and TNF production, unlike IL-10/IL-12 or NF-kB/TNF-signalling neighbours.

qualifier: cysteine palmitoylation cycle and RAS processing
name: Protein cysteine palmitoylation cycle and RAS C-terminal processing
rationale: Members are protein S-palmitoylation/depalmitoylation, N-terminal lipidation and RAS C-terminal processing, distinct from Wnt/Hedgehog ligand lipidation and RAB geranylgeranylation confusables.

qualifier: S-palmitoylation cycling and RAS C-terminal processing
name: Protein S-palmitoylation cycling and RAS C-terminal processing
rationale: Members concern cysteine palmitoylation/depalmitoylation, N-terminal lipidation and RAS C-terminal processing, distinct from RAB geranylgeranylation, Hedgehog and Wnt lipidation confusables.

qualifier: cysteine palmitoylation cycle and RAS processing
name: Protein S-palmitoylation, depalmitoylation and RAS C-terminal processing
rationale: Members concern reversible cysteine palmitoylation and C-terminal lipid processing of RAS, distinct from RAB geranylgeranylation and Hh/Wnt ligand acylation confusables.

name: Angiotensin signaling in renal control of blood pressure and volume
rationale: Members cover angiotensin signaling and renal renin-angiotensin regulation of blood volume, glomerular filtration and arterial pressure, distinct from angiotensin metabolism and aldosterone/sodium transport confusables.

qualifier: renin-angiotensin control of volume and glomerular filtration
name: Renin-angiotensin renal control of blood pressure and volume
rationale: Members concern angiotensin signaling and renal renin-angiotensin regulation of blood pressure, blood volume and glomerular filtration; confusables emphasize aldosterone/sodium transport or angiotensin and natriuretic peptide metabolism.

qualifier: renal angiotensin signaling and glomerular filtration
name: Renin–angiotensin renal control of blood pressure and volume
rationale: Members concern angiotensin signalling and renal control of blood volume, filtration and arterial pressure, unlike aldosterone/sodium or angiotensin metabolism/natriuretic confusables.

name: RIG-I/MDA5 cytosolic dsRNA sensing and its regulation
rationale: Members are RIG-I-like receptor signalling, its positive and negative regulators and dsRNA antiviral responses, lacking the TRAF/IRF interferon output, viral-evasion and DNA-sensing content of confusables.

name: RIG-I/MDA5 cytosolic dsRNA sensing and its regulation
rationale: Members concern RIG-I-like receptor signaling, its positive and negative regulators, dsRNA responses and FADD/RIP1 NF-kB activation, while confusables extend to IRF3/type I IFN induction, TRAF pathways and DNA sensing.

name: RIG-I-like receptor dsRNA sensing and regulation
rationale: Members are RIG-I/MDA5 signaling, its positive and negative regulation and dsRNA responses, unlike confusables centred on IRF3/IFN induction, DNA sensing or viral modulation.

core: Negative regulation of plasma membrane cation transport
name: Negative regulation of plasma membrane cation transport
rationale: All members regulate (mostly inhibit) Ca2+, Na+ or K+ movement across the plasma membrane, whereas confusables centre on muscle action potentials, cardiac repolarization or two-pore K+ channels and lack the sodium-transport members.

core: Negative regulation of plasma membrane cation transport
qualifier: sodium and calcium flux, outside cardiac action potential phases
name: Negative regulation of plasma membrane cation transport
rationale: All members regulate (mostly inhibit) sodium, calcium or potassium movement across the plasma membrane; unlike the confusables, the theme lacks cardiac action-potential phases and two-pore/Kir potassium channels and instead adds sodium import and transport control.

core: Negative regulation of plasma membrane cation transport
name: Negative regulation of plasma membrane Ca2+, Na+ and K+ transport
rationale: Members restrain calcium, potassium and sodium flux across the plasma membrane; the sodium-transport members set it apart from confusables centred on action potentials, K2P channels or cardiac repolarisation.

qualifier: protection from decay and translational enhancement
name: mRNA stabilization against decay and translational enhancement
rationale: Members protect mRNAs from deadenylation- and NMD-dependent decay (e.g. IGF2BP/CRD binding) and promote their export and translation, unlike miRNA silencing, stress granule or decapping/decay confusables.

name: Protection of mRNA from decay and translational promotion
rationale: Members inhibit NMD and deadenylation-dependent decay, stabilise mRNAs via IGF2BP/CRD binding and promote translation or export, unlike the miRNA silencing, decapping and stress granule confusables.

qualifier: inhibition of nonsense-mediated decay and nuclear export control
name: mRNA stabilization, export and translation, inhibiting nonsense-mediated decay
rationale: All members promote mRNA persistence or use (IGF2BP/CRD stabilization, blocked deadenylation and NMD, export, cytoplasmic translation); NMD inhibition and export distinguish it from miRNA silencing, stress granule and decapping confusables.

name: E2F target transcription at the G1/S transition
rationale: Members share E2F-driven G1/S transcription and its positive regulation, distinct from G2/M checkpoint, DNA replication initiation and RB/CDK-inhibition neighbours.

name: E2F target transcription driving G1/S transition
rationale: Members are E2F target gene sets, G1/S-specific transcription and cell-cycle modules promoting G1/S entry, distinguishing it from DNA replication, RB/CDK control and G2/M confusables.

name: E2F-driven G1/S transition transcription program
rationale: Members are E2F target and G1/S-specific transcription signatures promoting G1/S, unlike confusables on G2/M checkpoints, DNA replication initiation or RB/CDK regulatory mechanics.

name: LXR-driven cholesterol efflux, HDL formation and sterol homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, HDL formation and foam-cell suppression under LXR control, unlike confusables on SREBP biosynthesis, oxLDL uptake or lipoprotein remodelling.

name: Cholesterol efflux, reverse transport and foam cell suppression
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, HDL and apoA-I, LXR-driven transport and sterol homeostasis with inhibition of foam cells, unlike SREBP biosynthesis or lipoprotein remodeling neighbours.

qualifier: reverse cholesterol transport and foam cell suppression
name: Cholesterol efflux and reverse cholesterol transport regulation
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, HDL assembly, reverse cholesterol transport, LXR targets and suppression of foam cell formation, unlike confusables on lipoprotein remodeling, SREBP-driven synthesis or cholesterol import.

name: TCR signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members describe TCR proximal and downstream signaling and its tuning, and the CD28 costimulatory and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibitory pathways distinguish it from confusables focused on BCR signaling or T cell differentiation.

name: TCR signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members cover proximal and downstream TCR signaling, IL-2 output and its tuning by CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition, which separates the theme from BCR and T cell differentiation confusables.

name: TCR proximal signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members cover TCR phosphorylation, ZAP-70 recruitment, second messengers and IL-2 output; CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition set it apart from BCR and T cell differentiation neighbours.

qualifier: hair follicle, glands, nail and melanocytes
name: Ectodermal appendage, hair follicle and melanocyte development
rationale: Members are ectoderm-derived structures (hair follicle, sebaceous and mammary gland, nail, papillae) plus melanocytes, unlike confusables centred on keratinocyte differentiation and cornification or tooth development.

qualifier: hair follicles, skin glands and nails
name: Ectodermal appendage and hair follicle development
rationale: Members cover hair follicle, sebaceous and mammary gland, nail, papilla and melanocyte development from ectoderm, unlike confusables focused on keratinocyte differentiation, cornification or teeth.

name: Skin appendage, hair follicle and melanocyte development
rationale: Members are ectoderm-derived appendages (hair follicle, sebaceous, mammary, nail, papilla) with melanocyte expansion, unlike keratinocyte/cornification and tooth neighbours.

name: Glial fate specification and oligodendrocyte lineage proliferation
rationale: Members regulate glial fate, astrocyte/oligodendrocyte differentiation and glial/OPC proliferation, distinguishing it from midbrain neuron/Bergmann glia confusables and from myelin formation/maintenance confusables.

qualifier: fate specification, proliferation and oligodendrocyte differentiation
name: Glial fate specification, proliferation and oligodendrocyte differentiation
rationale: Members regulate glial fate, proliferation, migration and oligodendrocyte/astrocyte differentiation, distinct from CNS myelin formation/gliosis and Bergmann glia/midbrain neuron confusables.

name: Regulation of gliogenesis and oligodendrocyte differentiation
rationale: Members concern glial fate specification, proliferation, migration and differentiation of oligodendrocytes, astrocytes and Schwann cells, unlike confusables centred on CNS myelin maintenance and gliosis or on Bergmann glia and neuronal precursor proliferation.

qualifier: influenza and RSV transcription, RNP assembly and nuclear transport
name: Influenza and RSV genome replication and ribonucleoprotein assembly
rationale: Members cover influenza vRNP/vRNA synthesis, nuclear import/export and RSV genome transcription, replication and virion assembly, distinguishing it from confusables focused on viral mRNA translation, host-shutoff and coronavirus replication.

core: Viral genome replication and ribonucleoprotein assembly
name: Influenza and RSV genome replication and ribonucleoprotein assembly
rationale: All members cover negative-strand RNA virus (influenza, RSV) RNA synthesis, vRNP assembly and nuclear trafficking, whereas confusables add viral translation, host shutoff or coronavirus replication.

name: Influenza and RSV genome synthesis and ribonucleoprotein assembly
rationale: All members are influenza vRNP synthesis, nuclear import/export and assembly or RSV genome transcription, replication and virion assembly, whereas confusables centre on viral translation, host shutoff and coronavirus replication.

name: NLRP3 and NLRP1 inflammasomes and interleukin-1 processing
rationale: Members concern NLRP3/NLRP1 inflammasome activity and IL-1 precursor processing, distinguishing it from CASP4/5, AIM2 and pyroptosis confusables and from chemokine-production confusables.

name: NLRP3 and NLRP1 inflammasome activation and IL-1 processing
rationale: Members concern NLRP3/NLRP1 inflammasomes, purinergic triggering and IL-1 precursor processing, unlike confusables built on CASP4/5, AIM2 and IPAF inflammasomes, pyroptosis, IL-18 or chemokine production.

name: NLRP1 and NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated IL-1 processing
rationale: Members cover NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome assembly and regulation, purinergic triggering and IL-1 precursor processing, whereas confusables concern pyroptosis, CASP4/5, AIM2 and IPAF inflammasomes, IL-18 or chemokine production.

name: Beta-catenin destruction complex phosphorylation and its oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members are the GSK3/CK1 beta-catenin phosphorylation cascade and CTNNB1, AXIN and GSK3B mutants that escape it, unlike confusables on Wnt ligands, receptors and TCF transcription.

qualifier: destruction complex and its cancer mutants
name: Beta-catenin destruction-complex phosphorylation and its oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members are the GSK3-dependent beta-catenin phosphorylation cascade and its disruption by CTNNB1 phosphosite, AXIN and GSK3B mutants, distinct from confusables on Wnt receptor activation, TCF transcription and AXIN/DVL degradation.

core: Beta-catenin phosphorylation by the destruction complex
qualifier: oncogenic CTNNB1, AXIN and GSK3B mutants escaping it
name: Beta-catenin phosphorylation cascade and its oncogenic escape mutants
rationale: Members cover the destruction-complex phosphorylation of beta-catenin and the CTNNB1, AXIN and GSK3B mutants that evade it, unlike neighbours on receptor-level Wnt events, APC/AXIN degradation or TCF transcription.

name: Peripheral and cranial nerve neuron development and innervation
rationale: Members cover sympathetic, DRG, trigeminal, facial and branchiomotor neuron differentiation, migration and axon outgrowth; the peripheral/sympathetic innervation members separate it from hindbrain and cranial ganglion confusables.

qualifier: sensory, sympathetic and branchiomotor cranial nerves
name: Peripheral and cranial nerve neuron development and innervation
rationale: All members concern development, migration and axon outgrowth of peripheral and cranial nerve neurons (DRG, sympathetic, facial, trigeminal, branchiomotor), distinguishing it from brainstem/hindbrain maturation and generic axon guidance confusables.

core: Peripheral and cranial nerve neuron development
name: Peripheral sensory, sympathetic and cranial nerve neuron development
rationale: All members concern development, migration and axon outgrowth of DRG, sympathetic and trigeminal/facial (branchiomotor) neurons, unlike confusables centred on CNS monoaminergic axon guidance or brainstem/hindbrain maturation.

name: Fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation of glycolysis and lactate production
rationale: Members cover fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control of glycolysis, pentose-phosphate shunt and lactate fermentation, while confusables add hexokinase and fructose-1,6-bisphosphate steps or p53/mTORC1 metabolic programs.

name: Fructose 2,6-bisphosphate regulation of glycolysis and pentose phosphate flux
rationale: Members concern fructose 2,6-bisphosphate metabolism controlling glycolysis, lactate fermentation and the pentose phosphate shunt, whereas confusables cover core glucose catabolism, hexokinase defects or p53/mTORC1 metabolic programmes.

name: Fructose 2,6-bisphosphate control of glycolytic and lactate flux
rationale: Members regulate glycolysis via fructose 2,6-bisphosphate, pentose-phosphate branching and lactate fermentation, distinguishing them from confusables on core glucose catabolism or p53/mTORC1 metabolic genes.

qualifier: hemidesmosome assembly via integrins and laminins
name: Hemidesmosome and basement membrane adhesion via integrins and laminins
rationale: Members are integrin and laminin interactions, collagen trimerization, anchoring fibrils and hemidesmosome assembly; hemidesmosomes distinguish it from DGC, collagen crosslinking and desmosome/cell-cell adhesion neighbours.

name: Hemidesmosome assembly and basement membrane laminin-integrin anchorage
rationale: Members cover laminin/collagen basement membrane and integrin interactions together with hemidesmosome assembly, which distinguishes it from collagen/elastic fibre, dystroglycan and desmosome confusables.

name: Hemidesmosome and basement membrane integrin-laminin adhesion
rationale: Members concern epithelial anchoring to the basement membrane through integrin-laminin interactions, anchoring fibril collagen and hemidesmosome assembly; hemidesmosomes and integrin surface interactions are what the desmosome, dystroglycan and collagen-crosslinking confusables lack.

qualifier: fibronectin matrix and SRF-driven stress fibres in fibroblasts
name: Fibronectin-integrin-syndecan adhesion driving stress fibres and fibroblast migration
rationale: Members link fibronectin matrix, integrin/syndecan adhesion and SRF-dependent cytoskeletal remodeling to stress fibres and fibroblast migration, distinguishing from confusables on ROCK/PAK signaling, invadopodia, MET-PTK2 or focal adhesion assembly.

core: Cell-matrix adhesion signaling to the actin cytoskeleton
qualifier: fibronectin, integrin and syndecan; stress fibers and fibroblast migration
name: Fibronectin-integrin-syndecan adhesion driving stress fibers and fibroblast migration
rationale: Members link fibronectin matrix, integrin synthesis and syndecan interactions to SRF-dependent cytoskeletal remodeling, stress fibers and fibroblast migration, unlike confusables centred on focal adhesion assembly, ROCK/PAK, MET-PTK2 or invadopodia.

core: Fibronectin matrix adhesion and actin stress fibers
name: Fibronectin matrix adhesion driving stress fibers and fibroblast migration
rationale: Members link fibronectin matrix formation, syndecan and integrin adhesion to SRF-driven cytoskeletal remodelling, stress fiber assembly and fibroblast migration, unlike confusables on focal adhesion turnover, invadopodia, ROCK/PAK signaling or MET-PTK2 signaling.

name: Nuclear pore complex assembly, disassembly and positioning
rationale: Members cover mitotic NPC disassembly and reformation, pore localization and gene tethering at the nuclear periphery, as opposed to confusables about nucleocytoplasmic cargo transport or lamina/envelope remodeling.

core: Nuclear pore complex assembly and disassembly
name: Nuclear pore complex mitotic disassembly, reassembly and positioning
rationale: All members concern nuclear pore complex structure through mitosis (disassembly, postmitotic reformation, assembly, localization, gene tethering at the pore), whereas confusables cover nucleocytoplasmic cargo transport or lamina/envelope breakdown.

name: Nuclear pore complex assembly, disassembly and positioning
rationale: Every member concerns building, dismantling, reforming or localizing nuclear pores (including gene tethering at the periphery), whereas confusables cover nuclear envelope/lamina remodeling or cargo transport through the pore.

qualifier: naive/memory B cell surface and plasma cell immunoglobulin
name: Naive, memory B cell and plasma cell immunoglobulin signatures
rationale: Members are B cell, naive and memory B cell surface and plasma cell immunoglobulin expression modules plus plasma cell and germinal center differentiation; these signature modules distinguish it from confusables built on B cell activation, ICOS/Tfh co-stimulation or TBA modules.

name: Naive, memory and plasma B cell gene signatures
rationale: Members are B cell, naive/memory and plasma cell immunoglobulin expression signatures plus plasma cell and germinal centre differentiation, lacking the ICOS/Tfh help and B cell activation/proliferation pathways of the confusables.

core: B cell and plasma cell signatures
name: B cell and plasma cell transcriptional signatures
rationale: Members are B cell, naive/memory B and plasma cell immunoglobulin expression modules with plasma cell and germinal centre differentiation; these signatures distinguish it from confusables built on Tfh/ICOS help and B cell proliferation signaling.

qualifier: with inositol phosphate and pyrophosphate synthesis
name: PTEN-AKT signaling and inositol polyphosphate synthesis
rationale: Members cover PTEN regulation and loss, AKT activation and targets, restraint of PI3K/IGF/ERBB signaling, and nuclear/cytosolic inositol phosphate and pyrophosphate synthesis; this PTEN-AKT-inositol combination separates it from confusables about serine phosphorylation, pyrophosphate hydrolysis or PAK-2p34.

qualifier: with nuclear and cytosolic inositol (pyro)phosphate synthesis
name: PTEN regulation of PI3K-AKT signaling and inositol phosphate synthesis
rationale: Members cover PTEN regulation, AKT signaling outputs and inositol phosphate/pyrophosphate synthesis, which distinguishes it from PAK-2p34, pyrophosphate hydrolysis and serine-phosphorylation neighbours.

name: PTEN-AKT signaling control and inositol polyphosphate synthesis
rationale: Members cover PTEN regulation and loss, AKT activity and negative PI3K/AKT control alongside nuclear and cytosolic inositol phosphate/pyrophosphate synthesis; the PTEN/AKT arm distinguishes it from confusables limited to pyrophosphate hydrolysis or PAK-2 signaling.

qualifier: TLR-driven IRAK/TRIF activation of TAK1 and IKK
name: TLR-triggered TAK1/IKK activation and canonical NF-kappaB signaling
rationale: Members describe Toll-like receptor IRAK1/2 and TRIF/TRAF6 activation of TAK1 and IKK leading to canonical NF-kappaB, unlike confusables on TNFR1, non-canonical NF-kappaB or TAK1-JNK/p38.

name: Toll-like receptor IRAK-TRAF6-TAK1 activation of canonical NF-kB
rationale: Members describe TLR (MyD88/IRAK and TRIF) signalling through TRAF6/TAK1 to IKK and canonical NF-kB, unlike confusables on TAK1-JNK/p38, TNFR1 or non-canonical NF-kB signalling.

name: Toll-like receptor TAK1-IKK activation of canonical NF-kB
rationale: Members describe TLR4 (TRIF) and TLR7/8/9 (IRAK1/2, TRAF6) recruitment of TAK1 and IKK and positive regulation of canonical NF-kB, unlike confusables on non-canonical NF-kB, TAK1-JNK/p38 or TNFR1 signaling.

core: Coronavirus replicase expression and viral genome replication
name: Coronavirus replicase expression and viral genome replication
rationale: Members cover SARS-CoV replicase translation, frameshifting and maturation, viral genome replication and its host regulation, and viral manipulation of host translation and capping; unlike the confusables it lacks RNA editing/APOBEC restriction and centres on replication rather than viral mRNA translation or PKR.

core: Viral genome replication and replicase translation
name: Coronavirus replicase translation and genome replication
rationale: Members cover SARS-CoV replicase translation, frameshifting, capping, IFIT evasion and host control of viral replication, distinguishing it from confusables built on APOBEC3G/RNA editing restriction or PKR-centred viral mRNA translation.

qualifier: replicase translation and host translation control
name: Coronavirus replicase translation and genome replication
rationale: Members cover SARS-CoV replicase translation (frameshifting, capping), maturation, genome replication and host translation modulation, whereas confusables centre on viral RNA editing/APOBEC restriction or PKR and general viral mRNA translation.

name: Lipoprotein receptor endocytosis, degradation and LDL clearance
rationale: Members concern LDL/VLDL receptor internalisation, lysosomal degradation, reduced recycling and LDL clearance with sterol homeostasis, unlike triglyceride-rich lipoprotein remodeling and SREBP/cholesterol-synthesis confusables.

qualifier: LDL/VLDL receptor endocytosis limiting cholesterol uptake
name: Lipoprotein receptor internalization and degradation in cholesterol uptake
rationale: Members concern clathrin-mediated receptor internalization, reduced recycling and lysosomal degradation, centred on LDLR/VLDLR clearance and LXR-limited cholesterol uptake, distinct from confusables on lipase-driven lipoprotein remodelling, SREBP cholesterol sensing and generic endocytosis inhibition.

name: Receptor internalization and degradation controlling LDL cholesterol uptake
rationale: Members concern cargo recognition, receptor internalization, recycling and lysosomal degradation, especially LDLR/VLDLR, together with sterol homeostasis, unlike confusables on caveolar endocytosis, SREBP control or chylomicron/VLDL lipolysis.

name: ABCA1-mediated lipid efflux and HDL/LDL particle remodeling
rationale: Members cover ABCA1/apoA-I phospholipid efflux, HDL assembly and HDL/LDL remodeling, whereas confusables centre on regulation of cholesterol efflux, LXR targets and foam cells.

name: ABCA1-mediated HDL assembly and lipoprotein remodeling
rationale: Members concern ABCA1/apoA-I phospholipid efflux, HDL assembly and HDL/LDL remodeling, while confusables centre on regulation of cholesterol efflux, LXR gene expression and foam cell formation.

qualifier: ABCA1-mediated HDL assembly and phospholipid efflux
name: ABCA1-mediated HDL assembly and lipoprotein particle remodeling
rationale: Members cover HDL assembly via ABCA1 phospholipid efflux, apoA-I signaling and HDL/LDL particle remodeling, while confusables emphasise LXR-driven cholesterol efflux regulation, foam cells and HDL clearance.

core: Regulation of sequestered calcium release and cytosolic calcium
qualifier: ryanodine receptor release and Na+/Ca2+ exchange clearance
name: Ryanodine-receptor calcium release and Na+/Ca2+ exchange clearance
rationale: Members regulate release of ER/SR calcium through ryanodine-sensitive channels (including in skeletal muscle) and lowering of cytosolic calcium by Na+/Ca2+ exchangers, lacking the cardiac, SERCA-pump and store-operated entry terms of confusables.

name: Regulation of ER calcium release and cytosolic calcium clearance
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine-receptor release of sequestered ER calcium and its removal from the cytosol (Na+/Ca2+ exchange, ER re-uptake), distinguishing it from cardiac-specific, SERCA-only or store-operated calcium entry confusables.

qualifier: ER/sarcoplasmic calcium release and cytosolic clearance outside cardiac context
name: Regulation of ER calcium release and cytosolic calcium reduction
rationale: Members regulate release of sequestered calcium (ryanodine receptor, skeletal muscle) and lower cytosolic calcium via Na+/Ca2+ exchange and sequestration, without the cardiac contraction or store-operated entry pathways of the confusables.

qualifier: HSF1 heat shock and chaperone refolding
name: HSF1 heat shock response and chaperone-mediated protein refolding
rationale: Members cover HSF1 activation and attenuation, heat acclimation and chaperone-driven refolding (including UPRmt), distinguishing it from chaperonin folding, ER UPR and stress-granule neighbours.

core: Heat shock response and chaperone-mediated protein refolding
name: HSF1 heat shock response and chaperone-assisted protein refolding
rationale: Members cover HSF1 activation and attenuation, heat acclimation and chaperone refolding (including UPRmt and ER folding), distinguishing it from stress granule, ATF4/ATF6/IRE1 UPR, de novo chaperonin folding and aggrephagy confusables.

name: HSF1 heat shock response and chaperone-mediated protein refolding
rationale: Members cover HSF1 activation and attenuation, heat acclimation and chaperone refolding (including ER and mitochondrial protein-folding stress), distinguishing it from de novo folding, stress granule and ER UPR confusables.

qualifier: COPII export and COPI retrograde coat-mediated transport
name: COPII and COPI coated vesicle traffic between ER and Golgi
rationale: Members are COPII cargo loading/coating and ER export plus COPI budding and retrograde traffic, unlike confusables on vesicle targeting/tethering, ER quality control/ERAD or SRP-dependent ER targeting.

qualifier: COPII anterograde export and COPI retrograde return
name: COPII ER-to-Golgi export and COPI retrograde vesicle traffic
rationale: Members are COPII cargo loading/coat formation at ER exit sites and COPI budding for Golgi-to-ER return, distinguishing it from ER targeting/quality-control and vesicle tethering confusables.

qualifier: COPII cargo export and COPI retrograde coats
name: COPII cargo export and COPI retrograde ER-Golgi vesicle traffic
rationale: Members concern COPII cargo loading and budding and COPI Golgi-to-ER retrieval, rather than vesicle tethering/targeting or ER translocation and quality control in confusables.

qualifier: positive regulation via transcription of death genes
name: p53 transcriptional induction of apoptosis genes
rationale: Members are p53 transcription of caspases, death receptors and cytochrome-c release genes plus positive regulation of p53-mediated intrinsic apoptosis; confusables hold the negative regulation, BH3-only mitochondrial steps or p53 G1 arrest and expression control.

qualifier: positive transcriptional induction after DNA damage
name: p53-driven transcriptional induction of apoptosis after DNA damage
rationale: All members are p53 transcription of death genes or positive regulation of p53/DNA-damage intrinsic apoptosis, distinct from confusables with negative regulation, G1 arrest or BH3-only effector steps.

name: p53-dependent transcriptional induction of apoptosis after DNA damage
rationale: Members are p53 transcription of pro-death genes and positive regulation of p53-mediated intrinsic apoptosis, unlike BH3-only, p53 cell-cycle arrest and negative-regulation confusables.

qualifier: with ureteric bud and ureter development
