rationale: Members are homophilic/heterophilic neuronal adhesion (DSCAM, SDK, nectin, RPTP) and dendrite self-avoidance, whereas confusables centre on L1-family, neurofascin/paranodal or retinal differentiation.

core: Regulation of antibody-Fc receptor effector responses
qualifier: ADCC, type II hypersensitivity and acute antigen-driven inflammation
name: Antibody-Fc receptor effector regulation, ADCC and type II hypersensitivity
rationale: Members regulate circulating-immunoglobulin effector functions through activating/inhibitory Fc receptors, ADCC, phagocytosis and type II hypersensitivity, while confusables center on FCGR phagocytic machinery, neutrophil degranulation or B cell receptor inhibition.

core: Fc receptor regulation of antibody effector responses
qualifier: acute inflammation, ADCC and type II hypersensitivity
name: Fc receptor control of antibody-mediated inflammation and cytotoxicity
rationale: Members concern stimulatory/inhibitory Fc receptor signalling governing antibody-driven acute inflammation, ADCC, type II hypersensitivity and phagocytosis, distinct from confusables centred on FCGR phagocytic machinery, BCR inhibition or neutrophil degranulation.

core: Fc receptor regulation of antibody effector responses
qualifier: ADCC, type II hypersensitivity, acute antigenic inflammation
name: Fc receptor control of antibody effector and hypersensitivity responses
rationale: Members are Fc receptor stimulatory/inhibitory signaling governing ADCC, type II hypersensitivity, phagocytosis and antigen-triggered acute inflammation, unlike confusables centred on FCGR phagocytic cup formation, BCR or neutrophil degranulation.

core: Organic ion and xenobiotic transmembrane transport
name: Xenobiotic efflux and organic ion transmembrane transport
rationale: Members are transmembrane transport of xenobiotics (export, blood-brain barrier) and of organic cations/anions including alpha-ketoglutarate, distinguished from monocarboxylate/dicarboxylate transporter and drug-ADME/SLCO organic anion confusables by xenobiotic export and organic cation transport.

name: Organic ion transport and xenobiotic efflux
rationale: Members cover organic cation/anion and dicarboxylate transport plus xenobiotic export including at the blood-brain barrier, distinguishing it from monocarboxylate transport and SLCO-based drug ADME confusables.

core: Organic ion and xenobiotic transmembrane transport
qualifier: xenobiotic export including blood-brain barrier, organic cations
name: Xenobiotic export and organic cation/anion transport
rationale: Members cover organic cation/anion and xenobiotic transmembrane transport including efflux at the blood-brain barrier, distinguishing it from drug ADME/SLCO and monocarboxylate/dicarboxylate confusables.

name: Tyrosine and phenylalanine catabolism
rationale: Members are tyrosine catabolism plus phenylalanine and general L-amino acid breakdown terms, distinguishing it from histidine, threonine and glycine/glyoxylate catabolism neighbours and from the phenylketonuria-focused neighbour.

name: Tyrosine and phenylalanine catabolism
rationale: Members are tyrosine/phenylalanine catabolism plus general L-amino acid catabolic terms, unlike glycine, threonine and histidine catabolism neighbours.

name: Tyrosine and phenylalanine catabolism
rationale: Members are tyrosine/phenylalanine breakdown plus generic amino acid catabolic parent terms; tyrosine degradation distinguishes it from glycine/glyoxylate, threonine and histidine catabolism neighbours, while the phenylketonuria neighbour lacks the tyrosine-catabolic emphasis.

name: Mesenchymal cell proliferation and epithelial-mesenchymal signaling
rationale: Members concern mesenchymal cell proliferation and reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung mesenchyme and limb bud, while confusables centre on epithelial branching of salivary, prostate or pancreatic glands.

qualifier: mesenchyme proliferation in lung and limb bud
name: Lung and limb bud mesenchyme proliferation via epithelial crosstalk
rationale: Members are reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signalling and mesenchymal cell proliferation in lung and limb bud, whereas the confusables concern epithelial branching in prostate, salivary gland and pancreas.

qualifier: mesenchymal proliferation in lung and limb bud
name: Mesenchymal proliferation and epithelial-mesenchymal signalling in lung, limb
rationale: Members are reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signalling and mesenchymal proliferation in lung and limb bud development, whereas confusables concern glandular epithelial branching in prostate, salivary gland or pancreas.

name: Bone marrow development and cell number homeostasis
rationale: Members concern bone marrow development, cell proliferation/apoptosis and tissue cell-number homeostasis, unlike thymic T cell and HSC confusables.

qualifier: marrow cell proliferation, survival and number homeostasis
name: Bone marrow development and cell number homeostasis
rationale: Members concern bone marrow development, proliferation, apoptosis and cell-number homeostasis (with M-CSF and VENTX), distinct from thymic T-cell and HSC confusables.

name: Bone marrow development and cellularity homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate bone marrow development, marrow cell proliferation/apoptosis and tissue cell number, distinct from HSC and thymocyte neighbours.

name: Fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control of glycolysis and pentose-phosphate flux
rationale: Members describe fructose bisphosphate metabolism regulating glycolysis and pentose-phosphate shunt flux, while confusables are lactate fermentation, hexokinase/glucose catabolism or p53/mTORC1 metabolic programs.

qualifier: fructose 2,6-bisphosphate control balancing glycolysis and pentose phosphate shunt
name: Fructose 2,6-bisphosphate control of glycolysis versus pentose phosphate shunt
rationale: Members concern fructose 2,6- and 1,6-bisphosphate metabolism regulating glycolytic versus pentose-phosphate flux, unlike confusables centred on fermentation/lactate production, hexokinase or mTORC1/p53 metabolic programmes.

name: Glycolysis regulation by fructose bisphosphates and pentose-phosphate shunt
rationale: Members control glycolytic flux via fructose 1,6- and 2,6-bisphosphate and PPP diversion, unlike confusables on fermentation/lactate, hexokinase or p53/mTORC1 metabolic programs.

name: Selenium metabolism and selenocysteine incorporation
rationale: Members cover conversion of ingested selenium compounds to selenide, methylation for excretion, selenocysteine synthesis and readthrough insertion, distinguishing it from sulfur, methionine and redox neighbours.

name: Selenium metabolism and selenocysteine incorporation
rationale: Members cover conversion and excretion of dietary selenium compounds plus selenocysteine synthesis and UGA readthrough, distinguishing it from sulfur amino acid, methionine and ROS-detoxification confusables.

name: Dietary selenium metabolism and selenocysteine synthesis
rationale: Members cover conversion of ingested selenium compounds to selenide, methylation for excretion and selenocysteine synthesis/UGA readthrough, unlike sulfur amino acid, ROS and methionine confusables.

name: Bile acid metabolism and intestinal sterol absorption
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis, recycling, transport, signaling and transporter defects plus intestinal cholesterol/lipid absorption (ABCG5/8), distinguishing from xenobiotic-transport, lipoprotein and peroxisomal confusables.

core: Bile acid synthesis and enterohepatic transport
name: Bile acid synthesis, enterohepatic transport and intestinal sterol absorption
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis routes, recycling, transporter defects (ABCB11, ABCB4, ABCG5/8) and intestinal lipid/cholesterol absorption, unlike confusables on xenobiotic/organic anion transport, lipoproteins or dietary lipid digestion.

qualifier: intestinal sterol absorption and canalicular ABC transporter defects
name: Bile acid synthesis, transport and intestinal sterol absorption
rationale: Members cover cholesterol-to-bile-acid synthesis, enterohepatic bile acid transport and signaling, ABCB/ABCG transporter defects and intestinal cholesterol/lipid absorption, distinguishing it from confusables focused on xenobiotic/bilirubin transport, lipoprotein assembly and cholesterol efflux.

qualifier: E2F-driven G1/S origin licensing and replication checkpoint
name: E2F-driven G1/S origin licensing and replication checkpoint
rationale: Members cover ORC/CDC6 pre-replicative complex assembly and activation, E2F G1/S transcription and replication-stress ATR checkpoint, which the confusables (DNA unwinding, generic cell cycle, intra-S checkpoint) lack.

qualifier: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and origin licensing
name: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and replication origin licensing
rationale: All members concern E2F target transcription and ORC/CDC6 pre-replicative complex licensing and initiation of DNA replication, which the generic cell-cycle and intra-S checkpoint confusables lack.

qualifier: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and pre-replicative complex licensing
name: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and DNA replication licensing
rationale: Members combine E2F target/G1/S transcription with ORC/CDC6 pre-RC activation and replication checkpoints, which the replication-regulation and cell-cycle confusables lack.

qualifier: IL-23/IL-17 Th17 axis, IL-10 family and IL-1 family (IL-33/36/38)
name: IL-23/IL-17, IL-10-family and IL-1-family interleukin signalling
rationale: Members are IL-17, IL-23/IL-12, IL-10/IL-20 and IL-33/IL-36/IL-38 signalling, distinct from interferon, C-type lectin antifungal and IL-27/IL-35 confusables.

qualifier: Th17 axis plus IL-1-family and IL-10-family cytokines
name: Th17-axis, IL-1-family and IL-10-family interleukin signaling
rationale: Members are IL-12/23/17, IL-33/36/38 and IL-10/IL-20 family signaling and IL-17 regulation, while confusables add type III interferon, IL-27/35 or C-type lectin antifungal signaling.

name: Interleukin signalling centred on Th17 and IL-1 family cytokines
rationale: All members are interleukin signalling or production terms dominated by IL-23/IL-17/Th17 and IL-33/IL-36/IL-38, which separate the theme from type I/III interferon and Dectin/IL-27 confusables.

qualifier: terminal red cell maturation and enucleation
name: Erythroid differentiation and terminal red cell maturation
rationale: Members cover primitive and definitive erythrocyte differentiation and late erythroid membrane remodeling and enucleation, unlike confusables on stem/progenitor homeostasis, heme metabolism or megakaryocytic branching.

qualifier: primitive and definitive, through terminal enucleation
name: Primitive and definitive erythropoiesis through terminal enucleation
rationale: Members cover primitive and definitive erythrocyte differentiation, terminal maturation, membrane skeleton assembly and enucleation with hemopoietic transcriptional control, distinguishing them from confusables on HSC/myeloid progenitors and heme synthesis.

name: Primitive and definitive erythropoiesis with terminal red cell maturation
rationale: Members concern primitive and definitive erythrocyte differentiation and late erythroid membrane remodeling/enucleation, distinct from HSC homeostasis, myeloid progenitor and heme metabolism confusables.

qualifier: myeloid, signalling and keratinocyte target genes
name: RUNX1 transcriptional control of myeloid, signalling and keratinocyte genes
rationale: All members are RUNX-family (mainly RUNX1) control of target-gene programmes; the keratinocyte, WNT and estrogen-receptor targets separate it from RUNX1 megakaryocyte/expression (C3) and granulopoiesis (C4) themes.

name: RUNX-family regulation of signaling and differentiation gene transcription
rationale: All members are RUNX1/2/3 transcriptional programs targeting BCR, interleukin, WNT and estrogen-receptor signaling and myeloid/keratinocyte differentiation genes, unlike granulopoiesis, megakaryocyte-focused RUNX1, Hox and FLT3 confusables.

qualifier: signaling, myeloid and keratinocyte target genes
name: RUNX1-centred transcription of signaling, myeloid and keratinocyte genes
rationale: All members are RUNX-family (mainly RUNX1) regulation of target genes in WNT, interleukin, BCR and estrogen signalling and myeloid/keratinocyte differentiation, unlike megakaryocyte or granulopoiesis confusables.

qualifier: tooth formation and ectopic calcification disorders
name: Tooth mineralization and phosphate-linked ectopic calcification
rationale: Members cover enamel/dentin mineralization, tooth eruption, phosphate transport and calcification diseases (PXE, IBGC1, amelogenesis imperfecta); the dental context separates it from confusables on bicarbonate, renal phosphate homeostasis and bone mineralization.

qualifier: dental tissues and ectopic calcification disorders
name: Dental mineralization and phosphate-linked ectopic calcification
rationale: Members cover tooth/enamel/dentin formation, phosphate transport and calcification diseases (PXE, IBGC1); the dental and mineralization focus separates it from bicarbonate, Na/Pi cotransporter and PTH-phosphate confusables.

name: Dental mineralization and phosphate-linked ectopic calcification
rationale: Members cover enamel/dentin formation, tooth eruption, phosphate transport, secreted-protein phosphorylation and calcification disorders (PXE, IBGC1); confusables are about bicarbonate/anion transport or renal phosphate homeostasis and lack the tooth members.

qualifier: oocyte spindle positioning and polar body extrusion
name: Meiosis I progression and oocyte spindle positioning
rationale: Members concern meiosis I entry and spindle assembly/localization with polar body extrusion (plus a spermatogenesis set), distinct from recombination/synapsis and chromosome-cohesion confusables.

qualifier: oocyte spindle positioning and polar body extrusion
name: Meiosis I entry and oocyte spindle positioning
rationale: Members cover G2/MI transition, female meiosis I spindle assembly and positioning and polar body extrusion, unlike confusables on cohesion, checkpoints and male recombination/synapsis.

qualifier: oocyte spindle positioning and polar body extrusion
name: Meiosis I entry and oocyte asymmetric spindle positioning
rationale: Members regulate meiosis I and the G2/MI transition, with female meiotic spindle assembly, positioning and polar body extrusion (plus a spermatogenesis set), unlike neighbours on cohesion, chiasmata, checkpoints or male recombination.

name: CFTR trafficking and epithelial anion-water transport
rationale: Members concern CFTR delivery to the membrane, anion transport and transepithelial water movement and basolateral secretion, distinguishing it from confusables on apical raft localization, glandular secretion or TRP/K+ channels.

name: CFTR trafficking and epithelial anion and water transport
rationale: Members concern CFTR biosynthetic trafficking to the plasma membrane and the anion and transepithelial water transport it mediates, unlike apical raft-localization and TRP/secretion confusables.

qualifier: CFTR trafficking to the plasma membrane
name: CFTR trafficking and transepithelial anion-water transport
rationale: Members cover CFTR trafficking and defects, anion transport regulation, transepithelial water flow and Golgi-to-plasma-membrane/basolateral delivery, unlike apical-raft or secretion-regulation confusables.

name: Clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle endocytosis and recycling
rationale: Members concern presynaptic vesicle endocytosis, clathrin uncoating, vesicle recycling and transmitter release/uptake, distinct from presynaptic cytoskeleton/clustering and dopamine confusables.

name: Clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle recycling and neurotransmitter release control
rationale: Members regulate presynaptic transmitter release/uptake with synaptic vesicle endocytosis and clathrin uncoating, which confusables on presynaptic cytoskeleton, clustering or dendrites lack.

name: Presynaptic vesicle endocytic recycling and neurotransmitter release control
rationale: Members cover synaptic vesicle endocytosis, clathrin uncoating, recycling and regulation of neurotransmitter secretion and uptake, distinct from active-zone, dendritic and catecholamine confusables.

name: Cranial nerve development and neuronal migration
rationale: Members cover trigeminal, facial, olfactory and branchiomotor nerve development plus GnRH and hindbrain tangential neuron migration, distinguishing them from trunk peripheral/DRG neuron and inner-ear/sensory-organ confusables.

qualifier: cranial neuron migration and axon guidance
name: Cranial nerve development and cranial neuron migration
rationale: Members cover development of facial, trigeminal and olfactory nerves and cranial ganglia plus branchiomotor axon guidance and hindbrain/GnRH neuron migration, whereas confusables concern craniofacial glands, inner/outer ear, or trunk peripheral and sympathetic neurons.

name: Cranial nerve development and cranial neuron migration
rationale: Members cover trigeminal, facial, olfactory nerve and cranial ganglion development plus branchiomotor guidance, hindbrain tangential and GnRH neuron migration, distinguishing it from inner ear, peripheral ganglion and nasal/gland confusables.

qualifier: E2F–RB G1/S transcription and G2/M checkpoints
name: Cell cycle control by E2F–RB and G2/M checkpoints
rationale: Members span E2F/RB/DREAM G1/S transcription, cyclin-CDK regulation and G2/M checkpoint and transition events, whereas confusables emphasize DNA replication initiation or proliferation modules in stimulated T cells.

qualifier: E2F/RB G1/S control and G2/M checkpoints
name: Cell cycle: E2F-driven G1/S control and G2/M transition
rationale: Members span RB/E2F G1/S transcription, cyclin-CDK regulation, G2/M checkpoints and mitotic entry, distinguishing it from confusables focused on replication origin licensing and T-cell-stimulated division modules.

qualifier: E2F/RB control of G1/S and G2/M and checkpoints
name: E2F/RB-driven G1/S and G2/M transitions and checkpoints
rationale: Members cover RB/E2F transcription, cyclin-CDK G1/S and G2/M events and their checkpoints, unlike neighbours centred on DNA replication initiation or proliferating T-cell modules.

qualifier: histone stem-loop processing and snRNA/snRNP handling
name: Pre-mRNA 3'-end processing and nuclear RNA export
rationale: Members span cleavage and polyadenylation, histone stem-loop 3'-end processing, polymerase II termination and export of mature mRNA and snRNA from the nucleus, while confusables emphasise cytoplasmic mRNA decay, snRNA transcription or the spliceosome.

core: mRNA 3'-end processing with transcription termination and nuclear export
qualifier: polyadenylated and SLBP-dependent histone routes plus snRNP/snRNA handling
name: mRNA 3'-end processing, transcription termination and nuclear export
rationale: Every member concerns forming an mRNA 3' end (cleavage/polyadenylation or histone stem-loop), terminating Pol II, and moving the mature transcript or snRNA through the pore, whereas the confusables are spliceosome, mRNA decay or snRNA transcription themes.

core: nuclear mRNA 3'-end processing, termination and export
qualifier: histone pre-mRNA stem-loop route and snRNP/cap maturation
name: Nuclear mRNA 3'-end processing, termination and nuclear export
rationale: All members act on nascent transcript 3'-end cleavage and polyadenylation, Pol II termination and the delivery of mature mRNA through the pore, which distinguishes it from confusables centred on splicing, cytoplasmic mRNA decay, or snRNA and lncRNA transcription.

qualifier: ESCRT-III abscission and nuclear envelope resealing
name: Cytokinesis, abscission and ESCRT-III nuclear envelope resealing
rationale: Members span spindle midzone, contractile ring and furrow formation, midbody abscission and ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing; these late-mitotic events distinguish it from chromosome cohesion, checkpoint and lamina disassembly confusables.

name: Cytokinesis, abscission and nuclear envelope resealing
rationale: Members share late mitotic events: contractile ring, cleavage furrow, spindle midzone, ESCRT-mediated abscission and nuclear envelope reassembly, distinct from chromosome condensation/cohesion and nuclear envelope breakdown confusables.

name: Late mitotic cytokinesis and ESCRT-III nuclear envelope resealing
rationale: Members cover spindle midzone, contractile ring, septins, midbody abscission and ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing, unlike confusables on chromosome cohesion/condensation or nuclear envelope breakdown.

name: Vascular smooth muscle contraction, relaxation and arterial blood pressure
rationale: Members regulate smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, vasoconstriction and systemic/pulmonary blood pressure, unlike confusables centered on eNOS/NO-cGMP production or adrenergic receptor signaling.

core: Vascular smooth muscle contraction and relaxation
name: Vascular smooth muscle contraction–relaxation and arterial blood pressure control
rationale: Members regulate smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, vasoconstriction and systemic/pulmonary blood pressure, whereas confusables centre on eNOS/NO-cGMP production or adrenergic receptor signaling.

name: Vascular smooth muscle contraction, relaxation and arterial blood pressure
rationale: Members regulate smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, vasoconstriction and systemic/lung blood pressure; confusables centre on eNOS/NO-cGMP production or adrenergic receptor signaling.

name: Regulation of myoblast proliferation, differentiation and fusion
rationale: All members concern myoblast commitment, migration, proliferation, differentiation and fusion into myotubes, unlike confusables on satellite cell maintenance or mature muscle fibre differentiation.

name: Myoblast commitment, proliferation, differentiation and fusion
rationale: All members regulate myoblast fate, proliferation, migration, differentiation and fusion, whereas neighbours centre on satellite cells, regeneration and muscle fibre differentiation.

name: Regulation of myoblast proliferation, differentiation and fusion
rationale: All members regulate myoblast commitment, proliferation, migration, differentiation, fusion and myotube formation; confusables emphasise satellite cell activation, muscle regeneration or skeletal muscle fibre development.

qualifier: ERK5, p38 and atypical MAPK6/4 branches
name: NGF-TRKA signalling to ERK5, p38 and atypical MAPKs
rationale: All members are TRKA/NGF-triggered kinase signalling to CREB and MAPKs, and the ERK5 cascade and MAPK6/MAPK4 members are what the NTRK3/NGF confusables lack.

qualifier: ERK5, p38 and atypical MAPK branches to CREB
name: TRKA-driven ERK5, p38 and atypical MAPK cascades
rationale: Members are MAPK branches (ERK5, p38, MAPK4/6, FRS2/ARMS adaptors) leading to CREB and transcription after TRKA activation; confusables instead carry NTRK3, PLC-gamma, PI3K and STAT3 arms.

qualifier: ERK5, p38 and atypical MAPK branches
name: TRKA-driven MAPK signalling including ERK5, p38 and atypical MAPKs
rationale: Members are MAPK cascades (ERK5, p38, MAPK6/4, RAS-MAPK) and their CREB/transcriptional outputs downstream of NGF/TRKA adaptors (FRS2, ARMS); unlike the confusables they carry the ERK5, p38 and atypical MAPK arms rather than NTRK3, PI3K, PLCG1 or STAT3 branches.

core: Forebrain neuronal migration and axon tract formation
qualifier: commissural and corticospinal tracts with radial glia-guided migration
name: Forebrain commissure formation and radial glia-guided neuronal migration
rationale: Members cover anterior commissure, corpus callosum and corticospinal tract morphogenesis together with radial glia differentiation, neuroblast division and radial migration; confusables emphasise cortical layering, tangential/interneuron migration or cerebellar development.

core: Forebrain axon tract and neuronal migration development
name: Forebrain axon tract morphogenesis and radial glia-guided neuron migration
rationale: Members are corpus callosum, anterior commissure and corticospinal tract morphogenesis plus radial glial differentiation, neuroblast division and radial-glia-guided migration, unlike confusables on cerebellum/L1 or cortical layering and tangential interneuron migration.

core: Forebrain radial glia and neuron migration
name: Forebrain radial glia and commissural axon tract formation
rationale: Members combine forebrain radial glial differentiation, radial-glia-guided migration and neuroblast division with corpus callosum, anterior commissure and corticospinal tract morphogenesis; confusables cover cortical lamination, interneuron migration or cerebellar development.

name: Immediate-early growth factor and inflammatory stress response
rationale: Members are growth factor-induced early genes, PI3K/AKT/mTOR and TNF/NF-kB hallmarks, p38 activation and growth arrest, unlike AP-1/UV response and TAK1-JNK kinase cascade neighbours.

qualifier: growth factor, NF-kB, p38 and PI3K signaling
name: Immediate-early growth factor and stress signaling response
rationale: Members are early-response programs to external stimuli (NR4A induction, TNF-NF-kB, p38, PI3K-mTOR, growth arrest), distinct from AP-1, UV-response and TAK1-JNK confusables.

qualifier: NR4A induction with NF-kB, PI3K-mTOR and p38 signatures
name: Immediate-early NR4A, NF-kB and PI3K-mTOR stimulus response
rationale: Members are growth factor/stimulus-induced programmes (NR4A early genes, TNF-NF-kB and PI3K-AKT-mTOR hallmarks, p38 activation, growth arrest), distinguished from UV-response, AP-1/FOSL and TAK1-JNK confusables.

qualifier: CD1 lipid antigens and TLR7/8 endosomal sensing
name: Antigen presentation emphasizing CD1 lipid antigens and TLR7/8
rationale: Members cover antigen processing with CD1/MHC class Ib lipid presentation, DC receptors and TLR7/8, which separates the theme from MHC class II peptide presentation and monocyte surface-signature confusables.

qualifier: CD1 lipid antigens and TLR7/8 sensing
name: CD1 lipid antigen presentation and TLR7/8 sensing
rationale: Members cover antigen presentation with emphasis on CD1/MHC class Ib lipid antigens plus TLR7/TLR8, distinguishing it from MHC class II peptide presentation and monocyte/DC surface signature confusables.

name: Antigen presentation featuring CD1 lipid antigens and TLR7/8
rationale: Members are antigen presentation sets marked by CD1/MHC class Ib lipid antigen presentation and the TLR7/TLR8 cluster, unlike confusables centred on MHC class II peptide presentation or monocyte/DC surface signatures.

name: Mitochondrial gene expression and tRNA maturation
rationale: Most members are mtDNA replication, transcription, RNA processing and mitoribosomal translation, together with tRNA processing, modification and aminoacylation; neighbours focus on cytosolic rRNA modification or translation-factor modification.

name: Mitochondrial gene expression and tRNA processing and modification
rationale: Members cover mtDNA replication, mitochondrial transcription, RNA processing, ribosome assembly and translation together with nuclear and mitochondrial tRNA maturation and modification, unlike confusables focused on nucleolar rRNA modification, selenocysteine/readthrough or protein modification.

name: Mitochondrial genome expression and tRNA processing and modification
rationale: Members cover mtDNA replication, mitochondrial transcription, RNA processing, translation and ribosome assembly together with nuclear and mitochondrial tRNA maturation and modification, which confusables (cytosolic rRNA modification, peptidyl modifications, readthrough) lack.

qualifier: MHC class I and II, including cross-presentation
name: MHC class I and II peptide antigen presentation, including cross-presentation
rationale: Members span antigen processing, peptide loading and MHC I/II presentation including cross-presentation and viral MHC/CD4 downregulation, without the CD1/NKT lipid presentation or PD-L1/proteasome terms of the confusables.

qualifier: MHC class I and II, cross-presentation
name: MHC class I and II antigen processing and cross-presentation
rationale: Members cover peptide loading and presentation on MHC I and II, proteasomal and endosomal processing and cross-presentation, unlike confusables centred on CD1/NKT lipid presentation, Nef CD4/CD8/CD28 downregulation or PD-L1 and proteasome biology.

qualifier: both MHC class I and class II pathways
name: MHC class I and II antigen processing and presentation
rationale: Members cover peptide loading and presentation via MHC class I (including cross-presentation and proteasomal processing), class II and class Ib; carrying both arms distinguishes it from confusables restricted to class I/proteasome or to lipid/CD1 and NKT presentation.

qualifier: intrinsic pathway and inherited factor VIII/IX/V defects
name: Intrinsic coagulation cascade and inherited clotting factor defects
rationale: Members cover initiation, amplification and intrinsic/common coagulation with many factor VIII, IX and V variant defects, while confusables centre on fibrinolysis, platelets and VWF defects.

qualifier: defective factor VIII, IX and V variants
name: Coagulation cascade and defective factor VIII, IX and V
rationale: Members are coagulation initiation, intrinsic/common pathway and fibrin formation plus many defective F8, F9 and FV variants, the latter absent from the fibrinolysis, platelet and VWF confusables.

qualifier: inherited factor V, VIII and IX defects
name: Coagulation cascade and inherited factor V, VIII, IX defects
rationale: Members are intrinsic/extrinsic/common coagulation, fibrin formation and contact activation plus many defective F8, F9 and FV variants, the clotting-factor defects distinguishing it from fibrinolysis, platelet, VWF and kallikrein confusables.

qualifier: nodal sodium channel clustering and dendrite self-avoidance
name: Neuronal Ig-superfamily adhesion and axonal node assembly
rationale: Members are L1-family, nectin, DSCAM and SDK neuronal adhesion interactions plus paranodal junction and sodium channel clustering; neighbours carry L1 signalling/recycling, ephrin repulsion or myelination instead.

name: Neuronal Ig-family adhesion in nodal assembly and dendrite self-avoidance
rationale: Members are L1-family, DSCAM, SDK and nectin adhesion interactions; unlike NCAM/L1 signaling, ephrin repulsion and myelination neighbours, it includes sodium channel clustering at nodes/paranodes and heterophilic adhesion for dendrite self-avoidance.

name: Neuronal Ig-superfamily adhesion in nodal assembly and dendrite self-avoidance
rationale: All members are neuronal adhesion-molecule interactions; the theme combines L1/neurofascin/NrCAM ankyrin-anchored sodium channel clustering at nodes with DSCAM/SDK/nectin dendrite self-avoidance, each half separating it from different confusables.

qualifier: transcriptional activation of apoptosis and G1 arrest
name: p53 transcriptional activation of apoptosis and G1 arrest
rationale: Members are TP53 transcriptional targets in cell death and G1 arrest (p21, caspases, death receptors) plus positive regulation of p53 apoptosis and its expression and cofactors, unlike confusables on p14ARF/p16 defects, p53 phosphorylation/degradation and negative regulation.

qualifier: pro-apoptotic and G1 arrest target genes
name: p53-driven transcription of apoptosis and G1 arrest genes
rationale: Members describe p53 regulation and its transcription of caspase, death-receptor, cytochrome c release and p21/G1 arrest genes, distinguishing it from confusables on negative regulation, p14ARF/p16 senescence evasion and DNA repair/G2 checkpoints.

qualifier: pro-apoptotic and p21/G1 arrest target genes
name: p53 transcriptional activation of apoptosis and p21-mediated G1 arrest
rationale: Members cover TP53 expression, cofactors and its transcription of death receptors, caspases, cytochrome c release genes and p21/G1 arrest genes with positive regulation of p53 apoptosis, unlike confusables on negative regulation, ARF/INK4A senescence evasion or G2/DNA repair.

name: SUMO processing, E1-E2 conjugation and target protein SUMOylation
rationale: Members cover the SUMO conjugation machinery (processing, E1/E2 transfer, desumoylation) and SUMOylation of diverse nuclear targets, while confusables add chromatin/replication targets, Ran mitosis or PML nuclear-transport roles.

qualifier: SUMO processing, E1-E2 conjugation and desumoylation
name: SUMO conjugation cascade, desumoylation and substrate SUMOylation
rationale: All members concern the SUMO pathway, and SUMO maturation, E1/E2 transfer and desumoylation are what the substrate-only SUMOylation and PML/nuclear transport confusables lack.

name: SUMO conjugation cycle and substrate sumoylation
rationale: Members cover SUMO processing, E1/E2 transfer, desumoylation and sumoylation of substrate classes, while confusables hold substrate sets without the enzymatic cycle or PML-body/nuclear transport terms.

name: Toll-like receptor signaling regulation and inflammatory cytokine induction
rationale: Members regulate TLR (MyD88, TLR3/4) and CD40 signaling and IL-6/IL-8/TNF production, unlike IL-1/IL-37 regulation and TRIF/TAK1 mechanistic confusables.

name: Toll-like receptor signalling regulation and IL-6/IL-8/TNF production
rationale: Members positively/negatively regulate TLR (and CD40) signalling and the resulting inflammatory cytokine production, unlike confusables on TRIF/TAK1 mechanics or IL-1 signalling.

qualifier: proinflammatory IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production
name: TLR-driven proinflammatory cytokine production and its regulation
rationale: Members regulate TLR/CD40 signaling and IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, distinct from confusables on IL-1 family signaling and core TRIF/TAK1 signaling steps.

name: Lymphocyte homing and chemotaxis into lymphoid organs
rationale: Members cover lymphocyte homing and migration into lymphoid organs, B, T and dendritic cell chemotaxis and marginal zone B cell differentiation, separating it from generic chemokine signaling and S1P/lymph node development confusables.

qualifier: lymphocyte homing into lymphoid organs and B cell chemotaxis
name: Lymphocyte homing and chemotaxis into lymphoid organs
rationale: Members concern T, B and dendritic cell chemotaxis and adhesion-dependent homing to lymphoid organs (with Cdc42 and PLC/PKC signalling and marginal zone B cell positioning), distinct from confusables on chemokine-receptor binding modules and S1P/lymph node development.

qualifier: lymphocyte and dendritic cell homing to lymphoid organs
name: Lymphocyte and dendritic cell chemotaxis and lymphoid organ homing
rationale: Members cover B and T cell and myeloid DC chemotaxis, lymphocyte homing and migration into lymphoid organs and marginal zone B cell positioning, versus confusables on general chemokine/CXCR4 signalling or S1P-driven lymph node development.

name: Mesenchymal extracellular matrix, EMT and focal adhesion program

name: Mesenchymal extracellular matrix program with focal adhesion mechanosignaling

rationale: Most members are motor behaviors (walking, swimming, grooming, exploration, righting reflex) with amygdala and Purkinje layer development as motor/affective brain-region members, distinguishing it from synaptic transmission, vocal/sensory and proprioception confusables.

name: Leading-edge actin severing, depolymerization and protrusion
rationale: Members concern actin filament severing, depolymerization, capping and Arp2/3 restraint at the lamellipodial/pseudopodial leading edge, unlike confusables that promote actin polymerization, ruffling and contraction.

name: Leading-edge actin turnover by severing, capping and depolymerization
rationale: Members concern lamellipodial and pseudopodial actin turnover via severing, barbed-end capping, depolymerization and Arp2/3 inhibition, unlike confusables centred on actin polymerization, ruffling and WAVE/WASP activation.

qualifier: severing, depolymerization and capping at the leading edge
name: Actin filament severing and turnover at the leading edge
rationale: Members concern actin severing, depolymerization, barbed-end capping and Arp2/3 restraint supporting lamellipodium and pseudopodium formation, unlike confusables centred on actin polymerization, ruffles and Arp2/3 activation.

core: Viral attachment and entry into host cells
name: Receptor-mediated viral attachment and endocytic entry
rationale: Members describe virion receptor binding, endocytic uptake and promotion of viral entry; the generic receptor-mediated endocytosis members distinguish it from virus-specific Dengue/RSV entry and host suppression confusables.

name: Receptor-mediated virus attachment and endocytic host entry

name: Receptor-mediated viral attachment and endocytic entry into host cells
rationale: All members concern virion attachment, endocytic uptake and positive regulation of viral entry, generic across viruses, unlike virus-specific (dengue, RSV) life-cycle or host-restriction confusables.

name: Stress granule dynamics and aggresome clearance by aggrephagy
rationale: Members are stress granule assembly, protein localisation and disassembly plus aggresome assembly and aggrephagy, unlike ribosome quality control and ERAD/misfolded-protein confusables.

name: Stress granule dynamics and aggresome clearance by aggrephagy
rationale: Members concern assembly, protein recruitment and disassembly of stress granules together with aggresome assembly and aggrephagy, distinct from confusables on ribosome quality control, degron proteolysis, ERAD and chaperone-mediated autophagy.

name: Aggresome formation, aggrephagy and stress granule dynamics
rationale: All members concern aggresome assembly and aggrephagy or stress granule assembly and disassembly, distinguished from confusables on ribosome quality control, ERAD/misfolded protein response or chaperone-mediated autophagy.

qualifier: droplet formation and fusion with triglyceride homeostasis
name: Lipid droplet biogenesis and intracellular triglyceride homeostasis
rationale: Members are lipid droplet formation, fusion and organization plus triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis, unlike confusables on lipophagy, lipolysis or phospholipid synthesis.

name: Lipid droplet formation and intracellular triglyceride homeostasis
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation/fusion and triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis, unlike confusables on lipophagy, droplet disassembly, glycerolipid synthesis enzymes or LXR control.

name: Lipid droplet biogenesis and triglyceride storage homeostasis
rationale: Members cover lipid droplet formation, fusion and organization with triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis, whereas confusables emphasise lipolysis/lipophagy, LXR lipogenesis or phospholipid synthesis.

qualifier: plasma cell differentiation and immunoglobulin production
name: B cell to plasma cell differentiation and immunoglobulins
rationale: Members are B cell and plasma cell/immunoglobulin modules plus plasma cell differentiation, which distinguishes the theme from memory, germinal-centre and naive B cell confusables.

name: B cell and plasma cell immunoglobulin signatures
rationale: Members are B cell and plasma cell/immunoglobulin modules plus plasma cell differentiation, which the germinal centre, memory and naive B cell confusables lack.

qualifier: plasma cell differentiation and immunoglobulin expression
name: Plasma cell differentiation and immunoglobulin-expressing B cell signatures
rationale: Members are plasma cell/B cell immunoglobulin modules and plasma cell differentiation, which confusables lack in favour of memory, germinal centre or naive B cell signatures.

name: Sodium-coupled TCA-intermediate and pyruvate transport
rationale: Members are transport of succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, tricarboxylates and pyruvate via sodium-coupled carboxylate transporters (with proximal tubule development), distinct from confusables on monocarboxylate/lactate, organic cation and malate-aspartate shuttle transport.

name: Sodium-coupled TCA-intermediate and pyruvate transport, renal proximal tubule
rationale: Members are transport of succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, tricarboxylates and pyruvate by sodium-coupled carboxylate transporters, with proximal tubule development; confusables instead cover organic cations, monocarboxylate/lactate or malate-aspartate shuttle.

qualifier: sodium-coupled TCA intermediates, renal proximal tubule
name: Sodium-coupled TCA-intermediate carboxylate transport, renal proximal tubule
rationale: Members are transport of succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, citrate-type tricarboxylates and pyruvate by sodium-coupled carriers with proximal tubule development, distinct from carnitine, malate-aspartate, lactate and organic cation confusables.

name: AMPA and kainate receptor excitatory transmission
rationale: Members cover AMPA and kainate receptor activation, clustering and diffusion trapping in excitatory transmission, separating the theme from NMDA-receptor and presynaptic-modulation confusables.

name: Postsynaptic AMPA and kainate receptor activity and clustering
rationale: Members concern AMPA and kainate receptor activation, diffusion trapping and clustering in excitatory transmission and kainate excitotoxicity, distinguishing it from presynaptic kainate and NMDA receptor confusables.

name: AMPA/kainate receptor transmission, clustering and excitotoxicity
rationale: Members are AMPA and kainate receptor activation, receptor trapping/clustering, short-term plasticity and kainate-induced hippocampal neuron death, unlike NMDA-receptor and presynaptic-modulation neighbours.

core: Negative regulation of innate inflammatory signaling
qualifier: TLR/IL-1 signaling and proinflammatory cytokine production
name: Suppression of TLR/IL-1 signaling and proinflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members restrain TLR2/4, LPS and IL-1 signaling and IL-1, IL-6, IL-12 and TNF production, separating them from NF-kB, positive TLR regulation, inflammasome and IL-10 confusables.

qualifier: negative regulation downstream of TLR and IL-1
name: Suppression of TLR-induced proinflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members are negative regulation of TLR2/4, LPS and IL-1 signalling and of IL-1, IL-6, IL-12 and TNF production, unlike confusables on NF-kB/TNF signalling, IL-10, positive regulation and inflammasomes.

qualifier: negative regulation via TLR and IL-1 signaling
name: Suppression of TLR and IL-1 driven inflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members negatively regulate TLR2/4, LPS and IL-1 signalling and IL-1, IL-6, IL-12 and TNF production, unlike confusables dominated by positive regulation, inflammasomes or NF-kappaB.

name: ER protein quality control, retention and retrotranslocation
rationale: Members cover ER lumen retention, regulation of ER exit, ERQC demannosylation, ufmylation and ERAD retrotranslocation, distinguishing it from COPII export and SRP membrane-insertion confusables.

qualifier: retention, ER exit control and ERAD retrotranslocation
name: ER protein quality control, retention and ERAD retrotranslocation
rationale: Members cover ER quality-control compartment, mannose trimming, ER retention and exit regulation and ER-to-cytosol retrotranslocation for ERAD, distinct from the ER targeting/insertion and COPII export confusables.

name: ER quality control: protein retention, exit and retrotranslocation
rationale: Members cover ER retention, regulated ER exit, demannosylation, UFMylation and ERAD retrotranslocation to cytosol, whereas confusables concern ER targeting/insertion and COPII export.

core: negative feedback shutdown of the ERK/MAPK cascade
qualifier: phosphatase-mediated inactivation downstream of ERK, not RAS GAP control or RAF activation
name: Negative feedback inactivation of ERK MAPK signalling
rationale: All members are braking events on the RAS-ERK axis - ERK dephosphorylation and inactivation, tyrosine phosphatase action, RSK-dependent and other feedback loops, suppression of RAS signalling, and the mutants that escape it; the confusables centre on RAS GAPs and RAS/RAF activation steps rather than on feedback termination.

qualifier: dephosphorylation and negative feedback at the ERK tier
name: Negative feedback inactivation of ERK1/2 signalling
rationale: Members all concern switching ERK-MAPK output off, by phosphatase action, feedback loops and RSK-mediated restraint, which distinguishes them from confusables centred on RAS GAPs and RAS/RAF activating mutants.

name: ERK dephosphorylation and MAPK negative feedback
rationale: Members concern ERK inactivation by tyrosine dephosphorylation, RSK activation and feedback/negative regulation of Ras-ERK signalling (incl. MAPK mutants), unlike confusables on RAS GAPs, RAF activation or threonine dephosphorylation.

qualifier: membrane-tethered FGFR and PDGFR fusions plus ALK/LTK
name: Membrane-tethered oncogenic FGFR, PDGFR and ALK/LTK kinase signalling
rationale: All members are constitutive signalling by cancer-altered receptor tyrosine kinases at the plasma membrane (FGFR1/2/3 and PDGFR fusions, ALK and LTK), distinguishing them from cytosolic fusions, FLT3, and EGFR/ERBB2 or amplification mutants in the confusables.

name: Oncogenic membrane-tethered receptor tyrosine kinase fusions and ALK family
rationale: All members are cancer-driving RTK variants (PDGFR/FGFR1-3 membrane-bound fusions, LTK, TKI-bound ALK mutants), distinguished from confusables that hold EGFR/ERBB2 point mutants, amplifications or cytosolic fusions.

name: Oncogenic membrane-bound RTK fusions and ALK/LTK kinases
rationale: All members are constitutive oncogenic RTK signaling, specifically membrane-tethered FGFR/PDGFR fusions plus ALK/LTK, which the confusables lack in favour of amplification, point mutants or cytosolic fusions.

name: cAMP-PKA and AMPK regulation of triglyceride turnover
rationale: Members link glucagon/PKA, PDE3B and AMPK-ChREBP signaling to triglyceride catabolism and reduced triglyceride synthesis, while confusables address glycogen, gluconeogenesis, ChREBP activation or LXR lipid genes.

name: Glucagon-PKA and AMPK regulation of triglyceride metabolism
rationale: Members are PKA, PDE3B and AMPK signalling controlling lipolysis and triglyceride synthesis, unlike confusables on ChREBP glucose sensing, glycogen, gluconeogenesis or LXR.

name: cAMP-PKA and AMPK control of triglyceride synthesis and breakdown
rationale: Members are glucagon/PKA, PDE3B and AMPK signaling that suppress lipogenesis (ChREBP, TG synthesis) and drive TG catabolism, unlike confusables on glycogen, gluconeogenesis and LXR or ChREBP-driven transcription.

name: Intramembranous bone formation and tendon development
rationale: Members are direct ossification, cranial suture, trabecula and osteoblast development plus tendon development, distinguished from chondrocyte and osteoblast-proliferation/collagen-regulation confusables.

name: Intramembranous ossification, osteoblast development and tendon formation
rationale: Members cover direct ossification, cranial suture and trabecular bone formation, osteoblast development and tendon development, distinguishing it from chondrocyte/RUNX2 and osteoblast-proliferation-regulation confusables.

name: Intramembranous bone formation and tendon development
rationale: Members cover osteoblast development, direct ossification, cranial sutures, trabecular bone and tendon, distinguished from confusables that emphasize regulation of osteoblast differentiation/proliferation, collagen/proteoglycan synthesis or chondrocytes.

qualifier: phase I/II with organic anion and bilirubin transport
name: Phase I/II xenobiotic biotransformation and organic anion/bilirubin transport
rationale: Members cover CYP/FMO oxidation, conjugation (glucuronidation, sulfonation, methylation, acetylation), drug ADME and SLCO/ABCC transport including bilirubin, distinct from bile acid and sulfur-metabolism confusables.

name: Xenobiotic and drug biotransformation, conjugation and transport
rationale: Members are drug ADME, CYP/FMO oxidation, conjugation (glucuronidation, sulfonation, methylation, acetylation) and xenobiotic/bilirubin transport, unlike the sulfur-methyl, bile acid and organic anion transport confusables.

name: Xenobiotic, drug and bilirubin biotransformation and transport
rationale: Members cover phase I/II drug and toxin metabolism (CYPs, FMOs, UGT, sulfation, methylation), drug ADME, organic anion/cation transport and heme/bilirubin clearance; neighbours are bile acid, organic-anion-only and sulfur/selenium metabolism.

name: Cilium assembly, intraflagellar transport and ciliary motility
rationale: Members span basal body docking, IFT, ciliary cargo targeting, axoneme and dynein arm assembly and motile-cilia functions (mucociliary clearance, CSF flow, sperm motility), distinct from confusables on left/right patterning, photoreceptors, sperm mitochondria or tubulin modification.

name: Cilium assembly, intraflagellar transport and ciliary motility
rationale: Members cover centriole/basal body formation, intraflagellar transport, ciliary cargo targeting, axonemal dynein assembly and motile-cilium functions such as sperm motility and CSF flow, whereas confusables add sperm mitochondrial sheath, tubulin modification, photoreceptor or left-right patterning.

qualifier: intraflagellar transport, ciliary targeting and motility
name: Cilium assembly, ciliary protein trafficking and motile cilia function
rationale: Members span centriole/basal body formation, intraflagellar transport, cargo targeting to cilia and motile cilia/flagella and their roles in CSF flow and left-right asymmetry, unlike confusables on photoreceptors, sperm mitochondrial sheath, tubulin modification or organ laterality.

core: Ionotropic glutamate receptor activation and signaling
qualifier: spanning NMDA, AMPA and kainate receptors
name: NMDA, AMPA and kainate receptor activation and signaling
rationale: All members concern activation, trafficking or downstream effects of ionotropic glutamate receptors at excitatory synapses; unlike the CREB/CaMK-downstream and AMPA-clustering neighbours, the theme covers receptor activation itself including kainate receptors.

qualifier: AMPA, NMDA and kainate receptor activation
name: AMPA, NMDA and kainate receptor activation and signaling
rationale: All members concern ionotropic glutamate receptor activation, trafficking or downstream excitatory/excitotoxic effects, and unlike the confusables (plasticity/CREB/memory or AMPA clustering) the theme spans kainate, AMPA and NMDA receptor activation itself.

qualifier: AMPA and kainate as well as NMDA receptor activation
name: AMPA, NMDA and kainate receptor excitatory signalling
rationale: All members concern ionotropic glutamate receptor activation, trafficking and glutamatergic synaptic responses; unlike the NMDA-CREB and long-term plasticity confusables, the theme covers AMPA and kainate receptor activation and fast excitatory transmission.

qualifier: lens, anterior segment and hyaloid vasculature
name: Eye morphogenesis of lens, anterior segment and hyaloid vasculature
rationale: Members span eye development (optic cup, retina, lens, cornea, iris, eyelid, optic nerve) with lens transparency/gap junctions and hyaloid vessel regression distinguishing it from photoreceptor/retinal-neuron and retinal-vascular confusables.

qualifier: lens, anterior segment and hyaloid vasculature
name: Eye morphogenesis of lens, anterior segment and hyaloid vasculature
rationale: Members are eye development processes (optic cup, lens fibre, cornea, iris, eyelid, optic nerve, hyaloid regression), distinct from confusables focused on photoreceptor/retinal neuron differentiation or retinal vasculature.

qualifier: lens, anterior segment and hyaloid regression
name: Eye morphogenesis: lens, anterior segment, hyaloid vessel regression
rationale: All members are eye developmental processes, and unlike the photoreceptor/retinal-neuron and retinal-vasculature confusables they emphasise lens fibre development and transparency, cornea/iris/eyelid, optic cup/nerve and hyaloid vessel regression.

qualifier: oncogene, stress and replicative induction with heterochromatin foci and SASP
name: Oncogene, stress and replicative senescence with heterochromatin foci
rationale: Members cover oncogene-, oxidative- and replicative senescence, SAHF, PML bodies, Polycomb silencing and SASP, unlike confusables on UV response, p53 apoptosis or cancer evasion of senescence.

qualifier: heterochromatin foci, PML bodies and secretory phenotype
name: Cellular senescence with heterochromatin foci and secretory phenotype

qualifier: heterochromatin foci, Polycomb silencing and SASP
name: Cellular senescence with heterochromatin foci and secretory phenotype
rationale: Members span oncogene-, stress- and replicative senescence with SAHF, PML bodies, Polycomb modules and SASP, distinguishing them from confusables on p53 apoptosis, p16/ARF senescence evasion or UV response.

qualifier: RNA polymerase III and snRNA initiation
name: RNA polymerase III and snRNA transcription initiation
rationale: Members are Pol III promoter-type initiation, tRNA transcription and Pol II/III snRNA transcription, while confusables cover Pol III elongation/termination and rRNA transcription and processing.

qualifier: RNA polymerase III promoters and snRNA genes
name: RNA polymerase III and snRNA gene transcription initiation
rationale: Members cover Pol III initiation at type 1-3 promoters (tRNA, snRNA) and Pol II/III snRNA gene transcription, unlike confusables dominated by Pol III elongation/termination and rRNA processing.

qualifier: initiation at RNA polymerase III promoters and snRNA genes
name: RNA polymerase III initiation and snRNA gene transcription
rationale: Members are Pol III initiation at type 1-3 promoters (tRNA, snRNA) and Pol II/III snRNA gene transcription, distinguishing them from confusables on Pol III elongation and termination and Pol I rRNA transcription and processing.

core: Tight junction paracellular and magnesium transport
name: Tight junction paracellular and magnesium ion transport
rationale: The clearest shared thread is claudin-type tight junction paracellular transport and magnesium/inositol transport by multi-pass membrane proteins, with generic oligomerization members; confusables are aquaporin, chloride-cotransporter or metabolic groupings.

name: Responses to anesthetics, ethanol and chemical stress

name: Cellular stress responses to ethanol, anesthetics and drugs

core: Cellular response to drugs and stress
name: Cellular response to anesthetics, ethanol and other drugs
rationale: Most members are responses to chemicals (ethanol, ether, anesthetic, antibiotic, drug) or oxidative/hypoxic stress, and the anesthetic, ether and ethanol responses are what neighbours lacking them do not have; amine metabolism and developmental apoptosis fit only loosely.

name: Intramembrane proteolytic release of NOTCH2-4 and ERBB4 intracellular domains
rationale: Members concern cleavage-driven release and nuclear signalling or downregulation of NOTCH2/3/4 and ERBB4 intracellular domains, whereas confusables centre on NOTCH1 and Notch target transcription.

name: Intramembrane cleavage signaling by NOTCH2-4 and ERBB4
rationale: Members are receptor processing and intracellular-domain release for NOTCH2/3/4 and ERBB4, while confusables centre on NOTCH1 activation, its oncogenic mutants and Notch target transcription.

name: Regulated intramembrane proteolysis of NOTCH2-4 and ERBB4
rationale: Members share proteolytic release of receptor intracellular domains for NOTCH2/3/4 and ERBB4; confusables are NOTCH1 signaling and Notch target transcription.

qualifier: MYC targets and nutrient-dependent rRNA gene silencing
name: MYC- and nutrient-regulated ribosome biogenesis, rRNA gene silencing
rationale: Members govern ribosome biogenesis output (MYC target programs, methionine response, SIRT1/nucleolar chromatin repression of Pol I), whereas confusables hold the Pol I transcription and rRNA processing machinery itself.

name: Ribosome biogenesis control: MYC targets and rDNA silencing
rationale: Members concern growth-linked control of ribosome production (MYC target sets, ribosome biogenesis regulation, methionine sensing) and repression of rRNA genes (SIRT1, Pol I repression, nucleolar chromatin), whereas confusables hold the Pol I transcription machinery and rRNA processing steps.

name: Nucleolar ribosome biogenesis control and MYC targets
rationale: Members concern growth-linked control of ribosome production (Pol I repression, SIRT1/nucleolar chromatin silencing of rRNA, methionine sensing, MYC target sets), whereas confusables cover Pol I initiation/termination machinery and rRNA processing steps and lack the MYC target sets.

core: Inner ear sensory hair cell function
qualifier: vestibular gravity sensing and hair cell specification
name: Inner ear hair cell specification and vestibular balance sensing
rationale: Members cover gravity/balance sensing, otoliths, vestibular reflex, hair cell fate and efferent outer hair cell inhibition, unlike confusables on inner ear and sensory organ morphogenesis or cochlear sound transduction.

qualifier: vestibular gravity sensing and hair cell fate
name: Vestibular gravity sensing and inner ear hair cell fate
rationale: Members cover balance (equilibrioception, vestibular reflex, otoliths, gravity) and hair cell fate and efferent control; confusables are inner ear structural morphogenesis or cochlear sound transduction.

qualifier: vestibular balance sensing and hair cell specification
name: Vestibular balance sensing and inner ear hair cell specification
rationale: Members concern equilibrioception, gravity response, otoliths, vestibular reflex and hair cell fate/outer hair cell control, while confusables are cochlear auditory transduction or ear and craniofacial morphogenesis.

qualifier: muscle fiber differentiation and homeostasis, diaphragm
name: Skeletal myogenesis and muscle fiber homeostasis

name: Skeletal myogenesis and muscle fiber differentiation

name: Skeletal muscle fiber differentiation and homeostasis
rationale: Members centre on myogenesis, skeletal muscle fiber differentiation, muscle cell homeostasis and diaphragm development, distinguishing it from confusables on muscle atrophy, dystroglycan glycosylation or neuromuscular junction.

name: Differentiated intestinal epithelium identity and barrier maintenance

name: CDX-specified differentiated intestinal epithelium
rationale: Nearly all members describe the CDX/HNF4-driven differentiated intestinal epithelial programme (leukocyte migration is an outlier), distinguished from the intestine-plus-liver/kidney HNF4 modules, pancreatic lineage, antimicrobial and Wnt crypt confusables.

name: CDX/HNF4-driven intestinal absorptive epithelium identity
rationale: Nearly all members describe the differentiated intestinal epithelium and its hepatocyte-nuclear-factor/CDX lineage programme; CDX-specified intestinal (not hepatic, crypt-stem, Paneth or pancreatic) identity separates it from the confusables, with leukocyte migration an outlier.

qualifier: classical pathway, C3/C5 cleavage and opsonization
name: Classical complement activation, C3/C5 cleavage and opsonization
rationale: Members describe antibody/GZMK-initiated complement activation through C3/C5 and opsonization, whereas confusables center on the alternative pathway and complement regulation.

qualifier: classical pathway, C3/C5 cleavage and opsonization
name: Classical complement activation, C3/C5 cleavage and opsonization
rationale: Members cover antibody-mediated (and GZMK) complement activation through C3/C5 to opsonization, while confusables add the alternative pathway and negative regulation of the cascade.

qualifier: classical antibody-mediated route to C3/C5 activation and opsonisation
name: Classical complement activation, C3/C5 cleavage and opsonisation
rationale: Members cover classical antibody-triggered complement activation, C3 and C5 activation and opsonisation (with complement gene modules), whereas confusables centre on the alternative pathway and positive/negative regulation of the cascade.

qualifier: stem cell maintenance and erythroid-megakaryocytic differentiation
name: Hematopoietic stem cell, erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover HSC maintenance, RUNX1 hematopoietic programs, erythroid and megakaryocyte/platelet differentiation and myeloid progenitors, whereas confusables emphasize granulocyte/monocyte differentiation and non-hematopoietic RUNX targets.

qualifier: stem cell maintenance and erythroid-megakaryocyte lineage, RUNX1
name: Hematopoietic stem cell and erythroid-megakaryocyte lineage differentiation
rationale: Members cover HSC/progenitor maintenance, RUNX1-driven hematopoietic transcription and erythrocyte, megakaryocyte and early myeloid differentiation; neighbours focus on monocyte/granulocyte differentiation or non-hematopoietic RUNX1 targets.

qualifier: stem cell maintenance and erythroid-megakaryocyte differentiation
name: Hematopoietic stem cell maintenance and erythroid-megakaryocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover HSC/progenitor maintenance, RUNX1 programmes, erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation and early myeloid progenitors, while confusables focus on granulocyte/monocyte or lymphoid differentiation and other RUNX targets.

qualifier: lens, anterior segment, RPE and retinal vascular barrier
name: Eye morphogenesis and retinal vascular barrier formation
rationale: Members build the eye's lens, cornea, iris, RPE, optic cup/nerve and retinal/hyaloid vasculature and blood-retina barrier, whereas confusables concern photoreceptor/retinal neuron differentiation and phototransduction.

qualifier: lens, anterior eye and retinal vascular barriers
name: Eye morphogenesis, lens and retinal vascular barrier formation
rationale: Members cover structural eye development (optic cup, lens, iris, cornea, eyelid, RPE) and ocular vasculature and blood-retinal barrier, unlike confusables about photoreceptor/retinal neuron differentiation and phototransduction or retinoid metabolism.

qualifier: with retinal vasculature and blood-retinal barrier
name: Eye morphogenesis and retinal vascular barrier development
rationale: Members cover retina, lens, cornea, iris, eyelid and optic nerve morphogenesis together with hyaloid regression, retinal vessel formation and blood-retinal/brain barrier establishment, whereas confusables focus on photoreceptor and retinal neuron differentiation, lens/lacrimal development or phototransduction and retinoid metabolism.

core: Solute carrier ion transport and its defects
name: Bicarbonate, chloride and proton exchange by SLC transporters

rationale: Members are SLC4/9/12/26 chloride, bicarbonate, sodium-proton and inorganic anion transporters and their disease variants, unlike the CFTR/aquaporin, carbonic anhydrase and synaptic neighbours.

name: Anion exchangers, cation-chloride cotransporters and their inherited disorders
rationale: Members are bicarbonate, SLC26 anion, cation-chloride and sodium/proton exchangers with their genetic disease variants; confusables centre on CFTR, aquaporin water transport or carbonic anhydrase/pH regulation.

name: Keratinocyte differentiation, cornification and epidermal barrier formation

name: Keratinocyte differentiation, cornification and epidermal barrier formation

qualifier: spindle checkpoint and contractile ring cytokinesis
name: Mitotic spindle checkpoint and cytokinetic contractile ring formation

name: Mitotic spindle checkpoint and actomyosin ring cytokinesis
rationale: Members concern spindle assembly checkpoint, kinetochore attachment, spindle midzone/elongation and contractile/septin ring cytokinesis, unlike confusables on centrosome/AURKA, cohesion/condensation or abscission.

name: Mitotic spindle checkpoint, midzone and contractile-ring cytokinesis
rationale: Members span spindle checkpoint, kinetochore attachment, spindle elongation/midzone and actomyosin/septin cytokinesis; confusables cover centrosomes, abscission/nuclear envelope or chromosome cohesion.

qualifier: de novo synthesis and cardiolipin/PG remodeling
name: De novo glycerophospholipid and cardiolipin synthesis and turnover
rationale: Members cover CDP-DAG and CDP-choline routes to PE, PC, PS, PG and cardiolipin, PG/CL acyl remodeling and lysophospholipid hydrolysis, distinct from Lands-cycle remodeling of PC/PE/PI/PS and PI synthesis confusables.

qualifier: de novo PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin synthesis
name: De novo PC, PE, PS and cardiolipin synthesis and turnover
rationale: Members are head-group synthesis of PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin, plus cardiolipin/PG remodelling and lysophospholipid hydrolysis, unlike the confusables' Lands-cycle acyl remodelling and PI synthesis/transfer.

qualifier: PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin
name: PC, PE, PS, PG and cardiolipin synthesis and turnover
rationale: Members are de novo synthesis of PC/PE/PS/PG/cardiolipin via CDP intermediates plus lysophospholipid hydrolysis and cardiolipin remodelling, distinguishing it from Lands-cycle acyl remodelling and PI synthesis/transport confusables.

qualifier: melanin synthesis and pigment granule localization
name: MITF-M melanocyte program and melanin pigmentation

qualifier: melanin biosynthesis and pigment granule localization

qualifier: melanin synthesis and pigment granule localization
name: MITF-M target programs and melanin pigmentation
rationale: Members are MITF-M target gene programs plus melanin biosynthesis, pigment granule localization and pigmentation defects, distinguishing them from confusables centred on UV/blue-light response, melanocyte proliferation and MITF-driven apoptosis.

core: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface signature
qualifier: resting state with CD1 lipid antigen presentation
name: Monocyte and resting dendritic cell surface, CD1 lipid presentation

core: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface signature
qualifier: resting state with CD1 lipid antigen presentation

core: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface signature
name: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface signature with CD1 lipid presentation
rationale: Members are monocyte and resting dendritic cell surface signatures with CD1 lipid antigen presentation, unlike confusables featuring mature myeloid/neutrophil, activated DC/T cell or MHC II/TLR7 modules.

qualifier: phosphatidylinositol and sterol transfer at contact sites
name: ER phosphatidylinositol and sterol transfer between membranes
rationale: Members share ER-based lipid transfer and membrane tethering, including PI synthesis, PI/PC and cholesterol transport, distinguishing them from confusables on ER tubule shaping, glycolipid transfer or phosphoinositide phosphorylation.

core: ER lipid transfer and membrane traffic
name: Endoplasmic reticulum lipid transfer and ER-Golgi membrane traffic
rationale: Members cover ER-Golgi phospholipid/PI transfer, PI synthesis, ER-membrane tethering, cholesterol transport and Golgi vesicle traffic, unlike ER-shaping, phosphoinositide-signalling or glycolipid-transport confusables.

core: ER lipid transfer to other membranes
qualifier: phosphatidylinositol synthesis and ER-Golgi PI/PC transfer
name: ER-centred phospholipid and cholesterol transfer between membranes
rationale: Members concern ER positioning and tethering and lipid (PI, PC, cholesterol) transfer from the ER to other membranes, distinguished from ER-shaping, phosphoinositide and glycolipid confusables by PI synthesis and ER-Golgi transfer.

qualifier: vesicle endocytosis, recycling and active zone maintenance
name: Presynaptic vesicle endocytosis, recycling and active zone maintenance
rationale: Members regulate synaptic vesicle clustering, endocytosis, uncoating and recycling plus active zone/cytoskeleton maintenance; confusables cover vesicle docking/fusion release cycles, clathrin coat assembly or postsynaptic organisation.

qualifier: endocytosis, recycling and active zone maintenance rather than docking and fusion
name: Presynaptic vesicle endocytosis, recycling and active zone maintenance
rationale: Members regulate synaptic vesicle endocytosis, recycling, clustering, clathrin uncoating and active zone/cytoskeleton organization; the closest confusable instead covers vesicle docking, priming and fusion.

qualifier: endocytic recycling and active zone maintenance
name: Presynaptic vesicle endocytosis, recycling and active zone maintenance
rationale: Members regulate synaptic vesicle endocytosis, uncoating, recycling and clustering and presynaptic active zone/cytoskeleton structure; confusables instead feature postsynaptic organization, clathrin coat assembly or vesicle docking and exocytosis.

qualifier: brainstem neuronal migration and axon guidance
name: Brainstem development and hindbrain neuronal migration
rationale: All members concern hindbrain/brainstem (pons) development, cell differentiation, migration and branchiomotor axon guidance including brainstem respiratory control, distinct from cerebellar, cranial nerve, motor behaviour and spinal cord confusables.

qualifier: neuronal migration and brainstem respiratory control
name: Hindbrain and brainstem development with neuronal migration
rationale: All members concern hindbrain/pons/brainstem development, migration, branchiomotor axon guidance and brainstem respiratory control, distinguishing it from cranial nerve, cerebellar and spinal cord confusables.

qualifier: neuronal migration and branchiomotor axon guidance
name: Hindbrain development, neuronal migration and branchiomotor axon guidance
rationale: Members concern brainstem/pons development, hindbrain neuron migration and branchiomotor guidance, distinct from cerebellar, spinal cord patterning and motor behavior confusables.

qualifier: acidification and lysosomal fusion at host-pathogen interface
name: Phagosome acidification and lysosome fusion in microbial killing
rationale: Members cover phagosome acidification, phagolysosome fusion, ion flux and iron competition at the host-pathogen interface and PMN phagocytolysis; confusables add Mtb immune evasion or peptide transporters.

name: Phagosome acidification, fusion and ion/iron competition with pathogens
rationale: Members concern phagosome acidification, phagosome-lysosome fusion, PMN phagocytolysis and ion/iron exchange at the host-pathogen interface, while confusables focus on Mtb immune evasion, heme uptake or neutrophil granule programmes.

name: Phagosome acidification and ion control against intracellular mycobacteria
rationale: Members describe phagosome acidification, phagolysosome fusion, PMN phagocytolysis and ion/iron competition at the Mtb-host interface, whereas confusables cover broader Mtb immune evasion or neutrophil granule cargo and peptide transport.

qualifier: NGF production and p75NTR death/survival signaling
name: NGF production and p75NTR death and survival signaling
rationale: Members concern NGF/proNGF processing and p75NTR complex recruitment, proteolysis, NRIF/NADE death and NF-kB survival signaling, which TRKA, dependence-receptor and axon-regeneration confusables lack.

qualifier: NGF processing, NF-kB survival and NRIF death
name: p75 neurotrophin receptor signaling and NGF processing
rationale: Members are p75NTR ligand binding, proteolysis and survival/death outputs plus NGF/neurotrophin production, unlike TRKA confusables and the axon-regeneration/ceramide p75 confusable.

qualifier: NGF processing, NRIF/NADE death and NF-kB survival
name: NGF processing and p75NTR death/survival signaling
rationale: Members cover NGF/proNGF production and binding to p75NTR, its proteolysis and NRIF/NADE death or NF-kB survival outputs, distinguishing it from TRKA signaling and p75NTR RhoA/ceramide/axon-regeneration confusables.

name: IRF3-driven interferon-beta induction and cGAS-STING regulation
rationale: Members describe IRF3 activation of type I IFN and regulation of IFN-beta production/response and cGAS-STING; confusables carry RIG-I/MDA5 sensing or IFN-alpha/OAS responses instead.

name: IRF3-driven interferon-beta induction and cGAS-STING regulation
rationale: Members concern IRF3-mediated type I IFN induction and IFN-beta production/response with cGAS-STING control, unlike RIG-I/MDA5 sensing or IFN-alpha response confusables.

name: IRF3-driven interferon-beta induction and its cGAS-STING restraint
rationale: Members are IRF3-mediated type I IFN induction, interferon-beta response and production control, and negative regulation of cGAS/STING; confusables center on RIG-I/MDA5 sensing, TBK1 regulation or IFN-alpha/OAS responses.

name: Defensin and antimicrobial peptide defense against microbes
rationale: Members describe antimicrobial peptide production, defensins, metal sequestration and killing of bacteria, fungi and other microbes at mucosae; confusables concern bacterial entry, intestinal epithelium or neutrophil degranulation.

name: Antimicrobial peptide and mucosal innate defense against microbes
rationale: Members concern host killing of bacteria, fungi and parasites by defensins and other antimicrobial peptides, metal sequestration and mucosal/microbiota defense; confusables are Listeria entry, intestinal epithelial maintenance or neutrophil degranulation/respiratory burst.

qualifier: defensins, antimicrobial peptides and mucosal innate immunity
name: Defensin and antimicrobial peptide defense at mucosal surfaces
rationale: Members describe direct microbe killing and control by defensins, antimicrobial peptides, metal sequestration, cytolysis and mucosal innate responses, distinguishing the theme from neutrophil degranulation/respiratory burst, intestinal epithelial maintenance and bacterial invasion themes.

qualifier: processing, modification, stability and ribosome assembly
name: Mitochondrial RNA processing, modification, stability and ribosome assembly
rationale: Members concern mitochondrial tRNA/rRNA/mRNA processing, modification, import, stability and decay plus mitoribosome subunit assembly, unlike confusables on mitochondrial translation steps, mtDNA replication/transcription, nuclear tRNA processing or pseudouridylation.

name: Mitochondrial RNA processing, modification, stability and ribosome assembly
rationale: Members concern post-transcriptional handling of mitochondrial mRNA, tRNA and rRNA and mitoribosome assembly, unlike confusables on mitochondrial transcription/translation/DNA, pseudouridylation or nuclear tRNA processing.

qualifier: RNA processing, modification, stability and mitoribosome assembly
name: Mitochondrial RNA processing, modification, stability and ribosome assembly
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial tRNA/mRNA/rRNA processing, modification, decay and import plus mitoribosome assembly, distinguishing it from nuclear tRNA processing, mitochondrial translation/transcription and pseudouridylation confusables.

qualifier: gp130 receptors via STAT3 and ERK
name: IL-6 family gp130 cytokine signaling via STAT3 and ERK
rationale: Members cover IL-6, IL-11, LIF and CNTF receptor signaling through STAT3 and ERK1/2 activation, distinguishing it from common-gamma-chain/STAT5 cytokine and erythropoietin/FLT3 confusables.

name: IL-6-family cytokine signaling through STAT3 and ERK
rationale: Members are IL-6, IL-11, LIF and CNTF signalling with STAT3 and ERK1/2 activation and its negative regulation, unlike confusables on IL-2/IL-7/EPO STAT5 signalling or inflammatory cytokine output modules.

name: IL-6 family gp130 cytokine signaling via STAT3 and ERK
rationale: Members cover IL-6, IL-11, CNTF and LIF receptor signaling through STAT3 and ERK1/2, distinguishing it from IL-2/IL-7/STAT5 and EPO/FLT3 confusables.

qualifier: direct methyl-group reversal and base excision repair completion
name: DNA methyl-group removal and base excision repair completion
rationale: Members combine direct alkylation reversal, TET/TDG active demethylation and downstream BER gap-filling/AP-site resolution, whereas confusables centre on glycosylase recognition and cleavage steps.

qualifier: alkylation reversal, TET/TDG demethylation and BER gap filling
name: Alkylation damage reversal, active DNA demethylation and BER gap-filling
rationale: Members cover direct reversal of alkylation (ALKBH2/3, MGMT), TET/TDG-driven 5-methylcytosine demethylation and post-incision short/long-patch BER, whereas confusables centre on glycosylase recognition/cleavage, NEIL/OGG1 defects or methionine salvage.

core: DNA base damage repair and demethylation
qualifier: direct alkylation reversal and post-incision base excision steps
name: Alkylation damage reversal, base excision gap-filling and DNA demethylation
rationale: Members cover direct reversal of alkylation (ALKBH2/3, MGMT), AP-site resolution and gap-filling in base excision repair, and TET/TDG-mediated 5-methylcytosine demethylation, lacking the glycosylase recognition/cleavage and OGG1/MUTYH steps of the neighbours.

name: Acylglycerol synthesis and triglyceride lipolysis
rationale: Members cover the PA/DAG/MAG/TAG synthesis pathway and lipase-mediated triglyceride breakdown, unlike neighbours focused on lipid droplet organization, lipophagy and adipocyte storage regulation.

name: Phosphatidic acid, diacylglycerol and triglyceride synthesis and lipolysis
rationale: Members cover PA, DAG, MAG and TAG synthesis/remodeling plus lipase-driven triglyceride catabolism (incl. PDE3B), unlike confusables on lipid droplet dynamics and lipophagy.

name: Glycerolipid synthesis and hormone-regulated triglyceride lipolysis
rationale: Members cover PA, DAG, MAG and TAG synthesis/remodelling and lipase-driven triglyceride breakdown including PDE3B signalling; distinct from lipid droplet and lipophagy confusables.

name: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing driving IRF3 type I interferon induction
rationale: Members share RIG-I/MDA5, ZBP1 and cytosolic DNA sensing feeding IRF3 type I IFN induction, unlike confusables centred on OAS effectors, IRF7/TLR signaling or RLR negative regulation.

name: Cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing driving IRF3 type I interferon induction
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5 dsRNA and cytosolic DNA/ZBP1 sensing leading to IRF3-mediated type I IFN and IP-10, unlike confusables centred on helicase/IRF7 TLR routes, OAS or interferon-alpha response.

core: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon induction
name: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing and IRF3-driven type I interferon
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5 dsRNA sensing, ZBP1 and cytosolic DNA sensing leading to IRF3-mediated type I IFN and IP-10 induction, whereas confusables emphasize IRF7/TLR, negative regulators, OAS effectors or interferon-alpha responses.

core: Vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor metabolism
name: Vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor, serine and sulfide metabolism
rationale: Members span PLP and molybdenum cofactor (prosthetic group) metabolism together with serine metabolism/transport and sulfide oxidation, whereas confusables centre on transsulfuration, BH4/aromatic amino acids or proline/glycine.

core: Vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor metabolism
name: Vitamin B6, molybdenum cofactor, serine and sulfide metabolism
rationale: Members cover PLP and molybdenum cofactor (prosthetic group) metabolism plus the serine and sulfide reactions they serve; confusables are about transsulfuration, BH4/phenylalanine or general amino acid biosynthesis instead.

qualifier: vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor, sulfide oxidation, serine
name: Vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor, sulfide and serine metabolism
