rationale: Members span prosthetic cofactor metabolism (PLP, molybdenum cofactor), hydrogen sulfide oxidation and serine metabolism/transport; the cofactor and sulfide components separate it from the amino acid catabolism and transsulfuration confusables.

name: Protein lysine trimethylation and lysine/proline hydroxylation
rationale: Members are protein methylation and hydroxylation (peptidyl-lysine trimethylation and hydroxylation, proline modification), unlike tRNA and translation-factor modification or arginine/mono-dimethylation confusables.

name: Protein lysine and proline hydroxylation and trimethylation
rationale: Members are peptidyl hydroxylation (lysine, proline) and lysine trimethylation/protein methylation, distinguishing it from RNA modification, diphthamide/hypusine and arginine or mono/dimethylation confusables.

qualifier: lysine and proline hydroxylation and methylation
name: Peptidyl lysine and proline hydroxylation and methylation
rationale: All members are protein side-chain hydroxylation or methylation of lysine/proline, distinguishing them from RNA modification, translation-factor modification (hypusine, diphthamide) and mono/dimethylation confusables.

qualifier: dopamine synthesis and regulation of transmitter uptake and release
name: Catecholamine synthesis and presynaptic transmitter release regulation
rationale: Members are dopamine/catecholamine synthesis, transmitter uptake and secretion control, spontaneous transmission and neuron maturation; confusables are synaptic vesicle recycling, synapse organization or dopamine transport and receptor signaling without synthesis.

name: Dopamine biosynthesis and presynaptic transmitter release control
rationale: Members combine catecholamine/dopamine synthesis with regulation of transmitter secretion, uptake and spontaneous transmission; biosynthesis distinguishes it from dopamine transport and synaptic structure confusables.

name: Dopamine synthesis and presynaptic neurotransmitter release regulation
rationale: Members concern catecholamine/dopamine synthesis and presynaptic transmitter release, uptake and spontaneous transmission, distinct from synaptic vesicle/structure confusables and dopamine transport/receptor confusables.

qualifier: attachment, entry and host cell manipulation
name: Viral attachment, entry and host cell manipulation
rationale: Members cover virion attachment, receptor-mediated entry, fusion and host apoptosis/junction targeting across dengue, RSV, influenza, HIV and SARS, unlike confusables on viral protein maturation or host restriction of viruses.

name: Viral attachment, entry and host-cell fusion
rationale: Members center on virion attachment, receptor-mediated entry and fusion across dengue, RSV, influenza, HIV and SARS-CoV, distinguishing the theme from confusables on viral protein maturation or host restriction of infection.

core: Viral attachment and entry into host cells
qualifier: receptor binding, endocytosis and membrane fusion
name: Viral attachment, entry and host cell membrane fusion
rationale: Members centre on virus-receptor attachment, endocytic entry and fusion across dengue, RSV, influenza, HIV and coronaviruses, lacking the viral protein maturation/assembly and host restriction terms that define the neighbours.

qualifier: sensing, NHEJ and repair pathway choice
name: Double-strand break sensing, NHEJ and repair pathway choice
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing and ATM signaling, classical/alternative NHEJ, regulation of HR versus NHEJ and BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 defects, whereas confusables cover PARP ADP-ribosylation or HR mechanics such as resection and strand invasion.

qualifier: NHEJ and HR/NHEJ pathway choice, BRCA defects
name: Double-strand break sensing, NHEJ and repair pathway choice
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing/ATM signaling, classical and alternative NHEJ, regulation of HR versus NHEJ and BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 defects, whereas confusables emphasize resection, strand exchange or ADP-ribosylation.

qualifier: sensing, NHEJ and BRCA-dependent repair choice
name: Double-strand break sensing, NHEJ and BRCA-dependent response
rationale: Members concern DSB sensing/ATM signaling, classical and alternative NHEJ, HR-vs-NHEJ regulation and BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 defects; neighbours focus on resection/HR strand exchange or ADP-ribosylation.

name: Androgen and estrogen receptor transcriptional responses
rationale: Members are androgen, estrogen and progesterone receptor responses with prominent androgen/AR gene sets, which the estrogen-late, HSP90 chaperone and GPER1 confusables lack.

qualifier: combined estrogen and androgen receptor responses
name: Estrogen and androgen receptor signalling
rationale: Members are nuclear sex steroid receptor responses (estrogen, androgen, progesterone, testosterone), and the joint androgen-receptor/prostate arm separates it from estrogen-only confusables while the estrogen arm separates it from the androgen-leaning one.

name: Sex steroid receptor signaling, estrogen and androgen responses
rationale: Members are estrogen, androgen and progesterone receptor signaling and responses; unlike the estrogen-only confusables the theme includes androgen/prostate programs, and unlike C1 it includes androgen and estrogen response hallmarks.

core: Fasting hormonal control of hepatic fuel metabolism
name: Glucagon-PKA fasting control of gluconeogenesis and triglyceride metabolism
rationale: Members cover glucagon response and secretion, PKA/AMPK/PDE3B signaling and regulation of gluconeogenesis and triglyceride turnover; confusables emphasize ChREBP glucose sensing, LXR lipogenesis, insulin/adiponectin or glycogen.

qualifier: glucagon-PKA signaling over gluconeogenesis and lipolysis
name: Glucagon-PKA fasting control of gluconeogenesis and lipolysis
rationale: Members are glucagon/PKA, PDE3B and AMPK-ChREBP control of gluconeogenesis and triglyceride breakdown, unlike confusables on glucose-sensing ChREBP, insulin/adiponectin, LXR lipogenesis or glycogen.

name: Glucagon-PKA fasting control of gluconeogenesis and triglyceride metabolism
rationale: Members describe glucagon/PKA, PDE3B and AMPK signaling that tunes gluconeogenesis and triglyceride turnover under fasting or caloric restriction, unlike glycogen, LXR lipogenesis, insulin/adiponectin and ChREBP glucose-sensing confusables.

name: Presynaptic calcium control of GABA release and synaptic strength
rationale: Members are presynaptic calcium entry, vesicle exocytosis, GABA secretion and short-term modulation of GABAergic and glutamatergic transmission; confusables are G protein-gated K channel/kainate presynaptic signaling or glutamate secretion.

name: Presynaptic calcium-triggered transmitter release and GABAergic modulation
rationale: Members concern presynaptic calcium, vesicle exocytosis, GABA secretion and short-term plasticity; GABA terms distinguish it from glutamate-release C1 and calcium-driven exocytosis from the G-protein inhibitory confusables C2-C4.

name: Presynaptic calcium-dependent modulation of GABA and glutamate release
rationale: Members are presynaptic calcium and vesicle exocytosis control of GABAergic and glutamatergic transmission, unlike confusables centred on G-protein channel inhibition or inhibitory synapse assembly.

qualifier: with glial activation restraint and LTP suppression
name: Amyloid-beta generation, impaired clearance and glial suppression
rationale: Members promote amyloid-beta formation and ectodomain shedding, reduce its clearance and dampen astrocyte/microglia activation and LTP, unlike confusables on Aβ clearance, fibrils or TREM2/DAP12 microglial phagocytosis.

qualifier: amyloid-beta generation with glial and synaptic effects
name: Amyloid-beta generation and its glial and synaptic effects
rationale: Members concern amyloid-beta formation via ectodomain proteolysis, reduced clearance, responses to amyloid-beta, glial activation/proliferation and LTP suppression, unlike confusables centred on microglial phagocytosis or fibril clearance.

qualifier: increased production, reduced clearance, glial and synaptic effects
name: Amyloid-beta accumulation effects on glia and synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members promote amyloid-beta formation and ectodomain shedding, impair its clearance and regulate glial activation and LTP, unlike microglial phagocytosis or clearance-promoting confusables.

qualifier: proliferation and negative regulation of differentiation
name: Myeloid progenitor proliferation and restraint of myeloid differentiation
rationale: Members are the promyelocyte/progenitor programme, progenitor proliferation and negative regulation of granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation, unlike pro-differentiation, megakaryocyte and HSC confusables.

qualifier: with suppression of terminal myeloid differentiation
name: Myeloid progenitor expansion and restrained myeloid differentiation
rationale: Members cover common myeloid progenitor proliferation, the promyelocyte granule programme and negative regulation of granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation; confusables drive differentiation, HSC maintenance or megakaryopoiesis.

name: Immature myeloid progenitor expansion and restrained myeloid differentiation
rationale: Members are common myeloid progenitor proliferation, a promyelocyte granule-protein module and negative regulation of granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation, contrasting with confusables that promote monocyte/macrophage, megakaryocyte or stem-cell programmes.

name: COPI vesicle budding and ER-Golgi vesicle targeting
rationale: Members describe vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi and COPI vesicle budding for retrograde traffic, distinguishing the theme from vesicle tethering and COPII ER-export confusables.

name: COPI retrograde budding and ER-Golgi vesicle targeting
rationale: Members are COPI vesicle budding, Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic and ER/Golgi vesicle targeting, distinct from COPII export and tethering confusables.

name: ER-Golgi vesicle targeting and COPI retrograde budding
rationale: Members are vesicle targeting between ER exit sites and Golgi plus COPI budding and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic, distinguishing them from tethering (C1) and COPII anterograde/ER quality-control confusables.

name: Nucleosome assembly, disassembly and CHD1/2 chromatin remodeling
rationale: Members cover nucleosome organization, replication-dependent assembly, protein-DNA complex disassembly and CHD1/2 remodelers, distinguishing it from CENP-A centromeric and BAF complex confusables.

name: Replication-coupled nucleosome assembly and CHD1/2 remodeling
rationale: Members cover nucleosome organization, replication-dependent assembly, disassembly and chromatin targeting with CHD1/2 remodelers, whereas neighbours are BAF assembly or centromeric CENP-A deposition and acetylation.

qualifier: replication- and repair-coupled assembly and disassembly
name: Nucleosome assembly and disassembly in replication and repair
rationale: Members cover replication-dependent chromatin assembly, protein-DNA complex disassembly, CHD remodeling and NER regulation, unlike confusables on BAF complex formation or centromeric CENP-A deposition and condensation.

name: Arterial, venous and lymphatic endothelial cell specification
rationale: All members concern endothelial fate commitment and differentiation into arterial (dorsal aorta), venous and lymphatic identities, whereas confusables emphasise vasculogenesis, vessel maturation, BMP signaling or cardiopulmonary artery morphogenesis.

name: Arterial, venous and lymphatic endothelial cell fate specification
rationale: All members concern endothelial fate commitment and differentiation into arterial, venous and lymphatic identities including dorsal aorta morphogenesis, while confusables center on vasculogenesis, vessel maturation, BMP signaling or great-artery development.

name: Arterial, venous and lymphatic endothelial cell fate specification
rationale: All members concern endothelial differentiation into arterial, venous and lymphatic identities, whereas confusables emphasise BMP signalling, vessel maturation and cardiac/pulmonary vasculature.

name: Primary cilium trafficking and photoreceptor outer segment development
rationale: Members are intraflagellar/BBSome ciliary cargo transport, basal body and transition-zone assembly plus photoreceptor and retinal neuron development, distinguishing it from motile-cilium/axoneme, multiciliogenesis and mitotic centrosome confusables.

name: Primary cilium trafficking and photoreceptor outer segment development
rationale: Members cover intraflagellar transport, BBSome and ciliary cargo targeting, transition zone and basal body anchoring alongside photoreceptor outer segment and retinal neuron development, unlike motile cilia, sperm flagellum or mitotic centrosome neighbours.

qualifier: photoreceptor outer segment and retinal cell development
name: Primary cilium trafficking and photoreceptor outer segment development
rationale: Members are IFT, BBSome and ciliary cargo targeting, basal body anchoring and cilium assembly/disassembly together with rod/cone outer segment development, while confusables cover motile cilia/sperm axonemes, centrosome-spindle or tubulin modification.

name: BDNF and NT-3 signaling through TrkB and TrkC
rationale: Members are NTRK2/NTRK3 activation by BDNF, NT-3 and NT-4 and their PI3K, RAS, PLCG1, FRS and CDK5 effectors, whereas confusables cover NGF/TrkA signalling.

qualifier: TRKB and TRKC via BDNF, NT-3 and NT-4
name: BDNF/NT-3 signaling through TRKB and TRKC
rationale: Members are activation of NTRK2/NTRK3 by BDNF, NT-3 and NT-4 and their downstream RAS, PI3K, PLCG1 and FRS2 effectors, whereas confusables cover NGF-TRKA signaling.

name: BDNF and NT-3/4 signalling through TRKB and TRKC
rationale: Members are BDNF/NTF3/NTF4 activation of NTRK2/NTRK3 and their RAS, PI3K, PLCG1 and FRS outputs, whereas confusables cover NGF-TRKA signalling.

qualifier: pesticides, ethanol and aryl hydrocarbon receptor
name: Response to organic xenobiotics, pesticides and ethanol
rationale: Members are responses to organic chemicals (pesticides, dioxin via AhR, ethanol, nicotine, anesthetics), unlike confusables on metal ions, vitamin C or cytotoxic drugs.

qualifier: pesticides, dioxin/aryl hydrocarbon receptor, ethanol and nicotine
name: Responses to organic xenobiotics: pesticides, dioxins, ethanol, nicotine
rationale: Members are cellular responses to environmental organic chemicals (pesticides, dioxin via AhR, bisphenol A, ethanol, nicotine, anaesthetics); organic toxicants distinguish it from metal-ion, vitamin and anticancer-drug response confusables.

name: Responses to organic toxicants, pesticides, ethanol and nicotine
rationale: Members are cellular responses to environmental organic chemicals (AhR/dioxin, pesticides, bisphenol, ethanol, nicotine, anesthetics), unlike confusables on metal ions, vitamins or anticancer drugs.

name: Prostaglandin synthesis and prostanoid/leukotriene receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover PLA2/COX-driven prostaglandin and thromboxane synthesis and prostanoid and leukotriene GPCR signaling, unlike confusables on leukotriene/lipoxin synthesis or P450 eicosanoid metabolism.

name: Cyclooxygenase prostaglandin synthesis and prostanoid/leukotriene receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover PLA2/COX prostaglandin and thromboxane synthesis, its regulation and prostanoid and leukotriene GPCRs; neighbours instead cover lipoxygenase leukotriene synthesis or cytochrome P450 eicosanoids.

qualifier: COX/PLA2 prostaglandin synthesis and prostanoid/leukotriene receptors
name: Prostaglandin synthesis and prostanoid/leukotriene receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover PLA2/COX prostaglandin and thromboxane synthesis and its regulation plus prostanoid and leukotriene receptor signaling, while confusables are leukotriene/lipoxin synthesis or P450 eicosanoid metabolism.

qualifier: intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and metanephric mesenchyme
name: Early kidney development from intermediate mesoderm to renal vesicle
rationale: Members span intermediate mesoderm, pronephros, nephric duct, ureteric bud elongation, metanephric mesenchyme maintenance and MET to renal vesicles, whereas confusables cover later S-shaped body nephron morphogenesis or negative regulation of kidney growth.

qualifier: intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and metanephric mesenchyme induction
name: Early kidney development from intermediate mesoderm to nephron induction
rationale: Members span intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and pronephros formation, metanephric mesenchyme maintenance/differentiation, MET, renal vesicle and ureteric bud elongation, whereas confusables cover later S-shaped body morphogenesis or kidney growth control.

qualifier: intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and metanephric mesenchyme
name: Early kidney development from intermediate mesoderm to nephron epithelium
rationale: Members trace early nephrogenesis from intermediate mesoderm and nephric duct through metanephric mesenchyme maintenance, renal vesicle formation and tubule epithelial differentiation, unlike confusables on kidney size control or comma/S-shaped body morphogenesis.

core: Neural plate and axial midline morphogenesis
name: Neural plate and axial midline morphogenesis during axis elongation
rationale: Members cover notochord/axial mesoderm, floor plate and neural plate/fold morphogenesis; convergent extension, paraxial mesoderm and neural plate morphogenesis separate it from neural plate patterning and spinal cord patterning neighbours.

core: Axial mesoderm and neural plate morphogenesis
name: Notochord and neural plate morphogenesis during axis elongation
rationale: Members cover notochord/axial and paraxial mesoderm, floor plate and neural plate/fold formation; convergent extension, paraxial mesoderm and neural plate morphogenesis separate it from the spinal-cord patterning and neural-plate-border confusables.

core: Axial mesoderm and neural plate morphogenesis
name: Axial mesoderm, notochord and neural plate morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover axial mesoderm/notochord formation, floor plate and neural plate morphogenesis along the body axis; unlike the spinal cord patterning and neural plate border confusables, the theme includes notochord, convergent extension and paraxial mesoderm formation.

name: Purine (deoxy)nucleoside and nucleotide catabolism
rationale: Members cover breakdown of AMP, IMP, dGMP, adenosine, inosine and deoxypurines via ADA and PNP toward allantoin, distinguished from purine salvage/de novo synthesis confusables and pyrimidine deoxynucleotide catabolism.

name: Purine nucleotide and deoxynucleoside catabolism
rationale: Members degrade AMP/IMP/dGMP and (deoxy)adenosine/inosine via ADA and PNP toward allantoin, whereas confusables cover purine salvage, de novo synthesis or pyrimidine deoxynucleotide catabolism.

name: Purine ribo- and deoxyribonucleoside catabolism
rationale: Members cover breakdown of adenosine, inosine, AMP, IMP and deoxypurine nucleotides toward allantoin, including ADA and PNP defects, as opposed to the purine salvage and de novo synthesis or NUDT/thiopurine confusables.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signalling to PI3K–AKT and ERK
name: IGF1R–IRS and ALK/LTK signalling to PI3K–AKT and ERK
rationale: Members are RTK autophosphorylation and downstream PI3K/AKT, SOS and ERK signalling; IRS/IGF1R and ALK/LTK inputs separate it from the ERBB/MET confusables and the RAS/MAPK attenuation theme.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K/AKT and ERK
name: IGF1R and ALK/LTK signaling to PI3K/AKT and ERK
rationale: Members are tyrosine-kinase receptor events (IGF1R-SHC/IRS/SOS, ALK/LTK, autophosphorylation) feeding PI3K/AKT and ERK activation, distinguishing them from MET/ERBB receptor themes and from RAS/MAPK negative-feedback themes.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K/AKT and ERK
name: Receptor tyrosine kinase PI3K/AKT and ERK signaling via IRS/SHC adaptors
rationale: All members concern tyrosine-kinase receptor phosphorylation driving PI3K/AKT and ERK outputs; the IRS, SHC and SOS adaptor events (IGF1R, ALK/LTK) distinguish it from MET/ERBB-centred and negative-feedback RAS/MAPK neighbours.

name: RAF–MEK activation by RAS/MRAS and oncogenic RAF mutants
rationale: Members cover RAF and MAP2K activation, MRAS-SHOC2 complexes and BRAF/RAF1/MAP2K mutant signalling, versus confusables on integrin linkage, RAF fusions, Rap1 and ERK negative feedback.

qualifier: oncogenic BRAF, RAF1 and MEK mutants
name: RAF activation and oncogenic BRAF, RAF1, MEK mutants
rationale: Members cover RAF activation (including MRAS-SHOC2) and signalling by BRAF, RAF1, MAP2K and RAS mutants, while confusables add ERK negative feedback, fusions or integrin/Rap1 linkage.

qualifier: SHOC2-MRAS complexes and oncogenic RAF/MEK point mutants
name: RAF-MEK activation and oncogenic RAF/MEK mutant signaling
rationale: Members cover RAF activation, MAP2K/MAPK activation and BRAF/RAF1/MAP2K/MRAS mutant signaling, lacking the integrin linkage, fusions, RSK or ERK-feedback content of confusables.

name: Glycerol and polyol metabolism with acylglycerol biosynthesis
rationale: Members link glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate, alditol and fructose metabolism to PA, DAG, MAG and TAG synthesis, whereas confusables concern lipolysis, lipid droplets, phospholipid catabolism or glycerol transport.

qualifier: fed by glycerol, polyol and fructose metabolism
name: Glycerol, polyol and fructose metabolism feeding acylglycerol synthesis
rationale: Members build PA, DAG, MAG and TAG from glycerol-3-phosphate and include glycerol, alditol and fructose metabolism, which the triglyceride catabolism, phospholipid hydrolysis and glycerol transport confusables lack.

name: Glycerol and polyol metabolism with phosphatidate-to-triglyceride synthesis
rationale: Members concern glycerol, glycerol-3-phosphate, alditol and fructose metabolism and the PA-DAG-TAG synthesis they feed; the polyol/glycerol arm distinguishes it from triglyceride catabolism, lipid droplet and glycerol transport confusables.

name: Lung branching growth and trachea formation
rationale: Members describe lung bud branching, lobe and vascular development and growth plus trachea formation and cartilage, the latter absent from surfactant/pneumocyte and mesenchymal-signaling confusables.

qualifier: branching morphogenesis, growth and trachea formation
name: Lung branching morphogenesis, growth and trachea formation
rationale: Members cover lung bud branching, lobe growth, lung vasculature and trachea formation/cartilage, distinguishing it from confusables on alveolar pneumocyte differentiation, surfactant and lung mesenchyme proliferation.

name: Lung branching growth and trachea formation
rationale: Members concern lung bud branching, lobe and vascular growth plus trachea and tracheal cartilage formation, the tracheal terms separating it from mesenchyme and alveolar/surfactant confusables.

name: Activin-FSH axis in gonadotropin secretion and testis development
rationale: Members cover activin signalling and follistatin antagonism, glycoprotein hormones, LH/FSH secretion and FSH response, and Sertoli/seminiferous tubule development; confusables emphasise ovarian follicle, ovulation and Leydig or meiotic events.

name: Activin and FSH signaling in testis development
rationale: Members combine activin/follistatin signaling, glycoprotein hormone (FSH/LH) secretion and response, and Sertoli/seminiferous tubule development, unlike ovarian and LH-response confusables.

qualifier: activin control and Sertoli cell development
name: Activin-regulated gonadotropin secretion and Sertoli cell development
rationale: Members link activin/follistatin signalling and glycoprotein hormone FSH/LH secretion with Sertoli and seminiferous tubule development, the activin arm separating it from ovarian and Leydig/GnRH confusables.

name: Death-receptor apoptosis regulation via TRAIL/TNF and necrosis suppression
rationale: Members regulate extrinsic death-receptor apoptosis via TRAIL and TNF, execution-phase apoptosis and programmed necrosis, unlike confusables centred on TNFR1-NF-kB, caspase-8 machinery or Fas in T cells.

qualifier: TRAIL death receptor signalling with TNF and necroptosis restraint
name: TRAIL and death receptor extrinsic apoptosis regulation
rationale: Members regulate death-receptor extrinsic apoptosis, TRAIL signalling, execution-phase apoptosis and suppress TNF signalling, necrosis and hepatocyte apoptosis, unlike confusables on TNFR1-NF-kB, Fas/BID or caspase-8/necroptosis machinery.

name: Regulation of TRAIL/TNF death receptor-mediated extrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate death-domain receptor apoptosis (TRAIL, TNF), execution phase, necrosis and hepatocyte apoptosis, distinct from Fas/T-cell death, TNFR1-NF-kB and caspase-8/necroptosis machinery confusables.

name: Outflow tract, semilunar valve and cardiac artery morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern outflow tract septation, aortic/pulmonary valves, pharyngeal arch, pulmonary and coronary arteries and cardiac neural crest, unlike confusables on second heart field, AV valves/endocardial cushions or BMP-ductus physiology.

name: Outflow tract, great artery and semilunar valve morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern neural crest-dependent outflow tract septation, pharyngeal arch, pulmonary and coronary arteries and aortic/pulmonary valves, unlike confusables centred on second heart field cardiogenesis, AV valve/endocardial cushion formation or lung vascular BMP signalling.

name: Cardiac outflow tract, great artery and semilunar valve morphogenesis
rationale: Members share neural crest-dependent outflow tract septation, pharyngeal/pulmonary/coronary artery and aortic/pulmonary valve morphogenesis, unlike confusables on BMP/lung vasculature, second heart field or atrioventricular cushions.

name: Immediate-early transcriptional response to UV and mitogenic stress
rationale: Members are early-response gene programs to UV, phorbol ester, TNF-NF-kB and growth factors with growth arrest, distinguishing them from senescence/SASP and AP-1 network confusables.

name: Immediate-early stress gene response to UV and mitogens
rationale: Members are UV-B, phorbol ester, TNF/NF-kB and growth-factor-induced NR4A immediate-early gene programmes with growth arrest; UV and PMA responses distinguish it from senescence, AP-1 and PI3K confusables.

name: Immediate-early stress response to UV, TNF and phorbol ester
rationale: Members are UV, TNF/NF-kB and PMA-induced immediate-early (NR4A) and growth-arrest gene programmes, distinguishing it from senescence, AP-1 and light-response neighbours.

name: Meiotic sister chromatid cohesion, chiasma formation and chromosome segregation
rationale: Members are structural events of meiotic chromosome cohesion, chiasma assembly, alignment and segregation, unlike confusables on meiotic checkpoints and phase transitions or mitotic cohesion.

qualifier: cohesion, chiasma assembly and chromosome alignment
name: Meiotic chromosome cohesion, chiasma formation and segregation
rationale: Members cover the mechanics of meiotic chromosomes (sister cohesion, chiasmata, alignment, movement to poles), whereas confusables cover meiotic checkpoint and phase-transition regulation or mitotic cohesion.

name: Meiotic sister chromatid cohesion, chiasmata and chromosome segregation
rationale: All members describe the structural events of meiotic chromosome cohesion, chiasma formation, alignment and segregation; confusables are mitotic cohesion or meiotic cell cycle transition control.

qualifier: N-/O-glycans, glycosphingolipids, nucleotide sugars and lysosomal turnover
name: N-/O-glycan, glycosphingolipid and nucleotide-sugar metabolism with lysosomal turnover
rationale: Nearly all members concern N-glycan processing, mucin O-glycans, sialylation/fucosylation, GPI, glycosphingolipids, nucleotide-sugar synthesis/transport and lysosomal glycan catabolism (a few outliers aside), unlike confusables on proteoglycan GAGs, DAG1 O-mannosylation or dolichol-linked precursor assembly.

qualifier: N/O-glycan maturation, sialylation, glycosphingolipids, lysosomal catabolism
name: Glycoprotein and glycolipid glycan synthesis, sialylation and degradation
rationale: Nearly all members concern nucleotide-sugar supply, N- and O-glycan processing, sialic acid and fucose, GPI and glycosphingolipid synthesis and their lysosomal breakdown; confusables are proteoglycan/GAG and O-mannosyl glycosylation or early dolichol-linked CDG-I steps.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar supply and lysosomal glycan degradation
name: Glycoconjugate glycosylation, nucleotide-sugar supply and lysosomal glycan degradation
rationale: Members span N-/O-glycan, GPI and glycosphingolipid synthesis, nucleotide sugar/sialic acid supply and transport and lysosomal glycan catabolism; confusables are restricted to dolichol/early CDG steps or proteoglycan and O-mannosyl glycosylation.

qualifier: G2/M progression and RB1–E2F G1/S control
name: Cell cycle G2/M checkpoint and RB1–E2F G1/S control
rationale: Members span G2/M checkpoint and mitotic entry events plus RB1–E2F and CDK4/6 G1/S control, distinguishing them from E2F-transcription-only and APC/C mitotic-exit confusables.

name: RB-E2F G1/S and G2/M cell cycle checkpoint control
rationale: Members span RB/E2F/DREAM control of G1/S, CDK inhibition and G2/M checkpoint and mitotic entry events; lacking APC/C mitotic-exit and E2F G1/S-transcription-only content of the neighbours.

qualifier: RB1-E2F repression and G2/M checkpoint control
name: Cell cycle transitions via RB1-E2F repression and G2/M checkpoint
rationale: Members span cyclin-CDK control of G1/S via RB1/E2F and DREAM repression plus G2/M entry and checkpoint events; confusables are APC/C mitotic exit or E2F-target G1/S transcription and proliferation modules.

qualifier: astrocyte and oligodendrocyte fate, proliferation and gliosis
name: Glial cell fate, proliferation, gliosis and myelination
rationale: Members concern glial specification, proliferation, astrocyte activation/gliosis and CNS/PNS myelination with axon calibre, unlike confusables on nodal/paranodal assembly or axon sprouting and regeneration.

qualifier: glial fate, proliferation and reactive gliosis
name: Glial differentiation, proliferation, myelination and reactive gliosis
rationale: Members concern oligodendrocyte, astrocyte and Schwann cell specification, proliferation and differentiation, CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance and astrocyte activation, distinguishing it from axon regeneration and node-of-Ranvier confusables.

qualifier: oligodendrocyte, Schwann cell and astrocyte differentiation
name: Glial differentiation, proliferation and myelination in CNS and PNS
rationale: Members concern glial fate, proliferation and differentiation of oligodendrocytes, Schwann cells and astrocytes plus CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, distinguishing it from axon regeneration/sprouting and node-of-Ranvier assembly confusables.

qualifier: cobalamin uptake with thiamine and riboflavin metabolism
name: Cobalamin transport with thiamine and riboflavin metabolism
rationale: Members combine cobalamin absorption/transport and its defects with thiamine and riboflavin transport and metabolism; confusables have intracellular cobalamin metabolism or vitamin E/ubiquinol instead.

qualifier: cobalamin absorption with thiamine and riboflavin
name: Cobalamin absorption and thiamine-riboflavin transport and metabolism
rationale: Members cover cobalamin absorption/transport together with thiamine and riboflavin transport and metabolism, versus confusables limited to intracellular cobalamin metabolism or vitamin E.

qualifier: cobalamin absorption with thiamine and riboflavin
name: Cobalamin absorption plus thiamine and riboflavin transport and metabolism
rationale: Members cover dietary B12 uptake and delivery (intrinsic factor, cubilin/amnionless, transcobalamin) together with thiamine and riboflavin transport and metabolism; confusables are intracellular cobalamin metabolism or vitamin E/ubiquinone and lack the B1/B2 members.

qualifier: sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release and reuptake, contraction dampening
name: Muscle sarcoplasmic calcium release and cytosolic calcium reduction
rationale: All members regulate cytosolic calcium flux in cardiac or skeletal muscle (ryanodine-receptor release, SR import, Na/Ca exchange); unlike confusables the theme centres on SR calcium release control and negative regulation of contraction and heart rate rather than force enhancement or ER transport.

core: Muscle calcium cycling controlling contraction and relaxation
qualifier: ryanodine receptor release and negative cardiac chronotropy/inotropy
name: Cardiac calcium cycling via ryanodine receptor release
rationale: All members concern cytosolic/sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling that sets muscle contraction, relaxation and heart rate; unlike the confusables the theme includes ryanodine-receptor release regulation and negative regulation of heart rate and cardiac contraction.

core: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling in striated muscle
qualifier: ryanodine receptor release and SERCA reuptake control of contraction/relaxation
name: Striated muscle sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release and reuptake regulation
rationale: All members concern cytosolic calcium handling in cardiac/skeletal muscle (RyR release, SERCA import, NCX extrusion, relaxation and rate); unlike the confusables, the theme centres on regulation of ryanodine-sensitive release and cardiac contraction rather than ER calcium concentration or contractile force.

qualifier: with adherens junction remodelling in vessel formation
name: Endothelial fate specification and junction remodelling in vasculogenesis
rationale: Members cover arterial, venous and lymphatic endothelial differentiation, vasculogenesis and cadherin/adherens junction regulation; confusables are BMP/SMAD- and cardiac/pulmonary vessel-centred.

name: Endothelial differentiation, vessel morphogenesis and adherens junction regulation
rationale: Members cover endothelial fate, arterial/venous/lymphatic differentiation and vasculogenesis plus cadherin adherens-junction regulation, while confusables are BMP/SMAD-driven cardiac, outflow tract and coronary vascular development.

qualifier: arterial/venous/lymphatic specification and adherens junction control
name: Endothelial fate specification, vasculogenesis and junction remodelling
rationale: Members specify endothelial, arterial, venous and lymphatic cells, form vessels and regulate cadherin junctions, unlike the BMP-driven cardiac and pulmonary vascular neighbours.

qualifier: NIK-driven, via CD40 and Dectin-1, with IKK-complex deficiencies
name: NIK-driven noncanonical NF-kB signalling via CD40 and Dectin-1
rationale: Members share NIK/IKK-dependent NF-kB activation including TNFSF, CD40 and Dectin-1 inputs and IKK/IkBA deficiency diseases, unlike the T cell co-stimulation, TNFR1 and TLR-centred confusables.

name: Non-canonical NF-kB with CD40, Dectin-1 and IKK immunodeficiencies
rationale: All members concern NIK-driven non-canonical and antigen-receptor NF-kB activation, and unlike confusables (canonical TLR/TNFR1 NF-kB or T cell co-stimulation) the theme includes CD40, Dectin-1, TPL2 and IKBKG/IKBKB/IkBA deficiency diseases.

name: Non-canonical NF-kB via CD40, Dectin-1 and IKK defects
rationale: Members center on NIK-dependent NF-kB activation from TNFSF receptors, CD40 and Dectin-1 plus IKBKB/IKBKG/IkBA deficiency diseases, unlike TNFR1/TLR canonical or T cell activation confusables.

qualifier: positive regulation, fusion and skeletal muscle regeneration
name: Promotion of myoblast differentiation, fusion and muscle regeneration
rationale: Members promote myoblast commitment, differentiation, fusion and satellite-cell-driven regeneration, whereas neighbours add myoblast proliferation, migration and negative regulation.

qualifier: promotion of differentiation, fusion and regeneration
name: Promotion of skeletal myoblast differentiation, fusion and regeneration
rationale: All members promote myoblast commitment, differentiation, fusion and satellite-cell regeneration, whereas confusables carry myoblast proliferation, migration and negative regulation.

qualifier: positive regulation, fusion and skeletal muscle regeneration
name: Promotion of myoblast differentiation, fusion and muscle regeneration
rationale: All members promote myoblast commitment, differentiation and fusion including satellite-cell-driven regeneration, whereas confusables add myoblast proliferation, migration and negative regulation.

name: Deoxyribonucleotide metabolism and ADA/PNP purine salvage defects
rationale: Members are deoxyribonucleoside/deoxynucleotide synthesis and catabolism with ADA and PNP deficiency, separating it from ribonucleotide purine catabolism and general pyrimidine metabolism confusables.

qualifier: ADA and PNP purine deoxynucleoside defects
name: Deoxyribonucleotide catabolism and ADA/PNP deficiency
rationale: Members cover deoxynucleoside/deoxynucleotide (dAMP, dGMP, dCMP, dTMP) breakdown including ADA and PNP defects, unlike confusables centred on pyrimidine synthesis or ribonucleoside purine catabolism.

name: Deoxyribonucleotide metabolism with ADA and PNP defects
rationale: All members concern metabolism or catabolism of deoxyribonucleosides and deoxyribonucleotides, and the ADA/PNP defects and deoxy- rather than ribo-nucleoside focus separate it from purine ribonucleoside and pyrimidine biosynthesis confusables.

name: Sprouting angiogenesis and endothelial proliferation with FGF restraint
rationale: Members regulate angiogenic sprouting, vessel branching and vascular endothelial proliferation, and the negative regulation of FGF production and chemotaxis distinguishes it from VEGF/Tie2-centred or endothelial activation/apoptosis confusables.

name: Sprouting angiogenesis and endothelial proliferation with FGF restraint
rationale: Members regulate vessel sprouting, branching and endothelial proliferation, and uniquely include negative regulation of FGF production and chemotaxis, distinguishing it from VEGF/Tie2-driven or endothelial activation/apoptosis confusables.

core: Regulation of sprouting angiogenesis and endothelial proliferation
qualifier: negative control of FGF production and FGF chemotaxis
name: Sprouting angiogenesis regulation and FGF suppression
rationale: Members regulate vessel sprouting, branching and endothelial proliferation together with suppression of FGF production and FGF chemotaxis, which the VEGF, Tie and endothelial-activation confusables lack.

name: Cardiac contractility enhancement and cardiomyocyte hypertrophic adaptation
rationale: Members positively regulate heart contraction force and rate plus cardiac adaptation and sarcomere growth, which the calcium-handling and negative-regulation confusables lack.

qualifier: with cardiomyocyte growth and hypertrophic adaptation
name: Cardiac contractile force and cardiomyocyte hypertrophic adaptation
rationale: Members regulate force, rate and relaxation of heart contraction together with cardiomyocyte growth, sarcomere organization and muscle adaptation, whereas confusables centre on calcium handling and negative regulation of contraction.

qualifier: contractile force, heart rate and hypertrophic adaptation
name: Cardiac contractile force, heart rate and hypertrophic adaptation
rationale: Members regulate force of contraction, relaxation, heart rate and cardiomyocyte growth/sarcomere adaptation, distinguishing it from calcium-handling and negative-regulation confusables.

name: Maternal mRNA clearance in the maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members cover M- and Z-decay of maternal mRNAs, deadenylation, cleavage and egg cytoplasm/protein storage, unlike the chromatin/ZGA and general mRNA-decay confusables.

name: Maternal-to-zygotic transition and maternal mRNA clearance
rationale: Members cover M- and Z-decay of maternal transcripts, deadenylation, cleavage divisions and stored maternal cytoplasm/protein, distinguishing the theme from MZT chromatin reprogramming and from general mRNA decay confusables.

name: Maternal mRNA clearance at the maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members cover maternal mRNA decay (M- and Z-decay, deadenylation) and early embryo cytoplasm, unlike confusables on general mRNA decay or zygotic chromatin reprogramming.

qualifier: acyl-CoA and NAD(P) handling rather than fatty acid oxidation
name: Peroxisomal acyl-CoA and NAD(P) cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members are small peroxisome-associated activities (NAD transport, NADP+ synthesis, malonyl-, succinyl- and medium-chain acyl-CoA metabolism, TYSND1 processing), lacking the alpha/beta-oxidation and VLCFA pathways of confusables.

qualifier: medium-chain acyl-CoA and NAD(P) cofactor handling rather than oxidation
name: Peroxisomal medium-chain acyl-CoA and NAD(P) cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members are medium-chain, malonyl- and succinyl-CoA metabolism, NADP+ synthesis, NAD transport and TYSND1 peroxisomal processing, without the alpha/beta-oxidation pathways that define the confusables.

name: Peroxisomal medium-chain acyl-CoA and NAD(P) cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members are peroxisomal matrix housekeeping of medium-chain, malonyl- and succinyl-CoA, NAD transport/NADP synthesis and TYSND1 processing, lacking the VLCFA and alpha-oxidation pathways of the confusables.

qualifier: p53 and DREAM repression of cell cycle genes
name: G2/M progression and p53–DREAM repression of cell cycle genes
rationale: Members cover G2/M progression (MASTL, GTSE1) and p53/DREAM/p107-p130 transcriptional repression of cell cycle genes, unlike the APC/C mitotic-exit, RB-E2F G1/S and broader G2/M checkpoint confusables.

qualifier: p53 and DREAM repression of cell-cycle genes
name: G2/M progression and p53-DREAM transcriptional repression
rationale: Members concern G2/M progression and its transcriptional repression by p53 and DREAM/p107/p130 complexes plus GTSE1 and MASTL, whereas the close confusables centre on cyclin B-CDK1, PLK and checkpoint kinase events.

name: p53 and DREAM control of G2/M progression
rationale: Members concern transcriptional repression of cell cycle genes by DREAM/p107/p130 and p53 plus G2/M progression (GTSE1, MASTL), unlike confusables centred on APC/C mitotic exit, G1/S RB defects or cyclin B/PLK G2/M events.

name: Emi1 inhibition of APC/C and its SCF-betaTrCP removal
rationale: Members concern Emi1 phosphorylation and SCF-betaTrCP degradation, inhibition of APC/C ligase activity and CDK control at metaphase-anaphase, unlike confusables on APC/C-Cdc20/Cdh1 substrate degradation.

qualifier: Emi1 inhibition and its SCF-betaTrCP degradation
name: APC/C restraint by Emi1 and its SCF-betaTrCP degradation
rationale: Members concern inhibition of APC/C ubiquitin ligase activity via Emi1 and its phosphorylation-triggered removal at mitotic transitions, whereas confusables list APC/C-Cdc20/Cdh1 substrate degradation and activation.

name: APC/C inhibitor Emi1 control at metaphase-anaphase transition
rationale: Members concern restraint of APC/C ubiquitin ligase activity and its relief by Emi1 phosphorylation and SCF-beta-TrCP degradation around metaphase/anaphase, whereas confusables cover APC/C:Cdc20/Cdh1 substrate degradation and mitotic exit.

core: Promotion of macropinocytosis and membrane ruffling
name: Promotion of macropinocytosis, ruffling and early endosome trafficking
rationale: All members positively regulate fluid-phase uptake (macropinocytosis, pinocytosis, ruffles, podosomes) and onward early-endosome trafficking; unlike the confusables it lacks Rho GTPase cycles, clathrin/caveolin endocytosis and negative actin regulators.

qualifier: with podosome assembly and early endosome maturation
name: Macropinocytosis with ruffle formation and early endosome maturation
rationale: All members concern ruffle-driven fluid uptake (macropinocytosis, pinocytosis, ruffle and podosome assembly) and onward early-to-late endosome traffic, unlike confusables centred on lamellipodial migration, Rho GTPase cycles or caveolar/clathrin endocytosis and transcytosis.

name: Promotion of macropinocytosis, ruffling and early endosome progression
rationale: All members positively regulate fluid-phase uptake (pinocytosis, macropinocytosis), the ruffle/podosome protrusions that drive it, or onward early-endosome localization and transport, distinguishing it from the leading-edge motility confusable and the transcytosis/caveolar endocytosis confusables.

name: Mammary alveolar development, lactation and involution
rationale: Members cover mammary epithelial proliferation, alveolar differentiation, lactation and involution (with one hyperoxia-response outlier), whereas confusables cover mammary lineages, ductal branching or placental development.

name: Mammary alveolar development, lactation and involution
rationale: Members are mammary alveolar epithelial proliferation, differentiation, lactation and involution, whereas confusables concern mammary lineages, ductal branching and placental development.

name: Mammary alveolar differentiation, lactation and involution
rationale: All but one member (response to hyperoxia) describe the pregnancy-lactation cycle of mammary alveolar epithelium; confusables instead cover placental/trophoblast development, ductal branching or mammary lineage modules.

qualifier: mesodermal cell migration and fate specification
name: Gastrulation mesodermal cell migration and fate specification
rationale: Members concern germ-layer formation, mesendoderm and mesoderm migration and fate (with pericardium morphogenesis as a mesodermal derivative), unlike neighbours on primitive streak/EMT, endoderm, or heart field development.

qualifier: mesendoderm formation and mesodermal cell migration
name: Mesendoderm formation and mesodermal cell migration at gastrulation
rationale: Members concern germ layer and mesendoderm formation, mesodermal fate and cell migration during gastrulation, distinct from confusables on lateral plate mesoderm, primitive streak/EMT, endoderm or heart morphogenesis.

name: Mesoderm specification and migration at gastrulation
rationale: Members concern germ-layer and mesendoderm formation, mesodermal fate specification and cell migration in gastrulation, lacking the endoderm, primitive-streak/EMT, lateral-plate or heart-field members of the confusables.

qualifier: glycinergic, in touch and respiratory control
name: Glycinergic inhibitory neurotransmission in sensory and respiratory control
rationale: Members share inhibitory (glycinergic/GABAergic) dampening of nerve transmission, including hyperekplexia, touch perception and neural control of breathing, whereas confusables concern GABA metabolism and transport or locomotor behaviour.

name: Glycinergic inhibitory neurotransmission in sensory and respiratory control
rationale: Members share inhibitory (glycinergic, MECP2-regulated GABA) dampening of nerve impulse transmission affecting touch and breathing, whereas confusables cover GABA synthesis/reuptake or locomotor behaviour.

name: Inhibitory glycinergic neurotransmission in sensory and respiratory control
rationale: Members share inhibitory glycine/GABA signalling (glycinergic transmission, SLC6A5 hyperekplexia, MECP2-GABA genes, dampened nerve impulse transmission) applied to touch and breathing, unlike confusables about locomotor behavior or GABA synthesis and reuptake.

name: Arginine catabolism and ornithine-citrulline urea cycle regulation
rationale: Members cover arginine catabolism, ornithine, citrulline and aspartate metabolism, ornithine carrier defects and repression of urea cycle enzymes, rather than the core urea cycle enzymes, cationic transport or glutamate metabolism of confusables.

name: Ornithine–arginine metabolism and urea cycle regulation
rationale: Members cover ornithine, citrulline, arginine catabolism, aspartate metabolism, the mitochondrial ornithine carrier defect and transcriptional repression of urea cycle enzymes, not the core urea-cycle enzyme defects, glutamine/proline or arginine transport of the neighbours.

qualifier: ornithine, citrulline and arginine catabolism and regulation
name: Ornithine, citrulline and arginine metabolism linked to urea cycle
rationale: Members cover ornithine, citrulline, aspartate and arginine catabolism, mitochondrial ornithine transport and urea cycle enzyme repression, rather than the urea cycle enzymes and their deficiencies, glutamate/glutamine metabolism or cationic amino acid import.

name: Extracellular matrix and laminin co-expression signatures
rationale: All members are co-expression modules for extracellular matrix proteins, some with laminins, metallopeptidases and complement; neighbours are integrin/fibronectin, collagen/elastin or fibroblast pathways.

name: Co-expressed extracellular matrix and associated protein signatures
rationale: All members are co-expression modules dominated by extracellular matrix and matrix-associated genes, distinguished from neighbours describing specific collagen, elastic fibre, integrin or stromal processes.

name: Extracellular matrix, laminin and complement co-expression signature
rationale: All members are co-expression modules enriched for extracellular matrix and associated proteins (laminins, metallopeptidases, complement); unlike neighbours it lacks collagen/elastic fibre assembly, integrin signaling and fibroblast-proliferation terms.

name: Chondrocyte proliferation and differentiation in early chondrogenesis
rationale: Members cover cartilage condensation, chondroblast differentiation and chondrocyte proliferation/differentiation control; confusables are chondrocyte hypertrophy or osteoblast/bone development.

name: Regulation of early chondrocyte proliferation and differentiation
rationale: All members concern cartilage condensation, chondroblast differentiation and up/down regulation of chondrocyte proliferation and differentiation, unlike confusables on osteoblasts, hypertrophy and growth plate maturation.

name: Early chondrogenesis: chondrocyte proliferation and differentiation control
rationale: All members regulate chondroblast/chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and cartilage condensation, distinct from osteoblast/ossification confusables and RUNX2-driven hypertrophic maturation confusables.

name: Golgi lumen nucleotide-sugar and acetyl-CoA transporter disorders
rationale: Every member is an inherited defect of an SLC35 nucleotide-sugar or SLC33A1 acetyl-CoA Golgi transporter, unlike neighbours covering glycosyltransferase/ALG enzyme defects or normal nucleotide-sugar metabolism.

qualifier: inherited SLC35 and acetyl-CoA transporter disorders
name: Inherited defects of Golgi nucleotide-sugar and acetyl-CoA transporters
rationale: All members are diseases caused by defective SLC35 nucleotide-sugar or SLC33A1 acetyl-CoA transporters, distinct from confusables on normal nucleotide-sugar transport or ALG/glycosyltransferase CDGs.

name: Inherited nucleotide-sugar and acetyl-CoA transporter defects
rationale: Every member is a disease caused by a defective SLC35 nucleotide-sugar or SLC33A1 acetyl-CoA transporter, separating it from confusables about ALG/enzyme CDGs or nucleotide-sugar synthesis.

qualifier: sister chromatid cohesion, PLK1/Aurora A entry and spindle checkpoint
name: Mitotic entry kinases, sister chromatid cohesion and spindle checkpoint
rationale: Members cover PLK1/AURKA/NEK-driven mitotic entry, centromeric cohesion establishment and resolution and spindle checkpoint control, unlike APC/C-degradation or spindle-midzone/cytokinesis confusables.

core: Sister chromatid cohesion and mitotic progression
qualifier: PLK1/Aurora A/NEK mitotic kinases and spindle checkpoint
name: Sister chromatid cohesion and PLK1/Aurora A mitotic entry
rationale: Members span establishment, maintenance and resolution of centromeric cohesion with PLK1, Aurora A and NEK kinase control of mitotic entry and spindle checkpoint, distinct from APC/C-driven mitotic exit and spindle midzone/cytokinesis confusables.

qualifier: sister chromatid cohesion, PLK1/Aurora A and spindle checkpoint
name: Sister chromatid cohesion, PLK1/Aurora A and spindle checkpoint
rationale: Members span establishment, maintenance and resolution of sister chromatid cohesion, PLK1/AURKA/NEK mitotic kinases, centrosome separation and the spindle checkpoint, distinct from APC/C degradation and cytokinesis/midzone confusables.

name: Dendritic spine and postsynaptic actin remodelling in synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members concern spine morphogenesis, dendrite arborization, postsynaptic actin organization and structural plasticity/LTD, unlike confusables on reelin, EPHB/Rho GTPase or BDNF-TRKB signalling.

qualifier: activity-dependent spine actin remodeling and dendrite arborization
name: Activity-dependent postsynaptic remodeling, spine plasticity and dendrite arborization
rationale: Members regulate dendritic spine and postsynaptic actin remodeling, NMDAR-RAC1 signaling, synaptic plasticity/LTD and dendrite branching, unlike RHO/EPHB, BDNF-TRK or reelin spine-maintenance neighbours.

qualifier: postsynaptic actin-driven dendritic spine and arbor remodelling
name: Postsynaptic actin-driven dendritic spine and arbor remodelling in plasticity
rationale: Members concern postsynaptic actin, spine morphogenesis, dendrite arborization and long-term plasticity including NMDAR-RAC1, unlike neighbours on EPHB/RHO, BDNF/TRKB or reelin signalling.

name: Intestinal and renal hexose transport and disaccharide digestion
rationale: Members are sugar transporters (SGLT/GLUT defects, hexose absorption) and disaccharide digestion, distinguishing the theme from confusables centred on galactose/fructose catabolism or urate and amino acid transport.

qualifier: dietary carbohydrate digestion and intestinal absorption
name: Dietary carbohydrate digestion and hexose transmembrane transport
rationale: Members cover saccharide digestion and SLC2/SLC5-mediated hexose absorption and transport defects, unlike confusables focused on galactose/fructose catabolism or urate and amino acid transporters.

name: Dietary carbohydrate digestion and hexose transmembrane transport
rationale: Members share sugar handling via disaccharide digestion and SLC2/SLC5 hexose transporters, unlike neighbours focused on urate/amino acid transporters or galactose/fructose catabolism.

qualifier: cohesion establishment, condensation and centromeric CENP-A assembly
name: Cohesion establishment, chromosome condensation and CENP-A centromere assembly
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading and sister chromatid cohesion establishment, mitotic/meiotic condensation and CENP-A deposition, versus confusables on cohesion resolution, nuclear envelope remodelling or replication-coupled chromatin assembly.

qualifier: condensation, cohesion establishment and CENP-A deposition
name: Chromosome condensation, cohesion establishment and centromeric CENP-A deposition
rationale: Members build mitotic/meiotic chromosome architecture through condensation, cohesin loading and centromeric CENP-A assembly, unlike confusables on cohesion resolution, replication-coupled chromatin assembly or nuclear envelope dynamics.

core: Chromosome condensation and sister chromatid cohesion
qualifier: cohesion establishment and CENP-A centromeric chromatin assembly
name: Chromosome condensation, cohesion establishment and CENP-A centromere assembly
rationale: Members cover mitotic/meiotic chromosome condensation, cohesin loading and cohesion establishment, and CENP-A nucleosome deposition, while neighbours concern cohesion resolution, nucleosome assembly or nuclear envelope dynamics.

name: NOD1/2 bacterial sensing driving TAK1-JNK/p38 activation
rationale: Members cover peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide sensing by NOD1/2 and ALPK1 with TAK1-mediated stress kinase activation, distinguishing them from TLR/IKK-NF-kB (C3), TLR2/4 lipid sensing (C4) and JNK-only regulation (C2).

core: Cytosolic bacterial sensing by NOD1/2 and ALPK1
name: NOD-like bacterial sensing with TAK1-mediated JNK and p38 activation
rationale: Members cover peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide sensing via NOD1/2, ALPK1 and NLR signaling with K63 ubiquitination and TAK1-driven stress-kinase output, unlike TLR, IPAF inflammasome and generic JNK-regulation confusables.

name: NOD1/2 peptidoglycan sensing and TAK1-driven stress kinase activation
rationale: Members cover NOD1/2 and ALPK1 sensing of peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide with K63 ubiquitination and TAK1-mediated JNK/p38 activation, distinguishing it from TLR surface sensing and TLR-TAK1-NF-kB confusables.

qualifier: TRAF3/TRAF6 relay to type I interferon and NF-kB
name: RIG-I-like receptor–TRAF signaling to type I interferon
rationale: Members describe RIG-I/MDA5 sensing relayed through TRAF3/TRAF6 and FADD/RIP1 to IRF and NF-kB activation and IFN-alpha/beta production, including its negative regulators and RSV/SARS-CoV modulation, distinct from confusables on cytosolic DNA sensing, dsRNA/ZBP1, TLR7-9 and OAS responses.

qualifier: TRAF-mediated interferon induction and viral evasion
name: RIG-I-like receptor TRAF-mediated interferon induction and viral evasion
rationale: Members describe RLR (RIG-I/MDA5) signaling through TRAF3/TRAF6 to IRF and NF-kB and type I interferon, plus viral modulation of it, unlike neighbours focused on cytosolic DNA sensing, dsRNA response and IRF3/OAS effectors.

core: RIG-I/MDA5 antiviral signaling to type I interferon
name: RIG-I/MDA5-TRAF signaling to interferon and viral antagonism
rationale: Members are cytosolic RNA sensing by RIG-I-like receptors relayed via TRAF3/TRAF6 to IRF and NF-kB and interferon-alpha/beta production, including its modulation by SARS-CoV and RSV, while confusables emphasize IRF3, dsRNA, ZBP1 and cytosolic DNA sensing.

name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling and lung mesenchyme proliferation
rationale: Members share epithelial-mesenchymal signaling with regulation of mesenchymal proliferation, and the lung-associated mesenchyme members distinguish it from prostate, pancreatic/kidney and lung epithelial branching neighbours.

core: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in organ bud morphogenesis
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling and mesenchymal proliferation in organ buds
rationale: All members involve reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in salivary, lung and limb buds, with regulation of mesenchymal proliferation and lung mesenchyme setting it apart from prostate, pancreas/kidney and lung-epithelial branching confusables.

core: Epithelial–mesenchymal signaling in branching organ development
qualifier: mesenchymal proliferation in lung and salivary gland
name: Mesenchymal proliferation and epithelial–mesenchymal signaling in lung and salivary development
rationale: Members combine epithelial–mesenchymal crosstalk with regulation of mesenchymal proliferation and lung-associated mesenchyme and salivary branching, whereas confusables focus on prostate, pancreas/kidney or lung epithelial branching.

name: Circadian and PPARA/PGC-1alpha transcriptional control of energy metabolism
rationale: Members are transcriptional regulators of metabolism (PPARA, PGC-1alpha, mitochondrial biogenesis, ROR/REV-ERB, heme sensing); circadian BMAL1/CLOCK output and heme signaling separate it from the LXR, adipogenesis and gluconeogenesis neighbours, while the PPAR/PGC-1alpha arm separates it from the core-clock theme.

name: Circadian and PPARA/PGC-1alpha transcriptional control of metabolism
rationale: Members are transcriptional regulators linking clock (BMAL1:CLOCK, ROR/REV-ERB, heme, NPAS) and PPARA/PGC-1alpha mitochondrial-lipid programmes; unlike the core-clock confusable it has PPAR/PGC-1alpha, and unlike the gluconeogenic/LXR/adipogenic ones it has circadian activators.

core: PGC-1alpha and PPARA metabolic gene transcription
name: Clock-linked PGC-1alpha and PPARA metabolic transcription
rationale: Members are transcriptional programs controlling oxidative/fatty-acid metabolism (PGC-1alpha, PPARA, mitochondrial biogenesis) together with circadian BMAL1:CLOCK, ROR/REV-ERB and heme signaling, which separates it from the gluconeogenesis, adipogenesis, LXR and core-clock-protein confusables.

name: Naive B cell transcriptional and surface signatures
rationale: Members are B cell and naive B cell expression/surface modules, unlike neighbours with memory B, germinal centre, plasma cell and B cell activation content.

name: Naive and resting B cell signatures
rationale: Members are B-cell-enriched and naive B surface signature modules, distinguishing it from confusables that add plasma cell, germinal centre, memory B or B activation programs.

name: Naive resting B cell surface and transcript signatures
rationale: Members are blood B cell, naive B cell surface and generic lymphocyte expression modules, lacking the activation, germinal centre, plasma cell and memory B cell modules present in the confusables.

qualifier: CCR7 ligand-driven chemotaxis and survival of mature dendritic cells
name: CCR7-driven dendritic cell migration and maturation
rationale: Members share CCR7/CCL19/CCL21 signaling that drives mature conventional dendritic cell chemotaxis, survival and lymphoid homing, distinguishing it from general chemokine, CXCR4 or B/T cell homing neighbours.

name: CCR7-driven dendritic cell maturation and chemotaxis
rationale: Members cover conventional DC maturation, survival and chemotaxis with CCR7 signalling, Cdc42 and PLC/PKC relays and lymphocyte homing, while confusables are general chemokine clusters or B/T cell and CXCR4 migration.

qualifier: CCR7-mediated mature dendritic cell migration and survival
name: CCR7-mediated mature dendritic cell migration and survival
rationale: Members describe CCR7 (CCR1/7) signalling via Cdc42 and PLC/PKC driving mature conventional dendritic cell chemotaxis, homing and survival; confusables cover CXCR4, B/T lymphocyte homing or generic chemokine modules.

name: Cardiac calcium-release control with negative inotropy and chronotropy
rationale: Members regulate cardiac SR calcium release, relaxation, membrane potential and decreased contraction and heart rate; confusables are skeletal muscle, positive inotropy or conduction coupling.

core: Cardiac calcium release and contractility control
qualifier: dampening of contraction and heart rate
name: Cardiac calcium release and dampening of contraction and heart rate
rationale: Members concern sarcoplasmic calcium release regulating cardiac contraction and relaxation, cardiomyocyte membrane potential and ion homeostasis, with negative regulation of contraction and heart rate; the negative regulation terms separate it from the positive inotropy/chronotropy confusable, cardiac setting from the skeletal muscle one, and calcium release from the conduction/gap junction one.

qualifier: negative regulation of contraction and heart rate
name: Sarcoplasmic calcium release and dampening of cardiac contraction
rationale: Members regulate cardiac SR calcium release, membrane potential, relaxation and negative control of contraction and heart rate, versus positive-inotropy, conduction and skeletal-muscle neighbours.

name: HSF1 heat shock and mitochondrial unfolded protein responses
rationale: Members are HSF1 activation/attenuation, heat acclimation, protein refolding and UPRmt, unlike FOXO, ER folding, protein acetylation and stress-granule confusables.

qualifier: protein refolding and mitochondrial unfolded protein response
name: HSF1 heat shock response with refolding and mitochondrial UPR
rationale: Members are HSF1 activation/attenuation and heat acclimation plus chaperone refolding and UPRmt, which distinguish the theme from confusables pairing heat shock with protein acetylation or stress granules, and from ER folding or FOXO stress programs.

name: HSF1 heat shock and mitochondrial unfolded protein responses
rationale: Members cover HSF1 activation and attenuation, heat acclimation and chaperone refolding plus the mitochondrial UPR, whereas confusables add protein acetylation, stress granules, FOXO signalling or ER folding.

core: Regulation of NK cell activation and cytotoxicity
name: NK cell cytotoxicity regulation via MHC class Ib recognition
rationale: Members concern NK receptor activation, degranulation and cytokine output and inhibitory lymphoid–non-lymphoid interactions including MHC class Ib presentation, distinguishing it from T-cell costimulation and KIR/tolerance confusables.

core: Regulation of NK cell activation and cytotoxicity
qualifier: NK receptor recognition of MHC class Ib, degranulation
name: NK cell activation and degranulation via MHC class Ib recognition
rationale: Members regulate NK (and T cell) cytotoxic activation, degranulation and cytokine output through lymphoid-target receptor interactions including MHC class Ib, setting the theme apart from KIR-cluster, tolerance and dendritic/T-cell costimulation themes.

core: NK cell activation and cytotoxicity regulation
name: NK cell activation and cytotoxicity regulation via MHC class Ib
rationale: Members regulate NK and cytotoxic lymphocyte activation, degranulation and cytokine output through receptor recognition of non-lymphoid cells; MHC class Ib presentation and NK effector control distinguish it from T-cell costimulation and KIR/tolerance neighbours.

name: Monocyte activation, aggregation and recruitment in inflammation
rationale: Members describe monocyte activation, aggregation, chemotaxis and extravasation with inflammatory cytokine/chemokine responses; confusables emphasise negative regulation of chemotaxis, monocyte surface identity or anti-inflammatory control.

name: Monocyte recruitment and activation in inflammatory response
rationale: Members concern monocyte chemotaxis, extravasation, aggregation, activation and pro-inflammatory cytokines, distinguishing them from confusables on monocyte identity signatures, CCR2/CX3CR1 modules and negative regulation of leukocyte adhesion.

name: Proinflammatory monocyte activation, chemotaxis and extravasation
rationale: Members concern monocyte activation, aggregation, chemotaxis and extravasation within the inflammatory cytokine/chemokine response, while confusables emphasise negative regulation of monocyte chemotaxis, CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte identity modules or resolution of inflammation.

name: IRF3-mediated type I interferon induction by cytosolic DNA sensing
rationale: Members share IRF3-driven type I IFN and IP-10 induction in antiviral responses; cytosolic DNA sensing distinguishes it from the RIG-I/MDA5 dsRNA-sensing confusables.

name: IRF3-mediated antiviral type I interferon induction
rationale: Members cover the cellular response to virus via IRF3-dependent type I IFN and IP-10 induction including cytosolic DNA sensing, whereas confusables centre on RIG-I/MDA5 RNA-helicase and dsRNA sensing.

name: IRF3-mediated type I interferon induction via cytosolic DNA sensing
rationale: All members describe innate antiviral induction of type I interferon and interferon-stimulated output (IRF3 activation, IP-10, response to virus), and the cytosolic DNA-sensing arm distinguishes it from confusables built on RIG-I/MDA5 and dsRNA sensing.

name: Glycinergic inhibitory transmission and locomotor behaviour
rationale: Members combine glycinergic transmission and hyperekplexia with locomotion, righting reflex and cerebellar development; glycinergic inhibition distinguishes it from exploratory/psychomotor behaviour confusables, and motor behaviour from the MECP2/GABA confusable.

name: Glycinergic inhibitory transmission and motor coordination behaviour
rationale: Members link glycinergic transmission and its hyperekplexia defect with Purkinje layer formation, righting reflex and locomotion, distinct from confusables on GABA signalling, touch/proprioception and exploratory behaviours.

name: Glycinergic inhibitory transmission and motor coordination behaviour
rationale: All members concern inhibitory glycinergic neurotransmission (including SLC6A5 hyperekplexia) or the motor coordination and locomotor reflexes and cerebellar structures it supports, distinguished from confusables on exploratory/psychomotor behaviours, proprioception and neural RNA-binding modules.

qualifier: lung and exocrine glands via epithelial-mesenchymal signaling
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal branching morphogenesis of lung and glands
rationale: Members cover lung, trachea, mammary, prostate, salivary and lacrimal branching morphogenesis driven by epithelial-mesenchymal signaling, unlike kidney, pancreatic or reproductive-tract confusables.

qualifier: epithelial-mesenchymal signalling in lung, mammary, prostate and exocrine glands
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal branching development of lung, mammary, prostate and glands
rationale: Members cover epithelial-mesenchymal (FGFR2b) signalling and branching in lung, trachea, mammary, prostate, salivary and lacrimal glands plus related bud-derived structures, whereas confusables concern kidney, pancreas or female reproductive tract.

name: Epithelial-mesenchymal branching morphogenesis of lung, mammary and prostate
rationale: Members are mesenchymal-epithelial signaling driving bud formation and branching in lung, trachea, mammary, prostate, salivary and lacrimal glands, distinct from kidney, pancreatic and female reproductive tract confusables.

qualifier: with hindbrain segmentation and axial mesoderm
name: Neural plate regionalization, hindbrain segmentation and axial mesoderm
rationale: Members cover neural plate and border specification, rhombomere/midbrain-hindbrain boundaries, dorsoventral axis and notochord/floor plate; confusables are somitogenesis, convergent extension, Hox clusters or spinal cord patterning.

qualifier: neural plate regionalization and axial mesoderm
name: Neural plate regionalization and axial mesoderm patterning
rationale: Members cover neural plate formation, border and neural crest specification, hindbrain/MHB segmentation, notochord, floor plate and axial mesoderm, unlike confusables on somitogenesis, Hox clusters, spinal cord patterning or convergent extension.

qualifier: with axial mesoderm, floor plate and neural border
name: Neural plate regionalization with axial mesoderm and midline
rationale: Members pattern the early neural plate, hindbrain and neural border alongside notochord and floor plate formation, unlike spinal cord, Hox cluster, convergent extension or somitogenesis neighbours.

qualifier: piRNA transposon silencing and sperm/zygote chromatin remodeling
name: piRNA transposon silencing and germline-to-zygote chromatin reprogramming
rationale: Members cover piRNA biogenesis and retroelement silencing, sperm chromatin condensation and protamine replacement, oocyte construction, and zygotic epigenetic programming/genome activation, which the cleavage, germ-cell specification, imprinting and maternal mRNA decay confusables lack in combination.

name: piRNA transposon silencing and germline-to-zygote chromatin reprogramming
rationale: Members span piRNA biogenesis and transposon silencing, sperm chromatin condensation and protamine replacement, oocyte construction, and maternal-to-zygotic transition, unlike confusables on PGC specification, imprinting or maternal mRNA decay.

core: Germline and early embryo epigenetic programming
qualifier: piRNA transposon silencing and zygotic chromatin reprogramming
name: Germline piRNA transposon silencing and zygotic chromatin reprogramming
rationale: Members span piRNA biogenesis and retroelement silencing, sperm chromatin condensation and protamine replacement, oocyte construction and maternal-to-zygotic chromatin changes and ZGA; confusables emphasize germ cell specification, imprinting, X inactivation or maternal mRNA decay.

name: G2/M transition and its DREAM–p53 transcriptional control
rationale: Members cover G2/M cyclin, PLK and MASTL events, G2 checkpoint and DREAM/p53-repressed cell cycle genes, unlike APC/C mitotic exit, G1/S E2F and DNA-damage confusables.

qualifier: p53 and DREAM/E2F transcriptional repression of cell-cycle genes
name: G2/M progression and its p53/DREAM transcriptional repression
rationale: Members cover G2 phase, cyclin B-CDK1, PLK and MASTL control of mitotic entry and p53/DREAM/p107-p130 repression of cell-cycle genes, distinguishing it from APC/C mitotic exit, DNA-damage, G1/S and E2F-activation confusables.

qualifier: p53 and DREAM repression of cell cycle genes
name: G2/M transition and its p53–DREAM transcriptional repression
rationale: Members cover G2 phase, cyclin B–CDK1/PLK/MASTL events and G2/M checkpoint plus p53/DREAM-mediated repression of cell cycle genes, distinct from G1/S, E2F proliferation, DNA-damage p53 and APC/C mitotic exit confusables.

name: Axon regeneration and collateral sprouting in injured and intact nerves
rationale: Members regulate axon regrowth and collateral sprouting after injury and without it (RHOA inhibition, CRMP signaling, motor neuron survival), lacking the myelin/glial members of C1/C3 and the guidance repulsion of C2/C4.

name: Axon regeneration and collateral sprouting control
rationale: Members regulate axon regrowth after injury and collateral sprouting (growth stimulation and RHOA/ceramide inhibition, CRMP signaling, motor neuron survival), without the myelination of one confusable or the Sema3A repulsive guidance of others.

name: Axon regeneration and collateral sprouting control
rationale: Members regulate injured-axon sprouting, regeneration and collateral sprouting with RhoA, CRMP and ceramide signaling; collateral sprouting separates it from myelin/glia neighbours and regeneration from Sema3A repulsion neighbours.

qualifier: blood group antigens and sulfated selectin ligands
name: Fucosylated blood group and selectin ligand biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover GDP-fucose synthesis and SLC35 nucleotide-sugar transport, ABO/Lewis antigen synthesis, protein tyrosine sulfation and selectin-dependent leukocyte rolling and stem cell homing, distinguishing it from N/O-glycan and glycosphingolipid confusables.

qualifier: blood group and selectin ligands, with protein sulfation
name: Fucosylated blood group and selectin-ligand glycan synthesis
rationale: Members cover GDP-fucose/fucose metabolism, ABO/Lewis antigens, nucleotide-sugar transporter CDGs and tyrosine sulfation supporting leukocyte tethering and HSC homing, distinguishing it from general N/O-glycan and glycosphingolipid confusables.

qualifier: blood group antigens and selectin ligands
name: Fucosylated blood group and selectin ligand biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover GDP-fucose metabolism, SLC35C1/SLC35A1 nucleotide-sugar transport, ABO/Lewis antigen synthesis, tyrosine sulfation and selectin-dependent leukocyte rolling/HSC homing, which the N/O-glycan and glycosphingolipid confusables lack.

name: T cell response suppression with regulatory T cell promotion
rationale: Members dampen CD4/CD8 T cell activation, proliferation, Th1/Th17 and IFN output while promoting Treg differentiation, distinguishing it from NK, dendritic cell tolerance and Treg-restraining confusables.

core: Suppression of effector T cell responses
name: Suppression of effector T cell responses, favouring Treg differentiation
rationale: Members negatively regulate T cell proliferation, activation, Th1/Th17 and IFN/IL-2 cytokine output while promoting regulatory T cell differentiation, unlike Th1-promoting, dendritic-cell/tolerance, Treg-inhibiting and NK confusables.

core: Negative regulation of T cell responses
name: Suppression of effector T cell responses and Treg promotion
rationale: Members inhibit CD4/CD8 T cell activation, proliferation, Th1/Th17 commitment and IL-2/interferon production while promoting regulatory T cell differentiation, unlike confusables on NK cells, dendritic cell/costimulation tolerance or Th1/Treg transcriptional programs.

core: IL-10 and IL-12 family cytokine signalling
qualifier: with type III and type I interferon responses
name: IL-10, IL-12 family and type III interferon signalling
rationale: Members are IL-10/IL-20 and IL-12/23/27/35 family signalling plus type III interferon and interferon-alpha responses, distinguishing them from IL-17/IL-1 family, IFN-gamma and IL-15/IL-21 confusables.

qualifier: IL-12 family, IL-10 family and type III interferon
name: IL-12 family, IL-10 family and interferon-lambda signalling
rationale: Members are IL-12/23/27/35, IL-10 and IL-20 family and type III/alpha interferon signalling, distinguishing them from IL-17/IL-1-family, IL-15/IL-21, IL-37 and IFN-gamma confusables.

qualifier: IL-12/IL-10 families and type I/III interferons
name: IL-12/IL-10 family cytokine and type I/III interferon signalling
rationale: Members are IL-12, IL-23, IL-27, IL-35, IL-10 and IL-20 family signalling with type III interferon and interferon-alpha response modules, distinct from IL-17/33, IL-15/21, IL-37 or IFN-gamma confusables.

core: Cellular responses to ethanol, nicotine and anesthetics
name: Responses to ethanol, nicotine and anesthetics with agmatine/NO regulation
rationale: Members are responses to ethanol, nicotine, ether and anesthetics (including an alcohol-dependence gene module) plus agmatine synthesis and suppression of amine and NO biosynthesis, which distinguishes it from drug, xenobiotic and AhR response confusables.

core: Responses to ethanol, nicotine and anesthetics
name: Ethanol, nicotine and anesthetic responses, agmatine-nitric oxide restraint
rationale: Members are cellular responses to neuroactive drugs (alcohol, nicotine, ether, anesthetics) plus agmatine synthesis and suppression of amine and NO biosynthesis, distinguishing them from antibiotic, chemotherapy and xenobiotic-response confusables.

name: Neuroactive drug responses and agmatine–nitric oxide suppression
rationale: Members are responses to ethanol, ether, nicotine, anesthetics and an alcohol-use module plus agmatine synthesis and negative regulation of NO and amine metabolism; confusables cover xenobiotic/pesticide or antibiotic and oxidative-stress responses.

name: Enteric neural crest development via RET and endothelin signalling
rationale: Members concern neural crest migration into the gut, enteric nervous system and midgut development with GDNF/RET and endothelin receptor signalling; the RET/GDNF members distinguish it from gut motility and sympathoadrenal confusables.

name: RET-GDNF and endothelin signaling in enteric neural crest development
rationale: Members share RET/GDNF-family and endothelin receptor signaling driving neural crest migration and enteric nervous system/midgut development, unlike GI motility and sympathoadrenal confusables.

name: RET-GDNF and endothelin signaling in enteric neural crest development
rationale: Members combine GDNF/RET and endothelin receptor signaling with neural crest migration and enteric/midgut development, unlike confusables on gut motility, adrenal or blood pressure.

name: Mitotic cell-cycle DNA replication initiation and unwinding
rationale: Members concern initiation, DNA unwinding and polymerase activity of S-phase replication (plus E2F1 replication targets and break-induced replication), distinguishing it from ATR replication-stress checkpoint, cell division and broader E2F cell-cycle neighbours.

qualifier: helicase unwinding in the mitotic cycle
name: Mitotic DNA replication initiation and helicase unwinding
rationale: Members cover cell-cycle replication initiation, DNA unwinding, polymerase activation and break-induced replication, unlike E2F cell-cycle, ATR replication-stress or cell-division neighbours.
