qualifier: initiation and unwinding in the mitotic cell cycle
name: Mitotic DNA replication initiation and unwinding
rationale: Members concern origin unwinding, replication initiation and polymerase activity in mitotic S phase, including break-induced replication and E2F1 targets; neighbours instead carry replication-stress checkpoints or broader E2F cell-cycle modules.

qualifier: G6PC/SLC37A4 hydrolysis and transport, glucokinase regulation
name: Glucose-6-phosphate hydrolysis, transport and glucokinase regulation
rationale: Members concern glucose-6-phosphatase and its transporter (GSD Ia/Ib, G6PC3), hexose phosphate transport and glucokinase/GCKR control, lacking the glycogen synthesis/breakdown and glucagon terms of the confusables.

name: Glucose-6-phosphate hydrolysis, transport and glucokinase regulation
rationale: Members concern G6PC/G6PC3 and SLC37A4 glucose-6-phosphate hydrolysis and transport and glucokinase control, distinct from glycogen synthesis/breakdown, glucagon-PKA and fructose/gluconeogenesis confusables.

name: Glucose-6-phosphatase transport and glucokinase regulation
rationale: Members concern G6PC/G6PC3 and SLC37A4 hexose-phosphate transport defects plus glucokinase regulation, whereas confusables cover glycogen synthesis/breakdown and gluconeogenesis or fructose metabolism.

name: TLR9/TLR7-IRF7 type I interferon production in dendritic cells
rationale: Members concern endosomal TLR7/8/9-TRAF6-IRF7 and DEx/H helicase induction of IFN-alpha/beta in activated dendritic cells, unlike RIG-I/MDA5-IRF3 and cGAS confusables.

name: TLR9/IRF7-driven type I interferon production in dendritic cells
rationale: Members are TLR9 regulation, TRAF6-IRF7 activation, DEx/H helicase sensing and IFN-alpha/beta production in activated dendritic cells, unlike the RIG-I/MDA5 and IRF3-centred confusables.

name: TLR7/9-IRF7 type I interferon production in dendritic cells
rationale: Members concern TLR9/TLR7-driven, TRAF6-IRF7 and DEx/H-helicase induction of interferon-alpha/beta in activated dendritic cells, whereas confusables centre on RIG-I/MDA5-IRF3, cGAS-STING or broader antiviral responses.

name: Endosomal neurotransmitter receptor trafficking at the postsynaptic membrane
rationale: Members move receptors (including GluR2 AMPA receptors) between endosomes and the postsynaptic membrane with supporting postsynaptic actin and endosomal vesicle recycling; confusables cover presynaptic active-zone/Rab regulation, receptor clustering or BDNF signaling.

name: Endosomal trafficking and internalization of postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptors
rationale: Members concern endosome-based recycling, internalization and membrane localization of postsynaptic (AMPA) receptors with supporting actin and synaptic membrane recycling, whereas confusables cover presynaptic active-zone structure, BDNF/TrkB signaling or AMPA receptor clustering and plasticity.

name: Synaptic endosomal trafficking of postsynaptic AMPA receptors
rationale: Members are endosome-based recycling of synaptic vesicles and postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptors, including GluR2-AMPA trafficking and postsynaptic actin; neighbours are presynaptic active-zone, BDNF or AMPA clustering themes.

qualifier: CXCL12-CXCR4 in T cells, mast cells and astrocytes
name: CXCL12-CXCR4 positive chemotaxis of T and mast cells
rationale: CXCL12-CXCR4 signaling with induction of T cell, mast cell and astrocyte migration distinguishes it from neighbours on integrin homing, S1P/B cell trafficking and inhibitory monocyte chemotaxis.

qualifier: CXCR4-driven, of T cells, mast cells and astrocytes
name: CXCR4-driven chemotaxis of T cells, mast cells and astrocytes
rationale: Members concern positive chemotaxis/migration of T cells, mast cells and astrocytes with CXCL12-CXCR4 signaling, distinct from confusables on monocyte CCR2/CX3CR1, B cell/S1P or integrin-mediated homing.

qualifier: CXCL12–CXCR4-driven, T, mast and glial cells
name: CXCL12–CXCR4-driven chemotaxis of T, mast and glial cells
rationale: Members are CXCR4 signaling and induced chemotaxis/migration of T cells, mast cells and astrocytes, distinct from neighbours on lymphocyte homing integrins, monocyte CCR2/CX3CR1 recruitment or S1P-driven B cell migration.

name: Transcriptional repression through modulation of DNA binding
rationale: Members concern negative control of transcription initiation and of transcription-factor DNA binding (with TGFBR3 expression as a repressed target), whereas confusables are specific gene-transcription programs (CDH1, RUNX3, FOXO) or BMP/cell-cycle contexts.

qualifier: via control of transcription factor DNA binding
name: Transcriptional repression via control of transcription factor DNA binding
rationale: Members describe generic negative regulation of Pol II transcription and initiation through modulating regulatory-region DNA binding (with TGFBR3 expression as an example target), whereas confusables are gene-specific programs (CDH1/CDH11, RUNX3, FOXO, TGF-beta/BMP).

qualifier: control of transcription factor DNA binding
name: Transcriptional repression by control of promoter DNA binding
rationale: Members share negative regulation of transcription and of transcription factor DNA binding/promoter occupancy; confusables are gene-specific transcription programmes (CDH1, RUNX3, PAX3, BMP) rather than this generic DNA-binding control.

core: collagen synthesis and regulated fibril and matrix assembly
qualifier: biosynthetic and assembly control only, without crosslinking, elastic fibre or degradative steps
name: Collagen biosynthesis and fibril assembly control
rationale: All members are collagen production or the positive and negative regulation of collagen fibril and extracellular matrix assembly; every confusable adds lysyl crosslinking, elastic fibre components, basement membrane or chain trimerization, or matrix metalloproteinase-driven collagen degradation.

name: Regulation of collagen synthesis and fibril deposition
rationale: Each member concerns how much collagen is made and assembled into fibrils and matrix, whereas confusables cover crosslinking, elastic fibres, basement membrane and collagen degradation.

name: Regulation of collagen biosynthesis and fibril assembly
rationale: All members concern collagen synthesis, metabolic regulation (positive and negative) and fibril/ECM assembly, while confusables add crosslinking, elastic fibres, basement membrane or collagen degradation.

qualifier: TLR2 recognition of Gram-positive lipopeptides and lipoteichoic acid
name: TLR2-centred Toll-like receptor sensing of Gram-positive ligands
rationale: Members cover TLR signalling and its regulation with TLR2 ligands (diacyl lipopeptide, lipoteichoic acid), which distinguishes it from LPS/TLR4-CD14 and monocyte inflammatory-response neighbours.

name: TLR2 sensing of bacterial lipopeptides and endogenous ligands
rationale: Members cover TLR2 responses to diacyl lipopeptide and lipoteichoic acid and TLR regulation by endogenous ligands, distinct from LPS/TLR4 and generic monocyte inflammation neighbours.

qualifier: TLR2 recognition of bacterial lipopeptides and lipoteichoic acid
name: TLR2 sensing of bacterial lipopeptides and lipoteichoic acid
rationale: Members cover TLR signaling with TLR2 activation by diacyl lipopeptides, lipoteichoic acid and endogenous ligands in dendritic cells; the TLR2 ligand terms separate it from LPS/TLR4-CD14 and generic monocyte-inflammation neighbours.

name: T cell costimulation and CD8/gamma-delta differentiation
rationale: Members are T cell signaling, costimulation and differentiation including CD8 and gamma-delta subsets, unlike confusables on IL-2/IL-7 cytokine signaling, thymocyte/B cell modules or proximal TCR phosphorylation.

name: T cell activation and CD8 and gamma-delta differentiation
rationale: Members describe T cell signalling, costimulation and differentiation including CD8 alpha-beta and gamma-delta lineages, unlike thymocyte/B cell, IL-2/IL-7 cytokine and proximal TCR confusables.

name: T cell activation and CD8/gamma-delta lineage differentiation
rationale: Members are T cell signaling, costimulation and differentiation including CD8 alpha-beta and gamma-delta T cells, unlike proximal TCR, IL-2/IL-7 cytokine or thymocyte/B cell confusables.

name: Megakaryocyte-erythroid lineage differentiation and platelet formation
rationale: Members span megakaryocyte development, platelet morphogenesis and erythroid-megakaryocytic and terminal erythroid signatures, unlike confusables limited to erythrocyte differentiation or RUNX1/myeloid progenitor programmes.

qualifier: platelet formation within the erythroid-megakaryocytic lineage
name: Megakaryocyte differentiation and platelet formation, erythroid-megakaryocytic lineage
rationale: Members regulate megakaryocyte differentiation and platelet morphogenesis plus erythroid-megakaryocytic lineage modules, distinguishing the theme from confusables on erythrocyte maturation, RUNX1 regulation or myeloid progenitors.

name: Megakaryocyte-erythroid lineage maturation and platelet morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover megakaryocyte differentiation and platelet morphogenesis plus erythroid-megakaryocytic and terminal erythroid modules, whereas confusables emphasise RUNX1 control, myeloid progenitors and erythrocyte differentiation alone.

name: Deoxynucleotide catabolism and pyrimidine monophosphate salvage
rationale: Members are catabolism of dGMP, dTMP and deoxyribonucleosides plus CMP/dCMP metabolism and UMP salvage; confusables focus on purine deoxynucleoside defects (ADA/PNP) or pyrimidine base catabolism.

name: Nucleoside monophosphate breakdown and pyrimidine monophosphate salvage
rationale: Members concern turnover of ribo- and deoxyribonucleoside monophosphates (CMP, dCMP, dTMP, dGMP, UMP); CMP metabolism and UMP salvage distinguish it from the pyrimidine-catabolism (C1, C2) and purine-deoxynucleoside (C3, C4) confusables.

name: Nucleoside monophosphate turnover, including pyrimidine salvage
rationale: Members are (deoxy)nucleoside monophosphate metabolism and catabolism; CMP metabolism and UMP salvage separate it from purine deoxynucleoside and pyrimidine base catabolism confusables.

name: EGFR-driven ERBB signaling and transactivation
rationale: Members centre on EGFR (GRB2/SHC1 events, EGFR-ERBB2, gastrin transactivation, overexpression inhibition), whereas confusables centre on ERBB2, ERBB3 or ERBB4 signalling via PLCG1, GRB7 or PI3K.

qualifier: receptor activation and proximal adaptor events
name: EGFR activation and proximal adaptor signaling
rationale: Members center on EGFR itself (EGFR-ERBB2 dimers, transactivation, overexpression, SHC1/GRB2 docking), whereas confusables cover ERBB2/ERBB3/ERBB4 signaling and PLCγ/PI3K branches.

name: EGFR-centred ERBB signalling and its regulation

name: Neutral amino acid and oligopeptide membrane transport

core: Placental and early embryonic lineage development

rationale: Members synthesise UDP-GlcNAc, CMP-sialic acid, dolichyl-phosphate-glucose and related hexosamine/mannose precursors with their disorders, unlike confusables on N-glycan processing, lysosomal catabolism or nucleotide-sugar transport.

name: Hexosamine, sialic acid and nucleotide-sugar donor metabolism

qualifier: epithelial–mesenchymal signalling in lung and salivary gland
name: Epithelial–mesenchymal signalling in lung and salivary branching morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern lung and salivary gland branching, mesenchymal/epithelial proliferation and reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signalling, unlike neighbours on trachea, pneumocytes or prostate branching.

qualifier: TRKA and NTRK3 to MAPK and CREB
name: TRKA and TRKC neurotrophin signalling to MAPK and CREB

name: TRKA and TRKC neurotrophin receptor downstream signalling
rationale: Members are NGF/TRKA (FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, p38, CREB, PI3K) and NTF3/NTRK3 downstream cascades, distinguishing them from TRKB/BDNF and initial TRKA activation confusables.

qualifier: follicle and oocyte maturation through ovulation and luteolysis

qualifier: follicle and oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteal phase
name: Ovarian cycle: follicle and oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteolysis
rationale: All members concern the female ovarian/estrous cycle (antral follicle growth, oocyte meiotic maturation, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis, gonadotropin feedback), whereas confusables emphasize testis, gonadotropin hormone secretion and germ-cell biology.

qualifier: tachykinin signaling in reproductive and urinary tracts

core: Visceral smooth muscle contraction and relaxation
qualifier: tachykinin signalling in urogenital and reproductive function

rationale: Members concern smooth muscle contraction/relaxation in micturition, erection, parturition, insemination and peristalsis with tachykinin receptor signalling, distinct from adrenergic vascular, GnRH/G-protein calcium or gastric confusables.

rationale: Members are serotonin and muscarinic acetylcholine GPCR/channel signaling plus cAMP catabolism (CaM-PDE1), the latter distinguishing it from serotonin synthesis, nicotinic and tachykinin confusables.

name: Serotonin and muscarinic receptor signaling with cAMP breakdown
rationale: Members are serotonin and muscarinic acetylcholine GPCR (and 5-HT3) signaling plus PDE1-mediated cAMP catabolism; confusables lack the cAMP-degradation arm or the serotonin receptors.

name: Actin filament polymerization, severing, capping and crosslinking
rationale: All members concern assembly, disassembly and network organization of actin filaments, distinguishing it from lamellipodium/leading-edge, focal adhesion and filopodium confusables.

name: Actin filament severing, capping, crosslinking and polymerization dynamics

name: Actin filament polymerization, severing, capping and crosslinking
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerization, depolymerization, severing, barbed-end capping, Arp2/3 nucleation and crosslinked networks, distinct from lamellipodium, focal adhesion and filopodium confusables.

name: PDGF receptor signaling in mesenchymal fibroblast activation
rationale: Members are PDGF receptor signalling regulation together with mechanoresponsive fibroblast programmes and hyaluronan synthesis, unlike confusables on Hippo/YAP, KRAS or ECM-dominated stroma.

name: PDGF receptor signalling in mechanoresponsive fibroblast activation
rationale: Members are regulation of PDGFR-alpha/beta signalling and YAP/TAZ-linked fibroblast modules with hyaluronan synthesis, distinguishing it from generic ECM/stromal, TGF-beta and Hippo pathway themes.

name: PDGF receptor signaling and mechanoresponsive fibroblast activation
rationale: Members cover regulation of PDGFR-alpha/beta signaling and response to PDGF together with YAP/TAZ-driven fibroblast modules, distinguishing them from Hippo-centred or general stromal/ECM confusables.

qualifier: biotin-dependent carboxylase and biotin cycle defects
name: Leucine catabolism and biotin-dependent carboxylase inborn errors
rationale: Members are leucine-pathway organic acidemias (isovaleric, 3-MCC, 3-MGA, beta-ketothiolase) and biotin recycling/holocarboxylase defects; the biotin cycle (BTD, HLCS, biotin transport) is what the valine/isoleucine-oriented confusables lack.

name: Leucine-catabolic organic acidemias and biotin cofactor defects
rationale: Members are inborn errors of leucine/branched-chain acyl-CoA catabolism and of biotin supply to carboxylases (BTD, HLCS, biotin transport), the biotin arm being what the confusables lack.

name: Leucine-catabolism organic acidemias and biotin cycle defects
rationale: Members are inborn errors of branched-chain (mainly leucine) acyl-CoA catabolism plus biotin transport, biotinidase and holocarboxylase defects, the biotin arm being what the confusables lack.

name: Epithelial cell-cell junctions and adhesion
rationale: Members are general cell junction, apical junction and epithelial cell-cell adhesion sets including adherens junction maintenance and apoptotic cleavage of adhesion proteins, without the cadherin assembly, apical polarity or desmosome specifics of confusables.

name: Epithelial cell-cell junction maintenance and apoptotic dismantling
rationale: Members are generic epithelial cell-cell adhesion and apical/adherens junction sets plus junction maintenance and apoptotic cleavage of adhesion proteins, unlike the confusables' CDH1 trafficking, apical-basal polarity or cardiac desmosomes.

name: Epithelial apical junction adhesion, maintenance and apoptotic cleavage
rationale: Members concern epithelial cell-cell junctions, adherens junction maintenance and apoptotic cleavage of adhesion proteins, while confusables emphasise polarity, desmosomes, junction assembly or cadherin trafficking.

core: acidification of secretory and endosomal organelle lumens
qualifier: driven by sodium-proton exchangers, with their neurodevelopmental disease variants, not V-ATPase, bicarbonate or chloride transport
name: Sodium-proton exchanger control of organelle lumen acidification

name: Organellar lumen acidification by sodium/proton exchangers
rationale: All members concern setting luminal pH of endosomes, Golgi and synaptic vesicles through Na+/H+ exchange, including the SLC9A6 and SLC9A9 disease entries, rather than lysosomal V-ATPase pH control, chloride/potassium cotransport, P-type ATPases or bicarbonate exchange.

name: Organellar sodium/proton exchange and endomembrane lumen acidification
rationale: Members concern Na+/H+ exchangers (SLC9A6/A9 and their neurodevelopmental disorders) and acidification of endosome, Golgi and synaptic vesicle lumens, distinct from confusables on lysosomal V-ATPase pH, P-type ATPases, bicarbonate or chloride cotransport.

qualifier: GABA reuptake and synaptic vesicle loading
name: GABA reuptake and synaptic vesicle neurotransmitter loading

qualifier: GABA reuptake and synaptic vesicle loading
name: GABA uptake and synaptic vesicle neurotransmitter loading

name: GABA reuptake and synaptic vesicle neurotransmitter loading
rationale: Members are GABA import/reuptake, SLC neurotransmitter transport and synaptic vesicle acidification and loading; confusables are glutamate/aspartate handling, GABA synthesis and monoamine transport.

qualifier: ICOS-driven Tfh help and memory B cells
name: Tfh-germinal center B cell interaction and B cell memory

qualifier: Tfh help and memory B cells

rationale: Members share T follicular helper differentiation, ICOS costimulation, germinal center B cell differentiation and memory B cell signatures, unlike neighbours on general B cell homeostasis and plasma cells.

qualifier: Tfh help via ICOS and memory B cells
name: Germinal center Tfh help and memory B cell formation
rationale: Members cover Tfh differentiation, ICOS costimulation, germinal center B cell differentiation and memory B cell signatures, separating it from lymphoid activation/plasma cell (C1-C3) and B-cell homeostasis (C4) neighbours.

name: RAC-subfamily GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are the RAC1, RAC2, RAC3 and RHOG GTPase cycles plus generic small GTPase and G beta:gamma-CDC42 signaling, whereas confusables cover CDC42/RHOJ, RHOA-D cycles and downstream WAVE/Arp2/3 effectors.

name: RAC-subfamily (RAC1-3, RHOG) GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are the RAC1, RAC2, RAC3 and RHOG GTPase cycles plus generic small GTPase and G beta:gamma-CDC42 signaling, distinguishing them from RHOA/CDC42-family cycles and downstream WAVE/actin effector confusables.

name: RAC and RHOG GTPase cycles

qualifier: checkpoint signaling plus anaphase midzone and spindle elongation
name: Kinetochore checkpoint signaling and anaphase spindle elongation

core: Mitotic spindle checkpoint and kinetochore attachment
name: Mitotic spindle checkpoint, kinetochore attachment and midzone elongation
rationale: All members concern spindle-kinetochore attachment, spindle assembly checkpoint signaling and anaphase spindle elongation/midzone, distinct from cytokinesis and PLK1/AURKA mitotic-entry confusables.

core: Mitotic spindle checkpoint and kinetochore attachment
qualifier: with spindle midzone assembly and elongation
name: Mitotic spindle checkpoint, kinetochore attachment and midzone assembly

qualifier: inhibition of proliferation, migration and differentiation

name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and growth restraint

rationale: All members concern traffic between the trans-Golgi and late endosomes/lysosomes in both directions and Golgi retention, distinguishing it from COPI Golgi-ER and early-endosome confusables.

name: Trans-Golgi to endosome/lysosome trafficking and retrieval
rationale: Members cover Golgi-to-endosome/lysosome transport, lysosomal vesicle biogenesis and late endosome-to-Golgi retrieval, unlike the COPI Golgi–ER and intra-Golgi trafficking neighbours.

name: Epidermal differentiation, cornified barrier and ectodermal appendage development

name: Epidermal and ectodermal appendage development including cornification

name: Epidermal cornification, barrier and ectodermal appendage development

qualifier: elongation, ether-lipid use and peroxisomal beta-oxidation
name: Very-long-chain fatty acid elongation and peroxisomal beta-oxidation

core: very-long-chain and polyunsaturated fatty acyl-CoA metabolism
qualifier: peroxisomal beta-oxidation and ether/plasmalogen lipid synthesis
name: Very-long-chain fatty acyl-CoA synthesis, beta-oxidation and ether lipid biosynthesis

core: very-long-chain fatty acid elongation and peroxisomal beta-oxidation
qualifier: ether lipid and plasmalogen synthesis from the same acyl-CoA pool
name: Very-long-chain fatty acid elongation and peroxisomal beta-oxidation

name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells and hyaluronan

name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells and hyaluronan

qualifier: VWF–GPIb–collagen axis including VWF disease variants

qualifier: von Willebrand factor and GPIb-IX-V axis
name: VWF–GPIb-IX-V platelet adhesion and aggregation
rationale: All members concern platelet adhesion, activation or aggregation, and the VWF/GPIb-IX-V/ADAMTS13 variant pathways distinguish it from coagulation-cascade and platelet-receptor (P2Y, PAR, GPVI) neighbours.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor chemotaxis and extravasation
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil chemotaxis and extravasation

qualifier: chemotaxis, extravasation and formyl peptide receptors
name: Neutrophil chemotaxis and extravasation via formyl peptide receptors

name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil chemotaxis and extravasation

core: Cellular cholesterol efflux and sterol homeostasis
name: LXR-driven cholesterol efflux and sterol homeostasis limiting foam cells

qualifier: efflux and reverse transport, restraining storage and synthesis
name: Cholesterol efflux, reverse transport and foam cell restraint
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, reverse cholesterol transport, HDL clearance and LXR-driven export while restraining storage, foam cell formation and synthesis, unlike neighbours on SREBP-driven biosynthesis or HDL/LDL particle assembly and remodelling.

qualifier: mucosal effectors: agglutination, lysis, metal sequestration
name: Mucosal antibacterial effectors: agglutination, lysis and metal sequestration

qualifier: mucosal agglutination, lysis and metal sequestration
name: Mucosal antibacterial defense by agglutination, lysis and sequestration

qualifier: lysis, agglutination and metal sequestration against Gram-positive bacteria
name: Mucosal antibacterial lysis, agglutination and metal sequestration
rationale: Members describe innate mucosal defence against bacteria through peptidoglycan-targeting cytolysis, agglutination, epithelial attachment and nutritional metal sequestration, while confusables focus on defensins, neutrophil killing or antifungal responses.

name: Cytokinesis and post-mitotic nuclear envelope reassembly

name: Cytokinesis and post-mitotic nuclear envelope reassembly

qualifier: contractile ring cytokinesis and ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing
name: Contractile ring cytokinesis and ESCRT nuclear envelope sealing

name: Surface receptor internalization toward lysosomal degradation

qualifier: docking, priming and SNARE assembly before calcium-triggered fusion

name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming and calcium-triggered fusion

qualifier: viral genome replication, transport and release, without interferon effectors
name: Host regulation of viral replication, transport and release

qualifier: control of viral replication, transport and release
name: Host-virus control of viral replication, transport and release

qualifier: post-entry viral replication, transport and release
name: Host-virus control of viral replication, transport and release
rationale: Members regulate viral genome replication, protein levels, transport and release by host or virus, whereas confusables focus on viral entry or interferon/ISG15 antiviral programs.

name: Scavenger receptor uptake and hyaluronan degradation

name: Scavenger receptor uptake and hyaluronan turnover

name: Scavenger receptor-mediated clearance and hyaluronan degradation

name: Synaptic transmission potentiation and sensorimotor gating

name: Synaptic transmission enhancement and sensorimotor gating

qualifier: glutamatergic and GABAergic, with sensorimotor gating behaviour
name: Enhanced glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission with sensorimotor gating
rationale: Members share positive regulation of excitatory and inhibitory neuron-neuron transmission plus prepulse inhibition and nonassociative learning, unlike neighbours about spine maintenance, receptor clustering, synapse assembly or general behaviour.

name: IL-12-driven Th1 and CD4+ T cell differentiation
rationale: Members describe CD4+ T cell fate programs centred on IL-12/STAT-driven Th1 differentiation (plus Treg and memory differentiation), whereas confusables emphasise dendritic-cell IL-12 or IFN-gamma production and signalling.

name: T-helper 1 cell differentiation and effector function

name: B cell receptor signalling and its activating and inhibitory regulation

name: B cell receptor signaling and its tuning
rationale: All members are BCR signaling and its activating or inhibitory regulation (CD22, leukocyte brake module), distinct from Fc receptor and CD28/TCR costimulation confusables.

name: B cell receptor signalling and its co-receptor tuning

name: PAPS sulfate activation and selenocysteine synthesis
rationale: Members share PAPSS-type activation of sulfate (PAPS) and selenate plus selenocysteine synthesis and UGA readthrough; confusables lack the selenium arm and centre on thyroid/iodide, SLC26 anion or nucleotide-sugar transport.

name: PAPS synthesis and selenium assimilation into selenocysteine
rationale: Members link PAPS synthesis/transport (PAPSS) with selenate reduction, selenocysteine synthesis and UGA readthrough, which the nucleotide-sugar and thyroid/anion-transport neighbours lack.

name: Monocyte and neutrophil identity and activation signatures
rationale: Most members are monocyte/macrophage/neutrophil lineage and activation gene modules (one B cell development outlier), distinguished from CSF1-signalling and dendritic-cell/monocyte surface neighbours by monocyte activation and neutrophil modules.

name: Myeloid lineage identity and monocyte activation
rationale: Nearly all members are monocyte/neutrophil identity and activation modules (PU.1, TLR4, ectoenzymes), distinguished from confusables on dendritic/surface signatures, CSF1 signaling or degranulation.

name: Leukocyte lineage identity: monocyte, neutrophil and B cell
rationale: Members are hematopoietic lineage signatures, mostly monocyte/macrophage and neutrophil identity and activation plus B cell development, distinguishing it from CSF1, dendritic-cell surface and degranulation confusables.

core: Antigen presentation via MHC class II
name: MHC class II and lipid antigen presentation
rationale: Members are exogenous-peptide MHC class II presentation (incl. germinal centre B cells) plus general and lipid/MHC Ib presentation, the lipid/TLR7-8 component separating it from the regulatory class II confusables and class II from the CD1/DC-receptor confusable.

qualifier: MHC class II, lipid antigen and TLR7/8
name: MHC class II and lipid antigen presentation, TLR7/8 module
rationale: All members are antigen processing/presentation, centred on MHC class II in B cells, and unlike the confusables include the TLR7/8 co-expression module and MHC Ib lipid antigen presentation.

name: Antigen processing and presentation, predominantly MHC class II
rationale: All members are antigen processing/presentation terms centred on exogenous peptide presentation via MHC class II (germinal-centre B cells, MHC-TLR7-TLR8 cluster), distinguishing it from MHC class I cross-presentation and regulatory-term confusables.

name: Deadenylation-dependent maternal mRNA decay at maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members concern poly(A) shortening and deadenylation-dependent decay (P-bodies) with maternal mRNA M- and Z-decay at MZT, unlike confusables on ARE/miRNA-mediated decay, nuclear RNA surveillance or zygotic genome activation and piRNA.

qualifier: including maternal mRNA clearance at the maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Deadenylation-dependent mRNA decay and maternal mRNA clearance
rationale: Members concern poly(A) shortening, deadenylation-dependent decay and P-body assembly, including M- and Z-decay of maternal mRNAs, unlike confusables on nuclear RNA processing/surveillance, RBP- and miRNA-mediated decay or MZT chromatin and piRNA.

qualifier: maternal mRNA clearance at the maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Deadenylation-dependent mRNA decay in maternal mRNA clearance
rationale: Members combine poly(A) shortening, deadenylation-dependent decay and P-body assembly with M- and Z-decay of maternal transcripts, separating it from miRNA/RBP-mediated decay, MZT chromatin/zygotic genome activation, and nuclear RNA surveillance confusables.

name: Response to toxic heavy metals and cadmium detoxification
rationale: Members are responses to cadmium, mercury, lead, cobalt and selenium, distinct from zinc/copper/iron homeostasis and MTF1-metallothionein confusables.

name: Toxic heavy-metal response and cadmium detoxification
rationale: Members are responses to cadmium, lead, mercury, cobalt and selenium, unlike confusables centred on zinc/copper/MTF1 metallothionein and iron responses.

name: Cellular response to toxic heavy metals, especially cadmium
rationale: Members are responses to cadmium, mercury, lead, selenium and cobalt with cadmium transport and detoxification, unlike zinc/copper/iron homeostasis and metallothionein neighbours.

qualifier: metaphase alignment and anaphase onset control
name: Meiotic metaphase chromosome alignment and anaphase segregation control
rationale: All members concern meiotic metaphase alignment, poleward movement and the regulated metaphase-anaphase transition, distinct from confusables on meiotic prophase recombination, cohesion establishment, meiotic entry and oocyte spindle assembly.

name: Meiotic metaphase-to-anaphase chromosome alignment and segregation
rationale: All members concern meiotic chromosome alignment, separation control and movement to spindle poles, unlike neighbours on meiotic recombination, cohesion establishment and meiosis I entry.

qualifier: metaphase alignment and anaphase transition control
name: Meiotic metaphase chromosome alignment and anaphase transition control
rationale: All members concern aligning and segregating meiotic chromosomes and restraining the metaphase-anaphase transition, unlike confusables on recombination/synapsis, cohesion, G2/MI entry or oocyte spindle positioning.

qualifier: LXR regulation of lipogenic, gluconeogenic and lipolytic genes
name: LXR-regulated lipogenic, gluconeogenic and lipolytic gene expression
rationale: Members concern LXR (NR1H2/NR1H3) nuclear receptor control of metabolic genes, distinguishing it from PPAR/clock, adipogenesis and lipid droplet confusables.

core: Nuclear receptor transcriptional control of metabolism
qualifier: LXR targets in lipogenesis, lipolysis and gluconeogenesis
name: LXR transcriptional control of lipogenesis, lipolysis and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members are LXR (NR1H2/NR1H3) target gene programmes and nuclear receptor transcription/SUMOylation; LXR-specific gene regulation distinguishes it from PPAR/clock, lipid droplet and adipogenesis confusables.

core: Nuclear receptor transcriptional control of metabolism
name: LXR nuclear receptor regulation of lipid and glucose metabolism
rationale: Members are LXR-regulated lipogenesis, gluconeogenesis and lipolysis genes plus nuclear receptor transcription and SUMOylation, distinct from lipid droplet, adipogenesis and PPARA/circadian confusables.

core: Mitochondrial gene expression and tRNA/rRNA modification
name: Mitochondrial gene expression and tRNA/rRNA modification
rationale: Members span mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription, RNA processing and translation together with tRNA/rRNA processing and modification and translational fidelity, unlike confusables on nuclear Pol I/III transcription, splicing, protein methylation or telomerase/NMD.

core: Translation machinery biogenesis and RNA modification
qualifier: mitochondrial gene expression plus tRNA, rRNA and translation-factor modification
name: Mitochondrial gene expression and tRNA, rRNA, translation-factor modification
rationale: Members cover mtDNA replication, mitochondrial transcription, RNA processing and translation together with tRNA/rRNA modification, aminoacylation and translation-factor modifications (hypusine, diphthamide) serving translational fidelity, distinct from Pol I/III transcription and splicing, mRNA decay, protein methylation and Cajal body confusables.

core: RNA modification and translation machinery maturation
name: tRNA/rRNA modification, translation fidelity and mitochondrial gene expression
rationale: Members cover tRNA/rRNA/snRNA processing and modification, translation factor modification and fidelity, and mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription and translation, unlike confusables on protein methylation, mRNA decay, Pol I/III transcription or telomerase.

name: Spliceosomal splicing, snRNP biogenesis and mRNA 3'-end processing
rationale: Members cover snRNA transcription and snRNP assembly, spliceosome-mediated splicing and its regulation, and mRNA/histone pre-mRNA 3'-end processing; this distinguishes it from rRNA/Pol I-III, RNA decay and mRNA export confusables.

qualifier: with snRNA transcription and snRNP assembly
name: snRNA biogenesis, spliceosomal splicing and pre-mRNA 3'-end processing
rationale: Members span snRNA transcription and snRNP assembly, spliceosome assembly and splicing regulation, and polyadenylation and histone mRNA stem-loop 3'-end processing; confusables add mRNA export or rRNA/Pol I-III transcription instead.

qualifier: spliceosome and snRNP biogenesis with 3'-end processing
name: Pre-mRNA splicing, snRNP biogenesis and 3'-end processing
rationale: Members span spliceosome assembly and splicing, snRNA transcription/snRNP assembly and mRNA/histone pre-mRNA 3'-end processing, lacking the rRNA/Pol I/III and mRNA export content of confusables.

name: Cardiac action potential ion channels and conduction-system pacemaking
rationale: Members span all action potential phases, Kir/Kv/HCN/K2P channels and SA/AV node, His and Purkinje conduction, unlike confusables on gap junction coupling or negative regulation of calcium and action potentials.

name: Cardiac action potential depolarization, repolarization and pacemaker channels
rationale: Members span all action potential phases, K+ (Kir, TWIK, voltage-gated) and HCN channels and conduction-system signaling, while confusables center on gap-junction coupling or calcium-channel regulation.

qualifier: phase-specific ion channels and conduction-system depolarization
name: Cardiac action potential ion channels and conduction-system depolarization
rationale: Members span action potential phases 0-4, K+/HCN/Na+ channels and SA/AV/Purkinje depolarization, beyond the confusables' gap-junction coupling or calcium-channel regulation.

core: Hepatic xenobiotic and organic anion disposition
name: Hepatic bilirubin glucuronidation and xenobiotic organic anion transport
rationale: Members cover heme/bilirubin degradation and UGT conjugation with SLCO/ABCC organic anion and drug transport (ADME), distinguishing it from bile acid synthesis and sulfonation confusables.

core: Hepatic organic anion and drug transport
name: Hepatic organic anion, bilirubin and drug transport
rationale: Members cover SLCO/ABCC2 organic anion and xenobiotic transport, drug ADME, heme degradation and bilirubin glucuronidation disorders, distinguishing it from bile acid synthesis/transport and phase II sulfonation confusables.

qualifier: organic anion uptake, glucuronidation and export
name: Hepatic drug and bilirubin uptake, glucuronidation and export
rationale: Members are SLCO/ABCC organic anion transport, UGT glucuronidation, heme/bilirubin catabolism and drug ADME, distinguishing it from SLC22, bile acid and phase I xenobiotic metabolism neighbours.

qualifier: end replication, capping and recombination suppression
name: Telomere end replication, capping and recombination suppression
rationale: Members cover telomere C-strand synthesis and semi-conservative replication together with capping, D-loop/t-circle control and recombination inhibition, distinguishing them from telomerase extension, break-induced replication and general DNA topology confusables.

name: Telomere end protection, C-strand replication and recombination control
rationale: Members cover telomere capping, protection from NHEJ/recombination, t-circle and D-loop control and C-strand lagging synthesis, distinct from confusables on telomerase extension or general replication-fork and repair processes.

qualifier: C-strand replication, capping and recombination control
name: Telomere C-strand replication, capping and recombination control
rationale: Members cover telomere C-strand synthesis, semi-conservative replication, t-loop/D-loop handling and end protection, lacking the confusables' telomerase extension or general DNA topology.

name: Bicarbonate and inorganic anion exchange in acid-base balance
rationale: Members involve SLC4/SLC26 bicarbonate, sulfate, oxalate and iodide transport plus carbonic anhydrase and proton/pH control; the pH members separate it from the phosphate-mineralisation and organelle-acidification confusables.

name: Bicarbonate and anion exchange in acid-base regulation
rationale: Members share SLC4/SLC26 bicarbonate, chloride, iodide, sulfate and oxalate exchange with CO2 hydration and proton transport, distinct from organelle acidification, Na+/H+ exchange and phosphate transport confusables.

name: Bicarbonate and SLC26 anion exchange in acid-base balance
rationale: Members are SLC4/SLC26 bicarbonate, chloride, iodide, sulfate and oxalate exchangers, their diseases and CO2 hydration/pH control, unlike confusables about phosphate transport or organelle lumen acidification.

name: Phenylalanine-tyrosine degradation and general amino acid catabolism
rationale: The specific members concern phenylalanine/tyrosine catabolism and phenylketonuria while the rest are generic amino/organic acid metabolic parent terms; confusables add tetrahydrobiopterin, glycine conjugation or other amino acids instead.

name: Phenylalanine–tyrosine catabolism and general amino acid metabolism
rationale: Specific members concern phenylalanine/tyrosine breakdown and phenylketonuria, with broad amino/organic acid parent terms; it lacks the BH4 cofactor, aromatic acid conjugation and other amino acids of its neighbours.

qualifier: with general organic and amino acid metabolism
name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism with organic acid metabolism
rationale: Specific members are phenylalanine/tyrosine metabolism and phenylketonuria, joined by broad (obsolete) organic and amino acid terms; confusables add other amino acids (histidine, proline, threonine), BH4 synthesis or glycine conjugation.

qualifier: SMO activation and proteasomal GLI/DVL turnover
name: Hedgehog SMO–GLI transduction and proteasomal GLI/DVL turnover
rationale: Members concern SMO activation, ciliary localization and proteasomal GLI processing/degradation plus DVL degradation, separating it from Hh ligand processing, planar cell polarity and canonical Wnt/Notch confusables.

qualifier: SMO activation and proteasomal GLI processing
name: Hedgehog signal transduction via SMO and proteasomal GLI processing
rationale: Most members are Hedgehog pathway steps (SMO activation, GLI processing/degradation, GLI transcription) alongside proteasomal DVL and SLIT/ROBO regulation, unlike confusables on Wnt/Notch, planar polarity or Hh ligand lipidation.

qualifier: SMO activation and proteasomal GLI processing
name: Hedgehog SMO activation and proteasomal GLI processing
rationale: Members centre on Hedgehog reception, SMO activation and ciliary localisation and proteasome-dependent GLI1/2 degradation and GLI3 processing (with related proteasomal DVL turnover), unlike confusables on canonical Wnt/Notch, Hh ligand lipidation and release, or planar cell polarity.

name: Mitochondrial transcription and translation initiation, elongation, termination
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial transcription, translation phases and mtDNA maintenance, whereas neighbours focus on mitochondrial RNA processing, modification, stability or DNA replication.

name: Mitochondrial genome transcription, translation and maintenance
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial transcription initiation/termination, mitoribosome translation stages and mtDNA repair, distinguishing it from mitochondrial RNA stability/processing, modification and replication confusables.

name: Mitochondrial transcription and translation initiation, elongation, termination
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial transcription and translation steps and small ribosomal subunit assembly, whereas confusables emphasize mitochondrial RNA processing, stability, modification and DNA replication.

name: Gluconeogenesis from fructose, glycerol and alanine
rationale: Members are fructose, glycerol/alditol, alanine and oxaloacetate metabolism feeding gluconeogenesis, distinct from glucose-6-phosphate, pentose, galactose and glycolysis confusables.

name: Fructose, glycerol and alanine entry into gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members concern fructose, glycerol/alditol, alanine and oxaloacetate metabolism feeding gluconeogenesis, unlike confusables on galactose, glycolysis, glucose-6-phosphate or pentoses.

name: Gluconeogenic substrate metabolism: fructose, glycerol and alanine
rationale: Members concern fructose, glycerol/alditol, alanine and oxaloacetate metabolism feeding gluconeogenesis, distinct from glycolysis, glucokinase, galactose and pentose confusables.

core: Osmotic stress and renal sodium homeostasis
name: Osmosensing and aldosterone-regulated renal sodium-chloride transport
rationale: Members combine hyper/hypo-osmotic and salt-stress responses with aldosterone- and renin-linked renal sodium and chloride transport, unlike confusables on vasopressin water handling or potassium transport.

name: Osmotic stress response and renal sodium-chloride transport
rationale: Members are hyper/hypo-osmotic sensing, water homeostasis and renal sodium/chloride transport under aldosterone; confusables are potassium-coupled ion transport or vasopressin-aquaporin water handling.

qualifier: osmotic/salt stress responses and aldosterone-regulated renal sodium transport
name: Osmotic stress responses and aldosterone-regulated renal sodium transport
rationale: Members cover cellular responses to hyper-/hypo-osmotic and salt stress plus renal sodium and chloride transport under aldosterone and renin-angiotensin control, distinguished from potassium-transport and vasopressin/aquaporin water-handling confusables.

name: Factor XII-kallikrein contact activation and fibrinolysis regulation
rationale: Members are FXII/kallikrein intrinsic activation, hereditary angioedema, amyloid-FXII interaction, plasminogen activation and fibrin dissolution, unlike VWF, MMP and extrinsic/common coagulation confusables.

name: Factor XII contact activation and fibrinolysis regulation
rationale: Members are FXII/plasma kallikrein intrinsic coagulation, hereditary angioedema, amyloid-induced FXII activation, plasminogen activation and fibrin clot dissolution, distinct from extrinsic/common coagulation, VWF and MMP confusables.

name: FXII-kallikrein contact activation and fibrinolysis regulation
rationale: Members centre on FXIIa/plasma kallikrein contact activation of the intrinsic pathway (including amyloid-triggered FXII, C1-inhibitor/FXII angioedema) and plasminogen activation/fibrin dissolution, distinguishing it from VWF, extrinsic/common coagulation and MMP confusables.

qualifier: RHO, RND and CDC42 subfamilies with formin activation
name: RHO, RND and CDC42-subfamily GTPase cycles
rationale: All members are GTPase cycles of RHOA/B/C/D/F, RND2/3, CDC42/RHOU/V or formin activation by RHO, distinguishing the theme from RAC/RHOG-centered and actin-assembly confusables.

qualifier: Rho, Rnd and Cdc42 subfamilies with formin activation
name: Rho, Rnd and Cdc42 GTPase cycles
rationale: All members are GTPase cycles of RHOA/B/C/D/F, RND2/3, CDC42, RHOU/V and formin activation; confusables add RAC/RHOG cycles or actin-protrusion processes that this theme lacks.

qualifier: RHO, RND and CDC42 subfamilies with formin activation
name: RHO, RND and CDC42 GTPase cycles and formins
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles of RHOA/B/C/D/F, RND2/3, RHOU/V and CDC42 plus formin activation, distinguished from the RAC/RHOG/WASP-centered and actin-dynamics confusables.

core: CDK4/6-RB1 control of the G1/S transition
name: CDK4/6-RB1 G1/S restriction and p16INK4A senescence evasion
rationale: Members concern cyclin D/E-CDK, p27/p21 and RB1-E2F control of G1/S including defective p16INK4A-CDK4/6 binding; this distinguishes it from E2F target transcription, G2/M and p14ARF/TP53 confusables.

name: p16INK4A-CDK4/6-RB1 control of the G1/S transition
rationale: Members concern CDK4/6 and cyclin E-CDK2 control of RB1/E2F at G1/S, including p16INK4A and RB1 defects and cyclin D/p27 degradation, unlike confusables on E2F target transcription, G2/M and p14ARF/TP53.

core: Cyclin-CDK–RB1 control of the G1/S transition
qualifier: cancer defects including p16INK4A and RB1 loss
name: Cyclin-CDK–RB1 control of G1/S and its cancer defects
rationale: All members describe cyclin D/E-CDK, CKI and RB1/E2F control of G1/S entry or its disruption in cancer (defective p16INK4A, RB1 mutants, CDK4/6 inhibitors), distinguished from confusables on p14ARF/p53, G2/M checkpoints and E2F target transcription.

name: Viral receptor attachment, entry and membrane fusion
rationale: Members cover receptor-mediated virion attachment, endocytic entry and envelope-driven cell-cell fusion across dengue, RSV, influenza and HIV, whereas confusables emphasise regulation of entry, viral transport or viral protein maturation.

core: Viral attachment and host cell entry
name: Envelope glycoprotein-mediated viral attachment and host entry
rationale: Members describe receptor-mediated virion attachment, endocytic entry and envelope-driven cell-cell fusion across RSV, influenza, dengue and HIV, unlike confusables centred on regulation of entry, virus transport or viral protein maturation.

core: Viral attachment and entry into host cells
name: Receptor-mediated viral attachment, entry and membrane fusion
rationale: Members describe virion attachment, receptor-mediated endocytosis and envelope-driven fusion for dengue, RSV, influenza and HIV; the confusables instead centre on entry regulation, virus transport and viral protein maturation.

name: LDL/HDL remodeling and triglyceride-rich lipoprotein clearance
rationale: Members are remodeling and clearance of circulating lipoproteins; LDL/HDL remodeling and LDL clearance distinguish it from confusables centred on chylomicron assembly/remodeling and lipase activity.

name: ApoB-lipoprotein clearance with LDL and HDL remodeling
rationale: Members are clearance of VLDL, LDL, chylomicron and triglyceride-rich particles plus LDL/HDL remodeling, while confusables add chylomicron remodeling, lipase assembly, chylomicron assembly and HDL clearance.

qualifier: LDL/HDL remodeling and triglyceride-rich particle clearance
name: LDL/HDL remodeling and triglyceride-rich lipoprotein clearance
rationale: Members are remodeling of LDL/HDL and clearance of LDL, VLDL and chylomicrons, whereas confusables emphasise chylomicron assembly, lipase complexes and LXR-driven lipogenesis.

name: Hindbrain development with branchiomotor cranial nerve formation
rationale: Members cover brainstem/pons maturation, hindbrain neuron migration and brainstem-controlled functions (respiration, suckling), with facial/trigeminal branchiomotor nerve development distinguishing it from cerebellar, spinal-cord and cranial-ganglion confusables.

qualifier: branchiomotor cranial nerves and brainstem-controlled reflexes
name: Hindbrain development, branchiomotor nerves and brainstem reflexes
rationale: Members cover hindbrain/pons/brainstem development, neuronal migration and trigeminal/facial branchiomotor nerve formation plus brainstem-driven suckling and respiration, distinguishing them from spinal cord, cerebellar, olfactory/GnRH and locomotor-behaviour neighbours.

qualifier: branchiomotor cranial nerves and brainstem reflexes
name: Hindbrain development, branchiomotor cranial nerves and brainstem reflexes
rationale: Members cover hindbrain/pons/brainstem maturation, hindbrain neuron migration, trigeminal and facial branchiomotor nerves and brainstem-controlled suckling and breathing, distinguishing it from cranial ganglia, cerebellar, spinal cord and locomotor-behaviour neighbours.

name: Photoreceptor differentiation and outer segment maintenance
rationale: Members cover rod, cone and bipolar development with photoreceptor outer segment and ciliary transition zone protein targeting, unlike general cilium trafficking and whole-eye morphogenesis confusables.

qualifier: outer segment protein targeting and maintenance
name: Photoreceptor development and outer-segment protein targeting
rationale: Members concern rod/cone (and bipolar) development, photoreceptor morphogenesis and maintenance, and protein targeting to the outer segment/transition zone, unlike generic ciliary trafficking or broader eye-development confusables.

name: Photoreceptor development and outer segment maintenance
rationale: Members concern rod/cone development, outer segment organization, ciliary transition-zone protein targeting and photoreceptor maintenance, unlike ciliary-trafficking and whole-eye morphogenesis confusables.

qualifier: with phospholipid and triglyceride synthesis regulation
name: Lipid droplet biogenesis and phospholipid synthesis regulation
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation/fusion and regulation of phospholipid and triglyceride synthesis in fat-storing cells, unlike the lipophagy and droplet-disassembly confusables.

qualifier: with promotion of phospholipid and triglyceride synthesis
name: Lipid droplet biogenesis and glycerolipid synthesis regulation
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation/fusion and regulation of phosphatidylcholine and triglyceride synthesis in adipocytes, while confusables emphasise droplet disassembly, lipophagy and triglyceride turnover.

name: Lipid droplet formation and phospholipid synthesis regulation
rationale: Members cover lipid droplet formation, fusion and organization, regulation of phosphatidylcholine/phospholipid and triglyceride synthesis and an adipocyte lipid-storage module, whereas confusables focus on lipophagy, droplet disassembly and triglyceride homeostasis.

name: Stromal fibroblast adhesion, matrix and KRAS/AP-1 target genes
rationale: Members are fibroblast/stromal matrix and adhesion gene sets with fibroblast proliferation, KRAS-up and FOSL1/2 targets, differing from the YAP/TGF-beta, pure ECM and endothelial confusables.

name: Fibroblast stroma adhesion and KRAS/FOSL-driven proliferation
rationale: Members combine stromal ECM/complement and cell adhesion modules with fibroblast proliferation, KRAS-up and FOSL1/2 targets, the proliferative arm distinguishing it from YAP/TAZ, CXCL12 stromal and ECM-only confusables.

qualifier: cell adhesion, matrix and KRAS/AP-1 proliferation
name: Stromal fibroblast adhesion, matrix and KRAS/AP-1 proliferation
rationale: Members share a fibroblast/stromal program of cell adhesion, ECM/laminin and fibroblast proliferation with KRAS and FOSL targets, distinguishing it from pure ECM modules, YAP/TGF-beta mechanoresponsive and endothelial/secretory stromal confusables.

qualifier: YAP/TAZ-driven transcription and cell density sensing
name: Hippo signaling and YAP/TAZ-driven transcription
rationale: Members are Hippo pathway regulation, density sensing and YAP1/TAZ transcriptional output, which PTK6, RUNX3, Wnt and PDGF/mechanoresponsive confusables lack.

name: Hippo kinase signaling and YAP/TAZ-driven transcription
rationale: Members cover Hippo pathway regulation, cell-density detection and YAP1/TAZ target expression; confusables are PTK6, RUNX3, WNT or PDGF/fibroblast programmes lacking the Hippo kinase core.

qualifier: YAP/TAZ transcription and cell density sensing
name: Hippo–YAP/TAZ signalling and cell density sensing
rationale: All members concern Hippo pathway regulation and YAP1/TAZ-driven transcription with contact-inhibition sensing, distinct from RUNX3, WNT, PDGF and PTK6 neighbours.

name: Autophagosome assembly regulation and ER/nuclear selective autophagy
rationale: Members regulate autophagosome assembly, maturation and cargo recruitment together with reticulophagy and nucleophagy, distinct from mitophagy, pexophagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy neighbours.

name: Autophagosome assembly regulation and ER/nucleus-selective autophagy
rationale: Members regulate phagophore/autophagosome assembly and maturation and include reticulophagy and nuclear microautophagy, unlike confusables on mitophagy, pexophagy or aggrephagy.

name: Autophagosome assembly control and ER and nuclear autophagy
rationale: Members regulate phagophore/autophagosome assembly and maturation and include reticulophagy and nucleophagy; distinct from mitophagy, pexophagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy confusables.

qualifier: plasma heme scavenging and non-transferrin iron import
name: Iron and heme uptake, including plasma heme scavenging
rationale: All members concern cellular acquisition and homeostasis of iron and heme, and the heme scavenging/transport and plasma-membrane iron import distinguish it from the transferrin-based confusables.

name: Heme scavenging and cellular iron uptake
rationale: Members concern heme scavenging/transport and cellular iron import and homeostasis, distinct from confusables built on transferrin cycling, cadmium or oxygen/selenium responses.

name: Iron homeostasis with plasma heme scavenging and uptake
rationale: Members concern iron import, iron response and organismal iron balance together with heme scavenging, transport and assimilation, which the confusables (transferrin cycle, oxygen sensing, cadmium) lack.

name: Stalled-ribosome quality control and cytoplasmic stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members are ribosome-associated quality control of stalled ribosomes (ZNF598/RQT, RQC) and stress granule assembly/disassembly, unlike neighbours on general proteasomal degradation, ERAD or aggrephagy.

qualifier: stalled-ribosome rescue and stress granule dynamics
name: Ribosome-associated quality control and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members split between stalled-ribosome quality control (ZNF598/RQT, RQC nascent-chain degradation) and stress granule assembly/disassembly, which together set it apart from aggrephagy, N/C-degron, proteasome-regulation and ERAD confusables.

qualifier: ribosome quality control and stress granules
name: Ribosome-associated quality control and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members cover stalled-ribosome rescue and nascent-chain degradation plus stress granule assembly and disassembly, distinguishing it from ERAD, aggrephagy and general proteasomal degradation confusables.

name: Skeletal muscle fiber differentiation and myogenesis
rationale: Members share skeletal muscle differentiation and myogenic gene expression (including extraocular muscle and lithium response), unlike confusables on myoblast commitment/fusion, contraction, cardiac growth or calcineurin-driven hypertrophy.

name: Skeletal muscle fiber differentiation and homeostasis
rationale: Members share skeletal muscle fiber differentiation and maintenance, whereas confusables cover cardiac adaptation, sarcomere contraction and myoblast fusion/proliferation.

name: Skeletal muscle fiber differentiation and maintenance
rationale: Members concern skeletal muscle fiber differentiation, myogenesis and muscle cell homeostasis, whereas confusables focus on myoblast fusion, contraction, cardiac growth or regeneration.

name: Replicative DNA unwinding and break-induced replication
rationale: Members share replicative DNA synthesis machinery (DNA unwinding, polymerase activation, mitotic replication, break-induced replication repair); replication-driven helicase function distinguishes it from telomere, recombination repair and replication-initiation confusables.

qualifier: DNA unwinding and polymerase activity in dividing cells
name: Replicative DNA unwinding and polymerase synthesis in dividing cells
rationale: Members concern DNA unwinding, polymerase activity and replication in mitotic division (including break-induced replication), distinguishing it from telomere recombination, DNA repair and replication-initiation confusables.

qualifier: unwinding and polymerase activity in dividing cells
name: Replicative DNA unwinding and synthesis in dividing cells
rationale: Members concern DNA unwinding, polymerase activation and replication in the mitotic cycle, including break-induced replication, whereas neighbours center on telomere recombination, replication initiation control or DNA repair.

qualifier: membrane tubulation, vesicle budding and docking
name: Membrane tubulation and vesicle budding in intracellular transport
rationale: Members concern generic membrane traffic with emphasis on membrane/endosome tubulation, Golgi vesicle budding and membrane docking, whereas confusables are specific Golgi/ER secretory, Rab GTPase or recycling routes.

name: Membrane tubulation and vesicle budding in endomembrane traffic
rationale: Members concern vesicle budding, endosomal membrane tubulation, membrane docking and a broad trafficking module, whereas confusables are Golgi/COPI/COPII routes, Rab GTPase regulation, ER targeting or endocytic recycling.

name: Membrane tubulation and vesicle budding in intracellular transport
rationale: Members concern vesicle budding, endosomal membrane tubulation, membrane docking and cargo traffic, distinguishing them from Golgi/COPI, Rab GTPase and ER translocation neighbours.

name: Cyclooxygenase-dependent prostanoid synthesis and receptor signaling
rationale: All members concern PLA2-released arachidonate conversion by COX to prostaglandins/thromboxanes and their receptors, distinguishing it from the leukotriene/lipoxygenase confusables and from the GO prostaglandin-regulation confusables.

name: Cyclooxygenase-derived prostanoid synthesis and prostanoid receptors
rationale: All members cover arachidonate release by PLA2, COX conversion to prostaglandins/thromboxanes and their receptors, distinguishing the theme from leukotriene/lipoxin themes and from regulation-of-prostaglandin-secretion themes.

qualifier: cyclooxygenase route to prostaglandins and thromboxanes, with prostanoid receptors
name: Cyclooxygenase prostaglandin and thromboxane synthesis and receptors
rationale: All members cover arachidonate release by PLA2, COX conversion to prostaglandins/thromboxanes and prostanoid receptors, distinguishing the theme from leukotriene/lipoxin confusables and from those limited to regulation of prostaglandin secretion.

qualifier: methyl-DNA binding and NCoR–HDAC corepressor recruitment
name: MECP2 methyl-DNA binding and NCoR–HDAC corepressor recruitment
rationale: Members concern MECP2 function and its loss (methyl-DNA binding, NCoR/SMRT binding, phosphorylation) plus HDAC deacetylation, while confusables cover MECP2 neuronal target genes and behaviour.

core: MECP2 methyl-DNA binding and transcriptional repression
name: MECP2 methyl-DNA binding and NCoR–HDAC corepression
rationale: Members are MECP2 binding to 5mC/5hmC DNA and NCoR/SMRT, its phosphorylation and HDAC histone deacetylation, whereas confusables emphasise MECP2 neuronal target genes and behaviour.

name: MECP2 methyl-DNA binding and corepressor–HDAC repression

core: Checkpoint regulation of p53 and CDK activity
name: Checkpoint regulation of p53 stability and CDK activity
rationale: Members cover ubiquitin-mediated turnover of p53, COP1 and Cdc25A plus CDK inhibition and threonine dephosphorylation, while confusables emphasise p53 phosphorylation, radiation response and G2/M progression.

name: p53 and Cdc25A degradation restraining CDK activity

name: p53 and CDC25A turnover with CDK inhibition
rationale: Members concern ubiquitin degradation of p53, CDC25A and COP1 plus dephosphorylation and CDK inhibition, whereas confusables emphasize radiation-induced checkpoint signaling and p53 phosphorylation.

qualifier: base excision, mismatch and alkylation reversal
name: Base excision, mismatch and direct-reversal DNA repair
rationale: Members span glycosylase-initiated BER and its defects, mismatch repair and its defects, ALKBH/MGMT alkylation reversal, TET-TDG demethylation and crosslink repair; confusables instead centre on NER, translesion synthesis and antibody hypermutation.

qualifier: base excision, mismatch and direct-reversal repair
name: Base excision, mismatch and direct-reversal DNA repair
rationale: Members are glycosylase-initiated BER (including TET/TDG demethylation), mismatch repair, alkylation reversal and cross-link repair with their disease variants, distinguishing them from the NER, translesion and immunoglobulin-mutation neighbours.

core: DNA base damage and mismatch repair
qualifier: base excision, mismatch and alkylation reversal, not NER or translesion synthesis
name: Base excision, mismatch and alkylation-reversal DNA repair
rationale: Members cover glycosylase-initiated base excision repair and its defects, mismatch repair and its defects, direct alkylation reversal, interstrand cross-link repair and TDG-mediated demethylation; confusables are nucleotide excision repair, translesion synthesis and antibody hypermutation.

qualifier: glycosaminoglycans and glycosphingolipids with storage diseases
name: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan and glycosphingolipid degradation and storage diseases
rationale: All members concern lysosomal degradation of GAGs and gangliosides and the mucopolysaccharidoses/GM2 gangliosidoses caused by its defects, distinguishing the theme from GAG biosynthesis and sialic acid/nucleotide sugar neighbours.

name: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan and glycosphingolipid degradation and storage disorders
rationale: Members are lysosomal degradation of HS, CS/DS, keratan sulfate, hyaluronan and gangliosides and the mucopolysaccharidoses/gangliosidoses, distinct from GAG biosynthesis, sialic acid metabolism and generic lysosome confusables.

qualifier: glycosaminoglycans and glycosphingolipids with storage disorders
name: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan and glycosphingolipid degradation and storage disorders
rationale: Members are degradation of HS, CS/DS, keratan sulfate and gangliosides and the mucopolysaccharidoses, GM2 gangliosidoses and sialidosis, unlike confusables on sialic acid metabolism, GAG biosynthesis or general lysosome terms.

qualifier: ribosome quality control and translation-coupled mRNA decay
name: Cytoplasmic translation cycle and ribosome-associated mRNA surveillance
rationale: Members span cap- and IRES-dependent initiation, elongation, termination, ribosome rescue/RQC and NMD/no-go/non-stop decay, distinct from nuclear RNA processing and hypusine/hydroxylation neighbours.

qualifier: ribosome-associated mRNA and nascent protein quality control
name: Cytosolic translation cycle and ribosome-associated quality control
rationale: Members span translation initiation, elongation and termination with ribosome rescue, RQC, NMD and no-go decay, distinguishing it from nuclear RNA processing and translation-factor modification confusables.

qualifier: ribosome-associated mRNA and nascent-chain quality control
name: Cytoplasmic translation and ribosome-associated mRNA quality control
rationale: Members span translation initiation, elongation and termination with NMD, no-go/non-stop decay and ribosome quality control; confusables are protein hydroxylation/hypusination or nuclear RNA transcription, splicing and processing.

name: NGF signaling with p75NTR and dependence-receptor cell death
rationale: All members belong to NGF/neurotrophin receptor signaling, and the theme is distinguished from TRK-activation confusables by its p75NTR death/survival branches (NRIF, NRAGE, NADE, ceramide, regulated proteolysis) and dependence-receptor caspase activation.

qualifier: p75NTR death and TRKA survival effectors
name: NGF signaling via p75NTR death and TRKA survival effectors
rationale: Members span p75NTR death signaling (NRAGE, NRIF, NADE, ceramide, dependence receptors) and NGF-TRKA downstream effectors (FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, CREB, PI3K), unlike confusables centred on TRKA activation, TRKB/TRKC or axon regeneration.

qualifier: p75NTR death signaling alongside TRKA survival
name: NGF signaling via p75NTR death and TRKA survival
rationale: Members span NGF processing and p75NTR/dependence-receptor death signaling plus TRKA downstream survival arms (ERK5, CREB, PI3K/AKT, ARMS, FRS2); the p75NTR and dependence-receptor members distinguish it from TRKA-, TRKB/C- and axon-growth confusables.

name: Erythroid and megakaryocyte lineage differentiation
rationale: Members concern red cell and platelet/megakaryocyte development (erythroid maturation, enucleation, oxygen transport, RUNX1 megakaryocyte programmes, TAL1-GFI1B module), distinguishing it from myeloid progenitor, granulocyte and monocyte confusables.

name: Erythroid and megakaryocytic lineage differentiation
rationale: Nearly all members concern red cell and platelet/megakaryocyte development (RUNX1, TAL1-GFI1B, enucleation, oxygen transport), whereas confusables cover myeloid/granulocytic progenitors and HSC maintenance.

name: Erythroid and megakaryocytic lineage differentiation
rationale: Members describe erythrocyte and megakaryocyte/platelet differentiation, RUNX1 regulation, oxygen transport and erythroid/megakaryocyte expression modules (one TAK1-ATF module is an outlier), distinguishing the theme from confusables centred on myeloid, granulocytic and stem cell programmes.

core: Essential metal ion transport and homeostasis
name: Zinc, copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members cover SLC39/SLC30 zinc transport, copper import and detoxification, ceruloplasmin and manganese transport, distinct from cadmium, iron-export and metallothionein confusables.

core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
name: Zinc, copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members concern membrane transport, compartmentalization and intracellular homeostasis of zinc, copper and manganese including SLC39A4 and ceruloplasmin defects, distinct from confusables on cadmium detoxification, metallothioneins and iron export.

name: Zinc, copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members cover SLC39/SLC30 zinc transport, copper import and detoxification, ceruloplasmin defect and manganese transport, separating it from cadmium detoxification and iron/ferroportin confusables.

name: Intermediate filament-anchoring desmosomes and hemidesmosomes
rationale: Members cover desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly, intermediate filament bundling, cardiomyocyte and epithelial adhesion and laminin/collagen anchoring, contrasting with adherens-junction polarity, integrin or cornification neighbours.

qualifier: desmosomes and hemidesmosomes linked to intermediate filaments
name: Desmosome and hemidesmosome intermediate-filament anchoring junctions

qualifier: desmosomes and hemidesmosomes in epithelium and heart
name: Desmosome and hemidesmosome adhesion in epithelium and heart

qualifier: myelin formation/maintenance, axon caliber and reactive gliosis
name: Glial myelination, axon caliber and reactive gliosis

qualifier: myelin formation and maintenance, axon caliber, reactive gliosis
name: Myelin formation and maintenance, axon caliber and reactive gliosis
rationale: Members share glia-axon support: CNS and PNS myelin formation and maintenance (oligodendrocyte progenitors, Schwann cell initiation), neurofilament-based axon diameter, and astrocyte migration/reactive gliosis, unlike confusables on axon regeneration, glial fate specification or nodal sodium-channel clustering.

qualifier: CNS and PNS myelination, axon caliber and reactive gliosis
name: Myelin formation and maintenance, axon caliber and reactive gliosis
rationale: Members concern Schwann cell and oligodendrocyte myelin formation/maintenance, axon diameter and neurofilaments, and astrocyte reactive gliosis/migration, unlike confusables on axon regeneration, nodal organization or glial fate specification.

qualifier: tubular network shaping and ER-organelle tethering
name: ER tubular network shaping and ER-organelle membrane tethering
rationale: Members concern ER tubule formation, membrane bending and fusion, ER positioning and ER tethering to plasma membrane, mitochondria (with Miro RHOT GTPases) and autophagosomes, unlike confusables on phosphoinositide synthesis and lipid transfer or microtubule organelle transport.

qualifier: tubule shaping and organelle membrane contacts
name: ER tubule shaping and organelle membrane contacts

qualifier: tubular network shaping and organelle contact tethering
name: ER tubular network shaping and organelle membrane contact tethering
rationale: Members cover ER tubule formation, membrane bending and fusion, ER-mitochondria/plasma membrane tethering and Miro GTPase cycles, unlike confusables on lipid transfer, phosphoinositide synthesis or kinesin-based organelle transport.

qualifier: biosynthesis, trimerization and lysyl oxidase crosslinking
name: Collagen biosynthesis, crosslinking and elastic fibre assembly

name: Collagen biosynthesis, crosslinking and elastic fiber assembly
rationale: Members span collagen trimerization, biosynthesis, oxidative crosslinking, fibril and basement membrane assembly plus elastic fibres, the biosynthetic and crosslinking steps being what laminin/integrin, aortic and fibronectin matrix confusables lack.

core: Collagen fibril and elastic fiber assembly
name: Collagen biosynthesis, crosslinking and elastic fiber assembly

name: Netrin-mediated axon guidance and chemorepulsion

name: Netrin-dependent axon guidance and axon extension control

name: Netrin-mediated axon guidance and chemorepulsion

core: striated muscle contraction control by calcium release
name: Ryanodine-receptor calcium release controlling striated muscle contraction

qualifier: ryanodine receptor control of striated muscle contraction
name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release regulating striated muscle contraction
rationale: Members concern release of sequestered calcium via ryanodine-sensitive channels and its control of cardiac and skeletal contraction, relaxation and rate, whereas confusables emphasize SERCA calcium reuptake, ATPase regulation and positive inotropy/chronotropy.

core: Calcium-dependent regulation of striated muscle contraction
name: Ryanodine receptor calcium release control of striated muscle contraction
rationale: Members regulate release of sequestered calcium via ryanodine-sensitive channels to control cardiac and skeletal contraction, relaxation and rate; neighbours concern SERCA/calcium import and positive inotropy rather than release-channel control.

name: TGF-beta/BMP control of osteoblast and mesenchymal progenitor expansion

name: Kainate/AMPA receptor and G-protein-gated channel synaptic signalling
rationale: Members are ionotropic kainate/AMPA receptor activation and G-protein beta-gamma control of K+ and Ca2+ channels shaping presynaptic potential, distinct from confusables on excitatory plasticity, presynaptic calcium/inhibitory synapses or nicotinic receptors.

rationale: Members combine ionotropic kainate/AMPA receptor activation with G-beta-gamma-mediated GIRK activation, Ca channel inhibition and extrasynaptic GABA tuning of presynaptic potential, distinct from confusables on inhibitory synapse assembly, vesicle exocytosis or nicotinic receptors.

name: Kainate receptor signalling and presynaptic Gbeta-gamma channel modulation

core: Type I interferon induction by dsRNA

core: Type I interferon induction by dsRNA sensing
name: dsRNA sensing driving TBK1/IKKε-IRF3 type I interferon induction
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5 and TLR3 responses to dsRNA and their regulation converging on TBK1/IKKe-mediated IRF3/IRF7 activation and type I IFN induction, unlike confusables on downstream ISG responses, RLR-NF-kB/viral evasion, or cGAS/STING and IFN-beta regulation.

core: Hormonal control of hepatic glycogen metabolism
name: Glucagon-PKA and glucokinase control of hepatic glycogen

core: Hormonal control of hepatic glycogen turnover
name: Glucagon-PKA and glucokinase regulation of glycogen turnover

name: Glucagon–PKA and glucokinase control of hepatic glycogen
rationale: Members are glucagon/PKA signalling, AMPK-ChREBP, glucokinase regulation and glycogen synthesis/breakdown control, versus gluconeogenesis, triglyceride and G6PC/glycogen-storage-disease neighbours.

name: Plasma membrane-endosome cycling and constitutive secretory traffic
rationale: Members cover endocytosis, endocytic/receptor recycling and endosome organization; constitutive secretion and Golgi-membrane protein localization distinguish it from retrograde, Rab/ARF and early-to-late endosome confusables.

qualifier: constitutive secretion and Golgi membrane localization

name: Endocytic receptor recycling and constitutive secretory traffic

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor-driven recruitment and degranulation
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil recruitment and degranulation

name: Endothelial shear stress mechanotransduction and eNOS trafficking

qualifier: vesicle clustering, presynaptic cytoskeleton and dendrite/receptor stability
name: Synapse structure and modulation of neurotransmitter release

name: Fas (CD95) death receptor apoptosis and its restraint

qualifier: negative regulation, including hepatocyte and activation-induced T cell death

name: Fas ligand-induced apoptosis and its negative regulation

core: Macrophage lipoprotein cholesterol uptake and storage
name: Pro-foam-cell macrophage lipoprotein cholesterol uptake and storage

name: Lipoprotein cholesterol uptake and macrophage foam cell formation

name: Transcriptional control of cadherin switching in EMT

name: Transcriptional cadherin switching in epithelial-mesenchymal transition

name: Transcriptional control of cadherin switching in EMT

name: Muscarinic acetylcholine signaling and cAMP suppression

name: Muscarinic acetylcholine receptor signaling and cAMP attenuation

qualifier: response to replication-blocking drugs and DNA-protein crosslinks
