rationale: Members cover forebrain progenitor and asymmetric neuroblast division, radial and tangential neuron migration, cortical layering and commissure/tract morphogenesis; confusables are reelin/dendrite, cerebellar or neural tube/spinal patterning themes.

qualifier: progenitor division, neuronal migration and cortical lamination
name: Forebrain progenitor division, neuronal migration and cortical lamination
rationale: Members cover neuroblast and radial glial division, radial/tangential neuron migration, cortical layering and forebrain commissures, while confusables emphasize dorsoventral patterning, spinal cord, reelin/dendrite or cerebellar layer formation.

qualifier: left-right patterning, fluid clearance and sperm
name: Motile cilia in left-right patterning, fluid clearance and sperm
rationale: Members concern motile cilium/axoneme assembly (dynein arms, central apparatus, multiciliogenesis) and its roles in left-right asymmetry, CSF and mucociliary flow and sperm motility, unlike confusables on intraflagellar transport and primary cilia.

core: Motile cilium and flagellum assembly and motility
qualifier: left-right patterning and ciliary fluid flow
name: Motile cilia and sperm flagella: assembly, beating, left-right patterning
rationale: Members cover axonemal dynein and central apparatus assembly, multiciliogenesis, sperm flagellar motility, nodal left-right asymmetry, CSF circulation and mucociliary clearance, whereas confusables centre on intraflagellar transport and primary (non-motile) cilia.

name: Motile cilia and sperm flagella, including left-right patterning
rationale: Members cover motile axoneme and multiciliogenesis, sperm flagellum, mucociliary and CSF flow and nodal-cilia left-right asymmetry, unlike confusables centred on primary cilium intraflagellar transport.

qualifier: sex steroid (estrogen, androgen, progesterone) and thyroid
name: Sex steroid and thyroid hormone nuclear receptor signaling
rationale: Members are estrogen, androgen, progesterone and thyroid hormone receptor signaling and response programmes, distinguishing it from retinoic acid, hepatic, estrous-cycle and RUNX2/bone confusables.

qualifier: sex steroid and thyroid hormone receptors
name: Nuclear sex steroid and thyroid hormone receptor transcription
rationale: Members are estrogen, androgen, progesterone and thyroid hormone receptor signaling and their transcriptional output, which distinguishes them from the RUNX2/bone, liver, retinoic acid and reproductive-cycle confusables.

core: Nuclear steroid and thyroid hormone receptor signaling
qualifier: estrogen, androgen, progesterone and thyroid receptors
name: Sex steroid and thyroid hormone nuclear receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover estrogen, androgen, progesterone and thyroid hormone nuclear receptor signalling and responses; the combined sex-steroid plus thyroid receptor scope separates it from RUNX2, liver, retinoic acid and estrous-cycle confusables.

name: Cytidine deaminase editing in antiviral restriction and antibody diversification
rationale: Members link APOBEC/AID cytidine deamination to HIV restriction and to somatic hypermutation, class switching, V(D)J and B cell development, unlike confusables on adenosine-to-inosine editing or HIV life cycle.

name: AID/APOBEC cytidine deamination in antibody diversification and antiviral defense
rationale: Members span C-to-U deamination/editing used in somatic hypermutation, class switching and B cell development and APOBEC3G antiviral restriction, unlike ADAR A-to-I editing and HIV life-cycle confusables.

name: Cytidine deamination in antibody diversification and antiviral restriction
rationale: Members combine AID/APOBEC C-to-U deamination, somatic hypermutation, class switching, V(D)J recombination and APOBEC3G antiviral restriction, unlike confusables on HIV replication steps or ADAR A-to-I editing.

name: rRNA gene transcription and its nucleolar chromatin regulation
rationale: Members cover RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription steps, 5S rRNA Pol III transcription and nucleolar chromatin regulators (NoRC, B-WICH, SIRT1), unlike confusables on tRNA/snRNA Pol III transcription, rRNA processing or translation initiation.

name: rRNA gene transcription and its nucleolar chromatin regulation
rationale: Members cover RNA polymerase I initiation/termination and 5S rRNA transcription with chromatin regulators (NoRC, B-WICH, SIRT1, CSB/G9a), unlike confusables on Pol III tRNA/snRNA transcription, rRNA processing or translation initiation.

name: RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription and nucleolar chromatin control
rationale: Members cover Pol I initiation, promoter escape and termination plus chromatin regulators of rDNA (NoRC, B-WICH, CSB/G9a, SIRT1) and 5S rRNA Pol III transcription, distinct from confusables on Pol III/snRNA transcription, rRNA processing or translation initiation.

name: ARF/INK4A-p53-p21 G1 arrest and its cancer-associated defects
rationale: Members are TP53 expression/activity and p21-mediated G1 arrest plus p14ARF and p16INK4A loss-of-function variants that evade senescence, distinguishing it from generic senescence/SASP, p53 apoptosis and RB/CDK4/6 G1-S confusables.

qualifier: p21-mediated G1 arrest and p14ARF/p16INK4A loss in cancer
name: TP53–p21 G1 arrest and p14ARF/p16INK4A loss in cancer
rationale: Members describe TP53 regulation and p21-driven G1 arrest plus cancer defects in p14ARF, p16INK4A and TP53 that evade senescence, unlike neighbours on senescence induction/SASP, RB1-E2F or p53-driven apoptosis.

name: p53-p21 G1 arrest and CDKN2A defects evading senescence
rationale: Members are TP53 regulation and p21-driven G1 arrest plus p16INK4A/p14ARF loss-of-function evasion of oncogene- and oxidative-stress-induced senescence, which senescence-program and RB/CDK confusables lack.

name: NLRP inflammasome and interleukin-1 alpha/beta production control
rationale: NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasomes, IL-1 precursor processing and up/down regulation of IL-1 alpha/beta production distinguish it from neighbours focused on AIM2/caspase-4/5 pyroptosis and IL-18.

name: NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome regulation of interleukin-1 production
rationale: Members share NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome activity and IL-1 alpha/beta processing and regulation, whereas confusables center on pyroptosis, AIM2/CASP4/5 inflammasomes, IL-18 or chemokine production.

name: NLRP inflammasome control of interleukin-1 production
rationale: Members cover NLRP3 and NLRP1 inflammasomes, IL-1 precursor processing and IL-1 alpha/beta production and signaling, distinguishing it from neighbours built on pyroptosis, IL-18, AIM2/caspase-4/5 or chemokine production.

qualifier: SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K adaptor events
name: ERBB receptor SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K adaptor signaling
rationale: Members are EGFR/ERBB2/ERBB3/ERBB4 signaling via SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K adaptors, unlike confusables covering PLCG1/GRB7/PTK6 events, ERBB4 nuclear signaling or MET signaling.

qualifier: through SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K adaptors
name: ERBB receptor signalling through SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K adaptors
rationale: Members are adaptor-recruitment events (SHC1, GRB2, PI3K) downstream of EGFR, ERBB2, ERBB3 and ERBB4, unlike confusables about MET, EGFR transactivation, ERBB2 motility/PLCG1 or ERBB4 nuclear signalling.

qualifier: SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K adaptor events
name: ERBB receptor SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K adaptor signalling
rationale: Members are SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K docking events downstream of EGFR, ERBB2, ERBB3 and ERBB4 dimers, distinguishing it from confusables on ERBB4 nuclear signalling/downregulation, PLCG1/GRB7/PTK6 branches or MET signalling.

name: Sex steroid biosynthesis and androgen metabolism
rationale: Members cover pregnenolone, progesterone, androgen and estrogen synthesis, aromatase deficiency and androgen catabolism, while confusables are glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid synthesis and their enzyme defects.

qualifier: pregnenolone to progesterone, androgens and estrogens (aromatase)
name: Sex steroid biosynthesis from pregnenolone to estrogens
rationale: Members cover synthesis of pregnenolone, progesterone, androgens and estrogens including aromatase deficiency and androgen catabolism, distinct from confusables on gluco/mineralocorticoid biosynthesis and adrenal CYP enzyme defects.

name: Progestin, androgen and estrogen biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover pregnenolone and progesterone synthesis, androgen and estrogen synthesis, aromatase deficiency and the adrenodoxin electron supply, separating it from glucocorticoid/mineralocorticoid biosynthesis confusables.

qualifier: mesenchymal proliferation, survival and progenitor maintenance
name: Kidney development control via mesenchymal proliferation and survival
rationale: Members regulate kidney growth through cell proliferation, apoptosis and nephron progenitor maintenance, unlike confusables about nephron/duct morphogenesis and mesenchymal-to-epithelial differentiation.

qualifier: proliferation, apoptosis, stem-cell maintenance and organ size
name: Kidney development control of proliferation, survival and size
rationale: Members regulate kidney and metanephros development through cell proliferation, mesenchymal survival, progenitor maintenance and kidney size, while confusables cover nephron and ureteric duct morphogenesis and differentiation.

qualifier: nephron progenitor proliferation, survival and maintenance
name: Kidney growth control via nephron progenitor proliferation and survival
rationale: Members regulate kidney/metanephros size through mesenchymal progenitor proliferation, apoptosis and stem-cell maintenance, whereas confusables concern duct, tubule and nephron differentiation and morphogenesis.

name: Phosphatidic acid, acylglycerol synthesis and lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members cover synthesis of phosphatidic acid, mono-, di- and triacylglycerols and DAG/TAG remodeling plus LPC/LPE hydrolysis, unlike confusables on glycerol metabolism, phospholipid class synthesis, triglyceride lipolysis or PC regulation.

qualifier: phosphatidic acid to MAG/DAG/TAG plus lysophospholipid hydrolysis
name: Phosphatidic acid to DAG/TAG synthesis and lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members cover phosphatidic acid synthesis and its conversion to mono-, di- and triacylglycerols together with LPC/LPE hydrolysis, distinguishing it from glycerol metabolism, phosphatidylcholine synthesis, phospholipid acyl-chain remodeling and triglyceride catabolism confusables.

name: Acylglycerol and phosphatidic acid synthesis with lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members synthesize PA, MAG, DAG and TAG and hydrolyse lysophospholipids, which separates it from glycerol/fructose, phospholipid synthesis-remodeling and triglyceride lipolysis confusables.

name: TNFR1 signalling and canonical NF-kB transcription factor regulation
rationale: Members cover TNFR1 NF-kB and proapoptotic signalling, linear polyubiquitination and NF-kB activity regulation, versus confusables on non-canonical NF-kB and TLR/RIP1 IKK recruitment.

name: TNFR1 and linear ubiquitin-driven canonical NF-kappaB activation
rationale: Members cover TNFR1 signalling, linear polyubiquitination and NF-kappaB transcription factor activity, distinguished from confusables on TLR/RIP1 IKK recruitment, negative regulation or non-canonical NF-kappaB.

qualifier: TNFR1-driven, with transcription factor activity regulation
name: TNFR1 signaling and canonical NF-kappaB transcription factor activity
rationale: Members are TNFR1 NF-kappaB/proapoptotic signaling, linear ubiquitination and positive/negative NF-kappaB transcription factor activity, unlike TLR-, necroptosis- or non-canonical NF-kappaB confusables.

name: Inositol polyphosphate and pyrophosphate synthesis with inositol transport
rationale: Members cover inositol phosphate/pyrophosphate synthesis across compartments, nudix-type diadenosine polyphosphate hydrolysis and inositol transporters, whereas confusables add PIP/PTEN signalling or nucleotide interconversion instead of ER-lumen IP synthesis and inositol transport.

core: Soluble inositol polyphosphate and pyrophosphate metabolism
name: Soluble inositol polyphosphate and pyrophosphate metabolism, inositol transport
rationale: All members concern synthesis, turnover or uptake of soluble inositol phosphates/pyrophosphates (with NUDT-type diadenosine polyphosphate hydrolysis), and the inositol transport and ER-lumen IP synthesis set it apart from the nucleotide-interconversion and PIP/PTEN neighbours.

name: Inositol phosphate and pyrophosphate metabolism with inositol transport
rationale: Members cover synthesis and turnover of inositol phosphates, diphosphoinositol and diadenosine polyphosphates; inositol transport and ER-lumen IP synthesis set it apart from PIP/PTEN and nucleotide interconversion neighbours.

qualifier: degron-rule and ubiquitin-independent routes and their restraint
name: Degron-rule and ubiquitin-independent proteasomal degradation and its restraint
rationale: Members cover N-end and C-degron rule and ubiquitin-independent proteasomal degradation plus its negative regulation (incl. UCH deubiquitinases), unlike confusables on protein destabilisation, ribosome QC or stress granules.

qualifier: degron rules, ubiquitin-independent route and negative regulation
name: Proteasomal degradation via degron rules and its negative regulation
rationale: Members are N-end and C-end degron pathways, ubiquitin-independent proteasomal degradation, UCH deubiquitinases and negative regulation of proteolysis, unlike confusables on ribosome quality control, protein destabilization or stress granules.

qualifier: degron rules, ubiquitin-independent route and its negative regulation
name: Degron-rule and ubiquitin-independent proteasomal degradation and its restraint
rationale: Members concern N-end/C-end degron and ubiquitin-independent proteasomal degradation plus deubiquitinating and negative regulation of proteolysis, which confusables (stress granules, ribosome quality control, positive regulation) lack.

name: Kidney nephron, ureteric bud and glomerulus development
rationale: Nearly all members concern nephric duct, ureteric bud, nephron tubule and glomerular development and function, distinguishing the theme from lung, mammary, prostate and salivary branching morphogenesis confusables.

name: Kidney development: ureteric bud, nephron and glomerulus
rationale: Members describe intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct, ureteric bud, metanephric mesenchyme, nephron segment and glomerular development, distinguishing them from the lung, mammary, prostate and gland branching-organ confusables.

name: Nephron, ureteric bud and glomerular kidney development
rationale: Nearly all members concern renal organogenesis from intermediate mesoderm through nephric duct, ureteric bud, nephron tubules and glomerulus, whereas confusables are lung, prostate, mammary and other branching glands.

name: ER-Golgi-endosome vesicle trafficking and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation
rationale: Members cover COPII/COPI transport, Golgi organisation, TGN-endosome-lysosome routing, recycling and Rab/ARF GTPase control, distinct from neighbours on ER protein insertion, folding and ERAD.

qualifier: Golgi organization and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation
name: Golgi organization and Rab/ARF-regulated vesicle traffic
rationale: Members cover COPII/COPI transport, intra-Golgi and Golgi-endosome-lysosome traffic, Golgi assembly/disassembly and Rab/ARF regulation, distinguishing it from ER translocation, folding and ERAD confusables.

qualifier: COPI/COPII, Rab and ARF GTPase regulation and Golgi organization
name: Golgi vesicle trafficking and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation
rationale: Members cover ER-Golgi, intra-Golgi, Golgi-endosome-lysosome transport, Golgi assembly and Rab/ARF regulators, while confusables centre on ER protein targeting, insertion, folding and ERAD.

core: assembly, cargo delivery and beating of cilia and flagella
qualifier: motile and non-motile axoneme building with intraflagellar and BBSome transport, not cilium disassembly or left-right axis determination
name: Ciliary and flagellar assembly, cargo transport and motility
rationale: Every member builds a cilium or sperm flagellum, delivers cargo into it, or governs its beating and the fluid flow that results; the confusables add cilium disassembly and centriole-centrosome duplication, organ-level left/right asymmetry determination, or tubulin modification and sperm mitochondrial sheath assembly.

core: cilium and flagellum axoneme assembly, trafficking and beating
qualifier: intraflagellar transport, dynein arms and motile cilia function
name: Ciliary and flagellar axoneme assembly, trafficking and beating
rationale: Every member concerns building a cilium or sperm flagellum, delivering cargo along it, or driving its motility and the fluid flow that results, unlike confusables on left/right body axis determination, tubulin modification or cilium disassembly and centriole duplication.

qualifier: intraciliary transport, axonemal dynein assembly and ciliary motility
name: Cilium assembly, intraciliary transport and ciliary motility
rationale: Members span basal body docking, IFT and ciliary cargo targeting, axoneme/dynein arm assembly and motile cilia/sperm flagellum function (CSF flow, mucociliary clearance), unlike confusables on centriole duplication/cilium disassembly, left-right patterning or tubulin modification.

name: NK and cytotoxic T cell activation and immune tolerance
rationale: Members span NK and T cell cytotoxicity, NK receptor signatures, T cell activation and tolerance/anergy with dendritic cell regulation, whereas confusables focus on regulatory T cell differentiation and T cell suppression.

core: Cytotoxic lymphocyte regulation and peripheral tolerance
name: NK and T cell cytotoxicity, costimulation and tolerance
rationale: Members span NK cell signatures and KIR/receptor activation, granzyme killing, regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity, costimulation, anergy and tolerance, and DC differentiation; the NK cytotoxic arm is absent from the Treg/Th-centred confusables.

qualifier: NK cell and CD8 T cell
name: NK and T cell cytotoxic activation and tolerance
rationale: Members span NK cell signatures and cytotoxicity, CD8 T cell proliferation, MHC class I/Ib presentation, costimulation and peripheral tolerance, distinguishing the theme from confusables focused on Treg and T helper suppression.

qualifier: deoxypurine turnover, NUDT nucleotide sanitization and thiopurine metabolism
name: Purine (deoxy)nucleotide catabolism, sanitization and thiopurine metabolism
rationale: Members cover catabolism of purine (deoxy)nucleosides and nucleotides (ADA, PNP defects), NUDT hydrolysis protecting DNA and azathioprine/TPMT metabolism, unlike purine synthesis/salvage or pyrimidine catabolism neighbours.

qualifier: deoxynucleotide breakdown, nucleotide pool sanitization and thiopurine metabolism
name: Purine (deoxy)nucleotide catabolism, sanitization and thiopurine metabolism
rationale: Members cover purine (deoxy)nucleoside/nucleotide breakdown via ADA, PNP and NUDT hydrolases to allantoin plus TPMT/azathioprine handling, unlike de novo/salvage purine synthesis and pyrimidine catabolism confusables.

qualifier: NUDT pool sanitization and thiopurine metabolism
name: Purine (deoxy)nucleotide catabolism, NUDT sanitization and thiopurines
rationale: Members cover breakdown of purine nucleotides/nucleosides (AMP, IMP, adenosine, inosine, allantoin, ADA/PNP), NUDT hydrolysis of (d)NTPs and azathioprine/TPMT; confusables are de novo purine synthesis/salvage or pyrimidine catabolism.

name: RAS-RAF-ERK activation and phosphatase negative feedback
rationale: Members span SOS/MRAS-SHOC2-driven RAF activation and ERK inactivation by dephosphorylation and feedback, while confusables centre on RAS GAP regulation and BRAF/RAF1 oncogenic mutants.

name: RAS-RAF-ERK activation and phosphatase-mediated feedback inactivation
rationale: Members span RAS/MRAS-SHOC2 driven RAF activation and ERK/RSK signaling together with ERK dephosphorylation and negative feedback, which distinguishes it from RAS GAP, BRAF mutant and IGF1R/SHC confusables.

name: RAS–MAPK activation and phosphatase-mediated ERK feedback inactivation
rationale: Members span RAS/MRAS–SHOC2 and SOS-driven RAF activation and its termination by negative feedback and dual-specificity dephosphorylation of ERK, which RAS-GAP and BRAF-mutant neighbours lack.

name: Estrogen receptor-centred steroid hormone transcriptional response
rationale: Members are mainly estrogen receptor signaling and target genes plus progesterone/androgen responses and HSP90 receptor chaperoning, distinguishing it from androgen receptor-focused confusables.

name: Genomic estrogen and steroid hormone receptor signalling
rationale: Members centre on estrogen receptor-driven gene expression and estrogen responses with HSP90 receptor cycling, progesterone and androgen responses, unlike androgen/prostate-specific confusables or GPER1/estrous-cycle confusables.

name: Estrogen-centred steroid hormone receptor transcriptional response
rationale: Members are dominated by estrogen receptor signalling and gene expression with HSP90 receptor cycling, progesterone and androgen response sets, unlike neighbours on androgen receptor/prostate programmes or GPER1 and estrous cycle.

name: Microglia differentiation, activation and glial proliferation control
rationale: Members concern microglial/glial differentiation, activation, proliferation, migration and survival, without the amyloid-beta and apoptotic-cell clearance content of the confusables.

qualifier: microglial differentiation, survival and lysosome organization
name: Microglial and glial activation, proliferation and survival
rationale: Members regulate microglial differentiation, proliferation, migration, activation and cytotoxicity plus astrocyte activation and glial apoptosis, without the amyloid-beta and apoptotic-cell clearance content of the confusables.

name: Microglial and glial activation, proliferation and survival
rationale: Members regulate microglia and astrocyte activation, proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis, distinguishing it from amyloid-beta and apoptotic-cell clearance confusables.

name: DNA replication stress and topoisomerase lesion repair
rationale: Members concern replication fork stress (hydroxyurea, fork reversal, R-loops, replication initiation) and topoisomerase-related DNA topology and protein-DNA crosslink repair, unlike telomere and checkpoint confusables.

name: Replication fork stress and DNA topological processing
rationale: Members include replication initiation, fork reversal, R-loop and DNA-protein crosslink repair, DNA topological change and responses to hydroxyurea/camptothecin, versus telomere, checkpoint or transcription-termination confusables.

name: Replication stress and DNA topological processing
rationale: Members concern replication initiation, fork reversal, R-loops and responses to hydroxyurea and camptothecin with DNA topological change, unlike the telomere, checkpoint and transcription-termination confusables.

qualifier: dolichol, mannose-phosphate and Golgi processing defects
name: N-glycosylation disorders of dolichol, mannose supply and Golgi processing
rationale: All members are CDGs of the N-glycan pathway caused by defects in dolichol synthesis (DOLK, SRD5A3), mannose-phosphate supply (MPI, PMM2), LLO flipping/utilisation (RFT1, MPDU1) or Golgi trimming (MGAT2, B4GALT1), unlike confusables of DPM/GDP-mannose, ALG glycosyltransferase or GPI-anchor defects.

name: Congenital N-glycosylation disorders of precursor supply and Golgi processing
rationale: All members are CDGs, here from defects in mannose/dolichol precursor supply and utilisation (MPI, PMM2, DOLK, SRD5A3, MPDU1, RFT1) and Golgi glycan processing (MGAT2, B4GALT1), unlike neighbours centred on ALG glycosyltransferases, DPM synthesis or GPI anchoring.

qualifier: precursor supply, dolichol and Golgi enzyme defects
name: Congenital N-glycosylation disorders of precursor, dolichol and Golgi enzymes
rationale: All members are CDGs from defects in mannose-precursor (PMM2, MPI, MPDU1), dolichol (DOLK, SRD5A3), flippase (RFT1) or Golgi processing (MGAT2, B4GALT1) enzymes, unlike confusables dominated by DPM/GDP-mannose or ALG-glycosyltransferase defects.

name: FGF23-Klotho phosphate regulation of bone and dentin mineralization
rationale: Members link FGFR1c-Klotho/PTH signaling and phosphate response to positive bone mineralization, dentinogenesis and tooth eruption (with secretory protein phosphorylation), distinct from confusables on sodium-phosphate transporters, enamel and negative mineralization control.

name: FGF23-Klotho and PTH phosphate regulation of bone and dentin mineralization
rationale: Members link FGF23-Klotho, PTH and phosphate responses with bone mineralization, dentinogenesis and tooth eruption, unlike confusables on Na+/Pi transporters, enamel or ectopic calcification.

name: FGF23-Klotho phosphate signaling and dentin-bone mineralization
rationale: Members link FGFR1c-Klotho, PTH and phosphate responses with bone mineralization, dentinogenesis, tooth eruption and secreted protein phosphorylation, which phosphate transporter and mineralization-inhibition confusables lack.

core: Regulation of drug and cellular stress responses
name: Regulation of drug and cellular stress responses including apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate responses to drugs, antibiotics, oxidative, osmotic and hypoxic stress, and unlike the ethanol/anesthetic and respiration confusables they include stress-linked apoptosis and mitochondrial depolarization.

name: Cellular stress response and mitochondrial apoptosis regulation
rationale: Members regulate cellular responses to drug, antibiotic, hypoxic, oxidative and osmotic stress; mitochondrial depolarization and apoptosis set it apart from respiration/ATP and ethanol/anesthetic neighbours.

name: Stress response regulation with mitochondrial depolarization and apoptosis
rationale: Members modulate cellular responses to drugs, antibiotics, oxidative, hypoxic and osmotic stress together with apoptosis and mitochondrial depolarization, whereas confusables centre on respiration/ATP synthesis or ethanol/anesthetic responses.

qualifier: efflux and limitation of storage and foam cell formation
name: Cellular cholesterol efflux and foam cell prevention
rationale: Members promote cholesterol efflux and lipoprotein transport, limit cholesterol storage and foam cell differentiation (including LXR targets), unlike confusables on LDL receptor uptake, SREBP-driven synthesis or HDL particle assembly.

name: Cholesterol efflux and lipoprotein transport restraining foam cell formation
rationale: Members promote cholesterol efflux and lipoprotein transport while limiting storage and macrophage foam cell formation, unlike confusables on LDL receptor uptake, HDL assembly or SREBP-driven biosynthesis.

name: LXR-driven cholesterol efflux limiting macrophage foam cell formation
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol import/efflux, lipoprotein transport and storage under LXR control and inhibit foam cell formation, distinguishing them from HDL assembly, LDL receptor uptake and SREBP biosynthesis confusables.

qualifier: renal proximal tubule anion and cation carriers
name: Renal proximal tubule organic anion and cation transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated organic anion, cation and di/tricarboxylate transport tied to proximal tubule development, distinguishing them from xenobiotic export and mitochondrial carboxylate shuttle confusables.

name: Proximal tubule organic cation, anion and dicarboxylate transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated organic cation, organic anion and sodium-coupled di/tricarboxylate (pyruvate, alpha-ketoglutarate) transport tied to proximal tubule development; organic cation transport distinguishes it from succinate/citrate and xenobiotic export confusables.

qualifier: proximal tubule organic cation and dicarboxylate
name: Proximal tubule organic cation and dicarboxylate transport
rationale: Members are organic anion/cation and sodium-coupled di-/tricarboxylate, pyruvate and alpha-ketoglutarate transport with proximal tubule development, unlike the xenobiotic, malate-aspartate and succinate-only neighbours.

name: Base excision repair gap filling and mitochondrial DNA repair
rationale: Members concern AP-site resolution and short/long-patch BER synthesis plus mitochondrial DNA repair, which distinguishes the theme from broad DNA repair and editing confusables.

qualifier: AP-site gap-filling steps and mitochondrial DNA repair
name: Base excision repair gap filling and mitochondrial DNA repair
rationale: Members are AP-site processing and short/long-patch BER gap filling plus mitochondrial DNA repair and metabolism, distinguishing it from broad double-strand-break, glycosylase, mismatch and chromatin confusables.

name: Base excision repair gap-filling and mitochondrial DNA maintenance
rationale: Members are short- and long-patch BER gap-filling steps plus mitochondrial DNA repair/metabolism, a narrow subset distinct from broad DNA repair, editing or chromatin confusables.

name: Natriuretic peptide cGMP signaling and renal sodium excretion
rationale: Members are cyclic nucleotide (cGMP/cAMP) responses, receptor guanylyl cyclase signaling and natriuretic factors promoting natriuresis and urine output, whereas neighbours center on renin-angiotensin and vascular pressure control.

name: Guanylyl cyclase cGMP signaling in natriuresis and diuresis
rationale: Members combine cGMP synthesis, receptor guanylyl cyclase regulation and cyclic nucleotide responses with renal sodium excretion and urine volume, unlike renin-angiotensin and vascular-tone confusables.

name: Cyclic nucleotide signaling promoting natriuresis and diuresis
rationale: Members are cGMP synthesis and receptor guanylyl cyclase signalling, cellular responses to cAMP and cGMP, and renal sodium excretion and urine volume; confusables are renin-angiotensin or vascular blood-pressure themes lacking the cyclic-nucleotide responses.

name: Peroxide and hypoxic stress responses promoting ferroptosis
rationale: Members are responses to hydroperoxides, H2O2, ischemia and H2S plus ferroptosis promotion, distinguished from confusables on nitrosative stress, apoptosis regulation and respiration.

name: Peroxide and ischemic stress responses with ferroptosis
rationale: Members concern responses to hydrogen peroxide, hydroperoxides, ischemia and oxygen/sulfide with iron-dependent ferroptosis, distinguishing them from confusables about nitrosative stress, apoptosis regulation and respiration.

name: Cellular response to peroxides, ischemia and ferroptosis
rationale: Members are responses to hydrogen peroxide/hydroperoxide, ischemia, H2S and iron-dependent ferroptosis, unlike confusables about nitrosative stress, apoptosis regulation or respiration.

qualifier: post-ER: COPI, endosome-Golgi and lysosomal routes
name: Golgi organization and post-ER Golgi-endosome-lysosome vesicle traffic
rationale: Members cover Golgi assembly, COPI retrograde and intra-Golgi transport, endosome-Golgi exchange, lysosome targeting, recycling and ARF/RAB GAP regulation; confusables cover ER translocation and COPII export or RAB prenylation and GEFs.

qualifier: COPI, endosome-Golgi retrograde and lysosomal sorting
name: Golgi organization and COPI, endosome-Golgi and lysosomal traffic
rationale: Members span Golgi structure, COPI budding, Golgi-ER and endosome-Golgi retrograde transport, lysosomal targeting and Rab/ARF regulation, while confusables carry COPII ER export, ER protein targeting and Rab prenylation.

name: Golgi organization and COPI, endosomal and lysosomal vesicle traffic
rationale: Members span Golgi assembly, COPI retrograde/intra-Golgi transport, TGN sorting to lysosomes and endosome-Golgi recycling, whereas confusables cover ER entry, COPII export or Rab prenylation and GEF activity.

name: Specialized pro-resolving mediator biosynthesis and eicosanoid catabolism
rationale: Members synthesise resolvins, protectins, maresins and lipoxins and catabolise leukotriene B4 and other eicosanoids, unlike leukotriene synthesis/receptor and hepoxilin confusables.

name: Pro-resolving lipid mediator synthesis and eicosanoid catabolism
rationale: Members synthesise lipoxins, resolvins, protectins and maresins and inactivate leukotrienes by omega-oxidation; confusables concern leukotriene synthesis/receptors, 12-HETE/hepoxilins or PAF.

qualifier: omega-3 pro-resolving mediators and eicosanoid inactivation
name: Omega-3 pro-resolving mediator synthesis and eicosanoid inactivation
rationale: Members are biosynthesis of resolvins, protectins, maresins and lipoxins with HETE production and leukotriene/eicosanoid catabolism, whereas confusables cover leukotriene synthesis and receptors, hepoxilins or PAF metabolism.

qualifier: sarcomere assembly, dystrophin complex and neuromuscular junction
name: Skeletal muscle differentiation, sarcomere contraction and neuromuscular junction
rationale: Members cover myogenesis, myofilament assembly and contraction, the dystrophin-glycoprotein complex and NMJ assembly, distinct from cardiac junction, calcineurin and SRF-target confusables.

name: Skeletal muscle myogenesis, sarcomere and neuromuscular junction organisation
rationale: Members cover myogenesis, thin/thick filament assembly, contraction, DGC and NMJ assembly, unlike confusables on SRF targets, cardiac T-tubules/junctions or calcineurin-driven adaptation.

name: Skeletal muscle fiber formation, contraction and neuromuscular junction assembly
rationale: Members span myogenesis, sarcomere/thin-filament assembly, contraction, dystrophin-glycoprotein complex and NMJ assembly, distinguishing it from cardiac junction, calcineurin/atrophy and SRF-target neighbours.

qualifier: hair follicle, tooth, gland and pigment cell development
name: Ectodermal appendage development: hair, teeth, glands, melanocytes
rationale: Members cover hair follicle, tooth, sebaceous/mammary gland, nail, taste papilla and melanocyte development from ectoderm, distinguishing them from keratinocyte cornification and skin-barrier confusables.

qualifier: placode-derived hair, tooth and gland plus melanocytes
name: Ectodermal placode, hair follicle, tooth and melanocyte development
rationale: Members span ectodermal placode and appendage formation (hair follicle, tooth, nail, sebaceous and mammary gland, taste papilla, inner ear, cranial ganglion), melanocyte development and EDA-family TNF signalling, unlike confusables focused on keratinocyte cornification and skin barrier.

name: Ectodermal appendage development including hair, teeth and melanocytes
rationale: Members are ectoderm/placode-derived organogenesis (hair follicle, tooth, nail, sebaceous and mammary gland, taste papilla, melanocytes), distinguishing it from keratinocyte cornification and barrier confusables.

core: Systemic blood pressure and volume regulation
name: Renin-angiotensin and renal regulation of blood pressure and volume
rationale: Members concern angiotensin, renal sodium/urine/glomerular control, vasopressin and peptide catabolism in blood pressure homeostasis, distinguishing them from nitric oxide/smooth-muscle and renal water-reabsorption confusables.

name: Renin-angiotensin and renal control of blood pressure
rationale: Members regulate systemic blood pressure and volume through angiotensin production and signaling, glomerular filtration, renal sodium and urine output and peptide catabolism, unlike confusables centred on NO-cGMP smooth-muscle tone or vasopressin water reabsorption.

name: Renin-angiotensin and renal control of systemic blood pressure
rationale: Members concern systemic arterial pressure and blood volume via angiotensin generation and signaling, renal sodium/urine/glomerular control, natriuretic cGMP and kinin catabolism, distinct from nitric oxide/smooth muscle and vasopressin-aquaporin water confusables.

core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
name: Copper, manganese and transferrin/heme iron transport
rationale: Members cover copper and manganese transport/homeostasis together with transferrin, heme and ferroportin iron handling, distinguishing them from iron-only confusables and cadmium-detoxification confusables.

name: Iron, heme, copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members are transport and homeostasis of transition metals (transferrin/heme/ferroportin iron handling, copper, manganese, cobalt); the cadmium-detox neighbours lack heme/iron handling and the iron-import neighbours lack copper and manganese.

name: Iron, heme, copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members span transferrin/ferroportin/DMT1 iron handling, heme scavenging and copper, manganese and cobalt transport; copper/manganese separate it from iron-only confusables and heme/transferrin from cadmium-centred ones.

qualifier: C-type lectin receptors and IL-17/Th17 axis
name: Antifungal C-type lectin receptor and IL-17 immunity
rationale: Members combine fungal sensing by Dectin-1/Dectin-2/DC-SIGN with IL-17/IL-23/Th17 and IL-36/IL-38 epithelial cytokine signaling, distinguishing it from confusables centred on IL-12/IL-23 receptor signaling or IL-10/IL-27 regulatory cytokines.

core: Antifungal innate immunity and IL-17 axis
name: C-type lectin antifungal sensing and IL-17/IL-36 inflammatory axis
rationale: Members combine Dectin-1/Dectin-2/DC-SIGN fungal sensing with Th17/IL-23/IL-17 induction and IL-36/IL-38 signaling, whereas confusables center on IL-10, IL-12, IL-23 and IL-27 receptor signaling or other cytokine production.

qualifier: C-type lectin sensing driving IL-17/Th17 responses
name: Antifungal C-type lectin sensing driving IL-17/Th17 immunity
rationale: Members combine Dectin-1/Dectin-2/DC-SIGN fungal recognition with IL-23, IL-17, Th17 commitment and IL-36/IL-38 mucosal cytokines, whereas confusables centre on IL-10/IL-12/IL-27 regulatory cytokines.

qualifier: Nodal antagonism and extracellular ligand sequestration
name: Left-right patterning by Nodal antagonism and extracellular ligand sequestration
rationale: Members cover organ left/right asymmetry, nodal cilia movement, negative regulation of Nodal and extracellular sequestration of ligands such as BMP, distinguishing the theme from somitogenesis, motile cilium assembly, gastrulation and planar polarity confusables.

name: Left/right asymmetry determination via extracellular Nodal/BMP antagonism
rationale: Members concern left/right axis specification in organs and lateral mesoderm with Nodal regulation and extracellular ligand sequestration, distinct from planar polarity, somitogenesis, gastrulation and motile cilium assembly confusables.

qualifier: NODAL regulation and extracellular ligand sequestration
name: Left-right asymmetry establishment by NODAL and extracellular ligand sequestration
rationale: Members are left/right axis and organ asymmetry plus NODAL inhibition and extracellular BMP/ligand sequestration, distinct from confusables on gastrulation, planar cell polarity, motile cilium assembly or somitogenesis.

name: Lipid droplet biogenesis, lipophagy and triglyceride storage
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation, fusion and breakdown, lipophagy and triglyceride storage; neighbours instead emphasize glycerolipid synthesis enzymology, fatty acid oxidation, LXR control or adipogenesis.

qualifier: lipid droplet formation, fusion and lipophagy
name: Lipid droplet dynamics and triglyceride storage
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet biogenesis, fusion, disassembly and lipophagy with triglyceride storage homeostasis, distinguished from LXR-transcription, glycerolipid synthesis and fatty acid oxidation neighbours.

name: Lipid droplet dynamics and triglyceride storage
rationale: Members concern formation, fusion, disassembly and lipophagy of lipid droplets and the regulation of stored triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis in fat cells; neighbours instead hold fatty acid oxidation, TAG/PA synthesis enzymes or LXR transcription.

core: Lipid modification and secretion of morphogens
name: Palmitoylation and secretion of Wnt and Hedgehog morphogens
rationale: Members are N-terminal and cysteine palmitoylation by HHAT/PORCN and the resulting release of Hedgehog and Wnt ligands, unlike confusables on downstream Hh/Wnt signalling, Hh autoprocessing or prenylation.

name: Palmitoylation and secretion of Wnt and Hedgehog morphogens
rationale: Members cover cysteine palmitoylation by PORCN and HHAT and the release of Wnt and Hedgehog ligands, unlike confusables about prenylation, Hedgehog autoprocessing or downstream Hedgehog signaling.

name: Palmitoylation and secretion of Wnt and Hedgehog ligands
rationale: Members share cysteine palmitoylation/lipidation enabling Wnt and Hedgehog ligand secretion (PORCN, HHAT), distinct from confusables on prenylation, Hh autoprocessing or downstream signaling.

name: Myeloid inflammatory activation via neutrophil degranulation and complement receptors
rationale: Members are neutrophil/monocyte inflammatory activation modules with degranulation and complement receptor signalling, unlike neighbours on formyl peptide chemotaxis, SIRP inhibition or generic myeloid identity.

name: Myeloid inflammatory activation with neutrophil degranulation and complement receptors
rationale: Members cover inflammatory TLR signaling, monocyte/neutrophil modules, complement receptor signaling and neutrophil degranulation, unlike the formyl-peptide chemotaxis and SIRP-phagocytosis confusables.

name: Neutrophil degranulation and complement receptor signalling in myeloid inflammation
rationale: Members describe myeloid/neutrophil inflammatory activation, degranulation and complement receptor signalling, distinguishing it from formyl peptide chemotaxis and myeloid identity confusables.

qualifier: neuronal apoptosis and FOXO-driven death transcription
name: Stress-induced neuronal apoptosis and FOXO death transcription
rationale: Members share regulation of apoptosis under cellular stress (neuronal death, ligand-absent extrinsic signaling, FOXO cell-death genes, mitochondrial UPR, CDK5 neurodegeneration), unlike confusables on p75NTR dependence receptors, AKT-FOXO metabolic genes or HSF1 heat shock.

name: FOXO-driven and ligand-withdrawal neuronal apoptosis signaling
rationale: Members centre on pro-death FOXO transcription, ligand-absence extrinsic apoptosis, neuron apoptosis and CDK5 neurodegeneration, unlike confusables on AKT/acetylation control of FOXO, heat shock, or specific dependence receptors.

qualifier: ligand-withdrawal signaling and FOXO death transcription
name: Neuronal stress and ligand-withdrawal apoptosis with FOXO death transcription
rationale: Members regulate neuron death decisions (oxidative stress, ligand-absence signaling, CDK5, UPRmt, PI3K-FOXO death genes); FOXO death genes and UPRmt separate it from dependence-receptor confusables and ligand-absence/neuronal members from AKT-FOXO and HSF1 confusables.

qualifier: dendritic cell IL-12 and antigen presentation against protozoa
name: Dendritic cell-driven Th1 immunity to protozoa
rationale: Members link IL-12, IFN-gamma and Th1 cytokine production to activated dendritic cells and protozoan defence; DC antigen presentation and protozoan response are what the Th1/NKT confusables lack.

qualifier: dendritic cell antigen presentation, protozoan response
name: Dendritic cell IL-12 and Th1 cytokine response to protozoa
rationale: Members cover IL-12, IFN-gamma and GM-CSF production, Th1 responses, activated dendritic cells and DC antigen presentation in response to protozoa, the DC/protozoan aspect absent from Th1-differentiation and NKT confusables.

qualifier: dendritic cell antigen presentation and protozoan response
name: Dendritic cell-primed Th1 immunity to protozoa
rationale: Members link activated dendritic cells, IL-12 and GM-CSF production to IFN-gamma Th1 responses, and the DC antigen-presentation and protozoan-response members distinguish it from Th1-differentiation and NKT confusables.

name: HIV entry, uncoating, reverse transcription and Env/Vpu
rationale: Members are early HIV life-cycle steps (binding/entry, uncoating, minus/plus-strand DNA synthesis) and Env/Vpu functions; distinct from other-virus, integration/latency and Nef downregulation confusables.

qualifier: entry, uncoating, reverse transcription and Vpu-CD4 degradation
name: HIV entry, uncoating, reverse transcription and Vpu-mediated CD4 degradation
rationale: Members are early HIV events (binding/entry, uncoating, minus/plus-strand DNA synthesis) plus Env/Vpu synthesis and Vpu CD4 degradation; confusables cover integration, Nef downregulation or other viruses.

qualifier: entry, reverse transcription and Vpu/Env synthesis
name: HIV entry, reverse transcription and Vpu–Env synthesis
rationale: Members cover HIV binding, entry, uncoating, reverse transcription and Env/Vpu (CD4 degradation), lacking the integration, Nef and other-virus content of confusables.

name: UDP-GlcNAc and UDP-glucose supply for N-linked glycosylation
rationale: Members cover synthesis of UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-glucose and dolichyl-phosphate-glucose and their GFPT1/ALG14 myasthenic-syndrome defects; confusables instead cover N-glycan processing, GPI anchors or sialic acid metabolism.

core: Nucleotide-sugar donor supply for N-linked glycosylation
qualifier: UDP-GlcNAc and UDP-glucose; GFPT1/ALG14 myasthenic syndromes
name: UDP-GlcNAc and UDP-glucose supply for N-glycosylation
rationale: Members are UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-glucose and dolichyl-phosphate-glucose synthesis feeding N-glycosylation (including GFPT1/ALG14 congenital myasthenic defects), distinct from sialic acid, GPI anchor and N-glycan trimming confusables.

name: Nucleotide-sugar donor synthesis for dolichol-linked N-glycosylation
rationale: Members make UDP-GlcNAc and UDP-/dolichyl-phosphate-glucose feeding N-glycan precursor assembly (GFPT1, ALG14 myasthenic syndromes), distinct from sialic acid, GPI-anchor and N-glycan trimming confusables.

name: Regulation of RNA polymerase II transcription initiation
rationale: Members share control of Pol II transcription at promoters (preinitiation complex assembly, initiation surveillance, transcription factor and chromatin modules feeding transcription); the initiation focus distinguishes it from neighbours centred on elongation, pausing and termination.

name: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation and regulation
rationale: Members concern Pol II initiation, preinitiation complex assembly and transcription-factor/chromatin regulator modules, distinct from confusables focused on elongation, pausing and termination.

qualifier: preinitiation complex and transcriptional regulator modules
name: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation and regulatory modules
rationale: Members concern Pol II preinitiation/initiation and gene modules of transcriptional regulators, distinguishing it from confusables focused on elongation, pausing and termination or on chromatin/ubiquitin modules.

core: Nuclear pore complex and nucleocytoplasmic transport
qualifier: SUMO conjugation, mitotic nuclear envelope cycle
name: Nuclear pore transport, mitotic envelope remodeling and SUMOylation
rationale: Members combine NPC-mediated import/export, mitotic NPC and nuclear envelope disassembly/reformation, and SUMO conjugation of nuclear targets, unlike confusables centred on ESCRT envelope sealing or mRNA export.

core: Nuclear pore transport and envelope remodeling
name: Nuclear pore transport, SUMOylation and mitotic nuclear envelope remodeling
rationale: Members span nuclear pore protein/ribosome/IP transport, the SUMO conjugation cascade and mitotic nuclear envelope/NPC breakdown and reformation, whereas confusables emphasize ESCRT sealing or mRNA export.

core: Nuclear pore transport and nuclear envelope dynamics
name: Nuclear pore transport, mitotic envelope remodeling and SUMOylation
rationale: Members span nuclear pore complex assembly and NLS/Ran-dependent import-export, mitotic nuclear envelope breakdown and reformation, and the SUMO conjugation cascade on nuclear substrates, distinguishing it from confusables on ESCRT-III envelope sealing or mRNA export.

qualifier: calcium-triggered vesicle docking, priming and fusion
name: Calcium-triggered presynaptic neurotransmitter vesicle exocytosis
rationale: Members cover neurotransmitter release cycles, vesicle docking/priming/SNARE assembly and calcium-dependent exocytosis at the presynapse, distinguishing it from confusables about vesicle recycling/endocytosis or postsynaptic glutamate receptor signaling.

qualifier: calcium-triggered vesicle docking, priming and fusion
name: Calcium-triggered presynaptic vesicle fusion and neurotransmitter release
rationale: Members cover Ca2+-dependent synaptic and dense-core vesicle docking, priming, SNARE assembly and exocytosis plus the release cycles of glutamate, GABA, monoamines and acetylcholine, whereas confusables emphasize vesicle recycling/endocytosis or postsynaptic glutamate receptor signaling.

qualifier: calcium-triggered vesicle docking, priming and exocytosis
name: Calcium-triggered synaptic vesicle priming and neurotransmitter exocytosis
rationale: Members cover the release cycles of multiple transmitters, presynaptic calcium entry, SNARE assembly, vesicle docking/priming and calcium-dependent exocytosis, distinguishing it from vesicle recycling/endocytosis and postsynaptic glutamate-receptor confusables.

name: STAT5-activating hematopoietic cytokine and FLT3 receptor signaling
rationale: Members are IL-2/3/5/7/9, EPO, TPO and FLT3 (including oncogenic fusions) signaling converging on STAT5 with CBL regulation, distinguishing it from IL-6/STAT3 and growth hormone/prolactin neighbours.

name: STAT5-activating hematopoietic cytokine and FLT3 receptor signaling
rationale: Members are IL-2/3/5/7/9, EPO and TPO receptor signaling to STAT5 plus FLT3 and oncogenic kinase fusions, distinguishing it from IL-6/gp130-STAT3 and GH/prolactin confusables.

qualifier: hematopoietic cytokines and oncogenic kinase fusions
name: Hematopoietic cytokine and oncogenic kinase signaling via STAT5
rationale: Members are IL-2/3/5/7/9, EPO and TPO receptor signaling plus FLT3, PDGFR and FGFR1 oncogenic mutants converging on STAT5, distinct from IL-6/STAT3 and growth hormone/prolactin confusables.

name: TGF-beta-SMAD signaling with cancer mutants and RUNX3 targets
rationale: Members cover TGF-beta receptor/SMAD signaling and its downregulation, cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMADs, TGFBR3 and RUNX3 targets, unlike activin, Hippo/YAP or mutant-free confusables.

name: TGF-beta–SMAD2/3 signaling with cancer mutants and RUNX3 targets
rationale: Members cover TGF-beta receptor/SMAD signaling and its regulation including TGFBR/SMAD cancer mutants and RUNX3 targets, versus Hippo/YAP and activin confusables.

qualifier: cancer receptor/SMAD mutants and RUNX3 targets
name: TGF-beta–SMAD2/3 signaling, cancer mutants and RUNX3 targets
rationale: Members are TGF-beta receptor/SMAD signaling, its downregulation and TGFBR3 control, cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMADs, and RUNX3 target genes, distinguishing it from activin and RUNX3-YAP/Hippo confusables.

qualifier: isoform-specific ligand binding, splicing and activating mutants
name: FGFR isoform ligand binding, splicing and activating mutants
rationale: All members concern activation of FGFR1-4 receptors; unlike the confusables, which centre on FGFR1/2 downstream FRS/SHC/PLC cascades, this theme holds the b/c isoform ligand-binding events, FGFR2 splicing and oncogenic point mutants (plus FGFR3 signalling).

qualifier: isoform-specific ligand binding, splicing and activating mutants
name: FGFR activation by splice-isoform ligand binding and mutation
rationale: All members concern activation of FGFR1-4 receptors; unlike the confusables, which centre on FGFR1/FGFR2 downstream adaptor cascades, this theme holds the b/c splice-isoform ligand-binding events, FGFR2 alternative splicing and activating point mutants across FGFR1-4.

qualifier: splice-isoform ligand binding, activating mutants and FGFR3 cascades
name: FGFR isoform ligand binding, activating mutants and FGFR3 signaling
rationale: All members concern FGFR activation, and the theme is set apart from neighbours carrying FGFR1/FGFR2 downstream cascades by its isoform-specific (IIIb/IIIc) ligand binding, FGFR2 splicing, oncogenic point mutants and FGFR3 FRS/SHC signaling.

name: Proline, glycine and glyoxylate amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are amino/organic acid metabolism with specific proline, glycine and glyoxylate pathways, distinguishing it from aromatic/histidine/threonine catabolism and glycine-conjugation confusables.

name: Proline, glycine and glyoxylate amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are generic amino/organic acid metabolism terms anchored by proline synthesis/catabolism and glycine/glyoxylate metabolism, without the aromatic, histidine or threonine catabolism or glycine conjugation seen in confusables.

name: Proline, glycine and glyoxylate amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are generic amino and organic acid metabolism terms anchored by proline synthesis/catabolism, glycine synthesis and glyoxylate metabolism, while confusables centre on aromatic, histidine or threonine catabolism or glycine conjugation.

name: Responses to reactive oxygen, nitrogen and sulfur species
rationale: Members are responses to hydrogen peroxide, hydroperoxide, nitric oxide, nitrosative stress, hydrogen sulfide and ischemia, including oxidative-stress apoptosis; nitrogen/sulfur species distinguish it from confusables on respiration, ferroptosis and UPRmt.

name: Peroxide, nitric oxide and sulfide stress responses
rationale: Members are responses to H2O2/hydroperoxide, nitrosative stress, NO, H2S and ischemia with oxidative apoptosis regulation, unlike ferroptosis, respiration and UPRmt confusables.

name: Peroxide and nitrosative stress responses with oxidative apoptosis control
rationale: Members are cellular responses to hydrogen peroxide, nitric oxide/reactive nitrogen, hydrogen sulfide and ischemia plus regulation of oxidative stress-induced apoptosis; the nitrosative/ischemic members separate it from confusables on hyperoxia/UPRmt, ferroptosis or respiration control.

name: Plasma membrane phospholipid flipping and scrambling
rationale: Members concern aminophospholipid flippase and calcium-activated scramblase (ANO6) activity with associated membrane repair, blebbing and volume control, distinct from confusables on inter-organelle lipid transfer, apoptotic cell clearance or mechanosensing.

name: Plasma membrane phospholipid asymmetry, scrambling and repair
rationale: Members concern flippase/scramblase control of aminophospholipid distribution, with blebbing, volume control and membrane repair separating it from ER lipid transfer and apoptotic clearance confusables.

qualifier: flippase/scramblase activity, blebbing and membrane repair
name: Plasma membrane phospholipid flipping, scrambling and membrane repair
rationale: Members concern P4-ATPase flippases, calcium-activated scrambling (ANO6), phospholipid translocation, blebbing, cell volume and membrane repair, distinguishing the theme from apoptotic cell clearance, mechanosensing and ER intermembrane lipid transfer confusables.

name: Sensory-guided, social and vocal behavior
rationale: Members are behaviors driven by auditory, visual and mechanosensory input, social interaction and vocal learning, distinguishing them from confusables on MECP2 regulation and motor or locomotor behavior.

name: Vocal learning, sensorimotor gating and social behavior
rationale: Members are behaviors driven by auditory, visual and mechanosensory input, vocalization, observational learning and social interaction (with striatal development), unlike locomotor or MECP2 confusables.

name: Vocal, social and sensorimotor gating behaviors
rationale: Members are behavioural processes (vocalization and vocal learning, observational learning, intraspecies interaction, auditory/visual/mechanosensory behaviour, prepulse inhibition) with striatum development, unlike the MECP2 and locomotor/proprioception confusables.

qualifier: fatty acid and aquaglyceroporin glycerol transport
name: Adipose thermogenesis with fatty acid and aquaglyceroporin glycerol transport
rationale: Members link cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis and fatty acid cycling to aquaporin glycerol/urea transport out of adipocytes, while confusables centre on adipocyte differentiation or water transport.

qualifier: glycerol, urea and fatty acid transport
name: Thermogenic fat with glycerol, urea and fatty acid transport
rationale: Members join cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis and fatty acid cycling with aquaglyceroporin glycerol/urea/amide and fatty acid transport, distinguishing it from neighbours on brown/beige adipocyte differentiation or plain aquaporin water transport.

qualifier: fatty acid, glycerol and urea transmembrane transport
name: Adaptive thermogenesis with fatty acid and glycerol transport
rationale: Members link cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis to transport of fatty acids, glycerol and urea (aquaglyceroporins); thermogenic/fatty-acid terms separate it from the water-aquaporin confusable and glycerol/urea transport from the adipocyte-differentiation confusables.

name: Golgi vesicle sorting to lysosomes and lysosome-related organelles
rationale: Members describe coat-dependent cargo sorting from the Golgi to lysosomes and lysosome-related organelles (melanosomes, platelet dense granules, synaptic vesicles), unlike the melanin-pigmentation, endocytic clathrin and generic lysosome-biogenesis confusables.

name: Lysosome-related organelle biogenesis by Golgi coated-vesicle sorting
rationale: Members share adaptor/clathrin-coated vesicle cargo sorting from the Golgi that builds lysosomes, melanosomes, platelet dense granules and synaptic vesicles; confusables instead cover melanin pigmentation, endocytic clathrin coats or general secretion.

qualifier: Golgi clathrin sorting of lysosomal enzymes
name: Lysosome-related organelle biogenesis and lysosomal enzyme sorting
rationale: Members cover Golgi/clathrin-dependent cargo sorting to lysosomes and biogenesis of melanosomes, platelet dense granules and synaptic vesicles, distinct from melanin pigmentation and endocytic clathrin confusables.

name: Urogenital smooth muscle function in reproduction and micturition
rationale: Members concern smooth-muscle-driven urogenital functions (uterine contraction, parturition, erection, insemination, mating, micturition, peristalsis), distinguishing them from tachykinin signaling, general smooth muscle relaxation and gastrointestinal motility neighbours.

qualifier: urogenital: micturition, erection, mating and parturition
name: Urogenital smooth muscle contraction in micturition and reproduction
rationale: Members are urinary, uterine and penile smooth muscle functions and associated reproductive acts plus peristalsis, distinguished from gastrointestinal motility, relaxation and tachykinin/GPCR confusables.

name: Urogenital smooth muscle function in micturition, copulation and parturition
rationale: Members are urinary, uterine and penile contractile/visceral motor events (micturition, parturition, erection, insemination, peristalsis), unlike confusables on GI motility, smooth muscle relaxation, tachykinin signaling or social behaviour.

name: Microtubule nucleation, stabilisation and centrosome positioning
rationale: Most members concern MTOC microtubule nucleation, stabilisation and centrosome localization (with CIT and actin localization as outliers), distinct from spindle orientation, mitotic centrosome recruitment and cilium confusables.

name: Centrosomal microtubule nucleation and stabilization with actin crosstalk
rationale: Members concern centrosome positioning, MTOC microtubule nucleation and stabilization together with actin-linked localization and Rho-citron kinase, unlike confusables on centriole/cilium biology or mitotic spindle orientation.

name: Centrosomal microtubule nucleation and stabilization with actin crosstalk
rationale: Members concern centrosome positioning, microtubule nucleation and stabilization plus actin-linked localization (citron kinase); these distinguish it from mitotic centrosome, centriole/cilium and spindle orientation neighbours.

qualifier: elastic fibre and collagen fibril assembly
name: Elastic fibre and collagen fibril matrix assembly
rationale: Members are ECM modules plus elastic fibre assembly and collagen fibril organization; neighbours emphasize collagen degradation/MMPs, fibronectin-integrin matrix or collagen biosynthesis/crosslinking.

qualifier: elastic fibre and collagen fibril organization
name: Elastic fiber and collagen fibril extracellular matrix assembly
rationale: Members are ECM signatures with elastic fibre assembly and collagen fibril organization; unlike collagen degradation/MMP, fibronectin-integrin and collagen biosynthesis neighbours, it emphasizes elastic fibre and fibril assembly.

name: Extracellular matrix elastic fiber and collagen fibril assembly
rationale: Members are structural ECM modules and elastic fiber/collagen fibril organization, lacking the integrin/fibronectin, collagen biosynthesis/degradation and immune-matrix content of confusables.

name: DNA mismatch repair and its hereditary defects
rationale: All members are MutS/MutL-directed mismatch repair or its MLH1/MSH2/MSH3/MSH6 defects, unlike confusables on double-strand break repair and recombination.

name: DNA mismatch repair and its MutS-MLH1 defects
rationale: All members concern MutS-alpha/beta-directed mismatch repair and disease-associated MLH1/MSH2/MSH3/MSH6 defects, while confusables cover double-strand break, cross-link and repair synthesis processes.

name: DNA mismatch repair and its MSH/MLH1 defects
rationale: All members are DNA mismatch repair, including MutSalpha/MutSbeta-directed repair, meiotic MMR and MSH2/3/6 and MLH1 deficiencies; confusables are double-strand break and recombination repair.

name: Naive and memory B cell signatures
rationale: Members are B cell, naive and memory B cell surface/expression signatures and memory responses, lacking the germinal centre, plasma cell and Tfh members of the confusables.

name: Naive and memory B cell transcriptional signatures
rationale: Members are naive, memory and generic B cell expression signatures with adaptive memory response, distinguishing them from germinal centre, Tfh, plasma cell and B cell activation neighbours.

name: Naive and memory B cell surface signatures
rationale: Members are B cell, naive and memory B cell expression signatures and immune memory, distinguished from germinal centre, plasma cell and B cell activation neighbours.

qualifier: nephric duct formation and bud elongation
name: Nephric duct and ureteric bud formation, elongation and branching
rationale: Members concern nephric duct and ureteric bud formation, elongation, branching and ureter morphogenesis, distinct from intermediate mesoderm and metanephric mesenchyme/nephron confusables.

qualifier: nephric duct origin, elongation and branching
name: Nephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching
rationale: All members concern nephric duct and ureteric bud formation, elongation and branching; neighbours instead hold kidney size/metanephric mesenchyme control or intermediate mesoderm induction.

qualifier: nephric duct formation and bud elongation
name: Nephric duct and ureteric bud formation and elongation
rationale: All members concern formation, elongation and branching of the nephric duct/ureteric bud epithelial tube and ureter, distinguishing it from confusables on intermediate mesoderm induction, metanephric mesenchyme and kidney size control.

name: Centrosome, mitotic spindle and cytokinetic ring organization
rationale: Members concern centrosome/centriole control, microtubule nucleation and spindle positioning, cleavage furrow and contractile ring, versus confusables built on chromosome cohesion, condensation and nuclear envelope dynamics.

name: Centrosome cycle, mitotic spindle and cytokinesis
rationale: Members concern centrosome/centriole duplication, spindle assembly and positioning, cilium disassembly and cytokinesis, whereas the confusables centre on chromosome condensation, cohesion and nuclear envelope remodelling.

qualifier: microtubule nucleation, centriole control and cytokinesis
name: Mitotic centrosome, spindle microtubule and cytokinesis organization
rationale: Members span centrosome/centriole duplication and cohesion, microtubule nucleation and dynamics, spindle assembly and orientation, cilium disassembly and contractile-ring cytokinesis, while confusables centre on chromosome condensation and sister chromatid cohesion.

qualifier: death receptor and BH3/mitochondrial routes with necroptosis
name: Death receptor and BH3-driven apoptosis with necroptotic signalling
rationale: Members are the extrinsic death receptor and caspase-8 branch, BH3 protein activation with mitochondrial permeabilisation and apoptosome and nuclease steps, and the necroptotic alternative, whereas confusables add p53 transcriptional control of cell death or senescence.

qualifier: death receptor and BH3-only/BAX-BAK mitochondrial arms with caspase and nuclease execution, not p53 transcriptional input
name: Death receptor and BCL-2-family apoptotic execution with necroptosis
rationale: Every member is part of triggering or restraining cell death at the protein level: death receptor and caspase-8 signalling, BH3-only activation of BAX/BAK and cytochrome c release, apoptosome and nuclease execution, and RIPK1-dependent necroptosis, whereas the confusables supply the p53 transcriptional and senescence programs that act upstream.

core: death receptor and mitochondrial apoptosis execution with regulated necrosis
qualifier: effector machinery (BH3-only/BAX-BAK, apoptosome, caspase-8, RIPK1) rather than p53 transcriptional control
name: Death receptor and mitochondrial apoptosis execution with necroptosis
rationale: Every member is a step or regulator of committed cell death - BH3-only activation and outer membrane permeabilisation, cytochrome c release, apoptosome and caspase-8 control, death receptor and TRIF/RIPK1 necroptotic signalling, and nuclear demolition - whereas the confusables are dominated by p53-driven transcription of death genes, senescence programmes and PAK-2p34 signalling.

name: Nucleoside transport and nucleoside-analogue drug metabolism
rationale: Members share plasma-membrane purine/pyrimidine nucleoside transport, nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis and metabolism of nucleoside-analogue drugs (abacavir, ribavirin, azathioprine/TPMT), whereas confusables cover de novo purine synthesis, salvage and pyrimidine catabolism.

name: Nucleoside transport and nucleoside-analogue drug metabolism
rationale: Members cover plasma-membrane nucleoside/nucleobase transport, nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis and ADME of nucleoside-analogue drugs (abacavir, ribavirin, azathioprine/TPMT), whereas confusables cover de novo and salvage nucleotide synthesis or pyrimidine catabolism.

qualifier: nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis and nucleoside-analogue drug metabolism
name: Nucleoside transport, triphosphate hydrolysis and analogue drug metabolism
rationale: Members cover plasma membrane nucleoside/nucleobase transport, NUDT and triphosphate catabolism, and handling of thiopurine and nucleoside-analogue drugs, whereas confusables are de novo and salvage nucleotide biosynthesis without transport.

name: Gonadal sex determination and reproductive tract and prostate development
rationale: Members span sex determination, gonad and AMH signalling, prostate, uterus, oviduct, vagina and genitalia development, distinguishing it from mammary, germ-cell/seminiferous and pancreatic confusables.

qualifier: sex determination, gonad, prostate and Mullerian tract
name: Sex determination, gonad, prostate and genital tract development
rationale: Members span sex determination, gonad and Leydig cell development, AMH signalling, prostate morphogenesis and Mullerian/genital tract organs, unlike confusables on germ cells and Sertoli cells, mammary gland or pancreas.

qualifier: gonadal sex determination, genital tract and prostate
name: Gonadal sex determination and genital tract and prostate morphogenesis
rationale: Members span sex determination, gonad and Leydig/AMH signalling and morphogenesis of Mullerian tract, genitalia and prostate, unlike confusables on germ cells/Sertoli cells, pancreas or mammary gland.

name: Cardiac myocyte action potential plateau and potassium-mediated repolarization
rationale: Members cover action potential phases 1-4, Kir/TWIK/voltage-gated potassium channels and atrial/ventricular repolarization, unlike the contraction/calcium-handling and phase 0/conduction-system confusables.

name: Cardiac action potential plateau and potassium-channel repolarization
rationale: Members concern cardiac action potential phases 1-4, voltage-gated, Kir and TWIK potassium channels and atrial/ventricular repolarization; confusables emphasize depolarization, conduction system and gap junctions or calcium handling and contraction.

qualifier: potassium channel-mediated repolarization and resting potential
name: Cardiac action potential repolarization by potassium channels

qualifier: ganglioside synthesis, glycolipid transport and lysosomal degradation

qualifier: ganglioside synthesis, transport and lysosomal degradation

name: Sema3A-mediated axon repulsion and collateral sprouting control

name: Sema3A axon repulsion and collateral sprouting control

name: eNOS activation and nitric oxide-cGMP vasorelaxation

qualifier: eNOS regulation and vascular smooth muscle relaxation
name: eNOS-NO-cGMP signalling and vascular smooth muscle relaxation

qualifier: endothelial NO synthase activation and trafficking

rationale: Members cover eNOS activation/trafficking, NO-cGMP signalling and vascular smooth muscle relaxation, which blood-pressure, shear-stress and renal confusables lack.

qualifier: mRNA, ribosomal subunit and tRNA cargoes

qualifier: export of mature mRNA, ribosomal subunits and tRNA

qualifier: mRNA, tRNA and ribosomal subunit cargo

name: Proteasomal protein turnover regulation, degron pathways and K48 ubiquitination
rationale: Members regulate proteasomal catabolism and protein destabilisation via N-end and C-end degrons, K48 and autoubiquitination and UCH deubiquitinases, distinguishing them from atypical ubiquitin chain, ribosome quality control and ERAD/misfolded-protein confusables.

name: Proteasomal degradation control: degron recognition and K48 ubiquitination

qualifier: degron rules and K48 ubiquitination control
name: Degron-directed proteasomal protein degradation and its regulation
rationale: Members regulate proteasomal catabolism via N- and C-end degron rules, K48 ubiquitination, deubiquitination and protein destabilization, unlike confusables about ERAD/misfolded protein quality control, atypical ubiquitin chains or ribosome-associated quality control.

name: Canonical NF-kappaB activation via IKK recruitment downstream of TLRs
rationale: Members concern IKK complex recruitment by IRAK1, RIP1 and TICAM1 and positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB, lacking the TNFR1, non-canonical NF-kappaB and TAK1-activation terms of the confusables.

name: TLR-driven IKK recruitment and canonical NF-kB activation
rationale: Members concern IRAK1- and RIP1-mediated IKK recruitment and positive regulation of canonical NF-kB in TLR signaling, unlike noncanonical NF-kB, TNFR1 and TAK1-induction confusables.

qualifier: IRAK1/RIP1 IKK recruitment downstream of TLRs
name: TLR-driven IKK recruitment and canonical NF-kB activation
rationale: Members cover IRAK1-, RIP1- and TICAM1-mediated IKK complex recruitment, TLR7/8/9-IRF7 activation and positive NF-kB regulation, unlike TNFR1, TAK1-induction and noncanonical NF-kB confusables.

name: Phosphatidylserine exposure and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members span calcium-activated phospholipid scrambling, PS exposure, blebbing/cell shrinkage and recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells, whereas confusables cover scavenger receptor uptake, flippase-mediated aminophospholipid translocation and foam cell formation.

name: Apoptotic cell phosphatidylserine exposure and efferocytosis
rationale: Members cover phospholipid scrambling and PS exposure, blebbing and shrinkage of dying cells and their recognition and engulfment, whereas confusables cover general phospholipid translocation or scavenger-receptor uptake of lipoproteins.

name: Efferocytosis with phosphatidylserine exposure and phospholipid scrambling
rationale: Members cover dying-cell surface changes (PS exposure, ANO6 scrambling, blebbing, shrinkage) and their recognition and engulfment, whereas confusables emphasise scavenger receptors, aminophospholipid flippases or foam cell lipid uptake.

name: Store-operated calcium entry and cytosolic calcium elevation
rationale: Members concern SOCE activation, release of sequestered calcium and calcium sensing, whereas confusables cover calcium removal and Na/Ca exchange.

qualifier: elevation via store release and store-operated entry

name: Cytosolic calcium rise via store release and store-operated entry

name: Adenylate cyclase-cAMP-PKA signaling to CREB

name: Adenylate cyclase-cAMP-PKA signalling to CREB

name: Adenylate cyclase-cAMP-PKA signaling to CREB
rationale: Members concern adenylate cyclase activation (including dopamine receptor and forskolin), cAMP response, PKA activation and CREB phosphorylation, unlike confusables on cAMP degradation/DARPP-32 or CaMK-driven CREB and MECP2 signalling.

name: Gonadotropin secretion and FSH-responsive gonad development
rationale: Members regulate LH/FSH secretion and FSH-dependent Sertoli cell, germ cell, seminiferous tubule and ovarian follicle development, lacking the activin/AMH and GnRH-receptor content of neighbours.

name: Insulin processing and incretin-stimulated insulin secretion
rationale: All members concern beta-cell insulin maturation and its glucose/GLP-1/GIP-driven secretion, distinguishing it from confusables on fatty-acid, cholinergic or K-ATP control of secretion, GLUT4 translocation or pancreatic development.

qualifier: proinsulin processing and incretin (GLP-1, GIP) stimulation
name: Beta-cell insulin processing and incretin-stimulated secretion
rationale: Members cover insulin processing, beta-cell identity and glucose/GLP-1/GIP-stimulated insulin release, distinguishing it from confusables on K-ATP channels, fatty-acid or neural modulation, GLUT4 translocation or pancreatic development.

qualifier: incretin (GLP-1, GIP) stimulation and insulin processing
name: Incretin-stimulated insulin processing and secretion in beta cells
rationale: Members cover GLP-1/GIP synthesis and action, proinsulin processing and glucose-stimulated insulin secretion in beta cells, unlike neighbours centred on KATP channels, fatty-acid/acetylcholine modulation, GLUT4 or pancreatic development.

name: Osteoclast formation by macrophage fusion and DAP12 signaling
rationale: Members cover osteoclast differentiation, proliferation, fusion and bone resorption, with macrophage fusion, syncytium formation and DAP12 distinguishing it from M-CSF and negative bone remodeling neighbours.

name: Osteoclast formation by macrophage fusion and DAP12 signaling
rationale: Members promote osteoclast differentiation, proliferation, cell fusion and bone resorption with DAP12 signaling, lacking the M-CSF signaling and negative bone-remodeling members of the confusables.

name: Osteoclast fusion and differentiation via DAP12 signaling
rationale: Members concern osteoclast/macrophage fusion, differentiation and bone resorption, with DAP12 signaling and syncytium formation absent from IGF, CSF1 and negative bone-remodeling confusables.

name: Glycine and glyoxylate metabolism in amino acid catabolism

name: Amino acid catabolism and glyoxylate–glycine metabolism

name: Amino acid catabolism centred on glyoxylate and glycine

name: Chaperone protein folding, refolding and inclusion body suppression
rationale: Members concern de novo, chaperonin and ER folding, refolding, ATP-dependent chaperone activity and limiting inclusion bodies, unlike confusables specific to CCT/TriC substrates, aggrephagy or the heat shock response.

qualifier: de novo and ER folding, refolding
name: Chaperone-assisted de novo protein folding and refolding
rationale: Members concern ATP-dependent chaperone folding, refolding and oligomer assembly and suppression of inclusion bodies, unlike CCT/TRiC actin-tubulin folding, heat shock response and aggrephagy confusables.

qualifier: refolding, ER folding and inclusion body suppression
name: Chaperone-mediated protein folding, refolding and aggregation prevention
rationale: Members cover de novo and ER protein folding, refolding and suppression of inclusion bodies, distinguishing it from CCT/TriC actin-tubulin folding, heat shock response and aggrephagy confusables.

name: G2/M checkpoint recovery and TP53 stability control

name: p53 turnover and G2/M mitotic progression control
rationale: Members link p53 degradation and phosphorylation (COP1, GTSE1) with MASTL and Cdc25A-dependent G2/M progression, distinct from DNA-damage checkpoint and G1/S confusables.

name: G2/M checkpoint recovery via p53 and Cdc25A regulation
rationale: Members are Cdc25A and p53 degradation, p53 phosphorylation, COP1, GTSE1 and MASTL control of G2/M progression; confusables carry DNA-damage checkpoint signalling, CDK dephosphorylation or G1/S RB-E2F members.

qualifier: opsin light absorption and cascade, not retinoid cycle

qualifier: with lipoate, biotin and CoA cofactors and BCAA catabolism

rationale: Members are PDH, OGDH, BCKDH and OADH reactions, their lipoate/biotin/CoA cofactors and branched-chain and lysine catabolism with their disorders; this distinguishes it from fatty acid oxidation, vitamin B6 and TCA-enzyme/Fe-S neighbours.

qualifier: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases with lipoate, biotin and CoA cofactors
name: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase and branched-chain amino acid catabolism with cofactors

qualifier: branched-chain amino acid catabolism and CoA, lipoate, biotin cofactors

rationale: Members centre on PDH, OGDH, BCKDH and OADH complexes, their lipoate, biotin and CoA cofactors, and branched-chain amino acid and lysine catabolism with its inborn errors; confusables emphasise fatty acid beta-oxidation, TCA iron-sulfur and isocitrate/malate steps or vitamin B6.

qualifier: RB-E2F G1/S and cyclin B-Cdk1 G2/M checkpoints

core: Cell cycle phase transitions and checkpoints
qualifier: RB/DREAM repression of E2F targets and G2/M control
