qualifier: RB-E2F repression and cyclin-CDK control at both G1/S and G2/M
name: G1/S and G2/M checkpoint control via RB-E2F and cyclin-CDKs
rationale: Members cover cell cycle transition control at G1/S (RB1/E2F, cyclin D/E-CDK, p27/p21 degradation) and G2/M (Chk1/2, cyclin B, PLK, p53 G2 arrest); C1/C4 are E2F/G1/S-transcription focused and C2/C3 are p53/DNA-damage focused, while this theme alone spans RB-E2F and cyclin-CDK control of both transitions.

qualifier: node of Ranvier and paranodal assembly
name: Myelination and node of Ranvier axon-glia organization
rationale: Members cover CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, glial responses, axon caliber and neurofilaments, and nodal/paranodal assembly via neurofascin, NrCAM, L1-ankyrin and sodium channel clustering, which the regeneration and L1-signaling confusables lack.

name: Myelination and nodal/paranodal axon domain organization

name: Axon-glia myelination and nodal domain organization
rationale: Members span CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, glial responses, axon caliber and node/paranode assembly with sodium channel clustering, the nodal terms distinguishing it from axon regeneration and L1-signaling confusables.

name: Neuropeptide and opioid signalling in sleep-wake regulation

name: Neuropeptide and opioid signalling in sleep-wake regulation

qualifier: sleep-wake regulation, orexin and opioid receptors

rationale: Members share neuropeptide/opioid G-protein signaling, dense-core vesicle release and nerve impulse modulation tied to sleep-wake states and behavior, distinguishing it from confusables about mating, aggression and CRH/corticosterone stress responses.

qualifier: aquaglyceroporin glycerol transport and acylglycerol synthesis

qualifier: aquaglyceroporin glycerol transport and polyol interconversion
name: Glycerol transport, polyol metabolism and acylglycerol synthesis
rationale: Members cover glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate and polyol metabolism, aquaporin-mediated glycerol (and urea) transport, and PA/DAG/TAG synthesis; the glycerol transport branch separates it from lipid-droplet, lipolysis and fructose-catabolism confusables.

qualifier: entry, reverse transcription and Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation
name: HIV-1 entry, reverse transcription and Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation

qualifier: with Nef/Vpu downregulation of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I
name: HIV-1 entry, reverse transcription and Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation
rationale: Members cover HIV-1 binding, uncoating, reverse transcription and Nef/Vpu-mediated host receptor downregulation; neighbours carry PD-L1, MHC-I antigen presentation, proteasome or integration steps instead.

qualifier: entry, reverse transcription and Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation
name: HIV entry, reverse transcription and Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation
rationale: Members cover HIV binding, uncoating, reverse transcription, Env/Vpu synthesis and Nef/Vpu-mediated degradation of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I with host restriction; confusables hold integration/Rev steps or PD-L1 and MHC-I antigen presentation.

qualifier: FRS2, SHC, PI3K and PLCgamma adaptor cascades

name: FGFR downstream FRS, SHC and PI3K cascades

qualifier: FRS, SHC and PI3K cascades of FGFR1, 2 and 4

qualifier: complex assembly and mitochondrial translation elongation rather than electron transport
name: Respiratory chain complex assembly and mitochondrial translation elongation

name: Mitochondrial OXPHOS complex biogenesis from translation to assembly

name: Respiratory chain complex biogenesis and mitochondrial translation elongation

qualifier: oncogenic RAF/RAS mutants and integrin adaptors
name: RAF-MAPK activation by oncogenic RAF mutants and integrin adaptors

qualifier: oncogenic RAS/RAF mutants and integrin linkage

name: Sensorimotor gating, exploratory and social behavior
rationale: Members are behavioural phenotypes (grooming, prepulse inhibition, exploration, swimming, touch/visual behaviour, social interaction) with amygdala and MECP2-GABA links, distinguished from confusables on vocal learning, mating/aggression or synaptic transmission.

name: Podocyte development and brush-border microvillus assembly

name: Cytosolic calcium clearance by SERCA regulation and Na+/Ca2+ exchange

name: Cytosolic calcium clearance via SERCA and sodium-calcium exchange

core: Heart morphogenesis and mesoderm fate regulation

core: Heart morphogenesis and mesoderm development regulation
name: Mesoderm and heart morphogenesis regulation, coronary vasculature and pericardium

qualifier: T follicular helper and ICOS co-stimulation

name: E2F-driven G1/S transition and replication origin licensing

qualifier: G1/S transition and replication origin licensing
name: E2F-driven G1/S transition and DNA replication origin licensing
rationale: Members are E2F target programs, proliferating-cell cycle modules and ORC/CDC6/pre-replicative complex assembly and replication initiation, distinct from DREAM-mediated repression, G2/M checkpoint and DNA repair-replication neighbours.

core: G1/S progression and DNA replication initiation

qualifier: JNK/p38 MAPK and canonical NF-kappaB activation

rationale: Members are SRF-driven actin/contractile target modules and endothelial laminar/oscillatory shear-stress PIEZO1 signaling; each confusable has only one of these halves plus smooth muscle or eNOS terms.

qualifier: gametogenesis, meiosis, fertilization and gonadal hormones
name: Gametogenesis, meiosis, fertilization and gonadal endocrine control
rationale: Members span germ cell specification, meiotic recombination and segregation, spermatogenesis and oogenesis, fertilization, maternal-to-zygotic transition, germline piRNA/retroelement silencing and gonadotropin/gonad development, distinguishing it from mitotic cell-cycle and placental/trophoblast confusables.

qualifier: meiosis, gonadal hormones, fertilization and zygotic activation
name: Gametogenesis, meiosis, gonadal hormones, fertilization and zygotic activation
rationale: Members span germ cell specification, meiosis, sperm and oocyte development, gonadotropin/sex-steroid control, fertilization and maternal-to-zygotic transition, distinguishing it from mitotic cell-cycle and placental/trophoblast neighbours.

qualifier: meiosis, gonad development, fertilization and zygotic activation
name: Germ cell meiosis, gonad development, fertilization and zygotic activation
rationale: Members span gonad and germ cell development, gonadotropin/sex-hormone control, meiotic recombination and segregation, sperm-oocyte interaction, germline transposon silencing and the maternal-to-zygotic transition, whereas confusables are mitotic cell cycle or placental/reproductive-tract development.

qualifier: fatty acid beta-oxidation and branched-chain amino acid breakdown via 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases
name: Mitochondrial fatty acid and branched-chain amino acid acyl-CoA catabolism
rationale: Members are mitochondrial beta-oxidation, carnitine shuttle, ketone bodies, BCAA/lysine catabolism, PDH/OGDH/BCKDH complexes and their biotin/lipoate/CoA cofactors, unlike confusables centred on carnitine synthesis or cobalamin/thiamine/riboflavin vitamins.

qualifier: beta-oxidation, branched-chain amino acid and 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase steps
name: Mitochondrial beta-oxidation, branched-chain amino acid and 2-oxoacid catabolism
rationale: Members are mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation, ketone bodies, BCAA/lysine catabolism and PDH/OGDH/BCKDH complexes with their lipoyl, biotin, CoA and carnitine cofactors and inborn errors; BCAA and 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase content separates it from the B-vitamin and carnitine-synthesis neighbours.

name: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA metabolism via beta-oxidation and 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation, carnitine shuttle, ketone bodies, PDH/OGDH/BCKDH/OADH complexes with their lipoyl, biotin and CoA cofactors, and branched-chain amino acid catabolism defects; this separates it from B-vitamin cofactor and carnitine-synthesis/peroxisomal confusables.

name: Epidermal keratinization and ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte differentiation, cornification and hair, tooth, nail and gland development, unlike melanocyte MITF and intestinal epithelium confusables.

qualifier: epidermal keratinization and appendages (hair, tooth, nail, glands)
name: Epidermis and ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members span keratinocyte differentiation, cornification and hair, tooth, nail, sebaceous and placode development, distinguishing it from melanocyte/MITF, gut epithelium and NF-kB ectodermal dysplasia confusables.

name: Epidermal cornification and ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte differentiation, cornified envelope, hair follicle, tooth, nail, sebaceous and mammary placodes; this distinguishes it from melanocyte/MITF, intestinal epithelium and ectodermal-dysplasia confusables.

qualifier: adhesion via VWF-GPIb and collagen, agonist receptors, degranulation and aggregation
name: Platelet adhesion, activation, degranulation and aggregation
rationale: Members span platelet adhesion (VWF/GPIb, GPVI collagen), agonist receptor signaling (ADP, thrombin, thromboxane), degranulation and aggregation, distinct from coagulation-factor and generic G12/13-Rho confusables.

qualifier: collagen/VWF adhesion receptors and agonist receptors
name: Platelet adhesion, activation and aggregation signaling
rationale: Members span platelet adhesion via GPVI and GPIb-IX-V/VWF, agonist signalling (ADP, thrombin, thromboxane, prostacyclin) and degranulation, distinguishing it from G12/13-Rho confusables and coagulation-factor-defect confusables.

name: Platelet adhesion, activation and aggregation receptor signaling
rationale: Members are platelet receptor signaling (GPVI, GPIb-VWF, P2Y, PAR, TP, prostacyclin), degranulation and aggregation, unlike confusables focused on G12/13-Rho signaling or the plasma coagulation cascade.

name: Ubiquitin editing and deubiquitinase control of TNFR1-NF-kappaB signalling
rationale: Members combine TNFR1/NF-kappaB signalling regulation with deubiquitinase families, K48/K63/K11/linear chain editing and immune-protein SUMOylation, distinguishing it from confusables about IKK/TAK1 activation by TLR, NOD and TNFSF receptors.

name: Deubiquitinase-mediated ubiquitin editing in TNFR1-NF-kappaB signaling
rationale: Members pair deubiquitinase families and K11/K48/K63/linear chain control with TNFR1 and NF-kappaB regulation, whereas confusables cover TLR, NOD, TCR and non-canonical NF-kappaB kinase cascades without the DUB machinery.

name: Deubiquitinase control of TNFR1 and NF-kappaB signalling
rationale: Members combine TNFR1/NF-kappaB signalling regulation with deubiquitinase families and K48/K63/linear ubiquitin chain control; the deubiquitinase members are what the non-canonical NIK and TLR/IKK confusables lack.

qualifier: dendritic spines and arbors via postsynaptic actin
name: Dendritic spine and arbor structural plasticity via postsynaptic actin
rationale: Members regulate dendritic spine morphogenesis and maintenance, dendrite arborization, postsynaptic actin and density organization and reelin signalling, unlike the synapse-adhesion, LTP/memory and Rho GTPase confusables.

name: Dendrite arborization and dendritic spine structural plasticity
rationale: Members cover dendritic spine formation and maintenance, postsynaptic actin and receptor trafficking, dendrite branching, reelin and NMDAR-RAC1 signalling, distinguishing it from synapse-adhesion assembly, LTP/memory and Rho GTPase polarity confusables.

qualifier: reelin signaling and postsynaptic actin remodeling
name: Reelin-regulated dendrite arborization and postsynaptic spine structural plasticity
rationale: Members cover reelin signaling, dendrite arborization, spine morphogenesis and maintenance and postsynaptic actin/structure in plasticity, unlike synaptic adhesion/assembly, LTP/memory and Rho GTPase polarity confusables.

qualifier: kinesin/Miro motor transport and ER tubule shaping
name: Kinesin-driven organelle transport and ER tubular network shaping
rationale: Members are motor-based transport of mitochondria, vesicles and receptors along axons/dendrites plus ER tubular network formation, which confusables lack in favour of microtubule severing, tubulin modification or ER contact-site lipid transfer.

qualifier: kinesin motors and ER tubule shaping
name: Kinesin-driven organelle transport and ER tubular network shaping
rationale: Members cover kinesin/RHOT-dependent transport of mitochondria, vesicles and receptors in neurons plus ER tubular network and endolysosome size control, distinct from confusables on tubulin modification and ER contact-site lipid transfer.

qualifier: kinesin/Miro transport and ER tubular network shaping
name: Kinesin- and Miro-driven organelle transport and ER tubular network
rationale: Members are microtubule motor transport of mitochondria and vesicles in neurons (kinesins, RHOT1/2) and ER tubular network formation; confusables cover microtubule severing, ER contact-site tethering or tubulin modification.

name: Gastrointestinal and urinary smooth muscle contractility
rationale: Members concern smooth muscle contraction and relaxation in gut motility, peristalsis, micturition and stomach function (with tachykinin signalling), unlike histamine, serotonin or reproductive smooth muscle confusables.

name: Gastrointestinal and urinary smooth muscle contraction and relaxation
rationale: Members concern smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, peristalsis, gastric function and micturition, distinguishing it from serotonin, histamine and reproductive smooth muscle neighbours.

name: Gastrointestinal and urinary smooth muscle contraction and motility
rationale: Members cover smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, peristalsis, gastric motility, micturition and tachykinin signalling; confusables involve reproductive smooth muscle, serotonin or histamine receptors.

qualifier: transcriptional chaperone induction by ATF6, XBP1, ATF4, CREB3
name: ER unfolded protein response transcriptional chaperone induction
rationale: Members are the ER UPR arms activating chaperone and stress genes and their control of ER stress and beta-cell apoptosis; confusables instead carry stress translational control, mitochondrial UPR or negative UPR regulators.

qualifier: ATF6, XBP1 and ATF4 transcriptional arms
name: ER unfolded protein response via ATF6, XBP1 and ATF4
rationale: Members are ER-stress UPR signalling and its control of beta-cell and ER-stress apoptosis; the ATF6/CREB3, XBP1 and ATF4 chaperone gene activation distinguishes it from confusables centred on eIF2alpha kinases, mitochondrial UPR and translational control.

name: ER unfolded protein response transcription and beta-cell apoptosis
rationale: Members are XBP1/ATF4/ATF6/CREB3 transcriptional UPR outputs and regulation of ER-stress and beta-cell apoptosis; confusables add eIF2-kinase translational control and mitochondrial stress.

name: Presynaptic clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle endocytosis and recycling
rationale: Members regulate synaptic vesicle endocytosis, recycling, clustering, clathrin coat assembly/disassembly and active zone structure, lacking the docking/priming/release cycles and postsynaptic receptor trafficking of confusables.

name: Presynaptic clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle endocytosis and recycling
rationale: Members concern clathrin coat assembly/disassembly, synaptic vesicle endocytosis, clustering and recycling and active-zone structure, unlike confusables on vesicle docking/fusion, transmitter release cycles or postsynaptic receptor trafficking.

name: Presynaptic vesicle cycle with clathrin-mediated endocytosis
rationale: Members regulate presynaptic vesicle clustering, endocytosis and recycling with clathrin coat dynamics, unlike confusables on release-cycle docking/fusion or postsynaptic receptor trafficking.

name: mRNA stabilization and decapping-dependent 5'-3' decay
rationale: Members balance mRNA stabilization (CRD, IGF2BPs, 3'-UTR, inhibited deadenylation-dependent decay) against decapping and 5'-to-3' exonucleolytic decay, unlike confusables focused on deadenylation/P-bodies, ARE-binding destabilizers or nonsense-mediated decay and export.

name: mRNA stabilization and decapping-dependent 5'-3' decay
rationale: Members concern mRNA stabilization (CRD, IGF2BPs, 3'UTR) and decapping-driven 5'-to-3' decay, unlike confusables on deadenylation, ARE-binding destabilization or NMD/export.

name: mRNA stabilization by IGF2BPs and decapping-dependent 5'-3' decay
rationale: Members balance mRNA stabilisation (IGF2BPs, CRD, 3'-UTR) against decapping and 5'-3' exonucleolytic decay, distinguishing it from deadenylation, NMD and ARE-binding destabilisation confusables.

qualifier: glucuronate-xylulose pathway and its inborn errors
name: Fructose and glucuronate-xylulose catabolism and inborn errors
rationale: Members cover fructose catabolism and the glucuronate-to-xylulose-5-phosphate pathway with fructosuria, fructose intolerance and pentosuria, unlike the non-oxidative pentose phosphate and galactose confusables.

name: Glucuronate-xylulose pathway and fructose catabolism
rationale: Members are glucuronate-to-xylulose-5-phosphate metabolism and fructose catabolism with their inborn errors (pentosuria, fructosuria, fructose intolerance), unlike galactose and non-oxidative pentose phosphate confusables.

name: Fructose and glucuronate-xylulose catabolism and inborn errors
rationale: Members are fructose catabolism and the glucuronate-to-xylulose-5-phosphate pentose route with their inborn errors, unlike the galactose and non-oxidative pentose-phosphate confusables.

name: Mitochondrial transcription and mRNA stability
rationale: Members regulate mitochondrial transcription initiation/termination and mitochondrial mRNA processing, stability and decay, distinguishing them from mtDNA replication/repair and mitochondrial translation confusables.

name: Mitochondrial transcription and mitochondrial RNA stability
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial transcription initiation/termination and mitochondrial mRNA processing, stability and decay, distinguishing it from mtDNA replication/repair and mitochondrial translation/ribosome assembly confusables.

name: Mitochondrial transcription and RNA processing and decay
rationale: Members span mitochondrial transcription initiation/termination and mitochondrial mRNA processing, stability and catabolism; confusables instead cover mtDNA replication/repair or mitochondrial translation and ribosome assembly.

name: B cell gene modules with plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell and lymphocyte transcriptional modules plus plasma cell/immunoglobulin modules and plasma cell differentiation, whereas confusables add B cell surface signatures, germinal centre, ICOS and Tfh programmes.

name: B cell and plasma cell immunoglobulin signatures
rationale: Members are B cell and plasma cell gene modules with immunoglobulins and plasma cell differentiation control, which distinguishes it from confusables built on B cell surface, memory, germinal centre and Tfh signatures.

name: B cell and plasma cell immunoglobulin signatures
rationale: Members are B cell and plasma cell/immunoglobulin expression modules plus plasma cell differentiation, lacking the germinal centre, Tfh, memory and surface-signature members of the confusables.

name: Immunoregulatory IL-10, IL-27 and IL-35 signaling
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-27 and IL-35 signaling and IL-10/IL-12 production control, the suppressive cytokine axis, unlike confusables centred on IL-12/IL-23/IL-17 and fungal lectin signaling.

name: Immunosuppressive IL-10, IL-27 and IL-35 cytokine signaling
rationale: Members are IL-10 production/signaling, IL-27 and IL-35 signaling and suppression of IL-12 production, distinguishing it from confusables built on IL-12/IL-23/IL-17 or C-type lectin antifungal signaling.

qualifier: IL-10, IL-27 and IL-35 signaling with IL-10/IL-12 production control
name: Immunosuppressive IL-10, IL-27 and IL-35 signaling and production control
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-27 and IL-35 receptor signaling plus regulation of IL-10 production and suppression of IL-12, distinguishing it from confusables built on IL-12/IL-23, IL-17/Th17 and C-type lectin antifungal signaling.

name: Integrin and collagen receptor binding of extracellular matrix
rationale: Members combine ECM modules with integrin interactions, fibronectin matrix formation and collagen-activated receptor signaling, distinguishing it from stromal, elastic-fiber and complement ECM confusables.

name: Extracellular matrix assembly and integrin-collagen receptor signaling
rationale: Members combine ECM modules, fibronectin matrix formation, integrin interactions and collagen-activated receptor signaling, while confusables add stromal/EMT programmes or elastic fibres.

name: Integrin, fibronectin and collagen-receptor matrix interactions
rationale: Members are integrin cell-surface interactions, fibronectin matrix formation, collagen-activated receptor signalling and ECM modules, which elastic-fibre and stromal-programme confusables lack.

qualifier: with host silencing of endogenous retroelements
name: Retroviral DNA integration and host silencing of retroelements
rationale: Members cover HIV pre-integration complex import, integration and circle formation together with APOBEC3G, KRAB-ZFP and HUSH restriction of retroelements, whereas confusables cover HIV entry and reverse transcription or HCMV latency.

qualifier: with host retroelement silencing and restriction
name: Retroviral DNA integration and host retroelement restriction
rationale: Members cover HIV pre-integration complex import, integration and LTR circle formation together with HUSH/KRAB-ZFP retroelement silencing and APOBEC3G restriction, while confusables emphasise HIV entry/reverse transcription or HCMV latency and viral transcription.

qualifier: plus host silencing of endogenous retroelements
name: Retroviral DNA integration and host silencing of retroelements
rationale: Members cover HIV pre-integration import, integration, 2-LTR/autointegration circles and APOBEC3G restriction together with HUSH and KRAB-ZFP retroelement silencing, which the HIV-entry and HCMV/latency confusables lack.

name: T cell immunological synapse formation and polarization
rationale: Members concern immunological synapse assembly, raft localization, T cell polarity and Vav1/RHO cytoskeletal signaling downstream of CD28; the synapse and polarity focus distinguishes it from CORO1A-DEF6, antigen presentation and chemotaxis confusables.

name: T cell immunological synapse and polarity with CD28-Vav1 signaling
rationale: Members concern immunological synapse assembly, T cell polarity, raft localisation and lymphocyte aggregation, and CD28-Vav1 and Nef signaling distinguish it from CORO1A-DEF6, dendritic cell and homing confusables.

qualifier: T cell polarity with CD28–Vav1 signaling
name: T cell immunological synapse and polarity via CD28–Vav1
rationale: Members describe immunological synapse formation, T cell polarity, raft localization and lymphocyte aggregation, and the CD28-Vav1 and Nef signaling members are what neighbours with CORO1A-DEF6 networks lack.

qualifier: excision, mismatch and translesion repair plus nucleobase editing
name: Excision, mismatch and translesion repair and base editing
rationale: Members span BER, NER, MMR, translesion synthesis, direct damage reversal and deaminase-driven editing/demethylation (including somatic hypermutation), while the confusables are double-strand break repair, homologous recombination and NHEJ.

qualifier: excision repair, translesion synthesis and nucleobase editing, not double-strand breaks
name: Excision repair, translesion synthesis and nucleobase editing
rationale: Members span base and nucleotide excision repair, mismatch repair, translesion synthesis, damage reversal, DNA demethylation and cytidine/adenosine deamination (incl. somatic hypermutation), while confusables are double-strand break, homologous recombination and telomere pathways.

core: DNA excision repair and translesion synthesis
qualifier: with nucleobase deamination and editing, not double-strand break repair
name: Excision repair, translesion synthesis and nucleobase deamination
rationale: Members span base excision, nucleotide excision and mismatch repair, translesion synthesis, damage reversal and cytidine/adenosine deamination (APOBEC, editing, somatic hypermutation), whereas the confusables are dominated by double-strand break, homologous recombination, NHEJ and telomere repair.

qualifier: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases, branched-chain amino acids and ketone bodies
name: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA metabolism: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases, branched-chain amino acids, ketones
rationale: Members cover PDH/OGDH/OADH/BCKDH complexes and their lipoyl/biotin/CoA cofactors, branched-chain and lysine catabolism disorders, short-chain beta-oxidation and ketone bodies, unlike confusables on carnitine-dependent long-chain fatty acid oxidation or the malate-aspartate shuttle.

qualifier: branched-chain amino acid catabolism and cofactors
name: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA metabolism and branched-chain amino acid catabolism
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial acyl-CoA flux: BCAA/lysine catabolism and its disorders, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases with lipoate/biotin/CoA cofactors, ketone bodies and short-chain beta-oxidation, unlike carnitine/long-chain fatty acid and malate-aspartate shuttle neighbours.

qualifier: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and branched-chain amino acid breakdown
name: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA catabolism via 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and BCAA breakdown
rationale: Members are mitochondrial acyl-CoA-producing pathways (PDH/OGDH/BCKDH/OADH, BCAA and lysine catabolism, beta-oxidation, ketone bodies) with their cofactors and inborn errors, while confusables are carnitine-dependent fatty acid transport or malate-aspartate/carboxylate transport.

qualifier: RUNX1-regulated erythroid, megakaryocytic and granulocytic lineages
name: RUNX1-regulated erythroid, megakaryocytic and granulocytic hematopoiesis
rationale: Members span HSC maintenance and erythroid, megakaryocyte, granulocyte and other myeloid differentiation with many RUNX1 transcriptional programmes, which confusables centred on M-CSF/macrophage signalling or bone marrow development lack.

name: RUNX1-driven erythroid, megakaryocytic and granulocytic haematopoietic differentiation
rationale: Members cover HSC maintenance and erythroid, megakaryocyte and granulocyte lineage commitment with extensive RUNX1 transcriptional control, while confusables centre on M-CSF/macrophage signalling or bone marrow niche proliferation.

name: RUNX1-driven erythroid, megakaryocytic and granulocytic haematopoiesis
rationale: Members span RUNX-family transcription, stem/progenitor control and erythroid, megakaryocyte and granulocyte differentiation, whereas confusables emphasise M-CSF/macrophage or bone marrow development.

name: Camera-type eye development: retina, lens and ocular vasculature
rationale: Nearly all members concern morphogenesis and differentiation of eye tissues (retinal neurons and photoreceptors, lens, cornea, iris, eyelid, lacrimal gland, blood-retinal barrier, hyaloid regression); unlike the ear-development confusables it is ocular, and unlike the overlapping confusable it lacks phototransduction and retinoid-cycle function, being developmental.

name: Eye morphogenesis with photoreceptor and retinal neuron development
rationale: Nearly all members concern eye structures (retina, lens, cornea, iris, eyelid, lacrimal gland, ocular vessels and barriers); retinal neuron and photoreceptor differentiation separates it from the inner-ear/sensory-organ and phototransduction/retinoid neighbours.

qualifier: retinal neuron differentiation, lens and ocular vasculature
name: Eye development including retinal neurons, lens and vasculature
rationale: Nearly all members concern morphogenesis, differentiation or maintenance of eye tissues (retina, photoreceptors, lens, cornea, iris, retinal vessels and blood-retinal barrier); unlike the closest confusable it lacks phototransduction and retinoid metabolism, and unlike the others it lacks inner-ear development.

name: Nuclear pore transport, assembly and SUMOylation
rationale: Members concern nuclear pore complex assembly and nucleocytoplasmic traffic together with the SUMO conjugation cascade, distinguishing them from mRNA-export and nuclear envelope reformation confusables.

name: Nuclear pore transport and SUMO conjugation cycle
rationale: Members span nuclear pore complex assembly and nucleocytoplasmic import/export together with SUMO processing, conjugation and desumoylation, so the theme differs from mRNA-export, nuclear-envelope-breakdown and SUMO-target confusables by combining both.

core: Nuclear pore complex and nucleocytoplasmic transport
name: Nuclear pore transport and SUMO conjugation
rationale: Members combine nuclear pore assembly and nucleocytoplasmic transport (proteins, ribosomal subunits, inositol phosphates, HIV Rev) with the SUMO processing, conjugation and desumoylation cycle, which separates it from nuclear envelope, mRNA export and chromatin-SUMOylation confusables.

core: Sulfur amino acid and glutathione metabolism
qualifier: selenium compound metabolism and glutathione-cycle defects
name: Sulfur amino acid, glutathione and selenium compound metabolism
rationale: Members cover cysteine/transsulfuration, sulfide and H2S metabolism, glutathione synthesis, recycling, transport and its inherited defects, and selenium compound metabolism, which separate it from broad amino acid/urea-cycle, carnitine/choline and aromatic amino acid confusables.

core: Sulfur amino acid and glutathione metabolism
name: Sulfur amino acid, glutathione and selenium metabolism
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration, cysteine/sulfide catabolism, glutathione synthesis and turnover with their deficiencies, and selenium compound metabolism, unlike general amino acid, choline/carnitine or urea cycle confusables.

name: Sulfur amino acid, glutathione and selenium compound metabolism
rationale: Members span transsulfuration, cysteine/sulfide catabolism, glutathione synthesis/recycling defects and selenium compound metabolism, distinguishing it from carnitine/choline, aromatic amino acid and urea cycle confusables.

name: RUNX-driven granulopoiesis from myeloid progenitors
rationale: Members describe RUNX1/2/3-regulated transcription and the commitment of myeloid progenitors to neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell fates with granule programmes, which separates it from erythroid-megakaryocytic, monocyte-macrophage and M-CSF neighbours.

name: RUNX-driven transcriptional control of granulocytic myeloid differentiation
rationale: Members centre on RUNX1/2/3 and VENTX transcription governing progenitor commitment to neutrophil, eosinophil and mast lineages, unlike monocyte/DC, M-CSF or erythroid-megakaryocyte neighbours.

qualifier: RUNX-family transcriptional control, granulocyte/eosinophil/mast cell and progenitor stages
name: RUNX transcriptional control of myeloid progenitor and granulocyte differentiation
rationale: Members span RUNX1/2/3- and VENTX-driven transcription with myeloid progenitor proliferation and differentiation into neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell lineages; RUNX targets and granulocytic stages distinguish it from erythroid-megakaryocyte, monocyte-macrophage and CSF-signaling neighbours.

name: Glutathione metabolism and methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members cover glutathione synthesis, recycling, transport and their inherited defects plus glutathione-dependent methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and deglycase protein repair, distinguishing it from transsulfuration, ROS/NADPH and cofactor confusables.

name: Glutathione cycle and methylglyoxal-aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members cover glutathione synthesis, catabolism, transport and its enzyme defects plus glutathione-dependent methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and ferroptosis restraint, which the transsulfuration, ROS and vitamin-B6 confusables lack.

name: Glutathione synthesis, recycling and methylglyoxal detoxification
rationale: Members span the gamma-glutamyl cycle and its enzyme defects, cystine/glutathione transport, ferroptosis restraint and glutathione-dependent methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification with glycation protein repair; confusables center on vitamin B6/molybdenum cofactor, ROS/NADPH, or transsulfuration and selenium metabolism.

name: Sarcomere assembly and striated muscle contraction
rationale: Members are myofilament assembly, actin-myosin sliding and striated contraction in differentiating fibres, distinct from confusables on myoblast commitment, regeneration or neuromuscular junction formation.

name: Sarcomere assembly and striated muscle contraction
rationale: Members concern thick/thin filament organization, myofibril assembly and striated muscle contraction in differentiated fibres, whereas confusables focus on myoblast commitment, proliferation, regeneration or neuromuscular junction assembly.

name: Striated muscle sarcomere assembly and contraction
rationale: Members concern myosin/thin filament and myofibril assembly, actin-myosin sliding, contraction and stretch sensing within muscle fiber differentiation; confusables are myoblast proliferation/regeneration or NMJ formation.

name: Striated muscle adaptation: hypertrophy, atrophy and fiber-type switching
rationale: Members concern cardiac and skeletal muscle cell size control, atrophy, fiber-type transition and responses to activity or inactivity, distinguishing them from calcineurin-NFAT hypertrophy and myogenesis/contraction confusables.

name: Activity-dependent striated muscle size and fiber-type adaptation
rationale: Members cover muscle growth, atrophy, cell size, fiber-type transition and satellite-cell regeneration in response to activity, unlike confusables centred on calcineurin-NFAT, contraction or myogenesis.

qualifier: atrophy, hypertrophic growth and fiber-type switching
name: Striated muscle adaptation: atrophy, growth and fiber-type switching
rationale: Members concern muscle responses to activity and inactivity, cell size control, atrophy, regeneration and fiber-type transition, unlike confusables on calcineurin-NFAT hypertrophy signaling or myogenesis and contraction.

name: Craniofacial, limb, pharyngeal gland and spleen development
rationale: Members are face, palate, outer ear, limb and digit morphogenesis plus thyroid, parathyroid, thymus and spleen development, the organ components separating it from head-patterning, neural-crest outflow-tract and nose confusables.

qualifier: face, palate, limbs and pharyngeal-derived glands
name: Face, palate, limb and pharyngeal-derived organ morphogenesis
rationale: Members are embryonic morphogenesis of face, palate, outer ear, limbs/digits and pharyngeal-pouch organs (thymus, parathyroid, thyroid) plus spleen, unlike confusables on neural plate/head patterning or cardiac outflow.

qualifier: face, palate, limbs, pharyngeal glands, spleen
name: Embryonic face, limb, pharyngeal gland and spleen morphogenesis
rationale: All members are embryonic morphogenesis of face/palate/outer ear, limbs/digits, pharyngeal-derived glands (thyroid, parathyroid, thymus) and spleen, distinguishing it from neural plate/head patterning and cardiac neural crest confusables.

qualifier: downstream of insulin/IGF1 receptor and IRS
name: Insulin/IGF1 receptor IRS signalling activating PI3K-AKT
rationale: Members cover IRS/SHC/SOS adaptor events from IGF1R/insulin receptors leading to PI3K and AKT2 activation; confusables cover negative insulin regulation, ALK/LTK or MET/EPO receptor signalling.

qualifier: downstream of insulin/IGF1 receptor IRS signaling
name: Insulin/IGF1 receptor IRS signaling to PI3K/AKT activation
rationale: Members cover IRS/SHC/SOS events from insulin/IGF1 receptors leading to PI3K/AKT (AKT2) activation and glycogen synthesis, distinguished from confusables on negative insulin regulation, ALK/LTK or MET/EPO receptor signaling.

name: Insulin/IGF1 receptor-IRS signalling to PI3K-AKT
rationale: Members cover IRS/SHC/SOS signalling from IGF1R/insulin receptor to AKT2 activation and glycogen synthesis, unlike the MET, EPO and ALK receptor neighbours.

qualifier: positive regulation, PSD maintenance and receptor delivery
name: Promotion of postsynapse assembly and structural synaptic plasticity
rationale: All members build or strengthen the postsynaptic compartment (spine growth, PSD maintenance, receptor insertion, local translation, synapse maturation), whereas confusables emphasise dendritic arborization, negative spine regulation or calcium-driven LTP/LTD and memory.

name: Postsynapse assembly, maturation and positive structural plasticity
rationale: All members build or strengthen the postsynapse (spine morphogenesis, PSD maintenance, receptor transport, local translation, maturation), distinguishing it from confusables on LTP/LTD calcium, dendrite arborization or negative spine regulation.

name: Positive regulation of postsynaptic structural plasticity and maturation
rationale: All members promote postsynaptic structure (spines, PSD, actin, receptor delivery, local translation, maturation, plasticity), whereas confusables emphasise LTP/LTD calcium control, negative spine regulation or dendrite arborization.

qualifier: direct alkylation reversal and base excision gap-filling
name: Alkylation damage reversal and base excision gap-filling
rationale: Members are direct reversal of alkylation (ALKBH2/3, MGMT) and the polymerase gap-filling steps of short- and long-patch BER; confusables lack either the gap-filling steps or the direct reversal enzymes and instead have glycosylase or TET demethylation steps.

qualifier: BER repair synthesis and direct alkylation reversal
name: Base excision repair synthesis and alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members combine BER gap-filling (POLB/PCNA long patch, single-nucleotide) with ALKBH2/3 and MGMT alkylation reversal, a pairing that separates it from TET/TDG demethylation and glycosylase-recognition confusables.

name: Alkylation damage reversal and base excision gap-filling repair
rationale: Members are direct alkylation reversal (MGMT, ALKBH2/3) plus long-patch and single-nucleotide base excision repair gap-filling; confusables have TET/TDG demethylation or glycosylase recognition steps instead.

name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta clearance
rationale: Members cover microglial proliferation, migration, cytotoxicity and activation together with amyloid-beta and apoptotic cell clearance, with amyloid-beta clearance distinguishing it from microglia/efferocytosis and amyloid fibril confusables.

name: Microglial activation and clearance of amyloid-beta and apoptotic cells
rationale: Members cover microglial activation, migration, proliferation and cytotoxicity with apoptotic-cell and amyloid-beta clearance, the amyloid-beta clearance setting it apart from efferocytosis and DAP12 neighbours and the microglial terms from amyloid fibril neighbours.

qualifier: clearance of amyloid-beta and apoptotic cells
name: Microglial activation and clearance of amyloid-beta and apoptotic cells
rationale: Members cover microglial activation, proliferation, migration and cytotoxicity with amyloid-beta and apoptotic-cell clearance, distinguishing it from efferocytosis-recognition, amyloid fibril and DAP12 neighbours.

qualifier: anti-inflammatory and host-defense responses to protozoa
name: Macrophage anti-inflammatory and host defense against protozoa

name: Cytochrome P450 vitamin D and retinoic acid metabolism

name: Vitamin D metabolism and cytochrome P450 vitamin-hydroxylase defects

name: Folate and tetrahydrofolate one-carbon metabolism

qualifier: single-strand annealing, MMEJ and presynaptic RAD51 loading

name: DNA end resection and presynaptic double-strand break repair

name: Vitamin E, vitamin K and quinone metabolism
rationale: Members are transport and metabolism of tocopherol, vitamin K/menaquinone and ubiquinol/quinones, unlike confusables on cholesterol/mevalonate synthesis or gamma-carboxylation.

name: Mitochondrial depolarization in apoptosis and nucleotide synthesis control

qualifier: IL-6, IL-8, TNF output and IL-1 signaling regulation

name: IL-1/Toll-regulated production of IL-6, IL-8 and TNF

name: Toll/IL-1 receptor regulation of IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production
rationale: Members regulate Toll and IL-1 signalling and production of IL-6, IL-8, TNF and IL-1 alpha, unlike neighbours on TLR3/4, CD40 or inflammasome regulation.

core: Neuronal calcium entry and intercellular signaling
qualifier: inhibitory metabotropic glutamate receptor and gap junction coupling
name: Neuronal calcium entry and intercellular signaling
rationale: A loose theme of neural signaling: calcium import and channel control, inhibitory mGluR signaling, electrical gap-junction and neuron-glia communication (visual behavior is a weak fit); it lacks the presynaptic GABA/kainate and connexin-trafficking content of its confusables.

core: Neuronal calcium entry and intercellular signaling
qualifier: gap junction transmission and Gi-coupled glutamate receptor
name: Neuronal calcium entry, gap junction and Gi-coupled glutamate signaling

name: Neuronal calcium influx with metabotropic glutamate and gap-junction signaling

qualifier: adenylate cyclase cAMP and phospholipase C IP3/calcium
name: GPCR second-messenger generation via adenylate cyclase and phospholipase C
rationale: All members concern GPCR coupling to cAMP synthesis and to PLC/IP3/calcium production, distinct from neighbours on adrenergic inhibition, downstream PKA/PDE effectors or Wnt/lysophospholipid calcium signalling.

qualifier: complexes III and IV with inner membrane insertion

qualifier: complex III and IV, inner membrane insertion

qualifier: global-genome and transcription-coupled incision of UV damage

rationale: Members cover lamina depolymerization, nuclear membrane breakdown, reformation and ESCRT-III sealing with midbody abscission, unlike confusables about contractile ring cytokinesis, chromosome condensation or SUMOylation.

name: Proximal–distal nephron patterning from comma- and S-shaped bodies

qualifier: creatine and nucleoside kinases with mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
name: Creatine and nucleotide phosphotransfer with mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange

name: Nucleotide phosphotransfer, creatine shuttle and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange

name: Immediate-early stress response to UV, phorbol ester and TNF

qualifier: Tfh help and plasma cell differentiation
name: Germinal centre Tfh help and plasma cell differentiation

qualifier: Tfh/ICOS help and plasma cell differentiation
name: Germinal center Tfh help and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover germinal center B cell and Tfh differentiation, ICOS co-stimulation and plasma cell/immunoglobulin modules, distinguishing the theme from confusables on naive/memory B cell signatures and B cell proliferation.

qualifier: germinal center and plasma cell differentiation
name: Germinal center reaction and plasma cell differentiation

name: IL-2, IL-7, IL-15 and IL-21 gamma-chain cytokine signaling

name: Cationic amino acid transport and arginine-ornithine metabolism

name: Rho-ROCK/PAK actin stress fibers in matrix adhesion

core: Integrin–fibronectin cell–matrix adhesion and stress fibres
qualifier: Rho GTPase activation of ROCK and PAK

name: snRNP biogenesis, mRNA splicing, 3'-end processing and export

name: Neuropeptide regulation of sleep, stress and social behaviors
rationale: Members link neuropeptides (orexin, relaxin, CRH) to sleep/wake, stress, mating, aggression and parental behavior, unlike opioid synaptic signaling or HPA hormone secretion confusables.

name: SUMO conjugation cascade and SUMOylation of nuclear proteins

qualifier: SUMO conjugation cascade and nuclear substrates
name: Protein SUMOylation cascade and nuclear SUMO targets
rationale: Members cover SUMO processing, E1/E2 conjugation, desumoylation and SUMOylation of transcription, chromatin, DNA repair and nuclear envelope proteins, whereas confusables concern nuclear pore and nucleocytoplasmic transport.

name: DNA replication initiation and replication-associated genome maintenance

name: S-phase DNA replication with checkpoint and replication-coupled repair
rationale: Members cover replication initiation, DNA unwinding, polymerase regulation, intra-S checkpoint, break-induced replication and recombination-intermediate resolution with E2F/mitosis gene sets, distinguishing it from confusables on telomere maintenance, cohesion, DNA topology or the broad cell cycle.

name: Cell-cycle DNA replication initiation and replication-associated genome stability
rationale: Members cover replication initiation, unwinding, mitotic DNA replication, intra-S checkpoint and break-induced replication/DNA stability, narrower than the broad cell-cycle confusable and distinct from telomere and cohesion confusables.

qualifier: including oncogenic BRAF/RAF1/MAP2K and RAS mutants
name: RAF-MEK-ERK kinase activation and its oncogenic mutants

name: RAF-to-MAPK cascade activation, including oncogenic BRAF/RAF1/MEK mutants
rationale: Members cover RAF activation, MEK/ERK and RSK activation and RAF/MAP2K/MRAS mutant signaling, whereas confusables focus on upstream RAS-GAP/SOS regulation, integrin linkage or ERK inhibition.

qualifier: oncogenic RAF, MEK and RAS mutants
name: RAF–MEK–ERK activation including oncogenic RAF and MEK mutants
rationale: Members concern RAF activation and MAP2K/MAPK/RSK signalling including BRAF/RAF1 mutants, fusions and MRAS-SHOC2 complexes, unlike neighbours on RAS regulation by GAPs/SOS or ERK negative regulation.

core: Ubiquitin-dependent receptor endocytosis and lysosomal downregulation
name: Ubiquitin-mediated endocytic downregulation of EGFR/ERBB receptors

name: Ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation of EGFR/ERBB receptors
rationale: Members cover ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis and MVB sorting that terminate EGFR, ERBB2:ERBB3 and ERBB4 signaling, distinguishing it from MET/PTK6 signaling and from general ESCRT membrane-fission themes.

core: ubiquitin-dependent receptor endocytosis and lysosomal sorting
name: Ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation of ERBB-family receptors
rationale: Members describe ubiquitin-dependent internalisation and MVB/lysosomal sorting that terminates EGFR/ERBB2-4 signaling, unlike confusables about ESCRT/exosome machinery, AKT/PTEN, or MET/PTK6 signaling.

name: CSF1 and GM-CSF signaling in monocyte-macrophage differentiation
rationale: Members are M-CSF/GM-CSF and interleukin receptor signaling driving monocyte, macrophage and myeloid dendritic cell differentiation, unlike neighbours on osteoclast fusion, SIRP/DAP12 signaling or G-CSF granulopoiesis.

name: CSF1 and GM-CSF signaling in monocyte-macrophage differentiation

name: CSF1 and GM-CSF signaling in monocyte-macrophage differentiation

name: Regulation of Fas and TRAIL death receptor apoptosis

qualifier: Fas and TRAIL in T cells and hepatocytes
name: Fas/TRAIL death receptor apoptosis regulation in lymphocytes and hepatocytes

name: Regulation of Fas/TRAIL death receptor-induced apoptosis
rationale: All members concern Fas/FasL and TRAIL death-receptor apoptotic signalling and its positive/negative regulation (T-cell AICD, thymocyte and hepatocyte apoptosis, BID activation), whereas confusables centre on caspase-8/c-FLIP and T-cell signalling modules.

qualifier: monocyte and neutrophil innate effector state
name: Monocyte and neutrophil myeloid identity and activation

core: myeloid lineage identity and activation expression modules
qualifier: monocyte and neutrophil effector and degradative program, not surface-marker or TLR-inflammatory modules
name: Monocyte-neutrophil myeloid identity and activation program

core: monocyte and macrophage lineage identity programme in blood
qualifier: lineage-specifying and defense effector genes, not surface marker or inflammatory response sets
name: Monocyte-macrophage lineage identity and innate defense effector program
rationale: All members are blood expression modules or processes marking the mature monocyte-macrophage-neutrophil compartment and its defense machinery, while the confusables are instead monocyte and dendritic cell surface signatures, neutrophil degranulation and inflammatory response sets, or TLR inflammatory signalling.

name: Cullin neddylation, COP9 deneddylation and RHOBTB adaptor cycles

name: Cullin-RING ligase neddylation cycle and RHOBTB GTPases
rationale: Members concern cullin neddylation/deneddylation by the COP9 signalosome, a CUL1 substrate and the RHOBTB CUL3 adaptors, unlike confusables on PD-L1 degradation or generic proteolysis.

core: Cullin neddylation and COP9 signalosome deneddylation
name: Cullin neddylation-COP9 deneddylation cycle and RHOBTB GTPases

name: Phosphorylation and ubiquitin control of p53 stability

name: Phosphorylation-dependent control of p53 and Cdc25A degradation

qualifier: checkpoint kinase phosphorylation controlling p53 and Cdc25A stability
name: Checkpoint kinase phosphorylation control of p53 and Cdc25A stability
rationale: Members concern phosphorylation/dephosphorylation-dependent control of TP53 activity and degradation, COP1 and Cdc25A turnover, and p53-driven DNA repair genes, unlike neighbours on G2/M checkpoint progression or AKT targets.

name: Glutamate-family amino acid metabolism centered on proline

name: Non-mitochondrial RNA methylation, pseudouridylation and Cajal body targeting

qualifier: nucleolar/cytosolic methylation and pseudouridylation with Cajal body targeting

qualifier: nuclear-cytosolic, with snoRNP Cajal body localization
name: Nuclear-cytosolic RNA modification and Cajal body snoRNA localization
rationale: Members are rRNA/tRNA/mRNA/snRNA methylation and pseudouridylation with snoRNP assembly and Cajal body targeting, unlike rRNA cleavage/decay and mitochondrial RNA modification neighbours.

core: Lipid droplet triglyceride storage and mobilization
name: Adipocyte lipid droplet triglyceride storage and mobilization

name: Lipid droplet dynamics, lipophagy and adipocyte triglyceride storage

name: 3'UTR-binding protein control of mRNA stability and translation

core: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and translation
name: 3'UTR RNA-binding protein control of mRNA stability and translation

name: Notch O-glycosylation and heparan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthesis

core: Protein glycosylation of proteoglycans and Notch
qualifier: heparan sulfate plus Notch/TSR O-fucose and O-glucose

qualifier: Notch and TSR O-fucose/O-glucose plus heparan sulfate
name: Notch and TSR O-glycosylation with heparan sulfate synthesis

name: Tricarboxylic acid cycle and iron-sulfur cluster enzyme maturation
rationale: Members are TCA intermediates and steps (isocitrate, 2-oxoglutarate, succinate, malate, SDH to ubiquinone) plus Fe-S cluster assembly and TCA enzyme maturation, which the PDH/CoA, malate-aspartate shuttle and 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase confusables lack.

qualifier: iron-sulfur cluster assembly and oxidative phosphorylation
name: TCA cycle with iron–sulfur cluster assembly and oxidative phosphorylation
rationale: Members cover TCA intermediates (isocitrate, 2-oxoglutarate, succinate, malate), TCA enzyme maturation with Fe-S cluster assembly, succinate dehydrogenase electron transport and ATP synthesis, unlike neighbours on 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase lipoylation, PDH/CoA or the malate-aspartate shuttle.

qualifier: iron-sulfur cluster assembly and succinate-linked respiration
name: TCA cycle intermediates and iron-sulfur cluster assembly
rationale: Members are TCA intermediates (isocitrate, 2-oxoglutarate, succinate, malate), TCA enzyme maturation, Fe-S cluster assembly and succinate-to-ubiquinone/ATP synthesis, which the PDH/CoA, malate-aspartate shuttle and lipoylation confusables lack.

name: Pancreatic progenitor and neuroendocrine lineage differentiation

qualifier: progenitor lineages to endocrine, exocrine and ductal cells

name: Pancreatic progenitor, ductal and endocrine cell lineage development

qualifier: negative regulation of VEGF-driven endothelial responses

rationale: Members all inhibit endothelial proliferation, chemotaxis, migration and VEGF production/signaling in sprouting angiogenesis, unlike confusables featuring positive regulation, Tie2 or VEGFR2 signaling itself.

qualifier: sterol feedback on synthesis and LDL receptor uptake
name: Sterol feedback on cholesterol synthesis and lipoprotein receptor uptake
rationale: Members concern sterol sensing, SREBP control of cholesterol synthesis and LXR-driven limits on LDLR/VLDLR uptake, unlike confusables on generic receptor endocytosis/LDL clearance or HDL reverse cholesterol transport.

qualifier: SREBP sensing and lipoprotein receptor uptake
name: Sterol-sensing control of cholesterol synthesis and LDL receptor uptake

qualifier: biosynthesis control and lipoprotein receptor uptake
name: Cholesterol homeostasis via biosynthesis control and lipoprotein receptor uptake

name: Integrin-fibronectin adhesion, cell spreading and stress fiber formation
rationale: Members share integrin/syndecan-matrix adhesion, fibronectin assembly, spreading, stress fibers and MET-FAK/tensin signalling, whereas confusables add collagen/TGFB, EMT, focal adhesion or ROCK/PAK modules.

name: Integrin-fibronectin adhesion and spreading with MET-FAK/tensin signalling
rationale: Members share integrin/syndecan-based substrate adhesion, fibronectin matrix, stress fibres and cell spreading/migration, and the MET-PTK2 and MET-tensin members are what the matrix, EMT and RHO effector confusables lack.

name: Integrin-fibronectin adhesion and spreading with MET-FAK signaling
rationale: Members share integrin/syndecan-fibronectin adhesion, stress fibres, spreading and migration, and only this theme includes MET coupling to PTK2 and tensins.

qualifier: with negative feedback on FGF receptors
name: FGFR3 signaling and negative feedback on FGF receptors
rationale: Members are FGFR3 ligand activation, FRS/SHC cascades and activating mutants plus Sprouty/FGFRL1 inhibition of FGF signaling, distinguishing it from FGFR1/2/4 or PI3K/PLC cascade confusables.

name: FGFR3 activation and signaling with negative FGF feedback
rationale: Members are FGFR3 ligand binding, mutant activation and FRS/SHC cascades plus Sprouty and FGFRL1 inhibition, which the FGFR1/2/4 and PI3K/PLC cascade confusables lack.

qualifier: negative feedback on FGF receptors (Sprouty, FGFRL1)
name: FGFR3 signalling and negative feedback of FGF receptors
rationale: Members are FGFR3 ligand binding, FRS/SHC cascades and activating mutants plus Sprouty/FGFRL1 negative regulation; FGFR3 and the negative-feedback arm distinguish it from FGFR1/2/4 and PI3K/PLC cascade confusables.

qualifier: sperm mitochondrial sheath and Sertoli barrier
name: Germ cell development, sperm mitochondrial sheath and Sertoli barrier
rationale: Members span primordial germ cell migration, germ cell proliferation/death and meiotic entry through sperm mitochondrial sheath assembly and Sertoli barrier formation; confusables are gonadal somatic cell/oocyte maturation or sperm motility.

qualifier: PGC migration, meiotic entry and sperm mitochondrial sheath
name: Germ cell migration, meiotic entry and sperm mitochondrial sheath
rationale: Members cover primordial germ cell migration, germ cell proliferation and death, Sertoli barrier, meiosis activation and sperm mitochondrial sheath assembly, unlike confusables on Leydig/Sertoli development, oocyte maturation or sperm motility.

qualifier: Sertoli barrier and sperm mitochondrial sheath
name: Germ cell development, Sertoli barrier and sperm mitochondrial sheath
rationale: Members follow germ cells from migration and meiotic entry to sperm mitochondrial sheath, with the Sertoli barrier; confusables cover Leydig/Sertoli proliferation, oocyte maturation or sperm motility.

qualifier: skin morphogenesis and sebaceous gland development
name: Skin morphogenesis, keratinocyte differentiation and barrier formation
rationale: Members cover skin and epidermis morphogenesis, keratinocyte development, cornified envelope assembly, ABCA12 ichthyosis and barrier establishment, while confusables focus on keratinocyte proliferation control, desmosome/hemidesmosome adhesion or lipoxygenase lipid synthesis.

qualifier: keratinocyte development and skin barrier formation
name: Epidermal morphogenesis, keratinocyte development and skin barrier formation
rationale: Members cover epidermis and skin morphogenesis, keratinocyte differentiation, cornified envelope and barrier establishment (with sebaceous gland and ABCA12 ichthyosis), unlike confusables on keratinocyte proliferation, cell adhesion or lipoxygenase metabolism.

name: Skin and sebaceous gland morphogenesis with epidermal barrier formation
rationale: Members concern keratinocyte development, cornified envelope and skin barrier plus epidermis/skin/sebaceous gland morphogenesis; neighbours focus on keratinocyte proliferation control, cornification, adhesion junctions or lipoxygenase ichthyosis.

name: Netrin-DCC and ephrin growth cone guidance signaling
rationale: Members are netrin attraction/repulsion, ephrin/EPHA growth cone collapse, RAC1 activation and axon fasciculation, distinguishing it from L1, ROBO-SLIT and non-neuronal ephrin repulsion confusables.

name: Netrin-DCC and ephrin axon guidance signaling
rationale: Members cover netrin/DCC attraction and repulsion and ephrin/EPHA growth cone collapse with Rac1 activation and fasciculation, distinct from confusables built on L1 or ROBO-SLIT guidance.

qualifier: netrin and ephrin cues with fasciculation
name: Netrin and ephrin-driven axon guidance and fasciculation
rationale: Members are netrin/DCC attraction and repulsion, ephrin-induced growth cone collapse, Rac1 activation and fasciculation, distinguishing it from L1 and ROBO-SLIT confusables.

qualifier: ovulation, corpus luteum formation/regression and progesterone
name: Ovulation, luteal function and progesterone in ovarian cycle
rationale: Members cover ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis, estrous cycling and progesterone synthesis/response, distinct from follicle growth, gonadotropin and germ cell neighbours.

name: Ovulation, corpus luteum function and progesterone signaling
rationale: Members cover the estrous cycle, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis and progesterone synthesis/response, distinguishing it from gonadotropin, follicle growth and male gonad confusables.

name: Ovulation, corpus luteum function and progesterone signaling
rationale: Members cover ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis, progesterone synthesis and response and the estrous cycle; confusables cover male gonad development, follicle growth/oocyte maturation and gonadotropin control.

name: VEGF- and Tie2-driven angiogenesis and endothelial differentiation
rationale: Members concern endothelial proliferation, migration, differentiation and sprouting angiogenesis via VEGF/VEGFR and Tie2, whereas confusables concern smooth muscle, shear stress, BMP or cardiac/pulmonary artery morphogenesis.

qualifier: driven by VEGF and Tie2 signaling
name: Endothelial angiogenesis and vessel morphogenesis via VEGF and Tie2
rationale: Members regulate endothelial differentiation, sprouting, proliferation and vessel patterning with VEGF/VEGFR, neuropilin and Tie2 signaling, unlike smooth muscle, shear stress and BMP-driven cardiovascular confusables.

name: VEGF and Tie2 regulated angiogenesis and endothelial cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover VEGF/VEGFR2, neuropilin and Tie2 signaling, sprouting angiogenesis, endothelial proliferation, fate and arterial/venous/lymphatic specification, distinguishing the theme from BMP-driven cardiac vascular morphogenesis and smooth muscle/shear stress confusables.

core: Endocrine control of feeding and growth
qualifier: leptin, growth hormone, prolactin and glucocorticoid axes
name: Endocrine control of appetite, body growth and glucocorticoid secretion
rationale: Members are leptin/ghrelin appetite control, GH/prolactin receptor signaling and cortisol/ACTH secretion, unlike GI peptide GPCR, neuropeptide behavior and stress-response confusables.

core: Endocrine control of growth, appetite and glucocorticoids
qualifier: GH, prolactin and leptin receptor signaling
name: GH, prolactin and leptin signaling; growth, appetite, glucocorticoid control
rationale: Members combine GH, prolactin and leptin JAK-STAT receptor signaling with ghrelin, feeding behavior, body growth and ACTH/glucocorticoid secretion, distinguishing it from neuropeptide-behavior, gut GPCR hormone and stress-response confusables.

core: Neuroendocrine control of feeding and growth
qualifier: leptin, growth hormone, prolactin and glucocorticoid axes
name: Neuroendocrine control of feeding, growth and glucocorticoid secretion
rationale: Members are leptin/ghrelin appetite regulation, GH/prolactin receptor signaling and growth, and ACTH-cortisol secretion/response, distinguishing from neuropeptide behaviour, gut hormone GPCR or stress-only HPA confusables.

core: Striated muscle sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling
qualifier: SERCA uptake, ryanodine release and sodium-calcium exchange
name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling and sodium-calcium exchange in muscle
rationale: Members regulate SR calcium import, sequestration and ryanodine-receptor release, Na/Ca exchange and the resulting cardiac/skeletal contraction and relaxation, distinguishing the theme from confusables focused on plasma-membrane calcium flux, fiber-type switching or caffeine responses.

qualifier: cardiac contraction, relaxation and heart rate
name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling in cardiac contractility
rationale: Members regulate SR calcium uptake/release (SERCA, ryanodine receptor, Na/Ca exchange) and resulting cardiac force, relaxation and rate; confusables address plasma-membrane calcium flux, fiber-type or caffeine/calcium responses instead.

core: Cardiac and striated muscle calcium handling
qualifier: sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium sequestration, release and Na/Ca exchange
name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling in heart contraction and relaxation
rationale: Members regulate cytosolic calcium via SR/ER sequestration, ryanodine-receptor release and Na+/Ca2+ exchange to control cardiac (and skeletal) contraction, relaxation and rate, distinguishing them from confusables about plasma-membrane calcium flux, caffeine response and fibre-type switching.

core: ER protein targeting and quality control
qualifier: SRP and tail-anchored insertion, retention and exit
name: SRP and tail-anchored ER targeting, retention and quality control
rationale: Members cover SRP-dependent and post-translational ER targeting, membrane insertion, ER retention, exit and quality control, unlike confusables on ERAD or COPII transport.

qualifier: SRP and tail-anchored targeting, insertion and retention
name: ER protein targeting, membrane insertion and quality control
rationale: Members cover SRP-dependent and tail-anchored protein targeting and insertion into the ER, folding, ER retention/exit and ERQC, unlike COPII export and ERAD confusables.

qualifier: SRP and tail-anchored membrane insertion, retention and quality control
name: ER protein targeting, membrane insertion and quality control
rationale: Members cover SRP-dependent and tail-anchored targeting/insertion into the ER, ER retention, quality control and exit, unlike confusables centred on COPII export or ERAD.

name: Mitotic centrosome maturation, microtubule nucleation and anchoring
rationale: Members concern centrosome protein recruitment (AURKA-TPX2, NuMA, Nlp), centrosome positioning and MTOC microtubule nucleation/anchoring for spindle assembly, unlike broad mitosis, APC/C and spindle orientation/cilium confusables.

qualifier: mitotic maturation, positioning and spindle assembly
name: Centrosome maturation, positioning and microtubule nucleation for spindle assembly
rationale: Members concern mitotic centrosome protein recruitment, AURKA-TPX2, microtubule nucleation/anchoring, centrosome positioning and spindle assembly, unlike confusables on chromosome cohesion/condensation, cilia/centriole duplication, spindle orientation and APC/C.

name: Centrosome maturation, positioning and microtubule nucleation in mitosis
rationale: Members cover mitotic centrosome protein recruitment, centrosome location, microtubule nucleation/anchoring and spindle assembly, unlike APC/C mitotic progression (C1, C2) and spindle orientation/cilia (C3, C4) confusables.

qualifier: maternal mRNA clearance and piRNA silencing
name: Maternal-to-zygotic transition and piRNA transposon silencing
rationale: Members cover oocyte construction, maternal mRNA decay, zygotic genome activation, zygotic epigenetic programming/imprinting and piRNA silencing, distinguishing it from spermatogenesis/germline and general mRNA decay confusables.

qualifier: oocyte piRNA transposon silencing and maternal mRNA clearance
name: Maternal-to-zygotic transition and oocyte piRNA transposon silencing
rationale: Members cover oocyte construction, maternal mRNA decay, zygotic genome activation and zygotic epigenetic programming with piRNA silencing, distinct from male germline/spermatogenesis and general mRNA-decay confusables.

qualifier: maternal mRNA clearance and piRNA genome defense
name: Maternal-to-zygotic transition and piRNA germline genome defense
rationale: Members concern oocyte construction, maternal mRNA decay, zygotic genome activation and zygotic epigenetic programming together with piRNA biogenesis and transposon silencing, unlike confusables limited to mRNA deadenylation or centred on spermatogenesis and primordial germ cells.

name: Mitochondrial RNA modification, pseudouridylation and mitoribosome assembly
rationale: Members concern mitochondrial tRNA/rRNA/mRNA processing and modification, RNA pseudouridylation and mitoribosome assembly, unlike tRNA aminoacylation and mitochondrial transcription/replication confusables.

qualifier: modification and processing with mitoribosome assembly and pseudouridylation
name: Mitochondrial RNA modification, processing and mitoribosome assembly with pseudouridylation
rationale: Members concern processing and modification of mitochondrial tRNA, rRNA and mRNA, pseudouridine synthesis and mitoribosome subunit assembly, distinguishing it from aminoacylation/translation, cytosolic tRNA and mtDNA transcription/replication confusables.

name: Mitochondrial RNA modification, pseudouridylation and mitoribosome assembly
rationale: Members are mitochondrial tRNA/rRNA/mRNA modification and processing, pseudouridine synthesis and mitoribosome subunit assembly, unlike confusables on cytosolic tRNA processing/aminoacylation, mitochondrial translation or broad mitochondrial gene expression.

name: SWI/SNF (BAF) complex assembly and nucleosome remodeling
rationale: Members are formation of the cBAF, pBAF, ncBAF, esBAF and neuronal BAF complexes plus CHD1/2 and nucleosome organisation/assembly, distinguishing it from histone acetylation, CHD6-9 and NuRD neighbours.

qualifier: BAF complex assembly and replication-coupled nucleosome organization
name: BAF remodeler assembly and replication-coupled nucleosome organization
rationale: Members are SWI/SNF BAF variants and CHD1/2 remodelers acting on nucleosome assembly/disassembly, with replication-dependent chromatin assembly and repair regulation that the NuRD/CHD7, stem-cell and acetylation neighbours lack.

qualifier: BAF and CHD nucleosome organization and chromatin assembly
name: BAF and CHD nucleosome remodeling and chromatin assembly
rationale: Members are BAF complex assembly and CHD1/2 remodelers acting on nucleosome organization and replication-coupled chromatin assembly; the nucleosome/chromatin assembly members are what the BAF-sharing confusables lack.

name: Epidermal cornification and skin barrier formation
rationale: Members are keratinocyte terminal differentiation, cornified envelope cross-linking, barrier establishment and epidermal/sebaceous morphogenesis, unlike confusables on hair follicle, keratinocyte proliferation control, adhesion junctions or lipoxygenase lipids.

name: Epidermal cornification and skin barrier formation
rationale: Members are cornified envelope assembly, keratinocyte differentiation and skin barrier/epidermal morphogenesis, whereas confusables add keratinocyte proliferation control, hair follicle, cell adhesion and epidermal lipoxygenase pathways.

name: Epidermal cornification and skin barrier formation
rationale: Members are keratinocyte cornified envelope assembly, cross-linking and skin barrier/epidermis morphogenesis, unlike confusables on adhesion junctions, lipoxygenase lipids or keratinocyte proliferation control.

name: Glutamate, aspartate and alanine metabolism feeding gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members are glutamate/glutamine, aspartate and alanine metabolism linked to oxaloacetate and gluconeogenesis, unlike TCA, glycine-conjugation or proline confusables.

qualifier: glutamate, glutamine, alanine and aspartate linked to gluconeogenesis
name: Glutamate-centred amino acid nitrogen metabolism and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members cover glutamate, glutamine, alanine, aspartate and asparagine metabolism, oxaloacetate, nitrogen utilisation and gluconeogenesis, whereas confusables involve proline/glycine metabolism, glycine conjugation or the TCA cycle.

name: Glutamate, alanine and aspartate metabolism linked to gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members cover glutamate/glutamine, alanine and aspartate/asparagine metabolism, nitrogen utilisation, oxaloacetate and gluconeogenesis, distinct from confusables on glycine conjugation, TCA intermediates or proline/glyoxylate metabolism.

name: Stress granule dynamics and mRNA stabilization
rationale: Members cover stress granule assembly, localization and disassembly (PKR, arsenite, PML bodies) together with IGF2BP/CRD-mediated mRNA stabilization, whereas confusables centre on ARE-mediated mRNA decay and destabilization.

qualifier: with mRNA stabilization and translation under stress
name: Stress granule dynamics and stress-induced mRNA stabilization
rationale: Members cover stress granule assembly, localization and disassembly, PKR and arsenite stress, and mRNA-stabilizing or translation-promoting RNA binding, unlike confusables centred on ARE-mediated mRNA destabilization and decay.

name: Stress granule dynamics and mRNA stabilization
rationale: Members cover stress granule assembly, disassembly and arsenite/PKR stress responses together with IGF2BP/CRD-mediated mRNA stabilization and translation, while confusables carry only one half and add mRNA destabilization and decay.

name: Neuropeptide signaling in sleep-wake regulation
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide (orexin/NPFF/QRFP) G-protein signaling with REM, non-REM and wakefulness regulation, distinct from confusables on social, feeding and opioid behaviours.

name: Orexin-neuropeptide regulation of sleep-wake states
rationale: Members regulate REM/non-REM sleep and wakefulness through orexin/NPFF/QRFP neuropeptide G-protein signalling, while confusables concern feeding, social/mating behaviour or opioid synaptic signalling.

name: Neuropeptide G-protein signalling in sleep-wake regulation
rationale: Members combine orexin/neuropeptide receptor signalling and G-protein activation with control of REM, non-REM sleep and wakefulness, whereas confusables link neuropeptides to feeding, mating or other behaviours.

qualifier: via PI3K, RAC1 and CDK5 effectors
name: BDNF/NTF3-TRKB signaling via PI3K, RAC1 and CDK5
rationale: All members concern BDNF/NTF3 activation of NTRK2 and its PI3K/AKT, RAC1 and CDK5 outputs, unlike the TRKB FRS2/PLCG1/RAS-branch theme, the TRKA/NGF themes and the NMDAR-RAC1 synaptic plasticity theme.

qualifier: via PI3K, RAC1 and CDK5 branches
name: TRKB signaling through PI3K, RAC1 and CDK5
rationale: All members concern BDNF/NTF3 signaling through the NTRK2 (TRKB) receptor, and the theme is set apart from TRKA/ERK5, FRS2/PLCG1/RAS-branch TRKB and synaptic actin-plasticity confusables by its PI3K/AKT, RAC1 and CDK5 effector arms.

qualifier: via PI3K, CDK5 and RAC1 branches
name: TrkB neurotrophin signaling via PI3K, CDK5 and RAC1
rationale: All members concern BDNF/NT-3 activation of NTRK2 (TrkB) and its downstream PI3K/AKT, CDK5 and RAC1 outputs, which separates it from the NGF/TrkA theme and from the TrkB theme built on FRS2, PLCG1 and RAS branches.

name: IL-10 family, type III interferon and IL-12/IL-23 signaling
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-20 family and interferon-lambda plus IL-12/IL-23 signaling, distinguished from confusables by type III interferon and IL-20 family members.

name: IL-10 family, type III interferon and IL-12/IL-23 signaling
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-20-family and interferon-lambda signaling plus IL-12/IL-23 signaling, distinguished from confusables by the IL-10-family/type III interferon members and absence of IL-27/IL-35.

core: IL-10 family and IL-12 family cytokine signaling
name: IL-10 family, type III interferon and IL-12/IL-23 signaling
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-20 subfamily and type III interferon (lambda) signaling plus IL-12/IL-23 signaling, distinguished from IL-27/IL-35, IL-15/IL-21 and IFN-gamma confusables by the type III interferon and IL-20 content.

qualifier: prenylation of RAS and RAB GTPases
name: Protein prenylation of RAS and RAB GTPases
rationale: Members concern lipid modification of proteins, chiefly geranylgeranylation and C-terminal processing of RAS and RAB, distinguishing it from palmitoylation-based Hedgehog and Wnt confusables.

qualifier: prenylation of RAS and RAB GTPases
name: Prenylation and lipid modification of RAS and RAB GTPases
rationale: Members concern protein lipidation, chiefly geranylgeranylation and C-terminal processing of RAB and RAS small GTPases, whereas confusables involve palmitoylation, Wnt/Hedgehog lipidation or delipidation.

qualifier: prenylation of RAS and RAB small GTPases
name: Protein lipidation and prenylation of RAS and RAB GTPases
rationale: Members are protein lipid modification, notably geranylgeranylation of RABs and RAS C-terminal processing, distinct from palmitoylation, Wnt and Hedgehog lipidation neighbours.

core: Macrophage and microglial proliferation and activation
name: M-CSF-driven macrophage and microglial proliferation and activation
rationale: Members are M-CSF signaling and macrophage proliferation together with microglial proliferation, migration and cytotoxic activation, unlike confusables on microglial differentiation, inhibition or DAP12/CSF1R signaling detail.

core: Macrophage and microglial proliferation and activation
name: M-CSF-driven macrophage and microglial proliferation and activation
rationale: Members concern M-CSF signalling and macrophage proliferation together with microglial activation, migration and cytotoxicity; M-CSF separates it from glial-regulation confusables and microglia from the CSF1/DAP12 confusable.

core: Macrophage and microglial proliferation and activation
name: M-CSF-driven macrophage and microglial proliferation and activation
rationale: Members concern M-CSF signalling, macrophage proliferation and microglial proliferation, migration and cytotoxic activation, while confusables cover microglial differentiation/inhibition or DAP12/interleukin signalling.

name: Mechanoresponsive stromal fibroblast activation and proliferation
rationale: Members are fibroblast/stromal YAP-TAZ mechanoresponsive modules, collagen/TGF-beta, focal adhesion assembly and fibroblast proliferation, distinguishing it from confusables focused on ECM composition, EMT, fibronectin/integrin or migration.

name: Mechanoresponsive YAP/TAZ fibroblast stromal programme and proliferation
rationale: Members are fibroblast/stromal expression modules driven by mechanical and growth-factor cues (YAP/TAZ targets, caveolin, collagen/TGF-beta) plus fibroblast proliferation and focal adhesion assembly, distinguishing it from ECM/EMT and migration-centred confusables.

name: YAP/TAZ-driven stromal fibroblast activation and proliferation
rationale: Members describe mechanoresponsive fibroblast/stromal programmes, focal adhesion and fibroblast proliferation, without the EMT, fibronectin matrix and migration content of the confusables.

name: Monocyte and macrophage chemotaxis, extravasation and activation
rationale: All members are positive and negative regulation of monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, extravasation, activation and aggregation, while confusables add inflammatory cytokine production or CCR2/CX3CR1 expression modules.

name: Monocyte activation, aggregation, extravasation and chemotaxis regulation
rationale: All members concern monocyte (and macrophage) activation, aggregation, extravasation and up/down regulation of chemotaxis, unlike confusables about inflammatory cytokine production or CCR2/CX3CR1 expression modules.

name: Monocyte and macrophage chemotaxis, activation and extravasation
rationale: All members concern monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, extravasation, aggregation and activation, distinct from the CCR2/CX3CR1 module and the broader inflammatory adhesion confusables.

name: Striated muscle adaptation: atrophy, growth and fiber-type switching
rationale: Members share muscle adaptation to activity or inactivity (atrophy, skeletal and cardiac growth, sarcomere organization, fast/slow fiber transition), distinct from confusables centred on cell size, calcineurin-driven hypertrophy or myogenesis.

name: Striated muscle adaptation to activity and inactivity
rationale: Members concern muscle adaptation, fiber-type switching, atrophy, response to activity/inactivity and growth, distinct from myogenic development and calcineurin-driven hypertrophy confusables.

name: Striated muscle adaptation to activity and inactivity
rationale: Members cover atrophy, response to muscle (in)activity, fiber-type switching and cardiac adaptation/growth, unlike myogenesis, cell-size and calcineurin-hypertrophy confusables.

name: Cardiac chamber myocardium and conduction system development
rationale: Members cover heart tube, second heart field, ventricular/atrial myocardium and trabeculation plus sinoatrial, atrioventricular and His-Purkinje conduction system development, setting it apart from valve/cushion, septum and outflow-tract confusables.

qualifier: heart tube, chamber myocardium and conduction system
name: Heart tube, chamber myocardium and conduction system development
rationale: Members span heart tube patterning, secondary heart field, ventricular/atrial myocardium and trabeculation, cardiomyocyte fate and nodal/His-Purkinje conduction development, whereas confusables centre on septa, valves/cushions or outflow tract and coronary vessels.

name: Cardiac chamber myocardium and conduction system development
rationale: All members concern embryonic heart tube, chamber and myocardial development; conduction system (SA/AV node, His-Purkinje), ventricular myocardium and cardiomyocyte fate distinguish it from septum, valve/cushion and outflow tract confusables.

core: Regulation of T cell activation and tolerance
qualifier: dendritic cell costimulation, anergy and regulatory T cell induction
name: T cell activation versus tolerance via dendritic cell costimulation
