rationale: Members span dendritic cell differentiation and costimulation, T cell activation, anergy, tolerance and Treg differentiation with suppression of Th1/Th17 cytokines, whereas confusables focus on tumor immunity, Th1 differentiation or NK cytotoxicity.

core: Regulation of T cell activation and tolerance
name: Dendritic cell-T cell costimulation and tolerance induction
rationale: Members regulate T cell activation, costimulation, anergy, Treg induction and Th1/Th17 restraint together with dendritic cell differentiation and activation, which the T cell-, NK- and cytokine-focused confusables lack.

core: regulation of T cell activation and tolerance
qualifier: costimulation, anergy and dendritic cell differentiation
name: T cell activation-tolerance balance and dendritic cell differentiation
rationale: Members regulate T cell costimulation, proliferation, anergy, Treg/Th1/Th17 balance and cytokine output together with dendritic cell differentiation, which the T-cell-only and NK/cytotoxicity confusables lack.

core: Regulation of TLR and IL-1 signaling
name: Regulation of TLR and IL-1 signaling, promoting inflammatory cytokines
rationale: Members regulate TLR (TLR3/4, MyD88), IL-1, CD40 and IL-37 signaling and mostly promote IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, unlike the core TRIF/TAK1 cascade confusable and the inflammasome or cytokine-suppression confusables.

core: Regulation of TLR signaling and inflammatory cytokines
qualifier: MyD88-, TLR3/4- and CD40-linked positive and negative control
name: Positive and negative tuning of TLR-driven cytokine production
rationale: Members regulate TLR3/4, MyD88, CD40 and IL-1 signalling and IL-6, IL-8 and TNF output in both directions, unlike confusables centred on inflammasomes, LPS detection or TRIF/TAK1 signal transduction.

core: Regulation of TLR signaling and cytokine production
name: Regulation of TLR3/4 signaling and IL-6/IL-8/TNF induction
rationale: Members regulate TLR/MyD88, CD40 and IL-1 signalling and mostly promote IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, unlike confusables centred on TRIF/IKK adaptors, inflammasomes or negative cytokine regulation.

name: Histone mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA nuclear export
rationale: Members cover SLBP-dependent and independent histone pre-mRNA 3' processing, Pol II termination and mature mRNA export; histone stem-loop processing separates it from general RNA export neighbours and mRNA export from polyadenylation neighbours.

name: Histone mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA nuclear export
rationale: Members combine SLBP-dependent/independent histone pre-mRNA processing and Pol II termination with export of mature mRNAs through the nuclear pore; histone stem-loop processing separates it from export-only and polyadenylation confusables.

name: Histone mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA nuclear export
rationale: Members cover replication-dependent histone pre-mRNA stem-loop processing, Pol II termination and nuclear export of mature mRNAs; the histone/SLBP processing distinguishes it from export-only and polyadenylation confusables.

qualifier: progenitor proliferation, survival and growth control
name: Kidney development growth control via progenitor proliferation and survival
rationale: Members regulate kidney and ureteric/nephric duct development through proliferation, mesenchymal progenitor maintenance and apoptosis suppression, unlike confusables focused on ureteric bud branching, mesenchymal-epithelial differentiation or intermediate mesoderm formation.

qualifier: progenitor proliferation, survival and organ size
name: Kidney development control of progenitor proliferation and survival
rationale: Members regulate kidney and nephric duct development through mesenchymal progenitor proliferation, apoptosis, stem cell maintenance and kidney size, unlike confusables focused on ureteric bud branching or metanephric epithelial differentiation.

qualifier: nephron progenitor proliferation, survival and organ size control
name: Early kidney development and nephron progenitor growth control
rationale: All members concern nephric duct/ureteric bud/metanephric development, and the theme uniquely carries regulation of progenitor maintenance, proliferation, apoptosis and kidney size, whereas confusables focus on ureteric bud branching or mesenchymal-epithelial differentiation.

qualifier: alpha-2 adrenergic suppression of insulin and catecholamine secretion
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/z signaling inhibiting insulin and catecholamine secretion
rationale: Members are alpha-2 adrenergic, adenosine and Gz inhibitory cyclase signaling that suppresses insulin and catecholamine release, distinct from cardiac, smooth-muscle and cAMP/PKA confusables.

qualifier: alpha-2 suppression of catecholamine and insulin secretion
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi signalling suppressing catecholamine and insulin secretion
rationale: Members are Gi/Gz-coupled alpha-2 adrenergic and adenosine signalling that inhibit adenylate cyclase and epinephrine, norepinephrine and insulin secretion, unlike cardiac, smooth muscle, cAMP/PKA and muscarinic confusables.

qualifier: alpha-2 adrenergic and adenosine receptors inhibiting secretion
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic/adenosine Gi/z signaling inhibiting insulin and catecholamine secretion
rationale: Members are adrenergic and adenosine receptor Gi/z signalling that inhibits adenylate cyclase and insulin/catecholamine secretion, unlike neighbours on cAMP/PKA turnover, smooth-muscle or cardiac adrenergic effects and muscarinic receptors.

core: NK and cytotoxic T cell activity
name: NK and CD8 T cell activation promoting cytotoxicity
rationale: Members are NK/T cell signatures, CD8 T cell proliferation and positive regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity and cytokine production, whereas confusables carry inhibitory KIR/MHC class Ib interactions, tolerance and protection from NK killing.

name: NK and CD8 T cell cytotoxic activation
rationale: Members are NK and T cell signatures and positive regulation of NK and CD8 T cell cytotoxicity and proliferation, distinct from neighbours on MHC class Ib presentation, KIR receptors, inhibition and tolerance.

qualifier: NK and CD8 T cell effector activation
name: Activation of NK and CD8 T cell cytotoxicity
rationale: Members are NK and T cell signatures with positive regulation of NK/T cell cytotoxicity, degranulation and CD8 T cell proliferation, while confusables emphasize KIR/inhibitory receptors, MHC class Ib presentation and tolerance.

qualifier: ER-centered contact sites and ER organization
name: ER-centered intermembrane lipid transfer and organelle tethering
rationale: Members are non-vesicular transfer of phospholipids, glycolipids, ceramide-1-phosphate and cholesterol between membranes with ER localization, ER-plasma membrane tethering and ER/Golgi traffic, separating it from flippase, mitochondrial tethering, RAB prenylation and lipid catabolism confusables.

name: ER-centred intermembrane lipid and sterol transfer
rationale: Members transfer phospholipids, glycolipids, ceramide-1-phosphate and cholesterol between the ER and other membranes with ER tethering, distinct from flippase, RAB, phospholipid catabolism and ER-mitochondria contact confusables.

qualifier: ER-based, for glycolipids, phospholipids and sterols
name: ER-based intermembrane transfer of glycolipids, phospholipids and sterols
rationale: Members are non-vesicular transport of glycosphingolipids, ceramide-1-phosphate, PI/PC and cholesterol with ER tethering and localization; confusables cover ER-mitochondria tethering, RAB prenylation, phospholipid catabolism or flippases.

name: Tie2 and VEGFR2 signalling restraining sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Members are Tie2 and VEGFR2 signalling plus negative regulation of endothelial sprouting, migration, proliferation and apoptosis, whereas confusables carry the positive-regulation and VEGF-binding members.

name: Negative regulation of sprouting angiogenesis, VEGFR2 and Tie2 signaling
rationale: Members restrain endothelial sprouting, migration, proliferation and VEGF responsiveness via VEGFR2 and Tie2 signalling, whereas confusables carry the positive angiogenic regulators, VEGF production or neuropilin/lymphangiogenesis terms.

qualifier: negative regulation via Tie2 and VEGFR2 signalling
name: Tie2 and VEGFR2 signaling restraining sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Members are Tie2 and VEGFR2 signalling plus negative regulation of endothelial sprouting, proliferation, chemotaxis and apoptosis, whereas confusables add positive regulation of angiogenesis, VEGF-VEGFR binding/neuropilin or lymphangiogenesis.

qualifier: cytosolic calcium removal by SERCA and Na+/Ca2+ exchange
name: Cardiac cytosolic calcium removal by SERCA and Na/Ca exchange
rationale: Members concern SR calcium reuptake, Na/Ca exchangers and cardiac relaxation, whereas confusables emphasise calcium release, ryanodine receptors and store-operated entry.

qualifier: cytosolic Ca2+ removal via SERCA and Na+/Ca2+ exchange
name: Cardiomyocyte cytosolic calcium removal by SERCA and exchangers
rationale: Members concern lowering cytosolic Ca2+ through sarcoplasmic reticulum uptake and Na+/Ca2+ exchange to control cardiac relaxation and force, while confusables centre on Ca2+ release and ryanodine receptors.

name: Cardiac calcium reuptake and sodium-calcium exchange in relaxation
rationale: Members concern lowering cytosolic Ca2+ in cardiomyocytes via SR import and Na/Ca exchangers to control relaxation and force, unlike confusables centered on ryanodine-receptor release or caffeine responses.

name: Monocyte chemotaxis and activation in inflammatory cytokine response
rationale: Members regulate monocyte chemotaxis, extravasation, aggregation and MCP-1 production within inflammatory cytokine programs (incl. RAGE signalling), which confusables on generic migration, CCR2/CX3CR1 signatures or endothelial adhesion lack.

name: Inflammatory monocyte chemotaxis, activation and aggregation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte chemotaxis, MCP-1 production, extravasation, activation and aggregation within an inflammatory cytokine response, whereas confusables are monocyte surface signatures, CCR2/CX3CR1 modules or endothelial adhesion.

name: Monocyte chemotaxis and activation in inflammatory response
rationale: Members regulate monocyte chemotaxis, MCP-1 production, extravasation, activation and aggregation within inflammation, distinct from endothelial adhesion, monocyte surface signature and CCR2/CX3CR1 module neighbours.

qualifier: transcriptional control restraining granulocyte and monocyte fates
name: Transcriptional control of granulocyte-monocyte progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members are transcriptional programs (granulopoiesis, VENTX, RA/WNT/CSF network, promyelocyte module) and negative regulation of granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation, lacking the megakaryocyte/erythroid content and the pro-monocyte/dendritic GM-CSF content of confusables.

name: Myeloid progenitor commitment and restraint of monocyte-granulocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover myeloid progenitor proliferation and granulopoiesis transcription with negative regulation of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation, unlike confusables that promote monocyte/DC differentiation or centre on RUNX1-megakaryocyte biology.

core: Transcriptional control of myeloid progenitor fate
name: Transcriptional control of granulocyte-monocyte progenitor fate
rationale: Members are myeloid progenitor proliferation, granulopoiesis transcription, VENTX and RA/WNT/CSF networks restraining granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation, lacking the RUNX1/megakaryocyte content of its closest confusable.

qualifier: protein import and inner-membrane insertion with cristae formation
name: Mitochondrial protein import, inner-membrane insertion and cristae formation
rationale: Members concern import and membrane insertion of mitochondrial proteins and organisation of cristae and outer membrane, distinct from confusables on mitochondrial protein processing/degradation or respiratory chain function.

qualifier: protein import, inner-membrane insertion and cristae organization
name: Mitochondrial protein import, membrane insertion and cristae organization
rationale: Members share building mitochondrial membranes: protein import into matrix, insertion into the inner membrane, outer-membrane organization, cristae formation, fusion and complex III assembly, whereas confusables cover OXPHOS function, mitochondrial protein processing/degradation or calcium import.

core: Mitochondrial protein import and membrane organization
name: Mitochondrial protein import, membrane insertion and cristae organization
rationale: Members concern import and inner-membrane insertion of mitochondrial proteins together with cristae, outer membrane and fusion organization, unlike confusables on mitochondrial protein processing/degradation or OXPHOS complex assembly.

qualifier: autophagosome, phagosome and endosome fusion with lysosomes
name: Vesicle fusion and cargo delivery to lysosomes
rationale: Members concern fusion of autophagosomes, phagosomes, multivesicular bodies and endosomes with lysosomes and Golgi/endosome-to-lysosome transport, while confusables focus on autophagosome assembly and maturation.

name: Lysosomal and endosomal vesicle fusion with Golgi-derived transport
rationale: Members concern fusion of autophagosomes, phagosomes, MVBs and endosomes with lysosomes and Golgi-to-endosome/lysosome transport, unlike the autophagosome assembly regulation confusables.

name: Endolysosomal vesicle fusion and Golgi-to-lysosome delivery
rationale: Members describe fusion of autophagosomes, endosomes, multivesicular bodies and phagosomes with lysosomes plus Golgi-to-endosome/lysosome transport, whereas confusables focus on regulation of autophagosome assembly and maturation.

qualifier: synthesis, PDE1 degradation and PKA activation
name: cAMP turnover and protein kinase A activation
rationale: All members concern cAMP synthesis, PDE-mediated breakdown and PKA activation downstream of GPCRs; unlike confusables it lacks adenylate cyclase-activating dopamine/CREB or adrenergic inhibitory arms and adds cAMP catabolism and PKA activation.

qualifier: PKA activation and phosphodiesterase cAMP breakdown
name: cAMP signalling via PKA activation and phosphodiesterase breakdown
rationale: All members concern cAMP production, PKA activation or cAMP termination; unlike the adenylate cyclase-inhibition and dopamine/CREB confusables, the theme carries PKA activation and PDE1-mediated cAMP catabolism.

name: cAMP synthesis, phosphodiesterase breakdown and PKA activation
rationale: All members concern the cAMP second-messenger cycle (GPCR/forskolin-driven synthesis, PDE1 catabolism, PKA activation and its restraint), and unlike the adenylate cyclase-centred confusables the theme includes cAMP degradation and PKA activation.

qualifier: ependymal multiciliogenesis, CSF flow and sperm motility
name: Ependymal multiciliogenesis, CSF flow and sperm motility
rationale: Members concern motile cilia: multiciliogenesis and basal body/centriole assembly underlying ventricular CSF circulation, plus sperm flagellar motility, whereas confusables focus on axonemal dynein arm assembly and mucociliary clearance.

qualifier: multiciliogenesis in brain ventricles and sperm motility
name: Multiciliogenesis and ciliary motility in brain ventricles and sperm
rationale: Members cover multiciliated-cell centriole/basal body formation, ventricular development and CSF circulation, and sperm/cilium motility, whereas confusables centre on axonemal dynein assembly and mucociliary clearance.

qualifier: multiciliated/ependymal differentiation, CSF flow and sperm motility
name: Multiciliogenesis, ependymal CSF flow and sperm motility
rationale: Members cover multiciliated cell differentiation (centriole and basal body amplification), ventricle development and cerebrospinal fluid circulation, and regulation of cilium and sperm flagellar movement, whereas confusables centre on axonemal dynein arm assembly and mucociliary clearance.

name: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members cover glutamate/glutamine, aspartate/asparagine and citrulline metabolism and nitrogen utilization; aspartate-family biosynthesis distinguishes it from TCA, alanine and proline confusables.

name: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members cover glutamate, glutamine, aspartate, asparagine and citrulline metabolism and nitrogen utilization; the aspartate/citrulline arm separates it from alanine, proline and TCA-shuttle neighbours.

name: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are glutamate/glutamine synthesis and breakdown, aspartate/asparagine metabolism and nitrogen utilization; aspartate and citrulline members separate it from alanine/gluconeogenesis, TCA/malate-aspartate shuttle and proline/glycine confusables.

qualifier: CSF1 receptor and DAP12, proliferation and fusion
name: CSF1 and DAP12 signaling in macrophage proliferation and fusion
rationale: Members are M-CSF/CSF1R and DAP12 tyrosine kinase signaling controlling macrophage proliferation and fusion, unlike neighbours on osteoclast differentiation, SIRP interactions or CSF production.

qualifier: DAP12 and macrophage proliferation and fusion
name: M-CSF and DAP12 signalling in macrophage proliferation and fusion
rationale: Members cover CSF1/M-CSF receptor and DAP12 tyrosine kinase signalling driving macrophage proliferation and fusion, distinct from osteoclast, myeloid differentiation and SIRP/phagocytosis confusables.

qualifier: CSF1 receptor and DAP12 tyrosine kinase signalling
name: CSF1 and DAP12 signaling in macrophage proliferation and fusion
rationale: Members concern M-CSF/CSF1R and DAP12 tyrosine kinase signalling controlling macrophage proliferation and fusion, unlike confusables about osteoclasts, SIRP interactions or myeloid differentiation.

name: Calcineurin-NFAT signaling in cardiomyocyte hypertrophic growth
rationale: Members are calcineurin-NFAT signaling regulation and cardiac muscle adaptation, cell size and sarcomere growth, unlike neighbours on contractility, atrophy or regeneration.

name: Calcineurin-NFAT signaling in cardiomyocyte hypertrophic growth
rationale: Members pair calcineurin-NFAT regulation with cardiac muscle adaptation, cell size, sarcomere organization and cardiomyocyte growth, whereas confusables cover skeletal muscle, stress hypertrophy without calcineurin, or contractility.

name: Calcineurin-NFAT signaling in cardiomyocyte growth and hypertrophy
rationale: Members are calcineurin-NFAT activation and its regulation with cardiac muscle adaptation, cell size and sarcomere growth; confusables cover cardiac contractility, skeletal muscle atrophy or regeneration without calcineurin members.

qualifier: laminin/dystroglycan complex and neuromuscular junction assembly
name: Skeletal muscle basement membrane, dystroglycan complex and NMJ assembly
rationale: Members cover laminin interactions, basement membrane assembly, DGC formation, NMJ/AChR clustering and myogenesis, separating it from DAG1 glycosylation, collagen anchoring and contractile-apparatus confusables.

qualifier: dystrophin complex and neuromuscular junction assembly
name: Muscle fiber basement membrane and neuromuscular junction assembly
rationale: Members cover laminin/proteoglycan basement membrane assembly, the dystrophin-glycoprotein complex, AChR clustering at the NMJ and myofiber differentiation, unlike collagen, DAG1 glycosylation and sarcomere confusables.

qualifier: dystroglycan complex and neuromuscular synapse assembly
name: Muscle basement membrane, dystroglycan complex and neuromuscular synapse
rationale: Members are laminin and proteoglycan basement membrane assembly, dystrophin-glycoprotein complex formation, NMJ synapse and AChR clustering and myogenesis, unlike neighbours on DAG1 glycosylation, sarcomere contraction or collagen fibrils.

name: Lysine acetylation and MLL–WDR5 histone methylation
rationale: Members cover histone and non-histone (tubulin) lysine acetylation, and unlike the acetylation-only and general methylation/chromatin confusables they include WDR5/KMT2D (MLL4) histone lysine methyltransferase complexes.

core: Protein lysine acetylation and histone lysine methylation
name: Lysine acetylation and KMT2/WDR5 histone methylation complexes
rationale: Members concern lysine acetylation (histones, tubulin, centriole regulators) and histone lysine methylation; the WDR5/MLL4 (KMT2D) methyltransferase complexes distinguish it from BAF/CHD remodeling and general protein-methylation neighbours.

name: Lysine acetylation and WDR5/MLL-complex histone methylation
rationale: Members concern lysine acetylation of histones, tubulin and other proteins; unlike the acetylation and chromatin-remodeling confusables, the theme adds histone lysine methylation by WDR5-containing KMT2/MLL complexes.

core: Endothelin signalling in enteric and vascular development
qualifier: endothelin receptor control of arteries and blood pressure
name: Endothelin signalling in enteric nervous system and arteries
rationale: Members centre on endothelin receptor signalling driving enteric neural crest/gut development and arterial morphogenesis and pressure, which separates it from the RET/GDNF, gastrointestinal smooth muscle and catecholamine confusables.

qualifier: enteric nervous system and arterial regulation
name: Endothelin signaling in enteric innervation and arterial regulation
rationale: All members concern endothelin receptor signaling and its roles in enteric neural crest development, gut motility and arterial morphogenesis/pressure, which separates it from RET/GDNF, catecholaminergic and gastrointestinal smooth-muscle neighbours.

core: Enteric neural crest and gut development
qualifier: endothelin signalling, including arterial morphogenesis and blood pressure
name: Endothelin signalling in enteric neural crest and arteries
rationale: Members combine endothelin receptor signalling with enteric nervous system/neural crest and midgut development; unlike the GDNF/RET, GI smooth-muscle and sympathoadrenal confusables, this theme adds endothelin control of artery morphogenesis and systemic blood pressure.

name: Interleukin production restraint with IL-10 induction and IL-12 suppression
rationale: All members regulate T cell-linked cytokine output (IL-2, IL-6, IL-10, IL-12, IL-21, TNF, Th1, Treg); unlike the closest confusables it includes positive IL-10 and negative IL-12 production rather than IL-27/IL-35 signaling, direct T cell proliferation suppression, or IL-1 beta control.

core: Restraint of interleukin and TNF production
qualifier: including IL-10 and IL-12, in T cell responses
name: Restraint of interleukin and TNF production, including IL-10 and IL-12
rationale: Most members negatively regulate production of IL-2, IL-6, IL-10, IL-12, IL-21 and TNF or Th1/Treg responses; the IL-12 and IL-10 production terms separate it from the T cell-suppression confusable, and the T cell/IL-2/IL-21 terms from the inflammatory-cytokine one.

name: Regulation of interleukin-10/12 and T-cell cytokine production
rationale: Members regulate production of IL-2, IL-6, IL-10, IL-12, IL-21 and TNF-family cytokines and Th1/Treg/activated T-cell responses; IL-12 suppression and IL-10 induction set it apart from the T-cell suppression and inflammatory IL-1 neighbours.

qualifier: early endosome sorting and receptor recycling
name: Endocytosis, early endosome sorting and receptor recycling
rationale: All members concern plasma-membrane-to-endosome transport, early-to-late and recycling endosome routing and receptor recycling, lacking the Golgi, secretory and Rab/ARF members of confusables.

name: Endosomal sorting, maturation and recycling of internalized cargo
rationale: All members concern endocytosis, early-to-late/recycling endosome transport, receptor recycling and endosome organization, unlike confusables about Golgi, secretory and ARF/Rab signaling.

name: Endocytic recycling and early endosome cargo sorting
rationale: All members concern endosome organization, receptor recycling and early-endosome sorting, distinct from Golgi, secretory and ARF/Rab confusables.

core: fibroblast growth factor receptor signalling through FRS2 and SHC adaptors with its negative feedback
qualifier: FGFR1 and FGFR4 with the betaKlotho co-receptor, not FGFR2 or FGFR3 and not the PI3K or phospholipase C branches
name: FGFR1 and FGFR4 FRS and SHC signalling with feedback attenuation
rationale: All members are adaptor-level FGFR signalling events for FGFR1 and FGFR4, their co-receptor-dependent ligand binding, and the Sprouty, FGFRL1 and MAPK feedback that limits them; the confusables are set apart by FGFR2 and FGFR3 paralogue content and by PI3K and phospholipase C cascades that this theme does not contain.

core: FGFR1 and FGFR4 proximal adaptor signalling
qualifier: beta-Klotho ligand binding with Spry and FGFRL1 inhibition
name: FGFR1 and FGFR4 adaptor signalling and its inhibition
rationale: Members are the FRS- and SHC-mediated cascades of FGFR1 and FGFR4 with beta-Klotho ligand binding and the negative regulators acting on them, whereas confusables carry the FGFR2 and FGFR3 arms and the PI3K and phospholipase C branches.

qualifier: FRS/SHC adaptor cascades with negative feedback
name: FGFR1 and FGFR4 adaptor signalling and negative feedback
rationale: Members are FRS- and SHC-mediated FGFR1/FGFR4 cascades, betaKlotho ligand binding and Sprouty/FGFRL1 negative regulation, whereas confusables cover FGFR2/FGFR3 signalling and PI3K/PLC cascades.

name: Osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and bone mineralization
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast proliferation and differentiation and bone mineralization, while confusables add Wnt, mesenchymal stem cell, trabecula and tendon development.

name: Osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and bone mineralization
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast proliferation and differentiation, bone mineralization and chondrocyte development, whereas confusables emphasise Wnt/mesenchymal stem cell input, trabecula, suture and tendon development.

name: Regulation of osteoblast differentiation and bone mineralization
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast proliferation and differentiation, bone mineralization during maturation and chondrocyte development, while confusables concern Wnt and mesenchymal stem cell, trabecula and tendon formation.

name: mRNA polyadenylation and deadenylation-independent decapping decay
rationale: Members cover co-transcriptional cleavage and polyadenylation and decapping/XRN-mediated decay, distinct from histone stem-loop processing, deadenylation-dependent decay and mRNA stabilisation confusables.

name: mRNA cleavage-polyadenylation and decapping-dependent 5' to 3' decay
rationale: Members cover 3'-end cleavage/polyadenylation and deadenylation-independent decapping/XRN decay; confusables are histone mRNA processing or deadenylation-dependent decay and stabilization.

name: mRNA polyadenylation and decapping-dependent 5'-to-3' decay
rationale: Members cover mRNA cleavage/polyadenylation and deadenylation-independent decapping with 5'-3' exonucleolytic decay, unlike confusables on mRNA stabilization, deadenylation or histone mRNA processing.

qualifier: cerebellar granule layer and forebrain neuron specification
name: Cerebellar granule layer and forebrain neuron development
rationale: Members cover cerebellar granular layer formation, granule precursor proliferation, Bergmann glia and motor learning together with thalamus, pyramidal neuron and forebrain neuron-type commitment; the cerebellar granule/Bergmann arm and forebrain specification separate it from cortical migration, Purkinje/locomotor, L1 axon tract and retina confusables.

qualifier: cerebellar granule layer and forebrain neurons
name: Cerebellar granule layer and forebrain neuron development
rationale: Members combine cerebellar granule layer, granule precursor and Bergmann glia development and motor learning with forebrain/thalamic and pyramidal neuron development, unlike the cortical-migration, commissure and retina confusables.

name: Cerebellar granule layer and forebrain neuron development
rationale: Members cover cerebellar granule layer, granule precursor and Bergmann glia development with motor learning, plus pyramidal, thalamic and forebrain neuron specification, distinguishing it from commissure, Purkinje/locomotor, retinal and cortical migration confusables.

core: Chemokine and dendritic cell cytokine production
name: cGAS-STING-driven CCL5 and dendritic cell cytokine production
rationale: Members concern cGAS/STING activation (including cGAMP import) and the resulting CCL5 and dendritic-cell cytokine production, unlike confusables on type I/III interferon induction or macrophage CXCL/MCP-1 chemokines.

qualifier: cGAMP-STING and dendritic cell CCL5 output
name: cGAMP-STING-driven dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 production
rationale: Members concern cGAMP import and STING enhancement together with dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5/STAT6 chemokine production, distinguishing it from macrophage chemokine, interferon response or IRF3/type I IFN confusables.

core: Dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 production
name: Dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 production, cGAMP–STING promotion
rationale: Members concern myeloid dendritic cell cytokine output, CCL5 and STAT6-induced chemokines, and promotion of cGAS/STING signalling via cGAMP import; macrophage chemokine confusables lack the STING and dendritic members, interferon confusables lack the chemokine members.

qualifier: with lysosomal and Golgi membrane trafficking
name: Glycolipid transfer with lysosomal and Golgi membrane trafficking
rationale: Members are glycosphingolipid/ceramide-1-phosphate transport plus lysosome, Golgi membrane and lysosomal enzyme secretion modules, unlike glycosphingolipid synthesis/catabolism and phospholipid-transfer neighbours.

qualifier: with lysosomal and Golgi membrane compartments
name: Glycosphingolipid transfer with lysosomal and Golgi compartments
rationale: Members are glycolipid, glycosphingolipid and ceramide-1-phosphate transport together with lysosome, Golgi membrane and lysosomal enzyme secretion modules, unlike confusables centred on glycosphingolipid synthesis, catabolism or phospholipid transfer.

qualifier: with lysosomal and Golgi enzyme trafficking
name: Glycolipid transport and lysosomal enzyme trafficking
rationale: Members cover glycosphingolipid, glycolipid and ceramide-1-phosphate transfer together with lysosome/endosome proteins, Golgi membrane genes and lysosomal enzyme secretion, unlike confusables centred on glycosphingolipid catabolism or biosynthesis or ER-Golgi phospholipid transfer.

name: ERK, ERK5 and atypical MAPK signaling and inactivation
rationale: Members concern RAS–ERK MAPK signaling, its feedback inactivation and the ERK5 and atypical MAPK6/4 cascades, which the phosphatase and JNK/p38 confusables lack.

qualifier: feedback inactivation and atypical ERK5/ERK3/4 cascades
name: MAPK feedback inactivation and atypical ERK5/ERK3/4 cascades
rationale: Members cover ERK inactivation and negative feedback plus atypical MAPK cascades (ERK5, MAPK6/4), distinguishing it from neighbours defined by phosphatase dephosphorylation and JNK/p38 regulation.

name: ERK/MAPK negative feedback and atypical MAPK (ERK3/4/5) signaling
rationale: Members concern ERK inactivation and feedback suppression of MAPK signaling together with ERK5 and MAPK6/MAPK4 cascades, which phosphatase- and JNK/p38-focused confusables lack.

name: NTF3-NTRK3 receptor signaling to Ras, PLCG1 and PI3K
rationale: Members describe NT-3 activation of TrkC and its adaptor-mediated (FRS2, ARMS) downstream Ras, PLCG1 and PI3K branches, distinguishing it from NGF-TRKA and NTRK2 confusables.

name: NT-3/NTRK3 signaling and Trk adaptor-driven Ras activation
rationale: Members are NTF3-activated NTRK3 outputs (RAS, PLCG1, PI3K) plus ARMS- and FRS2-mediated Ras activation, separating it from NTRK2, NGF/TRKA and MAP2K/RIT neighbours.

core: Neurotrophin Trk receptor signaling to Ras
name: NT-3/TrkC receptor signaling via Ras-activating adaptors
rationale: Members are NTF3-NTRK3 signaling through RAS, PI3K and PLCG1 plus Frs2/ARMS adaptor-mediated Ras activation, distinguishing it from the NGF/TrkA, TrkB and p38/ERK5 confusables.

qualifier: assembly, remodeling, clearance and cholesterol efflux
name: Plasma lipoprotein lifecycle and cholesterol transport
rationale: Members span chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL assembly, remodeling and clearance plus ABC-transporter cholesterol efflux and intestinal lipid absorption, distinct from confusables adding SREBP control, receptor internalization or vitamin E transport.

name: Lipoprotein metabolism and ABC-transporter cholesterol and phospholipid efflux
rationale: Members span chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL assembly, remodeling and clearance with sterol homeostasis, and uniquely include ABCA1/ABCG5/ABCG8/ABCB4/ABCB11 lipid efflux absent from confusables focused on vitamin E, receptor endocytosis, triglyceride catabolism or SREBP.

qualifier: assembly, remodeling, clearance and cholesterol efflux
name: Plasma lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, clearance and cholesterol efflux
rationale: Members span chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL assembly, remodeling and clearance, ABC-transporter sterol efflux and intestinal lipid absorption, beyond confusables limited to SREBP/LDLR endocytosis, vitamin E or triglyceride catabolism.

name: Canonical and non-canonical NF-kB signaling via TNF-family receptors
rationale: Members cover IKK/NIK activation, linear ubiquitination and NF-kB regulation downstream of TNFR1, CD40 and TNFSF receptors, unlike confusables focused on lymphocyte antigen-receptor or TLR/TRIF routes to NF-kB.

name: TNF-receptor-driven canonical and non-canonical NF-kB regulation
rationale: Members regulate IKK/NIK activation, linear ubiquitination and NF-kB transcription factor activity downstream of TNFR1, CD40 and TNFSF receptors, unlike confusables centred on B/T-cell receptor or TLR-TAK1/IRF NF-kB activation.

name: TNF-receptor and IKK-driven canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB signaling
rationale: Members regulate canonical and NIK-dependent non-canonical NF-kappaB via TNFR1, CD40/TNFSF receptors, IKK recruitment and linear ubiquitination; confusables are lymphocyte-receptor, TLR/TRIF-TAK1 or sumoylation sets.

qualifier: HNF4/CDX-driven absorptive identity and crypt stem cells
name: Intestinal epithelial differentiation and HNF4/CDX absorptive identity
rationale: Members are dominated by intestinal crypt and enterocyte identity programmes driven by HNF4 and CDX factors, unlike confusables on endoderm specification, pancreatic development, lung epithelium or antimicrobial defense.

qualifier: HNF4/CDX-driven intestinal and hepatic absorptive epithelium
name: HNF4/CDX-driven intestinal and hepatic absorptive epithelium differentiation
rationale: Members mark differentiated intestinal/hepatic absorptive epithelium, crypt stem cells and pancreatic ductal/endocrine lineages, unlike confusables on early pancreatic progenitors and endoderm, antimicrobial defense or lung epithelium.

name: Intestinal absorptive epithelium and HNF4-driven endodermal identity
rationale: Members are dominated by HNF4/CDX-specified intestinal and hepatic absorptive epithelium programs, intestinal stem cell and epithelial maintenance, plus pancreatic ductal/endocrine lineage and columnar epithelial maturation, whereas confusables cover early endoderm and pancreatic progenitor specification, lung epithelium, or antimicrobial defensin programs.

name: Lactate, pyruvate and di/tricarboxylate transmembrane transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated transport of monocarboxylates (MCT/basigin, lactate, pyruvate) and TCA intermediates (malate-aspartate shuttle, succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, citrate), distinct from the carnitine, choline and cationic amino acid transport of the confusables.

name: Lactate, pyruvate and TCA-intermediate carboxylate membrane transport
rationale: Members concern SLC transport of monocarboxylates (lactate, pyruvate via MCT/basigin) and di/tricarboxylates (succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, malate shuttle), distinguishing them from the carnitine/choline and cationic amino acid transport confusables.

name: Organic ion transport of monocarboxylates and TCA intermediates
rationale: Members are solute-carrier transport of organic anions and cations, centred on lactate/pyruvate (MCT, basigin) and di/tricarboxylates (succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, malate-aspartate shuttle), which the carnitine, choline and amino-acid confusables lack.

core: Colony-stimulating factor control of myeloid cells
qualifier: monocyte-macrophage expansion and survival in bone marrow
name: Colony-stimulating factor-driven monocyte-macrophage expansion in bone marrow
rationale: Members cover M-CSF/GM-CSF/G-CSF production and signalling driving monocyte, macrophage and dendritic cell differentiation plus bone marrow cell proliferation and survival, unlike the granulopoiesis, osteoclast and bone marrow development neighbours.

core: Colony-stimulating factor signalling in myeloid development
qualifier: M-CSF/GM-CSF driven monocyte-macrophage and bone marrow cell expansion
name: M-CSF and GM-CSF signalling in monocyte-macrophage development
rationale: Members cover CSF1/GM-CSF signalling and production, interleukin receptor SHC signalling, and monocyte, macrophage and dendritic cell differentiation plus bone marrow cell proliferation and survival, whereas confusables centre on G-CSF-driven granulocyte/neutrophil differentiation or osteoclasts.

core: Colony-stimulating factor signaling in myeloid development
qualifier: macrophage and monocyte differentiation and bone marrow expansion
name: Colony-stimulating factor signaling in macrophage and monocyte development
rationale: Members centre on M-CSF/GM-CSF/G-CSF production and signaling driving macrophage, monocyte and myeloid dendritic cell differentiation and bone marrow cell proliferation/survival, unlike confusables focused on granulocyte/neutrophil transcriptional programs or osteoclasts.

core: Dendritic cell and monocyte surface signature
name: Dendritic cell and monocyte surface receptors, CD1 lipid presentation
rationale: Members are DC/monocyte surface and antigen-presentation gene signatures together with CD1/MHC class Ib lipid antigen presentation, separating it from neutrophil/monocyte effector, lymphocyte surface and MHC class II peptide-presentation neighbours.

core: Dendritic cell and monocyte surface signatures
name: Dendritic cell and monocyte surface signatures with CD1 lipid presentation
rationale: Members are DC/monocyte surface and enrichment modules plus CD1-mediated lipid antigen presentation, separating it from neutrophil/innate defence, MHC class II peptide presentation, and lymphocyte surface neighbours.

core: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface signatures
name: Monocyte/DC surface receptors and CD1 lipid antigen presentation
rationale: Members are monocyte and dendritic cell surface/receptor signatures and DC antigen presentation; CD1-mediated lipid antigen presentation distinguishes it from other myeloid signature confusables, and the surface signatures distinguish it from the MHC class II presentation confusable.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptors and chemokine production
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil recruitment and chemokine production
rationale: Members are neutrophil/granulocyte chemotaxis via formyl peptide receptors plus induction of CCL3/CCL5/CXCL1/CXCL2/CCL2 chemokines, which neutrophil-migration and DC-cytokine confusables lack.

name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven chemokine production and myeloid chemotaxis
rationale: Members combine formyl peptide receptor neutrophil responses with CXCL1/2, CCL2/3/5 production and granulocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, distinguishing them from neutrophil migration/apoptosis and DC-cytokine confusables.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptors and CXCL1/2, CCL2/3/5 chemokine induction
name: Formyl peptide receptor and chemokine-driven neutrophil and macrophage recruitment
rationale: Members concern recruitment of neutrophils, granulocytes and macrophages via formyl peptide receptors and induction of CXC/CC chemokines, unlike confusables on neutrophil degranulation, negative regulation of migration, extravasation, or dendritic cell cytokines.

name: Mucosal defensin-mediated antimicrobial and anti-nematode defence
rationale: Members cover defensins, cytolysis and agglutination of microbes, mucosal innate immunity and bacterial attachment to epithelium; chitin metabolism and response to nematodes distinguish it from the antibacterial-peptide and metal-sequestration confusables.

qualifier: defensins, microbe cytolysis, nematode and chitin response
name: Defensin and lytic mucosal defence against microbes and nematodes
rationale: Members share innate killing or neutralisation of microbes and parasites (defensins, agglutination, cytolysis, mucosal immunity, nematode/chitin response), whereas confusables centre on metal sequestration, antifungal responses or antimicrobial peptide production.

name: Defensin antimicrobial defense with nematode and chitin responses
rationale: Members share mucosal antimicrobial effector activity (defensins, cytolysis, agglutination, membrane disruption), and the response to nematodes and chitin metabolism distinguish it from the antibacterial/antifungal and metal-sequestration neighbours.

qualifier: osteoblast development, direct ossification and joint morphogenesis
name: Osteoblast development, direct ossification and skeletal joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover RUNX2-driven osteoblast development, intramembranous ossification, trabecula and cranial suture formation and joint/tendon morphogenesis, distinguishing them from chondrocyte maturation and osteoblast proliferation-regulation confusables.

qualifier: osteoblast, intramembranous bone and joint formation
name: Osteoblast development, intramembranous ossification and skeletal joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover osteoblast development and RUNX2 control, direct ossification, trabecular bone, cranial sutures, joints and tendon, unlike confusables on osteoblast proliferation/differentiation regulation or chondrocyte and endochondral programmes.

qualifier: RUNX2-driven osteoblast and intramembranous ossification, joint morphogenesis
name: RUNX2-driven osteoblast development, intramembranous ossification and joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover RUNX2-regulated osteoblast development, direct ossification, trabecular and suture formation, and joint, cartilage and tendon morphogenesis, whereas confusables emphasise chondrocyte maturation and endochondral ossification or osteoblast proliferation control.

qualifier: GABA turnover and GABA/glycine synaptic transport
name: GABA turnover and inhibitory GABA-glycine synaptic transmission
rationale: Members cover GABA synthesis, degradation, secretion and reuptake plus glycinergic transmission, whereas confusables concern glutamate and aspartate transport.

name: GABA and glycine inhibitory neurotransmitter metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover GABA synthesis, secretion, reuptake and degradation, glycinergic transmission and its transporter defect, distinguishing the theme from glutamate/aspartate transport confusables.

qualifier: GABA and glycine synthesis, release and reuptake
name: GABA and glycine inhibitory neurotransmitter synthesis and reuptake
rationale: Members are GABA synthesis, secretion, reuptake and degradation plus glycinergic transmission, distinguishing the theme from the glutamate/aspartate transport confusables.

core: Myeloid proinflammatory chemokine and cytokine production
name: Myeloid inflammatory chemokine production and its negative regulation
rationale: Members cover inflammatory chemokine/cytokine output from macrophages, monocytes and dendritic cells and its restraint (IL-8, CXCL2, MCP-1), unlike confusables about leukocyte adhesion/extravasation, NF-kB lymphocyte activation or monocyte chemotaxis.

core: Myeloid inflammatory chemokine and cytokine production
name: Myeloid inflammatory chemokine production and its negative regulation
rationale: Members describe pro-inflammatory chemokine/cytokine output of myeloid cells (IL-8, CXCL2, MCP-1, macrophage cytokines) and its restraint, unlike confusables about leukocyte adhesion/extravasation, lymphocyte cytokines or monocyte chemotaxis.

core: Myeloid proinflammatory cytokine and chemokine production
name: Myeloid inflammatory cytokine and chemokine production and restraint
rationale: Members cover proinflammatory cytokine/chemokine output of macrophages, monocytes and dendritic cells and its negative regulation (IL-8, CXCL2, MCP-1), distinct from confusables on leukocyte adhesion/extravasation, lymphocyte NF-kB activation or monocyte aggregation.

name: Kinesin-mediated neuronal vesicle and receptor transport
rationale: Members describe motor-driven transport of synaptic and dense core vesicles and receptor complexes in axons and dendrites; kinesins and microtubule depolymerization distinguish it from neighbours about mitochondrial/organelle transport or tubulin modification.

qualifier: kinesin-driven vesicle and synaptic protein delivery
name: Kinesin-driven neuronal vesicle and synaptic protein transport
rationale: Members describe axonal/dendritic transport of dense-core vesicles, synaptic vesicles and receptor complexes by kinesins, distinguished from confusables centred on mitochondrial and endolysosomal organelle transport or tubulin modification.

qualifier: kinesin-driven vesicle and synaptic protein cargo
name: Kinesin-driven neuronal vesicle and synaptic protein transport
rationale: Members describe motor-based transport of dense core vesicles, synaptic vesicles, receptor complexes and presynaptic proteins along neuronal cytoskeleton including kinesins, whereas confusables centre on mitochondrial/organelle transport or tubulin modification.

name: Locomotor behaviour and glycinergic inhibitory neurotransmission
rationale: Members are motor behaviours (walking, righting, proprioception) plus glycinergic transmission and hyperekplexia, which distinguishes it from behaviour confusables lacking inhibitory glycine signalling.

name: Glycinergic inhibitory transmission and locomotor coordination
rationale: Members combine glycinergic transmission (including GlyT2 hyperekplexia) with locomotion, proprioception, righting reflex and Purkinje layer formation, unlike cerebellar granule, exploratory or vocal behaviour neighbours; one neural RNA-binding module fits loosely.

name: Motor coordination and locomotion with glycinergic inhibitory transmission
rationale: Members are locomotor, postural and proprioceptive behaviours with cerebellar and neuronal components, and uniquely glycinergic transmission, hyperekplexia (GlyT2) and dampening of nerve impulse transmission absent from all confusables.

qualifier: hydrogen peroxide-triggered intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis
name: Hydrogen peroxide-induced intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis regulation
rationale: Members regulate peroxide/hydroperoxide responses and resulting intrinsic apoptosis or ferroptosis, distinguished from respiration, nitrosative and hypoxia/ischaemia confusables by the peroxide and ferroptosis focus.

name: Peroxide-induced intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis regulation
rationale: Members concern cell responses to hydrogen peroxide/hydroperoxides and regulation of oxidative-stress apoptosis and ferroptosis; ferroptosis and peroxide response separate it from nitrosative, hypoxic-ischaemic and respiration-control neighbours.

name: Hydrogen peroxide-induced apoptosis and ferroptosis regulation
rationale: Members regulate cell death triggered by hydrogen peroxide/hydroperoxides, including intrinsic apoptosis and iron-dependent ferroptosis; the ferroptosis/iron members and peroxide focus distinguish it from nitrosative/ischemia, respiration-control and general oxidative-stress confusables.

qualifier: mesonephric duct and ureteric bud elongation
name: Mesonephric duct and ureteric bud morphogenesis
rationale: Members describe nephric/mesonephric duct formation, ureteric bud elongation and ureter morphogenesis, whereas neighbours emphasise bud induction, branching or kidney size control.

qualifier: mesonephric duct and ureteric bud elongation
name: Mesonephric duct and ureteric bud development
rationale: Members cover nephric/mesonephric duct formation, ureteric bud elongation and ureter morphogenesis, distinct from confusables on ureteric bud initiation, branching and kidney growth regulation.

core: Nephric duct and ureteric bud development
qualifier: mesonephric duct and ureteric bud elongation
name: Mesonephric duct, ureteric bud and renal vesicle development
rationale: All members describe early urinary tract epithelial tube development; mesonephric duct, metanephric ureteric bud elongation and renal vesicle formation distinguish it from confusables on ureteric bud induction/branching and kidney size.

qualifier: primitive streak, lateral plate mesoderm and hindgut
name: Primitive streak, lateral plate mesoderm and hindgut morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern gastrulation, primitive streak formation, lateral mesoderm and posterior gut morphogenesis, unlike confusables on endoderm specification, mesendoderm and cardiac mesoderm.

qualifier: primitive streak, lateral plate mesoderm and hindgut
name: Primitive streak, lateral plate mesoderm and hindgut morphogenesis
rationale: Members span primitive streak formation, lateral plate mesoderm, mesenchyme migration and hindgut/digestive tract morphogenesis, unlike confusables on definitive endoderm, mesendoderm or cardiac mesoderm.

qualifier: primitive streak, lateral plate mesoderm and gut morphogenesis
name: Primitive streak, lateral mesoderm and embryonic gut morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover primitive streak formation, lateral plate mesoderm and mesenchyme migration and hindgut/digestive tract morphogenesis, unlike confusables centred on definitive endoderm, mesendoderm or cardiac mesoderm.

core: Membrane traffic to the plasma membrane
name: Endocytic recycling and post-Golgi delivery to the plasma membrane
rationale: Members promote endosome-to-plasma membrane recycling, receptor recycling and Golgi-to-plasma membrane transport, whereas confusables concern retrograde endosome-to-Golgi traffic, Golgi retention or Rab/ARF regulation.

name: Endocytic recycling and Golgi-to-plasma membrane trafficking
rationale: Members concern endosome organization, receptor/endocytic recycling and Golgi-to-surface transport, unlike confusables on Rab/ARF signalling, constitutive secretion or retrograde endosome-to-Golgi traffic.

core: Endosomal recycling to the plasma membrane
name: Endosomal recycling and post-Golgi delivery to the plasma membrane
rationale: Members cover receptor and endocytic recycling, endosome organisation, plasma membrane-endosome traffic and Golgi-to-surface transport, distinct from confusables on ARF/Rab-regulated Golgi budding or retrograde endosome-to-Golgi traffic.

name: RUNX3 tumour-suppressor transcription restraining proliferation
rationale: Members are RUNX3 regulation and its targets (ARF, CDKN1A, BIM, WNT, YAP1) plus FOXO cell-cycle transcription, all antiproliferative, whereas confusables centre on TGF-beta/SMAD, CDH1 or PAX3 transcription.

qualifier: restraining cell cycle, WNT and YAP1
name: RUNX3 tumour-suppressor transcription restraining cell cycle, WNT and YAP1
rationale: Members are RUNX3 (and FOXO) transcriptional programmes on CDKN1A, BIM, ARF, WNT and YAP1 targets, distinguishing it from TGF-beta/SMAD, Hippo and CDH1 transcription confusables.

name: RUNX3-centred tumour-suppressive transcription of growth-arrest genes
rationale: Members are RUNX3 (and FOXO) transcriptional control of cell-cycle, apoptosis, WNT and YAP1 targets; the RUNX3 focus separates it from TGF-beta/SMAD, Hippo and CDH1 transcription confusables.

qualifier: vesicle clustering, endocytic recycling and active zone structure
name: Presynaptic vesicle clustering, endocytosis and active zone maintenance
rationale: Members cover synaptic vesicle clustering, endocytosis, clathrin uncoating and recycling with presynaptic active zone and cytoskeleton maintenance; confusables involve postsynaptic receptor internalization, clathrin coat assembly or neurotransmitter secretion control.

qualifier: vesicle endocytosis, recycling, clustering and active zone structure
name: Presynaptic vesicle recycling and active zone organization
rationale: Members are synaptic vesicle endocytosis, recycling and clustering, clathrin uncoating and presynaptic active zone/cytoskeleton maintenance, unlike postsynaptic receptor trafficking, transmitter secretion or clathrin coat assembly confusables.

name: Presynaptic vesicle recycling and active zone cytoskeleton
rationale: Members are synaptic vesicle endocytosis, recycling, clustering and uncoating plus active zone and presynaptic cytoskeleton maintenance; confusables add clathrin assembly or postsynaptic receptor internalization.

core: Host regulation of viral life cycle
name: Host regulation of viral entry, spread and release
rationale: Members are generic regulation of viral entry, transport and release, while confusables name specific viruses or viral genome replication.

name: Regulation of viral entry, transport and release
rationale: Members are generic host and symbiont regulation of viral entry, virus transport and release, lacking the virus-specific (Dengue, RSV, influenza) entry modules and genome-replication terms of the confusables.

core: Host regulation of viral life cycle
name: Host regulation of viral entry and release
rationale: Members are general positive and negative regulation of viral entry, transport, life cycle and release, whereas confusables are virus-specific attachment/entry pathways or regulation of viral genome replication.

qualifier: inhibition of ruffling, spreading and epithelial migration
name: Leading-edge actin protrusion with ruffle and spreading inhibition
rationale: Members promote lamellipodia, pseudopodia and actin polymerization at the leading edge while restraining ruffles, cell spreading and epithelial migration, unlike confusables focused on Arp2/3 nucleation, severing or contraction.

qualifier: with restraint of ruffling, spreading and epithelial migration
name: Leading-edge actin protrusion with inhibited ruffling and spreading
rationale: Members promote actin polymerization, lamellipodia, pseudopodia and leading-edge localization while negatively regulating ruffles, cell spreading and epithelial migration; confusables instead involve actin severing, contraction and Arp2/3 nucleation.

qualifier: restraint of epithelial migration and spreading
name: Leading-edge protrusion regulation and epithelial migration restraint
rationale: Members regulate lamellipodia, pseudopodia, actin polymerization and leading-edge localization while negatively regulating ruffles, spreading and epithelial migration, which the actin-severing/contraction confusables lack.

name: Calcium ATPase pump regulation in striated muscle
rationale: Members concern inhibition of SR and plasma membrane calcium pumps with effects on muscle fiber type and survival, whereas confusables concern cardiac contraction, heart rate and other channel regulation.

name: Inhibitory regulation of striated muscle calcium pump activity
rationale: Members describe dampening calcium ATPase activity, SR calcium uptake and membrane calcium flux in muscle (with fibre-type and myocyte-death effects), unlike confusables on cardiac contraction, rate or channel excitability.

name: Calcium ATPase pump regulation in striated muscle fibres
rationale: Members regulate ATP-dependent calcium transport into the sarcoplasmic reticulum and across the plasma membrane with muscle fibre-type and apoptosis effects, whereas confusables concern cardiac contraction, heart rate and voltage-gated channels.

name: Cytosolic calcium homeostasis via sodium-calcium exchange and sequestration
rationale: Members concern lowering and buffering cytosolic calcium through Na/Ca exchangers and sequestration plus calcium/caffeine responses, unlike confusables on store-operated entry, ER release or cardiac excitation.

name: Cytosolic calcium homeostasis via sodium/calcium exchangers
rationale: Members concern cellular calcium handling and lowering cytosolic Ca2+ by Na+/Ca2+ exchange and sequestration; confusables centre on ER/ryanodine calcium release, store-operated entry or cardiac contraction.

name: Cytosolic calcium handling with sodium–calcium exchanger clearance
rationale: Members address cytosolic calcium responses, sequestration and reduction via Na+/Ca2+ exchangers, unlike confusables centred on ER/ryanodine calcium release and store-operated entry.

name: Hexosamine and sialic acid biosynthesis and their defects
rationale: Members are UDP-GlcNAc and CMP-sialic acid synthesis with GFPT1, GNE and ALG14 deficiencies, distinct from confusables about sialic/GlcNAc catabolism, mannose and dolichol pathways.

name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine and sialic acid biosynthesis
rationale: Members are synthesis of UDP-GlcNAc and CMP-sialic acid and their defects (GFPT1, GNE, ALG14), distinguishing it from GlcNAc catabolism, dolichol and GDP-mannose confusables.

name: Hexosamine biosynthesis of UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid
rationale: Members are UDP-N-acetylglucosamine synthesis (GFPT1, ALG14) and sialic acid/CMP-Neu5Ac metabolism (GNE), unlike confusables on dolichol, GDP-mannose or sialic acid catabolism.

name: Telomere DNA replication, recombination and topological remodeling
rationale: Members are telomere maintenance by recombination and replication, D-loop/t-circle handling, fork reversal and DNA topological change, distinct from telomere capping/protection and R-loop/crosslink repair neighbours.

qualifier: replication, recombination and DNA topological remodeling
name: Telomere replication, recombination and DNA topological remodeling
rationale: Members concern telomere maintenance by recombination and replication, D-loop and t-circle handling, fork reversal and DNA topology change, whereas confusables emphasise telomere capping/packaging or R-loop and crosslink repair.

qualifier: at telomeres (recombination, D-loops, t-circles) and reversed replication forks
name: Telomere recombination and replication fork DNA topology remodeling
rationale: Members concern DNA geometric/topological change during recombination-based telomere maintenance, D-loop disassembly, t-circle formation and fork reversal, unlike confusables on telomere capping/protection or R-loop and crosslink repair.

core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
name: Iron, heme, copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members are uptake, transport and homeostasis of iron (transferrin, heme, ferroportin), copper, manganese and cobalt, unlike oxygen transport, cadmium/metallothionein and scavenger-receptor confusables.

qualifier: iron, heme, copper and manganese transport
name: Iron, heme, copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members cover uptake, transport, detoxification and inherited disorders of iron (transferrin, ferroportin, ceruloplasmin), heme, copper, manganese and cobalt, unlike cadmium/metallothionein, oxygen transport and scavenger receptor confusables.

core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
name: Iron, heme, copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members cover uptake, transport and homeostasis of iron (transferrin, heme, ferroportin defects), copper, manganese and cobalt, distinct from cadmium detoxification, scavenger receptor and oxygen transport confusables.

qualifier: endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING with herpes encephalitis deficiencies
name: Endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING nucleic acid sensing
rationale: Members concern endosomal TLR3/7/8/9 trafficking and signaling, cGAS-STING regulation and IFN-beta, including TLR3-pathway deficiencies in herpes simplex encephalitis, whereas confusables emphasize RIG-I/IRF3, ADAR editing and IRF7 induction.

name: Endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING nucleic acid sensing
rationale: Members are endosomal TLR3/7/8/9 trafficking and signalling, their HSE-causing deficiencies, cGAS-STING regulation and IFN-beta control, unlike RIG-I/helicase, IRF3/IRF7 and ADAR editing confusables.

name: Endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING nucleic acid sensing
rationale: Members concern endosomal TLR trafficking, signalling and HSE-linked deficiencies plus cGAS-STING/TREX1 control of interferon-beta, which the RIG-I/IRF3 and ADAR confusables lack.

qualifier: tachykinin receptor signalling in gut, uterus, bladder and penis
name: Tachykinin-linked visceral smooth muscle contraction and relaxation
rationale: Members are smooth muscle contraction/relaxation of gut (peristalsis, gastric motility), uterus (parturition), urinary tract (micturition) and penis (erection, mating), with tachykinin receptor signalling; confusables carry histamine, serotonin or muscarinic receptor signalling instead.

qualifier: tachykinin receptor control in gut and urogenital tract
name: Tachykinin-regulated visceral smooth muscle of gut and urogenital tract
rationale: Members cover gastrointestinal, uterine and urinary smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, gastric function, micturition, erection and parturition plus tachykinin receptor signalling, whereas confusables carry serotonin, muscarinic, histamine or GnRH receptor signalling.

name: Visceral smooth muscle contraction and tachykinin receptor signaling
rationale: Members are gastrointestinal, urinary, uterine and penile smooth muscle contraction/relaxation and reproductive acts, with tachykinin receptor signaling; confusables substitute histamine, serotonin, muscarinic or GnRH receptor signaling.

qualifier: collagen, elastic fibre and basement membrane
name: Collagen, elastic fibre and basement membrane assembly
rationale: Members span collagen biosynthesis, trimerization and crosslinking, elastic fibre and basement membrane/anchoring fibril formation, whereas confusables emphasise integrin signaling, proteoglycans/DGC, hemidesmosomes or fibronectin.

qualifier: collagen, elastic fibre and basement membrane
name: Collagen, elastic fibre and basement membrane assembly
rationale: Members concern collagen biosynthesis, trimerization, crosslinking and fibril organization, elastic fibres, laminin and basement membrane assembly, whereas confusables emphasise integrin/collagen-receptor signaling, hemidesmosomes, fibronectin or proteoglycans.

qualifier: collagen, basement membrane and elastic fibre
name: Collagen, basement membrane and elastic fibre assembly
rationale: Members cover collagen biosynthesis, trimerization and oxidative crosslinking, laminin/basement membrane and anchoring fibril assembly and elastic fibres, whereas confusables emphasise proteoglycans, hemidesmosomes, fibronectin or integrin signalling.

qualifier: cationic amino acids and proton-coupled oligopeptides
name: Cationic and neutral amino acid and oligopeptide transport
rationale: Members are transport of neutral and cationic amino acids and di/oligopeptides, distinguished by proton/oligopeptide cotransport and arginine/SLC7A7 cationic transport absent from the confusables.

qualifier: with proton-coupled di- and oligopeptide transport
name: Amino acid and proton-coupled oligopeptide transmembrane transport
rationale: Members are transport of arginine, leucine, isoleucine, phenylalanine, tryptophan, glutamine, alanine, histidine and peptides (including SLC7A7 LPI and vacuolar transport), with the oligopeptide/dipeptide and cationic arginine transport setting the theme apart from lysine/ornithine, polyamine and glycine/proline confusables.

name: Amino acid and oligopeptide transmembrane transport
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane and lysosomal transport of amino acids and di/oligopeptides; proton/oligopeptide cotransport and cationic (SLC7A7, arginine) transport separate it from neutral amino acid and polyamine confusables.

core: Circadian and nuclear receptor control of metabolism
name: Circadian and nuclear receptor control of energy metabolism
rationale: Members join BMAL1/CLOCK and ROR/REV-ERB transcription with PGC-1alpha, PPARA, heme signaling, beta-cell growth and thermogenesis, distinct from core clock mechanics, adipogenesis and gluconeogenesis confusables.

name: Circadian nuclear receptor control of metabolism and beta cells
rationale: Members link BMAL1/CLOCK/NPAS and ROR/REV-ERB clock transcription with PPARA, PGC-1alpha mitochondrial biogenesis, thermogenesis and beta-cell growth, beyond the core CRY/PER clock and gluconeogenesis or adipogenesis confusables.

name: Circadian and PGC-1alpha transcriptional control of energy metabolism
rationale: Members join BMAL1/CLOCK, ROR/REV-ERB and heme signaling with PGC-1alpha, PPARA, mitochondrial biogenesis, thermogenesis and beta-cell regulation, versus core clock-protein, gluconeogenesis and adipogenesis confusables.

name: Renal epithelial polarity, brush border and podocyte development
rationale: Members combine apical/basal polarity, microvillus/brush border assembly and podocyte/glomerular epithelium (nephrin, basement membrane, albumin absorption), separating it from glomerular endothelium/mesangium and generic epithelial adhesion confusables.

name: Podocyte development, epithelial polarity and microvillus assembly
rationale: Members cover podocyte/glomerular epithelial development with nephrin and albumin uptake plus apical-basal polarity and brush border assembly, distinct from glomerular endothelial/mesangial and adherens-junction confusables.

qualifier: brush border microvilli and glomerular podocytes
name: Epithelial polarity, brush border and podocyte development
rationale: Members cover apical-basal polarity, microvillus/brush border assembly and podocyte/glomerular basement membrane development, distinct from glomerular endothelial/mesangial and adherens-junction neighbours.

name: B cell receptor signaling and its regulation
rationale: All members concern BCR signaling, its second messengers, RAS/BTK activation, CD22 and inhibitory tuning, and resulting B cell proliferation; the B cell antigen receptor focus separates it from T cell receptor and G-protein confusables and from B cell development or marker modules.

name: B cell receptor signaling and its regulation
rationale: All members concern BCR-triggered signaling (second messengers, BTK, RAS), its positive and inhibitory tuning (CD22, activation brakes) and resulting B cell proliferation, separating it from T cell receptor/CD28 and B cell marker-module confusables.

qualifier: B cell activation and its negative regulation
name: B cell receptor signaling and its regulation
rationale: Members are BCR signaling events (second messengers, RAS, BTK, CD22 regulation) plus B cell proliferation and differentiation and an activation-brake module, distinguishing it from T cell receptor and B cell development neighbours.

name: Osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and intramembranous bone formation
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast proliferation and differentiation, direct ossification, trabecular and cranial suture formation, whereas confusables centre on RUNX2, cartilage/joints, mesenchymal stem cells or Wnt.

qualifier: positive and negative regulation of osteoblast proliferation and differentiation; intramembranous ossification
name: Osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and intramembranous bone formation
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and development and the bone they form (direct ossification, cranial sutures, trabeculae, tendon), distinguished from confusables centered on Wnt/mesenchymal stem cell control or RUNX2 and cartilage/joint morphogenesis.

name: Osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and intramembranous bone formation
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and development and direct ossification, trabecular and cranial suture bone formation, unlike confusables centred on RUNX2, cartilage or mesenchymal stem cell/Wnt signalling.

name: RNA polymerase II pausing and elongation control
rationale: Members cover Pol II promoter clearance, pausing, elongation complex formation and elongation-coupled chromatin remodelling; confusables carry RNA processing, Pol I/III transcription, HIV transcription or initiation and termination.

name: RNA polymerase II promoter escape, pausing and elongation
rationale: All members concern the transition of Pol II from promoter clearance through pausing into regulated elongation, unlike confusables covering Pol I/III, HIV transcription and RNA processing.

name: RNA polymerase II promoter clearance, pausing and elongation
rationale: Members concern Pol II promoter escape, promoter-proximal pausing and elongation regulation, unlike confusables on HIV transcription, Pol I/III, termination or RNA processing.

qualifier: cytochrome and sulfonation metabolism of drugs and steroids
name: Drug and steroid xenobiotic biotransformation
rationale: Members are drug disposition (aspirin, atorvastatin, ciprofloxacin, prednisone), steroid, flavone and cytochrome metabolism and cytosolic sulfonation; confusables carry organic anion transport/bilirubin conjugation or mycotoxin detoxification.

name: Drug and steroid xenobiotic biotransformation
rationale: Members are phase I/II metabolism of drugs, steroids and flavonoids (specific drug ADME, sulfonation, cytochromes), distinct from mycotoxin detoxification and SLCO/UGT transport confusables.

name: Xenobiotic biotransformation and drug ADME
rationale: Members describe phase I/II metabolism of drugs, steroids and flavonoids (cytochromes, sulfonation, drug ADME), while confusables centre on xenobiotic transporters, bilirubin conjugation or mycotoxins.

qualifier: cell-type-specific BAF assembly and stem cell maintenance
name: BAF chromatin remodeler variants and stem cell maintenance
rationale: Members are assembly of cBAF, ncBAF, pBAF, esBAF and neuronal BAF variants plus CHD1/2 remodelers and stem cell maintenance, unlike confusables on histone acetylation and nucleosome assembly.

name: BAF (SWI/SNF) chromatin remodeling complex assembly
rationale: Most members are formation of BAF complex variants plus CHD1/2 remodelers and stem cell maintenance, distinct from histone acetylation and nucleosome assembly confusables.

name: BAF-family ATP-dependent chromatin remodeling complex assembly
rationale: Members are formation of the BAF complex variants plus CHD1/2 remodelers and stem-cell maintenance, unlike confusables centred on nucleosome assembly and histone/protein acetylation.

name: RHOBTB atypical GTPases in protein stability and proteasomal turnover
rationale: Members combine protein (de)stabilization and positive regulation of proteasomal degradation with the RHOBTB1-3 cycles, distinguishing it from chaperonin, neddylation and deubiquitinase confusables.

name: Protein stability control with RHOBTB GTPase cycles
rationale: Members regulate protein stabilization/destabilization and proteasomal catabolism together with RHOBTB1-3 cycles, which the deubiquitinase, neddylation and chaperone confusables lack.

name: Protein stability control involving RHOBTB atypical Rho GTPases
rationale: Members regulate protein stabilization, destabilization and proteasomal degradation together with RHOBTB1-3 cycles, which distinguish it from confusables on deubiquitination, chaperonin folding or neddylation.

qualifier: receptor-level control including IL-1, IL-37 and CD40
name: Receptor-level regulation of Toll-like, IL-1 and CD40 signaling
rationale: Members regulate TLR/MyD88, IL-1 receptor, IL-37 and CD40 signalling at the receptor level; confusables cover downstream TRIF/TAK1 events or inflammatory cytokine production.

qualifier: with IL-1, IL-37 and CD40 receptor signaling
name: Regulation of TLR, IL-1 and CD40 receptor signaling
rationale: Members regulate TLR (MyD88, TLR3, TLR4), IL-1/IL-37 and CD40 receptor signaling; receptor-level regulation distinguishes it from confusables centred on downstream TRIF/IKK/TAK1 events and inflammatory cytokine production.

qualifier: IL-1, IL-37 and CD40 receptor signaling
name: Regulation of Toll-like, IL-1 and CD40 receptor signaling
rationale: Members regulate TLR, MyD88, IL-1, IL-37 and CD40 receptor signalling, whereas neighbours carry downstream cytokine production or TRIF/TAK1 events.

core: Lipid-linked glycan carrier and anchor biosynthesis
name: Dolichyl-phosphate and GPI anchor biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern synthesis of dolichyl phosphate/dolichol-linked oligosaccharides or GPI anchor synthesis and attachment, unlike confusables on nucleotide sugars, glycosphingolipids or mannose-CDG defects.

name: Dolichyl-phosphate and GPI anchor biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover dolichyl-phosphate/dolichol-oligosaccharide synthesis and GPI anchor synthesis and attachment, unlike confusables on GDP-mannose CDGs, glycosphingolipids or UDP-GlcNAc/sialic acid.

name: GPI anchor and dolichyl phosphate biosynthesis
rationale: Members are GPI synthesis/attachment and dolichyl phosphate synthesis (including DHDDS disease), unlike confusables on nucleotide sugars, dolichyl-mannose CDGs or glycosphingolipids.

name: Netrin signaling and DSCAM/Sidekick neurite self-avoidance
rationale: All members concern guidance of axons and dendrites through netrin signaling and DSCAM/SDK-mediated self-avoidance, which the ephrin/L1/Slit and chemorepulsion confusables lack.

name: Netrin and DSCAM/sidekick neurite guidance and self-avoidance
rationale: Members combine netrin signalling and axon extension with DSCAM/SDK homophilic interactions and dendrite self-avoidance, the latter absent from the axon-repulsion, ephrin and L1 confusables.

name: Netrin axon guidance and DSCAM/sidekick dendrite self-avoidance
rationale: Members are netrin-driven axon extension/repulsion and DSCAM/SDK-mediated dendrite self-avoidance, distinguishing it from confusables built on ephrin, L1, semaphorin and Slit/Robo guidance.

qualifier: sterol-sensing SREBP control of biosynthesis and uptake
name: Sterol-sensing SREBP control of cholesterol biosynthesis and uptake
rationale: Members concern sensing cellular cholesterol and SREBP-mediated regulation of cholesterol synthesis and receptor-mediated uptake, unlike confusables about LXR-driven efflux, reverse transport or LDL receptor degradation.

qualifier: SREBP feedback on synthesis and uptake
name: SREBP-mediated sterol feedback on cholesterol synthesis and uptake
rationale: Members describe sterol sensing via SREBP that tunes cholesterol biosynthesis and receptor-mediated uptake, while confusables concern LXR-driven efflux, reverse cholesterol transport and lipoprotein receptor turnover.

name: Cholesterol sensing and SREBP feedback on biosynthesis
rationale: Members concern sterol sensing, SREBP signaling and regulation of cholesterol synthesis and uptake, distinct from the confusables' LXR-driven efflux and lipoprotein clearance.

qualifier: oxysterol routes and hereditary spastic paraplegias
name: Oxysterol bile acid synthesis and hereditary spastic paraplegias
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis via 24- and 27-hydroxycholesterol and diseases of oxysterol and related enzymes (CTX, SPG5A, SPG56, SPG42), unlike confusables on the 7alpha route, peroxisomal oxidation or cholesterol biosynthesis.

qualifier: oxysterol routes and hereditary spastic paraplegia
name: Oxysterol bile acid synthesis and hereditary spastic paraplegia
rationale: Members are 24-/27-hydroxycholesterol bile acid synthesis, cholesterol catabolism and CYP7B1/CYP2U1/SLC33A1/CYP27A1 neurological disorders, unlike classic 7alpha-hydroxylase or peroxisomal oxidation confusables.

qualifier: 24/27-hydroxycholesterol route and hereditary spastic paraplegia defects
name: Oxysterol-route bile acid synthesis and hereditary spastic paraplegia defects
rationale: Members are cholesterol catabolism via 24/27-hydroxycholesterol and related inherited defects (CTX, SPG5A, SPG56, SPG42), distinguishing it from 7alpha-hydroxylase, cholesterol synthesis and peroxisomal oxidation confusables.

name: OCT4/SOX2/NANOG pluripotency and definitive endoderm specification
rationale: Members span pluripotency-factor regulation, gastrulation EMT and definitive endoderm/foregut specification, distinguishing it from lateral mesoderm, primitive streak and pancreatic-lineage confusables.

name: Pluripotency network and definitive endoderm formation
rationale: Members cover OCT4/SOX2/NANOG pluripotency control and definitive endoderm/foregut specification, whereas confusables focus on mesoderm, primitive streak or pancreatic lineages.

name: Pluripotency exit and definitive endoderm specification
rationale: Members combine OCT4/SOX2/NANOG pluripotency control, gastrulation EMT, definitive endoderm fate and foregut morphogenesis, distinct from mesoderm/primitive streak, lateral plate and pancreatic lineage confusables.

name: IL-11, CNTF and other IL-6-family autocrine/paracrine cytokine signaling
rationale: Members concern IL-6-family cytokine receptor-ligand signalling (IL-11, CNTF, LIF/OSM) with autocrine and paracrine action, unlike confusables centred on IL-6/JAK-STAT3 itself or M-CSF signalling.

qualifier: CNTF and IL-11 ligands, autocrine and paracrine
name: IL-6-family cytokine ligands in autocrine and paracrine signalling
rationale: Members cover IL-6-type receptor ligands (CNTF, IL-11, LIF/OSM) with autocrine/paracrine signalling, unlike confusables centred on IL-6 JAK-STAT3/ERK signalling or CSF1 receptor signalling.

name: Autocrine/paracrine IL-6-family cytokine signaling via CNTF and IL-11
rationale: Members concern IL-6-type cytokine receptor-ligand interactions (CNTF, IL-11, LIF/OSM inflammatory cytokines) and autocrine/paracrine signaling, unlike confusables centred on IL-6/STAT3 itself or M-CSF signaling.

name: Desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly anchoring intermediate filaments
rationale: Members are desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly, intermediate filament bundling and epithelial junction protein localization, with hemidesmosomes distinguishing it from adherens/cardiac junction and cornification neighbours.

qualifier: desmosomes and hemidesmosomes with intermediate filaments
name: Desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly anchoring intermediate filaments
rationale: Members are assembly of intermediate-filament-anchoring junctions (desmosomes, hemidesmosomes) in epithelial adhesion; hemidesmosomes distinguish it from adherens/apical junction, cardiac adhesion and cornification neighbours.

name: Epithelial desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly
rationale: Members assemble intermediate filament-anchored desmosomes and hemidesmosomes in epithelial adhesion; neighbours lack hemidesmosomes and instead cover cardiac adhesion, apical/adherens junctions or cornification.

name: Erythroid differentiation with heme synthesis and oxygen transport
rationale: Members are erythroid-lineage differentiation programmes together with heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport, distinguishing them from confusables that are purely heme/Fe-S biosynthesis or primitive/definitive erythropoiesis regulation.

qualifier: with heme synthesis and oxygen transport
name: Erythroid maturation with heme synthesis and oxygen transport
