rationale: Members combine erythroid differentiation programmes with heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport, whereas confusables are either heme/Fe-S synthesis alone or erythroid differentiation without the heme arm.

name: Erythroid differentiation and heme biosynthesis
rationale: Members describe red cell differentiation, oxygen transport and heme synthesis; combining both distinguishes it from confusables that have only erythroid differentiation or only heme/Fe-S biosynthesis.

qualifier: repair DNA synthesis in SDSA and break-induced replication
name: Repair DNA synthesis in recombinational double-strand break repair
rationale: Members concern DNA unwinding and repair synthesis in synthesis-dependent strand annealing, break-induced replication and sister chromatid exchange, unlike confusables on NHEJ, BRCA signaling or checkpoints.

qualifier: repair DNA synthesis via SDSA and break-induced replication
name: Synthesis-dependent double-strand break repair and break-induced replication
rationale: Members concern repair DNA synthesis, unwinding and polymerase activation in SDSA, break-induced replication and sister chromatid exchange, whereas confusables cover NHEJ, break sensing, strand invasion and checkpoints.

name: Repair DNA synthesis in recombinational double-strand break repair
rationale: Members concern DNA synthesis-dependent DSB repair (break-induced replication, SDSA, sister chromatid exchange) and polymerase/unwinding activity, unlike confusables on DSB sensing, NHEJ or cell-cycle checkpoints.

qualifier: neutrophil lineage from myeloid progenitors via G-CSF
name: Neutrophil granulopoiesis from myeloid progenitors via G-CSF
rationale: Members are transcriptional and G-CSF-driven commitment of myeloid progenitors to neutrophils; confusables instead cover M-CSF/GM-CSF monocyte-macrophage, dendritic, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation.

name: Myeloid progenitor differentiation toward neutrophil granulocytes
rationale: Members describe myeloid progenitor commitment and transcriptional/G-CSF-driven granulopoiesis to neutrophils, whereas confusables concern monocyte/macrophage/dendritic cell, eosinophil/mast cell or GM-CSF/M-CSF-driven differentiation.

name: G-CSF-driven neutrophil differentiation from myeloid progenitors
rationale: Members cover myeloid progenitor commitment and transcriptional control of granulopoiesis with G-CSF signalling, unlike macrophage/monocyte, GM-CSF or eosinophil/mast cell neighbours.

qualifier: SOS/SHC-driven RAS activation and RSK output
name: SOS-mediated RAS activation and downstream MAPK/RSK signalling
rationale: Members describe positive RAS activation (SOS, SHC/IGF1R, RAS and MAP2K mutants) and outputs to RSK and p38, whereas confusables emphasize RAF/MRAS complexes, RAS GAPs and negative feedback.

name: SOS-mediated Ras activation and oncogenic RAS-MAPK signaling
rationale: Members are positive Ras signal transduction via SHC/SOS, RAS and MAP2K mutants, RSK and p38 outputs, unlike confusables on RAS GAPs, NF1 loss or ERK inactivation.

qualifier: SOS-driven, with RSK and p38 outputs
name: SOS-mediated RAS activation and downstream MAPK effector signaling
rationale: Members describe positive RAS signalling via SOS/SHC, RAS and MAP2K mutants and RSK/p38 outputs, unlike confusables dominated by RAS GAPs, ERK inactivation and negative feedback.

qualifier: calcium-triggered vesicle exocytosis and its modulation
name: Presynaptic calcium-triggered neurotransmitter release and its modulation
rationale: Members cover neurotransmitter release cycles, vesicle docking/priming/fusion, presynaptic calcium and G-protein modulation, unlike vesicle-recycling and postsynaptic AMPA/kainate confusables.

name: Presynaptic neurotransmitter release and its G-protein modulation
rationale: Members cover calcium-triggered vesicle docking, priming and exocytosis of transmitters and Gbeta-gamma/GIRK presynaptic inhibition, distinct from postsynaptic AMPA/kainate and vesicle-recycling confusables.

qualifier: calcium-triggered exocytosis and its presynaptic modulation
name: Presynaptic calcium-triggered neurotransmitter release and its modulation
rationale: Members cover synaptic vesicle docking, priming, SNARE assembly and calcium-dependent exocytosis for multiple transmitters plus presynaptic G-protein and kainate modulation, unlike the vesicle-recycling and postsynaptic AMPA/kainate receptor neighbours.

qualifier: desmosomes, hemidesmosomes, cadherin turnover in EMT
name: Epithelial cadherin junctions, desmosomes and polarity in EMT
rationale: Members cover adherens, desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly, apical-basal polarity and EMT, distinguishing them from endothelial adherens regulation and tight-junction barrier confusables.

qualifier: desmosomes, hemidesmosomes, apical-basal polarity and EMT
name: Epithelial adherens, desmosomal junctions, polarity and EMT
rationale: Members cover cadherin adherens junctions, desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly, epithelial polarity and EMT, which separates it from cadherin-regulation and tight-junction confusables.

name: Epithelial anchoring junctions, apicobasal polarity and EMT
rationale: Members cover cadherin adherens junctions, desmosomes, hemidesmosomes, apical-basal polarity and EMT, whereas confusables concern negative regulation of cadherin adhesion, endothelial morphogenesis or tight junctions.

qualifier: cell death control and mitochondrial respiration regulation
name: Redox-stress cell death and mitochondrial respiration regulation
rationale: Members cover responses to peroxide, NO and reactive nitrogen species, the ferroptotic and intrinsic apoptotic deaths they trigger, and regulation of OXPHOS/respiration, which the ROS-detoxification and hypoxia confusables lack.

qualifier: respiration regulation, ferroptosis and intrinsic apoptosis
name: Oxidative and nitrosative stress cell death and respiration regulation
rationale: Members are responses to H2O2, NO, ischemia and hypoxia, control of mitochondrial respiration/ATP synthesis, and ferroptotic and intrinsic apoptotic death, distinguishing it from ROS-detoxification and osmotic/drug-response neighbours.

core: Oxidative and nitrosative stress-induced cell death
qualifier: with mitochondrial respiration control and ferroptosis
name: Oxidative stress-induced apoptosis and ferroptosis with mitochondrial respiration control
rationale: Members are responses to peroxide, nitric oxide and ischemia regulating intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis together with regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and respiration, a combination no confusable has (they lack either the stress-death or the respiration arm).

name: Endocardial cushion EMT and cardiac valve-septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern endocardial cushion EMT, valve and membranous/muscular septum formation and great artery development, distinct from myocardial/ventricular and neural crest outflow tract neighbours.

name: Endocardial cushion EMT, valve and septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover endocardial cushion EMT and fusion, valve and septum morphogenesis and adjacent great-artery development, unlike confusables on myocardial/ventricular growth or neural crest outflow tract.

name: Endocardial cushion EMT, valve and septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern endocardium, cushion EMT and fusion, valve and septum formation and great artery roots; distinct from myocardial/ventricular and neural crest outflow tract confusables.

name: HGF-MET signaling in hepatocyte proliferation and liver regeneration
rationale: Members are MET/HGF and MST1 signalling cascades plus hepatocyte differentiation, liver morphogenesis and regeneration; confusables share kinase cascades but lack the liver context.

qualifier: in hepatocyte proliferation and liver regeneration
name: HGF-MET signaling in hepatocyte proliferation and liver regeneration
rationale: Members are MET receptor activation and downstream effectors, HGF/MST1 responses, plus hepatocyte proliferation and differentiation, liver morphogenesis and regeneration; MET and liver terms distinguish it from PTK6, generic PI3K/RTK, TGF-beta and erythropoietin/IGF1R confusables.

name: HGF–MET signaling in hepatocyte proliferation and liver regeneration
rationale: Members are MET receptor activation and its RAS, PI3K, STAT3, PTPN11, RAP1 effectors plus hepatocyte differentiation, proliferation and liver regeneration, which the TGF-beta, PI3K and PTK6 neighbours lack.

name: Melanosome and lysosome-related organelle biogenesis in pigmentation
rationale: Members cover melanin synthesis, melanosome/pigment granule and platelet dense granule biogenesis via coated-vesicle cargo loading, unlike confusables on organelle acidification, lysosomal targeting or other MITF programmes.

qualifier: melanosome and lysosome-related organelle biogenesis, light response
name: Melanin pigmentation and lysosome-related organelle biogenesis
rationale: Members cover melanin synthesis, melanosome assembly/maturation and related organelles (platelet dense granules, AP-3 coated vesicles) plus light responses; organelle biogenesis distinguishes it from MITF-M non-pigment target and organelle-acidification confusables.

name: Melanosome and lysosome-related organelle biogenesis in pigmentation
rationale: Members cover melanin synthesis, MITF pigmentation genes, melanosome/dense granule assembly and light responses, unlike confusables on other MITF programmes, organelle acidification or lysosomal enzyme targeting.

qualifier: endocannabinoid and platelet-activating factor lipid signals
name: Phospholipid and glycerolipid catabolism generating endocannabinoid signals
rationale: Members hydrolyze phospholipids, lysophospholipids, ether lipids, DAG and MAG and metabolize N-acylethanolamines and PAF feeding endocannabinoid signaling; confusables are dominated by glycerophospholipid synthesis and acyl-chain remodeling.

name: Glycerophospholipid and acylglycerol catabolism generating endocannabinoid signals
rationale: Members are phospholipase/lipase breakdown of lysophospholipids, PC, ether lipids, PAF, DAG and MAG yielding arachidonate and N-acylethanolamine/endocannabinoid signals, distinct from confusables on acyl-chain remodeling, phospholipid synthesis and glycerol metabolism.

name: Phospholipase-driven glycerophospholipid catabolism and endocannabinoid lipid signaling
rationale: Members hydrolyze phospholipids, lysophospholipids, DAG/MAG and NAPE/NAE and include endocannabinoid retrograde signaling; neighbours are phospholipid synthesis/remodeling or glycerol metabolism.

name: Craniofacial, limb and pharyngeal gland embryonic morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover face, skull, palate, ear and limb morphogenesis plus thymus/thyroid/parathyroid/pituitary/spleen development, distinguishing it from inner ear, neural plate and outflow tract confusables.

name: Craniofacial, limb and pharyngeal organ morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover face, skull, palate, ear, nose and limb morphogenesis plus thymus/parathyroid/thyroid development, distinguishing it from outflow-tract, inner-ear/gland and neural plate patterning confusables.

name: Craniofacial, limb and pharyngeal-derived organ development
rationale: Members cover face, palate, skull, nose and outer ear, limb/digit morphogenesis and thyroid, parathyroid, thymus (plus spleen) development; confusables are neural plate patterning, cardiac neural crest or inner ear/gland formation.

qualifier: NAD salvage, coenzyme A synthesis and pyruvate dehydrogenase
name: NAD, coenzyme A and pyruvate dehydrogenase acetyl-CoA metabolism
rationale: Members cover NAD/NADP biosynthesis and salvage, pantothenate/CoA synthesis and PDH-catalysed pyruvate to acetyl-CoA conversion, distinguishing it from thiamine/riboflavin vitamin, TCA cycle and OGDH/lipoylation neighbours.

qualifier: NAD and coenzyme A for pyruvate dehydrogenase
name: NAD and coenzyme A supply for pyruvate dehydrogenase
rationale: Members cover nicotinate/NAD(P) and pantothenate/CoA metabolism with PDH acetyl-CoA production, unlike thiamine/riboflavin, OGDH/lipoylation or TCA neighbours.

qualifier: pyruvate dehydrogenase, coenzyme A and NAD+ metabolism
name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase, coenzyme A and NAD+ cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover PDH conversion of pyruvate to acetyl-CoA, pantothenate/CoA synthesis and nicotinate/NAD(P)+ synthesis, salvage, transport and turnover; the NAD+/nicotinate terms distinguish it from thiamine/riboflavin, OGDH/lipoylation and TCA-cycle neighbours.

name: Keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and epidermal barrier formation
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis, cornification and skin barrier, distinguished from sebaceous, melanocyte and cornified-envelope-only confusables by keratinocyte regulation.

core: Keratinocyte differentiation and epidermal barrier formation
qualifier: control of keratinocyte proliferation versus differentiation
name: Keratinocyte proliferation-differentiation control and epidermal barrier formation
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis and cornification to build the skin barrier, distinguishing the theme from cornified-envelope cross-linking and hair/melanocyte/sebaceous confusables.

name: Keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and epidermal barrier formation
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation and differentiation through cornification to skin barrier, distinguishing it from melanocyte, sebaceous gland and envelope cross-linking confusables.

name: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuron specification and patterning
rationale: Members concern dorsoventral patterning and motor neuron/interneuron specification in spinal cord and brainstem, unlike confusables on branchiomotor nerves, floor plate/neural plate or midbrain dopaminergic neurons.

core: Hindbrain and spinal cord neural development
qualifier: brainstem maturation and spinal motor neuron patterning
name: Brainstem development and spinal cord motor neuron patterning
rationale: Members span hindbrain/pons maturation and respiratory control with dorsoventral spinal cord patterning and motor/interneuron specification, distinguishing it from cranial nerve, midbrain dopaminergic and floor plate/notochord confusables.

name: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuron specification and patterning
rationale: Members span both spinal cord dorsoventral patterning and motor/interneuron fate and hindbrain/brainstem development, whereas each confusable holds only one region plus floor plate, midbrain or cranial nerve terms.

name: Insulin- and adiponectin-regulated glucose and fatty acid uptake
rationale: Members cover GLUT4 translocation, insulin-stimulated glucose import, insulin receptor recycling/clearance, adiponectin signalling and fatty acid import/oxidation control, unlike confusables focused on beta-cell secretion, glucagon signalling or adipocyte lipolysis.

name: Insulin- and adiponectin-regulated glucose and fatty acid uptake
rationale: Members cover insulin-stimulated GLUT4 glucose import, insulin receptor recycling/clearance, adiponectin signaling and control of fatty acid uptake and oxidation, unlike confusables on insulin secretion, glucagon/gluconeogenesis or lipolysis.

qualifier: adiponectin; glucose and fatty acid uptake
name: Insulin- and adiponectin-regulated glucose and fatty acid uptake
rationale: Members cover GLUT4 translocation, insulin-stimulated glucose import, insulin receptor recycling/catabolism, adiponectin signalling and restraint of fatty acid uptake and oxidation, unlike confusables about beta-cell insulin secretion, lipolysis or glucagon signalling.

name: Two-pore-domain K+ leak channels and acid sensing
rationale: Members are K2P channel families setting resting potential plus acidic-pH responses, sour taste and TRP channels, which the pain, Ca2+-activated and KATP channel confusables lack.

name: Two-pore-domain K+ channels, acid sensing and sour taste
rationale: Members are K2P channel families setting resting potential plus acidic-pH responses, TRP channels and sour taste, distinguishing it from pain/thermosensation and Ca2+- or ATP-sensitive K+ channel neighbours.

core: Two-pore-domain potassium channels and resting potential
name: Two-pore K+ channels, resting potential and acid/sour sensing
rationale: Members are the K2P channel families setting resting membrane potential plus acid-pH responses and sour taste with TRP channels, while confusables are Ca2+-activated or ATP-sensitive K+ channels or pain/thermal TRP sensing.

qualifier: mating, parental and aggressive behavior plus parturition
name: Sexual, parental and aggressive behavior and parturition
rationale: Members are mating, parental and aggressive behaviors and reproductive physiology (erection, insemination, parturition, uterine contraction); neighbours add tachykinin signaling, urinary smooth muscle or exploratory behaviors.

name: Reproductive and social behaviour, mating and parturition
rationale: Members concern mating, parental and aggressive behaviour plus reproductive physiology (erection, insemination, parturition, uterine contraction, relaxin), distinguished from general behaviour, urinary smooth muscle and tachykinin signalling neighbours.

name: Reproductive behavior, parturition and uterine contraction
rationale: Members cover mating, parental and aggressive behavior, insemination, erection and relaxin-linked uterine contraction at parturition; unlike neighbours it combines reproductive behaviors with parturition rather than tachykinin, drinking, exploratory or urinary smooth muscle terms.

name: Mitochondrial valine/isoleucine catabolism and metabolite repair
rationale: Members cover valine/isoleucine and short-chain acyl-CoA catabolism defects, biotin metabolism and 2-hydroxyglutarate metabolite repair, unlike the leucine-catabolism disorder confusables.

name: Mitochondrial valine/isoleucine catabolism and organic acid repair
rationale: Members cover valine/isoleucine and short-chain acyl-CoA breakdown (ECHS1, HIBCH deficiencies), biotin-dependent carboxylation and 2-hydroxyglutarate/toxic metabolite repair, unlike the leucine-catabolism confusables.

core: Mitochondrial branched-chain and short-chain acyl-CoA catabolism
name: Mitochondrial valine, isoleucine and short-chain acyl-CoA catabolism
rationale: Most members concern valine/isoleucine and short-chain fatty acid catabolism (ECHS1, HIBCH deficiencies) with metabolite repair and biotin, distinguishing it from the leucine-catabolism confusables.

name: IL-6, IL-27 and IL-35 gp130 cytokine signalling
rationale: All members are IL-6, IL-27 or IL-35 signalling (gp130-using cytokines) including IL-6-driven ERK1/2 activation, distinguished from confusables with other IL-6-family (CNTF, LIF, IL-11) or common-gamma-chain cytokines by IL-27/IL-35.

core: IL-6 family cytokine signaling via STAT3
qualifier: IL-6, IL-27 and IL-35 with ERK activation
name: IL-6, IL-27 and IL-35 signaling via STAT3 and ERK
rationale: All members concern IL-6 and the IL-27/IL-35 heterodimeric cytokines signaling through JAK-STAT3 and ERK1/2, distinguishing it from confusables built on common-gamma-chain cytokines or CNTF/LIF/IL-11 gp130 ligands.

qualifier: IL-6, IL-27 and IL-35 with ERK1/2 activation
name: IL-6, IL-27 and IL-35 signalling with ERK1/2 activation
rationale: Members are IL-6 and the gp130-using IL-27/IL-35 cytokine pathways with downstream ERK1/2 activation; IL-27/IL-35 separate it from IL-11/CNTF/LIF confusables, and IL-6 and ERK members from the IL-2/IL-12 family confusable.

name: Mitotic centrosome maturation and spindle orientation
rationale: Members are AURKA-TPX2 activation, NuMA and centrosome protein recruitment and astral microtubule-driven spindle positioning; confusables cover interphase centrosome/cilia biology or the broader mitotic progression machinery.

qualifier: centrosome maturation and astral microtubule orientation
name: Mitotic centrosome maturation and spindle positioning
rationale: Members cover recruitment of centrosome proteins/NuMA, AURKA-TPX2 activation, astral microtubules and spindle localization/orientation, distinct from APC/C mitotic progression, centriole/cilia and chromosome segregation confusables.

name: Mitotic centrosome maturation and spindle orientation
rationale: Members cover recruitment of NuMA and centrosome proteins, AURKA-TPX2 activation, astral microtubules and spindle localization/orientation, distinguishing it from interphase centrosome/cilium confusables and broad mitotic progression confusables.

name: RUNX1 transcriptional control of haematopoietic and immune genes
rationale: All members concern RUNX-family (mainly RUNX1) regulation of myeloid, megakaryocyte, BCR and interleukin genes, distinct from granulopoiesis programmes and from RUNX1 targets outside blood (WNT, estrogen, keratinocyte).

qualifier: hematopoietic lineage and immune signaling target genes
name: RUNX1-centred transcription of hematopoietic and immune signaling genes
rationale: All members describe RUNX1 (with RUNX2/RUNX3) regulation and its control of myeloid, megakaryocyte, BCR and interleukin genes, unlike RUNX1 estrogen/WNT/keratinocyte or granulopoiesis neighbours.

qualifier: RUNX1 regulation and myeloid, megakaryocytic and lymphoid targets
name: RUNX1 control and its myeloid, megakaryocytic and lymphoid target genes
rationale: All members describe RUNX1 regulation, cofactors and its haematopoietic target programmes (myeloid, megakaryocyte/platelet, BCR, interleukin), separating it from neighbours on granulopoiesis, erythro-megakaryopoiesis and non-haematopoietic RUNX1 targets.

qualifier: thymocyte proliferation and survival with B-lineage differentiation
name: Thymocyte proliferation and survival with early B-lineage differentiation
rationale: Members regulate immature thymocyte proliferation, survival and differentiation together with pro-B/B cell and hematopoietic progenitor differentiation, unlike bone marrow niche, thymic selection and mature T cell activation confusables.

name: Regulation of early thymocyte and B-progenitor development
rationale: Members regulate hematopoietic progenitor, immature thymocyte proliferation/survival and pro-B differentiation, unlike confusables on thymic selection, T cell activation or bone marrow homeostasis.

qualifier: thymocyte expansion and B cell differentiation
name: Early lymphoid development: thymocyte expansion and B cell differentiation
rationale: Members regulate hematopoietic progenitor, pro-B and B cell differentiation and immature thymocyte proliferation/survival, whereas confusables emphasize thymic selection, mature T cell activation or bone marrow cell homeostasis.

name: Bicarbonate transport in renal acidification and enamel mineralization
rationale: Members are SLC4 bicarbonate transporters and their renal tubular acidosis defects plus enamel mineralization and tooth eruption, the dental context separating them from SLC26, carbonic anhydrase and sulfonate transport confusables.

name: Bicarbonate transport with enamel mineralization and tooth eruption
rationale: Members concern SLC4 bicarbonate transport and SLC24A4-dependent enamel mineralization/tooth eruption, which the SLC26 and carbonic-anhydrase confusables lack.

name: Bicarbonate transport in enamel mineralization and tooth eruption
rationale: Members share SLC4 bicarbonate transport (with its renal acidosis defects) and ion transport for enamel mineralization and tooth eruption, the dental context absent from SLC26 anion-exchange and pH confusables.

name: Epithelial and keratinocyte migration control in wound healing
rationale: Members regulate epithelial/keratinocyte migration, epidermal spreading, focal adhesion and ECM disassembly, distinct from confusables on keratinocyte proliferation/IL-20 or inhibition of cell adhesion and spreading.

qualifier: keratinocyte migration with adhesion and matrix disassembly
name: Epithelial and keratinocyte migration via adhesion and matrix disassembly
rationale: Members regulate epithelial and keratinocyte migration, focal adhesion and extracellular matrix disassembly and EGF response, whereas confusables emphasise wound-healing proliferation, inflammation or Rho/Rac adhesion inhibition.

name: Regulation of epithelial and keratinocyte cell migration
rationale: Members regulate epithelial and keratinocyte migration (with EGF response and focal adhesion/ECM disassembly), whereas confusables emphasise keratinocyte proliferation, wound inflammation or negative adhesion signalling.

name: Insulin-like growth factor response and bone maturation mineralization
rationale: Members combine IGF/peptide hormone responses with mineralization during bone maturation and chondrocyte development, and the IGF response distinguishes it from osteoblast, osteoclast and sphingolipid neighbours.

name: Insulin-like growth factor response and bone mineralization
rationale: Members combine IGF/peptide hormone responses with chondrocyte development and bone mineralization during maturation, lacking the osteoclast, osteoblast-proliferation and sphingolipid members of the confusables.

name: IGF response and bone mineralization
rationale: Members combine cellular responses to IGF/peptide hormones with bone mineralization and chondrocyte development, distinguishing it from osteoclast/bone-resorption and osteoblast-proliferation confusables.

qualifier: Fas-mediated death of activated T cells and thymocytes
name: Fas-mediated apoptosis of activated T cells and thymocytes
rationale: Members cover FasL signaling, BID activation, activation-induced T cell death, thymocyte apoptosis and T cell signaling/allograft modules, distinguishing them from TRAIL, caspase-8/c-FLIP or hepatocyte death-receptor confusables.

core: Death receptor apoptosis in T cells
name: Fas ligand-mediated activation-induced T cell death
rationale: Members are FasL/CD95 signalling, BID activation, thymocyte apoptosis, T cell activation-induced death and T cell/allograft modules, unlike the TRAIL and generic extrinsic apoptosis confusables.

qualifier: Fas ligand-mediated T cell activation-induced death
name: FasL-mediated T cell apoptosis and activation-induced cell death
rationale: Members concern Fas/FasL signalling, BID activation and T cell/thymocyte death and allograft rejection, distinguishing it from TRAIL and generic extrinsic apoptosis confusables.

qualifier: ER and endosomal compartments, inositol phosphate turnover
name: ER and endosomal phosphoinositide and inositol phosphate metabolism
rationale: Members are PIP synthesis at ER and early/late endosomes, phosphoinositide dephosphorylation and IP2/IP/inositol metabolism, unlike confusables on Golgi/plasma membrane PIPs or membrane traffic and lipid transfer.

qualifier: ER and endosome membranes, inositol phosphate dephosphorylation
name: ER and endosomal phosphoinositide synthesis and inositol phosphate dephosphorylation
rationale: Members cover PIP synthesis at ER and early/late endosome membranes and cytosolic dephosphorylation to IP2, IP and inositol, unlike confusables on Golgi/plasma membrane PIPs, IP3/IP4 synthesis or ER lipid transfer.

qualifier: endosomal and ER membranes plus inositol phosphate turnover
name: Endosomal and ER phosphoinositide and inositol phosphate turnover
rationale: Members are PIP synthesis at ER and early/late endosome membranes, phosphatidylinositol dephosphorylation and inositol phosphate breakdown, unlike Golgi/plasma membrane PIP or lipid-transfer confusables.

qualifier: chambers, septa and valves via endocardial cushions
name: Heart chamber, septum and valve morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover ventricular/atrial myocardium, septation, endocardial cushion EMT and valve formation, distinguishing it from conduction-system, outflow-tract/neural-crest and coronary-vessel confusables.

qualifier: chambers, septa, valves and endocardial cushion EMT
name: Heart chamber, septum and valve morphogenesis with endocardial cushion EMT
rationale: Members span ventricular/atrial myocardium, septation, valve formation, endocardial cushion EMT and second heart field, distinguishing the theme from outflow tract/neural crest, coronary vascular, sarcomere and conduction-system neighbours.

qualifier: chambers, septa and endocardial cushion valves
name: Heart chamber, septum and endocardial cushion valve development
rationale: Members span myocardial chamber, septum and valve development via endocardial cushion EMT, whereas neighbours focus on conduction system, coronary vasculature or outflow tract.

name: Lipoxygenase and cytochrome P450 eicosanoid metabolism
rationale: Members cover leukotriene, lipoxin, hepoxilin, HETE and EET synthesis and fatty acid omega-hydroxylation; confusables hold leukotriene/prostanoid receptor signaling or omega-3 resolvin and protectin synthesis.

core: Eicosanoid and oxidized fatty acid metabolism
qualifier: lipoxygenase and cytochrome P450 (omega-hydroxylase, epoxygenase) routes
name: Lipoxygenase and cytochrome P450 eicosanoid metabolism
rationale: Members are biosynthesis/catabolism of leukotrienes, lipoxins, HETEs, hepoxilins and EETs by lipoxygenases and P450 hydroxylases/epoxygenases, plus fatty-acid transport and skin defects in that pathway; confusables add eicosanoid receptors or pro-resolving mediators and lack the P450 members.

core: Oxidative metabolism of arachidonate and fatty acids
qualifier: by lipoxygenase and cytochrome P450 enzymes
name: Lipoxygenase and P450 eicosanoid and fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members cover lipoxygenase and P450 epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase production and turnover of eicosanoids (HETEs, EETs, leukotrienes, lipoxins, hepoxilins) and related fatty acid oxidation, distinguishing it from eicosanoid receptor signaling themes and from omega-3 resolvin/protectin biosynthesis.

qualifier: isoform-specific ligand binding and FRS/SHC cascades
name: FGFR isoform ligand binding and FRS/SHC-mediated signalling
rationale: Members are FGFR1-4 splice-isoform ligand binding, Klotho, oncogenic mutants and FRS/SHC/PLCG cascades, unlike Sprouty-regulation or PI3K-cascade FGFR confusables and EGFR/MET signalling.

qualifier: splice-isoform ligand binding and oncogenic mutants
name: FGFR isoform ligand binding, oncogenic mutants and adaptor cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR1-4 b/c isoform ligand binding, Klotho co-receptors, activating mutants and FRS/SHC/PLCgamma/PI3K cascades, which confusables (PI3K-only, Spry regulation, other RTKs) lack.

qualifier: splice-isoform ligand binding and activating mutants
name: FGFR splice-isoform ligand binding, mutant activation and signaling
rationale: All members are FGFR1-4 activation and adaptor cascades, and the b/c isoform-specific ligand binding, Klotho co-receptors and activating mutants distinguish it from Sprouty/PI3K-focused FGFR and other RTK confusables.

qualifier: docking, priming and SNARE-driven release cycle
name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming and neurotransmitter release cycle
rationale: All members concern vesicle docking, SNARE assembly, priming and calcium-dependent exocytosis of neurotransmitters, unlike confusables on vesicle recycling/endocytosis or GABA/glutamate secretion and short-term plasticity.

qualifier: vesicle docking, priming and calcium-triggered exocytosis
name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming and calcium-triggered neurotransmitter release
rationale: Members cover the release cycle of monoamine, acetylcholine and glutamate vesicles through docking, SNARE assembly, priming and Ca2+-dependent fusion, unlike confusables on vesicle recycling/endocytosis and presynaptic calcium or GABA/glutamate secretion control.

qualifier: docking, priming and calcium-triggered neurotransmitter release
name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming and calcium-triggered neurotransmitter release
rationale: Members cover SNARE-dependent vesicle docking, priming and Ca2+-dependent release cycles for multiple transmitters, unlike confusables focused on vesicle recycling/endocytosis or GABA/glutamate secretion control.

name: Growth plate chondrocyte maturation and RUNX2-driven ossification
rationale: Members cover chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy with RUNX2-regulated osteoblast development and endochondral/intramembranous ossification; confusables lack the chondrocyte regulation members or emphasise tendon, joint and articular cartilage.

name: Growth-plate chondrocyte maturation and RUNX2-driven ossification
rationale: Members span chondrocyte condensation, proliferation, hypertrophy and RUNX2-regulated chondrocyte/osteoblast maturation in endochondral and intramembranous ossification, unlike neighbours on joints and tendon, BMP/Wnt osteoblast control or articular cartilage.

name: RUNX2-regulated chondrocyte maturation and bone ossification
rationale: Members span chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy, endochondral and intramembranous ossification and RUNX2 control of osteoblasts, distinguishing it from joint cartilage, tendon or osteoblast-only confusables.

name: G1/S checkpoint control and its tumor-suppressor defects
rationale: Members describe CDK4/6-cyclin D-RB1 G1/S control and its cancer loss-of-function defects (p16INK4A, p14ARF, RB1, TP53), unlike confusables on TP53 transcriptional regulation, senescence or G2/M.

qualifier: CDK4/6–RB1 axis and its cancer defects
name: CDK4/6–RB1 G1/S control and its oncogenic defects
rationale: Members concern the p16/p14ARF–CDK4/6–RB1–E2F G1/S checkpoint, cyclin turnover and cancer variants that evade senescence, distinct from senescence induction, p53 transcriptional and G2/M neighbours.

qualifier: CDK4/6-RB axis and its cancer defects
name: G1/S checkpoint control by CDK4/6-RB and its cancer defects
rationale: Members concern cyclin D/CDK4/6, p16/p14ARF, RB1/E2F and p27/p21 control of G1/S and their cancer-associated defects, unlike confusables on senescence programs, TP53 transcriptional regulation or G2/M.

qualifier: second heart field, outflow tract and great arteries
name: Second heart field, outflow tract and great artery morphogenesis
rationale: All members are embryonic heart development, specifically second heart field, cardiac neural crest, outflow tract septation and pharyngeal/pulmonary/coronary arteries, which neighbours focused on chambers, valves, septa or conduction lack.

qualifier: outflow tract, second heart field and great arteries
name: Heart morphogenesis with outflow tract and great-artery development
rationale: Members describe heart tube, ventricle and septum morphogenesis plus second heart field, cardiac neural crest, outflow tract and pharyngeal/pulmonary/coronary artery formation, which the valve-, trabecula- and conduction-focused confusables lack.

qualifier: cationic and neutral, with transporter defects

qualifier: tetrahydrobiopterin, vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor

qualifier: restraint of apoptotic and necroptotic death

rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, HMOX1, redox homeostasis and reduced oxidoreductase activity together with MTF1 gene activation, which separates it from the BACH1/peroxide confusable, the metallothionein metal-response one and nitrosative stress ones.

qualifier: NF-kB-driven dendritic cell and TNF/IL-23 output

core: Anterior eye and ductal gland development
name: Lens transparency, cornea and lacrimal/bile duct development
rationale: Members concern lens fiber morphogenesis and transparency (gap-junction transport), cornea and lacrimal gland development plus bile duct development, whereas confusables are inner ear, retina or ocular vasculature themes.

name: ERBB4 receptor signaling, including nuclear ERBB4 action
rationale: Members describe ERBB4 homo- and heterodimer signaling, its PI3K, nuclear and downregulation branches and ERBB3 signaling, distinct from confusables built on ERBB2/EGFR, MET, PTK6 or IGF1R/ALK.

name: ERBB4 and ERBB3 receptor signaling
rationale: Members are ERBB4 homo- and heterodimer signaling, its nuclear and PI3K outputs and downregulation, plus ERBB3 signaling, whereas confusables centre on EGFR/ERBB2, MET, PTK6 or IGF1R.

name: ERBB4 homo- and heterodimer signaling, including nuclear ERBB4
rationale: Members describe ERBB4 homodimer and ERBB2/ERBB3 heterodimer signaling, its PI3K arm, nuclear signaling and downregulation, whereas confusables cover PTK6, EGFR, ERBB2 and MET signaling.

name: cAMP and calcium influx regulation in neuron-glia communication
rationale: Members loosely share regulation of adenylate cyclase signaling and calcium influx with gap-junction and neuron-glia signaling, separating it from alpha2-adrenergic/Gi neighbours and connexin-assembly/mGluR neighbours; cohesion is weak.

core: Modulation of cAMP and calcium signaling
name: cAMP and calcium signaling modulation in neuron-glia communication
rationale: Members regulate adenylate cyclase signaling and calcium entry together with gap-junction and neuron-glia signaling, separating it from glutamate/adrenergic Gi-receptor and connexon-assembly confusables; the grouping is loose.

qualifier: cAMP modulation, calcium influx and gap junctions
name: Neuron-glia signaling via cAMP, calcium influx and gap junctions
rationale: Members loosely share intercellular neural-glial communication through adenylate cyclase modulation, calcium entry and gap junction coupling; gap junctions and neuron-glia signaling distinguish it from Gi-coupled glutamate and adrenergic confusables.

name: GPI anchor biosynthesis from UDP-GlcNAc and protein attachment
rationale: Members synthesise the GPI anchor and its UDP-GlcNAc precursor and attach it to proteins, unlike confusables on N-glycosylation, dolichol and sialic acid metabolism.

name: GPI anchor biosynthesis and UDP-N-acetylglucosamine synthesis
rationale: Members are GPI synthesis and attachment plus UDP-GlcNAc synthesis via GFPT1, unlike N-glycosylation/dolichol and sialic acid neighbours.

name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine and GPI anchor biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover UDP-GlcNAc synthesis and GPI anchor synthesis and attachment, distinct from confusables on dolichol/N-glycan, GDP-mannose and sialic acid metabolism.

qualifier: break-induced replication, recombination intermediate resolution and intra-S checkpoint
name: Replication-coupled break repair and intra-S checkpoint signaling
rationale: Members combine DNA unwinding, polymerase stimulation, break-induced replication, resolution of mitotic recombination intermediates and intra-S checkpoint signaling; confusables focus on telomere maintenance, strand-invasion homologous recombination or general replication.

name: Intra-S checkpoint and break-induced replication repair
rationale: Members cover intra-S damage checkpoint, DNA unwinding and polymerase stimulation, break-induced replication and resolution of recombination intermediates, unlike confusables focused on telomere maintenance or general homologous recombination.

name: Replication stress checkpoint and break-induced replication
rationale: Members concern intra-S checkpoint signaling, DNA unwinding/polymerase activation and break-induced replication with recombination-intermediate resolution, unlike telomere-maintenance and general homologous-repair confusables.

name: SLC4 bicarbonate and alkanesulfonate transport
rationale: Members are SLC4 bicarbonate transporters and their diseases plus alkanesulfonate transport/metabolism, separating them from SLC26 anion exchange, carbonic anhydrase and enamel confusables.

name: SLC4 bicarbonate and alkanesulfonate anion transport
rationale: Members are SLC4 bicarbonate transporters, their renal tubular acidosis defects and alkanesulfonate transport, unlike SLC26 anion exchange, carbonic anhydrase or enamel mineralization confusables.

name: SLC4 bicarbonate and alkanesulfonate transport
rationale: Members are bicarbonate transporters (SLC4A1/SLC4A4 defects) and alkanesulfonate transport/metabolism, unlike confusables built on SLC26 anion exchange, carbonic anhydrase or enamel mineralization.

core: Type I/III interferon and IL-20 family cytokine responses
name: Type I/III interferon and IL-20 family epithelial responses
rationale: Members are interferon-alpha, type III (lambda) interferon and IL-20 family signaling plus epithelial wound-healing regulation, which separates the theme from the IL-10/IL-12, IL-17 and IL-15/NK confusables.

qualifier: type III interferon and IL-20 family, wound repair
name: Epithelial interferon and IL-20 family cytokine responses
rationale: Members are interferon (alpha, lambda) and IL-20 family responses acting on epithelia plus wound-healing epithelial proliferation and anti-inflammatory control, distinguishing them from the IL-10/12/17/23 and IL-15/NK-cell confusables.

core: Type III interferon and IL-20 family signaling
qualifier: epithelial antiviral defense and wound repair
name: Type III interferon and IL-20 family epithelial defense and repair
rationale: Members are interferon-alpha/type III interferon responses, IL-20 family signaling and epithelial wound-healing regulation, i.e. IL-10-superfamily cytokines acting on epithelia; confusables instead carry IL-10/12/23/27, IL-17 or IL-15/NK signaling and lack the wound-repair members.

qualifier: KIR and MHC class Ib recognition
name: NK cell regulation via KIR and MHC class Ib recognition
rationale: Members address NK cell degranulation, cytokine production and inhibition, protection from NK cytotoxicity, KIR-cluster signatures and MHC class Ib presentation, whereas confusables emphasise positive NK/T cell cytotoxicity and T cell activation.

qualifier: KIR and MHC class Ib inhibitory recognition
name: NK cell regulation by KIR and MHC class Ib recognition
rationale: Members concern NK cell signatures with KIR genes, MHC class Ib presentation, protection from and negative regulation of NK activity, and NK effector outputs, whereas confusables emphasize activating NK receptors and T cell cytotoxicity.

name: KIR and MHC class Ib regulation of NK cell cytotoxicity
rationale: Members concern NK activation and degranulation control, KIR-cluster signatures, MHC class Ib presentation and protection from NK killing, whereas confusables emphasise activating NK receptors, positive cytotoxicity and T cell signatures.

name: Cobalamin, folate and methionine one-carbon metabolism
rationale: Members span cobalamin uptake and processing, folate interconversion and transport, and methionine/SAM metabolism, unlike confusables on thiamine, riboflavin, carnitine or choline.

qualifier: folate, cobalamin and methionine cycle with inherited defects
name: Folate, cobalamin and methionine one-carbon metabolism and inherited defects
rationale: Members cover folate/pterin metabolism, cobalamin uptake and processing, methionine/SAM salvage and their inherited enzyme defects, unlike choline/carnitine or B1/B2/biotin vitamin confusables.

name: Folate, cobalamin and methionine one-carbon metabolism
rationale: Members cover folate metabolism, cobalamin uptake/processing defects and methionine/SAM metabolism, unlike confusables on carnitine/choline, histidine or other B vitamins.

core: Neural control of motor and social behavior
name: Locomotor, sensorimotor and social behavior with inhibitory neurotransmission
rationale: Members are locomotor, sensory, vocal and social behaviors with motor-circuit development and glycinergic/GABA inhibition, distinct from MECP2-centred, excitability and neurotrophic confusables.

name: Locomotor, sensorimotor and social communication behavior
rationale: Members are organismal motor, sensory and social behaviors (locomotion, reflexes, touch, prepulse inhibition, vocalization) with related brain-region development and glycinergic inhibition, unlike MECP2 transcriptional, neurotrophic or excitability confusables.

name: Locomotor, sensorimotor and vocal behavior control
rationale: Members concern locomotion, reflexes, touch/proprioception, vocalization and the motor circuits (striatum, cerebellum, glycinergic inhibition) supporting them, unlike MECP2-transcription and neurotrophic confusables.

qualifier: netrin, SLIT-ROBO, ephrin and L1 cues
name: Netrin, SLIT-ROBO, ephrin and L1 axon guidance signaling
rationale: All members concern guidance-cue signaling to Rho GTPases in axon pathfinding and fasciculation via netrin/DCC, SLIT-ROBO, ephrins and L1/CHL1, distinguishing it from semaphorin- and DSCAM-led guidance confusables.

qualifier: midline Slit-Robo, netrin and ephrin cues
name: Midline axon guidance by Slit-Robo, netrin and ephrin cues
rationale: All members concern axon guidance receptors (ROBO, DCC/netrin, EPH, L1/CHL1) and their Rho-GTPase effectors; commissural midline crossing and Slit-Robo signaling distinguish it from semaphorin- and DSCAM-dominated guidance confusables.

name: Axon guidance via SLIT–ROBO, netrin, ephrin and L1
rationale: All members are axon guidance cues and their Rho GTPase effectors (SLIT–ROBO, netrin/DCC, ephrin, L1/CHL1, RAC/CDC42), lacking the semaphorin–plexin and DSCAM components of neighbouring guidance themes.

qualifier: alveolar surfactant and erythrocyte Rh-mediated transport
name: Respiratory gas exchange: alveolar surfactant and erythrocyte Rh transport
rationale: Members combine pulmonary surfactant metabolism and its disorders with erythrocyte O2/CO2/NO exchange and Rh-glycoprotein ammonium transport, separating it from heme/iron, lactate transport and lung developmental neighbours.

qualifier: alveolar surfactant and erythrocyte gas and ammonium transport
name: Alveolar surfactant and erythrocyte gas and ammonium transport
rationale: Members split between pulmonary surfactant metabolism and its deficiency disorders and erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange with Rh-glycoprotein ammonium transport, sharing respiratory gas exchange and lacking the heme/iron and lung development content of confusables.

qualifier: erythrocyte gas and ammonium transport with lung surfactant
name: Erythrocyte gas and ammonium transport with pulmonary surfactant homeostasis
rationale: Members are erythrocyte O2/CO2 exchange, Rh glycoprotein ammonium transport and surfactant metabolism with its disease defects; confusables lack either the surfactant members (heme/iron, lactate transport) or the Rh/gas transport members (lung development).

qualifier: hypusine and diphthamide modification of elongation factors
name: Polyamine metabolism and hypusine/diphthamide elongation-factor modification
rationale: Members cover polyamine synthesis, interconversion, oxidation and transport plus the hypusine (eIF5A) and diphthamide (EEF2) modifications and related protein hydroxylation, which distinguish it from confusables about tRNA aminoacylation, protein methylation or selenocysteine/readthrough.

qualifier: hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine and hydroxylation modifications
name: Polyamine metabolism with hypusine, diphthamide and hydroxylation modifications
rationale: Members cover polyamine synthesis, interconversion, oxidation and transport together with specialised spermidine-linked or translation-machinery modifications (hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine, protein hydroxylation), distinguishing it from confusables centred on selenocysteine, tRNA aminoacylation or protein methylation.

qualifier: with hypusine, diphthamide and hydroxylation residue modifications
name: Polyamine metabolism and hypusine-diphthamide-type protein residue modification
rationale: Members combine putrescine/spermidine/spermine synthesis, interconversion and transport with specialised residue modifications of translation factors and tRNA (hypusine, diphthamide, hydroxylation, wybutosine); confusables carry only the modification half or only the amine half.

name: Epithelial adherens junctions, cadherin adhesion and apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members concern cadherin-based adherens junctions, epithelial apical-basal polarity and EMT restraint, unlike desmosome/hemidesmosome, CDH1 turnover or endothelial confusables.

name: Epithelial adherens junction and apical-basal polarity maintenance
rationale: Members concern cadherin adherens junctions, apical-basal polarity, apical constriction and EMT restraint, unlike desmosome, CDH1-trafficking and endothelial neighbours.

name: Epithelial adherens junction and apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members concern cadherin-mediated adherens junction assembly/maintenance with apical-basal polarity and apical constriction, whereas confusables emphasise desmosomes, cadherin degradation, EMT or endothelial junctions.

name: Heparan, keratan and chondroitin sulfate degradation: Sanfilippo-Morquio mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: Members are lysosomal HS/CS/KS degradation and the Sanfilippo, Morquio and Maroteaux-Lamy syndromes, distinct from Hurler, Hunter, Sly and Natowicz neighbours.

name: Sanfilippo, Morquio and Maroteaux-Lamy glycosaminoglycan degradation
rationale: Members are heparan, keratan and chondroitin sulfate degradation and the MPS III, IV and VI disorders, separating it from confusables built on Hurler, Hunter, Sly and Natowicz types.

name: Sanfilippo, Morquio and Maroteaux-Lamy glycosaminoglycan degradation
rationale: Members cover heparan, chondroitin/dermatan and keratan sulfate degradation and the MPS III, IV and VI diseases; confusables hold the Hurler, Hunter, Sly and Natowicz types.

core: Trans-synaptic adhesion in synapse membrane assembly
name: Trans-synaptic adhesion in excitatory synapse membrane assembly
rationale: Members are neurexin-neuroligin, SALM and receptor phosphatase adhesion organizing pre- and postsynaptic membranes with NMDA receptor and PSD-95 clustering, unlike confusables centred on inhibitory synapses, synaptic potentials or general synapse-assembly regulation.

qualifier: excitatory pre- and postsynaptic membrane assembly
name: Trans-synaptic adhesion driving excitatory pre- and postsynaptic assembly
rationale: All members concern synaptic adhesion organizers (neurexin-neuroligin, SALMs, LAR-RPTPs) building pre- and postsynaptic membranes with PSD-95/NMDA receptor clustering, unlike confusables centred on EPSP regulation, synapse-assembly regulation or inhibitory GABA/gephyrin synapses.

name: Trans-synaptic adhesion complexes in synaptic membrane assembly
rationale: Members cover neurexin-neuroligin, SALM and receptor phosphatase adhesion molecules organizing pre- and postsynaptic membranes and PSD-95/NMDA receptor clustering, whereas confusables center on regulation of synapse assembly or postsynaptic potential and inhibitory receptor clustering.

qualifier: kainate receptors and G beta-gamma presynaptic inhibition
name: Kainate/AMPA receptor transmission and G beta-gamma presynaptic inhibition
rationale: Members cover AMPA and kainate receptor activation and kainate responses plus Gbeta/gamma-mediated GIRK activation and calcium-channel inhibition at presynaptic terminals, separating it from the AMPA-trafficking, nicotinic and vesicle-release confusables.

name: Kainate/AMPA excitation and Gbeta-gamma presynaptic inhibition
rationale: Members cover kainate and AMPA receptor activation, excitatory transmission and excitotoxicity plus Gbeta-gamma-mediated GIRK activation and Ca2+ channel inhibition, distinguishing it from presynaptic release, nicotinic and AMPA-trafficking confusables.

name: Kainate and AMPA receptor signaling with Gbeta-gamma presynaptic inhibition
rationale: Members cover AMPA/kainate receptor activation and excitotoxicity plus GIRK and Ca2+ channel inhibition by Gbeta-gamma, which the presynaptic-release, nicotinic and receptor-trafficking confusables lack.

name: Metanephric mesenchyme survival and mesenchymal-to-epithelial differentiation
rationale: Members combine metanephric mesenchyme maintenance, survival and mesenchymal-to-epithelial tubule differentiation with kidney growth restraint, distinguishing it from nephric duct/ureteric bud and nephron-segment confusables.

qualifier: survival, maintenance and epithelial tubule differentiation
name: Metanephric mesenchyme survival, maintenance and epithelial tubule differentiation
rationale: Members cover metanephric mesenchyme progenitor maintenance, anti-apoptosis and growth restraint plus its mesenchymal-to-epithelial conversion into nephron tubules, unlike ureteric bud, nephric duct and nephron-segment confusables.

name: Metanephric mesenchyme differentiation and negative regulation of kidney growth
rationale: Members cover metanephric mesenchymal-to-epithelial differentiation into nephron tubules plus restraint of kidney size, proliferation and developmental apoptosis, distinguished from ureteric bud/nephric duct and nephron segment patterning confusables.

name: Mesoderm migration and lateral plate patterning at gastrulation
rationale: Members concern germ-layer formation, mesodermal migration and lateral plate derivatives (heart, pericardium, gut), unlike endoderm/primitive-streak or cardiogenesis confusables.

qualifier: mesodermal migration and lateral plate morphogenesis
name: Mesendoderm formation, mesodermal migration and lateral plate morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern germ-layer formation, mesendoderm and mesodermal cell migration and lateral plate derivatives (pericardium, heart, hindgut), whereas confusables emphasise primitive streak, definitive endoderm or second heart field cardiogenesis.

qualifier: lateral plate mesoderm, gut and pericardial morphogenesis
name: Gastrulation mesoderm migration and lateral plate mesoderm morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover germ layer formation, mesodermal/mesenchymal migration, lateral plate mesoderm and its gut, heart and pericardium derivatives, whereas confusables emphasise endoderm specification, primitive streak and pluripotency factors.

name: Erythroid-megakaryocyte differentiation and platelet formation
rationale: All members describe the erythroid-megakaryocytic branch (RUNX1/TAL1-GFI1B control, red cell and megakaryocyte development, platelet morphogenesis), distinguishing it from erythroid-only and granulocytic/myeloid-progenitor confusables.

name: Megakaryocyte-erythroid differentiation and platelet formation
rationale: All members cover the erythroid-megakaryocytic branch of haematopoiesis (megakaryocyte development, platelet morphogenesis, erythrocyte differentiation and their RUNX1/TAL1-GFI1B control), distinguishing it from myeloid-progenitor/granulopoiesis themes and from a late-erythroid-only theme.

name: Erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation and platelet formation
rationale: Members cover the erythroid-megakaryocytic lineage (erythrocyte and megakaryocyte differentiation, RUNX1 and TAL1-GFI1B control, platelet morphogenesis); the megakaryocyte/platelet arm separates it from the erythroid-only C1 and the myeloid-progenitor C2-C4.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell and thymocyte homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate HSC proliferation and bone marrow cell numbers together with thymocyte proliferation, survival and differentiation, which confusables lack.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell and thymocyte proliferation and survival
rationale: Members regulate HSC homeostasis and division, bone-marrow proliferation/apoptosis and immature thymocyte proliferation, survival and differentiation, distinct from neighbours on bone-marrow development, B-cell differentiation and thymic selection.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell and thymocyte proliferation homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate HSC proliferation, bone marrow cell survival and immature thymocyte proliferation and apoptosis, unlike confusables on bone marrow development, B cell differentiation or thymic selection.

name: Extracellular matrix degradation of collagen, elastin and hyaluronan
rationale: Members are catabolism of collagen, elastin and hyaluronan and MMP/protease regulation, distinguishing it from collagen synthesis and fibrinolysis confusables.

name: Extracellular matrix degradation by metalloproteinases and hyaluronidases
rationale: Members are collagen, elastin and hyaluronan catabolism, MMP activation and protease/inhibitor regulation, unlike neighbours on ECM synthesis/crosslinking or fibrinolysis.

qualifier: collagen, elastin and hyaluronan catabolism with protease control
name: Extracellular matrix degradation of collagen, elastin and hyaluronan
rationale: Members are MMP activation, endopeptidase regulation and catabolism of collagen, elastin and hyaluronan; confusables cover collagen/elastic fibre synthesis or fibrinolysis and lack hyaluronan turnover.

qualifier: neutrophil and T cell, endothelial adhesion
name: Leukocyte adhesion to endothelium and neutrophil/T cell extravasation
rationale: Members regulate leukocyte-endothelial adhesion, integrin-mediated migration and diapedesis of neutrophils and T cells, unlike shear-stress, PECAM1 or monocyte-centred confusables.

name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion and extravasation across endothelium
rationale: Members regulate leukocyte adhesion to endothelium, integrin-mediated migration and neutrophil/T-cell diapedesis, distinguishing it from monocyte-activation, PECAM1/integrin-activation and shear-stress confusables.

name: Neutrophil and T cell adhesion and extravasation across endothelium
rationale: Members regulate leukocyte-endothelial adhesion, integrin-mediated migration, diapedesis and neutrophil/T cell extravasation; confusables are PECAM/shear-stress or monocyte-centred sets.

name: Negative regulation of inflammatory and T-cell interleukin production
rationale: Members mostly suppress production of interleukins (IL-1b, IL-2, IL-6, IL-10, IL-12, IL-21) and TNF-family cytokines and Th1/Treg responses, unlike confusables centred on T cell proliferation/interferon suppression or TLR/NF-kB signal inhibition.

qualifier: IL-10, Th1 and T-cell cytokine restraint
name: Immunoregulatory control of inflammatory and T-cell cytokine production
rationale: Members mostly restrain production of inflammatory and T-cell cytokines (IL-1b, IL-6, IL-12, IL-2, IL-21, TNF) and Th1 responses with IL-10 regulation, which differs from neighbours centred on NF-kB/TLR signaling or direct T-cell activation suppression.

qualifier: Th1 and regulatory T cell responses
name: Regulation of interleukin production and Th1/Treg responses
rationale: Members mostly restrain IL-12, IL-2, IL-21, IL-6, IL-1b and TNF production and Th1/Treg differentiation while modulating IL-10 and activated T cell proliferation, unlike the TLR/NF-kB inhibition and T cell suppression confusables.

name: NGF processing and TRKA/p75NTR receptor signaling
rationale: Members concern NGF production and processing, its binding to TRKA and p75NTR, and proximal PLC-gamma1, STAT3 and retrograde signaling, whereas confusables cover downstream TRK effector cascades, p75NTR death signaling or NTRK3.

qualifier: NGF processing and proximal TRKA/p75NTR signaling
name: NGF processing and proximal TRKA and p75NTR signaling
rationale: Members span NGF production/processing, NGF/proNGF binding to TRKA and p75NTR and proximal outputs (PLC-gamma1, STAT3, retrograde, NADE), whereas confusables cover downstream TRKA effectors, NTRK3 or p75NTR death signalling.

name: NGF production and signaling via TRKA and p75NTR
rationale: Members span NGF processing/production, TRKA activation and proximal effectors, and proNGF-p75NTR binding, while confusables are TRK downstream cascades or p75NTR death signaling alone.

name: Peroxisomal very-long-chain acyl-CoA oxidation and peroxisome maintenance
rationale: Members combine acyl-CoA oxidase VLCFA and fatty-acyl-CoA oxidation, ABCD1 deficiency, TYSND1 processing and peroxisome fission, unlike confusables on branched-chain/alpha-oxidation or peroxisomal protein import.

qualifier: peroxisome fission, protein processing and ABCD1 import
name: Peroxisomal very-long-chain fatty acyl-CoA beta-oxidation and organelle upkeep
rationale: Members combine peroxisomal VLCFA and acyl-CoA oxidation with ABCD1 substrate import, TYSND1 processing and peroxisome fission, which confusables on branched-chain catabolism, alpha-oxidation or peroxisomal protein import lack.

name: Peroxisomal very-long-chain fatty acid shortening to medium-chain acyl-CoAs
rationale: Members concern peroxisomal acyl-CoA oxidase beta-oxidation of very-long-chain fatty acids (ABCD1/ALD) yielding medium-chain acyl-CoAs plus peroxisome maintenance, unlike confusables on pristanoyl/long-chain catabolism, peroxisome import or alpha-oxidation.

qualifier: Rab/ARF GTPase regulation at the Golgi
name: Rab/ARF-regulated vesicle tethering and targeting to Golgi
rationale: Members concern vesicle tethering/targeting to and within the Golgi, constitutive secretion and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation, distinct from confusables on Golgi organisation or COPI/COPII coat-mediated transport.

core: Vesicle tethering and targeting at Golgi
qualifier: regulated by Rab and ARF GTPases
name: Rab/ARF-regulated vesicle tethering and targeting at Golgi
rationale: Members concern vesicle targeting and tethering to and within the Golgi and constitutive secretion with Rab/ARF regulation, unlike COPI/COPII coat and Golgi organization confusables.

core: Vesicle targeting and tethering to the Golgi
name: Rab/ARF GTPase–regulated vesicle tethering at the Golgi
rationale: Members concern vesicle targeting/tethering at the Golgi and constitutive secretion together with Rab GAP and ARF signaling, distinguishing the theme from COPI/COPII coat-budding and Golgi-organization confusables.

name: HSF1 heat shock response regulation and protein acetylation
rationale: Members combine HSF1 activation, attenuation and heat acclimation with protein acetylation and redox state, distinguishing the theme from mitochondrial UPR/refolding, stress granule and histone acetylation confusables.

name: HSF1 heat shock response and protein acetylation
rationale: Members combine HSF1 activation, attenuation and heat acclimation with protein acetylation and redox response, distinguishing the theme from refolding/UPRmt, histone acetylation and stress granule confusables.

name: HSF1-mediated heat shock response and protein acetylation
rationale: Members cover HSF1 activation, attenuation and heat acclimation plus protein acetylation and redox response, unlike confusables on mitochondrial UPR and refolding, stress granules or histone/tubulin acetylation.

core: Cellular response to oxidative and hypoxic stress
qualifier: hydrogen peroxide-triggered intrinsic apoptosis, nitrosative and ischemic stress
name: Peroxide, nitrosative and ischemic stress responses with apoptosis
rationale: Members are responses to H2O2, hypoxia/ischemia, nitrosative stress and H2S with regulation of the resulting intrinsic apoptosis, unlike confusables centered on ferroptosis, respiration control or nitric oxide sensing.

core: Oxidative, nitrosative and ischemic stress responses
qualifier: control of peroxide- and hypoxia-induced apoptosis
name: Oxidative and ischemic stress responses and peroxide-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members are cellular responses to reactive oxygen/nitrogen species, H2S, ischemia and oxygen, plus regulation of H2O2-, oxidative- and hypoxia-induced intrinsic apoptosis, distinct from the ferroptosis/iron, nitric oxide and respiration-regulation confusables.

name: Oxidative and hypoxic stress responses governing intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members are responses to H2O2, nitrosative stress, hydrogen sulfide, ischemia and oxygen, mostly as regulation of intrinsic apoptosis, whereas neighbours focus on nitric oxide sensing or ferroptosis and respiration control.

name: Cholesterol-to-bile acid synthesis and peroxisomal side-chain oxidation
rationale: Members describe hydroxycholesterol routes to bile acids and their peroxisomal beta-oxidation step, whereas confusables cover bile acid transport/signaling, vitamin E or intestinal lipid absorption.

name: Bile acid synthesis and peroxisomal side-chain oxidation
rationale: Members cover cholesterol hydroxylation routes to bile acids and the peroxisomal/mitochondrial beta-oxidation that shortens the sterol side chain, distinguishing it from bile acid transport, recycling and intestinal lipid absorption confusables.

name: Bile acid synthesis from cholesterol with peroxisomal beta-oxidation
rationale: Members are cholesterol catabolism to bile acids via hydroxycholesterol routes plus peroxisomal pristanoyl-CoA oxidation; confusables emphasise bile acid transport/signaling, vitamin E or intestinal lipid absorption.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor signaling and CC-chemokine production
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven myeloid chemotaxis and chemokine production
rationale: Members are formyl peptide receptor responses, neutrophil/granulocyte/macrophage chemotaxis and production of CCL2, CCL3 and CCL5; confusables lack the chemokine-production terms and add neutrophil migration inhibition or degranulation.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor and CC chemokine production
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven myeloid chemotaxis and CC chemokine production
rationale: Members are formyl peptide receptor signaling, neutrophil/granulocyte/macrophage chemotaxis and production of CCL5, MCP-1 and MIP-1alpha; the chemokine production and macrophage chemotaxis terms are absent from all confusables.

name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven leukocyte chemotaxis and chemokine production
rationale: Members are FPR-mediated neutrophil and macrophage recruitment with CCL2/CCL3/CCL5 production, the chemokine-production terms separating it from neutrophil-migration confusables.

core: Epithelial apical-basal polarity and adherens junction maintenance
qualifier: podocyte nephrin junctions and cortical microtubules
name: Epithelial apical-basal polarity and podocyte junctions
rationale: All members concern establishing or maintaining epithelial polarity and cell-cell junctions; unlike the apical-junction/EMT and desmosome confusables, the theme includes podocyte nephrin interactions, podocyte migration and cortical microtubule organization.

core: Epithelial apical-basal polarity and cell-cell adhesion
qualifier: including podocyte nephrin interactions and cortical microtubules
name: Epithelial polarity and adhesion including podocyte nephrin
rationale: All members concern establishing/maintaining epithelial apical-basal polarity and cell-cell adhesion; unlike the adherens-junction/apical-junction confusables, the theme adds podocyte nephrin interactions, podocyte migration and cortical microtubule organization.

core: Epithelial apical-basal polarity and junction maintenance
name: Epithelial apical-basal polarity, podocyte nephrin and cortical microtubules
rationale: Members concern establishing and maintaining epithelial apical-basal and cytoskeletal polarity with adherens junctions; nephrin/podocyte and cortical microtubule members distinguish it from junction-assembly and EMT confusables.

name: Deadenylation-dependent mRNA decay and miRNA turnover
rationale: Members cover poly(A) shortening, P-body assembly, miRNA-directed mRNA destabilization and target-directed miRNA degradation, unlike confusables centred on miRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and translational repression.

core: Regulation of miRNA and mRNA decay
qualifier: miRNA turnover and deadenylation-dependent target decay
name: Regulation of miRNA turnover and deadenylation-dependent mRNA decay
rationale: Members regulate miRNA degradation and pre-miRNA processing together with miRNA-directed deadenylation, poly(A) shortening and P-body assembly, whereas neighbours concern miRNA/siRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and translational repression.

name: miRNA turnover and miRNA-directed mRNA deadenylation decay
rationale: Members cover miRNA degradation and processing control plus miRNA-driven mRNA deadenylation, poly(A) shortening and P-body assembly, unlike neighbours on miRNA biogenesis, RISC and translational repression.

qualifier: end processing, splicing and small RNA biogenesis
name: Nuclear tRNA end processing, splicing and small-RNA biogenesis
rationale: Members cover tRNA 5'/3' processing, intron splicing and tRF and siRNA biogenesis, distinguishing it from mitochondrial RNA processing and exosome decay confusables.

name: Nuclear tRNA processing and tRNA-fragment and siRNA biogenesis
rationale: Members describe tRNA 5'/3' end processing and intron splicing plus tRF and siRNA biogenesis, unlike mitochondrial RNA processing and nuclear exosome decay confusables.

name: Nuclear tRNA maturation and small regulatory RNA biogenesis
rationale: Members are tRNA 5'-leader, intron and 3'-end processing, tRNA-derived fragment generation and siRNA biogenesis, distinguishing it from nuclear RNA-decay and mitochondrial RNA/tRNA processing neighbours.

qualifier: NF-kB activation and type I interferon production
name: RIG-I-like receptor signalling to NF-kB and type I interferon
rationale: Members are RIG-I/MDA5 antiviral signalling, NF-kB activation via TRAF6/FADD and IFN-alpha/beta induction, distinguished from confusables on RIG-I negative regulators, dsRNA response and viral evasion/IRF activation.

qualifier: to NF-kB and type I interferon production
name: RIG-I-like receptor signalling to NF-kB and type I interferon
rationale: All members are RLR/MDA-5 antiviral signalling and its NF-kB and IFN-alpha/beta outputs; neighbours emphasise negative regulators, dsRNA response, IRF3/7 activation or viral evasion.

qualifier: type I interferon and NF-kB induction
name: RIG-I-like receptor induction of type I interferon and NF-kB
rationale: Members are RIG-I/MDA5 antiviral signaling with TRAF6- and FADD/RIP1-mediated NF-kB activation and positive regulation of interferon-alpha/beta production, contrasting with confusables centred on IRF activation, negative regulators, dsRNA sensing and viral evasion.

qualifier: complex III-IV transfer and complex IV assembly
name: Distal respiratory chain electron transfer and complex IV assembly
rationale: Members cover electron transfer from ubiquinol through cytochrome c to oxygen, chemiosmotic ATP formation, and cytochrome c oxidase/respirasome assembly, distinct from confusables on complex I/III assembly or mitochondrial translation.

qualifier: complex III–IV electron transfer and complex IV assembly
name: Late respiratory chain electron transfer and complex IV assembly
rationale: Members cover ubiquinol-to-cytochrome c and cytochrome c-to-oxygen electron transfer, chemiosmotic ATP formation and complex IV/respirasome assembly, distinguishing it from complex I/III assembly and mitochondrial translation neighbours.

qualifier: complex III-IV and cytochrome oxidase assembly
name: Complex III-IV electron transfer and cytochrome oxidase assembly
rationale: Members cover ubiquinol-to-oxygen electron transport, chemiosmotic ATP formation and complex IV/respirasome assembly, lacking the complex I/III biogenesis and mitochondrial translation of the confusables.

qualifier: multiciliated epithelia (airway, ependyma) and sperm axoneme
name: Motile cilium assembly and multiciliated epithelium function
rationale: Members build axonemal dynein arms and central apparatus, drive multiciliogenesis and serve mucociliary clearance and CSF flow, distinguishing them from sperm motility, left-right asymmetry and tubulin modification neighbours.

qualifier: multiciliogenesis, axoneme assembly and CSF flow
name: Motile cilium axoneme assembly, multiciliogenesis and CSF flow
rationale: Members cover motile cilia/axoneme and dynein arm assembly, multiciliated cell differentiation, mucociliary clearance and ventricular CSF circulation, unlike confusables on sperm motility, left-right asymmetry or tubulin modification.

qualifier: multiciliogenesis, mucociliary clearance and CSF flow
name: Motile cilium assembly, multiciliogenesis and ciliary fluid clearance
rationale: Members cover axonemal dynein arm and central apparatus assembly, multiciliated cell differentiation, mucociliary clearance and CSF circulation, unlike sperm motility, left-right asymmetry or tubulin modification confusables.

name: Reproductive organ development, gonadotropin signalling and placentation
rationale: Members span gonad/genital development and sex determination, ovarian follicle cycle and gonadotropin/activin/AMH hormones, and trophoblast/placental development, whereas confusables centre on meiosis, gametes and fertilisation or on mammary/prostate/pancreatic glands.

qualifier: gonad, germ cell, gonadotropin and placental development
name: Gonad and germ cell development, gonadotropins, and placentation
rationale: Members span gonad and reproductive tract development, germ cell specification, ovarian follicle/gonadotropin/activin signaling and trophoblast-placenta formation; placentation and gonadal endocrinology separate it from meiosis/gamete confusables and mammary/pancreas/prostate gland confusables.

qualifier: gonad, germ cell, placenta and reproductive hormone signalling
name: Gonad, germ cell and placental development with reproductive hormone signalling
rationale: Members span gonad and germ cell development, ovarian follicle and oocyte maturation, trophoblast/placenta formation and gonadotropin/activin/progesterone signalling, whereas confusables cover glandular organs or meiosis, gametes and fertilization.

qualifier: assembly, intraciliary trafficking and motility including sperm flagella
name: Cilium and flagellum assembly, trafficking and motility
rationale: Members cover ciliogenesis, intraflagellar and ciliary cargo transport, axoneme and dynein arm assembly, and motile cilia/sperm flagellum functions, unlike confusables on photoreceptor development, mitotic centrosomes or tubulin modification.

name: Cilium and sperm flagellum assembly, trafficking and motility
rationale: Members cover centriole/basal body formation, intraciliary transport, ciliary cargo targeting, axonemal dynein assembly, motile cilia function and sperm flagella, distinguished from confusables on kinesins, tubulin modification, retinal development or mitotic centrosomes.

qualifier: motile cilia, sperm flagella and photoreceptor outer segments
name: Ciliogenesis, ciliary trafficking and motility including sperm flagella
rationale: Members cover basal body/centriole formation, intraflagellar and cargo trafficking, motile cilia and sperm flagellum assembly and their tissue roles, while confusables concern mitotic centrosomes, retinal development, kinesins or tubulin modification.

name: Vasopressin and cation-chloride cotransporter control of water-salt balance
rationale: Members span vasopressin/aquaporin renal water absorption, SLC12 cotransporter disorders, osmotic stress responses and sodium/potassium transport regulation, unlike neighbours on magnesium/paracellular transport or renin-angiotensin control.

name: Osmoregulation via vasopressin, aquaporins and cation-chloride cotransporters
rationale: Members concern osmotic responses and renal water and sodium handling through vasopressin, aquaporins and SLC12 cotransporters, distinguishing it from renin-angiotensin and magnesium/tight junction neighbours.

qualifier: vasopressin-aquaporin water handling with cation-chloride cotransport
name: Renal and cellular osmoregulation by vasopressin and salt cotransport
rationale: All members concern sensing or correcting osmotic and salt load, from cellular hyper/hypotonic and osmosensory responses to renal sodium, chloride, potassium and water transport; the vasopressin receptor, aquaporin and SLC12 cotransporter members distinguish it from the renin-angiotensin blood pressure confusables and from the magnesium/paracellular and P-type ATPase ones.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase mutants and TKI resistance
name: KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR oncogenic mutants and TKI resistance
rationale: Members are oncogenic KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR mutants/fusions and their TKI binding or resistance, whereas confusables centre on FLT3 mutants, EPO/TPO signaling and PDGFR fusions.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase mutants and TKI resistance
name: Oncogenic KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR mutants and TKI resistance
rationale: Members are signalling by and inhibitor binding/resistance of KIT, PDGFR and ALK mutants plus FGFR fusions/amplifications, distinguished from confusables dominated by FLT3 mutants, EPO/cytokine signalling and cytosolic PDGFR fusions.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase variants and TKI resistance
name: Oncogenic KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR variants and TKI resistance
rationale: All members are signaling by, TKI binding of, or drug resistance of mutant, amplified or fused KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR kinases, whereas confusables centre on FLT3 inhibitor resistance, PDGFRA/FLT3 fusions or cytokine (EPO/TPO/IL-3) signaling.

qualifier: mtDNA replication, transcription and mRNA stability
name: Mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription and mRNA stability
rationale: Members cover mtDNA replication and repair, mitochondrial transcription, mRNA processing/decay and mitoribosome assembly, unlike neighbours on mitochondrial tRNA processing or translation elongation/termination.

qualifier: mtDNA replication, transcription, mRNA stability and ribosome assembly
name: Mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription, mRNA stability and ribosome assembly
rationale: Members span mtDNA replication and repair, mitochondrial transcription, mRNA processing/turnover and mitoribosome assembly, whereas confusables cover mitochondrial translation steps or tRNA processing.

qualifier: mtDNA replication, transcription, mRNA stability and mitoribosome assembly
name: Mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription and mRNA turnover
rationale: Members concern mtDNA replication and repair, mitochondrial transcription, mRNA processing/stability and mitoribosome assembly, whereas confusables are dominated by mitochondrial translation steps and tRNA processing.

qualifier: central nervous system oligodendrocytes and glial proliferation
name: CNS oligodendrocyte myelination and glial proliferation control
rationale: Members concern oligodendrocyte differentiation, CNS myelin formation/maintenance and glial proliferation/gliosis, whereas confusables emphasise Schwann-cell/PNS myelin, nodal assembly, axon regeneration or glial fate specification.

name: CNS oligodendrocyte development, myelination and glial proliferation
rationale: Members concern oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation and differentiation, CNS myelin formation and maintenance, glial proliferation/migration and reactive gliosis, distinguishing it from confusables centred on Schwann cell/PNS myelination, nodal assembly and axon regeneration.

name: Oligodendrocyte differentiation, CNS myelination and glial proliferation
rationale: Members concern glial (mainly oligodendrocyte) proliferation, differentiation and central myelin formation/maintenance, whereas confusables centre on peripheral Schwann-cell myelination, axon regeneration, nodal assembly or glial fate specification.

name: Motor coordination, locomotion and vocal learning behaviour
rationale: Members are locomotor, proprioceptive, reflex and vocal/auditory behaviours with cerebellar and striatal development, distinguished from confusables by vocal learning and voluntary movement rather than grooming, exploration or glycinergic transmission.

name: Locomotor, vocal and sensorimotor behaviour
rationale: Members are locomotion, vocalization and vocal learning, proprioception, reflexes and auditory/mechanosensory behaviour with striatal and cerebellar development, distinct from exploration/grooming and glycinergic neighbours.

name: Motor coordination and vocal learning behaviour, cerebellar-striatal development
