rationale: Members are locomotion, proprioception, righting reflex, vocal/observational learning and auditory response with Purkinje layer and striatum development; confusables involve grooming, exploration, amygdala development or glycinergic transmission.

name: TCA-intermediate carboxylate and organic ion membrane transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated transport of organic anions and cations, especially di/tricarboxylates, pyruvate and the malate-aspartate shuttle, distinguishing them from confusables on amino acid, carnitine or monocarboxylate transport.

core: Solute carrier transport of organic ions
name: Solute carrier transport of TCA intermediates and organic ions
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated transport of di/tricarboxylates, pyruvate, malate-aspartate shuttle and organic anions/cations (with proximal tubule development), distinguishing the theme from amino acid, monocarboxylate and carnitine/glucose transport neighbours.

core: Membrane transport of carboxylates and organic ions
qualifier: dicarboxylate shuttles and renal organic ion transport
name: Dicarboxylate shuttles and renal organic ion transport
rationale: Members transport succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, malate-aspartate, pyruvate and organic anions/cations including proximal tubule development, unlike carnitine, monocarboxylate/lactate and cationic amino acid confusables.

name: G beta-gamma-coupled phospholipase C, PKC and calcium signaling
rationale: Members are GPCR/RTK-driven PLC-beta and PI3K-gamma activation, IP3/phosphoinositide synthesis, calcium and PKC signaling, distinct from cAMP, BCR and Wnt-calcium confusables.

name: G protein–phospholipase C and protein kinase C signalling
rationale: Members share PLC-generated IP3/DAG second messengers driving calcium and PKC (G beta:gamma, Gq, LPA receptors, phorbol ester), unlike cAMP, BCR or Wnt-calcium confusables.

name: GPCR-driven phospholipase C, IP3 and PKC signalling
rationale: Members concern GPCR/G-beta-gamma activation of PLC-beta and PI3K-gamma, IP3/calcium and protein kinase C signalling, which cAMP, BCR and Wnt-calcium confusables lack.

core: Wnt ligand secretion and receptor-proximal signalling
name: Wnt ligand secretion and receptor-proximal Wnt/Ca2+ signalling
rationale: Members cover Wnt biogenesis, PORCN and Golgi secretion, ligand antagonists, LRP5/DVL activation and the non-canonical calcium pathway, unlike destruction-complex, Hedgehog or vascular Wnt confusables.

core: Wnt ligand secretion and receptor activation
name: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt/calcium signaling
rationale: Members cover PORCN-dependent Wnt biogenesis and secretion, receptor-level activation and antagonism, and WNT5A/Ca2+ non-canonical signaling, distinguishing it from canonical destruction-complex and Hedgehog-lipidation confusables.

qualifier: ligand secretion (PORCN) and non-canonical calcium branch
name: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical calcium signaling
rationale: Members cover Wnt ligand biogenesis, Golgi trafficking and secretion, receptor-level activation and the Wnt/Ca2+ and WNT5A branch, distinguishing it from destruction-complex, Hedgehog lipidation and blood-barrier confusables.

name: IL-10, IL-12/23 and IL-15/21 cytokine signaling
rationale: Members are signalling by IL-10, IL-12, IL-23, IL-15 and IL-21 with NK cell regulation; neighbours instead hold IL-2/IL-7, IL-27/35, NFkB myeloid activation or interferon/NKT responses.

qualifier: IL-12/23, IL-10 and IL-15/IL-21 in NK cells
name: IL-12/23, IL-10 and IL-15 signaling in NK cell development
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-12, IL-23, IL-15 and IL-21 signaling with NK cell proliferation/differentiation; unlike IL-27/35, type III IFN/NKT, IL-2/7 and TNF-inflammatory neighbours, it combines IL-12/23 and IL-10 with IL-15-driven NK biology.

qualifier: IL-12/23, IL-10 and IL-15/21 with NK development
name: IL-12/23, IL-10 and IL-15/21 cytokine signaling with NK development
rationale: Members are IL-12, IL-23, IL-10, IL-15 and IL-21 signaling plus NK cell differentiation/proliferation; IL-10/IL-12/IL-23 separate it from IL-2/IL-7 and interferon confusables, and IL-15/IL-21/NK from the IL-27/IL-35 confusable.

name: Cytoplasmic mRNA turnover via deadenylation and decapping
rationale: Members cover poly(A) shortening, cap removal, 5'-3' exonucleolytic decay and P-body assembly, distinguishing it from RBP/ARE-mediated stability, zygotic decay and polyadenylation confusables.

name: Deadenylation- and decapping-driven mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover poly(A) tail shortening, decapping, 5'-to-3' exonucleolytic decay, P-body assembly and poly(A)-linked stabilisation; confusables instead centre on ARE-binding protein stability control, zygotic decay or polyadenylation.

name: mRNA deadenylation, decapping and 5'-to-3' decay
rationale: Members cover the poly(A) shortening, decapping, P-body and 5'-3' exonuclease route of mRNA turnover, distinguishing the theme from confusables centred on ARE-binding stabilisers/destabilisers, polyadenylation or zygotic maternal-mRNA clearance.

qualifier: TCR, CD27 and NIK-dependent noncanonical NF-kB
name: T cell activation via TCR, CD27 and noncanonical NF-kB
rationale: Members link TCR signalling, CD27 co-stimulation, IL-2 production and NIK-driven NF-kB, distinguishing it from the CD40/Dectin-1 NF-kB confusables and the ITK/PKC second-messenger confusables.

qualifier: non-canonical NF-kB in T cell co-stimulation and IL-2
name: Non-canonical NF-kB in T cell co-stimulation and IL-2
rationale: Members combine NIK/TNFR-family non-canonical NF-kB and antigen-receptor NF-kB with T cell activation, CD27 signaling and IL-2 production, which distinguishes them from the CD40/Dectin-1 sibling and ITK/PKC T cell confusables.

qualifier: TCR, CD27 costimulation and NIK-dependent NF-kB
name: T cell activation via TCR, CD27 and NIK-NF-kB
rationale: Members join TCR signaling, CD27, IL-2 production and T cell activation with non-canonical NIK/NF-kB activation, which separately distinguishes them from each confusable.

core: Phase II conjugation of aromatic xenobiotics
qualifier: glycine and glutamine amino acid conjugation
name: Aromatic xenobiotic phase II conjugation with glycine and glutamine
rationale: Members are conjugation reactions (acetylation, methylation, amino acid conjugation) and CYP2E1/paracetamol detoxification of benzene-containing compounds; glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate separates it from the drug-ADME and CYP oxidation confusables.

name: Aromatic xenobiotic conjugation by amino acids, acetylation, methylation
rationale: Members detoxify benzene-containing and nitrogenous compounds (paracetamol, benzoate, salicylate, phenylacetate) by glycine/glutamine conjugation, acetylation, methylation and CYP2E1, distinguishing them from general xenobiotic catabolism and from drug-specific ADME themes.

qualifier: acetylation, methylation and amino acid conjugation
name: Phase II acetyl, methyl and amino acid conjugation of xenobiotics
rationale: Members are drug and aromatic-compound biotransformation steps (acetylation, methylation, glycine/glutamine conjugation, CYP2E1, paracetamol); the amino acid conjugation and acetyl/methyl transfer set it apart from drug-ADME and CYP-oxidation neighbours.

qualifier: fission, membrane potential and protein localization
name: Mitochondrial fission, membrane potential and protein localization regulation
rationale: Members promote fission/fragmentation and type 2 mitophagy, regulate membrane potential and localise proteins to mitochondria, unlike neighbours on PINK1-PRKN mitophagy, apoptotic MOMP or mitochondrial import machinery.

qualifier: pro-fission with protein localization to mitochondria
name: Pro-fission mitochondrial dynamics and protein localization to mitochondria
rationale: Members promote mitochondrial fission and fragmentation, inhibit fusion, modulate membrane potential and localize proteins to mitochondria, unlike PINK1-Parkin mitophagy, apoptotic permeabilization and mitochondrial import machinery neighbours.

core: mitochondrial fission and membrane potential control
qualifier: pro-fission, retention of mitochondrial proteins, and type 2 mitophagy
name: Mitochondrial fission, membrane potential and protein localization control
rationale: Members all set mitochondrial shape and state - promoting fission while suppressing fusion, raising or lowering membrane potential, retaining and importing mitochondrial proteins, and apoptotic fragmentation with type 2 mitophagy - unlike the confusables' PINK1-PRKN and receptor mitophagy, the import and processing machinery, and the cytochrome c release apoptotic arm.

name: Hyperosmotic salt stress and aldosterone-regulated sodium import
rationale: Members combine hyperosmotic/salt-stress osmosensing with aldosterone- and renin-angiotensin-linked regulation of sodium import, unlike confusables on potassium transport, hypotonic response or glomerular filtration.

name: Hyperosmotic salt response and sodium import regulation
rationale: Members cover osmosensing, hyperosmotic and salt stress responses and aldosterone/renin-linked control of sodium import; hyperosmotic sensing and sodium restraint distinguish it from hypotonic, potassium and renal blood-volume confusables.

name: Hyperosmotic salt stress sensing and sodium import regulation
rationale: Members are hyperosmotic/salt stress and osmosensory responses plus aldosterone- and renin-linked restraint of sodium import, distinguishing it from potassium, hypotonic/water and blood-volume neighbours.

name: Epithelial anion transport by CFTR and SLC26 exchangers
rationale: Members concern chloride, iodide, sulfate and oxalate transport by CFTR and SLC26 transporters and their diseases, unlike confusables built on SLC12 cation-chloride cotransport, SLC4 bicarbonate transport or aquaporins.

name: SLC26 and CFTR epithelial anion transport
rationale: Members are SLC26 anion exchange (iodide, sulfate, oxalate, chloride) and CFTR function and disease with transepithelial transport, distinguishing it from bicarbonate SLC4, aquaporin and SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporter themes.

name: Epithelial anion transport by SLC26 exchangers and CFTR
rationale: Members concern SLC26-mediated sulfate/iodide/oxalate exchange and CFTR chloride transport and their diseases, whereas confusables involve aquaporins, bicarbonate or cation-chloride cotransporters.

name: Post-lanosterol cholesterol synthesis and oxysterol bile acid synthesis
rationale: Members cover Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell cholesterol synthesis and 24/27-hydroxycholesterol bile acid synthesis (CYP27A1), lacking the mevalonate/lanosterol and other CYP disease terms of the confusables.

qualifier: post-lanosterol and oxysterol bile acid branches
name: Post-lanosterol cholesterol synthesis and oxysterol bile acid synthesis
rationale: Members cover the Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell routes and bile acid synthesis via 24-/27-hydroxycholesterol, lacking the mevalonate/lanosterol and CYP-defect content of the confusables.

qualifier: post-lanosterol sterol and oxysterol bile acid routes
name: Post-lanosterol cholesterol synthesis and oxysterol bile acid synthesis
rationale: Members cover Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell late cholesterol synthesis and bile acid synthesis via 24-/27-hydroxycholesterol (CYP27A1), unlike the mevalonate/lanosterol and CYP-disease confusables.

qualifier: dendritic cell, plasma cell and Th1 cell
name: Dendritic cell and lymphocyte surface marker signatures
rationale: Members are surface signatures of dendritic cells, plasma cells and T cells with butyrophilin interactions, distinguished by dendritic-cell content from monocyte, B cell and T cell activation confusables.

name: Dendritic, T and plasma cell surface signatures
rationale: Members are surface/enrichment signatures of dendritic, CD4 T and plasma cells with butyrophilin interactions; DC, T and plasma cell content separates it from monocyte, B cell and T cell activation neighbours.

name: Dendritic cell and lymphocyte surface marker signatures
rationale: Members are surface-gene signatures of resting/activated dendritic cells, plasma cells and Th1 CD4 T cells plus butyrophilin interactions and exosome assembly; the dendritic and plasma/T cell signatures separate it from monocyte, B cell and T cell-costimulation confusables.

name: Mesenchymal progenitor expansion via TGF-beta, BMP and Wnt signaling
rationale: Members concern mesenchymal stem cell proliferation, differentiation and migration driven by TGF-beta/SMAD, BMP and Wnt signals, whereas confusables focus on osteoblast differentiation, ossification or CDH1 transcription.

name: TGF-beta/BMP and Wnt signaling in mesenchymal progenitor fate
rationale: Members link SMAD, TGF-beta2 and Wnt signaling to mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation, whereas confusables are committed osteoblast differentiation or cadherin transcription.

core: Mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation
qualifier: TGF-beta, BMP and Wnt morphogen signalling
name: Morphogen (TGF-beta, BMP, Wnt) control of mesenchymal stem cells
rationale: Members concern mesenchymal progenitor expansion and differentiation under TGF-beta/SMAD, BMP and Wnt signalling, distinguishing it from confusables on osteoblast differentiation and ossification.

core: Histone methyltransferase and chromatin remodeller coregulators
name: Histone lysine/arginine methyltransferase and CHD-NuRD coregulator complexes
rationale: Members concern histone lysine/arginine methylation complexes (KMT2D/WDR5, PRMTs) and CHD/NuRD remodellers acting as transcription-factor cofactors, distinct from DNA methylation/PRC2 and HDAC/demethylase confusables.

core: Histone methylation and chromatin remodelling complexes
name: Histone methyltransferase and CHD-NuRD chromatin remodelling complexes
rationale: Members are histone lysine/arginine methyltransferase complexes (KMT2D/MLL4, WDR5) and CHD/NuRD remodellers with transcription-factor cofactors, distinct from confusables on DNA methylation, PRC2 silencing and histone deacetylation/demethylation.

qualifier: histone methyltransferase and CHD/NuRD remodeller complexes
name: Histone methyltransferase and CHD-remodeller transcriptional coregulator complexes
rationale: All members describe histone lysine/arginine methyltransferase complexes (WDR5/MLL4, PRMTs) or CHD/NuRD remodellers acting as transcription-factor coregulators, distinguished from confusables on DNA methylation, PRC2 heterochromatin and histone deacetylation/demethylation.

qualifier: Sanfilippo (MPS III) and Morquio (MPS IV) types
name: Sanfilippo and Morquio mucopolysaccharidoses (MPS III and IV)
rationale: All members are MPS III A-D or MPS IV A/B disease pathways, whereas confusables are dominated by Hurler, Hunter, Maroteaux-Lamy and Sly types or generic GAG degradation.

name: Sanfilippo and Morquio mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: All members are MPS III (Sanfilippo A-D) or MPS IV (Morquio A/B) disorders, whereas confusables hold Hurler, Hunter, Maroteaux-Lamy, Sly and Natowicz types or generic GAG degradation.

qualifier: Sanfilippo (MPS III) and Morquio (MPS IV) types
name: Sanfilippo and Morquio mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: All members are MPS IIIA-D or MPS IVA/B lysosomal storage disorders, distinguishing the theme from confusables containing Hurler, Hunter, Sly, Maroteaux-Lamy, Natowicz and generic GAG degradation.

core: Negative regulation of inflammatory cytokine signalling
name: Suppression of NF-kappaB and TNF/IL-1beta/IL-6 inflammatory cytokines
rationale: All members negatively regulate NF-kappaB signalling or TNF, IL-1beta and IL-6 production, while confusables add TLR/LPS signalling or IL-10/IL-12 and T cell regulation.

name: Suppression of TNF–NF-kappaB inflammatory cytokine signaling
rationale: All members negatively regulate inflammatory cytokines (TNF, IL-6, IL-1beta) and TNF/NF-kappaB signaling, the latter distinguishing it from TLR and IL-10/IL-12 confusables.

name: Negative regulation of NF-κB, TNF signaling and inflammatory cytokines
rationale: All members dampen canonical/non-canonical NF-κB and TNF signaling or IL-1β, IL-6 and TNF-family cytokine production, whereas confusables restrain TLR/LPS signaling or IL-10/IL-12/T cell cytokines.

name: Pseudouridylation and mitoribosome assembly for mitochondrial translation
rationale: Members combine pseudouridine synthesis on tRNA/mRNA/rRNA with mitochondrial rRNA/mRNA modification, mitoribosome subunit assembly and translation, whereas confusables emphasise mitochondrial RNA processing, stability and tRNA maturation.

name: RNA pseudouridylation and mitochondrial ribosome assembly
rationale: Members share RNA modification (pseudouridine synthesis in rRNA, tRNA and mRNA, mitochondrial rRNA/mRNA modification) tied to mitoribosome assembly and mitochondrial translation, whereas confusables cover mitochondrial tRNA processing, 3'-end processing and RNA stability.

core: Mitochondrial ribosome biogenesis and RNA modification
name: RNA pseudouridylation and mitochondrial ribosome assembly and translation
rationale: Members combine pseudouridine synthesis on mRNA, tRNA and rRNA with mitochondrial rRNA/mRNA modification, mitoribosome assembly and translation, unlike confusables on mitochondrial tRNA processing and RNA stability.

qualifier: migration, homing and NADPH oxidase activation
name: Leukocyte Rho GTPase signaling for migration and NADPH oxidase
rationale: Members link RHOH/Cdc42 and PLC/PKC signaling to leukocyte homing, dendritic cell chemotaxis and Rho-driven NADPH oxidase/antimicrobial activity, distinguishing it from immunological synapse and chemokine-receptor confusables.

qualifier: Rho-family GTPases (Cdc42, RHOH) and NADPH oxidase
name: Rho-family GTPase signaling in leukocyte chemotaxis and homing
rationale: Members link Cdc42/RHOH GTPase signaling, Rho-activated NADPH oxidase and PLC/PKC signaling to dendritic cell chemotaxis and lymphocyte homing, whereas confusables emphasize chemokine-receptor pairs or immunological synapse formation.

qualifier: NADPH oxidase activation and myeloid chemotaxis
name: Leukocyte Rho GTPase signaling for NADPH oxidase and chemotaxis
rationale: Members involve RHOH, Cdc42 and Rac-driven NADPH oxidase signaling with dendritic cell chemotaxis and lymphocyte homing, which chemokine and immunological-synapse confusables lack.

name: Phase I oxidation of amines and plant-derived compounds
rationale: Members are FMO and CYP1A2 oxidation, oxidative demethylation and metabolism of alkaloids, terpenoids and phenylpropanoids; confusables add conjugation reactions and general xenobiotic catabolism.

core: Phase I oxidative metabolism of xenobiotics
qualifier: FMO/CYP oxidation of amines and plant-derived compounds
name: FMO and CYP oxidation of amines and plant compounds
rationale: Members are FMO and CYP N-oxidation and oxidative demethylation of amines, alkaloids, phenylpropanoids and monoterpenoids, unlike confusables dominated by general xenobiotic catabolism and conjugation (sulfonation, acetylation, methylation).

core: Oxidative metabolism of amines and phytochemicals
name: Flavin monooxygenase and P450 oxidation of amines and phytochemicals
rationale: Members oxidise nucleophilic amines (FMO3/TMAU, CYP1A2 N-hydroxylation) and plant-derived alkaloids, terpenoids and phenylpropanoids; FMO members distinguish it from general xenobiotic, sulfonation and acetylation confusables.

qualifier: trans-synaptic adhesion and dendritic spine development
name: Synapse assembly, trans-synaptic adhesion and dendritic spine development
rationale: Members concern pre/postsynaptic assembly, neurexin-neuroligin adhesion, receptor clustering and dendrite/spine development, which neighbours on LTP and memory, vesicle recycling or glutamate receptor activation lack.

core: Synapse assembly and dendritic spine development
name: Synapse assembly, trans-synaptic adhesion and dendritic spine development
rationale: Members cover pre/postsynaptic assembly, neurexin-neuroligin and other synaptic adhesion, glutamate/GABA receptor clustering and dendrite/spine morphogenesis, unlike the receptor-activation, LTP-calcium and vesicle-recycling confusables.

name: Trans-synaptic adhesion, synapse assembly and dendrite morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover neurexin/neuroligin adhesion, receptor clustering, pre/postsynaptic assembly and dendrite/spine morphogenesis; adhesion and assembly members distinguish it from glutamate receptor activation, LTP and vesicle-recycling confusables.

qualifier: p53 transcriptional control and apoptosome activation
name: p53-driven mitochondrial intrinsic apoptosis and apoptosome activation
rationale: Members cover BH3-only/BAX/BAK activation, cytochrome c release, apoptosome/SMAC and p53-regulated intrinsic apoptosis; neighbours cover execution-phase DNA fragmentation, p53 cell-cycle arrest or senescence.

qualifier: p53-driven, via BCL-2 proteins and apoptosome
name: p53-driven mitochondrial apoptosis through BCL-2 proteins and apoptosome
rationale: Members cover BH3-only/BAX/BAK activation, cytochrome c release, apoptosome and SMAC, and p53 transcriptional control of apoptosis; unlike p53 cell-cycle/senescence and execution-phase neighbours, it is the mitochondrial commitment step.

name: p53-driven intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis via BCL-2 family and apoptosome
rationale: All members concern mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization by BH3-only/BAX/BAK, cytochrome c release, apoptosome/SMAC and p53 regulation of these genes, unlike the execution-phase, p53 cell-cycle and senescence confusables.

qualifier: destruction complex regulation and oncogenic mutants
name: Canonical Wnt/beta-catenin destruction complex regulation and oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members cover beta-catenin destruction-complex control, TCF/LEF target activation and repression and their cancer mutants or drugs, distinct from Notch, Wnt secretion and non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ confusables.

name: Canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signalling from receptor to TCF targets
rationale: Members span FZD/DVL activation, destruction-complex control of beta-catenin, TCF target regulation and oncogenic pathway mutants, distinct from confusables on Notch, Wnt secretion and non-canonical Wnt.

qualifier: full receptor-to-TCF span including oncogenic pathway mutants
name: Canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signalling from receptor to TCF target genes
rationale: All members concern canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signalling, from FZD/LRP/DVL and the AXIN destruction complex to TCF/LEF transcription, including its oncogenic mutants and inhibitors, distinguished from confusables on non-canonical/calcium Wnt and Wnt secretion, Notch signalling, and a narrower set of destruction-complex mutants.

name: Phospholipid remodeling and endocannabinoid lipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members cover acyl-chain remodelling and lysophospholipid hydrolysis plus DAG/MAG catabolism and NAPE/NAE endocannabinoid metabolism, unlike neighbours on de novo phospholipid synthesis, sphingolipids or PAF/ether lipids.

name: Phospholipid acyl-chain remodeling and endocannabinoid lipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members are Lands-cycle remodeling and lysophospholipid hydrolysis plus DAG/MAG and N-acylethanolamine turnover in endocannabinoid signalling, unlike confusables centred on de novo phospholipid or sphingolipid synthesis.

qualifier: acyl remodelling, lipase hydrolysis and endocannabinoids
name: Glycerophospholipid remodelling, hydrolysis and endocannabinoid generation
rationale: Members cover phospholipid acyl-chain remodelling, lysophospholipid/DAG/MAG hydrolysis and N-acylethanolamine endocannabinoid signalling; distinct from de novo phospholipid/sphingolipid synthesis and PAF/ether lipid confusables.

core: Bacterial peptidoglycan sensing by NOD-like receptors
qualifier: TAK1-driven JNK and p38 stress kinase activation
name: NOD1/2 peptidoglycan sensing and TAK1-driven JNK/p38 signaling
rationale: Members cover NOD1/2 and ALPK1 sensing of peptidoglycan and muramyl dipeptide and the downstream TAK1-JNK/p38 stress kinase cascade, whereas confusables are TLR/IRAK/TRIF and NF-kB/IKK signaling.

name: NOD1/2 bacterial sensing and JNK/p38 stress kinase signaling
rationale: Members cover NOD1/NOD2, ALPK1 and peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide sensing feeding TAK1-mediated JNK and p38 activation and their regulation; confusables are TLR/IRAK/TRIF- and NF-kB-centred instead.

core: Bacterial pattern-recognition signaling to stress MAP kinases
qualifier: NOD1/2 and NLR sensing via TAK1 to JNK and p38
name: NOD-like receptor signaling to JNK and p38
rationale: Members cover NOD1/2, NLR and ALPK1 sensing of bacterial products (peptidoglycan, muramyl dipeptide) and TAK1-driven JNK/p38 stress-kinase regulation, distinguishing it from confusables built on TLR/IRAK/TRIF routes to IKK and NF-kB.

name: Exogenous peptide presentation via MHC II and cross-presentation
rationale: Members share peptide antigen processing via MHC class II and class I cross-presentation pathways, distinguishing it from lipid/CD1 and TLR7 confusables and from classical MHC I peptide loading.

qualifier: MHC class II and exogenous cross-presentation
name: Peptide antigen processing for MHC II and cross-presentation
rationale: Members cover peptide antigen processing via MHC class II and phagosomal/endosomal cross-presentation to MHC I, unlike lipid/CD1 and TLR7 confusables or the classical endogenous MHC I loading confusable.

name: Peptide antigen presentation via MHC II and cross-presentation
rationale: Members concern processing of peptide antigens for MHC class II and for MHC class I cross-presentation via phagosome/endosome routes, unlike confusables on CD1 lipid antigen and TLR7/8 or on classical class I loading in the ER.

qualifier: vocal learning, sensory gating and striatum/amygdala development
name: Sensory, vocal and social behavior; striatal–amygdalar development
rationale: Members are sensory-driven, vocal, social and psychomotor behaviors with the striatal and amygdalar circuits underlying them, distinct from confusables built on MECP2 molecular events, mating/pheromone behavior or locomotor/motor control.

qualifier: striatum and amygdala development, sensorimotor gating
name: Sensorimotor, vocal and social behavior with striatum–amygdala development
rationale: Members are sensory, vocal, social and psychomotor behaviors plus striatum and amygdala development, which separates the theme from the MECP2-mechanism, mating/aggression and locomotor-motor neighbours.

name: Sensory, vocal and social behavior with striatum-amygdala development
rationale: Members are auditory, visual, tactile, vocal, social and psychomotor behaviors plus striatum and amygdala development, distinguished from mating/grooming, locomotor and molecular MECP2 confusables.

name: Adrenal corticosteroid biosynthesis and congenital enzyme deficiencies
rationale: All members concern pregnenolone-to-gluco/mineralocorticoid synthesis by CYP11A1/17A1/21A2/11B1/11B2 (and their defects, ferredoxin electron supply), unlike confusables centred on androgen/estrogen synthesis or aldosterone secretion regulation.

name: Adrenal corticosteroid biosynthesis and steroidogenic P450 defects
rationale: Members cover pregnenolone, progesterone, gluco- and mineralocorticoid synthesis with CYP11A1/11B1/11B2/17A1/21A2 deficiencies, distinguishing it from confusables on androgen/estrogen synthesis and aldosterone/cortisol regulatory terms.

name: Adrenal corticosteroid biosynthesis and its congenital enzyme defects
rationale: Members are glucocorticoid/mineralocorticoid synthesis from pregnenolone and progesterone plus CYP11A1/17A1/21A2/11B1/11B2 deficiencies; confusables add sex-steroid (androgen/estrogen) synthesis or aldosterone secretion regulation.

name: Platelet GPCR agonist signaling via G12/13 and Rho
rationale: Members cover thrombin-PAR, ADP-P2Y, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signaling with G12/13-Rho activation, whereas confusables emphasise VWF/GPVI adhesion, degranulation and coagulation.

name: Platelet agonist GPCR signaling through G12/13 and Rho
rationale: Members are thrombin PAR, thromboxane, prostacyclin and ADP P2Y receptor signaling with G12/13 and Rho activation, distinct from collagen/GPVI, VWF adhesion and degranulation confusables.

name: GPCR-driven platelet activation via G12/13-Rho signaling
rationale: Members cover P2Y1/P2Y12, PAR, TP and prostacyclin receptor signaling with G12/13-Rho, versus GPVI, VWF, degranulation and coagulation confusables.

qualifier: phosphatase inactivation of ERK, JNK and p38
name: Phosphatase-mediated inactivation of ERK, JNK and p38 MAPKs
rationale: Members concern feedback suppression of MAPKs by threonine/tyrosine dephosphorylation across ERK, JNK and p38, unlike the ERK-only, IL-6 and JNK-activating confusables.

qualifier: phosphatase dephosphorylation of ERK, JNK and p38
name: Phosphatase-mediated negative feedback on ERK, JNK and p38 MAPKs
rationale: Members describe MAPK inactivation by threonine/tyrosine dephosphorylation, negative regulation of JNK and p38 and feedback on AP-1 activation, unlike confusables about TAK1-driven activation, ERK-only/serine phosphorylation control or IL-6 signaling.

qualifier: threonine/tyrosine dephosphorylation of ERK, JNK and p38
name: MAPK feedback inactivation by threonine/tyrosine dephosphorylation
rationale: Members concern dual threonine/tyrosine dephosphorylation and negative feedback silencing ERK, JNK and p38 with AP-1 output; confusables cover MAPK activation (TAK1, IL-6) or serine phosphorylation and ERK5/atypical MAPK.

name: CFTR epithelial anion secretion and pH-sensing ion channels
rationale: Members concern CFTR-dependent anion/water transport and pH-sensing TRP/TALK channels; the pH channels separate it from epithelial polarity/secretion confusables and CFTR from sour-taste (C3).

qualifier: CFTR anion secretion and pH-sensitive cation channels
name: CFTR anion secretion and pH-sensitive cation channels
rationale: Members combine CFTR-dependent anion and water transport and pancreatic secretion with TRP and TALK channels and acidic pH responses, distinguishing it from sour-taste, apical protein sorting and secretion confusables.

name: CFTR epithelial anion-fluid secretion and pH-sensing ion channels
rationale: Members cover CFTR trafficking and disease, anion and transepithelial water transport and pancreatic secretion together with acid-pH response, TALK and TRP channels, unlike polarized protein secretion or sour-taste confusables.

qualifier: synthesis and regulated uptake and release
name: Regulation of catecholamine synthesis, uptake and synaptic release
rationale: Members regulate dopamine/catecholamine biosynthesis and metabolism, neurotransmitter uptake and secretion and spontaneous transmission, whereas confusables centre on monoamine transporters and their disease variants.

name: Catecholamine synthesis and synaptic uptake regulation
rationale: Members regulate dopamine/catecholamine biosynthesis and metabolism, neurotransmitter uptake and secretion and spontaneous transmission, while confusables emphasise monoamine transport, SLC6 transporter defects and dopaminergic signalling.

name: Regulation of catecholamine metabolism and neurotransmitter uptake
rationale: Members regulate dopamine/catecholamine synthesis and metabolism, neurotransmitter uptake and secretion and spontaneous synaptic transmission, unlike confusables focused on SLC6 transporter defects or dopamine receptor signalling.

name: Inherited immunodeficiencies of TLR-MyD88-IRAK4-NF-kappaB signaling
rationale: All members are disease variants (MyD88, IRAK4, IKBKB, IKBKG, IkBA deficiency) disrupting TLR-NF-kappaB signaling, whereas confusables describe normal TLR, inflammasome or NF-kappaB signaling.

core: Inborn errors of innate immune signalling
name: Primary immunodeficiencies of TLR-MyD88-NF-kB signalling
rationale: All members are inherited deficiencies of MyD88, IRAK4, IKBKB, IKBKG or IkBa that disrupt TLR-to-NF-kB signalling, whereas the confusables describe normal TLR, inflammasome or non-canonical NF-kB signalling.

name: Inherited MyD88, IRAK4 and IKK-NF-kB immunodeficiencies
rationale: All members are germline defects of the TLR-MyD88-IRAK4-IKK-IkBA signaling axis (EDA-ID, SCID); neighbours hold the normal TLR, NOD, inflammasome and non-canonical NF-kB signaling rather than disease variants.

name: FGFR4-betaKlotho signaling and FGFR phospholipase C-gamma cascades
rationale: All members are FGFR downstream cascades, centred on FGFR4 (FRS, SHC, PI3K, betaKlotho) and PLC-gamma cascades of FGFR1/3/4, whereas confusables carry PI3K/FRS/SHC cascades of FGFR1-3.

name: FGFR4 downstream signaling and FGFR phospholipase C cascades
rationale: All members are FGFR downstream cascades, dominated by FGFR4 (FRS, SHC, PI3K, betaKlotho) plus PLC-gamma cascades, whereas confusables carry FGFR1-3 PI3K/FRS/SHC branches.

name: FGFR4 signaling and FGFR phospholipase C cascades
rationale: All members are FGFR downstream cascades; the FGFR4 FRS/SHC/PI3K arms with betaKlotho binding and the PLC cascades for FGFR1/3/4 distinguish it from PI3K-centred FGFR1-3 neighbours.

core: Mycobacterium tuberculosis manipulation of host cell
qualifier: iron and heme scavenging, host defence suppression
name: M. tuberculosis iron scavenging and host-defence suppression
rationale: Members are Mtb strategies for nutrient (iron, heme, energy, ions) acquisition and for suppressing apoptosis, autophagy and nitric oxide, whereas confusables focus on phagosome maturation blockade, membrane repair inhibition and toxin uptake.

qualifier: iron/heme scavenging and suppression of host defences
name: Mycobacterial iron scavenging and host defence suppression
rationale: Members are Mtb strategies for acquiring iron and heme, altering host energy metabolism and ion flux, and suppressing nitric oxide, autophagy and apoptosis, whereas confusables centre on blocking phagosome maturation, acidification and membrane repair.

core: Mycobacterium tuberculosis manipulation of host cell
qualifier: nutrient acquisition and suppression of host defences
name: Mycobacterium tuberculosis nutrient acquisition and host defence suppression
rationale: Every member is an Mtb strategy of iron/heme acquisition, host metabolic and ion manipulation, or suppression of NO, apoptosis and autophagy, whereas confusables centre on blocking phagosome maturation, acidification and membrane repair.

qualifier: atypical RHOBTB, Rho and Ral GTPases
name: RHOBTB, Rho and Ral GTPase activity regulation
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles and activity regulation of RHOBTB, Rho effector and Ral GTPases; this separates it from the Rab/ARF neighbour and from the RHOBTB-with-neddylation/proteolysis neighbours.

qualifier: atypical RHOBTB, Rho effector and Ral GTPases
name: RHOBTB, Rho effector and Ral GTPase regulation
rationale: Members are small GTPase cycles and activity regulation (RHOBTB1-3, Rhotekin/Rhophilin effectors, Ral), distinguished from Golgi-Rho, Rab/ARF, protein-stability and neddylation neighbours by the RHOBTB and Ral content.

name: RHOBTB, RHO and Ral GTPase activity regulation
rationale: All members concern activation, inactivation or effector cycles of small GTPases (RHOBTB1-3, Rhotekin/Rhophilin, Ral); unlike the RAB/ARF neighbour it centres on RHOBTB and Ral, and unlike others it lacks proteolysis, neddylation and Golgi terms.

name: Iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis and respiratory complex III assembly
rationale: Members are Fe-S cluster assembly (incl. TCA enzyme maturation) and complex III assembly with matrix-side inner-membrane insertion, separating it from complex I/IV assembly and heme confusables.

name: Iron-sulfur cluster assembly and respiratory complex III biogenesis
rationale: Members are Fe-S cluster assembly, Fe-S-dependent TCA enzyme maturation and complex III assembly, distinguishing from complex I/IV assembly, ferredoxin and heme-related confusables.

name: Iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis and respiratory complex III assembly
rationale: Members cover [2Fe-2S]/[4Fe-4S] and cytosolic Fe-S assembly, Fe-S maturation of TCA enzymes and complex III assembly, separating it from heme/steroidogenic Fe-S neighbours (no complex III) and complex I/IV assembly neighbours (no Fe-S biogenesis).

name: Promotion of monocyte–macrophage recruitment via RAGE and p38
rationale: Members positively regulate monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, extravasation and MCP-1 production, with RAGE and p38 signaling distinguishing it from neutrophil and negative-regulation confusables.

core: Promotion of monocyte and macrophage recruitment
name: Monocyte and macrophage recruitment promoted by RAGE-p38 signaling
rationale: Members positively regulate monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, extravasation and MCP-1 production with AGE-receptor and p38 signaling, which distinguish it from monocyte-identity, negative-regulation and neutrophil chemotaxis confusables.

name: RAGE and p38-driven monocyte and macrophage recruitment
rationale: Members promote monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, extravasation and MCP-1 production via RAGE and p38 signaling; positive RAGE/p38-driven recruitment distinguishes it from negative-regulation, neutrophil and monocyte-identity neighbours.

name: Hedgehog autoprocessing and RAS C-terminal lipid processing
rationale: Members concern lipid modification and proteolytic processing of Hedgehog and RAS proteins, distinct from cysteine palmitoylation cycling and Wnt lipidation confusables.

qualifier: Hedgehog autoprocessing and Ras C-terminal modification
name: Hedgehog and Ras lipid modification and processing
rationale: Members are Hedgehog autoproteolysis, N-terminal palmitoylation and release, and Ras C-terminal processing; confusables centre on cysteine palmitoylation/depalmitoylation and WNT/PORCN lipidation.

qualifier: Hedgehog autoprocessing and RAS C-terminal processing
name: Hedgehog autoprocessing, lipidation and RAS C-terminal processing
rationale: Members are Hedgehog self-cleavage, palmitoylation and release, N-terminal lipidation and RAS C-terminal processing, separating the theme from WNT/PORCN palmitoylation and depalmitoylation confusables.

name: Cell-substrate adhesion and spreading with MET-FAK signaling
rationale: Members concern integrin/syndecan-mediated attachment, spreading and stress fibres, and the MET-PTK2/tensin members are what all adhesion and migration confusables lack.

name: Cell-substrate adhesion and spreading with MET-FAK signaling
rationale: Members are integrin/syndecan-mediated attachment, spreading and stress-fiber assembly, and the MET-PTK2 and MET-tensin members are exactly what the cytoskeletal, migration and matrix neighbours lack.

name: Integrin substrate adhesion and spreading via MET-FAK/tensin
rationale: Members are integrin and syndecan cell-matrix attachment, spreading, migration and stress fibers; the MET-PTK2 and MET-tensin members are what all confusables (ROCK/PAK cytoskeleton, ECM/EMT, invadopodia) lack.

name: Atypical MAPK signaling and peptidyl-serine phosphorylation control
rationale: Members concern RAS-MAPK relay including ERK5 and MAPK6/MAPK4 and regulation of serine phosphorylation; confusables focus on ERK inactivation, oncogenic RAF/RAS or neurotrophin-ERK5.

qualifier: atypical ERK5 and MAPK4/6 cascades with serine phosphorylation control
name: Atypical ERK5 and MAPK4/6 cascades with serine phosphorylation control
rationale: Members are RAS/MAPK signaling, its atypical ERK5 and MAPK4/6 branches and regulation of serine phosphorylation, distinguishing them from NGF-TRK, ERK-inactivation and RAF-mutant neighbours.

qualifier: noncanonical ERK5 and MAPK6/4 branches with serine phosphorylation control
name: Noncanonical ERK5 and MAPK6/4 signaling with serine phosphorylation control
rationale: Members are ERK5 and atypical MAPK6/MAPK4 cascades, RAS-MAPK signaling, Ras-GAP tuning and regulation of serine phosphorylation; confusables center on ERK1/2 RAF mutant and feedback inactivation or neurotrophin-driven activation.

qualifier: with interstrand crosslink and replication-fork repair, PARylation
name: Double-strand break, crosslink and replication-fork DNA repair
rationale: Members cover HR/NHEJ/SSA/MMEJ double-strand break repair, BRCA1/2-PALB2 defects, Fanconi/ICL repair, fork reversal and PARylation, lacking the base-excision, mismatch, nucleotide-excision, translesion and telomere repair that the near-superset confusable adds.

name: DNA double-strand break and interstrand crosslink repair
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing, HR/BRCA1-2/PALB2, NHEJ, SSA/MMEJ, Fanconi crosslink repair, fork reversal, PARylation and genotoxic drug responses, unlike the broader repair confusable that adds excision, mismatch and translesion repair or the telomere-maintenance confusables.

name: DNA double-strand break and crosslink repair
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing, HR/BRCA-PALB2, NHEJ, SSA/MMEJ, fork protection and Fanconi/ICL repair, unlike the broader confusable that adds base excision, mismatch and nucleotide excision repair or the telomere-focused ones.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I and III transcription
name: RNA polymerase I/III transcription, ribosome biogenesis and translation initiation
rationale: Members cover Pol I rRNA and Pol III tRNA/5S transcription, pre-rRNA cleavage, ribosome assembly, translation initiation and MYC growth targets, whereas confusables emphasise RNA decay/modification, Pol II/HIV transcription and splicing.

qualifier: MYC-driven Pol I/III transcription and translation initiation
name: MYC-driven rRNA/tRNA transcription, ribosome biogenesis and translation initiation
rationale: Members cover RNA polymerase I and III transcription, rRNA processing, ribosome assembly and cap-dependent translation initiation with MYC target signatures, while confusables cover RNA decay, splicing and Pol II elongation.

name: MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis, RNA polymerase I/III transcription and translation initiation
rationale: Members span rRNA/tRNA transcription by Pol I and III, rRNA processing, ribosome assembly, cap-dependent translation initiation and MYC targets, whereas confusables centre on Pol II/HIV transcription, mRNA splicing and RNA modification/decay.

core: RNA and nascent protein quality control
qualifier: nuclear exosome decay, NMD and stalled-ribosome rescue
name: Nuclear exosome RNA decay, NMD and stalled-ribosome quality control
rationale: Members cover nuclear RNA surveillance/exosome decay, nonsense-mediated, no-go and non-stop decay, ribosome quality control and degron-based protein degradation, distinct from neighbours on RNA polymerase I/III transcription, splicing/mRNA export, telomerase/snoRNA and translation initiation.

name: RNA surveillance decay and ribosome-associated quality control
rationale: Members span nuclear exosome RNA decay, NMD, no-go/non-stop decay, stalled ribosome rescue and degron-pathway protein disposal, unlike neighbours centred on RNA production/splicing, translation initiation or telomerase/snoRNA biogenesis.

name: RNA surveillance decay and ribosome-associated protein quality control
rationale: Members are nuclear exosome RNA decay, NMD, no-go/non-stop decay, stalled ribosome rescue and degron-mediated protein degradation; ribosome quality control and degron pathways separate it from splicing/processing, translation initiation and rRNA biogenesis confusables.

name: White, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis
rationale: Members cover white, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation, PPAR signaling, adipose development and cold/diet-induced thermogenesis, unlike lipid droplet, lipolysis and metabolic transcription confusables.

qualifier: white, brown and beige fat with thermogenesis
name: White, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis
rationale: Members cover adipose development, white/brown/beige fat differentiation, PPAR regulation and cold- or diet-induced thermogenesis, unlike confusables on hepatic lipid transcription or lipid droplet turnover.

qualifier: white, brown and beige fat with thermogenesis
name: White, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis
rationale: Members concern adipogenesis, PPARG regulation, white/brown/beige fat differentiation and cold- or diet-induced thermogenesis, unlike confusables on hepatic lipogenesis, lipid droplet turnover or PGC-1alpha mitochondrial programs.

name: Myelination and node of Ranvier axon-glia organisation
rationale: Members cover CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, sodium channel clustering, paranodal junctions, neurofascin/NrCAM/L1-ankyrin interactions and glial responses, while confusables emphasise axon regeneration and glial fate/proliferation.

qualifier: axon-glia nodal and paranodal domain organization
name: Myelination and axon–glia nodal domain organization
rationale: Members cover CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, oligodendrocyte and Schwann cell myelination, paranodal junctions, sodium channel clustering and neurofascin/L1/NrCAM-ankyrin interactions, unlike confusables on axon regeneration and glial fate or proliferation.

name: Myelination and axon-glia node of Ranvier organisation
rationale: Members combine CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, oligodendrocyte and Schwann cell myelination with neurofascin/NrCAM/L1-ankyrin and sodium channel clustering at nodes and paranodes, whereas confusables centre on axon regeneration or glial fate specification.

qualifier: common gamma-chain (IL-2/7/9/15/21) and beta-chain (IL-3/5) cytokines in T and NK cells
name: Common gamma-chain and IL-3/IL-5 cytokine STAT5 signalling
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15, IL-21, IL-3 and IL-5 receptor signalling via STAT5/SHC with T and NK cell differentiation; confusables are FLT3-STAT5, IL-10/IL-12-family/interferon or Th2/mast cell inflammatory cytokine programmes.

name: Common gamma-chain and IL-3/IL-5 cytokine STAT5 signalling
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15, IL-21, IL-3 and IL-5 signalling with STAT5 output and T/NK cell effects, unlike confusables built on FLT3-STAT5, IL-10/IL-12 family, interferon or Th2/mast-cell cytokines.

name: Common gamma-chain and beta-common cytokine STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15, IL-21 (common gamma chain) and IL-3, IL-5 (beta common) signaling with STAT5 and lymphocyte/NK outputs; confusables center on IL-6/IL-10/IL-12 families, Th2/mast cell biology, inflammatory NF-kB or FLT3-driven STAT5.

qualifier: host-cell invasion and subversion of phagosome maturation
name: Intracellular bacterial invasion and subversion of phagosome maturation
rationale: Members cover Listeria and Mtb attachment and entry, phagosome acidification and phagolysosome fusion, and pathogen blockade of these, of autophagy, apoptosis and NO; this phagosome-subversion focus distinguishes it from toxin-uptake and complement/antimicrobial-peptide confusables.

qualifier: host entry and phagosome maturation subversion
name: Intracellular bacterial invasion and subversion of phagosome maturation
rationale: Members cover Listeria/Mtb entry, nutrient acquisition and blockade of phagosome acidification, fusion and host defenses; neighbours are complement/antimicrobial or toxin and protozoan responses.

qualifier: host cell invasion and phagosome maturation subversion
name: Intracellular bacterial invasion and phagosome maturation subversion
rationale: Members cover Listeria and Mtb entry, phagosome acidification and lysosome fusion and their pathogen blockade, iron acquisition and suppression of host defenses; confusables center on complement and antimicrobial peptides or toxins and anti-inflammatory signaling.

name: NFE2L2 and AKT-FOXO stress-response transcription
rationale: Members are NRF2 target-gene programs plus AKT control of FOXO localisation and FOXO-driven death/oxidative-stress genes, distinguishing it from UPR, p53/mTORC1 metabolic and NFE2L2-degradation confusables.

name: NFE2L2 and AKT-regulated FOXO stress transcription
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 target-gene programs and AKT/acetylation control of FOXO-driven death and stress genes, with neuronal apoptosis, distinguishing it from ER-stress UPR, p53/mTORC1 metabolic and NFE2L2 degradation neighbours.

name: NRF2 and AKT-regulated FOXO stress-response transcription
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 target-gene programs and AKT-controlled FOXO localization and transcription of stress and death genes, whereas confusables are ER/integrated stress responses or NRF2/p53 metabolic regulation without FOXO.

core: Hormonal and nutrient control of fuel metabolism
name: Glucagon and glucose-sensing transcriptional control of fuel metabolism
rationale: Members are glucagon/PKA/PDE3B and glucose/ChREBP/AMPK regulation of gluconeogenesis and triglyceride metabolism, unlike adipogenesis, insulin/glucose-uptake and glycogen confusables.

qualifier: control of gluconeogenesis and triglyceride use
name: Glucose and glucagon signaling controlling gluconeogenesis and triglyceride use
rationale: Members share glucose-responsive (ChREBP) and glucagon/PKA signaling that set gluconeogenesis and triglyceride turnover, unlike adipogenesis, insulin/glucose-uptake, glycogen and LXR lipogenesis confusables.

core: Hormonal and glucose-sensing control of fuel metabolism
name: Glucagon and glucose-sensing control of gluconeogenesis and lipolysis
rationale: Members concern glucagon-PKA, PDE3B/PP2A and ChREBP/carbon-catabolite signalling regulating gluconeogenesis and triglyceride turnover, distinct from glycogen, insulin, LXR lipogenesis and adipogenesis confusables.

qualifier: Leloir galactose route, glucuronate-xylulose pathway and inherited defects
name: Galactose (Leloir) and pentose/glucuronate sugar metabolism
rationale: All members are galactose (Leloir enzymes and their deficiencies) or pentose/glucuronate-xylulose metabolism steps and defects, distinguishing it from fructose/alditol confusables and the non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt confusable.

qualifier: Leloir pathway, glucuronate-xylulose route and their inborn errors
name: Galactose Leloir and pentose-glucuronate catabolism with inborn errors
rationale: All members are Leloir galactose catabolism or pentose/glucuronate-to-xylulose-5-phosphate metabolism and their enzyme deficiencies; galactose and pentose content distinguishes it from the fructose and pentose-phosphate-shunt confusables.

name: Leloir galactose and glucuronate-xylulose pentose metabolism
rationale: Members cover Leloir galactose catabolism and its defects plus glucuronate-to-xylulose pentose metabolism and pentose-phosphate enzyme defects, lacking the fructose/glycerol content of neighbours and the shunt core of C3.

name: Intestinal and renal hexose and urate transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated hexose (glucose, galactose, fructose) and urate transport and their absorption/reabsorption disorders, distinct from carbohydrate digestion and amino acid/cystine transport neighbours.

name: Intestinal and renal hexose and urate transport
rationale: Members are SLC2/SLC5 hexose transport and absorption plus SLC22/SLC2A9 urate transport and their defects, distinct from confusables on disaccharide digestion, cystine or imino acid transport.

name: Epithelial hexose and urate transmembrane transport
rationale: Members are GLUT/SGLT hexose and SLC2A9/SLC22 urate transport and their disorders; urate handling separates it from carbohydrate digestion confusables and hexoses from amino acid transport confusables.

name: Regulation of oxidative stress-induced apoptosis and ferroptosis
rationale: Members are responses to hydrogen peroxide and nitrosative stress and their control of intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis; neighbours instead add ischemia, hydrogen sulfide or mitochondrial respiration control.

name: Oxidative stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis
rationale: Members regulate cell death and responses triggered by hydrogen peroxide, hydroperoxides and nitrosative stress, including intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis, distinguished from ischemia/oxygen and mitochondrial respiration neighbours.

name: Hydrogen peroxide-induced cell death and ferroptosis regulation
rationale: Members concern responses to peroxide and nitrosative stress and the regulation of H2O2-induced intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis; unlike neighbours it carries ferroptosis/iron vulnerability and lacks ischemia, hydrogen sulfide and respiration control terms.

qualifier: VEGF and FGF production and response
name: Endothelial angiogenic regulation via VEGF and FGF signaling
rationale: Members regulate endothelial proliferation, apoptosis, activation, migration and tube formation alongside VEGF and FGF production and signaling, in both directions, unlike the purely pro- or anti-sprouting and vessel-remodeling confusables.

qualifier: bidirectional, with VEGF and FGF production control
name: Endothelial angiogenic regulation including VEGF and FGF production control
rationale: All members regulate endothelial behaviour in vessel growth in both directions, and the theme uniquely includes control of VEGF/FGF production, endothelial activation and apoptosis, unlike the purely pro- or anti-sprouting confusables.

qualifier: VEGF/FGF control, activation, apoptosis and vascular repair
name: Endothelial VEGF/FGF control of angiogenesis and vascular repair
rationale: All members regulate endothelial proliferation, survival, migration or activation via VEGF/FGF in sprouting and wound healing, mixing positive and negative control unlike the one-directional angiogenesis confusables.

name: Cation-chloride cotransporters and sodium-potassium transport regulation
rationale: Members are SLC12 cotransporters and their Bartter/Gitelman disorders with renal Na+ and K+ transport regulation, unlike neighbours centred on vasopressin water handling, magnesium, Na+/H+ exchange or osmotic responses.

name: Cation-chloride cotransport and renal sodium-potassium handling
rationale: Members centre on SLC12 cotransporters (NKCC2, NCC, KCC3 disorders) with renal sodium transport and potassium uptake, unlike confusables on osmotic/water balance, magnesium transport or sodium-proton exchange.

name: Cation-chloride cotransporters and renal sodium-potassium transport
rationale: Members are SLC12 cotransporters and their Bartter/Gitelman/ACCPN defects, potassium channels and regulation of renal sodium and potassium transport; confusables emphasise osmotic responses, sodium/proton exchangers, vasopressin-aquaporin water handling or magnesium transport.

qualifier: ganglion development, neuronal migration and innervation
name: Cranial and peripheral nerve development and innervation
rationale: Cranial, olfactory, dorsal root and sympathetic ganglion/nerve development with axon outgrowth for innervation distinguish it from neighbours on hindbrain and spinal cord patterning and generic CNS axon guidance.

name: Peripheral and cranial nerve neuron development and migration
rationale: Members cover DRG, cranial ganglion, trigeminal/facial/olfactory nerve and sympathetic neuron development with GnRH and branchiomotor migration/guidance, unlike confusables on hindbrain/spinal patterning, CNS axon guidance or glandular development.

name: Cranial and peripheral nerve and ganglion development
rationale: Members address cranial nerve, cranial/dorsal root ganglion and sympathetic/PNS neuron development, migration and innervation, lacking the spinal cord, hindbrain patterning, gland or CNS axon-guidance members of the confusables.

core: NAD and coenzyme A cofactor metabolism
qualifier: from niacin and pantothenate via salvage
name: Niacin- and pantothenate-derived NAD and coenzyme A metabolism
rationale: Members are nicotinate/NAD(P) salvage, transport and turnover plus pantothenate-to-coenzyme A synthesis; neighbours instead hold tryptophan-derived de novo NAD, creatine/adenine nucleotide transport, or pyruvate-to-acetyl-CoA.

qualifier: NAD(P) salvage and coenzyme A from vitamin precursors
name: Vitamin-derived NAD(P) and coenzyme A metabolism
rationale: Members cover NAD(P) synthesis, salvage, transport and catabolism from nicotinate and coenzyme A synthesis from pantothenate, distinguished from tryptophan de novo NAD, creatine and pyruvate dehydrogenase neighbours.

qualifier: nicotinate NAD salvage and pantothenate-derived coenzyme A
name: Vitamin-derived NAD salvage and coenzyme A biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover nicotinate/pyridine nucleotide salvage, NAD(P) metabolism and transport, and pantothenate-to-CoA synthesis; unlike neighbours it lacks tryptophan de novo NAD, PDH acetyl-CoA, peroxisomal and creatine terms.

qualifier: fructose bisphosphate control and lactate fermentation
name: Glycolytic flux regulation via fructose bisphosphates and lactate fermentation
rationale: Members concern glycolysis regulation by fructose-2,6- and 1,6-bisphosphate, lactate fermentation, pentose-phosphate and nucleotide catabolism control; confusables are hexokinase-level glucose catabolism, HIF hypoxia and FOXO/mTORC1/p53 metabolic regulation.
