core: T cell activation and antigen receptor signalling
name: T cell receptor signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members centre on proximal TCR signalling, CD28 costimulation, CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition and T cell activation signatures, distinguished from confusables on BCR signalling, thymic selection, ICOS/germinal centre help or CD27.

name: TCR signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members centre on TCR proximal signalling (CD3 phosphorylation, ZAP-70, second messengers), CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition driving T cell activation, unlike confusables on thymic selection, BCR signalling, germinal centre/ICOS help or CD27.

name: Neuronal Ca2+/cAMP-CREB signaling and MECP2 transcriptional regulation
rationale: Members link synaptic Ca2+/CaMK and adenylate cyclase-PKA signalling to CREB and MECP2/NPAS4 activity-dependent transcription and memory; confusables lack either the MECP2 or the PKA/CaMK-CREB arm.

qualifier: CREB and MECP2 via PKA and CaMK
name: Activity-dependent CREB and MECP2 neuronal transcription via PKA/CaMK
rationale: Members link cAMP/PKA and CaMKII/IV signaling to CREB phosphorylation, MECP2 and NPAS4 regulation and long-term memory, distinguishing it from synaptic plasticity, MECP2-HDAC and dopamine-cAMP neighbours.

core: Activity-dependent neuronal transcription via CREB and MECP2
name: Activity-dependent CREB and MECP2 transcription via CaMK and PKA
rationale: Members link synaptic calcium/CaMK and cAMP/PKA signaling to CREB phosphorylation, NPAS4 and MECP2-regulated neuronal genes, whereas confusables lack MECP2 or lack the CREB/PKA arm.

qualifier: GDP-mannose, dolichol-phosphate mannose and GPI anchoring
name: GDP-mannose and dolichol-phosphate mannose synthesis with GPI anchoring
rationale: All members build GDP-mannose, dolichol phosphate or dolichol-phosphate mannose (and their CDG defects) or use them for GPI anchor synthesis, whereas confusables instead cover ALG-mediated N-glycan assembly or UDP-GlcNAc synthesis.

name: Dolichyl-phosphate mannose donor synthesis and GPI anchoring
rationale: All members make dolichol, GDP-mannose and Dol-P-mannose (and their CDG defects) feeding GPI anchor synthesis and attachment, unlike confusables centred on ALG-driven lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly or UDP-GlcNAc.

name: Dolichol-phosphate mannose donor synthesis and GPI anchoring
rationale: Members cover GDP-mannose, dolichyl-phosphate and dolichyl-phosphate-mannose synthesis with their CDG defects, plus GPI anchor synthesis and attachment; the GPI members separate it from confusables built on ALG-driven lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly, N-glycan processing or UDP-GlcNAc synthesis.

name: Cholesterol uptake via LDL receptor endocytosis and degradation
rationale: Members concern LDLR/VLDLR internalization, lysosomal receptor degradation, LDL clearance and sterol feedback on uptake and synthesis, unlike confusables focused on HDL and cholesterol efflux.

name: Cholesterol uptake via LDL receptor endocytosis and degradation
rationale: Members span LDL/VLDL receptor internalization, lysosomal receptor degradation and SREBP-linked sterol control of cholesterol uptake, while confusables emphasize HDL formation and cholesterol efflux.

name: LDL receptor endocytosis and degradation controlling cholesterol uptake
rationale: Members concern lipoprotein receptor internalization, recycling and lysosomal degradation with sterol feedback on uptake and synthesis, distinct from HDL/efflux and SREBP-activation neighbours.

core: MHC class II and CD1 antigen presentation
name: MHC-II and CD1 antigen presentation with NKT cell regulation
rationale: Members cover exogenous peptide presentation via MHC class II, CD1 lipid antigen presentation, TLR7/8-MHC modules and NKT activation/differentiation; confusables emphasise MHC class I cross-presentation, proteasome or dendritic/monocyte surface signatures.

qualifier: MHC class II and CD1 lipid antigens to NKT cells
name: MHC class II and CD1 lipid antigen presentation
rationale: Members are antigen presentation via MHC class II and CD1/MHC-Ib lipid antigens with NKT cell regulation, lacking the MHC class I cross-presentation and proteasome members of confusables.

qualifier: MHC class II and CD1 lipid, NKT activation
name: MHC class II and CD1-lipid antigen presentation with NKT activation
rationale: Members cover exogenous MHC class II and CD1 lipid antigen presentation with NKT cell regulation, distinguishing it from MHC class I cross-presentation and dendritic/monocyte surface-signature confusables.

qualifier: membrane transport, NTP catabolism and nucleoside-analog drugs
name: Nucleoside transport, triphosphate catabolism and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
rationale: Members are purine/pyrimidine nucleoside and nucleobase transport (incl. SLC29A3), NUDT/NTP catabolism and ADME of nucleoside-analog and thiopurine drugs, distinguishing it from nucleotide interconversion and general xenobiotic efflux neighbours.

qualifier: transport, purine triphosphate catabolism and analog drugs
name: Nucleoside transport and purine nucleotide catabolism, including analog drugs
rationale: Members cover nucleoside/purine base transporters, NUDT and triphosphate catabolism and nucleoside-analog/thiopurine drug handling, unlike general xenobiotic efflux, nucleotide interconversion or DNA-protection neighbours.

core: Nucleoside transport and nucleoside-analog drug handling
name: Nucleoside transport, NTP catabolism and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
rationale: Members are purine/pyrimidine nucleoside and base transport, NUDT/NTP hydrolysis and ADME of thiopurines, ribavirin and abacavir; NTP catabolism and thiopurine metabolism separate it from xenobiotic-transport confusables, transporters from nucleotide-interconversion confusables.

qualifier: bone and dental tissues with FGF23-Klotho/PTH control
name: Bone and tooth mineralization and odontogenesis
rationale: Members regulate bone, dentin, enamel and cementum mineralization and tooth development with PTH and FGF-Klotho inputs, distinguishing them from phosphate transporter and osteoclast/bone resorption confusables.

name: Bone and dental tissue mineralization and tooth development
rationale: Members concern bone, enamel, dentin and cementum mineralization and odontogenesis with FGF23-Klotho and PTH regulation, unlike confusables on Na-phosphate transport or osteoclast-driven resorption.

name: Bone and tooth mineralization and odontogenesis
rationale: Members cover regulation of bone, enamel, dentin and cementum mineralization, odontoblast and tooth development, with PTH and FGF23-Klotho phosphate signaling, whereas confusables focus on osteoclast-driven bone resorption or sodium-phosphate transport and its disorders.

name: Somitogenesis and Hox-mediated anteroposterior axial patterning
rationale: Members are somite specification, segmentation clock (LFNG), axis elongation and Hox cluster modules, unlike confusables on neural plate, hindbrain or limb patterning.

name: Somitogenesis and Hox cluster anterior–posterior axial patterning
rationale: Members cover somite specification, segmentation and axis elongation plus Hox cluster modules, which the neural plate, limb and hindbrain patterning confusables lack.

name: Hox-driven anterior-posterior patterning and somitogenesis
rationale: Members are Hox gene clusters, somite specification/segmentation and axis elongation; confusables lack Hox clusters or concern neural plate, dorsoventral and limb patterning.

name: K2P, KATP and calcium-activated potassium channels in hyperpolarization
rationale: Members are tandem-pore, KATP (and ABCC8/9 defects) and KCa channels and resting potential/hyperpolarization regulation; confusables involve Kir/Kv channels, sodium transport or smooth muscle.

qualifier: two-pore leak, ATP-sensitive and calcium-activated channels
name: Leak, ATP-sensitive and calcium-activated potassium channels setting membrane potential
rationale: Members are K2P leak channels, KATP channels with their SUR disease variants and KCa channels regulating resting potential and excitability; the KATP and K2P families separate it from Kir, voltage-gated and sodium-transport neighbours.

name: Two-pore, ATP-sensitive and Ca2+-activated potassium channels in excitability
rationale: Members are K2P (TWIK, TREK, TASK, THIK, TRESK), KATP (ABCC8/9 defects) and Ca2+-activated K+ channels regulating resting potential and excitability; confusables are Na+/K+ transport, Kir/voltage-gated channels and action-potential propagation.

qualifier: FGFR3 activation and PI3K/phospholipase C cascades
name: FGFR3 activation and FGFR PI3K/phospholipase C cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades across receptors plus FGFR3 ligand binding and mutant signaling, unlike neighbours centred on FRS/SHC-MAPK cascades and FGFR1/2/4 activation.

qualifier: FGFR3 activation and PI3K/phospholipase C branches
name: FGFR3 activation and FGFR PI3K/phospholipase C cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades plus FGFR3 ligand binding and mutant signaling, distinguishing it from confusables on FRS/SHC-MAPK branches, FGFR1/2 isoforms or non-FGFR PI3K signaling.

name: FGFR3 signaling and FGFR PI3K/PLCγ cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR3 ligand binding, adaptor and mutant signaling plus PI3K and phospholipase C cascades across FGFRs, unlike confusables built on FRS/SHC cascades of FGFR1/2/4 or non-FGFR PI3K signaling.

qualifier: HIF hypoxia sensing with p53 and mTORC1 glycolytic control
name: HIF hypoxic glycolytic reprogramming with p53 and mTORC1
rationale: Members share oxygen- and nutrient-stress control of glycolysis and nucleotide metabolism via HIF, p53 and mTORC1, distinguishing it from fructose/fermentation and NRF2-centred confusables.

qualifier: HIF signalling with p53 and mTORC1 metabolic input
name: HIF hypoxia signalling and glycolytic metabolic reprogramming
rationale: Members cover HIF oxygen sensing, hypoxia and control of glycolysis, pentose-phosphate and nucleotide catabolism (with p53/mTORC1 metabolic sets); HIF/hypoxia distinguishes it from glycolysis-enzyme confusables and the absence of NFE2L2 from the NRF2 confusables.

core: Metabolic reprogramming of glycolysis under stress
name: HIF- and p53-driven glycolytic metabolic reprogramming
rationale: Members cover HIF oxygen sensing, glycolysis, pentose-phosphate and nucleotide catabolism regulation with p53 and mTORC1 metabolic control, distinguishing it from fermentation/lactate and NRF2-centred neighbours.

qualifier: viral nucleic acid sensing via IRF3/IRF7
name: Viral RNA sensing and IRF3/IRF7-driven type I interferon production
rationale: Members describe RIG-I/MDA5, ZBP1 and TLR7/8/9 sensing that drives IRF3/IRF7-dependent IFN-alpha/beta production, unlike confusables on cytosolic DNA sensing, interferon responses (OAS) or viral evasion.

name: Nucleic acid sensor-triggered IRF3/IRF7 type I interferon induction
rationale: Members describe RIG-I/MDA5, ZBP1 and TLR7/8/9 sensing leading to IRF3/IRF7 activation and interferon-alpha/beta production, distinguishing it from interferon-response, cytosolic DNA sensing and generic antiviral/viral-evasion themes.

core: Type I interferon induction by nucleic acid sensing
qualifier: RIG-I/MDA5 and IRF3/IRF7 driven IFN-alpha/beta production
name: Viral RNA sensing driving IRF3/IRF7 type I interferon production
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5 and dsRNA sensing, IRF3/IRF7 activation and positive regulation of IFN-alpha/beta production, while confusables emphasise downstream antiviral/IFN responses, viral evasion or DNA sensing.

qualifier: with NADPH regeneration and protein repair
name: Reactive oxygen and aldehyde detoxification with NADPH regeneration
rationale: Members span ROS detoxification, redox homeostasis, methylglyoxal/aldehyde catabolism, isocitrate-linked NADPH regeneration and oxidized protein repair, distinct from glutathione-synthesis, ferroptosis and vitamin C confusables.

name: NADPH-dependent ROS and reactive aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, redox homeostasis, NADPH regeneration via isocitrate, methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and oxidized protein repair, distinct from the glutathione-synthesis, ferroptosis and vitamin confusables.

name: NADPH-dependent ROS and reactive aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members link ROS detoxification and redox homeostasis to NADPH regeneration via isocitrate, plus methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and protein repair, unlike glutathione/ferroptosis, sulfur and vitamin C confusables.

core: MECP2 regulation of neuronal gene expression
qualifier: methyl-DNA binding and neuronal channel/GABA targets, not corepressor recruitment
name: MECP2 methyl-DNA binding and neuronal signaling gene regulation
rationale: Most members are MECP2 regulation, methyl-DNA binding and target-gene pathways (neuronal ligands, receptors, channels, GABA), with calcium channel and touch-perception terms fitting Rett-type neuronal targets; unlike confusables it lacks the HDAC/NCoR corepressor and behavioural terms.

core: MECP2 control of neuronal gene expression
name: MECP2 neuronal gene control with translational and calcium-channel restraint
rationale: Most members are MECP2 regulatory events and Rett-type loss-of-function variants acting on neuronal genes; unlike C1/C4 the theme lacks the HDAC/NCoR and behavioural terms and instead carries repression of cytoplasmic translation and voltage-gated calcium channels.

core: MECP2 control of neuronal gene expression
qualifier: with calcium channel and translation repression
name: MECP2 regulation of neuronal genes, channels and translation
rationale: Members are MECP2 regulatory targets, Rett-type MECP2 loss-of-function events and MECP2-annotated neuronal processes; unlike the MECP2 confusables it carries calcium-channel and cytoplasmic-translation repression rather than NCoR/HDAC corepressor or behavioural terms.

core: Negative regulation of inflammatory cytokine production
qualifier: TLR2/4, LPS, TNF and NF-kappaB signalling inhibition
name: Suppression of TLR2/4–NF-kappaB inflammatory cytokine signalling
rationale: Every member is negative regulation of TLR2/4/LPS, TNF or NF-kappaB signalling or of IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNF production, whereas confusables add positive cytokine regulation, inflammasome or IL-10/IL-12 control and lack the NF-kappaB/TNF inhibition.

qualifier: TLR, TNF and NF-kB with IL-6/IL-1b/TNF output
name: Suppression of TLR-TNF-NF-kB signalling and inflammatory cytokines
rationale: Every member negatively regulates TLR2/4, LPS, TNF or NF-kB signalling or downstream proinflammatory cytokine production, while confusables add IL-10/IL-12 regulation, inflammasome activation or positive TLR signalling.

qualifier: TLR, TNF and NF-kappaB signalling inhibition
name: TLR, TNF and NF-kappaB inflammatory signalling suppression
rationale: Every member is a negative regulation of TLR2/4/LPS, TNF or NF-kappaB signalling or of the inflammatory cytokines they induce; confusables lack the NF-kappaB and TNF-signalling inhibition and add positive regulation, IL-10/IL-12 or inflammasome sets.

name: Rab and ARF GTPase control of endocytic recycling and secretion
rationale: Members cover Rab-GAP and ARF signalling governing endosome organisation, receptor recycling, endocytosis, Golgi localisation and constitutive secretion, unlike neuronal receptor trafficking, membrane tubulation and Golgi-lysosome transport confusables.

name: Rab and ARF GTPase control of endocytic recycling
rationale: Members are Rab/ARF GTPase signalling and RabGAPs governing endocytosis, endosome organization, recycling to the plasma membrane, Golgi localization and constitutive secretion, unlike confusables on membrane tubulation, Golgi-lysosome or neuronal receptor trafficking.

name: Rab and ARF GTPase control of endocytic recycling
rationale: Members combine Rab/ARF signalling and RabGAPs with endocytosis, endosome organization and recycling to the plasma membrane, unlike confusables about neuronal receptor trafficking, Golgi budding/tubulation or Golgi-lysosome transport.

core: Th1 differentiation of CD4 T cells
name: IL-12-driven Th1 differentiation and helper lineage choice
rationale: Members cover IL-12/IFN-gamma-driven Th1 differentiation plus competing Treg, Th17 and memory fate decisions, which separates the theme from dendritic/NKT-cell and IFN-gamma-response confusables.

qualifier: Th1 bias via IL-12 and IFN-gamma production
name: IL-12-driven Th1 lineage commitment and IFN-gamma production
rationale: Members concern CD4 helper fate decisions (Th1 differentiation, Th17/Treg restraint, memory) driven by IL-12 signalling and IFN-gamma/IL-12 production, whereas confusables centre on the response to IFN-gamma, MHC induction, Treg differentiation or NKT cells.

core: CD4 helper T cell lineage commitment
name: IL-12-driven Th1 polarization of CD4 helper lineage
rationale: Members cover CD4 helper fate choice centred on Th1 differentiation, IL-12/JAK-STAT input and IFN-gamma production (with Treg and Th17 restraint), whereas confusables emphasise IFN-gamma response signalling, dendritic/NKT cells or Treg differentiation.

qualifier: ribosomal subunit and Rev cargo export
name: Nuclear pore transport of ribosomal subunits and Rev cargo
rationale: All members concern the nuclear pore complex and traffic through it, and the theme is set apart from NPC assembly/disassembly and inositol-phosphate transport confusables by ribosomal subunit export and HIV Rev import/export.

qualifier: ribosomal subunit and HIV Rev cargo
name: Nuclear pore trafficking of ribosomal subunits and viral RNA
rationale: Members are nuclear pore complex components and the cargo they move (ribosomal subunit export, Rev import and HIV RNA export, periphery gene tethering), whereas confusables cover NPC assembly/disassembly, generic protein import/export regulation or inositol phosphate transport.

qualifier: ribosomal subunit and Rev RNA export
name: Nuclear pore complex function in ribosome and Rev export
rationale: Members describe the nuclear pore complex, its postmitotic reformation and cargo traffic (ribosomal subunits, HIV Rev) plus gene tethering at the pore, whereas confusables cover NPC assembly/disassembly, inositol phosphate transport or generic import regulation.

qualifier: nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon induction
name: Nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon antiviral response
rationale: Members span endosomal TLR3/7/8/9, RIG-I and cytosolic DNA sensing, IRF3/7 and type I/III interferon induction and ISG responses, far broader than dengue, cGAS-STING or PKR confusables.

qualifier: nucleic-acid sensing and type I/III interferon
name: Antiviral nucleic-acid sensing and type I interferon response
rationale: Members span RLR, endosomal TLR3/7/8/9, cGAS/STING and AIM2 sensing, IRF3/7 activation, type I/III interferon production and ISG responses, with confusables differing only by PKR, cGAMP import or dengue items.

qualifier: nucleic acid sensing and type I/III interferon response
name: Antiviral nucleic acid sensing and type I/III interferon response
rationale: Members span RIG-I-like, endosomal TLR and cytosolic DNA sensing, IRF/NF-kB activation and type I/III interferon responses, a broad core of which the confusables cover only narrow cGAS-STING, PKR or viral-modulation slices.

qualifier: assembly, remodeling and clearance of chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL plus cholesterol efflux
name: Lipoprotein particle assembly, remodeling, clearance and cholesterol efflux
rationale: All members concern the life cycle of plasma lipoproteins (intestinal lipid absorption, particle assembly, remodeling, receptor clearance) and LXR/ABCA1-driven cholesterol efflux, which the sterol-transporter, bile and foam-cell confusables lack.

core: Plasma lipoprotein metabolism and cholesterol efflux
qualifier: chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL assembly, remodeling and clearance
name: Lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, clearance and cholesterol efflux
rationale: All members concern lipoprotein particle assembly, remodeling, clearance, intestinal lipid absorption or LXR/ABCA1-driven cholesterol efflux; unlike confusables (foam-cell/oxLDL uptake, ABCG5/8 and bile transporter defects) it spans the full chylomicron-VLDL-LDL-HDL particle lifecycle.

core: Plasma lipoprotein assembly, remodeling and clearance
qualifier: chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL lifecycle with LXR-driven cholesterol efflux
name: Lipoprotein particle lifecycle and cholesterol efflux
rationale: All members concern assembly, remodeling, clearance or regulation of chylomicrons, VLDL, LDL and HDL and the cholesterol efflux/uptake they mediate; unlike the confusables (sitosterolemia ABCG5/8, bile transporters, oxLDL foam-cell uptake) it covers the full particle lifecycle and LXR/ABCA1 efflux.

name: Cellular senescence and p53-dependent intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members span oncogene-, stress- and replicative senescence (p16/ARF, SAHF, SASP) and p53-driven transcription of intrinsic apoptotic genes, while confusables centre on BCL-2/apoptosome execution, extrinsic death or p53 phosphorylation and G2 checkpoint.

qualifier: cellular senescence and DNA damage-induced intrinsic apoptosis
name: p53-driven senescence and DNA damage-induced intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members span p53/p21/p16-ARF control of oncogene-, oxidative- and replicative senescence (SAHF, SASP) and p53-transcribed intrinsic apoptosis (PUMA, NOXA); senescence distinguishes it from the broad apoptosis and G2-checkpoint confusables.

qualifier: cellular senescence and DNA damage-induced intrinsic apoptosis
name: p53-mediated senescence and DNA damage-induced intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members are p53/p14ARF/p16INK4A pathways driving oncogene- and stress-induced senescence (SAHF, SASP) and p53-dependent PUMA/NOXA apoptosis; senescence distinguishes it from the apoptosis-execution and G2-checkpoint confusables.

qualifier: TAK1/IKK downstream of TLR and NOD receptors
name: TLR/NOD-driven TAK1-IKK activation of NF-kB, JNK and p38
rationale: Members describe innate-receptor (TLR, NOD1/2, dectin-1, TNFSF) activation of TAK1 and IKK leading to canonical/noncanonical NF-kB, JNK and p38 signaling, while confusables emphasise TNFR1 signaling, linear ubiquitination, negative regulation or TBK1-IRF3 activation.

qualifier: positive TAK1/IKK signalling downstream of TLR, NOD and noncanonical NIK receptors
name: Innate receptor-driven TAK1/IKK activation of NF-kB and JNK/p38
rationale: Members are the TLR/TRIF/IRAK, NOD1/2 and NIK routes through TAK1 and IKK to canonical and noncanonical NF-kB, JNK and p38. The confusables add TBK1-IRF3, TNFR1 and the negative and linear-ubiquitin regulators instead.

core: Innate receptor activation of NF-kB and stress MAPKs
qualifier: TAK1/IKK downstream of TLR and NOD receptors
name: TAK1-mediated NF-kB and JNK/p38 activation by TLR, NOD receptors
rationale: Members are positive TAK1/IKK-driven NF-kB, JNK and p38 activation from TRIF/IRAK TLR, NOD1/2, Dectin-1 and TNFSF inputs, while confusables focus on TNFR1 signalling, negative NF-kB regulation, linear ubiquitination or TBK1/IRF3.

name: Intestinal, hepatic and pancreatic epithelial lineage differentiation
rationale: Members are HNF4/CDX-driven intestinal and hepatic absorptive epithelium programmes, intestinal stem cell and epithelial maintenance terms and pancreatic progenitor lineages, separating it from definitive endoderm, reproductive/mammary gland and beta-cell insulin secretion confusables (adrenal development and leukocyte migration are outliers).

name: Intestinal epithelium and pancreatic progenitor lineage differentiation
rationale: Members describe CDX/HNF4-driven intestinal absorptive epithelium identity and pancreatic progenitor/endocrine lineage development, distinct from neighbours on mammary/reproductive glands, beta-cell insulin secretion and definitive endoderm formation.

qualifier: intestinal HNF4/CDX epithelium and pancreatic progenitors
name: Intestinal epithelial identity and pancreatic progenitor lineage differentiation
rationale: Most members describe HNF4/CDX-driven intestinal absorptive epithelium, crypt stem cells and pancreatic progenitor, ductal and endocrine lineages (with minor adrenal and leukocyte outliers), distinguishing it from definitive endoderm (C1), reproductive gland (C2, C4) and beta-cell/incretin (C3) neighbours.

name: Chemokine receptor-driven dendritic cell and leukocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members are chemokines/receptors and chemotaxis of dendritic, T, B, NK and mast cells, distinct from confusables on lymphoid organ development, S1P signaling and integrin-mediated adhesion.

qualifier: dendritic cell, T, B, NK and mast cell migration
name: Chemokine receptor-driven leukocyte chemotaxis, especially dendritic cells
rationale: Members are chemokines and receptors (CXCR4, CCR7) and chemotaxis of dendritic, T, B, NK and mast cells; confusables instead centre on S1P/lymphoid organ development or integrin-mediated migration.

qualifier: leukocyte and dendritic cell chemokine receptors
name: Chemokine receptor signaling in leukocyte and dendritic cell chemotaxis
rationale: Members are chemokine/receptor modules and chemotaxis of T, B, NK, mast and dendritic cells, distinct from lymphoid organ homing/S1P and integrin adhesion confusables.

name: Renin-angiotensin and renal regulation of systemic blood pressure
rationale: Members regulate arterial pressure and blood volume via angiotensin, vasopressin, endothelin, vasoconstriction and renal sodium/filtration control, whereas confusables focus on NO-cGMP smooth muscle relaxation or renal water homeostasis.

name: Renin-angiotensin, renal and vasoconstrictor control of arterial blood pressure
rationale: Members concern angiotensin production and signaling, renal sodium/volume and glomerular control, vasopressin/endothelin vasoconstriction and peptide catabolism, versus confusables on NO-cGMP smooth muscle relaxation or vasopressin water homeostasis.

name: Renin-angiotensin and renal regulation of systemic blood pressure
rationale: Members are angiotensin, vasopressin, endothelin, kinin and renal mechanisms of blood pressure and volume; confusables center on NO-cGMP smooth-muscle relaxation or vasopressin water handling.

qualifier: linkage-specific DUBs restraining NF-kappaB and transcription factor activity
name: Linkage-specific deubiquitination restraining NF-kappaB and transcription factors
rationale: Members are deubiquitinase families and K11/K48/K63 deubiquitination with ubiquitin activation, plus negative regulation of NF-kappaB and transcription factor activity, unlike confusables on proteasome/neddylation, atypical chain synthesis or TNFR1-driven NF-kappaB activation.

name: Deubiquitinase removal of K48/K63 chains and NF-kappaB restraint
rationale: Members are DUB families (USP, OTU, JAMM) removing K11/K48/K63 chains plus negative control of NF-kappaB and transcription factor activity, distinct from chain polymerisation, neddylation/proteasome or TNFR1 linear ubiquitination in confusables.

qualifier: DUB control of ubiquitin chains and NF-kappaB activity
name: Deubiquitinase control of ubiquitin chains and NF-kappaB activity
rationale: Members include USP, OTU and metalloprotease DUBs, K11/K48/K63 deubiquitination and regulation of NF-kappaB/transcription factor activity, unlike confusables on proteasome/neddylation, TNFR1 linear ubiquitination or atypical chain synthesis.

qualifier: glucocorticoid and aldosterone secretion and response
name: Regulation of glucocorticoid and aldosterone synthesis and secretion
rationale: Members regulate adrenal glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid production, secretion, ACTH control and cellular response, whereas confusables are steroidogenic enzyme pathways and their defects, behavioural stress responses, or thyroid hormone.

qualifier: regulation of glucocorticoid and aldosterone synthesis and secretion
name: Regulation of glucocorticoid and aldosterone synthesis and secretion
rationale: Members regulate cortisol, corticosterone and aldosterone biosynthesis and secretion including ACTH drive and glucocorticoid response, distinct from confusables on stress behaviour, thyroid hormone or core steroidogenic enzyme reactions.

qualifier: secretion and biosynthetic control of glucocorticoids and aldosterone
name: Glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid secretion, synthesis control and response
rationale: Members regulate secretion and synthesis of cortisol, corticosterone and aldosterone (including ACTH drive) and responses to glucocorticoids, unlike the steroidogenic enzyme, stress-behaviour and thyroid confusables.

core: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuronal development
name: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuron specification and patterning
rationale: Members cover motor neuron and interneuron specification, neural tube dorsoventral patterning, brainstem and cranial/sensory ganglion development and brainstem-controlled behaviours; this hindbrain-spinal scope separates it from enteric, neural plate, midbrain and cranial sensory neighbours.

name: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuronal patterning and differentiation
rationale: Members pattern the dorsoventral neural tube and generate spinal motor/interneurons, brainstem and branchiomotor neurons, unlike midbrain, cranial-sensory, neural plate or enteric confusables.

core: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuron development
qualifier: motor neuron specification, patterning and migration
name: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuron specification and migration
rationale: Members cover neural tube D/V patterning, spinal motor/interneuron specification, hindbrain/brainstem development, branchiomotor and cranial nerves, unlike enteric, olfactory/cranial sensory, midbrain dopaminergic or neural plate confusables.

name: Chemokine receptor-driven dendritic cell and T cell chemotaxis
rationale: Members are chemokine/receptor signaling (CXCR4, CCR7) guiding leukocyte migration, with dendritic cell and T/NK chemotaxis distinguishing it from B-cell homing, monocyte, mast-cell and integrin confusables.

name: Chemokine receptor-driven dendritic cell and T/NK cell chemotaxis
rationale: Members are chemokine/receptor signalling (CCR7, CXCR4) directing migration of dendritic cells, T and NK cells; confusables cover B cell homing, integrin adhesion or monocyte chemokine clusters.

qualifier: dendritic, T and NK cells via CCR7/CXCR4
name: Chemokine receptor-driven dendritic cell and T cell chemotaxis
rationale: Members concern chemokines and receptors directing migration of dendritic, T and NK cells, distinct from confusables on mast/astrocyte chemotaxis, B cell homing and integrin adhesion.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to AKT and ERK
name: Insulin-like and ALK/LTK receptor signaling to AKT and ERK
rationale: Members are RTK autophosphorylation, IGF1R/IRS/SHC/SOS and ALK/LTK signaling to PI3K-AKT (incl. AKT2, glycogen synthesis) and ERK, distinct from FGFR-, ERBB/MET-, RAS/MAPK- and oncogenic-fusion confusables.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT
name: Insulin/IGF1R and ALK-family receptor signaling via PI3K-AKT
rationale: Members are tyrosine autophosphorylation, IRS/SHC/SOS adaptor events and AKT activation downstream of IGF1R/insulin receptor and ALK/LTK, distinguishing it from FGFR, ERBB/MET, RAS-MAPK and oncogenic fusion confusables.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT
name: Insulin/IGF1 and ALK-family receptor signaling to PI3K-AKT
rationale: Members are RTK autophosphorylation and IRS/SHC/SOS signalling to AKT and ERK from IGF1R/insulin and ALK/LTK receptors, unlike FGFR, ERBB, MET or oncogenic fusion confusables.

qualifier: FMO/CYP oxidation, sulfonation and acetylation of xenobiotics and phytochemicals
name: Xenobiotic and phytochemical detoxification by oxidation, sulfonation, acetylation
rationale: Members describe phase I/II detoxification of xenobiotics, toxins and plant-derived compounds by FMO and CYP oxidation, sulfonation and acetylation, while confusables add methylation, CYP2E1, aflatoxin or drug ADME.

name: Xenobiotic and phytochemical biotransformation with FMO oxidation
rationale: Members cover phase I/II metabolism of xenobiotics, steroids and plant-derived compounds by CYPs, FMOs, sulfonation and acetylation, with FMO and natural-product catabolism absent from methylation, paracetamol and aflatoxin confusables.

name: Xenobiotic and plant-compound detoxification with FMO oxidation
rationale: Members metabolize toxins, drugs and plant-derived terpenoids, alkaloids, phenylpropanoids and polyketides via oxidation, sulfonation and acetylation, with FMO pathways absent from all confusables.

core: Intestinal lipid absorption and lipoprotein assembly
name: Dietary lipid and vitamin E absorption, lipoprotein assembly
rationale: Members cover dietary lipid digestion/absorption, ABCG5/8 sterol efflux, chylomicron/VLDL assembly and vitamin E transport, unlike confusables on lipoprotein remodeling/clearance, cholesterol homeostasis or bile acids.

name: Intestinal lipid absorption and triglyceride-rich lipoprotein assembly
rationale: Members cover dietary lipid, sterol and vitamin E absorption and chylomicron/VLDL assembly, whereas confusables concern lipoprotein remodeling and clearance, cholesterol homeostasis and bile acids.

name: Intestinal lipid absorption and chylomicron/VLDL assembly

qualifier: PIEZO1 shear sensing and calcium-activated scrambling

core: initiation and execution of chromosomal DNA replication

core: mitotic DNA replication initiation and synthesis
qualifier: origin licensing and polymerase/helicase activity, not checkpoint signalling

qualifier: fission-fusion balance and protein localization to mitochondria
name: Regulation of mitochondrial fission-fusion and protein localization to mitochondria

name: Regulation of mitochondrial fission-fusion, protein localization, membrane potential
