name: Hedgehog ligand lipidation, autoprocessing and SMO-GLI signaling
rationale: Members cover Hh ligand autoprocessing, palmitoylation and release plus SMO activation, ciliary localization and GLI processing, distinct from confusables on Wnt/DVL, Wnt secretion or Notch.

qualifier: ligand lipidation, SMO activation and GLI processing
name: Hedgehog ligand lipidation, SMO activation and GLI processing
rationale: Members are Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing and palmitoylation, release, SMO activation, ciliary localization and GLI processing/degradation, distinct from the Wnt and Notch confusables.

qualifier: ligand autoprocessing and palmitoylation plus SMO-GLI
name: Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing, lipidation and SMO-GLI signaling
rationale: Members are Hedgehog ligand self-cleavage, palmitoylation and release plus SMO activation and GLI processing, separating it from Wnt/DVL, Wnt lipidation and Notch themes.

name: NGF signalling through TRKA and p75NTR
rationale: Members cover NGF processing and TRKA downstream signalling plus p75NTR survival/death signalling, distinguishing it from TRKB/TRKC confusables and from p75NTR-free or dependence-receptor themes.

name: NGF signaling through p75NTR and TRKA
rationale: Members cover NGF production/processing and its signaling via p75NTR (NRIF, NADE, NF-kB, proteolysis) and TRKA (FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, CREB), distinguishing them from NTRK2/NTRK3 and dependence-receptor themes.

name: NGF signaling through TRKA and p75NTR
rationale: Members cover NGF processing and signaling through TRKA and p75NTR (survival, death, proteolysis), distinguishing it from BDNF/NT3 NTRK2/3 signaling and dependence-receptor death neighbours.

name: tRNA processing, aminoacylation and decoding fidelity
rationale: All members concern tRNA processing, modification, charging (including selenocysteine) and translational fidelity/readthrough, distinct from confusables on mitochondrial gene expression, rRNA modification or translation-factor modification.

qualifier: translational fidelity, selenocysteine synthesis and readthrough
name: tRNA maturation, aminoacylation and translational fidelity
rationale: Members cover nuclear tRNA processing and splicing, anticodon modifications, cytosolic and mitochondrial aminoacylation, selenocysteine synthesis and translational fidelity/readthrough, distinguishing them from confusables that add rRNA/mRNA modification, protein modifications or mitochondrial gene expression.

name: tRNA processing, modification and aminoacylation for translational fidelity
rationale: Members are nuclear tRNA processing, anticodon modifications, cytosolic/mitochondrial aminoacylation and selenocysteine charging that safeguard decoding, unlike confusables on translation-factor modification or mitochondrial RNA processing.

name: Amino-acid and energy sensing control of mTORC1 signalling
rationale: Members are leucine/methionine/glucose sensing, LKB1-AMPK, AKT-TSC and lysosomal regulation of TORC1 and its translational output, unlike the FOXO/p53 metabolic and protein methylation neighbours.

name: Nutrient and energy sensing upstream of mTORC1
rationale: Members are amino-acid, glucose and energy (LKB1-AMPK, TSC) inputs that regulate mTORC1 and its translational output; neighbours cover mTORC1/p53 metabolic targets, FOXO and protein methylation.

qualifier: upstream amino acid and energy sensing
name: Amino acid and energy sensing by mTORC1
rationale: Members all concern mTORC1 control by leucine/methionine, glucose starvation, LKB1–AMPK, AKT–TSC and lysosomal recruitment, unlike neighbours centred on glycolytic/p53 metabolic targets, FOXO or protein methylation.

name: RUNX1-regulated myeloid progenitor and megakaryocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover RUNX1-driven HSC/myeloid progenitor programmes and megakaryocyte/platelet development, distinct from confusables focused on erythroid maturation, granulopoiesis or monocyte/macrophage differentiation.

name: RUNX1-regulated megakaryocyte and myeloid progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members cover RUNX1 transcriptional control, megakaryocyte/platelet development and myeloid progenitor/promyelocyte programmes, unlike the erythroid and monocyte/macrophage confusables.

name: RUNX1-regulated myeloid progenitor and megakaryocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover myeloid progenitor proliferation/differentiation, megakaryocyte and platelet development and RUNX1 transcriptional control, while confusables are erythroid, granulopoietic or monocyte-focused.

name: Pulmonary surfactant homeostasis and alveolar pneumocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover surfactant metabolism and its disorders plus alveolar pneumocyte and saccule development, distinguishing it from gas-transport, membrane-scrambling and airway branching confusables.

name: Perinatal alveolar surfactant homeostasis and pneumocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover surfactant metabolism and its disorders, type I/II pneumocyte differentiation, saccule development, hyperoxia and ductus closure at birth; surfactant/alveolar focus distinguishes it from lung branching, airway epithelium and gas-transport confusables.

name: Pulmonary surfactant and alveolar pneumocyte development
rationale: Members are surfactant metabolism and its inherited defects, type I/II pneumocyte differentiation, saccule development and perinatal hyperoxia/ductus closure, unlike lung branching, secretory cell or erythrocyte gas exchange confusables.

name: Cardiac myocardium, septum and endocardium morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover trabecular/compact ventricular and atrial myocardium, septal and endocardial morphogenesis, unlike confusables focused on valves, coronary vessels or heart tube and second heart field.

name: Cardiac chamber myocardium, endocardium and septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern trabecular and compact myocardium, endocardium, atrial and ventricular septa and cardiomyocyte proliferation, distinguishing it from confusables on valves and cushions, coronary vessels or early heart tube and second heart field.

name: Chamber myocardium, trabeculation, endocardium and septum morphogenesis
rationale: All members build atrial/ventricular myocardium, trabeculae, endocardium or septa, unlike confusables on early heart tube and second heart field, coronary vessels, or valve/cushion formation.

name: FGF receptor signaling via FRS2/SHC-MAPK and its regulation
rationale: All members are FGFR signaling, with FRS- and SHC-mediated MAPK cascades plus Sprouty, FGFRL1 and positive/negative regulation, distinguishing it from FGFR confusables dominated by PLC-gamma and PI3K arms and from generic RAS-MAPK feedback.

qualifier: FRS/SHC adaptor-mediated MAPK cascade and its feedback regulation
name: FGF receptor FRS/SHC-MAPK signalling and its regulation
rationale: All members concern FGFR activation and adaptor (FRS2/SHC)-driven MAPK signalling with Sprouty/FGFRL1 and positive/negative regulation, distinct from confusables built on PI3K/PLC-gamma FGFR branches or generic RAS-MAPK attenuation.

name: FGFR signalling via FRS/SHC adaptors to MAPK
rationale: Members are FGFR ligand binding, FRS- and SHC-mediated cascades to MAPK and their regulators (Sprouty, FGFRL1), separating it from the PI3K and PLC-gamma FGFR branches and generic RAS/MAPK feedback confusables.

qualifier: NRF2 antioxidant and HIF oxygen-sensing programs
name: NRF2 antioxidant and HIF hypoxia transcriptional programs
rationale: Members cover NFE2L2/NRF2 regulation and target gene programs together with HIF hydroxylation, signaling and hypoxia response, distinguishing the theme from FOXO, ferroptosis/redox and p53-metabolism confusables.

qualifier: HIF hypoxia and NRF2 oxidative stress
name: HIF hypoxia and NRF2 oxidative stress transcriptional responses
rationale: Members share oxygen/redox-sensing transcription factor control: HIF-alpha prolyl hydroxylation, HIF-1alpha target expression and hypoxia signatures, plus NFE2L2 regulation, degradation and its antioxidant, metabolic and inflammatory targets, unlike confusables on ROS detoxification/ferroptosis, p53/mTOR metabolic genes, FOXO or BACH1.

qualifier: NRF2 antioxidant and HIF hypoxia programs
name: NRF2 antioxidant and HIF hypoxia transcriptional programs
rationale: Members are NFE2L2-regulated gene programs and NFE2L2 control plus HIF oxygen sensing and hypoxic gene regulation, which confusables (p53/mTORC1 metabolism, FOXO, ROS detoxification, ferroptosis) lack in combination.

name: Copper and manganese homeostasis and metallothionein metal response
rationale: Members concern copper, manganese, zinc and iron handling with MTF1/metallothionein responses, where copper/manganese transport and the metal-responsive transcription arm distinguish it from zinc/cadmium transport confusables.

name: Copper and manganese homeostasis and metallothionein metal response
rationale: Members cover copper and manganese import, homeostasis and detoxification plus MTF1/metallothionein responses to zinc and iron, while confusables center on zinc transporters and cadmium detoxification.

qualifier: copper and manganese, with metallothionein/MTF1 responses
name: Copper and manganese homeostasis with metallothionein metal responses
rationale: Members cover copper and manganese transport and homeostasis plus MTF1/metallothionein responses to zinc, copper and iron, distinguishing it from cadmium detoxification and zinc transporter confusables.

name: Osmotic volume regulation via cation–chloride cotransporters and Na+/H+ exchangers
rationale: Members are osmosensory responses, renal sodium/chloride transport and SLC12/SLC9 transporter defects, versus confusables on potassium channels and SLC26/bicarbonate anion exchange.

qualifier: cation-chloride cotransport, Na+/H+ exchange and osmoregulation
name: Cation-chloride cotransport, Na+/H+ exchange and osmotic volume regulation
rationale: Members cover SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters, SLC9 Na+/H+ exchangers and their diseases with osmotic responses, unlike confusables on bicarbonate/anion exchange or potassium channel regulation.

qualifier: with Na+/H+ exchange and osmotic cell volume response
name: Cation-chloride cotransport and Na+/H+ exchange in osmoregulation
rationale: Members are SLC12 cotransporters, NHE exchangers, K+ channels and hyper/hypotonic responses, unlike confusables on synaptic, K+ channel regulation or bicarbonate/SLC26 anion exchange.

name: Platelet GPCR agonist signalling via G12/13-Rho and Rap1
rationale: Members are platelet-activating GPCR pathways (ADP P2Y1/P2Y12, thromboxane, thrombin PAR, prostacyclin) and their G12/13-Rho and Rap1 effector arms, unlike confusables centred on GPVI/collagen adhesion, degranulation and integrin cytoskeletal signalling.

qualifier: G protein-coupled receptors signalling through Rho and Rap1
name: GPCR-driven platelet activation via Rho and Rap1
rationale: Members are platelet agonist GPCR pathways (ADP P2Y1/P2Y12, thrombin PARs, thromboxane, prostacyclin) and their G12/13-Rho and Rap1 effectors, unlike confusables built on GPVI/collagen, integrin adhesion and degranulation.

qualifier: GPCR agonists (ADP, thrombin, thromboxane, prostacyclin) via Rho and Rap1
name: Platelet activation by GPCR agonists via Rho and Rap1
rationale: All members concern platelet activation through P2Y, PAR, TP and IP receptors coupling to G12/13-Rho and Rap1, whereas confusables emphasise GPVI/collagen adhesion, degranulation, coagulation or integrin-MAPK linkage.

core: cellular monovalent and magnesium ion homeostasis
qualifier: Na+/K+-ATPase pumps and renal sodium transport
name: Na+/K+-ATPase-driven sodium, potassium and magnesium homeostasis
rationale: Members concern sodium, potassium and magnesium homeostasis via P-type ATPases (glycoside-sensitive) and renal sodium transport, unlike confusables on paracellular tight-junction transport or potassium channels setting membrane potential.

qualifier: P-type ATPase sodium, potassium and magnesium balance
name: Na+/K+-ATPase-driven sodium, potassium and magnesium homeostasis
rationale: Members concern P-type ATPase transport, glycoside response and intracellular Na+, K+ and Mg2+ homeostasis maintaining transmembrane gradients, unlike confusables centered on potassium channels, membrane potential or paracellular transport.

qualifier: Na+/K+-ATPase-maintained sodium, potassium and magnesium gradients
name: Na+/K+-ATPase-maintained sodium, potassium and magnesium homeostasis
rationale: Members cover P-type ATPase ion transport, glycoside response and Na+, K+ and Mg2+ homeostasis, unlike potassium-channel excitability and paracellular magnesium confusables.

name: Intermembrane lipid transfer and aminophospholipid flipping
rationale: Members are intermembrane transfer of PI, PC, glycolipids and ceramide-1-phosphate plus P4-ATPase/TMEM30A flippase translocation; confusables carry ER tubular network shaping, scrambling, Rab prenylation or phospholipid catabolism.

name: Phospholipid and glycolipid transfer and flipping
rationale: Members are non-vesicular phospholipid/glycolipid transfer and P4-ATPase aminophospholipid flipping, distinct from ER tubule, RAB prenylation and phospholipid catabolism confusables.

name: Intermembrane lipid transfer and aminophospholipid flipping
rationale: Members concern non-vesicular phospholipid/glycolipid transfer between membranes and P4-ATPase aminophospholipid translocation, the flippase arm separating it from Rab, ER-tethering and phospholipid-catabolism confusables.

name: Axon guidance by semaphorin-3A and netrin repulsion
rationale: Members cover axon guidance and extension with Sema3A/CRMP and netrin repulsive signaling, unlike confusables on monoaminergic neuron guidance and collateral sprouting.

name: Axon guidance via Sema3A and netrin signalling
rationale: Members concern axon guidance and extension through Sema3A-plexin and netrin repulsion, distinguishing it from monoaminergic guidance and collateral sprouting confusables.

name: Axon guidance and extension by Sema3A and netrin repulsion
rationale: Members concern axon guidance and extension control with Sema3A and netrin repulsive signaling, separating it from collateral sprouting, monoaminergic guidance and generic plexin confusables.

core: Lamellipodial actin protrusion in cell motility
name: Arp2/3-driven lamellipodial protrusion at the leading edge
rationale: All members concern leading-edge actin protrusion (lamellipodia, pseudopodia, ruffles, spreading) during migration; unlike confusables centred on actin severing, CDC42/IQGAP or focal adhesion turnover, this theme carries Arp2/3 nucleation and WASP/WAVE activation.

core: Leading-edge actin protrusion in cell migration
name: Arp2/3-driven lamellipodial protrusion at the migrating leading edge
rationale: All members regulate leading-edge actin protrusions (lamellipodia, pseudopodia, ruffles) and spreading/migration; unlike the confusables, the theme carries Arp2/3 nucleation, WASP/WAVE activation and lamellipodium assembly rather than macropinocytosis/podosomes, actin severing/capping or CDC42/IQGAP/adhesion-disassembly signalling.

core: Leading-edge actin protrusion in cell migration
name: WAVE/Arp2/3-driven lamellipodial protrusion in cell migration
rationale: All members concern actin-driven protrusion at the leading edge (lamellipodia, pseudopodia, ruffles, spreading, motility), and the Arp2/3 nucleation and WASP/WAVE activation members separate it from confusables built on actin severing/capping, CDC42/IQGAP and focal-adhesion turnover, or macropinocytosis/podosomes.

name: Oncogene-induced senescence and senescence-associated heterochromatin formation
rationale: Members regulate entry into cellular senescence, especially oncogene-induced senescence with SAHF/subtelomeric heterochromatin and proliferation arrest, distinguished from confusables on SASP, replicative/oxidative senescence and p53 apoptosis.

name: Oncogene-induced senescence and senescence-associated heterochromatin formation
rationale: Members cover oncogene-induced senescence, SAHF/subtelomeric heterochromatin and regulation of senescence and proliferative arrest, whereas confusables emphasise SASP, oxidative or replicative senescence and p53-driven apoptosis.

name: Oncogene-induced senescence and senescence-associated heterochromatin
rationale: Members cover oncogene-induced senescence, SAHF and subtelomeric heterochromatin formation, and regulation of senescence and proliferative arrest; SASP, replicative/oxidative senescence and p53-apoptosis confusables lack the oncogene and heterochromatin members.

qualifier: including bile acid synthesis and transport
name: Cholesterol, lipoprotein and bile acid metabolism and transport
rationale: Members span chylomicron/VLDL/LDL/HDL assembly and clearance, cholesterol regulation and bile acid synthesis, transport and signaling, unlike neighbours on triglyceride storage or xenobiotic/bilirubin transport.

name: Lipoprotein, cholesterol and bile acid metabolism
rationale: Members cover lipoprotein assembly, remodelling and clearance, cholesterol homeostasis and bile acid synthesis and transport, distinguishing it from xenobiotic/bilirubin transport and adipose triglyceride storage neighbours.

qualifier: lipoprotein particle assembly, remodeling and clearance with bile acid synthesis and transport
name: Lipoprotein metabolism, bile acid synthesis and sterol homeostasis
rationale: Every member concerns sterol and phospholipid movement in lipoprotein particles (chylomicron, VLDL, LDL, HDL assembly, remodeling, clearance and receptor uptake) or the bile acid route that disposes of cholesterol, plus the SREBP/LXR and ABC transporter control over it - unlike the triglyceride storage and lipid droplet confusable and the xenobiotic/bilirubin transport ones.

qualifier: Golgi, with sulfation and nucleotide-sugar transport
name: Golgi glycoconjugate biosynthesis, sulfation and nucleotide-sugar transport
rationale: Members are biosynthesis of O-glycans, proteoglycans, complex N-glycans, glycolipids and blood-group antigens plus PAPS/nucleotide-sugar supply and their defects, unlike the lysosomal degradation and ER dolichol/GPI confusables.

name: Golgi glycoconjugate biosynthesis and nucleotide-sugar transport
rationale: Members cover Golgi N-glycan processing, O-glycosylation, proteoglycan/GAG and glycosphingolipid synthesis with nucleotide-sugar and PAPS transport, unlike confusables on lysosomal GAG degradation and dolichol/ER-stage glycosylation and GPI.

qualifier: Golgi glycoprotein, proteoglycan and glycolipid elongation
name: Golgi glycoprotein, proteoglycan and glycolipid glycan biosynthesis
rationale: Members span N-glycan processing, O-glycosylation, glycosaminoglycan/proteoglycan and glycosphingolipid synthesis with nucleotide-sugar transport and their defects; biosynthetic Golgi elongation distinguishes it from lysosomal degradation (MPS) and ER dolichol/GPI confusables.

name: Membrane glycerophospholipid and sphingolipid metabolism
rationale: Members span synthesis, acyl-chain remodelling, transfer and catabolism of glycerophospholipids together with sphingomyelin/ceramide metabolism, the sphingolipid part being absent from all confusables (which add ether lipids, endocannabinoids or DAG/TAG).

name: Glycerophospholipid and sphingolipid synthesis, remodeling and transfer
rationale: Members span synthesis and acyl-chain remodeling of PC/PE/PS/PG/PI/CL plus sphingolipid/ceramide metabolism and ER-Golgi lipid transfer, the sphingolipid and transfer parts being absent from all confusables.

name: Membrane glycerophospholipid and sphingolipid metabolism
rationale: Members span synthesis, acyl-chain remodelling, transfer and catabolism of glycerophospholipids plus sphingolipid/ceramide metabolism; the sphingolipid arm separates it from DAG/endocannabinoid and ether-lipid confusables.

qualifier: transition and heavy metal plus heme uptake
name: Metal ion and heme uptake, homeostasis and detoxification
rationale: Members span zinc, copper, iron, manganese and heavy metal transport, responses, metallothioneins and heme scavenging/HMOX1, unlike the heme biosynthesis, ascorbate and oxygen-sensing confusables.

qualifier: transport and detoxification of transition and heavy metals
name: Transition and heavy metal ion transport and detoxification
rationale: Members cover iron, zinc, copper, manganese, cadmium and heme uptake, efflux, homeostasis and detoxification, unlike confusables centred on heme biosynthesis, oxygen sensing or ascorbate.

qualifier: transition and heavy metals (Zn, Cu, Mn, Cd) beyond iron and heme
name: Transition and heavy metal ion uptake, homeostasis and detoxification
rationale: Members span iron/heme handling plus zinc, copper, manganese, cadmium and other metal transport, sensing and metallothionein detoxification, which the iron/heme-, oxygen- or vitamin-centred confusables lack.

name: Actin remodelling of filopodia, ruffles and motile protrusions
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerisation, severing, capping and bundling to build filopodia, ruffles, lamellipodia, podosomes and drive motility, whereas confusables centre on Rho GTPase cycles, Arp2/3 activation or focal adhesion complexes.

name: Actin filament dynamics driving filopodia, ruffles and cell motility
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerization, severing, capping and crosslinking for protrusions and motility, without the Rho GTPase cycles, WASP/WAVE activation or focal adhesion content of neighbours.

qualifier: in membrane protrusions and cell motility
name: Actin filament dynamics shaping protrusions and cell motility
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerisation, severing, capping, crosslinking and bundling in filopodia, ruffles, podosomes and lamellipodia during migration; confusables are Rho-family GTPase cycles, WASP/WAVE-Arp2/3 activation or focal adhesion signalling.

core: Mitochondrial protein import and membrane organization
qualifier: processing, cristae and outer membrane contacts
name: Mitochondrial protein import, processing and membrane organization
rationale: Members concern import and processing of proteins and RNA into mitochondria, cristae and outer-membrane organization, fusion and calcium uptake, unlike confusables on respiratory-chain assembly or mitophagy and fission regulation.

core: Mitochondrial protein import and membrane organization
qualifier: protein processing, cristae and contact sites
name: Mitochondrial protein import, processing and membrane organization
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial protein/RNA import, processing and degradation, cristae and outer-membrane organization and calcium uptake, without the mitophagy/fission regulation or respiratory-complex assembly of the confusables.

name: Mitochondrial protein import, processing and membrane organization
rationale: Members concern import, processing and degradation of mitochondrial proteins plus cristae, outer membrane, fusion and calcium/RNA import, unlike confusables on mitophagy and fission/fusion regulation or respiratory complex assembly.

name: Golgi ribbon organization and COPI-mediated vesicle traffic
rationale: Golgi disassembly/reassembly, ribbon formation and positioning plus COPI intra-Golgi and retrograde traffic set it apart from COPII ER-export and endosome/TGN-to-lysosome neighbours.

qualifier: COPI intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER retrograde transport
name: Golgi structural organization and COPI-mediated intra-Golgi traffic
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly/reassembly, positioning and COPI-dependent intra-Golgi and retrograde traffic, unlike confusables on COPII ER export or TGN-endosome-lysosome sorting.

qualifier: Golgi architecture and COPI intra-Golgi/retrograde transport
name: Golgi structural organization and COPI-mediated retrograde traffic
rationale: Members address Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly/reassembly, localization and retention plus COPI budding, intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER traffic, unlike neighbours centered on COPII ER export or TGN-endosome-lysosome routes.

core: Amino acid and peptide transmembrane transport
qualifier: neutral and imino amino acids plus proton-coupled oligopeptides
name: Neutral amino acid and proton-coupled oligopeptide transport
rationale: Members are transporters and inherited defects (SLC6A19/SLC6A20/SLC36A2, Hartnup, iminoglycinuria) moving neutral/imino amino acids and di/oligopeptides; unlike the confusables it has proton/oligopeptide cotransport and lacks cystine, urate and organic anion transport.

core: Amino acid and oligopeptide plasma membrane transport
qualifier: neutral and imino amino acids, proton-coupled peptide carriers
name: Neutral and imino amino acid and oligopeptide transport
rationale: Members are transport of neutral/imino amino acids (glycine, proline, histidine, tryptophan; Hartnup and iminoglycinuria defects) and proton-coupled di/oligopeptide transport, unlike confusables centred on cystine/urate carriers or branched-chain amino acid import.

core: Amino acid and peptide transmembrane transport
qualifier: neutral amino acids and proton-coupled oligopeptides
name: Neutral amino acid and proton-coupled peptide transport
rationale: Members are SLC carriers moving neutral amino acids (glycine, proline, tryptophan, histidine) and di/oligopeptides, incl. Hartnup and iminoglycinuria defects; unlike confusables they lack cystine/urate/organic anion carriers and branched-chain/aromatic leucine-type uptake but add proton-coupled peptide cotransport.

name: Keratinocyte and melanocyte regulation in epidermis and hair follicles
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis, melanocytes, hair follicle, nail and sebaceous gland development, whereas confusables focus on ectodermal placodes, cornification or tooth development.

name: Keratinocyte, hair follicle and melanocyte proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members share control of epidermal and appendage growth (keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis, hair follicle cycling, melanocyte proliferation/differentiation, nail and sebaceous gland development), whereas confusables cover ectodermal placodes, cornification/barrier formation or tooth development.

name: Keratinocyte proliferation-differentiation balance and skin appendage development
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis, melanocytes, and hair follicle, sebaceous gland and nail development, unlike confusables on ectodermal placodes or cornified envelope formation.

qualifier: with Golgi stack assembly and disassembly
name: COPI vesicle traffic and Golgi stack assembly and disassembly
rationale: Members cover COPI budding, intra-Golgi and Golgi-ER retrograde traffic together with Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly/reassembly and positioning, which the confusables (COPI-independent, endosome-Golgi, tubulation) lack.

core: COPI vesicle trafficking at the Golgi
qualifier: Golgi ribbon disassembly, reassembly and positioning
name: Golgi structural organization and COPI vesicle trafficking
rationale: Members span COPI-dependent intra-Golgi and Golgi-ER traffic and Golgi ribbon formation, mitotic disassembly/reassembly and positioning; confusables lack the structural organization and instead carry COPI-independent, endosome-to-Golgi or tubulation pathways.

name: Golgi stack organization and COPI-mediated vesicle traffic
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon assembly, disassembly and positioning together with COPI intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER traffic; confusables lack either the structural Golgi organization or the COPI arm.

qualifier: and miRNA control of specific target translation
name: Regulation of miRNA biogenesis, turnover and target translation
rationale: Members regulate miRNA transcription, processing and degradation and miRNA control of particular targets, whereas confusables centre on RISC silencing machinery and mRNA decay.

qualifier: miRNA transcription, processing and turnover, and miRNA control of specific targets
name: Regulation of miRNA processing, turnover and target-specific translation
rationale: Members regulate miRNA transcription, pri/pre-miRNA processing and target-directed degradation plus miRNA control of named targets, distinguishing it from core miRNA/siRNA biogenesis, RISC and mRNA-decay confusables.

core: Regulation of miRNA processing and turnover
qualifier: miRNA control of specific target translation
name: Regulation of miRNA processing, turnover and target-specific translation
rationale: Members regulate miRNA transcription, processing and degradation and miRNA control of particular mRNAs (CDH1, CDH11, PD-L1, NPAS4), whereas confusables are core RISC silencing and general mRNA decay.

name: Cerebellar cortex layer formation and motor coordination
rationale: Members combine cerebellar granule, Purkinje and Bergmann glial layer formation with locomotion, proprioception and motor learning, which separates the theme from amygdala/grooming behaviour, brainstem/hindbrain and forebrain development, and glycinergic transmission confusables.

qualifier: cerebellar layer formation, motor learning and proprioception
name: Cerebellar development and motor coordination behavior
rationale: Members cover cerebellar cortex formation (granule, Purkinje, Bergmann glia), nigral development, neural RNA regulation and motor behaviors (walking, righting, proprioception, motor learning), which separate it from exploratory/grooming, brainstem/hindbrain, forebrain and glycinergic confusables.

core: Cerebellar cortex formation and motor coordination
qualifier: cerebellar granule, Purkinje and Bergmann glial layering
name: Cerebellar cortex layering and motor coordination
rationale: Members combine cerebellar layer formation (granule, Purkinje, Bergmann glia) with locomotion, proprioception, motor learning and reflexes, unlike confusables centred on brainstem/hindbrain maturation, glycinergic transmission or forebrain development.

qualifier: chloride-coupled SLC12 and SLC26 exchangers and their disorders
name: Chloride and inorganic anion transporters and their disorders
rationale: Members are SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters, SLC26 anion exchangers (iodide, oxalate, sulfate) and their genetic diseases with linked K+ channels, distinct from bicarbonate transporters, aquaporins/CFTR and Na/H exchanger confusables.

qualifier: SLC12 cation-chloride cotransport and SLC26 anion exchange
name: Cation-chloride cotransport and SLC26 inorganic anion exchange
rationale: Members are SLC12 chloride cotransporters and SLC26 exchangers with their channelopathies (Bartter, Gitelman, Pendred, chloride diarrhea) and iodide, sulfate and oxalate transport, unlike confusables on bicarbonate, sodium/proton exchange or aquaporins.

qualifier: SLC26 exchangers and SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters
name: SLC26 anion exchangers and SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters
rationale: Members cover SLC26 sulfate, iodide, oxalate and chloride exchange and SLC12 cation-chloride cotransport with their channelopathies, whereas confusables centre on bicarbonate transporters, aquaporins or sodium/proton exchangers.

name: Ribonucleotide phosphorylation and inositol pyrophosphate metabolism
rationale: Members interconvert nucleoside mono-, di- and triphosphates (ADP, GDP, GTP) and handle pyrophosphate-containing inositol and diadenosine polyphosphates, unlike confusables on creatine/mitochondrial adenine transport, nuclear PIPs or deoxynucleotide synthesis.

name: Phosphoryl transfer among nucleotides and inositol pyrophosphates
rationale: Members interconvert nucleoside mono/di/triphosphates and synthesize or hydrolyse inositol and adenosine pyrophosphates, which separates it from creatine/mitochondrial ADP transport, deoxynucleotide synthesis and phosphoinositide confusables.

name: Nucleotide and inositol pyrophosphate phosphotransfer metabolism
rationale: Members interconvert nucleoside mono-, di- and triphosphates and metabolize pyrophosphate-containing inositol and diadenosine polyphosphates, unlike confusables on creatine/mitochondrial ADP transport, nuclear PIPs or deoxyribonucleotides.

core: VEGF and Tie2 receptor signaling in endothelium
name: VEGFR and Tie2 signaling in endothelial and lymphatic specification
rationale: All members concern VEGF/VEGFR2-neuropilin and Tie2 signaling driving endothelial fate, survival and lymphangiogenesis, while neighbours concern sprouting angiogenesis, its negative regulation, or arterial/venous identity.

core: VEGF receptor and Tie2 signaling in endothelium
name: VEGFR and Tie2 signaling in endothelial and lymphatic specification
rationale: Members are VEGF/VEGFR2/neuropilin and Tie/Tie2 signalling with endothelial fate, survival and lymphatic differentiation, whereas confusables centre on sprouting angiogenesis regulation or arterial/venous vessel morphogenesis.

core: Endothelial VEGFR2 and Tie2 receptor signaling
name: VEGFR2/Tie2 signaling in endothelial and lymphatic specification
rationale: Members are VEGF/VEGFR2-neuropilin and Tie2 signalling plus endothelial fate commitment, survival and lymphatic differentiation; confusables lack the lymphatic/fate members and instead cover arterial-venous morphogenesis or positive/negative control of sprouting angiogenesis.

name: NOD-like receptor sensing of bacterial peptidoglycan
rationale: Members are NOD1/NOD2 and NLR responses to peptidoglycan and bacteria with antibacterial and microbiota effects, distinct from confusables on TLR/LPS signaling, NF-kB machinery or pyroptotic inflammasomes.

qualifier: NOD1/NOD2 peptidoglycan sensing and the IPAF inflammasome
name: NOD-like receptor detection of bacteria and peptidoglycan
rationale: Members are NLR-mediated bacterial sensing (NOD1/NOD2 responses to peptidoglycan and muramyl dipeptide, IPAF inflammasome) with the resulting antibacterial, microbiota and dendritic cell presentation responses, distinct from TLR/LPS, downstream NF-kB or caspase-1/4/5 inflammasome confusables.

name: NOD1/NOD2 peptidoglycan sensing in antibacterial innate immunity
rationale: Members are bacterial detection via NOD1/NOD2 and NLR responses to peptidoglycan and muramyl dipeptide, unlike confusables on downstream NF-kB/TLR signalling, LPS sensing or caspase inflammasomes.

name: GPI anchor and glycosphingolipid synthesis and transport
rationale: Members span GPI anchor synthesis/attachment, ganglioside and galactosylceramide synthesis and glycolipid transfer, separating them from lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism, protein palmitoylation and nucleotide-sugar transport.

name: Glycosphingolipid and GPI anchor biosynthesis and transport
rationale: Members synthesize, attach or transfer glycolipids (GPI anchors, gangliosides, galactosylceramide, C1P), distinguishing them from lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism, nucleotide-sugar transport and protein palmitoylation.

qualifier: GPI anchor and glycosphingolipid, with lipid transfer
name: GPI anchor and glycosphingolipid biosynthesis and transfer
rationale: Members cover GPI synthesis/attachment, ganglioside and galactosylceramide synthesis and glycolipid/ceramide-1-phosphate transfer, unlike confusables on nucleotide-sugar transport, protein palmitoylation or lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism.

core: Branching organ morphogenesis via epithelial-mesenchymal signaling
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung, prostate and salivary morphogenesis
rationale: Members share epithelial-mesenchymal interaction driving branching and bud morphogenesis of lung, trachea, prostate and salivary/lacrimal glands, while confusables are mammary, pancreatic and gonadal development.

name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung, prostate and gland branching
rationale: Members describe mesenchyme-epithelium inductive signaling and branching of lung, trachea, prostate, salivary and lacrimal glands plus related bud outgrowths, whereas confusables concern mammary, gonadal and pancreatic development.

qualifier: lung, trachea, prostate and salivary/lacrimal glands
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung, prostate and salivary organogenesis
rationale: Members describe mesenchyme-epithelium interactions driving branching, bud and epithelial differentiation in lung, trachea, prostate, salivary and lacrimal glands, genitalia and palate, unlike confusables focused on mammary, gonadal and pancreatic development.

qualifier: RIG-I-like and cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing via TRAF-IRF activation
name: Antiviral RIG-I-like receptor signaling to IRF-driven type I interferon
rationale: All members concern cytosolic viral RNA/DNA sensing that activates TRAF3/TRAF6-IRF3/7 and NF-kB to produce type I interferon; the positive-induction arm (IRF activation, IFN-alpha/beta production, viral evasion) distinguishes it from confusables centred on negative regulation of RIG-I or TBK1 control.

qualifier: activating RIG-I/DNA-sensor to TRAF-IRF3/7 and NF-kB signaling
name: Virus-sensing activation of IRF3/7 and type I interferon induction
rationale: All members concern cytosolic RNA/DNA virus sensing that activates IRF3/7, NF-kB and type I IFN; confusables instead hold negative regulation of RIG-I/cGAS-STING and IFN-beta.

core: Antiviral nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon induction
name: Antiviral nucleic acid sensing activating type I interferon induction
rationale: All members concern RIG-I/MDA5, cytosolic DNA and TLR7/9 sensing driving IRF3/7 and NF-kB to produce type I IFN; it holds the activating arm, whereas confusables carry negative regulators of RIG-I and cGAS-STING.

qualifier: stem cell regulation and erythroid-megakaryocytic differentiation
name: Hematopoietic stem cell regulation and erythroid-megakaryocytic differentiation
rationale: Members cover HSC/progenitor regulation, RUNX1 programmes, erythrocyte and megakaryocyte/platelet differentiation and myeloid progenitor signatures, unlike neighbours focused on granulocyte/monocyte differentiation or stem cell maintenance.

qualifier: stem cell regulation and erythroid-megakaryocytic differentiation
name: Hematopoietic stem cell regulation and erythroid-megakaryocytic differentiation
rationale: Members concern hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell control and red cell and megakaryocyte/platelet differentiation (RUNX1, erythroid and platelet modules), unlike granulocyte/monocyte or stem cell maintenance neighbours.

qualifier: erythroid and megakaryocyte-platelet arm, including RUNX1 control and red cell maturation
name: Erythroid and megakaryocytic commitment from hematopoietic progenitors
rationale: All members concern stem and myeloid progenitor regulation resolving into red cell or platelet output - erythrocyte differentiation and enucleation, oxygen transport, megakaryocyte development, RUNX1 programmes, spleen and marrow context - while every confusable adds the granulocyte, monocyte or macrophage branch instead.

qualifier: heme biosynthesis and transferrin/ferroportin iron transport
name: Heme biosynthesis and systemic iron transport
rationale: Members cover porphyrin/heme synthesis, heme scavenging and transport, transferrin uptake and ferroportin/ceruloplasmin iron export, unlike zinc/copper/cadmium metal confusables and the erythrocyte gas transport confusable.

name: Heme biosynthesis, transport and iron homeostasis
rationale: Members span heme and protoporphyrin biosynthesis, heme scavenging, transferrin and ferroportin iron transport and iron-sulfur assembly, unlike metal-ion, oxygen-sensing and erythrocyte gas-transport confusables.

name: Heme biosynthesis, heme scavenging and iron transport
rationale: Members cover porphyrin/heme synthesis, heme uptake and transport, transferrin and ferroportin iron transport and their disorders, distinct from other-metal homeostasis, erythrocyte gas exchange and oxygen-sensing confusables.

core: Amino acid neurotransmitter transport and metabolism
name: Glutamate, GABA and glycine neurotransmitter transport and metabolism
rationale: Members cover uptake, vesicular loading, synthesis and degradation of glutamate, aspartate, GABA, glycine and serine with their SLC transporter diseases, whereas confusables concern cholinergic or monoaminergic transmission.

core: Amino acid neurotransmitter transport and metabolism
name: GABA, glutamate and glycine neurotransmitter transport and metabolism
rationale: Members cover synthesis, vesicular loading, release, reuptake and transporter disorders of GABA, glutamate/aspartate and glycine (with serine), distinguishing it from monoamine and cholinergic confusables.

qualifier: glutamate, GABA and glycine synthesis and transport
name: Glutamate, GABA and glycine neurotransmitter synthesis and transport
rationale: Members concern synthesis, degradation, reuptake and vesicular loading of glutamate, aspartate, GABA, glycine and serine with their transporter disorders; neighbours concern cholinergic or monoamine neurotransmission.

name: Depolarisation-induced mitophagy and mitochondrial fission-fusion control
rationale: Members concern PINK1-PRKN and receptor mitophagy, mitochondrial depolarisation, fission/fusion and protein localization to mitochondria, unlike pexophagy, reticulophagy or mitochondrial import confusables.

qualifier: PINK1-Parkin and receptor mitophagy with fission-fusion and autophagosome assembly control
name: Mitophagy, mitochondrial fission-fusion and autophagosome assembly regulation
rationale: Members regulate mitophagy, mitochondrial dynamics, membrane potential, protein targeting to mitochondria and autophagosome formation, separating the theme from pexophagy/reticulophagy and mitochondrial protein import confusables.

name: Mitophagy, mitochondrial dynamics and autophagosome formation
rationale: Members regulate mitophagy, mitochondrial fission/fusion, protein localization to mitochondria and autophagosome assembly, distinguishing it from pexophagy/reticulophagy and mitochondrial protein-import confusables.

qualifier: protein import plus fatty acid beta-oxidation
name: Peroxisomal protein import and fatty acid beta-oxidation
rationale: Members are peroxisomal protein targeting/import, fission and peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation of very long, long and medium-chain fatty acyl-CoAs, unlike neighbours on fatty acid elongation, plasmalogen and wax synthesis.

qualifier: biogenesis and protein import together with fatty acid oxidation
name: Peroxisome biogenesis, protein import and fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members span peroxisomal protein targeting and import, fission, and peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation of very long, branched and medium-chain fatty acids, whereas confusables centre on fatty acid elongation, plasmalogen and omega-3/6 lipid metabolism without peroxisome biogenesis.

qualifier: protein import and fatty acid oxidation
name: Peroxisomal protein import and fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members are peroxisome biogenesis/protein import and peroxisomal alpha- and beta-oxidation of fatty acyl-CoAs, unlike confusables centred on very-long-chain fatty acid synthesis and ether lipid biosynthesis.

core: G2/M transition and DNA damage checkpoint
name: G2/M transition and p53-dependent DNA damage checkpoint
rationale: Members cover G2 phase, G2/M progression and the G2 DNA damage checkpoint; unlike the E2F/G1-S and APC/C confusables, the theme adds TP53 regulation, gamma-radiation response and Cdc25A degradation.

qualifier: with p53 regulation and G2 arrest
name: G2/M DNA damage checkpoint and p53-mediated G2 arrest
rationale: Members span G2/M transition events (cyclin B–CDK1, PLK, MASTL, GTSE1), G2 DNA damage/replication checkpoints and p53 stability/activity and its G2-arrest and DNA-repair targets; C1 is G1/S, E2F and APC/C-driven proliferation and C2-C4 lack the G2/M transition machinery.

core: DNA damage checkpoint and p53 regulation
name: G2/M DNA damage checkpoint and p53 regulation
rationale: Members cover Chk1/Chk2, Cdc25A, cyclin B-CDK1, PLK and MASTL events at G2/M together with p53 stabilisation and transcription after DNA damage; the G2/M focus separates it from G1/S, replication-origin and broad proliferation neighbours.

name: Glycogen metabolism, glucose-6-phosphate handling and storage diseases
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis, breakdown and glycophagy, glycogen storage diseases and glucose-6-phosphate/glucokinase steps of gluconeogenesis, unlike confusables on glycolysis and fructose metabolism.

name: Glycogen and glucose-6-phosphate metabolism with storage diseases
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis/breakdown, glycogen storage diseases, G6P transport, gluconeogenesis and glucokinase, distinguishing it from glycolysis and fructose metabolism confusables.

name: Glycogen and glucose-6-phosphate metabolism and storage diseases
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis, breakdown, glycophagy and glycogen storage diseases with glucose-6-phosphate/glucokinase and gluconeogenic steps, whereas confusables centre on glycolysis and fructose metabolism.

qualifier: K-ATP channels, incretins and fatty-acid receptors
name: Beta-cell insulin secretion regulated by K-ATP channels and incretins
rationale: Members cover insulin processing and stimulus-secretion control in beta cells (K-ATP/ABCC8/9, TALK channels, GLP-1/GIP, FFAR1, neurotransmitters); confusables instead centre on insulin receptor signalling, GLUT4 translocation or glucagon receptors.

name: Beta-cell insulin secretion, KATP channels and insulin processing
rationale: All members concern regulation of pancreatic beta-cell insulin secretion and the insulin life cycle (incretins, FFAR1, neurotransmitters), with KATP/K2P channels and insulin processing/catabolism distinguishing it from glucagon-receptor and insulin-signaling confusables.

name: Islet insulin secretion with K-ATP channels and insulin processing
rationale: All members concern beta-cell hormone output (nutrient, incretin, neural and fatty-acid control of insulin and glucagon secretion), and the K-ATP/K2P channel and insulin processing/turnover members separate it from the incretin-receptor and insulin-action confusables.

qualifier: lung and salivary gland via epithelial-mesenchymal signaling
name: Lung and salivary branching via epithelial-mesenchymal signaling
rationale: Members regulate epithelial branching and mesenchymal proliferation with reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung, trachea, salivary gland and limb bud, while confusables cover lung maturation (pneumocytes, saccules), prostate or pancreas/kidney development.

qualifier: epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung and salivary gland
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung and salivary branching morphogenesis
rationale: Members are epithelial-mesenchymal signaling, mesenchymal proliferation and branching in lung, trachea, salivary gland and limb bud, unlike prostate, pancreas/kidney or alveolar-differentiation confusables.

qualifier: epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung and glands
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung and gland branching morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover epithelial-mesenchymal signaling, mesenchymal proliferation and bud branching of lung, trachea, salivary gland and limb bud, whereas confusables cover alveolar pneumocyte maturation, pancreatic/kidney lineages or prostate branching.

qualifier: smooth muscle tone and natriuretic cGMP signalling
name: Smooth muscle tone and natriuretic cGMP in blood pressure
rationale: Members are smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, guanylyl cyclase cGMP synthesis and renal sodium and urine output in arterial pressure control, unlike the eNOS-NO confusables or the renin-angiotensin confusable.

name: Smooth muscle contraction-relaxation and cGMP control of blood pressure
rationale: Members cover vascular smooth muscle contraction and relaxation, cGMP synthesis and effects and their impact on arterial pressure and natriuresis, distinct from confusables built on eNOS activation or renin-angiotensin.

core: Smooth muscle tone and blood pressure
name: cGMP-regulated smooth muscle tone, blood pressure and natriuresis
rationale: Members share smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, cGMP synthesis and guanylyl cyclase signaling with renal sodium/urine output, lacking confusables' eNOS activation or renin-angiotensin control.

name: Toll-like receptor signaling regulation and proinflammatory cytokine induction
rationale: Members regulate TLR2/3/4, MyD88/TRIF, IL-1 and CD40 signaling and promote IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, unlike confusables on inflammasomes, TAK1/IKK mechanics or cytokine suppression.

qualifier: TLR2/3/4 MyD88/TRIF with proinflammatory cytokine induction
name: Bidirectional TLR regulation and proinflammatory cytokine induction
rationale: Members positively and negatively regulate TLR2/3/4, MyD88/TRIF, IL-1 and CD40 signalling and promote IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, whereas confusables cover TAK1/IKK mechanics, inflammasomes or negative cytokine regulation.

qualifier: MyD88/TRIF control of inflammatory cytokine induction
name: Regulation of Toll-like receptor signaling and inflammatory cytokine induction
rationale: Members positively and negatively regulate TLR2/3/4, MyD88/TRIF, IL-1 and CD40 signaling and induction of IL-6, IL-8 and TNF, unlike confusables on adaptor-kinase mechanics, cytokine suppression or inflammasomes.

name: Endothelial eNOS-nitric oxide-cGMP control of vascular tone
rationale: Members link eNOS activation and trafficking and NO-cGMP signalling to vascular smooth muscle contraction/relaxation and arterial pressure, whereas confusables emphasise generic smooth muscle contraction or renal guanylyl cyclase and sodium excretion.

core: Vascular tone and blood pressure regulation
name: Endothelial NO-cGMP signaling in vascular tone and blood pressure
rationale: Members link eNOS activation, trafficking and NO-cGMP signaling to vascular smooth muscle relaxation and arterial pressure, which confusables share only in their smooth-muscle and renal parts and not the eNOS members.

name: Endothelial nitric oxide signaling in vascular tone
rationale: Members combine eNOS activation, trafficking and NO-cGMP signaling with vasoconstriction/relaxation and blood pressure control, whereas confusables lack eNOS and emphasise renal or generic smooth muscle regulation.

core: Spliceosomal snRNA biogenesis and pre-mRNA splicing
qualifier: snRNA gene transcription with spliceosome assembly
name: snRNA transcription and spliceosome-mediated pre-mRNA splicing
rationale: Members combine Pol II/Pol III snRNA gene transcription and cap hypermethylation with spliceosome assembly and major/minor splicing, unlike confusables on histone mRNA processing, generic Pol III transcription or nuclear RNA decay.

name: snRNA gene transcription and spliceosomal pre-mRNA splicing
rationale: Members are Pol II and Pol III (type 3 promoter) snRNA transcription, snRNA cap hypermethylation and spliceosome assembly and splicing, unlike confusables on Pol III tRNA transcription, histone mRNA processing or exosome RNA decay.

qualifier: Pol II/Pol III snRNA gene transcription and spliceosome assembly
name: snRNA gene transcription and spliceosomal pre-mRNA splicing
rationale: Members share snRNA production (Pol II and type 3 Pol III transcription, cap hypermethylation) and spliceosome assembly and splicing, unlike confusables on Pol III tRNA transcription, nuclear RNA decay or snRNP assembly/histone mRNA processing.

qualifier: to UV, nitric oxide and mitogen stimuli
name: AP-1 immediate-early response to UV, nitric oxide and mitogens
rationale: Members share induction of AP-1/FOS-family and NR4A immediate-early genes by UV, nitric oxide, phorbol ester, KRAS/PI3K and TNF signals, whereas confusables focus on upstream TAK1-JNK/p38 kinase regulation, ERK feedback or monocyte chemokines.

qualifier: to mitogens, UV and nitric oxide
name: AP-1 immediate-early gene response to mitogens, UV and nitric oxide
rationale: Members are immediate-early AP-1/FOSL/NR4A transcriptional programmes induced by growth factors, phorbol ester, KRAS/PI3K, UV and reactive nitrogen, distinguishing it from confusables on MAPK negative feedback or TAK1-JNK/p38 kinase activation.

qualifier: to UV, nitric oxide and mitogens
name: AP-1 immediate-early response to UV, nitric oxide and mitogens
rationale: Members centre on AP-1/FOS-family immediate-early transcription induced by UV, nitric oxide, phorbol ester, KRAS and growth factors, while confusables focus on MAPK negative feedback, TAK1-JNK/p38 kinase activation or monocyte chemokine signaling.

name: NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome IL-1 processing and proinflammatory cytokine induction
rationale: Members concern NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome activity, IL-1 processing and regulation of IL-1, IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, unlike the AIM2/CASP4/5 pyroptosis and IL-18 confusables.

name: NLRP3/NLRP1 inflammasome IL-1 processing and inflammatory cytokine regulation
rationale: Members concern NLRP3/NLRP1 inflammasomes, IL-1 processing and regulation of IL-1, IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production; confusables center on pyroptosis, AIM2/CASP4/5 and IL-18, TLR-negative regulation or chemokines.

name: NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome IL-1 processing and pro-inflammatory cytokine output
rationale: Members concern NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome activity, IL-1 precursor processing and regulation of IL-1, IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, distinct from AIM2/pyroptosis/IL-18, negative cytokine regulation and chemokine confusables.

name: Sensorimotor behaviour and locomotion with glycinergic inhibitory transmission
rationale: Members cover locomotion, proprioception, reflexes, touch, visual behaviour and their neural control, and the glycinergic/inhibitory synaptic transmission (SLC6A5 hyperekplexia, MECP2-GABA, nerve impulse damping) separates it from the exploration/vocalization behaviour neighbours.

name: Motor coordination, locomotion and inhibitory glycinergic neurotransmission
rationale: Members concern motor and sensory behaviours (walking, righting, proprioception, touch) and their neural control; glycinergic/GABA inhibitory transmission and respiratory neural control distinguish it from exploratory, vocal and social behaviour neighbours.

name: Locomotor and sensorimotor behaviour with glycinergic inhibitory transmission
rationale: Members cover walking, righting reflex, proprioception, touch and motor control together with inhibitory (glycinergic, MECP2–GABA) neurotransmission, distinguishing it from grooming/vocal-learning behaviour neighbours and the neuronal excitability neighbour lacking locomotion.

qualifier: with histone mRNA processing and decapping-dependent 5'-3' decay
name: Pre-mRNA 3'-end processing and 5'-to-3' mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover cleavage/polyadenylation, histone stem-loop processing and Pol II termination plus decapping and 5'-3' exonucleolytic decay, the latter absent from splicing/export confusables and the former from deadenylation and NMD confusables.

name: Histone and polyadenylated mRNA 3'-end processing and decapping
rationale: Members cover cleavage/polyadenylation, Pol II termination and SLBP histone mRNA processing plus decapping and 5'-3' decay, which confusables lack (splicing/export, deadenylation or ribosome-associated decay).

name: mRNA 3'-end processing and decapping-mediated decay
rationale: Members cover cleavage/polyadenylation, histone stem-loop processing and transcription termination plus decapping and 5'-3' decay, which the export/splicing confusables lack.

qualifier: p53 control and G2 arrest after ionizing radiation
name: p53 regulation and G2 checkpoint after ionizing radiation
rationale: Members are TP53 degradation/phosphorylation, G2 DNA damage checkpoint, Cdc25A degradation, CDK inhibition, senescence and gamma/X-ray responses, unlike confusables on normal G2/M progression, p53 apoptosis/ARF or AKT.

name: Ionizing radiation G2 checkpoint and p53 stabilization
rationale: Members concern G2 DNA damage checkpoint signaling, CDK inhibition and Cdc25A degradation, p53 phosphorylation/degradation control and responses to gamma/X-ray radiation, unlike confusables on AKT signaling, normal G2/M transition or p53-driven apoptosis.

qualifier: ionizing radiation response and p53 regulation
name: Ionizing radiation-induced G2 checkpoint and p53 regulation
rationale: Members cover radiation responses, G2 DNA damage checkpoint signaling, CDK inhibition, Cdc25A/p53 regulation, senescence and checkpoint recovery, unlike confusables on p14ARF/p53 apoptosis, AKT or unperturbed G2/M progression.

name: TLR-induced TAK1 activation of JNK and p38
rationale: Members describe TRAF6/IRAK2/TRIF-dependent TAK1 complex induction and its activation of JNK and p38 stress kinases, whereas confusables centre on IKK recruitment and NF-kappaB or on negative MAPK regulation.

name: TAK1-mediated JNK and p38 activation downstream of innate receptors
rationale: Members cover TRAF6-, IRAK2-, TRIF- and ALPK1-dependent activation of TAK1 and its activation of JNK and p38 stress kinases, whereas confusables centre on IKK recruitment and NF-kappaB signalling.

qualifier: JNK and p38 stress kinase output
name: Innate receptor TAK1 activation of JNK and p38 kinases
rationale: Members are TLR/TRIF/IRAK2/TRAF6 and ALPK1 routes to TAK1 activation and downstream JNK and p38 stress kinase signaling, while confusables focus on IKK recruitment and NF-kappaB activation.

qualifier: PPAR, PGC-1alpha and circadian nuclear receptors
name: White adipogenesis with PPAR, PGC-1alpha and circadian nuclear receptors
rationale: Members cover white fat cell differentiation and PPARG/PPARA-driven programs together with PGC-1alpha mitochondrial biogenesis and ROR/REV-ERB/BMAL clock regulation, which separate it from brown/beige adipocyte, LXR/SREBP lipogenic and negative-regulation confusables.

qualifier: PPAR–PGC-1alpha and circadian nuclear receptor transcription
name: White adipogenesis with PPAR–PGC-1α and circadian clock transcription
rationale: Members combine white fat cell differentiation and adipose development with PPARA/PPARG, PGC-1alpha mitochondrial biogenesis and BMAL/ROR/REV-ERB clock transcription, unlike brown/beige thermogenic or LXR/SREBP lipogenic neighbours.

qualifier: PPAR, PGC-1alpha and circadian nuclear receptor control
name: PPAR, PGC-1alpha and clock control of white adipogenesis
rationale: Members cover white fat differentiation and PPAR/PGC-1alpha transcriptional programs plus ROR/REV-ERB and BMAL/CLOCK regulation, absent from confusables focused on brown/beige fat or LXR-driven lipid homeostasis.

name: TGF-beta/BMP SMAD signalling and extracellular ligand sequestration
rationale: Members regulate TGF-beta, BMP and NODAL SMAD signalling, and the extracellular sequestration/retention of ligands separates it from the SMAD2/3-transcription, left-right and endothelial confusables.

name: BMP/TGF-beta SMAD signalling regulation and extracellular ligand sequestration
rationale: All members regulate BMP, TGF-beta or NODAL SMAD signalling, several by trapping ligand in the extracellular matrix; confusables concern somitogenesis/left-right patterning, endothelial fate or nuclear SMAD transcription.

name: BMP/TGF-beta-SMAD signalling regulation, including extracellular ligand sequestration
rationale: All members concern positive or negative control of BMP, TGF-beta, NODAL and SMAD signalling, and unlike the confusables (SMAD transcription/miRNA, somitogenesis, left-right, endothelial fate) the theme includes extracellular sequestration of ligands from receptors.

core: mRNA poly(A) tail dynamics and decay
name: mRNA polyadenylation, deadenylation and decapping-mediated decay
rationale: Members cover mRNA 3'-end cleavage/polyadenylation, poly(A) shortening, decapping and 5'-3' decay; polyadenylation separates it from ARE-binding and miRNA neighbours and deadenylation from histone mRNA processing neighbours.

name: mRNA polyadenylation and deadenylation-linked mRNA decay
rationale: Members span poly(A) addition and 3'-end processing through deadenylation, decapping and 5'-3' decay, unlike ARE-binding/miRNA confusables (no polyadenylation) and histone mRNA processing (no deadenylation).

name: mRNA poly(A) tail synthesis, shortening and decay
rationale: Members cover 3'-end cleavage and polyadenylation, poly(A) tail shortening, decapping and 5'-3' decay; ARE-binding protein and miRNA confusables lack polyadenylation, while the histone 3'-end confusable lacks deadenylation and decay.

name: Leukotriene and lipoxin synthesis, catabolism and receptor signalling
rationale: Members cover 5-lipoxygenase products (leukotrienes, lipoxins, 5-HETE), their omega-oxidation catabolism and transport, and leukotriene receptor signalling, which the broader eicosanoid and resolvin confusables lack.

name: Leukotriene and lipoxin biosynthesis, signaling and catabolism
rationale: All members concern 5-lipoxygenase-derived leukotrienes and lipoxins from synthesis through receptor signaling, transport and omega-oxidation catabolism, whereas confusables cover CYP eicosanoids, 12/15-HETE, hepoxilins or pro-resolving mediators without leukotriene receptor signaling.

qualifier: leukotriene and lipoxin synthesis, catabolism and receptor signalling
name: Leukotriene and lipoxin synthesis, catabolism and receptor signalling
rationale: Members cover 5-lipoxygenase products (leukotrienes, lipoxins, 5-HETE), their omega-oxidation and transport, plus leukotriene receptors and signalling, which the 12/15-lipoxygenase, resolvin and P450 neighbours lack.

qualifier: steroid metabolism, sulfonation and SLCO organic anion uptake
name: Drug and steroid metabolism with SLCO organic anion uptake
rationale: Members cover drug ADME, xenobiotic and steroid metabolism, cytosolic sulfonation and sodium-independent SLCO organic anion transport; the drug ADME/SLCO uptake set separates it from oxidative detoxification confusables, and sulfonation/steroid metabolism from bilirubin glucuronidation and xenobiotic export confusables.

qualifier: SLCO organic anion uptake, sulfonation and steroids
name: Drug metabolism with SLCO anion uptake and sulfonation
rationale: All members concern drug/xenobiotic disposition (drug ADME, cytochrome and steroid metabolism, sulfonation); SLCO sodium-independent organic anion uptake and sulfonation distinguish it from the xenobiotic-export/bilirubin and broad CYP/FMO detoxification confusables.

qualifier: steroid sulfonation and organic anion uptake
name: Drug disposition with steroid sulfonation and organic anion uptake
rationale: Members cover drug ADME, xenobiotic and steroid metabolism, cytosolic sulfonation and SLCO organic anion/glycoside transport; the ADME and SLCO uptake set it apart from the detoxification/catabolism confusables and sulfonation/steroid metabolism from the efflux/bilirubin confusables.

name: Mitotic centrosome maturation and separation at G2/M
rationale: Members involve AURKA, PLK1 and NEK kinase control of centrosome protein recruitment, separation and spindle assembly at mitotic entry, unlike checkpoint/cytokinesis and spindle-orientation confusables.

name: Mitotic centrosome maturation and AURKA/PLK1 activation at G2/M
rationale: Members concern centrosome protein recruitment, centrosome separation, centriole control and AURKA/PLK1/NEK kinase activation at mitotic entry, versus broader spindle/checkpoint/cytokinesis and spindle-orientation confusables.

name: Mitotic centrosome maturation and AURKA/PLK1 activation
rationale: Members concern recruitment of mitotic centrosome proteins, centrosome separation and AURKA, PLK1 and NEK kinase activation at G2/M, distinguished from confusables on spindle checkpoint, cytokinesis, spindle orientation or centriole duplication.

name: BDNF-TrkB and RAC1-driven postsynaptic actin plasticity
rationale: Members link BDNF/NTRK2 signaling and NMDAR-RAC1 activation to postsynaptic actin remodeling and structural plasticity, distinct from dendrite arborization, spine morphogenesis and AMPA receptor trafficking confusables.

qualifier: BDNF-TrkB and NMDAR-RAC1 postsynaptic actin signaling
name: BDNF-TrkB and NMDAR-RAC1 signaling in synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members link BDNF/NTRK2 and NMDAR-RAC1 signaling to postsynaptic actin remodeling, local translation and long-term plasticity; confusables cover dendrite arborization, spine morphogenesis or AMPA receptor trafficking.

name: BDNF-TrkB and RAC1-driven postsynaptic structural plasticity
rationale: Members tie BDNF/NTRK2 and NMDAR-RAC1 signaling to postsynaptic actin remodeling, local translation and long-term structural plasticity, distinct from dendrite arborization and receptor-trafficking neighbours.

name: RAF-MEK-ERK activation and negative-feedback ERK inactivation
rationale: Members span RAF/MEK/ERK/RSK activation (incl. MRAS-SHOC2 and MAPK mutants) and its dephosphorylation-based feedback shutoff, the latter distinguishing it from RAS/SOS/GAP-focused confusables.

name: RAF–MEK–ERK signalling with negative feedback and ERK inactivation
rationale: Members span RAF/MEK/MAPK activation and mutants together with ERK dephosphorylation and negative feedback, which confusables (RAS GAP/SOS, positive Ras regulation, BRAF mutants) lack.

name: RAF-ERK cascade with negative feedback and ERK dephosphorylation
rationale: Members span RAF activation (incl. MRAS-SHOC2), MAPK mutants and RSK, plus ERK inactivation, dephosphorylation and negative feedback, which the RAS/GAP/SOS and oncogenic-RAF neighbours lack.

qualifier: integrin- and S1P-dependent, secondary/mucosal lymphoid organs
name: Integrin-dependent lymphocyte homing and secondary lymphoid tissue development
rationale: Members concern integrin- and S1P-mediated lymphocyte homing to lymph nodes and gut-associated lymphoid tissue with lymphoid organ development, unlike confusables on immunological synapse, extravasation or chemokine signaling.

qualifier: integrin and S1P-guided, secondary lymphoid tissue
name: Integrin and S1P-guided lymphocyte homing to secondary lymphoid tissue
rationale: Members cover integrin adhesion, S1P receptor signalling and lymphocyte migration into lymph nodes, MALT/GALT and marginal zone, unlike confusables driven by chemokine chemotaxis or T cell synapse/endothelial extravasation.

qualifier: integrin and S1P-dependent migration into developing lymphoid tissues
name: Integrin/S1P lymphocyte homing and lymphoid tissue development
rationale: Members cover integrin- and S1P-receptor-dependent lymphocyte homing, B cell chemotaxis and marginal zone B cells, and lymph node, MALT and gut lymphoid tissue development, whereas confusables centre on chemokine signalling, T cell synapse adhesion or endothelial extravasation.

name: Mitochondrial 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and maple syrup urine disease
rationale: All members are reactions or defects of the BCKDH, PDH, OGDH and OADH multienzyme complexes, chiefly MSUD variants, while confusables add biotin carboxylases, lipoylation, glycine/lysine catabolism or CoA biosynthesis instead of PDH/OGDH.

name: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and maple syrup urine disease
rationale: All members concern the BCKDH, PDH, OGDH and OADH multienzyme complexes and MSUD-causing defects in BCKDH, which neighbours on lipoylation, glycine degradation and broader BCAA catabolism lack.

qualifier: including BCKDH defects of maple syrup urine disease
name: Mitochondrial 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and maple syrup urine disease

core: Golgi glycosylation donor supply and glycosphingolipid biosynthesis

qualifier: oxygen, carbon dioxide and Rh ammonium transport

qualifier: blood gas and Rh ammonium transport

name: Myoblast differentiation and striated muscle regeneration

name: Myoblast proliferation, differentiation and fusion in striated muscle

core: Amino sugar and sialic acid metabolism
qualifier: N-glycan processing and lysosomal glycan catabolism

name: Amino sugar metabolism in N-glycosylation and lysosomal glycan breakdown
rationale: Members share hexosamine/UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid metabolism feeding N-glycan processing and its lysosomal turnover (gangliosides, oligosaccharides, sialic acid storage), distinguishing it from O-glycan/fucose, GPI/glycosphingolipid synthesis and GAG-degradation confusables.

core: Amino sugar and sialic acid metabolism
qualifier: N-glycan processing and lysosomal glycoconjugate catabolism
name: Hexosamine, sialic acid, N-glycan and lysosomal glycoconjugate metabolism
rationale: Members span UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid metabolism, N-glycan processing and lysosomal ganglioside/oligosaccharide catabolism, distinct from GPI/glycolipid synthesis, O-glycan/nucleotide-sugar transport and mucopolysaccharidosis confusables.

qualifier: with mitochondrial fission-fusion and protein localization control

name: Selective organelle autophagy and mitochondrial dynamics regulation
rationale: Members span mitophagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy and nucleophagy with mitochondrial fission/fusion, membrane potential and protein targeting control, unlike lysosome fusion, mitochondrial import or aggrephagy/CMA confusables.

core: DNA double-strand break sensing and repair
name: Double-strand break sensing, NHEJ and protein ADP-ribosylation

qualifier: damage sensing, ADP-ribosylation and end-joining repair choice
name: Double-strand break sensing, ADP-ribosylation and end-joining choice

qualifier: damage sensing, end joining and ADP-ribosylation
name: DNA double-strand break sensing, end joining and ADP-ribosylation
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing/ATM signalling, NHEJ and regulation of HR-vs-NHEJ choice, BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 defects and PARP-type ADP-ribosylation, which the resection/D-loop HR confusables lack.

qualifier: macrophage and osteoclast development, bone resorption

qualifier: macrophage and osteoclast differentiation, bone resorption

name: Colony-stimulating factor control of macrophage and osteoclast development
rationale: Members cover M-CSF/CSF1 and GM-/G-CSF signalling and production, monocyte/macrophage/dendritic differentiation, osteoclast differentiation and fusion and bone resorption, distinct from granulopoiesis, macrophage fusion/DAP12 and SIRP confusables.

core: Peroxisome biogenesis and anabolic lipid metabolism
qualifier: protein import, VLCFA elongation and ether lipid synthesis

qualifier: protein import; very-long-chain and ether lipids

core: Peroxisome biogenesis and peroxisomal lipid synthesis
qualifier: protein import, fatty acid elongation, ether lipids
name: Peroxisome biogenesis, fatty acid elongation and ether lipid synthesis
rationale: Members cover peroxisomal protein import/fission and anabolic lipid routes (VLCFA and PUFA elongation, plasmalogen/ether and wax synthesis), distinguishing them from confusables centred on peroxisomal fatty acid alpha/beta-oxidation.

name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell engulfment

qualifier: apoptotic cell recognition and phagocytic clearance

name: Desmosome, hemidesmosome and integrin-laminin adhesion

qualifier: desmosomes, hemidesmosomes and integrin-laminin basement membrane

qualifier: vitamin D activation and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation

qualifier: vitamin K gamma-carboxylation and vitamin D activation

qualifier: epithelial assembly, maintenance and E-cadherin turnover
name: Epithelial cadherin adherens junction assembly and maintenance

qualifier: assembly and maintenance in epithelial cell-cell adhesion

name: Cadherin adherens junction assembly and E-cadherin turnover

qualifier: gut and pituitary peptide hormone GPCR signaling

qualifier: pituitary hormone secretion via ghrelin, somatostatin and glucagon-family receptors
name: Peptide hormone control of feeding and pituitary hormone secretion

qualifier: via ghrelin, somatostatin and glucagon-family GPCRs

qualifier: cadherin, PTEN and PD-L1 target genes

qualifier: lymph node and S1P receptor signalling

qualifier: paracellular magnesium handling via tight junctions

name: tRNA aminoacylation, methylation and pseudouridylation

qualifier: host cell entry and subversion of apoptosis, autophagy and phagolysosome fusion
name: Intracellular bacterial entry and subversion of host defences
rationale: Members describe how intracellular bacteria (Listeria InlB entry, M. tuberculosis) enter host cells and suppress apoptosis, autophagy, phagolysosome fusion, nitric oxide and membrane repair, whereas confusables centre on adhesion, phagosome acidification, ion flux or bacterial toxins.

name: COPI-mediated Golgi-ER vesicle traffic and tethering

qualifier: COPI-coated, retrograde and intra-Golgi, with vesicle tethering

core: Golgi vesicle budding, tethering and targeting
name: COPI and intra-Golgi vesicle budding, tethering and targeting
rationale: Members cover COPI vesicle budding, Golgi-to-ER retrograde and intra-Golgi traffic and Golgi vesicle tethering/targeting, whereas confusables centre on COPII ER export or Rab/ARF regulation.

qualifier: late sterol (Bloch/Kandutsch-Russell) steps and oxysterol-route bile acids

qualifier: late sterol steps and oxysterol bile acid routes
name: Late cholesterol synthesis and oxysterol-derived bile acid formation

qualifier: late sterol steps and oxysterol bile acid routes with spastic paraplegia defects
name: Late cholesterol synthesis and oxysterol bile acid pathways
rationale: Members are late Bloch/Kandutsch-Russell cholesterol synthesis and 24-/27-hydroxycholesterol bile acid synthesis with related CYP and SLC33A1 defects, unlike neighbours on peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation, the 7alpha-hydroxycholesterol route or early mevalonate steps.

qualifier: ADAR RNA editing, PKR and OAS
name: Type I interferon regulation by ADAR editing, PKR and OAS

qualifier: ADAR RNA editing, PKR and OAS
name: Type I interferon response with ADAR editing, PKR and OAS

name: Glucose-6-phosphate handling and regulation of glycogen turnover

name: Glucose-6-phosphate turnover and glycogen breakdown regulation
rationale: Members cover glucose-6-phosphatase/G6P transporter defects, glucokinase regulation, hexose phosphate transport and glycogenolysis/glycogen synthesis regulation, unlike confusables centred on glycolysis, glucagon/PKA, gluconeogenesis or glycogen synthesis disorders.

name: Hepatic glucose-6-phosphate turnover and glycogen regulation

qualifier: defensins in intestinal epithelial and microbiota homeostasis

qualifier: defensins in intestinal epithelium and microbiota
name: Defensin antimicrobial peptides shaping intestinal epithelium and microbiota
rationale: Members cover alpha/beta-defensin and antibacterial peptide production together with intestinal epithelial and stem cell maintenance and microbiota modulation, unlike confusables on broader humoral/mucosal antimicrobial responses or intestinal epithelial identity.

qualifier: intestinal epithelial and stem cell homeostasis, microbiota modulation
name: Defensin antimicrobial peptides and intestinal epithelial homeostasis
rationale: Members cover alpha/beta-defensin and antimicrobial peptide production and its regulation together with intestinal stem cell, epithelial structure and microbiota maintenance, which confusables on broad mucosal/antifungal defence, metal sequestration or enterocyte differentiation lack.

name: Fc-gamma receptor signaling and inhibitory immunoreceptor regulation

qualifier: with inhibitory receptor (CD22, SIRP) restraint of B cells and phagocytes

name: Collagen and elastic fibre formation and matrix secretion

name: Collagen–elastic fibre assembly and promotion of matrix secretion

name: Collagen and elastic fibre formation, promoting matrix secretion and adhesion

qualifier: glycine/threonine degradation and amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Glycine-threonine catabolism and amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids

qualifier: amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Glycine-threonine catabolism and amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
rationale: Members cover glycine and threonine degradation and glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, distinguishing it from proline, alanine and generic amino acid metabolism neighbours.

qualifier: amino-acid conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate
name: Glycine and threonine catabolism with xenobiotic acid conjugation
rationale: The members pair mitochondrial glycine and threonine breakdown (and its regulation) with the glycine/glutamine conjugation reactions that dispose of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, which sets it apart from the proline, alanine and glyoxylate metabolism and the generic obsolete amino-acid categories in the confusables.

name: GPCR-coupled cAMP turnover and PLC calcium second messengers
rationale: Members cover adenylate cyclase regulation, cAMP biosynthesis and PDE1 degradation together with PLC/IP3 calcium signaling, distinguishing it from adrenergic adenylate-cyclase inhibition and PKA/CREB downstream confusables.

qualifier: cAMP synthesis and degradation with PLC-calcium crosstalk
name: GPCR-regulated cAMP turnover and phospholipase C calcium signaling
rationale: Members cover adenylate cyclase regulation, cAMP synthesis and PDE1-mediated degradation together with PLC/IP3 calcium signaling, while confusables emphasize downstream PKA/CREB or adrenergic Gi/Gz inhibitory pathways.

qualifier: cAMP synthesis and degradation with Gq-calcium crosstalk
name: GPCR-driven cAMP synthesis and degradation with calcium crosstalk
rationale: Members regulate adenylate cyclase, cAMP synthesis and calmodulin-PDE breakdown together with PLC/IP3 calcium signaling, whereas confusables emphasise adrenergic inhibition, PKA/CREB or lysophospholipid receptors.

core: Unfolded protein and integrated stress responses
name: ER and integrated stress responses with AKT–FOXO survival signaling
rationale: Members span ATF6/IRE1/PERK UPR, eIF2 kinase (GCN2, HRI) translational control, UPRmt and stress-induced apoptosis, plus AKT–FOXO signaling that separates it from chaperone/ER-targeting and NFE2L2 confusables.

core: Unfolded protein and integrated stress responses
name: Unfolded protein and integrated stress responses, FOXO survival signaling
rationale: Members are ER/mitochondrial UPR, eIF2 kinase stress translation control and stress-induced apoptosis decisions, plus AKT-FOXO survival signaling that the ER folding/targeting and chaperonin confusables lack, while the NRF2 confusables lack the UPR.

name: ER and mitochondrial stress responses with AKT-FOXO survival control
rationale: Members are UPR branches (ATF6, IRE1/XBP1, PERK/ATF4), eIF2 kinase stress responses, UPRmt and AKT-regulated FOXO transcription deciding survival or apoptosis; FOXO separates it from ER folding/chaperone neighbours and UPR from NFE2L2 neighbours.

name: Oncogene- and stress-induced senescence via CDKN2A and p53
rationale: Members cover oncogene-, oxidative- and replicative senescence, p16INK4A/p14ARF evasion, p53-p21 G1 arrest, SAHF, SASP and Polycomb silencing, unlike p53 DNA-damage and apoptosis confusables.

qualifier: oncogene/stress induction and its evasion via p16INK4A/p14ARF defects
name: Oncogene- and stress-induced cellular senescence and its evasion
rationale: Members cover oncogene, oxidative and replicative senescence with SASP, SAHF, p53/p21 and Polycomb control and cancer evasion via p16INK4A/p14ARF defects, unlike p53 apoptosis and DNA-damage checkpoint confusables.

name: Cellular senescence via INK4A/ARF–p53 arrest and SASP
rationale: Members cover oncogene-, oxidative- and replicative senescence, p16INK4A/p14ARF defects, p53-p21 G1 arrest, SAHF, Polycomb silencing and SASP, unlike the p53 apoptosis and DNA damage checkpoint confusables.

qualifier: spanning ceramide/sphingomyelin synthesis, glycolipid transport and lysosomal ganglioside catabolism
