name: Sphingolipid and glycosphingolipid synthesis, transport and lysosomal catabolism
rationale: All members concern sphingolipid and glycosphingolipid synthesis, transport or lysosomal breakdown; unlike C1 it has the ganglioside/lysosomal side and unlike C2-C4 it has the ceramide/sphingomyelin side.

qualifier: spanning ceramide/sphingomyelin synthesis and lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism
name: Ceramide, sphingomyelin and glycosphingolipid synthesis and lysosomal catabolism
rationale: All members concern sphingolipid synthesis, transport or degradation; unlike C1/C2 the theme includes glycosphingolipid/ganglioside and lysosomal breakdown, and unlike C3/C4 it includes ceramide and sphingomyelin synthesis and turnover.

name: Sphingolipid synthesis and lysosomal glycosphingolipid degradation
rationale: Members cover ceramide/sphingomyelin synthesis and homeostasis plus glycosphingolipid and ganglioside synthesis, transport and lysosomal catabolism (GM2 gangliosidoses, sialidosis), unlike confusables centred on GPI anchors, amide or phospholipid transfer.

name: Nuclear and mitochondrial tRNA maturation, modification and aminoacylation
rationale: Members are dominated by tRNA processing, base modification and charging in cytosol and mitochondria, whereas confusables concern rRNA modification, mitoribosome assembly or mitochondrial translation and transcription.

name: tRNA processing, modification and aminoacylation
rationale: Members are tRNA end processing, splicing, base modification and aminoacylation in cytosol and mitochondria plus related RNA modification, whereas confusables centre on mitochondrial translation, ribosome assembly or rRNA modification.

qualifier: cytosolic and mitochondrial, for translational fidelity
name: tRNA maturation, modification and aminoacylation for translational fidelity
rationale: Members cover tRNA end processing, splicing, base modification and aminoacylation in nucleus, cytosol and mitochondria plus fidelity-related RNA modification, while confusables centre on rRNA modification or mitochondrial ribosome and translation machinery.

qualifier: presynaptic control of glutamate/GABA release and kainate receptors
name: Presynaptic modulation of glutamate and GABA release, kainate receptors
rationale: Members cover presynaptic calcium, vesicle exocytosis, glutamate/GABA secretion, kainate/AMPA receptor activation and short-term plasticity, whereas confusables focus on postsynaptic receptor clustering, diffusion trapping or inhibitory synapse assembly.

name: Presynaptic glutamate and GABA release and short-term plasticity
rationale: Members cover kainate/AMPA activation, presynaptic calcium and membrane potential, glutamate/GABA secretion and short-term potentiation, whereas confusables centre on postsynaptic receptor clustering and inhibitory synapse assembly.

name: Presynaptic modulation of glutamate and GABA transmission
rationale: Members cover kainate/AMPA/metabotropic glutamate and GABA signalling, presynaptic calcium and membrane potential, vesicle exocytosis and short-term plasticity, whereas confusables emphasise postsynaptic receptor clustering, nicotinic receptors and inhibitory synapse assembly.

name: mRNA decay and stabilization by 3'-UTR binding proteins
rationale: Members cover deadenylation, decapping and 5'-3' decay plus ARE/3'-UTR binders (TTP, AUF1, KSRP, BRF1, HuR, IGF2BPs), distinct from miRNA silencing, stress granule and nuclear 3'-end processing confusables.

name: ARE-binding protein control of cytoplasmic mRNA decay and stability
rationale: Members cover deadenylation, decapping, 5'-3' decay and AU-rich-element binders (HuR, AUF1, TTP, KSRP, BRF1), unlike confusables on 3'-end processing, miRNA silencing or stress granules.

qualifier: deadenylation, decay and RNA-binding protein stabilization
name: Cytoplasmic mRNA deadenylation, decay and stabilization
rationale: Members are deadenylation, decapping, 5'-3' decay and ARE/RNA-binding-protein control of mRNA stability and translation, distinct from 3'-end processing, stress granule and miRNA confusables.

qualifier: TNF receptor superfamily-driven canonical and non-canonical (NIK) pathways
name: TNF receptor superfamily canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB activation
rationale: Members are TNFR1, CD40 and TNFSF-driven canonical and NIK-dependent non-canonical NF-kB activation with linear ubiquitination, distinguishing it from TLR/RIP1, NF-kB negative regulation and lymphocyte NF-kB confusables.

name: TNF-receptor-driven canonical and NIK-dependent non-canonical NF-kB activation
rationale: Members span TNFR1 canonical NF-kB with linear ubiquitination and IKBKB, and NIK-driven non-canonical NF-kB via CD40, TNFSF members and Dectin-1, distinguishing it from lymphocyte/TLR NF-kB and negative-regulation confusables.

qualifier: TNF receptor superfamily, canonical and non-canonical
name: TNF receptor superfamily canonical and non-canonical NF-kB activation
rationale: Members are TNFR1, CD40 and TNFSF-driven canonical and NIK non-canonical NF-kB activation with linear ubiquitination, versus TCR, TLR/RIP1 or negative-regulation NF-kB neighbours.

qualifier: via incretin, glucagon and fatty-acid G protein-coupled receptors
name: Islet hormone secretion via incretin, glucagon and fatty-acid receptors
rationale: Members cover GLP-1/GIP, glucagon, somatostatin, acetylcholine and free fatty acid receptor regulation of insulin and glucagon secretion, unlike calcitonin/amylin, adrenergic/PKA and KATP-channel confusables.

core: Regulation of pancreatic islet hormone secretion
name: Incretin and nutrient GPCR control of insulin and glucagon secretion
rationale: Members concern GPCR inputs (GLP-1, GIP, glucagon, FFAR1, HCA, acetylcholine, somatostatin) regulating islet hormone secretion, distinguishing it from PKA/metabolic glucagon signaling, calcitonin/amylin receptor and KATP channel confusables.

name: Incretin and nutrient GPCR control of islet hormone secretion
rationale: Members are GLP-1/GIP, glucagon-family, free fatty acid, hydroxycarboxylic acid, muscarinic and somatostatin receptor control of insulin, glucagon and growth hormone secretion, unlike confusables on PKA/adrenergic insulin inhibition, K-ATP channels or calcitonin/amylin receptors.

core: Removal or editing of modified nucleic acid bases
qualifier: direct demethylation/alkylation reversal and APOBEC cytidine deamination with antiviral restriction
name: Nucleic acid base demethylation and APOBEC cytidine deamination
rationale: Members are TET/ALKBH/MGMT demethylation and alkylation reversal plus APOBEC C-to-U editing used in viral restriction; this separates it from excision repair, B-cell somatic hypermutation and ADAR adenosine-to-inosine editing confusables.

core: Enzymatic nucleobase modification and its reversal
qualifier: APOBEC cytosine deamination, TET demethylation, alkylation reversal
name: Nucleobase editing, DNA demethylation and alkylation damage reversal
rationale: All members chemically modify or restore nucleic-acid bases (APOBEC C-to-U editing in antiviral defence, TET/TDG 5mC oxidation, ALKBH/MGMT direct reversal), distinct from excision-repair, somatic hypermutation and A-to-I editing confusables.

qualifier: direct demethylation and APOBEC cytidine deamination
name: Direct base demethylation and APOBEC cytidine deamination
rationale: Members are direct reversal of alkylation/methylation (ALKBH, MGMT, TET) and APOBEC C-to-U editing with antiviral restriction, unlike somatic hypermutation, A-to-I editing or excision-repair confusables.

qualifier: tooth formation and ectodysplasin/NF-kB-linked ectodermal dysplasia
name: Odontogenesis and ectodermal dysplasia-linked appendage development
rationale: Members cover tooth development (odontoblast differentiation, dentinogenesis, cementum, eruption), hair placode formation and EDA-ID/TNF-receptor NF-kB defects, which together separate it from enamel mineralization and skin/keratinocyte confusables.

name: Tooth and ectodermal appendage development, EDA-NF-kB signalling
rationale: Members cover ectodermal derivatives (tooth odontogenesis, dentin, cementum, eruption, hair placode) and EDA receptor/NF-kB defects of ectodermal dysplasia, distinguishing it from skin/keratinocyte and enamel-mineralization confusables.

name: Odontogenesis and EDA-NF-kB ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members cover tooth/dentin/cementum formation, hair placode and ectodermal differentiation with EDA-ID (NF-kB) defects and TNF-family receptor binding; tooth and EDA-ID members separate it from the skin/keratinocyte and enamel-mineralization confusables.

qualifier: DC differentiation and T cell costimulation
name: Dendritic cell differentiation and T cell costimulation
rationale: Members concern dendritic cell differentiation/activation and APC-driven T cell costimulation and proliferation, distinguished from NK/tolerance and regulatory T cell confusables.

name: Dendritic cell differentiation and antigen-presenting T cell costimulation
rationale: Members concern dendritic cell differentiation/activation signatures and APC-dependent T cell activation and costimulation, distinct from regulatory T cell, NK cell and generic surface-signature confusables.

qualifier: dendritic cell differentiation and resting DC signatures
name: Dendritic cell differentiation and T cell costimulation
rationale: Members concern DC differentiation/activation signatures and APC-driven T cell costimulation, unlike confusables about NK/tolerance or regulatory T cell differentiation.

name: Autophagosome formation, maturation and selective cargo capture
rationale: Members regulate autophagosome assembly and maturation and deliver cargo to phagophores (mitophagy, xenophagy, synaptic protein turnover); confusables center on autophagosome/endosome-lysosome fusion or nucleophagy/reticulophagy instead.

name: Autophagosome formation, maturation and selective cargo targeting
rationale: Members regulate phagophore/autophagosome assembly and maturation and deliver cargo (mitochondria, microbes, synaptic proteins) to autophagosomes, whereas confusables focus on lysosome/endosome fusion or reticulophagy and nucleophagy.

name: Autophagosome assembly, maturation and selective cargo targeting
rationale: Members regulate phagophore/autophagosome formation and maturation and deliver selective cargo (mitochondria, microbes, synaptic proteins); neighbours instead emphasize lysosome and endosome fusion or reticulophagy.

name: Bicarbonate and phosphate transporter defects in mineralization and acidosis
rationale: Members are bicarbonate (SLC4), phosphate (SLC20A2, ABCC6) and cation-exchanger (SLC24) transport and their diseases of enamel/ectopic mineralization and tubular acidosis, unlike SLC26 anion exchange, SLC34 Na/Pi or carbonic anhydrase neighbours.

qualifier: bicarbonate and phosphate transporters in mineralization and acidosis
name: Bicarbonate and phosphate transporter defects in mineralization and acidosis
rationale: Members are bicarbonate, phosphate and calcium-exchanger transport and their disorders affecting enamel, tooth and ectopic mineralization and renal acidosis; neighbours instead cover type II Na/Pi cotransporters, SLC26 anion exchange and carbonic anhydrase.

core: Ion transporter defects in tissue mineralization
name: Bicarbonate, phosphate and calcium exchanger defects in mineralization
rationale: Members are bicarbonate (SLC4), phosphate (SLC20A2, ABCC6) and Na/K/Ca exchanger (SLC24) transport and their disorders, mostly affecting enamel/tooth or ectopic mineralization and acid-base balance (SLC24A5 albinism is an outlier), unlike neighbours on carbonic anhydrase, dentin, SLC26 anion exchange or Na/Pi cotransport.

name: Selenium metabolism, selenoprotein synthesis and thyroid hormone activation
rationale: Members cover dietary selenium metabolism, selenocysteine synthesis/readthrough and selenoprotein-dependent thyroid hormone generation, unlike confusables on sulfonation, ROS detox or thyroid hormone receptor signaling.

name: Selenium metabolism, selenocysteine incorporation and thyroid hormone generation
rationale: Members cover selenium compound metabolism, selenocysteine synthesis/readthrough and selenoprotein-dependent thyroid hormone generation and transport, unlike confusables on ROS detoxification, sulfonation or thyroid receptor signaling.

name: Selenium metabolism, selenocysteine synthesis and thyroid hormone activation
rationale: Members cover dietary selenium conversion and excretion, selenocysteine synthesis via UGA readthrough, and regulation of thyroid hormone generation, transport and activity (selenoprotein deiodinase-dependent), distinguishing it from confusables on thyroid hormone receptor signaling, ROS detoxification or iodide/sulfonation.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar supply, N-/O-glycans, sialylation and fucosylation
name: Nucleotide-sugar supply and N-/O-glycan and glycolipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover nucleotide sugar synthesis and transport, N- and O-glycan processing, sialic acid and fucose metabolism, glycosphingolipids and their congenital disorders, unlike GPI-anchor or lysosomal catabolism confusables.

name: Nucleotide-sugar supply and N-, O- and glycolipid glycosylation
rationale: Members cover nucleotide-sugar synthesis and transport, N- and O-glycan processing, sialylation, fucosylation, glycosphingolipid and blood group antigen synthesis and their CDG defects, whereas confusables are GPI anchoring or lysosomal glycan catabolism.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar supply, N- and O-glycan processing
name: Nucleotide-sugar metabolism and protein and lipid glycosylation
rationale: Members cover nucleotide-sugar synthesis and transport, N- and O-glycan processing, sialylation, fucosylation, blood-group and glycosphingolipid synthesis and their CDG defects, beyond the GPI-anchor and lysosomal glycolipid catabolism confusables.

qualifier: NK cytotoxicity and T cell costimulation
name: NK and T cell cytotoxicity, costimulation and tolerance regulation
rationale: Members regulate NK cytotoxicity and receptors, T cell costimulation, proliferation, anergy and Treg differentiation, and DC activation, which the confusables (thymic tolerance, DC signatures, cytokine suppression, Treg/TCR signaling) cover only partly.

name: NK receptor and T cell cytotoxicity and tolerance regulation
rationale: Members concern NK and T cell cytotoxicity, costimulation, MHC presentation and tolerance/anergy, with NK receptor and KIR modules distinguishing it from DC, Th1/Treg and T cell signaling confusables.

qualifier: NK and T cell, inhibitory control
name: NK and T cell cytotoxic activation and inhibitory control
rationale: Members cover NK receptor/KIR and T cell activation signatures, cytotoxicity, granzyme killing and its positive and negative regulation including tolerance and anergy, beyond the Th1/Treg, cytokine-production and DC-signature confusables.

qualifier: SLC4/SLC26 anion exchangers, cation-chloride cotransporters and NHEs with disease defects
name: Inherited defects of chloride, bicarbonate and sodium-coupled ion transporters
rationale: Members are chloride, bicarbonate and other anion exchangers, cation-chloride cotransporters, NHEs and CFTR with their inherited disorders, whereas confusables involve aquaporins, osmotic responses or carbonic anhydrase pH control.

qualifier: chloride and bicarbonate transporters and their inherited defects
name: Epithelial chloride and bicarbonate transport and inherited transporter defects
rationale: Members cover chloride, bicarbonate and other anion transport by CFTR, SLC26, SLC4, SLC12 and sodium/proton exchangers with their channelopathies, distinct from osmotic-response, aquaporin, acidification or carbonic anhydrase confusables.

name: Epithelial anion and cation transporters and inherited transport disorders
rationale: Members are CFTR, SLC26, SLC4, SLC12 and NHE transport of chloride, bicarbonate, sulfate, iodide and cations with their channelopathies and transepithelial salt/water flux, unlike confusables on osmosensing, aquaporins or CO2 hydration/pH.

core: Heart valve, septum and outflow tract morphogenesis
name: Endocardial cushion-derived valve, septum and outflow tract morphogenesis
rationale: Members are valve, septum, outflow tract and great-artery morphogenesis via endocardial cushion EMT and cardiac neural crest, unlike confusables on heart tube, ventricular myocardium or second heart field.

qualifier: with outflow tract and great artery formation
name: Heart valve, septum and outflow tract-great artery morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover endocardial cushion EMT, valve and septum morphogenesis plus neural crest-dependent outflow tract, aortic, pulmonary and coronary artery formation, which the myocardial and heart-tube confusables lack.

qualifier: endocardial cushion EMT, neural crest outflow tract and great arteries
name: Cardiac cushion valves, septa, outflow tract and great arteries
rationale: Members cover endocardial cushion EMT forming valves and septa plus neural crest-dependent outflow tract septation and aortic, pulmonary, pharyngeal arch and coronary artery morphogenesis, distinguishing it from confusables on heart tube, secondary heart field, ventricular trabeculation and myocardium.

qualifier: L1-ankyrin nodal sodium channel clustering and dendrite self-avoidance
name: Neuronal Ig-superfamily adhesion, L1-ankyrin nodal clustering and self-avoidance
rationale: Members are neuronal Ig-superfamily adhesion molecules (L1, CHL1, NrCAM, neurofascin, DSCAM, SDK, nectins) and their roles in nodal/paranodal sodium channel clustering and dendrite self-avoidance, unlike the myelination, RPTP or axon-repulsion confusables.

name: Neuronal immunoglobulin-superfamily adhesion and nodal sodium channel clustering
rationale: Members are L1, NrCAM, neurofascin, CHL1, DSCAM, SDK and nectin adhesion with axonal sodium channel clustering and paranodal assembly, which repulsion, NCAM and myelination neighbours lack.

qualifier: axonal nodal domains and dendrite self-avoidance
name: Neuronal Ig-superfamily adhesion at axon nodes and dendrites
rationale: Members are L1-family, nectin, DSCAM and SDK adhesion interactions organising nodal/paranodal axon domains, sodium channel clustering and dendrite self-avoidance, unlike confusables on L1 recycling/repulsion, myelination, RPTP signaling or NCAM1.

name: Hypoxia-inducible factor signaling and glycolytic flux control
rationale: Members combine HIF oxygen sensing and hypoxia responses with glycolysis, fructose-bisphosphate regulation, lactate production and p53/mTORC1 metabolic control, distinguishing it from FOXO/AKT, NRF2 and plain glucose-catabolism confusables.

qualifier: hypoxia/HIF oxygen sensing and lactate fermentation
name: Hypoxia/HIF control of glycolytic flux and fermentation
rationale: Members combine HIF oxygen sensing and hypoxia, p53/mTORC1 metabolic control, fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation of glycolysis and lactate fermentation; the HIF/hypoxia and fermentation arms separate it from NFE2L2, FOXO and plain glucose-catabolism neighbours.

name: Hypoxia/HIF and p53 control of glycolytic flux
rationale: Members cover glycolysis, fructose bisphosphate and lactate metabolism together with HIF, oxygen homeostasis, p53 and mTORC1 regulators of it, whereas confusables emphasise FOXO/AKT, NRF2 or plain glucose catabolism.

core: RNA polymerase I and III transcription
name: RNA polymerase III and I transcription with pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Members are Pol III tRNA/5S transcription steps, Pol I elongation/termination and pre-rRNA cleavage events, differing from confusables focused on Pol I initiation, rDNA chromatin control or snRNA transcription.

core: RNA polymerase I and III transcription
name: RNA polymerase I and III transcription with pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Members are Pol III tRNA/5S rRNA transcription steps, Pol I elongation/termination and early pre-rRNA cleavages; confusables lack Pol III (C1, C2), lack pre-rRNA cleavage (C4), or centre on Pol I initiation and rDNA chromatin control (C3).

qualifier: RNA polymerase III and I, with early pre-rRNA cleavage
name: RNA polymerase III and I transcription and pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Members cover Pol III initiation, elongation and termination for tRNA and 5S rRNA, Pol I elongation and termination and ETS/ITS pre-rRNA cleavages; the Pol III arm separates it from neighbours centred on Pol I initiation, rRNA gene regulation and snRNA transcription.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor and chemokine production
name: Formyl peptide and chemokine-driven myeloid leukocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members regulate neutrophil, macrophage and granulocyte chemotaxis via formyl peptide receptors and chemokine production, unlike degranulation, respiratory burst, extravasation or DC cytokine confusables.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor signaling and chemokine production
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven myeloid chemotaxis and chemokine production
rationale: Members cover neutrophil/monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, formyl peptide and complement receptor signaling and CCL/CXCL chemokine production, unlike confusables on degranulation, respiratory burst or extravasation.

core: Myeloid leukocyte chemotaxis and chemokine production
qualifier: formyl peptide and complement receptor signaling
name: Myeloid chemotaxis via formyl peptide receptors and chemokines
rationale: Members regulate neutrophil, monocyte and macrophage chemotaxis and CCL/CXCL chemokine production via formyl peptide and complement receptors, unlike confusables centred on degranulation, respiratory burst, extravasation or DC cytokines.

core: Glutamate-family and aspartate amino acid metabolism
qualifier: glutamine, proline and arginine catabolism with ammonium handling
name: Glutamate-family and aspartate amino acid metabolism, ammonium handling
rationale: Members are glutamate, glutamine, proline, arginine and aspartate/asparagine metabolism with ammonium homeostasis and nitrogen utilization; confusables centre on urea cycle disorders, ornithine/lysine transport or glyoxylate and 2-oxoglutarate metabolism.

qualifier: glutamate, glutamine, proline, aspartate and ammonium handling
name: Glutamate-family and aspartate metabolism with ammonium handling
rationale: Members cover glutamate/glutamine, proline, arginine and aspartate metabolism plus nitrogen utilization and ammonium homeostasis, distinct from urea-cycle/ornithine disorder and glyoxylate confusables.

name: Glutamate-family and aspartate amino acid nitrogen metabolism
rationale: Members cover glutamate, glutamine, proline, arginine and aspartate metabolism with ammonium handling, unlike urea-cycle disorder and glyoxylate/2-oxoglutarate confusables.

name: Stress granule dynamics and AU-rich element mRNA turnover
rationale: Members cover ARE-binding proteins (HuR, TTP, KSRP, BRF1, AUF1) controlling mRNA stability plus stress granule assembly/disassembly, arsenite and PKR stress signalling, which the translation/decay-focused confusables lack.

name: Stress granule dynamics and AU-rich element mRNA turnover
rationale: Members combine ARE-binding protein control of mRNA stability (HuR, TTP, AUF1, BRF1, KSRP) with stress granule assembly/disassembly and stress responses (PKR, arsenite, PML bodies), the stress granule part being what the mRNA-decay confusables lack.

qualifier: stress granule dynamics under arsenite/PKR stress
name: ARE-mediated mRNA decay and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members combine ARE-binding protein control of mRNA stability (AUF1, TTP, BRF1, KSRP, HuR) with stress granule assembly, disassembly and arsenite/PKR stress signalling, which the ARE-only confusables lack.

qualifier: germinal centre and T follicular helper costimulation
name: B cell activation, proliferation and germinal centre T-cell help
rationale: Members concern B cell proliferation, survival, differentiation and germinal centre formation with Tfh/ICOS/CD27 help, whereas confusables are B/plasma cell surface signatures and plasma cell differentiation.

name: B cell activation, proliferation and germinal center costimulation
rationale: Members regulate B cell proliferation, survival, differentiation and germinal center reactions with Tfh, ICOS and CD27 costimulation, unlike plasma cell and B cell surface-signature confusables.

qualifier: T-dependent germinal center help (Tfh, ICOS, CD27)
name: B cell activation, proliferation and T-dependent germinal center responses
rationale: Members concern B cell activation, proliferation, survival, homeostasis and germinal center formation with Tfh/ICOS/CD27 help and memory, distinguishing the theme from confusables made of B cell/plasma cell expression signatures and immunoglobulin modules.

name: Chaperonin folding of tubulin and actin, tubulin glutamylation
rationale: Members cover prefoldin/TRiC folding of tubulin, actin and G-beta plus tubulin C-terminal glutamylation and microtubule severing, separating it from general chaperone refolding/ER folding and tubulin acetylation confusables.

name: Chaperonin folding of tubulin and actin, tubulin glutamylation
rationale: Members describe CCT/TRiC and prefoldin folding of actin, tubulin and G-beta plus tubulin C-terminal (de)glutamylation and severing, which the general-chaperone and acetylation confusables lack.

qualifier: with tubulin glutamylation and microtubule severing
name: Chaperonin tubulin/actin folding and tubulin glutamylation
rationale: Members cover CCT/TRiC and prefoldin folding of tubulin, actin and G-beta plus post-chaperonin tubulin processing, and the tubulin C-terminal (de)glutamylation and microtubule severing set it apart from general ER/refolding chaperone and acetylation neighbours.

qualifier: thymic and peripheral T cell expression signatures
name: T cell activation and differentiation expression signatures
rationale: Members are mostly T cell activation, signalling and thymocyte differentiation signatures with minor B/NK modules, distinguishing them from confusables dominated by B cell development and BCR signalling.

name: T cell activation, TCR signalling and thymic differentiation
rationale: Members are dominated by T cell activation/signalling modules, IL2/IL7/TCR network, double-positive thymocytes and CD8 and gamma-delta T cell differentiation, while the confusables are centred on B cell receptor signalling and B cell development.

name: T cell activation, signalling and thymic differentiation
rationale: Members are mainly T cell activation/signalling modules, TCR-IL2-IL7 networks and thymocyte, CD8 and gamma-delta differentiation, whereas the confusables are dominated by B cell development and BCR signalling.

core: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell regulation
qualifier: stem cell maintenance and bone marrow homeostasis
name: Hematopoietic stem cell maintenance and bone marrow homeostasis
rationale: Members concern HSC proliferation, division, homeostasis and early progenitor/lineage decisions within the bone marrow, whereas confusables centre on committed myeloid, granulocytic, erythroid and megakaryocytic differentiation and CSF signaling.

core: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell regulation
qualifier: stem cell homeostasis in bone marrow
name: Hematopoietic stem cell homeostasis and bone marrow hemopoiesis
rationale: Members concern hematopoietic stem cell division, proliferation, homeostasis and early progenitor fate in bone marrow, unlike the confusables, which centre on myeloid, granulocyte, erythroid and RUNX1-driven lineage differentiation.

qualifier: stem cell maintenance and bone marrow
name: Hematopoietic stem cell maintenance and bone marrow hemopoiesis
rationale: Members concern HSC proliferation, division, homeostasis and differentiation control plus bone marrow development and output, whereas confusables centre on myeloid/granulocyte lineage commitment, CSF signaling and RUNX1 transcription.

name: Muscle ryanodine-receptor calcium release and Na+/Ca2+ exchange
rationale: Members concern regulation of sarcoplasmic calcium release and cytosolic calcium clearance shaping cardiac and skeletal contraction/relaxation, unlike confusables on SERCA calcium uptake and positive inotropy.

qualifier: ryanodine receptor release and cytosolic calcium clearance
name: Sarcoplasmic calcium release and cytosolic calcium clearance in striated muscle
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine-receptor calcium release, Na/Ca exchange and calcium sequestration that set relaxation, contraction and heart rate, unlike confusables centred on SERCA import or positive inotropy/chronotropy.

core: Calcium handling in striated muscle contraction
qualifier: ryanodine receptor SR calcium release and sodium-calcium exchange, contraction dampening
name: Ryanodine receptor Ca2+ release and Na+/Ca2+ exchange in striated muscle
rationale: Members concern regulation of sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release via ryanodine receptors and cytosolic calcium clearance by Na+/Ca2+ exchangers controlling cardiac/skeletal contraction and relaxation, unlike confusables on SERCA/ATPase uptake and positive inotropic or chronotropic regulation.

core: Inflammatory chemokine production and leukocyte-endothelial adhesion
qualifier: regulation of extravasation and myeloid proinflammatory output
name: Regulation of inflammatory chemokine production and leukocyte-endothelial adhesion
rationale: Members combine myeloid proinflammatory cytokine/chemokine modules with regulation of IL-8, CXCL2, MCP-1 production and leukocyte adhesion/extravasation, whereas confusables emphasise monocyte activation and chemotaxis or lymphocyte TNF/IL-23 activation.

qualifier: control of leukocyte-endothelial adhesion and extravasation
name: Inflammatory chemokine output and leukocyte-endothelial adhesion control
rationale: Members combine myeloid proinflammatory chemokine/cytokine programs with (mostly negative) regulation of IL-8, CXCL2, MCP-1 and adhesion-molecule production, leukocyte adhesion to endothelium and extravasation, whereas confusables center on monocyte chemotaxis/activation or lymphocyte TNF/IL-23 output.

name: Inflammatory chemokine output and leukocyte adhesion to endothelium
rationale: Members are myeloid proinflammatory chemokine/cytokine programmes and control of IL-8, CXCL2, MCP-1 and adhesion-molecule production, leukocyte-endothelial adhesion and extravasation, unlike confusables focused on monocyte chemotaxis or NF-kB activation.

name: Morphogen lipidation and secretion with non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling
rationale: Members cover Wnt and Hedgehog ligand lipidation, autoprocessing and secretion together with Wnt/Ca2+ signaling, unlike Hh-GLI, canonical Wnt and cysteine-palmitoylation confusables.

name: Wnt/Hedgehog ligand lipidation, secretion and Wnt/Ca2+ signaling
rationale: Members cover Wnt and Hedgehog ligand palmitoylation, autoprocessing and release plus non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling, distinguishing it from palmitoylation-only, Hh receptor/GLI and canonical Wnt neighbours.

core: Wnt and Hedgehog ligand lipidation and secretion
name: Morphogen lipidation and secretion with non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling
rationale: Members cover PORCN/HHAT lipidation, Hh autoprocessing and Wnt/Hh ligand release plus WNT5A-Ca2+ signaling, unlike generic palmitoylation, canonical Wnt or Hh reception confusables.

name: MTF1-metallothionein metal response and ROS detoxification
rationale: Members combine responses to zinc, copper, manganese and iron via MTF1/metallothioneins with ROS detoxification and redox homeostasis, whereas confusables add cadmium/heavy metals, copper/manganese transport or NO/peroxide responses.

core: Cellular metal and oxidative stress response
qualifier: metallothionein metal binding and ROS detoxification
name: Metallothionein metal response and ROS detoxification
rationale: Members join MTF1/metallothionein responses to zinc, copper, manganese and iron with ROS detoxification, redox homeostasis and HMOX1, whereas confusables cover heavy-metal transport/detoxification only or nitrosative and peroxide responses only.

name: Metallothionein-MTF1 metal response and ROS detoxification
rationale: Members join MTF1/metallothionein responses to copper, zinc, manganese and iron with ROS detoxification and redox homeostasis, whereas confusables cover only nitrosative stress or toxic heavy metals and copper transport.

qualifier: oncogenic RAF, Rap1 and integrin inputs
name: RAF-MAPK activation by oncogenic RAF, Rap1 and integrins
rationale: Members concern RAF/BRAF mutant and fusion signalling and MAPK activation downstream of RAS, Rap1 and integrin GRB2/p130Cas links, with Rap1 and integrin inputs absent from RAS/MRAS and ERK feedback neighbours.

qualifier: oncogenic BRAF/RAF1, Rap1 and integrin inputs
name: RAF-to-ERK activation by oncogenic RAF, Rap1 and integrins
rationale: Members concern RAF-MEK-ERK activation including BRAF/RAF1 mutants and fusions, with Rap1 and integrin linkage as inputs, unlike confusables on RAS GAP regulation, MRAS/SHOC2 or ERK negative feedback.

qualifier: via Rap1, integrin adaptors and oncogenic RAF/RAS mutants
name: RAF-MAPK activation via Rap1, integrins and oncogenic RAF
rationale: Members describe RAF-MEK-ERK activation by BRAF/RAF1 mutants and fusions, RAS mutants, Rap1 and integrin-linked GRB2:SOS/p130Cas complexes, distinguishing them from MRAS/SHOC2, negative-feedback and RAS-GAP confusables.

name: Viral attachment, receptor-mediated entry and intracellular transport
rationale: Members describe virion attachment, receptor-mediated endocytic entry and transport of viruses (dengue, RSV, influenza), separating the theme from confusables centred on viral protein maturation, cell-cell fusion or host suppression of infection.

core: Viral attachment and entry into host cells
name: Viral attachment and receptor-mediated endocytic entry
rationale: Members describe virus attachment, receptor-mediated endocytic entry and host-cell transport (RSV, Dengue, influenza), distinct from confusables about viral protein maturation, cell-cell fusion or host suppression of viral life cycle.

name: Viral receptor attachment and endocytic entry into host cells
rationale: Members describe virus attachment, receptor-mediated endocytic entry and transport (dengue, influenza, RSV) plus their positive regulation, unlike confusables centered on host restriction (C1), fusion-based entry (C2, C3) or viral protein maturation (C4).

qualifier: cerebellar granule layer and brainstem, with motor and respiratory function
name: Cerebellar granule layer and brainstem development and function
rationale: Members cover cerebellar granule layer/Bergmann glia, pons and brainstem development plus motor learning and respiratory control; neighbours emphasize Purkinje layer, locomotor behavior, forebrain or hindbrain axon guidance instead.

name: Brainstem and cerebellar granule layer development
rationale: Members concern development of hindbrain structures (pons, brainstem, cerebellar granule layer, Bergmann glia) and their functions, distinguished from Purkinje-layer, forebrain and motor-behaviour neighbours by granule-layer and brainstem content.

name: Cerebellar granule layer and brainstem development
rationale: Members concern hindbrain maturation: cerebellar granule precursors, Bergmann glia, granular layer, pons/brainstem and their motor/respiratory functions; unlike neighbours it lacks Purkinje layer, forebrain and locomotor-behaviour terms.

name: Replication stress response to fork-stalling lesions and drugs
rationale: Members address stalled replication forks: fork reversal, R-loop and protein-DNA crosslink processing, camptothecin/hydroxyurea responses and intra-S checkpoint, unlike telomere maintenance, homologous recombination or DNA topology confusables.

name: Replication stress response to fork-stalling lesions
rationale: Members cover responses to camptothecin and hydroxyurea, fork reversal, R-loop and DNA-protein crosslink processing and checkpoint signalling, unlike the telomere, DNA topology and recombination-repair neighbours.

qualifier: fork reversal, R-loops and intra-S checkpoint
name: Replication stress response: fork reversal, R-loops, intra-S checkpoint
rationale: Members address stalled replication (fork reversal, R-loop processing, DNA-protein crosslink repair, hydroxyurea/camptothecin response) with checkpoint and p53 repair-gene control; confusables are homologous recombination repair or telomere maintenance.

core: Chemotactic migration of leukocytes and astrocytes
name: CXCL12-CXCR4-driven leukocyte and astrocyte chemotaxis
rationale: All members concern directed cell migration (T cell, mast cell, dendritic cell, astrocyte, lymphocyte homing) and its Cdc42/PLC-PKC/pseudopod machinery, and the CXCL12-CXCR4 axis distinguishes it from the CCR/dendritic-cell chemokine and S1P/B-cell homing neighbours.

qualifier: CXCR4 signalling with Cdc42-driven pseudopod extension
name: CXCR4-linked chemotaxis with Cdc42-driven pseudopod extension
rationale: Members are chemotaxis and directed migration of T, mast, dendritic cells and astrocytes; CXCL12-CXCR4 signalling, Cdc42/PLC-PKC transduction and pseudopodium assembly separate it from chemokine-receptor, B-cell and S1P/lymph-node homing neighbours.

qualifier: CXCL12–CXCR4 driven, in T, mast, dendritic cells and astrocytes
name: CXCL12–CXCR4 directed leukocyte and astrocyte chemotaxis
rationale: All members concern chemoattractant-guided migration (T, mast, dendritic cell and astrocyte chemotaxis, pseudopodium/Cdc42/PLC-PKC effectors) anchored by CXCL12–CXCR4, distinguishing it from the S1P/B-cell lymphoid-homing and chemokine-receptor/dendritic-cell neighbours.

name: Histone and non-histone lysine methylation and demethylation
rationale: Members cover histone lysine methyltransferases and demethylases, KMT2/WDR5 complexes, lysine and arginine methylation including p53 methylation, and DNA methylation, whereas confusables emphasise PRC2 silencing, imprinting or chromatin remodelers.

name: Histone and protein lysine/arginine methylation and demethylation
rationale: Members cover lysine and arginine methyltransferases, demethylases, WDR5/KMT2D complexes and non-histone (p53) methylation, unlike confusables on PRC2/CpG imprinting or CHD/NuRD chromatin remodeling.

qualifier: histone and non-histone lysine/arginine methylation and demethylation
name: Histone and non-histone protein methylation and demethylation
rationale: All members concern methylation marks (lysine mono/dimethylation, arginine methylation, MLL/WDR5 complexes, histone demethylases, p53 methylation, DNA methylation), unlike confusables built on chromatin remodelers/HDACs or PRC2-imprinting silencing.

qualifier: Dishevelled level, canonical and Wnt/Ca2+ branches
name: Dishevelled-mediated canonical and noncanonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling
rationale: Members center on DVL activation and degradation, destruction complex disassembly and WNT5A/Ca2+ non-canonical signaling, unlike neighbours on Wnt ligand secretion or FZD ubiquitination/RNF43.

name: Dishevelled-level Wnt signalling, including WNT5A calcium non-canonical branch
rationale: Members cover receptor-proximal Wnt events (DVL activation and degradation, AXIN recruitment, ligand antagonists, LRP5 mutants) together with WNT5A/calcium non-canonical signalling, unlike confusables on FZD ubiquitination, Wnt secretion or AXIN degradation.

name: Frizzled-Dishevelled Wnt signaling including Wnt/calcium pathway
rationale: Members concern receptor-proximal Wnt events (DVL activation and degradation, AXIN recruitment, ligand antagonists, LRP5) spanning canonical and Wnt/Ca2+ branches, unlike confusables on Wnt secretion, RNF43/FZD ubiquitination or AXIN degradation.

qualifier: glucosylation and mannose trimming to hybrid/complex glycans
name: N-glycan glucosylation, trimming and hybrid/complex processing
rationale: Members concern glucose donors, glucose/mannose trimming (MOGS, MAN1B1) and hybrid/complex N-glycan processing and degradation, distinct from UDP-GlcNAc/sialic acid, nucleotide-sugar transport and O-glycan neighbours.

name: N-glycan glucosylation, mannose trimming and hybrid/complex processing
rationale: Members concern Dol-P-Glc/UDP-glucose donors, glucosidase/mannosidase trimming (MOGS, MAN1B1), hybrid and complex N-glycan reactions and lysosomal oligosaccharide catabolism, distinct from sialylation, nucleotide-sugar transport and O-glycan themes.

name: N-glycan glucose and mannose trimming and processing
rationale: Members cover ER/Golgi N-glycan glucosidase and mannosidase trimming toward hybrid/complex glycans, Dol-P-glucose supply and lysosomal oligosaccharide breakdown; distinct from nucleotide sugar, sialylation and O-glycan confusables.

qualifier: increased contractile force and stress-induced hypertrophy
name: Cardiac contractile force enhancement and hypertrophic muscle adaptation
rationale: Members regulate heart contraction force, rate and relaxation together with stress-induced cardiomyocyte hypertrophy, sarcomere growth and fibre-type adaptation, unlike confusables centred on calcium handling and negative inotropy or on cardiomyocyte proliferation, regeneration and calcineurin signalling.

name: Cardiac contractile enhancement and hypertrophic muscle adaptation
rationale: Members concern increasing heart rate, force and relaxation of cardiac contraction and hypertrophic adaptation of striated muscle, as opposed to calcineurin-driven proliferation/regeneration or calcium-handling negative regulation in confusables.

qualifier: contractile force, heart rate and hypertrophic adaptation
name: Positive regulation of cardiac contractility and hypertrophic adaptation
rationale: Members regulate heart contraction force, rate and relaxation plus stress hypertrophy and cardiac adaptation, distinct from calcineurin/proliferation-regeneration and calcium-handling confusables.

core: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in branching organ morphogenesis
qualifier: salivary gland and pancreatic duct epithelium
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in salivary and pancreatic branching
rationale: All members concern reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling, branching and epithelial maturation in developing organs; the salivary gland and pancreatic ductal/endocrine lineage members distinguish it from the mammary/prostate, kidney and lung neighbours.

core: Epithelial-mesenchymal interactions in branching organ morphogenesis
qualifier: salivary gland and pancreatic duct lineages
name: Branching epithelial morphogenesis of salivary gland and pancreas
rationale: All members concern epithelial-mesenchymal signaling, epithelial branching or maturation in developing organs, and the salivary gland and pancreatic lineage members distinguish it from the lung, nephron and mammary/prostate confusables.

core: Epithelial–mesenchymal signaling in branching organ morphogenesis
name: Epithelial–mesenchymal signaling in salivary and pancreatic morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern reciprocal epithelial–mesenchymal signaling, epithelial branching and maturation in developing glands (salivary branching, pancreatic ductal/endocrine lineages, kidney, limb bud), whereas confusables centre on lung, mammary/prostate or metanephric kidney development.

qualifier: complex III/IV assembly and inner-membrane protein insertion
name: Mitochondrial electron transport, complex III/IV assembly and inner-membrane insertion
rationale: Members are respiratory chain electron transfer and chemiosmotic coupling plus assembly of complexes III, IV, I and respirasomes and inner-membrane insertion, while confusables add complex I biogenesis, ATP synthase, Fe-S clusters or mitochondrial translation.

name: Respiratory electron transport and complex III-IV assembly
rationale: Members are electron transport chain flux with complex III/IV, respirasome assembly and inner-membrane protein insertion, whereas confusables carry complex I biogenesis, ATP synthase assembly, mitochondrial translation or Fe-S clusters.

name: Respiratory chain electron transport and complex III/IV assembly
rationale: Members are the respiratory chain and oxidative phosphorylation with complex III, IV and respirasome assembly and inner-membrane protein insertion; confusables feature complex I biogenesis, ATP synthase assembly, mitochondrial translation or Fe-S cluster assembly.

qualifier: B-vitamin cofactor supply (cobalamin, biotin, thiamine, riboflavin, CoA, lipoate)
name: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA catabolism with B-vitamin cofactor supply
rationale: Members span mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation, branched-chain amino acid and organic acid catabolism, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases, ketone bodies and the inborn errors of these routes, together with the B-vitamin cofactors they need, which separates the theme from one-carbon/folate, choline, threonine and peroxisomal long-chain neighbours.

core: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA and organic acid catabolism
name: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA catabolism and B-vitamin cofactor supply
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial beta-oxidation, ketone bodies, branched-chain amino acid and propionyl-CoA catabolism, PDH/OGDH and the TCA cycle together with the cobalamin, thiamine, riboflavin, biotin, pantothenate/CoA and lipoate cofactors these dehydrogenases and carboxylases need, distinguishing it from folate/methionine one-carbon, peroxisomal oxidation and choline confusables.

qualifier: B-vitamin cofactors (cobalamin, thiamine, riboflavin, biotin, pantothenate)
name: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA metabolism and B-vitamin cofactors
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial acyl-CoA handling (fatty acid beta-oxidation, branched-chain amino acid and organic acid catabolism, ketone bodies, PDH/OGDH/TCA) plus the B-vitamin cofactors these enzymes need (cobalamin, thiamine, riboflavin, biotin, CoA), which separates it from choline/folate/one-carbon and peroxisomal confusables.

qualifier: glycosyltransferase steps building O-glycans, N-glycan antennae, GAG chains and blood-group antigens
name: Glycosyltransferase-mediated protein glycan and proteoglycan biosynthesis
rationale: Members are glycan-building reactions on proteins (GAG chains, O-GalNAc/O-Man/O-Fuc glycans, N-glycan maturation, fucosylation, sialylation, ABO/Lewis antigens); neighbours instead cover nucleotide-sugar supply/transport or glycosphingolipid synthesis.

qualifier: including fucosylation, sialylation and blood-group antigens
name: Glycoprotein and proteoglycan glycan biosynthesis, including fucosylation
rationale: Members span biosynthesis of GAG chains, O- and N-glycans, fucose/GDP-fucose, sialylation and ABO/Lewis antigens; confusables instead emphasise nucleotide-sugar transport, glycosphingolipids or lack the fucosylation and N-glycan arms.

qualifier: including N-glycan processing and fucosylated blood-group antigens
name: Proteoglycan, O- and N-glycan synthesis with fucosylated antigens
rationale: Members span GAG/proteoglycan synthesis, O-glycosylation, N-glycan processing, fucose metabolism, sialylation and ABO/Lewis antigens; confusables lack these and instead hold nucleotide-sugar transport and glycosphingolipid synthesis.

qualifier: feeding, sleep, stress and social behaviour
name: Neuropeptide control of feeding, sleep, stress and social behaviour
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide/GPCR signalling with feeding, sleep-wake, HPA stress and mating/parental behaviour, unlike the growth-hormone and dopaminergic confusables.

core: Neuropeptide and neuroendocrine control of behaviour
qualifier: HPA axis, feeding, sleep and mating
name: Neuropeptide and HPA-axis control of feeding, sleep and behaviour
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide/opioid GPCR signalling, glucocorticoid stress axis and appetite hormones with feeding, sleep, mating and stress behaviours; confusables are GH/prolactin JAK-STAT, dopamine signalling or beta-cell development.

qualifier: feeding, stress, sleep and social behaviour
name: Neuropeptide control of feeding, stress, sleep and social behaviour
rationale: Members are neuropeptide/GPCR signalling and HPA-axis hormone responses governing appetite, stress, sleep-wake, mating, parental and aggressive behaviour, distinct from GH/prolactin growth signalling and dopaminergic drug-response confusables.

name: Hepatobiliary bile acid, bilirubin and xenobiotic handling
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis/recycling, bilirubin glucuronidation, organic anion transporters and drug ADME with their hereditary defects, unlike intestinal lipid absorption and organic cation transport confusables.

name: Hepatobiliary bile acid, bilirubin and drug clearance
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis/transport/signalling, bilirubin glucuronidation and heme degradation, and SLCO/ABC-mediated xenobiotic ADME, unlike intestinal lipid absorption and organic cation transport confusables.

name: Hepatobiliary bile acid, bilirubin and xenobiotic metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis/recycling, bilirubin conjugation and SLCO/ABC-mediated drug and organic-anion transport with their disorders, unlike intestinal lipid absorption or organic cation confusables.

name: Mammary gland and placental trophoblast development
rationale: Members cover mammary gland branching, lineages, lactation and involution together with trophoblast differentiation, placental labyrinth and early embryo-maternal processes, unlike prostate/genital-tract or stem-cell-maintenance confusables.

qualifier: mammary gland and placental trophoblast in pregnancy
name: Mammary gland and placental trophoblast development in pregnancy
rationale: Members cover mammary lineage differentiation, branching, lactation and involution together with trophoblast, labyrinth, decidual and early embryonic development of pregnancy, distinct from prostate/genital-tract, germline stem cell and male gonad confusables.

name: Placental trophoblast and mammary gland development in pregnancy
rationale: Members cover trophoblast/placental labyrinth formation, decidualization and mammary development through lactation and involution, distinct from prostate, genital tract and germ-stem-cell confusables.

qualifier: death receptor caspase-8 apoptosis and necroptosis
name: Death receptor caspase-8 apoptosis and necroptosis
rationale: Members are TRAIL/Fas/TNF death-receptor signaling via caspase-8, c-FLIP and RIPK1/TRIF necroptosis, distinct from the intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis and T-cell cytotoxicity confusables.

name: Death receptor-mediated extrinsic apoptosis and necroptosis
rationale: Members are Fas/TRAIL/TNF/TRIF caspase-8, c-FLIP, BID and RIPK1 necroptosis signaling and its regulation, distinguishing it from mitochondrial intrinsic apoptosis and T-cell/tumour-defense confusables.

name: Death receptor apoptosis, caspase-8 control and necroptosis
rationale: Members cover Fas/TRAIL/TNF death receptor signalling, procaspase-8 dimerisation and c-FLIP control, BID activation, TRIF/RIPK1 necroptosis and T cell activation-induced death, distinct from the mitochondrial BCL-2/apoptosome confusable and tumour defence/allograft confusables.

qualifier: phenylalanine-tyrosine (with BH4), histidine, threonine and proline
name: Phenylalanine, tyrosine, histidine, threonine and proline catabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid metabolism dominated by aromatic, histidine, threonine, glycine and proline catabolism plus the BH4 cofactor for phenylalanine hydroxylation; neighbours concern serine, sulfur amino acids, vitamin B6 or molybdenum cofactor.

qualifier: phenylalanine/tyrosine with BH4, histidine, threonine, proline
name: Phenylalanine-tyrosine, BH4, histidine, threonine and proline metabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid catabolic/biosynthetic pathways for aromatic amino acids with their BH4 cofactor, histidine, threonine, proline and glycine/glyoxylate, unlike confusables centred on serine, sulfur amino acids and vitamin B6.

qualifier: aromatic, histidine, threonine and proline with tetrahydrobiopterin
name: Aromatic, histidine, threonine and proline amino acid catabolism
rationale: Members cover phenylalanine/tyrosine (with BH4 cofactor and phenylketonuria), histidine, threonine, proline and glycine/glyoxylate metabolism, whereas confusables centre on sulfur amino acids, serine, vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor.

qualifier: telomerase recruitment and telomere chromatin protection (ATRX/DAXX)
name: Telomerase recruitment and telomere chromatin protection
rationale: Members concern telomerase assembly, Cajal body trafficking and telomere extension together with telomere packaging, subtelomeric heterochromatin and ATRX/DAXX inhibition of recombination, unlike confusables on C-strand synthesis, ALT recombination or rRNA modification.

qualifier: telomerase action with capping and recombination suppression
name: Telomere maintenance by telomerase, capping and recombination suppression
rationale: Members concern telomerase recruitment and extension together with telomere packaging, capping and ATRX/DAXX suppression of recombination, unlike confusables on C-strand replication, ALT recombination or rRNA modification.

qualifier: telomerase assembly via Cajal bodies and telomere chromatin protection
name: Telomerase assembly, Cajal body trafficking and telomere protection
rationale: Members concern telomerase holoenzyme assembly and Cajal body localization plus telomere packaging and ATRX/DAXX suppression of recombination, distinguishing it from C-strand synthesis, ALT recombination and rRNA/snRNA modification confusables.

name: PTEN-AKT signaling control and inositol polyphosphate synthesis
rationale: Most members concern PTEN regulation, AKT targets and negative PI3K/AKT/IGF1R signaling, alongside nuclear/cytosolic inositol phosphate and pyrophosphate synthesis (plus PAK-2p34 cell-death regulation); confusables add serine autophosphorylation or pyrophosphate hydrolysis.

qualifier: with inositol phosphate and pyrophosphate synthesis
name: PTEN-AKT signaling control and inositol polyphosphate synthesis
rationale: Members cover PTEN regulation, AKT targets and negative PI3K/AKT regulation together with nuclear/cytosolic inositol (pyro)phosphate synthesis, while confusables add pyrophosphate hydrolysis and serine phosphorylation terms instead.

name: PTEN-AKT signaling regulation and inositol polyphosphate synthesis
rationale: Most members regulate PTEN stability, localization and translation or AKT/TSC/TORC2 output, alongside nuclear and cytosolic inositol (pyro)phosphate synthesis; the PTEN/AKT arm is what the pyrophosphate and serine-phosphorylation confusables lack, though the PAK-2p34 members fit only loosely.

name: Neuropeptide control of sleep-wake, social and stress behaviors
rationale: Members are orexin/relaxin neuropeptide signaling with sleep-wake regulation, mating, parental, aggressive, drinking and stress behaviors, unlike confusables emphasising opioid/G-protein synaptic signaling or HPA corticosteroid responses.

name: Neuropeptide control of sleep-wake and innate social behaviors
rationale: Members concern sleep/wake regulation, mating, parental, aggressive and drinking behaviours and stress behaviour with orexin, relaxin and neuropeptide signalling, distinguishing them from opioid/synaptic neuropeptide and HPA-axis confusables.

qualifier: sleep-wake, mating, aggression and parental behavior
name: Neuropeptide regulation of sleep-wake and innate social behaviors
rationale: Members cover orexin/relaxin neuropeptide receptor signaling with sleep-wake regulation and innate behaviors (mating, parental, aggressive, drinking, stress), unlike confusables focused on HPA-axis glucocorticoid responses or opioid and dense-core vesicle synaptic signaling.

core: Synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine regulation
name: Reelin-regulated synaptic plasticity, dendritic spines and memory
rationale: Members regulate LTP/LTD, spine maintenance, postsynaptic calcium and memory with Reelin signalling and amyloid-beta responses; these distinguish it from neurodegeneration, synaptic translation and spine-cytoskeleton confusables.

core: Long-term synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine maintenance
name: Reelin-linked long-term synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine maintenance
rationale: Members share regulation of LTP/LTD, spine and dendrite maintenance and memory, and unlike the confusables include reelin signaling and amyloid-beta response.

name: Reelin-driven synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine maintenance
rationale: Members combine reelin signaling with LTP/LTD, synapse maturation, spine maintenance and memory, unlike confusables on dendrite arborization, synaptic transmission or amyloid/tau formation.

name: Adrenergic control of cardiac contraction and insulin secretion
rationale: Members are epinephrine/norepinephrine responses regulating heart force, rate and insulin secretion and catecholamine release, unlike confusables centred on adenylate-cyclase-inhibitory and smooth muscle signaling.

name: Adrenergic control of cardiac contractility and insulin secretion
rationale: Members are adrenoceptor/catecholamine signalling regulating heart rate, contraction force and insulin and catecholamine secretion, distinguishing it from adenylate-cyclase-inhibitory and smooth-muscle confusables.

name: Adrenergic signaling increasing heart rate and contractile force
rationale: Members are adrenoceptor/catecholamine signaling and its effects; positive inotropic and chronotropic cardiac members distinguish it from the Gi/smooth-muscle adrenergic confusables.

name: Sleep-wake regulation and innate mating, parental, aggressive behaviours
rationale: Members are sleep/wake stage regulation and innate social, reproductive and drinking behaviours, distinct from the neuropeptide/opioid G-protein signalling and feeding/locomotor confusables.

qualifier: sleep-wake states and mating, parental, aggressive behavior
name: Sleep-wake states and innate mating, parental, aggressive behavior
rationale: Members are sleep/wake regulation, orexin receptor binding and innate social/reproductive and drinking behaviors, while confusables add opioid/neuropeptide G-protein signaling or feeding and locomotor rhythm.

name: Sleep-wake control and innate social and reproductive behaviour
rationale: Members concern sleep/wake states (including orexin) together with mating, parental, aggressive and drinking behaviours, which distinguish the theme from neuropeptide signalling and feeding-behaviour confusables.

qualifier: postsynaptic glutamate receptor clustering and short-term plasticity
name: Postsynaptic glutamate receptor clustering and excitatory synaptic strength
rationale: Members concern AMPA receptor clustering, diffusion trapping and postsynaptic localisation with resulting synaptic potentiation and sensory gating, unlike confusables on receptor activation/LTP, receptor trafficking or presynaptic release.

name: Postsynaptic glutamate receptor clustering and enhanced synaptic transmission
rationale: Members concern AMPA receptor clustering, diffusion trapping and localisation together with positive regulation of glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission and gating behaviours, unlike neighbours on receptor endosomal trafficking, presynaptic kainate function or NMDA signalling.

qualifier: receptor clustering and enhanced synaptic transmission
name: Postsynaptic AMPA receptor clustering and enhanced synaptic transmission
rationale: Members cover AMPA receptor clustering, diffusion trapping and localisation with positive regulation of excitatory and GABAergic transmission and sensorimotor gating; these distinguish it from presynaptic, endosomal-trafficking and NMDA/kainate activation confusables.

name: Calcitonin-family and glucagon-type peptide receptor cAMP signaling
rationale: Members are peptide-hormone GPCRs (glucagon-type, calcitonin/amylin/CGRP, relaxin, somatostatin) coupled to adenylate cyclase/cAMP; the calcitonin-family receptors distinguish it from free fatty acid, feeding and insulin-secretion confusables.

core: Peptide hormone GPCR signalling via cAMP
name: Calcitonin/amylin/CGRP and related peptide receptor cAMP signalling
rationale: Members are peptide-hormone GPCRs (calcitonin-like, relaxin, glucagon-type, somatostatin) acting through adenylate cyclase/cAMP; calcitonin-family and relaxin receptors set it apart from nutrient-receptor, feeding and insulin-secretion confusables.

name: Calcitonin/amylin and glucagon-type peptide receptor cAMP signaling
rationale: Members are peptide hormone receptors coupled to adenylate cyclase/cAMP with nutrient and GH secretion outputs; calcitonin-like, amylin, CGRP and relaxin receptors separate it from free fatty acid, incretin and feeding confusables.

qualifier: B cell homeostasis and restraint of B cell proliferation
name: Germinal center B cell responses and B cell homeostasis
rationale: Members cover germinal center formation, Tfh/ICOS help, GC B cell differentiation and memory responses together with B cell homeostasis and negative regulation of B cell proliferation and apoptosis, which the B cell signature and activation confusables lack.

qualifier: Tfh/ICOS help and B cell homeostasis
name: Germinal centre Tfh help and B cell homeostasis
rationale: Members cover germinal centre formation, ICOS co-stimulation and Tfh differentiation, memory, and restraint of B cell proliferation and apoptosis (B cell homeostasis), distinguishing it from B-signature and B cell activation confusables.

qualifier: T follicular helper and ICOS help
name: Germinal center B cell regulation and T follicular help
rationale: Members cover B cell modules, B cell homeostasis and restraint of proliferation/apoptosis, germinal centre formation and Tfh differentiation with ICOS co-stimulation, which the plasma-cell signature and BCR-activation confusables lack.

name: ER tubule shaping, membrane fusion and contact-site lipid transfer
rationale: Members concern ER tubular network formation, membrane bending and fusion, ER tethering and phospholipid/cholesterol transfer, unlike confusables on ER-mitochondria tethering and phosphoinositide synthesis.

qualifier: tubular network shaping and contact-site lipid transfer
name: ER tubule shaping, fusion and contact-site lipid transfer
rationale: Members concern ER tubular network formation, membrane bending and fusion, ER-plasma membrane tethering and lipid/cholesterol transfer, distinguishing it from confusables on ER-mitochondria tethering or phosphoinositide synthesis.

qualifier: tubular network shaping and lipid transfer
name: ER tubular network shaping, fusion and lipid transfer
rationale: Members cover ER tubule formation, membrane bending, ER fusion and localisation, ER-plasma membrane tethering and lipid/cholesterol transfer with vesicle traffic; confusables are phosphoinositide synthesis, ER-Golgi PI transfer and mitochondria-ER tethering.

qualifier: of lineage differentiation and signaling genes
name: RUNX1-mediated transcription of lineage differentiation and signaling genes
rationale: All members are RUNX1 (or RUNX-family) regulation of target genes across myeloid, megakaryocyte, B cell, keratinocyte and estrogen/WNT/interleukin programs, unlike megakaryocyte development (C1), Hox clusters (C2, C3) or FLT3/STAT5 signaling (C4).

qualifier: RUNX1 expression control and lineage-specific targets
name: RUNX1 expression control and lineage-specific target transcription
rationale: All members describe RUNX1 regulation or RUNX-driven transcription in hematopoietic, keratinocyte, WNT and estrogen contexts; confusables are Hox/TFAP2, FLT3 or erythroid-megakaryocyte programmes without RUNX1 regulation.

qualifier: target programmes in hematopoiesis and signalling
name: RUNX1-centred transcriptional regulation and its target gene programmes
rationale: Nearly all members are RUNX1 (with RUNX2/3) regulation and its target programmes in myeloid, megakaryocyte, keratinocyte, BCR, WNT and estrogen-receptor contexts, unlike Hox/TFAP2, erythroid-megakaryocyte or FLT3 neighbours.

name: Meiotic prophase I recombination, synapsis and checkpoint control
rationale: Members cover meiotic double-strand break formation and repair, recombination, synaptonemal complex and telomere attachment, and meiotic checkpoints, distinguishing them from confusables on meiotic cohesion, chromosome segregation and spermatogenesis.

name: Meiotic prophase I recombination, synapsis and checkpoint
rationale: Members cover meiotic DSB formation, recombination, synaptonemal complex, telomere attachment and checkpoint control, distinct from confusables on meiotic chromosome segregation, spindle and spermatogenesis.

name: Meiotic prophase I recombination and homolog synapsis
rationale: Members cover meiotic DSB formation/repair, recombination resolution, synaptonemal complex, telomere attachment and prophase checkpoints, unlike confusables on meiotic cohesion, segregation, spindle and spermatogenesis.

qualifier: cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing and ISG output
name: Cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing driving type I interferon and ISG response
rationale: Members span cytosolic DNA/dsRNA sensing via helicases/IRF3 and the downstream interferon-alpha response (OAS, IP-10, activated DCs), whereas confusables focus on RIG-I/TRAF signaling, NF-kB and regulation of IFN production.

qualifier: interferon-stimulated output: OAS, IFN-alpha response, IP-10
name: Cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing and interferon-stimulated antiviral response
rationale: Members link RIG-I/helicase and cytosolic DNA sensing via IRF3 to type I IFN and downstream OAS, IFN-alpha and IP-10 responses, the downstream effector side that RLR/NF-kB-focused confusables lack.

qualifier: interferon-alpha effector response, OAS and IP-10
name: Cytosolic RNA/DNA sensing and interferon-alpha antiviral effector response
rationale: Members link RIG-I/helicase and DNA sensing via IRF3 to type I interferon effectors (OAS, IP-10, DC activation), whereas confusables focus on regulators of RLR signaling and IFN production.

name: Interferon-alpha-induced antiviral gene signature
rationale: All members are type I IFN/interferon-alpha antiviral response sets (OAS, IRF2 targets, IP-10, cytosolic DNA sensing); the ISG transcriptional signature separates it from ISG15, RIG-I regulation and dengue confusables.

name: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral gene signature
rationale: Members are IFN-alpha/type I IFN response signatures (OAS, IRF2 targets, IP-10, cytosolic DNA sensing), distinguishing them from ISG15, dengue and RIG-I/IRF3 induction confusables.

qualifier: interferon-alpha signature with OAS and IP-10
name: Interferon-alpha antiviral signature with OAS and IP-10 induction
rationale: All members are type I interferon/antiviral responses and IFN-stimulated gene signatures; the OAS, IP-10, IFN-alpha response and cytosolic DNA sensing members separate it from confusables built on ISG15, IFN-signaling feedback or RIG-I/dsRNA sensing.

name: Retinoid metabolism, phototransduction and photoreceptor development
rationale: Members cover vitamin A/retinoic acid metabolism, the visual retinoid cycle, phototransduction and its diseases, and photoreceptor/retinal neuron development, while the confusables concern lens, cornea, iris and eye vasculature development.

name: Vitamin A metabolism, phototransduction and photoreceptor development
rationale: Members cover the retinoid cycle and retinoic acid metabolism, opsin phototransduction and its inherited defects, and photoreceptor/retinal neuron development, whereas confusables are lens, cornea, iris and vascular eye development.

name: Retinoid metabolism, phototransduction and photoreceptor development
rationale: Members cover vitamin A/retinoic acid metabolism and the visual retinoid cycle, opsin phototransduction and its defects, and photoreceptor differentiation, whereas confusables are non-photoreceptor eye morphogenesis (lens, cornea, iris, optic cup).

name: Pre-mRNA splicing and nuclear exosome RNA surveillance
rationale: Members span spliceosome assembly and splice-site recognition plus exosome-mediated 3'-5' nuclear RNA decay and surveillance, whereas confusables emphasise snRNA transcription, histone mRNA processing and mRNA export.

core: Pre-mRNA splicing and nuclear RNA processing
qualifier: with nuclear exosome RNA decay and surveillance
name: Spliceosomal pre-mRNA splicing and nuclear exosome RNA decay
rationale: Members combine spliceosome assembly and splice-site recognition with exosome-mediated 3'-to-5' nuclear RNA decay and surveillance, which the export, 3'-end processing and snRNA-transcription neighbours lack.

qualifier: nuclear exosome RNA decay and surveillance
name: Spliceosomal splicing and nuclear exosome RNA decay and surveillance
rationale: Members cover spliceosome assembly and splicing together with exosome-mediated 3'-5' decay and surveillance of mRNA, rRNA, snRNA and tRNA, which the snRNP assembly, 3'-end processing and export neighbours lack.

core: Endothelial cell differentiation and vessel morphogenesis
qualifier: via VEGFR2 and Tie2 signaling, arterial/venous/lymphatic specification
name: Endothelial cell differentiation and vessel morphogenesis via VEGFR2/Tie2
rationale: Members cover endothelial fate, arteriovenous and lymphatic specification and VEGF/VEGFR2/Tie2 signaling, unlike BMP-driven cardiopulmonary vasculature (C1, C2) or regulation of sprouting angiogenesis (C3, C4).

name: VEGFR2/Tie2-driven endothelial specification and vascular morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover VEGF/VEGFR2, neuropilin and Tie2 signaling with arterial, venous and lymphatic endothelial fate and vessel maturation, versus sprouting-angiogenesis regulation (C1/C2) and BMP-driven cardiovascular development (C3/C4).

name: Endothelial specification and VEGFR2/Tie2 signalling in vessel development
rationale: Members cover endothelial fate and arterial/venous/lymphatic differentiation with VEGF-VEGFR2-neuropilin and Tie2 signalling, unlike sprouting-angiogenesis regulation or BMP-driven cardiac vascular neighbours.

name: RUNX1-regulated myeloid progenitor and megakaryocyte differentiation
rationale: Members govern myeloid progenitor fate choice with emphasis on megakaryocyte development and platelet formation under RUNX1 control, while confusables are erythroid-terminal or monocyte-network focused.

name: RUNX1-regulated myeloid progenitor and megakaryocyte differentiation
rationale: Members describe RUNX1-driven transcriptional control of myeloid progenitor fate, megakaryocyte/platelet development and restraint of other myeloid lineages, lacking the erythroid and stem-cell maintenance members of its confusables.

name: RUNX1-regulated myeloid progenitor fate and megakaryocyte differentiation
rationale: Members regulate myeloid progenitor choices among granulocyte, monocyte, erythroid and megakaryocyte fates with RUNX1 and platelet modules, lacking the erythroid/HSC content of one confusable and adding RUNX1/megakaryocyte content absent from the granulopoiesis confusable.

name: MITF-M melanocyte gene regulation and UV response
rationale: Members are MITF-M target programs and melanocyte proliferation/differentiation; unlike confusables (pigmentation, melanin synthesis, keratinocytes) the theme adds UV-A/UV-B/blue-light and phorbol ester responses.

qualifier: UV and visible-light response, without pigment synthesis
name: MITF-M melanocyte regulation and UV light response
rationale: Members are MITF-M target-gene programmes, melanocyte proliferation/differentiation and cellular UV/light responses; unlike its confusables it carries UV-B/Hallmark UV response and lacks melanin synthesis, melanosome and keratinocyte members.

name: MITF-M melanocyte gene regulation with UV and light response
rationale: Members are MITF-M target-gene programs, melanocyte proliferation/differentiation and responses to UV-A/UV-B, blue light and TPA; the UV-response sets distinguish it from the pigmentation/melanin-synthesis confusables.

name: Cholinergic and serotonergic receptor signalling, including nicotinic transmission
rationale: Members are muscarinic, nicotinic and serotonin receptor signalling plus acetylcholine synthesis/secretion, distinct from purinergic/PDE, tachykinin gut, and histamine/serotonin synthesis confusables.

name: Cholinergic and serotonergic receptor signaling
rationale: Members are acetylcholine (nicotinic, muscarinic, neuromuscular, secretion) and serotonin receptor signalling; confusables involve tachykinin, adenosine/cAMP or histamine and serotonin synthesis/uptake and lack the cholinergic members.

name: Cholinergic and serotonergic receptor neurotransmission
rationale: All members are acetylcholine (nicotinic, muscarinic, release, metabolism) or serotonin receptor signalling, separating the theme from histamine, adenosine/PDE and tachykinin confusables.

name: Tryptophan-kynurenine catabolism and NAD+ biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover tryptophan/kynurenine/quinolinate catabolism feeding de novo NAD+ synthesis plus nicotinate salvage, NAD(P)+ synthesis/transport and redox; the tryptophan-kynurenine branch and NAD focus separate it from the polyamine and coenzyme A/pyruvate confusables.

name: Tryptophan-kynurenine catabolism and NAD(P)+ metabolism
rationale: All members concern NAD/NADP+ production, salvage, transport or redox use, largely from tryptophan via kynurenine and quinolinate, which separates the theme from the polyamine and coenzyme A/pyruvate confusables.

qualifier: de novo synthesis via tryptophan-kynurenine pathway
name: NAD(P)+ metabolism and tryptophan-kynurenine de novo synthesis
rationale: Members cover NAD+/NADP+ synthesis, salvage, catabolism and transport plus tryptophan-kynurenine-quinolinate catabolism feeding de novo NAD+, distinguishing it from coenzyme A/pyruvate and polyamine neighbours.

name: RIG-I/MDA5 antiviral signaling with interferon-alpha effector response
rationale: All members concern cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing (RIG-I/MDA5, DNA sensing) driving IRF3/type I IFN antiviral responses; unlike the RLR confusables it adds downstream interferon-alpha responses and effectors (OAS, IP-10, chemokine induction).

core: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing and type I interferon response
qualifier: RIG-I/MDA5 regulation and antiviral effectors (OAS, IP-10)
name: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing, type I interferon and antiviral effectors
rationale: All members concern RIG-I/MDA5 or cytosolic DNA sensing leading to IRF3-driven type I interferon and antiviral output; unlike the confusables the theme adds RIG-I/MDA5 regulators and downstream effectors (OAS, IP-10, IFN-alpha response) rather than TRAF/IRF7 or virus-evasion pathways.

core: Cytosolic nucleic acid sensing to type I interferon
name: RIG-I/MDA5 sensing and interferon-alpha antiviral effector response
rationale: Members span RIG-I/MDA5 and cytosolic DNA sensing through IRF3 to type I IFN, and unlike the confusables (IFN-beta production, TBK1 regulation, TLR7/8/9) the theme adds downstream IFN-alpha response, OAS and IP-10 antiviral effectors.

name: Noncanonical and lymphocyte receptor-driven NF-kB activation
rationale: Members describe NIK-dependent noncanonical NF-kB and NF-kB activation downstream of TCR, CD40, CD27 and BCR (with IKK-complex deficiencies), distinguishing it from TLR/TNFR1/NOD innate NF-kB confusables and from lymphocyte-biology confusables lacking NF-kB.

qualifier: TCR and TNF receptor superfamily costimulation
name: NF-kB activation in TCR and TNFRSF lymphocyte signaling
rationale: Members combine canonical and non-canonical (NIK) NF-kB activation downstream of TCR, CD27, CD40 and IKK deficiencies with T cell activation and IL-2 output, unlike the innate TLR/NOD/TNFR1 NF-kB confusables or broad B/T cell development confusables.

name: NF-kB activation via TCR and non-canonical NIK signaling
rationale: Members are NF-kB activation downstream of TCR/BCR and TNF-superfamily receptors (CD40, CD27, NIK non-canonical) plus IKK-deficiency immunodeficiencies, distinct from innate TLR/TNFR1/NOD canonical NF-kB and broad lymphocyte development confusables.

name: Somite segmentation and Notch/TSR protein O-glycosylation
rationale: Members cover somite specification, axis elongation and tail morphogenesis together with Notch processing and O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation (LFNG, B3GALTL); confusables are Nodal/BMP left-right, limb, neural plate or Hox patterning without glycosylation.

name: Somite segmentation and Notch O-fucosylation and glucosylation
rationale: Members are somite specification, axis elongation and segmentation together with Notch processing and O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation (LFNG, B3GALTL), distinguishing them from Hox, limb, neural plate and Nodal confusables.

name: Notch O-glycosylation and somite segmentation
rationale: Members are somite specification, axis elongation and Notch processing by O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation (LFNG, B3GALTL); confusables are Hox clusters, neural plate patterning, limb morphogenesis or Nodal left-right signaling.

qualifier: endothelial fluid shear stress and platelet activation
name: Integrin-Rap1 signaling in shear stress and platelet activation
rationale: Members share integrin activation, Rap1 signaling and adhesion-cytoskeleton coupling, applied to endothelial responses to laminar and oscillatory shear and to platelet activation; the shear-stress (PIEZO1) context distinguishes it from Rho/ROCK, G12/13, PECAM leukocyte adhesion and platelet GPCR confusables.

name: Rap1-mediated integrin activation and endothelial shear stress signaling
rationale: Members centre on Rap1-driven integrin activation and integrin-linked MAPK/cytoskeletal signaling in platelets and endothelium, and the PIEZO1 laminar/oscillatory shear-stress responses distinguish it from GPCR platelet, Rho and adhesion confusables.

name: Integrin–Rap1 signaling and endothelial shear stress response
rationale: Members share integrin activation, Rap1 and integrin-to-MAPK signaling in platelets and adhesion, and uniquely include PIEZO1/integrin responses to laminar and oscillatory shear stress in endothelium.

core: HPA-axis stress hormone secretion and response
name: HPA-axis stress response and social behaviors
rationale: Members combine CRH/ACTH/glucocorticoid secretion and stress responses with mating, parental, aggressive, fear and drinking behaviors, which separates it from the sleep/feeding neuropeptide confusables and the glucocorticoid-signaling confusable lacking behavior.

core: HPA-axis glucocorticoid secretion and stress-linked behavior
name: HPA-axis glucocorticoid secretion and stress-linked social behaviors
rationale: Members combine CRH/ACTH-driven corticosteroid secretion and response with stress, fear, mating, parental and aggressive behaviors; the glucocorticoid-secretion arm separates it from the neuropeptide/sleep confusable and the behavioral arm from the glucocorticoid-response confusable.

core: Stress-axis glucocorticoid secretion and innate social behaviors
name: Stress-axis glucocorticoid secretion and innate social behaviors
rationale: Members combine HPA-axis corticotropin/glucocorticoid secretion and stress responses with mating, parental, aggressive and drinking behaviors; the glucocorticoid secretion arm separates it from the neuropeptide/sleep and feeding neighbours.

qualifier: Tie2 and restraint of VEGF sprouting
name: Endothelial stabilization via Tie2 and restraint of VEGF sprouting
rationale: Members negatively regulate VEGF signaling and sprouting while Tie2, adherens-junction and survival terms maintain endothelium, unlike pro-angiogenic or cell-matrix confusables.

qualifier: restraint of angiogenic sprouting and junction control
name: Endothelial VEGFR2 and Tie2 signaling restraining angiogenic sprouting
