rationale: Members describe VEGFR2 and Tie2 signaling, endothelial adherens junction control and negative regulation of sprouting, migration and proliferation, unlike the pro-angiogenic and VEGF-binding confusables.

name: Endothelial stabilization via Tie2, restraining VEGF-driven sprouting
rationale: Members cover Tie2 and VEGFR2 signaling, negative regulation of VEGF responses and sprouting, endothelial survival and adherens junction control, separating it from pro-angiogenic VEGF and integrin/Rac adhesion confusables.

qualifier: cranial and peripheral nerves and specific neuron types
name: Cranial and peripheral nerve development and axon guidance
rationale: Members concern cranial, sensory and sympathetic nerve development, axon guidance of defined neuron types and neuronal migration, without the hindbrain patterning or semaphorin/netrin signaling terms of confusables.

name: Cranial and peripheral nerve development and axon guidance
rationale: Members cover axon guidance and migration of cranial, peripheral ganglion and monoaminergic neurons, unlike confusables on hindbrain patterning, enteric nervous system or semaphorin/netrin guidance signalling.

qualifier: cranial and peripheral nerve and ganglion development
name: Axon guidance and cranial and peripheral nerve development
rationale: Members cover axon guidance of specific neuron types and development of cranial nerves, cranial/dorsal root ganglia and sympathetic/GnRH neuron migration, unlike confusables on hindbrain patterning, spinal cord specification or semaphorin/netrin signalling machinery.

qualifier: ERBB2-driven PTK6 activation and downstream AKT/STAT3
name: PTK6 kinase signaling downstream of ERBB2
rationale: Nine of twelve members are PTK6 expression, activation and effector pathways, joined by ERBB2:ERBB3 downregulation, AKT activation and estrogen membrane signaling; confusables are MET, ALK/LTK, generic ERBB adaptor or EGFR downregulation pathways.

qualifier: ERBB2-coupled, with AKT and estrogen nuclear signalling
name: PTK6 (BRK) signalling downstream of ERBB2
rationale: Most members describe PTK6 expression, activation by ERBB2 and its effectors (STAT3, AKT, RHO/RAS, cell cycle), which distinguishes it from MET and ERBB receptor-proximal signalling confusables.

name: PTK6 non-receptor tyrosine kinase signaling and regulation
rationale: Most members are PTK6 expression, activation by ERBB2 and downstream effects, with AKT activation and ERBB2:ERBB3 downregulation, distinct from ERBB/MET receptor signaling confusables.

name: Exploratory and locomotor behaviour with glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission
rationale: Members combine locomotor, exploratory and sensorimotor-gating behaviours with positive regulation of glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission, which the behaviour-only confusables lack.

name: Locomotor behavior, sensorimotor gating and glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission
rationale: Members include locomotion, exploration, grooming, prepulse inhibition and nonassociative learning plus enhanced glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission, which vocal, cerebellar and touch neighbours lack.

qualifier: sensorimotor gating and glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission enhancement
name: Locomotor behavior, sensorimotor gating and synaptic transmission enhancement
rationale: Members combine exploratory, locomotor, grooming and prepulse-inhibition behaviors with positive regulation of glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission, which confusables on vocal, sensory or cerebellar behavior lack.

core: Negative regulation of cell-matrix adhesion and motility
name: Inhibition of VEGF-driven sprouting angiogenesis and cell-matrix adhesion
rationale: All members negatively regulate sprouting angiogenesis/VEGF signaling or integrin, Rho/Rac and focal adhesion-driven motility, with the angiogenic arm distinguishing it from most confusables.

core: Negative regulation of cell-matrix adhesion and migration
name: Negative regulation of angiogenic sprouting and cell-matrix adhesion
rationale: Members inhibit VEGF-driven endothelial sprouting, chemotaxis and proliferation together with integrin, Rho/Rac, lamellipodium and focal adhesion signaling, a combination no confusable holds.

core: Negative regulation of angiogenesis and adhesion
name: Inhibition of VEGF-driven sprouting angiogenesis and cell-matrix adhesion
rationale: Members negatively regulate VEGF signaling, endothelial sprouting and chemotaxis together with Rho/Rac, integrin and focal adhesion-dependent adhesion, combining the arms its neighbours split.

qualifier: NADPH oxidase ROS and peroxide control
name: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and peroxide control
rationale: Members regulate NADPH oxidase superoxide and H2O2 generation and degradation in phagocytes, unlike confusables on degranulation, Fc/complement receptors and chemotaxis.

name: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and ROS generation
rationale: Members regulate respiratory burst, superoxide and hydrogen peroxide production by phagocyte NADPH oxidase, unlike confusables on neutrophil degranulation, Fc receptor signaling or anti-inflammatory macrophage responses.

qualifier: NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and hydrogen peroxide turnover
name: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and peroxide regulation
rationale: Members regulate NADPH oxidase-driven respiratory burst, superoxide and hydrogen peroxide production and breakdown in phagocytes, which confusables on neutrophil degranulation, Fc/complement receptors and chemotaxis lack.

name: Mechanoresponsive stromal fibroblast extracellular matrix signatures
rationale: Members are ECM, EMT and fibroblast/stromal expression modules including YAP/TAZ-responsive matricellular programmes, distinguishing it from integrin, fibronectin and cell-migration confusables.

name: Mesenchymal fibroblast matrix and stromal secretory programme
rationale: Members are fibroblast/stromal ECM, EMT and mechanoresponsive matricellular modules, distinct from confusables built on integrin, fibronectin and migration signaling.

name: Stromal fibroblast matrix and YAP/TAZ mechanoresponsive programme
rationale: Members are ECM, collagen/TGFB, EMT and fibroblast stromal and YAP/TAZ-matricellular modules plus fibroblast proliferation, unlike integrin, fibronectin and cell-migration confusables.

qualifier: chondroitin/dermatan sulfate degradation (Hurler, Hunter, Sly, Maroteaux-Lamy, Natowicz)
name: Chondroitin/dermatan sulfate degradation mucopolysaccharidoses (Hurler, Hunter, Sly)
rationale: Members are CS/DS and HS proteoglycan catabolism and MPS I, II, VI, VII and IX, whereas confusables carry Sanfilippo, Morquio and keratan sulfate degradation.

name: Chondroitin/dermatan sulfate degradation and mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: Members are CS/DS and heparan sulfate proteoglycan catabolism and MPS I, II, VI, VII and IX, distinguishing them from Morquio (keratan sulfate) and Sanfilippo (heparan sulfate only) confusables.

qualifier: chondroitin/dermatan and heparan sulfate (MPS I, II, VI, VII, IX)
name: Chondroitin/dermatan sulfate degradation in mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: Members are CS/DS and HS proteoglycan catabolism and the MPS I, II, VI, VII and IX defects in it, while confusables add keratan sulfate and Sanfilippo/Morquio types.

core: Camera-type eye morphogenesis and retinal neuron differentiation
qualifier: optic nerve and ganglion cell axon formation
name: Eye morphogenesis, retinal neuron differentiation and optic nerve formation
rationale: All members are developmental steps of the eye (optic cup, iris, eyelid, retinal layering, rod/bipolar/amacrine differentiation), and the optic nerve and retinal ganglion axon guidance members separate it from the lens/cornea and phototransduction confusables.

name: Embryonic eye morphogenesis and retinal neuron differentiation
rationale: Members cover optic cup, iris, eyelid and optic nerve morphogenesis plus differentiation of rod, bipolar, amacrine and ganglion cells, distinguishing it from confusables centred on lens/cornea, ocular vasculature or phototransduction and retinoid metabolism.

name: Camera-type eye morphogenesis and retinal neuron differentiation
rationale: Members cover developmental shaping of the eye (optic cup, iris, eyelid, optic nerve, retina layers) and differentiation of retinal neurons, without the phototransduction/retinoid, lens/cornea or vascular content of the confusables.

core: Endocytic uptake and early endosome sorting
name: Clathrin- and caveolin-mediated endocytosis and early endosome sorting
rationale: Members regulate clathrin cargo recognition, caveolin/raft endocytosis, pinocytosis, transcytosis and early-endosome routing, unlike macropinocytosis/ruffling (C4), recycling (C2) or receptor internalization/degradation (C3).

name: Raft- and caveolin-associated endocytosis and early endosomal sorting
rationale: Members concern raft assembly, caveolin- and clathrin-mediated uptake, pinocytosis regulation, transcytosis and early endosome sorting, unlike macropinocytosis/ruffling, receptor recycling and GLUT4 translocation confusables.

core: Endocytic entry and early endosome sorting
name: Raft-caveolar and clathrin endocytosis with early endosome sorting
rationale: Members concern raft assembly, caveolin and clathrin cargo uptake, pinocytosis, transcytosis and early-to-late/recycling endosome sorting, distinguishing it from macropinocytosis/ruffling, GLUT4 translocation and receptor recycling/degradation confusables.

name: Skeletal muscle growth and atrophy in response to activity
rationale: Members concern skeletal muscle size, atrophy, regeneration and responses to activity or inactivity, unlike calcineurin/NFAT and cardiac muscle adaptation neighbours.

core: Muscle adaptation and cell size regulation
qualifier: skeletal muscle atrophy, growth and regeneration
name: Skeletal muscle mass adaptation: atrophy, growth and regeneration
rationale: Members concern skeletal muscle responses to activity and inactivity, atrophy, growth, cell size and satellite-cell regeneration, distinguishing it from cardiac adaptation and calcineurin-signaling confusables.

qualifier: atrophy and growth in response to activity and inactivity
name: Skeletal muscle mass adaptation to activity and inactivity
rationale: Members concern skeletal muscle atrophy, growth, cell size and regeneration in response to use and disuse, whereas confusables cover calcineurin-NFAT signaling or cardiac muscle adaptation and fiber-type switching.

core: GPCR control of adenylate cyclase and cAMP
name: Gi/Gz-mediated adenylate cyclase inhibition, alpha-2 adrenergic
rationale: Members describe GPCR regulation of adenylate cyclase and cAMP synthesis, centred on inhibitory Gi/Gz coupling via alpha-2 adrenergic receptors, unlike neighbours focused on adrenoceptor secretion control, downstream PKA/PDE, or muscarinic/purinergic receptors.

qualifier: inhibitory Gi/Gz and alpha-2 adrenergic signalling
name: GPCR regulation of adenylate cyclase via inhibitory Gi/Gz signalling
rationale: Members describe GPCR control of cAMP production, dominated by adenylate cyclase inhibition through Gz and alpha-2 adrenergic receptors, distinct from confusables on catecholamine secretion, PKA/PDE downstream events, Gq calcium signalling and muscarinic/purinergic receptors.

name: Adenylate cyclase regulation by Gi/z-coupled alpha-2 adrenergic receptors
rationale: Members concern GPCR control of adenylate cyclase and cAMP production, with emphasis on inhibitory Gi/Gz and alpha-2 adrenergic signalling, unlike confusables centred on cAMP/PKA effectors, cholinergic/purinergic receptors or catecholamine secretion.

qualifier: regulation of extrinsic apoptosis and necroptosis
name: Regulation of death receptor-induced apoptosis and necroptosis
rationale: Members regulate TNF/TRAIL death-receptor apoptosis and necroptosis in either direction, unlike the mitochondrial apoptotic machinery (C1), Fas/caspase-8/T cell death (C2, C3) or core necroptotic signaling (C4).

name: TNF/TRAIL death-receptor control of apoptotic, necroptotic and autophagic death
rationale: Members regulate death-receptor extrinsic apoptosis, necroptosis and autophagic death including TRAIL and anti-tumour defense, versus mitochondrial apoptosis (C1), Fas/T-cell death (C2/C3) and RIPK1 necroptosis alone (C4).

core: Regulation of death-receptor and necrotic cell death
qualifier: necroptosis, autophagic death and tumor-cell killing
name: Regulation of death-receptor apoptosis, necroptosis and tumor-cell killing
rationale: Members are regulatory terms for TRAIL/TNF death-receptor apoptosis, necroptosis, autophagic death and anti-tumor defence, lacking the Fas/caspase-8, BCL2/mitochondrial and RIPK1 mechanism pathways of neighbours.

qualifier: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 in T cells
name: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 γc cytokine signaling in T cells
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 receptor signaling and T cell activation via STAT5, distinct from confusables on IL-3/IL-5/IL-6 family signaling or IL-15/IL-21 NK-cell signaling.

qualifier: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 in T cells
name: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 cytokine signaling in T cells
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 receptor signaling with STAT5 and T-cell activation programs, distinguishing the theme from IL-3/IL-5, IL-6 family and IL-15/IL-21 NK-cell neighbours.

qualifier: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 in T cells
name: IL-2, IL-7 and IL-9 signaling in T cells
rationale: Members are IL-2/STAT5, IL-7 and IL-9 signaling with T cell activation and gamma-delta T cell differentiation, distinct from IL-6/gp130, IL-3/IL-5 and IL-15/IL-21 NK-cell confusables.

name: Cardiomyocyte calcium handling and response to calcium and caffeine
rationale: Members concern cytosolic calcium control in cardiac muscle (Na/Ca exchange, sequestration, membrane potential); responses to calcium and caffeine and calcium-channel activation distinguish it from SR-pump-focused confusables.

name: Cardiomyocyte calcium handling via sodium-calcium exchange and calcium-triggered release
rationale: Members concern cytosolic calcium control in cardiac muscle (Na/Ca exchangers, sequestered calcium release, membrane potential); responses to calcium/caffeine and calcium-channel activation distinguish it from SERCA/relaxation and ryanodine-inhibition confusables.

qualifier: sodium/calcium exchange and voltage-gated channel activation
name: Cardiac calcium homeostasis via sodium/calcium exchange
rationale: Members concern cardiomyocyte calcium handling, membrane potential and lowering cytosolic calcium via Na/Ca exchangers, whereas confusables focus on SERCA/sarcoplasmic reticulum uptake and ryanodine release.

qualifier: NT-3/TRKC with ERK5 and RIT/RIN-p38 arms
name: Neurotrophin-3 TRKC signalling via Ras-MAPK cascades
rationale: Members are NTF3-NTRK3 signalling and its Ras/FRS2/ARMS adaptors feeding ERK5, p38 and MAPK cascades; confusables are NGF/TRKA-centred with CREB and STAT3 outputs.

name: NT-3/TrkC receptor signaling through RAS–MAPK cascades
rationale: Members are NTF3/NTRK3 signaling via RAS, FRS2/ARMS adaptors, ERK5 and RIT/RIN-p38 MAPK cascades, while confusables centre on NGF/TrkA signaling and CREB/STAT3 outputs.

name: TrkC (NTRK3) signalling through Ras-MAPK cascades
rationale: Members are NT-3/NTRK3 signalling via Ras, FRS2/ARMS, RIT/RIN and MAPK/ERK5 cascades, distinguishing it from the NGF/TrkA neighbours.

core: Endocrine steroid and vitamin D hormone synthesis
name: Steroidogenesis, vitamin D and phosphate-mineral homeostasis
rationale: Members combine adrenal/gonadal steroidogenesis and its defects, vitamin D activation, Na/Pi transport, FGF23-Klotho/PTH signaling and tooth/bone mineralization, unlike retinoid/vitamin K, thyroid or mineralization-only confusables.

core: Steroid and vitamin D hormone metabolism
name: Steroidogenesis, vitamin D metabolism and phosphate–mineral homeostasis
rationale: Members combine CYP-driven adrenal/gonadal steroidogenesis and vitamin D metabolism with SLC34/FGF23-Klotho/PTH phosphate handling and tooth/bone mineralization, versus retinoid/vitamin K, thyroid and mineralization-only confusables.

core: Steroid and vitamin D hormone synthesis
name: Steroid and vitamin D hormone synthesis, phosphate-mineral homeostasis
rationale: Members span adrenal/gonadal steroidogenesis and its CYP defects, vitamin D metabolism and FGF23-Klotho/NaPi phosphate handling with tooth and bone mineralization, distinguishing it from thyroid, retinoid and vitamin K confusables.

name: Organelle-selective autophagy, mitophagy and mitochondrial dynamics
rationale: Members span autophagosome formation and lysosomal fusion for mitochondria, peroxisomes, ER and nucleus, with a mitochondrial arm (PINK1-PRKN mitophagy, fission/fusion, protein targeting) that confusables lack.

name: Mitophagy, mitochondrial dynamics and autophagosome-lysosome fusion
rationale: Members are mitophagy, pexophagy/reticulophagy, mitochondrial fission/fusion and targeting, and autophagosome-lysosome fusion; the mitochondrial arm distinguishes it from aggrephagy/CMA and endolysosomal confusables.

name: Selective autophagy with mitophagy and mitochondrial dynamics
rationale: Members span autophagosome formation, selective autophagy and lysosome fusion, with PINK1-PRKN mitophagy, mitochondrial fission/fusion and protein targeting distinguishing it from aggrephagy/CMA and endolysosomal confusables.

qualifier: homing to and development of secondary lymphoid tissue
name: Chemokine-directed leukocyte homing and secondary lymphoid tissue development
rationale: Members cover chemokine receptor/S1P signaling and Rac/Cdc42-driven migration of dendritic, T, B, NK and mast cells plus lymph node and MALT development, unlike integrin-adhesion or monocyte chemokine neighbours.

qualifier: lymphocyte homing and lymphoid tissue development
name: Chemokine-guided leukocyte homing and lymphoid tissue development
rationale: Members cover chemokine receptor and S1P signalling, Rac/Cdc42 motility and homing of DC, B, T, NK and mast cells into lymph nodes and MALT, unlike confusables centred on integrin-mediated migration or monocyte chemokines and T cell extravasation.

name: Chemokine-guided leukocyte chemotaxis and lymphoid organ homing
rationale: Members cover chemokine/S1P receptor signalling (CCR7, CXCR4) with Rac/Cdc42 motility driving T, B, DC, NK and mast cell chemotaxis plus lymph node and mucosal lymphoid tissue development; confusables are integrin-mediated adhesion or monocyte differentiation modules.

name: BDNF, NT-3 and NT-4 signaling via TRKB and TRKC
rationale: Members cover BDNF/NT-3/NT-4 activation of TRKB and TRKC and their downstream RAS, PI3K, PLCG1, ERK5, p38 and CREB effectors, while confusables centre on NGF/TRKA, retrograde signaling or p75NTR.

qualifier: TRKB/TRKC driven by BDNF, NT-3 and NT-4
name: TRKB and TRKC neurotrophin receptor downstream signaling
rationale: Members are BDNF/NT-3/NT-4 activation of NTRK2/NTRK3 and their RAS, PI3K, PLCG1, FRS2, ERK5 and CREB outputs, whereas confusables centre on NGF/TRKA and p75NTR signaling.

name: Neurotrophin TRK signaling, chiefly BDNF/NT-3 via TRKB and TRKC
rationale: All members are neurotrophin-TRK signaling and its downstream RAS, PI3K, PLCG1, ERK5 and CREB arms, with NTRK2/NTRK3 branches that the NGF/TRKA and p75NTR confusables lack.

qualifier: cohesion, condensation and centromeric chromatin assembly
name: Chromosome cohesion, condensation and centromeric chromatin assembly
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading and resolution, chromosome condensation and CENP-A nucleosome deposition; confusables instead emphasise spindle/cytokinesis/nuclear envelope, meiotic recombination or histone acetylation.

name: Sister chromatid cohesion, chromosome condensation and CENP-A deposition
