core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signalling and TKI resistance
name: FLT3 and erythropoietin receptor signalling, TKI-resistant FLT3 mutants
rationale: Members are FLT3 signalling, fusions and drug-resistant FLT3 mutants with EPO/STAT5/CBL signalling, whereas confusables cover ALK, KIT, PDGFR, FGFR mutants or other EPO branches.

name: Adrenal and gonadal steroid hormone biosynthesis
rationale: Members are CYP-mediated pregnenolone, corticosteroid, androgen, estrogen and progesterone synthesis and their defects; the sex-steroid members separate it from corticosteroid-secretion confusables and the steroid focus from vitamin D/retinoid CYP confusables.

qualifier: adrenal and gonadal steroidogenic CYP deficiencies
name: Steroid hormone biosynthesis and steroidogenic CYP deficiencies
rationale: Members span pregnenolone, gluco-, mineralo-corticoid, androgen, estrogen and progesterone synthesis and the CYP11/17/19/21 defects, distinguishing it from aldosterone/cortisol secretion and vitamin D/retinoic acid CYP confusables.

qualifier: sex steroids and CYP enzyme defects
name: Adrenal and gonadal steroidogenesis including CYP enzyme defects
rationale: Members cover pregnenolone, progesterone, gluco/mineralocorticoid, androgen and estrogen synthesis and the CYP deficiency diseases, while confusables concern vitamin D/retinoid CYPs or aldosterone/cortisol secretion without sex steroid synthesis.

core: fibroblast activity and fibrotic tissue repair
name: TGF-beta/SMAD-regulated fibroblast activity and fibrotic repair
rationale: Members cover fibroblast differentiation and survival, extracellular matrix and collagen control and connective tissue replacement, together with positive and negative regulation of TGF-beta/SMAD signaling (including SMAD-linked miRNA control); the TGF-beta/SMAD regulators are what the fibrosis, cardiac and miRNA-processing confusables lack.

name: TGF-beta-SMAD regulation of fibroblast fibrotic remodeling
rationale: Members span TGF-beta receptor/SMAD2/3 signaling and its feedback, plus myofibroblast, collagen, matrix assembly and connective-tissue replacement outputs; confusables share the fibroblast/matrix side but lack the core TGF-beta/SMAD terms (having cardiac muscle, MMP/elastin, or miRNA processing instead).

core: TGF-beta regulation of fibroblast-driven tissue repair
name: TGF-beta–SMAD signaling regulation of fibroblast-driven tissue repair
rationale: Members cover TGF-beta/SMAD2/3 signaling and its downregulation together with fibroblast, myofibroblast, ECM and connective tissue replacement outputs; the SMAD signaling core is what the fibrosis and cardiac-muscle neighbours lack.

qualifier: sterols, quinones and vitamin K gamma-carboxylation
name: Isoprenoid-derived sterols, quinones and vitamin K gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members span the mevalonate/prenyl diphosphate pathway feeding cholesterol, ubiquinol and vitamin K, plus vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation, unlike confusables on cholesterol catabolism/bile acids or vitamin E.

qualifier: cholesterol, ubiquinone and vitamin K-dependent carboxylation
name: Mevalonate isoprenoids: cholesterol, ubiquinone and vitamin K carboxylation
rationale: Members span mevalonate/isoprenoid synthesis feeding cholesterol, ubiquinol and menaquinone, plus vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation, unlike confusables on vitamin E, cholesterol catabolism/bile acids or cytochrome P450 defects.

qualifier: sterols, quinones and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation
name: Mevalonate-derived sterols, quinones and vitamin K-dependent carboxylation
rationale: Members span isoprenoid and cholesterol biosynthesis, ubiquinone/menaquinone metabolism and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation, whereas neighbours add vitamin E, bile acid synthesis or cytochrome P450 disease terms.

name: Two-pore and ATP-sensitive potassium channels in membrane potential
rationale: Members concern K+ channels and Na+/K+ pumps setting resting potential and ion homeostasis, unlike renal sodium transport, magnesium or smooth-muscle confusables.

core: Membrane potential control by potassium channels
qualifier: two-pore, ATP-sensitive and Ca2+-activated K+ channels with Na+/K+ pumps
name: Potassium channels and Na+/K+ gradients setting membrane potential
rationale: Members are K2P, KATP and KCa channels, P-type ATPases and Na+/K+ homeostasis governing resting potential and action potentials, distinguishing it from confusables on renal sodium transport, negative regulation of excitability or hair cell and smooth muscle physiology.

name: Two-pore-domain and ATP-sensitive K+ channels setting resting potential
rationale: Members are K2P, KATP and Ca2+-activated K+ channels, P-type ion pumps and Na+/K+ homeostasis setting resting potential and excitability, unlike confusables on renal Na+/Mg2+ handling or hair-cell and smooth-muscle physiology.

qualifier: neural plate and axial mesoderm specification
name: Neural plate, axial mesoderm and dorsoventral axis specification
rationale: Members specify the neural plate, its border and neural crest, notochord/floor plate and the dorsoventral axis, lacking the hindbrain, planar-polarity convergent extension and spinal cord neuron programs of confusables.

core: Early neural plate and axial patterning
qualifier: axial mesoderm, floor plate and neural plate border
name: Neural plate, border and axial mesoderm midline specification
rationale: Members specify the neural plate, its border/neural crest and the axial mesoderm-notochord-floor plate midline along the dorsoventral axis, unlike confusables about hindbrain HOX, planar polarity/convergent extension or spinal cord patterning.

qualifier: neural plate border and axial mesoderm
name: Neural plate, border and axial mesoderm specification
rationale: Members specify the anterior/posterior neural plate, its border and crest, floor plate, notochord and dorsoventral axis, unlike hindbrain, spinal cord or convergent-extension confusables.

core: Selective autophagy and autophagosome assembly control
name: Organelle-selective, micro- and chaperone-mediated autophagy
rationale: All members concern autophagic cargo delivery (pexophagy, reticulophagy, mitophagy, aggrephagy, microautophagy, CMA) and its assembly regulation, while confusables emphasise PINK1-PRKN mitochondrial dynamics, xenophagy or aggresome/ERAD quality control.

name: Selective autophagy variants including microautophagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy
rationale: All members concern cargo-selective autophagy (mitophagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy, aggrephagy) and autophagosome regulation, and only this theme holds microautophagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy, unlike the PINK1-mitophagy and aggresome/ERAD confusables.

name: Selective autophagy, microautophagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy
rationale: All members concern cargo-selective autophagy (aggrephagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy, receptor mitophagy, nuclear microautophagy, CMA) and autophagosome assembly control, unlike confusables focused on PINK1-PRKN mitophagy and mitochondrial dynamics or aggresome protein quality control.

name: Centriole duplication, centrosome maturation and spindle positioning
rationale: Members regulate centriole duplication, mitotic centrosome protein recruitment (PLK1, AURKA-TPX2, NuMA) and spindle assembly and orientation, unlike confusables on cilia, cytokinesis/kinetochore events or interphase MTOC anchoring.

qualifier: centrosome maturation and duplication, spindle positioning
name: Centrosome maturation, duplication and mitotic spindle positioning
rationale: Members concern centriole duplication, mitotic centrosome protein recruitment via PLK1/AURKA and spindle assembly and orientation, lacking the cytokinesis, kinetochore and cilium members of confusables.

name: Centrosome duplication, maturation and mitotic spindle orientation
rationale: Members regulate centriole duplication, mitotic centrosome maturation (AURKA, PLK1, NuMA) and spindle assembly and positioning, unlike confusables on cytokinesis/checkpoint, cilia or microtubule anchoring.

core: Cofactor metabolism and reactive metabolite detoxification
qualifier: vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactors; reactive carbonyl damage control
name: Vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactors, reactive carbonyl damage control
rationale: Members combine PLP and molybdenum cofactor biosynthesis with detoxification of methylglyoxal, aldehydes and sulfide and repair of protein/DNA damage, distinct from sulfur amino acid, selenium, lipoylation and urea cycle confusables.

core: Reactive aldehyde detoxification and damage repair
qualifier: methylglyoxal glycation repair with vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactors
name: Methylglyoxal detoxification, glycation repair, and vitamin B6/molybdenum cofactors
rationale: Members combine methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and protein/DNA deglycation repair with cofactor (vitamin B6, molybdenum cofactor, sulfide oxidation) metabolism, which amino acid, lipoyl-dehydrogenase and selenium/sulfur confusables lack.

core: Reactive aldehyde detoxification and cofactor metabolism
name: Methylglyoxal-aldehyde detoxification and molybdenum/vitamin B6 cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover aldehyde and methylglyoxal detoxification with protein/DNA glycation repair and molybdenum cofactor, vitamin B6 and sulfide oxidation prosthetic-group metabolism, distinct from sulfur amino acid, glutathione and lipoyl-dehydrogenase confusables.

name: Germ cell development and oocyte meiotic maturation
rationale: Members concern germ cell migration, proliferation and meiotic entry, oocyte maturation and testicular somatic support cells, unlike sex determination (C1) or follicle/gonadotropin endocrinology (C2-C4).

qualifier: meiotic entry, oocyte maturation and testis somatic cells
name: Germline development, meiotic entry and oocyte maturation
rationale: Members concern primordial germ cell migration and proliferation, meiotic activation and G2/MI control in oocyte maturation, plus Sertoli/Leydig and seminiferous tubule development, rather than gonadotropin-driven follicle growth or sex determination in the confusables.

qualifier: meiotic entry, oocyte maturation and testis development
name: Germ cell meiotic entry, oocyte maturation and testis development
rationale: Members cover germ cell proliferation, migration and death, meiosis activation and oocyte maturation plus Sertoli/Leydig/seminiferous tubule development, unlike confusables on gonadotropin-driven ovarian follicle biology or sex determination.

core: Double-stranded RNA sensing and its restraint
qualifier: TLR3 pathway deficiency, PKR and ADAR editing
name: Double-stranded RNA sensing by TLR3/PKR and ADAR editing
rationale: Members are endosomal TLR3–TICAM1–TRAF3 signalling (and its HSE deficiencies), PKR and ADAR A-to-I editing with negative regulation of type I IFN, narrower than the broad antiviral confusable and distinct from TLR3-induced cell death.

core: Double-stranded RNA sensing and type I interferon control
qualifier: TLR3 pathway deficiencies and ADAR RNA editing
name: Double-stranded RNA sensing by TLR3/PKR and ADAR editing
rationale: Members concern dsRNA detection (endosomal TLR3 and its HSE-causing deficiencies, PKR) and its dampening by ADAR A-to-I editing and negative IFN regulation, which confusables lacking TLR3 deficiencies or ADAR editing do not share.

core: Double-stranded RNA sensing and interferon restraint
name: Double-stranded RNA sensing by TLR3/PKR and ADAR editing
rationale: Members concern host handling of dsRNA: endosomal TLR3 pathway (and its HSE deficiencies), PKR, ADAR A-to-I editing and damping of type I IFN signaling; TLR3-HSE and ADAR editing distinguish it from broad antiviral, TLR7/8/9 and TLR3 cell-death neighbours.

name: Ascorbate and tetrahydrobiopterin redox cofactors regulating nitric oxide synthase
rationale: Members cover ascorbate and BH4 metabolism, vitamin C/E responses, superoxide removal, oxygen sensing and oxidoreductase/NOS activation; the BH4-NOS regulation distinguishes it from iron, xenobiotic and general ROS-detoxification confusables.

qualifier: redox and nitric oxide synthase control
name: Ascorbate and tetrahydrobiopterin metabolism in redox and NOS control
rationale: Members cover vitamin C and BH4 synthesis, transport and response with oxidoreductase/NOS activity and superoxide regulation, distinguished from confusables on xenobiotic response, iron homeostasis or general ROS detoxification and NADPH metabolism.

qualifier: nitric oxide synthase and oxidoreductase regulation
name: Ascorbate and tetrahydrobiopterin metabolism in redox enzyme regulation
rationale: Members are vitamin C and BH4 metabolism/transport with regulation of NOS, oxidoreductase and superoxide removal; neighbours concern NADPH/ROS detoxification, iron handling or xenobiotic responses and lack BH4/NOS.

name: Neuroblast proliferation and forebrain dorsoventral patterning
rationale: Members regulate neuroblast/progenitor division, stem cell maintenance and neuron differentiation together with forebrain morphogenesis and patterning (incl. adenohypophysis), unlike confusables on neuronal migration, glial fate or catecholaminergic neurons.

name: Neural progenitor proliferation with forebrain and adenohypophysis patterning
rationale: Members regulate neuroblast/neural stem cell division and differentiation together with forebrain patterning and pituitary development, which the glial, catecholaminergic and cortical migration confusables lack.

name: Neural progenitor proliferation and division in forebrain development
rationale: Members regulate neuroblast/neural stem cell proliferation, asymmetric division and neuron differentiation alongside forebrain patterning; confusables add neuronal migration, glial fate, sympathetic or dopaminergic lineages.

qualifier: anterograde Golgi-to-endosome export and endosomal tubulation
name: Anterograde Golgi-to-endosome traffic and endosome membrane tubulation
rationale: Members cover Golgi vesicle budding and positioning, Golgi-to-endosome and constitutive secretion, endocytosis, early-to-late endosome transport, membrane tubulation and receptor recycling, distinct from confusables on retrograde endosome-to-Golgi, COPI Golgi-ER traffic and Golgi organization.

name: Post-Golgi and endosomal trafficking with membrane tubulation
rationale: Members cover Golgi vesicle budding, constitutive secretion, Golgi-to-endosome and endocytic transport with membrane tubulation and Golgi positioning, unlike neighbours on COPI/Golgi-ER retrograde traffic, Golgi organization and endosome-to-Golgi retrieval.

qualifier: post-Golgi export and endosome membrane tubulation
name: Post-Golgi and endosomal transport with endosome membrane tubulation
rationale: Members are Golgi vesicle budding, constitutive secretion, Golgi-to-endosome and endosomal transport with membrane tubulation and receptor recycling, while confusables center on COPI/Golgi-ER retrograde traffic, Golgi organization and lysosomal targeting.

qualifier: ribbon disassembly/reassembly and intra-Golgi COPI traffic
name: Golgi ribbon disassembly, reassembly and intra-Golgi COPI traffic
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly, reassembly and positioning together with intra-Golgi and COPI retrograde/anterograde traffic, whereas confusables emphasise vesicle budding, membrane tubulation or Golgi-to-ER retrieval alone.

name: Golgi ribbon disassembly-reassembly and intra-Golgi trafficking
rationale: Members concern Golgi ribbon/stack organization, disassembly, reassembly and positioning together with intra-Golgi and retrograde traffic, unlike confusables limited to vesicle budding or COPI retrograde traffic.

name: Golgi ribbon disassembly, reassembly and intra-Golgi traffic
rationale: Members concern Golgi ribbon formation, positioning, mitotic disassembly/reassembly and intra-Golgi/retrograde COPI traffic, while confusables cover only vesicle budding, membrane tubulation or Golgi retention.

name: HIF hypoxic response with glycolysis and oxygen transport
rationale: Members combine HIF stabilisation and hypoxic gene regulation with glycolytic glucose catabolism and erythroid oxygen transport, which the glycolysis-regulation and gluconeogenesis confusables lack.

name: HIF hypoxia response, glycolysis and erythroid oxygen transport
rationale: Members combine HIF-alpha oxygen sensing and hypoxic gene regulation with glucose catabolism, plus erythrocyte differentiation and oxygen transport, which distinguish it from confusables limited to glycolysis regulation (mTORC1/p53, fructose-2,6-bisphosphate) or gluconeogenesis.

name: HIF hypoxia response, glycolysis and erythroid oxygen transport
rationale: Members combine HIF-alpha oxygen sensing and hypoxia gene programmes with glucose catabolism, plus erythrocyte differentiation and oxygen transport, which the glycolysis-regulation, mTORC1/p53 and gluconeogenesis confusables lack.

qualifier: host and viral control of entry, genome replication and release
name: Host and virus control of viral entry, replication and release
rationale: Members are host- or virus-driven positive and negative regulation of viral entry, transport, replication, protein levels and release, lacking the interferon/ISG15 programmes and endocytic entry routes of the confusables.

name: Regulation of viral entry, replication and release
rationale: Members regulate viral entry, genome replication, protein levels and release by host or virus, without the interferon/ISG15 programmes or receptor-mediated virion endocytosis of the confusables.

core: Viral life cycle regulation in host
qualifier: entry, genome replication and release, independent of interferon
name: Host regulation of viral entry, replication and release
rationale: Members share host- and virus-driven control of viral entry, replication, protein levels and release, lacking the interferon/ISG15 signatures of most confusables and the endocytic attachment steps of the entry confusable.

qualifier: G12/13 and Sema4D inputs to Rho-ROCK/PAK, RND GTPases
name: Rho-ROCK signaling from G12/13 and Sema4D, with RND GTPases
rationale: Members share Rho activation via G12/13-coupled GPCRs and Sema4D-plexin-B, its ROCK/PAK effectors and the RND1-3 cycles, distinct from confusables on Sema3A, RAC/CDC42 GTPase cycles or ephrin-driven cytoskeletal signaling.

name: Rho/Rnd GTPase signaling downstream of G12/13 and Sema4D
rationale: Members are G alpha 12/13 and Sema4D inputs to Rho, Rnd1-3 cycles and ROCK/PAK effectors, unlike confusables on Rac/Cdc42 cycles or Sema3A-plexin axon repulsion.

core: Rho GTPase signaling to ROCK and PAK
qualifier: via G alpha 12/13 GPCRs, Sema4D and Rnd GTPases
name: Rho-ROCK signaling via Galpha12/13, Sema4D and Rnd GTPases
rationale: Members share Rho pathway activation by G alpha 12/13 GPCRs and Sema4D plus Rnd1-3 cycles and ROCK/PAK effectors, unlike confusables on Sema3A repulsion, Rac/Cdc42 cycles or filopodia and ephrin signaling.

core: Gq-coupled GPCR signaling via phospholipase C
name: Purinergic GPCR signaling through phospholipase C and calcium
rationale: Members share P2Y/P1 receptor signaling with extracellular ATP release and hydrolysis feeding PLC/IP3/calcium, distinct from eicosanoid GPCR, Wnt-calcium and calcium-import neighbours.

name: Purinergic and lysophospholipid GPCR signaling via phospholipase C
rationale: Members concern P2Y/adenosine purinergic and LPA/S1P receptor signaling, extracellular ATP release and hydrolysis, and PLC-IP3 calcium signaling, setting it apart from prostanoid/leukotriene GPCRs and Wnt/calcium confusables.

qualifier: extracellular ATP release and hydrolysis, PLC activation
name: Purinergic GPCR signaling and extracellular ATP turnover
rationale: Members center on P2Y/adenosine receptor signaling, ATP export and NTPDase hydrolysis with PLC-IP3-calcium coupling, unlike confusables on generic calcium elevation, Wnt-calcium or eicosanoid receptors.

core: Execution phase of regulated cell death
qualifier: apoptotic nuclear dismantling and necroptosis regulation
name: Apoptotic execution-phase nuclear dismantling and necroptosis regulation
rationale: Members concern the execution phase of apoptosis (DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation, lamina breakdown) and regulation of necroptotic death; this terminal stage distinguishes it from mitochondrial, p53 and death-receptor initiation confusables.

qualifier: apoptotic DNA fragmentation and nuclear breakdown
name: Apoptotic execution phase and nuclear DNA fragmentation
rationale: Members concern the execution phase of cell death (DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation, lamina breakdown, with necroptosis regulation), distinguishing it from mitochondrial/BCL2, p53, death-receptor and RIPK1 initiation confusables.

qualifier: apoptotic nuclear dismantling and necroptosis control
name: Apoptotic nuclear dismantling and necroptosis regulation
rationale: Members are the execution phase of apoptosis (DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation, lamina breakdown) plus regulation of necroptosis, unlike neighbours on extrinsic, mitochondrial intrinsic or RIPK1 necroptotic signaling.

core: tRNA and rRNA modification and maturation
qualifier: aminoacylation and cytosolic rRNA modification for translational fidelity
name: tRNA and rRNA modification, maturation and aminoacylation
rationale: Members are dominated by tRNA processing, modification and charging plus cytosolic rRNA and mRNA modifications serving translational fidelity, lacking the mitochondrial gene-expression and protein-hydroxylation members of confusables.

core: tRNA and rRNA modification and maturation
qualifier: for translational fidelity, including cytosolic rRNA modification
name: tRNA and rRNA modification and maturation for translational fidelity
rationale: Members span tRNA processing, modification and aminoacylation, rRNA methylation/pseudouridylation, RNA editing and translational fidelity; confusables are dominated by mitochondrial gene expression or protein-level translation factor modification.

name: tRNA and rRNA modification, aminoacylation and translational fidelity
rationale: Members span tRNA/rRNA processing and chemical modification, tRNA charging, diphthamide and translation termination fidelity, unlike the mitochondrial gene expression, protein modification and selenocysteine confusables.

qualifier: Golgi organization, COPI and endosome-Golgi retrograde and lysosomal sorting routes
name: Golgi structure and Golgi-centred vesicle traffic
rationale: Members cover Golgi assembly/disassembly and ribbon formation, COPI and Golgi-ER retrograde traffic, endosome-to-Golgi and Golgi-to-lysosome transport; confusables instead hold endocytic recycling to the plasma membrane and ARF/RAB GAP signaling.

qualifier: COPI, endosome-Golgi retrograde and lysosomal sorting routes
name: Golgi organization and COPI/retrograde vesicle traffic
rationale: Members concern Golgi structure (assembly, ribbon, stacking) and Golgi-centred vesicle budding/fusion to ER, endosomes and lysosomes, whereas confusables concern endocytic recycling to the plasma membrane.

qualifier: Golgi organization, COPI and endosome-Golgi-lysosome routes
name: Golgi organization and Golgi-centred vesicle trafficking
rationale: Members cover Golgi structure, COPI traffic, endosome-to-Golgi retrograde and Golgi-to-lysosome/secretory routes, whereas confusables concern endocytic recycling to the plasma membrane.

name: SUMO conjugation and regulated nucleocytoplasmic protein transport
rationale: Members are SUMO processing, conjugation and target SUMOylation (including viral nucleoproteins) plus regulation of nuclear protein import/export, unlike confusables on nuclear envelope/pore assembly or PML bodies.

name: Protein SUMOylation and regulation of nucleocytoplasmic protein transport
rationale: Members are the SUMO conjugation cycle and its targets (including viral nucleoproteins) plus regulation of nuclear import/export, without the nuclear pore, envelope or PML body content of neighbours.

name: SUMOylation of host and viral proteins, nucleocytoplasmic transport control
rationale: Members are the SUMO processing/conjugation cascade and its targets, viral nucleoprotein maturation and regulation of nuclear import/export; confusables cover nuclear pore assembly, nuclear envelope dynamics or PML body/senescence.

core: Nucleoside and nucleotide transport and interconversion
qualifier: ADP/ATP phosphotransfer including mitochondrial exchange and creatine
name: Nucleoside transport and ADP/ATP phosphotransfer
rationale: Members combine plasma-membrane nucleoside/nucleobase transport with nucleotide kinase interconversion, mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange and phosphocreatine, distinguishing it from NAD, NUDT/thiopurine and xenobiotic transport confusables.

core: Nucleotide and nucleoside transport and interconversion
qualifier: mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange and phosphocreatine phosphotransfer
name: Nucleoside transport, mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange and phosphotransfer
rationale: Members cover plasma-membrane nucleoside/nucleobase transport (and nucleoside-analog drugs), mitochondrial adenine nucleotide exchange and NDP/NTP and creatine phosphotransfer, unlike NUDT/thiopurine, NAD and xenobiotic-efflux neighbours.

qualifier: mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange and creatine phosphotransfer
name: Nucleoside transport and nucleotide phosphotransfer, including mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
rationale: Members combine plasma-membrane nucleoside/nucleobase and analogue-drug transport with nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion, creatine phosphotransfer and mitochondrial ADP/ATP carrier function, which confusables (NUDT/thiopurine, xenobiotic efflux, NAD metabolism) lack.

qualifier: aromatic amino acids, histidine, threonine and proline
name: Catabolism of aromatic amino acids, histidine, threonine and proline
rationale: Members are degradation and interconversion of phenylalanine/tyrosine, histidine, threonine, proline and glycine/glyoxylate; confusables add glutamate/aspartate, conjugation or BH4 metabolism and lack histidine catabolism.

qualifier: aromatic, histidine, threonine and pyrimidine degradation
name: Amino acid catabolism spanning aromatics, histidine, threonine and pyrimidines
rationale: Members are amino acid metabolism focused on Phe/Tyr, His, Thr, Pro and glycine/glyoxylate catabolism plus pyrimidine nucleobase breakdown; histidine and pyrimidine catabolism distinguish it from the broader central amino acid neighbours.

name: Aromatic, histidine, proline and threonine amino acid catabolism
rationale: Members are degradation and interconversion of phenylalanine/tyrosine, histidine, proline, threonine/glycine and glyoxylate; histidine and aromatic catabolism separate it from glutamate/aspartate, glycine-conjugation and BH4 confusables.

name: Mismatch repair and B cell immunoglobulin diversification
rationale: Members are mismatch repair and its inherited defects together with somatic hypermutation, class switching, V(D)J recombination and B lineage commitment; the B cell diversification arm separates it from proliferating T cell and TGF-beta mutant neighbours, and the MMR arm from base excision repair and APOBEC editing neighbours.

qualifier: immunoglobulin gene diversification in B cells
name: Mismatch repair and B cell immunoglobulin gene diversification
rationale: Members are MMR and its defects plus somatic hypermutation, class switching, V(D)J recombination and B cell commitment, unlike T cell proliferation, TGF-beta cancer mutant, base excision or APOBEC confusables.

qualifier: immunoglobulin somatic diversification in B cells
name: Mismatch repair and immunoglobulin somatic diversification in B cells
rationale: Members are MutS/MutL mismatch repair and its defects plus somatic hypermutation, class switching, V(D)J recombination and B cell commitment, unlike TGFBR cancer mutant, APOBEC, T cell division or base excision repair confusables.

qualifier: selective cargo autophagy and autophagosome assembly regulation
name: Selective autophagy and autophagosome assembly regulation
rationale: Members span cargo-selective autophagy (mitophagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy, aggrephagy, micro- and chaperone-mediated) and regulation of autophagosome assembly/maturation, whereas confusables cover lysosome fusion, aggresomes or ESCRT/MVB.

qualifier: cargo-specific and microautophagy with autophagosome biogenesis control
name: Selective macro- and microautophagy and autophagosome biogenesis regulation
rationale: Members span cargo-selective autophagy (mito-, pexo-, reticulo-, aggre-, xenophagy), CMA, microautophagy and autophagosome assembly/maturation control, unlike confusables on lysosomal fusion, ESCRT or aggresome assembly.

name: Selective autophagy and autophagosome assembly regulation
rationale: Members cover cargo-selective autophagy (mito-, pex-, aggre-, reticulo-, micro- and chaperone-mediated) and regulation of autophagosome formation, whereas confusables cover lysosome fusion and ESCRT/endosomal sorting.

name: Catecholamine reuptake and monoamine oxidative degradation
rationale: Members cover dopamine/norepinephrine synthesis, SLC6A2/SLC6A3 reuptake and their defects, and MAO/COMT catabolism of monoamines, distinct from serotonin synthesis/uptake and vesicular loading neighbours.

core: Catecholamine and monoamine reuptake and catabolism
name: Catecholamine reuptake and MAO/COMT-mediated monoamine degradation
rationale: Members cover dopamine/norepinephrine transport and reuptake (with transporter defects) and monoamine oxidative deamination and COMT degradation, distinct from confusables on catecholamine synthesis and vesicular release or serotonin synthesis.

name: Catecholamine reuptake and monoamine oxidative catabolism
rationale: Members concern dopamine/norepinephrine reuptake transporters and MAO/COMT degradation of biogenic amines, unlike confusables focused on serotonin synthesis or catecholamine synthesis and vesicular release.

core: Cardiac contractility and heart rate regulation
name: Sarcoplasmic calcium regulation of cardiac contractility and heart rate
rationale: Members regulate SR calcium uptake/release and plasma-membrane calcium flux to set cardiac force, relaxation and rate, unlike confusables on skeletal ryanodine/store-operated calcium, gap-junction conduction or action potentials.

qualifier: sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling and heart rate
name: Calcium-cycling control of cardiac contraction, relaxation and heart rate
rationale: Members regulate cardiac force, relaxation and rate through SR calcium uptake/release and Ca-ATPase activity, unlike confusables on gap-junction conduction, store-operated entry or skeletal ryanodine release.

qualifier: via sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling and heart rate
name: Calcium-handling control of cardiac contractility and heart rate
rationale: Members regulate heart rate, contractile force and relaxation through SR calcium uptake/release and membrane calcium flux, unlike confusables on cardiac conduction, skeletal ryanodine/store-operated calcium or action potential suppression.

qualifier: DNA topology, R-loop and protein-DNA crosslink resolution
name: Replication stress response and DNA topology resolution
rationale: Fork reversal, R-loop processing, topological change, topoisomerase-poison and hydroxyurea responses and protein-DNA crosslink repair distinguish it from neighbours on telomere maintenance, ADP-ribosylation and transcription termination.

qualifier: fork reversal and DNA topological maintenance
name: Replication fork stress response and DNA topological maintenance
rationale: Members concern replication fork reversal, R-loops, topological change, topoisomerase cross-link repair and hydroxyurea/camptothecin responses, unlike confusables on telomere maintenance, ADP-ribosylation or chromatin assembly.

name: Replication stress response and DNA topological maintenance
rationale: Members concern fork reversal, R-loop processing, DNA topological change, protein-DNA crosslink repair and responses to hydroxyurea and camptothecin, whereas confusables focus on telomere maintenance or ADP-ribosylation.

name: TBK1/IKKe-IRF3-driven interferon-beta production and its regulation
rationale: Members regulate nucleic-acid-sensor to TBK1/IKKe-IRF3 induction of IFN-alpha/beta (RIG-I, MDA5, cGAS/STING, TLR3), which confusables lack in favour of broader antiviral effector or NF-kB outputs.

qualifier: TBK1-IRF3 regulation by nucleic acid sensors
name: Regulation of TBK1-IRF3-driven type I interferon production
rationale: Members regulate IRF3/TBK1 induction of IFN-alpha/beta downstream of RIG-I, MDA5, TLR3 and cGAS-STING, a narrower regulatory core than confusables that add broad antiviral, NF-kB, ZBP1 and chemokine pathways.

name: Regulation of TBK1-IRF3-mediated type I interferon induction
rationale: Members regulate cytosolic sensor (RIG-I/MDA5, cGAS) signaling through TBK1/IKKe to IRF3 and IFN-alpha/beta production; confusables add broader antiviral effector, NF-kappaB, chemokine and virus-specific modules.

qualifier: with cilium assembly, disassembly and basal body anchoring
name: Centrosome positioning, centriole duplication and ciliogenesis control
rationale: Members regulate centrosome location, centriole cohesion/duplication/elongation, MTOC microtubule nucleation and primary cilium assembly/disassembly, whereas confusables concern mitotic spindle orientation and mitotic centrosome maturation.

qualifier: centriole duplication and primary cilium assembly/disassembly
name: Centrosome, centriole duplication and primary cilium regulation
rationale: Members regulate centrosome positioning, MTOC nucleation, centriole duplication/cohesion and basal body/cilium assembly, whereas confusables concern mitotic spindle assembly and orientation.

qualifier: centriole duplication and primary cilium assembly control
name: Centrosome organization and primary cilium assembly regulation
rationale: Members concern centrosome positioning, microtubule nucleation and centriole duplication plus basal body anchoring and cilium assembly/disassembly, which the mitotic spindle confusables lack.

qualifier: serotonin, muscarinic and adenosine receptors controlling cAMP
name: Serotonin, muscarinic and adenosine receptor cAMP signaling
rationale: Members are serotonin, muscarinic acetylcholine and adenosine receptor signaling with adenylate cyclase inhibition and cAMP breakdown, unlike confusables on nicotinic, histamine, tachykinin or adrenergic receptors.

name: cAMP regulation by serotonin, muscarinic and adenosine receptors
rationale: Members are serotonin, muscarinic and adenosine/purinergic receptor signalling coupled to adenylate cyclase, PLC and PDE1-mediated cAMP breakdown, unlike serotonin metabolism, adrenergic, nicotinic and tachykinin confusables.

qualifier: serotonin, muscarinic and adenosine receptors controlling cAMP
name: Serotonin, muscarinic and adenosine receptor signaling to cAMP
rationale: Members are serotonin, muscarinic and adenosine receptor pathways with adenylate cyclase inhibition and cAMP degradation, distinguishing it from adrenergic, nicotinic, histamine and tachykinin confusables.

name: Pre-rRNA processing and ribosomal subunit nuclear export
rationale: Members cover Pol I rRNA transcription, pre-rRNA cleavage, ribosome assembly and subunit export with MYC growth targets, restricted to ribosome biogenesis unlike confusables spanning Pol II/III transcription, splicing and snRNA processing.

qualifier: MYC-driven, with pre-rRNA cleavage and subunit export
name: MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis and pre-rRNA processing
rationale: Members cover Pol I rRNA transcription, pre-rRNA cleavages, ribosome assembly and subunit nuclear export plus MYC target sets, distinguishing them from confusables built on Pol II/III transcription machinery, splicing, snoRNA/telomerase or exosome RNA decay.

qualifier: MYC-driven, through pre-rRNA cleavage and subunit nuclear export
name: MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis and subunit nuclear export
rationale: Members span Pol I rRNA elongation, ETS/ITS pre-rRNA cleavages, ribosome assembly, subunit export and MYC target sets; the export/assembly and MYC components separate it from neighbours centred on general transcription machinery or RNA modification and decay.

qualifier: IL-12 family, IL-10 and IL-15/IL-21 with NK cell expansion
name: IL-12 family, IL-10 and IL-15/21 signaling with NK expansion
rationale: All members are IL-10, IL-12-family (IL-12/23/27/35) or IL-15/IL-21 signaling and the NK-cell differentiation/proliferation they drive, unlike confusables centred on type III interferon/IL-20, NKT cells or IL-2/7/9.

qualifier: IL-12 family, IL-10, IL-15/IL-21 with NK cell expansion
name: IL-12 family, IL-10 and IL-15/IL-21 signaling with NK expansion
rationale: All members are IL-12-family (IL-12/23/27/35), IL-10, IL-15/IL-21 cytokine signaling or the NK-cell proliferation and differentiation they drive, distinguishing it from the IL-20/type III interferon and IL-2/7/9 confusables.

qualifier: IL-12/IL-10 family plus IL-15/IL-21 and NK cell expansion
name: IL-12/IL-10 family and IL-15/IL-21 cytokine signaling
rationale: All members are signaling by IL-10, IL-12-family (IL-12, IL-23, IL-27, IL-35) or IL-15/IL-21 cytokines and their NK-cell effects, unlike the IL-2/7/9 common-gamma-chain theme or the IL-10/IL-20/type III interferon theme lacking IL-15/IL-21.

qualifier: protein import and very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation
name: Peroxisomal protein import and very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members combine peroxisomal matrix/membrane protein import and fission with VLCFA beta-oxidation, unlike medium-chain fatty acid or pexophagy confusables.

qualifier: protein import and very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation
name: Peroxisomal protein import and very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members combine peroxisomal matrix/membrane protein import and fission with acyl-CoA oxidase beta-oxidation of very-long-chain fatty acids, which the other fatty acid catabolism and pexophagy confusables lack.

qualifier: protein import and very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation
name: Peroxisomal protein import and very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members cover peroxisomal matrix/membrane protein import and VLCFA beta-oxidation (including ALD), distinguishing them from pexophagy and medium-chain fatty acid confusables.

qualifier: scrambling, blebbing and mechanical stress repair
name: Phospholipid flipping/scrambling and membrane mechanical stress response
rationale: Members share aminophospholipid flippase/scramblase activity together with membrane blebbing, repair, cell volume and pressure responses, distinguishing it from ER lipid transfer, apical trafficking and apoptotic PS-clearance confusables.

qualifier: scrambling in membrane repair and mechanical stress
name: Phospholipid flipping and scrambling in membrane repair and mechanosensing
rationale: Members center on aminophospholipid flipping and Ca-activated scrambling together with membrane repair, blebbing, cell volume and pressure/mechanical load responses; confusables instead have ER lipid transfer, apical trafficking or apoptotic-cell clearance.

qualifier: flipping/scrambling with membrane repair and mechanical stress
name: Membrane phospholipid flipping, scrambling and mechanical stress response
rationale: Members cover aminophospholipid flipping and Ca-activated scrambling alongside membrane repair, blebbing, cell volume and pressure/mechanical load, unlike ER lipid-transfer, apoptotic-cell clearance or apical transport neighbours.

qualifier: with hair cycle, melanocyte and sebaceous niches
name: Keratinocyte proliferation-differentiation control in epidermis and pilosebaceous unit
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis together with anagen, melanocyte and sebaceous gland development; confusables focus on wound re-epithelialisation, cornification, nail/hair follicle morphogenesis or MITF pigmentation.

name: Keratinocyte and melanocyte proliferation–differentiation control in skin
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis plus melanocyte proliferation, anagen and sebaceous gland development, distinguishing it from cornification/barrier, wound healing and melanin synthesis neighbours.

qualifier: hair cycle, sebaceous gland and melanocyte growth
name: Keratinocyte proliferation–differentiation control with hair-cycle and melanocyte growth
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis together with anagen, sebaceous gland and melanocyte proliferation/differentiation; the appendage and melanocyte terms separate it from cornification/barrier and MITF-pigmentation confusables.

qualifier: with Golgi vesicle targeting and tethering
name: Rab/ARF GTPase cycle and Golgi vesicle tethering
rationale: Members cover Rab prenylation, GEF/GAP control and ARF signalling plus vesicle targeting/tethering to the Golgi, unlike confusables focused on COPI/COPII coats or Golgi organization.

core: Rab/ARF GTPase regulation of vesicle traffic
qualifier: Rab prenylation, GEF/GAP cycle and vesicle tethering to Golgi
name: Rab/ARF GTPase regulation and Golgi vesicle tethering
rationale: Members cover Rab GEFs, GAPs, geranylgeranylation and ARF signalling plus vesicle targeting/tethering to the Golgi, distinguishing it from confusables on COPI/COPII coats, Golgi organisation and SNARE docking.

core: Vesicle targeting and tethering to Golgi
name: Rab GTPase regulation and vesicle tethering at Golgi
rationale: Members combine Rab GEF/GAP control, Rab geranylgeranylation and ARF signalling with vesicle targeting/tethering to the Golgi, distinct from confusables centred on COPI/COPII coats, Golgi structure or SNARE docking.

core: Dendritic cell-driven CD4 T cell activation
name: Dendritic cell maturation, T cell costimulation and Treg differentiation
rationale: Members cover dendritic cell differentiation/activation and the costimulation, proliferation and Treg/Th17 fate of CD4 T cells they prime, distinguishing it from NK/tolerance and negative T cell regulation confusables.

qualifier: DC differentiation and CD4 T cell costimulation
name: Dendritic cell differentiation and costimulatory CD4 T cell activation
rationale: Members cover dendritic cell differentiation/activation and the costimulation-driven activation and Treg/Th17 differentiation of CD4 T cells, whereas confusables emphasize T cell inhibition, NK receptors and tolerance.

core: Dendritic cell-driven CD4 T cell activation
qualifier: costimulation and regulatory T cell differentiation
name: Dendritic cell maturation, T cell costimulation and Treg induction
rationale: Members concern dendritic cell differentiation/activation and the TCR-MHC costimulatory activation of CD4 T cells biased toward Treg over Th17, unlike confusables centred on NK cells, tolerance/anergy or negative T cell regulation.

qualifier: RAS/RAB prenylation and Wnt ligand acylation
name: RAS/RAB prenylation and Wnt ligand lipidation for secretion
rationale: Members concern lipid modification of proteins (geranylgeranylation of RAS/RAB, PORCN acylation of Wnt) and resulting trafficking, distinguishing it from Hedgehog palmitoylation and phospholipid-transfer confusables.

qualifier: RAB/RAS prenylation and Porcupine Wnt acylation
name: RAB/RAS prenylation and Porcupine-mediated Wnt lipidation
rationale: Members concern lipid modification of proteins: geranylgeranylation of RAB and RAS processing plus PORCN acylation in Wnt secretion; prenylation and Wnt lipidation distinguish it from Hedgehog palmitoylation and phospholipid-transfer confusables.

qualifier: Rab/Ras prenylation and Wnt ligand lipidation
name: Rab/Ras prenylation and Wnt ligand lipidation
rationale: Members concern geranylgeranylation of Rabs, Ras processing and PORCN-dependent Wnt lipidation and secretion, whereas confusables involve Hedgehog palmitoylation or phospholipid transfer.

name: IFN-gamma signalling and MHC expression regulation
rationale: Members are type II interferon signalling and its regulation, MHC class I/II induction and T cell antigen presentation, unlike the Th1 differentiation, IL-12 and dendritic cytokine confusables.

qualifier: MHC class I/II induction and T cell antigen presentation
name: Interferon-gamma signaling and MHC class I/II induction
rationale: Members are IFN-gamma signaling and its regulation with MHC class I/II expression and CD8 T cell responses, unlike confusables centred on Th1 differentiation, IL-12 and dendritic cell cytokines.

qualifier: MHC expression and T cell antigen presentation
name: Interferon-gamma signalling and MHC antigen presentation regulation
rationale: Members cover type II interferon signalling and its regulation together with MHC class I/II expression, T cell antigen presentation and CD8 T cell proliferation, unlike Th1 differentiation and dendritic cell/IL-12 cytokine confusables.

qualifier: eIF2alpha kinases (HRI, GCN2), ATF4 and mitochondrial stress
name: eIF2alpha kinase integrated stress response and translational control
rationale: Members concern stress-induced eIF2alpha kinase (HRI, GCN2) signalling, ATF4 induction, translational repression and mitochondrial stress, unlike confusables centred on IRE1/ATF6/XBP1 branches of the ER unfolded protein response.

qualifier: via eIF2-alpha kinases HRI, GCN2 and mitochondrial stress
name: Integrated stress response via eIF2-alpha kinases and mitochondrial stress
rationale: All members concern stress-induced eIF2-alpha/ATF4 translational control and unfolded protein responses; HRI, GCN2 and mitochondrial UPR members set it apart from the ATF6/IRE1/XBP1 ER-stress confusables.

qualifier: eIF2α kinase (HRI, GCN2) and ATF4 arm, including mitochondrial stress
name: eIF2α kinase–ATF4 integrated stress response and translational control
rationale: All members concern stress-induced eIF2α phosphorylation, translational repression and ATF4 output (HRI, GCN2, mitochondrial UPR, ATF4 targets), which separates the theme from confusables built on the ATF6/XBP1/IRE1 ER chaperone arms.

name: Serotonin and tachykinin receptor signaling in gastrointestinal motility
rationale: Members cover serotonin and tachykinin receptor signaling with gastric/intestinal smooth muscle contraction, motility and acid secretion; confusables involve histamine, muscarinic or general smooth muscle contraction.

name: Serotonin and tachykinin receptor signaling in gastrointestinal motility
rationale: Members are serotonin and tachykinin receptor signaling with gut smooth muscle contraction, gastric motility, acid secretion and stomach development; confusables are general smooth muscle, histamine or muscarinic signaling.

name: Serotonin and tachykinin receptor control of gastrointestinal motility
rationale: Members are serotonin and tachykinin receptor signaling and GI smooth muscle contraction, gastric motility and acid secretion; confusables are general/urogenital smooth muscle, histamine/itch or muscarinic signaling.

name: Hindbrain, cranial nerve and enteric nervous system development
rationale: Members cover brainstem/pons maturation, branchiomotor, trigeminal and facial nerve development and brainstem-driven behaviours, and the enteric/autonomic neural crest and peristalsis members separate it from spinal cord and cranial ganglion confusables.

qualifier: with enteric and autonomic neural crest
name: Hindbrain, cranial nerve and enteric nervous system development
rationale: Members cover hindbrain/brainstem maturation, branchiomotor and trigeminal/facial nerve development and brainstem-controlled behaviours (suckling, respiration), plus enteric/autonomic neural crest and peristalsis, which the spinal-cord-patterning confusables lack.

qualifier: enteric and autonomic neural crest, gut motility
name: Hindbrain and enteric nervous system development
rationale: Members cover hindbrain/brainstem and cranial nerve development and brainstem-controlled functions (suckling, respiration); enteric nervous system, autonomic neural crest migration and peristalsis separate it from spinal cord and peripheral ganglia confusables.

name: Calcineurin-NFAT control of cardiomyocyte hypertrophy and cell size
rationale: Members regulate calcineurin-NFAT signalling, cardiomyocyte growth, cell size and stress hypertrophy, whereas confusables concern skeletal muscle growth, atrophy, fibre-type switching or regeneration.

name: Calcineurin-NFAT control of cardiomyocyte hypertrophy and cell size
rationale: Members regulate calcineurin-NFAT signalling, cardiac muscle adaptation, stress hypertrophy and cell size/sarcomere organization, while confusables concern skeletal muscle atrophy, fibre-type transition or regeneration.

name: Calcineurin-NFAT control of cardiomyocyte hypertrophy and cell size
rationale: Members regulate cardiac muscle cell growth, adaptation and size, sarcomere organization and calcineurin-NFAT signalling, whereas confusables concern skeletal muscle growth, atrophy or regeneration.

name: Ear and olfactory placode derivative development
rationale: Members are morphogenesis of inner, middle and outer ear plus olfactory nerve, nose, cranial ganglia and GnRH neuron migration from the olfactory placode, setting it apart from confusables about face/skull, eye or gland development.

name: Ear, nose and cranial sensory placode development
rationale: Members cover inner, middle and outer ear, olfactory/nose, cranial ganglion and GnRH neuron migration development, all placode-associated sensory structures, unlike gland, face/limb or eye-focused confusables.

qualifier: cranial sensory nerves and olfactory-derived GnRH neuron migration
name: Ear, nose and cranial sensory nerve development
rationale: Members are morphogenesis of ear and nose structures plus olfactory/vestibulocochlear nerves, cranial ganglia and olfactory-placode GnRH neuron migration, setting it apart from eye, gland and general craniofacial confusables.

name: Intermembrane lipid transfer and Rab geranylgeranylation
rationale: Members combine non-vesicular transfer of glycolipids, PI and PC between membranes with Rab geranylgeranylation and GEF activation; the Rab prenylation arm distinguishes it from flippase, phospholipid catabolism and Golgi traffic neighbours, and glycolipid transport from the Wnt secretion neighbour.

core: Membrane lipid and Rab identity at ER-Golgi
qualifier: non-vesicular lipid transfer and Rab prenylation
name: Intermembrane lipid transfer and Rab GTPase prenylation/activation
rationale: Members combine ER-Golgi phospholipid/glycolipid transfer with Rab geranylgeranylation and GEF activation; the glycolipid transfer separates it from Wnt secretion and the Rab prenylation from lipid hydrolysis, vesicle traffic and flippase confusables.

name: Non-vesicular lipid transfer and Rab geranylgeranylation
rationale: Members combine protein-mediated transfer of glycolipids, ceramide-1-phosphate and phospholipids between membranes with Rab prenylation and GEF activation; flippase, vesicular traffic and phospholipid catabolism confusables lack the Rab prenylation or glycolipid transfer members.

core: Direct DNA alkylation reversal and DNA demethylation
name: Direct DNA alkylation reversal, DNA demethylation and methionine salvage
rationale: Members are oxidative/direct removal of alkyl and methyl groups from DNA (ALKBH, MGMT, TET) together with methionine salvage, unlike base-excision-repair confusables.

core: Removal of methyl and alkyl groups from DNA
name: Direct DNA dealkylation and demethylation with methionine salvage
rationale: Members are direct alkylation-damage reversal (MGMT, ALKBH2/3), TET/TDG 5-methylcytosine demethylation and methylthioadenosine-to-methionine salvage, the last being what separates it from base-excision repair confusables.

core: Removal of methyl and alkyl groups from DNA
name: DNA dealkylation, cytosine demethylation and methionine salvage
rationale: Members are direct alkylation damage reversal (ALKBH2/3, MGMT), TET/TDG 5-methylcytosine demethylation and methylthioadenosine-to-methionine salvage, distinct from the base excision repair confusables.

qualifier: with methionine-responsive translation initiation and ribosome biogenesis
name: Non-histone protein methylation and methionine-responsive translation initiation
rationale: Members combine lysine/arginine protein methylation (including p53) with methionine sensing, cap-dependent translation initiation and ribosome biogenesis control, distinguishing them from chromatin-remodeling, histone modification and rRNA transcription confusables.

name: Non-histone lysine and arginine methylation with methionine-sensed translation initiation
rationale: Members are protein lysine/arginine methylation (including TP53) and methionine-responsive cap-dependent translation and ribosome biogenesis, unlike confusables on histone/chromatin modifier complexes, Pol I/III transcription or protein hydroxylation.

name: Non-histone protein methylation and methionine-responsive translation initiation
rationale: Members are protein mono/di/trimethylation (including p53) plus methionine sensing, cap-dependent initiation and ribosome biogenesis control, distinct from chromatin remodelling, histone-modifying, hypusine/hydroxylation and rRNA transcription confusables.

qualifier: junction assembly and its regulation, including EMT and endothelium
name: Adherens junction assembly and cadherin adhesion regulation
rationale: Members are adherens junction assembly/organization, calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion and its positive/negative regulation, with EMT and endothelial morphogenesis; confusables emphasize epithelial polarity or specific CDH1/CDH11 handling.

name: Cadherin adherens junction regulation in endothelial morphogenesis and EMT
rationale: Members concern cadherin-mediated cell-cell adhesion and adherens junction assembly, with endothelial morphogenesis and junction-organization regulation distinguishing it from the epithelial polarity and CDH1 trafficking confusables.

name: Cadherin adherens junction dynamics, including endothelial morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern cadherin-mediated adherens junction assembly and its positive and negative regulation, with endothelial morphogenesis and TGF-beta EMT distinguishing it from epithelial-polarity and CDH1-trafficking confusables.

name: Golgi vesicle traffic, lysosomal sorting and protein secretion
rationale: All members concern vesicle budding and transport through the Golgi; unlike confusables centred on COPI budding or endosome-to-Golgi retrieval, this theme adds TGN/lysosomal vesicle biogenesis, lysosomal targeting and secretion.

name: Golgi vesicle traffic and secretory-lysosomal cargo sorting
rationale: All members concern vesicle traffic through and from the Golgi (intra-Golgi, COPI, TGN, Golgi-to-ER); unlike the confusables, which emphasise endosome-to-Golgi retrieval and COPI budding, this theme adds protein secretion and lysosomal targeting and vesicle biogenesis.

name: Golgi vesicle traffic for secretion and lysosomal sorting
rationale: All members concern vesicle budding and traffic through the Golgi (COPI anterograde/retrograde, intra-Golgi, TGN); unlike the confusables, which emphasise endosome-to-Golgi retrieval, this theme carries protein secretion, Golgi-associated and lysosome vesicle biogenesis and lysosomal protein targeting.

name: Checkpoint-coupled genome maintenance and break-induced replication
rationale: Members combine intra-S checkpoint signaling, p53-driven repair gene transcription, DNA unwinding, break-induced replication and mitotic recombination resolution, distinguishing it from replication-initiation, fork-reversal and homologous recombination confusables.

name: S-phase checkpoint, break-induced replication and genome stability
rationale: Members combine intra-S damage checkpoint, break-induced replication, recombination intermediate resolution and DNA stability control, distinguishing them from replication initiation, fork-reversal and strand-invasion repair confusables.

name: Replicative genome stability, checkpoint signaling and cell division
rationale: Members link replication-associated DNA maintenance (unwinding, break-induced replication, recombination-intermediate resolution, TP53 repair genes) to intra-S checkpoint signaling and mitotic division, unlike the fork-stress, homologous-recombination and replication-initiation confusables.

qualifier: SRF contractile programme and vessel-wall modules
name: Vessel wall smooth muscle differentiation and SRF contractile programme
rationale: Members cover vascular smooth muscle development, SRF-driven cytoskeletal/contractile modules and perivascular/endothelial vessel-wall modules, lacking the phenotypic-switching and shear-stress terms of the confusables.

qualifier: SRF-driven contractile cytoskeleton and smooth muscle differentiation
name: Vascular wall cell identity and SRF contractile programme
rationale: Members combine SRF actin/contractile targets with vascular smooth muscle development, matrix adhesion and endothelial/perivascular modules; confusables add shear-stress responses and smooth muscle phenotypic switching.

core: Vascular wall smooth muscle and endothelial programmes
name: Vascular smooth muscle differentiation and SRF contractile gene programme
rationale: Members are vascular smooth muscle development, differentiation and matrix adhesion, SRF-target cytoskeletal/contractile modules and perivascular/endothelial identity modules, whereas confusables emphasize smooth muscle phenotypic switching, proliferation/migration or endothelial shear-stress responses.

qualifier: FGFR2/FGFR3 adaptor cascades and activating point mutants
name: FGFR2/FGFR3 adaptor cascades and activating FGFR point mutants
rationale: Members are FRS/SHC/PLC cascades and ligand binding of FGFR2 and FGFR3 plus oncogenic point-mutant FGFR signaling, whereas confusables centre on FGFR1 and FGFR1/2 isoform ligand binding or feedback regulation.

core: FGFR downstream cascades and activating mutants
name: FGFR2/FGFR3 cascades and activating FGFR point mutants
rationale: Members are FRS/SHC/PLC cascades and ligand activation for FGFR2 and FGFR3 plus oncogenic FGFR1-4 point mutants, whereas confusables centre on FGFR1, FGFR1/2 ligand binding or FGF signaling regulators.

qualifier: FGFR2/FGFR3 adaptor cascades and activating point mutants
name: FGFR2/3 adaptor cascades and activating FGFR mutants
rationale: Members are FRS/SHC/PLC cascades and ligand activation of FGFR2 and FGFR3 plus activating point mutants of FGFR1-4, whereas confusables centre on FGFR1/FGFR2 ligand binding, splicing or feedback regulation.

qualifier: tRNA charging, wobble modification and translation-factor hydroxylation
name: tRNA charging, wobble modification and translation-factor hydroxylation
rationale: Members cover tRNA aminoacylation and anticodon modification together with diphthamide and hydroxylation of translation-related proteins; confusables lack either the aminoacylation or the protein-modification arm.

name: tRNA aminoacylation, tRNA modification and translation factor hydroxylation
rationale: Members cover cytosolic/mitochondrial tRNA charging, anticodon wobble modifications including wybutosine, and modifications of translation proteins (diphthamide on EEF2, lysyl hydroxylation); these distinguish it from RNA methylation/pseudouridylation and hypusine confusables.

name: tRNA aminoacylation and anticodon modification with protein hydroxylation
rationale: Members are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging, anticodon-loop modifications (wybutosine, wobble thiolation) and protein lysine hydroxylation/diphthamide, unlike neighbours centred on RNA methylation and pseudouridylation.

name: Osmotic salt-water homeostasis via vasopressin, aquaporins and cation-chloride cotransporters
rationale: Members cover renal sodium, potassium, chloride, magnesium and water handling, osmotic stress responses, vasopressin-aquaporin signalling and SLC12 cotransporter disorders, distinguishing them from renin-angiotensin, potassium channel and glycerol-aquaporin confusables.

name: Renal salt-water balance and cellular osmotic regulation
rationale: Members cover renal Na+/K+/Cl-/Mg2+ transport, cation-chloride cotransporter defects, vasopressin-aquaporin water reabsorption and cellular osmotic stress responses, distinct from renin-angiotensin, K+ channel and glycerol/urea transport confusables.

name: Osmoregulation and renal salt-water reabsorption via vasopressin
rationale: Members span osmotic stress responses, Na+/K+/Mg2+/Cl- homeostasis, SLC12 cotransporters, aquaporins and vasopressin signaling, unlike confusables on renin-angiotensin, neuronal K+ channels or urea/glycerol transport.

core: Protein N-glycosylation and GPI anchor biosynthesis
qualifier: dolichol and nucleotide-sugar precursors with congenital glycosylation disorders
name: Dolichol-linked N-glycosylation, GPI anchoring and congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: Members cover dolichol, GDP-mannose and UDP-sugar precursor synthesis, nucleotide-sugar transport, N-glycan assembly/processing and GPI anchoring, mostly as CDG gene defects, whereas the confusables centre on sialic acid and amino-sugar metabolism.

core: Protein glycosylation precursor synthesis and congenital glycosylation disorders
qualifier: dolichol-linked N-glycan and GPI anchor assembly
name: Dolichol-linked N-glycosylation, GPI anchoring and congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: Members cover dolichol, GDP-mannose and nucleotide-sugar donor synthesis, ALG/DPM-step N-glycan assembly with their CDG defects and GPI anchor synthesis, which the sialic acid-focused confusables lack.

core: Dolichol-linked N-glycan and GPI anchor biosynthesis
name: Dolichol-linked N-glycan and GPI anchor biosynthesis defects
rationale: Members cover nucleotide-sugar and dolichol precursor synthesis, lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly, N-glycan processing and GPI anchoring with their CDG defects, whereas confusables centre on sialic acid, UDP-GlcNAc transport and glucuronate metabolism.

qualifier: PPAR, SREBP, LXR and ChREBP gene regulation
name: Adipogenesis and PPAR/SREBP/LXR control of lipid metabolism
rationale: Members cover white, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and nuclear-receptor/SREBP/ChREBP transcriptional control of lipid and glucose metabolism, unlike glucagon-PKA signaling or thermogenesis confusables.

core: Transcriptional control of adipogenesis and lipid metabolism
qualifier: PPAR, LXR, SREBP and ChREBP gene programs
name: Transcriptional control of adipocyte differentiation and lipid metabolism
rationale: Members cover white/brown/beige adipocyte differentiation and nuclear-receptor, SREBP, ChREBP and clock-driven metabolic gene expression, unlike confusables on thermogenesis and fatty acid transport or glucagon/PKA signaling.

core: Transcriptional control of lipid metabolism and adipogenesis
name: Adipogenesis and PPAR/SREBP/LXR control of lipid metabolism
rationale: Members span white/brown/beige adipocyte differentiation and nutrient-responsive transcription (PPAR, SREBP, LXR, ChREBP, PGC-1alpha, circadian factors) over lipid, cholesterol and glucose metabolism, whereas confusables emphasize insulin/glucagon signaling, glucose-sensing alone, or thermogenesis and fatty acid transport.

name: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan, glycolipid and sialoglycan catabolism
rationale: Members describe lysosomal degradation of GAGs (mucopolysaccharidoses), gangliosides, oligosaccharides and sialic acid/amino sugar metabolism, whereas confusables concern glycan and GAG biosynthesis.

name: Lysosomal degradation of glycosaminoglycans, glycolipids and oligosaccharides
rationale: Members are lysosomal catabolism of GAGs (mucopolysaccharidoses), gangliosides, oligosaccharides and sialic acid/amino sugars, while confusables are glycan and proteoglycan biosynthesis and glycosylation disorders.

qualifier: glycosaminoglycans, glycolipids, oligosaccharides and amino sugar metabolism
name: Lysosomal glycoconjugate degradation and amino sugar metabolism
rationale: Members cover lysosomal breakdown of GAGs (mucopolysaccharidoses), glycosphingolipids and oligosaccharides plus sialic acid and hexosamine metabolism, while confusables are glycan biosynthesis and glycosylation disorders.

name: MET and ERBB-family receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Members are RTK activation and adaptor events (GRB2, SHC1, PI3K, PLCG1, STAT3) leading to AKT and ERK, dominated by MET and EGFR/ERBB2-4 receptors; these receptor families distinguish it from PTK6- and IGF1R-centred neighbours.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K/AKT and ERK
name: ERBB-family and MET receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Members are EGFR/ERBB2-4 and MET/HGF receptor signalling events via SHC/GRB2/PI3K/PLCG1 to AKT and ERK, distinguishing it from PTK6-, IGF1R- and MET-only confusables.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K/AKT and RAS
name: ERBB, MET and ALK-family receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Members are adaptor (GRB2, SHC1, GAB1, PI3K, PLCG1) signaling downstream of EGFR/ERBB2-4, MET/RON and ALK/LTK, distinguishing it from IGF1R/IRS, PTK6 and nuclear ERBB4 confusables.

qualifier: PCNA-dependent excision repair and translesion bypass
name: PCNA-dependent repair synthesis in excision repair and translesion bypass
rationale: Members are NER, long-patch BER, translesion synthesis and polymerase switching with gap-filling synthesis; confusables carry mismatch repair, glycosylases, alkylation reversal or double-strand break repair.

core: DNA polymerase synthesis in repair and replication
qualifier: PCNA-dependent excision repair and translesion synthesis
name: PCNA-dependent DNA synthesis in replication, excision repair and translesion
rationale: Members are polymerase-driven synthesis steps: replication initiation/elongation and polymerase switching, NER and long-patch BER gap filling and translesion bypass; it lacks the glycosylase, mismatch, alkylation and double-strand break repair content of its confusables.

qualifier: excision-repair gap filling and translesion bypass
name: PCNA-dependent DNA synthesis in excision repair and translesion bypass
rationale: Members centre on PCNA/polymerase-driven DNA synthesis: NER and long-patch BER gap filling, translesion polymerases, polymerase switching, flap removal and primer/telomere C-strand synthesis with UV damage response, unlike confusables on double-strand break repair, glycosylase/mismatch repair or telomere capping.

qualifier: p53-regulated, from BH3-only activation through apoptosome to execution
name: p53-regulated mitochondrial apoptosis from BH3-only activation to execution
rationale: Members trace p53-controlled intrinsic apoptosis through BH3-only proteins, BAX/BAK, cytochrome c release, apoptosome, SMAC and execution-phase DNA fragmentation, whereas confusables cover senescence, extrinsic death-receptor and necroptotic death or p53 cell cycle arrest.

qualifier: p53 and DNA damage induction through execution
name: Intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis from p53 induction to execution
rationale: Members span p53/DNA-damage-driven BH3-only activation, BAX/BAK, cytochrome c release, apoptosome and execution (DNA fragmentation, lamina breakdown, PAK-2p34), unlike confusables on death-receptor/necroptotic, senescence or p53 cell-cycle arrest programs.

name: p53-driven intrinsic apoptosis and execution, including PAK-2p34
rationale: Members run from p53-regulated apoptotic transcription and BH3/BAX/BAK activation through cytochrome c release, apoptosome, caspases and DNA fragmentation; the p53 arm separates it from extrinsic/necroptosis confusables and the PAK-2p34 members from its near-twin.

qualifier: germinal center, memory and plasma cell states
name: B cell germinal center, memory and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell identity signatures and germinal center, memory and plasma cell differentiation with Tfh/ICOS help, whereas confusables cover T cell development, proximal BCR signaling or extrathymic T cells.

qualifier: germinal center, memory and plasma cell fates
name: B cell differentiation into germinal center, memory, plasma cells
rationale: Members are B cell, memory and plasma cell signatures with germinal center, Tfh/ICOS help and humoral memory, distinct from confusables on proximal BCR signalling or T cell development.

qualifier: germinal centre, memory and plasma cell
name: B cell identity, germinal centre and plasma/memory differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell signatures, germinal centre and Tfh/ICOS/CD27 help, memory and plasma cell differentiation, unlike confusables on proximal BCR signalling or T cell development.

name: Ionotropic glutamate receptor signaling at excitatory postsynapses
rationale: Members are AMPA, NMDA and kainate receptor activation, clustering and signaling driving glutamatergic transmission, whereas confusables cover receptor endosomal recycling, long-term plasticity, presynaptic modulation or CREB signaling.

qualifier: postsynaptic ionotropic receptor activation and clustering
name: Postsynaptic ionotropic glutamate receptor signaling and clustering
