rationale: Members cover PI/PIP/IP synthesis at ER, Golgi, endosome and plasma membranes, ER tubule shaping and fusion, intermembrane lipid transfer and Miro GTPases, unlike mitochondrial tethering, phosphatase regulation and flippase neighbours.

core: Phosphoinositide metabolism and ER membrane organization
name: Phosphoinositide synthesis, lipid transfer and ER tubular network
rationale: Members combine compartment-specific PI/PIP and inositol phosphate synthesis with ER tubular network shaping and ER-Golgi/membrane lipid transfer, unlike confusables on phospholipid flipping, mitochondria-ER tethering or phosphatase regulation.

qualifier: compartment-specific phosphoinositide synthesis and ER tubular network lipid transfer
name: Compartmental phosphoinositide synthesis and ER-network lipid transfer
rationale: Members combine PIP/IP synthesis at plasma membrane, Golgi, ER and endosomes with ER tubular network shaping, membrane contact lipid/cholesterol transfer and Miro (RHOT) cycles, distinguishing it from mitochondria-ER tethering, phosphatase regulation and phospholipid flippase themes.

name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming, fusion and recycling
rationale: Members cover synaptic vesicle docking, priming, SNARE assembly, fusion, endocytic recycling and neurotransmitter release cycles, unlike confusables on presynaptic modulation of exocytosis or postsynaptic receptor trafficking.

qualifier: docking and priming through endocytic recycling
name: Presynaptic synaptic vesicle cycle from docking to recycling
rationale: Members cover neurotransmitter release cycles (glutamate, monoamines, acetylcholine), vesicle docking, priming, SNARE assembly and Ca2+-dependent fusion, plus vesicle endocytosis, clathrin uncoating, recycling and active zone/presynaptic cytoskeleton maintenance; confusables focus on presynaptic modulation/Ca2+ channel control of exocytosis or postsynaptic receptor trafficking and lack the recycling members.

qualifier: vesicle endocytic recycling and active zone
name: Synaptic vesicle cycle from docking to endocytic recycling
rationale: Members cover vesicle docking, priming, SNARE assembly, fusion and transmitter-specific release cycles plus vesicle endocytosis, recycling and active zone maintenance, which the presynaptic-modulation and postsynaptic receptor-trafficking confusables lack.

name: Striated muscle size adaptation and cardiomyocyte proliferation/regeneration
rationale: Members cover hypertrophy, atrophy, fiber-type and calcineurin-NFAT adaptation plus cardiomyocyte proliferation and regeneration, distinct from confusables on myogenesis, myoblast differentiation and sarcomere contraction.

name: Calcineurin-regulated muscle hypertrophy, atrophy and cardiomyocyte proliferation
rationale: Members regulate muscle hypertrophy, atrophy, cell size and calcineurin-NFAT signaling together with cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation and regeneration, unlike confusables on myoblast myogenesis or sarcomere contraction.

name: Striated muscle hypertrophy, atrophy and cardiomyocyte proliferation
rationale: Members cover muscle hypertrophy, atrophy, fiber-type switching and calcineurin-NFAT signaling together with cardiomyocyte proliferation, survival and muscle regeneration, unlike confusables centred on myoblast differentiation, myogenesis and sarcomere contraction.

core: DNA polymerase synthesis and gap filling
qualifier: base excision repair and error-prone translesion synthesis
name: DNA synthesis in replication, base excision repair and translesion bypass
rationale: Members share PCNA-associated DNA polymerase synthesis steps (polymerase switching, flap removal, long-patch BER gap filling, error-prone TLS by REV1/POLI/POLK, somatic hypermutation), whereas confusables cover NER incision and error-free POLH bypass.

qualifier: polymerase switching, error-prone translesion and long-patch excision repair
name: Polymerase switching and gap-filling DNA synthesis in replication and repair
rationale: Members share DNA polymerase-driven synthesis steps (primer synthesis, strand elongation, flap removal, long-patch BER, error-prone TLS, somatic hypermutation), whereas confusables centre on nucleotide-excision repair incision and error-free POLH bypass.

qualifier: polymerase switching, long-patch repair and error-prone translesion synthesis
name: DNA polymerase switching in replication, gap-filling repair and mutagenic bypass
rationale: Members share PCNA-coordinated polymerase handoff for primer synthesis, telomere C-strand fill-in, long-patch BER, NER gap filling, error-prone translesion synthesis and somatic hypermutation, whereas confusables add nucleotide excision incision steps and error-free POLH bypass.

qualifier: snoRNP assembly and telomerase RNA Cajal body localization
name: RNA modification, snoRNP assembly and telomerase Cajal-body localization
rationale: Members cover rRNA/tRNA/mRNA methylation and pseudouridylation, snoRNP assembly and scaRNA/telomerase RNA Cajal body targeting, unlike confusables on RNA decay, mitochondrial RNA or transcription and splicing.

qualifier: snoRNP/scaRNA and Cajal body telomerase assembly
name: RNA modification, snoRNP biogenesis and Cajal body telomerase assembly
rationale: Members cover rRNA, tRNA, snRNA and mRNA methylation and pseudouridylation, box C/D snoRNP and scaRNA localization to Cajal bodies and telomerase holoenzyme assembly, unlike confusables on RNA transcription, processing, decay or mitochondrial RNA.

qualifier: Cajal body snoRNP and telomerase assembly
name: rRNA/tRNA modification and Cajal body snoRNP-telomerase assembly
rationale: Members are methylation and pseudouridylation of rRNA, tRNA, snRNA and mRNA plus snoRNP/scaRNA and telomerase assembly at Cajal bodies, distinct from rRNA cleavage/transcription, RNA decay and mitochondrial translation confusables.

core: Misfolded protein quality control and selective autophagy
name: Misfolded protein clearance and selective autophagy including pexophagy
rationale: Members cover misfolded protein responses, ERAD regulation, aggresome/aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated, micro- and reticulophagy; pexophagy and membrane docking set it apart from the chaperonin-folding and stress-granule confusables.

name: Misfolded protein quality control by selective autophagy and ERAD
rationale: Members handle misfolded or aggregated proteins via aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and micro-autophagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy and ERAD regulation, distinguishing it from chaperonin folding, proteasomal and stress-granule neighbours.

name: Misfolded protein triage via aggrephagy, selective autophagy and ERAD
rationale: Members handle misfolded proteins through aggresome/aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and micro-autophagy, pexophagy/reticulophagy and ERAD regulation, unlike chaperonin folding, stress granule and proteasomal-ubiquitination confusables.

core: Cell-matrix adhesion turnover and cell migration
qualifier: epithelial and keratinocyte migration, wound spreading
name: Cell-matrix adhesion turnover in epithelial and keratinocyte migration
rationale: Members regulate focal adhesion/matrix adhesion, Rac/Rho-driven protrusions, invadopodia and ECM disassembly together with epithelial, keratinocyte and wound-edge migration, which the CDC42 leading-edge and phosphatase-adhesion confusables lack.

qualifier: epithelial/keratinocyte migration with matrix and focal adhesion disassembly
name: Cell-matrix adhesion turnover in epithelial cell migration
rationale: Members regulate cell-substrate adhesion, spreading, protrusion and Rho/Rac signalling together with epithelial, keratinocyte and fibroblast migration, invadopodia and ECM/focal adhesion disassembly, whereas confusables emphasise CDC42-driven protrusion or receptor phosphatase and homophilic adhesion.

core: Epithelial cell migration and cell-matrix adhesion control
name: Keratinocyte and epithelial migration via cell-matrix adhesion control
rationale: Members regulate epithelial, keratinocyte and fibroblast migration through Rho/Rac, lamellipodia, focal adhesion and matrix turnover, and the wound-spreading, EGF and invadopodia terms separate it from leading-edge actin confusables.

qualifier: TGF-beta receptor/SMAD cancer mutants, RUNX3 and Hippo-YAP
name: Tumour-suppressive TGF-beta, RUNX3 and Hippo-YAP growth control
rationale: Members are cancer mutants of TGF-beta receptors/SMADs and TCF7L2, RUNX3 target regulation, Hippo-YAP/TAZ and cell-density sensing, i.e. tumour-suppressive growth control, whereas neighbours are wild-type TGF-beta/TGFBR3/activin signalling.

qualifier: Hippo-YAP/TAZ, RUNX3 and cancer-mutant TGF-beta receptors and SMADs
name: Hippo-YAP, RUNX3 and cancer-mutant TGF-beta/SMAD tumour suppression
rationale: Members combine Hippo-YAP/TAZ signalling and cell density sensing, RUNX3 target regulation (CDKN1A, BIM, p14-ARF) and cancer mutants of TGF-beta receptors and SMADs, whereas confusables are wild-type TGF-beta/activin/TGFBR3 signalling without Hippo or RUNX3.

qualifier: Hippo-YAP, RUNX3 and mutant TGF-beta receptor/SMAD
name: Hippo-YAP, RUNX3 and TGF-beta receptor tumor-suppressor signaling
rationale: Members combine Hippo/YAP-TAZ density sensing, RUNX3 target regulation and cancer mutants of TGF-beta receptors/SMADs, with Hippo and RUNX3 separating the theme from TGFBR3/activin-centred confusables.

name: Phospholipid flipping, intermembrane transfer and ER tubular network
rationale: Members cover aminophospholipid flipping and scrambling, intermembrane lipid transfer and ER tubule formation/fusion, unlike confusables on phosphoinositide synthesis, Golgi vesicle traffic, mitochondria-ER tethering or glycolipid transport.

core: ER membrane organization and lipid transfer
name: ER membrane shaping with phospholipid transfer, flipping and scrambling
rationale: Members cover ER tubular network formation, membrane fusion and tethering together with intermembrane phospholipid transfer, flippase/scramblase translocation and PI synthesis, whereas confusables emphasise mitochondrial contacts, phosphoinositide synthesis or glycolipid transport.

qualifier: flipping/scrambling and ER tubular network shaping
name: Phospholipid transfer, flipping and ER tubular network shaping
rationale: Members cover intermembrane phospholipid transfer, flippase/scramblase translocation and ER tubule formation, fusion and tethering, which confusables on glycolipid transport, Golgi traffic, mitochondria-ER contacts or phosphoinositides lack.

qualifier: T cell tolerance and NK cell activation
name: Immunoregulatory receptors in T cell tolerance and NK activation
rationale: Members concern co-stimulatory/inhibitory receptor control of T cell costimulation, anergy and tolerance, dendritic cell activation and KIR-type NK receptors, while confusables lack the NK/tolerance arm or focus on Treg differentiation or NK cytotoxicity.

qualifier: T cell tolerance, NK and dendritic cell activation
name: Immunoregulatory receptors in T cell tolerance and NK/dendritic cell activation
rationale: Members concern lymphoid/non-lymphoid immunoregulatory and KIR receptors controlling T cell costimulation, anergy and tolerance, NK activation and DC differentiation, unlike confusables focused on Treg differentiation or NK cytotoxicity.

core: Regulation of lymphocyte tolerance and activation
qualifier: costimulatory and NK (KIR) receptor interactions with antigen-presenting cells
name: Costimulatory and NK receptor control of lymphocyte tolerance
rationale: Members concern surface-receptor control of T cell costimulation, anergy and tolerance, NK activation via KIR/activating receptors and dendritic cell differentiation, whereas confusables emphasise Treg/Th17 differentiation and T cell suppression, NK cytotoxicity, or dendritic cell signatures.

name: Repulsive axon guidance and midline crossing decisions
rationale: Members are axon guidance processes dominated by chemorepulsion, SLIT/ROBO commissural midline choice and specific tract guidance, unlike confusables centred on ROBO-RAC signalling, netrin attraction, semaphorins or ephrins.

name: Neuron-type-specific axon pathfinding and midline chemorepulsion
rationale: All members describe axon guidance of specific neuron classes (dopaminergic, serotonergic, commissural, retinal ganglion), midline choice points and chemorepulsion, whereas confusables are defined by semaphorin, netrin, ephrin, L1 or ROBO receptor signalling cascades.

qualifier: midline repulsion and neuron type-specific pathfinding
name: Neuron type-specific axon guidance and midline repulsion
rationale: All members concern axon guidance, with chemorepulsion, commissural midline choice and specific neuron types (retinal, dopaminergic, serotonergic, DRG) that the receptor-signaling confusables (SLIT-ROBO, netrin, ephrin, semaphorin) lack.

qualifier: AhR ligands (dioxin, pesticides, bisphenol A) and ascorbate/vitamin E
name: AhR xenobiotic responses and ascorbate/vitamin E handling
rationale: Members are responses to environmental chemicals via aryl hydrocarbon receptor plus vitamin C metabolism/transport and vitamin E response, separating it from ROS-detoxification, ethanol/nicotine and heavy-metal confusables.

core: Response to environmental chemicals and antioxidant vitamins
qualifier: aryl hydrocarbon receptor and vitamin C
name: Aryl hydrocarbon receptor xenobiotic response and vitamin C metabolism
rationale: Members combine AhR/dioxin, pesticide, bisphenol and genistein responses with ascorbate and vitamin E handling, each block being what one group of confusables lacks.

qualifier: aryl hydrocarbon receptor and ascorbate metabolism
name: Aryl hydrocarbon xenobiotic response and ascorbate metabolism
rationale: Members combine AhR/dioxin, pesticide, bisphenol and genistein responses with vitamin C and E metabolism; confusables lack either the xenobiotic or the ascorbate arm.

qualifier: germinal center Tfh help, plasma and memory B cells
name: Germinal center B cells, Tfh/ICOS help and plasma cells
rationale: Members are B cell, plasma cell and memory signatures plus Tfh differentiation and ICOS co-stimulation, which distinguish it from generic B-cell surface and isotype-switching confusables.

qualifier: germinal centre, Tfh and plasma cell
name: Germinal centre B cell, Tfh and plasma cell responses
rationale: Members are germinal centre, memory and plasma cell signatures with Tfh differentiation and ICOS co-stimulation, unlike confusables focused on naive B signatures, B cell development/homeostasis or isotype switching.

qualifier: germinal center, plasma cell and Tfh help
name: Germinal center B, plasma cell and Tfh differentiation
rationale: Members are B-cell, memory B and plasma-cell/immunoglobulin signatures with germinal-centre, plasma-cell and Tfh/ICOS differentiation, distinguishing it from naive B-cell, CD27/B-homeostasis and isotype-switching neighbours.

name: NRF2 and AKT–FOXO stress-responsive transcription
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 target-gene programmes and AKT control of FOXO transcription, which together separate the theme from NRF2-only, hypoxia and p53 confusables.

qualifier: NFE2L2 target genes and AKT-regulated FOXO
name: NFE2L2 and AKT–FOXO stress-responsive transcription
rationale: Members are NFE2L2-driven antioxidant/detoxification gene programmes and AKT-controlled FOXO transcription, combining the two arms each confusable has only one of.

name: NFE2L2 and AKT–FOXO stress-responsive transcription
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 target-gene programs and AKT/acetylation control of FOXO transcription, combining what separate NRF2-only and FOXO-only neighbours carry.

core: Regulation of insulin and glucagon secretion
qualifier: by GPCR ligands and cAMP-PKA signalling
name: GPCR and cAMP-PKA regulation of insulin and glucagon secretion
rationale: Members are islet hormone secretion controls via fatty acid, GLP-1, adrenergic and cholinergic receptors plus glucagon-PKA/PDE3B signalling, whereas confusables centre on insulin receptor action, glucose uptake and LXR-driven lipid metabolism.

core: Control of pancreatic islet hormone secretion
name: GPCR and cAMP-PKA control of insulin and glucagon secretion
rationale: Members are GPCR inputs (GLP1, free fatty acid, hydroxycarboxylic acid, adrenergic, cholinergic receptors) and cAMP-PKA/PDE3B/glucagon signalling that tune islet insulin and glucagon release, unlike confusables centred on KATP channels, insulin processing, insulin receptor action or hepatic glucose metabolism.

core: Hormonal control of insulin and glucagon secretion
name: GPCR and cAMP-PKA control of insulin and glucagon secretion
rationale: Members are receptor-driven (free fatty acid, GLP-1, acetylcholine, adrenergic, HCA receptors) and cAMP/PKA/PDE3B/AMPK regulators of islet insulin and glucagon secretion, unlike confusables centred on insulin action, KATP channels, lipid gene regulation or glycogen metabolism.

qualifier: neurexin-neuroligin at excitatory and inhibitory synapses
name: Neurexin-neuroligin postsynaptic assembly at excitatory and inhibitory synapses
rationale: Members describe neuroligin-linked clustering of NMDA, PSD-95, gephyrin and GABA receptors and tuning of excitatory/inhibitory potentials, unlike confusables centred on presynaptic and SALM/RPTP adhesion or LGI-ADAM.

core: Postsynaptic receptor clustering and synapse assembly
name: Postsynaptic receptor clustering and neurexin–neuroligin synapse assembly
rationale: Members concern clustering of GABA-A/gephyrin and NMDA/PSD-95 at postsynaptic membranes and neurexin–neuroligin-driven assembly, distinct from neighbours built on other synaptic adhesion molecules, presynaptic assembly or LGI-ADAM.

qualifier: receptor clustering at both excitatory and inhibitory synapses
name: Postsynaptic receptor clustering at excitatory and inhibitory synapses
rationale: Members cluster NMDA, GABA receptors, PSD-95 and gephyrin and tune excitatory and inhibitory postsynaptic potentials, while confusables centre on synaptic adhesion molecules and presynaptic assembly.

qualifier: centred on monocyte and dendritic cell surface receptors
name: Leukocyte surface signatures centred on monocytes and dendritic cells
rationale: Members are surface-marker signatures of monocytes, dendritic cells, T cells and plasma cells (with butyrophilin interactions), whereas confusables emphasise lipid or MHC class II antigen presentation or T cell costimulation.

name: Myeloid-predominant leukocyte surface protein signatures
rationale: Members are surface-marker signatures of monocytes, dendritic cells, T and plasma cells plus butyrophilin interactions, whereas confusables are defined by MHC class II or lipid antigen presentation and T-cell costimulation processes.

name: Leukocyte surface signatures, dendritic cell and monocyte enriched
rationale: Members are cell-surface/receptor signatures of dendritic cells, monocytes, plasma and T cells (plus butyrophilin and exosome assembly), while confusables are defined by lipid or MHC class II antigen presentation or T cell costimulation.

qualifier: TLR3/7/8/9 to IRF3/IRF7, herpes encephalitis defects
name: Endosomal TLR signaling to IRF3/IRF7 and herpes encephalitis defects
rationale: Members cover TLR3 and TLR7/8/9 signaling through IRAK/TRAF6/TBK1 to IRF3/IRF7 and IKK, endosomal TLR trafficking and UNC93B1/TLR3/TRIF/TRAF3 herpes simplex encephalitis deficiencies, unlike confusables on TRIF-mediated cell death, TLR4 or cytosolic nucleic acid sensing.

qualifier: IRAK/TRAF to IRF3/7, herpes simplex encephalitis deficiencies
name: Endosomal TLR signaling to IRF3/7 and HSE immunodeficiencies
rationale: Members cover TLR3 and TLR7/8/9 endosomal trafficking and IRAK/TRAF/TBK1 signaling to IKK and IRF3/7 plus the UNC93B1/TRAF3/TICAM1/TLR3 deficiencies causing HSE, unlike confusables on TRIF-mediated cell death or cGAS/IFN regulation.

name: Endosomal TLR signaling to IKK and IRF3/IRF7 activation
rationale: Members concern TLR3/7/8/9 trafficking and downstream IRAK1/2-IKK and TBK1-IRF3/7 activation, including UNC93B1/TLR3/TRAF3 deficiencies; neighbours concern cGAS/IFN regulation, TRIF/TLR4 or necroptotic death.

name: Calcineurin-NFAT-regulated muscle adaptation, atrophy and fibre-type switching
rationale: Members cover cardiac and skeletal muscle adaptation, stress hypertrophy, disuse atrophy, fibre-type transition and calcineurin-NFAT signalling, which neighbours on muscle growth, cell size and sarcomere organisation lack.

qualifier: calcineurin signaling, atrophy and fiber-type switching
name: Calcineurin-dependent striated muscle adaptation, atrophy and fiber-type switching
rationale: Members cover calcineurin-NFAT signaling, stress hypertrophy, cardiac adaptation, disuse atrophy and fast-slow fiber transition, distinguishing it from cell-size and sarcomere growth confusables.

qualifier: calcineurin-NFAT control, hypertrophy, atrophy and fibre type
name: Calcineurin-NFAT control of striated muscle hypertrophy, atrophy and fibre type
rationale: Members cover cardiac and skeletal muscle adaptation (hypertrophy, atrophy, fast/slow fibre transition) with calcineurin-NFAT regulation, which distinguishes it from cell size and muscle growth confusables.

name: Collagen and elastic fiber assembly in aortic development
rationale: Members cover collagen biosynthesis and crosslinking, elastic fiber assembly and turnover and ECM assembly together with aorta smooth muscle morphogenesis, unlike confusables on basement membrane, MMP collagen degradation or generic ECM modules.

name: Collagen and elastic fiber assembly in aortic wall development
rationale: Members cover collagen biosynthesis and crosslinking, elastic fiber assembly and ECM assembly regulation with ascending aorta and aortic smooth muscle morphogenesis, unlike confusables on MMP-mediated degradation or basement membrane.

name: Elastic fiber and collagen assembly in aortic wall development
rationale: Members concern elastic fiber assembly and elastin turnover, collagen biosynthesis and crosslinking and aorta development; neighbours concern generic ECM modules, basement membrane or MMP-mediated degradation.

qualifier: dendritic cell IL-12 and IFN-gamma production
name: Dendritic cell IL-12-driven Th1 polarization and IFN-gamma production
rationale: Members describe activated dendritic cell cytokine (IL-12, GM-CSF) production, MHC upregulation and Th1 differentiation with IFN-gamma production, whereas confusables centre on IFN-gamma receptor signaling and its negative regulation, Tregs or CD8 T cell proliferation.

qualifier: dendritic cell IL-12 and cytokine output, MHC upregulation
name: Dendritic cell-driven Th1 polarisation and IFN-gamma production
rationale: All members promote Th1 immunity: dendritic cell IL-12/GM-CSF production, Th1 differentiation, IFN-gamma production and MHC upregulation; confusables are instead IFN-gamma receptor signalling, its negative regulation, or CD8/antigen presentation.

core: Th1 polarization and type II interferon production
qualifier: driven by dendritic cell IL-12/GM-CSF and MHC upregulation
name: Dendritic cell-driven Th1 and type II interferon promotion
rationale: Members positively regulate Th1 differentiation, IFN-gamma production and MHC expression via dendritic cell cytokine (IL-12, GM-CSF) production, whereas confusables center on IFN-gamma receptor signaling and its negative regulation.

qualifier: amino acid conjugation of carboxylic acids
name: Drug metabolism with amino acid conjugation of carboxylates
rationale: Members are ADME of specific drugs plus glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, distinguishing them from confusables on xenobiotic/toxin oxidation by CYP, FMO and sulfonation.

name: Drug ADME and glycine/glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids
rationale: Members are absorption-metabolism-excretion routes for specific drugs (aspirin, paracetamol, atorvastatin, prednisone, ciprofloxacin) and mitochondrial amino-acid conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, distinguishing it from broader CYP/FMO/sulfonation xenobiotic confusables.

name: Drug ADME with glycine/glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids
rationale: Members are drug ADME routes and phase II conjugations, distinguished from broader xenobiotic oxidation confusables by amino acid conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate and specific drug ADME.

core: Synaptic transmission and dendritic spine maintenance
name: Synaptic transmission, spine maintenance and sensorimotor gating
rationale: Members combine glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission, spine and postsynaptic maintenance and prepulse inhibition/nonassociative learning; the gating and transmission arms distinguish it from reelin plasticity, AMPA clustering and locomotor behaviour confusables.

core: Synaptic transmission and dendritic spine maintenance
name: Glutamatergic and GABAergic synapse function and dendritic spine maintenance
rationale: Members regulate excitatory and inhibitory transmission, spine/projection maintenance and postsynaptic organization with amyloid-beta response and sensorimotor gating, distinct from confusables on AMPA receptor clustering, reelin-driven plasticity and locomotor behaviour.

core: Synaptic transmission and dendritic spine maintenance
name: Dendritic spine maintenance and excitatory–inhibitory synaptic transmission
rationale: All members concern neuron-neuron synaptic function, namely dendritic spine and projection maintenance, postsynaptic organization and glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission with their behavioural readouts (prepulse inhibition, nonassociative learning), distinguished from confusables on locomotor behaviour, reelin/LTP structural plasticity and AMPA receptor clustering.

name: Erythroid differentiation with heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport
rationale: Members cover primitive/definitive erythrocyte differentiation, erythroid transcription and red cell modules, while the heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport members are what the other erythropoiesis themes lack.

qualifier: with heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport
name: Erythrocyte differentiation with heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport
rationale: Members cover primitive/definitive erythroid differentiation and the red-cell heme/oxygen-carrier programme; the heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport members are what the erythropoiesis confusables lack, while the confusable with heme lacks the differentiation subtypes.

name: Erythrocyte differentiation with heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport
rationale: Members cover primitive and definitive erythropoiesis, heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport; the heme synthesis and oxygen-carrying members are what the erythroid confusables lack.

name: Stress granule dynamics and regulation of proteasomal protein turnover
rationale: Members regulate proteasomal/ubiquitin-dependent degradation and protein destabilization together with stress granule assembly, disassembly and PKR signalling, the latter absent from the ubiquitination and PML confusables.

name: Stress granule dynamics and regulation of proteasomal protein degradation
rationale: Members regulate ubiquitin-proteasome protein turnover and destabilization alongside stress granule assembly/disassembly and PKR signalling, the stress-granule arm distinguishing it from ubiquitination, ribosome quality control and PML confusables.

qualifier: stress granule dynamics and PKR signaling
name: Stress granule dynamics, PKR signaling and proteasomal turnover regulation
rationale: Members combine regulation of proteasomal degradation and protein destabilization with stress granule assembly/disassembly and PKR signaling, which distinguishes it from deubiquitinase, ribosome quality control and PML/arsenite confusables.

qualifier: biliary and intestinal sterol and phospholipid
name: ABC transporter–mediated biliary and intestinal lipid efflux
rationale: Members describe ABCB4/ABCB11/ABCG5/ABCG8 lipid export and their cholestasis/sitosterolemia defects, distinct from lipoprotein remodelling, chylomicron assembly and bile acid synthesis confusables.

name: ABC transporter-mediated biliary and intestinal lipid efflux
rationale: Members are ABCB4/ABCB11/ABCG5/ABCG8 lipid and sterol export, phospholipid efflux and intestinal cholesterol absorption, unlike confusables on lipoprotein assembly/remodelling and bile acid synthesis/signaling.

name: Hepatobiliary and intestinal lipid efflux by ABC transporters
rationale: Members cover ABCG5/8, ABCB4 and ABCB11 lipid efflux and their disorders plus intestinal lipid absorption, distinct from lipoprotein remodelling, bile acid synthesis and chylomicron assembly confusables.

name: Atypical-linkage polyubiquitin chain assembly and deubiquitination
rationale: Members cover E1/E2/E3 ubiquitin activation and atypical or branched chain formation with USP and metalloprotease DUBs, unlike the proteasomal, ERAD, Fanconi and OTU-deubiquitination confusables.

name: Ubiquitin conjugation cascade and atypical-linkage polyubiquitin chains
rationale: Members cover E1/E2/E3 ubiquitin activation and transfer, free-chain and branched K6/K11/K27/K29 chain synthesis and ubiquitin-processing DUBs, unlike confusables on deubiquitination, proteasomal degradation or ERAD.

qualifier: atypical linkage types and DUB editing
name: Atypical-linkage polyubiquitin chain assembly and editing
rationale: Members cover E1/E2/E3 ubiquitination with K6, K11, K27, K29, branched and free chains plus USP and metalloprotease DUBs, while confusables centre on K48/K63 deubiquitination or proteolysis.

name: Actin-driven ruffling, podosome formation and macropinocytosis
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerization into ruffles, lamellipodia, pseudopodia and podosomes and macropinocytosis, unlike confusables focused on actin severing/bundling, Arp2/3 nucleation or Rho GTPase cycles.

name: Leading-edge ruffling, podosome assembly and macropinocytosis
rationale: Members regulate actin-driven ruffles, lamellipodia, pseudopodia, podosomes and macropinocytosis at the leading edge, which the Arp2/3, CDC42/IQGAP and actin network confusables lack.

name: Leading-edge protrusion, membrane ruffling and macropinocytosis
rationale: Members regulate lamellipodia, ruffles, pseudopodia, podosomes and macropinocytosis at the cell leading edge, which actin-nucleation, Rho GTPase and actin-network confusables lack.

name: Phosphatidic acid-derived triglyceride and phosphatidylcholine synthesis
rationale: All members concern synthesis of PA, DAG/MAG, TAG and PC via CDP-choline; PC synthesis and its regulation distinguish it from neighbours focused on phospholipid remodelling, hydrolysis or triglyceride catabolism and lipid droplets.

name: Glycerolipid biosynthesis via PA, DAG, TAG and CDP-choline
rationale: All members concern synthesis of phosphatidic acid, mono-/di-/triacylglycerol and phosphatidylcholine via the CDP-choline route and its regulation, whereas confusables cover other phospholipid classes and remodeling or triglyceride breakdown and lipid droplets.

name: Phosphatidic acid-derived triglyceride and phosphatidylcholine synthesis
rationale: All members concern synthesis of phosphatidic acid, mono/diacylglycerol, triglyceride and phosphatidylcholine (CDP-choline) and their regulation, distinguishing it from lipolysis/lipid-droplet confusables and from the broader phospholipid remodelling/catabolism confusable.

name: Apoptotic nuclear dismantling and developmental cell death
rationale: Members cover DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation and lamina breakdown in apoptosis execution plus developmental, involution and autophagic cell death, unlike confusables on PAK-2p34, dependence receptors or necroptosis.

name: Cell death execution, nuclear dismantling and tissue involution
rationale: Members cover apoptotic DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation, lamina breakdown, execution-phase control, autophagic death and developmental/involution death, unlike dependence-receptor, necroptosis, PAK-2 and BAF confusables.

name: Execution-phase cell death: DNA fragmentation, lamina breakdown, involution
rationale: Members cover apoptotic DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation and lamina breakdown plus developmental and autophagic death in involution, unlike PAK-2p34, dependence-receptor and necroptosis neighbours.

qualifier: netrin and semaphorin-plexin signaling with axon extension
name: Netrin and semaphorin-plexin axon guidance and extension
rationale: All members are axon guidance and projection extension with netrin and semaphorin-plexin signaling, while confusables emphasize Sema3A chemorepulsion and negative regulation of extension.

qualifier: netrin and semaphorin-plexin signaling with axon extension
name: Netrin and semaphorin-plexin axon guidance and extension
rationale: All members concern guided axon growth via netrin and semaphorin-plexin signaling and positive axon extension, while confusables emphasise Sema3A chemorepulsion and negative extension control.

qualifier: netrin and semaphorin cues with projection extension
name: Netrin and semaphorin axon guidance with projection extension
rationale: Members are axon guidance and extension processes including netrin and semaphorin-plexin signaling; netrin signaling and positive axon extension distinguish it from chemorepulsion-centred neighbours.

name: Lipid droplet triglyceride storage with LXR and lipophagy control
rationale: Members regulate triglyceride storage, lipid droplet disassembly and lipophagy, with LXR (NR1H2/3) lipogenic/lipolytic programs absent from glycerolipid-synthesis and lipase confusables.

name: Lipid droplet triglyceride storage, lipophagy and LXR regulation
rationale: Members cover lipid droplet organization, lipophagy and triglyceride storage with LXR (NR1H2/3) transcriptional control, which the TAG-synthesis, lipolysis and adipogenesis confusables lack.

name: Lipid droplet triglyceride storage, lipophagy and LXR control
rationale: Members regulate triglyceride storage, lipid droplet organization/disassembly and lipophagy, with NR1H2/3 (LXR) lipogenic/lipolytic gene control that the TAG synthesis, lipolysis and adipocyte confusables lack.

name: Nuclear mRNA and snRNA maturation, splicing, export and surveillance
rationale: Members cover spliceosome and snRNP biogenesis, polyadenylation and histone 3'-end processing, mRNA export and nuclear exosome decay, distinguishing them from cytoplasmic mRNA decay and rRNA/Pol I-III transcription confusables.

qualifier: pre-mRNA/snRNA splicing, 3'-end processing, surveillance and export
name: Nuclear pre-mRNA and snRNA processing, surveillance and export
rationale: Members cover splicing, snRNP biogenesis, histone and polyadenylated 3'-end processing, nuclear exosome decay and mRNA export, distinguishing it from rRNA/Pol I-III transcription and cytoplasmic decapping/5'-3' decay confusables.

qualifier: pre-mRNA splicing, snRNA and 3'-end processing, nuclear surveillance and export
name: Pre-mRNA and snRNA processing, nuclear surveillance and export
rationale: Members cover spliceosome and snRNP biogenesis, mRNA and histone 3'-end processing, nuclear exosome decay and mRNA export, unlike confusables on Pol I/III rRNA synthesis or cytoplasmic 5'-to-3' mRNA decay.

core: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and translation
name: mRNA stability and silencing by small RNAs and RNA-binding proteins
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA biogenesis and silencing, ARE-binding protein mRNA decay/stabilisation, deadenylation and decay, distinct from translation, mRNA export, splicing and transcription confusables.

core: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and translation
qualifier: RNA-binding protein and small RNA-mediated silencing
name: mRNA stability, decay and small RNA-mediated silencing
rationale: Members are ARE-binding proteins, deadenylation/decay, miRNA/siRNA biogenesis and silencing and translational repression; confusables are mRNA export, transcription, translation/NMD or splicing.

name: Post-transcriptional mRNA stability, decay and small-RNA silencing
rationale: Members cover ARE-binding protein decay/stabilization, deadenylation, decapping, polyadenylation and miRNA/siRNA biogenesis and silencing, unlike confusables on mRNA export, translation, splicing or transcription.

name: Lipoxygenase-derived eicosanoids and specialized pro-resolving mediators
rationale: Members cover lipoxygenase and epoxygenase products (leukotrienes, lipoxins, hepoxilins, EETs) plus resolvins, protectins and maresins, which confusables on omega-hydroxylase HETEs and eicosanoid receptors lack.

name: Lipoxygenase and epoxygenase oxylipin and pro-resolving mediator biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover leukotriene, lipoxin, HETE, hepoxilin and EET production and resolvin/protectin/maresin biosynthesis, distinct from confusables on omega-hydroxylation, fatty acid transport and eicosanoid receptors.

core: Oxygenated polyunsaturated fatty acid mediator biosynthesis
qualifier: lipoxygenase eicosanoids and specialized pro-resolving mediators
name: Lipoxygenase eicosanoid and pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover leukotriene, HETE, hepoxilin, lipoxin and EET synthesis plus resolvin, protectin and maresin biosynthesis, which confusables (omega-hydroxylation, prostanoid/leukotriene receptors) lack.

qualifier: chemosensation (taste, smell, pheromone) plus pain and temperature
name: Chemosensory and pain/temperature sensory transduction
rationale: Members are taste, smell, pheromone, itch, pain and thermosensory perception with their TRP and two-pore K+ channels, whereas confusables lack the taste and olfactory receptor systems.

qualifier: taste, smell, pain and thermosensation; TRP and K2P channels
name: Taste, smell, pain and thermosensation with TRP and K2P channels
rationale: Members are chemosensory (taste, olfaction, pheromone), nociceptive, itch and thermal perception plus TRP and tandem-pore K+ channels, whereas confusables are dominated by resting-potential K2P or tachykinin signaling without chemosensation.

qualifier: taste, smell, pain and thermal sensing with K2P/TRP channels
name: Chemosensation, nociception and two-pore potassium/TRP channels
rationale: Members span taste, olfaction, pheromone, pain, itch and temperature sensing together with K2P and TRP channels, whereas confusables are limited to resting-potential K2P channels or tachykinin signaling without chemosensory perception.

qualifier: gonad, genital tract, prostate and pancreatic endocrine lineage
name: Gonad, genital tract, prostate and pancreatic endocrine development
rationale: Members cover sex determination, gonad, uterus/vagina/oviduct, prostate, adrenal and pancreatic endocrine progenitor development; the gonadal, genital-tract and prostate content separates it from the pancreatic-duct, mammary and germ-cell confusables.

qualifier: gonad, reproductive tract and pancreatic endocrine lineages
name: Gonadal, reproductive tract and pancreatic endocrine development
rationale: Members cover sex determination, gonad, prostate, uterus/vagina and adrenal development plus pancreatic endocrine progenitor lineages, which together separate the theme from the pancreatic-ductal, mammary-gland and germ-cell/seminiferous confusables.

qualifier: gonad, genital tract, prostate and pancreatic endocrine lineages
name: Gonad, genital tract, prostate and pancreatic endocrine development
rationale: Members cover sex determination, gonad and reproductive tract (uterus, oviduct, vagina, genitalia) and prostate morphogenesis plus pancreatic endocrine/exocrine progenitor lineages and adrenal development, unlike confusables centred on germ cells and seminiferous tubules, mammary gland or pancreatic ducts.

qualifier: HGF/MET plus TGF-beta/activin receptors and their cancer mutants
name: HGF/MET and TGF-beta/activin receptor signaling with cancer mutants
rationale: Members are MET receptor activation and downstream effectors plus TGF-beta, activin, AMH and TGFBR3 signaling and TGFBR/SMAD cancer mutants; the TGF-beta superfamily half separates it from PI3K/ALK, PTK6/ERBB and liver confusables.

core: HGF-MET and TGF-beta superfamily receptor signaling
name: HGF-MET and TGF-beta/activin receptor signaling with cancer mutants
rationale: Members are MET/HGF signalling and TGF-beta/activin/AMH receptor signalling including TGFBR3 and cancer receptor/SMAD mutants, which the liver-development, PI3K/ALK and PTK6/EGFR confusables lack.

qualifier: HGF–MET and TGF-beta/activin, with cancer mutants
name: HGF–MET and TGF-beta/activin receptor signaling with oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members combine HGF/MET (and MST1) receptor signaling with TGF-beta, activin and AMH receptor signaling, TGFBR3 regulation and cancer mutants of TGFBR/SMAD; confusables carry PTK6/ERBB, ALK/PI3K or liver-development members instead.

core: Aromatic and sulfur amino acid catabolism
qualifier: with selenium compound metabolism and BH4/B6 cofactors
name: Aromatic and sulfur amino acid catabolism with selenium handling
rationale: Members cover phenylalanine/tyrosine and cysteine/transsulfuration catabolism with their cofactors (BH4, PLP, Moco), and the selenium metabolism reactions separate it from the broader amino acid and glutathione confusables.

core: Sulfur and aromatic amino acid metabolism
qualifier: with selenium, BH4, vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor
name: Sulfur, selenium and aromatic amino acid metabolism with cofactors
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration/cysteine/sulfide catabolism, phenylalanine-tyrosine catabolism and their cofactors (BH4, PLP, MoCo), plus selenium compound metabolism, which separates the theme from the glutathione, urea-cycle and general amino-acid confusables.

core: Sulfur and aromatic amino acid metabolism
qualifier: selenium, tetrahydrobiopterin, B6 and molybdenum cofactors
name: Sulfur, selenium and aromatic amino acid metabolism with cofactors
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration/sulfide, phenylalanine-tyrosine catabolism and their cofactors (BH4, PLP, MoCo), with selenium compound metabolism and aromatic/cofactor members separating it from urea-cycle, glutathione and choline neighbours.

qualifier: positive and negative control of inflammatory cytokine output
name: Regulation of TLR signaling and inflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members regulate TLR/IL-1/CD40 signaling and the IL-6, IL-1, TNF, IL-10, IL-12 cytokines they induce; confusables instead cover inflammasomes/LPS detection, TAK1/IKK adaptor steps or T-cell NF-kB restraint.

qualifier: controlling inflammatory cytokine production (IL-1, IL-6, IL-10, IL-12, TNF)
name: Regulation of Toll-like receptor signalling and inflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulators of TLR2/3/4, MyD88/TRIF, IL-1 and CD40 signalling and of IL-1, IL-6, IL-10, IL-12 and TNF production, whereas confusables emphasise TAK1/IKK intermediates, inflammasomes and LPS detection, or T-cell and NF-kB suppression.

name: Regulation of toll-like receptor signalling and inflammatory cytokine output
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulators of TLR (TLR2/3/4, MyD88, TRIF), IL-1, CD40 signalling and of IL-6, IL-10, IL-12, IL-1, TNF and IFN-alpha production, distinct from confusables on T-cell suppression, TRIF/TAK1 mechanics or inflammasomes and LPS detection.

qualifier: iron, heme, copper and cadmium rather than zinc
name: Iron, heme, copper and heavy-metal transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members are transport, homeostasis and detoxification of iron/heme/transferrin, copper, cadmium, manganese and cobalt, distinguished from confusables dominated by zinc handling or HMOX1/BACH1 metal responses.

name: Iron, copper, manganese and cadmium transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members concern uptake, transport, detoxification and homeostasis of iron/heme, copper, manganese, cadmium and cobalt, whereas confusables are zinc-centred or about HMOX1/metal-responsive transcription.

core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
name: Iron, heme, copper and cadmium transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members concern uptake, transport, detoxification and homeostasis of iron/heme/transferrin, copper, cadmium, manganese and cobalt; confusables are zinc-centred, oxidative-stress (HMOX1) or general membrane transport.

core: Protein quality control and ubiquitin-dependent degradation
name: Ubiquitin-dependent quality control of misfolded proteins and ERAD
rationale: Members cover misfolded-protein responses, E3 ligases, DUBs, N-/C-degron and proteasomal degradation and ERAD regulation, unlike confusables on ubiquitin chain types, ribosome-associated QC, stress granules or aggrephagy.

qualifier: misfolded protein quality control, ERAD and degron rules
name: Ubiquitin-dependent quality-control degradation of misfolded proteins
rationale: Members cover misfolded protein responses, ERAD regulation, N/C-end degron and proteasomal degradation control with DUBs and E3s, distinguishing it from ubiquitin chain-type, ribosome quality control and aggrephagy neighbours.

core: Protein quality control by ubiquitin-proteasome degradation
qualifier: misfolded proteins, ERAD and degron pathways
name: Ubiquitin-proteasome quality control of misfolded proteins, including ERAD
rationale: Members cover misfolded-protein responses, ERAD, N-/C-degron and ubiquitin-dependent proteasomal catabolism and DUBs, unlike neighbours on atypical ubiquitin chains, ribosome QC/stress granules or aggrephagy.

qualifier: attachment, entry, envelope protein maturation and assembly
name: Viral attachment, entry, envelope protein maturation and assembly
rationale: Members span virion attachment and entry, maturation of envelope/spike/3a proteins and virion assembly, combining what confusables split between entry-only and nucleoprotein-maturation sets.

name: Viral entry, envelope protein maturation and virion assembly
rationale: Members combine virus attachment/entry with maturation of envelope, spike and accessory proteins and virion assembly/release across dengue, coronavirus, RSV and HIV, whereas each confusable has only part of this (entry or nucleoprotein maturation).

qualifier: with envelope protein maturation and virion assembly
name: Viral attachment, entry and envelope protein maturation
rationale: Members span viral attachment/entry and maturation of viral envelope/structural proteins with virion assembly (dengue, coronavirus, RSV, HIV), whereas each confusable lacks either the entry or the protein maturation component.

core: Germline and early embryonic genome programming
qualifier: piRNA transposon silencing, spermatogenesis and maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Germline piRNA silencing, spermatogenesis and maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members span germ cell specification and spermatogenesis, piRNA biogenesis and transposon heterochromatin silencing, and zygotic chromatin remodelling, genome activation and maternal mRNA clearance, unlike confusables limited to maternal mRNA deadenylation/M-decay, imprinting or X inactivation.

core: Germline and early embryonic gene regulation
qualifier: piRNA silencing, spermatogenesis and maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Germline piRNA silencing, spermatogenesis and maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members concern germ-cell specification, piRNA transposon silencing, sperm chromatin and spermatogenesis, and zygotic genome activation, distinguishing them from imprinting/X inactivation and maternal mRNA deadenylation in confusables.

core: Germline and early embryo gene regulation
qualifier: piRNA silencing, gametogenesis and maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Germline piRNA silencing, gametogenesis and maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members span piRNA biogenesis and transposon silencing, spermatogenesis, oocyte and germ cell specification, and zygotic genome activation, unlike confusables on imprinting/X-inactivation or maternal mRNA deadenylation and M-decay.

core: Organelle acidification and cation gradient homeostasis
name: Organelle acidification and Na+/K+/H+ gradient homeostasis
rationale: Members cover V-ATPase acidification of lysosome, endosome, Golgi and synaptic vesicle lumens plus Na+/H+ exchangers and P-type ATPase Na+/K+ homeostasis; the cation-exchange arm separates it from phagosome, bicarbonate/anion and phosphate confusables.

name: Organelle lumen acidification and Na+/K+/H+ gradient maintenance
rationale: Members cover V-ATPase acidification of lysosomes, endosomes, Golgi and synaptic vesicles together with Na+/H+ exchangers and Na+/K+ P-type ATPase homeostasis, distinguishing the theme from confusables on phospholipid scrambling, phosphate/bicarbonate or anion transport, and phagosome acidification.

qualifier: with Na+/H+ exchange and Na+/K+ gradient homeostasis
name: Organelle acidification and sodium/potassium/proton gradient homeostasis
rationale: Members set luminal pH of endosomes, lysosomes, Golgi and synaptic vesicles plus Na+/H+ exchangers and P-type ATPase cation gradients, unlike phagosome, phospholipid scrambling or anion-exchange neighbours.

name: FcεRI-mediated mast cell activation and hypersensitivity
rationale: Members are FcεRI signalling (Ca2+, MAPK, NF-kB), mast cell degranulation, cytokine output and differentiation, and hypersensitivity reactions, unlike the Th2/eosinophil and Fc-gamma receptor confusables.

name: Fc-epsilon receptor mast cell activation and hypersensitivity
rationale: Members are FcERI signalling, mast cell differentiation, degranulation and histamine release, and hypersensitivity reactions, setting it apart from Th2/eosinophil cytokine and Fc-gamma phagocytosis confusables.

name: FcεRI-mediated mast cell activation and hypersensitivity reactions
rationale: Members are FcεRI signaling, mast cell degranulation/histamine/cytokine output and hypersensitivity types, unlike Th2/eosinophil cytokine confusables and Fc-gamma phagocytosis confusables.

name: Perinatal alveolar maturation and surfactant homeostasis
rationale: Members cover pneumocyte differentiation, saccular and pulmonary vascular development, perinatal adaptations (hyperoxia, ductus closure) and surfactant metabolism and its genetic defects, which distinguish it from lung-branching and other epithelial confusables.

name: Perinatal alveolar maturation, pneumocytes and surfactant homeostasis
rationale: Members cover surfactant metabolism and its disorders, type I/II pneumocyte and saccule development and perinatal transitions (hyperoxia, ductus closure), distinguishing it from the lung branching and unrelated membrane/oxygen-transport confusables.

name: Perinatal lung alveolar maturation and surfactant homeostasis
rationale: Members cover pneumocyte and saccule development, surfactant metabolism and its genetic defects, and perinatal adaptations (ductus closure, hyperoxia); surfactant distinguishes it from branching-morphogenesis neighbours and alveolar development from gas-transport and scrambling neighbours.

qualifier: tract-level pathfinding of commissural and projection neurons
name: Tract-level axon pathfinding of commissural and projection neurons
rationale: Members describe axon guidance at the level of specific tracts and neuron types (commissural, retinal, dopaminergic, serotonergic, corticospinal) including midline repulsion, while confusables are dominated by the underlying SLIT-ROBO, netrin and ephrin signaling machinery.

qualifier: tract- and neuron-type-specific pathfinding and midline crossing
name: Axon pathfinding of specific tracts and midline crossing
rationale: Members are axon guidance processes defined by target tract or neuron type (commissural, retinal, corticospinal, monoaminergic) and midline choice points, unlike neighbours defined by ephrin, netrin, L1 or SLIT/ROBO signaling machinery.

name: Axon pathfinding of commissural and long-range projection tracts
rationale: Members describe guidance of commissural, retinal, corticospinal, dopaminergic and serotonergic axons and tract morphogenesis at the process level, unlike the confusables' molecular SLIT-ROBO, netrin, ephrin and L1 signaling.

name: Two-pore-domain potassium channels in pain and thermosensation
rationale: Members are K2P channel families (TWIK, TREK, TASK, TALK, THIK, TRESK) with pain, itch and temperature sensing, unlike TRP, taste/olfaction and Ca-activated K+ confusables.

name: Two-pore-domain K+ channels in pain and thermosensation
rationale: Members combine K2P channel families with pain, itch and temperature detection and neuronal excitability, separating it from TRP/taste and Ca2+-activated K+ channel confusables.

name: Two-pore-domain potassium channels in pain and temperature sensing
rationale: Members are K2P channel families with excitability and pain/thermal/itch perception; the K2P channels distinguish it from TRP/tachykinin and taste/smell confusables, and pain sensing from the Ca-activated K+ confusable.

core: Dendritic cell and T cell surface signatures
qualifier: T cell costimulation and dendritic cell differentiation
name: Dendritic cell and T cell surface costimulation
rationale: Members are DC and T cell surface signatures with regulation of T cell costimulation and DC differentiation; neighbours are NK/cytotoxic, monocyte, MHC-II presentation or B cell themes.

core: Dendritic cell and T cell surface signatures
qualifier: T cell costimulation and DC differentiation
name: Dendritic cell surface signatures and T cell costimulation
rationale: Members are APC and T cell surface signatures plus regulation of DC differentiation and T cell costimulation/activation; unlike monocyte, B cell, NK/tolerance and MHC-II processing neighbours, it emphasizes DC-T cell contact.

core: Antigen-presenting cell and T cell surface signatures
name: Dendritic cell-T cell surface costimulation and dendritic cell differentiation
rationale: Members are DC, T and plasma cell surface signatures plus regulation of T cell costimulation and DC differentiation/activation, lacking the MHC presentation, monocyte/CD1 and NK cytotoxicity content of confusables.

qualifier: lipoxygenase/hepoxilin branch and inherited enzyme or transporter defects
name: Lipoxygenase eicosanoids and inherited fatty acid enzyme defects
rationale: Members share fatty acid and eicosanoid metabolism via the 12-lipoxygenase/hepoxilin route and inherited defects of fatty acid enzymes and transporters, unlike confusables centred on P450 epoxygenase and omega-hydroxylase routes.

qualifier: lipoxygenase products and inherited enzyme/transporter defects
name: Lipoxygenase eicosanoid synthesis and fatty acid metabolism disorders
rationale: Members are fatty acid/eicosanoid metabolism, lipoxygenase/hepoxilin synthesis and inherited CYP/SLC defects, versus confusables centred on omega-hydroxylase and epoxygenase P450 routes.

name: 12-lipoxygenase eicosanoids and inherited fatty acid enzyme defects
rationale: Members span eicosanoid/fatty acid synthesis and transport, with the 12-lipoxygenase hepoxilin branch and inherited TBXAS1/CYP/SLC defects distinguishing it from the P450 omega-hydroxylase and epoxygenase confusables.

qualifier: L1-family nodal axon adhesion and connexin gap junctions
name: Nodal axon adhesion complexes and connexin gap junctions
rationale: Members combine L1/neurofascin-ankyrin node and paranode organisation with connexin gap junction assembly, both serving electrical signal propagation, unlike confusables on neuronal adhesion, L1 signalling and myelination.

qualifier: nodal axon domains and connexin gap junctions
name: Nodal axon domains and connexin gap junction assembly
rationale: Members combine L1-family/neurofascin/NrCAM-ankyrin and LGI-ADAM interactions building paranodes and sodium channel clusters for action potential propagation with connexin trafficking and gap junction formation, the latter absent from myelination and L1-adhesion confusables.

name: L1-CAM/ankyrin nodal assembly and connexin gap junction formation
rationale: Members combine L1-family CAM (neurofascin, NrCAM, CHL1)-ankyrin sodium channel clustering and paranodal assembly with connexin trafficking and gap junction formation, the latter absent from L1, adhesion and myelination confusables.

core: Striated muscle sarcomere organization and contraction
name: Striated muscle sarcomere, T-tubule and desmosomal junction organization
rationale: Members span sarcomere filament assembly and contraction plus cardiomyocyte adhesion, desmosomes and T-tubules, which separate it from SRF/myogenesis, generic adhesion and costamere/DGC confusables.

core: Striated muscle sarcomere assembly and contraction
name: Striated muscle sarcomere, contraction and cardiomyocyte junctions
rationale: Members span myofibril/filament assembly, T-tubules, contraction and stretch sensing plus desmosome and cardiomyocyte cell-cell junctions; confusables lack the junction members and instead carry costamere/DGC, SRF targets or myogenesis development.

core: Striated muscle sarcomere assembly and contraction
name: Striated muscle sarcomere and cardiomyocyte intercalated-disc junctions
rationale: Members span myofibril/filament assembly, contraction, T-tubules and cardiomyocyte cell-cell adhesion via desmosomes and intermediate filaments; the junctional component distinguishes it from confusables centred on muscle development, costameres or SRF targets.

core: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt signaling
qualifier: retinal vascular and blood-brain barrier formation
name: Wnt secretion, non-canonical Wnt and blood-retinal barrier formation
rationale: Members combine Wnt ligand biogenesis/PORCN-dependent secretion, WNT5A-Ca2+ non-canonical signaling and FZD internalization with retinal vessel morphogenesis, RPE development and blood-retina/blood-brain barrier establishment; the vascular-barrier arm distinguishes it from canonical Wnt, Hedgehog lipidation and planar polarity confusables.

name: Wnt secretion, Wnt/Ca2+ signalling and blood-retina barrier
rationale: Members cover Wnt ligand biogenesis/secretion, WNT5A-FZD non-canonical Ca2+ signalling and FZD4-dependent retinal vessel and blood-retina/brain barrier formation, unlike canonical Wnt, Hedgehog lipidation and PCP confusables.

name: Wnt secretion, non-canonical signaling and blood-retinal barrier formation
rationale: Members cover PORCN-dependent Wnt biogenesis/secretion, WNT5A-Ca2+ signaling and FZD internalization, and retinal vessel/RPE and blood-brain/retinal barrier formation, which the PCP, canonical beta-catenin and Hedgehog-lipidation confusables lack.

qualifier: modulation by betaglycan (TGFBR3), follistatin and negative feedback
name: TGF-beta/activin SMAD2/3 signalling modulated by betaglycan and antagonists
rationale: Members concern TGF-beta and activin signalling through SMAD2/3:SMAD4 and its tuning by TGFBR3, follistatin and receptor/SMAD downregulation, unlike confusables on cancer receptor/SMAD mutants, RUNX3 targets, AMH or BMP signalling.

name: TGF-beta and activin SMAD2/3 signalling with betaglycan regulation
rationale: Members regulate TGF-beta and activin signalling through SMAD2/3:SMAD4, including TGFBR3 coreceptor and follistatin control, unlike BMP, AMH or cancer-mutant TGF-beta receptor pathways in confusables.

core: TGF-beta and activin SMAD2/3 signalling regulation
name: TGF-beta and activin signalling tuned by betaglycan and follistatin
rationale: Members regulate TGF-beta/activin-SMAD2/3 signalling via TGFBR3 co-receptor, follistatin antagonism and SMAD downregulation, unlike confusables on cancer receptor/SMAD mutants, BMP signalling or RUNX3.

name: Autophagosome assembly and maturation in cargo-selective autophagy
rationale: Members regulate phagophore cargo recruitment, autophagosome assembly and maturation for mitophagy, pexophagy and xenophagy, versus confusables on PINK1-PRKN mitochondrial control, lysosome fusion or micro/chaperone-mediated autophagy.

qualifier: receptor-mediated pexophagy, mitophagy and autophagosome regulation
name: Receptor-mediated pexophagy, mitophagy and autophagosome regulation
rationale: Members cover cargo targeting in pexophagy, receptor-mediated mitophagy and xenophagy plus regulation of autophagosome assembly and maturation, unlike reticulophagy, aggrephagy/CMA, lysosome fusion and PINK1-PRKN confusables.

qualifier: receptor-mediated cargo targeting and autophagosome biogenesis regulation
name: Receptor-mediated selective autophagy and autophagosome biogenesis regulation
rationale: Members cover receptor-mediated mitophagy, pexophagy and xenophagy, cargo targeting to phagophores and regulation of autophagosome assembly and maturation, unlike the microautophagy/CMA, PINK1-PRKN mitochondrial, lysosome-fusion and reticulophagy confusables.

name: Motile cilium axoneme assembly and left-right asymmetry
rationale: Members cover axonemal dynein arm and central apparatus assembly, sperm axoneme and mucociliary clearance plus nodal-cilia left-right organ asymmetry, which multiciliogenesis and CSF-flow confusables lack.

name: Motile cilium axoneme assembly and left-right asymmetry
rationale: Members concern axonemal dynein/central apparatus assembly in motile cilia and sperm and the nodal-cilia-driven left-right asymmetry of organs, which the multiciliogenesis and CSF-flow neighbours lack.

qualifier: axoneme assembly and left-right asymmetry determination
name: Motile cilium axoneme assembly and left-right asymmetry determination
rationale: Members concern axonemal dynein arm/central apparatus assembly, sperm axoneme and mucociliary clearance plus left-right axis specification, which the multiciliogenesis/basal body confusables lack.

qualifier: Ig-superfamily (L1, CHL1, DSCAM, SDK, nectin) in fasciculation and self-avoidance
name: Ig-superfamily neuronal adhesion in fasciculation and self-avoidance
rationale: Members are neuronal adhesion molecule interactions driving fasciculation, dendrite self-avoidance, synapse pruning and contact repulsion, unlike confusables on netrin, semaphorin and SLIT/ROBO axon guidance.

qualifier: immunoglobulin-superfamily L1/DSCAM receptors, self-avoidance and fasciculation
name: L1/DSCAM-family neuronal adhesion and dendrite self-avoidance
rationale: Members concern Ig-superfamily neuronal adhesion molecules (L1, CHL1, DSCAM, sidekick, nectins) mediating fasciculation, self-avoidance, remodelling and pruning, unlike the semaphorin, netrin and SLIT-ROBO axon guidance confusables.

qualifier: L1, DSCAM, sidekick and nectin roles in fasciculation and self-avoidance
name: Neuronal adhesion molecules in fasciculation and dendrite self-avoidance
rationale: Members are neuronal adhesion molecule interactions driving fasciculation, self-avoidance and remodeling, unlike confusables built on netrin, slit-robo, semaphorin and ephrin guidance cues.

qualifier: self nucleic acid tolerance (ADAR editing, TREX1)
name: Endosomal TLR7/8/9 signalling and self nucleic acid tolerance
rationale: Members regulate TLR7/8/9 and IRF5 signalling and restrain type I interferon through ADAR A-to-I editing and TREX1, distinguishing it from RIG-I/cytosolic sensing, OAS/PKR and TLR3 confusables.

core: Nucleic acid-sensing control of type I interferon
qualifier: endosomal TLR7/8/9 and ADAR RNA editing
name: Endosomal TLR7/8/9 and ADAR editing control of interferon
rationale: Members regulate self nucleic acid sensing (TLR7/8/9, IRF5, TREX1) and A-to-I editing restraining type I interferon; confusables are cytosolic RIG-I/cGAS antiviral responses or TLR3 defects lacking these.

name: Self-nucleic-acid sensing via endosomal TLR7-9 and ADAR editing
rationale: Members cover endosomal TLR7/8/9 signalling regulation, TREX1 and ADAR A-to-I editing that restrain type I interferon responses, unlike confusables on cytosolic RIG-I/cGAS, PKR/OAS or TLR3 sensing.

name: Peroxisome biogenesis, protein import and pexophagy
rationale: Members cover peroxisomal membrane/matrix protein import, fission and autophagic turnover of peroxisomes, while neighbours are peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation and lipid synthesis.

qualifier: matrix and membrane protein import, fission, pexophagy
name: Peroxisome biogenesis, protein import and pexophagy
rationale: Members concern targeting and import of peroxisomal proteins, peroxisome fission and autophagy of peroxisomes, while confusables are peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation and lipid synthesis.

name: Peroxisome biogenesis, protein import and pexophagy
rationale: Members are peroxisomal matrix and membrane protein import, fission, TYSND1 processing and peroxisome autophagy; confusables are peroxisomal fatty-acid oxidation and lipid synthesis themes.

qualifier: ephrin, netrin and SLIT-ROBO receptors via Rho GTPases
name: Ephrin, netrin and SLIT-ROBO axon guidance via Rho GTPases
rationale: Members are ephrin, netrin/DCC and SLIT-ROBO guidance signalling and the RAC1/CDC42/RHOA switching they drive, distinct from semaphorin, L1 and commissural midline confusables.

qualifier: netrin, ephrin and SLIT-ROBO cues acting via Rho GTPases
name: Netrin, ephrin and SLIT-ROBO guidance via Rho GTPases
rationale: Members are netrin/DCC, EPH-ephrin and SLIT-ROBO signalling with RAC1/CDC42/RHOA regulation and growth cone collapse, distinguishing it from L1, semaphorin-plexin and commissural midline confusables.

qualifier: ephrin, netrin and SLIT-ROBO cues acting via Rho GTPases
name: Ephrin, netrin and SLIT-ROBO guidance signaling via Rho GTPases
rationale: Members are ephrin/EPH, netrin/DCC and SLIT/ROBO signaling with RAC/CDC42/RHOA regulation, distinguishing it from semaphorin-plexin, L1/CHL1/DSCAM and commissural midline confusables.

qualifier: telomerase recruitment to telomeres plus snRNA/rRNA modification
name: Cajal body telomerase trafficking and small RNA modification
rationale: Members cover scaRNA/telomerase RNA localisation to Cajal bodies, telomerase assembly and telomere extension alongside snRNA/rRNA modification; telomerase extension separates it from snoRNP/RNA-modification confusables and RNA modification from telomere-capping confusables.

name: Telomerase recruitment via Cajal bodies and snRNA/rRNA modification
rationale: Members cover telomerase assembly, scaRNA/telomerase localization to Cajal bodies and telomere extension together with snRNA and rRNA modification/processing, lacking the telomere capping/heterochromatin, tRNA methylation, box C/D snoRNP or RNA decay content of the confusables.

core: Cajal body small RNA trafficking and modification
name: Cajal body RNA modification and telomerase-mediated telomere extension
rationale: Members cover scaRNA/telomerase RNA localization to Cajal bodies, sn/rRNA modification, telomerase holoenzyme assembly and telomere lengthening; the telomerase extension arm separates it from the snoRNA modification confusable and the RNA modification arm from the telomere protection confusable.

name: SRP-dependent and tail-anchored protein targeting to ER
rationale: Members are co- and post-translational ER targeting and membrane insertion plus ER retention and folding, distinct from COPII export and ERAD confusables.

core: Protein targeting to the endoplasmic reticulum
name: SRP-dependent and tail-anchored protein targeting to ER
rationale: Members describe co- and post-translational protein targeting, membrane insertion and retention in the ER, distinguishing it from confusables on COPII export and ER-associated degradation.

name: SRP-dependent and tail-anchored protein insertion into ER

qualifier: negative regulation of IFN and cGAS-STING signalling

core: Type I interferon induction and response

qualifier: erythrocyte gas exchange and iron-export disorders

rationale: Members cover iron uptake/export (transferrin, ferroportin, ceruloplasmin), heme scavenging and erythrocyte O2/CO2/NO transport, distinct from heme biosynthesis, cadmium and membrane-transport confusables.

name: Iron uptake, heme scavenging and erythrocyte gas exchange
rationale: Members cover transferrin/ferroportin/DMT1/ceruloplasmin iron handling, heme transport and scavenging, and erythrocyte O2/CO2/NO transport; confusables add heme biosynthesis and Rh ammonium transport, cadmium handling or pathogen iron assimilation instead.

qualifier: pyrimidine/deoxynucleotide breakdown and NUDT pool sanitisation
name: Pyrimidine and deoxynucleotide catabolism with NUDT pool sanitisation
rationale: Members degrade pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotides and hydrolyse nucleoside triphosphates (NUDT, thiopurine handling), unlike confusables on nucleotide biosynthesis, salvage or purine deoxynucleoside metabolism.

name: Nucleotide and deoxynucleotide catabolism including thiopurine drugs
rationale: Members degrade pyrimidine and (deoxy)nucleotides and triphosphates (NUDT sanitization, TPMT/azathioprine), unlike biosynthetic or antiviral-drug neighbours.

qualifier: pyrimidine and nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis including thiopurines
name: Pyrimidine and nucleoside triphosphate catabolism
rationale: Members degrade pyrimidine nucleotides and hydrolyse (deoxy)nucleoside triphosphates including NUDT-mediated pool sanitisation and thiopurine metabolism, unlike confusables on nucleotide biosynthesis, salvage and purine deoxynucleoside metabolism.

qualifier: filtration barrier: podocytes, mesangium and basement membrane
name: Glomerular filtration barrier and mesangium development
rationale: Members are glomerular vasculature, podocyte, mesangial and basement membrane development plus filtration and nephrin/laminin interactions, unlike confusables on nephron tubule development or brush border/epithelial polarity.

qualifier: podocyte, mesangial and glomerular basement membrane
name: Glomerular filtration barrier development: podocytes, mesangium, basement membrane
rationale: Members address glomerular endothelium, podocyte, mesangial and basement membrane development (nephrin, laminin) and filtration function, distinguishing it from tubule development and epithelial polarity/brush border confusables.

qualifier: podocyte, mesangium and basement membrane filtration barrier
name: Glomerular filtration barrier development: podocyte, mesangium, basement membrane
rationale: Members concern glomerular podocyte, mesangial, endothelial and basement membrane development and filtration, lacking the tubule development and brush border/polarity content of confusables.

qualifier: glycosylase excision, direct alkylation reversal and TET-TDG demethylation
name: Glycosylase base repair, alkylation reversal and active DNA demethylation
rationale: Members cover DNA glycosylase lesion recognition and cleavage, direct reversal of alkylation damage, NEIL3 cross-link resolution and TET-TDG demethylation, whereas confusables are restricted to BER gap-filling or specific glycosylase defects.

qualifier: glycosylase excision, alkylation reversal and TET-TDG demethylation
name: Glycosylase excision, alkylation reversal and TET-TDG DNA demethylation
rationale: Members are glycosylase recognition and cleavage of damaged bases (NEIL1/3, crosslink repair), direct reversal of alkylation (ALKBH2/3, MGMT) and TET-TDG demethylation, whereas confusables cover downstream BER gap-filling or specific defective glycosylases.

qualifier: glycosylase excision, alkylation reversal and active demethylation
name: Glycosylase excision, alkylation reversal and active DNA demethylation
rationale: Members span DNA glycosylase recognition/cleavage, ALKBH/MGMT direct alkylation reversal, NEIL3 crosslink resolution and TET/TDG demethylation, whereas confusables are BER gap-filling steps or defective OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1 variants.

qualifier: proteasomal control of GLI, DVL and NOTCH4, nuclear receptor regulation
name: Hedgehog-GLI signalling and proteasomal turnover of developmental regulators
rationale: Members centre on SMO activation and GLI processing/degradation alongside proteasome-dependent turnover of DVL, NOTCH4 and SLIT/ROBO regulation plus retinoic acid/estrogen receptor modulation, unlike confusables on Notch activation, Hh ligand lipidation or planar cell polarity.

qualifier: SMO-GLI processing with proteasomal developmental signaling crosstalk
name: Hedgehog SMO-GLI transduction and proteasomal developmental signaling crosstalk
rationale: Members center on SMO activation and proteasomal GLI processing/degradation alongside proteasome-linked regulation of DVL, NOTCH4, SLIT/ROBO and nuclear receptor signaling, unlike confusables on Hh/Wnt ligand lipidation, planar polarity or Notch transcription.

qualifier: SMO-GLI with proteasomal turnover of signalling regulators
name: Smoothened-GLI Hedgehog transduction and proteasomal regulator turnover
rationale: Members centre on SMO activation and GLI processing/degradation plus proteasome-mediated turnover of DVL, NOTCH4 and SLIT/ROBO regulators and nuclear receptor signalling modulation, whereas confusables cover Hh ligand lipidation/release, Notch activation or Wnt planar polarity.

name: Vitamin D–FGF23–PTH axis in bone mineralization
rationale: Members span vitamin D activation/inactivation and its disorders, FGF23-Klotho and PTH responses, and regulation of bone mineralization, unlike confusables centred on vitamin K, phosphate transporters or tooth mineralization.

qualifier: endocrine control by PTH and FGF23/Klotho
name: Vitamin D, PTH and FGF23 control of bone mineralization
rationale: Members cover vitamin D synthesis/catabolism and its disorders, PTH and FGF23-Klotho signalling, phosphate response and regulation of bone mineralization, distinguishing it from confusables centred on sodium-phosphate transporters, tooth mineralization or vitamin K.

qualifier: vitamin D metabolism, PTH and FGF–Klotho
name: Vitamin D metabolism and endocrine control of bone mineralization
rationale: Members combine vitamin D synthesis/catabolism (CYP27B1, CYP24A1 defects), PTH and FGFR1c–Klotho signalling with bone mineralization regulation, whereas confusables centre on phosphate transporters, tooth mineralization or vitamin K.

qualifier: photoreceptor outer segment and rod/cone development
name: Ciliary cargo targeting and photoreceptor outer segment development
rationale: Members combine primary-cilium membrane cargo targeting (BBSome, VxPx, ARL13B-INPP5E, myristoylated proteins, basal body anchoring) with photoreceptor outer segment and rod/cone development, distinguishing it from intraflagellar transport, motile cilia and non-ciliary retinal differentiation confusables.

name: Ciliary cargo targeting and photoreceptor outer segment development
rationale: Members combine sorting of cargo into the primary cilium (BBSome, VxPx, ARL13B, transition zone, basal body docking) with photoreceptor rod/cone development and outer segment organization, unlike confusables centered on intraflagellar transport, motile cilia or retinal layer formation.

qualifier: photoreceptor outer segment development and maintenance
name: Ciliary cargo targeting and photoreceptor outer segment development
rationale: Members combine BBSome/ARL13B/VxPx cargo delivery to the primary cilium with photoreceptor rod/cone outer segment development, which intraflagellar-transport and motile-cilia confusables lack.

qualifier: with Rett-associated sensory, vocal and social behavior
name: MECP2 regulation and associated sensory, vocal, social behavior
rationale: Members combine MECP2 molecular function (DNA/corepressor binding, HDAC deacetylation, target genes) with the sensory, vocal, social and striatal phenotypes it governs; confusables carry either the molecular half or the behavioral half alone.

core: MECP2 transcriptional regulation and neurodevelopmental behavior
name: MECP2 transcriptional regulation and vocal, social, sensorimotor behavior
rationale: Members combine MECP2 activity, its loss-of-function variants and HDAC corepressor action with Rett-relevant behaviors (vocalization, social and observational learning, prepulse inhibition), which separates the theme from behavior-only and MECP2-memory neighbours.

qualifier: with vocal, social and sensorimotor behavior
name: MECP2 chromatin repression with vocal and sensorimotor behavior
rationale: Members combine MECP2 DNA/NCoR binding, HDAC repression and target regulation with the vocal, auditory, social and prepulse-inhibition behaviors it affects, whereas confusables carry only the molecular MECP2 part or only the behaviors.

qualifier: commissural midline crossing via SLIT-ROBO, ephrin, netrin-DCC and L1
name: Commissural axon guidance by SLIT-ROBO, ephrin, netrin and L1
rationale: Members cover SLIT-ROBO, ephrin, netrin-DCC and L1 signaling with midline choice and fasciculation, whereas confusables emphasise semaphorin/netrin repulsion or neuron-type-specific guidance.

qualifier: ephrin, SLIT-ROBO, netrin-DCC and L1 cues
name: Axon guidance by ephrin, SLIT-ROBO, netrin-DCC and L1 signaling
rationale: All members concern axon guidance and fasciculation through ephrin, ROBO, DCC/netrin and L1 receptors with RAC/CDC42 control; confusables lack ephrin and L1 and emphasize semaphorin/netrin repulsion or neuron-type-specific guidance.

qualifier: via SLIT-ROBO, ephrin, DCC and L1
name: Axon guidance and fasciculation via SLIT-ROBO, ephrin, DCC and L1
rationale: Members are midline and commissural guidance by SLIT-ROBO, ephrin, netrin-DCC attraction and L1 with RAC1 control, whereas confusables emphasise netrin repulsion, semaphorin/CHL1/DSCAM or neuron-type-specific guidance.

qualifier: pyruvate dehydrogenase entry and coenzyme A synthesis feeding the TCA cycle
name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase entry, coenzyme A synthesis and TCA cycle
rationale: Members cover pyruvate decarboxylation by PDH, pantothenate/CoA biosynthesis and TCA cycle intermediates, whereas confusables emphasise Fe-S cluster assembly, OGDH/lipoylation or malate-aspartate shuttle transport.

core: Mitochondrial acetyl-CoA and TCA cycle metabolism
qualifier: pyruvate dehydrogenase and coenzyme A synthesis
name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase, coenzyme A synthesis and TCA cycle
rationale: Members cover PDH-mediated pyruvate oxidation, CoA/pantothenate synthesis and TCA intermediates, distinct from confusables on OGDH/lipoylation, carboxylate transport or Fe-S/ATP synthesis.

core: Mitochondrial carbon entry and TCA cycle
name: PDH-mediated acetyl-CoA entry, coenzyme A synthesis and TCA cycle
rationale: Members cover pyruvate decarboxylation by PDH, CoA/pantothenate synthesis and TCA intermediates (isocitrate, 2-oxoglutarate, succinate, malate), separating it from confusables on Fe-S maturation, carboxylate transport or OGDH/lipoylation.

name: Nucleotide-sugar supply for GPI anchors and glycosphingolipids
rationale: Members cover nucleotide-sugar synthesis and SLC35 transport (and their defects), GPI anchor synthesis/attachment and glycosphingolipid/ganglioside synthesis, distinct from N-glycan, sialic acid and dolichol confusables.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar transport, glycolipid and GPI anchor
name: Nucleotide-sugar transport, glycosphingolipid and GPI-anchor biosynthesis
rationale: Members are SLC35 nucleotide-sugar transporter defects, GDP-fucose/UDP-glucuronate synthesis, glycosphingolipid and GPI-anchor synthesis, unlike confusables centred on N-glycan, dolichol, UDP-GlcNAc or sialic acid metabolism.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar transport, GPI anchoring and glycosphingolipids
name: Nucleotide-sugar transport, GPI anchoring and glycosphingolipid synthesis
rationale: Members cover SLC35/SLC33 nucleotide-sugar transporter defects, GDP-fucose and UDP-glucuronate formation, GPI anchor synthesis/attachment and glycosphingolipid synthesis, whereas confusables focus on N-glycan, dolichol, sialic acid and UDP-GlcNAc metabolism.

name: Epithelial and cardiomyocyte cell-cell junctions with apical-basal polarity
