rationale: Members cover adherens and desmosome junctions, epithelial polarity and cardiomyocyte adhesion, unlike cadherin-assembly neighbours lacking cardiac adhesion and the hemidesmosome theme lacking polarity.

qualifier: epithelial apical–basal polarity and cardiac adhesion
name: Epithelial and cardiac cell junctions with apical–basal polarity
rationale: Members are adherens and desmosomal junctions, apical-basal polarity and cardiomyocyte adhesion; polarity and cardiac intercalated-disc adhesion distinguish it from hemidesmosome and cadherin-assembly neighbours.

qualifier: epithelial apical polarity and cardiomyocyte desmosomal adhesion
name: Epithelial apical junctions, polarity and cardiomyocyte desmosomal adhesion
rationale: Members cover adherens/apical junction maintenance, apical-basal polarity and desmosomal cardiomyocyte adhesion, distinguishing it from cadherin-assembly neighbours and the hemidesmosome neighbour.

name: RB-E2F and CDK control of G1/S transition
rationale: All members concern G1/S control via cyclin D/CDK4/6, cyclin E/CDK2, p27/p21 degradation and RB/DREAM repression of E2F targets, distinct from confusables focused on DNA replication origin licensing or G2/M.

name: G1/S transition control by RB-E2F and G1 CDKs
rationale: All members describe the G1/S switch: RB/DREAM repression of E2F targets, cyclin D/CDK4-6 and cyclin E/CDK2 activity, p27/p21 degradation, distinguishing it from confusables centred on replication origin licensing or G2/M progression.

name: RB-E2F control of G1/S transition
rationale: Members cover RB/p107/p130 repression of E2F targets, cyclin D degradation, CDK4/6 and cyclin E:CDK2 activity and p27/p21 turnover at G1/S, whereas confusables extend to replication origin licensing or G2/M events.

qualifier: germinal center and T follicular help
name: B cell activation, germinal center and memory responses
rationale: Members cover BCR-driven B cell proliferation, germinal center and B-1 differentiation, Tfh/ICOS/CD27 co-stimulation and memory responses, whereas confusables emphasise B cell development and differentiation.

qualifier: Tfh/ICOS-CD27 co-stimulation and B cell memory
name: Germinal center B cell response, Tfh co-stimulation and memory
rationale: Members describe B cell activation, proliferation and germinal center differentiation driven by T follicular helper/ICOS and CD27 co-stimulation leading to memory B cells and humoral memory, beyond the general B cell development modules of the confusables.

name: Antigen-driven B cell activation, Tfh co-stimulation and memory
rationale: Members cover germinal centre and B-1 B cell differentiation, BCR-driven proliferation, Tfh/ICOS/CD27 co-stimulation, memory B cell signatures and B cell modules, which the B cell development confusables lack.

core: Pathogen subversion of host cell defences
qualifier: macrophage survival strategies and bacterial toxin uptake
name: Pathogen subversion of macrophage defences and toxin uptake
rationale: Members describe how pathogens (Mtb, Leishmania, toxins, SARS) suppress autophagy, apoptosis, NO, phagolysosome fusion and membrane repair in host cells, unlike confusables about bacterial entry, phagosome acidification or anti-inflammatory macrophage signalling.

core: Pathogen subversion of host cell defences
qualifier: mycobacterial immune evasion and bacterial toxins
name: Host defence subversion by mycobacteria and bacterial toxins
rationale: Members describe pathogens manipulating host cells (Mtb suppression of autophagy, apoptosis, NO, phagolysosome fusion; anthrax and diphtheria toxins), unlike confusables focused on Listeria entry, phagosome acidification or DC/IL-10 signalling.

core: Pathogen subversion of host cell defenses
qualifier: by bacterial toxins and intracellular pathogens
name: Bacterial toxin and intracellular-pathogen subversion of host defenses
rationale: Members describe pathogens manipulating host cells (Mtb blocking NO, autophagy, apoptosis, membrane repair and phagolysosome fusion; anthrax and diphtheria toxin uptake; Leishmania damping), whereas neighbours centre on bacterial entry, phagosome acidification or anti-inflammatory cytokine signaling.

name: NGF signaling via TRKA effector cascades and p75NTR
rationale: Members are NGF production and signaling through TRKA downstream effectors (FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, PI3K, CREB) and p75NTR complexes, distinct from NTRK2/NTRK3 and p75NTR-death confusables.

name: NGF signaling through TRKA and p75NTR
rationale: Members are NGF production/processing, p75NTR complexes and TRKA downstream signaling (FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, PI3K, CREB), distinguishing it from TRKB/TRKC and p75NTR death-only confusables.

qualifier: NGF production, TRKA downstream cascades and p75NTR complexes
name: NGF production and TRKA/p75NTR downstream signaling
rationale: Members span NGF processing and binding, TRKA-driven ERK5/p38/PI3K/CREB signaling and p75NTR signalling complexes, unlike confusables on BDNF/NT-3 via NTRK2/NTRK3 or p75NTR-mediated death and proteolysis.

name: Neddylated cullin ligase protein turnover and PD-L1 stability
rationale: Members share cullin-RING ligase control by neddylation/COP9 deneddylation (including RHOBTB CUL3 adaptors), and uniquely include PD-L1 degradation and stabilisation affecting anti-tumour T cell responses.

name: Cullin neddylation and PD-L1 protein turnover
rationale: Members span neddylation/COP9 deneddylation, cullin-adaptor (RHOBTB, SPOP, BTRC) mediated degradation and protein stabilisation, with PD-L1 glycosylation and degradation and anti-tumour T cell regulation distinguishing it from confusables on other CRL substrates, PD-L1 transcription or general proteolysis.

name: Cullin neddylation and PD-L1 stability in tumor immunity
rationale: Members span neddylation/COP9 deneddylation, cullin-adaptor RHOBTB cycles and cullin-mediated degradation, with a block on PD-L1 glycosylation, degradation and T cell anti-tumour responses that the main neddylation confusable lacks.

name: SWI/SNF (BAF) and CHD-family chromatin remodeling complexes
rationale: Most members are assembly or action of BAF, CHD, NuRD and ChAHP remodeling complexes, distinguishing it from histone methylation and nucleosome assembly/acetylation confusables.

name: BAF and CHD/NuRD ATP-dependent chromatin remodeling complexes
rationale: Members center on assembly of BAF variants, CHD subfamilies, NuRD and ChAHP remodelers with associated cofactors, while confusables emphasize histone acetylation, lysine methylation and Polycomb silencing.

name: BAF and CHD/NuRD chromatin remodeling complexes
rationale: Most members are assembly of BAF (SWI/SNF) variants and CHD/NuRD/ChAHP remodelers, which the histone acetylation and methylation confusables lack.

name: mRNA nuclear processing, export, stabilization and decay
rationale: Members span mRNA fate control from splicing, 3'-end processing and export to stabilization (IGF2BP, CRD), NMD/deadenylation inhibition and decapping decay, with the nuclear processing/export steps separating it from ARE-binding decay and polyadenylation confusables.

name: mRNA stabilization by IGF2BPs, decapping and nuclear processing
rationale: Members regulate mRNA turnover (stabilisation, decapping, 5'-3' decay, NMD) and nuclear splicing, export and 3'-end processing, with IGF2BP-mediated stabilisation set against confusables dominated by ARE-mediated destabilisation and stress granules.

name: mRNA stabilization, decapping decay and nuclear processing regulation
rationale: Members regulate mRNA processing, export, stabilization (IGF2BP, CRD, 3'-UTR, decay inhibition), decapping/5'-3' decay and translation; confusables focus on polyadenylation or on ARE-binding destabilization and stress granules.

qualifier: aldosterone synthesis/secretion and renal sodium handling
name: Aldosterone synthesis and renal sodium control of blood pressure
rationale: Members are aldosterone synthesis, secretion and response with renal sodium import, glomerular filtration and blood pressure regulation, distinct from cortisol, angiotensin, vasopressin/water and potassium-transport neighbours.

name: Aldosterone synthesis and renal sodium control of blood pressure
rationale: Members combine aldosterone/mineralocorticoid production and response with renal sodium transport, filtration and blood pressure regulation, separating it from vasopressin/angiotensin, potassium transport and glucocorticoid neighbours.

name: Aldosterone synthesis and renal sodium control of blood pressure
rationale: Members link mineralocorticoid synthesis, aldosterone secretion and response with renal sodium transport and blood pressure; aldosterone separates it from vasopressin/angiotensin and potassium confusables, renal sodium handling from the adrenal steroid confusable.

qualifier: naive/memory B cell proliferation and differentiation
name: Peripheral B cell activation, proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell signature modules and regulation of B cell proliferation, differentiation and BCR signalling, lacking the germinal-centre, ICOS/Tfh and memory-signature members of the confusables.

qualifier: naive and memory B cell signatures
name: Naive and memory B cell activation, proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members describe B cell signatures, CD27 signalling and positive regulation of B cell proliferation, differentiation and BCR signalling, unlike confusables centred on germinal centre, Tfh and ICOS-driven responses.

name: B cell activation, proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell signature modules and positive regulation of B cell proliferation, differentiation (including B-1) and BCR/CD27 signalling, whereas confusables emphasise memory B signatures, germinal centre and Tfh/ICOS differentiation.

name: Glutamate and glutamine metabolism with aromatic acid conjugation
rationale: Members center on glutamate/glutamine/aspartate nitrogen metabolism, plus glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, which separates it from proline/glycine, alanine-gluconeogenesis and generic organic-acid confusables.

qualifier: amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Glutamine/glutamate metabolism and glycine conjugation of aromatic acids
rationale: Members are glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism plus mitochondrial glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, which the proline/glycine, alanine and amide confusables lack.

core: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism
name: Glutamate-glutamine nitrogen metabolism and glycine/glutamine aromatic acid conjugation
rationale: Members centre on glutamate/glutamine/aspartate and nitrogen metabolism plus mitochondrial glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, which separates it from alanine/gluconeogenesis and proline/glycine confusables.

name: PGC-1alpha-linked metabolic adaptation to fasting and caloric restriction
rationale: Members combine PGC-1alpha/PPARA and clock nuclear receptor (ROR/REV-ERB) transcription with gluconeogenesis, caloric restriction, redox and acetylation responses, which neighbours focused on LXR lipid homeostasis or BMAL1 circadian output lack.

qualifier: fasting-responsive PGC-1alpha and circadian nuclear receptors
name: Fasting-responsive PGC-1alpha and circadian control of energy metabolism
rationale: Members link PGC-1alpha/PPARA, clock nuclear receptors, caloric restriction, redox and acetylation to gluconeogenesis and mitochondrial biogenesis, unlike pure circadian, NPAS4 or LXR lipid-homeostasis neighbours.

qualifier: PGC-1alpha/PPARA and circadian clock nuclear receptors
name: PGC-1alpha and clock nuclear receptor control of energy metabolism
rationale: Members link PGC-1alpha/PPARA-driven mitochondrial biogenesis and fatty-acid response, ROR/REV-ERB/BMAL clock regulation, and gluconeogenesis, caloric restriction, redox and acetylation (nutrient-sensing) control; gluconeogenic and caloric-restriction terms separate it from circadian-output and lipid-homeostasis neighbours.

qualifier: reelin-guided neuronal migration, lamination and axon tracts
name: Reelin-guided cortical neuron migration, lamination and axon tracts
rationale: Members concern radial glia, radial and tangential neuronal migration, cortical layer formation and commissural/corticospinal tract morphogenesis; reelin signaling and dendrite growth are what the theme has and the forebrain-patterning confusables lack.

core: Cerebral cortex neuronal migration and lamination
name: Reelin-guided cortical neuron migration and forebrain axon tract formation
rationale: Members concern cortical layering, radial and tangential migration and forebrain commissures; reelin signaling and dendrite development distinguish it from broader forebrain/cerebellar neighbours.

core: Cortical neuron migration and forebrain axon tract formation
name: Reelin-guided cortical neuron migration and forebrain commissure formation
rationale: Members are cortical layering, radial and tangential migration, radial glia, and corpus callosum/anterior commissure/corticospinal tract morphogenesis; reelin signaling and dendrite development are what this theme has that the near-identical confusables lack.

name: Dopamine synthesis and DAT-mediated reuptake
rationale: Members cover dopamine biosynthesis, catecholamine metabolism and SLC6A3 reuptake, unlike confusables on dopamine receptor signalling or norepinephrine transport.

name: Dopamine synthesis and dopamine transporter-mediated reuptake
rationale: Members concern dopamine biosynthesis, DAT (SLC6A3) catecholamine uptake and transmitter release control, unlike norepinephrine-transport and dopamine-receptor neighbours.

name: Presynaptic dopamine synthesis and transporter-mediated reuptake
rationale: Members concern dopamine biosynthesis, catecholamine metabolism and dopamine transporter uptake (including its disease defects), distinct from confusables on dopamine receptor signaling, release, or norepinephrine/serotonin transport.

name: Leukotriene and lipoxin synthesis, transport and catabolism
rationale: All members concern 5-lipoxygenase-derived eicosanoids (leukotrienes, lipoxins, 5-HETE) and their omega-oxidation and export, distinguishing it from cytochrome P450 HETE/EET confusables and from leukotriene receptor signalling.

name: 5-lipoxygenase leukotriene and lipoxin metabolism
rationale: All members concern synthesis, transport and omega-oxidative breakdown of leukotrienes, lipoxins and 5-HETE, unlike confusables centred on cytochrome P450 HETE/EET and 12/15-lipoxygenase products or on leukotriene receptor signalling.

name: 5-Lipoxygenase leukotriene and lipoxin synthesis and catabolism
rationale: All members concern 5-lipoxygenase-derived leukotrienes, lipoxins and 5-HETE including their omega-oxidative catabolism and transport, unlike confusables dominated by CYP epoxygenase/HETE, 12/15-LOX or leukotriene receptor signalling.

name: Regulation of monocyte, macrophage, granulocyte and dendritic cell differentiation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte, macrophage, granulocyte and myeloid dendritic cell differentiation (including GM-CSF response), versus confusables on neutrophil/G-CSF, M-CSF and myeloid progenitor programmes.

name: Regulation of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation
rationale: Members regulate differentiation of monocytes, macrophages, granulocytes and dendritic cells including GM-CSF response, whereas confusables concern neutrophil/G-CSF, myeloid progenitors or M-CSF signalling.

qualifier: monocyte, macrophage and dendritic cell lineage regulation
name: Regulation of monocyte, macrophage, dendritic and granulocyte differentiation
rationale: Members regulate myeloid lineage differentiation with emphasis on monocyte/macrophage/DC and GM-CSF response, unlike confusables focused on neutrophil/G-CSF, progenitors or M-CSF proliferation.

name: Chaperone-mediated autophagy and aggrephagy of misfolded proteins
rationale: Members concern lysosomal clearance of proteins via chaperone-mediated autophagy, microautophagy and aggrephagy with aggresome formation and reduced protein folding/mitochondrial targeting; autophagic routes distinguish it from proteasomal quality control, ERAD and stress granule confusables.

name: Aggrephagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy of misfolded proteins
rationale: Members concern lysosomal disposal of aggregated or misfolded proteins (aggresome, aggrephagy, CMA, microautophagy) and restraint of mitochondrial protein targeting, distinguishing it from ERAD/ubiquitin quality control and stress granule confusables.

name: Aggrephagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy
rationale: Members concern aggresome formation, aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and endosomal microautophagy, with the regulation of chaperone-mediated autophagy distinguishing it from ubiquitin-proteasome and stress granule neighbours.

qualifier: very-long-chain substrates and spastic paraplegia/leukodystrophy defects
name: Peroxisomal very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation and spastic paraplegias
rationale: Members are acyl-CoA oxidase-driven peroxisomal oxidation of very-long-chain and branched fatty acids and its defects (ALD, SPG5A, SPG42, SPG56), distinguishing them from peroxisome import/biogenesis and alpha-oxidation neighbours.

qualifier: adrenoleukodystrophy and hereditary spastic paraplegia defects
name: Peroxisomal fatty acid beta-oxidation and spastic paraplegia defects
rationale: Members are acyl-CoA oxidase beta-oxidation of very-long-chain and branched fatty acids plus ABCD1, CYP7B1, CYP2U1 and SLC33A1 disease defects, distinguished from alpha-oxidation and peroxisome biogenesis confusables.

qualifier: hereditary spastic paraplegia and adrenoleukodystrophy defects
name: Peroxisomal fatty acid beta-oxidation and hereditary spastic paraplegia defects
rationale: Members are acyl-CoA oxidase, very-long-chain and pristanoyl-CoA beta-oxidation plus ALD and spastic paraplegia gene defects, while confusables emphasise peroxisome biogenesis, protein import or alpha-oxidation.

qualifier: raft/caveolae, integrin-ILK adhesion and electrical coupling
name: Cardiomyocyte membrane rafts, integrin-ILK adhesion and electrical coupling
rationale: Members combine T-tubule and raft/caveolar organization, PINCH-ILK-parvin integrin adhesion, gap junction and action potential regulation, separating it from sarcomere contraction and desmosome confusables.

name: Cardiomyocyte sarcolemmal membrane domains and integrin-ILK adhesion
rationale: Members concern cardiomyocyte membrane architecture (T-tubules, rafts/caveolae, gap junctions, cell adhesion, excitability) and ILK-PINCH-parvin integrin adhesions, unlike the desmosome and sarcomere contraction confusables.

name: Cardiomyocyte membrane organization: caveolae, integrin adhesion, gap junctions
rationale: Members cover cardiomyocyte T-tubules, rafts/caveolae, ILK-PINCH-parvin focal adhesions, gap junctions and action potential control, whereas confusables concern sarcomeric contraction and desmosomes.

name: Stress granule dynamics and TTP-family mRNA destabilisation
rationale: Members cover stress granule assembly and disassembly under arsenite and PKR signalling plus TTP, BRF1 and KSRP mRNA decay, distinguishing it from heat shock, HuR/AUF1 stabilisation and proteolysis neighbours.

name: Stress granule dynamics and AU-rich element mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover stress granule assembly/disassembly, arsenite and PKR stress responses and TTP/BRF1/KSRP-mediated mRNA destabilization, distinguishing it from heat-shock and mRNA-stabilization confusables.

name: Stress granule dynamics and ARE-binding protein mRNA destabilization
rationale: Members cover stress granule assembly/disassembly, PKR and arsenite stress and TTP/BRF1/KSRP-mediated mRNA decay; stress granules separate it from AUF1/HuR ARE confusables and ARE decay from heat shock and proteolysis confusables.

core: Glial and amyloid regulation in neurodegeneration
qualifier: glial activation, proliferation and survival with pro-amyloid and tangle regulation
name: Glial activation, survival and pro-amyloid, tau-tangle regulation
rationale: Members share regulation of astrocyte/microglial activation, glial proliferation and apoptosis together with promotion of amyloid-beta formation, reduced clearance and tangle assembly, unlike confusables centred on amyloid clearance, microglial immune function or APP biosynthesis.

qualifier: glial activation, survival and amyloid pathology
name: Glial activation, survival and amyloid pathology regulation
rationale: Members regulate microglial/astrocyte activation, glial proliferation and apoptosis together with amyloid-beta formation, tangles and nerve regeneration, while confusables centre on amyloid clearance or APP synthesis.

qualifier: glial proliferation and survival with amyloid-beta and tau pathology
name: Glial activation and proliferation in amyloid and tau neurodegeneration
rationale: Members share regulation of microglial and astrocyte activation, glial proliferation/apoptosis and nerve regeneration alongside amyloid-beta production/clearance and tangle assembly, unlike confusables centred on microglial immune function, Abeta clearance or APP processing.

qualifier: from glycosylase base cleavage to gap filling
name: Base excision repair from base cleavage to gap filling
rationale: All members are steps of base excision repair, spanning glycosylase recognition and cleavage of damaged purines/pyrimidines through AP-site processing and short/long-patch gap filling, which the NEIL-defect, alkylation-reversal and OGG1/MUTYH-defect confusables do not jointly cover.

name: Base excision repair from glycosylase cleavage to gap filling
rationale: All members are steps of base excision repair, from glycosylase recognition and cleavage of damaged purines/pyrimidines to short- and long-patch gap filling, which the confusables (defective glycosylases, SSB repair, alkylation reversal) lack.

qualifier: from glycosylase cleavage to gap filling
name: Base excision repair from glycosylase cleavage to gap filling
rationale: All members are steps of base excision repair (glycosylase recognition and base cleavage, AP-site resolution, short- and long-patch gap filling); unlike confusables it covers the normal repair sequence end to end rather than glycosylase disease variants, NEIL/ICL or alkylation reversal.

core: Phosphoregulation of p53 and G2/M progression
name: AKT-linked phosphoregulation of p53 turnover and G2/M progression
rationale: Members concern AKT target phosphorylation, p53 phosphorylation/degradation, Cdc25A turnover, CDK inhibition and MASTL/GTSE1 G2/M progression; AKT/PI3K members distinguish it from DNA damage checkpoint and p53 transcription confusables.

name: AKT and p53 regulation of G2/M cell-cycle progression
rationale: Members combine PI3K-AKT signalling with p53 stability/phosphorylation, Cdc25A degradation, CDK inhibition and G2/M progression (GTSE1, MASTL), whereas confusables centre on p53-driven DNA damage checkpoint and radiation responses without AKT.

name: AKT signaling and p53 control of G2/M progression
rationale: Members combine AKT/PI3K signaling with p53 phosphorylation/degradation and CDK, Cdc25A, MASTL and GTSE1 control of G2/M, the AKT terms separating it from DNA damage checkpoint confusables.

name: Granulocyte differentiation and neutrophil antimicrobial granule programme
rationale: Members cover neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation, G-CSF/GM-CSF responses and the maturing neutrophil granule cargo, unlike confusables centred on M-CSF/macrophage or RUNX1/erythroid-megakaryocytic programmes.

name: Granulocyte lineage differentiation and neutrophil granule programme
rationale: Members centre on neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation, G-CSF/GM-CSF responses and neutrophil antimicrobial granule modules, distinguishing it from monocyte/macrophage CSF1, RUNX1-driven or erythroid-megakaryocytic neighbours.

name: Granulocyte differentiation and neutrophil antimicrobial granule maturation
rationale: Most members concern G-CSF/GM-CSF-driven neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation and the neutrophil granule cargo programme; the granule modules and non-neutrophil granulocytes distinguish it from broad hematopoiesis and M-CSF/macrophage confusables.

qualifier: Sanfilippo and Morquio (heparan and keratan sulfate)
name: Lysosomal GAG degradation in Sanfilippo and Morquio syndromes
rationale: All members are lysosomal HS, KS or CS/DS degradation and the MPS III/IV disorders, while confusables hold MPS I, II, VI, VII and IX.

name: Lysosomal GAG degradation in Sanfilippo and Morquio mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: Members are heparan, keratan and chondroitin/dermatan sulfate degradation and the MPS III and MPS IV disorders, whereas confusables carry Hurler, Hunter, Sly and Maroteaux-Lamy types.

name: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan degradation, Sanfilippo and Morquio mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: All members are heparan, keratan or chondroitin/dermatan sulfate degradation or their MPS III/IV deficiencies; Sanfilippo and Morquio forms separate it from neighbours holding Hurler, Hunter, Sly and Maroteaux-Lamy.

name: Fas/TRAIL death receptor-caspase-8 extrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members are FasL/TRAIL signalling, procaspase-8 activation, c-FLIP, BID and T-cell activation-induced death, distinct from the necroptosis and TLR3/TRIF death confusables.

qualifier: TRAIL/FasL death receptors via caspase-8 and BID
name: TRAIL and FasL death-receptor caspase-8 apoptosis
rationale: Members are TRAIL/Fas signaling, procaspase-8 dimerization, c-FLIP control and BID activation including T cell activation-induced death, whereas confusables add necroptosis and negative regulation.

qualifier: FasL/TRAIL caspase-8 in T-cell and antitumour responses
name: FasL/TRAIL caspase-8 apoptosis in T-cell and antitumour responses
rationale: Members cover FasL and TRAIL signalling through procaspase-8, c-FLIP and BID with T-cell activation-induced death and tumour defence, distinguishing the theme from necroptosis and thymocyte/allograft confusables.

core: white adipocyte differentiation and adipose tissue development
name: PPAR-regulated white adipogenesis and adipose tissue development
rationale: Members are white fat cell proliferation and differentiation, adipose and fat pad development, adipogenic PPARG programs and PPAR signaling regulation; confusables cover PPARA/circadian mitochondrial biogenesis, thermogenesis or LXR lipid metabolism.

name: PPAR-gamma-driven white adipocyte differentiation and adipose development
rationale: Members cover PPAR-gamma signaling regulation, white fat cell differentiation and proliferation and fat pad development, unlike confusables centred on LXR lipid genes, PGC-1alpha/circadian programs or thermogenesis.

core: White adipocyte differentiation and adipose tissue development
name: PPARG-regulated white adipocyte differentiation and adipose development
rationale: Members are white fat cell differentiation/proliferation, adipose and fat pad development and PPAR(G) signaling control; neighbours involve thermogenesis, PPARA/PGC-1alpha circadian or LXR lipid metabolism.

qualifier: splicing, nuclear export and quality-control surveillance
name: mRNA splicing, nuclear export and quality-control decay
rationale: Members cover pre-mRNA splicing, 3'-end processing, mRNA/snRNA export and nuclear and ribosome-coupled RNA surveillance and decay, unlike the main confusable centred on rRNA transcription and processing.

qualifier: splicing, 3' end processing, export and decay
name: Pre-mRNA splicing, 3' processing, export and surveillance decay
rationale: Members cover spliceosome and snRNP biogenesis, mRNA 3' end processing, nuclear export, and NMD/no-go/ribosome-quality-control decay, whereas the main confusable is rRNA and ribosome biogenesis.

qualifier: splicing, nuclear export, decay and ribosome-associated quality control
name: mRNA splicing, export, decay and ribosome quality control
rationale: Members cover snRNP/spliceosome function, 3'-end processing, mRNA export, NMD and other decay routes and stalled-ribosome rescue, distinguishing the theme from the rRNA/Pol I-III ribosome biogenesis confusable and the lncRNA or N-end-rule neighbours.

core: Viral genome replication and gene expression in host cells
name: Viral replication and gene expression, including retroviral integration
rationale: All members describe viral genome replication, transcription, translation or their host restriction across HIV, coronaviruses, influenza, RSV and HCMV, and the theme uniquely adds HIV reverse transcription, integration and latency that confusables lack.

core: Viral genome replication and gene expression in host cells
qualifier: retroviral reverse transcription and integration; host control of viral transcription
name: Viral genome replication, gene expression and retroviral integration
rationale: Members span intracellular viral replication of HIV, influenza, RSV, coronaviruses and HCMV (reverse transcription, integration, viral RNA synthesis, viral translation and host modulation of viral transcription), lacking the entry, assembly and protein-maturation steps that dominate the confusables.

core: Viral genome replication and gene expression in host
name: Viral genome replication, transcription and translation, including retroviral integration
rationale: Members are intracellular steps of the viral life cycle (genome synthesis, transcription, translation and host interference) across HIV, HCMV, influenza, RSV and coronaviruses; the HIV reverse transcription/integration and viral transcription regulation members distinguish it from confusables.

name: Platelet agonist-receptor activation, adhesion and integrin-Rho signalling
rationale: Members cover VWF/GPIb and collagen/GPVI adhesion, thrombin, ADP, thromboxane signalling, degranulation and Rap/Rho/integrin signalling; confusables carry coagulation factor cascade or endothelial shear stress.

qualifier: receptor and G12/13-Rho signalling, without coagulation cascade
name: Platelet adhesion, activation and degranulation via GPCR-Rho signalling
rationale: Members cover VWF/collagen adhesion, GPVI, GPIb, PAR, TP and P2Y receptor signalling, Rap1/integrin and Rho signalling and degranulation, lacking the coagulation factor cascade of its confusables and the endothelial shear stress of C1.

name: Platelet adhesion and GPCR–Rho activation signaling
rationale: Members are platelet adhesion (GPVI, GPIb-VWF, integrins), agonist GPCR signaling (thrombin, ADP, thromboxane, G12/13-Rho, Rap1) and degranulation, lacking the coagulation-factor cascade of the large confusables and the endothelial shear-stress arm of another.

name: Eye morphogenesis and placental trophoblast development
rationale: Members combine lens, retinal vasculature and anterior eye development with trophoblast, labyrinth and decidual placental processes; the placental component distinguishes it from purely ocular/retinal confusables.

name: Eye morphogenesis and placental trophoblast development
rationale: Members split between camera-type eye development (lens, retina vasculature, cornea, iris, eyelid) and placenta/early pregnancy (trophoblast, labyrinth, decidualization); the trophoblast-placental block distinguishes it from the eye-only confusables.

name: Eye, retinal vasculature and placental trophoblast development
rationale: Members are a composite of eye morphogenesis (lens, cornea, iris, RPE, retinal vessels, blood–retinal barrier) and placental trophoblast/decidual development, the trophoblast arm being what the purely ocular confusables lack.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signalling and endocytic downregulation
name: MET and PTK6 signalling with RTK endocytic downregulation
rationale: Members cover HGF/MET receptor signalling, PTK6 (BRK) signalling and ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis/MVB sorting that downregulates EGFR/ERBB/MET, whereas confusables are dominated by ERBB adaptor events and PI3K/ALK signalling without MET, PTK6 or receptor degradation.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling and endocytic downregulation
qualifier: MET and PTK6 signaling with ubiquitin-dependent receptor endocytosis
name: MET and PTK6 signaling with receptor endocytic downregulation
rationale: Members cover HGF/MET receptor activation and effectors, PTK6 signaling and ubiquitin/ESCRT-mediated endocytic downregulation of EGFR/ERBB4, whereas confusables are dominated by ERBB adaptor and PI3K/AKT events lacking MET, PTK6 and receptor degradation.

core: MET and PTK6 receptor tyrosine kinase signalling
name: MET and PTK6 signalling with endocytic receptor downregulation
rationale: Members cover HGF/MET receptor signalling, PTK6 (BRK) signalling and ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation of EGFR/ERBB4; the PTK6 and endocytic-downregulation members separate it from ERBB/PI3K confusables, and the MET members from the PTEN/ERBB4 confusable.

qualifier: chamber, septum and valve formation with endocardial EMT
name: Cardiac chamber, septal and valve morphogenesis with endocardial EMT
rationale: Members cover ventricular/atrial myocardium, trabeculation, septation and valve formation via endocardial cushion EMT, distinct from confusables on coronary vasculature, early heart tube/second heart field or outflow arteries.

name: Cardiac valve, septum and ventricular chamber morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover endocardial cushion EMT, valve and septum formation, trabeculation and chamber myocardium morphogenesis, whereas confusables address heart tube and secondary heart field specification, coronary vasculature or great arteries.

name: Cardiac chamber, valve and septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover ventricular/atrial myocardium, trabeculation, endocardial cushion EMT, valves and septa, while confusables concern early heart tube, secondary heart field, coronary vessels or great arteries.

qualifier: carnitine shuttle and synthesis with ketone body metabolism
name: Mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation, carnitine shuttle and ketogenesis
rationale: Members are the stepwise acyl-CoA beta-oxidation spiral, carnitine synthesis/transport and ketone body synthesis/use; confusables are branched-chain/organic acid and cofactor metabolism or peroxisomal alpha-oxidation.

qualifier: carnitine shuttle and ketone body metabolism
name: Carnitine-dependent fatty acid beta-oxidation and ketone body metabolism
rationale: Members are the chain-shortening steps of mitochondrial beta-oxidation, carnitine synthesis/transport/shuttle and ketone body synthesis and use, unlike confusables on branched-chain amino acid and cofactor disorders or alpha-oxidation.

name: Fatty acid beta-oxidation, carnitine shuttle and ketone bodies
rationale: Members are stepwise acyl-CoA beta-oxidation, carnitine synthesis/transport and ketone body synthesis/use; confusables are alpha-oxidation, short-chain/amino acid catabolism or branched-chain and cofactor disorders.

core: Mitotic chromosome and nuclear envelope dynamics
qualifier: condensation, cohesion establishment, CENP-A deposition, envelope reassembly
name: Mitotic chromosome condensation, cohesion and nuclear envelope remodeling
rationale: Members cover chromosome condensation, cohesin loading/establishment, CENP-A deposition and nuclear envelope disassembly/ESCRT-III resealing and abscission; confusables emphasise spindle/centrosome control, cohesion resolution, meiosis or histone acetylation.

name: Mitotic chromosome condensation, cohesion and nuclear envelope remodeling
rationale: Members span chromosome condensation, cohesin loading, CENP-A deposition and mitotic nuclear envelope disassembly/ESCRT-III resealing, the envelope arm being what the cohesion and spindle confusables lack.

name: Mitotic chromosome condensation, cohesion and nuclear envelope remodelling
rationale: Members concern chromosome condensation, cohesin loading, CENP-A deposition and nuclear envelope breakdown/ESCRT resealing, the nuclear envelope arm distinguishing it from spindle, cohesion-resolution and meiosis confusables.

core: Proteasomal MHC class I antigen presentation
name: Proteasomal MHC class I antigen presentation and PD-L1 turnover
rationale: Members are proteasome assembly, class I processing and cross-presentation, viral Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation and PD-L1 trafficking/degradation, the class I and PD-L1 components separating it from class II and DC-surface confusables.

qualifier: proteasome, PD-L1 regulation and viral evasion
name: Proteasomal MHC class I presentation, PD-L1 and viral evasion
rationale: Members are proteasome-dependent MHC I processing and cross-presentation plus Nef-mediated CD4/CD8/MHC-I downregulation and PD-L1 regulation of anti-tumour T cells, whereas confusables centre on MHC class II and dendritic-cell signatures.

core: MHC class I antigen processing and presentation
name: Proteasomal MHC class I presentation and immune receptor degradation
rationale: Members share proteasome/ERAD-dependent processing for MHC class I presentation and cross-presentation together with degradation of immune surface proteins (PD-L1, and Nef/Vpu targets CD4, CD8, CD28, MHC-I), which the MHC class II and dendritic-cell confusables lack.

qualifier: common gamma-chain, IL-12 and IL-10 families
name: Interleukin JAK–STAT signaling: gamma-chain, IL-12 and IL-10 families
rationale: Members are signalling by IL-2/7/9/15/21, IL-12/23/27/35, IL-10/20 and IL-3/5 with STAT control and NK regulation; the IL-12 and IL-10 families distinguish it from IL-2/TCR and IL-6 confusables.

qualifier: common gamma-chain, IL-12 and IL-10 family cytokines, NK cells
name: Gamma-chain, IL-12 and IL-10 family interleukin JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: Members are signalling by IL-2/7/9/15/21, IL-3/5, IL-12/23/27/35 and IL-10/20 family interleukins with NK-cell regulation and STAT control, the IL-12 and IL-10 families distinguishing it from IL-6/gp130 and T-cell confusables.

qualifier: common gamma-chain, IL-12 and IL-10 families
name: Common gamma-chain, IL-12 and IL-10 family interleukin signaling
rationale: Members are signalling by IL-2/7/9/15/21, IL-12/23/27/35, IL-10/20 and IL-3/5 with NK-cell regulation, whereas confusables are IL-6/gp130 family or TCR network signalling.

core: Nucleic acid sensing driving type I interferon
name: Endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING sensing driving type I interferon
rationale: Members cover endosomal TLR3/7/8/9 and cGAS-STING nucleic acid sensing, their regulation and HSE deficiencies, and dendritic-cell interferon production; confusables centre on RIG-I/IFN-stimulated responses and TBK1 regulation.

core: Nucleic acid sensing for type I interferon
name: Endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING sensing driving type I interferon
rationale: Members are endosomal TLR3/7/8/9 trafficking and signaling (and their HSE deficiencies), cGAS-STING regulation and IFN-alpha/beta and DC cytokine production; confusables centre on RIG-I/IRF3 cytosolic RNA sensing and interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors.

core: Nucleic acid sensing driving type I interferon
qualifier: endosomal TLR3/7/8/9 and cGAS-STING in dendritic cells
name: Endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING nucleic acid sensing in dendritic cells
rationale: Members cover endosomal TLR trafficking and TLR7/8/9 signaling, cGAS-STING regulation, their inherited HSE deficiencies and resulting dendritic cell IFN and cytokine production, distinguishing the theme from RIG-I/ISG antiviral response and TBK1-IRF3 regulation themes.

qualifier: megakaryocyte, erythroid and granulocyte fate choice
name: Myeloid progenitor lineage decisions toward megakaryocyte, erythroid and granulocyte fates
rationale: Members describe progenitor-level commitment and its transcriptional control (RUNX1, VENTX, GM-CSF) across megakaryocyte, erythroid, granulocyte and monocyte fates, whereas confusables emphasise stem cell homeostasis, terminal red cell maturation or RUNX targets in lymphoid and cytokine programmes.

name: Myeloid progenitor fate choice: erythroid, megakaryocytic, granulocyte-monocyte
rationale: Members span transcriptional control (RUNX1, granulopoiesis, VENTX) and positive/negative regulation of erythroid, megakaryocyte, granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation, distinct from confusables focused on HSC maintenance, terminal erythropoiesis or RUNX target programs.

name: Myeloid progenitor lineage commitment and megakaryocyte-erythroid differentiation
rationale: Members regulate myeloid progenitor fate choices (granulocyte, monocyte, macrophage, erythroid, megakaryocyte) via RUNX1 and related programmes, combining megakaryocyte-erythroid branches absent from granulocyte-focused confusables with myeloid-restraint terms absent from erythroid/HSC confusables.

name: E2F- and MYC-driven proliferation and G2/M cell cycle signature
rationale: Members are E2F/MYC transcriptional networks, G1/S and G2/M transition events and proliferating (stimulated CD4 T cell) cell cycle modules, whereas confusables emphasise RB/DREAM repression, replication origin licensing or p53 checkpoint arrest.

qualifier: G2/M transition and activated CD4 T cell proliferation
name: E2F-driven G2/M proliferation programme including activated CD4 T cells
rationale: Members are E2F/MYC cell-cycle transcription, G2/M transition and checkpoint events and proliferating CD4 T cell modules; confusables instead centre on RB-E2F G1/S control or replication origin licensing.

qualifier: E2F and MYC-driven G1/S and G2/M, stimulated CD4 T cells
name: E2F- and MYC-driven G1/S and G2/M proliferation program
rationale: Members are E2F/G2M cell cycle transcription and checkpoint modules including MYC network and stimulated CD4 T cell division, versus confusables on DREAM/RB repression and replication initiation.

qualifier: bicarbonate/acid-base and phosphate transporters and their disorders
name: Bicarbonate, phosphate and other inorganic anion transport
rationale: Members are transport of bicarbonate, phosphate, sulfate, oxalate and iodide (SLC4, SLC26, SLC34, SLC20) with pH regulation and transporter-defect diseases, unlike confusables on enamel mineralization or organelle acidification.

qualifier: bicarbonate, phosphate and sulfate carriers and their disorders
name: Bicarbonate, phosphate and sulfate anion transport and its disorders
rationale: Members are SLC4/SLC26/SLC34/SLC20 anion transport and their inherited defects plus CO2 hydration, while confusables add enamel/tooth mineralization or organelle acidification.

name: Phosphate, bicarbonate and other inorganic anion transport
rationale: Members are transport of phosphate, bicarbonate, sulfate, iodide and oxalate and their transporter diseases plus pH/CO2 hydration, unlike confusables on tooth mineralization and organelle acidification.

name: Polyamine metabolism and tryptophan-kynurenine NAD+ biosynthesis
rationale: Members are either polyamine synthesis, interconversion and transport (ODC, putrescine, spermidine, spermine) or tryptophan catabolism via kynurenine to NAD+/nicotinate; neighbours carry only one of these blocks.

name: Polyamine metabolism and tryptophan-kynurenine-derived NAD+ synthesis
rationale: Members span putrescine/spermidine/spermine synthesis, oxidation and transport plus tryptophan-kynurenine catabolism feeding nicotinate/NAD+ metabolism; confusables have only one of these halves (polyamine/hypusine/methionine salvage or NAD(P) transport/redox).

name: Polyamine metabolism and tryptophan-kynurenine NAD+ biosynthesis
rationale: Members split between polyamine synthesis, interconversion and transport and tryptophan-kynurenine-nicotinate routes to NAD+; the polyamine arm distinguishes it from NAD/redox confusables and the kynurenine-NAD+ arm from methionine salvage and hypusine confusables.

qualifier: colony-stimulating factor control of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte lineages
name: Colony-stimulating factor control of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte, macrophage, granulocyte and myeloid dendritic differentiation through M-CSF, G-CSF and GM-CSF signaling, unlike the erythroid/megakaryocytic and interleukin/bone-marrow confusables.

qualifier: colony-stimulating factor control of granulocyte and monocyte-macrophage fates
name: CSF-driven granulocyte and monocyte-macrophage differentiation
rationale: Members regulate granulocyte, monocyte, macrophage and myeloid DC differentiation through M-CSF, G-CSF and GM-CSF signalling, unlike confusables on RUNX targets, erythroid/megakaryocyte lineages or bone marrow homeostasis.

qualifier: colony-stimulating factor driven granulocyte and monocyte-macrophage
name: CSF-driven granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation
rationale: Members regulate granulocyte, monocyte, macrophage and myeloid DC differentiation via G-CSF, M-CSF and GM-CSF, unlike the erythroid/megakaryocyte, RUNX and bone-marrow homeostasis confusables.

core: ER protein exit and quality control
qualifier: COPII export, ER retention and retrotranslocation
name: COPII export, ER retention and ER quality control
rationale: Members cover COPII cargo loading and ER exit, ER lumen retention and ERQC/ERAD retrotranslocation to cytosol, distinguishing it from confusables built on SRP targeting/folding or COPI retrograde traffic.

core: ER protein exit and quality control
qualifier: COPII export, ER retention and ERAD retrotranslocation
name: ER protein exit control via COPII export and ERAD
rationale: All members concern deciding whether ER proteins leave (COPII cargo loading, ER exit, retention) or are retrotranslocated for ERAD, whereas confusables carry SRP/tail-anchored targeting or COPI retrograde traffic instead.

core: ER protein export and quality control
qualifier: COPII cargo exit and ERAD retrotranslocation
name: COPII-mediated ER export and ER protein quality control
rationale: Members cover ER exit-site cargo loading, COPII vesicle targeting to Golgi, ER retention and ERQC/ERAD retrotranslocation, unlike confusables centred on SRP-dependent ER targeting/folding or COPI retrograde traffic.

core: Nucleoside and nucleotide transport and interconversion
qualifier: membrane nucleoside transporters and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
name: Nucleoside and adenine nucleotide transport and phosphorylation interconversion
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane nucleoside/nucleobase transport (including nucleoside-analogue drugs), mitochondrial ADP/ATP carriage and nucleotide phosphorylation, unlike nucleotide catabolism/NUDT and creatine confusables.

qualifier: with nucleotide phosphorylation and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
name: Nucleoside and nucleobase transport with nucleotide phosphorylation
rationale: Members cover plasma-membrane nucleoside/nucleobase transporters (incl. nucleoside-analogue drugs), nucleotide kinase interconversion and mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport; the transport arm separates it from creatine neighbours and the phosphorylation arm from NUDT/thiopurine catabolism neighbours.

core: Nucleoside and nucleotide transport and interconversion
qualifier: mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange and nucleotide phosphorylation
name: Nucleoside transport and nucleotide phosphorylation with mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
rationale: Members cover plasma-membrane nucleoside/nucleobase transporters (incl. SLC29A3 and abacavir/ribavirin uptake), mitochondrial ADP/ATP carriers and nucleoside mono/diphosphate phosphorylation; the kinase and mitochondrial-carrier members separate it from thiopurine/NUDT drug-metabolism confusables, and nucleoside transport from creatine/nucleotide-synthesis confusables.

core: Regulation of NK and T cell activation
name: Inhibitory-receptor regulation of NK and T cell activation and tolerance
rationale: Members concern KIR/NK receptor signatures, inhibitory Fc and lymphoid-non-lymphoid interactions, costimulation and peripheral tolerance, distinct from confusables on positive NK/T cytotoxicity or regulatory T cell suppression.

qualifier: NK inhibitory receptors and peripheral tolerance
name: Immunoregulatory NK, T and dendritic cell activation and tolerance
rationale: Members cover NK inhibitory receptors, Fc inhibitory signaling, T cell costimulation, anergy/tolerance and dendritic cell activation, unlike Treg-focused and NK cytotoxicity confusables.

core: Immunoregulatory receptor control of lymphocyte activation
qualifier: NK inhibitory receptors, T cell tolerance and dendritic cells
name: Immunoregulatory receptor control of NK, T and dendritic cell activation
rationale: Members cover KIR/MHC class Ib inhibitory NK receptors, Fc inhibitory signaling, T cell costimulation, anergy and peripheral tolerance and dendritic cell activation, distinguishing the theme from Treg-suppression and NK cytotoxicity-promoting confusables.

qualifier: glycerolipid synthesis with lipid droplet formation and turnover
name: Triglyceride synthesis and lipid droplet storage dynamics
rationale: Members cover PA/DAG/TAG synthesis and lipid droplet formation, fusion, disassembly and lipophagy in adipocyte fat storage, whereas confusables emphasize triglyceride catabolism, PDE3B signaling or phospholipid regulation.

name: Glycerolipid synthesis and lipid droplet storage dynamics
rationale: Members span PA/DAG/TAG synthesis and lipid droplet formation, fusion, disassembly and lipophagy, while confusables add triglyceride catabolism and PDE3B-driven lipolysis.

qualifier: glycerolipid synthesis and lipid droplet life cycle
name: Glycerolipid synthesis and lipid droplet life cycle
rationale: Members span PA/DAG/MAG/TAG synthesis, lipid droplet formation, fusion and disassembly, lipophagy and adipocyte fat storage, whereas confusables lean on TG catabolism, PDE3B and fatty acid homeostasis.

qualifier: ventricular wall, septum, endocardium and coronary vessel formation
name: Ventricular wall, septal, endocardial and coronary heart morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover trabeculation/compaction of ventricular and atrial myocardium, septum morphogenesis, endocardium and coronary vasculogenesis, while confusables emphasize heart tube, second heart field, conduction system or valve/cushion development.

name: Cardiac chamber wall, septum and endocardium morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern atrial/ventricular myocardium, trabeculae, septa, endocardium and coronary vessel morphogenesis, distinct from early heart tube/second heart field, valve and conduction system confusables.

qualifier: myocardial wall maturation, septation and endocardium
name: Myocardial wall maturation, septation and endocardial development
rationale: Members concern ventricular trabeculation and compaction, cardiac septum, endocardium and coronary vasculogenesis, whereas confusables cover early heart tube, second heart field, valves and cushions.

name: RNA methylation and pseudouridylation with mitochondrial ribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members are rRNA, tRNA and mRNA methylation and pseudouridylation together with mitochondrial RNA processing, mitoribosome assembly and translation, unlike confusables on tRNA aminoacylation, nuclear tRNA processing or snRNA modification.

name: RNA methylation and pseudouridylation with mitochondrial ribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members are rRNA, tRNA and mRNA methylation and pseudouridylation plus mitochondrial RNA processing and mitoribosome subunit assembly, unlike confusables on tRNA aminoacylation, nuclear tRNA processing or RNA import.

name: RNA methylation and pseudouridylation with mitoribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members concern methylation and pseudouridylation of rRNA, tRNA and mRNA, especially mitochondrial RNA processing and mitoribosome assembly, unlike confusables on tRNA aminoacylation or nuclear tRNA processing.

name: Stress-induced senescence and CDKN2A (p16/p14ARF) defects
rationale: Members cover oncogene- and oxidative-stress-induced senescence, SASP, polycomb control and p16INK4A/p14ARF evasion defects, unlike p53/p21 and SAHF/replicative senescence confusables.

qualifier: oncogene/oxidative stress-induced, evaded by CDKN2A defects
name: Stress-induced senescence and its evasion via CDKN2A defects
rationale: Members are oncogene- and oxidative-stress-induced senescence, SASP and Polycomb/CDKN2A (p16INK4A, p14ARF) loss, separating it from p53/p21 arrest and SAHF/replicative senescence confusables.

qualifier: stress-induced, with evasion through CDKN2A defects
name: Stress-induced cellular senescence and evasion through CDKN2A defects
rationale: Members concern oncogene/oxidative-stress senescence, SASP and its evasion via p16INK4A/p14ARF loss; the CDKN2A defect members distinguish it from SAHF/replicative senescence confusables, and senescence members from p53/p21 confusables.

qualifier: CFTR-mediated anion and fluid secretion, pancreatic duct
name: Apical membrane trafficking and CFTR-mediated epithelial fluid secretion
rationale: Members combine apical/raft protein localization and Golgi-to-plasma-membrane transport with CFTR trafficking, anion and transepithelial water transport in pancreatic ductal epithelium, unlike flippase/bile, TRP channel or tight-junction confusables.

qualifier: apical delivery and CFTR in secretory ducts
name: Apical membrane protein trafficking in secretory ductal epithelia
rationale: Members cover apical/basolateral protein delivery, raft localization, CFTR trafficking and ductal anion/water secretion, unlike confusables on tight junctions, bile lipid flippases or phospholipid scrambling.

name: Apical epithelial protein trafficking and CFTR anion secretion
rationale: Members cover apical/raft protein localization, Golgi-to-plasma-membrane transport, microvilli, CFTR trafficking and ductal water and anion secretion, unlike confusables on lipid flippases, bile secretion and pH-sensing channels.

qualifier: with T-cell response regulation (Th1, IL-2/IL-21, Treg)
name: TLR–NF-kappaB cytokine inhibition and T-cell response regulation
rationale: Members are mostly negative regulation of TLR/LPS, NF-kappaB and inflammatory cytokine production plus IL-37 and IL-10, with T-cell items (Th1, IL-2, IL-21, Treg, activated T cell proliferation) that the innate-only confusables lack and NF-kappaB inhibition that the T-cell suppression confusable lacks.

qualifier: TLR-NF-kB plus T-cell cytokines, mostly inhibitory
name: Regulation of TLR-NF-kB and T-cell cytokine responses, largely inhibitory
rationale: Members are predominantly negative regulators of TLR/NF-kB/TNF signalling and of IL-1/6/8/12 and T-cell (IL-2, IL-21, Th1) cytokines plus IL-10/IL-37 anti-inflammatory signals, distinguishing it from confusables that activate NF-kB, TLR or inflammasomes or regulate only T-cell activation.

qualifier: extends to Th1 and T-cell cytokines (IL-2, IL-21)
name: Restraint of innate cytokine, NF-kappaB and Th1 responses
rationale: Members mostly inhibit TLR/NF-kappaB/TNF signalling and inflammatory cytokine production, and uniquely add control of IL-2, IL-21, Th1 and Treg responses, separating it from the purely innate confusables and from the T-cell-only suppression set.

name: Somitogenesis and left-right patterning via extracellular Nodal/BMP sequestration
rationale: Members combine somite specification and axis elongation with Nodal regulation, left-right asymmetry and extracellular sequestration of BMP/ligands; confusables share somitogenesis but add limb, Hox, Notch O-glycosylation or neural plate members instead.

qualifier: Nodal left-right signalling and extracellular ligand sequestration
name: Somitogenesis and Nodal left–right patterning via ligand sequestration
rationale: Members combine somite segmentation and tail/axis elongation with Nodal-dependent left-right asymmetry and extracellular BMP/ligand sequestration, which neighbours on limb, neural plate, Hox or Notch glycosylation lack.

qualifier: extracellular antagonism of Nodal and BMP signalling
name: Somitogenesis and extracellular sequestration of Nodal/BMP signalling
rationale: Members cover somite specification, segmentation and axis elongation plus left-right Nodal regulation and extracellular ligand/BMP sequestration, which distinguishes it from limb, Notch glycosylation, Hox and neural plate confusables.

name: Phagocyte respiratory burst, degranulation and antimicrobial killing
rationale: Members concern neutrophil/phagocyte oxidative burst, superoxide generation, degranulation and killing of bacteria and fungi, whereas confusables centre on chemotaxis, formyl peptide and complement receptor signalling.

qualifier: respiratory burst, degranulation and microbial killing
name: Neutrophil respiratory burst, degranulation and microbial killing
rationale: Members concern phagocyte killing of bacteria and fungi via superoxide/ROS generation and degranulation, distinguishing it from confusables about neutrophil chemotaxis, recruitment, formyl peptide and complement receptor signaling.

name: Neutrophil respiratory burst, degranulation and microbial killing
rationale: Members concern phagocyte oxidative burst, superoxide generation, degranulation and killing of bacteria and fungi, whereas confusables centre on neutrophil chemotaxis, formyl peptide receptors and complement signalling.

name: RUNX1, AP-2 and HOX transcription factor programs
rationale: All members are target-gene programs of RUNX, TFAP2 and HOX cluster transcription factors; the HOX and AP-2 members distinguish it from the haematopoietic RUNX1/megakaryocyte and granulopoiesis confusables.

name: RUNX, AP-2 and HOX lineage transcription factor programmes
rationale: All members are transcriptional programmes of developmental/lineage transcription factors (RUNX1-3 targets, TFAP2 family, Hox cluster modules); AP-2 and Hox members separate it from RUNX1 megakaryocyte/granulopoiesis confusables.

name: RUNX, AP-2 and HOX transcription factor programs
rationale: Every member is a transcriptional program of the RUNX, TFAP2 (AP-2) or HOX-cluster transcription factor families, and the AP-2 and HOX members distinguish it from confusables limited to RUNX1 in haematopoiesis and granulopoiesis.

name: Lung and trachea morphogenesis and pneumocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover lung branching, mesenchyme, vasculature, saccules, pneumocyte differentiation and trachea/diaphragm formation, distinct from salivary branching, bronchial epithelium and surfactant neighbours.

name: Lung, trachea and diaphragm development
rationale: Members cover lung branching, mesenchyme, vasculature, saccule and pneumocyte development plus trachea and diaphragm formation, unlike confusables on salivary branching or surfactant metabolism.

qualifier: lung branching, trachea and alveolar cells
name: Lung and trachea morphogenesis and alveolar differentiation
rationale: Members cover lung branching, mesenchyme, saccule, vasculature and pneumocyte differentiation plus trachea and adjacent diaphragm development; distinct from salivary branching and surfactant confusables.

core: Cytosolic RNA sensing inducing type I interferon
name: RIG-I-like RNA sensing driving type I interferon production
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5, dsRNA and TLR7/8/9-IRF7 sensing leading to IFN-alpha/beta induction; neighbours add virus-specific evasion, OAS effectors, TBK1 regulation or cytosolic DNA sensing.

core: Type I interferon induction by cytosolic RNA sensing
name: RIG-I/MDA5-driven type I interferon induction and its restraint
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5, IRF3/IRF7 and ZBP1 sensing leading to IFN-alpha/beta production; unlike virus-response and TBK1/cGAS neighbours, it includes the negative regulators of RIG-I signaling and antiviral defense.

core: Cytosolic dsRNA sensing to type I interferon
name: Cytosolic dsRNA sensing to type I interferon, with negative regulators
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5 and related nucleic-acid sensing that induces IRF3/IRF7-driven type I interferon; unlike confusables it includes negative regulation of RIG-I and antiviral defense rather than ISG effector or cGAS/STING arms.

qualifier: de novo synthesis and nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis
name: De novo purine synthesis and nucleoside triphosphate sanitization
rationale: Members combine de novo IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis with NUDT-mediated (d)NTP hydrolysis and thiopurine handling, distinguishing it from salvage/catabolism and antiviral-drug-metabolism confusables.

qualifier: de novo synthesis and nucleoside triphosphate sanitization
name: De novo purine synthesis and nucleotide pool sanitization
rationale: Members combine de novo IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis with NUDT-mediated NTP hydrolysis and thiopurine (azathioprine/TPMT) handling, distinguishing it from purine salvage/catabolism and antiviral nucleoside drug neighbours.

core: Purine nucleotide synthesis and nucleoside triphosphate turnover
qualifier: thiopurine metabolism and NTP pool sanitization
name: De novo purine synthesis, thiopurine metabolism and NTP sanitization
rationale: Members combine de novo IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis with NUDT-mediated nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis and TPMT/azathioprine thiopurine handling, which separates it from salvage/catabolism and antiviral-drug confusables.

name: Integrin-fibronectin adhesion driving mesenchymal cell migration and spreading
rationale: Members combine integrin and syndecan matrix interactions, fibronectin matrix formation, focal adhesion and stress fiber assembly with fibroblast/EMT migration programmes, distinguishing them from plain ECM modules and MET-PTK2 confusables.

name: Integrin-fibronectin adhesion driving mesenchymal fibroblast migration and spreading
rationale: Members share integrin/syndecan-fibronectin adhesion, focal adhesion and stress fibre formation and fibroblast/EMT migration programmes, distinct from MET-PTK2 and bare ECM-module confusables.

name: Integrin-fibronectin adhesion driving mesenchymal cell migration and spreading
rationale: Members span integrin and syndecan interactions, fibronectin matrix, focal adhesion and stress fiber assembly and an EMT/fibroblast migration program, distinct from MET-PTK2 signaling and pure ECM-composition confusables.

name: TRKA and TRKB neurotrophin receptor downstream signaling
rationale: Members are NGF/TRKA and BDNF-NT3/TRKB effector signaling (PI3K, CDK5, RAC1, ERK5, CREB); neighbours are TRKB-only or TRKC branches, or p75NTR signaling.

qualifier: TRKA and TRKB downstream PI3K, ERK5 and CREB
name: TRKA and TRKB neurotrophin receptor signalling
rationale: Members are TRK receptor downstream events (NTRK2 via PI3K, CDK5, RAC1; TRKA via FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, CREB), distinguished from NTRK2 RAS/PLCG1, NTRK3 and p75NTR neighbours.

qualifier: TRKA and TRKB via PI3K, ERK5 and CREB
name: TRKA and TRKB signaling via PI3K, ERK5 and CREB
rationale: Members are NGF/TRKA (FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, p38, CREB, transcription) and BDNF/NTF3-TRKB (PI3K, CDK5, RAC1) downstream signaling; unlike neighbours it lacks NTRK3, the TRKB RAS/PLCG1 branches and p75NTR death signaling.

core: Membrane potential regulation by K+ and Na+ transport
name: Two-pore leak K+ channels and resting membrane potential
rationale: Members are TWIK/TREK/TASK/THIK/TRESK and Ca2+-activated K+ channels with regulation of resting potential, hyperpolarization and Na+ transport, unlike the KATP, cation-chloride cotransporter and P-type ATPase confusables.

qualifier: two-pore-domain K+ channels and Na+ transport
name: Resting potential control by two-pore K+ channels and Na+ transport
rationale: Members are K2P (TWIK/TREK/TASK/THIK/TRESK) and Ca2+-activated K+ channels plus Na+/K+ transport regulation setting resting potential and excitability, unlike P-type ATPase, chloride cotransporter or KATP channel confusables.

core: Membrane potential and monovalent cation transport
name: Two-pore-domain K+ channels and Na+/K+ transport regulation
rationale: Members are K2P and Ca2+-activated K+ channels setting resting potential plus regulation of Na+/K+ transport, unlike the cation-chloride cotransporter, KATP and P-type ATPase confusables.

name: HSF1 heat shock response and cytoplasmic stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members are HSF1 activation and attenuation, refolding and proteostatic stress plus stress granule and PKR/arsenite responses, which the ER-UPR, chaperonin and mitochondrial import neighbours lack.

core: Heat shock and proteotoxic stress response
qualifier: HSF1 chaperones and stress granule dynamics
name: HSF1 heat shock response and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members are HSF1-driven heat shock response, protein refolding and stress granule/PML body regulation under heat and arsenite; neighbours cover ER UPR, chaperonin folding, mitochondrial import and acetylation.

core: Heat shock and proteotoxic stress response
qualifier: stress granule and PML body dynamics
name: Heat shock and proteotoxic stress response with stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members cover HSF1 heat shock response, refolding, UPRmt and arsenite/PKR stress with stress granule and PML body organisation, the latter absent from neighbours on chaperonin folding, ER UPR, aggrephagy or protein acetylation.

qualifier: strand invasion and recombination intermediate resolution
name: Recombinational DNA repair via strand invasion and intermediate resolution
rationale: Members describe strand invasion, break-induced replication, SDSA, sister chromatid exchange, cross-link repair and resolution of recombination intermediates, distinct from confusables about replication initiation, NHEJ/BRCA damage sensing and telomere maintenance.

qualifier: strand invasion, break-induced replication and intermediate resolution
name: Homologous recombination repair and recombination intermediate resolution
rationale: Members share homologous recombination-based repair (strand invasion, SDSA, BIR, sister chromatid exchange, intermediate resolution) with checkpoint context, unlike the NHEJ, replication-initiation and telomere confusables.

qualifier: strand invasion and recombination intermediate resolution
name: Homologous recombination repair via strand invasion and resolution
rationale: Members describe recombinational repair steps (strand invasion, SDSA, break-induced replication, sister chromatid exchange, intermediate resolution, repair synthesis), distinguishing it from NHEJ/DSB-sensing, telomere and replication-initiation confusables.

name: CaMK-CREB signaling in synaptic plasticity and memory
rationale: Members link postsynaptic calcium and CaMK/CAMKK cascades to CREB phosphorylation, LTP/LTD and memory, unlike confusables centred on PKA/MECP2, structural plasticity or glutamate-receptor signaling.

name: Calcium-CaMK-CREB signaling in synaptic plasticity and memory
rationale: Members link postsynaptic calcium to CaMK/AMPK and adenylate cyclase-driven CREB phosphorylation, LTP/LTD and memory, unlike confusables centred on PKA/MECP2, structural plasticity or NMDA receptor gating.

name: Calcium-CaMK-CREB signaling in synaptic plasticity and memory
rationale: Members link postsynaptic calcium, CaMK/adenylate cyclase signaling and CREB/NPAS4 to LTP, LTD and memory; confusables are PKA/forskolin, structural plasticity, MECP2 or NMDA receptor sets.

name: Stromal extracellular matrix with integrin and syndecan adhesion
rationale: Members are fibroblast/stromal ECM, EMT and cell adhesion programmes; unlike confusables built on collagen degradation, fibronectin assembly or YAP mechanosignalling, this theme carries integrin and syndecan cell-surface interactions and stromal fibroblast markers.

name: Stromal extracellular matrix with integrin and syndecan adhesion
rationale: Members describe the fibroblast/stromal ECM programme (ECM modules, collagen/TGFB, EMT, fibroblast proliferation); integrin and syndecan cell-surface adhesion distinguish it from the YAP/TAZ mechanoresponsive, fibronectin/collagen-receptor and collagen-degradation neighbours.

qualifier: stromal fibroblast, EMT and integrin–syndecan interactions
name: Stromal fibroblast matrix, EMT and integrin–syndecan adhesion
rationale: All members describe fibroblast/stromal extracellular matrix and adhesion biology; EMT, KRAS/FOSL-driven stromal programmes and syndecan/integrin interactions distinguish it from confusables centred on fibronectin assembly, focal adhesion or collagen degradation.

qualifier: brush border, tight junctions and raft sorting
name: Apical brush border, tight junction and raft protein sorting
rationale: Members concern apical membrane identity: microvilli, polarized Golgi-to-membrane sorting, raft localization and tight junction/paracellular transport, unlike CFTR/bile transport or podocyte polarity confusables.

qualifier: microvilli/brush border, tight junctions and polarised protein sorting
name: Epithelial apical surface, brush border and polarised protein sorting
rationale: Members concern microvillus and brush-border assembly, tight junctions and paracellular transport, apical/raft protein localisation and Golgi-to-membrane delivery, while confusables centre on CFTR, podocytes, pancreatic ducts or bile lipid transport.

qualifier: brush border, tight junctions and raft protein sorting
name: Epithelial apical brush border, tight junctions and raft sorting
rationale: Members concern microvillus/brush border assembly, tight junctions and paracellular transport, and polarised Golgi-to-membrane and raft protein localisation, distinct from confusables on CFTR/water transport, bile lipid flippases or podocyte polarity.

name: Pain, itch and thermosensation via TRP channels and tachykinins
rationale: Members detect painful thermal/mechanical stimuli, itch, acid and fever via TRP channels and tachykinin signalling; these distinguish it from K2P channel and chemosensory confusables.

name: Nociception, itch and thermosensation via TRP and tachykinin signaling
rationale: Members share detection of painful, thermal, mechanical and acidic stimuli and itch, and unlike K2P channel and chemosensory confusables include TRP channels and tachykinin receptor signaling.

name: Pain, itch and thermal sensing via TRP channels and tachykinins
rationale: Members cover detection of noxious mechanical, thermal and acid stimuli, itch and fever with TRP channels and tachykinin receptors, distinguishing it from two-pore potassium channel and taste/smell confusables.

qualifier: Notch O-glycosylation and ER N-glycan trimming
name: Notch O-glucosylation/fucosylation and ER N-glycan trimming
rationale: Members cover O-glucose/O-fucose glycosylation of Notch and TSR proteins and ER N-glycan glucose/mannose processing (MOGS, MAN1B1, dolichyl-phosphate-glucose), unlike confusables on glycosaminoglycans, O-mannose, dolichol CDGs or lysosomal glycan degradation.

qualifier: Notch O-fucose/glucose and N-glycan glucose trimming
name: Notch O-fucosylation/glucosylation and ER N-glycan trimming
rationale: Members cover O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation of Notch and TSR proteins and glucose-linked N-glycan processing (MOGS, MAN1B1, Dol-P-Glc), unlike GAG, CDG and lysosomal storage neighbours.

core: Protein glycosylation in ER and Golgi
qualifier: N-glycan glucose trimming and Notch O-fucose/O-glucose
name: N-glycan glucose processing and Notch O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation
rationale: Members cover glucosyl donor synthesis, N-glycan glucose/mannose trimming defects and O-fucosylation/O-glucosylation of Notch and TSR proteins; confusables are GAG/proteoglycan, dystroglycan, sialic acid or dolichol-oligosaccharide glycosylation.

qualifier: spinal cord motor neuron and interneuron fate
name: Dorsoventral spinal cord patterning and motor neuron specification
rationale: Members are neural plate and neural tube dorsoventral patterning events together with floor plate, spinal interneuron and motor neuron fate specification, whereas confusables sit in hindbrain, midbrain dopaminergic or axial mesoderm territory.

core: spinal cord and neural plate dorsoventral patterning
qualifier: motor neuron and ventral interneuron fate, floor plate and ventral midline
name: Spinal cord dorsoventral patterning and motor neuron fate specification
rationale: All members pattern the neural plate and spinal cord along the dorsoventral axis and specify its motor neurons, interneurons and floor plate, while the confusables are hindbrain/brainstem, midbrain dopaminergic or axial mesoderm themes.

core: dorsoventral patterning of the neural plate and spinal cord
qualifier: motor neuron and ventral interneuron fate specification
name: Spinal cord dorsoventral patterning and motor neuron fate specification
rationale: Each member is a neural plate, neural fold or spinal cord patterning step or a fate decision made along its dorsoventral axis, distinguishing it from confusables centred on hindbrain and brainstem development, axial mesoderm and notochord, or midbrain dopaminergic and serotonergic neurons.

qualifier: DREAM/E2F control in stimulated CD4 T cells
name: DREAM/E2F cell-cycle transcription in stimulated CD4 T cells
rationale: Members share G1/S and E2F-target transcription under DREAM/p107/p130 repression plus cell-cycle modules of stimulated CD4 T cells, which distinguishes it from generic replication-initiation and G2/M neighbours.

name: G1/S cell-cycle transcription by E2F and DREAM repressors
rationale: Members center on E2F-driven G1/S gene transcription, its repression by DREAM/p107/p130 and E2F6, and proliferation modules of stimulated T cells, lacking the DNA replication initiation and G2/M members of the confusables.

name: E2F/DREAM G1/S transcription in proliferating CD4 T cells
rationale: Members combine E2F/DREAM/RB-family G1/S transcription with stimulated CD4 T cell division modules, unlike confusables on replication origin licensing, checkpoints or G2/M.

qualifier: Rac-driven, with endosomal trafficking in myeloid cells
name: Rac-driven ruffling, macropinocytosis and endosomal trafficking
rationale: Members concern Rac-dependent ruffles, podosomes, macropinocytosis, early endosome sorting and macrophage fusion/DAP12, while confusables are clathrin/caveolin endocytosis or RHO GTPase cycles.

name: Rac-driven ruffling, macropinocytosis and early endosome trafficking
rationale: Members link Rac signaling, ruffle and podosome assembly to macropinocytosis and early endosomal transport, unlike confusables on clathrin/caveolin endocytosis or Rho GTPase cycles.

qualifier: Rac-driven ruffling and early endosome trafficking
name: Rac-driven ruffling, macropinocytosis and early endosome trafficking
rationale: Members share actin protrusion-based uptake (ruffles, podosomes, Rac, DAP12) and early endosome routing, unlike Rho GTPase cycle and clathrin/caveolin endocytosis neighbours.

core: Metabolic hormone G protein-coupled receptor signaling
name: Nutrient-sensing and glucagon-family hormone GPCR signaling
rationale: Members are GPCRs for free fatty acids, hydroxycarboxylic acids, glucagon-family peptides, somatostatin, relaxin and ghrelin with nutrient and hormone secretion responses, distinguishing them from feeding behavior/leptin and calcitonin/amylin receptor neighbours.

core: GPCR regulation of metabolic hormone secretion
qualifier: nutrient-sensing, glucagon, ghrelin and somatostatin receptors
name: Metabolic peptide hormone and nutrient-sensing GPCR signaling
rationale: Members are free fatty acid, hydroxycarboxylic acid, glucagon, somatostatin and relaxin receptor signaling with ghrelin, glucagon and growth hormone secretion, distinguished from feeding-behavior and calcitonin/amylin confusables.

name: Glucagon, ghrelin and nutrient-metabolite GPCR signaling
rationale: Members are GPCR-mediated metabolic hormone and nutrient sensing (glucagon, ghrelin, somatostatin, free fatty acid and hydroxycarboxylic acid receptors, adenylate cyclase activation), unlike confusables on feeding behaviour, leptin or calcitonin/amylin receptors.

qualifier: cardiac mesoderm, second heart field and coronary vessels
name: Cardiac mesoderm, second heart field and coronary vessel formation
rationale: Members cover mesoderm fate, second heart field specification, heart tube and pericardium morphogenesis plus coronary vasculogenesis and vascular smooth muscle, which the chamber, valve and conduction confusables lack.

qualifier: cardiac mesoderm, second heart field and coronary vessels
name: Cardiac mesoderm, second heart field and coronary vessel development
rationale: Members cover mesodermal fate, second heart field, heart tube and pericardium morphogenesis with cardiac vascular smooth muscle and coronary vasculogenesis, unlike neighbours focused on chambers, septa, valves, conduction or outflow tract.

qualifier: secondary heart field and cardiac mesoderm specification
name: Secondary heart field and cardiac mesoderm specification
rationale: Members cover cardiac mesoderm fate, secondary heart field specification and proliferation, early heart tube, pericardium and coronary vasculogenesis, unlike septum, conduction and outflow tract neighbours.

name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta handling in neurodegeneration
rationale: Members regulate microglial/astrocyte activation, amyloid-beta formation and clearance, tau tangles and lysosomal function, distinct from confusables on glial proliferation, axon regeneration or amyloid fibril biochemistry.

name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta clearance in Alzheimer pathology
rationale: Members concern microglial/astrocyte activation, amyloid-beta formation and clearance and tau tangle regulation, combining glial activation (absent from amyloid-fibril confusables) with amyloid handling (absent from microglial proliferation/migration confusables).

name: Microglial activation, lysosomal function and amyloid-beta clearance
rationale: Members regulate microglial differentiation and activation, lysosome organization and amyloid-beta formation and clearance, while confusables lack microglial differentiation or focus on amyloid fibrils or glial proliferation alone.

qualifier: collagen and elastic fibre synthesis, crosslinking and MMP degradation
name: Collagen and elastic fibre synthesis, assembly and MMP degradation
rationale: Members cover collagen biosynthesis, fibril organization and crosslinking, elastic fibre assembly and MMP-driven collagen/elastin degradation; confusables are generic ECM expression modules or aortic development and fibrinogen terms.

qualifier: collagen and elastic fibre synthesis, crosslinking, MMP degradation
name: Collagen and elastic fibre synthesis, crosslinking and degradation
rationale: All members address collagen and elastin fibre biosynthesis, assembly, crosslinking and MMP-mediated degradation, unlike generic ECM expression modules and aortic development confusables.

name: Collagen and elastic fiber assembly and MMP-mediated degradation
rationale: Members cover collagen/elastin synthesis, crosslinking, fibril organization and MMP-driven degradation, whereas confusables lack the degradation side or are generic extracellular matrix modules.

qualifier: TGF-beta1 production and fibroblast proliferation control
name: Stromal fibroblast secretory program and TGF-beta1 production regulation
rationale: Members are fibroblast/perivascular stromal secretory and complement-ECM modules with regulation of TGF-beta1 production, fibroblast proliferation and adhesion, unlike neighbours on collagen-integrin ECM, YAP/TAZ mechanoresponse or endothelial programs.

name: Stromal fibroblast secretory program with TGF-beta1 production control
rationale: Members are fibroblast/perivascular stromal modules with fibroblast proliferation, KRAS/FOSL targets and regulation of TGF-beta1 production, distinct from mechanoresponsive YAP/TAZ, endothelial and core ECM confusables.

name: Fibroblast stromal secretory programme with TGF-beta1 production control
