rationale: Members are stromal/fibroblast matrix, complement and chemokine expression modules, fibroblast proliferation, adhesion and regulation of TGF-beta1 production; confusables are endothelial-perivascular, core collagen-integrin ECM or YAP/TAZ mechanoresponsive themes.

qualifier: fermentation to lactate and fructose bisphosphate metabolism
name: Glucose fermentation to lactate and fructose bisphosphate metabolism
rationale: Most members describe glycolysis from hexokinase through fructose-1,6/2,6-bisphosphate to lactate fermentation (oxygen transport and resveratrol response are outliers), distinguishing it from PPP/glycolysis regulation, gluconeogenesis and creatine confusables.

name: Glycolysis to lactate and fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation
rationale: Most members describe glucose catabolism through glycolysis to lactate with fructose-2,6-/1,6-bisphosphate control (oxygen transport and resveratrol response are outliers), and the fermentation and F2,6BP arm distinguish it from creatine/oxygen, gluconeogenesis and pentose-shunt confusables.

name: Glycolysis to lactate and fructose 2,6-bisphosphate regulation
rationale: Most members describe glucose catabolism to lactate and its control by fructose 2,6-bisphosphate (with oxygen transport and resveratrol as peripheral), which confusables lack in favour of gluconeogenesis, creatine or pentose-phosphate regulation.

qualifier: substrate adhesion with Rho kinase and ILK complex signaling
name: Integrin-dependent cell spreading and substrate-attached migration
rationale: Members cover integrin signaling, substrate-dependent spreading/migration and the RHO-PAK/ROCK and PINCH-ILK-parvin cytoskeletal links, unlike the fibronectin-matrix, platelet and Rap1/MAPK confusables.

qualifier: ILK complex and Rho effector cytoskeletal remodeling
name: Integrin-mediated cell spreading and migration via Rho-effector cytoskeletal remodeling
rationale: Members share integrin-dependent substrate adhesion, spreading and migration coupled to actin remodeling (PINCH-ILK-parvin, ROCK, PAK, SRF targets), distinguishing it from Rap1/MAPK integrin signaling, fibronectin matrix assembly and platelet/stress-fiber confusables.

qualifier: Rho effector (ROCK, PAK) and ILK complex cytoskeletal remodelling
name: Integrin-dependent cell spreading and Rho-effector cytoskeletal remodelling
rationale: All members concern integrin/substrate adhesion driving cell spreading and migration via ILK-PINCH-parvin and Rho-ROCK/PAK remodelling, unlike confusables centred on fibronectin matrix, stress fibres, platelet activation or Rap1/MAPK integrin activation.

qualifier: IRF3 activation, cell death, HSE deficiencies
name: TLR3-TRIF signalling to IRF3 and necroptosis; HSE deficiencies
rationale: Members are endosomal TLR3 trafficking, TRIF-TBK1-IRF3/7 activation, TRIF-mediated necroptotic death and TLR3-pathway herpes encephalitis deficiencies, unlike the TLR7/8/9 IRAK and RIPK1 confusables.

qualifier: IRF3 activation, necroptosis and herpes encephalitis deficiencies
name: Endosomal TLR3-TRIF signalling, necroptosis and herpes encephalitis defects
rationale: Members are endosomal TLR3 trafficking, TRIF-driven TBK1/IRF3 activation and necroptotic death, and TLR3-pathway deficiencies in herpes simplex encephalitis, unlike TLR7/8/9 MyD88-IRAK and IKK/TAK1 confusables.

qualifier: IRF3/7 activation, necroptosis and herpes encephalitis deficiencies
name: TLR3-TRIF signaling to IRF3/7 and necroptosis in HSE
rationale: Members are endosomal TLR3 trafficking and TRIF/TICAM1-dependent TBK1-IRF3/7 activation and programmed cell death, with HSE-causing deficiencies, unlike MyD88/IRAK TLR7/8/9, TRIF-TAK1/IKK and RIPK1 necrosis confusables.

qualifier: telomerase extension and C-strand fill-in synthesis
name: Telomere maintenance via telomerase and C-strand synthesis
rationale: All members concern telomere end maintenance (protein recruitment to telomeres, telomerase assembly and extension, packaging, recombination inhibition); the C-strand fill-in steps and telomerase extension distinguish it from confusables centred on recombination-based maintenance, capping and Cajal body trafficking.

name: Telomere maintenance by telomerase extension and C-strand fill-in
rationale: All members concern telomere maintenance (telomerase recruitment and assembly, telomere packaging, C-strand synthesis), and the telomerase/C-strand fill-in steps separate it from confusables centred on capping, recombination-based maintenance and Cajal-body trafficking.

qualifier: telomerase extension and C-strand fill-in synthesis
name: Telomere lengthening by telomerase and C-strand synthesis
rationale: All members concern telomere maintenance, and the theme uniquely carries telomerase extension, telomerase holoenzyme assembly and C-strand fill-in steps, whereas confusables centre on recombination-based maintenance, capping and NHEJ protection.

core: Transcriptional control of fatty acid and glucose homeostasis
qualifier: fasting/caloric restriction and PPARA-driven fatty acid response
name: Fasting-state fatty acid and gluconeogenic transcriptional regulation
rationale: Members link caloric restriction, fatty acid sensing (PPARA, mitochondrial biogenesis), triglyceride/fatty acid homeostasis and nuclear-receptor control of gluconeogenesis, whereas confusables emphasize SREBP/LXR lipogenesis, cholesterol or circadian receptors.

core: Nuclear receptor control of fasting metabolism
name: PPAR-alpha-driven fasting control of gluconeogenesis and triglycerides
rationale: Members are fatty-acid/caloric-restriction responses regulating gluconeogenesis, triglyceride and mitochondrial biogenesis via PPARA and LXR; confusables emphasise SREBP/lipogenesis, circadian or adipose lipolysis programmes.

core: Transcriptional control of fatty acid and glucose homeostasis
qualifier: fasting/caloric-restriction gluconeogenesis and PPARA mitochondrial program
name: Nutrient-state transcriptional control of fatty acid and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members link nuclear-receptor-driven gene expression (PPARA, LXR, mitochondrial biogenesis) to fatty acid/triglyceride homeostasis and gluconeogenesis under caloric restriction, distinguished from confusables centered on SREBP/LXR lipogenesis, adipose lipolysis and clock/PGC-1alpha regulation.

name: Gluconeogenesis from alanine, glycerol and fructose precursors
rationale: Members cover gluconeogenesis and metabolism of its substrates (alanine, oxaloacetate, glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate, alditols, fructose), with phosphocreatine as an outlier; biosynthetic gluconeogenic flow separates it from fructose catabolism disorders and the pentose phosphate shunt.

name: Gluconeogenesis from alanine, glycerol and oxaloacetate precursors
rationale: Members cover gluconeogenesis and the metabolism of its carbon sources (alanine, glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate, oxaloacetate, alditols, fructose synthesis), distinguishing the theme from fructose catabolism disorders and the pentose phosphate shunt.

name: Gluconeogenesis and glycerol, alditol and alanine metabolism
rationale: Members cover gluconeogenesis and its carbon sources (glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate, alditols, alanine, oxaloacetate, fructose synthesis), distinguishing it from pentose-phosphate and fructose catabolism neighbours.

name: Glycosphingolipid synthesis and inherited lipid-enzyme or transporter defects
rationale: Members combine glycosphingolipid/ganglioside/galactosylceramide biosynthesis with inherited defects of mostly lipid- and eicosanoid-handling CYPs and transporters (CYP1B1, CYP2U1, CYP7B1, TBXAS1, SLCO2A1, SLC33A1, ABCB6), which separates it from confusables on bile acid, cholesterol, GPI or fatty acid/eicosanoid synthesis.

qualifier: glycosphingolipid synthesis plus inherited CYP and transporter disorders
name: Glycosphingolipid synthesis with inherited CYP and transporter disorders
rationale: A loose lipid-metabolism grouping of ganglioside/galactosylceramide synthesis and monogenic defects of cytochrome P450s (CYP7B1, CYP1B1, CYP2U1, TBXAS1) and transporters (SLCO2A1, SLC33A1, ABCB6); confusables centre on bile acid, eicosanoid, cholesterol or GPI-anchor metabolism.

name: Glycosphingolipid synthesis and monogenic lipid-metabolizing enzyme defects
rationale: Members are glycosphingolipid/ganglioside biosynthesis plus inherited defects of oxysterol, eicosanoid and lipid-handling enzymes or transporters (ABCB6 is an outlier), separating them from bile acid, fatty acid/eicosanoid and cholesterol synthesis confusables.

qualifier: amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Organic acid metabolism and amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
rationale: Members are broad organic acid/amide metabolism plus glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, versus confusables on specific amino acid metabolism.

qualifier: amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Organic acid and amide metabolism via amino acid conjugation
rationale: Members combine broad organic acid and amide metabolism with glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, whereas confusables are specific amino acid catabolic pathways.

name: Amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids and organic acid metabolism
rationale: Members are glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate with general organic acid/amide metabolism, which the amino acid catabolism confusables lack.

name: Metal ion oxidative stress, heme oxygenase and ferroptosis
rationale: Members are responses to cobalt, lead, mercury, selenium and iron together with BACH1/HMOX1 regulation, peroxide metabolism and ferroptosis, distinguishing the theme from cadmium detoxification, iron import and MTF1/metallothionein confusables.

core: Response to iron and heavy metal ions
qualifier: heme oxygenase oxidative stress and ferroptosis
name: Iron and heavy metal oxidative stress response and ferroptosis
rationale: Members are responses to iron, lead, mercury, cobalt and selenium with HMOX1/BACH1 oxidative stress control and ferroptosis, distinct from metallothionein/zinc-cadmium and iron import confusables.

core: Response to metal ions and oxidative stress
name: Metal-induced oxidative stress with heme oxygenase and ferroptosis
rationale: Members are responses to lead, cobalt, mercury, selenium and iron with HMOX1/BACH1 regulation, peroxide control and ferroptosis, which the cadmium, iron-transport and metallothionein confusables lack.

name: B cell proliferation and plasma-cell differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell activation, proliferation, germinal-centre/B-1 differentiation, Tfh/ICOS help and plasma-cell immunoglobulin signatures, the plasma-cell content separating it from memory/homeostasis B cell confusables.

core: B cell activation and plasma cell differentiation
name: Tfh-helped B cell proliferation and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover B cell proliferation, germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation with Tfh differentiation and ICOS co-stimulation, unlike confusables dominated by memory/naive B cell signatures and B cell homeostasis.

name: Germinal-centre B cell activation toward plasma cells
rationale: Members cover B cell proliferation and differentiation, germinal-centre and Tfh/ICOS help and plasma-cell/immunoglobulin programmes, unlike confusables on B cell homeostasis, memory and surface signatures.

name: Basement membrane-hemidesmosome anchorage and cornified envelope cross-linking
rationale: Members concern laminin/integrin/collagen anchoring of epithelia via hemidesmosomes and basement membrane, with cornified envelope and peptide cross-linking distinguishing it from collagen-ECM and desmosome confusables.

name: Hemidesmosome-basement membrane anchorage and epidermal cross-linking
rationale: Members describe laminin-integrin hemidesmosome and anchoring-fibril attachment of epithelium to basement membrane plus cornified envelope peptide cross-linking, unlike desmosome/cell-cell adhesion and collagen fibril confusables.

name: Epidermal basement membrane, hemidesmosome and cornified envelope assembly
rationale: Members cover laminin-integrin basement membrane interactions, anchoring fibrils, hemidesmosomes and transglutaminase cross-linking of the cornified envelope, setting it apart from collagen/elastic fibre and desmosome/cell-cell adhesion confusables.

name: Glycerolipid metabolism: phospholipid remodeling and triglyceride storage
rationale: Members span glycerophospholipid synthesis and acyl-chain remodeling together with DAG/TAG turnover, lipid droplets and adipocyte lipolysis, which separates it from the TG-only, glycerol/fructose and sphingolipid confusables.

qualifier: phospholipid remodeling and triglyceride lipid droplet turnover
name: Glycerophospholipid and triglyceride metabolism with lipid droplet turnover
rationale: Members span synthesis and acyl-chain remodeling of PC/PE/PS/PG/PI/CL, DAG/MAG/TAG synthesis and lipolysis, lipid droplets and adipocyte biology; the glycerophospholipid side separates it from fatty acid/TAG-only confusables, and the TAG/droplet side from the sphingolipid/membrane lipid confusable.

qualifier: phospholipid remodeling plus triglyceride and lipid droplet dynamics
name: Glycerophospholipid and triglyceride metabolism with lipid droplet dynamics
rationale: Members span glycerophospholipid synthesis and acyl-chain remodeling, triglyceride/DAG/MAG turnover and lipid droplet biology; confusables lack either the phospholipid arm (fatty acid/glycerol themes) or the triglyceride/lipid droplet arm (sphingolipid/membrane lipid theme).

qualifier: beta-catenin destruction complex and Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling
name: Wnt/beta-catenin destruction complex and Hippo-YAP signaling
rationale: Members cover Wnt ligand secretion, destruction-complex regulation and its cancer mutants, TCF transcription, non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ and Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling, separating it from Notch, Hedgehog, planar polarity and RUNX3/TGF-beta neighbours.

qualifier: beta-catenin destruction complex and Hippo-YAP crosstalk
name: Wnt/beta-catenin destruction complex and Hippo-YAP signaling
rationale: Members are canonical and non-canonical Wnt signalling, destruction-complex cancer mutants and Wnt secretion together with Hippo/YAP-TAZ, separating it from TGF-beta, Notch/Hedgehog and planar cell polarity confusables.

qualifier: beta-catenin destruction complex, Wnt/Ca2+ and Hippo-YAP
name: Wnt/beta-catenin, Wnt/Ca2+ and Hippo-YAP signaling
rationale: Members cover canonical Wnt/beta-catenin (destruction complex and its cancer mutants, Wnt secretion), Wnt/Ca2+ signalling and Hippo-YAP/TAZ density signalling; confusables are planar cell polarity, Notch/Hedgehog or RUNX3/TGF-beta mutant sets.

name: Epidermal keratinization and ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte differentiation and cornification, hair follicle, sebaceous gland, nail and tooth/odontogenesis and EDA-ID ectodermal dysplasia, distinguishing it from adhesion, wound healing, pigmentation and intestinal epithelium neighbours.

name: Ectodermal organ development: epidermis, hair follicle and tooth
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte differentiation and cornification, hair follicle, gland, nail and tooth/odontoblast development and ectodermal dysplasia, with tooth and EDA-ID members separating it from pigmentation and junction confusables.

name: Epidermal keratinocyte differentiation and ectodermal appendage development
rationale: Members span keratinocyte differentiation and cornification plus hair, tooth, nail and gland appendage development (including ectodermal dysplasia); this separates it from junction, pigmentation and intestinal epithelium confusables.

name: Nuclear receptor transcriptional control of adipogenesis and lipid-glucose metabolism
rationale: Members describe PPAR, LXR, ROR/REV-ERB, SREBP and PGC-1alpha transcriptional control of white/brown fat differentiation and lipid and glucose metabolism, unlike confusables on lipid droplet enzymology, ChREBP sugar signaling and thermogenesis.

core: adipocyte differentiation and lipid metabolic regulation
qualifier: nuclear receptor (PPAR, LXR, circadian) transcriptional control
name: Adipocyte differentiation and nuclear receptor control of lipid metabolism
rationale: Members cover white/brown/beige adipogenesis and PPAR, LXR, SREBP, PGC-1alpha and ROR/REV-ERB control of triglyceride, fatty acid and glucose metabolism, distinguishing the theme from ChREBP glucose sensing, lipid droplet turnover and thermogenesis confusables.

name: Nuclear receptor control of adipogenesis and energy metabolism
rationale: Members cover PPAR, LXR, ROR/REV-ERB and PGC-1alpha transcriptional control of white, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation, triglyceride synthesis and gluconeogenesis, whereas confusables emphasise lipid droplet dynamics, lipolysis, ChREBP sugar signaling, thermogenesis or cholesterol.

core: Neurobehavior: motor, sensory and social behavior
name: MECP2 neuronal gene regulation and motor-sensory behavior
rationale: Members combine MECP2 regulation and loss-of-function pathways with locomotor, sensory, vocal, social and respiratory-control behaviors and glycinergic transmission (Rett-related phenotypes), which the synaptic transmission and hindbrain development confusables lack.

name: MECP2-regulated neuronal transcription and motor-sensory behavior
rationale: Members combine MECP2 regulation and its loss-of-function effects on neuronal genes with locomotor, sensory, vocal and social behaviours, glycinergic transmission and forebrain development, which hindbrain/cerebellar development and synaptic transmission confusables lack.

name: MECP2-regulated neuronal transcription and sensorimotor behavior
rationale: Members combine MECP2 (Rett) transcriptional regulation with locomotor, sensory, vocal and social behaviors and related neural development, unlike confusables centred on hindbrain development or synaptic transmission.

name: Zinc, copper and heavy metal ion homeostasis and detoxification
rationale: Members cover zinc, copper, manganese, cadmium and other metal transport, sensing (MTF1) and metallothionein detoxification, whereas confusables centre on iron, transferrin and heme handling.

qualifier: zinc, copper and non-iron heavy metals via SLC39/SLC30, metallothionein, MTF1
name: Zinc, copper and heavy metal transport and detoxification
rationale: Members cover transport, homeostasis and responses to zinc, copper, manganese, cadmium, cobalt and other heavy metals with metallothionein/MTF1 detoxification, while confusables centre on iron, heme and transferrin handling.

qualifier: zinc, copper and toxic heavy metals rather than iron
name: Zinc, copper and heavy metal handling and detoxification
rationale: Members cover SLC39/SLC30 zinc transport, copper and manganese transport, metallothioneins, MTF1 and responses to cadmium, lead, mercury and cobalt, distinguishing it from neighbours built around iron, transferrin and heme handling.

qualifier: vascular smooth muscle contraction and cGMP-mediated relaxation
name: Vascular smooth muscle tone regulating systemic blood pressure
rationale: Members regulate arterial pressure via smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, cGMP effects, vasoconstriction and renal sodium excretion; smooth muscle tone distinguishes it from renin-angiotensin and eNOS-activation neighbours.

core: Vascular smooth muscle tone and blood pressure
name: Vascular smooth muscle tone and blood pressure via NO-cGMP
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle contraction/relaxation and arterial pressure through NO-cGMP, endothelin and catecholamines, unlike confusables centred on renin-angiotensin metabolism or eNOS activation.

core: Vascular smooth muscle tone and blood pressure
name: Vascular smooth muscle contraction, relaxation and cGMP signaling
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle contraction/relaxation and arterial pressure via cGMP, catecholamines, endothelin and angiotensin, whereas confusables focus on renin-angiotensin metabolism or eNOS activation.

name: Antifungal lectin receptor-Th17 axis with IL-18/IL-36 signaling
rationale: Members join Dectin-1/2 and DC-SIGN fungal sensing, IL-17/Th17 and IL-23 production with IL-1-family IL-18, IL-36 and IL-38 signaling; the IL-18 and lectin members separate it from IL-10/IL-12 and IL-1 processing confusables.

qualifier: C-type lectin sensing with IL-17, IL-18, IL-36
name: Antifungal C-type lectin and IL-17/IL-18/IL-36 inflammatory signaling
rationale: Members are Dectin-1/2 and DC-SIGN fungal sensing with IL-17/Th17, IL-18, IL-36/IL-38 and IL-23/GM-CSF production, distinguishing it from confusables on IL-1 processing, IL-10/IL-12/IL-27 or type III interferon.

core: Antifungal C-type lectin and Th17 immunity
qualifier: IL-18, IL-36 and IL-38 cytokine signaling
name: Antifungal C-type lectin, Th17 and IL-18/IL-36 signaling
rationale: Members link Dectin-1/Dectin-2/DC-SIGN fungal recognition to IL-23/IL-17/Th17 responses and IL-1 family (IL-18, IL-36, IL-38) signaling; IL-18 distinguishes it from the IL-10/IL-12 confusable and the lectin members from IL-1 processing confusables.

qualifier: telomerase assembly and Cajal body localization
name: TRiC chaperonin folding and telomerase Cajal body assembly
rationale: Members combine CCT/TRiC and prefoldin folding of actin and tubulin with telomerase holoenzyme assembly, Cajal body localization and telomere extension; confusables have either general/ER folding without telomerase or RNA modification without chaperonin folding.

qualifier: telomerase assembly and Cajal body trafficking
name: CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding and telomerase Cajal body trafficking
rationale: Members combine prefoldin-CCT/TRiC folding of actin and tubulin with CCT-dependent telomerase holoenzyme assembly, Cajal body localization and telomere extension; confusables have generic folding/refolding or rRNA modification without both arms.

qualifier: telomerase assembly and Cajal body localization
name: CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding and telomerase Cajal body trafficking
rationale: Members are CCT/TRiC and prefoldin folding of actin and tubulin plus telomerase holoenzyme assembly and scaRNA/telomerase Cajal body localization; folding-only neighbours lack the telomerase arm and the rRNA neighbour lacks folding.

qualifier: GPCR agonists with Rho and Rap1-integrin signaling
name: Platelet GPCR activation with Rho and Rap1-integrin signaling
rationale: Members are thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signaling in platelets coupled to G12/13-Rho and Rap1-integrin cytoskeletal signaling, distinguishing it from collagen/VWF adhesion and degranulation neighbours.

qualifier: GPCR to Rho, Rap1 and integrins
name: Platelet GPCR signaling to Rho, Rap1 and integrins
rationale: Members are ADP, thromboxane, thrombin and prostacyclin receptor signaling with G12/13-Rho, Rap1 and integrin-cytoskeleton linkage, lacking the degranulation, VWF/GPVI adhesion and ERK5/MAPK members of the confusables.

qualifier: GPCR agonists to Rho, Rap1 and integrins
name: Platelet GPCR agonist signaling to Rho, Rap1 and integrins
rationale: Members are thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and prostacyclin GPCR signaling through G12/13-Rho and Rap1 to integrin and cytoskeletal activation, unlike GPVI/VWF adhesion and degranulation confusables.

qualifier: NAD(P) salvage and coenzyme A with pyruvate dehydrogenase
name: NAD(P) and coenzyme A metabolism with pyruvate dehydrogenase
rationale: Members share NAD(P) and CoA cofactor synthesis/turnover and pyruvate-to-acetyl-CoA conversion; NAD salvage and nicotinate metabolism distinguish it from TCA, thiamine and lipoylation confusables.

qualifier: NAD(P) and coenzyme A with pyruvate-to-acetyl-CoA conversion
name: NAD(P) and coenzyme A metabolism with pyruvate-to-acetyl-CoA conversion
rationale: Members cover NAD/NADP synthesis, salvage, transport and NADPH regeneration, CoA/pantothenate synthesis and PDH-catalysed acetyl-CoA formation; the pyridine nucleotide arm distinguishes it from TCA, OGDH/lipoylation and thiamine confusables.

qualifier: pyruvate dehydrogenase, coenzyme A and NAD(P) synthesis
name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase, coenzyme A and NAD(P) cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover PDH-mediated acetyl-CoA formation, CoA biosynthesis and NAD/NADP salvage and regeneration, distinguishing it from TCA cycle, thiamine and lipoylation/OGDH confusables.

core: Transcriptional control of lipid and glucose metabolism
qualifier: by nuclear receptors and SREBP, including cholesterol homeostasis
name: Nuclear receptor and SREBP control of lipid metabolism
rationale: Members are nuclear receptor (LXR, PPARA, ROR/REV-ERB), PGC-1alpha and SREBP programs governing lipid, cholesterol and glucose metabolism; neighbours instead center on adipocyte differentiation or ChREBP sugar sensing.

core: Transcriptional control of lipid and energy metabolism
qualifier: nuclear receptors and SREBP-driven cholesterol synthesis
name: Nuclear receptor and SREBP regulation of lipid metabolism
rationale: Members are nuclear receptor (LXR, PPARA, ROR/REV-ERB) and SREBP/PGC-1alpha transcriptional control of cholesterol, lipid and glucose metabolism, distinguished from the adipogenesis- and ChREBP/sugar-centred neighbours by SREBP/cholesterol and nuclear receptor content.

name: Nuclear receptor and SREBP control of lipid metabolism
rationale: Members are LXR, PPARA, ROR/REV-ERB, PGC-1alpha and SREBP transcriptional regulation of cholesterol, lipid and glucose metabolism; unlike neighbours it carries SREBP/cholesterol homeostasis and generic nuclear receptor transcription rather than adipocyte differentiation or ChREBP sugar sensing.

qualifier: nutrient and energy sensing via AKT-TSC and LKB1-AMPK
name: Nutrient- and energy-sensing mTORC1 control via AKT, TSC, AMPK
rationale: Members describe amino acid, glucose and energy inputs to mTORC1/TORC2 via AKT-TSC and LKB1-AMPK, whereas confusables centre on PTEN regulation and ERBB2/3 or phosphoinositide signalling.

qualifier: nutrient and energy sensing via AKT-TSC and LKB1-AMPK
name: Nutrient- and energy-sensing mTORC1 signalling via AKT and TSC
rationale: Members describe TORC1/2 regulation by amino acids, glucose, energy (LKB1-AMPK) and AKT-TSC with translational output, whereas confusables focus on PTEN regulation and ERBB2:ERBB3 downregulation.

qualifier: nutrient, amino acid and energy sensing
name: Nutrient- and energy-sensing mTOR signalling
rationale: Members describe TORC1/TORC2 regulation by amino acids, glucose starvation, LKB1-AMPK and AKT-TSC with downstream translation control, while confusables centre on PTEN and PI3K/ERBB restraint.

name: RNA polymerase II promoter escape, pausing and elongation control
rationale: Most members regulate Pol II preinitiation, promoter clearance, pausing, elongation and termination; Pol II specificity separates it from confusables dominated by Pol I/III, rRNA processing, HIV transcription and splicing.

qualifier: promoter clearance, pausing and elongation control
name: RNA polymerase II promoter clearance, pausing and elongation control
rationale: Most members regulate Pol II preinitiation, promoter clearance, pausing, elongation and termination, distinct from Pol I/III, RNA processing and HIV-elongation confusables.

name: RNA polymerase II pausing, elongation and termination control
rationale: Most members regulate Pol II promoter clearance, pausing, elongation and termination (two translation-elongation/frameshifting members are outliers); confusables add Pol I/III, HIV transcription, rRNA processing or splicing.

name: Lymphocyte antigen receptor signaling, costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members cover proximal TCR and BCR signaling plus CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA/CD22 inhibitory tuning, whereas confusables are T cell-only activation/differentiation or B cell proliferation sets.

name: Lymphocyte antigen receptor signaling and costimulatory/coinhibitory control
rationale: Members cover proximal TCR and BCR signaling plus CD28 costimulation, CTLA4/BTLA/CD22 coinhibition and receptor-signal brakes, spanning both T and B cells whereas confusables are T-activation-only or B-differentiation-only.

qualifier: with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibitory checkpoints
name: TCR and BCR signaling with costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members are proximal TCR and BCR signaling plus CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA/CD22 inhibitory tuning, covering both T and B cell receptors unlike the B cell development or T cell activation/differentiation confusables.

core: Circadian and nuclear receptor metabolic regulation
qualifier: PGC-1alpha/PPARA control of gluconeogenesis and energy metabolism
name: Circadian clock and PGC-1alpha control of energy metabolism
rationale: BMAL1/CLOCK and ROR/REV-ERB transcription plus PGC-1alpha, PPARA, gluconeogenesis, thermogenesis and beta-cell regulation distinguish it from neighbours on core clock protein turnover, glucocorticoids and adipogenesis.

name: Circadian clock and PGC-1alpha control of energy metabolism
rationale: Members couple circadian transcription (BMAL1/CLOCK, ROR/REV-ERB, heme) with PGC-1alpha/PPARA-driven gluconeogenesis, beta-cell, thermogenic and mitochondrial biogenesis programs, unlike confusables on the core clock mechanism, adipogenesis or lipid homeostasis.

name: Circadian and PGC-1α/PPAR control of energy metabolism
rationale: Members link BMAL1/CLOCK, ROR/REV-ERB and heme clock outputs with PGC-1α, PPARA, gluconeogenesis, thermogenesis, beta-cell and caloric-restriction responses, whereas confusables cover the core clock feedback loop, adipogenesis, glucocorticoids or lipid homeostasis.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ and PTK6 kinase signaling
rationale: Members are Hippo/YAP-TAZ density-sensing signaling plus PTK6 (BRK) signaling events; the PTK6 set is what the ERBB, MET and ALK confusables lack.

name: PTK6 kinase and Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling
rationale: Members are PTK6 (BRK) signaling events and Hippo/YAP-TAZ cell-density signaling; the Hippo-YAP arm is absent from all confusables, which instead carry MET, ERBB or PI3K-AKT receptor signaling.

name: PTK6 signaling with Hippo–YAP/TAZ regulation
rationale: Members are PTK6 (BRK) signaling events plus Hippo/YAP1–TAZ transcriptional control and cell-density sensing; the Hippo block is what neighbouring tyrosine-kinase themes lack.

name: Nucleotide deamination editing, antiviral restriction and translation repression
rationale: Members cover ADAR A-to-I and APOBEC C-to-U editing, APOBEC3G restriction of HIV and translational repression/frameshifting, distinguishing the theme from DNA demethylation/alkylation repair, retroviral integration and coronavirus replication confusables.

core: Nucleotide deamination editing in viral restriction
name: Nucleotide deamination editing and translational repression restricting viruses
rationale: Members combine ADAR/APOBEC deaminase editing and host suppression of viral replication with translational silencing, distinct from confusables on HIV/coronavirus replication or DNA demethylation repair.

name: Nucleotide deamination editing, antiviral restriction and translational repression
rationale: Members combine ADAR/APOBEC deamination editing, APOBEC3G and other host restriction of viral replication, and translational repression/frameshifting, unlike confusables on HIV life cycle, DNA demethylation/repair or coronavirus replication.

name: Hepatic gluconeogenesis, glucose-6-phosphatase and fructose metabolism
rationale: Members cover gluconeogenesis, G6PC/SLC37A4 deficiencies, glucokinase regulation and fructose/alanine metabolism, unlike glycolysis, glycogenolysis and glycogen synthesis confusables.

name: Hepatic glucose-6-phosphate and fructose metabolism, gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members cover glucokinase, glucose-6-phosphatase/transport disorders, fructose catabolism defects and gluconeogenesis, distinguishing it from glycogen and glycolysis confusables.

name: Gluconeogenesis, glucose-6-phosphate handling and fructose catabolism
rationale: Members cover gluconeogenesis, G6PC/SLC37A4 and glucokinase regulation, and fructose catabolism disorders, whereas confusables center on glycolysis and glycogen metabolism.

name: COPI retrograde and endosome-Golgi-lysosome vesicle traffic
rationale: Members cover COPI intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER retrograde transport plus endosome-Golgi and Golgi-lysosome traffic, unlike COPII export, secretion or endosomal recycling confusables.

qualifier: COPI and endosome-to-Golgi routes with lysosomal sorting
name: COPI and endosome-to-Golgi retrograde traffic with lysosomal sorting
rationale: Members cover COPI Golgi-to-ER and intra-Golgi transport, endosome-to-Golgi retrieval and Golgi-to-lysosome sorting, whereas confusables emphasise COPII ER export, Golgi organization or secretion and recycling.

name: COPI, endosome-to-Golgi and Golgi-to-lysosome vesicle traffic
rationale: Members center on COPI and retrograde endosome/Golgi/ER traffic plus Golgi-to-lysosome delivery, unlike COPII ER-exit, secretion or recycling confusables.

name: Somitogenesis and embryonic limb and joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover somite specification and segmentation clock (LFNG) with limb, digit and joint morphogenesis; the somitogenesis members are what Hox, nodal and neural-plate confusables lack.

name: Somitogenesis and embryonic limb and joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover somite specification, segmentation clock and axis elongation plus limb, digit and joint morphogenesis; the limb/joint members distinguish it from Hox, neural plate and nodal patterning confusables.

name: Somite segmentation and embryonic limb and joint morphogenesis
rationale: Members are somitogenesis, axis elongation and segment patterning plus limb, digit and joint morphogenesis, which neighbours centred on Nodal asymmetry, Hox clusters and neural plate lack.

name: EGFR/ERBB endocytic downregulation and PTEN regulation
rationale: Members are ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis and lysosomal sorting of EGFR/ERBB receptors with PTEN stability/localization control, unlike generic ESCRT and MET/PTK6 signaling confusables.

name: Ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation of ERBB receptor signalling
rationale: Members concern ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis and MVB/lysosomal sorting that terminates EGFR/ERBB signalling, distinguishing it from generic ESCRT and MET/PTK6 signalling confusables.

name: Ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation of EGFR/ERBB receptors
rationale: Members concern ERBB/EGFR attenuation via ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis and MVB-lysosomal sorting with linked PTEN regulation, unlike MET/PTK6 signalling or generic ESCRT confusables.

qualifier: FLT3 and PDGFR mutants to STAT5
name: Oncogenic FLT3 and PDGFRA/B signalling to STAT5
rationale: Members cover FLT3 and PDGFRA/B mutant and fusion signalling, STAT5 activation and CBL-mediated negative regulation, distinct from ALK/FGFR resistance (C1) and EPO/interleukin STAT5 signalling (C2-C4).

qualifier: FLT3 and PDGFR mutants driving STAT5
name: Oncogenic FLT3 and PDGFR kinase signaling to STAT5
rationale: Members are mutant/fusion FLT3, PDGFRA/B and FGFR1 signaling with CBL regulation, TPO signaling and STAT5 activation, distinguishing it from EPO/interleukin cytokine-receptor confusables and ALK/FGFR amplification-fusion confusables.

qualifier: oncogenic FLT3 and PDGFR mutants and fusions
name: Oncogenic FLT3 and PDGFR mutant signaling with STAT5 activation
rationale: Members cover FLT3 ITD/fusion/CBL-mutant and PDGFRA/B mutant and fusion signalling, TPO and STAT5 activation, unlike EPO/IL-3 cytokine-STAT5 confusables or ALK/FGFR fusion confusables.

name: mRNA polyadenylation, stabilization and decay control
rationale: Members span mRNA 3'-end cleavage and polyadenylation, decapping and decay and their inhibition, IGF2BP/CRD stabilization and export, unlike confusables centred on ARE- and miRNA-mediated destabilization or histone mRNA processing.

name: mRNA polyadenylation, stabilization and decay
rationale: Members span mRNA 3'-end cleavage/polyadenylation, export, decapping/decay and protection from decay, unlike confusables centred on ARE/miRNA-mediated destabilization or histone mRNA processing.

name: mRNA 3'-end polyadenylation and transcript stabilization against decay
rationale: Members cover cleavage/polyadenylation, export, decapping and stabilizing inhibition of mRNA decay, whereas confusables center on histone mRNA processing, deadenylation and ARE- or miRNA-mediated destabilization.

qualifier: CHD/NuRD remodeling, deacetylation and retroelement silencing
name: CHD/NuRD and HDAC chromatin repression with retroelement silencing
rationale: Members are corepressor chromatin machinery (NuRD, CHD subfamilies, HDACs, MECP2-NCoR, SUMOylated cofactors, X inactivation); KRAB-ZFP and HUSH retroelement silencing distinguish it from confusables dominated by BAF, HAT and methylation complexes.

name: Chromatin silencing by CHD-NuRD remodelers and retroelement repressors
rationale: Members include CHD/NuRD/ChAHP remodelers, HDAC and MECP2-NCoR repression, KRAB-ZFP/HUSH retroelement silencing and X inactivation, versus confusables dominated by BAF assembly and histone methylation/acetylation.

name: HDAC and CHD-remodeler chromatin silencing of retroelements
rationale: Most members are repressive chromatin machinery (HDACs, NuRD/CHD, ChAHP, MECP2-NCoR, SUMOylated corepressors) silencing retroelements (KRAB-ZFP, HUSH) and the inactive X; confusables are broader histone methylation/acetylation and BAF assembly; 'organism emergence' is an outlier.

qualifier: nucleotide pool sanitization and nucleoside analogue drug metabolism
name: Nucleotide pool sanitization and nucleoside analogue drug metabolism
rationale: Members cover NUDT-mediated triphosphate hydrolysis protecting DNA and metabolism/methylation of thiopurine and antiviral nucleoside analogues, unlike de novo purine synthesis, purine/pyrimidine catabolism and nucleoside transport confusables.

qualifier: NUDT sanitization and nucleoside-analogue drug metabolism
name: Nucleotide pool sanitization and nucleoside-analogue drug metabolism
rationale: Members share NTP hydrolysis by NUDT enzymes and metabolism of thiopurine, ribavirin and abacavir (TPMT methylation), whereas confusables cover purine/pyrimidine salvage, de novo synthesis or nucleoside transport.

qualifier: nucleotide pool sanitization and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
name: Nucleotide pool sanitization and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
rationale: Members cover NUDT hydrolysis and interconversion of (d)NTPs that protect DNA, and the metabolism of nucleoside-analog/thiopurine drugs (abacavir, ribavirin, azathioprine, TPMT methylation), unlike de novo purine synthesis, pyrimidine catabolism, nucleoside transport and ADA/PNP neighbours.

core: Adenine nucleotide, NAD and phosphocreatine energy metabolism
name: Mitochondrial ATP/ADP, NAD and creatine energetics with viral apoptosis
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial ATP/ADP and NAD transport, NAD salvage, creatine/phosphocreatine and viral MOMP-induced apoptosis; the creatine and viral apoptosis members separate it from nucleotide-interconversion and tryptophan-NAD confusables.

core: NAD and adenine nucleotide energy metabolism
qualifier: mitochondrial nucleotide translocation and creatine buffering
name: NAD salvage, adenine nucleotide translocation and creatine energy buffering
rationale: Members share pyridine nucleotide salvage, mitochondrial ADP/ATP and NAD transport (including viral-induced permeabilization) and phosphocreatine metabolism, unlike tryptophan-derived NAD and nucleotide interconversion confusables.

qualifier: NAD salvage, phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
name: NAD salvage, phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
rationale: Members concern pyridine nucleotide salvage and transport, creatine/phosphocreatine and mitochondrial adenine nucleotide carriers (targeted in virus-induced apoptosis), unlike confusables on nucleotide interconversion or tryptophan-derived NAD.

core: Post-transcriptional mRNA stability and translation control
qualifier: ADAR editing and PKR/type I interferon restraint
name: mRNA stability control and ADAR editing restraining interferon response
rationale: Members combine 3'-UTR-mediated mRNA stabilization/destabilization and translational silencing with ADAR A-to-I editing, PKR and negative regulation of type I interferon signaling, which the ARE-decay and OAS antiviral confusables lack.

qualifier: ADAR editing and PKR restraint of interferon signaling
name: ADAR editing, PKR and AU-rich mRNA stability control
rationale: Members combine HuR/AUF1 3'-UTR mRNA stability, translational silencing and mRNA localization with ADAR A-to-I editing, PKR signaling and negative regulation of type I interferon, distinguishing it from TTP/KSRP/stress-granule and OAS antiviral confusables.

name: ADAR editing, PKR restraint and ARE-mediated mRNA stability
rationale: Members combine A-to-I editing that dampens PKR/type I interferon signaling with ARE-binding mRNA stability and translational silencing, distinguishing it from other ARE-decay, antiviral OAS and stress-granule confusables.

name: Peroxisomal alpha- and beta-oxidation of fatty acids
rationale: Members are peroxisomal VLCFA/pristanoyl beta-oxidation, phytanate alpha-oxidation and PUFA processing, unlike confusables on mitochondrial short/medium-chain catabolism or VLCFA and ether lipid synthesis.

name: Peroxisomal fatty acid alpha- and beta-oxidation
rationale: Members describe peroxisomal oxidation of very-long-chain, branched and polyunsaturated fatty acids, unlike confusables on fatty acid elongation, plasmalogens or mitochondrial short/medium-chain catabolism.

name: Peroxisomal very-long-chain and branched fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members are peroxisomal beta- and alpha-oxidation of VLCFA, pristanate and phytanate and polyunsaturated fatty acids, unlike mitochondrial short/medium-chain and VLCFA synthesis neighbours.

name: Integrin-dependent leukocyte adhesion and extravasation through endothelium
rationale: Members regulate integrin activation, leukocyte adhesion to vascular endothelium, diapedesis and neutrophil/T cell extravasation, unlike neighbours on endothelial shear stress, PECAM1 and monocyte activation.

qualifier: integrin activation driving neutrophil and T cell diapedesis
name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion and transendothelial extravasation
rationale: Members cover integrin activation and integrin-mediated adhesion, leukocyte adhesion to endothelium and its negative regulation, and neutrophil/T cell extravasation and diapedesis, while confusables centre on PECAM1/shear stress signalling or monocyte activation.

name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion and extravasation across endothelium
rationale: Members describe integrin activation, leukocyte-endothelial adhesion, diapedesis and neutrophil/T cell extravasation, unlike confusables on endothelial shear stress/PECAM1 or monocyte activation.

core: Non-Pol II transcription and rRNA processing
qualifier: Pol I/III elongation, termination and pre-rRNA cleavage
name: RNA polymerase I/III elongation, termination and pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Members are RNA polymerase I and III elongation and termination plus endonucleolytic pre-rRNA cleavages, unlike confusables on Pol I/III initiation, rRNA gene epigenetic control or tRNA/snRNA transcription.

qualifier: Pol I/III elongation, termination and pre-rRNA cleavage
name: RNA polymerase I/III elongation, termination and pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Members concern elongation and termination of RNA polymerase I and III transcription and early pre-rRNA endonucleolytic cleavages, unlike initiation, tRNA/snRNA transcription and rDNA regulation confusables.

qualifier: Pol I and Pol III elongation, termination and pre-rRNA cleavage
name: Pol I/III transcription elongation, termination and pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Members concern RNA polymerase I and III elongation and termination plus pre-rRNA spacer cleavages, while confusables centre on Pol I/III initiation and nucleolar rRNA gene regulation.

name: Lipid second-messenger and PKC signalling from G beta-gamma and BCR
rationale: Members share PLC/PI3K-generated lipid second messengers, calcium and PKC signalling downstream of G beta-gamma, lysophospholipid receptors, VEGFR2 and the B cell receptor, unlike confusables limited to BCR regulation, Fc-gamma phagocytosis or GPCR calcium signalling.

core: Lipid second messenger signaling through PLC, PI3K and PKC
qualifier: downstream of B cell receptor and G-protein-coupled receptors
name: PLC-PI3K-PKC lipid second messenger signaling from BCR and GPCRs
rationale: Members generate and act on phosphoinositide-derived messengers (PLC, PI3K-gamma, PKC, Ca2+) from BCR, G beta:gamma, S1P/LPA receptors and VEGFR2, distinguishing it from confusables focused on calcium/ionomycin responses, Fc-gamma phagocytosis or BCR regulation by CD22.

qualifier: from G beta-gamma, BCR and lysophospholipid receptors
name: Lipid second-messenger signalling via G beta-gamma, BCR and lysophospholipid receptors
rationale: Members share generation of PLC/PI3K/PKC lipid and calcium second messengers downstream of G beta-gamma, the B cell receptor, S1P/LPA receptors and VEGFR2; Fc-gamma phagocytosis, CD22 BCR regulation and generic calcium confusables lack the G beta-gamma and lysophospholipid receptor members.

name: Chemokine-guided monocyte trafficking via CCR2/CX3CR1 axis
rationale: All members concern chemokine/chemokine-receptor-directed leukocyte (mainly monocyte) chemotaxis and recruitment; the CCR2/CX3CR1 receptor modules and chemokine clusters set it apart from the inflammatory-monocyte-activation, lymphocyte/DC homing and integrin-adhesion confusables.

qualifier: monocyte and macrophage recruitment via CCR2/CX3CR1
name: Chemokine receptor-guided monocyte and macrophage recruitment
rationale: All members concern chemokine–receptor signalling and leukocyte chemotaxis, centred on monocyte/macrophage recruitment and CCR2/CX3CR1 modules, unlike confusables focused on lymphocyte homing, integrins or monocyte inflammatory activation.

name: Chemokine receptor-directed monocyte and macrophage migration
rationale: All members concern chemokines, their receptors or leukocyte chemotaxis/migration, centred on monocyte and macrophage recruitment (CCR2/CX3CR1 modules, monocyte differentiation and aggregation, monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis regulation), which separates it from confusables focused on lymphocyte homing, dendritic/T cell migration, lymphoid organ development or inflammatory monocyte activation.

name: Regulation of JNK and p38 stress-activated kinase cascades
rationale: Members positively and negatively regulate JNK and p38 cascades, including TAK1- and ALPK1-mediated activation; confusables add AP-1 transcription, ERK feedback, TLR-TAK1 activation or NOD signaling.

name: TAK1-driven JNK and p38 stress kinase cascade regulation
rationale: Members regulate JNK and p38 stress-activated cascades including TAK1 and ALPK1 activation, whereas confusables add AP-1 outputs, ERK feedback, or upstream TLR/NOD receptor routes.

core: JNK and p38 stress kinase cascade regulation
name: TAK1-driven JNK and p38 stress kinase cascade regulation
rationale: Members positively and negatively regulate JNK/p38 stress-activated cascades including TAK1 and ALPK1 activation, whereas confusables focus on upstream TLR/NOD receptor routes or AP-1 and ERK feedback.

name: Mitochondrial translation, tRNA aminoacylation and wobble modification
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial translation initiation/elongation/termination, cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging and wobble-base modification; confusables emphasise tRNA processing, mitochondrial transcription or mtDNA maintenance.

name: tRNA aminoacylation, wobble modification and mitochondrial translation
rationale: Members are tRNA charging and wobble-position modification feeding mitochondrial translation initiation to termination, unlike the tRNA processing and mitochondrial transcription confusables.

name: Mitochondrial translation, tRNA aminoacylation and wobble modification
rationale: Members cover mitoribosome initiation-elongation-termination with tRNA charging and wobble-position modification for decoding, versus confusables on mitochondrial transcription, RNA processing and cytosolic tRNA processing.

core: Integrin cell-matrix adhesion and focal adhesion
name: Integrin focal adhesion and spreading with MET-FAK signaling
rationale: Members cover integrin/fibronectin/syndecan matrix adhesion, focal adhesion and stress fiber assembly and adhesion-dependent spreading, and MET-PTK2/tensin coupling is what confusables (ECM, EMT, Rho effectors) lack.

name: Integrin-matrix focal adhesion signaling including MET-FAK coupling
rationale: Members cover integrin, syndecan and fibronectin matrix adhesion, focal adhesion and stress fiber assembly and cell spreading, with MET-PTK2/tensin signaling setting it apart from EMT and ROCK/PAK confusables.

qualifier: focal adhesion assembly and cell spreading
name: Integrin focal adhesion assembly and substrate-dependent cell spreading
rationale: Members cover integrin/syndecan/fibronectin adhesion, focal adhesion and stress fibre assembly with MET-FAK/tensin signaling and cell spreading, distinct from ECM-composition and Rho-effector neighbours.

core: Cell adhesion to collagen and laminin matrix
name: Integrin and VWF adhesion to collagen and laminin matrix
rationale: Members combine integrin, laminin and collagen-receptor interactions, collagen trimerization/anchoring fibrils and VWF-collagen-GPIb variants, while confusables are hemidesmosome assembly, collagen crosslinking or platelet activation.

name: Collagen, laminin and integrin adhesion with VWF variants
rationale: Members are integrin, laminin and collagen interactions and basement membrane organization plus VWF variants affecting collagen/GPIb binding, distinct from platelet signaling, hemidesmosome and collagen crosslinking confusables.

name: Collagen, laminin and integrin interactions including VWF-collagen binding
rationale: Members concern basement membrane collagen and laminin assembly and integrin binding plus VWF variant binding to collagen and GPIb, unlike confusables on hemidesmosomes, collagen crosslinking or platelet activation.

name: Purinergic ATP and adenosine signalling with calcium mobilization
rationale: Members cover ATP export and hydrolysis, P2Y and P1 receptors, and the downstream rise in cytosolic calcium and CAMKK-AMPK, unlike confusables on other lipid/amine GPCRs or K-ATP channels.

qualifier: extracellular ATP turnover and cytosolic calcium elevation
name: Purinergic ATP/adenosine signaling and cytosolic calcium elevation
rationale: Members cover P2Y and P1 receptors, ATP export and NTPDase hydrolysis and the resulting calcium rise and CAMKK-AMPK signalling; confusables are KATP channels, other lipid/histamine GPCRs or PLC-coupled signalling.

qualifier: extracellular ATP release and hydrolysis with calcium elevation
name: Extracellular ATP/adenosine purinergic signalling and calcium elevation
rationale: Members cover ATP export, NTPDase hydrolysis, P2Y and adenosine receptor signalling and resulting cytosolic calcium rise, unlike confusables on lipid/histamine/prostanoid GPCRs or KATP channels.

qualifier: cullin neddylation, COP9 deneddylation and RHOBTB adaptors
name: Cullin neddylation and regulation of protein stability
rationale: Members combine neddylation/COP9-signalosome deneddylation, RHOBTB cullin-adaptor GTPase cycles and positive regulation of proteasomal degradation/stability, unlike confusables about PD-L1 degradation, chaperonin folding or deubiquitinases.

core: Regulation of protein stability and proteasomal degradation
name: Cullin neddylation, COP9 signalosome and protein stability control
rationale: Members concern neddylation/deneddylation of cullin-RING ligases, their CUL3 adaptors (RHOBTB) and substrates, and regulation of protein stabilization/destabilization; neighbours instead concern chaperonin folding, PD-L1 degradation or deubiquitinases.

qualifier: cullin neddylation and COP9 signalosome deneddylation
name: Cullin neddylation, deneddylation and protein stability regulation
rationale: Members concern neddylation/deneddylation of cullin ligases (COP9 signalosome, CUL1/CUL3-RHOBTB adaptors) and protein (de)stabilization, distinguishing it from deubiquitinase, PD-L1 degradation and chaperone-folding confusables.

name: Endosomal neurotransmitter receptor trafficking in postsynaptic plasticity
rationale: Members concern endosomal recycling and internalization of postsynaptic (AMPA) receptors, postsynaptic calcium and actin, LTD and short-term memory, unlike presynaptic vesicle-cycle, BDNF/TRK or receptor clustering confusables.

qualifier: endosomal trafficking and internalization of glutamate receptors
name: Endosomal glutamate receptor trafficking in postsynaptic plasticity
rationale: Members concern endosomal recycling and internalization of postsynaptic (AMPA) receptors, LTD, synaptic plasticity and short-term memory. The confusables instead cover presynaptic active zone, receptor clustering or BDNF signalling.

qualifier: endosomal AMPA receptor recycling in synaptic plasticity
name: Postsynaptic receptor endosomal trafficking in synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members cover neurotransmitter/AMPA receptor internalisation, endosomal recycling, postsynaptic calcium and actin, LTD and memory, distinguishing it from presynaptic, BDNF and receptor-clustering confusables.

name: Organic cation, polyamine and xenobiotic membrane transport
rationale: Members concern SLC-mediated transport of organic cations, polyamines (putrescine, spermidine) and xenobiotics including blood-brain barrier export, whereas confusables emphasise SLCO organic anion/drug ADME, bilirubin or dicarboxylate transport.

name: Organic cation, polyamine and xenobiotic membrane transport
rationale: Members cover SLC transport of organic cations and anions, polyamines and xenobiotics including blood-brain barrier export, whereas confusables centre on SLCO anion transport, drug ADME and bilirubin handling.

core: Organic ion and xenobiotic membrane transport
name: Organic cation, polyamine and xenobiotic membrane transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated organic cation, polyamine and xenobiotic transport, whereas confusables emphasise organic anion SLCO/SLC22 transport, drug ADME and bilirubin handling.

name: AKT-FOXO and p53 regulation of glycolytic and metabolic genes
rationale: Members are AKT-mediated FOXO control, p53 and mTORC1 metabolic programmes and regulation of glycolysis/pentose-phosphate flux, unlike the NFE2L2 and fructose-bisphosphate confusables.

name: AKT-FOXO, p53 and mTORC1 control of glycolytic metabolism
rationale: Members link AKT-regulated FOXO, p53 metabolic targets and mTORC1 to regulation of glycolysis, pentose phosphate shunt and nucleotide catabolism; confusables are fermentation/fructose bisphosphate or NFE2L2 programmes.

name: AKT-FOXO, p53 and mTORC1 control of glucose metabolism
rationale: Members combine AKT regulation of FOXO localization and activity, p53 metabolic targets and mTORC1 with regulation of glycolysis and the pentose phosphate shunt, whereas confusables centre on NRF2 targets or fructose bisphosphate/fermentation.

core: Neural progenitor proliferation and neuronal differentiation
name: Neural progenitor proliferation with sympathoadrenal neuron development
rationale: Members regulate neuroblast/neural stem cell proliferation and asymmetric division plus noradrenergic, sympathetic ganglion and adrenal development, which the midbrain, cerebellar and glial neighbours lack.

core: Neural progenitor proliferation and neuronal differentiation
name: Neuroblast proliferation and sympathoadrenal neuron development
rationale: Members regulate neuroblast and forebrain progenitor division and neuronal differentiation, and the noradrenergic, sympathetic ganglion and adrenal members distinguish it from midbrain, glial and forebrain patterning neighbours.

core: neural progenitor division and neuronal fate acquisition
name: Neuroblast asymmetric division and catecholaminergic neuron differentiation
rationale: All members couple neuroblast/neural stem cell division and asymmetric division to neuronal differentiation, and the theme's own noradrenergic, sympathetic ganglion, adrenal and dopaminergic members make the fate catecholaminergic, unlike the confusables' glial, forebrain-patterning and midbrain-only content.

core: Cytokine control of NK and NKT cells
qualifier: IL-15, IL-21 and type I/III interferons
name: NK and NKT cell regulation by IL-15, IL-21 and interferons
rationale: Members are IL-15/IL-21 signaling, type I and III interferon responses and regulation of NK/NKT proliferation, differentiation and activation, distinguishing the theme from confusables built on IL-10, IL-12/23/27 and IL-20 family signaling.

core: Cytokine control of NK and NKT cells
qualifier: IL-15, IL-21 and type I/III interferon
name: IL-15/IL-21 and interferon signaling in NK and NKT cells
rationale: Members are IL-15, IL-21 and type I/III interferon responses plus NK and NKT cell proliferation, differentiation and activation; confusables instead carry IL-10/IL-12/IL-23/IL-27 family signaling and wound-related IL-20/IFN-lambda production.

name: IL-15/IL-21 and interferon signaling in NK and NKT cells
rationale: Members are IL-15/IL-21 and type I/III interferon responses plus NK and NKT cell differentiation, proliferation and activation, which distinguishes the theme from the IL-10/IL-12/IL-23/IL-27 and IL-20/type III interferon production confusables.

qualifier: type III and alpha interferon with chemokine induction
name: Interferon-lambda and -alpha responses with antiviral chemokine induction
rationale: Members cover type III interferon production and response, IFN-alpha response and CCL5/CXCL10 chemokine induction, distinct from confusables dominated by RIG-I/TLR sensing, ISG15 or GBP host defence.

core: Interferon-alpha and type III interferon response
name: Type III and alpha interferon response with chemokine induction
rationale: Members cover cellular responses to IFN-alpha and type III interferon, type III IFN production, OAS effectors and cytosolic DNA/virus sensing, together with IP-10, CCL5 and STAT6 chemokine induction; the broad antiviral confusables centre on RLR/TLR sensing and type I IFN or viral restriction and lack the type III IFN and chemokine members.

qualifier: type III interferon and chemokine induction
name: Type III and alpha interferon responses with chemokine induction
rationale: Members cover IFN-alpha and type III interferon production and response, OAS and cytosolic DNA sensing with CCL5, IP-10 and STAT6 chemokine induction, which distinguishes it from broader type I IFN, GBP and T-cell confusables.

name: CXCR4 and S1P receptor-guided lymphocyte migration
rationale: Members cover CXCL12-CXCR4 and S1P receptor signalling with Rac driving B/T cell chemotaxis and lymph node/marginal zone development; confusables centre on chemokine/dendritic cell trafficking, lymphocyte homing adhesion or GALT.

qualifier: CXCR4 and S1P receptor-driven, lymphoid organ context
name: CXCR4 and S1P receptor lymphocyte chemotaxis in lymphoid organs
rationale: Members involve CXCL12/CXCR4 and S1P receptor signaling, Rac activation and T/B cell chemotaxis with lymph node and marginal zone B cell development, while confusables emphasise mucosal lymphoid tissue, dendritic/myeloid chemokine responses or Cdc42/PLC signaling.

name: CXCR4 and S1P receptor-driven lymphocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members drive T, B and mast cell chemotaxis and lymphoid positioning via CXCL12-CXCR4, S1P receptors and Rac, distinguishing it from homing and chemokine/dendritic cell neighbours.

name: K+ channel-mediated restraint of neuronal action potentials
rationale: Members regulate resting/presynaptic membrane potential, hyperpolarization and suppression of depolarization and action potentials via K+ channels, unlike confusables on other K2P/KATP channels, pacemaker HCN currents or Na+/K+ ATPase gradients.

name: Neuronal action potential dampening by potassium-channel hyperpolarization
rationale: Members control resting potential, hyperpolarization and suppression of action potentials and depolarization via TRESK and Ca2+-activated K+ channels, distinct from pacemaker HCN, other K2P/KATP channel and ion-pump confusables.

qualifier: potassium channel dampening of action potentials and depolarization
name: Neuronal action potential and membrane potential dampening
rationale: Members regulate resting, presynaptic and action potentials with an inhibitory bias (TRESK, Ca2+-activated K+ channels, negative regulation of depolarization), distinguishing it from cardiac pacemaker, Na+/K+-ATPase and K2P channel confusables.

name: PTEN post-translational control and AKT signaling
rationale: Members concern AKT activation and targets, phosphoinositide synthesis and PTEN stability/localization, distinguishing it from confusables on PTEN translational (ceRNA) control, PAK-2p34 and inositol pyrophosphates.

qualifier: PTEN stability and localization, AKT targets
name: PTEN stability, localization and AKT kinase signaling
rationale: Members concern control of PTEN and phosphoinositides and downstream AKT/TORC2 kinase signaling, unlike confusables with PTEN loss, ceRNA translation control, PAK-2p34 or inositol pyrophosphates.

name: PTEN-AKT signalling and nuclear phosphoinositide regulation
rationale: Members cover PTEN localization/stability, AKT activation and targets, TORC2 and nuclear PIP synthesis with PI5P, while confusables focus on PTEN loss via ceRNAs, PAK-2p34 or inositol pyrophosphates.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling and TGFBR/SMAD2/3 cancer mutants
rationale: Members combine Hippo/YAP-TAZ growth control with TGF-beta receptor and SMAD2/3 cancer mutants, the latter absent from the Hippo-only confusables and differing from the SMAD4/TGFBR mutant set of C4.

qualifier: with TGF-beta receptor and SMAD2/3 cancer mutants
name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling and TGF-beta receptor-SMAD2/3 cancer mutants
rationale: Members combine Hippo/YAP-TAZ growth control (cell density, YAP transcription) with oncogenic TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3 mutants; Hippo distinguishes it from the TGFBR/SMAD4 mutant confusable and the SMAD2/3 mutants from the others.

core: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling and cell density sensing
qualifier: with TGF-beta receptor and SMAD2/3 cancer mutants
name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling and TGF-beta receptor-SMAD2/3 cancer mutants
rationale: Members combine Hippo pathway regulation, contact-density sensing and YAP/TAZ transcription with cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3, distinguishing it from confusables on RUNX3 targets, SMAD4/TCF7L2 mutants, TFAP2 or anoikis.

name: Protein lysine/arginine methylation and lysine/proline hydroxylation
rationale: All members concern methylation or hydroxylation of protein amino acid residues, distinguishing it from acetylation, histone-chromatin methylation and translation-factor modification confusables.

name: Peptidyl lysine/arginine methylation and lysine/proline hydroxylation
rationale: All members concern methylation of lysine and arginine and hydroxylation of lysine and proline on proteins such as TP53, distinguishing it from acetylation, histone methylation and hypusine/diphthamide confusables.

name: Protein lysine/arginine methylation and lysine/proline hydroxylation
rationale: All members are peptidyl methylation or hydroxylation, distinguishing it from hypusine/diphthamide, histone methylation and acetylation confusables.

name: Keratinocyte migration and epidermal wound re-epithelialization
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte/epithelial migration, focal adhesion and junction turnover and epidermal spreading in wound healing, unlike confusables on wound inflammation, epithelial proliferation or Rho/Rac adhesion restraint.

core: Epithelial cell migration in wound healing
name: Growth factor-driven epithelial migration in wound re-epithelialization
rationale: Members regulate epithelial and keratinocyte migration and wound spreading with EGF/VEGFR2 signalling and junction, focal adhesion and matrix turnover, unlike confusables on wound proliferation and inflammation or Rho/Rac-mediated suppression of spreading.

name: Growth factor-regulated epithelial migration and wound spreading
rationale: Members regulate epithelial and keratinocyte migration and wound-edge spreading together with EGF/VEGFR2 responses, focal adhesion, junction and matrix disassembly, unlike confusables on negative Rho/Rac-integrin adhesion signalling or wound epithelial proliferation and inflammation.

name: Macrophage NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and anti-inflammatory signaling
rationale: Members concern NADPH oxidase superoxide generation in macrophages with CD163 and FCGR3A-IL10 anti-inflammatory and pathogen-damping responses; confusables centre on neutrophil killing or hydrogen peroxide handling.

qualifier: with macrophage anti-inflammatory and pathogen-response signaling
name: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase burst and macrophage anti-inflammatory signaling
rationale: Members combine respiratory burst and superoxide regulation via NADPH oxidase with tissue macrophage programmes (CD163, FCGR3A-driven IL-10) and phagocyte responses to anthrax toxin and Leishmania; the macrophage anti-inflammatory and pathogen terms distinguish it from neutrophil killing and hydrogen peroxide/ROS confusables.

name: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and macrophage pathogen responses
rationale: Members centre on NADPH oxidase superoxide generation and respiratory burst in phagocytes plus macrophage responses to pathogens and anti-inflammatory CD163/FCGR3A signalling, which the ROS and neutrophil-killing neighbours lack.

qualifier: germinal center, Tfh help and isotype switching
name: Germinal center B cell maturation, isotype switching and plasma cells
rationale: Members cover germinal center and Tfh differentiation, IgA/IgG class switching, plasma cell differentiation and B/plasma cell immunoglobulin modules, unlike BCR signaling and B/T development neighbours.

qualifier: isotype switching and plasma cell differentiation
name: Germinal center isotype switching and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover germinal centre B and Tfh differentiation, IgG/IgA class switching and plasma cell/immunoglobulin signatures, distinguishing it from BCR signalling and B cell development confusables.

qualifier: germinal center, isotype switching and plasma cells
name: Germinal center isotype switching and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover Tfh and germinal center B cell differentiation, IgG/IgA class switching, plasma cell differentiation and B/plasma cell immunoglobulin modules; confusables cover BCR signalling, B cell development and T cell activation.

qualifier: via G beta-gamma to PI3Kgamma and PLC beta
name: Lipid-mediator GPCR signalling via G beta-gamma effectors
rationale: Members are prostanoid, leukotriene and sphingosine-1-phosphate receptor signalling with G beta-gamma activation of PI3Kgamma and PLC beta, which the histamine, leukotriene-synthesis and calcium-signalling confusables lack.

qualifier: eicosanoid and S1P receptors via G-beta-gamma effectors
name: Eicosanoid and sphingosine-1-phosphate GPCR signaling via G-beta-gamma
rationale: Members are leukotriene, prostanoid and S1P receptor signaling plus G-beta-gamma coupling to PI3K-gamma and PLC-beta, whereas neighbours concern leukotriene synthesis, histamine receptors or generic PLC calcium signaling.

core: Lipid mediator G protein-coupled receptor signalling
name: Lipid mediator GPCR signalling through G beta-gamma effectors
rationale: Members are leukotriene, prostanoid and sphingosine-1-phosphate GPCR signalling plus G beta-gamma signalling via PLC beta and PI3K gamma, which the leukotriene-synthesis, histamine and calcium neighbours lack.

qualifier: aldosterone and cortisol production in blood pressure control
name: Aldosterone and cortisol synthesis regulation in blood pressure control
rationale: Members concern regulation of mineralocorticoid/glucocorticoid biosynthesis, aldosterone secretion and response, and renin-angiotensin blood pressure control; hormone-synthesis regulation separates it from renal sodium-handling confusables, and the blood-pressure context from steroidogenic-enzyme defect confusables.

name: Aldosterone and cortisol synthesis control and blood pressure response
rationale: Members concern regulation of aldosterone/cortisol biosynthesis and aldosterone responses raising blood pressure, as opposed to steroidogenic enzyme defects, renin-angiotensin or renal sodium neighbours.

name: Regulation of aldosterone and cortisol synthesis and blood pressure
rationale: Members regulate mineralocorticoid and glucocorticoid biosynthesis, aldosterone secretion and response, and systemic arterial pressure; confusables carry renal sodium handling, CYP enzyme defects or renin-angiotensin signaling.

core: Nephric duct and ureteric bud formation
name: Intermediate mesoderm to nephric duct and ureteric bud formation
rationale: Members cover intermediate mesoderm, nephric/mesonephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching, with intermediate mesoderm and organ induction absent from all confusables.

qualifier: intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and ureteric bud formation
name: Intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct and ureteric bud formation
rationale: All members describe the early urogenital lineage from intermediate mesoderm through nephric/mesonephric duct to ureteric bud induction and branching, distinguishing it from confusables on bud elongation, renal vesicle and nephron progenitor proliferation.

core: Ureteric bud and nephric duct development
name: Nephric duct and ureteric bud formation from intermediate mesoderm
rationale: Members trace intermediate mesoderm, nephric/mesonephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching, distinguishing from confusables on ureteric bud elongation, renal vesicles or metanephric mesenchyme proliferation.

qualifier: MYC-driven Pol I/III transcription, rRNA, snRNA and splicing
name: MYC-driven nuclear RNA synthesis, processing and ribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members cover Pol I/III and snRNA transcription, rRNA/tRNA/snRNA processing and modification, splicing, 3'-end processing and MYC targets; confusables are Pol II initiation/HIV elongation, telomerase, or mRNA export/decay/translation.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I/III transcription and splicing
name: Nuclear RNA polymerase I/III transcription, RNA processing and splicing
rationale: Members span Pol I/III transcription, rRNA/snRNA/tRNA processing and modification, spliceosome and 3'-end processing with MYC growth targets; this separates it from confusables on telomerase (C1), Pol II initiation/HIV (C2) and mRNA export/translation quality control (C4).

qualifier: Pol I/III transcription with rRNA, snRNA and splicing
name: Nuclear RNA synthesis and maturation, including Pol I/III transcription
rationale: Members span Pol I/II/III transcription, rRNA/snRNA/tRNA processing, splicing and nuclear RNA decay with MYC targets; the Pol I/III and rRNA terms separate it from mRNA export/NMD, Pol II initiation and telomerase confusables.

name: Cilium assembly, transport and motility with centrosome organization
rationale: Members span ciliogenesis, intraflagellar transport, axonemal motility (sperm, airway, ependyma, photoreceptor) and centrosome/microtubule organization, whereas confusables are mitotic spindle, cytokinesis or Hedgehog/PCP signaling.

name: Cilium assembly, motility and centrosome–microtubule organization
rationale: Members span ciliogenesis, intraflagellar transport, axoneme/sperm flagellum and photoreceptor outer segment, centriole and microtubule organization, whereas confusables are mitotic spindle/cell-cycle or Hedgehog/planar-polarity programmes.

name: Cilium assembly, centrosome and microtubule cytoskeleton organization
rationale: Members concern ciliogenesis, intraflagellar transport, axonemes, centrosome/centriole and microtubule organization including sperm flagella and photoreceptor cilia, unlike confusables about mitotic division machinery or Hedgehog/planar polarity.

qualifier: transition metal transport, detoxification and heme synthesis
name: Transition metal ion and heme homeostasis and detoxification
rationale: Members cover iron, zinc, copper, manganese and toxic metal transport, sensing and metallothionein detoxification together with heme synthesis/scavenging, oxygen transport and linked antioxidant (ascorbate, peroxide) processes, unlike confusables on erythrocyte gas/ammonium transport, NADPH redox or oxidative phosphorylation.

qualifier: iron, zinc, copper transport and metal detoxification
name: Iron, zinc, copper and heme homeostasis and detoxification
rationale: Members concern uptake, storage, sensing and detoxification of transition metals and heme synthesis and scavenging, setting them apart from erythrocyte gas exchange, NADPH redox and mitochondrial respiration in confusables.

name: Transition metal ion homeostasis, heme biosynthesis and detoxification
rationale: Members handle iron, zinc, copper, manganese and cadmium transport, metallothionein detoxification and heme synthesis/scavenging, distinct from ROS/NADPH redox, oxidative phosphorylation and erythrocyte gas/ammonium transport confusables.

qualifier: ER/mitochondrial UPR, heat shock and CCT/TriC chaperonin folding
name: UPR, heat shock response and chaperonin-mediated protein folding
rationale: Members span ER and mitochondrial UPR, eIF2 kinase stress signalling, HSF1 heat shock and CCT/TriC-prefoldin folding, distinct from FOXO, ER translocation/ERAD and stress-granule confusables.

qualifier: chaperone/CCT folding with UPR, heat shock and integrated stress response
name: Chaperone folding and unfolded-protein, heat-shock, integrated stress responses
rationale: Members span ATF6/IRE1/PERK UPR, HSF1 heat shock, GCN2/HRI translational stress, mitochondrial UPR and chaperonin folding, whereas confusables emphasize ER targeting/ERAD, FOXO death signaling or stress granules.

qualifier: chaperonin folding, HSF1 heat shock and ER/mitochondrial unfolded protein responses
name: Chaperone protein folding and heat shock/unfolded protein responses
rationale: Members span chaperone/CCT-TriC folding, HSF1 heat shock response, ER and mitochondrial UPR and eIF2-kinase translational stress control, distinguishing the theme from stress granule, ER targeting/ERAD, nitrosative stress and FOXO confusables.

qualifier: dietary hexose absorption, galactose, fructose and pentose
name: Dietary hexose absorption and galactose, fructose and pentose metabolism
rationale: Members cover intestinal sugar digestion and hexose transport plus Leloir galactose, fructose, pentose phosphate non-oxidative and glucuronate-xylulose metabolism, unlike glycogen, glycolysis and gluconeogenesis neighbours.

qualifier: intestinal hexose absorption, fructose, galactose and pentose
name: Dietary sugar absorption and fructose, galactose, pentose metabolism
rationale: Members cover intestinal digestion and absorption of hexoses, fructose and galactose (Leloir) catabolism, non-oxidative pentose phosphate and glycerol/glucuronate metabolism with their inherited defects, unlike the glycolysis and glycogen confusables.

qualifier: fructose, galactose, pentose and intestinal hexose absorption
name: Fructose, galactose and pentose metabolism with intestinal hexose absorption
rationale: Members cover fructose, galactose (Leloir), pentose/xylulose and non-oxidative PPP metabolism plus dietary carbohydrate digestion and hexose transport, distinguishing it from glycolysis, gluconeogenesis and glycogen confusables.

qualifier: keratinocyte cornification plus MITF-driven melanocyte pigmentation
name: Epidermal keratinocyte cornification and MITF-driven melanocyte pigmentation
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte differentiation, cornified envelope, skin barrier and hair follicle together with MITF-M, melanin and melanocyte programmes; confusables have only pigment granules, ectodermal appendages, or intestinal epithelium.

qualifier: keratinocyte cornification plus melanocyte MITF-driven pigmentation
name: Keratinocyte cornification and melanocyte MITF-driven pigmentation
rationale: Members span keratinocyte differentiation, cornified envelope and skin barrier formation together with MITF-M-regulated melanocyte and melanin programmes; the MITF/melanin arm distinguishes it from the ectodermal appendage confusables and the keratinocyte arm from the pigment granule confusable.

qualifier: keratinocyte cornification and melanocyte MITF pigmentation
name: Skin epidermis: keratinocyte cornification and melanocyte pigmentation
rationale: Members span keratinocyte differentiation/cornified envelope and skin barrier plus MITF-M-driven melanocyte pigmentation, combining what the hair/appendage and melanosome-only neighbours each have alone.

qualifier: neural plate and tube regionalization with somite segmentation
name: Embryonic axial patterning of neural tube and somites
rationale: Members are anteroposterior and dorsoventral patterning of the neural plate, tube and spinal cord together with somitogenesis, axial mesoderm and notochord formation and the neural crest and boundary decisions along that axis, whereas confusables are HOX cluster activation itself or craniofacial, limb and organ morphogenesis.

core: axial patterning of the early embryo
qualifier: neural plate and neural tube regionalization with somite and axial mesoderm specification
name: Neural plate, neural tube and somite axial patterning
rationale: Every member patterns the embryonic axis itself - forming and regionalizing the neural plate and tube, specifying its neurons and midline, and segmenting the paraxial and axial mesoderm - whereas the confusables are Hox-cluster limb and digit morphogenesis or craniofacial and pharyngeal organ development.

core: anteroposterior and dorsoventral patterning of the embryonic trunk axis
qualifier: neural plate and neural tube regionalisation with somitogenesis and axial mesoderm, not limb Hox or craniofacial programmes
name: Trunk axis patterning of neural tube, somites and axial mesoderm
rationale: All members specify position and fate along the elongating embryonic body axis - neural plate formation and regionalisation, neural tube dorsoventral patterning, somite segmentation and axial mesoderm - whereas the confusables add Hox cluster activation with limb and digit morphogenesis, or TFAP2-driven craniofacial, placodal and organ primordium development.

core: MHC class I and II antigen processing and presentation
qualifier: proteasome, cross-presentation and HIV immune evasion
name: MHC antigen processing via proteasome, cross-presentation and HIV evasion
rationale: Members are MHC I/II and CD1 antigen processing and presentation, including proteasome function, cross-presentation and HIV Nef/Vpu downregulation, unlike DC-surface signature, NKT and PD-L1 confusables.

qualifier: class I and II, with HIV immune evasion
name: MHC class I/II antigen processing, presentation and HIV evasion
rationale: Members cover proteasomal processing, MHC class I loading, cross-presentation, MHC class II and CD1 presentation plus Nef/Vpu downregulation of CD4/MHC-I, broader than the NKT, DC-signature or PD-L1 confusables.

core: MHC class I and II antigen processing and presentation
