qualifier: proteasomal and endosomal processing, cross-presentation and HIV Nef/Vpu evasion
name: Proteasomal and endosomal antigen processing for MHC presentation
rationale: Members cover proteasome assembly and degradation, peptide loading of MHC class I/II/Ib, cross-presentation and viral downregulation of MHC and co-receptors, distinguishing it from confusables on PD-L1 regulation, immune cell surface signatures and NKT cell activation.

name: Glycan and glycosphingolipid metabolism including lysosomal catabolism
rationale: Members span amino-sugar and sialic acid synthesis, N-glycan processing, ganglioside synthesis and their lysosomal degradation, distinguished from neighbours by the lysosomal catabolic arm rather than nucleotide-sugar transport, GPI synthesis or O-glycan elongation.

qualifier: amino sugar synthesis and lysosomal glycan and glycosphingolipid catabolism
name: Amino sugar, sialic acid and lysosomal glycoconjugate metabolism
rationale: Members span amino sugar/sialic acid and N-glycan precursor metabolism plus glycosphingolipid and lysosomal oligosaccharide catabolism with their disorders, unlike confusables about O-glycans, GPI synthesis or nucleotide-sugar transport.

qualifier: amino sugar, sialic acid and lysosomal glycan catabolism
name: Amino sugar, sialic acid and lysosomal glycoconjugate metabolism
rationale: Members span amino-sugar and sialic acid synthesis, N-glycan and glycosphingolipid processing and their lysosomal catabolism (HEXA/HEXB, NEU1, Salla), while confusables centre on nucleotide-sugar transport, O-glycans, fucose or GPI synthesis.

core: Erythrocyte heme synthesis and gas transport
name: Erythrocyte heme synthesis and gas/ammonium transport
rationale: Members cover heme biosynthesis, iron handling and red-cell O2/CO2/NO transport, plus Rh-glycoprotein ammonium transport, which the iron-scavenging, transferrin and Fe-S cluster confusables lack.

qualifier: red cell gas exchange and Rh ammonium transport
name: Erythroid heme synthesis, gas exchange and Rh ammonium transport
rationale: Members cover heme/porphyrin biosynthesis, iron import and homeostasis, erythrocyte differentiation and red cell O2/CO2/NO transport; the red cell gas exchange and Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium transport members are what the heme-scavenging, iron-sulfur and transferrin confusables lack.

core: Erythroid heme synthesis, iron handling and gas transport
name: Erythrocyte heme synthesis, iron handling and gas transport
rationale: Members cover heme biosynthesis, iron homeostasis and erythrocyte O2/CO2/ammonium (Rh) transport; unlike confusables built on transferrin uptake, heme scavenging or Fe-S/TCA maturation, this theme adds red-cell gas exchange and Rh transport.

core: Plasma lipoprotein assembly, remodeling and clearance
qualifier: intestinal dietary lipid and vitamin E absorption
name: Lipoprotein lifecycle and intestinal dietary lipid absorption
rationale: Members cover chylomicron/VLDL assembly, LDL/HDL remodeling and clearance, intestinal lipid and sterol absorption (ABCG5/8) and vitamin E transport, whereas confusables emphasize cholesterol efflux, LXR/SREBP regulation and foam-cell biology.

core: Plasma lipoprotein assembly, remodeling and clearance
qualifier: intestinal lipid absorption and vitamin E transport
name: Dietary lipid absorption and lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, clearance
rationale: Members cover chylomicron/VLDL assembly, LDL/HDL remodeling and clearance and intestinal lipid and sterol absorption; confusables share lipoprotein biology but carry HDL assembly and cholesterol efflux rather than intestinal absorption and vitamin E transport.

qualifier: dietary lipid and vitamin E intestinal absorption
name: Dietary lipid absorption and lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, clearance
rationale: Members cover intestinal lipid/sterol/vitamin E absorption and the assembly, remodeling and clearance of chylomicrons, VLDL, LDL and HDL, distinguished from confusables centered on cholesterol efflux, HDL biogenesis, LXR regulation and foam cells.

name: Glycogen and glucose metabolism under glucagon control
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis/breakdown and its storage diseases, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis and fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control, plus glucagon-PKA and AMPK-ChREBP regulation, whereas confusables are dominated by fructose, galactose, pentose and hexose-transport metabolism.

name: Glycogen and glucose metabolism under glucagon-PKA control
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis/breakdown and storage diseases, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis via hexose phosphates; confusables share the carbohydrate core but lack the glucagon-PKA, AMPK-ChREBP and lactate/fermentation regulatory members.

qualifier: glucagon-PKA regulation and glycogen storage diseases
name: Glycogen and glucose metabolism with glucagon-PKA regulation
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis/breakdown and its storage diseases, glucose-6-phosphate glycolysis/gluconeogenesis and glucagon-PKA control, distinguishing them from confusables focused on fructose, galactose, pentose and hexose absorption.

core: Hormonal control of glucose and glycogen metabolism
name: Insulin, glucagon and glucose-sensing regulation of glucose metabolism
rationale: Members span insulin receptor/AKT2/GLUT4 signaling, glucagon-PKA, ChREBP glucose sensing and glycogen/gluconeogenesis control, whereas confusables focus on lipogenesis, insulin secretion or glycolytic fructose bisphosphate.

qualifier: insulin/glucagon action on target tissues, not insulin secretion
name: Insulin/glucagon target-tissue regulation of glucose and glycogen metabolism
rationale: Members cover insulin receptor and glucagon/PKA signaling, glucose uptake, glycogen and gluconeogenesis control and glucose-sensing transcription, whereas confusables focus on insulin secretion, lipogenesis or fructose bisphosphate glycolytic control.

name: Insulin, glucagon and glucose-sensing control of fuel metabolism
rationale: Members cover insulin receptor/AKT2/GLUT4 and glucagon/PKA signaling over glycogen, gluconeogenesis and triglyceride breakdown plus ChREBP and carbon-catabolite glucose-responsive transcription, whereas confusables focus on beta-cell insulin secretion, insulin signaling alone, fructose bisphosphate glycolytic control or LXR lipid genes.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar synthesis, Golgi transport and GPI anchors
name: Glycosylation donor supply: nucleotide-sugar synthesis, transport and GPI
rationale: Members synthesize or transport glycosylation donors (UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-glucuronate, GDP-fucose, CMP-sialic acid via SLC35 and related transporters, with their CDG defects) and build GPI anchors, distinct from confusables on dolichol N-glycan assembly, glycosphingolipids and O-glycans.

qualifier: synthesis, Golgi transport and GPI anchoring
name: Nucleotide-sugar donor synthesis, Golgi transport and GPI anchoring
rationale: Members concern synthesis of UDP-GlcNAc, GDP-fucose, CMP-sialic acid and UDP-glucuronate, their transport into the Golgi with transporter defects, and GPI anchor synthesis, separating the theme from N-glycan, glycosphingolipid and lysosomal glycan neighbours that build or degrade the glycans themselves.

qualifier: SLC35 Golgi transport and GPI anchoring
name: Nucleotide sugar synthesis, SLC35 transport and GPI anchoring
rationale: Members synthesise UDP-GlcNAc, GDP-fucose, CMP-sialic acid and UDP-glucuronate, transport them via SLC35-family carriers and build GPI anchors, unlike the N-glycan, dolichol, glycosphingolipid and lysosomal catabolism confusables.

qualifier: IL-12/IL-10-family, IL-17/Th17 and IL-1-family alarmin cytokines
name: IL-12/IL-10-family, Th17 and barrier alarmin cytokine signaling
rationale: Members cover IL-12/23/27/35, IL-10/IL-20 family and type III interferon, IL-17/Th17 and IL-33/IL-36/IL-38 signaling, whereas confusables are built on fungal lectin, Th2/common-gamma-chain or NK-cell cytokine programs.

qualifier: IL-10, IL-12, IL-17 and IL-1 families, Th17 and barrier
name: IL-10, IL-12, IL-17 and IL-1 family cytokine signaling
rationale: Members share signaling and production of IL-10-family (IL-10, IL-20 family, type III interferon), IL-12-family (IL-12/23/27/35), IL-17/Th17 and IL-1-family (IL-33/36/38) cytokines with epithelial wound responses, whereas confusables centre on common-gamma-chain/NK cytokines, Th2/mast cell and IL-6 signaling, or fungal C-type lectin responses.

qualifier: IL-12/IL-23, IL-17, IL-10-family and IL-1-family cytokines
name: IL-12/IL-23, IL-17, IL-10-family and IL-1-family cytokine signaling
rationale: Members are IL-12-family, IL-17/Th17, IL-10-family (IL-10, IL-20, type III interferon) and IL-1-family (IL-33, IL-36, IL-38) signaling with barrier wound-healing roles, unlike confusables on fungal lectin receptors, IL-15/IL-21 NK cytokines or Th2/IL-6 cytokines.

name: Mammary gland and placental trophoblast development
rationale: Members split between mammary lineage, branching and lactation and placental trophoblast, labyrinth and decidual development, together distinguishing it from involution, early embryo and prostate/genital confusables.

name: Placental trophoblast and mammary gland development in pregnancy
rationale: Members cover trophoblast/labyrinth/decidual placentation and mammary lineage, branching, alveolar development and lactation, distinguishing them from prostate/genital and early embryo lineage confusables.

name: Mammary gland and placental trophoblast development
rationale: Members cover mammary lineages, branching and lactation together with trophoblast, labyrinth and decidual development, distinguishing it from early embryo (C2) and prostate (C3, C4) confusables.

name: Lipase-mediated plasma lipoprotein remodeling and clearance
rationale: Members cover LPL/LIPC lipase activation and remodeling and clearance of chylomicrons, VLDL, LDL and HDL with triglyceride catabolism, unlike confusables on intestinal lipid absorption, lipoprotein assembly or negative lipolysis regulation.

name: Plasma lipoprotein remodeling, lipase-driven triglyceride hydrolysis and clearance
rationale: Members describe intravascular remodeling and clearance of chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL particles with LPL/hepatic lipase activation, unlike confusables centred on intestinal absorption, lipoprotein assembly or LXR transcription.

name: Lipase-mediated plasma lipoprotein remodeling and clearance
rationale: Members describe lipase-driven remodeling and receptor clearance of chylomicrons, VLDL, LDL and HDL with associated triglyceride and phospholipid hydrolysis, unlike confusables on intestinal lipid absorption, lipoprotein assembly or LXR-driven lipogenesis.

qualifier: ISG15 conjugation and type I/II interferon signatures, not sensing
name: Interferon-stimulated antiviral effector response and ISG15 conjugation
rationale: Members are IFN-alpha/gamma response signatures, ISG15 and host restriction of viral replication, distinguishing it from RIG-I/IRF3/TLR sensing (C1, C3) and Th1/MHC II IFN-gamma (C2) confusables.

qualifier: ISG effector restriction of the viral life cycle
name: Interferon-stimulated gene effector restriction of viral life cycle
rationale: Members share the interferon-induced antiviral effector program (IFN-alpha/gamma response signatures, ISG15, restriction of viral replication, release and entry), distinguishing it from upstream RIG-I/TLR/IRF3 sensing-induction and IFN-gamma/MHC class II confusables.

qualifier: ISG effectors restricting the viral life cycle
name: Interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors restricting viral life cycle
rationale: Members are type I/II interferon response signatures, ISG15 and host restriction of viral replication, release and transport, whereas confusables emphasise RIG-I/TLR/IRF3 sensing and interferon induction, type III/chemokine output, or IFN-gamma Th1/MHC II.

name: Fatty acid oxidation and oxysterol bile acid synthesis
rationale: Members span alpha-, beta- and omega-oxidation of fatty acids and bile acid synthesis from 24-/27-hydroxycholesterol with linked spastic paraplegia defects, which peroxisome biogenesis and lipid-synthesis confusables lack.

core: Fatty acid oxidation and cholesterol catabolism
qualifier: alpha/beta/omega-oxidation and oxysterol bile acid synthesis
name: Fatty acid alpha/beta/omega-oxidation and oxysterol bile acid synthesis
rationale: Members are peroxisomal/ER oxidation of very-long, branched and medium-chain fatty acids and bile acid synthesis from 24/27-hydroxycholesterol with their inherited defects, which the peroxisome-biogenesis and lipid-synthesis neighbours lack.

qualifier: fatty acid alpha/beta/omega-oxidation and oxysterol bile acid synthesis
name: Peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation and oxysterol bile acid synthesis
rationale: Members cover very-long/branched-chain fatty acid alpha-, beta- and omega-oxidation and 24/27-hydroxycholesterol bile acid synthesis with related disorders, while confusables add peroxisome biogenesis, fatty acid elongation or cholesterol biosynthesis.

core: Sulfur, selenium and methylated amine metabolism
name: Transsulfuration, selenium and choline-carnitine methyl compound metabolism
rationale: Members span sulfur amino acid catabolism, sulfide oxidation, selenium methylation, MAT1A and choline/carnitine/FMO trimethylamine metabolism, unlike glutathione, broad amino acid or phenylalanine/BH4 confusables.

qualifier: transsulfuration with choline, carnitine and FMO oxidation
name: Transsulfuration, selenium methylation and choline-carnitine metabolism
rationale: Members share sulfur/selenium amino acid catabolism and methyl-group-linked choline, carnitine and trimethylamine (FMO3) metabolism, unlike confusables on urea cycle, aromatic amino acids, biotin or glutathione.

qualifier: plus trimethylammonium compounds: choline, carnitine, trimethylamine
name: Sulfur, selenium and trimethylammonium compound metabolism
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration, sulfide and selenium compound metabolism together with choline, carnitine and FMO3-mediated trimethylamine oxidation, which the amino-acid, glutathione and cofactor confusables lack.

name: Iron and heme uptake, transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members centre on transferrin, ferroportin, DMT1, ceruloplasmin and heme scavenging, distinguishing them from copper/manganese, oxygen transport and scavenger receptor confusables.

name: Iron and heme uptake, transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members concern transferrin, ferroportin, DMT1, ceruloplasmin and heme transport and iron homeostasis, unlike copper/manganese, oxygen-transport and scavenger-receptor neighbours.

name: Iron and heme transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members concern cellular iron and heme import, transferrin cycling, ferroportin/ceruloplasmin defects and iron sequestration at host-pathogen interfaces, unlike confusables on oxygen transport, copper/manganese/cadmium handling or scavenger receptors.

qualifier: ubiquitin-dependent degradation of misfolded proteins and ERAD
name: Ubiquitin-proteasome quality control of misfolded proteins and ERAD
rationale: Members cover E3 ligase ubiquitination, N-end rule and proteasomal catabolism, ERAD regulation, protein unfolding and responses to misfolded proteins, unlike confusables on aggrephagy/chaperone-mediated autophagy or deubiquitinase restraint of degradation.

name: Misfolded protein quality control via ubiquitin-proteasome and ERAD
rationale: Members concern recognition and ubiquitin-dependent proteasomal or ER-associated degradation of misfolded proteins (plus reticulophagy), unlike aggrephagy/chaperone-mediated autophagy and deubiquitinase confusables.

name: Misfolded protein quality control via ubiquitin-proteasome and ERAD
rationale: Members address misfolded protein recognition, E3 ligase ubiquitination, N-end rule and ERAD degradation, whereas confusables focus on aggrephagy/chaperone-mediated autophagy or inhibitory deubiquitination.

qualifier: coronavirus targeting of host signalling and PDZ proteins
name: Viral protein maturation and coronavirus host-pathway targeting
rationale: Members are maturation of SARS-CoV, RSV and dengue proteins, virion assembly and SARS-CoV targeting of host signalling/PDZ proteins, while confusables centre on viral attachment and entry.

qualifier: coronavirus targeting of host signalling and junction PDZ proteins
name: Viral protein maturation and coronavirus host-protein targeting
rationale: Members are maturation of SARS-CoV, RSV and dengue proteins, virion component assembly and SARS-CoV targeting of host signalling and PDZ junction proteins, whereas confusables centre on viral attachment, entry and fusion.

name: Viral protein maturation and assembly, coronavirus host targeting
rationale: Members are post-translational maturation of SARS-CoV, RSV and dengue proteins, virion assembly and SARS-CoV targeting of host PDZ/signalling proteins, while confusables are dominated by viral attachment and entry.

name: Neural progenitor proliferation and midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation
rationale: Members regulate neuroblast/progenitor proliferation and neuronal specification in midbrain, forebrain and related tissues; confusables carry cortical migration or sympathoadrenal development.

core: Neural progenitor proliferation and neuron differentiation
name: Neural progenitor expansion and midbrain-forebrain neuron specification
rationale: Members concern neuroblast/neural stem cell division and maintenance and regional differentiation (midbrain dopaminergic, forebrain patterning, cerebellar precursors); this distinguishes it from sympathetic, radial glia, cortical migration and retinal confusables.

name: Neural progenitor proliferation and midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation
rationale: Members are neuroblast/progenitor proliferation and maintenance, forebrain patterning and dopaminergic/photoreceptor differentiation; confusables add cortical neuron migration, radial glia or sympathoadrenal development.

name: Endothelial differentiation and vessel morphogenesis with Tie2 signaling
rationale: All members concern endothelial fate, arterial/venous/lymphatic specification, junctions and vessel maturation, and the Tie2, neuropilin and adherens-junction members distinguish it from the BMP-driven cardiac/pulmonary vascular and VEGFR-only neighbours.

core: Endothelial cell specification and vessel morphogenesis
name: Endothelial cell specification and Tie2-mediated vessel maturation
rationale: All members concern endothelial fate, arterial/venous/lymphatic differentiation and vessel maturation including Tie2, neuropilin and adherens-junction control, which separates it from BMP/Nodal-driven vascular and cardiac confusables and from the VEGFR2-centred confusable.

name: Endothelial specification and vessel maturation with Tie2 signaling
rationale: All members concern endothelial cell differentiation, arterial/venous/lymphatic identity and vessel maturation, and the theme uniquely carries Tie2 and neuropilin signaling and adherens-junction regulation, unlike the BMP/cardiac and VEGFR2-only confusables.

core: Cytosolic RNA sensing to type I interferon
name: RIG-I-like receptor signaling and ISG15 antiviral response
rationale: Members describe RIG-I/MDA5-TRAF-IRF signaling to type I interferon, its viral modulation and ISG15 conjugation, which separates it from DNA-sensing/TLR and interferon-response signature confusables.

name: RIG-I/MDA5 antiviral interferon induction and ISG15 modification
rationale: Members are cytosolic RNA sensing by RIG-I/MDA5 through TRAF3/TRAF6 to IRF/NF-kB, its viral evasion and ISG15 conjugation; ISG15 and RLR signaling distinguish it from IFN-response signatures and broader DNA/TLR sensing confusables.

name: RIG-I/MDA5 antiviral signaling and ISG15 conjugation
rationale: Members are cytosolic RNA sensing via RIG-I/MDA5 to TRAF3/6–IRF/NF-kB and type I interferon, its viral evasion, and ISG15 conjugation, which distinguishes it from DNA-sensing/TLR and interferon-response neighbours.

qualifier: JNK/p38 regulation with AP-1 immediate-early response
name: JNK/p38 stress kinase regulation and AP-1 immediate-early response
rationale: Members regulate TAK1-driven JNK/p38 cascades and AP-1/immediate-early (NR4A, TNF-NF-kB) transcription, separating it from UV/nitric-oxide stress responses, ERK negative feedback and NOD receptor signaling confusables.

qualifier: JNK and p38 with AP-1 induction
name: JNK and p38 stress kinase signalling with AP-1 induction
rationale: Members regulate JNK/p38 stress-activated cascades via TAK1 and the AP-1/immediate-early transcriptional output (TNF-NFkB, NR4A, growth arrest), distinguishing it from NOD1/2 sensing, ERK feedback and UV-response themes.

qualifier: TAK1 activation and AP-1 immediate-early transcription
name: TAK1-driven JNK/p38 stress signalling and AP-1 immediate-early response
rationale: Members cover TAK1/ALPK1-driven JNK and p38 activation and its regulation together with AP-1 and growth-factor/TNF-induced immediate-early gene programmes, unlike confusables centred on NOD receptors, UV response or ERK negative feedback.

name: NRF2 antioxidant and HIF hypoxia transcriptional programs
rationale: Members cover NRF2 (and BACH1) antioxidant gene regulation and HIF oxygen sensing, distinguishing it from p53/mTORC1, FOXO and ferroptosis confusables.

qualifier: NRF2 oxidative-stress plus HIF hypoxia responses
name: NRF2 oxidative-stress and HIF hypoxia transcriptional responses
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 target programmes and regulation plus HIF oxygen sensing, hypoxia and glycolysis; having both NRF2 and HIF arms distinguishes it from HIF/p53/mTORC1, ROS-detoxification/ferroptosis and FOXO confusables.

qualifier: NRF2 oxidative and HIF hypoxic programmes
name: NRF2 and HIF redox and hypoxia transcription
rationale: Members combine NRF2 regulation and target programmes with HIF oxygen sensing, glycolysis and BACH1 control, whereas confusables involve p53/mTORC1 metabolism, FOXO or ROS/ferroptosis.

qualifier: receptor-mediated uptake of LDL, VLDL, HDL and chylomicron remnants
name: Plasma lipoprotein remodelling and receptor-mediated clearance
rationale: Members are remodelling and clearance of circulating lipoprotein particles and the cholesterol import and storage they drive, whereas confusables include lipoprotein assembly, intestinal absorption, lipase complexes and cholesterol efflux.

core: plasma lipoprotein particle remodelling and clearance
qualifier: receptor-mediated uptake and cholesterol import control, not particle assembly or absorption
name: Plasma lipoprotein remodelling and receptor-mediated clearance
rationale: Every member concerns remodelling circulating HDL, LDL, VLDL and chylomicrons and clearing them with the cholesterol import and storage that follows, whereas the confusables add intestinal absorption and particle assembly, lipase assembly or foam cell formation.

core: circulating lipoprotein particle remodelling and receptor-mediated clearance
qualifier: cellular cholesterol uptake and storage responses to those particles
name: Plasma lipoprotein remodeling, clearance and cholesterol uptake
rationale: All members concern the fate of lipoprotein particles already in plasma - their remodelling, clearance and the cholesterol import and storage that follows - unlike confusables centred on chylomicron remodelling and lipase assembly, intestinal absorption and particle assembly with efflux regulation, or foam cell formation from oxidised LDL.

core: Potassium channel control of membrane potential
name: Two-pore and ATP-sensitive potassium channels setting membrane potential
rationale: Members are K2P, KATP (ABCC8/9) and calcium-activated potassium channels regulating resting potential and excitability, distinct from Na+/K+-ATPase and action-potential propagation confusables.

name: Two-pore-domain and ATP-sensitive potassium channels in resting potential
rationale: Members are K2P, KATP and calcium-activated potassium channels governing resting potential and hyperpolarization, distinguished from Na+/K+ pump and action-potential confusables by the channel families.

qualifier: two-pore, ATP-sensitive and Ca2+-activated K+ channels
name: Potassium leak and K-ATP channels setting resting potential
rationale: Members concern K2P, K-ATP and Ca2+-activated potassium channels setting resting potential and hyperpolarization, unlike Na+/K+-ATPase, action-potential or sensory confusables.

name: Golgi sialylated O-, N-glycan and ganglioside biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover mucin-type O-glycan and complex/hybrid N-glycan maturation, sialic acid supply, sialylation and ganglioside synthesis, distinguishing the theme from nucleotide-sugar/fucose and ER N-glycan processing confusables.

name: Glycan elongation and sialylation of glycoproteins and glycosphingolipids
rationale: Members cover complex/hybrid N-glycan and O-GalNAc glycan elongation, sialic acid supply, sialylation and ganglioside synthesis, unlike confusables on early N-glycan processing, nucleotide-sugar synthesis/transport or fucosylation.

qualifier: on O-GalNAc and complex N-glycans and gangliosides
name: Golgi glycan elongation and sialylation on glycoproteins and gangliosides
rationale: Members cover mucin-type O-glycan and complex/hybrid N-glycan elongation, sialic acid metabolism, sialylation and ganglioside synthesis, whereas confusables cover early N-glycan processing, nucleotide-sugar synthesis/transport or fucosylation and blood groups.

qualifier: germ cell, oocyte and somatic cell maturation
name: Germ cell, oocyte and gonadal somatic cell maturation
rationale: Members span germ cell migration and meiotic entry, oocyte and follicle maturation, Sertoli/Leydig development and gonadotropin responses, unlike confusables on hormone secretion, ovulation/luteinization or male sex determination.

core: Gonadal germ cell and somatic cell maturation
name: Gonadotropin-responsive germ cell and gonadal cell maturation
rationale: Members cover FSH/LH responses, follicle growth, oocyte meiotic maturation, germ cell proliferation/migration and Sertoli/Leydig development, distinguishing them from gonadotropin secretion, ovulation/luteinization and sex determination.

name: Gonad and germ cell development with oocyte meiotic maturation
rationale: Members cover germ cell migration and proliferation, follicle and seminiferous tubule development, FSH/LH responses and oocyte meiotic maturation, whereas confusables focus on ovulation/luteinisation, gonadotropin secretion or male sex determination.

qualifier: MHC expression and TLR signaling regulation
name: Interferon-gamma signaling and MHC expression regulation
rationale: IFNG receptor signaling and its regulation, MHC class I/II biosynthesis and antigen presentation distinguish it from neighbours on IL-12-driven Th1 differentiation and dendritic cell cytokine production.

name: Interferon-gamma signaling and regulation of MHC expression
rationale: Members share IFN-gamma receptor signaling and its regulation with MHC class I/II biosynthesis and antigen presentation, distinguishing it from confusables on IL-12-driven Th1 differentiation and dendritic cell cytokine production.

qualifier: IFN-gamma signaling regulation and MHC expression
name: Interferon-gamma signaling and MHC expression regulation
rationale: Members cover IFNG receptor signaling and its positive and negative regulation, MHC class I/II induction, antigen presentation and TLR dampening, whereas confusables emphasize IL-12/JAK-STAT-driven Th1 or NKT differentiation and dendritic cytokine output.

name: Common gamma-chain cytokine signalling in T and NK cells
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15 and IL-21 signalling plus T/NK cell differentiation and proliferation; confusables instead centre on beta-common (IL-3/IL-5), gp130/IL-6 and IL-10/IL-12 family cytokines.

name: Common gamma-chain cytokine signaling in T and NK cells
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15 and IL-21 signaling and their T/NK cell outcomes, distinguishing the theme from confusables dominated by IL-6/gp130, IL-10/IL-12 family and IL-3/IL-5 cytokines.

name: Common gamma-chain cytokine signalling in T and NK cells
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15 and IL-21 signalling and their T/NK differentiation effects, distinguishing it from IL-3/5, IL-6 and IL-10/12 family neighbours.

core: Hematopoietic cytokine receptor signaling to STAT5
qualifier: IL-3/5/7/9 and FLT3 with CBL-mediated attenuation
name: IL-3/5/9 and FLT3 signaling to STAT5 with CBL attenuation
rationale: Members share STAT5/SHC signaling from IL-3, IL-5, IL-7, IL-9, G-CSF and FLT3 receptors and its CBL-dependent negative regulation, separating them from IL-2/IL-7 lymphoid signaling, EPO/TPO cascades and FLT3/FGFR1 fusion oncoproteins.

qualifier: IL-3/5/9 and FLT3 with CBL attenuation
name: IL-3/5/9 and FLT3 receptor signaling to STAT5, CBL-attenuated
rationale: Members are IL-3, IL-5, IL-7, IL-9 and FLT3 receptor signalling to SHC/STAT5 and its CBL-mediated shutoff, distinct from confusables built on IL-2/IL-7 STAT5, erythropoietin/thrombopoietin or FLT3/FGFR1 fusion signalling.

qualifier: IL-3/5/7/9 and FLT3 with CBL attenuation
name: Hematopoietic cytokine (IL-3/5/7/9, FLT3) signaling with CBL attenuation
rationale: Members are STAT5/SHC signaling from IL-3, IL-5, IL-7, IL-9, G-CSF and FLT3 receptors and their CBL/negative regulation, separating it from IL-2-centred, EPO/TPO and fusion-oncoprotein confusables.

core: Osteoclast and macrophage fusion and proliferation
qualifier: M-CSF and DAP12 signaling, bone resorption
name: M-CSF–driven osteoclast and macrophage fusion and bone resorption
rationale: Members combine CSF1 receptor and DAP12 signaling with macrophage/osteoclast fusion, proliferation, osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption, unlike confusables on GM-CSF myeloid/dendritic differentiation or microglia.

qualifier: CSF1 and DAP12 signaling, cell fusion, bone resorption
name: CSF1–DAP12 signaling in osteoclastogenesis and macrophage fusion
rationale: Members center on M-CSF and DAP12 signaling driving macrophage proliferation and fusion, osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption, which microglial and GM-CSF/monocyte confusables lack.

name: M-CSF signaling in osteoclast differentiation and macrophage fusion
rationale: Members span CSF1/M-CSF, DAP12 and interleukin receptor signaling driving osteoclast/macrophage proliferation, fusion and bone resorption; neighbours concern monocyte/dendritic differentiation or microglia rather than osteoclast fusion.

qualifier: structural protein maturation and assembly rather than entry
name: Viral structural protein maturation and virion assembly
rationale: Members are host-mediated maturation of coronavirus, RSV and dengue structural proteins and assembly at budding sites, whereas confusables are dominated by viral attachment and entry.

name: Viral protein maturation and virion assembly, mainly coronavirus
rationale: Members describe post-translational maturation of SARS-CoV, dengue and RSV proteins and assembly at the budding site, whereas confusables centre on virus attachment and entry.

name: Viral structural protein maturation and host pathway targeting
rationale: Members are maturation and assembly of coronavirus, RSV and dengue proteins plus SARS-CoV host signaling targeting, whereas confusables emphasize viral attachment, entry and release.

qualifier: forebrain progenitors and neuron versus glia fate

qualifier: Pol I/III rRNA–tRNA transcription and HIV Tat-mediated Pol II elongation
name: Nuclear RNA polymerase I–III transcription with HIV Tat elongation
rationale: Members cover initiation, elongation and termination by RNA polymerases I, II and III, rDNA chromatin regulation and early rRNA cleavage, plus HIV promoter escape and Tat-dependent elongation; HIV/Pol II terms separate it from translation and splicing confusables and Pol I/III terms from Pol II-only confusables.

qualifier: RIG-I/MDA5 sensing and host restriction of viral life cycle
name: RIG-I/MDA5 type I interferon induction and host viral restriction
rationale: Members span RLR sensing, TBK1/TRAF-IRF3/7 type I IFN induction, ISG15 and host suppression of viral replication and release, which distinguishes it from confusables centred on endosomal TLRs, cGAS/STING, IFN-gamma or chemokine output.

name: Antiviral type I interferon response via RIG-I-like sensing
rationale: Members span virus sensing through RIG-I/MDA5, TRAF3/TBK1-IRF3/7 activation, ISG15 and interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors, distinct from confusables adding endosomal TLR7/8/9, cGAS-STING regulation and IFN-gamma responses.

name: RIG-I-like receptor-driven type I interferon antiviral response
rationale: Members span cytosolic RNA sensing (RIG-I/MDA5), TBK1-IRF3/7 type I IFN induction and ISG/ISG15 restriction of viral replication; confusables add endosomal TLR7/8/9, cGAS-STING, type III or IFN-gamma responses.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase and cytokine receptor signaling
qualifier: ALK, FGFR, PDGFR mutants and erythropoietin-STAT5
name: Oncogenic ALK, FGFR, PDGFR mutants and erythropoietin-STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members share constitutive kinase signalling by oncogenic ALK, FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3 and LTK variants together with EPO/TPO/IL-3 STAT5 signalling, whereas confusables are dominated by FLT3, KIT and ERBB2 drug-resistance mutants.

core: Oncogenic kinase and cytokine receptor signalling
name: Hematopoietic cytokine STAT5 and oncogenic ALK/FGFR/PDGFR signalling
rationale: Members combine EPO, TPO, IL-3, G-CSF and FLT3 STAT5/CBL signalling with oncogenic ALK, FGFR, PDGFR and LTK variants, whereas confusables are dominated by FLT3, KIT and ERBB2 drug-resistance mutants.

core: Oncogenic and hematopoietic tyrosine kinase signaling
qualifier: ALK, FGFR, PDGFR and EPO/TPO STAT5
name: Oncogenic ALK/FGFR/PDGFR kinases and EPO/TPO STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members combine ALK TKI-resistance, FGFR/PDGFR/FLT3 fusion signaling and erythropoietin/thrombopoietin/IL-3 STAT5 cytokine signaling, while confusables add KIT, ERBB2 and FLT3 TKI-resistance sets absent here.

qualifier: receptor signaling, transporter reuptake and drug-reward behavior
name: Dopamine receptor signaling, catecholamine reuptake and drug reward behavior
rationale: Members cover dopamine receptor signaling, DAT/NET-mediated catecholamine uptake and behavioral responses to cocaine, amphetamine, nicotine and ethanol; confusables focus on catecholamine biosynthesis, MAO/COMT degradation or nicotinic receptors.

qualifier: dopamine receptor signaling, transporter reuptake and drug-reward behavior
name: Dopamine receptor signaling, catecholamine reuptake and drug-reward behavior
rationale: Members span dopamine receptor signaling, catecholamine transport/reuptake (SLC6A2/SLC6A3) and behavioral responses to cocaine, amphetamine, ethanol and nicotine; confusables emphasize monoamine degradation, biosynthesis, serotonin or nicotinic receptors.

qualifier: dopamine receptor signaling, catecholamine reuptake and drug-reward behavior
name: Dopamine receptor signaling, catecholamine reuptake and addictive drug responses
rationale: Members cover dopamine receptor signaling, DAT/NET-mediated catecholamine uptake and transport, and behavioral responses to cocaine, amphetamine, nicotine and ethanol; confusables instead centre on catecholamine/serotonin biosynthesis and degradation or nicotinic/alcohol genetics.

name: Adenylate cyclase–cAMP–PKA signalling with adrenergic receptor control
rationale: Members span cAMP synthesis, PDE breakdown, PKA/CREB/DARPP-32 effectors and their regulation, with alpha-2 adrenergic and epinephrine/norepinephrine control setting it apart from purinergic, cholinergic and smooth-muscle confusables.

name: Catecholamine-regulated adenylate cyclase-cAMP-PKA signaling
rationale: All members concern cAMP production, degradation and PKA/CREB/DARPP-32 output, with adrenergic and dopaminergic receptor regulation of the cyclase setting it apart from purinergic/muscarinic, LPA/PLC and smooth-muscle contraction neighbours.

qualifier: adrenergic receptor control and catecholamine secretion
name: Adenylate cyclase-cAMP-PKA signalling with adrenergic receptor control
rationale: Members span cAMP synthesis, breakdown and PKA/CREB/DARPP-32 effectors, with a strong alpha-2 adrenergic and epinephrine/norepinephrine arm that separates it from cholinergic, purinergic, lysophospholipid and smooth-muscle neighbours.

qualifier: terminal fucosylation, sialylation and blood-group antigens
name: N-, O-glycan and glycolipid fucosylation, sialylation and blood-group antigens
rationale: Members cover N- and O-glycan elongation and termination, GDP-fucose and sialylation, ABO/Lewis antigens, glycosphingolipids and selectin-dependent leukocyte rolling, distinguishing it from nucleotide-sugar, GAG/O-mannose and sialic acid metabolism confusables.

qualifier: terminal fucosylation, sialylation and selectin ligands
name: Glycan biosynthesis with terminal fucosylation, sialylation and selectin ligands
rationale: Members span N- and O-GalNAc glycan and glycosphingolipid synthesis with GDP-fucose, sialylation, sulfation and ABO/Lewis antigens that build selectin ligands for leukocyte rolling and stem cell homing, unlike neighbours on nucleotide-sugar synthesis, glycosaminoglycans or O-mannose/O-fucose glycosylation.

qualifier: fucosylation, sialylation and blood group/selectin-ligand glycans
name: Fucosylated and sialylated glycoprotein and glycosphingolipid glycan synthesis
rationale: Members span N- and O-glycan processing, glycosphingolipid and blood group antigen synthesis, GDP-fucose and sialic acid supply and sulfated selectin ligands for leukocyte rolling, whereas confusables cover GAG/O-mannose glycosylation or nucleotide-sugar metabolism.

core: polyamine metabolism and amino acid residue modification
qualifier: protein methylation/hydroxylation and hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine synthesis
name: Polyamine metabolism with protein methylation and hypusine/diphthamide modification
rationale: Members span polyamine synthesis, interconversion and transport together with protein lysine/arginine methylation, hydroxylation and special residue modifications (hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine); the polyamine and methylation arms separate it from translation-factor, methionine salvage and tRNA confusables.

core: Polyamine metabolism and amino acid modification
qualifier: protein methylation, hydroxylation and hypusine/diphthamide formation
name: Polyamine metabolism and protein methylation, hydroxylation, hypusination
rationale: Members combine polyamine synthesis, interconversion and transport with post-translational lysine/arginine methylation, hydroxylation and translation-factor modifications (hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine), distinct from methionine salvage, tRNA aminoacylation and selenocysteine confusables.

core: Polyamine metabolism and specialised residue modification
qualifier: peptidyl methylation, hydroxylation, hypusine and diphthamide
name: Polyamine metabolism and peptidyl methylation, hydroxylation and hypusination
rationale: Members join polyamine synthesis, interconversion and transport with spermidine-derived hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine and protein lysine/arginine methylation and hydroxylation, which confusables split between them or lack.

name: Complement activation, its regulation and hypersensitivity responses
rationale: Members are classical, lectin and alternative complement activation, MAC and opsonization control plus ADCC and hypersensitivity; confusables are Fc receptor/phagocyte signalling or antimicrobial neutrophil defence.

name: Complement activation and regulation in antibody-driven hypersensitivity
rationale: Members are classical, lectin, alternative and terminal complement activation and their regulation plus antibody-dependent cytotoxicity and type II/IV hypersensitivity; the complement core separates it from Fc receptor/myeloid confusables, and the hypersensitivity/ADCC terms from the antimicrobial confusable.

name: Complement activation, regulation and antibody-dependent effector responses
rationale: Members cover classical, lectin and alternative complement activation, the terminal pathway and its regulators plus ADCC and hypersensitivity, distinct from neutrophil, Fc-receptor and antimicrobial-peptide neighbours.

qualifier: glutathione synthesis, NADPH regeneration, aldehyde detoxification
name: Glutathione synthesis, NADPH regeneration and oxidative/aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members cover glutathione synthesis, recycling, transport and inherited defects with ROS, methylglyoxal and aldehyde detoxification and NADPH supply, unlike confusables on alkylation repair, ascorbate/NAD metabolism or transsulfuration.

name: Glutathione-centred redox homeostasis and aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members cover glutathione synthesis, recycling, transport and inherited defects together with ROS and methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and NADPH regeneration, unlike ascorbate/NADP, ferroptosis, transsulfuration or alkylation-repair confusables.

name: Glutathione cycle and glutathione-dependent redox and dicarbonyl detoxification
rationale: Members are glutathione synthesis, recycling, transport and its inherited defects, plus ROS, aldehyde and methylglyoxal detoxification and NADPH regeneration; confusables cover transsulfuration/selenium, ascorbate/NADP, alkylation repair or ferroptosis promotion.

name: HIF, NRF2 and p53 regulation of glycolytic metabolism
rationale: Members combine hypoxia/HIF signalling, NFE2L2 target programmes and p53/mTORC1 metabolic regulation with glycolysis, fructose bisphosphate and pentose-phosphate control, unlike FOXO-centred or ROS/ferroptosis confusables.

qualifier: NRF2 and HIF control of glycolysis and redox
name: NRF2- and HIF-driven glycolytic and redox metabolic reprogramming
rationale: Members are NRF2 target programmes, HIF hypoxia signalling and glycolytic/PPP/NADP regulation (with p53 and mTORC1 metabolic signatures), unlike confusables built on AKT-FOXO signalling or ROS/ferroptosis and NADPH regeneration.

qualifier: NRF2, HIF and p53 regulation of glycolysis
name: NRF2, HIF and p53 control of glycolytic metabolism
rationale: Members are NRF2 target programs, HIF hypoxia signalling, p53/mTORC1 metabolic genes and glycolysis, fructose-2,6-bisphosphate, lactate and NADP+ metabolism, distinguishing it from confusables on ROS/ferroptosis or FOXO signalling.

qualifier: MHC class II and CD1 lipid presentation
name: MHC-II and CD1 antigen presentation by myeloid cells
rationale: Members are MHC class II and CD1 lipid antigen presentation and dendritic cell/monocyte signatures including NKT regulation, unlike the MHC class I cross-presentation confusable.

name: MHC class II and CD1 antigen presentation by myeloid cells
rationale: Members are MHC class II and CD1 lipid presentation, NKT regulation and dendritic cell/monocyte signatures, unlike MHC class I cross-presentation neighbours.

qualifier: MHC class II and CD1 in dendritic cells and monocytes
name: Myeloid MHC class II and CD1 antigen presentation
rationale: Members cover MHC class II and CD1 lipid antigen presentation, NKT cell regulation and dendritic cell/monocyte surface signatures, whereas confusables focus on MHC class I cross-presentation or lymphocyte surface signatures.

qualifier: in antibody diversification and HIV early infection
name: AID/APOBEC deamination in antibody diversification and HIV infection
rationale: Members combine AID-driven somatic hypermutation, class switching and B cell development with APOBEC3G restriction and the HIV early life cycle (entry, reverse transcription, integration), unlike neighbours on HIV late events, ADAR A-to-I editing or retroelement silencing.

core: Cytidine deamination in viral restriction and antibody diversification
name: HIV early replication, APOBEC3G restriction and antibody diversification
rationale: Members combine HIV entry-to-integration steps and APOBEC3G/cytidine deaminase restriction with B cell somatic hypermutation, class switching and V(D)J recombination, the antibody diversification side being absent from all confusables.

name: HIV replication, APOBEC restriction and immunoglobulin diversification
rationale: Members cover HIV entry, reverse transcription and integration, APOBEC3G cytidine deaminase restriction and AID-driven immunoglobulin recombination, hypermutation and class switching; the B cell diversification and APOBEC arms separate it from HCMV/retroelement and ADAR editing confusables.

core: Vascular tone and blood pressure regulation
name: Endothelial nitric oxide-cGMP control of vascular tone
rationale: All members concern eNOS activation, NO/cGMP signaling and its effects on vascular smooth muscle contraction and arterial pressure, unlike confusables built on renin-angiotensin control or generic smooth muscle contraction.

core: Regulation of vascular tone and blood pressure
name: eNOS-nitric oxide-cGMP regulation of vascular tone
rationale: All members concern vascular smooth muscle tone and arterial pressure, and the eNOS activation/trafficking, BH4 and NO-cGMP members distinguish it from the renin-angiotensin and smooth-muscle-contraction confusables.

core: Nitric oxide-cGMP control of vascular tone
name: Endothelial nitric oxide-cGMP control of vascular tone
rationale: Members concern eNOS activation, trafficking and BH4 cofactor supply, NO-cGMP signalling and resulting smooth muscle relaxation and blood pressure control, which the renin-angiotensin and smooth muscle contraction confusables lack.

qualifier: mast cell activation and Fc-gamma phagocytosis
name: Fc receptor signaling in mast cell activation and phagocytosis
rationale: All members concern Fc-epsilon and Fc-gamma receptor signaling and its outcomes (mast cell degranulation, hypersensitivity, ADCC, phagocytic cup formation), unlike confusables on BCR signaling or SIRP/inhibitory immune regulation.

qualifier: mast cell activation and FcgammaR phagocytosis
name: Fc receptor signalling in mast cell activation and phagocytosis
rationale: All members are FcepsilonRI and FcgammaR signalling outputs: mast cell activation/degranulation, hypersensitivity, ADCC and Fc-mediated phagocytosis, distinct from BCR-centred confusables.

qualifier: mast cell activation and Fc-gamma phagocytosis
name: Fc receptor signaling in mast cell activation and phagocytosis
rationale: Members are FcERI and FcgammaR signaling with mast cell degranulation, hypersensitivity and phagocytosis, which the BCR-centered confusables lack.

name: MET/HGF receptor and PTK6 kinase signaling
rationale: Members are MET activation and effectors (including InlB entry, MST1 and receptor recycling) and PTK6 signaling; the confusables are ERBB/EGFR, ALK/LTK and EGFR downregulation themes lacking MET and PTK6.

name: HGF receptor MET and PTK6 kinase signaling
rationale: Members are MET/HGF receptor activation, effectors and recycling plus PTK6 signaling; confusables are ERBB/EGFR, ALK/LTK or generic PI3K/EGFR downregulation.

core: Receptor and non-receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
name: MET/RON and PTK6 tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Members cover HGF receptor MET (activation, effectors, recycling, InlB entry), MSP/RON and PTK6 signaling, distinguishing the theme from ERBB, ALK and EGFR-downregulation neighbours.

qualifier: oxidative phosphorylation control and oxidative-stress-induced apoptosis
name: Mitochondrial respiration control and oxidative-stress-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate respiration, electron transport, ATP synthesis and ROS, and hydrogen peroxide/hypoxia-induced intrinsic apoptosis, unlike confusables on ferroptosis, nitrosative stress or calcium-linked muscle apoptosis.

core: Mitochondrial respiration and oxidative stress cell death
name: Mitochondrial respiration control and oxidative stress-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate electron transport, OXPHOS, ATP synthesis and ROS and the intrinsic apoptosis triggered by peroxide, hypoxia and osmotic stress; confusables centre on ferroptosis, nitrosative stress and ischemia or calcium-linked muscle apoptosis.

qualifier: oxidative and hypoxic stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis
name: Mitochondrial respiration control and oxidative/hypoxic stress-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate oxidative phosphorylation, electron transport, ATP synthesis and ROS together with peroxide/hypoxia-triggered intrinsic apoptosis; the respiration and PGC-1alpha arm separates it from ferroptosis/nitrosative stress and calcium-flux confusables.

name: Thymic T cell development, selection and early T cell activation
rationale: Members cover thymocyte selection, proliferation, apoptosis, migration and lineage (CD8, gamma-delta, Treg) together with T cell activation modules, whereas confusables focus on proximal TCR/CD28 signaling or Tfh and germinal center B cell programmes.

name: Thymocyte selection, T cell differentiation and activation
rationale: Members cover thymocyte proliferation, apoptosis, positive/negative selection, Treg development and T cell activation signatures, unlike confusables on proximal TCR/CD28 signalling or B cell/Tfh differentiation.

name: Thymic T cell development, selection and early activation
rationale: Members cover thymocyte selection, proliferation, survival and migration, lineage differentiation including Tregs, tolerance and T cell activation modules, versus confusables on B cell/Tfh or proximal TCR costimulation signalling.

name: Toll-like receptor IKK/TAK1 and noncanonical NIK NF-kappaB signaling
rationale: Members cover TLR/TRIF-IRAK-TRAF6 activation of TAK1, IKK and TBK1 plus NIK-dependent noncanonical NF-kappaB and IKK deficiencies, while confusables are TNFR1-centred or lymphocyte-receptor NF-kappaB.

name: TLR adaptor and NIK-dependent NF-kappaB activation
rationale: Members are IKK/TAK1 activation downstream of TLR/TRIF/IRAK adaptors plus NIK-driven non-canonical NF-kB and IKK deficiencies, distinct from the TNFR1 and lymphocyte NF-kB confusables.

name: TLR-driven IKK activation and non-canonical NF-kB signaling
rationale: Members cover IRAK/TRIF/TRAF6-mediated TAK1 and IKK activation, TBK1-IRF3/7 and NIK non-canonical NF-kB with IKK deficiencies, distinct from TNFR1, lymphocyte and negative-regulation confusables.

qualifier: adrenergic Gi/z inhibition of adenylate cyclase
name: Adrenergic Gi/z inhibition of cAMP-PKA signalling
rationale: Members are cAMP synthesis, degradation and PKA activation with alpha-2 adrenergic and G alpha z inhibition of adenylate cyclase, unlike Gq-calcium, adenosine and dopamine-stimulatory confusables.

qualifier: alpha-2 and Gz adenylate cyclase inhibition
name: Adrenergic cAMP-PKA signalling with alpha-2 adenylate cyclase inhibition
rationale: Members cover adrenoceptor signalling, cAMP synthesis/degradation and PKA activation with alpha-2/Gz inhibition of adenylate cyclase and catecholamine secretion; confusables are calcium/PLC signalling, adenosine or dopamine-driven cyclase activation.

name: Adrenergic Gi/z-inhibited cAMP synthesis, degradation and PKA activation
rationale: Members cover cAMP synthesis, PDE degradation and PKA activation together with alpha-2 adrenergic and G alpha z inhibition of adenylate cyclase and catecholamine secretion, unlike confusables centred on Gq calcium, dopamine/CREB or adenosine signalling.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I and III mechanics plus snRNA genes
name: Pol I and Pol III transcription of rRNA, tRNA, snRNA
rationale: Members are initiation, elongation and termination by RNA polymerases I and III (rRNA, 5S, tRNA) and Pol II/III snRNA transcription, unlike confusables on rRNA processing, rDNA chromatin regulation or snRNP/histone mRNA processing.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I and III plus snRNA
name: RNA polymerase I, III and snRNA gene transcription
rationale: Members cover initiation, elongation and termination by Pol I and Pol III and snRNA transcription, whereas confusables address rRNA processing, snRNP assembly or rDNA chromatin regulation.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I and III machinery
name: Transcription of rRNA, tRNA and snRNA genes
rationale: Members are initiation, elongation and termination by RNA polymerases I and III plus snRNA transcription, unlike confusables on rRNA processing, rDNA chromatin control and snRNP/histone mRNA processing.

name: MECP2 neuronal transcription and sensory-social behavior
rationale: Members are MECP2 regulation and its Rett-associated loss-of-function events plus behaviors and brain regions it affects (vocalization, touch, prepulse inhibition, social interaction, amygdala/striatum), distinguished from motor/glycinergic neighbours.

name: MECP2 transcriptional regulation and sensorimotor and social behavior
rationale: Members combine MECP2 function and Rett-associated loss-of-function events with sensory, vocal, social and learning behaviours and striatum/amygdala development, distinct from locomotion/glycinergic and neuronal excitability confusables.

name: MECP2 transcriptional regulation and sensorimotor and social behavior
rationale: Members combine MECP2 regulation and Rett-associated loss-of-function events with vocal, social, sensory and sensorimotor-gating behaviours and striatum/amygdala development, unlike confusables centred on locomotion or glycinergic transmission.

qualifier: TLR2/4/5 bacterial ligand sensing via MyD88-IRAK4
name: TLR2/4/5 bacterial ligand sensing and MyD88-dependent inflammation
rationale: Members cover LPS/lipopeptide/LTA detection, TLR2/4 regulation, MyD88/IRAK4 deficiencies and monocyte inflammatory modules, distinct from inflammasome and NOD-receptor confusables.

qualifier: TLR2/4 bacterial lipid sensing in monocytes
name: TLR2/4 bacterial lipid sensing and monocyte inflammatory response
rationale: Members cover LPS/lipopeptide/lipoteichoic acid detection via TLR2/4-MyD88-IRAK4 and monocyte inflammatory modules, versus inflammasome, NOD and phagocyte-regulation confusables.

name: TLR2/4/5 sensing of bacterial lipids and monocyte inflammation
rationale: Members are LPS/lipopeptide/lipoteichoic acid detection, TLR2/4 regulation, MyD88/IRAK4 deficiencies and monocyte inflammatory modules; confusables are inflammasome, NOD or SIRP/phagocytosis sets.

qualifier: Fc and complement receptor regulation, neutrophil degranulation
name: Fc and complement receptor regulation of myeloid inflammatory activation
rationale: Members cover neutrophil/monocyte/macrophage inflammatory activation and degranulation regulated by Fc receptor, complement receptor and SIRP signalling with ADCC and hypersensitivity, unlike confusables centred on formyl peptide chemotaxis, respiratory burst killing, myeloid expression modules or FCGR phagocytosis.

name: Fc and complement receptor-driven myeloid inflammatory activation
rationale: Members cover Fc and complement receptor signaling, ADCC, neutrophil degranulation and macrophage/monocyte inflammatory activation and hypersensitivity, broader than the FCGR phagocytosis neighbour and unlike respiratory burst or formyl peptide chemotaxis neighbours.

name: Fc and complement receptor-driven myeloid inflammatory responses
rationale: Members combine Fc and complement receptor signalling, ADCC, hypersensitivity, neutrophil degranulation and monocyte/macrophage/neutrophil modules, distinguishing it from FcgR phagocytosis (C1), formyl peptide chemotaxis (C2), myeloid marker (C3) and microbial killing (C4) neighbours.

name: Centrosome duplication, microtubule nucleation and spindle orientation
rationale: Members concern centriole duplication, MTOC nucleation/anchoring, astral microtubules and spindle positioning in asymmetric division, distinguishing them from neuroblast division, tubulin modification, ciliogenesis and mitotic centrosome maturation.

name: Centriole duplication, microtubule nucleation and spindle positioning
rationale: Members cover centriole duplication and cohesion, MTOC nucleation/anchoring and astral microtubule-based spindle orientation, separating it from tubulin modification, mitotic centrosome maturation, neural progenitor division and cilia confusables.

name: Centrosome duplication, microtubule nucleation and spindle orientation
rationale: Members cover centriole duplication/cohesion, MTOC nucleation and anchoring, astral microtubules and spindle positioning in asymmetric division, distinct from neuroblast division, mitotic centrosome maturation, tubulin modification and cilia confusables.

name: Protein lipidation and lipidated Wnt/Hedgehog ligand secretion
rationale: Members cover S-palmitoylation, depalmitoylation, prenylation (RAS/RAB) and lipid-dependent Wnt and Hedgehog ligand processing and release, distinguishing it from Hh/Wnt signal reception, delipidation and phospholipid transfer confusables.

qualifier: palmitoylation and prenylation of Wnt, Hedgehog, Ras and Rab
name: Protein palmitoylation and prenylation of morphogens and small GTPases
rationale: Members concern lipid modification and processing of proteins: Wnt/Hedgehog palmitoylation and maturation and Ras/Rab prenylation and processing; confusables concern delipidation/autophagy, ER lipid transfer or downstream Wnt/Hh signaling.

qualifier: palmitoylation and prenylation of Wnt, Hedgehog, Ras and Rab
name: Palmitoylation and prenylation of Wnt, Hedgehog, Ras and Rab
rationale: Members cover S-palmitoylation/depalmitoylation, geranylgeranylation and Hh autoprocessing for Wnt, Hedgehog, Ras and Rab proteins, unlike downstream Hh or Wnt signalling confusables.

name: Atypical ubiquitin chains and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members combine K6/K11/K27/K29, branched and free ubiquitin chain formation and DUBs with misfolded-protein responses, ERAD regulation and degron pathways, whereas confusables lack the atypical chain types or the ERAD/misfolding arm.

name: Ubiquitin-mediated protein quality control with atypical chain linkages
rationale: Members cover misfolded-protein handling, ERAD and degron pathways plus K6/K11/K27/K29 and branched ubiquitination and DUBs, which neighbours lack in favour of proteasome and K48 regulation.

name: Atypical ubiquitin chain linkages and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members cover K6/K11/K27/K29 and branched ubiquitination, degron-rule degradation, deubiquitinases and ERAD/misfolded protein handling; confusables centre on proteasomal degradation regulation, K48 chains and protein destabilisation.

qualifier: collagen and elastic fibre synthesis and degradation
name: Collagen and elastic fibre matrix synthesis and degradation
rationale: All members concern ECM constituents, collagen and elastin biosynthesis, crosslinking, fibre assembly and MMP-mediated degradation; this turnover focus distinguishes it from confusables centred on EMT, integrin adhesion or basement membrane assembly.

core: Extracellular matrix collagen and elastic fiber turnover
name: Extracellular matrix collagen and elastic fiber assembly and degradation
rationale: Members are ECM modules plus collagen/elastin synthesis, crosslinking and MMP-driven degradation; neighbours instead carry integrin adhesion, basement membrane or EMT/TGF-beta content.

qualifier: collagen and elastic fiber synthesis and metalloproteinase degradation
name: Collagen and elastic fiber matrix synthesis and degradation
rationale: Members span collagen and elastin biosynthesis, crosslinking, elastic fiber assembly and MMP-mediated collagen/elastin catabolism; confusables instead center on EMT, basement membrane or integrin-mediated matrix adhesion.

name: Tight-junction barrier permeability and mechanical stress responses
rationale: Members combine tight-junction and endothelial/intestinal barrier permeability control with PIEZO1-mediated shear, pressure and membrane mechanoresponses, which junctional confusables lack, while scrambling and eNOS confusables lack the tight junction members.

core: Barrier permeability and mechanical stress response
qualifier: tight junction regulation and PIEZO1 mechanosensing
name: Tight junction barrier permeability and PIEZO1 mechanical stress response
rationale: Members combine tight-junction control of endothelial, intestinal and blood-brain barrier permeability with PIEZO1 shear and pressure sensing, volume and membrane repair responses, unlike confusables on adherens/desmosomal adhesion, eNOS trafficking or lipid scrambling.

core: Tight junction and endothelial barrier regulation
name: Mechanosensitive regulation of tight junction and endothelial barrier
rationale: Members combine tight junction assembly/disassembly and vascular/intestinal barrier permeability with shear stress, PIEZO1 mechanical load, hydrostatic pressure and membrane repair responses, unlike confusables on eNOS trafficking, apical junction adhesion, scramblases or cadherin adhesion and EMT.

name: Excitatory synaptic transmission via kainate, AMPA and nicotinic receptors
rationale: Members describe activation of kainate, AMPA and nicotinic ionotropic receptors with receptor trapping and presynaptic excitability, distinct from confusables on transmitter secretion and inhibitory synapse assembly.

name: Ionotropic glutamate and nicotinic receptor synaptic signaling
rationale: Members center on AMPA, kainate and nicotinic receptor activation and postsynaptic excitation with related channel modulation, whereas neighbours emphasize presynaptic glutamate release modulation or inhibitory clustering and vesicle exocytosis.

qualifier: AMPA, kainate and nicotinic ionotropic receptor activation
name: AMPA, kainate and nicotinic receptor-mediated excitatory synaptic transmission
rationale: Members describe activation and trapping of AMPA, kainate and nicotinic receptors with presynaptic depolarization in excitatory transmission, unlike confusables on presynaptic release modulation or inhibitory synapse assembly.

name: Base deamination and oxidative demethylation of DNA and RNA
rationale: Members are APOBEC/ADAR deamination editing (including antiviral restriction), TET/TDG demethylation and ALKBH/MGMT direct alkylation reversal, distinguishing it from viral replication, base-excision and broad DNA repair confusables.

core: Direct enzymatic editing of nucleic acid bases
qualifier: deamination, oxidative demethylation and alkylation reversal
name: Nucleobase deamination, oxidative demethylation and alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members share enzymes that chemically rewrite bases in place: ADAR/APOBEC RNA/DNA deamination with antiviral restriction, TET-TDG oxidative demethylation and ALKBH/MGMT alkylation reversal, unlike base excision repair, broad DNA repair or HIV lifecycle neighbours.

qualifier: deamination editing, oxidative demethylation and alkylation reversal
name: Nucleobase deamination editing, demethylation and alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members are ADAR/APOBEC base deamination (including antiviral restriction), TET/TDG 5mC demethylation and ALKBH/MGMT alkylation reversal, which distinguishes it from retroviral life-cycle, excision repair and broad DNA repair confusables.

qualifier: translation, mitoribosome assembly and RNA modification
name: Mitochondrial translation, mitoribosome assembly and mt-RNA modification
rationale: Members are mitochondrial translation steps, mitoribosome assembly and mitochondrial tRNA/rRNA/mRNA modification and processing; confusables emphasise mtRNA decay, mtDNA replication or pseudouridylation.

qualifier: translation, ribosome assembly and RNA modification
name: Mitochondrial translation, ribosome assembly and RNA modification
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial translation initiation to termination, mitoribosome assembly and quality control, and mt tRNA/rRNA/mRNA modification and processing, unlike mt RNA decay, mtDNA replication and pseudouridylation confusables.

name: Mitochondrial translation and ribosome, tRNA and rRNA maturation
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial translation initiation to termination and quality control plus mitoribosome assembly and mitochondrial tRNA/rRNA/mRNA processing and modification, unlike mtDNA replication, mtRNA decay or pseudouridylation confusables.

name: Neutrophil respiratory burst, degranulation and microbial killing
rationale: Members concern neutrophil/monocyte degranulation, ROS and respiratory burst control and killing of bacteria and fungi, while confusables emphasise Fc-receptor regulation, formyl-peptide chemotaxis or monocyte identity signatures.

qualifier: respiratory burst, degranulation and microbe killing
name: Phagocyte respiratory burst, degranulation and microbial killing
rationale: Members share neutrophil/macrophage effector killing via ROS/NADPH oxidase and degranulation against bacteria and fungi, unlike confusables on Fc-receptor/ADCC, formyl peptide chemotaxis or anti-inflammatory signaling.

qualifier: respiratory burst, degranulation and bacterial/fungal killing
name: Phagocyte respiratory burst, degranulation and microbial killing
rationale: Members concern neutrophil/myeloid activation, NADPH-oxidase respiratory burst, degranulation and killing of bacteria and yeast, distinguishing them from anti-inflammatory macrophage, monocyte marker, formyl-peptide chemotaxis and Fc-receptor confusables.

name: Axonal cargo transport with tubulin glutamylation and severing
rationale: Members are kinesin-driven axo-dendritic transport of vesicles, mitochondria and receptors together with tubulin C-terminal polyglutamylation/deglutamylation and microtubule severing, which none of the organelle-transport confusables contain.

name: Neuronal microtubule transport and tubulin polyglutamylation
rationale: Members are kinesin/axonal-dendritic organelle and vesicle transport plus tubulin C-terminal glutamylation and microtubule severing, the latter absent from all transport confusables.

name: Neuronal microtubule cargo transport, tubulin glutamylation and severing
rationale: Members cover kinesin-driven axonal/dendritic transport of vesicles, mitochondria and receptors together with tubulin C-terminal (poly)glutamylation and microtubule severing, the latter being what all confusables lack.

qualifier: PPARG and LXR transcriptional control of triglyceride metabolism
name: White adipogenesis and LXR/PPARG-driven triglyceride homeostasis
rationale: Members are white fat cell differentiation/proliferation and PPARG- and NR1H2/3-regulated triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis, unlike brown/beige thermogenic and PPARA/PGC-1alpha confusables.

qualifier: white fat differentiation and triglyceride control
name: White adipocyte differentiation and triglyceride homeostasis
rationale: Members concern white fat cell differentiation and adipose development (PPARG, LXR targets) together with triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis, distinguishing them from brown/beige thermogenesis, PPARA/PGC-1alpha and SREBP-gluconeogenesis confusables.

core: White adipocyte differentiation and triglyceride homeostasis
name: White adipogenesis and LXR-regulated triglyceride homeostasis
rationale: Members cover white fat cell differentiation, PPARG-driven adipogenesis and LXR (NR1H2/NR1H3) control of triglyceride synthesis, lipolysis and fatty acid homeostasis, unlike confusables on brown/beige thermogenesis, PPARA/PGC-1alpha mitochondrial biogenesis or SREBP and gluconeogenesis.

name: Arp2/3-mediated lamellipodium and ruffle protrusion
rationale: Members regulate Arp2/3 nucleation via WASP/WAVE and lamellipodium, ruffle, podosome and pseudopodium assembly, unlike confusables involving filament severing, capping, crosslinking and Rho GTPase cycles.

name: Arp2/3 branched-actin protrusions: lamellipodia, ruffles and podosomes
rationale: Members cover WASP/WAVE-driven Arp2/3 nucleation and regulation of lamellipodia, ruffles, pseudopodia, podosomes and macropinocytosis in cell spreading and migration, unlike confusables dominated by RHO GTPase cycles and actin severing/capping/bundling.

name: Arp2/3-WAVE-driven lamellipodium and ruffle protrusion
rationale: Members regulate Arp2/3 nucleation, WASP/WAVE activation and lamellipodia, ruffles, podosomes and macropinocytosis, whereas confusables cover actin severing, bundling, capping and Rho GTPase cycles.

qualifier: NFE2L2 and p53 regulation of NADPH metabolism
name: NFE2L2 and p53 control of redox and NADPH metabolism
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 target programs and turnover with p53/mTORC1 metabolic regulation of pentose phosphate, NADP+ and glycolysis, unlike the FOXO and HIF hypoxia confusables.

name: NRF2- and p53-driven antioxidant and NADPH metabolic regulation
rationale: Members are NRF2 target programmes and its regulation together with p53/mTORC1 control of glycolysis, pentose phosphate shunt and NADP+ synthesis, unlike the HIF/hypoxia and FOXO confusables.

core: Transcriptional control of redox and central carbon metabolism
name: NRF2 and p53 control of redox and glucose metabolism
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 target programmes and its regulation plus p53/mTORC1 control of glycolysis, pentose-phosphate shunt and NADP+, unlike the FOXO and HIF/hypoxia confusables.

name: Redox detoxification and direct DNA alkylation reversal
rationale: Members span ROS, aldehyde and methylglyoxal detoxification, NADPH supply and protein repair, and the ALKBH/MGMT direct alkylation reversal members are what no confusable (glutathione, ferroptosis, ascorbate) contains.

qualifier: direct reversal of DNA alkylation damage
name: Redox detoxification with direct reversal of alkylation damage
rationale: Members span ROS and aldehyde/methylglyoxal detoxification, NADPH regeneration and repair of damaged protein, with ALKBH/MGMT direct reversal of alkylated DNA distinguishing it from glutathione and ascorbate confusables.

name: Redox, aldehyde detoxification and direct alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members span ROS and methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification, NADPH regeneration and protein repair, and uniquely include direct DNA alkylation reversal (ALKBH2/3, MGMT, oxidative demethylation) absent from glutathione/ferroptosis neighbours.

qualifier: and incretin-stimulated insulin processing and secretion
name: Pancreatic endocrine development and incretin-stimulated insulin secretion
rationale: Members span pancreatic progenitor lineages, endocrine/neuroendocrine differentiation and beta-cell insulin processing with GLP-1/GIP-driven secretion; the insulin/incretin arm separates it from ductal/endoderm confusables and the development arm from secretion-only confusables.

name: Pancreatic endocrine development and incretin-regulated insulin secretion
rationale: Members span pancreatic progenitor-to-endocrine (beta, alpha) lineage programs plus insulin processing and GLP-1/GIP-driven secretion, which the endoderm, ductal/intestinal epithelial and receptor-regulated insulin secretion confusables lack in combination.

name: Pancreatic endocrine development and incretin-driven insulin secretion
rationale: Members cover pancreatic progenitor lineages, endocrine/neuroendocrine differentiation and beta-cell function; unlike C1-C3 the theme includes insulin processing and GLP-1/GIP incretin control of insulin secretion, and unlike C4 it includes islet development.

name: Metanephric glomerular mesangium and tubule segment development
rationale: Members cover development of glomerular mesangium and endothelium and proximal, distal, loop of Henle and collecting duct segments plus filtration, unlike confusables on early nephrogenesis/ureteric bud or podocyte and basement membrane.

name: Metanephric tubule segment and glomerular mesangium development
rationale: Members cover development of proximal/distal tubule, loop of Henle and collecting duct segments, glomerular mesangial, endothelial and vascular development, kidney cell proliferation/migration and glomerular filtration; confusables are early nephrogenesis (ureteric bud, MET), podocyte/basement membrane, or lung/pancreas epithelia.

name: Glomerular mesangium and nephron tubule segment development
rationale: Members cover development of glomerular mesangium/endothelium and proximal, distal, loop of Henle and collecting-duct segments plus filtration, unlike early nephrogenesis/ureteric bud and podocyte confusables.

qualifier: with ROS detoxification, NADPH supply and ferroptosis control
name: NRF2 antioxidant response, NADPH supply and ferroptosis control
rationale: Members cover NFE2L2 regulation and its target programs plus ROS detoxification, redox homeostasis, NADPH/isocitrate metabolism and ferroptosis; confusables lack either the NFE2L2 arm (p53/mTOR, HIF) or the ROS/ferroptosis arm (glutathione transport).

name: NRF2 antioxidant response, redox homeostasis and ferroptosis control
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 regulation and target programmes, ROS detoxification, NADPH regeneration and ferroptosis control; this separates it from the hypoxia/HIF confusables (C1, C2, C4) and from the glutathione-transport confusable C3, which lacks the NFE2L2 terms.

qualifier: NRF2 transcriptional program, NADPH supply and ferroptosis
name: NRF2-driven redox defense, NADPH supply and ferroptosis
rationale: Members cover NFE2L2 target programs, NADPH/isocitrate supply, ROS detoxification and ferroptosis control; the NFE2L2 regulation distinguishes it from glutathione, p53-metabolic and HIF/hypoxia confusables.

qualifier: TRIF- and IRAK-dependent activation of TAK1, IKK and IRF3/7
name: TRIF- and IRAK-dependent TLR activation of TAK1, IKK and IRFs
rationale: Members are TRIF/TICAM1 and IRAK/TRAF6 steps activating TAK1, IKK, TBK1-IRF3/7 and TRIF cell death, which confusables lack in favor of NF-kappaB regulation or endosomal TLR trafficking.

qualifier: TRIF- and IRAK-dependent TAK1, IKK and TBK1-IRF3/7 activation
name: TRIF and IRAK adaptor signaling to TAK1 and IRF3/7
rationale: Members describe TRIF/TICAM1 and IRAK-driven TAK1, IKK and TBK1/IRF3/7 activation, TRIF cell death and TLR3-pathway HSE deficiencies, setting the theme apart from IKK-to-NF-kappaB, endosomal TLR trafficking and negative TLR regulation confusables.

qualifier: TRIF and IRAK routes to TAK1 and IRF3/7
name: TRIF- and IRAK-mediated TLR signaling to TAK1 and IRF3/7
rationale: Members describe TLR adaptor-proximal steps (TRIF/TICAM1, IRAK, TRAF6) activating TAK1, IKK, TBK1-IRF3/7 and TRIF cell death, distinguishing it from NF-kappaB-only and endosomal TLR trafficking confusables.

name: Immunoregulatory IL-10 and IL-12 family cytokine signaling
rationale: Members cover IL-10, IL-20 family, IL-12/23/27/35 and IL-37 signaling and IL-10 production, distinguishing them from IL-17/Dectin, broad JAK-STAT and NK/interferon confusables.

name: IL-10, IL-20 and IL-12-family interleukin signalling
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-20-family, IL-12/23/27/35 and IL-37 signalling with IL-10 production regulation, distinguishing them from confusables on IL-17/IL-33/IL-36, IL-15/IL-21, type 2 cytokines and interferons.

core: IL-10 and IL-12 family cytokine signaling
qualifier: anti-inflammatory, IL-37 and IL-10 production control
name: Anti-inflammatory IL-10, IL-12 family and IL-37 cytokine signaling
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-20, IL-12/23/27/35 and IL-37 signaling plus regulation of IL-10 production, distinguishing it from confusables on Th2/mast-cell cytokines, IL-15/interferon-lambda or IL-17/fungal responses.

core: Pyruvate and TCA cycle intermediate metabolism
qualifier: with di- and tricarboxylate membrane transport
name: Pyruvate and TCA intermediate metabolism with carboxylate transport
rationale: Members span pyruvate handling, TCA cycle, malate-aspartate shuttle and transport of di/tricarboxylates and organic anions; the transport arm separates it from purely metabolic confusables and the metabolic arm from SLC-transport confusables.

core: Pyruvate and TCA cycle intermediate metabolism
qualifier: with di- and tricarboxylate membrane transport
name: Pyruvate and TCA-cycle carboxylate metabolism and transport
rationale: Members span pyruvate oxidation to acetyl-CoA, TCA/malate-oxaloacetate metabolism and the SLC transport of pyruvate, succinate and tricarboxylates, combining the metabolism that transporter-only confusables lack with the transport that TCA-only confusables lack.

name: Pyruvate and TCA-cycle carboxylate metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover pyruvate oxidation to acetyl-CoA, malate/oxaloacetate/TCA metabolism and transport of pyruvate and di/tricarboxylates, unlike confusables centred on CoA synthesis, other SLC transporters, or succinate/2-oxoglutarate respiration.

qualifier: galactose (Leloir), fructose and glycerol with inborn errors
name: Galactose, fructose and glycerol metabolism and their inborn errors
rationale: Members are Leloir galactose and fructose catabolism with their inherited defects plus glycerol/alditol metabolism, whereas confusables cover disaccharide digestion, pentose/xylulose metabolism, glycolysis/glycogen or the pentose phosphate shunt.

qualifier: fructose, galactose and glycerol with inborn errors
name: Fructose, galactose and glycerol metabolism and inborn errors
rationale: Members cover fructose, Leloir galactose and glycerol/alditol pathways with their enzyme deficiencies, distinct from pentose phosphate, glycolysis/glycogen or disaccharide digestion confusables.

qualifier: galactose, fructose and glycerol with inborn errors
name: Galactose, fructose and glycerol metabolism and inborn errors
rationale: Members are Leloir galactose catabolism, fructose and glycerol/alditol metabolism and their enzyme deficiencies, unlike confusables on lactose digestion, pentose pathways or glucose/glycogen metabolism.

name: AKT–FOXO signaling in IGF response and cell death
rationale: All members concern PI3K/AKT control of FOXO activity and its outputs; unlike confusables (HSF1 heat shock, NFE2L2, p53/mTORC1) the theme adds IGF/peptide response, apoptotic signaling and muscle atrophy.

qualifier: downstream of IGF signalling, driving apoptosis and muscle atrophy
name: IGF–AKT control of FOXO-driven apoptosis and atrophy
rationale: Members centre on AKT phosphorylation, acetylation and nuclear exclusion of FOXO factors with their IGF/insulin-like inputs and cell-death, neuronal-apoptosis and muscle-atrophy outputs, whereas confusables are built around mTORC1/p53 metabolism, NFE2L2 antioxidant control or HSF1 heat shock.

qualifier: IGF response, apoptosis and muscle atrophy
name: AKT-FOXO signalling in IGF response and cell death
rationale: All members concern PI3K/AKT control of FOXO localisation and transcription and its outputs (IGF/peptide response, neuronal and hormone-mediated apoptosis, muscle atrophy), whereas confusables pair FOXO with NFE2L2, p53/mTORC1 or HSF1 stress programmes.

qualifier: progenitor proliferation and collagen matrix production
name: Osteoblast-lineage proliferation, differentiation and collagen matrix production
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation/differentiation, Wnt signalling, collagen and proteoglycan production, tendon and trabecular bone, unlike confusables on RUNX2/ossification, BMP/TGF-beta or mineralization.

name: Mesenchymal-osteoblast proliferation and collagen matrix production
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation together with collagen, proteoglycan and matrix secretion, tendon and trabecular bone; confusables centre on ossification, RUNX2, mineralization or BMP/TGF-beta programmes.

name: Osteoprogenitor proliferation, differentiation and collagen matrix production
