rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast proliferation/differentiation with collagen, proteoglycan and matrix secretion, trabecular bone and tendon; confusables emphasise RUNX2/BMP control, mineralization and ossification modes.

name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells and hyaluronan
rationale: Members share uptake and lysosomal clearance by scavenger receptors, efferocytosis and hyaluronan degradation, which separates the theme from the oxidized-LDL foam cell and microglial amyloid clearance neighbours.

core: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells
name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells and hyaluronan
rationale: Members share scavenger-receptor and efferocytic clearance with lysosomal handling, and uniquely add hyaluronan degradation, AGE receptor signaling and lysosome organization, lacking the microglial, amyloid and oxidized-LDL/foam-cell members of the confusables.

name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells and hyaluronan
rationale: Members cover scavenger receptor classes, efferocytosis, immune complex clearance, lysosomal handling and hyaluronan degradation, unlike confusables focused on oxidized LDL, foam cells or microglial amyloid clearance.

core: Vitamin K and vitamin C metabolism
name: Vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation and vitamin C metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and protein gamma-carboxylation plus ascorbate metabolism/transport and responses, distinguishing it from vitamin A/D and vitamin E/ubiquinol confusables.

qualifier: vitamin K gamma-carboxylation and vitamin C
name: Vitamin K, C and E metabolism and gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation of proteins, ascorbate metabolism/transport and vitamin E response, while confusables centre on vitamin D, retinoid or ubiquinone metabolism.

name: Vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation and vitamin C metabolism
rationale: Members concern vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors plus ascorbate metabolism and response, distinguishing it from vitamin E/ubiquinone, vitamin D and retinoid neighbours.

qualifier: cerebellar cortex layers and motor coordination
name: Cerebellar cortex development and motor coordination
rationale: Members combine granule, Purkinje and Bergmann glia layer formation with proprioception, motor learning and voluntary locomotion, unlike forebrain (C1), vocal behavior (C2) or brainstem/pons maturation (C3, C4).

qualifier: cerebellar cortex layers, proprioception and voluntary movement
name: Cerebellar cortex development and motor coordination
rationale: Members combine cerebellar granular/Purkinje layer formation, Bergmann glia and granule precursor proliferation with motor learning, proprioception and locomotion, unlike brainstem/respiratory, vocal-learning and forebrain confusables.

name: Cerebellar cortex development and voluntary motor control
rationale: Members combine Purkinje, granule and Bergmann glia layer development with proprioception, voluntary movement, locomotion and motor-neuron survival, which the brainstem/respiratory and vocal/striatal confusables lack.

qualifier: BAF SWI/SNF complexes and lysine acetylation
name: Protein acetylation and BAF chromatin remodeling complexes
rationale: Members are histone/protein acetylation and BAF/CHD chromatin remodeler assembly, whereas confusables centre on chromatin assembly or histone/protein methylation.

qualifier: BAF and CHD1/2 remodellers with lysine acetylation
name: BAF chromatin remodelling and protein lysine acetylation
rationale: Members are BAF complex variants and CHD1/2 remodellers alongside histone, N-terminal and tubulin acetylation, distinguishing it from methylation-, repressive chromatin- and nucleosome-assembly confusables.

qualifier: BAF remodeling complexes and protein acetylation
name: BAF chromatin remodeling complexes and protein lysine acetylation
rationale: Members are assembly of BAF/SWI-SNF variants and CHD1/2 remodelers together with histone and non-histone protein acetylation; confusables center on histone methylation or nucleosome assembly.

core: Sulfur and selenium amino acid catabolism
qualifier: plus choline/FMO oxidation and carnitine synthesis
name: Sulfur amino acid, selenium and choline catabolism
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration, selenoamino acid metabolism, choline catabolism with FMO oxidation and carnitine synthesis, distinguishing them from confusables on sulfide oxidation, B6, BH4 or aromatic amino acids.

core: Sulfur, selenium and methylamine compound catabolism
name: Transsulfuration, selenium methylation and choline/trimethylamine catabolism
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration and cysteine/serine catabolism, selenocompound metabolism and excretion, and choline, carnitine and FMO trimethylamine oxidation; neighbours lack the choline/FMO arm or the sulfur/selenium arm.

core: Sulfur, selenium and methylamine compound catabolism
name: Transsulfuration, selenium methylation and choline/trimethylamine catabolism
rationale: Members combine transsulfuration and sulfur amino acid catabolism, selenium compound methylation, and choline catabolism, FMO trimethylamine oxidation and carnitine synthesis; the choline/FMO arm separates it from sulfur/B6 confusables and the sulfur/selenium arm from the carnitine confusable.

name: Endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion and vascular remodeling
rationale: Members regulate endothelial activation, apoptosis and sprouting, leukocyte adhesion/extravasation and vessel remodeling/wound healing, unlike confusables focused on growth-factor production, monocyte activation or smooth muscle migration.

name: Endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion and vascular remodeling
rationale: Members concern endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion to endothelium, vessel remodeling, wound healing and angiogenic proliferation, unlike confusables centred on FGF/VEGF production, smooth muscle migration or monocyte activation.

name: Endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion and vascular remodeling
rationale: Members concern endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion to vascular endothelium, vascular wound healing and vessel remodeling/angiogenesis, whereas confusables focus on smooth muscle migration, monocyte activation or VEGF/FGF production.

qualifier: monocyte and resting dendritic cell surface modules
name: Monocyte and resting dendritic cell transcriptional signatures
rationale: Members are blood module signatures enriched in monocytes, dendritic cells and neutrophils (surface, differentiation, myeloid receptors), unlike confusables focused on MHC antigen presentation, activated DCs or PU.1-driven monocyte activation.

qualifier: monocyte and dendritic cell surface identity
name: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface identity signatures
rationale: Members are transcriptional and surface signatures of monocytes, resting dendritic cells and neutrophils, unlike confusables on activated DC antigen presentation or monocyte activation.

qualifier: circulating monocyte and resting dendritic cell surface programs
name: Circulating monocyte and resting dendritic cell surface signatures
rationale: Members share blood monocyte, dendritic cell and neutrophil enrichment signatures and surface markers, unlike confusables on antigen processing/presentation, CD1 and TLR7, or monocyte activation and lineage transcription.

qualifier: histone lysine methylation, deacetylation and CHD/NuRD remodelling
name: Histone lysine methylation, deacetylation and CHD chromatin remodelling
rationale: Members concern histone lysine methyltransferases and demethylases, HDACs, WDR5/MLL complexes and CHD/NuRD/ChAHP remodellers with X inactivation, distinguishing it from DNA methylation/PRC2, arginine methylation and BAF complex confusables.

qualifier: lysine methylation/demethylation, deacetylation and CHD-family remodelers
name: Histone lysine methylation, deacetylation and CHD-family chromatin remodeling
rationale: Members cover histone lysine methyltransferases/demethylases, HDACs, CHD/NuRD/ChAHP remodelers and X inactivation, whereas confusables centre on DNA methylation/PRC2, BAF complexes or arginine methylation.

qualifier: lysine methylation/demethylation, deacetylation and CHD remodelers
name: Histone lysine methylation, deacetylation and CHD chromatin remodeling
rationale: Members cover histone lysine methyltransferases/demethylases, HDACs, NuRD/CHD/ChAHP remodelers and X inactivation, unlike confusables on BAF complexes, DNA methylation/PRC2 or arginine methylation.

name: Plasma lipoprotein remodeling and clearance
rationale: Members cover LDL/HDL remodeling and clearance of LDL, VLDL and chylomicrons with cholesterol import and lipoprotein signalling, distinguishing it from lipoprotein assembly, lipase activation and intestinal absorption confusables.

name: Plasma lipoprotein remodelling, clearance and cholesterol uptake
rationale: Members cover LDL/HDL remodelling, LDL/VLDL/chylomicron clearance, lipoprotein transport and cholesterol import, distinct from the lipoprotein assembly, lipase and intestinal absorption confusables.

name: Lipoprotein clearance, remodelling and receptor-mediated cholesterol uptake
rationale: Members cover LDL/VLDL/chylomicron clearance, HDL/LDL remodelling and cholesterol import, whereas confusables emphasise intestinal assembly/absorption and lipase activity.

name: miRNA biogenesis regulation and fibroblast-driven connective tissue repair
rationale: Members combine regulation of pri/pre-miRNA processing and miRNA transcription with fibroblast survival, myofibroblast differentiation, connective tissue replacement and dampened TGF-beta response, whereas confusables lack miRNA processing and centre on ECM, collagen or SMAD signaling.

qualifier: regulation of miRNA processing alongside fibroblast fate
name: Fibroblast fibrotic repair and miRNA biogenesis regulation
rationale: Members combine regulation of fibroblast/myofibroblast differentiation, survival and connective tissue replacement with miRNA transcription and processing control. The miRNA arm is what the ECM, collagen and TGF-beta confusables lack.

core: Fibroblast fate in fibrotic tissue repair
name: Fibroblast fate in fibrotic repair and miRNA biogenesis regulation
rationale: Members combine fibroblast/myofibroblast apoptosis and differentiation in connective tissue repair with regulation of miRNA transcription and processing, the latter being what separates it from TGF-beta/ECM fibrosis confusables.

name: CSF1–DAP12 signaling in microglial and macrophage activation
rationale: Members are M-CSF/CSF1 and DAP12 tyrosine-kinase signaling driving macrophage proliferation/fusion and microglial activation, migration and cytotoxicity, distinguishing it from GM-CSF differentiation, osteoclast and microglial-inhibition confusables.

name: CSF1 and DAP12 signaling in macrophages and microglia
rationale: Members are CSF1/M-CSF and DAP12 tyrosine-kinase signaling driving macrophage and microglial proliferation, activation and migration; microglial and DAP12 members separate it from the osteoclast and monocyte-differentiation confusables.

name: CSF1 and DAP12 signaling in macrophage and microglial activation
rationale: Members are M-CSF/CSF1 and DAP12 signaling driving macrophage and microglial proliferation, migration, fusion and cytotoxicity; CSF1/microglia distinguish it from osteoclast, GM-CSF differentiation and negative-glial neighbours.

name: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral gene response
rationale: Members are interferon-alpha response and antiviral ISG signatures (OAS, ISG15, IRF2 targets, IP-10), the effector side of IFN signaling, whereas confusables focus on RIG-I/TLR/STING-driven interferon induction and its regulation.

name: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral gene response
rationale: Members are interferon-alpha/type I IFN-stimulated antiviral gene programmes (OAS, ISG15, IRF2 targets, IP-10, activated DC signatures), whereas confusables focus on upstream IFN induction via RLR/TLR/cGAS sensing and its regulation.

name: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral gene response
rationale: Members are IFN-alpha/type I IFN response signatures and ISG effectors (OAS, ISG15, IP-10), whereas confusables centre on RIG-I/cGAS/TLR sensing and IFN induction.

qualifier: Rho-ROCK/PAK stress fibres in spreading, migration and platelets
name: Rho-ROCK/PAK actin remodelling in integrin adhesion and spreading
rationale: Members combine integrin/syndecan adhesion, cell spreading and migration with Rho-driven ROCK/PAK stress fibre assembly and platelet activation modules; confusables are fibronectin matrix assembly, PINCH-ILK focal adhesion or MET-PTK2 signalling.

core: Integrin adhesion and actin cytoskeletal remodelling
qualifier: Rho-ROCK/PAK stress fibres in cell spreading
name: Integrin adhesion and Rho-ROCK/PAK stress-fibre remodelling
rationale: Members are integrin/syndecan adhesion, ROCK and PAK activation, stress fibre assembly, cell spreading and migration and platelet activation, distinguishing them from fibronectin matrix, MET-PTK2 and PINCH-ILK-parvin confusables.

name: Integrin adhesion with Rho-ROCK/PAK actin remodeling and spreading
rationale: Members are integrin/syndecan adhesion, Rho-driven ROCK/PAK activation, stress fibers, spreading, migration and platelet activation modules; confusables are fibronectin matrix, MET-FAK or ILK-PINCH focal adhesion assembly.

qualifier: ATP/adenosine receptors and KATP channels in ischemia
name: Purinergic ATP/adenosine signaling and KATP channels in ischemia
rationale: Members are P2Y and adenosine receptor signaling, ATP export/hydrolysis, KATP channels and ischemic/gasotransmitter responses, separating it from other GPCR, nitric oxide and calcium signaling confusables.

qualifier: ATP-sensitive potassium channels in ischemic response
name: Purinergic signalling and ATP-sensitive potassium channels in ischemia
rationale: Members share extracellular ATP/adenosine signalling (P2Y, P1, NTPDases, ATP export) with KATP channels and ischemia/hypoxia responses, which the calcium, histamine/prostanoid and PLC confusables lack.

name: Extracellular ATP/adenosine purinergic signalling and K-ATP channels in ischemia
rationale: Members cover ATP export, NTPDase hydrolysis, P2Y/P1 receptor signalling plus K-ATP channels and ischemia/hypoxia responses, which histamine/prostanoid, calcium or PLC confusables lack.

qualifier: integrin activation, Rap1 and Rho-ROCK/PAK to cell spreading
name: Integrin activation and Rap1/Rho signalling for cell spreading
rationale: Members describe integrin activation and adhesion-complex signalling via Rap1, Rho-ROCK/PAK, p130Cas and GRB2:SOS that drive stress fibres and spreading, unlike confusables about platelet/BTM cytoskeleton, fibronectin matrix, shear stress or migration.

qualifier: Rap1 and Rho GTPase effectors driving spreading and stress fibres
name: Integrin-Rap1 and Rho signalling driving cell spreading
rationale: All members are integrin-coupled signalling events (Rap1, ROCK/PAK, IPP complex, Cas/GRB2-SOS linkage) producing stress fibres and cell spreading, unlike confusables centred on platelet activation, shear stress, fibronectin matrix or fibroblast migration.

qualifier: Rap1-driven activation and outside-in signalling to stress fibres and spreading
name: Integrin activation and outside-in signalling to stress fibres
rationale: All members concern integrin activation (Rap1, signal complex) and downstream adhesion signalling (ILK-PINCH-parvin, Cas/GRB2-SOS, Rho-PAK/ROCK) to stress fibres and spreading, unlike confusables centred on fibroblast migration, matrix assembly, platelets or shear stress.

core: Transition and heavy metal ion transport and detoxification
name: Copper, manganese and cadmium transport and detoxification
rationale: All members concern transport, homeostasis or detoxification of copper, manganese, cadmium or cobalt ions, which separates the theme from the iron/heme and zinc confusables and, through cadmium detoxification, from the MTF1 metal-response confusable.

core: Non-iron transition metal transport and detoxification
name: Copper, manganese and cadmium ion transport and detoxification
rationale: Members cover transport, homeostasis and detoxification of copper, manganese, cadmium and cobalt including metallothioneins; cadmium detoxification and copper/manganese transport separate it from the zinc, iron and MTF1 metal-response neighbours.

core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
qualifier: copper, manganese and cadmium, with cadmium detoxification and metallothionein binding
name: Copper, manganese and cadmium transport and detoxification
rationale: All members concern transport, homeostasis or detoxification of copper, manganese, cadmium or cobalt (incl. metallothioneins and ceruloplasmin), distinguishing it from the zinc (C1, C2), iron/heme (C3) and MTF1 metal-response (C4) neighbours, which lack cadmium detoxification.

qualifier: brown and beige fat differentiation and cold-induced thermogenesis
name: Brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and thermogenesis
rationale: Members concern brown/beige fat differentiation (EBF2, PGC-1alpha), cold- and diet-induced thermogenesis and associated fatty acid cycling/transport, unlike confusables on white adipogenesis, lipogenic transcription or lipid droplet/triglyceride storage.

name: Brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and cold-induced thermogenesis
rationale: Members concern brown/beige fat differentiation, cold and diet-induced thermogenesis, PGC-1alpha activation and fatty acid cycling, distinguishing it from white adipogenesis, lipolysis/lipid droplet and lipogenic transcription confusables.

qualifier: brown and beige differentiation and cold-induced thermogenesis
name: Brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and cold-induced thermogenesis
rationale: Members cover brown/beige fat differentiation, cold and diet-induced thermogenesis, PGC-1alpha activation and fatty acid cycling/uncoupling, distinguishing the theme from white adipogenesis, lipogenic transcription and lipid droplet/lipolysis confusables.

qualifier: perivascular stroma, endothelium and IL-33 alarmin signaling
name: Perivascular stroma and endothelium with IL-33 alarmin signaling
rationale: Members are fibroblast, perivascular stromal and endothelial signatures with IL-33 signaling, chemotaxis and adhesion, whereas confusables emphasise ECM/EMT, TGF-beta1 production, fibroblast proliferation or KRAS targets.

name: Perivascular stromal and endothelial signature with IL-33 signaling
rationale: Members are fibroblast, perivascular and endothelial signatures with adhesion, chemotaxis and IL-33 signalling, while confusables centre on ECM/EMT, TGF-beta and fibroblast proliferation.

name: Perivascular stroma and endothelium with IL-33-driven chemotaxis
rationale: Members are fibroblast, perivascular and endothelial gene modules with adhesion, IL-33 signalling and positive chemotaxis, while confusables lack the endothelial/IL-33 components and instead carry generic ECM, KRAS or fibroblast proliferation sets.

name: Cadherin adherens junction assembly opposing epithelial–mesenchymal transition
rationale: Members cover cadherin adhesion, adherens/apical junction assembly, apical constriction and EMT restraint, whereas confusables emphasise apicobasal polarity, desmosomes or specific cadherin gene regulation.

name: Adherens junction assembly and cadherin adhesion opposing EMT
rationale: Members cover adherens/apical junction assembly, cadherin adhesion, apical constriction and EMT suppression, unlike epithelial polarity, desmosome and cadherin-expression confusables.

qualifier: restraint of epithelial–mesenchymal transition and substrate attachment
name: Adherens junction assembly opposing epithelial–mesenchymal transition
rationale: Members cover calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion, adherens junction assembly and apical constriction with negative regulation of EMT and substrate attachment, which confusables centred on junction maintenance and apical-basal polarity lack.

qualifier: monocyte/DC and CD1 lipid antigen presentation
name: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface signatures, CD1 lipid presentation
rationale: Members are surface-marker signatures of monocytes, dendritic cells and other leukocytes plus CD1/butyrophilin lipid antigen presentation, separating it from MHC class II peptide presentation, T cell costimulation and neutrophil neighbours.

core: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface signatures
name: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface signatures, CD1 lipid presentation
rationale: Members are mostly monocyte/DC (and some lymphocyte) surface-marker modules with CD1/MHC class Ib lipid antigen presentation and butyrophilins, distinct from MHC class II peptide presentation, T cell costimulation and neutrophil/innate confusables.

qualifier: monocyte/dendritic cell markers and CD1 lipid antigen presentation
name: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface markers, CD1 lipid presentation
rationale: Members are mostly monocyte, dendritic cell and other leukocyte surface signatures plus CD1/MHC class Ib lipid antigen presentation, distinguishing them from MHC class II peptide presentation, neutrophil and T cell activation confusables.

name: Ephrin and Sema3A repulsive axon guidance and remodeling
rationale: Members are ephrin and Sema3A-plexin repulsion, growth cone collapse, fasciculation, branching and pruning, distinguishing it from L1/NCAM, Sema4D, netrin and collateral sprouting neighbours.

qualifier: ephrin and Sema3A signalling with neurite remodelling
name: Ephrin and Sema3A repulsive axon guidance and neurite remodelling
rationale: Members combine ephrin/EPH and Sema3A repulsion, growth cone collapse and microtubule destabilisation with fasciculation, nerve branching, neuron remodelling and synapse pruning, whereas confusables centre on L1/NCAM adhesion, netrin, Sema4D or collateral sprouting.

name: Sema3A- and ephrin-mediated repulsive axon guidance and remodeling
rationale: Members are Sema3A-plexin and ephrin-Eph repulsion, growth cone collapse, fasciculation, nerve branching and pruning, distinct from netrin, Sema4D, L1/NCAM and collateral sprouting confusables.

core: Nuclear envelope and nuclear pore complex organization
name: Mitotic nuclear envelope and pore complex breakdown and reassembly
rationale: All members concern nuclear envelope/NPC assembly, positioning or function, and unlike the transport/SUMOylation confusables the theme includes lamina depolymerization and NE disassembly and reformation.

core: Nuclear envelope and nuclear pore complex organization
name: Mitotic nuclear envelope and pore complex disassembly and reassembly
rationale: All members concern nuclear envelope, lamina and pore complex organization, dominated by their mitotic breakdown and reformation, which the transport/SUMOylation confusables lack and which goes beyond ESCRT-mediated sealing.

name: Nuclear envelope and pore complex disassembly and reassembly
rationale: All members concern nuclear envelope and nuclear pore complex organization, chiefly their mitotic breakdown and rebuilding (lamina depolymerization, NPC disassembly/reassembly), which separates it from ESCRT-mediated sealing and from nucleocytoplasmic transport/SUMOylation neighbours.

qualifier: iron-sulfur cluster assembly; complexes I, III and ATP synthase
name: Iron-sulfur cluster and respiratory complex I/III/V assembly
rationale: Members are Fe-S cluster assembly (cytosolic, 2Fe-2S, 4Fe-4S, TCA enzyme maturation), inner-membrane protein insertion and assembly of complex I, complex III and ATP synthase; Fe-S assembly distinguishes it from complex IV, mitochondrial translation and electron transport confusables.

qualifier: iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis, complexes I/III and ATP synthase
name: Iron-sulfur cluster and respiratory complex I/III assembly
rationale: Members cover Fe-S cluster assembly, maturation of Fe-S TCA enzymes, inner-membrane insertion and assembly of complexes I, III and ATP synthase; Fe-S biogenesis and absence of complex IV, electron transport and mitotranslation distinguish it.

name: Iron-sulfur cluster and respiratory complex I/III assembly
rationale: Members are Fe-S cluster assembly, Fe-S-dependent TCA enzyme maturation, inner-membrane protein insertion and complex I/III/ATP synthase assembly; Fe-S assembly and absence of complex IV separate it from the electron-transport and mitochondrial-translation confusables.

qualifier: galactose, fructose and polyol inborn errors
name: Galactose, fructose and polyol catabolism with inborn errors
rationale: Members cover the Leloir galactose pathway, fructose catabolism, alditol metabolism and their enzyme deficiencies, distinct from pentose/xylulose and glycerol confusables.

qualifier: galactose, fructose and polyol with inherited defects
name: Galactose, fructose and polyol catabolism and inherited defects
rationale: Members are Leloir galactose and fructose catabolism, their enzyme deficiencies and alditol metabolism, unlike confusables on pentose/xylulose or glycerol metabolism.

qualifier: fructose and galactose with inherited enzyme defects
name: Fructose and galactose catabolism and inherited defects
rationale: Members are fructose and Leloir galactose catabolism, alditol metabolism and their inborn errors, distinguishing them from pentose phosphate, xylulose and glycerol confusables.

name: Mannose and amino-sugar metabolism with N-glycan trimming
rationale: Members cover mannose, fructose-6-phosphate, GlcNAc and sialic acid catabolism together with N-glycan glucosidase/mannosidase processing (MOGS, MAN1B1), which separates it from UDP-GlcNAc/sialic acid synthesis themes.

qualifier: N-glycan trimming, oligosaccharide catabolism and mannose metabolism
name: N-glycan trimming, oligosaccharide catabolism and mannose metabolism
rationale: Members combine ER N-glycan processing (MOGS, MAN1B1, dolichyl-phosphate-glucose), lysosomal oligosaccharide and glycoside breakdown, and mannose/amino-sugar phosphorylation, distinguishing it from sialic acid and UDP-GlcNAc biosynthesis confusables.

name: N-glycan trimming and mannose and amino-sugar catabolism
rationale: Members cover N-glycan processing (MOGS, MAN1B1), lysosomal oligosaccharide and glycoside catabolism and mannose/GlcNAc/sialic acid breakdown and phosphorylation, unlike confusables on nucleotide-sugar and sialic acid biosynthesis.

qualifier: cranial ganglia and olfactory/GnRH migration rather than spinal or peripheral
name: Brainstem and cranial nerve development
rationale: Members cover hindbrain/pons development, cranial nerves (facial, trigeminal, olfactory), cranial ganglia and related neuronal migration, distinguishing the theme from spinal, enteric and dorsal root ganglion confusables.

qualifier: cranial ganglia and olfactory placode derivatives (olfactory nerve, GnRH neuron migration)
name: Brainstem and cranial nerve development, including olfactory placode derivatives
rationale: All members concern development of the brainstem/hindbrain and the cranial nerves and ganglia they serve; cranial ganglion, olfactory nerve, GnRH neuron migration and taste papilla members distinguish it from the spinal-cord, enteric and dorsal-root-ganglion confusables.

qualifier: with olfactory nerve and GnRH neuron migration
name: Hindbrain, cranial nerve and olfactory–GnRH neuron development
rationale: Members cover brainstem/pons maturation, trigeminal/facial/branchiomotor nerves and cranial ganglia, and unlike the spinal-cord, DRG or enteric confusables they add olfactory nerve development, GnRH neuron migration and fungiform papilla formation.

name: Amino and organic acid metabolism with aromatic acid conjugation
rationale: Members are broad amino acid and organic acid metabolism plus glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate in mitochondria; the conjugation members are absent from threonine, glycine and proline confusables.

name: Organic acid metabolism with glycine/glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids
rationale: Members are broad amino/organic acid metabolic terms plus mitochondrial conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate with glycine or glutamine, which the proline, glycine and threonine confusables lack.

name: Organic and amino acid metabolism with aromatic acid conjugation
rationale: Members are broad (obsolete) amino/organic acid metabolism terms plus mitochondrial glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, the conjugation arm being absent from threonine, glycine and proline confusables.

qualifier: IL-12-driven NKT and Th1 cytokine production
name: IL-12-driven Th1 and NKT cell activation, IFN-gamma production
rationale: Members cover IL-12 production/signaling, Th1 cytokines, IFN-gamma/GM-CSF production and NKT activation, distinct from confusables on IFN-gamma response, MHC induction and Treg/Th differentiation.

name: IL-12-driven NKT and Th1 activation with IFN-γ production
rationale: Members concern IL-12 production/signaling driving NKT and Th1 activation and IFN-gamma/GM-CSF production; NKT regulation and IL-12 members distinguish it from IFN-gamma response and Th1 differentiation confusables.

qualifier: IL-12 production and NKT cell activation
name: IL-12 production and NKT/Th1 cytokine activation
rationale: Members cover IL-12 production and signaling, Th1 and NKT cell activation and IFN-gamma/GM-CSF production; confusables emphasize Th1 differentiation, IFN-gamma response, MHC regulation or Treg control.

qualifier: replicase translation and host translation shutoff
name: Coronavirus replicase translation and host translation suppression
rationale: Members cover SARS-CoV frameshifting, replicase and protein E maturation and suppression of host translation; confusables emphasize viral genome replication, capping or other viruses.

qualifier: replicase frameshifting, protein E maturation and host translation shutoff
name: SARS-CoV protein translation, maturation and host translation shutoff
rationale: Members cover coronavirus replicase translation with frameshifting, protein E maturation and viral suppression of host translation, distinguishing it from themes on viral genome replication, capping and other viruses' RNA synthesis.

qualifier: replicase frameshifting, protein E maturation and host translation suppression
name: Coronavirus replicase translation and host translation suppression
rationale: Members cover SARS-CoV replicase translation/frameshifting, protein maturation and viral suppression of host translation elongation, lacking the genome replication, capping and other-virus pathways of the confusables.

qualifier: TNFR1 and TLR4-TRIF via RIP1 and linear ubiquitination
name: RIP1-mediated canonical NF-kappaB activation by TNFR1 and TLR4
rationale: Members describe TNFR1 and TLR4/TICAM1 signaling through RIP1, linear ubiquitination and TAK1/IKK recruitment to canonical NF-kappaB, unlike confusables on NF-kappaB inhibition, IRAK-dependent TLR7/8/9 or non-canonical NIK signaling.

name: TNFR1 and RIP1-mediated canonical NF-kappaB activation via linear ubiquitination
rationale: Members cover TNFR1 signaling, RIP1-mediated IKK recruitment and linear polyubiquitination driving canonical NF-kappaB, unlike confusables on non-canonical NF-kappaB, IRAK-TLR signaling or NF-kappaB inhibition.

qualifier: RIP1-mediated, downstream of TNFR1 and TLR4
name: RIP1-mediated canonical NF-kB activation downstream of TNFR1 and TLR4
rationale: Members cover RIP1/linear-ubiquitin-dependent IKK recruitment and canonical NF-kB activation from TNFR1 and TLR4-TRIF, whereas confusables cover IRAK/TLR7-9 signaling and non-canonical NF-kB.

name: Phosphate homeostasis in ectopic calcification and enamel mineralization
rationale: Members cover phosphate transport/homeostasis, PTH response and mineralization disorders (SLC20A2 brain calcification, ABCC6 PXE, SLC24A4 enamel); these separate it from SLC34/FGF23-Klotho and dentinogenesis confusables.

qualifier: in enamel, bone and ectopic mineralization
name: Phosphate transport in enamel, bone and ectopic mineralization
rationale: Members concern phosphate transport, homeostasis and PTH response alongside mineralization of enamel and bone and ectopic calcification disorders (PXE, basal ganglia calcification); confusables centre on renal type II Na/Pi cotransporters, FGF23-Klotho or dentinogenesis.

qualifier: ectopic calcification and enamel mineralization disorders
name: Phosphate homeostasis, ectopic calcification and enamel mineralization
rationale: Members concern phosphate transport/homeostasis and PTH response together with mineralization control and its disorders (PXE, IBGC1, amelogenesis imperfecta), unlike SLC34/FGF23-klotho or dentinogenesis neighbours.

qualifier: lactate, fatty acid, carnitine and glucose transporters
name: Membrane transport of lactate, fatty acids, carnitine and glucose
rationale: Members are transporter processes and transporter-defect diseases for monocarboxylates (with basigin), fatty acids, carnitine and GLUT1 glucose, distinguishing them from confusables on pyruvate/creatine, organic anion/dicarboxylate transport or mitochondrial carnitine shuttle and beta-oxidation.

name: Plasma-membrane transport of lactate, carnitine and fatty acids
rationale: Members are solute carriers and their deficiency disorders moving lactate (MCT/basigin), carnitine, fatty acids and glucose across plasma membranes, unlike pyruvate/creatine, organic ion or mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation in confusables.

core: Monocarboxylate and lipid nutrient membrane transport
qualifier: lactate, carnitine and fatty acid transporters and their deficiencies
name: Lactate, carnitine and fatty acid transporters and deficiencies
rationale: Members concern SLC16/basigin lactate transport, carnitine and fatty acid uptake and their inherited defects, unlike confusables on pyruvate/creatine, organic anion/cation transport or the mitochondrial carnitine shuttle.

name: Fatty acid and carnitine transport for beta-oxidation
rationale: Members concern carnitine and fatty acid transport across plasma, mitochondrial and blood-brain barrier membranes and their defects, whereas neighbours cover beta-oxidation enzymology and ketone bodies.

qualifier: carnitine shuttle and membrane transport for beta-oxidation
name: Fatty acid and carnitine membrane transport for beta-oxidation
rationale: Members concern carnitine and fatty acid transport across membranes including transporter disorders and promotion of beta-oxidation, unlike confusables on beta-oxidation steps, ketone bodies or insulin secretion.

name: Fatty acid and carnitine transport for beta-oxidation
rationale: Members concern carnitine shuttle, carnitine and fatty acid transporters (including blood-brain barrier transport and transporter deficiencies) feeding beta-oxidation, while confusables cover the oxidation steps themselves and ketone bodies.

qualifier: heparan and chondroitin/dermatan chains, with skeletal dysplasia defects
name: Heparan and chondroitin/dermatan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern synthesis of heparan, heparin, chondroitin or dermatan sulfate proteoglycans or their inherited skeletal defects (EXT1/2, SLC35D1, SLC26A2), distinguishing the theme from broad O/N-glycosylation, keratan sulfate, nucleotide-sugar transport and GAG degradation neighbours.

qualifier: heparan and chondroitin/dermatan sulfate, incl. EXT, sulfate and UDP-sugar transporter defects
name: Heparan and chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan chain biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern building HS/heparin and CS/DS chains or their inherited defects (EXT1/2, SLC26A2, SLC35D1), unlike the degradation/MPS confusable and the broader O-/N-glycan and keratan sulfate confusables.

qualifier: heparan and chondroitin/dermatan chains with skeletal dysplasia defects
name: Heparan and chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan synthesis and skeletal dysplasias
rationale: All members concern biosynthesis of heparan, heparin, chondroitin and dermatan sulfate proteoglycan chains or inherited defects in it (EXT1/2 exostoses, SLC26A2 and SLC35D1 chondrodysplasias), unlike the degradation/mucopolysaccharidosis confusable and the broader glycosylation confusables with keratan, O-glycan and linkage-region pathways.

name: Apoptotic cell clearance and oxidized LDL-driven foam cell formation
rationale: Members cover phosphatidylserine-mediated recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells and neutrophils plus oxLDL response, cholesterol storage, foam cell differentiation and amyloid-beta clearance, unlike microglial activation and scavenger receptor class confusables.

qualifier: apoptotic cells and oxidized LDL foam cells
name: Efferocytosis and oxidized LDL-driven macrophage foam cell formation
rationale: Members share phagocyte recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells, amyloid-beta and oxidized LDL with cholesterol storage and foam cell differentiation, unlike microglial activation and scavenger receptor class neighbours.

qualifier: with oxidized-LDL foam cell formation and amyloid-beta clearance
name: Efferocytosis and macrophage oxidized-LDL foam cell formation
rationale: Members cover recognition, phosphatidylserine signalling and engulfment of apoptotic cells plus oxLDL response, foam cell differentiation, cholesterol storage and amyloid-beta clearance, which the scavenger receptor (C1, C2, C4) and microglia (C3) neighbours lack.

qualifier: regulation of fatty acid import and carnitine shuttle
name: Regulation of fatty acid import and beta-oxidation
rationale: Members concern control of fatty acid uptake and mitochondrial entry (carnitine shuttle, malonyl-CoA) and beta-oxidation regulation; regulatory/import members separate it from beta-oxidation step, carnitine transport and lipid droplet confusables.

qualifier: regulation of fatty acid import and beta-oxidation
name: Regulation of fatty acid import and beta-oxidation
rationale: Members cover acyl-CoA/malonyl-CoA metabolism, the carnitine shuttle and positive/negative regulation of fatty acid transport and beta-oxidation; the regulatory control of import distinguishes it from confusables of beta-oxidation steps, carnitine transport or lipid droplets.

qualifier: regulation of fatty acid entry via carnitine shuttle and malonyl-CoA
name: Control of fatty acid entry into beta-oxidation
rationale: Members regulate fatty acid import, the carnitine shuttle, malonyl-CoA and medium-chain acyl-CoA metabolism, whereas confusables hold the individual beta-oxidation steps, ketone bodies or lipid droplet turnover.

name: Stress protein quality control with methylglyoxal glycation repair
rationale: Members cover protein repair, methylglyoxal handling, nitrosative/manganese stress and restraint of folding, mitochondrial targeting and chaperone-mediated autophagy; protein repair and methylglyoxal set it apart from heat-shock, refolding, aggrephagy and ROS-detoxification neighbours.

name: Protein repair and methylglyoxal response under cellular stress
rationale: Members are DJ-1-type stress-protective functions (protein deglycation repair, methylglyoxal metabolism, nitrosative and manganese stress, restraint of folding, mitochondrial targeting and chaperone-mediated autophagy), and protein repair plus methylglyoxal handling separate it from chaperone, aggrephagy, heat-shock and ROS-detoxification confusables.

core: Protein integrity defence under cellular stress
name: Damaged-protein repair and methylglyoxal stress defence
rationale: Members cover repair of damaged proteins, methylglyoxal (glycation) metabolism and responses to nitrosative and manganese stress with restraint of folding, CMA and mitochondrial targeting (a DJ-1-like protective profile), unlike confusables centred on aggrephagy, refolding, ROS detoxification or heat shock.

name: Selenium and sulfide metabolism and cofactor activation
rationale: Members are inorganic chalcogen metabolism (dietary selenium compounds to H2Se and excretion, hydrogen sulfide oxidation, cysteine catabolism) plus prosthetic-group synthesis, distinct from the transsulfuration and glutathione confusables.

qualifier: with molybdenum cofactor and PLP synthesis
name: Selenium and sulfide metabolism with cofactor biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover ingested selenium compound metabolism and methylation, sulfide oxidation and cysteine catabolism, plus prosthetic-group synthesis (molybdenum cofactor, pyridoxal phosphate), which the transsulfuration and glutathione confusables lack.

qualifier: selenium detoxification and molybdenum/PLP cofactor synthesis
name: Selenium detoxification, sulfide oxidation and MoCo/PLP cofactor synthesis
rationale: Members cover ingested selenium compound metabolism and methylation, hydrogen sulfide oxidation, cysteine catabolism and prosthetic cofactors (molybdenum cofactor, pyridoxal phosphate), whereas confusables centre on transsulfuration, glutathione and choline/carnitine metabolism.

qualifier: vitamin E handling and hereditary spastic paraplegia defects
name: Oxysterol bile acid synthesis, vitamin E and spastic paraplegia defects
rationale: Members share oxysterol/sterol hydroxylation routes to bile acids and related CYP/transporter defects (CTX, SPG5A, SPG56, SPG42) plus vitamin E metabolism, distinguishing them from bile acid transport/signaling, peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation and cholesterol biosynthesis confusables.

core: Cholesterol catabolism to bile acids via oxysterols
qualifier: with vitamin E handling and spastic paraplegia genes
name: Oxysterol bile acid synthesis, vitamin E handling, spastic paraplegia genes
rationale: Members are oxysterol-route bile acid synthesis and its CYP7B1/CYP27A1/CYP2U1/SLC33A1 disease defects plus vitamin E metabolism and transport, which no confusable (cholesterol synthesis, bile acid transport/signalling, fatty acid oxidation) contains.

qualifier: with vitamin E metabolism and spastic paraplegia defects
name: Oxysterol bile acid synthesis, vitamin E metabolism, spastic paraplegias
rationale: Members are cholesterol catabolism to bile acids via hydroxycholesterols and its CYP defects (CTX, SPG5A, SPG56, SPG42) plus vitamin E metabolism and transport, the latter and the paraplegias absent from the bile acid transport, peroxisomal oxidation and cholesterol synthesis confusables.

qualifier: Ca2+ branch in retinal vasculature and blood-neural barriers
name: Non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling in retinal vasculature and blood-neural barriers
rationale: Members combine WNT5A/Ca2+ non-canonical signaling and FZD internalization with retinal vessel morphogenesis, RPE development and blood-retina/brain barrier formation; the vascular-barrier context separates it from eye-morphogenesis, Wnt-secretion and planar-polarity confusables.

qualifier: in retinal and blood-brain barrier vasculature
name: Non-canonical Wnt-Frizzled signaling in retinal and blood-brain barrier development
rationale: Members cover WNT5A/Ca2+ signaling, Frizzled internalization and FZD4-linked barrier and retinal vessel/RPE development; neighbours carry Wnt secretion, planar polarity or eye morphogenesis.

qualifier: WNT5A/Ca2+ and retinal/brain vascular barrier formation
name: WNT5A-Ca2+ signaling and blood-retinal barrier vascular formation
rationale: Members cover WNT5A-driven Frizzled internalization and Wnt/Ca2+ signaling together with retinal vessel, blood-retina and blood-brain barrier formation; confusables cover eye morphogenesis, Wnt secretion, planar cell polarity or canonical signaling.

name: Monocyte-endothelial adhesion control in synovial inflammation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte activation/aggregation, leukocyte endothelial adhesion and extravasation with synoviocyte proliferation, hyaluronan and MMP secretion, unlike chemotaxis, integrin and cytokine confusables.

qualifier: monocyte activation, adhesion molecule and hyaluronan control
name: Monocyte activation and leukocyte-endothelial adhesion control
rationale: Members regulate monocyte activation/aggregation, leukocyte adhesion to endothelium, extravasation and adhesion-molecule, MMP and hyaluronan output, whereas confusables emphasise chemotaxis, inflammatory cytokines or integrin migration.

qualifier: with synoviocyte proliferation and matrix metalloproteinase control
name: Monocyte activation and endothelial adhesion with synoviocyte proliferation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte activation, aggregation and leukocyte adhesion to endothelium, adhesion-molecule and CXCL2 production, extravasation, and synovial hyaluronan/MMP/synoviocyte responses, the latter separating it from monocyte chemotaxis, integrin diapedesis and inflammatory-cytokine neighbours.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling, cell density sensing and anoikis
rationale: Members concern Hippo pathway and YAP/TAZ transcription with density sensing, anoikis and growth-arrest/cell death outputs, distinct from confusables on senescence, TFAP2, PTK6 or TGF-beta receptor mutants.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling with anoikis and cell death control
rationale: Members are Hippo/YAP-TAZ signaling and cell-density sensing together with anoikis, autophagic cell death and antitumor defense, which the TGF-beta mutant, senescence, PTK6 and AP-2 confusables lack.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling and anoikis regulation
rationale: Members are Hippo pathway, YAP/TAZ transcription and cell-density sensing plus anoikis and autophagic cell death regulation, the latter separating it from confusables sharing the Hippo core with TGF-beta mutants, AP-2, senescence or PTK6.

core: T cell immunological synapse and polarity
qualifier: Vav1–Cdc42 signaling and membrane raft localization
name: T cell polarity and immunological synapse via Vav1–Cdc42 signaling
rationale: Members concern lymphocyte synapse formation, polarity, aggregation and homing driven by CD28–Vav1, Cdc42/Rho and PLC/PKC signaling; confusables emphasise integrin adhesion, antigen presentation or other RHO GTPase effectors.

core: Leukocyte polarization and immunological synapse signaling
name: Vav1-Cdc42 signaling in T cell polarity and immune synapse
rationale: Members cover T cell polarity, immune synapse, lymphocyte aggregation/homing and DC chemotaxis driven by Rho-family GTPase, Vav1 and PLC/PKC signaling; confusables instead emphasize CORO1A-DEF6, integrin adhesion or NADPH oxidase RHO effectors.

core: Lymphocyte polarization and immunological synapse formation
name: Lymphocyte polarity and immunological synapse via Vav1/Cdc42 signaling
rationale: Members cover T cell polarity, synapse and raft localization, lymphocyte homing/aggregation and Rho-family (Vav1, Cdc42, Rhotekin) signaling; the confusables instead emphasise integrin adhesion, CORO1A-DEF6 or NADPH oxidase/RHOH.

name: RUNX3, FOXO and PAX3 transcription of growth-suppressor genes
rationale: Most members are transcriptional programs (RUNX3 on CDKN1A/BIM/p14-ARF, FOXO cell-cycle genes, PTEN transcription, PAX3 targets) controlling proliferation and apoptosis, unlike confusables centered on CDH1, TGF-beta/SMAD or RUNX3-WNT/YAP regulation.

name: Tumor-suppressor gene transcription by RUNX3 and FOXO
rationale: Most members are transcriptional regulation of growth-restraining genes (CDKN1A, p14-ARF, BIM, PTEN, FOXO cell-cycle targets), with RUNX3 and FOXO distinguishing it from CDH1/TGF-beta transcription and RUNX3-WNT/YAP confusables.

name: RUNX3- and FOXO-driven growth-suppressive gene transcription
rationale: Most members are transcriptional control of tumor-suppressive targets (RUNX3 on CDKN1A, BIM and p14-ARF, FOXO cell-cycle genes, PTEN) with PAX3 target modules and ALK/MAPK6-4 nuclear signaling as looser additions; confusables center on CDH1/CDH11 transcription or TGF-beta/SMAD signaling.

name: Plasma cell and B cell immunoglobulin expression signatures
rationale: Nearly all members are naive, memory and plasma B cell surface/immunoglobulin signatures and plasma cell differentiation, contrasting with BCR signaling, B cell proliferation and T cell development confusables; ionomycin response and extrathymic T cell differentiation are minor outliers.

qualifier: naive, memory B cell and plasma cell immunoglobulin
name: B cell and plasma cell surface and immunoglobulin signatures
rationale: Members are naive, memory B cell and plasma cell surface/immunoglobulin expression signatures and plasma cell differentiation, distinct from BCR signalling, germinal centre and T cell confusables.

name: Plasma cell differentiation and immunoglobulin-expressing B cell signatures
rationale: Members are naive/memory B cell and plasma cell signatures, immunoglobulin modules and plasma cell differentiation, distinct from the B cell activation/germinal centre and T cell confusables.

qualifier: presynaptic organization via receptor tyrosine phosphatases and SALMs
name: Synaptic adhesion and presynapse assembly via RPTPs and SALMs
rationale: Members are synaptic adhesion and synapse/presynapse assembly regulation including RPTPs and SALMs, whereas confusables centre on neurexin-neuroligin and postsynaptic receptor/PSD-95 clustering.

qualifier: SALM and receptor tyrosine phosphatase complexes, positive and negative regulation
name: Trans-synaptic adhesion regulating synapse assembly via SALMs and RPTPs
rationale: Members are synaptic adhesion molecules (SALMs, RPTPs), neuron adhesion and pre/postsynaptic assembly with its positive and negative regulation, while confusables are defined by neurexin-neuroligin and receptor/PSD-95 clustering.

name: Receptor phosphatase and SALM trans-synaptic adhesion in synapse assembly
rationale: Members are synaptic adhesion and pre/post-synapse assembly regulation with receptor-type PTPs and SALMs, rather than the neurexin-neuroligin and receptor clustering content of confusables.

name: Xenobiotic, phytochemical and steroid biotransformation
rationale: Members cover cytochrome P450 and sulfonation metabolism of xenobiotics, toxins, plant secondary metabolites (alkaloids, terpenoids, phenylpropanoids, polyketides) and steroids, unlike confusables on acetylation, methylation, CYP2E1 and FMO reactions.

qualifier: CYP oxidation and sulfonation of xenobiotics and plant compounds
name: Xenobiotic and phytochemical biotransformation by CYP oxidation and sulfonation
rationale: Members cover xenobiotic, toxin, alkaloid, terpenoid and steroid metabolism via cytochrome P450 oxidation and cytosolic sulfonation, unlike confusables on FMO oxidation, acetylation/methylation or paracetamol handling.

qualifier: cytochrome P450 oxidation and sulfonation; steroids
name: Xenobiotic and steroid biotransformation by P450 oxidation and sulfonation
rationale: Members cover phase I oxidative (CYP-mediated demethylation, hydroxylation) and sulfonation metabolism of xenobiotics, toxins, terpenoids and steroids, whereas confusables emphasise acetylation, methylation, FMO or specific drugs/mycotoxins.

name: Gonadotropin control of ovarian cycle and testicular development
rationale: Members share LH/FSH secretion and response governing ovulation, luteinization, Leydig/Sertoli development and germ cell proliferation, unlike confusables on oocyte maturation, activin or glycoprotein hormone ligands.

name: Gonadotropin control of ovulation, luteinization and testis development
rationale: Members cover FSH/LH secretion and response, ovarian cycle events and Sertoli/Leydig/seminiferous development, unlike confusables on oocyte maturation and activin signaling.

name: Gonadotropin control of ovulation, luteinization and testis development
rationale: Members link FSH/LH secretion and response to follicle development, ovulation, luteinization and the estrous cycle and to Sertoli, Leydig and germ cell development in the testis, unlike confusables on activin/AMH signaling, antral follicle growth and luteolysis, oocyte maturation or glycoprotein hormone receptors.

qualifier: embryonic heart morphogenesis with BMP signaling
name: Embryonic heart and vascular development with BMP signaling
rationale: Members span heart tube, chamber, valve, septum, conduction system, cardiomyocyte and endocardial development plus vascular/endothelial differentiation and BMP-SMAD signalling, unlike smooth muscle phenotypic switching, gastrulation, HOX patterning and cardiac adaptation confusables.

name: Cardiac chamber, valve and vascular endothelial morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover cardiogenesis, septation, valve and conduction system formation, cardiomyocyte differentiation, BMP signaling and arterial/venous endothelial specification, unlike neighbours on gastrulation, axial patterning, muscle adaptation and smooth muscle phenotypic switching.

qualifier: heart chambers, valves, conduction system and vessels with BMP signalling
name: Heart chamber, valve and blood vessel morphogenesis
rationale: Members span cardiac chamber, septum, valve, endocardial cushion and conduction-system development, cardiomyocyte growth and arterial/venous/lymphatic vessel formation with BMP signalling, unlike smooth-muscle adaptation (C1, C2), gastrulation (C3) and Hox body patterning (C4) neighbours.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I/III, rRNA, snRNA and splicing
name: Nuclear rRNA, snRNA and pre-mRNA transcription and processing
rationale: Members span Pol I/III transcription, rRNA processing, snRNP assembly, splicing, histone mRNA processing and nuclear RNA decay, distinguishing them from mRNA export, RNA modification and translation initiation neighbours.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I-III transcription with rRNA, snRNA and mRNA processing
name: Nuclear RNA polymerase I-III transcription and RNA processing
rationale: Members are Pol I, II and III transcription, rRNA and snRNA maturation, splicing, 3'-end processing and nuclear RNA decay, unlike translation initiation, mRNA export and RNA modification confusables.

qualifier: Pol I/III rRNA and small RNA transcription plus splicing
name: Nuclear transcription and processing of rRNA, small RNAs and pre-mRNA
rationale: Members span Pol I and Pol III transcription, pre-rRNA processing, snRNA/snRNP biogenesis, splicing, histone mRNA 3' processing and nuclear RNA decay, whereas confusables concern mRNA export, rRNA modification or cytoplasmic translation initiation.

name: Neurotransmitter synthesis, vesicular release and reuptake
rationale: Members concern synthesis, vesicular loading, toxin-sensitive release, reuptake and degradation of monoamines, GABA, glutamate, glycine and acetylcholine, distinguishing them from dopamine receptor signaling/behavior and cholinergic neuromuscular neighbours.

qualifier: synthesis, vesicular release and reuptake across transmitter classes
name: Neurotransmitter synthesis, vesicular release and reuptake
rationale: Members are synthesis, vesicle loading, toxin-sensitive release, reuptake and degradation of GABA, glutamate, monoamines and acetylcholine, distinct from receptor signaling, NMJ and sympathoadrenal development confusables.

qualifier: amino acid, monoamine and cholinergic transmitters
name: Neurotransmitter synthesis, vesicular release, reuptake and degradation
rationale: Members cover synthesis, vesicle loading, clostridial-toxin-sensitive release, SLC reuptake and catabolism of GABA, glutamate, glycine, monoamines and acetylcholine, unlike confusables limited to catecholaminergic development, dopamine receptor behaviour or cholinergic NMJ transmission.

qualifier: skin, melanocyte pigmentation and intestinal epithelium
name: Skin, pigment cell and intestinal epithelial differentiation

core: Surface epithelial and pigment cell differentiation
qualifier: epidermal keratinocyte, MITF-driven melanocyte and intestinal absorptive epithelium

qualifier: catecholamine and serotonin metabolism, drug-reward behavior

qualifier: catecholamine and serotonin metabolism, reuptake and psychostimulant response

qualifier: synthesis, reuptake, catabolism and dopamine receptor signaling

rationale: Members cover catecholamine/serotonin biosynthesis, vesicular loading, SLC6 reuptake, MAO/COMT degradation and dopamine receptor signaling with drug-response behaviours, distinguishing it from cholinergic, amino-acid transmitter, neuropeptide and addiction-only confusables.

name: Epithelial and endothelial cell-cell junctions, polarity and EMT
rationale: Members are adherens, tight, desmosome and hemidesmosome junctions, cadherin adhesion, apical/basal polarity, barrier and EMT, unlike mechanosensing, ECM/integrin, leading-edge and cornification confusables.

qualifier: cadherin adherens/tight/desmosomal junctions, apical-basal polarity and EMT

qualifier: cadherin and tight junctions, apicobasal polarity and EMT
name: Epithelial cell-cell junctions, apicobasal polarity and EMT
rationale: Members are adherens, tight, desmosome and hemidesmosome junctions, cadherin adhesion, apical-basal polarity, barrier function and EMT, unlike basement membrane/integrin, mechanosensing, cornified envelope and Rho GTPase migration confusables.

name: DNA double-strand break repair by recombination and end joining
rationale: Members span break sensing, resection, homologous recombination (including BRCA1/2/PALB2 defects), NHEJ, SSA and MMEJ with ADP-ribosylation control, unlike confusables on replication fork, telomere and checkpoint processes.

qualifier: HR/NHEJ pathway choice, BRCA defects and ADP-ribosylation
name: Double-strand break repair, BRCA defects and ADP-ribosylation
rationale: Members cover sensing, resection and repair of double-strand breaks by HR, NHEJ, SSA and MMEJ, BRCA1/2-PALB2 defects and PARP-mediated ADP-ribosylation, unlike confusables centred on telomere maintenance, fork reversal or strand invasion.

name: Double-strand break repair, ADP-ribosylation and BRCA defects
rationale: Members span break sensing, resection, HR, NHEJ, SSA and MMEJ pathway regulation, PARP ADP-ribosylation and BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 loss-of-function variants, which the replication-fork, recombination-intermediate and telomere confusables lack.

qualifier: histone and DNA methylation, acetylation and BAF remodeling complexes
name: Histone and DNA modification and chromatin remodeling complexes

qualifier: histone and DNA methylation, acetylation and BAF remodeling
name: Histone modification, DNA methylation and BAF chromatin remodeling
rationale: Members are histone and protein methylation/acetylation, DNA methylation-based silencing (imprinting, X inactivation) and BAF/CHD/NuRD remodeling complexes, beyond the confusables' nucleosome assembly, SUMOylation or single-factor regulation.

qualifier: histone and DNA methylation/acetylation and BAF/CHD remodeling
name: Histone and DNA modification and chromatin remodeling complexes
rationale: Most members concern histone methylation/acetylation/deacetylation, DNA methylation, imprinting and X inactivation, and BAF/CHD/NuRD remodelers, unlike confusables centred on SUMOylation, retroelement silencing, nucleosome assembly or TFAP2.

name: RUNX1-directed myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocyte lineage differentiation
rationale: Members cover granulocyte, monocyte, mast cell, erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation and their RUNX1/RUNX2/RUNX3 transcriptional control, whereas confusables centre on stem cell homeostasis, erythrocyte maturation or non-haematopoietic RUNX1 targets.

name: Myeloid lineage differentiation under RUNX transcriptional control
rationale: Members cover granulocyte, monocyte, mast cell, erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation and the RUNX1/2/3 transcriptional programs that drive them, unlike confusables centred on stem-cell homeostasis, erythrocyte maturation or non-haematopoietic RUNX1 targets.

name: Myeloid lineage commitment under RUNX transcriptional control
rationale: Members cover granulocyte, megakaryocyte, erythroid, mast cell and monocyte differentiation plus RUNX1/2/3 target programmes, unlike confusables centred on HSC maintenance or non-haematopoietic RUNX1 targets.

qualifier: progenitor division and radial glia-guided migration
name: Brain progenitor division and radial glia-guided neuronal migration
rationale: Members span forebrain/midbrain/cerebellar progenitor division, radial glia, cortical layering and neuronal migration; unlike confusables (spinal cord patterning, reelin/dendrites, dopaminergic or pituitary development) it centres on neural progenitor division and guided migration.

qualifier: progenitor division, neuronal migration and cortical layering
name: Brain progenitor division, neuronal migration and cortical layering
rationale: Members span forebrain, midbrain and cerebellar neural progenitor division, radial glia, neuronal migration and cortical/cerebellar layer formation, unlike confusables centred on pituitary/forebrain morphogenesis, reelin-dendrite signaling, dopaminergic differentiation or spinal cord patterning.

qualifier: forebrain and cerebellar progenitor division and layering
name: Brain progenitor division, neuronal migration and layer formation
rationale: Members cover neural progenitor proliferation, radial/tangential neuronal migration and layer formation in cortex, cerebellum and other brain regions, unlike the spinal cord, reelin/dendrite or dopaminergic neighbours.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to RAS and PI3K
name: MET-centred receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to RAS and PI3K
rationale: Members are RTK adaptor cascades (SHC/SOS/IRS/PI3K/PLCG/STAT3) dominated by HGF-MET plus EPO, IGF1R, ALK and LTK; the MET members distinguish it from ERBB and cytokine-receptor confusables.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to RAS and PI3K/AKT
qualifier: centered on MET, with erythropoietin and IGF1R adaptors
name: MET-centered tyrosine kinase signaling to RAS and PI3K
rationale: Members are RTK/cytokine-receptor adaptor cascades (SHC, SOS, IRS, PLCG) feeding RAS-ERK and PI3K-AKT, dominated by MET/HGF signaling, which separates it from ERBB, EPO-STAT5 and AKT2 neighbours.

core: Growth factor receptor tyrosine signaling to RAS and PI3K
qualifier: MET/HGF-centred, with EPO, IGF1R/IRS and ALK/LTK inputs

qualifier: peptide and nutrient GPCRs, gut motility
name: Appetite and gut motility control by peptide/nutrient GPCRs

qualifier: peptide-hormone and nutrient GPCR signaling, GI motility
name: Feeding regulation, gut motility and nutrient/peptide-hormone GPCR signaling
rationale: Members cover appetite and food intake, GI smooth muscle and gastric secretion, and GPCRs for calcitonin/amylin, glucagon, relaxin, somatostatin and fatty acids; confusables emphasize GH, prolactin, leptin and glucocorticoid axes.

qualifier: via cAMP-coupled peptide and nutrient GPCRs
name: Gut-brain feeding control via cAMP-coupled peptide and nutrient GPCRs
rationale: Members span appetite, gastric secretion and motility, ghrelin and leptin, and glucagon, calcitonin/amylin, relaxin and nutrient-sensing GPCRs with cAMP signaling, whereas confusables centre on growth hormone, prolactin and glucocorticoid axes.

core: Axon growth and regeneration with glial myelination
qualifier: collateral sprouting and injury regeneration plus myelin formation
name: Axon regeneration, collateral sprouting and glial myelination
rationale: Members combine axon growth/regeneration and sprouting with myelination and glial responses, distinguishing it from Sema3A guidance confusables (no myelin) and node or glial-fate confusables (no regeneration).

qualifier: axon regeneration, collateral sprouting and myelination
name: Axon regeneration, collateral sprouting and myelination
rationale: Members combine regulation of axon regeneration and collateral sprouting (including axonal growth inhibition/stimulation) with CNS and PNS myelin formation and maintenance and glial responses, setting it apart from nodal-domain, Sema3A axon-guidance and glial-fate neighbours.

qualifier: axon sprouting and regeneration combined with myelination
name: Axon sprouting, regeneration and glial myelination
rationale: Members span axon growth inhibition/stimulation, collateral and injury-induced sprouting, regeneration and CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance by glia; confusables cover only Sema3A axon guidance, nodal adhesion, or glial fate without the regeneration plus myelination combination.

qualifier: chemotaxis, respiratory burst and degranulation control
name: Neutrophil chemotaxis, respiratory burst and degranulation control
rationale: Members concern regulation of neutrophil recruitment (formyl peptide receptors, granulocyte chemotaxis), superoxide/respiratory burst and degranulation, distinguishing it from microbial killing, Fc-receptor, chemokine-production and extravasation confusables.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor-driven recruitment, respiratory burst and degranulation
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil recruitment, respiratory burst and degranulation
rationale: Members cover formyl peptide receptor and complement signaling, granulocyte chemotaxis control, respiratory burst, degranulation and myeloid inflammatory modules; the FPR-mediated recruitment plus oxidative burst combination separates it from extravasation, microbial killing, chemokine production and Fc receptor confusables.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor-driven recruitment and respiratory burst
name: Neutrophil recruitment and respiratory burst with formyl peptide receptors
rationale: Members concern granulocyte chemotaxis, formyl peptide receptor signalling, respiratory burst, degranulation and myeloid inflammatory modules; confusables cover microbial killing, extravasation, chemokine production or Fc receptor signalling.

name: Bone and dental tissue mineralization and osteoclast remodeling
rationale: Members span bone, dentin, enamel and cementum mineralization with osteoclast differentiation/resorption and mineral-regulating signals (PTH, FGF23-Klotho), whereas confusables centre on IGF responses or sodium-phosphate transport.

name: Bone and tooth mineralization, osteoclast remodeling and odontogenesis
rationale: Members span bone, enamel, dentin and cementum mineralization, osteoclast regulation and odontogenesis, distinguishing it from confusables on phosphate transporters or IGF responses.

name: Bone and tooth mineralization and osteoclast remodeling
rationale: Members span bone, dentin, enamel and cementum mineralisation, odontogenesis, osteoclast differentiation and resorption and their PTH/FGF23-Klotho/phosphate controls, versus confusables on phosphate transporters or IGF responses.

name: Sphingolipid metabolism and non-vesicular lipid transfer at ER contacts
rationale: Members cover sphingolipid/ceramide synthesis, catabolism and homeostasis plus intermembrane lipid transfer and ER tethering, distinct from glycerophospholipid remodelling, lysosomal glycosphingolipid and vesicular Golgi confusables.

qualifier: non-vesicular lipid transfer at ER contact sites
name: Sphingolipid metabolism and non-vesicular lipid transfer at ER contacts
rationale: Members span sphingomyelin/ceramide synthesis and catabolism plus lipid-transfer-protein movement of glycolipids, C1P and PI/PC at ER tethering sites, unlike Golgi vesicle traffic, lysosomal glycosphingolipid or glycerophospholipid synthesis confusables.

name: Sphingolipid metabolism and ER contact-site lipid transfer
rationale: Members cover sphingolipid/ceramide synthesis, catabolism and homeostasis plus non-vesicular lipid transfer and ER-plasma membrane tethering, distinguishing it from glycerophospholipid, lysosomal glycosphingolipid and Golgi vesicle traffic neighbours.

qualifier: telomerase recruitment, capping and recombination suppression
name: Telomerase recruitment, telomere capping and recombination suppression
rationale: Members cover telomerase assembly and Cajal body trafficking, telomere capping and ATRX/DAXX inhibition of telomeric recombination, versus confusables on C-strand synthesis and replication-based maintenance.

name: Telomere maintenance by telomerase, capping and recombination control
rationale: Members concern telomerase assembly and Cajal body trafficking, telomere capping, and suppression of telomeric recombination, while confusables focus on C-strand synthesis and replication-associated telomere maintenance.

qualifier: capping, telomerase Cajal body recruitment and recombination suppression
name: Telomere capping, telomerase recruitment and recombination suppression
rationale: Members address telomerase assembly/Cajal body trafficking, telomere capping and suppression of recombination/NHEJ at telomeres, unlike confusables centred on C-strand replication and D-loop disassembly.

name: Deubiquitinases, neddylation and proteasome assembly
rationale: Members cover deubiquitinase families and chain-specific deubiquitination, neddylation/COP9 and proteasome assembly, which the confusables (E3 ligation and chain-type ubiquitination, NF-kappaB regulation) lack.

name: Proteasome assembly, deubiquitination and cullin neddylation
rationale: Members span proteasome assembly, DUB families and linkage-specific deubiquitination, and NEDD8/COP9 signalosome control of cullins; confusables centre on E3 ligation and ubiquitin chain types or NF-kappaB regulation.

qualifier: deubiquitinases, neddylation cycle and proteasome assembly
name: Deubiquitination, neddylation and proteasome assembly
rationale: Members combine DUB families and chain-specific deubiquitination with neddylation/COP9 deneddylation and proteasome assembly, which the neighbours (NF-kB regulation, ubiquitin chain synthesis) lack.

core: Viral genome replication and host restriction
qualifier: coronavirus replicase and APOBEC cytidine deamination
name: Coronavirus replication-transcription and APOBEC cytidine-deamination antiviral restriction
rationale: Members combine SARS-CoV replicase translation, capping and genome replication with APOBEC3G/editosome cytidine deamination restricting viruses; the cytidine-deamination arm separates it from viral translation confusables and from ADAR A-to-I editing.

core: Viral RNA replication and host restriction
qualifier: coronavirus replicase and APOBEC3G cytidine deamination
name: Coronavirus RNA replication and APOBEC3G cytidine-deamination restriction

name: Coronavirus genome replication and APOBEC3G cytidine deaminase restriction
rationale: Members combine SARS-CoV replicase translation, frameshifting, capping and host translation modulation with host restriction by APOBEC3G C-to-U editing/deamination and foreign nucleic acid clearance; the APOBEC3G arm separates it from viral-translation confusables and the coronavirus arm from the ADAR A-to-I editing confusable.

qualifier: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase lipoylation and Fe-S cluster assembly
name: TCA cycle, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase lipoylation and Fe-S assembly

qualifier: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes, lipoylation and Fe-S cluster assembly
name: TCA cycle, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases, lipoylation and Fe-S clusters
rationale: Members cover TCA cycle reactions, OGDH/PDH/OADH complexes and their lipoyl and Fe-S cofactor maturation, distinct from confusables on CoA/pantothenate biosynthesis and PDH regulation or vitamin B6 and serine metabolism.

qualifier: lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and Fe-S cluster assembly
name: TCA cycle with lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and Fe-S clusters
rationale: Members cover TCA cycle intermediates, PDH/OGDH/OADH complexes with protein lipoylation and DLD defects, lysine and glycine catabolism, and Fe-S cluster assembly for TCA enzymes, whereas confusables add coenzyme A/pantothenate synthesis and PDH regulation or vitamin B6 and serine metabolism.

core: Ribosome biogenesis and nuclear RNA processing
qualifier: pre-rRNA cleavage and exosome-mediated RNA surveillance
name: Pre-rRNA processing and exosome-mediated nuclear RNA surveillance
rationale: Members span pre-rRNA cleavage, trimming and 2'-O-methylation, ribosome assembly and RNA exosome 3'-5' decay/surveillance of mRNA, snRNA, snoRNA and tRNA, unlike confusables on RNA base methylation, tRNA processing or telomerase/Cajal body RNA.

core: Ribosome biogenesis and nuclear RNA processing
qualifier: pre-rRNA cleavage and exosome RNA surveillance
name: Pre-rRNA processing and exosome-mediated nuclear RNA surveillance
rationale: Members are pre-rRNA cleavage/trimming and methylation, snoRNA/snRNA 3'-end processing and exosome-mediated nuclear RNA decay; confusables are RNA base modification, tRNA processing or telomerase/Cajal body functions.

name: Pre-rRNA processing and exosome-mediated nuclear RNA surveillance
rationale: Members cover pre-rRNA cleavage, trimming and modification for ribosome assembly plus exosome-mediated 3'-5' decay and surveillance of mRNA, snRNA, snoRNA and tRNA, distinguished from tRNA processing, RNA methylation and Cajal body/telomerase confusables.

name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell engulfment

name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell engulfment

name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell clearance

qualifier: retinal neurons, photoreceptors, lens and anterior eye

qualifier: retinal neurons, photoreceptors, lens and anterior segment
name: Eye development: retinal neurons, photoreceptors, lens, anterior segment
rationale: Members build eye tissues (retinal layers and neurons, photoreceptors, lens, cornea, iris, eyelid, optic cup), distinguishing it from confusables about phototransduction/retinoids, retinal vasculature, optic nerve or lacrimal gland.

qualifier: photoreceptors, retinal neurons, lens and anterior segment
name: Eye morphogenesis and photoreceptor, retinal neuron and lens development
rationale: Members build retinal neurons, photoreceptor outer segments, lens, cornea, iris and eyelid, distinct from the phototransduction/retinoid and retinal-vasculature confusables.
