qualifier: NOD1/2 and TLR2/4/5 recognition of cell-wall ligands
name: NOD1/2 and TLR2/4/5 sensing of bacterial cell-wall ligands
rationale: Members cover NOD1/2, peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide, LPS, lipoteichoic acid and lipopeptide responses and MyD88/IRAK4 deficiency in TLR2/4/5 signalling, unlike confusables on endogenous TLR ligands, IPAF inflammasome or TAK1/ALPK1 kinases.

name: Bacterial ligand sensing by NOD1/2 and TLR-MyD88/IRAK4
rationale: Members respond to peptidoglycan, muramyl dipeptide, lipopeptides, LPS and flagellin via NOD1/2 and TLR2/4/5 with MyD88/IRAK4 deficiencies; confusables cover TAK1-MAPK, LPS detection with chemotaxis, or the IPAF inflammasome.

name: Glucagon, insulin and adiponectin control of glucose homeostasis
rationale: Members concern glucagon-PKA signalling, gluconeogenesis, insulin responsiveness, glucose import and adiponectin, unlike confusables on lipolysis, ChREBP glucose sensing, glycogen/glucokinase or proximal insulin receptor signalling.

name: Glucagon, adiponectin and insulin-sensitivity control of glucose homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate gluconeogenesis, glucose uptake and insulin responsiveness through glucagon-PKA, adiponectin, AMPK and caloric restriction, unlike confusables on glycogen/glucokinase, lipolysis, ChREBP glucose sensing or proximal insulin receptor-GLUT4 signalling.

name: Glucagon and adiponectin regulation of glucose homeostasis
rationale: Members cover glucagon/PKA signalling, adiponectin, insulin sensitivity, gluconeogenesis and glucose import control, unlike confusables on proximal insulin receptor-AKT-GLUT4 signalling, glycogen/glucokinase, triglyceride lipolysis or ChREBP sugar sensing.

core: Cytoskeletal remodelling of dendrites and synapses
qualifier: dendrite arborization, filopodia and postsynaptic structure
name: Cytoskeletal control of dendrite arborization and postsynaptic structure
rationale: Members regulate actin/microtubule organisation underlying dendrite branching, filopodia and postsynaptic density structure (incl. EPHB and RHO GTPase signalling), whereas confusables emphasise NMDAR-RAC1, BDNF-NTRK2, reelin signalling and synaptic plasticity.

qualifier: Rho GTPase and EPHB signalling, filopodia
name: Rho/EPHB cytoskeletal control of dendrite and postsynapse structure
rationale: Members regulate actin/microtubule organisation shaping dendrite arborization, spines, filopodia and postsynaptic structure via RHO GTPases and EPHB, whereas confusables add NMDAR-RAC1, reelin, BDNF-TRK and synaptic plasticity.

core: Dendrite and postsynaptic actin cytoskeleton organisation
name: Actin cytoskeletal shaping of dendrites, spines and filopodia
rationale: Members regulate dendrite arborization, spine and postsynaptic actin structure and filopodium assembly via Rho/EphB signalling, while confusables emphasise synaptic plasticity, NMDAR-RAC1, reelin or BDNF signalling.

qualifier: planar cell polarity, convergent extension and Wnt ligand secretion
name: Non-canonical Wnt/PCP convergent extension and Wnt ligand secretion
rationale: Members cover Wnt/PCP and Wnt/Ca2+ signalling, convergent extension and epithelial planar polarity with PORCN-dependent Wnt biogenesis and secretion, distinguishing it from Nodal left-right, Hedgehog and axial mesoderm confusables.

qualifier: planar cell polarity and Ca2+ branches with Wnt ligand secretion
name: Non-canonical Wnt/PCP and Ca2+ signaling with Wnt ligand secretion
rationale: Members cover PCP, convergent extension, Wnt/Ca2+ signalling and Wnt biogenesis/PORCN secretion, which the axial mesoderm, Hedgehog and left-right confusables lack.

qualifier: planar cell polarity, convergent extension and Wnt secretion
name: Non-canonical Wnt/PCP signaling, convergent extension and Wnt secretion
rationale: Members cover planar cell polarity, Wnt/Ca2+ signaling, convergent extension and Wnt ligand biogenesis/secretion, while confusables centre on hedgehog, axial mesoderm/neural plate patterning or left-right asymmetry.

name: Cadherin-based adherens junction assembly, turnover and EMT
rationale: Members concern cadherin-mediated cell-cell adhesion, adherens junction assembly, CDH1/CDH11 regulation and degradation and EMT, distinct from tight junctions (C1) and the desmosome/polarity content of C2-C4.

qualifier: E-cadherin assembly, turnover and EMT regulation
name: Cadherin adherens junction assembly and E-cadherin turnover
rationale: Members concern calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion, adherens junction assembly and CDH1/CDH11 regulation, degradation and EMT, unlike tight-junction, desmosome/hemidesmosome and apical-basal polarity confusables.

name: Cadherin adherens junction assembly, turnover and EMT control
rationale: Members concern calcium-dependent cadherin (CDH1, CDH11) cell-cell adhesion, adherens junction assembly, CDH1 trafficking/degradation/cleavage and EMT regulation, distinguishing it from epithelial polarity/desmosome and tight junction barrier confusables.

name: TCA cycle and lipoyl and iron-sulfur cofactor assembly
rationale: Members are TCA cycle reactions with protein lipoylation and Fe-S cluster assembly maturing TCA enzymes, distinguishing them from confusables on PDH/coenzyme A, the malate-aspartate shuttle and lysine/glycine catabolism.

qualifier: Fe-S cluster and lipoyl cofactor assembly
name: TCA cycle with Fe-S cluster and lipoyl cofactor assembly
rationale: Members cover TCA intermediates, OGDH, succinate dehydrogenase and NADPH-producing isocitrate metabolism together with Fe-S cluster assembly and protein lipoylation that mature TCA enzymes, distinct from confusables on PDH/CoA synthesis, malate-aspartate shuttle or lysine/glycine catabolism.

qualifier: Fe-S cluster and lipoyl cofactor maturation
name: TCA cycle with Fe-S cluster and lipoyl cofactor assembly
rationale: Members cover TCA intermediates, OGDH and succinate dehydrogenase steps plus the Fe-S cluster assembly and protein lipoylation that mature TCA enzymes, distinguishing it from PDH/CoA, malate-aspartate shuttle and other DLD-complex confusables.

name: tRNA modification, aminoacylation and RNA pseudouridylation
rationale: Members cover tRNA base modifications, cytosolic and mitochondrial aminoacylation for translational fidelity and pseudouridine synthesis, unlike confusables centred on tRNA end-processing/splicing or selenocysteine and translation termination.

qualifier: anticodon-loop modification and RNA pseudouridylation for translational fidelity
name: tRNA modification, RNA pseudouridylation and aminoacylation
rationale: Members cover tRNA anticodon-loop modifications (t6A, wybutosine, wobble), RNA pseudouridylation and methylation, and cytosolic and mitochondrial aminoacylation for fidelity, unlike confusables centred on tRNA end processing, splicing and translation-factor modification.

name: tRNA modification and aminoacylation for translational fidelity
rationale: Members cover tRNA base modifications (wobble, wybutosine, t6A, pseudouridine, methylation) and cytosolic/mitochondrial aminoacylation for translational fidelity, unlike confusables centred on tRNA end processing and splicing, selenocysteine or translation termination.

name: Translation initiation and its regulation by cellular stress
rationale: Members cover ternary/43S complex formation, scanning, 60S joining and eIF2 recycling plus GCN2- and ER-stress control of translation, which confusables (termination, NMD, ribosome rescue, RNA polymerase I/III) lack.

name: Translation initiation and stress-induced translational control
rationale: Members are 43S/48S assembly, scanning, eIF2 recycling and 60S joining plus GCN2 and ER-stress control of initiation, distinct from rRNA transcription and from translation termination, mRNA decay and ribosome quality control.

qualifier: stress control via eIF2 and GCN2
name: Translation initiation and its stress-responsive eIF2 control
rationale: Members cover 43S/48S formation, scanning, 60S joining, eIF2 recycling and GCN2/ER-stress translational control, which termination/NMD and rRNA transcription neighbours lack.

qualifier: UDP-sugar synthesis, Golgi transport and N-glycan trimming
name: UDP-sugar synthesis and Golgi transport for N-glycan processing

name: UDP-sugar synthesis and transport for N-glycan processing
rationale: Members cover UDP-GlcNAc/glucose/glucuronate synthesis, SLC35 nucleotide-sugar transport and N-glycan trimming, distinct from sialic acid/GPI, dolichol-ALG CDG and O-glycan/antennae confusables.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar synthesis and SLC35 transport, N-glycan trimming
name: Nucleotide-sugar supply and transport for N-glycan processing
rationale: Members synthesize UDP-sugars (UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-glucose, UDP-glucuronate, Dol-P-Glc), transport them into the Golgi (SLC35A1-3) and process/trim N-glycans (MOGS, MAN1B1); confusables center on GPI anchors, dolichol/mannose CDGs, sialic acid or O-glycan/fucose synthesis.

qualifier: cytokine inhibition and regulatory T cell differentiation
name: Negative regulation of T cell cytokines and Treg differentiation
rationale: Members mostly restrain T cell activation, proliferation and cytokine output (IL-2, IL-21, IFN-gamma, IL-6, IL-10) and control Treg/Th17 differentiation, unlike confusables on innate cytokine suppression, tolerance induction or NK/T cytotoxic activation.

qualifier: cytokine production, proliferation and Treg differentiation
name: T cell suppression: cytokines, proliferation and Treg differentiation
rationale: Members restrain T cell activation, proliferation and cytokine output (IL-2, IFN-gamma, IL-10, IL-21) and regulate Treg differentiation, unlike confusables on T cell signaling/Th1, tolerance induction, innate inflammatory cytokines or NK cells.

qualifier: proliferation, cytokine output and regulatory T cell differentiation
name: T cell proliferation, cytokine and Treg differentiation control
rationale: Members predominantly restrain T cell activation, proliferation and cytokine (IL-2, IFN-gamma, IL-6, IL-10, IL-21) production and regulate Treg/Th17 differentiation, unlike neighbours on innate cytokine/TLR suppression, tolerance induction or NK cytotoxicity.

name: HSF1 heat shock response and AKT-regulated FOXO transcription
rationale: Members combine the HSF1 heat shock response and protein refolding with AKT/acetylation control of FOXO transcription; confusables are NFE2L2, ER UPR or p53/mTORC1 programs without HSF1.

qualifier: FOXO regulation and HSF1 heat shock response
name: FOXO and HSF1 transcriptional responses to heat and oxidative stress

rationale: Members span primordial germ cell migration, germ cell proliferation/death and meiotic entry, the Sertoli barrier, and sperm mitochondrial sheath assembly and motility; the motility/midpiece members separate it from gonad and oocyte confusables, and germline development from axoneme-assembly and fertilization confusables.

name: Fc-gamma receptor signalling in ADCC and hypersensitivity
rationale: Members are FCGR activation, inhibitory/stimulatory Fc signalling, ADCC and type I/II/IV hypersensitivity and antigen-driven acute inflammation, distinct from FCGR phagocytosis and Fc-epsilon mast cell confusables.

name: Fc receptor signaling in hypersensitivity and antibody cytotoxicity
rationale: Members share Fc-gamma receptor activation and inhibitory/stimulatory Fc signaling driving ADCC, hypersensitivity types I, II and IV and acute antigen-driven inflammation, unlike confusables centred on FCGR-mediated phagocytosis or mast-cell FcεRI signaling.

name: Fc-gamma receptor signaling, ADCC and hypersensitivity
rationale: Members are Fc-gamma receptor activating/inhibitory signaling, antibody-dependent cytotoxicity and antibody-driven hypersensitivity/acute inflammation, distinct from the Fc-epsilon mast cell and Fc-gamma phagocytosis confusables.

qualifier: gastric secretion, gut motility and itch
name: Histamine signalling in gastric secretion, gut motility and itch
rationale: Members cover histamine metabolism, receptors and responses in gastric acid secretion, GI smooth muscle, stomach development, itch and TRP channels, unlike serotonin, acetylcholine and tachykinin smooth-muscle confusables.

qualifier: histamine signalling, TRP channels and itch
name: Histamine signalling in gastric secretion, gut motility and itch
rationale: Members share histamine receptors and metabolism, TRP channels, gastric acid secretion, GI smooth muscle contraction and itch, whereas confusables involve serotonin, tachykinin, muscarinic or urinary smooth muscle.

qualifier: histamine signaling, TRP channels and itch
name: Histamine signaling in gastric secretion, gut motility and itch
rationale: Members link histamine metabolism, receptors and response to gastric acid secretion, GI smooth-muscle contraction and itch via TRP channels, while neighbours centre on serotonin, tachykinin, muscarinic or urinary smooth-muscle control.

qualifier: lipid droplet formation and glycerolipid synthesis regulation in adipogenesis
name: Adipogenic lipid droplet formation and glycerolipid synthesis regulation
rationale: Members cover lipid droplet formation/fusion, triglyceride and phospholipid synthesis regulation, fatty acid homeostasis and adipogenesis, whereas confusables emphasize lipolysis, lipophagy and triglyceride catabolism or biosynthetic enzymes.

core: Lipid droplet biogenesis and triglyceride storage
name: Lipid droplet biogenesis and triglyceride storage in adipogenesis
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation and fusion, triglyceride and phospholipid synthesis regulation and adipocyte programs, whereas confusables carry lipophagy, droplet disassembly and triglyceride catabolism.

name: Lipid droplet biogenesis and adipocyte triglyceride storage
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation and fusion, triglyceride and phospholipid synthesis regulation and adipogenesis/leptin, whereas confusables emphasize lipophagy, droplet disassembly and triglyceride catabolism.

name: Proteasome assembly, antigen processing and PD-L1 degradation
rationale: Members centre on the proteasome and its assembly, proteasomal antigen processing for CD8 T cells and PD-L1 glycosylation/degradation; PD-L1 turnover distinguishes it from the Nef/Vpu and MHC class I loading neighbours.

core: Proteasomal degradation in antitumor T-cell immunity
name: Proteasome assembly and PD-L1 turnover in antitumor immunity
rationale: Members combine proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-independent proteasomal degradation with PD-L1 glycosylation/degradation and CD8 T-cell antitumor responses, whereas confusables centre on MHC-I peptide loading or HIV Nef/Vpu degradation.

qualifier: PD-L1 turnover and antitumor T cell response
name: Proteasome function and PD-L1 turnover in antitumor immunity
rationale: Members combine proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-independent proteolysis with PD-L1 glycosylation and degradation and CD8 T cell antitumor responses; the PD-L1 and antitumor members are absent from the MHC class I loading and Nef/Vpu degradation confusables.

name: Proteasome assembly and degron-directed proteasomal degradation
rationale: Members centre on the proteasome, its assembly and N-end/C-end degron and ubiquitin-independent degradation, whereas confusables concern ubiquitin chain types, deubiquitinases, ERAD or aggrephagy.

name: Proteasome assembly and degron-directed proteasomal degradation
rationale: Members concern proteasome assembly, N-end/C-end degron and ubiquitin-independent proteasomal catabolism (two untitled BTM modules attached), whereas confusables cover ubiquitin chain linkage/deubiquitination or misfolded-protein quality control and autophagy.

name: Proteasome assembly and degron-directed proteasomal degradation
rationale: Members center on proteasome assembly, structure and N-/C-degron or ubiquitin-independent proteasomal catabolism, whereas confusables cover ubiquitination, DUBs, ERAD and autophagy.

name: APC/C-Cdc20 control of metaphase-anaphase transition
rationale: Members describe APC/C-Cdc20 activity, its regulation and degradation of securin, cyclin B and Nek2A at metaphase-anaphase and mitotic exit, unlike spindle/cohesion confusables and APC/C-Cdh1 late mitosis confusables.

name: APC/C-Cdc20 activity at metaphase-anaphase transition
rationale: Members are APC/C-Cdc20 activation, inhibition and degradation of securin, cyclin B and Nek2A driving anaphase and mitotic exit, unlike confusables on APC/C-Cdh1 in late mitosis/G1 or spindle checkpoint and cohesion.

name: APC/C-Cdc20 control of metaphase-anaphase transition and mitotic exit
rationale: Members describe APC/C-Cdc20 activity, its inhibition and substrate degradation driving anaphase onset and mitotic exit, distinct from APC/C-Cdh1, spindle checkpoint and cytokinesis confusables.

qualifier: surface signature, positive chemotaxis and extravasation
name: Monocyte surface identity, activation and positive recruitment
rationale: Members describe monocyte surface/differentiation signatures, activation, aggregation and promotion of chemotaxis and extravasation, distinguishing it from generic myeloid modules and from confusables centered on negative regulation of monocyte/macrophage recruitment.

name: Monocyte surface signature, activation and recruitment
rationale: Members cover monocyte surface/receptor signatures, activation, aggregation, differentiation and positive regulation of monocyte chemotaxis/extravasation, unlike confusables dominated by negative regulation of monocyte chemotaxis, inflammatory cytokines or broad myeloid modules.

name: Monocyte surface identity, activation and recruitment
rationale: Members describe monocyte surface signatures, differentiation, activation, aggregation, chemotaxis and extravasation, whereas confusables emphasise broader myeloid modules or macrophage chemotaxis and inflammatory cytokines.

name: Canonical Wnt signaling at ligand secretion and receptor level
rationale: Members cover Wnt ligand biogenesis/PORCN, FZD ubiquitination by RNF43, LRP5, DVL activation and ligand antagonists, upstream of the destruction-complex/TCF and non-canonical calcium confusables.

name: Wnt ligand secretion and receptor-level canonical signalling control
rationale: Members cover Wnt biogenesis/secretion (PORCN), FZD ubiquitination (RNF43), LRP5, DVL activation and destruction complex disassembly, unlike confusables centred on AXIN/DVL degradation and TCF transcription or non-canonical calcium signalling.

name: Canonical Wnt ligand secretion and receptor-level regulation
rationale: Members cover PORCN-dependent Wnt biogenesis and secretion, FZD ubiquitination by RNF43, LRP5, DVL activation and ligand antagonists, unlike neighbours on the destruction complex, TCF/beta-catenin transcription or non-canonical Ca2+ Wnt.

name: Proximal insulin/IGF1 receptor signaling via IRS and SHC
rationale: Members cover IRS and SHC/SOS activation, AKT2, signal attenuation and regulation of glycogen synthesis and glucose import, lacking the GLUT4 translocation and adiponectin members of confusables.

qualifier: proximal IRS/SHC adaptors to AKT2 and glycogen
name: Proximal insulin/IGF1 receptor signalling via IRS, SHC and AKT2
rationale: Members are insulin/IGF1 receptor adaptor signalling (IRS, SHC, SOS, AKT2) and its effects on glycogen and glucose uptake, distinguishing it from generic PI3K/AKT and GLUT4/adiponectin confusables.

qualifier: proximal IRS/SHC-SOS to AKT2 and glycogen synthesis
name: Proximal insulin/IGF1 receptor signalling via IRS, SHC and AKT2
rationale: Members are IRS/SHC-SOS adaptor events, AKT2 activation, signal attenuation and insulin-regulated glycogen and glucose import, unlike the GLUT4/adiponectin and generic PI3K-AKT confusables.

qualifier: CDC42 subfamily, RHOD and Rnd atypical GTPases
name: CDC42-subfamily, RHOD and Rnd atypical GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles of CDC42, RHOJ, RHOU, RHOV, RHOD, RND2 and RND3 with formin/IQGAP effectors and Rac antagonism, distinguishing it from RhoA/B/C and Rac-centred confusables.

name: CDC42-subfamily, RHOD and RND GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles of CDC42, RHOJ, RHOU, RHOV, RHOD, RND2 and RND3 with formin/IQGAP effectors, distinct from the RHOA/B/C and RAC confusables.

qualifier: CDC42 subfamily, RND and atypical Rho GTPases
name: CDC42, RND and atypical Rho GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are the CDC42, RHOJ, RHOU, RHOV, RHOD, RND2 and RND3 GTPase cycles with formin/IQGAP effectors and Rac antagonism, distinguishing it from RHOA/B/C- or RAC-centred confusables.

name: Ephrin signaling and Rho GTPase control of filopodia
rationale: Members are Eph-ephrin signalling, growth cone collapse and RAC1/CDC42/RHOF regulation of filopodia and actin bundles; the Rho GTPase/filopodia members distinguish it from L1, netrin and SLIT-ROBO guidance neighbours.

qualifier: ephrin receptors and Rho GTPase filopodium control
name: Ephrin signaling and Rho GTPase control of filopodia
rationale: Members are ephrin/EPH repulsion and growth-cone collapse with RAC1/CDC42/RHOF regulation of filopodia and actin bundles, unlike confusables centred on netrin, SLIT-ROBO and L1 guidance.

core: Ephrin and axon guidance cytoskeletal signaling
name: Ephrin repulsion and Rho GTPase control of filopodia
rationale: Members cover ephrin signaling, growth cone collapse and DCC attraction acting through RAC1/CDC42/RHOF on filopodia and actin bundles, whereas confusables centre on netrin, SLIT-ROBO and L1 guidance.

name: Mechanosensitive ATP release and calcium entry channels
rationale: Members span mechanical/pressure responses, ATP export, calcium influx, cell volume, blebbing and gap-junction transmission, unlike endothelial shear-stress, connexin-trafficking and glutamate receptor confusables.

core: Cellular responses to membrane mechanical stress
qualifier: calcium entry, ATP release and gap-junction coupling
name: Mechanosensitive calcium entry, ATP release and gap-junction coupling
rationale: Members link mechanical and osmotic membrane stress (pressure, volume, blebbing, repair, PIEZO1) to channel-mediated calcium influx, ATP export and gap-junction/glial signaling, distinguishing it from endothelial shear-stress, connexon trafficking and glutamate receptor confusables.

name: Mechanosensitive channel-mediated calcium influx and ATP release
rationale: Members concern membrane channel responses to pressure/load (PIEZO1, hemichannel ATP export, K-ATP SUR2, gap junctions, calcium entry, volume, membrane repair), unlike confusables on endothelial shear stress, glutamate receptor signaling or connexin trafficking.

name: ER contact-site tethering and phosphatidylinositol lipid transfer
rationale: Members describe ER tethering to plasma membrane, mitochondria and autophagosomes with intermembrane phospholipid transfer and PI/PIP synthesis, distinct from Golgi vesicle traffic and ER tubular network confusables.

name: ER membrane contact sites and interorganelle lipid transfer
rationale: Members concern ER tethering to mitochondria, plasma membrane and autophagosomes and phosphoinositide/phospholipid transfer between membranes, unlike the ER-tubule shaping and Golgi vesicle-traffic neighbours.

name: ER contact-site tethering and phosphatidylinositol lipid transfer
rationale: Members concern ER tethering to mitochondria, plasma membrane and autophagosomes with intermembrane phospholipid transfer and PI/PIP synthesis, unlike confusables on ER tubule shaping or glycolipid/cholesterol vesicle transport.

name: L-amino acid catabolism, chiefly histidine and threonine degradation
rationale: Members are amino acid (and related amide/pyrimidine nucleobase) catabolic processes, with histidine and threonine breakdown distinguishing it from the glycine/proline and phenylalanine/tyrosine neighbours.

qualifier: histidine, threonine and tyrosine, with pyrimidine base breakdown
name: Histidine, threonine and tyrosine catabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid catabolic and metabolic terms anchored by histidine, threonine and tyrosine degradation (plus pyrimidine nucleobase and amide catabolism), while confusables centre on phenylalanine/tyrosine or proline/glycine metabolism and lack histidine and threonine.

name: Amino acid and nucleobase catabolism, chiefly histidine and threonine
rationale: Members are amino acid (histidine, threonine, tyrosine), amide and pyrimidine nucleobase catabolic processes, with histidine and threonine breakdown distinguishing them from phenylalanine/tyrosine and proline/glycine confusables.

name: Hepatic alanine gluconeogenesis and choline-carnitine metabolism
rationale: Members combine alanine/oxaloacetate gluconeogenesis and threonine catabolism with choline catabolism and carnitine synthesis, the latter separating it from glutamate/aspartate and conjugation confusables and the former from biotin/carnitine-transport ones.

qualifier: gluconeogenic amino acids, choline and carnitine
name: Gluconeogenic amino acid, choline and carnitine metabolism
rationale: Members combine alanine and threonine catabolism with oxaloacetate/gluconeogenesis and choline catabolism with carnitine synthesis, a loose hepatic metabolic grouping distinct from glutamate/aromatic amino acid, biotin/FMO and fatty-acyl-CoA confusables.

core: Gluconeogenic amino acid and quaternary amine metabolism
name: Alanine/threonine gluconeogenic and choline/carnitine metabolism
rationale: Members combine alanine/threonine catabolism with oxaloacetate and gluconeogenesis and choline catabolism with carnitine synthesis, which together separate it from glutamate/aromatic amino acid, fatty acyl-CoA and biotin/FMO confusables.

qualifier: glycolysis with phosphocreatine and oxygen transport
name: ATP supply via glycolysis, phosphocreatine, oxygen and nucleotide transport
rationale: Members combine glycolysis with phosphocreatine buffering, mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange and oxygen transport, which the pure glycolysis/gluconeogenesis confusables lack.

qualifier: glycolysis with phosphocreatine buffering and oxygen transport
name: Glycolytic ATP supply with phosphocreatine buffering and oxygen transport
rationale: Members combine glycolysis with creatine/phosphocreatine energy buffering, mitochondrial ATP/ADP exchange and oxygen transport, which the glycolysis-regulation and gluconeogenesis confusables lack.

qualifier: with phosphocreatine shuttle, mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange and oxygen transport
name: Glycolysis with phosphocreatine shuttle and oxygen transport
rationale: Members combine glycolysis with cellular energy buffering (creatine/phosphocreatine, mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport) and oxygen transport, which the confusables (gluconeogenesis, glycogen, fermentation, fructose-2,6-bisphosphate) lack.

qualifier: aortic and coronary vascular smooth muscle
name: Cardiac growth and aortic/coronary smooth muscle development
rationale: Members concern developmental growth of heart muscle and smooth muscle of the aorta and coronary vessels, distinguishing it from cardiomyocyte proliferation/regeneration, endocardial/trabecular and adult VSMC phenotypic-switching confusables.

qualifier: aortic and coronary smooth muscle with cardiac growth
name: Cardiac growth and aortic-coronary smooth muscle development
rationale: Members combine heart/cardiomyocyte growth with cardiac, coronary and aortic vascular smooth muscle development, whereas confusables focus on ventricular myocardium proliferation or adult VSMC phenotypic switching.

qualifier: aortic and coronary, with cardiac growth
name: Aortic and coronary smooth muscle development and heart growth
rationale: Members concern aortic/coronary vascular smooth muscle differentiation and artery morphogenesis plus positive control of cardiomyocyte growth and sarcomere organization, unlike confusables on cardiomyocyte proliferation/trabeculation or adult VSMC phenotypic switching.

core: Cell death after loss of survival cues
qualifier: absent dependence-receptor ligand or matrix attachment
name: Cell death upon loss of ligand or matrix attachment
rationale: Members concern apoptosis triggered by unliganded dependence receptors (NTRK3), anoikis, involution and developmental death, unlike the p75NTR/neurotrophin and apoptotic-execution confusables.

core: Cell death on loss of survival cues
name: Survival-cue withdrawal death via dependence receptors and anoikis
rationale: Members concern death triggered when trophic or attachment signals are lost (unliganded dependence receptors, anoikis, involution, autophagic and developmental death), unlike confusables centred on p75NTR, apoptotic execution or neuronal/FOXO death.

qualifier: dependence receptors in absence of ligand, anoikis, developmental
name: Dependence receptor apoptosis, anoikis and developmental cell death
rationale: Members concern ligand-withdrawal dependence-receptor apoptosis, anoikis regulation and developmental/involution death, unlike the p75NTR/neuronal-death and apoptotic-execution confusables.

core: Rho and ILK-driven actin cytoskeleton remodeling
name: Rho- and ILK-driven actomyosin remodeling with SRF target expression
rationale: Members combine RHO-ROCK/PAK and PINCH-ILK-parvin control of stress fibers and spreading with SRF actin and contractile target modules, distinguishing them from integrin-matrix adhesion and platelet activation confusables.

core: Rho and integrin signaling to actin
name: Rho-ROCK/PAK and ILK signaling to SRF-driven actin cytoskeleton
rationale: Members share Rho-ROCK/PAK and ILK-PINCH-parvin focal adhesion signaling and SRF actin/contractile target genes, which the integrin-matrix and fibronectin confusables lack.

qualifier: Rho GTPase and ILK signaling with SRF targets
name: Rho GTPase and ILK-driven actin remodeling with SRF targets
rationale: Members are ROCK/PAK activation, ILK-PINCH-parvin focal adhesion signaling, stress fiber assembly and SRF-target cytoskeletal gene modules, distinct from integrin-matrix migration and platelet activation confusables.

name: Cullin neddylation, deneddylation and ubiquitin-dependent protein turnover
rationale: The coherent core is neddylation, COP9 deneddylation and ubiquitin-dependent degradation, with several broad BTM modules attached loosely through ubiquitin/protein turnover, which distinguishes it from transcription, Fanconi and RHOBTB confusables.

core: Cullin neddylation and ubiquitin-dependent protein turnover
name: Cullin neddylation, COP9 deneddylation and ubiquitin-dependent turnover
rationale: Most members concern neddylation, COP9 signalosome deneddylation and cullin-ubiquitin degradation, with ubiquitination-enriched expression modules (one notably mitochondrial) attached, distinguishing the theme from RHOBTB, transcription-regulation and Fanconi anemia confusables.

qualifier: ATF6/CREB3 transcriptional arm and IRE1/PERK modulation
name: ATF6/CREB3-arm unfolded protein response and IRE1/PERK modulation

name: ATF6/CREB3-driven ER unfolded protein response and UPR regulation
rationale: Members cover ATF6/CREB3 chaperone induction, ER overload and regulation of IRE1/PERK signaling and ER stress apoptosis, while confusables carry ATF4/XBP1 and translational control arms.

qualifier: ATF6 and CREB3 transcription factor arm
name: ER unfolded protein response via ATF6 and CREB3 factors
rationale: Members center on ATF6/ATF6B/CREB3 chaperone gene activation plus regulation of IRE1/PERK branches and ER-stress apoptosis, whereas confusables carry the ATF4/eIF2alpha translational and XBP1 arms.

name: Blood pressure control by angiotensin and endothelin vasoconstriction
rationale: Members cover renin-angiotensin signaling, endothelin, neural and renal control of arterial and pulmonary pressure and regulation of vasoconstriction, distinguishing it from natriuretic/cGMP, renal sodium excretion and NO smooth-muscle relaxation confusables.

name: Blood pressure control by angiotensin and endothelin vasoconstriction
rationale: Members cover arterial pressure regulation via renin-angiotensin, endothelin and vasoconstriction, distinguishing it from natriuretic/cGMP, renal sodium and NO-smooth-muscle relaxation confusables.

name: Renin-angiotensin and endothelin control of arterial pressure
rationale: Members regulate systemic/pulmonary blood pressure via angiotensin generation and signaling, endothelin, neural input and vasoconstriction, unlike confusables centred on NO-cGMP smooth muscle relaxation and renal sodium/bradykinin handling.

name: Positive regulation of p53-dependent apoptotic transcription
rationale: Members are TP53 transcription of death receptor, caspase and cytochrome c release genes plus positive regulation of p53 expression and activity, distinguishing it from confusables on negative regulation, PUMA and p21-mediated G1 arrest.

qualifier: transcription of death genes and positive control of p53 expression and activity
name: p53-dependent apoptotic gene transcription and p53 activation
rationale: Members concern p53 transcriptional induction of apoptotic genes (cytochrome c release, death receptors, caspases) and positive regulation of p53 expression, cofactors and COP1 turnover, distinct from confusables on p53-driven G1 arrest/p21 and negative regulation of p53 apoptosis.

name: p53 activation and pro-apoptotic target gene transcription
rationale: Members cover regulation of TP53 levels and cofactors and TP53 transcription of death receptors, caspases and cytochrome c release genes, unlike confusables on p21-mediated arrest or negative regulation and PUMA translocation.

qualifier: mitotic and meiotic chromosome segregation machinery
name: Mitotic and meiotic cell cycle progression and chromosome segregation
rationale: Members span E2F/replication licensing, APC/C and PLK1/Aurora control, spindle, cohesion, condensation, nuclear envelope and meiotic recombination/synapsis, which the chromatin, telomere and DNA-damage confusables and the transcription-only cell-cycle confusable lack.

qualifier: mitotic and meiotic progression and chromosome segregation
name: Mitotic and meiotic cell cycle progression and chromosome segregation
rationale: The broad membership spans replication licensing, G2/M control, spindle, cohesion, cytokinesis and meiotic recombination, i.e. the whole mitotic and meiotic cycle, unlike the telomere and DNA-damage confusables.

qualifier: mitotic and meiotic division from replication licensing to cytokinesis
name: Mitotic and meiotic cell cycle, replication licensing to cytokinesis
rationale: The 190 members span G1/S E2F control, origin licensing, G2/M, spindle, cohesion, APC/C, cytokinesis and meiotic recombination/segregation, far broader than the checkpoint, telomere and chromatin confusables.

qualifier: megakaryocyte lineage and RUNX1 transcriptional control
name: Myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocyte hematopoiesis with RUNX1 regulation
rationale: Members cover HSC maintenance and granulocyte, monocyte, erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation driven by RUNX1 and CSF signaling, distinguishing them from lymphocyte development and interleukin/JAK-STAT confusables.

qualifier: RUNX1-directed myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocytic lineages
name: RUNX1-directed myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocyte hematopoiesis
rationale: Members cover stem/progenitor maintenance and myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation with RUNX1 transcription and CSF signaling, unlike confusables on cytokine JAK-STAT signaling, Th2/mast cell responses or lymphocyte activation.

name: Myeloid and erythro-megakaryocytic hematopoietic differentiation
rationale: Members cover HSC maintenance, RUNX1-driven programs and differentiation of monocytes/macrophages, granulocytes, mast cells, erythrocytes and megakaryocytes with CSF signaling, whereas confusables center on cytokine JAK-STAT receptor signaling or B and T lymphocyte development and activation.

qualifier: canonical Wnt, Notch and Hedgehog including cancer mutants
name: Canonical Wnt, Notch and Hedgehog transduction including cancer mutants
rationale: Members are beta-catenin destruction complex, Notch intracellular domain and GLI/SMO signaling with their oncogenic mutants and regulated intramembrane proteolysis, distinguishing the theme from planar polarity, Hippo, Wnt secretion and Hedgehog ligand processing neighbours.

core: Developmental WNT, NOTCH and Hedgehog signaling
qualifier: intracellular transduction and oncogenic pathway mutants
name: WNT, NOTCH and Hedgehog signal transduction and oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members span canonical WNT/beta-catenin, NOTCH and GLI/SMO transduction including cancer mutants and regulated intramembrane proteolysis, whereas confusables focus on Hh/WNT ligand biogenesis, planar cell polarity or Hippo signaling.

core: Canonical Wnt, Notch and Hedgehog signal transduction
name: Canonical Wnt, Notch and Hedgehog signaling including oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members cover beta-catenin destruction complex and TCF signaling, Notch receptor processing and NICD transcription, and GLI/SMO Hedgehog signaling with their cancer mutants, unlike confusables on Hh ligand lipidation, Hippo, Wnt secretion or planar cell polarity.

core: Steroid hormone and fat-soluble vitamin metabolism
qualifier: retinoid, vitamin D and vitamin K/gamma-carboxylation

core: Steroid hormone and fat-soluble vitamin metabolism
name: Steroidogenesis and fat-soluble vitamin A, D, K metabolism
rationale: Members are cytochrome P450 steroid hormone biosynthesis and retinoid, vitamin D and vitamin K metabolism; confusables cover only the steroid side with thyroid/pituitary hormones, phosphate-mineral handling, or the visual retinoid cycle.

core: Cytochrome P450-dependent sterol and isoprenoid metabolism
qualifier: steroid hormones plus vitamins A, D and K
name: Steroid hormone and fat-soluble vitamin A, D, K metabolism
rationale: Members cover biosynthesis, catabolism and inherited CYP defects of corticosteroids, sex steroids and vitamins A, D and K (including vitamin K-dependent carboxylation), distinguished from thyroid/pituitary hormone, phosphate-mineral and visual retinoid-cycle confusables.

qualifier: chain-type ubiquitination, deubiquitination and misfolded-protein quality control
name: Ubiquitin-proteasome degradation, deubiquitination and misfolded-protein quality control
rationale: Members span E1/E2/E3 chain-specific ubiquitination, DUB families, proteasome assembly, ERAD, aggrephagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy, distinguishing it from chaperonin folding, neddylation and ribosome-stall confusables.

name: Ubiquitin-proteasome and autophagic protein quality control
rationale: Members span ubiquitin chain synthesis and editing, DUBs, proteasome assembly, ERAD regulation and aggrephagy/CMA of misfolded proteins, whereas confusables centre on chaperonin folding, ribosome stalling or neddylation.

qualifier: with deubiquitinases and misfolded-protein quality control
name: Ubiquitin-proteasome degradation and misfolded-protein quality control
rationale: Members span ubiquitin chain synthesis and editing, DUB families, proteasome assembly, ERAD, aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy and ribosome-associated quality control, a broader degradation-and-quality-control scope than the chaperonin-folding, neddylation and stalled-ribosome/stress-granule neighbours.

name: Rho GTPase-driven leading-edge actin and lamellipodial motility
rationale: Members span the Rho/Rac/Cdc42 GTPase cycles and their effectors with Arp2/3 nucleation, lamellipodia, ruffles, podosomes and macropinocytosis; confusables carry focal adhesion IPP, ROCK/PAK/citron effectors or filopodia/cytokinesis.

name: Rho GTPase actin remodeling in lamellipodial cell motility
rationale: Members are Rho-family GTPase cycles and their actin effectors driving lamellipodia, ruffles, podosomes and macropinocytosis, unlike the focal adhesion, filopodium/cytokinesis and ROCK/PAK confusables.

name: Rho-family GTPase cycles in Arp2/3 lamellipodial protrusion and motility
rationale: Members are the Rho/Rac/Cdc42 GTPase cycles with Arp2/3-driven lamellipodia, ruffles, macropinocytosis and actin filament dynamics in migration, distinguishing it from cytokinesis/filopodia, ROCK/PAK and focal adhesion confusables.

qualifier: polymerase I and III transcription with rRNA processing
name: Polymerase I and III rRNA synthesis, processing and translation initiation
rationale: Members are nucleolar polymerase I and polymerase III transcription, rRNA cleavage and processing, and the assembly of the cytoplasmic initiation complex and chain elongation, whereas confusables add MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis regulation, nucleolar chromatin control or snRNA transcription.

core: RNA polymerase I and III transcription with cytoplasmic translation initiation
qualifier: rRNA and tRNA synthesis and early rRNA cleavage feeding 43S/80S initiation and elongation
name: RNA polymerase I and III transcription with cytoplasmic translation initiation
rationale: Every member is either Pol I/Pol III synthesis of rRNA and tRNA with the first rRNA cleavages, or assembly of the ternary and 43S initiation complexes and chain elongation that consume those products, whereas the confusables are chromatin regulators of rRNA expression, MYC target programs and snRNA transcription.

core: RNA polymerase I and III transcription with rRNA processing and translation initiation
qualifier: the transcription and initiation machinery itself, not its chromatin or MYC-driven regulation
name: RNA polymerase I and III transcription and translation initiation
rationale: Members are Pol I and Pol III initiation, elongation and termination steps, the rRNA cleavage events that follow, and ribosomal subunit joining and initiation complex formation, distinguishing the theme from confusables weighted towards nucleolar chromatin and SIRT1/MYC regulation of rRNA expression or snRNA and tRNA transcription.

qualifier: death receptor apoptosis, necroptosis, non-NLRP3 inflammasomes
name: Death receptor apoptosis, necroptosis and IL-18-linked pyroptosis

core: Inflammatory and extrinsic programmed cell death
name: Death receptor apoptosis, necroptosis and non-NLRP3 inflammasome pyroptosis
rationale: Members span FAS/TRAIL/caspase-8 apoptosis, RIPK necroptosis and AIM2/NLRP1/IPAF/CASP4/5 pyroptosis with IL-18, distinguished from the NLRP3/IL-1 confusables and the mitochondrial apoptosis confusable.

name: Death receptor apoptosis, necroptosis and non-NLRP3 inflammasome pyroptosis
rationale: Members span FAS/TRAIL/TNFR1-caspase-8 apoptosis, RIPK1/TRIF necroptosis and AIM2/NLRP1/IPAF/CASP4/5 pyroptosis with IL-18, distinct from NLRP3/IL-1 and mitochondrial apoptosis confusables.

core: Renal fluid and blood pressure homeostasis
name: Vasopressin and renin-angiotensin control of renal fluid balance
rationale: Members span vasopressin/aquaporin water reabsorption, renin-angiotensin and renal sodium/blood pressure regulation, distinguishing them from osmotic chloride-cotransporter themes (C1, C3) and vascular tone/endothelin themes (C2, C4).

core: Renal regulation of blood pressure and fluid volume
name: Renin-angiotensin and vasopressin regulation of blood pressure and volume
rationale: Members span angiotensin generation and signaling, vasopressin/AVPR and aquaporin water reabsorption, renal sodium and urine-volume control and systemic pressure, distinguishing it from vascular-tone and cation-chloride/osmotic-stress confusables.

core: renal and hormonal control of body fluid and blood pressure
name: Vasopressin and angiotensin control of fluid balance and blood pressure
rationale: Members cover vasopressin/aquaporin water reabsorption, renin-angiotensin regulation, urine volume and systemic arterial pressure, distinguishing it from confusables on osmotic/sodium-chloride transport or vascular smooth-muscle tone.

qualifier: receptor-mediated uptake, efflux and SREBP-LXR control
name: Cellular cholesterol uptake, efflux and SREBP-LXR transcriptional control
rationale: Members cover LDL/VLDL receptor endocytosis and degradation, cholesterol efflux and SREBP/LXR-regulated sterol homeostasis, unlike neighbours on triglyceride-rich lipoproteins, ABCA1/phospholipid efflux or bile acid and intestinal absorption.

name: Cellular cholesterol homeostasis via SREBP, LXR and LDL-receptor turnover
rationale: Members concern sterol sensing by SREBP and LXR, cholesterol uptake and efflux, and lipoprotein receptor internalization and lysosomal degradation, distinguishing it from neighbours about plasma lipoprotein assembly, triglyceride lipolysis and foam cells.

qualifier: SREBP and LXR sterol sensing with lipoprotein receptor endocytosis and degradation
name: Cholesterol sensing and lipoprotein receptor endocytic turnover
rationale: Every member is either transcriptional sterol sensing (SREBP activation, NR1H2/NR1H3 limits on uptake, sterol homeostasis, cholesterol efflux, storage and reverse transport) or the receptor-side endocytosis, recycling and lysosomal degradation that sets cholesterol uptake, distinguishing it from confusables built on lipoprotein particle remodeling, phospholipid efflux and intestinal and bile handling.

qualifier: misfolded protein quality control and atypical ubiquitin chains
name: Ubiquitin-proteasome degradation and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: All members concern ubiquitin chain formation (K6/K11/K27/K29, branched), proteasomal and degron-rule catabolism, ERAD and misfolded protein handling; proteasomal quality control distinguishes it from autophagy-, deubiquitinase- and proteasome-assembly-centred confusables.

name: Ubiquitin-proteasome quality control and atypical polyubiquitin linkages
rationale: All members concern ubiquitin-dependent or proteasomal degradation of misfolded proteins (ERAD, N/C-degron rules, proteasome, DUBs), and K6/K11/K27/K29/branched chain formation distinguishes it from autophagy, proteasome-assembly and deubiquitination confusables.

qualifier: atypical ubiquitin linkages and misfolded protein quality control
name: Ubiquitin-proteasome degradation and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members span ubiquitin chain formation (K6/K11/K27/K29, branched), degron-based proteasomal degradation, ERAD and misfolded protein quality control, distinguishing it from deubiquitinase, aggrephagy and proteasome assembly neighbours.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I transcription and rDNA chromatin control
name: RNA polymerase I rRNA synthesis and rDNA chromatin control
rationale: Members centre on RNA polymerase I initiation, elongation and termination at rDNA, its epigenetic control (NoRC, B-WICH, SIRT1, CSB/G9a), 5S rRNA and early pre-rRNA cleavage and MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis, unlike confusables on RNA polymerase II/III and HIV transcription, translation initiation or later ribosome assembly.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I transcription and nucleolar chromatin regulation
name: RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription and nucleolar chromatin control
rationale: Members cover Pol I initiation to termination, epigenetic rDNA control (NoRC, B-WICH, SIRT1), 5S synthesis, early pre-rRNA cleavage and MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis, unlike translation, tRNA/Pol III or Pol II transcription in confusables.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I with nucleolar chromatin control
name: Nucleolar rRNA gene transcription and its chromatin control
rationale: Members cover Pol I initiation to termination, 5S rRNA synthesis, early rRNA cleavage, MYC targets and NoRC/B-WICH/SIRT1 chromatin regulation of rDNA, unlike confusables on Pol III/translation, Pol II elongation or rRNA processing.

name: Peroxisomal lipid metabolism with sterol and isoprenoid biosynthesis
rationale: Members span very-long-chain and ether lipid synthesis, alpha-oxidation and peroxisome function together with mevalonate/cholesterol biosynthesis, which the beta-oxidation-focused confusables lack.

core: Peroxisomal very-long-chain and ether lipid metabolism
name: Mevalonate-cholesterol synthesis and peroxisomal very-long-chain lipid metabolism
rationale: Members combine cholesterol/isoprenoid biosynthesis with VLCFA synthesis/catabolism, plasmalogen and alpha-oxidation peroxisomal lipid metabolism; the sterol branch separates it from beta-oxidation and peroxisome-import neighbours.

qualifier: sterol, isoprenoid and very-long-chain/ether lipid synthesis
name: Peroxisome-linked sterol, isoprenoid and very-long-chain lipid synthesis
rationale: Members cover mevalonate/cholesterol synthesis, VLCFA elongation, PUFA and ether lipid metabolism with peroxisome markers; confusables are dominated by peroxisomal beta-oxidation and protein import without sterol synthesis.

name: Mammary, prostate and reproductive tract glandular development
rationale: Members concern development of mammary and prostate glandular epithelium and the uterus, vagina, oviduct and genitalia, distinguishing it from lung/salivary branching, kidney and gonad determination confusables.

core: Glandular epithelial morphogenesis of reproductive organs
name: Mammary, prostate and genital tract epithelial morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover mammary lineages and branching, prostate bud and acinus morphogenesis and uterus, vagina, oviduct and genitalia development, distinguishing it from lung/salivary branching, gonad determination and kidney confusables.

name: Mammary, prostate and reproductive tract epithelial development
rationale: Members concern branching, differentiation and growth of mammary and prostate glandular epithelium and development of uterus, oviduct, vagina and genitalia; confusables cover lung/salivary branching, gonad/sex determination or kidney development.

core: Innate immune receptor signalling to NF-kappaB
qualifier: IRAK-TRAF6-TAK1 relay to JNK/p38 including TRIF and inflammasome inputs
name: Toll-like receptor TRAF6-TAK1 relay to NF-kappaB and JNK/p38
rationale: Members are TLR/TRIF-, ALPK1- and inflammasome-linked IRAK-TRAF6-TAK1-IKK steps with K63 ubiquitination and JNK/p38 activation, distinguishing it from NOD1/2, TNFR1/non-canonical NF-kB and cytokine-production confusables.

qualifier: TRAF6-TAK1 to canonical NF-kappaB, JNK and p38
name: Innate receptor TRAF6–TAK1 signaling to canonical NF-κB and JNK/p38
rationale: Members are TLR (MyD88/IRAK and TRIF), inflammasome and ALPK1 signalling converging on TRAF6/TAK1, K63 ubiquitination, IKK and JNK/p38, unlike the NOD, TNFR and non-canonical NF-kB confusables.

qualifier: canonical NF-kappaB and JNK/p38 activation via TLR, TRIF and inflammasome
name: Toll-like receptor TAK1 signaling to canonical NF-kappaB and JNK
rationale: Members are TLR/TRIF/IRAK-TRAF6 activation of TAK1 and IKK leading to canonical NF-kB, JNK and p38, plus inflammasome/ALPK1 inputs, whereas confusables cover non-canonical NF-kB, TNFR1 or NOD signaling.

qualifier: PTK6 signaling and ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation
name: PTK6 signaling and ubiquitin-dependent ERBB receptor downregulation
rationale: Members combine PTK6 (BRK) signaling with ubiquitin/ESCRT-mediated ERBB endocytosis and PTEN regulation, while confusables focus on MET and ERBB adaptor activation cascades.

name: PTK6 signalling and ERBB receptor endocytic downregulation
rationale: Members are PTK6 signalling events plus ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation of EGFR/ERBB and PTEN regulation, lacking the MET and ERBB adaptor-activation members of confusables.

name: PTK6 and ERBB signaling with ubiquitin-dependent receptor downregulation
rationale: Members cover PTK6 (BRK) signalling, ERBB/EGFR endocytic downregulation via ubiquitin and MVB sorting, and PTEN regulation, whereas neighbours centre on MET/HGF activation or ERBB adaptor and PI3K cascades.

qualifier: amino sugar and sialic acid precursors with GPI anchoring
name: Nucleotide sugar synthesis, transport and GPI anchoring
rationale: Members cover UDP-GlcNAc and CMP-sialic acid synthesis, SLC35 nucleotide-sugar transporter defects and GPI anchor synthesis, unlike neighbours focused on N-glycan processing, fucose and glycosphingolipid synthesis.

name: Nucleotide sugar supply and GPI anchor synthesis
rationale: Members cover synthesis of UDP-GlcNAc, CMP-sialic acid and UDP-glucuronate, Golgi nucleotide-sugar transporters and their defects, and GPI anchor synthesis/attachment, rather than the N-glycan, O-glycan and glycolipid elaboration of the confusables.

name: Nucleotide sugar synthesis, transport and GPI anchoring
rationale: Members cover hexosamine/UDP-GlcNAc and CMP-sialic acid synthesis, SLC35 nucleotide-sugar transporter defects and GPI anchor synthesis; the transport and GPI members distinguish it from N-/O-glycan and glycosphingolipid confusables.

core: Golgi structure and endosomal membrane dynamics
name: ARF/Rab GTPase control of Golgi structure and endocytic recycling
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon disassembly/reassembly, COPI budding, endosome tubulation and receptor recycling under ARF/Rab GTPase regulation, whereas confusables are about Golgi-ER/endosome-Golgi retrograde routes and lysosomal delivery.

name: Golgi organization and endocytic recycling under ARF/Rab control
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon assembly/disassembly and positioning, COPI budding, endosome tubulation and receptor recycling together with ARF/Rab GTPase regulators, which the confusables (retrograde Golgi-ER and Golgi-lysosome traffic) lack.

qualifier: ARF/Rab GTPase-regulated Golgi ribbon dynamics and endocytic recycling
name: ARF/Rab-regulated Golgi architecture and endosomal recycling
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon disassembly/reassembly, COPI budding, ARF and Rab-GAP signalling and endosome tubulation/recycling, whereas confusables are dominated by Golgi-endosome-lysosome and retrograde transport routes.

core: Male germ cell development and fertilization
qualifier: sperm acrosome, motility and zona pellucida binding
name: Male germ cell development, sperm function and fertilization
rationale: Members span germ cell migration/proliferation, Sertoli barrier, sperm structure (acrosome, manchette, mitochondrial sheath), capacitation, motility and sperm-egg binding/fusion, whereas confusables cover meiotic recombination, germline epigenetics or gonadal hormones.

core: Male germ cell and sperm function
name: Germ cell development, sperm function and fertilization
rationale: Members cover germ cell proliferation and migration, spermatid structure (acrosome, manchette, mitochondrial sheath), capacitation, motility, zona pellucida binding and egg activation, unlike confusables centred on meiotic recombination, piRNA/zygotic transition or gonadotropin signalling.

qualifier: germ cell migration and proliferation control
name: Sperm function, fertilization and germ cell proliferation control
rationale: Members cover sperm structure, capacitation, motility, acrosome reaction, zona binding and egg activation plus primordial germ cell migration and germ cell proliferation, whereas confusables concern meiotic recombination, piRNA/zygotic genome control or gonadotropin and ovarian follicle regulation.

name: Inflammasome-mediated IL-1 processing and inflammatory cytokine regulation
rationale: All members regulate pro-inflammatory cytokine production and TLR/TNF/IL-1 signalling, and the NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome and IL-1 precursor processing members distinguish it from TLR-focused neighbours.

name: Inflammasome-mediated IL-1 processing and inflammatory cytokine regulation
rationale: Members regulate IL-1, IL-6, TNF and TLR-driven cytokine output, and uniquely include NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome assembly and IL-1 precursor processing absent from the TLR-focused confusables.

name: Inflammasome, interleukin-1 processing and inflammatory cytokine regulation
rationale: Members regulate TLR-driven inflammatory cytokine production (IL-1, IL-6, TNF, IL-12) and uniquely include NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasomes and IL-1 precursor processing, absent from TLR/TRIF-centred confusables.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
name: HGF-MET receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
rationale: Members are MET activation and its effectors plus related RTKs (MST1/RON, ALK/LTK) driving PI3K-AKT and ERK; the MET focus distinguishes it from ERBB-, PTK6- and IGF1R-centred neighbours.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K/AKT and ERK
name: MET/HGF and ALK-family receptor signaling to PI3K/AKT
rationale: Members are MET/HGF receptor activation and effectors plus ALK/LTK and PI3K/AKT/ERK activation, lacking the ERBB, PTK6 and IGF1R content of confusables.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K/AKT and ERK
name: MET/RON and ALK/LTK receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Members are HGF-MET and MSP-RON signaling plus ALK/LTK and downstream PI3K/AKT/ERK, distinguishing it from ERBB, PTK6 and IGF1R/IRS confusables.

qualifier: methylation and pseudouridylation, mitochondrial RNA processing and ribosome assembly
name: RNA methylation, pseudouridylation and mitochondrial RNA processing
rationale: Members are tRNA/rRNA/mRNA base methylation and pseudouridine synthesis plus mitochondrial tRNA/rRNA processing and mitoribosome assembly, which distinguishes it from neighbours centred on aminoacylation and translational fidelity, mitochondrial transcription/translation, or nuclear snRNA modification.

core: tRNA and rRNA modification and processing
name: tRNA and rRNA modification with mitochondrial ribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members are RNA methylation/pseudouridylation and processing of tRNA, rRNA and mitochondrial transcripts plus mitoribosome assembly, distinguishing it from neighbours centred on tRNA aminoacylation, translational fidelity or mitochondrial transcription/translation.

core: tRNA and rRNA modification and processing
name: tRNA and rRNA modification, largely mitochondrial
rationale: Members are RNA modification (pseudouridylation, methylation, wybutosine) and processing of tRNA/rRNA, most in the mitochondrion with mitoribosome assembly; the mitochondrial emphasis separates it from the nuclear rRNA/snRNA modification confusable, and modification rather than mitochondrial transcription/translation separates it from the broader mitochondrial gene expression confusable.

qualifier: de novo purine and pyrimidine synthesis and NMP/NDP phosphorylation
name: De novo purine and pyrimidine ribonucleotide synthesis and interconversion
rationale: Members are de novo IMP/AMP/GMP and pyrimidine synthesis plus nucleotide phosphorylation to di- and triphosphates, distinct from deoxynucleotide and nucleotide catabolism neighbours.

qualifier: de novo purine and pyrimidine with NTP interconversion
name: De novo purine and pyrimidine nucleotide synthesis and interconversion
rationale: Members cover de novo IMP/AMP/GMP and pyrimidine synthesis plus nucleoside mono/di/triphosphate interconversion, distinct from confusables on nucleotide catabolism and deoxyribonucleotide metabolism.

qualifier: de novo purine and pyrimidine synthesis and interconversion
name: De novo purine and pyrimidine nucleotide synthesis and interconversion
rationale: Members cover de novo IMP/AMP/GMP and pyrimidine synthesis plus nucleoside mono/di/triphosphate interconversion, whereas confusables centre on nucleotide catabolism and deoxyribonucleotide metabolism.

name: cAMP-PKA second-messenger signaling via stimulatory adenylate cyclase
rationale: Members cover adenylate cyclase activation, cAMP synthesis/degradation, PKA, CREB and DARPP-32 events, whereas confusables carry PLC/IP3 or alpha-2 adrenergic adenylate cyclase inhibition.

name: Adenylate cyclase activation, cAMP turnover and PKA-CREB signalling
rationale: Members concern cAMP synthesis, degradation and PKA/CREB/DARPP-32 output downstream of Gs-coupled receptors, unlike the Gi-inhibitory adrenergic and PLC/IP3 confusables.

name: Adenylate cyclase activation and cAMP-PKA-CREB signaling
rationale: Members concern cAMP synthesis, degradation and PKA/CREB/DARPP-32 signaling downstream of stimulatory GPCRs, distinct from confusables on Gi/alpha-2 adrenergic cyclase inhibition and PLC/IP3 signaling.

core: chaperonin-assisted folding and stabilization of newly made proteins
qualifier: CCT/TRiC and prefoldin handling of actin, tubulin and G-protein subunits, not degradative clearance or tubulin modification
name: Chaperonin-mediated folding of cytoskeletal and nascent proteins
rationale: All members are folding, refolding, assembly or stabilization events centred on the CCT/TRiC chaperonin and its cofactors acting on cytoskeletal and other nascent substrates; the confusables instead carry aggrephagy, aggresome and ubiquitin-proteasome clearance, or post-translational tubulin modification and severing.

core: chaperonin-mediated de novo folding of cytoskeletal and oligomeric substrates
qualifier: CCT/TriC with prefoldin, and refolding or stabilization of complexes
name: Chaperonin-mediated de novo folding of actin and tubulin
rationale: Members centre on the cytosolic chaperonin route that folds actin, tubulin and G-protein beta subunits and on the refolding, stabilization and complex assembly it supports, distinct from tubulin post-translational modification, aggrephagy and ubiquitin-proteasome degradation confusables.

qualifier: TRiC/CCT chaperonin and prefoldin folding of actin and tubulin
name: Chaperonin-mediated protein folding and tubulin biogenesis
rationale: Members centre on TRiC/CCT and prefoldin-assisted de novo folding (actin, tubulin, G-beta), refolding and complex assembly, distinguishing them from confusables on aggrephagy/ubiquitin degradation or tubulin post-translational modification.

qualifier: vasopressin-aquaporin water, glycerol and urea transport
name: Vasopressin-aquaporin water, glycerol and urea transport
rationale: Members cover vasopressin signaling, aquaporin water reabsorption and aquaglyceroporin glycerol/urea transport, whereas confusables emphasise sodium/chloride transport, osmotic stress and renin-angiotensin control.

qualifier: vasopressin-aquaporin water, glycerol and urea transport
name: Vasopressin-aquaporin water reabsorption and aquaglyceroporin transport
rationale: Members concern vasopressin-regulated aquaporin water reabsorption and aquaporin/urea transporter passage of glycerol and urea; confusables centre on renin-angiotensin blood pressure control or sodium/chloride/potassium salt transport.

qualifier: vasopressin-aquaporin water, urea and glycerol transport
name: Vasopressin-aquaporin water, urea and glycerol transport
rationale: Members center on vasopressin signaling and aquaporin-mediated water, urea and glycerol transport in kidney water balance, distinct from neighbours on sodium/chloride transport, osmotic stress and renin-angiotensin control.

name: Mitochondrial heme, iron-sulfur cluster and ubiquinone biosynthesis
rationale: Members are heme/porphyrin synthesis, Fe-S cluster assembly, ferredoxin electron transfer, ubiquinol/quinone synthesis and Fe-S-dependent TCA enzyme maturation, unlike confusables on respiratory complex assembly, erythrocyte gas transport or iron/heme uptake.

name: Mitochondrial heme, iron-sulfur cluster and ubiquinone biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover heme/porphyrin synthesis, Fe-S cluster assembly with ferredoxin electron supply, and quinone synthesis, distinct from neighbours on erythrocyte gas/iron transport and respiratory complex assembly.

name: Mitochondrial heme, iron-sulfur cluster and quinone biosynthesis
rationale: Members are biosynthesis of heme/tetrapyrroles, Fe-S clusters and ubiquinol plus Fe-S/ferredoxin-dependent processes (TCA enzyme maturation, pregnenolone synthesis), distinguishing it from erythrocyte gas transport, iron uptake and respiratory chain assembly confusables.

qualifier: vitamin D and vitamin K with protein gamma-carboxylation
name: Vitamin D and vitamin K metabolism with protein gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members cover vitamin D hydroxylation and its CYP defects and vitamin K metabolism with gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors, distinguishing it from phosphate/mineralization, retinoic acid and vitamin E/ubiquinol confusables.

qualifier: vitamin K gamma-carboxylation and vitamin D
name: Vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation and vitamin D metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors plus vitamin D hydroxylation and CYP-related vitamin defects, separating it from retinoid, vitamin E and phosphate/mineralization neighbours.

qualifier: vitamin D and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation
name: Vitamin D and vitamin K metabolism with gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members cover vitamin D activation/inactivation (CYP27B1, CYP24A1) and vitamin K metabolism with protein gamma-carboxylation, plus CYP26 defects, distinguishing it from vitamin E/ubiquinol (C1), retinoid (C2, C4) and phosphate/mineralization (C3) neighbours.

qualifier: sterols, very-long-chain fatty acids, ether lipids
name: Sterol, very-long-chain fatty acid and ether lipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members are anabolic routes for cholesterol (Bloch/Kandutsch-Russell), fatty acid elongation and essential PUFA metabolism, plasmalogens and waxes, unlike confusables on mevalonate isoprenoids or peroxisomal beta-oxidation.

qualifier: sterols, fatty acid elongation and ether lipids
name: Sterol, fatty acid elongation and ether lipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members are cholesterol synthesis (lanosterol, Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell), very-long-chain and polyunsaturated fatty acid elongation and plasmalogen/wax synthesis, distinct from VLCFA beta-oxidation and mevalonate isoprenoid confusables.

qualifier: cholesterol, very-long-chain fatty acid and ether lipid
name: Cholesterol, very-long-chain fatty acid and ether lipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members are anabolic: sterol synthesis from farnesyl-PP to cholesterol, fatty acid elongation/PUFA metabolism and plasmalogen/wax synthesis, unlike confusables on fatty acid beta-oxidation or early mevalonate steps.

name: Inorganic anion transporters and tooth mineralization
rationale: Members combine SLC4/SLC26 bicarbonate, sulfate, iodide, oxalate and phosphate transport (and their diseases) with enamel/dentin mineralization and tooth eruption, unlike neighbours on proton/pH control and sodium-phosphate cotransport.

qualifier: with tooth and tissue mineralization disorders
name: Inorganic anion transport and tooth mineralization disorders
rationale: Members combine bicarbonate, SLC26, phosphate, sulfate, iodide and oxalate transport and their channelopathies with enamel, dentin and ectopic calcification diseases, distinguishing it from confusables on proton/pH regulation and sodium-phosphate cotransport.

core: Inorganic anion transport and its disorders
name: Inorganic anion transporter disorders and tooth mineralization
rationale: Members are bicarbonate, sulfate, iodide, oxalate and phosphate transporters and their genetic diseases plus enamel/dentin mineralization and ectopic calcification, unlike confusables on sodium-phosphate cotransport or proton/pH regulation.

name: Osteoblast differentiation and ossification from mesenchymal progenitors
rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast proliferation/differentiation and ossification (RUNX2, Wnt, BMP); osteoblast focus distinguishes it from chondrocyte/joint and bone mineralization or collagen-secretion confusables.

name: RUNX2-driven osteoblast differentiation and ossification from mesenchymal progenitors
rationale: Members cover mesenchymal progenitor expansion, RUNX2/Wnt/BMP-driven osteoblast differentiation and direct/replacement ossification, distinct from confusables on mineralization, chondrocyte development and matrix secretion.

name: Osteoblast differentiation and bone formation from mesenchymal progenitors
rationale: All members concern mesenchymal progenitor commitment to osteoblasts, RUNX2/Wnt/BMP control of osteoblast proliferation and differentiation, and ossification of bone, cartilage and tendon matrix, distinguished from confusables on chondrocyte maturation, joint morphogenesis, bone mineralization and generic collagen/ECM secretion.

core: Phosphatidylserine exposure and apoptotic cell clearance
qualifier: membrane lipid asymmetry and mechanical membrane responses
name: Phospholipid asymmetry, PS exposure and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members cover flippase/scramblase control of membrane lipid asymmetry, PS exposure, recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells, plus blebbing, volume and pressure responses; confusables cover intermembrane lipid transfer, ER shaping, apical trafficking or surfactant.

qualifier: phosphatidylserine exposure and apoptotic cell clearance
name: Phosphatidylserine translocation, exposure and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Most members concern flippase/scramblase control of phosphatidylserine, its exposure on apoptotic cells and platelets, and efferocytosis, with membrane repair and mechanoresponse terms, unlike confusables on apical trafficking, ER lipid transfer or surfactant.

name: Membrane phospholipid scrambling and phosphatidylserine-mediated apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members cover aminophospholipid flipping/scrambling, PS exposure, apoptotic cell recognition and engulfment, and related membrane blebbing, repair and mechanical responses, unlike surfactant, ER lipid transfer and apical trafficking confusables.

name: B cell antigen receptor signaling and B cell development
rationale: Members cover BCR second-messenger, BTK, RAS and CD22 signaling with B cell development, plus leukocyte-brake and myeloid kinase modules, distinguishing it from confusables on CD27/germinal center or generic lymphocyte expression clusters.

core: B cell receptor signaling and development
name: BCR signaling and B cell development, with inhibitory regulation
rationale: Members cover antigen-BCR second messengers, BTK/RAS activation, CD22 and negative regulation of BCR signaling, and B cell development, which confusables focused on CD27, survival or generic B-cell modules lack.

qualifier: and B cell development and activation
name: BCR signaling and B cell development and activation
rationale: Members cover antigen-BCR signaling (BTK, RAS, CD22 regulation) and B cell development and activation modules, whereas the nearest confusable centres on CD27, apoptosis and germinal center control and others are B cell-enriched expression modules.

qualifier: iron sequestration and endolysosomal peptide-histidine transport
name: Phagocyte iron sequestration and endolysosomal peptide-histidine transport
rationale: Members combine iron and heme acquisition at the host-pathogen interface, neutrophil antimicrobial granule programmes and proton/oligopeptide-histidine transporters, unlike confusables on systemic transferrin, heme scavenging and erythrocyte gas transport.

core: Iron acquisition at the host-pathogen interface
name: Host-pathogen iron competition, neutrophil granules and oligopeptide transport
rationale: Members combine iron import and pathogen iron/heme assimilation with neutrophil antimicrobial granule programs and proton-coupled oligopeptide/histidine transport, while confusables cover systemic iron, heme and transferrin handling without the phagocyte components.

name: Iron and oligopeptide transport at host-pathogen interface
rationale: Members combine iron import/homeostasis, proton-oligopeptide and vacuolar transport with neutrophil antimicrobial granules and pathogen nutrient competition, which the heme/transferrin confusables lack.

name: HSF1 heat shock response and chaperone-mediated protein refolding
rationale: Members concern HSF1 activation and attenuation, heat acclimation, protein refolding and chaperone-dependent fates (aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy, UPRmt), unlike confusables built on ER UPR, CCT folding, mitochondrial import or stress granules.

qualifier: HSF1 heat shock response and refolding
name: HSF1 heat shock chaperone response and protein refolding
rationale: Members centre on HSF1 activation and attenuation, heat acclimation, protein refolding and stress-regulated chaperone activity (including UPRmt and mitochondrial targeting), distinguishing them from de novo/chaperonin folding, ER UPR, stress granule and aggrephagy confusables.

qualifier: HSF1-driven, with mitochondrial and autophagic chaperone control
name: HSF1 heat shock chaperone response and protein refolding
rationale: Members cover HSF1 activation/attenuation, heat acclimation, protein refolding, UPRmt and chaperone control of mitochondrial targeting and chaperone-mediated autophagy, unlike confusables on ER UPR/chaperonins, stress granules or mitochondrial import.

qualifier: CDC42 signaling and restraint of integrin adhesion
name: CDC42 leading-edge protrusion and restraint of integrin adhesion
rationale: Members concern CDC42/IQGAP-driven leading-edge actin dynamics together with negative regulation of integrin adhesion, Rac/Rho signaling and lamellipodia, which confusables lack in favour of epithelial migration, wound healing or WASP/WAVE activation.

qualifier: CDC42-driven, with suppression of integrin-matrix adhesion
name: CDC42-driven protrusion and suppression of integrin-matrix adhesion
rationale: Members are CDC42/Rho GTPase control of lamellipodia, pseudopodia and actin polymerisation with negative regulation of integrin adhesion and spreading, unlike epithelial migration, invadopodia or WASP/WAVE confusables.

core: Leading-edge actin and cell-matrix adhesion regulation
name: CDC42-driven leading-edge actin and suppressed integrin adhesion
rationale: Members concern CDC42/IQGAP-driven protrusion and actin polymerization with negative regulation of integrin and cell-matrix adhesion, which epithelial migration and WASP/WAVE confusables lack.

name: Monocyte recruitment and endothelial adhesion in inflammation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte activation, chemotaxis, aggregation and leukocyte adhesion to and extravasation through endothelium in inflammatory settings (RAGE, inflammatory response), distinguishing it from confusables focused on CCR2/CX3CR1 chemotaxis, monocyte surface identity or myeloid chemokine output.

name: Monocyte endothelial adhesion, extravasation and inflammatory activation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte/macrophage activation, chemotaxis, adhesion to vascular endothelium and extravasation in inflammation, and the adhesion-molecule and extravasation control separates it from monocyte surface-signature, CCR2/CX3CR1 and synoviocyte confusables.

name: Monocyte recruitment and endothelial adhesion control in inflammation
rationale: All members concern monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, extravasation, activation and inflammatory cytokine output; unlike confusables the theme adds regulation of leukocyte adhesion to endothelium and adhesion-molecule production.

name: Dystroglycan O-mannosylation and keratan sulfate glycosylation
rationale: Members are DAG1 O-mannosyl glycan/matriglycan synthesis and its dystroglycanopathies plus keratan sulfate synthesis and degradation, distinct from muscle-development neighbours and other glycosaminoglycan (CS/DS/HS) pathways.

core: Specialised O-glycan and keratan sulfate synthesis
name: Dystroglycan O-mannosylation and keratan sulfate metabolism
rationale: Members are DAG1 O-mannosyl core/matriglycan synthesis and its dystroglycanopathies plus keratan sulfate synthesis/degradation defects, distinct from other GAG synthesis and muscle/basement membrane themes.

name: Dystroglycan O-mannosylation and keratan sulfate glycosylation
rationale: Members cover DAG1 O-mannosyl/matriglycan synthesis and keratan sulfate synthesis/degradation with their congenital disorders; distinct from other GAG and muscle/basement membrane confusables.

qualifier: SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters and paracellular magnesium
name: Cation-chloride cotransport and tight-junction paracellular magnesium transport
rationale: Members cover SLC12 cotransporters and their Bartter/Gitelman defects plus magnesium homeostasis via tight-junction paracellular transport, each half missing from the sodium/potassium, vasopressin and P-type ATPase confusables.

qualifier: SLC12 cation-chloride cotransport and paracellular magnesium
name: Cation-chloride cotransport and paracellular magnesium transport
rationale: Members include SLC12 cotransporters and their diseases (Bartter, Gitelman), potassium channels and anion homeostasis together with tight-junction paracellular and magnesium transport, combining what each confusable lacks.

qualifier: SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters and paracellular magnesium
name: SLC12 cation-chloride cotransport and paracellular magnesium transport
rationale: Members combine cation-chloride cotransporters and their Bartter/Gitelman diseases with tight-junction paracellular and magnesium transport; each confusable lacks one of these two arms.

name: Misfolded protein clearance via ERAD, reticulophagy and aggrephagy
rationale: Members cover protein quality control by ERAD regulation, reticulophagy, aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy and unfolding; the ERAD/reticulophagy and inclusion-body arms distinguish it from aggresome-only, ribosome QC and stress-granule neighbours.

qualifier: ERAD regulation, reticulophagy and lysosomal autophagy
name: Misfolded protein triage via ERAD, aggrephagy and lysosomal autophagy
rationale: Members handle misfolded proteins through ERAD regulation, unfolding, inclusion/aggresome control, reticulophagy, aggrephagy and chaperone-mediated/microautophagy, distinguishing it from aggresome-only, stress-granule and ribosome quality-control confusables.

name: Misfolded protein quality control by ERAD and selective autophagy
rationale: Members cover handling of misfolded proteins by unfolding, ERAD regulation, reticulophagy, aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy; confusables lack the ERAD and ER-phagy arm or focus on ribosome quality control and stress granules.

name: Inhibition of integrin-matrix adhesion and Rho/Rac protrusive signaling
rationale: Members negatively regulate integrin signaling, focal adhesion, lamellipodia and Rho/Rac signaling, with IQGAP, invadopodia and RPTP signaling distinguishing it from epithelial-migration and wound confusables.

name: Suppression of integrin–matrix adhesion and Rac/Rho protrusive signalling
rationale: Members negatively regulate integrin signalling, cell-matrix adhesion, lamellipodia and Rho/Rac signalling and promote focal adhesion disassembly, lacking the epithelial wound-migration and CDC42/actin polymerisation members of confusables.

name: Inhibition of integrin-matrix adhesion and Rho/Rac-driven actin assembly
rationale: Members restrain integrin signalling, focal adhesions, lamellipodia and actin bundles via Rho/Rac and IQGAP, with invadopodia, RPTP signalling and endothelial morphogenesis that the wound-migration and CDC42 neighbours lack.

name: Calcium-cAMP-CREB signaling in synaptic plasticity and spine growth
rationale: Members link calcium-stimulated adenylate cyclase and CaMKII/IV to CREB phosphorylation with LTP/LTD, synaptic translation, maturation and spine morphogenesis; the cAMP-CREB arm and structural plasticity distinguish it from confusables built on NMDA/AMPA receptor signaling and NPAS4.

qualifier: driving synaptic plasticity and spine maturation
name: Calcium-cAMP-CREB signaling in synaptic plasticity and spine maturation
