qualifier: adenylyl cyclase/cAMP and CaMK routes, structural plasticity
name: Adenylyl cyclase and CaMK-driven CREB activation in synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members cover cAMP and CaMKII/IV routes to CREB phosphorylation with LTP/LTD, spine morphogenesis and synapse maturation; confusables center on NMDA/AMPA receptor signaling or neuronal RNA-binding translational control.

name: Folate-dependent de novo purine and pyrimidine synthesis
rationale: Members are de novo purine and pyrimidine nucleotide synthesis plus tetrahydrofolate/10-formyl-THF metabolism, the folate arm being what all confusables lack.

name: De novo nucleotide synthesis and folate one-carbon metabolism

name: De novo nucleotide synthesis with folate one-carbon metabolism

qualifier: dendritic cell IL-12 and IFN-gamma production
name: Dendritic cell-driven Th1 polarization and IFN-gamma production
rationale: Members span dendritic cell IL-12/cytokine production, Th1 differentiation, IFN-gamma production/response and MHC upregulation, versus confusables focused on IFNG signal regulation, IL-12 JAK-STAT, NKT or Treg biology.

qualifier: dendritic cell IL-12 and IFN-gamma induction
name: Dendritic cell IL-12 and IFN-gamma driven Th1 polarization
rationale: Members describe dendritic-cell cytokine and antigen-presentation activation, IL-12 and IFN-gamma production, MHC upregulation and Th1 differentiation, the upstream induction side absent from IFNG-signaling and IL-12 JAK-STAT/NKT neighbours.

qualifier: dendritic cell IL-12 production and antigen presentation
name: Dendritic cell IL-12 production driving Th1 interferon-gamma responses
rationale: Members span DC cytokine (IL-12, GM-CSF) production, MHC upregulation, Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma response, whereas confusables emphasize IFNG receptor signaling, IL-12 JAK-STAT, CD8 or NKT cells.

name: Acetylcholine, serotonin and tachykinin receptor control of gut motility
rationale: Members are muscarinic, serotonin and tachykinin receptor signaling with gastric motility, acid secretion and intestinal smooth muscle contraction, unlike the generic smooth muscle, cAMP/PDE and histamine confusables.

core: GPCR control of gut motility and secretion
name: Serotonin, muscarinic and tachykinin receptor control of gut motility
rationale: Members are serotonin, acetylcholine and tachykinin receptor signalling with gastric motility, acid secretion and intestinal contraction, unlike confusables on cAMP/PDE, histamine/serotonin synthesis or general smooth muscle relaxation.

name: Serotonin, muscarinic and tachykinin receptor control of gut motility
rationale: Members are serotonin, muscarinic and tachykinin receptor signalling with gastric motility, acid secretion and intestinal smooth muscle contraction, unlike the cAMP, histamine/serotonin metabolism and generic smooth muscle confusables.

qualifier: alpha-, beta- and omega-oxidation with neurometabolic disease defects
name: Fatty acid alpha-, beta- and omega-oxidation and neurometabolic disease
rationale: Members are fatty acid alpha/beta/omega oxidation plus inherited defects (ALD, spastic paraplegias, CTX), distinguishing it from peroxisome biogenesis/lipid synthesis and bile acid confusables.

qualifier: alpha-, beta- and omega-oxidation with hereditary neurometabolic defects
name: Fatty acid alpha-, beta-, omega-oxidation and hereditary neurometabolic defects
rationale: Members are peroxisomal alpha/beta and omega oxidation of fatty acids plus inherited defects (ALD, CTX, spastic paraplegias) in lipid-oxidizing enzymes and transporters, distinct from peroxisome biogenesis, lipid synthesis and bile acid neighbours.

core: Fatty acid alpha-, beta- and omega-oxidation
qualifier: inherited neurometabolic defects (adrenoleukodystrophy, spastic paraplegias, CTX)
name: Fatty acid alpha-, beta- and omega-oxidation and neurometabolic defects
rationale: Members are peroxisomal alpha/beta and omega fatty acid oxidation of medium-to-very-long and branched chains plus the inherited disorders ALD, SPG5A/42/56 and CTX; confusables add peroxisome biogenesis, sterol/bile acid synthesis or PUFA metabolism instead of these disease defects.

name: Myeloid lineage fate regulation with monocyte CCR2/CX3CR1 signatures
rationale: Members regulate monocyte, macrophage, granulocyte and DC differentiation, including CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte modules and GM-CSF response, unlike confusables on promyelocyte progenitors, RUNX1 HSC programmes or CSF signaling.

qualifier: monocyte-macrophage versus granulocyte fate and monocyte identity
name: Monocyte-macrophage versus granulocyte fate control and monocyte identity

name: Myeloid differentiation and CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte recruitment
rationale: Members regulate monocyte, macrophage, dendritic cell and granulocyte differentiation and monocyte chemokine-receptor identity; the CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte modules distinguish it from myeloid progenitor and CSF signalling confusables.

core: Germinal center and memory B cell responses
name: Germinal center and memory B cell responses
rationale: Members span Tfh/ICOS help, germinal center formation, CD27, B cell homeostasis and memory B/T cell signatures, unlike confusables centred on B cell development, proliferation or plasma cells.

core: B cell homeostasis and germinal center responses
name: Germinal center, memory and Tfh-supported B cell responses

qualifier: Tfh help via ICOS and CD27
name: Germinal center Tfh help and B cell memory
rationale: Members span germinal center formation, Tfh differentiation, ICOS and CD27 co-stimulation, memory B/T cell responses and B cell homeostasis signatures, setting it apart from confusables on B cell development, proliferation and plasma cells.

core: Ascorbate and hydrogen peroxide redox metabolism
name: Ascorbate metabolism, hydrogen peroxide and thyroid hormone generation
rationale: Members combine vitamin C metabolism and transport, H2O2/ROS production and breakdown, and thyroid hormone generation/transport; ascorbate separates it from selenium/thyroid-signalling neighbours and the thyroid/H2O2 members from iron and ROS-detox neighbours.

qualifier: ascorbate and H2O2-dependent thyroid hormone generation
name: Ascorbate metabolism and H2O2-dependent thyroid hormone generation
rationale: Members combine vitamin C/E handling with hydrogen peroxide production and thyroid hormone generation and transport, distinct from confusables on iron/selenium, generic ROS detoxification or thyroid hormone receptor signaling.

core: Hydrogen peroxide and antioxidant vitamin metabolism
name: Thyroid hormone generation, hydrogen peroxide and ascorbate metabolism
rationale: Members combine peroxide-dependent thyroid hormone generation/transport and H2O2 regulation with vitamin C/E metabolism and response, distinguishing it from selenium, thyroid receptor, ROS detoxification and iron confusables.

qualifier: glial lineages and midbrain dopaminergic neurons
name: Glial and midbrain dopaminergic neuron fate differentiation
rationale: Members regulate glial (oligodendrocyte, astrocyte, Bergmann glia) and midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation and precursor proliferation, distinguishing it from forebrain progenitor and Schwann cell/myelination confusables.

qualifier: midbrain dopaminergic neurons versus glia (oligodendrocytes, astrocytes, Bergmann glia)
name: Dopaminergic neuron and glial fate differentiation balance
rationale: Members regulate neuron versus glial differentiation, including midbrain dopaminergic neurons, cerebellar precursors and oligodendrocyte/astrocyte/Bergmann glia fates, unlike the forebrain progenitor and Schwann cell confusables.

qualifier: neuron versus glia fate, midbrain dopaminergic neurons
name: Neuronal versus glial differentiation, including midbrain dopaminergic neurons
rationale: Members regulate neuron, astrocyte and oligodendrocyte differentiation and midbrain/cerebellar progenitor proliferation incl. dopaminergic neurons, whereas confusables are forebrain progenitor division or Schwann/myelination themes.

name: Defensin and metal-sequestering antimicrobial defense

name: Defensin and metal-sequestration antimicrobial defense
rationale: Members describe direct microbial killing and lysis by alpha/beta defensins, metal-chelating antimicrobials and mucosal innate defense, which confusables lacking defensins and metal sequestration do not share.

name: Defensin and metal-sequestering antimicrobial defense
rationale: Members describe direct antimicrobial killing by alpha/beta defensins, metal/iron sequestration, cytolysis and mucosal defense, with defensins and metal chelation absent from all confusables.

name: snRNA biogenesis, snRNP assembly and histone mRNA 3'-end processing
rationale: Members span Pol II/III snRNA transcription, cap hypermethylation, transport and snRNP assembly together with SLBP-linked histone mRNA 3' processing and Pol II termination, unlike confusables centred on splice-site recognition, polyadenylation or nuclear RNA decay.

name: snRNA transcription, snRNP biogenesis and histone mRNA 3'-end processing
rationale: Members are Pol II/III snRNA transcription, cap hypermethylation, transport and snRNP assembly plus SLBP/stem-loop histone pre-mRNA processing, distinct from confusables on spliceosome catalysis, splicing regulation or polyadenylation.

name: snRNA biogenesis and histone mRNA 3'-end processing
rationale: Members are Pol II/III snRNA transcription, cap hypermethylation, transport and snRNP assembly together with SLBP stem-loop histone pre-mRNA processing and decay, distinct from splicing-catalysis, polyadenylation and nuclear RNA decay confusables.

qualifier: olfaction and pheromone rather than taste
name: Olfactory and pheromone chemosensation and olfactory system development
rationale: Most members concern olfactory receptors, smell, pheromone and odorant response and nose/olfactory nerve/GnRH neuron development (a few outliers like saliva, nicotine and alcohol likely ride on receptor genes), distinguishing it from taste-perception confusables.

qualifier: odorant and pheromone, olfactory system development
name: Olfactory and pheromone chemosensation and olfactory system development
rationale: Members centre on odorant/pheromone perception, olfactory receptors, olfactory-driven behaviour and nose/olfactory nerve/GnRH neuron development (with peripheral chemosensory items), whereas confusables are taste perception or cranial gland development.

qualifier: olfactory system development and chemosensory behavior
name: Olfactory perception, development and chemosensory behaviors
rationale: Members are smell perception, olfactory receptors, odorant/pheromone responses, nose and olfactory nerve development and chemically driven behaviors, whereas confusables centre on taste perception or cranial gland development.

qualifier: AP-1 induction and AU-rich element mRNA turnover
name: Immediate-early AP-1 response and ARE-mediated mRNA turnover
rationale: Members combine growth-factor/TNF/KRAS-induced AP-1 immediate-early programs with TTP, AUF1, KSRP, BRF1 and HuR control of AU-rich mRNA stability, the AP-1 side distinguishing it from stress-granule/translation confusables and the ARE side from FOSL-target confusables.

name: Immediate-early AP-1 response with AU-rich mRNA turnover
rationale: Members combine AP-1/NR4A immediate-early induction downstream of TNF/NF-kB and KRAS with ARE-binding proteins (TTP, AUF1, KSRP, BRF1, HuR) controlling mRNA stability, distinguishing it from translational-silencing, stress-granule and FOSL target confusables.

name: Immediate-early AP-1 response and AU-rich element mRNA turnover
rationale: Members combine growth-factor/TNF-induced AP-1 immediate-early programs with ARE-binding protein control of mRNA stability, separating it from FOSL target, translational silencing and stress-granule confusables.

qualifier: lipid-modified Wnt and Hedgehog ligand secretion
name: Cysteine palmitoylation and lipid-modified Wnt/Hedgehog ligand secretion

name: Protein S-palmitoylation and lipidated Wnt and Hedgehog secretion
rationale: Members concern cysteine palmitoylation/depalmitoylation and lipidation-dependent Wnt and Hedgehog ligand biogenesis and release, unlike confusables on Hh autoprocessing, geranylgeranylation or non-canonical Wnt.

qualifier: Wnt and Hedgehog ligand acylation and secretion
name: Protein palmitoylation and acylation of Wnt and Hedgehog ligands
rationale: Members are S-palmitoylation/depalmitoylation and PORCN/HHAT acylation enabling Wnt and Hh-Np secretion, unlike confusables on prenylation, Hh autoprocessing or Wnt-Ca2+ signaling.

name: CDC42-IQGAP control of leading-edge protrusion and adhesion
rationale: Members regulate lamellipodia, ruffles, pseudopodia, actin polymerization and integrin/focal adhesion dynamics, with the CDC42 cycle and IQGAP members distinguishing it from the WASP/WAVE, invadopodia and macropinocytosis confusables.

name: CDC42-IQGAP control of leading-edge protrusion and adhesion
rationale: Members cover CDC42 and IQGAP regulation of lamellipodia, pseudopodia, actin polymerization, Rac/integrin signaling and focal adhesion turnover, distinguishing it from WASP/WAVE, invadopodia and macropinocytosis confusables.

core: Regulation of leading-edge protrusion and adhesion
name: CDC42-IQGAP regulation of leading-edge protrusion and adhesion

qualifier: base excision repair gap filling and error-prone translesion synthesis
name: BER gap-filling and error-prone translesion DNA synthesis

qualifier: base excision gap filling and error-prone translesion synthesis
name: Base excision repair gap filling and error-prone translesion synthesis

qualifier: error-prone translesion and long-patch base excision repair
name: Error-prone translesion synthesis and base excision repair gap filling

qualifier: transferrin/DMT1 iron import and cadmium detoxification
name: Transferrin iron uptake and cadmium detoxification

qualifier: heme scavenging and transport, iron uptake

name: cGAS-STING regulation of interferon-beta and CCL5 production

name: cGAS-STING control of interferon-beta and CCL5 production

qualifier: cGAS-STING, CCL5 and dendritic cell cytokines

name: Histidine-histamine metabolism and proton-coupled peptide/histidine transport

name: pH-sensing channels and CFTR-dependent epithelial fluid transport

core: Acid-sensing ion channels and epithelial fluid transport
name: Acid-sensing ion channels and CFTR-mediated epithelial fluid transport

core: Monocyte and neutrophil innate immune activation

qualifier: EGFR, ERBB2 and FGFR mutants, amplifications and fusions

qualifier: EGFR/ERBB2 mutants and FGFR fusions and amplifications
name: Oncogenic EGFR/ERBB2 mutant and FGFR fusion/amplification signaling

name: Neurotrophin TRK receptor downstream kinase and transcriptional signaling

name: Trk neurotrophin receptor downstream kinase and transcriptional signaling

qualifier: downstream kinase cascades and transcriptional output rather than ligand binding or adaptor recruitment
name: Neurotrophin TRK receptor downstream kinase and transcriptional signaling
rationale: Each member is an effector arm of activated TRKA/TRKB signaling - PI3K/AKT, CDK5, RAC1, p38MAPK, ERK5, CREB phosphorylation and NGF-stimulated transcription, plus BDNF responses - distinguishing it from the confusables' ligand-specific receptor activation steps, FRS2/ARMS adaptor recruitment and p75NTR death signaling.

core: Membrane channel trafficking and surface localization
name: Connexin trafficking and cell-surface regulation of ion channels

core: Gap junction and surface channel regulation
qualifier: connexin trafficking and suppression of ion flux

qualifier: connexin gap junctions and ion channel regulation

qualifier: FGFR3 and FGFR1 adaptor cascades with feedback

qualifier: FGFR3 and FGFR1 with positive and negative modulation

core: Regulation of protein stability and proteasomal turnover

core: Neural cell fate and differentiation regulation

name: Organic ion transport with carnitine and choline metabolism

qualifier: metabolic response to activity and disuse

qualifier: metabolic response to activity and disuse
name: Skeletal muscle metabolic adaptation to activity and disuse

core: Adipocyte fatty acid and glycerol flux

core: Adipose thermogenesis and lipolysis product handling

qualifier: anti-inflammatory IL-10, IL-27, IL-35 and IL-37

qualifier: Fanconi anemia cross-link repair and monoubiquitination cycle

rationale: Members combine interstrand cross-link repair, protein monoubiquitination/deubiquitination, recombination-intermediate resolution and checkpoint/p53 repair-gene control; the Fanconi pathway monoubiquitination cycle separates it from homologous recombination and telomere/fork confusables.
