qualifier: APC/C and SCF ubiquitin-ligase control of cyclins
name: APC/C- and SCF-controlled G2/M progression and mitotic exit
rationale: Members are G2/M transition, checkpoint and mitotic exit events dominated by APC/C (Cdc20/Cdh1) and SCF-mediated degradation of cyclins, Emi1 and CDK inhibitors, plus DREAM/p53 G2 arrest transcription, distinguishing it from E2F/G1-S, DNA replication and spindle/cohesion confusables.

name: G2/M progression and APC/C-driven mitotic exit
rationale: Members cover G2/M checkpoint and transition, APC/C and SCF-mediated cyclin degradation and mitotic exit, and DREAM repression, distinct from E2F/G1-S replication and spindle/cohesion confusables.

name: APC/C- and SCF-controlled G2/M progression and mitotic exit
rationale: Members cover G2/M checkpoint and transition, cyclin/CDK regulation and APC/C- and SCF-mediated cyclin/securin degradation through mitotic exit; confusables center on E2F-driven G1/S and replication or on spindle and cohesion machinery.

core: Muscle cell growth and differentiation control
qualifier: both vascular smooth muscle and cardiomyocytes
name: Vascular smooth muscle and cardiomyocyte proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members regulate proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis, migration and adaptation of both vascular smooth muscle and cardiac muscle cells, whereas confusables are vascular-remodeling-only or heart-morphogenesis-only.

qualifier: cardiac and vascular smooth muscle, phenotypic switching
name: Cardiac and vascular smooth muscle cell growth and differentiation
rationale: Members regulate proliferation, differentiation, hypertrophy and phenotypic switching of cardiomyocytes and vascular smooth muscle cells; one neighbour covers heart chamber morphogenesis without smooth muscle and others vascular remodeling without cardiac muscle.

core: Muscle cell growth and differentiation regulation
qualifier: vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and cardiomyocyte proliferation/hypertrophy
name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and cardiomyocyte growth regulation
rationale: Members regulate VSMC proliferation, migration, differentiation and phenotypic switching together with cardiomyocyte proliferation, hypertrophy and adaptation; the VSMC content separates it from heart-development C1 and the cardiac content from vascular-remodeling C2-C4.

core: ER-Golgi vesicle traffic and Golgi organization
qualifier: COPII export and COPI retrograde transport
name: COPII/COPI ER-Golgi vesicle traffic and Golgi structure
rationale: Members are ER exit, COPII cargo loading, COPI anterograde/retrograde and intra-Golgi transport plus Golgi assembly, ribbon and localisation; confusables are Rab/ARF GTPase regulation or post-Golgi endosome-lysosome trafficking.

qualifier: COPII/COPI ER-Golgi transport and Golgi organization
name: ER-Golgi COPII/COPI vesicle traffic and Golgi organization
rationale: Members are COPII export, COPI retrograde and intra-Golgi transport, Golgi tethering/fusion and Golgi ribbon disassembly/reassembly, distinguishing them from post-Golgi endosome/lysosome sorting and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation confusables.

core: ER-Golgi vesicle traffic and Golgi organization
name: COPII and COPI ER-Golgi traffic and Golgi organization
rationale: Members are COPII export from the ER, COPI anterograde/retrograde and intra-Golgi traffic, plus Golgi ribbon assembly, disassembly and positioning; confusables cover post-Golgi lysosomal/endosomal routing and Rab regulation.

qualifier: Hox clusters, somites, hindbrain and limbs
name: Hox-driven axial patterning of somites, hindbrain and limbs
rationale: Members are Hox gene clusters, somitogenesis, rhombomere/hindbrain, neural plate and limb/digit/joint patterning, separating the theme from axial mesoderm/floor-plate/spinal cord and craniofacial/pharyngeal confusables.

qualifier: Hox clusters, somitogenesis and limb morphogenesis
name: Hox-driven embryonic axis patterning, somitogenesis and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members are embryonic body-plan patterning by Hox clusters, somite formation and segmentation, neural plate and hindbrain regionalization and limb/digit/joint morphogenesis, distinguishing it from craniofacial-organ, forebrain and axial-mesoderm/neural-tube confusables.

qualifier: Hox clusters, somites, hindbrain and limbs
name: Hox-driven axial patterning of somites, hindbrain and limbs
rationale: Members cover Hox clusters, somitogenesis, rhombomere and neural plate patterning and limb/joint morphogenesis, distinguishing the theme from confusables about craniofacial and pharyngeal organ development or axial mesoderm and ventral neural tube patterning.

name: Cytochrome P450 steroid, vitamin D and retinoic acid metabolism
rationale: Members are CYP-catalysed syntheses and catabolism of steroid hormones, calcitriol and retinoic acid (with their inherited CYP defects); the vitamin D/retinoid arm separates it from steroid-only confusables and the steroid arm from vitamin A/K confusables.

qualifier: steroids, vitamin D and retinoic acid
name: Cytochrome P450 steroid, vitamin D and retinoic acid metabolism
rationale: Members are CYP-catalysed steroidogenesis, vitamin D and retinoid metabolism and their CYP-defect diseases, unlike confusables centred on phosphate/mineral homeostasis, steroid secretion control or vitamin K.

core: Steroid hormone and vitamin hormone biosynthesis
name: Steroid hormone, vitamin D and retinoic acid metabolism
rationale: Members are largely CYP-driven steroidogenesis (pregnenolone to glucocorticoid, mineralocorticoid, androgen, estrogen) plus vitamin D and retinoic acid synthesis/catabolism; the retinoid and vitamin D arms separate it from steroid/phosphate confusables and steroidogenesis from the vitamin K/retinol confusable.

name: Ubiquitin chain editing, neddylation and proteasome assembly
rationale: Members cover linkage-specific ubiquitination and deubiquitination, DUB families, neddylation/COP9 and proteasome assembly, while confusables emphasise protein quality control, autophagy and degradation regulation.

name: Ubiquitin chain linkage, deubiquitination, neddylation and proteasome assembly
rationale: Members span linkage-specific ubiquitination, DUB families, neddylation/deneddylation, COP9 signalosome and proteasome assembly, whereas confusables emphasise protein quality control, aggrephagy, ERAD and degron pathways.

qualifier: chain-type editing, deubiquitinases, neddylation, proteasome assembly
name: Ubiquitin chain editing, deubiquitinases, neddylation and proteasome assembly
rationale: Members cover linkage-specific ubiquitination, DUB families, neddylation/COP9 deneddylation and proteasome assembly, whereas confusables emphasise substrate degradation, antigen processing or protein quality control and autophagy.

qualifier: miRNA/siRNA and AU-rich element binding proteins
name: MicroRNA silencing and ARE-binding protein mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover small RNA biogenesis and RISC silencing plus ARE-protein, decapping and deadenylation-linked mRNA decay, while confusables emphasise mRNA stabilisation, 3'-end processing or splicing.

qualifier: small RNA pathways and AU-rich element binding proteins
name: Small RNA silencing and AU-rich element–mediated mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA biogenesis and silencing plus ARE-binding protein and decapping-driven mRNA decay; the combination separates it from splicing, 3'-end processing and translation-control confusables.

qualifier: small RNA biogenesis and AU-rich element-binding proteins
name: Small RNA silencing and RNA-binding protein–directed mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and miRNA-mediated silencing plus ARE-binding protein (TTP, AUF1, KSRP, HuR) control of mRNA stability, decapping and 5'-3' decay, unlike confusables on splicing, 3'-end processing or translational control.

qualifier: vitamins A, D and K, including retinoic acid and gamma-carboxylation
name: Vitamin A, D and K metabolism and response
rationale: All members concern retinoid, calciferol or vitamin K metabolism, signaling or vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation, unlike confusables centred on phosphate/bone mineralization, steroid hormone CYPs or the visual retinoid cycle.

qualifier: vitamins A, D and K, with gamma-carboxylation
name: Vitamin A, D and K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation
rationale: All members concern fat-soluble vitamin (retinoid, calciferol, vitamin K) metabolism, response or vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation, distinguishing it from steroid hormone, phosphate/mineralization and visual retinoid-cycle confusables.

qualifier: vitamins A, D and K, including vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation
name: Vitamin A, D and K metabolism and response
rationale: All members concern retinoid, calciferol or vitamin K metabolism, signaling or disease, which separates the theme from the retinoid visual cycle, phosphate/bone mineralization and steroid hormone biosynthesis confusables.

name: Circadian clock machinery and its control of energy metabolism
rationale: Members cover the BMAL1:CLOCK/CRY:PER clock loop with its metabolic outputs (gluconeogenesis, PGC-1alpha, PPARA, beta-cell, thermogenesis); confusables share only the metabolic nuclear-receptor terms and lack the clock itself, focusing on LXR/SREBP lipids, adipogenesis or glucocorticoids.

core: circadian clock control of energy metabolism
qualifier: BMAL1:CLOCK/CRY:PER clock with nuclear receptor metabolic transcription
name: Circadian clock and nuclear receptor metabolic gene regulation
rationale: Members combine the core BMAL1:CLOCK/CRY:PER transcriptional clock with PPARA/PGC-1alpha, LXR-gluconeogenesis and beta-cell metabolic regulation; confusables lack the clock and centre on glucocorticoids, SREBP/LXR lipogenesis or adipogenesis.

name: Circadian clock coupling to nuclear-receptor metabolic regulation
rationale: Members span the BMAL1:CLOCK/CRY:PER core clock and its links to ROR/REV-ERB, PPARA, PGC-1alpha and NR1H-controlled gluconeogenesis and energy metabolism, which the lipogenic, adipogenic and glucocorticoid neighbours lack.

qualifier: replication stress, crosslink repair and recombination resolution
name: Replication-stress DNA repair, crosslink repair and recombination resolution
rationale: Members concern repair at stalled replication forks (fork reversal, ICL/Fanconi repair, BIR, SDSA, strand invasion, responses to crosslinking and topoisomerase drugs), while confusables centre on DSB sensing, NHEJ, BRCA1/2 defects or ADP-ribosylation.

qualifier: interstrand crosslink, fork stress and recombination intermediates
name: Replication-coupled crosslink and fork-stress repair by recombination
rationale: Members concern repair during replication stress (Fanconi/ICL repair, fork reversal, BIR, SDSA, recombination intermediate resolution, genotoxin responses), unlike confusables centred on DSB sensing, NHEJ, BRCA-mediated HR and ADP-ribosylation.

qualifier: fork stress, cross-link repair and recombination resolution
name: Replication fork stress, cross-link repair and recombination resolution
rationale: Members share repair at stalled replication forks (Fanconi/ICL repair, fork reversal, BIR, SDSA, intermediate resolution, genotoxic drug responses), whereas confusables centre on DSB sensing, NHEJ, BRCA defects or ADP-ribosylation.

name: Protein quality control via selective autophagy and ERAD
rationale: Members cover misfolded-protein handling through aggrephagy, pexophagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy, aggresome formation and ERAD regulation, distinguishing them from proteasomal N-end rule, stress granule, chaperonin folding and ribosome QC confusables.

name: Misfolded protein quality control via selective autophagy and aggresomes
rationale: Members cover misfolded protein handling through aggrephagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy and ERAD regulation, unlike the stress-granule, proteasomal and chaperonin-folding confusables.

name: Selective autophagy and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members cover aggrephagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy with ERAD and misfolded-protein responses, while confusables centre on chaperonin folding, stress granules or proteasomal/ribosome QC.

core: plasma membrane phospholipid redistribution and the lipid-dependent clearance it enables
qualifier: phosphatidylserine exposure with apoptotic cell engulfment and alveolar surfactant lipid handling
name: Membrane phospholipid exposure in apoptotic clearance and surfactant homeostasis
rationale: All members involve translocation or scrambling of membrane phospholipids and the processes that read it - PS display, blebbing, recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells and neutrophils, membrane repair, and surfactant lipid secretion and its transporter diseases; the confusables substitute general secretory and mitochondrial housekeeping modules, mechanotransduction, or lung epithelial differentiation.

core: plasma membrane phospholipid externalization and lipid-mediated cell clearance
name: Phospholipid scrambling, apoptotic cell clearance and surfactant lipid handling
rationale: Members all concern moving phospholipid between membrane leaflets or compartments and what that enables, phosphatidylserine display with engulfment of dying cells and surfactant lipid secretion and its genetic failures, unlike the alveolar cell differentiation and generic membrane-traffic confusables.

qualifier: pulmonary surfactant and phosphatidylserine scrambling in apoptotic cell clearance
name: Surfactant homeostasis, phospholipid scrambling and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members combine surfactant metabolism and its genetic disorders with phospholipid translocation/scrambling, PS exposure, efferocytosis and plasma-membrane remodelling, unlike confusables on lung development or general membrane traffic.

core: Transcriptional control of lipid and glucose metabolism
qualifier: nutrient-sensing ChREBP, LXR, SREBP, PPARA and circadian receptors
name: Nutrient-sensing transcriptional regulation of lipid and glucose metabolism
rationale: Members are glucose/fatty acid-responsive transcriptional programs (ChREBP, LXR, SREBP, PPARA, PGC-1alpha, ROR/REV-ERB) controlling lipogenesis, triglycerides and gluconeogenesis, unlike adipogenesis or glucagon-PKA confusables.

core: Transcriptional control of lipid and glucose metabolism
name: Nutrient-sensing transcriptional control of lipogenesis and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members are sugar-, fatty acid- and sterol-responsive transcriptional regulators of triglyceride, cholesterol and glucose metabolism; neighbours instead focus on adipocyte differentiation, glucagon/PKA signaling or SREBP processing.

qualifier: glucose/lipid sensing by ChREBP, SREBP, LXR, PPARA and clock factors
name: Glucose- and lipid-sensing transcriptional control of lipogenesis and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members are transcriptional responses to sugar and fatty acids (ChREBP, SREBP, LXR, PPARA, PGC-1alpha, circadian nuclear receptors) governing triglyceride, lipogenesis and gluconeogenesis, unlike glucagon/PKA, adipogenesis or cholesterol-synthesis confusables.

qualifier: mitotic nuclear envelope disassembly and ESCRT resealing
name: SUMOylation and mitotic nuclear envelope disassembly and resealing
rationale: Members are the SUMO conjugation cascade and its targets plus mitotic nuclear envelope breakdown, reformation and ESCRT-III sealing/abscission, unlike the nuclear pore, cohesin and spindle confusables.

qualifier: with mitotic nuclear envelope breakdown, ESCRT sealing and abscission
name: SUMOylation and mitotic nuclear envelope turnover
rationale: Members are SUMO conjugation of many substrate classes plus lamina depolymerization, nuclear envelope reformation/ESCRT-III sealing and abscission; confusables are chromosome condensation, spindle events or nuclear pore transport.

core: SUMOylation and mitotic nuclear envelope dynamics
name: SUMOylation and mitotic nuclear envelope disassembly and resealing
rationale: Members are the SUMO conjugation cascade and SUMOylation of nuclear targets together with mitotic nuclear envelope breakdown, reassembly, ESCRT-III sealing and abscission, unlike nuclear pore transport and chromosome condensation confusables.

qualifier: reward and behavioural responses to addictive drugs
name: Dopaminergic signalling and reward responses to addictive drugs
rationale: Members combine dopamine receptor signalling with behavioural and cellular responses to cocaine, nicotine, ethanol, amphetamine and opioids, unlike confusables on catecholamine transport, neuropeptides or social behaviours.

qualifier: drug, nicotine and alcohol reward behaviour
name: Dopamine receptor signalling in drug and alcohol reward behaviour
rationale: Members combine dopamine/nicotinic/opioid receptor signalling with behavioural responses to cocaine, nicotine, ethanol and amphetamine and reward conditioning, whereas confusables cover monoamine transport/synthesis or neuropeptide-driven behaviours.

qualifier: responses to addictive drugs including nicotine and ethanol
name: Dopaminergic reward signalling and responses to addictive drugs
rationale: Members combine dopamine/opioid receptor signalling and nicotinic receptors with behavioural and cellular responses to cocaine, amphetamine, nicotine and ethanol, which confusables on neuropeptide behaviour or catecholamine transport lack.

core: Renal sodium and blood pressure regulation
name: Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone regulation of sodium and blood pressure
rationale: Members cover angiotensin generation and signalling, renal sodium handling, blood volume and pressure, plus aldosterone/corticosteroid synthesis, which separates it from the vasopressin/water and natriuretic confusables.

core: Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone control of blood pressure and sodium
name: Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone control of blood pressure and sodium
rationale: Members cover angiotensin generation and signalling, renal sodium and volume handling, and aldosterone/corticosteroid synthesis and response; the aldosterone/steroidogenic arm distinguishes it from the vasopressin-aquaporin and natriuretic/cGMP blood-pressure neighbours.

name: Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system and adrenal corticosteroid synthesis
rationale: Members cover angiotensin generation and signaling, aldosterone synthesis/secretion/response and renal sodium and blood-volume control; the mineralocorticoid/glucocorticoid biosynthesis members separate it from the vasopressin, water and natriuretic confusables.

qualifier: Sema3A repulsion, collateral sprouting and peripheral regeneration
name: Axon outgrowth inhibition, Sema3A repulsion and nerve regeneration
rationale: Members concern axon growth stimulation and inhibition, Sema3A/CRMP repulsion, collateral sprouting and peripheral axon regeneration, which neighbours focused on netrin, ephrin and Slit guidance lack.

name: Axon sprouting and regeneration with Sema3A repulsion
rationale: Members cover axon outgrowth, collateral sprouting, peripheral axon regeneration and Sema3A/RhoA growth inhibition, whereas confusables centre on netrin, Slit-Robo and ephrin axon pathfinding.

name: Axon growth, sprouting and regeneration with Sema3A repulsion
rationale: Members concern axon extension, collateral sprouting, regeneration and Sema3A/RHOA growth inhibition; regeneration and sprouting members distinguish it from netrin, slit and ephrin guidance confusables.

name: Polyubiquitin chain assembly and proteasomal protein degradation
rationale: Members share E3-mediated polyubiquitination with diverse chain linkages and proteasomal/degron-rule degradation, unlike confusables on deubiquitination/neddylation, ERAD quality control or ribosome-associated QC.

name: Polyubiquitin chain types and proteasome-dependent protein degradation
rationale: Members cover E3 ligases, K6/K11/K27/K29/branched chain formation, degron pathways and regulation of proteasomal catabolism, unlike confusables on ERAD quality control, deubiquitination or ribosome quality control.

qualifier: E3 ligation, atypical and branched chain linkages
name: E3 ubiquitination, atypical chain linkages and proteasomal degradation
rationale: Members cover E3-ligase ubiquitination, K6/K11/K27/K29 and branched chain formation, N-end and C-end degron pathways, the proteasome and regulation of proteasomal catabolism, distinguishing it from confusables on deubiquitinases and neddylation, ERAD and misfolded-protein quality control, or ribosome-associated quality control.

name: Chromatin remodelling by BAF complexes and protein acetylation
rationale: Members are SWI/SNF BAF complex assembly, histone/protein acetylation and nucleosome assembly/disassembly, whereas confusables centre on methylation, NuRD and CHD6-9 repression without acetylation.

name: BAF chromatin remodeling complexes and histone acetylation
rationale: Members center on assembly of the BAF remodeling complex variants with histone/protein acetylation and nucleosome organization, while confusables add CHD6-9, NuRD and histone methylation machinery.

name: BAF complex chromatin remodeling and protein acetylation
rationale: Members combine BAF-family complex formation, nucleosome assembly/disassembly and histone/protein acetylation, while confusables add NuRD, CHD6-9 and histone/DNA methylation.

qualifier: ApoB lipoproteins and LDL-receptor family turnover
name: ApoB-lipoprotein remodeling, clearance and LDL-receptor family turnover
rationale: Members are chylomicron/VLDL/LDL remodeling and clearance with LDLR/VLDLR internalization and degradation, unlike HDL, cholesterol efflux/biosynthesis and intestinal absorption confusables.

qualifier: chylomicron/VLDL and LDL remodeling and receptor uptake
name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein and LDL remodeling and receptor-mediated clearance
rationale: Members cover chylomicron/VLDL/LDL remodeling, lipase complexes and receptor internalization for clearance, whereas confusables add HDL, cholesterol efflux, ABC transporters and SREBP sterol homeostasis.

name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein remodelling and receptor-mediated clearance
rationale: Members cover chylomicron/VLDL/LDL remodelling by LPL/LIPC and receptor-mediated internalization and degradation, distinguishing the theme from cholesterol homeostasis/HDL, LDL-cholesterol endocytosis and broader lipid absorption/ABC transporter confusables.

core: Endothelial specification and arterial vessel morphogenesis
name: BMP-promoted endothelial specification and arterial vessel morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover endothelial fate (arterial, venous, lymphatic) and great-artery/outflow morphogenesis with positive BMP/SMAD signaling, versus confusables with BMP inhibition, Nodal asymmetry or adherens junction terms.

qualifier: endothelial fate specification and BMP signaling
name: Endothelial specification, arterial morphogenesis and BMP signaling
rationale: Members cover endothelial, arterial, venous and lymphatic fate, great-artery and outflow tract morphogenesis and positive BMP/SMAD signaling, unlike confusables on BMP/Nodal antagonism, adherens junctions or coronary vasculogenesis.

qualifier: BMP-driven endothelial specification and outflow-artery morphogenesis
name: BMP signaling in endothelial specification and outflow-artery morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover arterial/venous/lymphatic endothelial fate, vasculogenesis and BMP/SMAD signaling together with pharyngeal arch, pulmonary, coronary and outflow-tract artery morphogenesis; confusables lack either the endothelial-fate or the outflow-artery components.

qualifier: with myelination and glial injury response
name: Axon regeneration, myelination and glial injury response
rationale: Members span axon growth/regeneration signaling, CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, and glial responses (gliosis, astrocyte migration, OPC proliferation); the myelin and glial members distinguish it from axon-sprouting and Sema3A confusables.

qualifier: myelination plus axon regeneration and caliber
name: Axon regeneration, caliber and glial myelination
rationale: Members cover CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, gliosis, axon diameter and neurofilaments together with injured-axon regeneration; the sprouting/guidance confusables lack the myelination side and the oligodendrocyte confusable lacks axon regeneration.

name: Axon regeneration, myelination and glial injury responses
rationale: Members cover axon sprouting/regeneration plus CNS/PNS myelin formation, oligodendrocyte and astrocyte responses; the myelin and glial component separates it from collateral-sprouting/Sema3A neighbours, and the axon regeneration component from the myelination-only neighbour.

qualifier: cyclooxygenase prostanoid and cytochrome P450 (EET, HETE) branches
name: Prostaglandin and cytochrome P450 eicosanoid synthesis
rationale: All members concern arachidonate release and its conversion to eicosanoids via COX (prostaglandins, thromboxanes, fever) and P450 epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase (EETs, HETEs), whereas confusables centre on leukotrienes, lipoxygenase products and pro-resolving mediators.

qualifier: cyclooxygenase prostanoid and cytochrome P450 epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase branches
name: Cyclooxygenase and cytochrome P450 eicosanoid synthesis
rationale: All members concern arachidonate-derived eicosanoid production and response via COX (prostaglandins, thromboxanes) and CYP450 (EETs, HETEs) routes, unlike confusables centred on lipoxygenase products such as leukotrienes, lipoxins and resolvins.

core: Arachidonic acid eicosanoid synthesis and signaling
qualifier: cyclooxygenase prostanoid and cytochrome P450 hydroxylase/epoxygenase branches
name: Cyclooxygenase and P450 eicosanoid synthesis and signaling
rationale: All members concern eicosanoid production or response via COX-derived prostaglandins/thromboxanes and P450-derived HETEs/EETs, unlike confusables centred on lipoxygenase leukotrienes, lipoxins and resolvins.

qualifier: tolerance, Treg differentiation and activation-induced death
name: T cell activation control: tolerance, Treg differentiation, activation-induced death
rationale: Members restrain or steer T cell activation (suppressed proliferation and cytokines, Treg and Th1 differentiation, tolerance, AICD/Fas, allograft rejection), and unlike confusables include T cell signalling modules and AICD rather than NK/DC cytotoxicity or anergy.

qualifier: regulatory T cell differentiation and tolerance
name: CD4 T cell activation, Treg differentiation and tolerance
rationale: Members regulate T cell activation, proliferation and cytokine output with emphasis on Treg differentiation, tolerance induction and activation-induced death, distinguished from confusables on Th1 positive effector, other cytokine repression or NK-cell cytotoxicity.

qualifier: Treg differentiation, tolerance and Th1 restraint
name: Regulation of T cell activation, Treg differentiation and Th1 responses
rationale: Members regulate T cell activation, proliferation, cytokine output and death alongside Treg differentiation, tolerance and Th1/Th17 commitment; confusables focus on peripheral tolerance/anergy, cytokine suppression, Th1 effector induction or NK cytotoxicity.

name: Adherens junctions and apical–basal epithelial polarity
rationale: Members cover cadherin adherens junction assembly and maintenance together with apical-basal polarity, apical constriction and EMT restraint, separating them from desmosome/hemidesmosome, CDH processing and tight-junction confusables.

name: Adherens junction adhesion and epithelial apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members are cadherin-mediated adherens junction assembly and regulation plus apical-basal polarity and apical constriction, unlike confusables on desmosomes/hemidesmosomes, CDH1 turnover or tight junctions.

name: Cadherin-based adherens junctions and epithelial apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members cover cadherin adhesion, adherens junction assembly/maintenance and apical-basal polarity, distinct from desmosome/hemidesmosome, CDH1/CDH11 processing and tight junction confusables.

core: Extracellular protease cascades and their inhibition
qualifier: contact system, fibrinolysis and matrix degradation
name: Contact system, fibrinolysis and matrix proteolysis regulation
rationale: Members share plasma/extracellular proteolysis — FXII/kallikrein and bradykinin, plasminogen activation, MMP-driven collagen/elastin breakdown and serpin inhibition — unlike coagulation-cascade or ECM-adhesion confusables.

name: Plasma contact activation, fibrinolysis and matrix proteolysis control
rationale: Members are FXII/kallikrein contact activation, plasminogen activation and fibrinolysis, MMP-driven collagen and elastin breakdown and their serpin inhibition, distinguishing it from confusables on the extrinsic/common coagulation cascade and VWF or on ECM adhesion.

core: Extracellular protease cascades and their inhibitors
qualifier: contact system, fibrinolysis and matrix metalloproteases
name: Contact-system, fibrinolytic and matrix metalloprotease cascades and inhibitors
rationale: Members concern FXII-kallikrein-bradykinin contact activation, plasminogen/fibrinolysis, MMP-driven collagen and elastin breakdown and their serpin-type inhibition, unlike confusables centred on the coagulation cascade/VWF or integrin-ECM adhesion.

name: Renal proximal tubule urate, organic ion and cystine transport
rationale: Members are SLC carriers for urate, organic anions and cations and cystine with their renal hypouricemia and cystinuria defects and proximal tubule development, distinguishing them from the amino acid and peptide transporter confusables.

name: Renal proximal tubule organic ion, urate and cystine transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated organic anion/cation, urate and cystine transport and their renal diseases (cystinuria, hypouricemia) in the proximal tubule, distinct from confusables dominated by amino acid and peptide transporters.

name: Renal tubular organic ion, urate and cystine transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated organic anion/cation, urate and cystine transport and their renal disorders, whereas confusables focus on neutral amino acid and peptide transport.

name: Erythropoietin, CSF1 and LTK/ALK receptor PI3K-AKT/ERK signaling
rationale: Members are PI3K-AKT, RAS-ERK, PLCG and STAT5 signaling downstream of EPO/TPO, interleukin, CSF1 and LTK/ALK receptors, distinguishing them from MET, IGF1R/IRS and oncogenic RTK fusion confusables.

core: Receptor signalling to PI3K-AKT and RAS
name: Hematopoietic cytokine and LTK/ALK receptor signalling to PI3K-AKT
rationale: Members are erythropoietin, thrombopoietin, CSF1, interleukin SHC and LTK/ALK signalling feeding PI3K-AKT, ERK and STAT5, distinguishing them from confusables on oncogenic RTK mutants, IGF1R/IRS and MET.

core: Receptor signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
name: Erythropoietin/thrombopoietin, CSF1 and ALK/LTK signaling to PI3K-AKT
rationale: Members are EPO, TPO, CSF1, interleukin-SHC and ALK/LTK signaling converging on PI3K-AKT, RAS-ERK and STAT5, distinct from MET, IGF1R/IRS and oncogenic FGFR/PDGFR fusion confusables.

core: Tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
name: PTK6 and ALK/LTK signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
rationale: Members are PTK6 signaling events, ALK/LTK signaling and tyrosine autophosphorylation driving PI3K-AKT and ERK activation, distinguishing it from MET and ERBB receptor confusables.

core: Tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K/AKT and ERK
name: PTK6 and ALK/LTK kinase signaling via PI3K/AKT
rationale: Members are PTK6 signalling events, ALK/LTK signalling and tyrosine autophosphorylation feeding PI3K/AKT and ERK, which distinguishes them from the ERBB- and MET-centred confusables.

core: Tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
name: PTK6 and ALK/LTK kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
rationale: Members describe PTK6 and ALK/LTK tyrosine kinase signaling, autophosphorylation and activation of PI3K/AKT and ERK cascades, distinguishing the theme from MET and ERBB family receptor confusables.

qualifier: capping, recombination and DNA topological remodelling
name: Telomere capping, recombination and DNA topological remodelling
rationale: Members cover telomere capping, recombination-based maintenance, D-loop/t-circle control and DNA topology, R-loop and fork-reversal remodelling, distinct from C-strand synthesis and replication-stress checkpoint confusables.

core: Telomere protection and DNA structure remodeling
qualifier: R-loops, fork reversal and NHEJ suppression
name: Telomere protection and DNA topology remodeling during replication and repair
rationale: Members combine telomere capping, recombination-based telomere maintenance and NHEJ protection with R-loop processing, fork reversal and DNA topological change, unlike neighbours centred on telomeric C-strand synthesis, replication-stress checkpoints or break-induced replication.

core: Telomere maintenance and DNA repair regulation
qualifier: telomere end protection and DNA topology remodeling
name: Telomere end protection and DNA structural remodeling in repair
rationale: Members cover telomere capping, recombination and replication with DNA topological change, fork reversal, R-loop processing and NHEJ restraint, unlike C-strand synthesis and replication stress neighbours.

qualifier: glutamate-family interconversion and ammonium homeostasis rather than urea cycle enzymes
name: Glutamate-centered amino acid interconversion and ammonium homeostasis
rationale: Members cover glutamate/glutamine, aspartate, proline, ornithine/arginine and GABA conversion plus ammonium handling, while confusables emphasize urea cycle defects, amino acid transport or glyoxylate/glycine metabolism.

name: Glutamate-family and aspartate amino acid metabolism, nitrogen balance
rationale: Members cover glutamate, glutamine, proline, ornithine, arginine, aspartate and GABA metabolism with ammonium homeostasis, without the urea cycle enzyme defects, amino acid transport or glyoxylate/glycine content of confusables.

core: Glutamate-family and aspartate amino acid metabolism
name: Glutamate-family and aspartate amino acid metabolism, ammonium homeostasis
rationale: Members span glutamate, glutamine, proline, ornithine, arginine and aspartate metabolism with ammonium/nitrogen handling, lacking the core urea cycle enzyme defects, cationic amino acid transport and glyoxylate/2-oxoglutarate sets of the confusables.

qualifier: desmosomes, hemidesmosomes and collagen/laminin basement membrane
name: Desmosome, hemidesmosome and collagen–laminin basement membrane adhesion
rationale: Members are cell-cell (desmosome, cadherin) and cell-basement membrane (hemidesmosome, integrin, laminin, collagen, anchoring fibril) adhesion, distinguished from adherens-junction/polarity/EMT confusables by the hemidesmosome and basement-membrane matrix members.

core: Cell adhesion junctions and matrix attachment
name: Cadherin, desmosome and hemidesmosome-basement membrane adhesion
rationale: Members span cadherin/desmosome cell-cell adhesion and hemidesmosome, laminin, collagen and integrin anchorage to basement membrane, distinct from confusables focused on adherens/apical junctions, polarity and EMT or cornified envelope.

qualifier: desmosomes, hemidesmosomes and basement membrane adhesion
name: Cell-cell and cell-basement membrane anchoring junctions
rationale: Members cover desmosome/hemidesmosome assembly, cadherin adhesion and laminin/collagen/integrin basement-membrane contacts, unlike confusables centred on adherens junctions and apical polarity or cornified envelope.

name: Osteoclast bone remodeling, mineralization and IGF/phosphate responses
rationale: Members regulate osteoclast differentiation/fusion, bone resorption and mineralization with IGF and FGF23-Klotho phosphate responses, unlike osteoblast/Wnt and tooth mineralization confusables.

qualifier: osteoclast activity with IGF and phosphate responses
name: Osteoclast-mediated bone remodelling, mineralization and IGF/phosphate responses
rationale: Members concern bone mineralization, osteoclast differentiation/fusion and resorption with IGF, phosphate and FGF23-Klotho responses, whereas confusables are osteoblast/Wnt or tooth mineralization programmes.

qualifier: osteoclast-driven, with IGF and phosphate responses
name: Osteoclast bone remodelling, mineralization and IGF/phosphate responses
rationale: Members cover osteoclast differentiation/fusion, bone resorption and mineralization with IGF and FGF23–Klotho phosphate responses, whereas confusables emphasize osteoblast/Wnt or tooth mineralization.

qualifier: glutamate, aspartate, alanine and malate-aspartate shuttle
name: TCA cycle anaplerosis via glutamate, aspartate and alanine
rationale: Members connect glutamate, glutamine, aspartate and alanine metabolism to TCA intermediates, the malate-aspartate shuttle and gluconeogenesis, unlike confusables on oxidative phosphorylation, broad amino acid catabolism or urea cycle.

name: TCA-linked glutamate, aspartate and alanine metabolism
rationale: Members link TCA intermediates (oxaloacetate, malate, 2-oxoglutarate, pyruvate) to glutamate, aspartate and alanine via transamination, the malate-aspartate shuttle and gluconeogenesis, unlike confusables on other amino acid catabolism, dicarboxylate transport or OXPHOS.

name: TCA-cycle-linked glutamate, aspartate and alanine metabolism
rationale: Members link the TCA cycle, malate-aspartate shuttle, gluconeogenesis and pyruvate with glutamate, glutamine, aspartate and alanine metabolism, unlike oxidative phosphorylation, dicarboxylate transport or broad amino acid catabolism/urea cycle confusables.

qualifier: cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth and ventricular myocardium
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation and ventricular myocardium growth
rationale: Members regulate cardiac muscle cell proliferation, differentiation, hypertrophy, regeneration and compact/trabecular ventricular myocardium, whereas neighbours emphasise septation, endocardium and second heart field.

qualifier: myocardial wall (trabecular/compact) morphogenesis, regeneration and hypertrophy
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation and growth in myocardial wall morphogenesis
rationale: Members regulate cardiac muscle cell proliferation, differentiation, survival and growth in trabecular/compact myocardium, regeneration and stress hypertrophy, whereas confusables concern early heart tube, second heart field, septal and endocardial morphogenesis.

qualifier: ventricular myocardial wall morphogenesis and regeneration
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth and myocardial wall morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern cardiac muscle cell proliferation, differentiation, hypertrophy, survival and regeneration and trabecular/compact ventricular myocardium formation, while confusables centre on septum, endocardium and early heart-field specification.

qualifier: heart tube, second heart field and septation
name: Embryonic heart tube, second heart field and septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members describe cardiogenesis from heart tube patterning and second heart field specification to ventricle formation and septum morphogenesis, distinguishing it from conduction-system, valve/cushion, outflow-tract and cardiomyocyte-growth neighbours.

qualifier: heart tube, second heart field and septation
name: Heart tube, second heart field and cardiac septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members describe cardiogenesis from heart tube patterning and second heart field to ventricle formation and atrial/ventricular septation, distinguishing it from outflow tract, coronary, valve/endocardial cushion and conduction system confusables.

qualifier: chamber formation and septation from heart tube and second heart field
name: Embryonic heart chamber formation and cardiac septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern heart tube patterning, second heart field, ventricle formation and atrial/ventricular septum morphogenesis, while confusables centre on conduction system, trabeculation, valves, outflow tract or coronary vessels.

core: Small GTPase control of membrane traffic
qualifier: ARF/Rab regulation of endocytic recycling and Golgi export
name: ARF/Rab GTPase regulation of endosomal recycling and Golgi export
rationale: Members concern ARF and Rab GTPase regulation of endosome tubulation, recycling, Golgi budding and constitutive secretion, distinguishing it from Golgi-lysosome transport and Golgi structure confusables.

name: ARF/Rab GTPase control of endocytic recycling and endosome tubulation
rationale: Members share ARF/Rab GTPase regulation of endosome recycling, tubulation and Golgi vesicle budding, distinct from confusables on Golgi-lysosome transport and Golgi organization.

name: Rab-GAP and Arf control of endosomal recycling and Golgi
rationale: Members combine Rab GAP/Arf GTPase regulation with endocytic recycling, endosome tubulation and Golgi vesicle budding/localization, which Golgi-organization, retrograde and lysosome-biogenesis confusables lack.

name: Mismatch repair and TGF-beta/SMAD mutants in cancer
rationale: Members combine mismatch repair and its defects with cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3/4 (MSI targets), which neither the Hippo/RUNX3, TGFBR3, immunoglobulin diversification nor BER confusables contain.

name: Mismatch repair defects and TGF-beta/SMAD cancer mutants
rationale: Members combine mismatch repair and its defective forms with TGFBR/SMAD and TCF7L2 mutants typical of microsatellite-unstable cancer, unlike confusables on Hippo/RUNX3, TGFBR3, base excision repair or somatic hypermutation.

qualifier: with TGF-beta receptor and SMAD cancer mutants
name: Mismatch repair and TGF-beta receptor/SMAD cancer mutants
rationale: Members combine MutS/MutL mismatch repair and its defects with cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2, SMAD2/3/4 and TCF7L2, the microsatellite-instability axis, whereas confusables pair the TGF-beta mutants with RUNX3/Hippo or TGFBR3, or the mismatch repair set with base excision repair or immunoglobulin diversification.

name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism with tetrahydrobiopterin synthesis
rationale: Members center on phenylalanine/tyrosine catabolism, phenylketonuria and the BH4 cofactor, with generic amino/organic acid terms, which confusables on sulfur, serine, glycine or glycine-conjugation pathways lack.

name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism with tetrahydrobiopterin cofactor
rationale: Members are phenylalanine/tyrosine degradation, phenylketonuria, BH4 synthesis and general organic/amino acid metabolism terms, distinct from glycine, threonine, proline and sulfur amino acid confusables.

name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism with tetrahydrobiopterin synthesis
rationale: Members concern phenylalanine/tyrosine metabolism, phenylketonuria and BH4 synthesis with generic amino/organic acid terms, distinct from glycine, threonine, proline and sulfur amino acid neighbours.

name: Extracellular matrix degradation, fibrinolysis and integrin adhesion
rationale: Members combine MMP/collagen/elastin degradation, plasminogen activation and fibrin clot dissolution with integrin adhesion; confusables add contact-activation/kallikrein or hyaluronan turnover instead.

name: Matrix and fibrin clot proteolysis with integrin adhesion
rationale: Members combine MMP/collagen/elastin degradation with plasminogen activation, fibrinolysis, platelet degranulation and integrin adhesion, separating it from contact-activation/kallikrein and hyaluronan/ectodomain-shedding neighbours.

name: Matrix degradation with plasminogen fibrinolysis and integrin adhesion
rationale: Members combine collagen/elastin degradation and MMP control with plasminogen activation, fibrin clot dissolution and integrin-mediated adhesion; fibrinolysis and adhesion are what hyaluronan- and contact-system confusables lack.

qualifier: von Willebrand factor-platelet adhesion variants and plasminogen regulation
name: Coagulation, fibrinolysis and von Willebrand factor-platelet adhesion
rationale: Members span the extrinsic/common coagulation cascade, fibrin formation and dissolution, plasminogen activation and VWF/GPIb/ADAMTS13 variants, distinguishing them from contact-pathway FXII and factor VIII/IX defect neighbours.

name: Coagulation, fibrinolysis and von Willebrand factor platelet adhesion
rationale: Members span the coagulation cascade, fibrin formation and plasminogen-mediated clot dissolution plus VWF variant binding/cleavage, distinguishing it from confusables on factor V, factor VIII/IX defects or the FXII/kallikrein contact pathway.

core: Blood coagulation and fibrin clot turnover
name: Coagulation, fibrinolysis and VWF-dependent platelet adhesion
rationale: Members span the coagulation cascade, fibrin formation and dissolution, plasminogen activation and VWF-GPIb/collagen platelet adhesion variants; confusables focus on F8/F9 defects, contact-pathway FXII/kallikrein or FV variants.

qualifier: interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors (ISG15, OAS, PKR) and signalling feedback
name: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors and signalling feedback
rationale: Members are the downstream type I interferon response: IFN-alpha signalling and its negative regulation, ISG signatures and effectors such as ISG15, OAS and PKR, unlike confusables centred on upstream nucleic-acid sensing (RIG-I, TLR, cGAS-STING) and interferon production.

qualifier: interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors and signalling feedback
name: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors and signalling feedback
rationale: Members are interferon-alpha response genes and effectors (ISG15, OAS, PKR) with negative regulation of IFN signalling, unlike the pattern-recognition sensing and IFN induction (RIG-I, cGAS-STING, TLR, IRF3) in confusables.

name: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral effector response
rationale: Members are IFN-alpha response signatures and ISG effectors (ISG15, OAS, PKR) with feedback regulation, distinct from confusables on nucleic acid sensing, TLR/RIG-I/cGAS signalling and IFN production.

name: Neurexin-neuroligin synapse assembly and postsynaptic receptor clustering
rationale: Members describe neurexin-neuroligin-driven pre/postsynaptic assembly, clustering of GABA-A, NMDA, gephyrin and PSD-95 and resulting excitatory/inhibitory transmission; confusables are RPTP and SALM synaptic adhesion sets.

name: Synapse assembly with glutamate and GABA receptor clustering
rationale: Members concern pre/postsynaptic assembly with PSD-95, NMDA, GABA receptor and gephyrin clustering and excitatory/inhibitory transmission, versus confusables on synaptic adhesion molecules and RPTPs.

name: Synapse assembly with glutamate and GABA receptor clustering
rationale: Members build pre- and postsynaptic membranes and cluster NMDA, GABA-A, PSD-95 and gephyrin while tuning excitatory/inhibitory potentials; confusables center on synaptic adhesion molecules and receptor tyrosine phosphatases.

name: Nucleoside and nucleoside-analogue drug transport with xenobiotic efflux
rationale: Members concern purine/pyrimidine nucleoside transport, abacavir and ribavirin handling and xenobiotic export, unlike neighbours on nucleotide interconversion, thiopurine metabolism and mitochondrial nucleotide transport.

name: Nucleoside and xenobiotic drug transmembrane transport
rationale: Members cover plasma membrane purine/pyrimidine nucleoside transport and nucleoside-analog drugs together with xenobiotic export and drug response, unlike the nucleotide interconversion and catabolism confusables.

name: Nucleoside and xenobiotic drug transmembrane transport
rationale: Members cover nucleoside/nucleobase transporters (including SLC29A3), nucleoside-analogue drug transport and xenobiotic export; transport distinguishes it from nucleotide catabolism and thiopurine metabolism confusables.

qualifier: glycerol transport and glycerol-3-phosphate to triglyceride synthesis
name: Glycerol transport and glycerol-3-phosphate to triglyceride synthesis
rationale: Members cover glycerol/polyol metabolism and aquaporin transport, glycerol-3-phosphate, PA, DAG and TAG synthesis and lysophospholipid hydrolysis, unlike confusables on lipolysis, endocannabinoids, lipid droplets or PC synthesis.

qualifier: glycerol backbone metabolism, aquaglyceroporin transport and acylglycerol synthesis
name: Glycerol metabolism, aquaglyceroporin transport and acylglycerol synthesis
rationale: Members share glycerol-backbone metabolism (glycerol, glycerol-3-phosphate, alditols/fructose, PA, MAG/DAG/TAG synthesis, lysophospholipid hydrolysis) and aquaporin glycerol/urea transport, unlike confusables centred on lipid-droplet and TG catabolism, endocannabinoids or PC synthesis.

qualifier: aquaporin glycerol transport and polyol metabolism
name: Glycerol, polyol and acylglycerol synthesis with aquaporin glycerol transport
rationale: Members cover glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate and alditol metabolism, PA/DAG/MAG/TAG synthesis, lysophospholipid hydrolysis and aquaporin glycerol/urea transport, unlike confusables on endocannabinoids, PC synthesis or lipid droplet/lipolysis regulation.

qualifier: OXPHOS, ATP synthesis and ROS output
name: Regulation of mitochondrial respiration, ATP synthesis and ROS output
rationale: Members regulate oxidative phosphorylation, electron transport, ATP and nucleotide synthesis, PGC-1alpha activation and ROS-linked stress responses, unlike confusables centred on peroxide-, hypoxia- and ferroptosis-induced cell death.

qualifier: ATP synthesis and nucleotide output under stress
name: Mitochondrial respiration and ATP synthesis regulation under cellular stress
rationale: Members regulate oxidative phosphorylation, electron transport, ATP and nucleotide synthesis, PGC-1alpha and mitochondrial depolarization alongside hypoxia, drug and oxidative stress responses, whereas confusables focus on peroxide-induced death and ferroptosis.

name: Regulation of mitochondrial respiration and oxidative phosphorylation
rationale: Members regulate electron transport, oxidative phosphorylation, ATP and nucleotide synthesis, ROS output and PGC-1alpha with linked depolarization and apoptosis, whereas confusables centre on peroxide-induced cell death and ferroptosis.

name: Methionine cycle, choline and carnitine metabolism
rationale: Members cover methionine and S-adenosylmethionine metabolism, salvage and inherited methylation-cycle defects together with choline catabolism and carnitine synthesis; these distinguish it from cobalamin, folate and other vitamin metabolism confusables.

name: Methionine cycle, choline and carnitine methyl-group metabolism
rationale: Members cover the methionine/SAM cycle, transsulfuration, methionine salvage, choline catabolism and carnitine synthesis with their inborn errors, distinguishing it from folate, cobalamin and other vitamin metabolism confusables.

name: Methionine cycle, choline and carnitine metabolism
rationale: Members cover methionine/SAM metabolism, salvage and inherited defects plus choline catabolism and carnitine synthesis, which neighbours focused on cobalamin, folate and other vitamins lack.

name: Polyamine metabolism, transport and eIF5A hypusination
rationale: Most members concern polyamine synthesis, interconversion, oxidation and transport plus spermidine-dependent eIF5A hypusination and translation elongation, separating it from protein-modification, NAD/tryptophan and methionine-salvage confusables; a few members (autophagy, manganese, mitochondrial module) are peripheral.

name: Polyamine metabolism and transport, including eIF5A hypusination
rationale: Most members concern putrescine/spermidine/spermine synthesis, interconversion, ODC regulation and transport plus spermidine-dependent eIF5A hypusination, without the tryptophan/NAD, methionine salvage or protein methylation/hydroxylation of neighbours.

name: Polyamine metabolism and transport with eIF5A hypusination
rationale: Most members concern putrescine/spermidine/spermine synthesis, interconversion, ODC regulation and transport, with spermidine-derived hypusine and translational elongation; confusables are protein methylation/hydroxylation, tryptophan-NAD or methionine salvage.

core: p53 regulation and G2 DNA damage checkpoint
name: p53 phospho-regulation, G2 damage checkpoint and AKT signaling
rationale: Members cover p53 phosphorylation and degradation, radiation-induced G2 checkpoint signaling and AKT phosphorylation of cytosolic targets such as MDM2; the AKT component distinguishes it from the p53 transcription and G2/M cell cycle confusables.

core: DNA damage G2 checkpoint and p53 regulation
name: DNA damage G2 checkpoint, p53 regulation and AKT signaling
rationale: Members concern radiation responses, G2 checkpoint/Cdc25A degradation, p53 phosphorylation and degradation, senescence and AKT/PI3K signaling; confusables lack the AKT members and center on p53 transcriptional arrest or G2/M cyclin events.

core: p53 and G2 DNA-damage checkpoint control
name: Kinase control of p53 and G2 checkpoint, including AKT
rationale: Members link radiation-induced checkpoint signaling, p53 phosphorylation/degradation, Cdc25A turnover and mitotic re-entry with PI3K-AKT kinase signaling, whereas confusables focus on p53 transcriptional targets, G2/M cyclin events or p14ARF defects.

qualifier: GAP-mediated and feedback attenuation, pathway mutants
name: RAS-ERK signalling attenuation by GAPs and feedback
rationale: Members concern RAS-ERK pathway activity and its termination (RAS GAPs, NF1, ERK inactivation, negative feedback, tyrosine dephosphorylation) and RAS/MAPK mutants, whereas confusables emphasise RAF activation or PI3K/AKT and receptor-specific RTK signalling.

qualifier: attenuation by RAS GAPs and negative feedback
name: RAS–ERK signaling attenuation by GAPs and negative feedback
rationale: Members center on SOS/SHC/IRS input into RAS-MAPK and its termination by RAS GAPs (NF1), ERK inactivation and feedback, including RAS/MAP2K mutants, while confusables emphasise RAF activation, PI3K/AKT or upstream RTKs.

qualifier: attenuation by RAS GAPs and negative feedback
name: RAS-ERK signalling with GAP and feedback attenuation
rationale: Members cover RAS/MAPK transmission (SOS, IRS/SHC, RSK, pathway mutants) together with its attenuation by RAS GAPs, NF1 loss, ERK inactivation and dephosphorylation, whereas confusables emphasise RAF activation or RTK/PI3K upstream signalling.

qualifier: polyubiquitin chain linkage types and E3 ligase action
name: Polyubiquitin chain linkage types and E3-directed proteasomal degradation
rationale: Members are K6/K11/K27/K29/branched chain formation, E3 ligase ubiquitination and promotion of proteasomal degradation, unlike DUB/E1-E2, degron-rule and ERAD/quality-control confusables.

qualifier: E3 ligase chain linkage types (K6, K11, K27, K29, branched)
name: E3 ligase polyubiquitin chain types and proteasomal targeting
rationale: Members describe E3 ubiquitination with diverse chain linkages and regulation of proteasomal degradation, distinguishing it from confusables focused on DUB families, E1/E2 activation, degron rules or ERAD.

name: E3-mediated polyubiquitin chain formation and proteasomal degradation
rationale: Members concern E3 ligase ubiquitination with diverse chain linkages (K6, K11, K27, K29, K48, branched) and promotion of proteasomal degradation, unlike confusables on ERAD/protein quality control, deubiquitinases or degron-rule catabolism.

core: Transcriptional control of lipid and glucose metabolism
name: PPARA, LXR and SREBP control of lipid-glucose metabolism
rationale: Members are nuclear receptor/SREBP/PGC-1alpha programs regulating triglyceride, fatty acid and gluconeogenic metabolism, distinguishing it from adipocyte differentiation and circadian nuclear receptor confusables.

core: Transcriptional control of lipid and glucose homeostasis
name: LXR, PPARalpha and SREBP control of lipid-glucose homeostasis
rationale: Members concern nuclear receptor and SREBP/PGC-1alpha transcriptional control of triglyceride, fatty acid and gluconeogenic metabolism, unlike adipocyte differentiation (PPARG) and circadian confusables.

name: LXR/SREBP/PPARA transcriptional control of lipid and glucose metabolism
rationale: Members concern LXR, SREBP, PPARA and PGC-1alpha transcriptional regulation of lipogenesis, triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis and gluconeogenesis, unlike confusables centred on adipocyte differentiation or circadian nuclear receptors.

qualifier: receptor cleavage releasing Notch, ERBB4 and p75NTR intracellular domains
name: Regulated intramembrane proteolysis of Notch, ERBB4 and p75NTR
rationale: Members concern proteolytic activation and intracellular-domain signaling of Notch, ERBB4 and p75NTR, whereas confusables centre on Notch target-gene transcription.

qualifier: Notch, p75NTR and ERBB4 intracellular domain release
name: Intramembrane proteolysis of Notch, p75NTR and ERBB4 receptors
rationale: Members are gamma-secretase-type cleavage releasing intracellular domains of Notch, p75NTR and ERBB4 and their nuclear signalling, whereas confusables centre on Notch target transcription.

qualifier: Notch, p75NTR and ERBB4 signal release
name: Regulated intramembrane proteolysis of Notch, p75NTR and ERBB4
rationale: Members are receptor cleavage and intracellular-domain release for Notch1-4, p75NTR (with NRIF/NF-kB outputs) and ERBB4; confusables cover Notch intracellular-domain transcriptional output rather than processing.

name: Hematopoietic stem and early myeloid-erythroid progenitor regulation
rationale: Members regulate HSC homeostasis, proliferation and commitment into myeloid and erythroid progenitors (including RUNX1 and promyelocyte programmes), distinguishing it from confusables on terminal erythroid/megakaryocyte maturation or bone marrow B cell niches.

core: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell regulation
name: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor regulation with myeloid–erythroid commitment
rationale: Members regulate HSC proliferation, homeostasis and differentiation, myeloid progenitor and primitive/definitive erythroid differentiation, distinguishing it from late erythroid/megakaryocyte, B-lineage and stem-maintenance confusables.

core: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell regulation
qualifier: early myeloid and erythroid progenitor fate
name: Hematopoietic stem and myeloid-erythroid progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members concern HSC homeostasis, proliferation and division and early myeloid/erythroid progenitor differentiation (RUNX1, promyelocyte programme, primitive/definitive erythropoiesis); confusables emphasise stem cell maintenance, bone marrow/B cell development, or late erythroid and megakaryocyte maturation.

qualifier: FGFR, EGFR/ERBB2 and PDGFRA mutants, amplifications and membrane fusions
name: Signaling by oncogenic FGFR, ERBB and PDGFRA receptor variants
rationale: All members are constitutive signaling by cancer-associated RTK variants; the FGFR, EGFR/ERBB2 and PDGFRA mutants distinguish it from confusables dominated by ALK inhibitor resistance, ERBB2 drug resistance and cytosolic PDGFR/FGFR/FLT3 fusions.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase variant signalling
qualifier: EGFR, ERBB2, PDGFRA and FGFR mutants, fusions, amplifications
name: Oncogenic EGFR, ERBB2, PDGFRA and FGFR variant signalling
rationale: All members are constitutive signalling by cancer-associated RTK mutants, fusions or amplifications of EGFR/ERBB2/PDGFRA/FGFR1-3 (and LTK), unlike confusables on ALK/ERBB2 drug resistance or cytosolic PDGFR/FLT3 fusions.

qualifier: activating FGFR, ERBB and PDGFRA variants
name: Activating FGFR, ERBB and PDGFRA cancer variant signaling
rationale: All members are constitutive signaling by cancer-associated RTK mutants, amplifications or fusions, chiefly FGFR, EGFR/ERBB2 and PDGFRA, without the drug-resistance and ALK/FLT3 fusion content of confusables.

name: Golgi disassembly-reassembly and RHOBTB/Ral GTPase cycles
rationale: Members combine Golgi ribbon disassembly/reassembly and positioning with atypical RHO (RHOBTB), Ral and GTPase activity regulation, whereas confusables centre on ARF/RAB vesicle budding and membrane tubulation.

qualifier: RHOBTB, Ral and Rho effector GTPase regulation
name: Golgi ribbon disassembly-reassembly and small GTPase regulation
rationale: Members combine Golgi ribbon assembly, disassembly and positioning with small GTPase cycles (RHOBTB1-3, Ral, Rhotekin/KTN1), unlike confusables built on Golgi vesicle budding, tubulation and Rab/ARF trafficking.

core: Golgi organization and small GTPase regulation
name: Golgi ribbon dynamics and Rho-family GTPase regulation
rationale: Members combine Golgi ribbon disassembly, reassembly and positioning with Rho/RHOBTB/Ral GTPase cycles and effectors, distinguishing the theme from confusables centred on Golgi vesicle budding, membrane tubulation and Rab/ARF trafficking.

name: Ascorbate metabolism and extracellular matrix crosslinking and turnover
rationale: Members join vitamin C metabolism/transport and antioxidant vitamin responses with collagen crosslinking, basement membrane assembly, hyaluronan degradation and proteoglycan synthesis, the ECM side that the ROS, BH4, iron and vitamin K confusables lack.

core: Ascorbate metabolism and extracellular matrix maturation
name: Ascorbate metabolism and extracellular matrix crosslinking and turnover
rationale: Members join vitamin C/E metabolism and dehydroascorbate transport with oxidative matrix steps (collagen crosslinking, basement membrane, hyaluronan and proteoglycan turnover), absent from the iron, ROS, vitamin K and BH4 confusables.

qualifier: collagen crosslinking and matrix glycan turnover
name: Ascorbate metabolism with collagen crosslinking and matrix glycan turnover
rationale: Members join vitamin C metabolism and transport with collagen crosslinking, basement membrane assembly, proteoglycan and hyaluronan turnover, which confusables (ROS detoxification, BH4, vitamin K, iron) lack.

core: Blood pressure and blood volume regulation
name: Renin-angiotensin control of blood pressure and renal sodium excretion
rationale: Members concern angiotensin generation and signaling, kinin/peptide catabolism, cGMP natriuretic signaling and renal sodium, volume and filtration control of blood pressure, distinguishing them from vasodilation-focused confusables and vasopressin/aquaporin water reabsorption.

core: Renal control of blood pressure and volume
name: Renin-angiotensin and renal control of blood pressure and volume
rationale: Members concern angiotensin generation and signalling, kinin catabolism, cGMP and renal sodium/urine/filtration control of blood pressure and volume, unlike the vasoconstriction and vasopressin water-reabsorption confusables.

core: Renal regulation of blood pressure and volume
name: Renin-angiotensin renal regulation of blood pressure and volume
rationale: Members concern angiotensin generation/signalling, renal sodium, urine and glomerular control of blood volume and pressure (with ACE-linked bradykinin catabolism and cGMP), unlike the vasopressin water-balance and vascular-tone confusables.

name: Endothelial shear-stress sensing and integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion
rationale: Members cover PIEZO1/PECAM1 shear-stress signaling and integrin-dependent leukocyte adhesion to endothelium, distinguishing it from diapedesis, neutrophil migration and T cell surface confusables.

qualifier: endothelial shear stress signaling and integrin activation
name: Shear-stress endothelial signaling and integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion
rationale: Members cover integrin activation, PECAM1 and leukocyte adhesion to endothelium plus endothelial flow-shear responses, whereas confusables carry diapedesis, extravasation and T cell signatures.

name: Endothelial shear-stress sensing and integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion
rationale: Members combine PIEZO1/PECAM1 laminar and oscillatory shear-stress signalling with integrin activation and leukocyte adhesion to endothelium, while confusables cover diapedesis and T cell/neutrophil extravasation without flow sensing.

core: Vascular wall endothelium and smooth muscle
name: Vascular shear-stress response and aortic smooth muscle development
rationale: Members concern endothelial responses to laminar and oscillatory shear, SRF-driven contractile smooth muscle and aorta development, whereas neighbours centre on smooth muscle phenotypic switching, proliferation and migration.

core: Vascular smooth muscle and endothelial shear-stress response
name: Aortic smooth muscle and endothelial shear-stress response
rationale: Members cover aortic and vascular smooth muscle development with SRF contractile targets and endothelial responses to laminar and oscillatory flow; aorta development and shear-stress signaling separate it from smooth-muscle phenotypic-switching confusables.

core: Vascular wall smooth muscle and endothelium
name: Vascular smooth muscle and endothelial shear stress response
rationale: Members span SRF-driven smooth muscle contractile/actin programmes, aortic smooth muscle development and endothelial responses to laminar and oscillatory shear; the shear stress and aorta development members separate it from smooth muscle phenotypic switching confusables.

qualifier: proximal-distal patterning and distal tubule segments
name: Nephron patterning and distal tubule segment development
rationale: All members describe metanephric nephron formation from renal vesicle to segment-specific tubules, and the distal tubule, loop of Henle and collecting duct members are what the ureteric bud and nephric duct confusables lack.

qualifier: proximal-distal patterning and distal segment differentiation
name: Nephron segment patterning and distal tubule development
rationale: All members describe nephron formation from renal vesicle through comma/S-shaped bodies to patterned tubule segments, and the theme alone has distal tubule, loop of Henle and collecting duct development rather than nephric duct, ureteric bud or intermediate mesoderm.

qualifier: proximal-distal patterning and distal tubule segments
name: Nephron patterning and distal tubule segment development
rationale: All members describe nephron formation from renal vesicle through comma/S-shaped bodies to tubule segments; unlike confusables (nephric duct, ureteric bud, MET), the theme specifically contains proximal-distal patterning and distal tubule, loop of Henle and collecting duct development.

qualifier: calcium-triggered vesicle priming and fusion with short-term plasticity
name: Presynaptic calcium-triggered vesicle exocytosis and short-term plasticity
rationale: Members regulate synaptic vesicle priming, fusion and calcium-dependent exocytosis, spontaneous release and short-term potentiation at the active zone; confusables are transmitter-specific release cycles, vesicle docking/SNARE assembly or presynaptic calcium channel modulation.

qualifier: regulation of calcium-triggered vesicle priming and fusion
name: Regulation of calcium-triggered synaptic vesicle exocytosis and priming
rationale: Members regulate synaptic vesicle priming, fusion and calcium-dependent exocytosis, spontaneous release and short-term potentiation, whereas confusables add transmitter-specific release cycles, docking/SNARE assembly, calcium channels or vesicle recycling.

name: Presynaptic regulation of calcium-triggered vesicle exocytosis and plasticity
rationale: Members regulate synaptic vesicle priming, fusion and Ca2+-dependent exocytosis and short-term potentiation; confusables are transmitter-specific release cycles, docking/SNARE assembly, calcium channels or vesicle endocytosis.

name: Skeletal muscle sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine receptor release, SERCA-mediated reuptake and ER calcium in striated (skeletal) muscle contraction and fiber-type switching; the skeletal context distinguishes it from cardiac conduction and contraction confusables.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling in skeletal muscle
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine-receptor release, SERCA uptake and membrane calcium flux in striated muscle with skeletal contraction and fibre-type transition, distinguishing it from cardiac contraction and conduction confusables.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling in skeletal muscle
rationale: Members regulate SR/ER calcium uptake and ryanodine receptor release in striated muscle, with skeletal contraction and fibre-type transition, whereas neighbours center on cardiac contraction, conduction and store-operated entry.

name: Ephrin, L1 and DCC axon guidance signaling
rationale: Members combine ephrin-EPH repulsion, L1 signaling and recycling, netrin-DCC attraction and commissural pathfinding, distinct from confusables centred on ROBO-SLIT, netrin repulsion or CHL1/DSCAM.

name: Commissural axon guidance with ephrin and L1 signaling
rationale: Members cover netrin-DCC attraction, SLIT-ROBO commissural pathfinding, ephrin repulsion and L1-mediated fasciculation, distinguishing it from netrin/semaphorin repulsion and ROBO-GTPase confusables.

qualifier: commissural pathfinding with ephrin and L1
name: Commissural axon pathfinding and ephrin-L1 guidance signaling
rationale: Members combine netrin/DCC attraction and SLIT-ROBO commissural pathfinding with ephrin repulsion, L1 signaling and fasciculation, unlike confusables on netrin repulsion, axon extension or ROBO-Rho GTPase control.

core: Coenzyme A and NADP cofactor metabolism
name: Coenzyme A, NADP cofactor metabolism and peroxisome maintenance
rationale: Members concern CoA/pantothenate and acyl-CoA metabolism, NAD(P) synthesis and transport, and peroxisome fission/protease processing; confusables are fatty acid oxidation, TCA and amino acid catabolism.

qualifier: pantothenate-derived CoA and NADP+ cofactor synthesis
name: Coenzyme A, acyl-CoA and NADP+ cofactor metabolism

name: Glucagon–PKA control of hepatic glycogen and glycolytic flux

qualifier: downstream second messengers, PKC and NF-kB

core: Oxidative and hypoxic stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis

name: Epidermal cornified envelope and lipoxygenase-derived barrier lipids

name: Nucleolar pre-rRNA processing and snoRNA-guided rRNA methylation

qualifier: SREBP sterol and ChREBP glucose sensing

qualifier: E2F-driven proliferation signatures and G1/S transition
name: E2F-driven cell cycle and DNA replication initiation signatures

qualifier: L1/CHL1, DSCAM and Sidekick adhesion plus netrin

rationale: Members are L1/CHL1, DSCAM and SDK adhesion-molecule signalling, dendrite self-avoidance and netrin-driven axon extension; confusables are ephrin, semaphorin or Slit repulsion and synapse-adhesion themes lacking the L1/DSCAM/SDK members.

qualifier: NLRP1/NLRP3 IL-1 processing and chemokine production

name: Rab/ARF-regulated synaptic vesicle and receptor trafficking

core: Synaptic vesicle and neurotransmitter receptor trafficking

name: Stress-induced cellular senescence and UV response

qualifier: 5' cap formation, decapping and snRNP biogenesis

qualifier: snRNP cap hypermethylation and decapping decay

qualifier: 5' cap formation, decapping and snRNP biogenesis

qualifier: oxidative crosslinking, hyaluronan degradation and ascorbate supply

qualifier: ascorbate supply and oxidative enzyme modification
name: Ascorbate transport and oxidative extracellular matrix modification
rationale: Members link ascorbate/dehydroascorbate transport and metabolism to oxidative ECM processing (collagen crosslinking, basement membrane, hyaluronan degradation, arylsulfatase activation); confusables are vitamin C responses, sulfation cofactors or collagen/integrin assembly without the ascorbate-oxidation link.

qualifier: ascorbate-dependent and oxidative modification, hyaluronan degradation
name: Ascorbate-linked oxidative ECM maturation and hyaluronan degradation
rationale: Members tie ascorbate/dehydroascorbate supply and oxidative enzyme activity (collagen crosslinking, arylsulfatase activation, protein oxidation) to basement membrane assembly and hyaluronan breakdown, distinguished from confusables on collagen synthesis, integrin/laminin binding and nucleotide-sugar sulfation.

qualifier: refolding plus aggresome formation and aggrephagy
name: Chaperone protein folding, refolding and aggresome clearance

name: Chaperone-assisted protein refolding and aggresome-mediated aggregate clearance

name: CHD and NuRD nucleosome remodeling and assembly

name: CHD-family and NuRD chromatin remodeling, nucleosome assembly

name: CHD/NuRD chromatin remodeling and nucleosome organization

qualifier: activated by lysophospholipid receptors, phorbol ester and ionomycin

qualifier: phorbol ester, ionomycin and lysosphingolipid receptor activation

qualifier: lysophospholipid (S1P/LPA) receptors and phorbol ester/ionophore responses
name: Protein kinase C signaling via lysophospholipid receptors
rationale: Members center on PKC activation by lipid messengers (phorbol ester, ionomycin, PRKCZ, phosphoinositide synthesis, VEGFR2 proliferation), and the S1P/LPA receptor and phorbol/ionophore members distinguish it from the G beta:gamma-PLC, calcium and BCR signaling confusables.

name: Ventricular trabeculation, endocardium and coronary vessel development

qualifier: trabeculation, endocardium and coronary vessel development

name: Ventricular trabeculation, endocardium and coronary vessel development

name: Regulation of antimicrobial peptide production and microbial killing

qualifier: regulation of antimicrobial peptide production and antifungal response

qualifier: regulation of antimicrobial peptide production and antifungal response

name: Fatty acid catabolism with branched-chain phytanate alpha-oxidation

core: Fatty acid and organic acid catabolism
name: Fatty acid catabolism including peroxisomal branched-chain alpha-oxidation
rationale: Members cover short/medium/long-chain fatty and organic acid catabolism plus phytanate alpha-oxidation and pristanoyl-CoA beta-oxidation, which mitochondrial beta-oxidation, carnitine and BCAA confusables lack.

qualifier: Fanconi interstrand crosslink repair, monoubiquitination and BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 defects

qualifier: renal vesicle to S-shaped body tubule formation

qualifier: adenylate cyclase synthesis and phosphodiesterase degradation in neurons

core: Hormonal and nuclear-receptor control of triglyceride metabolism

qualifier: netrin–DCC and L1 promoting Rac1-driven axon extension
name: Netrin–DCC and L1 guidance driving axon extension
