qualifier: including HIV Tat-regulated elongation and rRNA gene control
name: Transcription by RNA polymerases I-III and HIV Tat elongation
rationale: Members cover initiation, promoter escape, elongation and termination for Pol I (rRNA), Pol II (including HIV Tat pausing/elongation) and Pol III (tRNA, 5S, snRNA) plus MYC targets, whereas confusables emphasize RNA processing, splicing, ribosome assembly and chromatin.

qualifier: RNA polymerases I, II and III including rRNA and HIV transcription
name: Transcription cycle of RNA polymerases I, II and III
rationale: Members are initiation, promoter escape, elongation/pausing and termination by Pol I, II and III (incl. rRNA expression control, MYC targets and HIV Tat elongation), whereas neighbours concern RNA processing, splicing, decay and ribosome assembly.

name: Rho-family GTPase control of actin dynamics and protrusion
rationale: Members are Rho/Rac/Cdc42 GTPase cycles and effectors plus actin polymerization, lamellipodia, filopodia and motility, distinguishing them from axon guidance, cell junction and G12/13 Rho activation confusables.

qualifier: Rho-family GTPase cycles driving cell motility
name: Rho-family GTPase control of actin cytoskeleton and motility
rationale: Members are RHO/RAC/CDC42 GTPase cycles and effectors regulating actin polymerization, protrusions and migration, distinct from axon guidance, cell-junction and G alpha 12/13 confusables.

qualifier: effector control of actin protrusions and cell motility
name: Rho GTPase control of actin protrusions and cell motility
rationale: Members are Rho/Rac/CDC42 GTPase cycles and effectors regulating actin polymerization, lamellipodia, filopodia and motility, unlike confusables on G12/13 Rho activation, axon guidance or cell junctions.

qualifier: in both meiosis and mitosis, with meiotic recombination
name: Meiotic and mitotic chromosome cohesion, condensation and segregation
rationale: Members cover sister chromatid cohesion, chromosome condensation, centromere/CENP-A assembly and segregation in mitosis and meiosis; unlike the confusables (nuclear envelope, cytokinesis, APC/C, centrosome) the theme includes meiotic recombination, synapsis and meiotic division.

qualifier: meiotic as well as mitotic, including meiotic recombination and synapsis
name: Meiotic and mitotic chromosome cohesion, condensation and segregation
rationale: All members concern chromosome cohesion, condensation, centromere/kinetochore and segregation events in mitosis and especially meiosis (synapsis, recombination, chiasmata, female/male meiosis I), which the mitotic-exit, cytokinesis and nuclear-envelope confusables lack.

qualifier: meiotic and mitotic, including meiotic recombination and synapsis
name: Meiotic and mitotic chromosome cohesion, condensation and segregation
rationale: Members cover sister chromatid cohesion, chromosome condensation, centromeric CENP-A chromatin and spindle-driven segregation in both divisions, and unlike the mitotic-exit, nuclear-envelope and chromatin-assembly confusables the theme carries the meiotic programme (recombination, synapsis, chiasmata, meiosis I regulation).

core: MHC class I and II antigen processing and presentation
qualifier: proteasome, cross-presentation and APC surface signatures
name: MHC I/II antigen processing, cross-presentation and APC signatures
rationale: Members share antigen processing (proteasome, ER-phagosome and endosomal routes), MHC I/II peptide loading and its viral subversion, plus dendritic cell, monocyte and B cell surface signatures, whereas confusables concern PD-L1 turnover, NKT regulation or NK/T cytotoxicity.

qualifier: proteasomal and endosomal routes to MHC I/II in APCs
name: Proteasomal and endosomal antigen processing for MHC I/II presentation
rationale: Members cover proteasome assembly, MHC I/II peptide loading, cross-presentation, viral MHC/CD4 downregulation and antigen-presenting cell signatures, unlike confusables on NK/T cytotoxicity, PD-L1 regulation or NKT activation.

qualifier: proteasomal and endosomal class I and II routes
name: Proteasomal and endosomal MHC class I/II antigen processing and presentation
rationale: Members span proteasome-dependent class I loading, cross-presentation, class II presentation, APC surface signatures and viral Nef/Vpu downregulation, while confusables focus on NKT regulation, PD-L1 turnover or NK/T cytotoxicity.

name: Notch and Hedgehog signalling with proteolytic processing and palmitoylation
rationale: Members are Notch receptor processing and NICD transcription, Hedgehog autoprocessing, palmitoylation and GLI processing, plus related intramembrane proteolysis (ERBB4, p75NTR), distinguishing it from the Wnt destruction-complex and Wnt secretion neighbours.

qualifier: regulated proteolysis and lipid modification of signalling proteins
name: Notch and Hedgehog signalling via regulated proteolysis and lipidation
rationale: Members are Notch receptor processing and transcription, Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing/palmitoylation and GLI signalling, and related intramembrane proteolysis of ERBB4 and p75NTR; neighbours are Wnt destruction-complex, Wnt secretion and beta-catenin themes.

name: Notch and Hedgehog signalling via regulated proteolysis and lipidation
rationale: Members span Notch receptor processing and intracellular-domain signalling, Hedgehog autoprocessing, palmitoylation and GLI regulation, plus other intramembrane-proteolysis receptors (ERBB4, p75NTR), distinguishing it from Wnt destruction-complex and Wnt ligand-secretion neighbours.

qualifier: class I hematopoietic/hormone receptors and oncogenic kinase fusions via STAT5
name: Class I cytokine, hormone and oncogenic kinase JAK-STAT signalling
rationale: Members are JAK-STAT3/5 signalling by IL-2/3/5/6/7/9/11, LIF/CNTF, EPO, TPO, GH, prolactin and leptin receptors plus FLT3 and PDGFR/FGFR fusions, separating it from IL-10/12/23/27/15/21 and Th2/mast cell confusables.

qualifier: STAT5/STAT3 via haematopoietic, IL-6-family and growth-hormone receptors
name: JAK-STAT5/STAT3 signalling by haematopoietic, IL-6-family and growth-hormone receptors
rationale: Members are IL-2/3/5/7/9, EPO, TPO, FLT3/fusion kinase, IL-6-family, GH, prolactin and leptin receptor signalling through STAT5/STAT3 and ERK, unlike the IL-10/12/15/21/23/27 and Th2/mast cell confusables.

qualifier: haematopoietic cytokines, growth hormone and prolactin
name: JAK-STAT5 signalling by haematopoietic cytokines, growth hormone, prolactin
rationale: Members are STAT5/STAT3-coupled receptors for IL-2/3/5/7/9, IL-6 family, EPO, TPO, GH, prolactin and leptin plus oncogenic FLT3/PDGFR fusions, while confusables cover IL-10/12/15/21/23/27 and Th2/mast cell immunity.

core: Amino acid and cholinergic neurotransmitter turnover
name: Amino acid and cholinergic neurotransmitter turnover, including clostridial neurotoxins
rationale: Members cover synthesis, release, reuptake and receptor action of GABA, glutamate, glycine and acetylcholine plus botulinum/tetanus toxicity at cholinergic synapses, unlike the monoamine confusable and confusables lacking the cholinergic/toxin arm.

qualifier: cholinergic and amino acid (GABA, glutamate, glycine), not monoamine
name: Cholinergic and amino acid neurotransmitter synthesis and transport
rationale: Members cover acetylcholine, GABA, glutamate/aspartate and glycine synthesis, SLC transport, nicotinic receptors and clostridial toxins blocking release, distinguishing the theme from the monoamine-rich confusable and from confusables lacking the cholinergic or amino acid transporter arms.

name: Amino acid and cholinergic neurotransmitter synthesis, transport and release
rationale: Members cover GABA, glutamate, glycine and acetylcholine synthesis, vesicular loading, reuptake, SLC transporter defects and clostridial toxin block of release, while the main confusable is defined by monoamine (catecholamine, serotonin) handling.

qualifier: with protein import and cristae biogenesis
name: Oxidative phosphorylation with mitochondrial protein import and cristae biogenesis
rationale: Members cover respiratory chain assembly, ATP synthesis and Fe-S clusters plus protein import, processing, cristae and calcium uptake; confusables lack either OXPHOS or the import/membrane terms and add heme or translation.

qualifier: respiratory chain assembly, protein import and iron-sulfur biogenesis
name: Mitochondrial respiratory chain assembly, protein import and iron–sulfur biogenesis
rationale: Members span electron transport and ATP synthesis, complex I/III/IV/ATP synthase assembly, mitochondrial protein import and processing, cristae and Fe-S cluster assembly, while confusables add mitochondrial RNA import, translation or heme/ubiquinol synthesis.

qualifier: protein import and inner membrane organisation
name: Mitochondrial respiratory chain biogenesis and protein import
rationale: Members span respiratory complex I-IV and ATP synthase assembly, electron transport, Fe-S clusters, mitochondrial protein import/processing and cristae formation, distinct from confusables on mitochondrial RNA import, heme/ubiquinol synthesis or mitochondrial translation.

qualifier: transamination, glycine conjugation and gluconeogenic carbon
name: Amino acid transamination, catabolism and glycine conjugation
rationale: Members span glutamate/glutamine, aspartate, alanine, aromatic, glycine, proline and threonine metabolism with glycine/glutamine conjugation and gluconeogenesis; confusables instead carry urea cycle, sulfur/serine/glutathione, selenium or TCA shuttle pathways.

core: Amino acid and organic acid catabolism
qualifier: gluconeogenic carbon flow and glycine conjugation
name: Amino acid catabolism linked to gluconeogenesis and glycine conjugation
rationale: Members span amino acid (aromatic, glutamate/aspartate/alanine, glycine, proline) and organic acid metabolism with xenobiotic glycine conjugation and BH4; gluconeogenesis/oxaloacetate distinguishes it from urea-cycle, sulfur/glutathione and TCA neighbours.

qualifier: glucogenic and aromatic amino acids with glycine conjugation
name: Glucogenic and aromatic amino acid metabolism with glycine conjugation
rationale: Members cover glutamate/aspartate/alanine/proline/threonine/glycine and phenylalanine/tyrosine metabolism linked to gluconeogenesis and oxaloacetate, plus BH4 and glycine/glutamine conjugation; gluconeogenic links and absence of urea-cycle, sulfur and glutathione terms separate it from confusables.

core: Glutamate-family amino acid and nitrogen metabolism
qualifier: urea cycle, ornithine/arginine and ammonia handling
name: Urea cycle, ammonia and glutamate-family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members cover urea cycle enzymes and their inherited defects, ornithine/arginine/citrulline, glutamate/glutamine/proline/aspartate metabolism and ammonium homeostasis, which distinguishes them from confusables centred on aromatic, sulfur, glycine or TCA/gluconeogenic metabolism.

core: Urea cycle and glutamate/aspartate-family amino acid metabolism
qualifier: with malate-aspartate shuttle and ammonium handling
name: Urea cycle and glutamate/aspartate-family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members cover urea cycle enzymes and their inherited defects, ornithine/arginine/citrulline/proline/glutamine/aspartate metabolism and ammonium homeostasis; unlike the broader amino acid neighbour it includes the malate-aspartate shuttle and lacks sulfur, aromatic and glycine/serine catabolism, and unlike the others it is centred on the urea cycle.

core: Urea cycle and glutamate/aspartate-family amino acid metabolism
name: Urea cycle, glutamate/aspartate metabolism and malate-aspartate shuttle
rationale: Members cover the urea cycle and its inborn errors, ornithine/arginine/citrulline, glutamate, glutamine, proline and aspartate metabolism and ammonium handling; urea-cycle content separates it from C1/C3/C4 and the malate-aspartate shuttle is what it has over the broader amino acid theme C2.

core: Bacterial TLR signaling and inflammatory cytokine production
name: TLR2/4 and inflammasome control of inflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members combine LPS/lipopeptide TLR2/4 signaling with NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome IL-1 processing and cytokine production control, which TRIF-, NOD- and monocyte-module confusables lack.

qualifier: TLR2/4 bacterial lipid sensing and NLRP inflammasome IL-1 processing
name: TLR2/4 bacterial lipid sensing and inflammasome IL-1 processing
rationale: Members combine MyD88/IRAK4-dependent TLR2/4/5 sensing of LPS and lipopeptides with NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome IL-1 processing and inflammatory cytokine regulation, distinguishing it from TRIF, NOD1/2 and monocyte-module confusables.

name: MyD88-dependent TLR and inflammasome-driven inflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members cover TLR2/4/5 MyD88/IRAK4 signaling, LPS detection, NLRP1/3 inflammasomes and IL-1/IL-6/TNF regulation, unlike TRIF, NOD, myeloid-module or IL-10 confusables.

qualifier: neural plate, hindbrain segmentation, craniofacial and pharyngeal organs
name: Embryonic neural plate, craniofacial and pharyngeal organ patterning
rationale: Members span early anterior neural plate/border specification, hindbrain rhombomere and D/V patterning, craniofacial skeleton, limbs and pharyngeal-derived glands (thyroid, thymus, parathyroid), whereas confusables emphasize face/ear sensory organs, somitogenesis and Hox clusters.

qualifier: neural plate, hindbrain and craniofacial-pharyngeal derivatives
name: Embryonic neural plate, hindbrain and craniofacial-pharyngeal patterning
rationale: Members span neural plate/border and rhombomere specification, dorsoventral axis, craniofacial, pharyngeal-organ and limb morphogenesis; confusables share craniofacial organs but lack the neural plate, hindbrain HOX and axis-specification members.

qualifier: neural plate, hindbrain, craniofacial and pharyngeal organs
name: Embryonic neural plate, hindbrain and craniofacial patterning
rationale: Members are early embryonic patterning events (neural plate and border formation, hindbrain rhombomeres, dorsoventral axis, craniofacial, palate, limb and pharyngeal-gland development), distinguished from confusables centered on face/ear sensory organs, somitogenesis and Hox clusters.

core: Actin remodelling in protrusion and motility
name: Actin remodelling of protrusions via ROCK/PAK and focal adhesions
rationale: Members regulate actin assembly, severing and bundling in ruffles, filopodia and motility, and the ROCK/PAK effector and IPP focal adhesion members distinguish it from RHO GTPase cycle confusables.

qualifier: membrane protrusions and motility via ROCK/PAK effectors
name: Actin dynamics in membrane protrusion and cell motility
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerization, severing and bundling for filopodia, ruffles, podosomes, macropinocytosis and migration, including ROCK/PAK effectors and focal adhesion, whereas confusables are RHO GTPase cycles or capping/microtubule processes.

name: Actin remodelling for protrusion, adhesion and cell motility
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerization, severing, bundling and protrusions (filopodia, ruffles, podosomes) with PAK/ROCK and integrin links driving motility, distinct from neighbours made of RHO GTPase cycles.

core: Nuclear noncoding RNA maturation and decay
qualifier: exosome surveillance, snoRNP/Cajal body and telomerase assembly
name: Nuclear exosome RNA surveillance, snoRNP and telomerase biogenesis
rationale: Members cover 3'-5' exosome trimming/decay of rRNA, snRNA, snoRNA and CUTs, snoRNP/Cajal body localization, rRNA modification and telomerase assembly, distinct from confusables on splicing, mRNA export, NMD/ribosome quality control and Pol I/III transcription.

core: Non-coding RNA maturation and nuclear RNA surveillance
qualifier: Cajal body snoRNP and telomerase biogenesis
name: Cajal body snoRNP, telomerase and nuclear exosome RNA processing
rationale: Members cover snoRNP/scaRNA assembly and Cajal body localization, telomerase assembly and telomere extension, rRNA modification and exosome-mediated nuclear RNA decay; the telomerase and Cajal body members are absent from the transcription, RNA-modification and mRNA-decay confusables.

core: Nuclear noncoding RNA processing and exosome decay
qualifier: snoRNP and telomerase RNP biogenesis, Cajal body
name: Nuclear exosome RNA decay, snoRNP and telomerase RNP biogenesis
rationale: Members cover exosome-mediated nuclear RNA surveillance, snoRNA/scaRNA processing and Cajal body targeting, rRNA modification and telomerase assembly, distinct from NMD, splicing/export, RNA modification and transcription confusables.

qualifier: SWI/SNF (BAF) and CHD remodelers with protein acetylation
name: BAF and CHD chromatin remodeling with protein acetylation
rationale: Members center on nucleosome remodeling complexes (BAF variants, CHD subfamilies, NuRD) and acetyltransferase activity, distinguishing the theme from confusables focused on histone deacetylation, methylation or centromeric chromatin.

qualifier: BAF and CHD complexes with protein acetylation
name: BAF and CHD chromatin remodeling with protein acetylation
rationale: Members center on nucleosome remodeling complexes (BAF variants, CHD, NuRD, ChAHP) and histone/protein acetylation, unlike confusables focused on histone methylation, deacetylation or chromosome condensation.

qualifier: ATP-dependent remodeler complexes (BAF, CHD, NuRD) and protein acetylation
name: ATP-dependent chromatin remodeling complexes and protein acetylation
rationale: Most members are BAF/CHD/NuRD/ChAHP remodeler assembly, nucleosome organization and histone/protein acetylation, which separates the theme from confusables centred on chromosome condensation, histone methylation, DNA methylation or HDAC/SUMO repression; a few members (UCH proteinases, centriole replication, organism emergence) are peripheral.

qualifier: vasopressin-aquaporin renal water handling and cellular osmotic response
name: Vasopressin-aquaporin water balance and cellular osmotic stress response
rationale: Members cover vasopressin receptors and aquaporin water reabsorption, osmosensing, hyper/hypotonic responses and renal sodium handling, beyond the renin-angiotensin and cation-chloride cotransporter confusables.

name: Vasopressin-aquaporin water balance and cellular osmotic stress response
rationale: Members cover vasopressin signaling, aquaporin water reabsorption, osmotic and salt stress responses and renal sodium/chloride handling, unlike confusables on cation-chloride cotransporters or renin-angiotensin and natriuresis.

name: Vasopressin-regulated renal water, sodium and osmotic homeostasis
rationale: Members concern vasopressin/aquaporin water reabsorption, renal sodium and chloride transport and cellular osmotic responses, distinguishing them from confusables on renin-angiotensin control or cation-chloride cotransporter disorders.

name: Presynaptic release modulation and AMPA/kainate receptor signaling
rationale: Members regulate presynaptic glutamate/GABA release, calcium and potential plus AMPA/kainate receptor activation and clustering, distinguishing it from the vesicle release cycle, NMDA/LTP and inhibitory synapse assembly confusables.

qualifier: AMPA/kainate receptors and presynaptic modulation of release
name: AMPA/kainate transmission and presynaptic modulation of neurotransmitter release
rationale: Members concern AMPA/kainate receptor activation and clustering together with presynaptic G-protein, calcium and vesicle-fusion control of glutamate/GABA release, distinguishing it from NMDA/LTP, inhibitory-synapse assembly and generic release-cycle confusables.

name: Presynaptic modulation and AMPA/kainate glutamatergic transmission
rationale: Members cover presynaptic regulation of glutamate/GABA release, G protein modulation of channels, short-term plasticity and AMPA/kainate receptor activation and trafficking, separating it from NMDA/LTP, nicotinic, vesicle-cycle and inhibitory synapse assembly confusables.

name: Insulin receptor signaling and GLUT4-mediated glucose uptake
rationale: Members concern insulin receptor activation and attenuation, AKT2/IRS signaling, GLUT4 exocytic translocation, glycogen synthesis and glucokinase regulation in target tissues; peripheral insulin action distinguishes it from beta-cell insulin secretion and PGC-1alpha confusables.

name: Insulin receptor signaling to GLUT4 translocation and glucose uptake
rationale: All members concern insulin action on target cells (IRS/AKT2, receptor recycling, GLUT4 exocytosis, glucose import, glycogen synthesis, glucokinase), distinguishing it from beta-cell insulin secretion and fatty acid oxidation confusables.

qualifier: receptor signaling and glucose uptake in target tissues
name: Insulin receptor signaling and GLUT4 glucose uptake
rationale: Members concern insulin receptor signaling, IRS/AKT2 activation, GLUT4 translocation, glucose import and glycogen synthesis, separating it from neighbours about beta-cell insulin secretion or muscle activity.

name: NRF2 and FOXO oxidative-stress transcription and metabolic rewiring
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 and FOXO transcriptional programs with AKT, p53 and mTORC1 control of glycolysis and pentose-phosphate flux, unlike neighbours centred on HIF hypoxia/glycolysis or ER unfolded protein response.

core: Stress-responsive transcriptional control of metabolism and survival
name: FOXO and NRF2 stress transcription controlling metabolism and survival
rationale: Members centre on FOXO and NFE2L2 transcriptional programs with AKT, p53 and mTORC1 control of NADPH, glycolytic and survival genes, whereas confusables are hypoxia/glycolysis or ER unfolded protein response themes.

qualifier: NRF2, FOXO and p53 with redox metabolism
name: NRF2, FOXO and p53 stress transcription with redox metabolism
rationale: Members are NRF2 target programmes, AKT-regulated FOXO transcription, p53 and mTORC1 hallmarks and regulation of pentose-phosphate and glycolytic flux; confusables are hypoxia/HIF glycolysis or ER-stress UPR themes.

name: Adrenergic, adenylate cyclase-inhibitory control of smooth muscle tone
rationale: Members concern smooth muscle contraction/relaxation across vascular, urogenital and uterine beds together with alpha-2 adrenergic and Gi/Gz adenylate cyclase inhibition, unlike confusables on cGMP/endothelin, adenosine or cardiac contraction.

name: Adrenergic control of smooth muscle contraction and relaxation
rationale: Members combine adrenoceptor/alpha-2 adenylate cyclase-inhibitory signalling with vascular, uterine, urinary and penile smooth muscle tone, unlike confusables driven by cGMP/endothelin, cardiac contractility or adenosine receptors.

core: Adrenergic control of smooth muscle contraction
qualifier: alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz inhibition of adenylate cyclase
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz signaling and smooth muscle contraction
rationale: Members combine adrenaline/noradrenaline signaling through adenylate cyclase-inhibiting (alpha-2, Gz) receptors with vascular, uterine, urinary and penile smooth muscle contraction, unlike confusables featuring cGMP/endothelin or cardiac contraction.

qualifier: 3'-end processing including histone mRNAs, snRNP assembly
name: mRNA 3'-end processing, snRNP assembly and nuclear export
rationale: Members cover polyadenylation and histone stem-loop 3'-end processing, snRNP assembly and cap hypermethylation, and nuclear export of mature mRNAs, combining processing and export that the splicing, decay and snRNA-transcription confusables split.

qualifier: 3'-end processing incl. histone mRNA, snRNP biogenesis and nuclear export
name: mRNA 3'-end processing, snRNP biogenesis and nuclear mRNA export
rationale: Members cover polyadenylation and histone stem-loop 3'-end processing, snRNP assembly/cap hypermethylation and export of mature mRNAs through the nuclear pore, distinguishing them from splice-site recognition, snRNA transcription and mRNA decay neighbours.

qualifier: 3'-end processing, histone mRNA, snRNP assembly and nuclear export
name: Pre-mRNA 3'-end processing, snRNP assembly and nuclear mRNA export
rationale: Members cover polyadenylation and histone stem-loop 3'-end processing, Pol II termination, snRNP assembly and export of mature mRNAs through the nuclear pore, unlike neighbours centred on snRNA transcription, splice-site recognition or mRNA decay.

core: Host-virus control of RNA translation and editing
qualifier: ADAR/APOBEC nucleic acid editing and coronavirus replicase translation
name: Nucleic acid editing and translational control in host-virus conflict
rationale: Members combine ADAR/APOBEC editing restriction, coronavirus replicase translation and host translational/mRNA-decay control, whereas confusables lack the editing arm and focus on viral replication regulation or HIV entry.

core: Host-virus control of viral RNA replication and translation
name: Viral RNA replication, translation control and host nucleic-acid editing
rationale: Members span coronavirus replication and host-translation modulation, translational repression and host antiviral restriction, with APOBEC3G/ADAR deamination and editing distinguishing it from HIV-entry, influenza and viral-replication-regulation confusables.

core: Host-virus control of RNA and translation
qualifier: coronavirus replication and antiviral nucleotide editing
name: Coronavirus replication, antiviral nucleotide editing and translational repression
rationale: Members combine SARS-CoV replication and host translation hijacking, ADAR/APOBEC editing restricting viruses, and host translational repression, with the editing arm distinguishing it from HIV entry, influenza and viral replication regulation confusables.

name: Glycerol/polyol and mono-/diacylglycerol metabolism with endocannabinoid signalling
rationale: Members cover glycerol and polyol metabolism/transport, DAG/MAG/PA turnover and N-acylethanolamine endocannabinoids, unlike triglyceride lipolysis, phospholipid synthesis/remodeling and lipid droplet confusables.

qualifier: DAG/MAG endocannabinoid signaling, glycerol transport and polyols
name: Glycerol and acylglycerol metabolism with endocannabinoid lipid signaling
rationale: Members cover glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate, PA, DAG and MAG metabolism, endocannabinoids, aquaglyceroporin transport and polyol/fructose, lacking the phospholipid synthesis, acyl remodeling and lipolysis regulation of confusables.

name: Glycerol and acylglycerol metabolism including endocannabinoid lipids
rationale: Members span glycerol/alditol metabolism and transport, mono-, di- and triacylglycerol and phosphatidic acid turnover and endocannabinoid (NAE, DAG-derived) signalling, unlike confusables centred on triglyceride lipolysis or phospholipid synthesis and remodelling.

name: APC/C-mediated ubiquitination controlling anaphase and mitotic exit
rationale: Members concern APC/C-Cdc20/Cdh1 regulation, Emi1 control and K11 ubiquitination driving anaphase and mitotic exit, unlike confusables on cohesion, spindle, PLK1 or G1/S transcription.

name: APC/C-mediated ubiquitination controlling anaphase and mitotic exit
rationale: Members concern APC/C regulation, Emi1, K11-linked ubiquitination and substrate degradation at metaphase-anaphase and mitotic exit, unlike cohesion, spindle or G1/S neighbours.

name: APC/C ubiquitin ligase control of anaphase and mitotic exit
rationale: Members describe APC/C regulation and K11/branched ubiquitination degrading securin, cyclins and other substrates at the metaphase-anaphase transition and mitotic exit, whereas confusables cover cohesion, spindle, meiosis or G1/S-G2 checkpoints.

qualifier: GPI anchoring, glycolipid transport and lysosomal catabolism
name: Glycosphingolipid and GPI anchor synthesis, transport, lysosomal catabolism
rationale: Members span glycosphingolipid/ganglioside synthesis, transport and lysosomal breakdown (HEXA/HEXB, NEU1) plus GPI-anchor synthesis, unlike confusables centred on nucleotide sugars and N/O-linked protein glycosylation disorders.

qualifier: glycosphingolipid and GPI anchor, lysosomal degradation
name: Glycosphingolipid and GPI-anchor metabolism with lysosomal degradation
rationale: Members cover glycosphingolipid/ganglioside synthesis, transport and lysosomal catabolism (GM2 gangliosidoses, sialidosis), GPI anchor synthesis and attachment, and lysosomal glycoside breakdown, whereas confusables are N-glycosylation, CDG and nucleotide-sugar pathways.

qualifier: ganglioside lysosomal catabolism and GPI anchor synthesis
name: Glycosphingolipid, ganglioside and GPI anchor metabolism with lysosomal catabolism
rationale: Members span ganglioside/glycosphingolipid synthesis, transport and lysosomal (HEXA/HEXB/NEU1) degradation plus GPI anchor synthesis, distinguishing them from confusables focused on N-glycosylation, nucleotide sugars and CDG disorders.

qualifier: degron and ribosome-associated degradation, aggrephagy, stress granules
name: Degradative protein quality control, aggrephagy and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members concern clearance of misfolded or stalled nascent proteins via ERAD, degron rules, ribosome quality control, aggrephagy/reticulophagy and stress granule regulation, whereas confusables emphasise chaperone folding and chaperone-mediated autophagy.

qualifier: degron, ribosome-stall and aggregate clearance with stress granules
name: Ubiquitin-dependent clearance of misfolded, aggregated and ribosome-stalled proteins
rationale: Members share protein quality control by degradation: N-/C-degron pathways, ribosome-associated quality control of stalled nascent chains, ERAD regulation, aggresome/aggrephagy and stress-granule dynamics, while confusables emphasise E3/K48 ubiquitination regulation, chaperonin folding or chaperone-mediated autophagy.

qualifier: ribosome rescue, aggrephagy and stress granules
name: Degradative protein quality control, ribosome rescue, aggrephagy and stress granules
rationale: Members concern ubiquitin/degron-mediated removal of misfolded proteins, ribosome-associated quality control, aggresome/aggrephagy, ERAD regulation and stress granule dynamics, unlike confusables on chaperonin folding and chaperone-mediated autophagy.

qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and thyroid hormone
name: Growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and thyroid hormone signaling
rationale: Members are growth hormone, prolactin and leptin JAK-STAT receptor signaling, thyroid hormone generation, transport and response, and organism growth/lifespan regulation; thyroid hormone and GH/prolactin/leptin content separates it from glucagon/somatostatin, IGF and IL-6-family cytokine confusables.

qualifier: thyroid hormone plus GH, prolactin and leptin receptors
name: Growth control by thyroid hormone and GH, prolactin, leptin
rationale: Members cover organism growth/lifespan regulated by thyroid hormone (transport, receptor, generation, LAT-type amino acid transport) and GH, prolactin and leptin receptor signalling, unlike the IGF, IL-6-family cytokine and glucagon/somatostatin confusables.

qualifier: GH, prolactin, leptin and thyroid hormone
name: Growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and thyroid hormone signaling
rationale: Members are growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptor signaling, thyroid hormone transport/action (with LAT1-type amino acid transport) and organismal growth regulation; thyroid hormone and GH/prolactin/leptin distinguish it from IL-6-family, IGF and glucagon/somatostatin confusables.

qualifier: IL-10/IL-12 families, IL-15/21, type III interferon; NK/NKT
name: IL-10/IL-12-family, IL-15/21 and interferon-lambda signalling; NK/NKT regulation
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-20, IL-12, IL-23, IL-27, IL-35, IL-15, IL-21 and type III/alpha interferon signalling with NK and NKT cell regulation, unlike the Th2/IL-6/mast cell, IL-17/IL-33 and NF-kB confusables.

qualifier: IL-10/IL-12 families, IL-15/21, interferon-lambda and NK/NKT regulation
name: IL-10/IL-12-family, IL-15 and interferon-lambda signalling regulating NK/NKT cells
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-20, IL-12/23/27/35, IL-15/21 and type III interferon signalling with NK/NKT proliferation and differentiation, distinguishing it from IL-17/IL-33, TNF/NF-kB and Th2/IL-6/IL-2 cytokine confusables.

qualifier: IL-10/IL-12 families, interferons and IL-15/21 in NK/NKT cells
name: IL-10/IL-12-family, interferon and IL-15/21 signaling to NK/NKT cells
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-20, IL-12/23/27/35, type I/III interferon and IL-15/21 signaling with NK/NKT proliferation and activation, unlike IL-17/IL-33/IL-1 family, type 2/common gamma-chain and NF-kB activation confusables.

name: NMDA receptor-dependent synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine remodeling
rationale: Members cover NMDA/AMPA signaling, LTP/LTD, synaptic translation and spine/structural plasticity, which the CREB nuclear-signaling and AMPA/kainate trafficking confusables lack.

core: NMDA receptor signaling and synaptic plasticity
name: NMDA receptor signaling and structural synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members cover NMDA/AMPA receptor signaling, LTP/LTD and spine and structural plasticity, unlike neighbours centred on CREB transcription or kainate/AMPA receptor activation.

qualifier: synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine remodeling
name: NMDA receptor-dependent synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine remodeling
rationale: Members cover NMDA receptor activation, downstream Ras/RAC1/AMPK signaling and LTP/LTD and spine plasticity, unlike CREB nuclear-signaling or AMPA/kainate receptor confusables.

name: Thyroid hormone and glucocorticoid axis regulation

qualifier: thyroid hormone and HPA glucocorticoid axes
name: Thyroid hormone and hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal glucocorticoid secretion

name: Thyroid hormone and adrenal glucocorticoid axis regulation
rationale: Members span thyroid hormone generation, transport and signalling plus ACTH/cortisol secretion and response with pregnenolone/progesterone synthesis, combining two axes that the GH/prolactin, stress-behaviour and steroid-biosynthesis confusables do not.

name: Golgi architecture and Rab/ARF GTPase-regulated vesicle tethering
rationale: Members cover Golgi disassembly, reassembly and ribbon formation together with Rab GEF/GAP, geranylgeranylation and ARF signalling, unlike neighbours centred on COPI/COPII vesicle budding and endosomal traffic.

name: Rab GTPase regulation and Golgi structural organization
rationale: Members cover Golgi assembly, disassembly and positioning together with Rab GEFs/GAPs, geranylgeranylation and vesicle tethering, unlike confusables on COPI/COPII coat-mediated vesicle traffic and endosomal transport.

qualifier: Rab and Arf GTPase regulation and vesicle tethering
name: Rab and Arf GTPase regulation of Golgi organization
rationale: Members cover Golgi assembly, disassembly and ribbon formation with Rab GEF/GAP activity, Rab geranylgeranylation, Arf signalling and vesicle tethering, whereas confusables centre on COPI/COPII vesicle traffic and endosomal transport.

core: Pyruvate oxidation and TCA cycle metabolism
qualifier: carboxylate transmembrane transport and malate-aspartate shuttle
name: Pyruvate-TCA metabolism with carboxylate transport and malate-aspartate shuttle
rationale: Members span PDH, CoA synthesis and TCA intermediates together with pyruvate/di- and tricarboxylate SLC transport and the malate-aspartate shuttle, which the glutamate/nitrogen and Fe-S/electron-transport confusables lack.

qualifier: with di/tricarboxylate transport and malate-aspartate shuttle
name: Pyruvate oxidation, CoA synthesis and carboxylate transport shuttles
rationale: Members cover PDH-mediated pyruvate oxidation, CoA biosynthesis and TCA intermediates together with pyruvate, succinate and tricarboxylate transport and the malate-aspartate shuttle, separating the theme from glutamate/nitrogen and electron-transport confusables.

qualifier: dicarboxylate transport, malate-aspartate shuttle and CoA synthesis
name: Pyruvate oxidation, CoA synthesis and TCA intermediate transport
rationale: Members are PDH pyruvate oxidation, CoA/pantothenate synthesis, TCA intermediates and their SLC transport and malate-aspartate shuttle, which distinguishes them from glutamate/nitrogen, succinate-oxidation and gluconeogenesis neighbours.

name: Motile axoneme assembly and tubulin post-translational modification
rationale: Members cover dynein arm, central apparatus and sperm axoneme assembly with tubulin folding, glutamylation and severing, unlike confusables on intraflagellar transport, primary cilia or centrosomes.

core: Motile cilium and sperm axoneme assembly
name: Motile cilium and sperm axoneme assembly with tubulin modification
rationale: Members concern motile axoneme and dynein arm assembly, sperm flagellum structure, multiciliogenesis and tubulin folding/polyglutamylation, the latter separating it from intraflagellar transport and centrosome confusables.

core: Motile cilium and sperm axoneme assembly
name: Sperm and motile cilia axoneme assembly, tubulin glutamylation
rationale: Members are axonemal dynein arm and central apparatus assembly, multiciliogenesis, sperm tail structures and tubulin folding/glutamylation/severing, distinguishing the theme from centrosome, intraflagellar transport and sperm motility confusables.

qualifier: AKT-FOXO and p53 with fructose-bisphosphate regulation
name: AKT-FOXO and p53 control of glycolytic flux
rationale: Members combine fructose-2,6/1,6-bisphosphate regulation of glycolysis and lactate production with AKT-FOXO, p53 and mTORC1 metabolic signalling, unlike confusables driven by hypoxia/HIF or NRF2 or lacking the glycolytic arm.

name: AKT-FOXO and p53 control of glycolysis and survival
rationale: Members combine AKT-regulated FOXO localization and transcription, p53 and mTORC1 programmes with control of glycolysis (fructose 2,6-bisphosphate, lactate, pentose shunt), whereas confusables centre on NFE2L2, hypoxia/HIF or core glycolysis.

qualifier: AKT-FOXO and p53, fructose bisphosphate and lactate
name: AKT-FOXO and p53 regulation of glycolysis and lactate production
rationale: Members join AKT-FOXO/p53/mTORC1 signalling with fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation of glycolysis, fermentation and lactate synthesis, distinguishing them from hypoxia/HIF, NRF2 or plain glycolysis confusables.

qualifier: proximal antigen receptor signaling and its positive/negative tuning
name: B cell antigen receptor signaling and B cell activation thresholds
rationale: Members cover BCR signaling (second messengers, BTK, RAS, CD22) with B cell development and positive and negative regulators of activation, whereas confusables emphasise B cell surface/plasma signatures, T cell activation or Fc receptor signaling.

qualifier: B cell receptor signaling and its tuning
name: B cell receptor signaling and B cell development, proliferation
rationale: Members combine proximal BCR signalling (second messengers, RAS, BTK, CD22) and its positive/negative regulation with B cell development, proliferation and homeostasis, distinct from confusables on GC/plasma-cell signatures, T cell programs or Fc receptor signalling.

qualifier: tuning in B cell development and proliferation
name: BCR signaling and its tuning in developing B cells
rationale: Members cover BCR second messengers, BTK/RAS, CD22 and inhibitory brakes with B cell development, proliferation and homeostasis, separating it from confusables on T cell activation, Fc receptors or B cell surface/plasma cell signatures.

qualifier: core circadian clock loop and MECP2
name: Core circadian clock loop and MECP2 neuronal transcription
rationale: Members combine the BMAL1:CLOCK/CRY:PER feedback loop and its entrainment with MECP2 regulation and loss-of-function and activity-dependent CREB/NPAS4/HDAC transcription; each confusable has only one of these two arms.

qualifier: core circadian feedback loop and MECP2
name: Core circadian clock feedback and MECP2-regulated neuronal transcription
rationale: Members combine the BMAL1:CLOCK/CRY:PER feedback loop with MECP2, CREB/NPAS4 and HDAC transcriptional control in neurons, unlike confusables limited to MECP2-GABA targets, cAMP/PKA-CREB or circadian output genes.

qualifier: core clock feedback loop together with MECP2 regulation
name: Circadian clock feedback loop and MECP2 neuronal transcriptional control
rationale: Members cover the BMAL1:CLOCK/CRY:PER clock loop and MECP2, HDAC, CREB and NPAS4 activity-dependent neuronal transcription, a combination that separates the theme from MECP2-only, circadian-output-only and cAMP/PKA confusables.

qualifier: fructose, glycerol and alanine entry points
name: Glycolysis-gluconeogenesis with fructose, glycerol and alanine metabolism
rationale: Members cover glycolytic and gluconeogenic flux and the fructose, glycerol/alditol, alanine and pyruvate/oxaloacetate branches feeding it, whereas confusables centre on glycogen storage and hexose transport.

name: Glycolysis and gluconeogenesis with fructose and glycerol metabolism
rationale: Members cover central glycolytic/gluconeogenic carbon flux and its feeders (fructose, glycerol/alditols, alanine, oxaloacetate, phosphocreatine); fructose and glycerol metabolism distinguish it from glycogen and hexose-transport confusables.

name: Glycolysis and gluconeogenesis with fructose and glycerol metabolism
rationale: Members cover glycolytic and gluconeogenic carbon flux including fructose, glycerol/alditol, pyruvate, oxaloacetate and alanine metabolism, unlike neighbours focused on glycogen, hexose transport and glucokinase/G6Pase.

name: tRNA processing, aminoacylation and RNA base modification
rationale: Most members are nuclear/mitochondrial tRNA processing, modification and cytosolic/mitochondrial aminoacylation, with related RNA pseudouridylation and editing, whereas confusables lack aminoacylation and emphasise rRNA/mitoribosome or wybutosine/t6A modification.

qualifier: aminoacylation, cytosolic and mitochondrial, with RNA pseudouridylation
name: tRNA processing, modification and aminoacylation, cytosolic and mitochondrial
rationale: Members center on tRNA end processing, splicing, base modification (wobble, methylation, pseudouridine) and aminoacylation in both compartments, distinguishing it from rRNA modification/mitoribosome, wybutosine/t6A and 5'-leader removal confusables.

qualifier: processing, modification and aminoacylation, plus RNA pseudouridylation and editing
name: tRNA maturation, aminoacylation and RNA base modification
rationale: Members span nuclear and mitochondrial tRNA processing, modification and cytosolic/mitochondrial aminoacylation with pseudouridylation and ADAR editing, unlike confusables centred on rRNA modification/mitoribosome assembly or wybutosine/t6A fidelity modifications.

name: RUNX1 transcriptional programs and megakaryocyte-erythroid differentiation
rationale: Members are RUNX1-driven transcriptional regulation across targets plus megakaryocyte/platelet and erythroid differentiation; the broad RUNX1 target set and megakaryocyte arm separate it from granulocytic and progenitor confusables.

name: RUNX1 transcriptional targets and megakaryocyte-erythroid differentiation
rationale: Members are RUNX1-regulated transcription across contexts plus megakaryocyte, platelet and erythroid differentiation; confusables cover granulocytic/myeloid progenitor and HSC programmes without the broad RUNX1 target set.

name: RUNX1-driven transcription and megakaryocyte-erythroid lineage differentiation
rationale: Members are RUNX1 target and regulation programs plus megakaryocyte, platelet and erythroid differentiation modules, distinct from confusables on granulopoiesis, myeloid progenitors and HSC maintenance.

qualifier: autophagosome and endosome maturation, organelle size
name: Autophagosome and endosome maturation and lysosomal fusion
rationale: Members are fusion of autophagosomes, phagosomes, MVBs and endosomes with lysosomes and regulation of autophagosome maturation and endosome/lysosome size, unlike the ESCRT and selective-autophagy confusables.

name: Autophagosome and endosome fusion with lysosomes, organelle size control
rationale: Members are fusion of autophagosomes, endosomes, phagosomes and MVBs with lysosomes, autophagosome assembly/maturation regulation and endolysosome size, distinguishing it from selective-autophagy and ESCRT neighbours.

core: Autophagosome and endosome fusion with lysosomes
qualifier: autophagosome maturation and organelle size control
name: Autophagosome maturation and endolysosomal fusion with organelle size control
rationale: Members regulate autophagosome assembly/maturation and fusion of autophagosomes, endosomes, phagosomes and MVBs with lysosomes plus endosome/lysosome size, while confusables are selective autophagy, mitophagy or ESCRT/MVB sorting.

name: Fatty acid and eicosanoid metabolism with inherited enzyme defects
rationale: Members cover fatty acid, eicosanoid and 12-lipoxygenase/hepoxilin metabolism and transport, and unlike the eicosanoid-oxidation confusables (EET/HETE, omega-oxidation) they include the inherited CYP and transporter defect diseases (CYP1B1, CYP2U1, CYP7B1, TBXAS1, SLC27A4, SLCO2A1 and others).

qualifier: lipoxygenase/hepoxilin branch and inherited CYP and transporter defects
name: Lipoxygenase eicosanoid and fatty acid metabolism, inherited defects
rationale: Members cover fatty acid and eicosanoid synthesis and transport, with the 12-lipoxygenase/hepoxilin branch and inherited CYP, TBXAS1 and SLC transporter defects that the P450 epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase confusables lack.

qualifier: inherited enzyme and transporter defects, lipoxygenase/hepoxilin branch
name: Fatty acid and eicosanoid metabolism with inherited enzyme/transporter defects
rationale: Members cover fatty acid/eicosanoid synthesis, transport and 12-lipoxygenase hepoxilin products; unlike the P450 epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase confusables, the theme holds the Mendelian CYP and SLC/ABC transporter defect entries.

qualifier: fork reversal, DNA topology and recombinational telomere maintenance
name: Replication fork stress resolution and recombinational telomere maintenance
rationale: Members concern resolving replication-stress structures (fork reversal, R-loops, topology, recombination intermediates) and replication/recombination-based telomere maintenance, versus confusables on telomere capping and NHEJ protection.

qualifier: fork reversal, DNA topology and recombination-based telomere maintenance
name: Replication fork stress and recombinational telomere maintenance
rationale: Members address stalled-fork processing, DNA topological change, R-loops and recombination-based telomere maintenance; fork/topology responses distinguish it from telomere-capping and DNA damage checkpoint confusables.

qualifier: DNA topology and recombinational telomere maintenance
name: Replication stress, DNA topology and recombinational telomere maintenance
rationale: Members address fork reversal, topoisomerase-linked damage, R-loops and recombination/replication-based telomere maintenance, while confusables centre on telomere capping/NHEJ protection or checkpoint signaling.

core: Nuclear RNA processing and exosome decay
qualifier: tRNA processing and small RNA biogenesis
name: Exosome-mediated nuclear RNA decay and tRNA/small RNA processing
rationale: Members concern 3'-5' exonucleolytic trimming and surveillance of nuclear RNAs (rRNA, snRNA, snoRNA, CUTs, mRNA) together with tRNA end processing/splicing and siRNA/tRF biogenesis, the last two being absent from the rRNA modification, splicing and Pol I/III transcription confusables.

core: Nuclear RNA surveillance and exosome decay
qualifier: with tRNA and small RNA processing
name: Nuclear RNA surveillance, exosome decay and tRNA/small RNA processing
rationale: Members cover 3'-5' exosome-mediated decay and trimming of mRNA, CUTs, rRNA, snRNA and snoRNA plus tRNA end processing, splicing and tRF/siRNA biogenesis; the tRNA/small RNA processing separates it from RNA modification, rRNA processing and mRNA splicing/export confusables.

core: Nuclear noncoding RNA processing and decay
name: Nuclear exosome RNA decay, surveillance and tRNA maturation
rationale: Members concern 3'-end processing and exosome-mediated decay/surveillance of rRNA, snRNA, snoRNA, CUTs and mRNA plus tRNA processing and small RNA biogenesis; confusables cover RNA modification, rRNA cleavage/ribosome assembly or mRNA splicing and transcription.

name: Axon guidance by semaphorin-plexin and netrin repulsive signaling
rationale: Members share axon guidance and extension through Sema3A-plexin (CRMP, PAK, integrin) and netrin repulsion, distinct from confusables on ephrin, L1, DCC attraction, Sema4D or collateral sprouting.

name: Semaphorin 3A and netrin repulsive axon guidance
rationale: Members are axon guidance and extension driven by Sema3A-plexin (CRMPs, PAK, integrin) and netrin repulsion, distinguishing them from ephrin/L1/DCC, collateral sprouting and Sema4D/Rnd confusables.

name: Netrin and Sema3A-plexin axon guidance and chemorepulsion
rationale: Members share axon guidance and extension control through netrin and Sema3A/plexin repulsive signaling (CRMPs, PAK, integrin inhibition), unlike confusables built on ephrin, L1, DCC attraction, Sema4D or collateral sprouting.

name: Protein methylation, hydroxylation and translation-factor hypermodification
rationale: Members are residue-level modifications (lysine/arginine methylation, histone demethylation, lysine/proline hydroxylation) plus hypusine, diphthamide and wybutosine; confusables carry polyamine metabolism, translation termination or initiation instead.

name: Lysine methylation, hydroxylation and translation-factor residue modification
rationale: Members are lysine/arginine methylation, histone demethylation, hydroxylation and specialised translation-machinery modifications, distinct from translation termination, polyamine and initiation confusables.

name: Protein methylation, hydroxylation and translation factor modifications
rationale: Members are covalent residue modifications: lysine/arginine methylation and demethylation, lysine/proline hydroxylation, and translation-apparatus modifications (hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine); the methylation members separate it from confusables on translation initiation/termination, selenocysteine or polyamines.

qualifier: membrane contact sites and non-vesicular lipid transfer
name: Endoplasmic reticulum shaping and contact-site lipid transfer
rationale: Members cover ER tubular network formation and fusion, ER-mitochondria and ER-plasma membrane tethering with Miro GTPases, and PI/PC/cholesterol transfer and PI synthesis at the ER, distinguishing it from Golgi traffic, inositol phosphate and flippase confusables.

core: ER membrane organization and inter-organelle contacts
qualifier: ER tubule shaping, organelle tethering and lipid transfer
name: ER tubule shaping and inter-organelle contact lipid transfer
rationale: Members concern ER tubular network formation, ER-mitochondria/plasma membrane tethering, Miro GTPases and phospholipid/cholesterol transfer between membranes, which the Golgi traffic, flippase and phosphoinositide confusables lack.

qualifier: tubular network shaping and organelle contact-site lipid transfer
name: ER tubule shaping and ER-organelle contact-site lipid transfer
rationale: Members concern ER tubular network formation/fusion, membrane tethering to mitochondria and plasma membrane (incl. Miro GTPases) and intermembrane PI/PC/cholesterol transfer, whereas confusables emphasize Golgi vesicle traffic, phospholipid flipping or PIP synthesis at other membranes.

qualifier: tryptophan-kynurenine de novo synthesis and nicotinate salvage, with energy-redox balance
name: Tryptophan-kynurenine and nicotinate NAD+ synthesis with energy-redox homeostasis
rationale: Members span kynurenine-route and salvage NAD+/NADP+ synthesis, NAD and mitochondrial ATP/ADP transport, phosphocreatine and redox state, distinguishing it from coenzyme A, pyruvate dehydrogenase, polyamine and creatine confusables.

qualifier: tryptophan-kynurenine NAD+ synthesis and mitochondrial ATP/ADP transport
name: Kynurenine-route NAD+ metabolism and mitochondrial adenine nucleotide exchange
rationale: Members are tryptophan-kynurenine-quinolinate de novo NAD+ synthesis, nicotinate salvage and NAD(P) turnover plus mitochondrial ATP/ADP/NAD transport and phosphocreatine, separating it from CoA, PDH and polyamine confusables.

qualifier: tryptophan-kynurenine synthesis and mitochondrial nucleotide transport
name: Tryptophan-kynurenine NAD+ synthesis and mitochondrial nucleotide transport
rationale: Members are tryptophan/kynurenine catabolism to quinolinate and NAD+, NAD(P) salvage and NAD/ADP/ATP mitochondrial transport, whereas confusables centre on coenzyme A, creatine or polyamine metabolism.

name: Chromatin remodeling and ADP-ribosylation at DNA damage sites
rationale: Members concern nucleosome organization and assembly, CHD remodelers, protein-chromatin loading and PARylation at damaged or replicating DNA, lacking the double-strand break repair pathways and telomere terms of its confusables.

name: Poly-ADP-ribosylation and chromatin remodeling at DNA damage
rationale: Members concern PARylation, nucleosome assembly/remodeling (CHD1/2), chromatin protein recruitment and fork/R-loop processing, without the DSB repair pathways or telomere maintenance of the confusables.

name: ADP-ribosylation and chromatin remodeling at DNA damage sites
rationale: Members combine poly-ADP-ribosylation cycles, nucleosome organization, CHD remodelers and chromatin recruitment at damage sites, unlike the HR/NHEJ repair, telomere and replication confusables.

name: Lipid droplet turnover, triglyceride catabolism and fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation, fusion and disassembly, lipophagy, triglyceride breakdown and fatty acid uptake/oxidation, whereas confusables emphasise triglyceride and phospholipid biosynthesis, glycerol metabolism or lipase/PDE3B regulation.

core: Lipid droplet triglyceride storage and mobilization
name: Lipid droplet triglyceride mobilization and fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members span lipid droplet formation, fusion, lipolysis and lipophagy with fatty acid import, carnitine shuttle and beta-oxidation control (plus adipokine signalling), unlike confusables focused on triglyceride and phospholipid biosynthesis and adipogenesis.

name: Lipid droplet triglyceride mobilization and fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members share lipid droplet dynamics, lipolysis, lipophagy and regulation of fatty acid uptake and beta-oxidation (carnitine shuttle, adiponectin), whereas confusables emphasise triglyceride and phospholipid synthesis.

name: Platelet VWF-GPIb adhesion, activation and degranulation
rationale: Members concern platelet adhesion through VWF-GPIb-IX-V and collagen, degranulation and aggregation, distinguishing it from confusables built on ADP, thrombin, thromboxane and GPVI receptor signalling.

name: Platelet VWF-GPIb-IX-V adhesion, activation and degranulation
rationale: Members concern platelet adhesion via VWF/GPIb-IX-V to collagen, activation, degranulation and coagulation, while confusables emphasize ADP, thrombin, thromboxane, prostacyclin and GPVI receptor signalling.

name: VWF-GPIb platelet adhesion, activation and degranulation
rationale: Members concern platelet adhesion via VWF and GPIb-IX-V (including VWF/ADAMTS13 variants), activation, degranulation and coagulation, unlike confusables centred on ADP, thrombin, thromboxane and GPVI receptor signalling.

name: BDNF-TRKB-driven actin remodeling of dendrites and spines
rationale: Members cover dendrite arborization, spine/filopodium regulation and postsynaptic actin organization driven by BDNF/NTRK2 and EPHB signaling; confusables add NMDAR-RAC1, PSD maintenance and synaptic plasticity.

core: Dendritic arbor and postsynaptic actin remodeling
qualifier: driven by BDNF-TrkB (NTRK2) signaling to RAC1/CDK5
name: BDNF-TrkB-driven dendritic arborization and postsynaptic actin remodeling
rationale: Members link BDNF/NTRK2, EPHB and RHO GTPase signaling to dendrite branching, filopodia and postsynaptic actin, while confusables center on NMDAR-RAC1, synaptic plasticity and PSD maintenance.

name: Dendrite and filopodium actin remodeling via BDNF-TrkB and EphB
rationale: Members link BDNF/NTRK2, EphB and RHOF/RAC1 signaling to actin, filopodia, dendrite arborization and spine shape, whereas confusables emphasise NMDAR-RAC1, PSD maintenance and structural synaptic plasticity.

name: Hematopoietic progenitor homeostasis and thymic T cell development
rationale: Members regulate bone marrow progenitor homeostasis and lymphoid differentiation, with thymocyte proliferation, survival and selection distinguishing the theme from stem-cell-division and myeloid confusables.

qualifier: bone marrow niche and thymic T cell development
name: Bone marrow hematopoiesis and thymic T cell development
rationale: Members regulate bone marrow hematopoiesis and lymphoid development, notably thymocyte proliferation, apoptosis and selection, which the HSC proliferation, myeloid and erythroid confusables lack.

name: Bone marrow hematopoiesis and thymocyte development
rationale: Members regulate bone marrow hematopoietic cells and thymic T cell proliferation, apoptosis and selection, which distinguishes them from confusables on HSC proliferation and myeloid differentiation.

name: Retinal neuron development and photoreceptor phototransduction
rationale: Members cover photoreceptor, bipolar and amacrine differentiation, outer segment organization and the phototransduction cascade, unlike confusables on the retinoid cycle/opsins or anterior eye and optic cup morphogenesis.

qualifier: development, outer segment maintenance and phototransduction
name: Photoreceptor development, outer segment maintenance and phototransduction
rationale: Members combine retinal neuron and photoreceptor differentiation, outer segment/ciliary organisation and the phototransduction cascade, distinct from retinoid cycle/opsin defects and from eye morphogenesis confusables.

qualifier: photoreceptor and retinal neuron development with phototransduction
name: Retinal neuron development and photoreceptor phototransduction
rationale: Members cover rod/cone, bipolar and amacrine development, outer segment organization and phototransduction, distinct from retinoid cycle/opsin and eye morphogenesis neighbours.

name: Solute carrier transport of metabolic carboxylates and carnitine
rationale: Members concern SLC-mediated transport of lactate/pyruvate, TCA intermediates, organic anions/cations and carnitine and their transporter defects, unlike confusables on carnitine synthesis, creatine, fatty acid or cationic amino acid transport.

name: Solute carrier transport of carboxylates, monocarboxylates and carnitine
rationale: Members concern SLC-mediated transport of lactate/pyruvate, di- and tricarboxylates, carnitine and organic ions and their transporter diseases, unlike creatine, fatty acid, cationic amino acid and choline confusables.

qualifier: monocarboxylates, TCA carboxylates, carnitine and organic ions
name: Solute carrier transport of carboxylates and organic ions
rationale: Members concern SLC-mediated transport of lactate, pyruvate, TCA intermediates, carnitine and organic anions/cations and their transporter diseases, unlike fatty acid, creatine, cationic amino acid or carnitine synthesis confusables.

name: V-ATPase organelle acidification and melanosome pigmentation
rationale: Members combine V-ATPase-driven acidification of lysosomes, endosomes, Golgi and synaptic vesicles with melanin synthesis and pigment granule maturation, whereas confusables cover only pigmentation or only pH regulation.

name: V-ATPase organelle acidification and melanosome pigmentation
rationale: Members combine V-ATPase-driven acidification of lysosomes, endosomes, Golgi and synaptic vesicles with melanin synthesis and pigment granule maturation (MITF, SLC24A5); confusables have pigmentation without acidification or pH control without pigmentation.

name: V-ATPase organelle acidification and melanosome pigmentation
rationale: Members combine V-ATPase-dependent acidification of lysosomes, endosomes, Golgi and synaptic vesicles with melanin synthesis, pigment granule maturation and MITF pigmentation genes, unlike neighbours on CO2/pH buffering, melanosome assembly or UV response.

name: Glutamate, glutamine, proline and aspartate nitrogen metabolism
rationale: Members are glutamate/glutamine/proline/aspartate metabolism linked through 2-oxoglutarate and transamination to glycine/glyoxylate; confusables carry glycine conjugation, alanine/gluconeogenesis or urea cycle.

name: Glutamate, glutamine and proline amino acid nitrogen metabolism
rationale: Members cover glutamate-family amino acid synthesis and breakdown, 2-oxoglutarate, glycine/glyoxylate, aspartate/asparagine and nitrogen utilization; this glutamate-hub focus separates it from urea cycle, glycine conjugation and alanine/gluconeogenesis confusables.

name: Glutamate-centred nonessential amino acid and nitrogen metabolism
rationale: Members are glutamate/glutamine, proline, glycine, aspartate, 2-oxoglutarate and glyoxylate metabolism and nitrogen use; confusables add glycine conjugation, threonine catabolism, urea cycle or alanine/gluconeogenesis.

name: Cytochrome P450 and leukotriene eicosanoid metabolism
rationale: Members cover leukotriene synthesis, transport and catabolism plus P450 omega-hydroxylase and epoxygenase HETE/EET production; the P450 branch distinguishes it from lipoxin and lipoxygenase confusables.

qualifier: leukotrienes and cytochrome P450 hydroxylase/epoxygenase products
name: Leukotriene and cytochrome P450 eicosanoid synthesis and catabolism
rationale: Members cover leukotriene synthesis, transport and breakdown plus P450 omega-hydroxylase (HETE) and epoxygenase (EET) eicosanoids; the P450 and leukotriene arms distinguish it from lipoxin/lipoxygenase and leukotriene-receptor neighbours.

qualifier: leukotrienes plus cytochrome P450 HETE/EET branches
name: Leukotriene and cytochrome P450 HETE/EET eicosanoid metabolism
rationale: All members are eicosanoid synthesis, transport or catabolism, combining cysteinyl/B4 leukotrienes with P450 omega-hydroxylase and epoxygenase products; confusables lack the P450 branches (lipoxin-focused) or the cysteinyl leukotriene arm (12-LOX/hepoxilin).

qualifier: midline (notochord/floor plate) and spinal neuron specification
name: Ventral midline patterning and spinal cord neuron specification
rationale: Members cover notochord/floor plate midline development, dorsoventral neural tube patterning and spinal motor neuron/interneuron fate, unlike the neural plate, hindbrain boundary and midbrain dopaminergic confusables.

qualifier: notochord/floor plate midline and spinal motor and interneuron fates
name: Axial midline-driven ventral spinal cord neuron patterning
rationale: Members link notochord/axial mesoderm and floor plate development to dorsoventral neural tube patterning and spinal motor neuron/interneuron specification, unlike confusables centred on neural plate borders, hindbrain HOX, convergent extension or midbrain dopaminergic neurons.

qualifier: axial midline (notochord, floor plate) and ventral spinal neuron fates
name: Axial midline and ventral spinal cord neuron patterning
rationale: Members span axial mesoderm, notochord and floor plate development with dorsoventral neural tube patterning and spinal motor neuron and interneuron specification, unlike confusables on neural plate border/hindbrain or midbrain dopaminergic neurons.

name: Platelet GPCR agonist signaling and degranulation
rationale: Members are platelet activation through thrombin PAR, ADP P2Y1/P2Y12, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptors with degranulation and cytoskeletal remodeling, whereas confusables cover VWF/GPIb and GPVI adhesion, coagulation and Rap1/integrin signaling.

name: Platelet GPCR agonist signaling and degranulation
rationale: Members are thrombin PAR, ADP P2Y, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signaling, cytoskeletal change and granule release in platelets, whereas confusables emphasize VWF/collagen adhesion, coagulation or integrin/Rap1 signaling.

qualifier: GPCR-driven (ADP, thrombin, thromboxane, prostacyclin) with degranulation
name: GPCR-driven platelet activation and degranulation
rationale: Members are platelet P2Y, PAR, TP and prostacyclin receptor signaling, degranulation, SNARE and cytoskeletal changes, whereas confusables emphasise VWF/GPIb/GPVI adhesion and coagulation, or G12/13-Rap1-integrin signaling.

core: Class I cytokine receptor JAK-STAT signaling
qualifier: GH, prolactin, leptin and gp130 cytokines
name: GH, prolactin, leptin and gp130 cytokine JAK-STAT signaling

core: Class I cytokine receptor JAK-STAT signaling
qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and gp130 cytokines
name: Growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and gp130 cytokine JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: Members are JAK-STAT cytokine-receptor signalling by GH, prolactin, leptin, IL-6 family (LIF, CNTF, IL-11) and thrombopoietin with organism growth control; this receptor set distinguishes it from erythropoietin, thyroid hormone and GH-secretion confusables.

qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and gp130 cytokines
name: Growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and gp130 cytokine JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: Members are GH, prolactin, leptin, TPO and IL-6-family (CNTF, LIF, IL-11) receptor signaling via STAT and regulation of body growth; confusables cover erythropoietin, thyroid hormone or GH secretion.

core: vitamin and cofactor transport and metabolism
qualifier: thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E and ubiquinol, with CYP disorders
name: Thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E, ubiquinol metabolism and CYP disorders
rationale: Most members concern thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E and ubiquinone/quinone transport or synthesis, plus inherited CYP1B1/CYP2U1/CYP7B1 and SLCO2A1 defects of lipophilic metabolite handling; this separates it from cobalamin, coenzyme A and carnitine/choline confusables.

core: Vitamin and cofactor transport and metabolism
qualifier: thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E, ubiquinone; cytochrome P450 defects
name: Thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E metabolism and cytochrome P450 defects
rationale: Members cover transport and metabolism of vitamins B1, B2, E and ubiquinone/quinones together with inherited CYP (and SLCO2A1) defects, distinguishing it from cobalamin, coenzyme A/pantothenate and carnitine/choline confusables.

core: Vitamin and cofactor metabolism and transport
qualifier: thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E and ubiquinone, plus cytochrome P450 defects
name: Thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E, ubiquinone metabolism and P450 defects
rationale: Members cover B1, B2 and vitamin E metabolism/transport and quinone synthesis plus inherited CYP and SLCO2A1 disorders, distinguishing it from cobalamin, coenzyme A and carnitine/choline confusables.

core: Glycerolipid (PA, DAG, TAG, phospholipid) synthesis and turnover
name: Glycerolipid synthesis and lipase-driven triglyceride/phospholipid catabolism
rationale: All members concern synthesis, remodeling or breakdown of phosphatidate, acylglycerols and phospholipids; unlike the PC-synthesis and lipid-droplet storage confusables, the theme adds lipase activation, PDE3B-regulated lipolysis and TAG/phospholipid catabolism.

qualifier: phosphatidic acid, diacylglycerol and triglyceride axis
name: Phosphatidic acid–diacylglycerol–triglyceride synthesis and lipolysis
rationale: Members cover PA/DAG/MAG/TAG synthesis, acyl remodelling, lipase activation and TAG/PC catabolism, unlike confusables centred on lysophospholipid hydrolysis, lipid droplet storage or CDP-choline PC synthesis.

name: Glycerolipid synthesis and lipase-regulated triglyceride and phospholipid breakdown
rationale: Members cover PA/DAG/MAG/TAG synthesis plus regulated lipase-driven TAG and PC catabolism (incl. PDE3B antilipolysis), distinguishing it from lipid-droplet/adipocyte storage, PC-synthesis and lysophospholipid-hydrolysis neighbours.

qualifier: cancer-relevant targets: cadherins, PTEN, PD-L1, PAX3
name: Gene-specific transcriptional repression of cancer-relevant targets
rationale: Members are negative transcription/DNA-binding regulation and promoter-level control of CDH1, CDH11, PTEN, PD-L1, TGFBR3 and PAX3 targets; confusables are RUNX3, FOXO and BMP/TGF-beta programmes.

name: Transcriptional regulation of tumor-relevant genes and PAX3 targets
rationale: Members concern promoter-level control of CDH1, CDH11, PTEN, PD-L1 and TGFBR3, ALK-STAT3 nuclear events and PAX3 target sets, separating them from RUNX3, FOXO and BMP-driven differentiation neighbours.

qualifier: cadherin, PTEN and PD-L1 promoters, PAX3 targets, ALK-STAT3
name: Transcriptional control of cadherins, PTEN, PD-L1 and PAX3 targets
rationale: Members are promoter-level transcriptional regulation, mostly repression, of CDH1/CDH11, PTEN, PD-L1 and TGFBR3, PAX3 targets and ALK-STAT3 nuclear events; confusables are RUNX3, FOXO and BMP/TGF-beta transcription programs.

qualifier: cAMP synthesis, degradation and PKA activation
name: cAMP synthesis, degradation and PKA activation
rationale: Members cover adenylate cyclase regulation, cyclic nucleotide hydrolysis by PDE, PKA activation and cellular responses to cAMP/cGMP, distinguishing the theme from adrenergic-inhibitory, CREB/dopamine and PLC-coupled confusables.

name: cAMP/PKA signaling and cyclic nucleotide turnover
rationale: Members cover cAMP synthesis and breakdown (adenylate cyclase, PDE1), PKA activation and cyclic nucleotide responses, distinguishing them from adrenergic Gi, phospholipase C and dopamine/CREB confusables.

name: cAMP second messenger turnover and PKA activation
rationale: Members span cAMP synthesis and PDE degradation, adenylate cyclase regulation, PKA activation and cyclic nucleotide responses, distinct from CREB/dopamine activating, PLC/IP3 and alpha-2 adrenergic inhibitory confusables.

name: E2F-regulated DNA replication initiation and cell cycle progression
rationale: Members are E2F target programmes, G1/S and G2/M promotion and initiation of mitotic DNA replication with origin unwinding; replication initiation and E2F1/E2F6 targets distinguish it from neighbours on E2F/DREAM transcriptional repression and replication-stress checkpoints.

name: E2F-regulated cell cycle and DNA replication initiation
rationale: Members are E2F target/cell cycle modules plus replication initiation and unwinding, whereas confusables emphasise G1/S transcription repression, pre-RC assembly or break-induced replication.

name: E2F-driven cell cycle genes and DNA replication initiation
rationale: Members combine E2F target/cell-cycle gene modules with replication initiation, unwinding and its regulation, whereas confusables emphasize either E2F/DREAM transcriptional control or pre-RC assembly and checkpoints alone.

name: Lipoprotein-linked amyloid-beta clearance and glial activation
rationale: Members concern amyloid-beta formation and clearance, apoptotic-cell clearance and glial/microglial activation; unlike the microglia-centred confusables the theme carries lipoprotein particle signaling and oxidised-LDL response.

core: Amyloid-beta clearance and glial activation control
name: Lipoprotein-signaling control of amyloid-beta and glial activation
rationale: Members concern amyloid-beta formation and clearance, apoptotic-cell and membrane uptake, and restraint of microglia/astrocytes; unlike the confusables, the theme includes lipoprotein particle signaling and oxidised-LDL responses rather than microglial proliferation, migration or cytotoxicity.

core: Amyloid-beta clearance and glial activation control
name: Lipoprotein-signaling control of amyloid-beta and glial activation
rationale: All members concern amyloid-beta formation/clearance, glial (microglia, astrocyte) activation and related synaptic or clearance effects; unlike every confusable, the theme includes lipoprotein particle and oxidised-LDL signaling.

qualifier: processing, incretin-stimulated secretion and GLUT4 translocation
name: Insulin processing, incretin-stimulated secretion and GLUT4 translocation
rationale: Members span insulin processing and catabolism, GLP-1/GIP-stimulated secretion and insulin-driven GLUT4 translocation/receptor recycling, unlike confusables on K-ATP/fatty-acid secretion control or insulin receptor signaling.

name: Insulin processing, incretin-driven secretion and GLUT4 membrane trafficking
rationale: Members span insulin processing/catabolism, GLP-1/GIP-stimulated beta-cell secretion and insulin-stimulated GLUT4 translocation and receptor recycling, distinguishing it from K-ATP/fatty-acid secretion and insulin-receptor signaling confusables.

name: Insulin processing, incretin-stimulated secretion and GLUT4 translocation
rationale: Members span insulin processing/degradation, GLP-1/GIP-driven beta-cell secretion and insulin-triggered GLUT4 and receptor trafficking; confusables lack incretins (receptor signaling) or GLUT4 trafficking (channels, fatty-acid control).

qualifier: pharyngeal, placodal glands and otic structures
name: Ear and glandular organ morphogenesis
rationale: Members are morphogenesis of placode- and pharyngeal-derived organs (thyroid, parathyroid, thymus, salivary, lacrimal, mammary glands, papillae, spleen) and of the inner, middle and outer ear; confusables carry face, limb and palate or airway/bile duct development instead.

qualifier: exocrine/endocrine glands, pharyngeal organs and ear
name: Gland, pharyngeal organ and ear morphogenesis
rationale: Members are development of epithelial glands (lacrimal, salivary, mammary, thyroid, parathyroid), pharyngeal organs (thymus) and ear structures, lacking the limb and craniofacial skeletal members of the confusables.

name: Ear, gland, thymus and spleen organogenesis
rationale: Members are organogenesis terms for inner/middle/outer ear, exocrine and endocrine glands, thymus, spleen and taste papilla, whereas confusables cover craniofacial, limb or airway morphogenesis.

name: MECP2 control of neuronal gene expression and excitability
rationale: Members are MECP2 regulation, its Rett-associated binding defects and its neuronal targets (GABA signalling, receptors, channels, action potential, calcium channels); unlike confusables they lack the HDAC/NCoR corepressor and broad behavioural phenotype terms.

core: MECP2 regulation of neuronal gene expression
qualifier: neuronal excitability, ion channel and receptor targets
name: MECP2 control of neuronal excitability and channel genes
rationale: Members are MECP2 regulation and loss-of-function steps plus the neuronal excitability readouts they control (channels, action potential, mGluR, GABA genes, touch and vision), whereas confusables add HDAC/NCoR repression and vocal or social behaviors.

name: MECP2-dependent neuronal gene regulation and excitability
rationale: Members centre on MECP2 control and loss-of-function affecting neuronal receptors, channels and GABA genes, plus action potential, calcium channel and glutamate receptor regulation, whereas confusables add HDAC/NCoR repression and Rett-type behavioural and developmental terms.

core: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism
qualifier: with sodium-coupled di/tricarboxylate and SLC17 anion transport
name: Glutamine-glutamate-aspartate metabolism and dicarboxylate transport
rationale: Members cover glutamine/glutamate/aspartate metabolism, ammonium handling and the malate-aspartate shuttle together with succinate/citrate and SLC17A5 anion transport; confusables are the urea cycle, TCA/gluconeogenesis or carnitine/cationic amino acid transporters.

core: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism
qualifier: with malate-aspartate shuttle and carboxylate anion transport
name: Glutamate, aspartate and ammonium metabolism with carboxylate anion transport
rationale: Members cover glutamate/glutamine/aspartate metabolism, ammonium handling, the malate-aspartate shuttle and SLC13/SLC17/SLC25 di- and tricarboxylate transport, unlike TCA/gluconeogenesis, urea cycle, cationic amino acid or carnitine transport confusables.

name: Glutamine-glutamate nitrogen metabolism and di-/tricarboxylate transport
rationale: Members cover glutamate, glutamine, aspartate metabolism, ammonium handling, the malate-aspartate shuttle and SLC13/SLC25 carboxylate transport; confusables are the urea cycle, TCA/gluconeogenesis or carnitine/cationic amino acid transport.

name: TCA cycle and lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes
rationale: Members are TCA reactions plus the lipoyl-dependent PDH, OGDH, OADH and glycine-cleavage systems, protein lipoylation and DLD defects, which the electron-transport, PDH-regulation and B6 confusables lack.

name: TCA cycle and lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes
rationale: Members are TCA cycle steps plus the lipoylated PDH, OGDH, OADH and glycine cleavage complexes sharing DLD and protein lipoylation, which confusables on CoA synthesis, B6/serine or Fe-S clusters lack.

name: Lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and TCA cycle
rationale: Members share the lipoate/DLD-dependent PDH, OGDH and OADH complexes (with protein lipoylation, glycine cleavage, lysine catabolism) feeding the TCA cycle, which separates them from respiratory-chain, CoA/PDH-regulation and serine/B6 confusables.

name: Cardiomyocyte action potential phases and His-Purkinje conduction
rationale: Members cover depolarization, plateau and repolarization of atrial and ventricular action potentials plus His-bundle and Purkinje signaling; confusables add potassium-channel resting potential, gap junction coupling or SA node pacemaking instead.

name: Cardiac action potential phases 0-3 and His-Purkinje conduction
rationale: Members cover depolarization, plateau and repolarization of atrial, ventricular and AV-node myocytes plus His-Purkinje signaling, distinct from confusables centred on potassium channels and phase 4 resting potential or SA-node pacemaking and gap-junction coupling.

qualifier: depolarization-repolarization phases 0–3 in atrial, ventricular and Purkinje cells
name: Atrial, ventricular and Purkinje action potential phases 0–3
rationale: Members are the depolarization, plateau and repolarization phases of working-myocardium and His-Purkinje action potentials; neighbours center on resting potential and K+ channels or SA-node pacemaking and gap-junction coupling.

name: Cullin-RING ligase neddylation and substrate ubiquitination
rationale: Members cover neddylation/deneddylation and COP9 signalosome control of cullin-RING ligases and their substrate degradation (PD-L1, NRF2, DVL, AURKA, NOTCH4) with K11/branched chains, which the RHOBTB/protein-stability confusables lack.

name: Cullin-RING ligase degradation regulated by neddylation
rationale: Members are cullin-RING ligase ubiquitination of substrates (PD-L1, NRF2, DVL, AURKA, NOTCH4) together with neddylation/deneddylation and COP9 assembly, which confusables built on RHOBTB cycles, AMPK-ERAD and protein stabilization lack.

name: Neddylation and cullin-RING ligase degradation of signaling proteins
rationale: Members share cullin-RING ubiquitin ligase activity and its neddylation/COP9 control, targeting NFE2L2, PD-L1, AURKA, DVL and NOTCH4; AURKA, DVL, NOTCH4 and K11/branched chain members distinguish it from PD-L1/tumor-immunity and RHOBTB confusables.

qualifier: HSF1 heat-shock response and mitochondrial import
name: Chaperone folding, HSF1 heat-shock response and mitochondrial import
