rationale: Members cover chaperone/chaperonin folding and refolding, HSF1 heat-shock regulation and mitochondrial protein import/UPRmt, distinct from confusables on aggrephagy, nitrosative stress or stress granules.

qualifier: HSF1 heat shock and mitochondrial import
name: HSF1 heat shock response, chaperonin folding and mitochondrial import
rationale: Members cover HSF1 activation and attenuation, chaperonin and ER folding, refolding, UPRmt and mitochondrial matrix import, distinct from stress granule, aggrephagy and nitrosative-stress confusables.

qualifier: HSF1 heat shock, chaperonin folding and mitochondrial import
name: HSF1 heat shock response, chaperonin folding and mitochondrial protein import
rationale: Members are HSF1-driven heat shock response, chaperone/chaperonin folding and refolding, UPRmt and mitochondrial protein import, unlike confusables on chaperone-mediated autophagy, stress granules or aggrephagy.

name: Iron uptake with ascorbate and antioxidant vitamin response
rationale: Members combine iron import/homeostasis with vitamin C metabolism, vitamin E/selenium responses and superoxide removal; the ascorbate/antioxidant component separates it from heme, transferrin and other-metal confusables.

core: Iron uptake and antioxidant micronutrient responses
name: Iron uptake with ascorbate metabolism and antioxidant micronutrient responses
rationale: Members combine cellular iron import/homeostasis with vitamin C metabolism and responses to vitamin E, selenium, superoxide and oxygen; the ascorbate and antioxidant members separate it from heme biosynthesis and heavy-metal confusables.

qualifier: ascorbate and vitamin E antioxidant responses
name: Iron homeostasis and ascorbate/vitamin E antioxidant responses
rationale: Members combine iron/heme uptake and oxygen sensing with ascorbate metabolism and responses to vitamin E, selenium and superoxide; the ascorbate/antioxidant arm separates it from the transferrin, heavy-metal and heme-biosynthesis confusables.

name: Redox homeostasis, NADPH supply and ferroptosis control
rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, NADPH/isocitrate metabolism, glutathione and cystine transport and ferroptosis regulation, distinct from confusables on NFE2L2 regulation, glutathione synthesis defects, NADP biosynthesis or ascorbate/BH4 metabolism.

name: Redox homeostasis, NADPH supply and ferroptosis control
rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, NADPH regeneration via isocitrate metabolism, glutathione and cystine handling, and positive and negative regulation of ferroptosis, whereas confusables centre on NFE2L2 regulation, glutathione synthesis defects with methylglyoxal, or vitamin C/BH4/NAD metabolism.

name: Cellular redox homeostasis, NADPH supply and ferroptosis control
rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, NADPH regeneration via isocitrate metabolism, glutathione/cystine transport and pro- and anti-ferroptosis regulation, distinct from confusables on glutathione synthesis defects, NFE2L2 target programs and NAD/ascorbate metabolism.

qualifier: retinoic acid, BMP and PAX3 developmental regulators
name: Differentiation-coupled quiescence with retinoic acid, BMP and PAX3 regulators
rationale: Members link G0 entry/exit, FOXO and p75NTR cell-cycle arrest and BMP cytostatic modules to retinoic acid/estrogen receptor regulation and PAX3 targets, a developmental growth-arrest context absent from the p53, thyroid hormone and ALK transcription confusables.

core: Quiescence entry and cell cycle exit during differentiation
qualifier: retinoid receptor, BMP/TGF-beta and PAX3 control
name: Differentiation-linked quiescence with retinoid and BMP signaling
rationale: Members concern G1-to-G0 transition and growth arrest (FOXO, p75NTR, p15/BMP modules) coupled to differentiation via retinoic acid receptor regulation and PAX3 targets, which distinguishes the theme from thyroid-receptor, ALK/PTEN/CDH1 transcription and p53 cell-cycle-arrest confusables.

name: Differentiation-linked G0 entry via retinoid, BMP and PAX3 programs
rationale: Members control G1-to-G0 transition and cytostatic arrest during differentiation together with retinoic acid receptor, BMP/TGF-beta and PAX3 target programs, distinguishing them from thyroid hormone receptor, CDH1/PTEN transcription and TP53-driven arrest neighbours.

qualifier: atypical chain linkages and Fanconi anemia monoubiquitination
name: E3 ubiquitination with atypical chains and Fanconi cross-link repair
rationale: Most members concern ubiquitin chain assembly (K6/K11/K27/K29, branched, free chains), monoubiquitination and E3 ligase activity including Fanconi interstrand cross-link repair, whereas confusables centre on deubiquitinases, proteasome and quality control.

qualifier: E3-mediated chain assembly and Fanconi anemia monoubiquitination
name: E3 ubiquitin chain assembly and Fanconi anemia monoubiquitination
rationale: Members share ubiquitin conjugation by E3 ligases, covering atypical K6/K11/K27/K29 and branched chains, monoubiquitination and the monoubiquitin-driven Fanconi crosslink repair pathway, whereas confusables emphasise deubiquitinases, proteasome and protein quality control.

qualifier: atypical chain linkages, monoubiquitination and Fanconi interstrand crosslink repair
name: Atypical-linkage ubiquitination, monoubiquitination and interstrand crosslink repair
rationale: Members concern E3-mediated K6/K11/K27/K29 and branched chains, monoubiquitination and its reversal, and the Fanconi anemia crosslink repair pathway, which confusables (DUB families, proteasome, ERAD) lack.

qualifier: PDGF receptor regulation in mechanoresponsive fibroblasts
name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signalling and PDGF receptor regulation
rationale: Members combine Hippo/YAP-TAZ transcription and cell-density sensing with PDGFR-alpha/beta and FGFR signalling control in fibroblasts; confusables lack either the Hippo arm or the PDGF arm.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling and PDGF receptor regulation
rationale: Members combine Hippo pathway, YAP/TAZ transcription and cell-density sensing with regulation of PDGFR-alpha/beta and FGFR signaling in mechanoresponsive fibroblasts; confusables have one half but not both.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ and PDGF receptor signaling regulation
rationale: Members combine Hippo/YAP-TAZ transcriptional control and cell density sensing in fibroblasts with regulation of PDGF and FGF receptor signaling, which separates it from TGF-beta, AP-2 and stromal confusables.

name: Basement membrane matrix of skeletal muscle and neuromuscular junction
rationale: Members are laminin/collagen basement membrane assembly and receptor interactions, and the muscle differentiation, dystrophin complex and NMJ assembly members distinguish it from collagen-fibril and hemidesmosome confusables.

name: Laminin basement membrane in muscle and neuromuscular junction
rationale: Members are basement membrane assembly, laminin/collagen/proteoglycan interactions and their use in skeletal muscle (dystrophin-glycoprotein complex, myogenesis) and neuromuscular junction assembly, unlike hemidesmosome or fibrillar collagen ECM neighbours.

name: Basement membrane matrix in skeletal muscle and neuromuscular junction
rationale: Members concern basement membrane assembly (laminins, collagen trimers, syndecans, proteoglycans, dystroglycan complex) together with myogenesis and neuromuscular synapse assembly, which the hemidesmosome and collagen-fibril confusables lack.

name: Organelle acidification and phospholipid scrambling
rationale: Members combine V-ATPase-driven acidification of Golgi, endosome, lysosome and synaptic vesicle lumens with aminophospholipid translocation and ANO6 calcium-activated scrambling; the scrambling arm is what the pH-regulation confusables lack.

name: Organelle lumen pH regulation and phospholipid scrambling
rationale: Members combine V-ATPase-driven acidification of lysosome, endosome, Golgi and synaptic vesicle lumens with ANO6-type calcium-activated phospholipid scrambling, the latter absent from all pH/proton-exchange confusables.

name: Organelle lumen acidification and phospholipid scrambling
rationale: Members are V-ATPase-driven acidification of lysosomes, endosomes, Golgi and synaptic vesicles plus aminophospholipid translocation and ANO6 scrambling, the latter absent from all acidification confusables.

qualifier: glycine cleavage and PLP-dependent serine metabolism
name: Protein lipoylation, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and PLP-dependent glycine-serine metabolism
rationale: Members are lipoylation-dependent PDH/OGDH/OADH/DLD complexes and lysine catabolism plus glycine cleavage, serine and vitamin B6 metabolism, distinct from TCA cycle, BCKDH/beta-oxidation and broad amino acid confusables.

qualifier: with vitamin B6 and serine metabolism
name: Lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases plus vitamin B6 and serine metabolism
rationale: Core members are lipoate-dependent PDH/OGDH/OADH/glycine-cleavage enzymes and their lysine/glycine substrates; the vitamin B6 and serine members are what confusables (TCA, BCAA, cofactor and amino acid catabolism) lack.

name: Lipoyl 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and vitamin B6-dependent serine-glycine metabolism
rationale: Members cover protein lipoylation, PDH/OGDH/OADH complexes, DLD, glycine cleavage and lysine catabolism plus serine and vitamin B6 metabolism, the latter distinguishing it from TCA and fatty acid oxidation confusables.

qualifier: sialic acid, GDP-mannose and lysosomal oligosaccharide breakdown
name: Sialic acid, GDP-mannose and lysosomal oligosaccharide sugar metabolism
rationale: Members concern sialic acid synthesis/catabolism, mannose and GDP-mannose synthesis and lysosomal glycoside catabolism; confusables carry UDP-GlcNAc, nucleotide-sugar transport, GPI or dolichol synthesis.

qualifier: sialic acid, GDP-mannose and lysosomal glycan catabolism
name: Sialic acid, mannose and amino sugar metabolism
rationale: Members are sialic acid synthesis/breakdown, GDP-mannose and mannose/fructose-6-phosphate metabolism and lysosomal oligosaccharide catabolism, unlike confusables centred on UDP-GlcNAc, dolichol, GPI and nucleotide-sugar transport.

qualifier: sialic acid and mannose with lysosomal catabolism
name: Sialic acid, mannose and GlcNAc metabolism and lysosomal catabolism
rationale: Members are sialic acid/CMP-Neu5Ac, GDP-mannose, mannose and GlcNAc metabolism including GNE and NEU1 defects and lysosomal oligosaccharide breakdown; confusables center on UDP-GlcNAc synthesis, nucleotide-sugar transport, dolichol and N-glycan processing.

qualifier: cerebellar layering, brainstem and forebrain nuclei with motor coordination
name: Regional brain development: cerebellum, brainstem and forebrain
rationale: Members are development of cerebellar layers (granule, Purkinje, Bergmann glia), brainstem/hindbrain, thalamus, striatum and forebrain neurons plus motor learning and righting reflex; confusables focus on pons/hindbrain migration or locomotor behaviour.

qualifier: cerebellar cortex layering and motor coordination
name: Regional brain development centred on cerebellar cortex layering
rationale: Members span cerebellar Purkinje/granular layer formation, Bergmann glia and motor learning together with thalamus, striatum, substantia nigra and brainstem development, whereas confusables add locomotor behaviour or pons/hindbrain maturation.

qualifier: cerebellar layering and forebrain neuron specification
name: Regional brain development: cerebellar layers and forebrain neurons
rationale: Members span cerebellar granule/Purkinje layer formation, Bergmann glia, forebrain, striatum, thalamus and brainstem development with motor learning; confusables emphasize locomotor behavior or hindbrain/pons maturation.

qualifier: IL-12-driven Th1 and regulatory T cell polarization
name: IL-12-driven Th1 and regulatory T cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover IL-12/IFN-gamma-driven Th1 commitment and Treg (FOXP3) differentiation with suppression of Th2/Th17 fates, which separates it from the dendritic-cell, IFN-gamma signalling, NKT and T cell tolerance neighbours.

qualifier: Th1 and regulatory T cell fates
name: CD4 T cell commitment to Th1 and regulatory lineages
rationale: All members promote IL-12/IFN-gamma-driven Th1 or Treg differentiation while suppressing Th2/Th17 fates, unlike neighbours centred on IFN-gamma response, dendritic/NKT cells or T cell inhibition.

core: CD4 T helper cell fate specification
qualifier: IL-12-driven Th1 and regulatory T cell
name: IL-12-driven Th1 and regulatory T cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover IL-12/JAK-STAT-driven Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma output, suppression of Th2/Th17 fates and FOXP3 Treg development; the neighbours instead centre on IFN-gamma response, dendritic/NKT cells or T cell suppression and lack the Th1/Treg differentiation terms.

qualifier: fibroblast fate, matrix turnover, TGF-beta1 production
name: Fibroblast-driven fibrotic repair with matrix turnover and TGF-beta1 production
rationale: Members regulate fibroblast/myofibroblast differentiation and survival, connective-tissue replacement and ECM assembly/breakdown; elastin catabolism, MMP secretion and TGF-beta1 production set it apart from migration-, collagen- and SMAD-focused confusables.

name: Fibroblast fate and TGF-beta1 production in fibrotic matrix remodeling
rationale: Members regulate fibroblast/myofibroblast differentiation and apoptosis, TGF-beta1 production, matrix assembly/disassembly and connective tissue replacement, whereas confusables emphasise SMAD signaling, collagen metabolism or fibroblast migration.

qualifier: TGF-beta1 production and matrix degradation control
name: Fibrotic repair with TGF-beta1 production and matrix turnover control
rationale: Members regulate fibroblast differentiation/survival, connective tissue replacement, ECM assembly and disassembly, elastin breakdown and TGF-beta1 production; the TGF-beta1 production, MMP secretion and elastin/ECM disassembly members are what confusables (SMAD signaling, fibroblast migration, collagen metabolism) lack.

qualifier: thyroid hormone and retinoic acid receptors with quiescence control
name: Thyroid and retinoid nuclear receptor signaling and quiescence
rationale: Members are thyroid hormone, retinoic acid and estrogen nuclear receptor regulation plus G0/G1 transitions; confusables emphasise liver development, steroid sex-hormone responses or TGF-beta-driven arrest.

qualifier: thyroid hormone and retinoic acid receptors, with quiescence transitions
name: Thyroid hormone and retinoid receptor transcription and quiescence control
rationale: Members concern thyroid hormone, retinoic acid and estrogen receptor signaling regulation, nuclear receptor transcription and SUMOylation, together with G0/G1 transitions; thyroid/retinoid receptor terms distinguish it from the sex steroid confusable, and nuclear receptor terms from the FOXO/morphogen quiescence confusables.

qualifier: thyroid hormone and retinoic acid receptors with G0 transitions
name: Thyroid/retinoic acid receptor transcription and G0 quiescence transitions
rationale: Members are thyroid hormone and retinoic acid receptor signalling, nuclear receptor transcription/SUMOylation and G0-G1 transitions, distinct from steroid (estrogen/androgen), FOXO and liver neighbours.

core: Sensory organ and cranial nerve morphogenesis
qualifier: eye, inner ear and cranial ganglia
name: Eye, inner ear and cranial sensory ganglion morphogenesis
rationale: All members are embryonic morphogenesis of cranial sensory structures (eye/retina, cochlea and vestibule, cranial ganglia, taste papillae); eye/retina and trigeminal ganglion members separate it from the olfactory/outer-ear and the hearing-function/lens confusables.

core: Cranial sensory organ and nerve morphogenesis
qualifier: eye, inner ear and cranial ganglia
name: Embryonic eye, inner ear and cranial ganglion morphogenesis
rationale: All members concern embryonic morphogenesis of head sensory organs and their nerves (eye, inner ear, cranial/trigeminal ganglia, taste papilla); eye structures separate it from the olfactory/facial confusables and cranial ganglia from the eye-and-ear confusable.

qualifier: eye, inner ear and cranial ganglia
name: Eye, inner ear and cranial ganglion morphogenesis
rationale: All members concern embryonic morphogenesis of cranial sense organs and their nerves/ganglia; the eye (retina, iris, optic cup) and inner-ear components distinguish it from olfactory/facial confusables and from the lens/hair-cell-function confusable.

name: Skeletal muscle development and activity-dependent adaptation
rationale: Members cover skeletal muscle differentiation, diaphragm/extraocular muscle development and responses to activity, inactivity and atrophy, unlike confusables on cardiac adaptation, cell size or sarcomere contraction.

name: Skeletal muscle growth, atrophy and activity-dependent adaptation
rationale: Members cover skeletal muscle development, fibre differentiation, growth, atrophy and responses to activity or inactivity, distinguishing it from cardiac adaptation, satellite-cell regeneration and contraction/sarcomere themes.

qualifier: fibre differentiation, growth and atrophy in response to activity
name: Skeletal muscle fibre differentiation, growth and atrophy
rationale: Members cover skeletal myogenesis and fibre differentiation (including diaphragm and extraocular muscle), growth, atrophy and responses to activity or inactivity, whereas confusables centre on cardiac muscle adaptation, sarcomere assembly and calcineurin-dependent contraction.

qualifier: granule cargo and phagosomal nutrient/peptide transport
name: Neutrophil antimicrobial granules and phagosomal nutrient transport
rationale: Members combine neutrophil granule programmes and PMN phagocytolysis with host-pathogen iron/heme competition and proton-coupled oligopeptide/histidine transport, a loose nutritional-immunity grouping distinct from iron homeostasis, histamine and phagosome acidification confusables.

qualifier: neutrophil antimicrobial granules and oligopeptide/histidine transport
name: Neutrophil antimicrobial granules and host-pathogen nutrient transport
rationale: Members combine neutrophil granule and phagocytic programmes with iron/heme assimilation, ion flux at the host-pathogen interface and proton-coupled oligopeptide/histidine transport, unlike phagosome acidification, histamine or systemic iron confusables.

name: Neutrophil antimicrobial granules and phagosomal peptide/metal transport
rationale: Members combine neutrophil granule and phagocytolytic programmes with oligopeptide/histidine, iron and ion transport at the host-pathogen interface, unlike acidification, histamine or iron-homeostasis confusables.

qualifier: IRF3 activation and necroptotic cell death
name: TLR3-TRIF signaling to IRF3 and necroptotic cell death
rationale: Members concern endosomal TLR3/TRIF signaling to TBK1-IRF3, its HSE-causing deficiencies and RIPK1/ZBP1 necroptosis, which TAK1/IKK, interferon-response and RNA-editing confusables lack.

qualifier: IRF3 activation, necroptosis and HSE immunodeficiency
name: Endosomal TLR3-TRIF signaling to IRF3 and necroptosis
rationale: Members cover endosomal TLR3 trafficking, TRIF/TBK1 activation of IRF3/7, its herpes encephalitis deficiencies and RIPK/ZBP1 necroptotic cell death, which broad antiviral IFN and TRIF-IKK confusables lack.

qualifier: IRF3 activation, HSE deficiencies and necroptosis
name: TLR3-TRIF antiviral signaling, HSE deficiencies and necroptosis
rationale: Members cover endosomal TLR3/TRIF signaling to TBK1-IRF3/7, its HSE-causing deficiencies and RIPK1/ZBP1 necroptosis, distinguishing them from RIG-I/interferon and TAK1/NF-kB confusables.

name: Dendritic spine maintenance with reelin and amyloid-beta signaling
rationale: Members concern maintenance of dendritic spines, projections and postsynaptic membrane under reelin signaling and amyloid-beta/tangle-related regulation, which distinguishes it from microglial pruning and plasticity-enhancing confusables.

name: Reelin and amyloid-beta signaling in dendritic spine maintenance
rationale: Members link reelin signalling, amyloid-beta formation/response, neurofibrillary tangle regulation and NMDAR-AMPK to dendrite/spine and postsynaptic maintenance and reduced LTP, whereas confusables are about promoting synaptic plasticity, synaptic transmission or microglia.

name: Reelin signaling in dendritic spine maintenance and amyloid-tau pathology
rationale: Members link Reelin signaling and dendrite/spine maintenance with amyloid-beta and neurofibrillary tangle regulation, which the plasticity, microglia and synaptic transmission confusables lack.

name: TRIF-dependent TLR signaling with TBK1-IRF3/7 activation
rationale: Members are TICAM1/TRIF-dependent TLR3/TLR4 signaling to TBK1-IRF3/7, RIP1-IKK, TAK1 and cell death and its regulation, unlike confusables on IRAK/MyD88-NF-kB, NOD or TNFR pathways.

qualifier: to TBK1-IRF3 and RIP1 cell death
name: TRIF-dependent TLR signaling to TBK1-IRF3 and RIP1 cell death
rationale: Members are TICAM1/TRIF-mediated TLR3/4 outputs (IKK, TAK1, TBK1-IRF3, programmed death) and their regulation, unlike MyD88/IRAK, NF-kB and NOD confusables.

core: Toll-like receptor signalling and its regulation
name: TRIF-dependent toll-like receptor signalling to TBK1-IRF3 and its regulation
rationale: Members are TRIF/TICAM1-dependent TLR3/4 signalling (TBK1-IRF3, RIP1-IKK, TRAF6-TAK1, cell death) and TLR regulation; the TRIF-TBK1-IRF3 arm distinguishes it from NF-kappaB, IRAK, NOD and TLR-cytokine confusables.

name: Insulin/IGF1R-PI3K-AKT signaling and glycogen synthesis control
rationale: Members cover IRS/SHC activation, PI3K-AKT signaling and its attenuation with glycogen and glucose-uptake control, distinguishing it from GLUT4/adiponectin and oncogenic RTK confusables.

name: Insulin receptor PI3K-AKT signaling, glycogen control and signal attenuation
rationale: Members are IRS/IGF1R-AKT activation, glycogen synthesis regulation and negative regulation of insulin response and glucose import, unlike confusables on oncogenic RTKs or GLUT4 translocation and adiponectin.

qualifier: insulin/IGF1 receptor-IRS input and its attenuation
name: Insulin/IGF1 receptor-IRS-PI3K-AKT signaling and attenuation
rationale: Members cover IRS/SHC/SOS signaling from insulin and IGF1 receptors to PI3K-AKT, its negative regulation and glycogen/glucose-uptake outputs, distinguishing them from GLUT4/adiponectin glucose-uptake confusables and oncogenic RTK signaling.

name: Inositol pyrophosphate, nuclear phosphoinositide and PTEN regulation
rationale: Most members concern inositol (pyro)phosphate and nuclear phosphoinositide synthesis, NUDT pyrophosphate hydrolysis and PTEN localization/stability, which AKT- and ceRNA-focused PTEN confusables lack.

qualifier: pyrophosphates, nuclear phosphoinositides and PTEN regulation
name: Inositol pyrophosphate, nuclear phosphoinositide and PTEN regulation
rationale: Members cover inositol and diadenosine pyrophosphate metabolism, nuclear PIP/IP synthesis and PTEN localization and stability, unlike confusables on AKT targets, PTEN loss in cancer or ceRNA control of PTEN.

name: Inositol pyrophosphate, nuclear phosphoinositide and PTEN regulation
rationale: Most members concern inositol (pyro)phosphate and nuclear phosphoinositide synthesis, pyrophosphate hydrolysis and PTEN localization/stability, which separates it from the AKT/PTEN loss-of-function confusables; a few protein (de)phosphorylation members are only loosely attached.

name: HIV-1 replication cycle centred on reverse transcription and integration
rationale: All members are HIV-1 life-cycle steps from entry and uncoating through reverse transcription, PIC import and integration to Rev export and Env; this separates it from HCMV, other RNA viruses and retroelement restriction neighbours.

name: HIV-1 replication cycle with integration and Rev RNA export
rationale: Members trace HIV-1 entry, uncoating, reverse transcription, nuclear import, integration, Rev export and Env synthesis; integration and Rev-mediated export distinguish it from restriction-factor, latency and other-virus confusables.

name: HIV-1 replication cycle with reverse transcription and integration
rationale: All members are HIV-1 life cycle steps (entry, uncoating, reverse transcription, nuclear import, integration, Rev export, Env/Vpu); reverse transcription and integration distinguish it from other-virus and host retroelement restriction confusables.

name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein lipolysis, clearance and LXR-driven lipogenesis
rationale: Members are chylomicron and VLDL remodelling by LPL/LIPC, their clearance, and LXR control of lipogenesis and triglyceride turnover, distinguishing them from intestinal assembly and HDL/LDL remodelling confusables.

name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein clearance and LXR-regulated triglyceride metabolism
rationale: Members cover VLDL/chylomicron remodeling and clearance by LPL/LIPC and LXR control of lipogenesis and lipolysis, unlike confusables centred on HDL/LDL remodeling and intestinal lipid absorption.

name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein clearance and LXR triglyceride regulation
rationale: Members cover chylomicron/VLDL remodeling and clearance, lipase assembly and LXR-driven lipogenesis/lipolysis, unlike confusables on intestinal absorption or HDL/LDL remodeling.

core: Cellular response to oxidative and nitrosative stress
name: Hydrogen peroxide and nitrosative stress responses with oxidative apoptosis
rationale: Members are responses to hydroperoxides and reactive nitrogen species including BACH1/HMOX1 regulation and oxidative-stress-induced apoptosis, distinguished from confusables on ROS detoxification, ferroptosis and hypoxia.

core: Cellular response to peroxide and nitrosative stress
qualifier: HMOX1-BACH1 regulation and oxidative apoptosis control
name: Peroxide and nitric oxide stress responses with HMOX1-BACH1 regulation
rationale: Members are responses to hydrogen peroxide, hydroperoxide and nitric oxide/nitrosative stress with HMOX1-BACH1 control and oxidative-stress apoptosis, while confusables emphasise ROS detoxification, hypoxia or ferroptosis.

name: Peroxide and nitrosative stress responses, BACH1–HMOX1 and apoptosis
rationale: Members are cellular responses to hydrogen peroxide, hydroperoxide and nitric oxide, including HMOX1/BACH1 regulation and oxidative-stress-induced apoptosis; ROS-detoxification confusables lack the apoptosis and nitrosative members, and ferroptosis/hypoxia confusables lack BACH1–HMOX1.

qualifier: autoprocessing and release in head morphogenesis
name: Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing and secretion in head morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern Hh precursor self-proteolysis, palmitoylation defects, ERAD and release alongside head, neurocranium and diaphragm morphogenesis, unlike confusables on SMO/GLI signal transduction, Wnt or Notch processing.

qualifier: in embryonic head and diaphragm morphogenesis
name: Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing and release in embryonic morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern Hedgehog precursor self-cleavage, palmitoylation defects, ERAD of mutants and release of Hh-Np, together with Hh-dependent morphogenesis (anterior head, neurocranium, diaphragm) and cell localisation; confusables are downstream SMO/GLI signalling, Notch O-glycosylation, generic palmitoylation or Wnt secretion and lack the morphogenesis members.

name: Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing and release in head development
rationale: Members concern Hh precursor autoproteolysis, palmitoylation defects, ERAD and release together with anterior head, neurocranium and diaphragm morphogenesis, unlike confusables centred on SMO/GLI signaling, protein lipidation and Notch glycosylation.

core: Regional neuronal differentiation in developing brain
name: Forebrain, retinal and cerebellar neuronal differentiation
rationale: Members concern fate commitment and differentiation in forebrain, thalamus, retina, cerebellum, substantia nigra and adenohypophysis; neighbours emphasize cortical migration, neuroblast division or spinal cord patterning.

name: Neuronal fate specification in forebrain, retina and cerebellum
rationale: Members concern regional neuron and glia differentiation in forebrain, thalamus, retina, cerebellum and midbrain; unlike cortical migration/spinal and progenitor-division neighbours, it includes retinal and cerebellar cell fates.

core: Regional central nervous system neuron differentiation
name: Regional brain and retinal neuron differentiation
rationale: Members are neuron/glia differentiation and patterning in forebrain, thalamus, midbrain, cerebellum and pituitary plus retinal amacrine/photoreceptor differentiation, which the progenitor-division, cortical-migration and spinal confusables lack.

core: Growth hormone axis signaling and somatic growth
qualifier: including GPCR control of GH secretion
name: Growth hormone axis: receptor signaling and secretory control
rationale: Members concern GH receptor/JAK-STAT signaling, IGF and body-growth regulation and leptin, and unlike the cytokine/prolactin/thyroid confusables they include the GPCR/adenylate cyclase arm (somatostatin, glucagon-family GHRH receptors) that controls GH secretion.

core: Growth hormone axis and body growth regulation
qualifier: with somatostatin and glucagon-family GPCR signaling
name: Growth hormone axis and body growth, with somatostatin/glucagon GPCRs
rationale: Members center on growth hormone receptor/JAK-STAT signaling, GH secretion, IGF and leptin input and control of organismal growth rate; unlike the prolactin/cytokine, IGF-response and thyroid confusables it adds somatostatin, glucagon-type receptor and adenylate cyclase GPCR signaling.

core: Growth hormone axis and somatic growth control
name: Growth hormone axis with somatostatin and glucagon-family receptors
rationale: All members concern growth hormone signalling, secretion and organismal growth regulation; unlike the confusables (which add prolactin, thyroid hormone or IL-6-family cytokines) this theme adds somatostatin and glucagon-type GPCR/adenylate cyclase control.

name: Solute carrier transport of dicarboxylates and cationic amino acids
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated movement of succinate/citrate, malate-aspartate shuttle and lysine/arginine/ornithine with their transporter disorders, unlike glutamate/urea-cycle metabolism or carnitine confusables.

name: Membrane transport of cationic amino acids and di/tricarboxylates
rationale: Members are arginine, lysine and ornithine transport and their disorders plus succinate/citrate and malate-aspartate shuttle carriers, distinguishing it from confusables on urea-cycle and glutamate metabolism, carnitine or pyruvate transport.

name: Solute carrier transport of carboxylates and cationic amino acids
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated transport of di/tricarboxylates (malate-aspartate shuttle, succinate, citrate) and lysine/arginine/ornithine with their transporter diseases, whereas confusables are glutamate, urea-cycle or carnitine metabolism.

name: Protein lysine acetylation and H3K4 methyltransferase complexes
rationale: Most members are lysine acetylation (HATs, N-terminal and tubulin) and KMT2/WDR5 histone methylation with TFAP2 coactivation, whereas confusables emphasize BAF/NuRD remodeling, deacetylation, chromosome condensation or DNA methylation.

name: Histone acetyltransferase and lysine methyltransferase complex activity
rationale: Members concern lysine acetylation of histones and other proteins and WDR5/KMT2 histone methylation complexes with their cofactors, unlike confusables on BAF/NuRD remodeling, DNA methylation, deacetylation or chromosome condensation.

name: Lysine acetylation, KMT2 methylation and AP-2 factor regulation
rationale: Members share histone/protein lysine acetylation and KMT2/WDR5 histone methylation, and uniquely include TFAP2 activity regulation that separates it from broad chromatin-remodeling neighbours.

qualifier: non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt and glycerol
name: Non-oxidative pentose phosphate, polyol-fructose and glycerol metabolism
rationale: Members cover the non-oxidative pentose phosphate branch (RPIA, TALDO1 defects), polyol-route fructose synthesis and glycerol/alditol metabolism, unlike galactose, glycolysis and glycogen confusables.

name: Non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt and glycerol/fructose metabolism
rationale: Members cover non-oxidative PPP (TALDO1, RPIA, xylulose-5-P) with fructose, glycerol and alditol metabolism, distinct from glycolysis/glycogen and galactose/pentose catabolism neighbours.

name: Non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt and alditol/fructose metabolism
rationale: Members cover non-oxidative pentose phosphate interconversions with TALDO1/RPIA defects plus glycerol, alditol and polyol-route fructose metabolism, unlike glycolysis/glycogen, galactose or glucuronate confusables.

name: Gastrulation mesoderm formation and early cardiogenesis
rationale: Members cover primitive streak, EMT and mesoderm migration at gastrulation plus secondary heart field and heart morphogenesis, distinguishing it from endoderm/lateral plate and later heart tube confusables.

name: Gastrulation mesoderm formation and early heart field specification
rationale: Members cover primitive streak, gastrulation EMT and mesendoderm/mesoderm specification leading into cardiogenesis and secondary heart field, unlike confusables on heart tube, lateral plate, endoderm or gut.

name: Gastrulation, mesoderm specification and early heart field development
rationale: Members concern primitive streak, EMT and mesendoderm/mesoderm formation during gastrulation plus cardiogenesis and secondary heart field specification, unlike confusables centred on lateral plate/endoderm derivatives, pluripotency factors or heart tube morphogenesis.

qualifier: hydrogen peroxide production and turnover, oxygen sensing
name: Reactive oxygen species production, hydrogen peroxide turnover and detoxification
rationale: Members combine ROS detoxification, superoxide and hydrogen peroxide generation and catabolism, oxygen detection, selenium response and BACH1-HMOX1 regulation; ROS/H2O2 production and oxygen sensing are what the nitrosative-stress and MTF1 confusables lack.

core: Reactive oxygen species detoxification and redox homeostasis
qualifier: peroxide and superoxide removal with BACH1-HMOX1 regulation
name: Peroxide and superoxide detoxification with BACH1-HMOX1 regulation
rationale: Members cover hydrogen peroxide catabolism, superoxide removal, selenium and oxygen sensing, BACH1 and HMOX1 control of redox homeostasis, lacking the nitrosative/peroxide response and MTF1 terms of the confusables.

core: Reactive oxygen species detoxification and redox homeostasis
name: Reactive oxygen species detoxification and hydrogen peroxide turnover
rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, BACH1/HMOX1 regulation and the regulation of H2O2 synthesis/catabolism, superoxide removal and oxygen detection, which separate it from nitrosative-stress, MTF1 and ferroptosis confusables.

core: Drug reward behaviour and neuropeptide signalling
name: Psychostimulant reward behaviour and opioid neuropeptide G-protein signalling
rationale: Members combine responses to cocaine, amphetamine and ethanol and reward conditioning with opioid/neuropeptide G-protein signalling; drug reward distinguishes it from social/sleep behaviour confusables and neuropeptide/opioid signalling from the dopamine receptor confusable.

name: Neuropeptide and opioid signalling in drug reward and reinforcement
rationale: Members link opioid/neuropeptide GPCR signalling, DARPP-32 and dense core vesicle release to responses to cocaine, amphetamine and ethanol and reward learning, distinct from confusables on dopamine receptor subtypes and innate social/sleep behaviours.

core: Neuropeptide G protein-coupled signalling in behaviour
qualifier: opioid signalling and drug reward responses
name: Neuropeptide and opioid signalling in drug reward behaviour
rationale: All members concern neuropeptide/opioid GPCR signalling, dense-core vesicle release and DARPP-32, or behavioural responses to addictive drugs and reward conditioning, distinguished from confusables on dopamine receptor signalling and neuropeptide-driven social, feeding and sleep behaviours.

name: Locomotor and exploratory behaviour with neurotrophic signalling
rationale: Members are behavioural readouts (locomotion, exploration, grooming, social) plus RET, ATF and neuronal specification modules; confusables emphasize synaptic transmission, sensory gating or motor reflexes.

name: Locomotor and exploratory behaviour with RET neurotrophic signalling
rationale: Members are locomotor, exploratory, grooming, social and nonassociative learning behaviours plus RET, ATF and neurotrophic signalling, the neurotrophic and locomotor members distinguishing it from sensorimotor-gating and synaptic transmission themes.

name: Locomotor and exploratory behavior with RET neurotrophic signaling
rationale: Members are locomotor, exploratory, grooming, social and nonassociative-learning behaviours plus RET/ATF neurotrophic and neuronal-specification signaling, the latter absent from all behavioural confusables (sensorimotor gating, synaptic transmission, cerebellar motor).

name: Calcineurin-NFAT signaling in cell size and muscle atrophy
rationale: Members concern calcineurin/NFAT and calcium signaling regulating cell size, dendrite morphogenesis and muscle atrophy/inactivity, distinct from phosphatase regulation, myogenesis/contraction and hypertrophy confusables.

qualifier: in cell size and muscle disuse atrophy
name: Calcineurin-NFAT signaling in cell size and muscle atrophy
rationale: Members center on calcineurin-NFAT calcium signaling and its regulation, controlling cell size, dendrite morphogenesis and skeletal muscle atrophy/inactivity; confusables cover hypertrophy, muscle structure or general phosphatase regulation.

qualifier: cell size control and muscle atrophy
name: Calcineurin–NFAT signaling, cell size and muscle atrophy
rationale: Members concern calcineurin/NFAT calcium signalling with cell size, dendrite morphogenesis and inactivity-induced muscle atrophy, unlike hypertrophy, phosphatase or contraction confusables.

qualifier: natural-product toxins and steroids, with sulfonation
name: Detoxification of natural-product xenobiotics and steroids
rationale: Members span metabolism of mycotoxins, flavones, polyketides and steroids with sulfonation and toxin catabolism, whereas confusables emphasise drug ADME, organic anion transport and CYP/FMO oxidation of aromatic amines and alcohols.

name: Xenobiotic detoxification of aflatoxin, flavonoids and steroids
rationale: Members describe biotransformation of mycotoxins/aflatoxin, polyketides, flavones/genistein and steroids including cytosolic sulfonation, while confusables centre on drug ADME, organic anion transport or other xenobiotic chemistries.

name: Xenobiotic and natural-product toxin detoxification with sulfonation
rationale: Members span xenobiotic, steroid, flavone, polyketide and mycotoxin metabolism with cytosolic sulfonation and PAP metabolism, separating it from confusables on drug ADME transport, CYP/FMO oxidation of amines and alcohols.

name: Apical membrane phospholipid translocation and canalicular bile secretion
rationale: Members concern apical/raft membrane transport including phospholipid flipping, ABCB4/ABCB11 bile canalicular transport and CFTR, distinguished from confusables on CFTR trafficking and transepithelial water by lipid translocation and bile secretion.

core: Apical membrane transport and lipid translocation
name: Apical membrane lipid translocation and canalicular bile transport
rationale: Members cover apical/raft protein localisation, phospholipid and sphingolipid flipping and ABCB4/ABCB11/CFTR apical transporters for bile secretion, unlike confusables on CFTR trafficking, epithelial water transport or scramblase and vesicle traffic modules.

qualifier: ABC transporter defects in bile secretion
name: Apical phospholipid translocation and ABC transporter defects
rationale: Members cover phospholipid/sphingolipid flipping, apical and raft protein localisation, bile acid secretion and diseases of the apical ABC transporters ABCB4, ABCB11 and CFTR; the lipid translocation and ABCB members are what the CFTR-trafficking and epithelial secretion confusables lack.

name: Circulating monocyte surface and activation signatures
rationale: Members are monocyte/myeloid enrichment modules, monocyte surface signatures and monocyte activation/differentiation, distinguished from dendritic cell, neutrophil degranulation/inflammation and monocyte extravasation confusables.

name: Circulating monocyte surface marker and activation signatures
rationale: Members are monocyte/myeloid surface, receptor and differentiation signatures plus monocyte activation and myeloid chemotaxis control, lacking the dendritic-cell, TLR4 lineage, chemotaxis-extravasation or neutrophil-degranulation content of the confusables.

name: Monocyte and myeloid surface receptor signatures
rationale: Members are monocyte/myeloid surface and enrichment signatures plus monocyte activation and differentiation, distinguished from confusables on myeloid lineage specification, neutrophil degranulation, monocyte extravasation or dendritic cell signatures.

name: PPAR-driven white adipogenesis with circadian and PGC-1alpha control
rationale: Members are nuclear receptor/coactivator transcription of white adipocyte differentiation, PPAR and PGC-1alpha mitochondrial programmes and BMAL/ROR/REV-ERB clock control, unlike gluconeogenic, LXR, circadian-only and fat-pad confusables.

name: Nuclear receptor control of adipogenesis and mitochondrial biogenesis
rationale: Members are PPAR, ROR/REV-ERB, PGC-1alpha and steroid-responsive transcription driving white adipocyte differentiation and mitochondrial biogenesis, distinct from circadian-only, gluconeogenic and LXR lipid confusables.

name: Transcriptional control of adipogenesis, mitochondrial biogenesis and circadian clock
rationale: Members describe nuclear receptor and PGC-1alpha transcriptional programmes for white adipogenesis, fatty-acid oxidation, mitochondrial biogenesis and clock genes, unlike the LXR, gluconeogenesis and circadian-only confusables.

name: Circadian and glucocorticoid control of glucose homeostasis
rationale: Members link BMAL1:CLOCK circadian output and glucocorticoid responses to gluconeogenesis, beta-cell growth and hormone secretion; glucocorticoid response separates it from core-clock/PGC-1alpha confusables and the circadian/gluconeogenic arm from HPA cortisol secretion.

name: Circadian and glucocorticoid control of gluconeogenesis and beta-cell growth
rationale: Members link BMAL1:CLOCK rhythms and glucocorticoid response with gluconeogenesis, steroid/endocrine secretion and beta-cell proliferation, while confusables cover core clock machinery, PGC-1alpha/PPAR or ACTH/cortisol secretion.

qualifier: glucocorticoid and circadian regulation of gluconeogenesis and beta cells
name: Glucocorticoid and circadian control of gluconeogenesis and beta cells
rationale: Members join glucocorticoid response, BMAL1/CLOCK rhythms, gluconeogenesis and beta cell development/proliferation, unlike the cortisol-secretion and core clock/PPAR confusables.

qualifier: dietary lipid digestion and lipase activation
name: Dietary lipid digestion and chylomicron/VLDL assembly
rationale: Members cover lipid digestion, lipase and phospholipid catabolism, and chylomicron/VLDL assembly, while confusables address lipoprotein clearance, remodeling, HDL assembly and cholesterol efflux.

qualifier: triglyceride-rich particle assembly and dietary lipid digestion
name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein assembly and dietary lipid digestion
rationale: Members cover chylomicron and VLDL assembly, dietary lipid digestion, acylglycerol transport and lipase/phospholipid catabolism, whereas confusables emphasise lipoprotein clearance, remodeling, HDL assembly and cholesterol efflux.

core: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein assembly and lipid digestion
name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein assembly and dietary lipid digestion
rationale: Members cover dietary lipid digestion, lipase/phospholipid catabolism and chylomicron/VLDL assembly, whereas confusables emphasise sterol absorption transporters and lipoprotein remodeling/clearance.

qualifier: in bone marrow, thymus and developing kidney
name: Proliferation control in bone marrow, thymus and developing kidney
rationale: Members regulate cell proliferation, apoptosis and differentiation in hematopoietic tissues and metanephric development, the kidney arm separating it from hematopoietic confusables and the marrow/thymus arm from the kidney confusable.

name: Cell number control in developing kidney, bone marrow and thymus
rationale: Members concern proliferation, survival and differentiation control setting cell number in kidney development, bone marrow and thymic/B lymphopoiesis, distinguishing it from hematopoietic stem cell homeostasis and kidney size/glomerulus confusables.

qualifier: progenitor proliferation in kidney development and lymphopoiesis
name: Progenitor proliferation control in developing kidney and lymphopoiesis
rationale: Members regulate cell proliferation and number in metanephric kidney development and in bone marrow/thymic lymphopoiesis, combining both contexts unlike kidney-only or haematopoietic-only confusables.

qualifier: L1-family and NCAM at nodes of Ranvier
name: L1-family and NCAM adhesion organizing nodes of Ranvier
rationale: Members are L1, CHL1, NrCAM, neurofascin and NCAM1 interactions together with sodium-channel clustering and paranodal assembly, distinguishing it from myelin, gap-junction and DSCAM/nectin adhesion confusables.

name: L1-family adhesion and nodal sodium channel clustering
rationale: Members are L1, CHL1, NrCAM, neurofascin and NCAM1 interactions together with paranodal assembly, sodium channel clustering and action potential propagation, unlike myelination, gap junction or DSCAM/nectin adhesion neighbours.

core: L1-family and NCAM cell adhesion signalling
name: L1-family and NCAM adhesion in axonal node organisation
rationale: Members are L1, CHL1, NrCAM, neurofascin and NCAM1 interactions with ankyrin, paranodal junction assembly and sodium channel clustering for conduction; confusables add DSCAM/nectin adhesion, myelination or gap junctions instead of L1 recycling/signalling and NCAM1.

name: Craniofacial and inner, middle, outer ear morphogenesis
rationale: Members are face, neurocranium and viscerocranium morphogenesis with otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canal, middle and outer ear and vestibulocochlear nerve formation, whereas confusables add glands, palate, cranial ganglia or olfactory development.

qualifier: inner and outer ear development (otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canals)
name: Craniofacial and inner ear morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern embryonic head, face and skull morphogenesis together with otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canal, ear and vestibulocochlear nerve formation, distinct from confusables on cranial/olfactory nerve development and pharyngeal gland or palate organogenesis.

qualifier: including inner ear and vestibulocochlear development
name: Craniofacial and inner, middle, outer ear morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover neurocranium, viscerocranium, face and nose development with cochlea, semicircular canal, otic vesicle, middle and outer ear and vestibulocochlear nerve formation, distinguishing it from gland-organ and cranial nerve/olfactory confusables.

name: Olfactory, cranial nerve and craniofacial gland development
rationale: Members cover nose/olfactory nerve and GnRH neuron migration, trigeminal/facial nerve and cranial ganglia, taste papillae, and lacrimal/salivary gland branching, unlike hindbrain and inner-ear confusables.

qualifier: nasal-olfactory, trigeminal/facial nerve, lacrimal and salivary
name: Nasal-olfactory, cranial nerve and lacrimal/salivary gland development
rationale: Members concern development and function of nose/olfactory structures, cranial (trigeminal, facial) nerves and ganglia, taste papillae and lacrimal/salivary glands, whereas neighbours concern inner/outer ear and hindbrain.

qualifier: olfactory, trigeminal/facial nerve and lacrimal/salivary gland
name: Olfactory, cranial nerve and craniofacial gland development
rationale: Members concern nose, olfactory and trigeminal/facial nerve development, GnRH neuron migration, taste papillae and lacrimal/salivary glands, whereas confusables are hindbrain or inner/outer ear development.

qualifier: tubulin glutamylation and severing in spermatogenesis
name: Tubulin glutamylation and microtubule remodelling in spermatogenesis
rationale: Members concern tubulin glutamylation, severing and kinesin-driven microtubule remodelling in sperm development, unlike confusables on axoneme assembly, centrosomes or cilia trafficking.

qualifier: tubulin glutamylation and severing in spermatogenesis
name: Tubulin glutamylation and microtubule remodelling in spermatogenesis
rationale: Members cover tubulin poly/deglutamylation, severing, depolymerisation and kinesins together with sperm mitochondrial sheath and Sertoli barrier formation; these distinguish it from centrosome, ciliogenesis and axonemal dynein confusables.

name: Tubulin glutamylation and microtubule remodeling in spermatogenesis
rationale: Members cover tubulin polyglutamylation/deglutamylation, microtubule severing, kinesins and sperm mitochondrial sheath/Sertoli barrier formation, unlike ciliary axoneme or centrosome/spindle confusables.

name: Carnitine, choline, biotin and ubiquinol metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover synthesis, transport and inherited defects of carnitine, choline (with FMO3 trimethylamine oxidation), biotin and ubiquinol, rather than the thiamin/riboflavin vitamins or amino acid and fatty acid oxidation of the confusables.

qualifier: including transport and FMO trimethylamine oxidation
name: Carnitine, choline and biotin metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover carnitine synthesis/transport, choline catabolism with FMO3 trimethylamine oxidation, biotin recycling and ubiquinol synthesis; confusables are thiamin/riboflavin vitamins, amino acid catabolism or mitochondrial beta-oxidation.

name: Carnitine, choline-trimethylamine and biotin cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover synthesis/transport of carnitine, choline catabolism with FMO3 trimethylamine oxidation, biotin recycling and ubiquinol synthesis with their inborn errors, distinct from thiamin/riboflavin, B12 and amino-acid catabolism confusables.

name: Cadherin adhesion with E-cadherin turnover and cadherin-11 signaling
rationale: All members concern cadherin-based adherens junctions and their EMT context (CDH1 processing, degradation, Listeria InlA binding, CDH11 interactions/STAT3), and the protein-level CDH1/CDH11 regulation distinguishes it from junction-organization and cadherin-transcription confusables.

qualifier: protein-level assembly, turnover and EMT at adherens junctions
name: Cadherin adhesion, turnover and EMT at adherens junctions
rationale: All members concern E-cadherin/cadherin-11 adhesion at adherens junctions, its protein trafficking, degradation, pathogen exploitation and loss in EMT; unlike C1 it acts at the protein/junction level rather than cadherin gene transcription, and it is more cadherin-specific than the broad apical-junction confusables.

qualifier: E-cadherin and cadherin-11 protein-level control, EMT
name: Cadherin adherens junction adhesion, E-cadherin turnover and EMT
rationale: All members concern cadherin-based adherens junction adhesion and its loss in EMT; unlike confusables (cadherin gene transcription, generic cell-junction sets) the theme centres on post-translational CDH1/CDH11 processing, degradation and signalling.

qualifier: gap junction electrical coupling and negative regulation of rate and contraction
name: Cardiac gap junction coupling and negative regulation of contraction
rationale: Members concern cardiomyocyte electrical coupling via gap junctions, membrane potential and calcium-release control with negative regulation of heart rate and contraction, distinct from confusables on positive inotropy, SR calcium handling or action potential phases and ion channels.

qualifier: gap junction electrical coupling and negative regulation of rate and contraction
name: Cardiac gap junction coupling and negative regulation of contraction
rationale: Members regulate cardiac conduction through gap-junction coupling, membrane potential, T-tubule-dependent calcium release and dampening of heart rate and contraction, unlike confusables focused on calcium handling that increases force, cardiomyocyte adhesion or action-potential ion channels.

name: Cardiac gap-junction coupling and negative heart rate/contraction control
rationale: Members regulate electrical coupling via gap junctions, membrane potential, T-tubules and dampening of heart rate and contraction, versus confusables on action-potential phases, SR calcium handling or positive inotropy.

name: HSF1 heat-shock response and suppression of p53-mediated apoptosis
rationale: Members combine HSF1 activation/attenuation and heat acclimation with regulation (mainly suppression) of p53-mediated intrinsic apoptosis and anoikis, whereas confusables add UPRmt, stress granules, acetylation or positive p53 apoptosis.

name: HSF1 heat shock response and p53/anoikis cell-death regulation
rationale: Members combine HSF1 activation, attenuation and heat acclimation with chaperone-linked restraint of p53/DNA-damage apoptosis and anoikis control, which the UPRmt, pro-apoptotic p53 and stress-granule confusables lack.

qualifier: HSF1 heat shock and p53/anoikis apoptosis control
name: HSF1 heat shock response and stress-induced apoptosis regulation
rationale: Members combine HSF1 activation/attenuation and heat acclimation with regulation of p53-mediated DNA-damage apoptosis and anoikis; confusables carry only one of these halves plus UPRmt, stress granules or acetylation.

name: Polyamine metabolism and methionine salvage
rationale: Members cover synthesis, interconversion and oxidation of putrescine, spermidine and spermine plus the linked methylthioadenosine-methionine salvage; the salvage branch distinguishes it from confusables centred on ODC regulation, polyamine transport and hypusination.

name: Polyamine metabolism and linked methionine salvage
rationale: Members cover polyamine synthesis, oxidation and interconversion together with methionine salvage from methylthioadenosine, which separates it from confusables centred on ODC regulation, polyamine transport and hypusination.

name: Polyamine metabolism and methionine salvage
rationale: Members cover synthesis, oxidation and interconversion of putrescine, spermidine and spermine linked to methionine salvage from methylthioadenosine, which neighbours focused on ODC regulation, polyamine transport and hypusine lack.

name: Protein acetylation and tubulin polyglutamylation
rationale: Members cover histone/lysine/N-terminal acetylation and tubulin glutamylation/deacetylation, distinct from confusables on protein methylation, tubulin folding or histone methyltransferase complexes.

name: Histone and tubulin acetylation with tubulin glutamylation
rationale: Members concern lysine and N-terminal acetylation of histones and tubulin plus tubulin glutamylation/deglutamylation, distinguishing it from methylation and tubulin folding confusables.

name: Lysine acetylation and tubulin glutamylation post-translational modification
rationale: Members concern lysine/N-terminal and histone acetylation together with tubulin acetylation status and C-terminal polyglutamylation/deglutamylation, separating the theme from tubulin folding, histone methylation and protein methylation confusables.

qualifier: neutral amino acids, polyamines and inositol
name: Neutral amino acid, polyamine and inositol membrane transport
rationale: Members transport neutral/aromatic amino acids, polyamines and inositol, whereas confusables carry cationic amino acids, ornithine and oligopeptides.

qualifier: neutral amino acids, polyamines and inositol
name: Neutral amino acid, polyamine and inositol membrane transport
rationale: Members transport neutral/aromatic amino acids, polyamines and inositol, while confusables center on cationic amino acid and oligopeptide transport.

qualifier: neutral amino acids, polyamines and inositol
name: Neutral amino acid, polyamine and inositol transmembrane transport
rationale: Members transport neutral/aromatic amino acids, polyamines and inositol, distinguishing them from confusables on cationic amino acid and oligopeptide transport.

name: G-beta-gamma and Rac signaling in leukocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members share G-beta-gamma to PI3Kgamma/PLCbeta and RAC1/2/RHOH signaling, including NADPH oxidase activation, in leukocyte chemotaxis and homing, unlike confusables on chemokines, T cell synapse or CXCR4.

name: Leukocyte G-protein beta-gamma to Rac signaling in migration
rationale: Members link GPCR beta-gamma (PLC-beta, PI3K-gamma), S1P receptors and RAC1/RAC2/RHOH-NADPH oxidase to leukocyte homing and chemotaxis, unlike confusables on T cell synapse or chemokine ligands.

qualifier: G beta-gamma to Rac, PI3K-gamma and PLC-beta
name: Leukocyte G beta-gamma signaling to Rac, PI3K-gamma and PLC-beta
rationale: Members link chemoattractant and S1P receptor G beta-gamma signaling through PI3K-gamma, PLC-beta and RAC1/RAC2/RHOH (including NADPH oxidase activation) to dendritic cell chemotaxis and lymphocyte homing, unlike confusables on chemokine-receptor binding, CXCR4 or immunological synapse formation.

core: Epithelial lineage differentiation in branched organs
qualifier: distal lung pneumocyte and pancreatic lineages
name: Distal lung epithelial and pancreatic lineage differentiation
rationale: Members centre on lung saccule/pneumocyte/bronchial epithelial maturation with pancreatic ductal and endocrine progenitor lineages and terminal-unit branching, distinguishing it from mammary, prostate, salivary and kidney nephron development confusables.

name: Lung alveolar and branched-organ epithelial differentiation
rationale: Members centre on distal lung epithelium (pneumocytes, saccules, secretory cells, bronchial branching) with pancreatic duct and kidney epithelial lineages, unlike confusables focused on mammary/prostate, salivary or nephron development.

name: Lung alveolar and pancreatic epithelial differentiation
rationale: Most members are distal lung epithelial differentiation (pneumocytes, saccule, bronchus, secretory cells, hyperoxia) plus pancreatic ductal/endocrine lineages and columnar epithelial maturation, unlike the mammary, prostate, salivary and nephron confusables; ductus arteriosus closure and kidney cell migration are outliers.

qualifier: brainstem/pons maturation, locomotor and reflex behaviors
name: Brainstem and hindbrain maturation with locomotor and reflex behavior
rationale: Members combine brainstem, pons and hindbrain development with locomotion, righting, suckling and respiratory control; confusables instead stress hindbrain cell migration or cerebellar granule/Bergmann glia development.

qualifier: brainstem/pons with locomotor, suckling and respiratory control
name: Brainstem development, locomotor and respiratory motor behavior
rationale: Members combine hindbrain, brainstem and pons development with brainstem-dependent behaviours (locomotion, righting, suckling, neural control of breathing), separating it from cerebellar granule/Bergmann glia and hindbrain migration confusables.

name: Hindbrain development and locomotor, reflex and suckling behavior
rationale: Members combine brainstem/pons/hindbrain maturation and Purkinje layer formation with brainstem-driven motor outputs (walking, righting reflex, suckling, respiratory control, motor learning), which the cerebellar granule/Bergmann glia and hindbrain migration confusables lack.

qualifier: peroxisomal alpha-oxidation of branched fatty acids
name: Short/medium-chain acyl-CoA metabolism and peroxisomal alpha-oxidation
rationale: Members are short/medium-chain fatty acid and acyl-CoA (malonyl-, succinyl-CoA) metabolism together with phytanate alpha-oxidation and pristanoyl-CoA beta-oxidation, the branched-chain peroxisomal arm absent from the mitochondrial beta-oxidation and VLCFA confusables.

name: Branched-chain alpha-oxidation and short/medium-chain acyl-CoA metabolism
rationale: Members share short/medium-chain and branched (phytanate, pristanoyl) acyl-CoA handling with malonyl/succinyl-CoA metabolism; phytanate alpha-oxidation and short-chain catabolism distinguish it from confusables on mitochondrial beta-oxidation/carnitine, VLCFA peroxisomal beta-oxidation and choline/threonine catabolism.

name: Short/medium-chain acyl-CoA metabolism and peroxisomal alpha-oxidation
rationale: Members concern short/medium-chain fatty acid and acyl-CoA turnover plus peroxisomal phytanate alpha-oxidation and pristanoyl beta-oxidation, which distinguishes it from mitochondrial beta-oxidation/ketone and very-long-chain confusables.

name: RUNX3 target and cadherin gene transcriptional regulation
rationale: Members regulate transcription of growth-restraining genes (RUNX3 targets BIM, CDKN1A, p14-ARF; CDH1, CDH11, TGFBR3; FOXO cell cycle genes); this distinguishes it from confusables centred on ALK/STAT3, PTEN/PD-L1 or RUNX3 WNT/YAP targets.

core: Transcriptional control of growth-suppressive and cadherin genes
name: Transcriptional regulation of RUNX3 targets and cadherin genes
rationale: Members are transcriptional regulation of tumor-suppressive targets (RUNX3 on p14-ARF, BIM, CDKN1A; FOXO cell-cycle genes; TFAP2, TGFBR3) and of CDH1/CDH11; confusables lack either the RUNX3 target set or the cadherin promoter regulation.

qualifier: RUNX3 growth-arrest targets and cadherin gene transcription
name: RUNX3 tumour-suppressor targets and cadherin gene transcription
rationale: Members are transcriptional programs for growth arrest/apoptosis (RUNX3 targets CDKN1A, BIM, p14-ARF; FOXO cell cycle) and CDH1/CDH11/TGFBR3 expression; confusables instead cover ALK/STAT3, PTEN/PD-L1 or RUNX3 WNT/YAP regulation.

qualifier: presynaptic calcium-channel and glutamate receptor control
name: Presynaptic excitability control and sensorimotor behaviour
rationale: Members combine neuronal excitability and presynaptic regulation (calcium channels, mGluR, active zone, GABA genes) with sensory and motor behaviours, while confusables add glycinergic transmission and broader behaviour and brain development.

name: Neuronal excitability, presynaptic signalling and sensorimotor behaviour
rationale: Members combine neuronal action potential and calcium-channel regulation, presynaptic active zone, inhibitory mGluR and MECP2-GABA signalling with sensorimotor behaviours (prepulse inhibition, touch, vision, voluntary movement); the presynaptic/mGluR components separate it from behaviour-only and glycinergic confusables.

qualifier: presynaptic glutamate and calcium channel signalling
name: Neuronal excitability, presynaptic signalling and sensorimotor behaviour
rationale: Members mix neuronal action potential and calcium channel control, presynaptic active zone and mGluR signalling with touch, vision, prepulse inhibition and movement behaviours; the presynaptic and channel members distinguish it from behaviour-only or glycinergic confusables.

name: RHOA/B/C, RHOD/F, RHOG GTPase cycles and macropinocytosis
rationale: Members are RHOA-D, RHOF and RHOG GTPase cycles with macropinocytosis, podosome and endosome transport, lacking the CDC42, RAC, RND, RHOU/V and actin-machinery content of confusables.

name: RHOA/B/C, RHOD/F and RHOG cycles with macropinocytosis
rationale: Members are RHOA/B/C/D/F/G GTPase cycles plus macropinocytosis, pinocytosis, podosome and endosome transport regulation, whereas confusables carry CDC42, RAC, RND and actin-nucleation content.

name: RhoA-subfamily, RhoD/F and RhoG cycles with macropinocytosis
rationale: Members are RHOA/B/C, RHOD, RHOF and RHOG GTPase cycles with macropinocytosis and endosomal trafficking, distinct from CDC42/RAC/RND themes and actin-dynamics themes.

name: SREBP-regulated cholesterol biosynthesis and ER sterol transport
rationale: Members concern SREBP target activation, cholesterol homeostasis and ER/vesicular sterol transport, distinct from fatty acid homeostasis, reverse cholesterol transport, ATF6/CREB3 and nuclear receptor confusables.

name: SREBP transcriptional control of cholesterol biosynthesis
rationale: Members are SREBP signalling and target-motif modules, positive/negative regulation of cholesterol synthesis and ER sterol transport, unlike confusables on cholesterol efflux, ATF6 UPR or fatty acid homeostasis.

qualifier: SREBP transcriptional control of ER cholesterol biosynthesis
name: SREBP-driven cholesterol biosynthesis and sterol homeostasis
rationale: Members cover SREBP activation and target-gene programmes (SREBF motifs, ER modules), regulation of cholesterol biosynthesis and intracellular cholesterol transport, distinguishing the theme from ATF6/CREB3 ER stress, reverse cholesterol transport, fatty acid and vitamin D confusables.

name: Pre-rRNA spacer cleavage and proliferation housekeeping genes
rationale: Half the members are pre-rRNA cleavage/processing and ribosome assembly steps and the rest are growth/proliferation housekeeping modules (RB1/BCL2L1, mitochondrial, polycomb, mitotic, inner cell mass), lacking the Pol I/III transcription, splicing and MYC-target content of confusables.

qualifier: pre-rRNA cleavage with proliferation-associated co-expression modules
name: Pre-rRNA processing and ribosome assembly in proliferating cells
rationale: Half the members are pre-rRNA cleavage and cytosolic ribosome assembly, accompanied by inner cell mass proliferation and co-expression modules (chromatin, mitochondrial, RB1/BCL2L1, ubiquitination) of growing cells, unlike confusables centred on Pol I-III transcription, splicing or Fanconi repair.

qualifier: with heterogeneous proliferation-linked housekeeping gene modules
name: Pre-rRNA processing with proliferation-linked housekeeping modules
rationale: About half the members are pre-rRNA spacer cleavage and ribosome assembly, the rest are loosely proliferation-linked gene modules (mitochondrial upkeep, RB1/BCL2L1, polycomb, ubiquitination, centrosome), lacking the RNA polymerase I/III transcription and MYC programmes of the confusables.

qualifier: cadherin gene transcriptional regulation and EMT restraint
name: Cadherin transcriptional regulation and epithelial identity versus EMT
rationale: Members concern transcriptional control of CDH1/CDH11/CDH19, epithelial identity programs and negative regulation of EMT, distinct from confusables on adherens junction assembly and cadherin post-translational processing.

qualifier: transcriptional control of cadherins and EMT
name: Cadherin gene regulation in epithelial identity and EMT
rationale: Members regulate CDH1/CDH11/CDH19 expression, cadherin adhesion and EMT within epithelial programmes; confusables concern adherens junction assembly, cadherin trafficking/degradation or delamination.

qualifier: transcriptional regulation of cadherin genes and EMT restraint
name: Cadherin gene regulation, epithelial identity and EMT restraint
rationale: Members concern transcriptional control of CDH1/CDH11/CDH19, epithelial identity and cadherin adhesion with negative regulation of EMT, distinguished from confusables on cadherin protein trafficking/degradation and adherens-junction assembly.

qualifier: IL-15/IL-21 NK cell expansion and NF-kB inflammatory output
name: IL-15/IL-21-driven NK cell expansion and NF-kB inflammatory cytokine activation
rationale: Members combine IL-15/IL-21 signaling and NK cell differentiation with NF-kB-driven myeloid activation and TNF/IL-23 output, whereas confusables centre on IL-10/IL-12 family, IL-2/IL-7 or type 2 and mast cell cytokine programmes.

core: Cytokine-driven innate lymphocyte and myeloid activation
name: IL-15/IL-21 signaling, NK cell expansion and myeloid NF-kB activation
rationale: Members cover IL-15/IL-21 signalling, NK differentiation/proliferation and NF-kB-driven myeloid/DC and TNF/IL-23 activation, unlike confusables on common-gamma-chain T cell cytokines, IL-10/IL-12 family or type 2 responses.

qualifier: NK cell expansion and NF-kB inflammatory activation
name: IL-15/IL-21 signaling, NK cell expansion and NF-kB inflammatory activation
rationale: Members are IL-15/IL-21 and STAT signalling, NK cell proliferation/differentiation and NF-kB-driven TNF/IL-23 activation modules, distinct from confusables on IL-2/IL-7, IL-10/IL-27 family or type 2/mast cell cytokines.

name: Monocyte surface markers, TLR7/8 and CD1 lipid antigen presentation
rationale: Members combine monocyte surface signatures, TLR7/8 and antigen presentation including CD1/MHC class Ib lipid antigens, unlike confusables dominated by dendritic-cell signatures and MHC class II peptide presentation.

name: Monocyte antigen presentation with CD1 lipid antigens and TLR7/8
rationale: Members are monocyte surface/differentiation signatures, CD1/MHC Ib lipid antigen presentation and the MHC-TLR7/8 cluster, distinguishing them from dendritic cell surface signatures and MHC class II peptide presentation themes.

name: Monocyte antigen presentation with CD1 lipid antigens and TLR7/8
rationale: Members combine general and lipid (CD1/MHC Ib) antigen presentation with monocyte surface/TLR7-TLR8 signatures, while confusables centre on MHC class II peptide presentation and dendritic cell signatures.

qualifier: hydrogen peroxide/oxidative stress and death receptor triggers
name: Regulation of oxidative stress- and death receptor-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate intrinsic apoptosis triggered by hydrogen peroxide/oxidative stress and extrinsic death-receptor apoptosis (with or without ligand), unlike confusables on nitrosative stress, ferroptosis or general peroxide responses.

name: Regulation of oxidative stress-induced and ligand-independent apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate intrinsic apoptosis triggered by hydrogen peroxide, oxidative stress or hypoxia and ligand-independent extrinsic apoptosis, unlike confusables on nitrosative stress, ferroptosis or general peroxide responses.

qualifier: oxidative stress and ligand-deprivation (dependence receptor) signaling
name: Apoptosis control under oxidative stress and ligand deprivation
rationale: Members regulate hydrogen peroxide-, oxidative stress- and hypoxia-induced intrinsic apoptosis together with extrinsic apoptosis triggered in the absence of ligand, whereas confusables cover broader peroxide, nitrosative or hyperoxic stress responses and ferroptosis without the ligand-deprivation arm.

name: Two-pore domain potassium channels setting resting membrane potential
rationale: Members are the K2P channel families (TWIK, TREK, TASK, TRESK, THIK) plus resting potential and ion-flux restraint, distinct from confusables built on Ca2+-activated, ATP-sensitive, TRP or TALK channels.

core: Two-pore domain potassium channels and resting potential
qualifier: inhibition of sodium and calcium influx
name: Two-pore K+ channel resting potential and cation-influx inhibition
rationale: Members are K2P channel families (TREK, TASK, TWIK, THIK, TRESK) and resting-potential control; the negative regulation of Na+, Ca2+ and K+ fluxes is what the K+ channel confusables lack.

core: Two-pore-domain potassium channels and resting membrane potential
name: Two-pore-domain K+ channels and inhibition of cation flux
rationale: Members are K2P leak channels (TREK, TASK, TWIK, THIK, TRESK) setting resting potential plus negative regulation of sodium, potassium and calcium transport, which the confusables (Ca2+-activated, KATP, TALK/TRP channels) lack.

qualifier: actin cytoskeleton and dendritic spine/filopodium control
name: Postsynaptic actin remodelling and dendritic spine structure
rationale: Members concern postsynaptic actin organisation, PSD maintenance, spine and filopodium morphogenesis and receptor delivery to the postsynapse, while confusables emphasise dendrite arborization, EPHB signalling and cell polarity.

qualifier: dendritic spine and filopodium structural plasticity
name: Postsynaptic actin cytoskeleton and dendritic spine structural plasticity
rationale: Members concern postsynaptic actin, PSD maintenance, spine morphogenesis, filopodium assembly and receptor delivery to the postsynapse, while confusables add dendrite arborization, EPHB signaling and cell polarity.

qualifier: actin-based dendritic spine and filopodium remodelling
name: Actin-based dendritic spine and postsynaptic structure regulation
rationale: Members concern postsynaptic actin organisation, filopodia, spine morphogenesis, synapse structural plasticity and receptor delivery, whereas confusables emphasise dendrite arborisation, EPHB signalling or NMDAR-RAC1 plasticity.

qualifier: myeloid differentiation and colony-stimulating factor production
name: Bone marrow myelopoiesis and colony-stimulating factor production
rationale: Members cover bone marrow development, cell proliferation and survival there and myeloid (macrophage, dendritic cell) fate with M-CSF and G-CSF production, unlike confusables centred on stem-cell homeostasis, CSF receptor signalling or RUNX1/erythroid programmes.

qualifier: myeloid colony-stimulating factor production and macrophage/dendritic differentiation
name: Bone marrow cell homeostasis and myeloid colony-stimulating factor production
rationale: Members cover bone marrow cell survival, proliferation and number plus G-CSF/M-CSF production and macrophage/myeloid DC differentiation, distinct from the stem-cell, RUNX1 and CSF-receptor signalling confusables.

qualifier: myeloid differentiation and colony-stimulating factor production
name: Bone marrow homeostasis, myeloid differentiation and CSF production
rationale: Members cover bone marrow development, cell proliferation/apoptosis and cell-number homeostasis plus macrophage/dendritic differentiation and G-CSF/M-CSF production, distinguishing it from confusables built on CSF receptor signaling, granulopoiesis, HSC maintenance or RUNX transcription.

qualifier: GPER1 and progesterone receptor signalling, estrous cycle
name: Estrogen, GPER1 and progesterone receptor signalling
rationale: Members concern estrogen nuclear and GPER1 signalling, progesterone receptor signalling and the estrous cycle, which separates it from androgen-receptor and hallmark estrogen-response confusables.

name: Estrogen and progesterone receptor signaling, including GPER1
rationale: Members are cellular responses to estradiol and progesterone, ER regulation, GPER1 and estrous cycle, whereas confusables add androgen receptor and hallmark estrogen-response sets.

name: Estrogen and progesterone receptor signaling, including GPER1
rationale: All members concern estrogen/estradiol and progesterone responses and receptor signaling (nuclear and GPER1) and the estrous cycle, while confusables add androgen receptor or hallmark estrogen-response signatures.

qualifier: positive regulation of respiration and ATP synthesis
name: Stimulation of mitochondrial respiration and ATP synthesis
rationale: Members positively regulate respiration, electron transport, ATP and nucleotide synthesis alongside hypoxia/oxidative-stress responses, whereas confusables carry negative regulation of respiration and ROS.

name: Positive regulation of respiration with drug and hypoxia responses
rationale: Members combine upregulation of mitochondrial respiration and ATP synthesis with drug, antibiotic, hypoxia and oxidative-stress responses, unlike confusables centred on negative regulation of OXPHOS or anaesthetic responses.

qualifier: with hypoxia, oxidative stress and drug responses
name: Positive regulation of mitochondrial ATP production and stress responses
rationale: Members combine upregulation of respiration and ATP/nucleotide synthesis with responses to hypoxia, oxidative stress and drugs; positive respiration regulation separates it from C1/C4, and the energy members from C2/C3.

name: Small GTPase regulation by GEFs, GAPs and geranylgeranylation
rationale: Members concern activity control and prenylation of Rab, Ral, ARF and Rho GTPases, unlike confusables on vesicle budding, Golgi trafficking or ER protein targeting.

name: Small GTPase activity cycling and geranylgeranylation
rationale: Members cover Rab GEFs/GAPs, Rab/protein geranylgeranylation, Ral, ARF and Rho effector signalling and GTPase activity regulation, unlike confusables on ER/Golgi vesicle trafficking and Golgi organization.

name: Small GTPase regulation and Rab geranylgeranylation
rationale: Members concern GTPase activation/inactivation of Rab, ARF, Ral and Rho proteins and Rab prenylation, whereas confusables are dominated by Golgi/ER vesicle trafficking itself.

name: DNA and protein methylation in heterochromatin silencing and imprinting
rationale: Members combine DNA methylation, PRC2 and lysine/arginine methylation with imprinting and facultative heterochromatin, unlike confusables centered on KMT2/WDR5 lysine methyltransferases, demethylases or X inactivation.

name: DNA and histone methylation in silencing and imprinting
rationale: Members concern DNA methylation, PRC2 and arginine/lysine methylation driving gene silencing, imprinting and facultative heterochromatin, unlike WDR5/MLL activating methylation or demethylase confusables.

qualifier: with non-histone lysine and arginine methylation
name: DNA and protein methylation in Polycomb gene silencing
rationale: Members combine DNA/CpG methylation, PRC2, facultative heterochromatin and imprinting with lysine/arginine methylation of histones, p53 and RUNX1/E2F6 partners, unlike confusables centred on WDR5/MLL lysine methylation, demethylases or chromatin remodelers.

qualifier: histone and non-histone methylation and demethylation
name: Histone and non-histone lysine and arginine methylation
rationale: Members are peptidyl-lysine/arginine methylation states, histone arginine methylation and demethylation, TP53 methylation and methyl-reader cofactors, unlike confusables on DNA methylation, PRC2/heterochromatin or BAF/NuRD remodeling.

qualifier: histone and non-histone targets, including demethylation
name: Histone and non-histone arginine and lysine methylation
rationale: Members are peptidyl-arginine and lysine mono/di/trimethylation, histone arginine methylation and demethylation and TP53 methylation, distinguishing it from confusables on PRC2/MLL/NuRD/BAF chromatin complexes and DNA methylation.

qualifier: lysine and arginine methylation with histone demethylation
name: Protein lysine and arginine methylation and histone demethylation
rationale: Members are peptidyl-lysine mono/di/trimethylation, arginine methylation of histones, histone demethylases and methylation of p53/RUNX1 cofactors and CHD1/2, distinguishing it from BAF/NuRD remodeller, PKMT complex and DNA methylation/heterochromatin confusables.

name: Myogenesis restraint, satellite cell maintenance and muscle atrophy
rationale: Members are negative regulation of myoblast/myotube differentiation, satellite cell maintenance and inactivity-induced atrophy, unlike confusables on myogenic differentiation and cardiac muscle growth.

qualifier: disuse atrophy and satellite cell maintenance
