name: Negative regulation of myogenesis and skeletal muscle disuse atrophy
rationale: Members restrain myoblast proliferation/differentiation and muscle development and cover inactivity-induced atrophy and satellite cell maintenance, unlike pro-myogenic and cardiac growth confusables.

name: Skeletal muscle atrophy and restraint of myoblast differentiation
rationale: Members are muscle atrophy/inactivity responses, satellite cell maintenance and negative regulation of myoblast/myotube differentiation; confusables are pro-myogenic, cardiac or satellite-cell activation sets.

name: Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization in oxidative-stress apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate intrinsic apoptosis to hydrogen peroxide, hypoxia and oxygen-glucose deprivation via MOMP, cytochrome c release, BAD and membrane potential, which confusables lack.

name: Oxidative/hypoxic stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis via mitochondrial permeabilization
rationale: Members regulate peroxide-, oxidative- and hypoxia-induced intrinsic apoptosis through MOMP, cytochrome c release, BAD and mitochondrial membrane potential, which the oxidative-stress confusables lack.

qualifier: outer membrane permeabilization under oxidative and hypoxic stress
name: Mitochondrial permeabilization control in oxidative and hypoxic apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization, cytochrome c release, membrane potential and BAD translocation in peroxide-, hypoxia- and ischemia-triggered intrinsic apoptosis, which confusables on calcium flux, extrinsic death receptors or nitrosative stress lack.

name: Neuropeptide control of sleep-wake, feeding and locomotor rhythm
rationale: Members govern REM/non-REM sleep and wakefulness, eating behaviour and locomotor rhythm including orexin/QRFP/NPFF receptor binding, distinguishing them from stress-hormone, social behaviour and appetite-hormone confusables.

name: Sleep-wake arousal with feeding and locomotor behavior
rationale: Members regulate sleep/wake states, feeding and locomotor rhythm, including orexin signaling, whereas confusables cover HPA stress responses, other neuropeptide behaviors or hormonal appetite control without sleep.

qualifier: orexin-linked sleep-wake, feeding and locomotor rhythm
name: Orexin-regulated sleep-wake, feeding and locomotor rhythm
rationale: Members cover sleep/wake and feeding behaviour with orexin/neuropeptide FF receptor signaling, distinct from confusables on stress-axis hormones, appetite hormones or opioid/social behaviour.

name: Hydrogen peroxide metabolism and nitrosative stress responses
rationale: Members concern H2O2 production, catabolism and cellular responses plus nitric oxide/reactive nitrogen responses, distinguishing it from ROS detoxification, BACH1, ferroptosis and oxidative apoptosis confusables.

qualifier: hydrogen peroxide metabolism and reactive nitrogen species
name: Hydrogen peroxide metabolism and nitrosative stress responses
rationale: Members concern hydrogen peroxide production, catabolism and response plus responses to nitric oxide/reactive nitrogen species, unlike ROS detoxification, ferroptosis and oxidative apoptosis confusables.

qualifier: hydrogen peroxide metabolism and nitric oxide
name: Hydrogen peroxide and nitrosative stress responses
rationale: Members concern cellular responses to hydrogen peroxide, hydroperoxides, nitric oxide and reactive nitrogen species and control of H2O2 production and breakdown, unlike confusables on general ROS detoxification, BACH1/MTF1 regulation or oxidative cell death.

core: Mitochondrial amino acid catabolism feeding succinyl-CoA
name: GABA shunt, lysine and glycine catabolism with protein lipoylation
rationale: Members are GABA synthesis/degradation, lysine and glycine catabolism, succinyl-CoA synthesis and protein lipoylation, while neighbours are defined by the 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes (PDH, OGDH, OADH, DLD) themselves.

name: GABA shunt and lipoate-dependent glycine and lysine catabolism
rationale: Members span protein lipoylation, glycine cleavage, lysine catabolism and succinyl-CoA formation together with GABA synthesis and degradation, the GABA arm being absent from all neighbours.

core: Mitochondrial amino acid catabolism with protein lipoylation
name: GABA metabolism with lysine and glycine catabolism and lipoylation
rationale: Members are lysine, glycine and GABA catabolism feeding succinyl-CoA, with lipoylation of the dehydrogenase complexes; GABA synthesis and degradation are what all four 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase confusables lack.

name: Protein prenylation and lipidation of Rab and Ras
rationale: Members concern protein lipid modification, notably geranylgeranylation of RABs and RAS C-terminal processing; neighbours instead carry cysteine palmitoylation and Wnt/Hedgehog ligand lipidation.

qualifier: small GTPase prenylation and autophagy-linked lipidation
name: Small GTPase geranylgeranylation and autophagy-linked protein lipidation
rationale: Members cover RAB/RAS geranylgeranylation and processing, protein lipidation/delipidation and nucleophagy; unlike palmitoylation and Hedgehog/Wnt lipidation neighbours, it is prenylation plus delipidation and microautophagy.

qualifier: small GTPase prenylation and autophagy-linked delipidation
name: Small GTPase prenylation and autophagy-linked protein lipidation
rationale: Members concern lipid modification of proteins, chiefly RAS/RAB geranylgeranylation and processing, plus delipidation and autophagy-related processes, rather than the palmitoylation, Wnt and Hedgehog lipidation of confusables.

core: Water and solute transport across epithelial barriers
name: Water, magnesium and inositol transport across epithelial barriers
rationale: Members cover aquaporin water transport, claudin-based paracellular and magnesium transport, inositol transporters and blood-brain-barrier lipid transport, distinguished from confusables on tight junctions and cation-chloride cotransport by aquaporin water handling.

qualifier: aquaporin and inositol transport with paracellular flux
name: Water, inositol and magnesium transport across membranes and epithelia
rationale: Members centre on passive transport of water, inositol, magnesium and lipids via aquaporins, inositol transporters and claudin-type paracellular routes (coherence is loose), whereas confusables emphasise chloride cotransporters, potassium channels and tight-junction or magnesium homeostasis.

core: Membrane transport of water and small solutes
qualifier: aquaporin, magnesium, inositol and paracellular routes
name: Aquaporin water, magnesium, inositol and paracellular transport
rationale: Members describe water homeostasis via aquaporins, magnesium and inositol transport, and paracellular/barrier transport; aquaporin and inositol members distinguish it from the tight junction and cation-chloride cotransporter confusables.

core: Magnesium homeostasis and cellular energy buffering
qualifier: mitochondrial ATP/ADP exchange, creatine and inositol metabolism
name: Magnesium homeostasis, ATP/ADP exchange and creatine-inositol metabolism
rationale: Members combine magnesium transport/homeostasis with mitochondrial adenine nucleotide exchange, phosphocreatine and inositol metabolism/transport, which the ion-transport and protein-oligomerization confusables lack; calcium-independent adhesion is an outlier.

qualifier: magnesium, inositol and phosphocreatine-ATP energy shuttle
name: Magnesium and inositol transport with phosphocreatine energy shuttle
rationale: Members are loosely united by solute handling (magnesium transport and homeostasis, inositol transport/metabolism) plus creatine/phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange, which distinguishes them from chloride, aquaporin and tight-junction confusables; calcium-independent adhesion is an outlier.

qualifier: phosphocreatine shuttle, adenine nucleotide exchange and magnesium
name: Phosphocreatine shuttle, ADP/ATP exchange and magnesium homeostasis
rationale: Most members concern creatine/phosphocreatine metabolism, mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport and magnesium transport/homeostasis (Mg-ATP), with inositol transport and calcium-independent adhesion as outliers; neighbours concern aquaporins, chloride cotransport and protein oligomerization.

name: Sympathoadrenal neural crest development and catecholamine biosynthesis
rationale: Members share neural crest/endothelin-driven autonomic and enteric development with sympathetic, adrenal and catecholamine synthesis, the latter absent from the RET/GDNF and gut-motility confusables.

name: Sympathoadrenal and enteric neural crest development, catecholamine synthesis
rationale: Members cover neural crest migration into sympathetic, adrenal and enteric lineages with endothelin signaling and catecholamine synthesis, unlike confusables on GI motility or RET/GDNF signaling.

name: Autonomic neural crest development and sympathoadrenal catecholamine synthesis
rationale: Members cover endothelin-dependent neural crest migration into enteric, sympathetic and adrenal lineages together with noradrenergic neuron development and catecholamine biosynthesis, whereas confusables emphasize RET/GDNF signaling, gut motility or endothelin blood-pressure control.

name: Social, reproductive and communicative behaviour
rationale: Members cover mating, parental, aggressive, pheromone, vocal learning and observational learning behaviour; confusables emphasize drinking, exploration/locomotion or copulatory physiology.

name: Social, mating, parental and vocal-learning behaviour
rationale: Members are intraspecies behaviours (aggression, mating, parental care, pheromone response, grooming, observational and vocal learning), distinguishing it from ethanol, exploratory/sensorimotor and sexual physiology themes.

qualifier: mating, aggression, parental and vocal learning
name: Social, reproductive and vocal-learning behavior
rationale: Members are intraspecies social behaviours (mating, aggression, parental care, pheromone response, vocal and observational learning), distinguished from confusables on exploration/locomotion, sensory behaviour or drinking.

qualifier: myoblast commitment, migration, proliferation and fusion
name: Skeletal myoblast commitment, migration, fusion and differentiation
rationale: Members describe skeletal muscle development from myoblast fate through fusion and fiber differentiation, unlike confusables on sarcomere contraction, cardiac growth/adaptation and negative regulation of myogenesis.

name: Skeletal myogenesis from myoblast commitment to fiber differentiation

name: Neuronal excitability, glycinergic inhibition and neural translation control

core: Control of neuronal excitability and inhibitory transmission
name: Glycinergic inhibition and neuronal excitability control
rationale: Members share neural control of excitability (glycinergic transmission and hyperekplexia, dampening of nerve impulses and calcium channels, action potential regulation, MECP2-GABA genes, neuronal mRNA translation repressors), distinguishing it from confusables dominated by MECP2 disease variants or locomotor and social behaviors.

qualifier: Gq-phospholipase C, IP3 and calcium mobilization
name: Eicosanoid receptor Gq-phospholipase C calcium signaling

qualifier: prostanoid and leukotriene receptors via PLC/IP3

qualifier: prostanoid and leukotriene receptors via PLC-IP3 calcium
name: Prostanoid and leukotriene GPCR signaling via PLC-calcium

qualifier: positive regulation of proliferation; naive and memory B cell signatures

qualifier: positive regulation of proliferation and differentiation, outside germinal centre

core: B cell activation, proliferation and differentiation
qualifier: naive/memory B cell signatures, positive regulation

qualifier: dendritic cell and lymphocyte surface proteins
name: Dendritic cell and lymphocyte surface protein signatures

name: Dendritic cell-centred leukocyte surface marker signatures

name: Dendritic, T and plasma cell surface signatures
rationale: Most members are leukocyte surface-marker signatures centred on dendritic cells plus T, plasma cell and butyrophilin sets, which the monocyte- and MHC-presentation confusables lack.

qualifier: ISG signature with feedback restraint and Dengue modulation
name: Type I interferon signature and Dengue-modulated antiviral response
rationale: Members are type I IFN/IRF2-target response signatures, innate antiviral response, negative regulation of RIG-I and antiviral defense, and Dengue modulation of immunity and apoptosis; the downstream signature with feedback and Dengue context separate it from confusables centred on sensor-driven IFN induction or ISG effector mechanisms.

qualifier: interferon-stimulated gene signatures and dengue immune modulation
name: Type I interferon-stimulated gene signatures and dengue virus immune modulation
rationale: Members are IFN-alpha/IRF2-target expression signatures and dengue modulation of antiviral responses, distinct from sensor-level TLR/cGAS/RIG-I signaling and ISG15/OAS effector neighbours.

core: Type I interferon antiviral response signature
qualifier: negative feedback and dengue immune modulation
name: Type I interferon signature, negative feedback and dengue modulation
rationale: Members are IFN-alpha/antiviral transcriptional signatures, negative regulation of RIG-I and antiviral defense, and dengue modulation of immunity; the dengue members are absent from all confusables, which emphasize sensing, cGAS-STING or ISG effectors.

name: B cell-enriched leukocyte surface marker signatures
rationale: Members are surface/identity signatures of B cells, dendritic cells and T cells (plus butyrophilin interactions and exosome assembly); unlike the confusables, the theme carries the naive and mature B cell surface signatures.

qualifier: B cell, dendritic cell and T cell
name: B cell, dendritic cell and T cell surface signatures
rationale: Members are surface-marker signatures of B cells, LPS-activated and resting DCs and Th1 CD4 T cells plus butyrophilin and exosome surface biology; the B cell signatures separate it from DC/antigen-presentation confusables and the DC/T cell signatures from the B-cell-only confusable.

name: B, T and dendritic cell surface marker signatures
rationale: Members are surface/identity signatures of naive and mature B cells, activated dendritic cells and Th1 CD4 T cells (plus butyrophilin surface interactions); the B cell signatures separate it from DC/monocyte/antigen-presentation neighbours, and the DC and T cell signatures from the B-cell-only neighbour.

name: Drug ADME and amino acid conjugation of xenobiotic acids
rationale: Members are drug ADME pathways (aspirin, paracetamol, statin, prednisone, ciprofloxacin) with glycine/glutamine conjugation and CYP2E1 reactions, unlike confusables on sulfonation, acetylation/methylation or organic anion transport.

core: Drug absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion
name: Drug disposition and glycine/glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids

name: Drug ADME with glycine and glutamine conjugation
rationale: Members are drug ADME pathways and mitochondrial amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids, unlike confusables featuring sulfonation, SLCO transport, acetylation or methylation.

qualifier: with suppression of amyloid precursor protein metabolism
name: Sphingolipid biosynthesis and amyloid precursor protein suppression

name: Sphingomyelin biosynthesis and amyloid precursor protein regulation
rationale: Members combine de novo sphingolipid/sphingomyelin synthesis and homeostasis with regulation of amide metabolism and APP synthesis and catabolism, which the sphingolipid catabolism and amyloid fibril confusables lack in combination.

name: Sphingolipid biosynthesis and amyloid precursor protein regulation
rationale: Members combine de novo sphingolipid/sphingomyelin synthesis and amide/membrane lipid regulation with negative regulation of APP synthesis and catabolism, which separates it from amyloid-fibril and sphingolipid-catabolism confusables.

name: Glucose and sterol sensing transcription via ChREBP and SREBP
rationale: Members are sugar-responsive ChREBP/carbon-catabolite transcription and SREBP-driven cholesterol programs, unlike confusables on PKA/AMPK metabolic phosphorylation, nuclear receptors or adipogenesis.

name: Glucose- and sterol-responsive transcription via ChREBP and SREBP
rationale: Members combine carbohydrate-sensing transcription (ChREBP, glucose/sugar signalling, PP2A) with SREBP-driven cholesterol homeostasis, unlike confusables centred on adipogenesis, PPAR/LXR or PKA/AMPK metabolic control.

qualifier: glucose via ChREBP and sterols via SREBP
name: Glucose and sterol sensing transcription via ChREBP and SREBP
rationale: Members cover glucose-responsive (ChREBP, carbon catabolite, sugar signalling) and sterol-responsive (SREBP, cholesterol homeostasis) gene control, unlike neighbours driven by nuclear receptors, adipogenesis, motif sets or PKA/AMPK signalling.

name: Selenium metabolism, selenoprotein synthesis and redox protection
rationale: Members cover dietary selenium conversion and excretion, selenocysteine synthesis and readthrough insertion, and selenoprotein-linked ROS detoxification and protein repair, unlike the sulfur, glutathione, NADPH and thyroid confusables.

name: Selenium metabolism and selenoprotein-based antioxidant defense
rationale: Members cover selenium compound metabolism, selenocysteine synthesis via translational readthrough, ROS detoxification and methionine sulfoxide protein repair; confusables are sulfur/glutathione, NADPH/ascorbate or thyroid hormone pathways.

qualifier: selenocysteine synthesis and selenoprotein redox defense
name: Selenium metabolism and selenoprotein antioxidant redox defense
rationale: Members cover dietary selenium conversion and excretion, selenocysteine synthesis and recoding, and the redox/ROS detoxification and protein repair selenoproteins perform, distinct from NADPH/ascorbate, glutathione/sulfur and thyroid hormone confusables.

core: Neural progenitor proliferation and neuronal differentiation
name: Neural progenitor proliferation and midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation

core: Neural progenitor proliferation and neuronal differentiation
qualifier: midbrain dopaminergic neurons and radial glia

core: Neural progenitor division and neuron differentiation
name: Neural progenitor division and midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation
rationale: Members cover neural progenitor/radial glia division and differentiation with midbrain dopaminergic and cerebellar specialization, unlike neural stem cell maintenance, oligodendrocyte and axon guidance neighbours.

name: Cortical spindle orientation and astral microtubule stabilization

name: Spindle positioning via astral microtubule-cortex interactions

core: Chromatin remodeling in DNA repair and replication
name: Nucleosome remodeling in DNA repair and replication with ADP-ribosylation
rationale: Members concern nucleosome assembly/disassembly and chromatin access during replication and repair, with regulation of protein ADP-ribosylation and de-ADP-ribosylation distinguishing them from CHD/NuRD/BAF transcriptional remodeler and double-strand-break confusables.

qualifier: during DNA replication and repair, with ADP-ribosylation reversal
name: Nucleosome assembly and remodeling during DNA replication and repair
rationale: Members concern nucleosome assembly/disassembly and CHD1/2 remodeling coupled to DNA replication, excision repair and damage-induced telomere maintenance, including de-ADP-ribosylation and deubiquitination, unlike transcription-linked remodeler/histone methylation confusables or DSB-repair localization.

name: Replication- and repair-coupled nucleosome remodeling with ADP-ribosylation control
rationale: Members concern nucleosome assembly/disassembly during DNA replication and repair with ADP-ribosylation and deubiquitination regulation, unlike confusables on transcriptional chromatin complexes or DSB repair choice.

qualifier: monocyte, macrophage, dendritic cell and osteoclast differentiation and fusion
name: CSF1-driven monocyte, macrophage and osteoclast differentiation and fusion
rationale: Members span M-CSF signaling and differentiation, proliferation and fusion of monocytes, macrophages, myeloid DCs and osteoclasts; confusables carry interleukin/SHC signaling and bone remodeling terms rather than the differentiation/fusion set.

name: CSF1-driven monocyte, macrophage and osteoclast differentiation and fusion

name: CSF1-driven mononuclear phagocyte differentiation and osteoclast fusion
rationale: Members combine M-CSF signaling with monocyte, macrophage, dendritic cell and osteoclast differentiation, proliferation and fusion; the differentiation and fusion terms separate it from CSF1 signaling and bone-remodeling confusables.

core: Ephrin and L1/NCAM signaling in neurite remodeling
qualifier: growth cone collapse, synapse pruning and fasciculation
name: Ephrin repulsion and L1/NCAM signaling in neurite remodeling
rationale: Members combine Eph-ephrin repulsion, L1/NCAM/CHL1 signalling, axon fasciculation and dendrite/synapse remodeling; neighbours instead emphasize adhesion, DCC/netrin attraction, RAC1 or Sema3A guidance.

name: Ephrin and L1/NCAM signaling in axon fasciculation and neurite remodeling
rationale: Members combine ephrin repulsion and L1/CHL1/NCAM signaling in fasciculation, pruning and dendrite restraint; unlike heterophilic adhesion, netrin/RAC1 and Sema3A neighbours, it is defined by ephrin and L1/NCAM pathways.

qualifier: L1/NCAM and ephrin signaling with neuron remodeling
name: L1/NCAM and ephrin signaling in axon fasciculation and neuron remodeling
rationale: Members are L1, CHL1, NCAM1 and ephrin-mediated repulsion, fasciculation and pruning; NCAM1/L1 and synapse pruning/remodeling distinguish it from the netrin, semaphorin and DSCAM confusables.

qualifier: R-loops, protein-DNA crosslinks and transcription termination
name: Replication stress, R-loop resolution and transcription termination
rationale: Members concern replication-transcription conflicts: R-loop processing, transcription termination, DNA-protein crosslink repair and camptothecin/hydroxyurea responses, distinguishing them from double-strand break repair and telomere confusables.

qualifier: R-loops, protein-DNA crosslinks and transcription termination
name: Replication-transcription conflict resolution and protein-DNA crosslink repair
rationale: Members concern replication stress responses, R-loop processing, DNA-protein crosslink repair and transcription termination, unlike confusables on double-strand break repair and telomere maintenance.

name: Replication stress, R-loop and protein-DNA crosslink resolution
rationale: Members cover replication initiation and stress responses (hydroxyurea, camptothecin), R-loop processing, DNA-protein crosslink repair and coupled transcription termination, unlike confusables on double-strand break repair, telomeres or DNA topology.

qualifier: phase II conjugation by methylation, acetylation and sulfonation
name: Phase II xenobiotic conjugation by methylation, acetylation, sulfonation

qualifier: phase II methylation, acetylation and sulfonation

qualifier: phase II conjugation and thiopurine methylation
name: Xenobiotic phase II conjugation and thiopurine methylation

qualifier: glucagon receptor-cAMP-PKA and glucose-regulated insulin secretion
name: Glucagon-cAMP-PKA signaling and glucose-regulated insulin secretion

name: Glucagon-cAMP-PKA signaling in islet hormone secretion

name: Post-Golgi endosomal sorting to lysosomes and recycling

qualifier: between Golgi, endosomes, lysosomes and plasma membrane
name: Post-Golgi trafficking among Golgi, endosomes, lysosomes and plasma membrane

name: Replication-coupled cohesin loading and sister chromatid cohesion establishment

core: ER membrane-bound transcription factor activation of sterol genes
qualifier: ATF6 and CREB3 unfolded protein response arm

qualifier: SREBP sterol control plus ATF6/CREB3 unfolded protein response
name: SREBP cholesterol and ATF6 unfolded-protein transcription
rationale: Members are SREBP-driven cholesterol homeostasis programmes and ATF6/CREB3 ER-stress transcription (both ER-anchored factors released by proteolysis); the ATF6/CREB3 arm is what all confusables lack.

qualifier: FGFR, ERBB and MET via RAS-MAPK and PI3K
name: FGFR, ERBB and MET signaling through RAS-MAPK and PI3K

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signalling to RAS-MAPK and PI3K
qualifier: adaptor cascades of FGFR, ERBB and MET including point mutants
name: Receptor tyrosine kinase adaptor signalling to RAS-MAPK and PI3K
rationale: Members are FGFR, ERBB, MET, IGF1R and ALK/LTK adaptor (SHC, GRB2, FRS, PLCG, PI3K) cascades and RAS/RAF/MEK mutants feeding ERK and AKT, whereas confusables emphasize alternative MAPKs, AKT2 metabolic output, or RTK fusions and amplifications in cancer.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to RAS-MAPK and PI3K
name: ERBB, FGFR and MET receptor signaling to RAS-MAPK and PI3K
rationale: Members are RTK (mainly ERBB, FGFR, MET) adaptor cascades through SHC/GRB2/FRS/PLCG/PI3K to RAS-RAF-MAPK and AKT, including RAS/RAF point mutants and feedback, whereas confusables emphasise oncogenic RTK fusions/amplifications or ERK5/p38 branches.

name: Amino acid metabolism with urea cycle and glutathione

qualifier: urea cycle, sulfur amino acid and glutathione metabolism with inborn errors
name: Amino acid, urea cycle and glutathione metabolism
rationale: Members span amino acid synthesis and catabolism, urea cycle and its disorders, transsulfuration, glutathione and cofactor (B6, BH4) metabolism; nitrogen/amino acid handling distinguishes it from selenium, gluconeogenesis, malate-aspartate shuttle and TCA confusables.

qualifier: urea cycle and glutathione/sulfur amino acid metabolism
name: Amino acid catabolism, urea cycle and glutathione metabolism
rationale: Members span amino acid synthesis and catabolism, urea cycle disorders, glutathione and transsulfuration, BH4 and B6 cofactors, while confusables are selenium metabolism, malate-aspartate shuttle or gluconeogenesis.

qualifier: GAG and dystroglycan O-glycan synthesis plus lysosomal degradation
name: Glycosaminoglycan and O-glycan synthesis and lysosomal glycan degradation
rationale: Members cover GAG/proteoglycan biosynthesis, O-mannosyl/fucosyl/glucosyl glycosylation (dystroglycan, Notch), and lysosomal GAG and glycolipid degradation with their disorders, distinct from N-glycan/CDG and blood-group confusables.

name: Glycosaminoglycan turnover and dystroglycan/Notch O-glycosylation

name: Glycosaminoglycan and protein O-glycan synthesis and lysosomal degradation

qualifier: adipocyte differentiation and lipid droplet triglyceride dynamics
name: Adipocyte differentiation and lipid droplet triglyceride storage

qualifier: Hox clusters, somitogenesis and neural crest/craniofacial derivatives
name: Hox-driven axial patterning, somitogenesis and neural crest craniofacial development

qualifier: Hox clusters, somites, limbs and craniofacial structures
name: Hox-driven somite, limb and craniofacial patterning

qualifier: Hox clusters, somitogenesis and neural crest derivatives
name: Hox and neural crest-driven axial and craniofacial patterning
rationale: Members cover Hox clusters, hindbrain and somite segmentation, neural crest and craniofacial, ear, limb and pharyngeal organ morphogenesis, unlike confusables centred on joints, forebrain or axial mesoderm/neural tube patterning.

qualifier: steroidogenesis with thyroid, growth hormone and leptin axes
name: Steroidogenesis and thyroid, growth hormone and leptin endocrine signaling

qualifier: steroidogenesis, thyroid, growth hormone, prolactin and leptin axes
name: Steroidogenesis, thyroid and growth hormone endocrine axes
rationale: Members span adrenal/gonadal steroid biosynthesis and its CYP defects, corticosteroid secretion, thyroid hormone handling and GH/prolactin/leptin cytokine-receptor signaling, distinguishing it from vitamin D, retinoid, vitamin K and growth-rate confusables.

qualifier: adrenal-gonadal steroidogenesis, thyroid hormone and GH/prolactin/leptin
name: Adrenal-gonadal steroidogenesis, thyroid and GH-prolactin-leptin hormone signaling
rationale: Members span corticosteroid, sex-steroid and progesterone biosynthesis and secretion, thyroid hormone generation and signaling, and growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptor signaling, distinguishing it from vitamin A/D/K metabolism themes and a growth-rate/amino-acid transport theme.

qualifier: APC/C control, chromatid separation, spindle and cytokinesis
name: APC/C-controlled anaphase, chromatid separation, spindle and cytokinesis
rationale: Members span APC/C regulation and substrate degradation, sister chromatid cohesion and separation, spindle checkpoint and assembly, PLK1/AURKA and cytokinesis; confusables cover only one side (cohesion/spindle, condensation/nuclear envelope, or G1/S–G2/M control).

qualifier: APC/C regulation, cohesion resolution and spindle checkpoint
name: Mitotic progression and exit: APC/C, cohesion, spindle checkpoint
rationale: Members cover APC/C activation and substrate degradation, sister chromatid cohesion/separation, spindle assembly checkpoint, PLK1/AURKA and cytokinesis, unlike confusables on chromosome condensation, nuclear envelope or G1/S–G2/M regulation.

qualifier: APC/C-driven anaphase, chromatid separation and spindle checkpoint
name: APC/C-driven anaphase, sister chromatid separation and mitotic exit

name: ESCRT multivesicular body sorting and selective autophagy

qualifier: by autophagy and ESCRT-mediated multivesicular body sorting
name: Autophagy and ESCRT-mediated multivesicular body sorting
rationale: Members span selective autophagy, autophagosome/MVB-lysosome fusion and ESCRT-dependent MVB sorting, receptor downregulation and viral budding; confusables lack either the ESCRT/MVB arm (lysosome fusion, endosome size) or the autophagy arm (cytokinetic ESCRT) or are protein quality control.

name: Selective autophagy and ESCRT-dependent membrane remodelling

qualifier: beta-cell insulin secretion, insulin action, glucagon and glycogen
name: Islet hormone secretion and action in glucose homeostasis

qualifier: islet insulin/glucagon secretion and insulin action
name: Islet hormone secretion and insulin action in glucose homeostasis
rationale: Members span beta-cell insulin secretion (KATP, incretins, FFAR1, glucokinase), glucagon signaling, insulin receptor action/GLUT4 and glycogen control, unlike confusables on adipose lipid storage, thermogenesis or gluconeogenic transcription.

qualifier: insulin and glucagon secretion and action
name: Insulin and glucagon secretion and action in glucose homeostasis
rationale: Members span beta-cell insulin secretion (KATP, GLP-1/GIP, FFAR1), insulin receptor signalling and GLUT4, glucagon/PKA signalling and glycogen and glucokinase control, while confusables focus on adipocyte lipid handling, gluconeogenic transcription or peripheral uptake only.

name: Hexose absorption, glycogen metabolism and their inherited disorders

qualifier: with dietary hexose uptake, fructose catabolism and inherited disorders
name: Hexose uptake, fructose and glycogen metabolism with inherited disorders

qualifier: intestinal hexose absorption and inherited disorders
name: Glucose, fructose and glycogen metabolism with intestinal hexose absorption
rationale: Members cover glycolysis, gluconeogenesis, glycogen synthesis/breakdown and storage diseases, fructose metabolism and dietary sugar digestion and hexose transport, versus pentose/galactose and glucagon-signalling neighbours.

core: Triglyceride storage and lipid droplet turnover
qualifier: adipocyte, with glycerol-3-phosphate and fructose metabolism
name: Adipocyte triglyceride storage, lipolysis and glycerol metabolism
rationale: Members cover triglyceride/DAG/PA synthesis, lipolysis, lipid droplet formation, lipophagy and adipogenesis, and unlike the phospholipid-remodeling and thermogenic/insulin confusables they add glycerol, glycerol-3-phosphate and fructose metabolism.

core: Triglyceride and lipid droplet storage and turnover
qualifier: with glycerol, glycerol-3-phosphate and fructose metabolism
name: Triglyceride and lipid droplet turnover with glycerol metabolism
rationale: Members cover acylglycerol synthesis and lipolysis, lipid droplet formation/fusion/lipophagy and adipose triglyceride storage control, and unlike the insulin/thermogenesis, adipocyte-transcription, fatty acid oxidation and phospholipid-remodelling confusables they include glycerol, glycerol-3-phosphate, alditol and fructose metabolism.

qualifier: lipid droplet storage and glycerol backbone
name: Triglyceride storage, lipid droplets and glycerol metabolism
rationale: Members cover triglyceride/DAG/PA synthesis and lipolysis, lipid droplet formation, fusion and lipophagy, adipose lipid storage and glycerol/alditol metabolism, which separates them from adipocyte differentiation/thermogenesis, phospholipid remodelling, fatty acid oxidation and insulin/glucose signalling neighbours.

qualifier: with hair cell stereocilia and mechanosensation
name: Eye and inner ear morphogenesis and sensory hair cell function
rationale: Members cover eye (lens, retina vasculature, cornea, iris) and inner/outer ear morphogenesis with hair cell stereocilia and hearing/balance; confusables are photoreceptor-centred retina or cranial nerve/olfactory development.

name: Eye and inner ear development and hair-cell function
rationale: Members span camera-eye, lens, retina and ocular vasculature development together with inner ear morphogenesis, hair-cell stereocilia and auditory/vestibular sensation, whereas confusables cover photoreceptor/retinal neuron differentiation or cranial nerve and olfactory development.

name: Eye and inner ear development, hearing and balance
rationale: Members build eye (lens, retina vasculature, cornea, iris) and ear structures and mediate hearing and equilibrioception, unlike photoreceptor-focused retina or cranial nerve/olfactory neighbours.

qualifier: aromatic, sulfur and serine/threonine amino acids with pterin, B6 and molybdenum cofactors
name: Aromatic, sulfur and serine-family amino acid and cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover catabolism/synthesis of aromatic (Phe, Tyr, His), sulfur (Cys, transsulfuration, sulfide) and serine/glycine/threonine/proline amino acids plus BH4, vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactors, unlike confusables centred on glutamate/aspartate, alanine, glycine conjugation or generic organic acid metabolism.

qualifier: serine, sulfur and aromatic amino acids with cofactors
name: Serine, sulfur and aromatic amino acid and cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover synthesis and breakdown of serine/glycine/threonine, sulfur (cysteine, transsulfuration, sulfide) and aromatic (Phe/Tyr, BH4) amino acids plus B6 and MoCo cofactors, unlike confusables centred on glycine conjugation, organic acids, glutamate/glutamine or alanine.

qualifier: sulfur, aromatic and serine/threonine amino acids; vitamin B6 and BH4
name: Sulfur, aromatic and serine-family amino acid and cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover catabolism and synthesis of sulfur (cysteine, transsulfuration, sulfide), aromatic (Phe/Tyr, PKU), serine/threonine/glycine, histidine and proline plus B6, BH4 and molybdenum cofactors, unlike confusables centred on glutamate/aspartate nitrogen, mitochondrial organic acids, glycine conjugation or alanine.

qualifier: chaperonin TRiC/CCT folding and aggregate clearance
name: Chaperone folding and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members span chaperone and TRiC/CCT-mediated folding, refolding, protein stabilization and clearance of misfolded proteins by aggrephagy, CMA and proteasome regulation, while confusables lack the chaperonin folding arm and focus on ubiquitin chain biology or ribosome quality control.

name: Chaperonin folding and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members span TRiC/CCT and chaperone folding, refolding, aggregate handling and degradation control, while confusables lack the chaperonin folding arm and centre on ubiquitin enzymology, RQC or organelle autophagy.

qualifier: chaperonin CCT/TRiC folding and aggregate clearance
name: Chaperonin protein folding and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members cover de novo/chaperonin folding, refolding, aggregate and misfolded protein handling and its link to proteasomal degradation, with CCT/TRiC folding distinguishing it from ubiquitin/proteasome and RQC confusables.

qualifier: FLT3, ALK and FGFR; inhibitor resistance
name: FLT3, ALK and FGFR oncogenic mutants and inhibitor resistance
rationale: All members are oncogenic RTK mutants or fusions and their kinase-inhibitor resistance; FLT3, ALK and FGFR content separates it from KIT/PDGFR resistance and normal FLT3/cytokine signaling confusables.

qualifier: FLT3, ALK, FGFR and PDGFR; inhibitor resistance
name: Oncogenic FLT3, ALK, FGFR and PDGFR mutants and kinase-inhibitor resistance
rationale: All members are cancer-associated RTK mutants, fusions or TKI-resistant variants of FLT3, ALK/LTK, FGFR and PDGFR, distinguishing it from KIT-focused and normal FLT3/cytokine signalling confusables.

qualifier: FLT3, ALK, FGFR and PDGFRA with inhibitor resistance
name: Oncogenic FLT3, ALK, FGFR, PDGFRA mutants and inhibitor resistance
rationale: All members are cancer-associated mutant or fusion RTK signaling and TKI binding/resistance for FLT3, ALK/LTK, FGFR1-3 and PDGFRA/B, distinct from KIT-focused and normal FLT3/cytokine-STAT5 confusables.

qualifier: Fc receptors and BCR, mast cell degranulation
name: Fc receptor and BCR signaling, mast cell degranulation
rationale: Members cover FcepsilonRI and Fcgamma receptor and BCR signaling with mast cell activation, hypersensitivity and Fc-mediated phagocytosis, distinguishing it from B cell development, Th2/eosinophil and neutrophil neighbours.

qualifier: Fc-epsilon, Fc-gamma and B cell receptors
name: Fc-epsilon, Fc-gamma and B cell receptor signaling
rationale: Members span FcERI-driven mast cell activation, FcGR phagocytosis/ADCC and BCR signaling with their inhibitory regulation, combining what the confusables split and lacking their Th2/eosinophil, B cell development and neutrophil members.

qualifier: Fc receptors and BCR in degranulation and phagocytosis
name: Fc receptor and BCR signaling in degranulation and phagocytosis
rationale: Members are Fc-epsilon, Fc-gamma and B cell receptor signaling driving mast cell degranulation, hypersensitivity and antibody-dependent phagocytosis, unlike B cell development, neutrophil or Th2/eosinophil confusables.

qualifier: centromeric cohesion and spindle checkpoint control
name: Centromeric cohesion and spindle control in mitotic chromosome segregation
rationale: Members cover sister chromatid cohesion and its resolution, CENP-A deposition, condensation, kinetochore/spindle checkpoint and PLK1/Aurora A control, distinct from cohesin loading and centrosome/cytokinesis confusables.

qualifier: centromeric cohesion, condensation and spindle-kinetochore control
name: Mitotic sister chromatid cohesion, condensation and spindle-driven segregation
rationale: Members cover centromeric cohesion and its resolution, CENP-A centromere assembly, chromosome condensation and PLK1/Aurora spindle-checkpoint control; confusables are cohesin loading/looping or centrosome and cytokinesis events.

qualifier: sister chromatid cohesion, centromere and spindle checkpoint
name: Mitotic sister chromatid cohesion, centromere and spindle checkpoint control
rationale: Members cover cohesion establishment and resolution, CENP-A centromere assembly, chromosome condensation, spindle checkpoint and PLK1/AURKA mitotic regulation, distinct from cohesin loading, cytokinesis and centrosome confusables.

qualifier: cardiomyocyte growth, proliferation and myocardial wall morphogenesis
name: Cardiomyocyte growth, proliferation and myocardial wall morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation, hypertrophy and ventricular/trabecular myocardium plus related cardiac smooth muscle growth, while confusables add endocardium, septum, valve and conduction-system development.

qualifier: myocardial growth, proliferation and adaptation, with vascular smooth muscle
name: Cardiomyocyte growth, proliferation and differentiation with vascular smooth muscle
rationale: Members concern cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, hypertrophy, regeneration and ventricular/atrial myocardium morphogenesis plus aortic and coronary smooth muscle development, while confusables add valves, septa, endocardium and conduction system.

qualifier: cardiomyocyte growth, hypertrophy and ventricular wall formation
name: Myocardial growth, hypertrophy and ventricular wall morphogenesis
rationale: Members centre on cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation, hypertrophy and regeneration, trabecular/compact myocardium and associated vascular smooth muscle, whereas confusables add septum, endocardium, valve and conduction-system development.

core: IL-12 family and IL-17 cytokine immunity
name: Dectin-driven antifungal immunity with IL-12-family and IL-17 cytokines
rationale: Members combine Dectin-1/Dectin-2/DC-SIGN antifungal lectin signalling with IL-12/23/27/35, IL-10, IL-17 and IL-20/36/38 cytokine signalling and production; confusables lack the lectin arm and instead carry IL-18, IL-33/type III interferon or protozoan/TLR responses.

name: C-type lectin antifungal sensing and IL-12/23/17/10 cytokines
rationale: Members combine Dectin-1/Dectin-2/DC-SIGN fungal recognition with production and signalling of IL-12, IL-23, IL-17, IL-10, IL-27/35 and related cytokines; the lectin/fungal arm and Th17 axis distinguish it from neighbours on IL-37, IL-33/type III IFN, IL-18 or protozoan responses.

name: C-type lectin antifungal sensing and IL-12/IL-17/IL-10 family cytokines
rationale: Members combine Dectin-1/2 and DC-SIGN fungal recognition with the IL-12/23/27/35, IL-17/Th17 and IL-10/20 cytokine axis it drives; lectin sensing and the IL-12/IL-10 families distinguish it from IL-18, IL-33/interferon and IL-37 confusables.

qualifier: AU-rich element binding proteins and stress granules
name: ARE-mediated mRNA turnover and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members cover deadenylation, decapping and ARE-binding protein control of mRNA stability and translation, and the stress granule, PKR and arsenite members distinguish it from miRNA/siRNA silencing confusables.

qualifier: ARE-binding proteins and stress granule dynamics
name: Cytoplasmic mRNA decay, stabilization and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members cover ARE-binding protein control of mRNA stability, deadenylation, decapping, translational control and stress granule/P-body assembly, distinct from the miRNA/siRNA silencing confusables.

core: Cytoplasmic mRNA decay and translational control
qualifier: AU-rich element binding proteins and stress granules
name: ARE-mediated mRNA turnover and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members cover deadenylation, decapping and ARE-binding proteins (TTP, HuR, AUF1, KSRP, BRF1) plus stress granule and PKR responses, distinct from miRNA/siRNA silencing neighbours.

core: Dendritic spine remodelling and long-term synaptic plasticity
name: Dendritic spine remodelling and synaptic plasticity with reelin signalling
rationale: All members concern postsynaptic structure, dendrite/spine morphogenesis and LTP/LTD; reelin, LTP regulation, amyloid-beta and memory distinguish it from synapse assembly/adhesion and filopodium/RHO GTPase confusables.

name: Dendritic spine remodelling and long-term synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members regulate postsynaptic actin, spine and dendrite morphogenesis together with LTP/LTD, reelin signalling and memory, unlike confusables on synapse assembly/adhesion or filopodial/BDNF signalling.

qualifier: dendritic spine remodelling with long-term potentiation/depression
name: Dendritic spine remodelling and long-term synaptic plasticity
rationale: All members regulate dendrite and spine morphogenesis/maintenance, postsynaptic actin and density organization, or long-term synaptic plasticity and memory (including reelin and NMDAR-RAC1 input), distinguished from confusables on BDNF/TrkB, synapse assembly and adhesion, and generic Rho GTPase filopodia control.

name: Left-right asymmetry and planar polarity in embryonic morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover planar cell polarity/convergent extension and Nodal/SMO-dependent left-right axis determination; the left-right asymmetry members are what the Wnt/PCP and hedgehog/neural plate confusables lack.

qualifier: Nodal-regulated left-right asymmetry and planar cell polarity
name: Left-right asymmetry and planar polarity in embryonic axis morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover left-right axis specification (Nodal regulation, nodal cilia, organ laterality) together with planar cell polarity and convergent extension; this left-right/Nodal component separates it from the neural plate/axial mesoderm, Wnt-calcium and Hedgehog/GLI confusables.

core: Embryonic planar polarity and left-right asymmetry
name: Embryonic planar polarity and Nodal-driven left-right asymmetry
rationale: Members cover planar cell polarity, convergent extension and left-right axis specification with Nodal regulation and extracellular ligand sequestration; the confusables share PCP/Hedgehog components but lack the left-right asymmetry and Nodal arm.

name: Skeletal muscle sarcomere function and calcineurin-dependent adaptation
rationale: Members cover sarcomeric filament assembly, contraction, stretch detection, atrophy/growth and calcineurin-NFAT phosphatase signaling, unlike the dystrophin/NMJ, myoblast and cardiac adaptation confusables.

core: Skeletal muscle contraction and fiber maintenance
qualifier: sarcomere assembly and calcineurin-regulated fiber size
name: Skeletal muscle sarcomere function and calcineurin-regulated fiber size
rationale: Members cover skeletal sarcomere assembly and contraction plus calcineurin/phosphatase control of fiber size, atrophy and adaptation, unlike confusables on myoblast/cardiac growth, neuromuscular junction or fiber-type transition.

name: Skeletal muscle contraction, fiber growth and calcineurin-dependent adaptation
rationale: Members cover sarcomere assembly and contraction, fiber development, growth/atrophy and calcineurin-NFAT and phosphatase regulation, unlike the cardiac adaptation and myoblast confusables.

qualifier: kinesin and Miro motors with ER tubular network shaping
name: Microtubule motor organelle transport and ER tubular network shaping
rationale: Members cover kinesin- and RHOT/Miro-driven transport of mitochondria, vesicles and receptors in axons and dendrites together with ER tubule formation, fusion and organelle tethering; this combination separates it from confusables on microtubule severing, tubulin modification, ER lipid transfer or Golgi traffic.

qualifier: kinesin/RHOT-driven, with ER tubular network shaping
name: Kinesin-driven organelle transport and ER tubular network shaping
rationale: Members cover kinesin/RHOT transport of mitochondria and neuronal vesicles plus ER tubule formation and tethering; neighbours instead hold lipid transfer, microtubule severing, tubulin modification or Golgi traffic.

qualifier: axonal kinesin transport and ER tubular network shaping
name: Kinesin-driven axonal organelle transport and ER tubule shaping
rationale: Members cover kinesin and Miro (RHOT) mediated transport of mitochondria, vesicles and receptors in neurons plus ER tubular network formation and organelle tethering; confusables instead emphasize tubulin modification, microtubule severing or ER lipid transfer.

qualifier: NADPH regeneration, ascorbate and aldehyde detoxification
name: Redox homeostasis via NADPH, ascorbate and aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, NADPH/NADP+ supply, ascorbate and tetrahydrobiopterin metabolism, methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and protein repair, rather than the glutathione, ferroptosis-promoting or DNA alkylation repair terms of confusables.

qualifier: via ascorbate, NADPH and reactive species detoxification
name: Redox homeostasis via ascorbate, NADPH and reactive species detoxification
rationale: Members address ROS, aldehyde and methylglyoxal detoxification supported by ascorbate, NADPH/NADP+ and BH4 metabolism, whereas confusables centre on glutathione synthesis, ferroptosis promotion or alkylation DNA repair.

qualifier: NADPH regeneration, ascorbate and aldehyde detoxification
name: Cellular redox homeostasis via NADPH, ascorbate and aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, NADPH/NADP+ supply, ascorbate and BH4 metabolism and methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification, lacking the glutathione synthesis, ferroptosis-promoting and DNA alkylation repair pathways of the confusables.

core: Renal fluid and blood pressure control
name: Renin-angiotensin and vasopressin regulation of blood volume and pressure
rationale: Members cover angiotensin generation and signaling, vasopressin/AVPR-driven renal water reabsorption and renal sodium/urine volume control of blood pressure, whereas confusables centre on cGMP natriuretic signaling, aquaporin passive transport or osmotic stress responses.

core: Renal fluid and blood pressure regulation
name: Vasopressin and renin-angiotensin regulation of renal fluid balance
rationale: Members are vasopressin, angiotensin and aldosterone control of renal water and sodium handling, blood volume and arterial pressure. The confusables instead emphasise aquaporin/osmotic stress or natriuretic cGMP signalling.

core: Renal control of water, sodium and blood pressure
name: Vasopressin and renin-angiotensin regulation of renal water and pressure
rationale: Members cover vasopressin receptor signalling, angiotensin generation, renal water/sodium handling and blood pressure, distinguishing it from osmotic-stress/aquaporin and natriuretic cGMP confusables.

qualifier: organelle acidification, bicarbonate transport and tooth mineralization
name: Organelle acidification, bicarbonate and phosphate transport in mineralization
rationale: Members concern proton/bicarbonate handling (V-ATPase, carbonic anhydrase, SLC4) and phosphate transport (SLC34, SLC20) with their mineralization disorders, distinct from SLC26 anion exchange and FGF23/bone-mineralization neighbours; it is broad but coherent around ion transport for pH and mineral.

name: Acid-base and phosphate transport in organelle pH and mineralization
rationale: Members cover V-ATPase organelle acidification, bicarbonate/carbonic anhydrase pH control, Na+/Pi cotransport and its disorders, and enamel/dentin mineralization, distinguishing it from SLC26 anion exchange, sodium/proton exchanger and FGF23/PTH bone confusables.

name: Phosphate and bicarbonate transport, organelle acidification, tooth mineralization
rationale: Members combine SLC phosphate and bicarbonate transporters and their disorders, organelle pH regulation and enamel/dentin mineralization, unlike confusables on FGF23/bone mineralization or SLC26 anion exchange.

name: Glucose homeostasis via gluconeogenesis, glycogenolysis, fructose and glycerol metabolism
rationale: Members span glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, glycogen breakdown, fructose and glycerol metabolism and their inborn errors, unlike confusables on glycogen synthesis, galactose or pentose phosphate metabolism.

name: Glucose, fructose and glycerol metabolism via glycolysis and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members cover glycolysis, gluconeogenesis, glucokinase and glycogen regulation, glucose-6-phosphate transport, fructose and glycerol/alditol metabolism, distinguishing them from pentose/galactose and glycogen-synthesis disorder confusables.

core: Hexose phosphate and central carbohydrate metabolism
qualifier: fructose and glycerol utilization with gluconeogenesis and glycogenolysis
name: Glucose and fructose phosphate metabolism with gluconeogenesis and glycerol
rationale: Members span glucose phosphorylation, G6P transport/hydrolysis, glycogen breakdown, gluconeogenesis from alanine/oxaloacetate, and fructose and glycerol catabolism, distinct from confusables on glycogen synthesis disorders, galactose or pentose phosphate metabolism.

qualifier: mitotic nuclear envelope disassembly and reassembly
name: Nuclear pore complex and mitotic nuclear envelope remodelling
rationale: Members concern NPC assembly, nucleocytoplasmic transport of inositol phosphates, ribosomal subunits and Rev, and mitotic envelope breakdown and ESCRT-III resealing, unlike confusables on chromosome condensation, mRNA export or SUMOylation.

core: Nuclear pore complex and nucleocytoplasmic transport
qualifier: mitotic nuclear envelope breakdown and ESCRT-III resealing
name: Nuclear pore complex and mitotic nuclear envelope remodelling
rationale: Members cover NPC assembly, localisation and transport (ribosomal subunit, inositol phosphate and Rev/HIV RNA traffic) together with mitotic NPC/lamina disassembly and nuclear envelope reformation and ESCRT-III sealing; confusables are chromosome condensation/cohesion, SUMOylation or mRNA export/NLS import and lack the envelope-remodelling members.

core: Nuclear pore complex and nuclear envelope dynamics
name: Nuclear pore transport and mitotic nuclear envelope remodeling
rationale: Members cover NPC assembly, transport through the pore (IPs, Rev, ribosomal subunits) and mitotic envelope disassembly, ESCRT-III sealing and reformation, which the SUMOylation, mRNA export and chromosome condensation confusables lack.

name: Gamma-chain, beta-common and gp130 cytokine JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: Members cover IL-2/7/9, IL-3/5 and IL-6/LIF/CNTF receptor signaling via STAT and ERK, distinct from IL-27/35, EPO/FLT3, IL-11 and IL-10/12/23 confusables.

qualifier: common gamma-chain, beta-common and gp130 receptors
name: Common gamma-chain, beta-common and gp130 cytokine JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: Members are IL-2/7/9, IL-3/5 and IL-6/LIF/CNTF receptor signaling via STAT5/STAT3 and ERK, distinguishing them from IL-10/12/23/27-family and EPO/FLT3 confusables.

qualifier: IL-6 family and common gamma/beta chain cytokines
name: IL-6-family and common gamma/beta-chain cytokine JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: Members cover IL-6/LIF/CNTF, IL-2/7/9 and IL-3/5 receptor signaling via STAT and SHC-ERK, distinguishing them from IL-10/12/23/27, EPO/FLT3 and IL-11 confusables.

qualifier: de novo head-group synthesis and intermembrane lipid transfer
name: Glycerophospholipid de novo synthesis and intermembrane lipid transfer
rationale: Members cover synthesis of PC, PE, PS, PI, PG, cardiolipin and plasmalogens, lysophospholipid hydrolysis and non-vesicular lipid transfer, unlike confusables dominated by acyl-chain remodeling, sphingolipid or endocannabinoid metabolism.

qualifier: de novo synthesis plus intermembrane lipid transfer
name: De novo glycerophospholipid synthesis and intermembrane lipid transfer
rationale: Members cover de novo synthesis of PC, PE, PS, PI, PG, cardiolipin and plasmalogens plus lipid transfer between membranes, distinguishing it from acyl-chain remodelling and sphingolipid confusables.

qualifier: de novo synthesis and intermembrane lipid transfer
name: De novo glycerophospholipid synthesis and intermembrane lipid transfer
rationale: Members cover synthesis of PC, PE, PS, PI, PG, cardiolipin and plasmalogens plus non-vesicular lipid transfer (including ABCA4/A2E retinal lipid handling), distinct from acyl-chain remodeling and sphingolipid confusables.

core: Glutamate receptor signaling in synaptic plasticity and memory
qualifier: NMDAR calcium-CaMK/cAMP-CREB signaling to the nucleus
name: NMDA receptor-Ca2+-CREB signaling in synaptic plasticity and memory
rationale: Members cover NMDA/AMPA receptor activation and trafficking, LTP/LTD and memory, with calcium-driven CaMK, adenylyl cyclase and AMPK cascades to CREB/NPAS4 transcription separating it from structural-plasticity and kainate/AMPA-activation confusables.

core: Glutamate receptor signaling in synaptic plasticity
name: NMDA receptor-CaMK-CREB signaling in plasticity and memory
rationale: Members link NMDA/AMPA receptor activation and calcium/cAMP kinase cascades to CREB and NPAS4 transcription, LTP/LTD and memory, distinguishing them from kainate/AMPA channel activation and structural plasticity confusables.

core: Glutamate receptor signaling in synaptic plasticity
qualifier: NMDA receptor calcium coupling to CREB
name: NMDA receptor–calcium–CREB signaling in plasticity and memory
rationale: Members cover NMDA/AMPA receptor activation and trafficking, postsynaptic calcium, CaMK/cAMP-driven CREB and NPAS4 activation, LTP/LTD and memory; confusables lack the CREB/nuclear arm and instead emphasize structural plasticity or kainate/AMPA activation.

qualifier: cAMP-PKA and CaMK-CREB signaling with MECP2 regulation
name: Neuronal cAMP-PKA and CaMK-CREB signaling with MECP2
rationale: Members share neuronal second-messenger signaling to the nucleus (adenylate cyclase/PKA, CaMK-CREB, NPAS4) and MECP2 regulation underlying memory, unlike confusables centered on NMDA/AMPA receptor signaling and synaptic structural plasticity.

qualifier: cAMP-PKA and CaMK cascades with MECP2 regulation
name: Neuronal cAMP-PKA and CaMK-CREB signaling with MECP2
rationale: Members are adenylate cyclase/PKA and CaMK routes to CREB, MECP2 regulation and memory; confusables are NMDA/AMPA receptor plasticity programmes lacking the cAMP-PKA and MECP2 members.

qualifier: PKA and CaMK activation of CREB with MECP2 transcriptional regulation
name: Neuronal cAMP/CaMK-CREB signaling and MECP2 transcriptional regulation
rationale: Members link adenylate cyclase/PKA and CaMK signaling to CREB activation, memory and potentiation, together with MECP2 regulation of neuronal genes, which distinguishes them from NMDA/AMPA receptor and synaptic-plasticity confusables.

qualifier: G1/G2 checkpoint arrest and p53 stabilization (ARF, phosphorylation, degradation)
name: p53 activation and DNA damage cell-cycle checkpoint arrest
rationale: Members cover regulation of TP53 expression, stability and activity, p14ARF defects, p21 induction and G1/G2 DNA damage checkpoints, whereas confusables emphasise p53 apoptotic targets, senescence programmes or AKT signaling.

qualifier: ARF-MDM2 control and G1/G2 checkpoint arrest
name: p53 regulation and DNA damage-induced G1/G2 checkpoint arrest
rationale: Members concern p53 expression, activation, degradation and ARF defects plus radiation-induced G1/G2 checkpoint arrest (p21, CDC25A, GTSE1), whereas confusables emphasise p53-driven apoptosis, p16-dependent senescence or AKT signalling.

qualifier: TP53 stability control and G1/G2 checkpoint arrest
name: p53 stability control and DNA damage checkpoint arrest
rationale: Members concern regulation of TP53 expression, degradation and activity (including p14ARF) and checkpoint arrest after radiation, whereas confusables emphasize p53 apoptotic targets, senescence programs or AKT signaling.

name: Osteoblast–osteoclast regulation of bone remodelling and mineralization
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and osteoclast proliferation/differentiation, bone resorption and mineralization via Wnt, TGF-beta and BMP signals in mesenchymal stroma, whereas confusables centre on ossification, chondrocyte and skeletal morphogenesis.

name: Osteoblast-osteoclast coupling in bone remodeling and mineralization
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and osteoclast differentiation, bone resorption and mineralization with Wnt/TGF-beta/BMP and mesenchymal stromal inputs, whereas confusables focus on ossification, chondrocyte and tendon development without the osteoclast arm.

qualifier: osteoblast-osteoclast balance, mineralization and Wnt/TGF-beta signals
name: Osteoblast-osteoclast bone remodelling and mineralization under Wnt/TGF-beta
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and osteoclast differentiation, bone resorption and mineralization with Wnt, TGF-beta/SMAD and stromal/BMP programmes, whereas neighbours focus on ossification, cartilage and tendon development.

qualifier: alveolar pneumocyte differentiation and surfactant homeostasis
name: Lung alveolar development and surfactant homeostasis
rationale: Members span lung branching, lobe and saccule growth, pneumocyte differentiation and surfactant metabolism with its disorders, while confusables emphasise trachea, diaphragm, lung mesenchyme or other branching organs.

name: Lung branching, alveolar maturation and surfactant homeostasis
rationale: Members cover lung branching and lobe growth, pneumocyte differentiation, surfactant metabolism and its inherited dysfunctions, while confusables emphasize trachea, diaphragm, lung mesenchyme or other branching organs.

name: Lung morphogenesis, alveolar differentiation and surfactant homeostasis
rationale: Members cover lung branching, lobe and saccule development, pneumocyte differentiation and surfactant metabolism with its genetic defects, unlike confusables centred on trachea, diaphragm, mesenchyme or other branching organs.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling in cardiac excitation-contraction coupling
rationale: Members concern ryanodine-receptor release, SERCA reuptake, Na/Ca exchange and T-tubules controlling cardiac contraction and relaxation, unlike confusables on store-operated calcium entry or fiber-type and heart-rate regulation.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling in cardiac and skeletal contraction
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine-receptor release, SERCA reuptake and Na/Ca exchange that set muscle contraction and relaxation, unlike confusables on store-operated calcium entry or chemical heart-rate control.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling in cardiac excitation-contraction coupling
rationale: Members cover ryanodine-receptor calcium release, SERCA reuptake, sodium/calcium exchange, T-tubules and their control of cardiac contraction, relaxation and rhythm, distinguishing it from confusables on store-operated calcium entry, chemical control of heart rate or fiber-type transition.

name: Nicotinic cholinergic transmission and clostridial neurotoxin blockade
rationale: Most members concern acetylcholine synthesis, choline transport, release, nicotinic receptors and botulinum/tetanus toxin blockade of release; confusables cover NMJ assembly, muscarinic/serotonin GPCRs, or GABA/glutamate transport.

qualifier: nicotinic receptors, neuromuscular junction, clostridial neurotoxins
name: Cholinergic neuromuscular transmission, nicotinic receptors and clostridial neurotoxins
rationale: Members center on acetylcholine synthesis, release, choline uptake, nicotinic and other ligand-gated channels and botulinum/tetanus toxin blockade, unlike confusables on GPCR muscarinic/serotonin signaling, NMJ assembly or amino-acid transmitter transport.

name: Cholinergic neuromuscular transmission and clostridial neurotoxin action
rationale: Members span acetylcholine synthesis, choline uptake, release and nicotinic receptors at the neuromuscular junction plus botulinum/tetanus toxins blocking release, unlike muscarinic/serotonin GPCR, NMJ assembly and GABA/glutamate transport confusables.

name: NRF2- and HIF-driven metabolic reprogramming under oxidative and hypoxic stress
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 and HIF transcriptional programmes controlling glycolysis, pentose phosphate and NADP metabolism, with p53 and mTORC1 metabolic outputs, unlike confusables on fructose glycolysis, FOXO, or ROS detoxification and ferroptosis.

core: Stress-responsive transcriptional control of central metabolism
qualifier: HIF hypoxia and NRF2 oxidative-stress regulators
name: HIF and NRF2 transcriptional control of glycolytic and redox metabolism
rationale: Members are HIF/oxygen sensing, NRF2 target-gene regulation and p53/mTORC1 control of glycolysis, pentose-phosphate and NADP metabolism; HIF and NRF2 transcriptional arms separate it from ROS-detox/ferroptosis, FOXO and plain glycolysis neighbours.

core: Transcriptional control of metabolism under stress
name: HIF, NRF2 and p53 regulation of glycolytic and redox metabolism
rationale: Members are hypoxia/HIF, NFE2L2/BACH1 and p53/mTORC1 programs that tune glycolysis, pentose phosphate and nucleotide metabolism; HIF and NRF2 together separate it from glycolysis-enzyme, ROS/ferroptosis and FOXO/AKT confusables.

name: Oncogenic RTK fusions and amplifications activating PI3K-AKT and ERK
rationale: Members are FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3, ALK/LTK and CSF1R fusion/amplification signaling feeding PI3K-AKT and ERK, distinct from ligand-driven FGFR/ERBB cascades and TKI-resistance mutant confusables.

qualifier: oncogenic fusions and amplifications to AKT and ERK
name: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase fusions activating AKT and ERK
rationale: Members are FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3, ALK and LTK fusion/amplification signaling with PI3K-AKT and ERK activation, unlike confusables on ligand-specific FGFR/ERBB/MET cascades, IGF1R/insulin or drug-resistant mutants.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
name: Oncogenic RTK fusion and amplification signaling via PI3K-AKT
rationale: Members are FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3, ALK/LTK and CSF1R signaling, mostly via cancer fusions and amplifications, feeding PI3K-AKT and ERK; confusables instead cover ligand-driven FGFR/ERBB/MET cascades, TKI-resistant point mutants or insulin signaling.

name: Microglial activation, DAP12 signaling and apoptotic-cell clearance
rationale: Members describe microglial activation, proliferation, amyloid-beta response and DAP12-linked phagocytosis of apoptotic cells, whereas confusables focus on amyloid-beta clearance and fibril formation.

qualifier: apoptotic cell clearance and amyloid-beta response
name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell clearance in neurodegeneration
rationale: Members concern microglial differentiation, activation and DAP12 signalling, efferocytosis and amyloid-beta responses, whereas confusables emphasise amyloid fibril formation and clearance.

qualifier: apoptotic cell clearance and amyloid-beta response
name: Microglial activation and apoptotic cell clearance in neurodegeneration
rationale: Members concern microglial differentiation, activation and migration, engulfment of apoptotic cells (DAP12, PS exposure) and responses to amyloid-beta and neuronal injury, whereas neighbours centre on amyloid fibril formation and clearance.

qualifier: endocytic recycling of vesicles and receptors
name: Synaptic vesicle and neurotransmitter receptor endocytic recycling
rationale: Members cover clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle endocytosis and recycling, active zone and synaptic cytoskeleton organisation and postsynaptic receptor internalisation/transport, unlike neighbours on vesicle docking/priming, plasticity or general endosomal recycling.

qualifier: vesicle endocytic recycling and postsynaptic receptor trafficking
name: Synaptic vesicle recycling and postsynaptic receptor trafficking
rationale: Members span presynaptic vesicle endocytosis, clathrin coat dynamics and active zone organization plus postsynaptic receptor internalization and AMPA receptor trafficking, separating it from vesicle docking/fusion, Rab endosomal recycling and plasticity neighbours.

qualifier: clathrin-dependent synaptic vesicle recycling together with postsynaptic receptor internalization
name: Synaptic vesicle recycling and postsynaptic receptor trafficking
rationale: Every member is a trafficking or cytoskeletal step on one side of the synapse - clathrin coat dynamics and vesicle endocytosis/recycling presynaptically, AMPA receptor and neurotransmitter receptor internalization and localization postsynaptically - distinguishing it from generic Rab/ARF endosomal recycling, from plasticity and memory readouts, and from the calcium-triggered release cycle.

name: Antibacterial sensing by TLR2/4/5 and NOD1/2 receptors
rationale: Members detect bacterial LPS, lipopeptides, peptidoglycan and muramyl dipeptide via TLR2/4/5 (MyD88/IRAK4) and NOD1/2, distinct from TRIF/TLR3, inflammasome-cytokine and monocyte TLR confusables.

name: Bacterial pattern recognition by TLR2/4/5 and NOD1/2
rationale: Members detect bacterial ligands (LPS, lipopeptides, lipoteichoic acid, peptidoglycan, muramyl dipeptide) via TLR2/4/5-MyD88/IRAK4 and NOD1/2, distinguishing it from TRIF/TLR3, inflammasome/IL-1 and negative-regulation confusables.

name: Bacterial ligand sensing via TLR2/4/5 and NOD1/2
rationale: Members detect LPS, lipopeptides, peptidoglycan and flagellin via TLR2/4/5 (incl. MyD88/IRAK4 deficiency) and NOD1/2, which distinguishes it from TRIF, inflammasome-cytokine and TLR-regulation confusables.

core: Plasma membrane lipid and protein organization
qualifier: phospholipid scrambling/flipping and apical CFTR trafficking
name: Plasma membrane phospholipid scrambling and apical protein trafficking
rationale: Members concern plasma membrane composition: aminophospholipid flipping and Ca2+-activated scrambling (ANO6), membrane repair, rafts and blebs, plus polarized Golgi-to-membrane delivery of apical cargo such as CFTR, which separates it from the apoptotic PS-exposure, pancreatic-duct and bile-transporter neighbours.

core: Plasma membrane phospholipid translocation and polarized membrane protein trafficking
qualifier: scrambling, membrane repair and apical/raft delivery
name: Plasma membrane phospholipid scrambling, repair and apical trafficking
rationale: Members concern plasma membrane lipid asymmetry (flippases, scrambling, ANO6), membrane repair, cell volume/mechanical responses and apical/raft protein delivery including CFTR, which sets it apart from bile-acid transporter, apoptotic-cell clearance and pancreatic duct confusables.

core: Plasma membrane lipid asymmetry and protein targeting
qualifier: phospholipid flipping/scrambling with apical, raft and CFTR trafficking
name: Plasma membrane phospholipid translocation and apical-raft protein targeting
rationale: Members concern plasma membrane organisation: flippase/scramblase lipid translocation, blebbing, repair and volume control plus apical/basolateral, raft and CFTR protein delivery; the lipid-translocation side separates it from epithelial/bile confusables and the apical-raft targeting separates it from the apoptotic PS-exposure confusable.

qualifier: lipid-modified Hedgehog and Wnt ligand biogenesis
name: Hedgehog signaling and lipidated Hedgehog/Wnt ligand biogenesis
rationale: Members span SMO/GLI Hedgehog signalling and the autoprocessing, palmitoylation and secretion of Hh and Wnt ligands, distinguishing it from DVL/Wnt, prenylation and non-canonical Wnt confusables.

qualifier: lipid-modified Hh and Wnt ligand biogenesis
name: Hedgehog signaling and lipid-modified Hh/Wnt ligand biogenesis
rationale: Members combine SMO/GLI Hedgehog signaling with autoprocessing, palmitoylation and secretion of Hh and Wnt ligands, distinguishing it from prenylation, DVL/TCF and non-canonical Wnt neighbours.

qualifier: lipid-modified Hedgehog and Wnt ligand biogenesis
name: Hedgehog signaling and lipid-modified Hedgehog/Wnt ligand biogenesis
rationale: Members cover SMO/GLI Hedgehog signaling plus palmitoylation, autoprocessing and secretion of Hh and Wnt ligands, whereas confusables are DVL/Wnt regulation, prenylation or Wnt/calcium signaling.

name: Linkage-specific polyubiquitin chain assembly and deubiquitinase editing
rationale: Members are E1/E2/E3 ubiquitination of specific lysine linkages and DUB families that edit chains, rather than proteasomal degradation and quality control (C1, C4), neddylation (C2) or NF-kB regulation (C3).

name: Linkage-specific ubiquitin chain assembly and deubiquitinase editing
rationale: Members are E1/E2/E3 ubiquitination, K6/K11/K27/K29/K48/K63 chain formation and DUB families; confusables add proteasome, protein quality control, neddylation or NF-kB regulation.

qualifier: linkage-specific chain types and DUB families
name: Linkage-specific ubiquitin chain assembly and deubiquitination
rationale: Members are E1/E2/E3 ubiquitination of specific chain linkages (K6, K11, K27, K29, K48, K63, branched) and DUB families, without the proteasome, autophagy, NF-kB or neddylation content of neighbours.

name: Nucleotide catabolism and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
rationale: Members cover breakdown and sanitization of (deoxy)nucleotides and pyrimidines plus thiopurine/abacavir/ribavirin handling; confusables instead emphasize purine biosynthesis/salvage or nucleoside transport.

name: Nucleotide catabolism and nucleoside-analogue drug metabolism
rationale: Members are pyrimidine/deoxynucleotide and NTP breakdown, NUDT sanitising and thiopurine/abacavir/ribavirin handling, whereas confusables are purine biosynthesis/salvage or nucleoside transport.

qualifier: pyrimidine breakdown and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
name: Pyrimidine nucleotide catabolism and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
rationale: Members are nucleotide/deoxynucleotide and pyrimidine catabolism plus NUDT sanitization and thiopurine/ribavirin/abacavir metabolism, setting it apart from neighbours centred on purine/pyrimidine biosynthesis, salvage or nucleoside transport.

name: Epithelial SLC26/SLC4 anion exchange and aquaporin water transport
rationale: Members are chloride/bicarbonate/sulfate/iodide exchangers, CFTR and their disease defects plus aquaporin and paracellular water transport; neighbours instead hold cation-chloride cotransporters, Na+/H+ exchangers or carbonic anhydrase pH control.

name: Epithelial bicarbonate and anion exchange with aquaporin water transport
rationale: Members are bicarbonate, SLC26 anion and CFTR transport (and their disorders) plus aquaporin, paracellular and gap junction water/solute movement; unlike cation-chloride cotransporter, carbonic anhydrase and organic anion neighbours, it pairs anion exchange with water transport.

qualifier: SLC4/SLC26 anion exchange, CFTR and aquaporins
name: Epithelial anion exchange and aquaporin water transport
rationale: Members cover bicarbonate, chloride, iodide, sulfate and oxalate transport by SLC4/SLC26/CFTR and water movement by aquaporins and paracellular/gap junction routes, unlike cation-chloride, organic-anion or pH-regulation confusables.

qualifier: cholinergic, serotonergic and adenosine receptors with cAMP control
name: Cholinergic, serotonergic and adenosine receptor signalling
rationale: Members are acetylcholine (nicotinic/muscarinic), serotonin and adenosine receptor signalling with cAMP regulation, unlike confusables on histamine/serotonin synthesis, adrenergic or tachykinin signalling.

qualifier: cholinergic, serotonergic and adenosine receptors with cAMP control
name: Cholinergic, serotonergic and adenosine receptor neurotransmission
rationale: Members are nicotinic/muscarinic acetylcholine, serotonin and adenosine receptor signalling with cholinergic transmission and cAMP regulation; acetylcholine and adenosine receptors distinguish it from tachykinin, histamine/serotonin synthesis and adrenergic confusables.

name: Acetylcholine, serotonin and adenosine receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover nicotinic and muscarinic cholinergic transmission, serotonin and adenosine receptors and their cAMP coupling, distinguishing it from tachykinin, adrenergic and histamine/serotonin-synthesis confusables.

core: Cardiac muscle and fibroblast regulation in tissue repair
qualifier: cardiomyocyte proliferation and fibrotic matrix control
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation and fibroblast regulation in fibrotic repair
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation/differentiation and regeneration together with fibroblast migration, apoptosis, myofibroblast differentiation and ECM/collagen deposition in wound repair, unlike confusables centred on ECM disassembly, cardiac adaptation, TGF-beta/SMAD signaling or miRNA processing.

qualifier: cardiomyocyte proliferation with fibroblast and matrix control
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation and fibroblast-mediated connective tissue repair
rationale: Members regulate cardiac muscle cell proliferation, differentiation and regeneration alongside fibroblast migration, apoptosis, myofibroblast differentiation and matrix/collagen deposition, distinguishing it from confusables centred on cardiac hypertrophic adaptation, TGF-beta signalling, matrix degradation or miRNA processing.

core: Cardiomyocyte proliferation and fibroblast-driven tissue repair
qualifier: fibrotic extracellular matrix and connective tissue replacement
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation and fibroblast-driven fibrotic tissue repair
rationale: Members regulate cardiac muscle cell proliferation, differentiation and regeneration together with fibroblast migration, apoptosis, myofibroblast differentiation and ECM/collagen deposition in wound repair, distinguishing the theme from confusables about miRNA processing, ECM disassembly, sarcomere hypertrophy or core TGF-beta/SMAD signaling.

qualifier: apoptotic cells, oxidized lipoproteins and amyloid-beta
name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells, lipoproteins and amyloid-beta
rationale: Members span scavenger receptor classes, efferocytosis, oxLDL/foam cell responses, amyloid-beta and immune complex clearance by microglia/macrophages, which confusables (hyaluronan, RAGE, lysosome, microglial proliferation) lack.

qualifier: apoptotic cells, oxidised LDL, amyloid-beta; microglia
name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells, oxLDL and amyloid-beta
rationale: Members are scavenger receptor classes and phagocytic clearance of apoptotic cells, immune complexes, oxidised lipoproteins (foam cells) and amyloid-beta, including microglial activation, which the hyaluronan/RAGE and lysosomal confusables lack.

qualifier: apoptotic cells, oxidized LDL and amyloid-beta by microglia/macrophages
name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells, oxLDL and amyloid-beta
rationale: Members describe scavenger receptor and microglial/macrophage uptake of apoptotic cells, lipoproteins and amyloid-beta, which hyaluronan, AGE receptor and lysosome confusables lack.

qualifier: telomere protection and replication fork processing
name: Telomere protection and replication fork stress response
rationale: Members concern telomere capping, replication and recombination-based maintenance plus fork reversal, R-loop and topological stress, intra-S checkpoint and responses to camptothecin/hydroxyurea, unlike confusables centred on canonical double-strand break repair.

qualifier: telomere protection and replication fork stress
name: Telomere protection and replication fork stress responses
rationale: Members concern telomere capping and maintenance, fork reversal, R-loop and topological processing, intra-S checkpoint and responses to replication-stalling drugs, distinguishing the theme from double-strand break repair confusables.

name: Replication stress response, DNA topology and telomere maintenance
rationale: Members cover replication fork reversal, intra-S checkpoint, topoisomerase/DNA topology, R-loops and telomere maintenance and capping, unlike confusables centred on double-strand break repair pathways.

qualifier: phosphatase feedback with IL-6 and AP-1 output
name: MAPK signaling attenuation by phosphatases, with IL-6 and AP-1
rationale: Members center on negative feedback and dephosphorylation of ERK/p38/JNK cascades alongside IL-6/STAT3 and AP-1 output, unlike confusables on RAS/RAF activation or TAK1-driven stress kinase activation.

qualifier: negative feedback with AP-1 and IL-6 outputs
