name: ERK MAPK negative feedback with AP-1 and IL-6 signaling
rationale: Members cover ERK1/2, ERK5 and atypical MAPK activation and their phosphatase-mediated attenuation, linked to AP-1 and IL-6/STAT3 signaling, unlike upstream RAS/RAF or JNK/p38 activation confusables.

qualifier: phosphatase-mediated negative feedback, AP-1 and IL-6/STAT3 output
name: ERK MAPK negative feedback, AP-1 and IL-6 signaling
rationale: Members combine ERK1/2, ERK5 and atypical MAPK activation with their dephosphorylation and negative feedback plus AP-1 and IL-6/STAT3 outputs, unlike confusables centred on TAK1-JNK/p38 activation, TNF/NF-kB early genes, or oncogenic RAS/RAF activation.

qualifier: biliary/intestinal ABC transporters and HDL remodeling
name: Biliary and intestinal sterol-phospholipid transport, HDL remodeling
rationale: Members span dietary lipid absorption, ABCG5/8, ABCB4 and ABCB11 biliary lipid secretion and HDL/LDL remodeling, unlike confusables on chylomicron/VLDL assembly and lipoprotein clearance.

qualifier: ABC transporter export into bile, intestine and HDL
name: ABC transporter lipid export to bile, intestine and HDL
rationale: Members cover ABCA/ABCB/ABCG-mediated lipid and sterol efflux, bile secretion defects, intestinal absorption and HDL/LDL remodeling, which confusables centred on VLDL/chylomicron clearance and uptake lack.

qualifier: ABC-transporter sterol/bile export and HDL/LDL remodeling
name: Intestinal lipid absorption, biliary ABC-transporter export and HDL remodeling
rationale: Members cover dietary lipid absorption, ABCG5/G8, ABCB4 and ABCB11 sterol, phospholipid and bile acid export and HDL/LDL remodeling, which the VLDL, chylomicron-clearance and cholesterol-storage confusables lack.

qualifier: dorsoventral patterning of forebrain and spinal cord
name: Dorsoventral neural patterning, neuron fate specification and migration
rationale: Members cover regional patterning, neuron subtype commitment and interneuron/motor neuron migration in forebrain and spinal cord; confusables lack spinal cord and dorsoventral patterning and instead stress neuroblast division and commissure formation.

core: Regional CNS patterning and neuron migration
qualifier: dorsoventral neural tube and spinal cord neuron fate specification
name: Dorsoventral neural patterning, neuron subtype specification and migration
rationale: Members cover forebrain/cortex regionalization and interneuron migration together with spinal cord motor and interneuron fate specification and dorsoventral neural tube patterning; confusables share forebrain development but lack the spinal cord dorsoventral specification.

core: Regional neural patterning and neuronal fate specification
qualifier: dorsoventral neural tube patterning, spinal motor/interneuron identity, forebrain neuron migration
name: Dorsoventral neural patterning, neuronal subtype specification and migration
rationale: Members span dorsoventral patterning of spinal cord and forebrain, specification of motor and interneuron subtypes, and cortical/olfactory neuron migration; confusables lack the spinal patterning and fate specification and instead feature neuroblast division, glia and commissures.

name: Centrosomal microtubule organization with tubulin glutamylation and severing
rationale: Members address microtubule nucleation, anchoring and stability at the centrosome, and the theme differs from spindle/centriole/cilium confusables by tubulin C-terminal polyglutamylation/deglutamylation and severing.

name: Centrosomal microtubule nucleation, anchoring and tubulin glutamylation
rationale: Members cover MTOC nucleation/anchoring, centrosome positioning, microtubule stability and tubulin C-terminal (de)glutamylation and severing; the glutamylation/severing content separates it from confusables on spindle orientation, centriole duplication and cilia.

name: Centrosomal microtubule organisation with tubulin glutamylation and severing
rationale: Members cover microtubule nucleation, anchoring and centrosome positioning, and uniquely include tubulin C-terminal (poly)glutamylation and severing, whereas confusables add spindle orientation, cilia and centriole duplication.

core: contractile apparatus of striated muscle with its sarcolemmal adhesion and membrane domains
qualifier: filament assembly, T-tubule, raft and integrin-dystrophin adhesion complexes, not myogenic differentiation
name: Sarcolemmal adhesion complexes and striated muscle contractile machinery
rationale: Members pair thin- and thick-filament assembly, sliding and excitability of cardiac and skeletal muscle with the membrane-cytoskeleton junctions that transmit force (dystrophin-glycoprotein complex, PINCH-ILK-PARVIN focal adhesions, caveolae, rafts, gap junctions, T-tubules); the confusables are myogenic differentiation programmes, SRF-driven cytoskeletal modules or desmosomal junction assembly.

core: striated muscle contractile apparatus and its membrane anchoring
qualifier: costamere, T-tubule, caveolar and integrin-adhesion coupling
name: Striated muscle contraction with costameric membrane-cytoskeleton anchoring
rationale: All members concern the assembled contractile apparatus of cardiac and skeletal fibres and the junctions, rafts, T-tubules and adhesion complexes that transmit and electrically coordinate its force, not myogenic differentiation, epithelial desmosomes or SRF transcriptional targets.

qualifier: sarcolemmal costamere, T-tubule and cardiomyocyte junctions
name: Striated muscle contraction and sarcolemmal costamere organization
rationale: Members cover myofibril/thin-filament assembly and contraction together with sarcolemmal structures (dystrophin-glycoprotein complex, ILK-PINCH-parvin, caveolae/rafts, T-tubules, cardiomyocyte adhesion and gap junctions), unlike confusables on myogenic differentiation, SRF targets or desmosomes.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, NTP hydrolysis and thiopurine drugs
name: De novo purine synthesis, NTP hydrolysis and thiopurine metabolism
rationale: Members cover de novo IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis, nucleoside triphosphate catabolism and thiopurine (azathioprine/TPMT) metabolism, unlike confusables on purine salvage, pyrimidine metabolism or nucleoside transport.

name: De novo purine synthesis and thiopurine drug metabolism
rationale: Members concern de novo IMP/AMP/GMP/GTP synthesis, nucleotide triphosphate turnover and azathioprine/TPMT handling, distinguishing it from pyrimidine, purine salvage and nucleoside transport confusables.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, NTP sanitization and thiopurine metabolism
name: De novo purine synthesis, NTP sanitization and thiopurine metabolism
rationale: Members are de novo IMP/AMP/GMP/GTP synthesis, NUDT nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis and azathioprine/TPMT methylation, unlike confusables on nucleoside transport, purine salvage or pyrimidine metabolism.

core: ER membrane protein targeting and insertion
name: ER membrane protein insertion and COPII ER-to-Golgi export
rationale: Members cover SRP-dependent, tail-anchored and multi-pass insertion into the ER and COPII cargo export, unlike confusables on ER quality control, ERAD and COPI retrograde traffic.

name: ER protein targeting, membrane insertion and COPII export
rationale: Members cover SRP and tail-anchored targeting and insertion into the ER and COPII cargo export to Golgi, unlike COPI retrograde and ER quality-control neighbours.

qualifier: membrane insertion and COPII anterograde transport
name: ER protein targeting, membrane insertion and COPII export
rationale: Members cover SRP and tail-anchored targeting and insertion into the ER membrane plus COPII cargo loading and ER-to-Golgi transport, distinct from confusables on COPI retrograde traffic, ER quality control and ERAD.

name: CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte-macrophage recruitment and danger-ligand sensing
rationale: Members cover monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis and MCP-1 control with CCR2/CX3CR1 modules plus RAGE, class B scavenger and endogenous TLR ligand sensing, unlike monocyte surface signature, chemokine-cluster and endothelial adhesion confusables.

name: CCR2/CX3CR1-guided monocyte and macrophage recruitment in inflammation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte and macrophage chemotaxis, MCP-1 production and activation with CCR2/CX3CR1 myeloid modules and inflammatory sensing, distinct from monocyte surface signatures, chemokine-receptor binding and endothelial adhesion confusables.

qualifier: CCR2/CX3CR1 chemotaxis and endogenous danger-ligand sensing
name: Monocyte-macrophage recruitment and endogenous danger-signal sensing
rationale: Members cover monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, CCR2/CX3CR1 modules and AGE, class B scavenger and endogenous TLR ligand sensing, which adhesion, surface-signature and generic chemokine neighbours lack.

qualifier: ribosome quality control and stress granules
name: Proteasomal degradation, ribosome quality control and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members are proteasome function and its regulation, degron pathways, ribosome-associated quality control and stress granule assembly/disassembly, whereas confusables emphasise ubiquitin chain types, ERAD/aggrephagy or PKR stress signaling.

core: Proteasomal protein degradation and its regulation
qualifier: ribosome-associated quality control and stress granule dynamics
name: Proteasomal degradation, ribosome quality control and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members concern proteasome function and regulation of ubiquitin-dependent and degron-rule proteolysis together with ribosome-stall quality control and stress granule assembly/disassembly, distinct from confusables on ERAD/misfolded protein and aggrephagy, ubiquitin chain types, or PKR/PML stress signalling.

qualifier: ribosome quality control and stress granule dynamics
name: Proteasomal degradation with ribosome quality control and stress granules
rationale: Members are regulation of proteasomal and degron-based degradation, ribosome-associated quality control of stalled nascent chains and stress granule assembly/disassembly, which ERAD, ubiquitin-linkage and PKR/PML confusables lack.

qualifier: polyadenylation, histone mRNA and deadenylation-dependent decay
name: mRNA 3'-end processing, polyadenylation and deadenylation-dependent decay
rationale: Members cover cleavage/polyadenylation, histone mRNA stem-loop processing, Pol II termination and deadenylation/decapping-driven mRNA decay, distinct from confusables on capping/splicing, ARE-binding protein stability control and nuclear exosome surveillance.

qualifier: histone stem-loop processing, deadenylation and decapping
name: mRNA 3'-end formation, histone mRNA processing and deadenylation-dependent decay
rationale: Members are cleavage/polyadenylation, Pol II termination, histone stem-loop mRNA processing, deadenylation, decapping and 5'-3' decay, unlike confusables on ARE-binding stability, capping/splicing or NMD and export.

qualifier: histone stem-loop processing and deadenylation-dependent decay
name: mRNA 3'-end formation, histone mRNA processing and deadenylation-dependent decay
rationale: Members cover cleavage/polyadenylation, SLBP histone mRNA processing, deadenylation, decapping and 5'-3' decay, distinct from capping/splicing, ARE-binding and nuclear exosome confusables.

name: cAMP suppression via adrenergic, cholinergic and adenosine receptors
rationale: Members are adenylate cyclase inhibition and cAMP degradation downstream of alpha-2 adrenergic, muscarinic/nicotinic and adenosine/purinergic receptors, distinguishing it from cAMP synthesis/PKA activation and serotonin receptor confusables.

qualifier: adenylate cyclase inhibition by adrenergic, muscarinic, adenosine receptors
name: Adenylate cyclase inhibition by adrenergic, muscarinic and adenosine receptors
rationale: Members are inhibitory GPCR/cyclic nucleotide signaling via alpha-2 adrenergic, muscarinic, adenosine and Gz receptors plus cAMP degradation, whereas confusables carry cyclase activation, PKA and serotonin receptors.

name: Adrenergic, cholinergic and adenosine receptor inhibition of cAMP
rationale: Members centre on Gi/z-coupled adrenergic, muscarinic and adenosine receptors that inhibit adenylate cyclase plus cAMP degradation; the cholinergic and adenosine receptors separate it from Gs/PKA-activating and serotonin confusables.

name: Oxidative and nitrosative stress response with ROS detoxification
rationale: Members are responses to H2O2, NO, reactive nitrogen and ischemia, ROS detoxification, HMOX1/BACH1 and ferroptosis, distinct from confusables about mitochondrial respiration control and oxidative-stress apoptosis.

qualifier: antioxidant detoxification and heme oxygenase control
name: Reactive oxygen/nitrogen species responses and antioxidant detoxification
rationale: Members are cellular responses to H2O2, NO, reactive nitrogen and H2S with ROS detoxification, BACH1/HMOX1, MTF1 and ferroptosis promotion, whereas confusables concern mitochondrial respiration control and oxidative-stress apoptosis.

name: Oxidative and nitrosative stress response and ROS detoxification
rationale: Members share cellular responses to ROS/RNS (H2O2, NO, hydroperoxide, ischemia) and antioxidant control (ROS detoxification, HMOX1/BACH1, MTF1, redox homeostasis), unlike the confusables that centre on respiration control and oxidative-stress apoptosis.

name: Scavenger receptor clearance and iron-heme uptake
rationale: Members combine transferrin/heme/iron import and iron-transport disorders with class A/B/F/H scavenger receptor clearance and immune complex clearance, which all confusables lack.

core: Iron and heme uptake and transport
name: Iron and heme uptake with scavenger receptor plasma clearance
rationale: Members cover transferrin/ferroportin/heme iron handling plus class A/B/F/H scavenger receptors and immune complex clearance, which the copper/manganese, oxygen-transport and metal-detox confusables lack.

name: Iron and heme uptake with scavenger receptor clearance
rationale: Members cover transferrin/iron import, heme scavenging and iron-overload disorders together with class A/B/F/H scavenger receptor clearance, which the metal-ion transport and oxygen-transport confusables lack.

name: Locomotor and sensorimotor behavior
rationale: Most members are motor behaviors (walking, swimming, righting, grooming, proprioception) with glycinergic and cerebellar contributors, distinguishing it from confusables built on vocalization, social learning and auditory responses.

name: Locomotor, postural and sensorimotor behavior
rationale: Members are locomotory, postural (righting reflex, proprioception), exploratory and sensorimotor behaviors with their neural substrates (glycinergic inhibition, Purkinje layer); confusables instead hold vocalization, learning and auditory/prepulse behaviors or neuronal excitability without locomotor members.

core: Neural control of locomotor and sensorimotor behavior
name: Neural control of locomotor and sensorimotor behavior, glycinergic inhibition
rationale: Most members are motor and sensory behaviors (walking, swimming, righting reflex, proprioception, grooming) with supporting neural circuitry (Purkinje layer, amygdala, inhibitory transmission), and the glycinergic/hyperekplexia and motor members distinguish it from vocalization/social learning and neuronal excitability themes.

qualifier: integrin-mediated adhesion to endothelium and diapedesis
name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte-endothelial adhesion and extravasation
rationale: Members regulate leukocyte adhesion to vascular endothelium, integrin activation, PECAM1 interactions, diapedesis and neutrophil/T cell extravasation, unlike monocyte inflammation, immunological synapse or chemokine confusables.

name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion and endothelial extravasation
rationale: Members cover integrin activation, leukocyte-endothelial adhesion, diapedesis and T cell/neutrophil extravasation, unlike confusables on monocyte activation, chemokine signaling or T cell immunological synapse.

name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte-endothelial adhesion and extravasation
rationale: Members concern leukocyte (neutrophil, T cell) adhesion to endothelium, integrin activation, PECAM1 interactions and diapedesis, distinguishing it from monocyte inflammatory activation, chemokine-driven homing and T cell immunological synapse confusables.

qualifier: by dendritic, myeloid and B-lineage cells
name: MHC class II antigen presentation by professional APCs
rationale: Members are MHC II peptide processing/presentation and surface signatures of dendritic cells, monocytes and plasma/germinal center B cells; confusables are B cell identity, T cell costimulation or CD1 lipid antigen presentation.

qualifier: MHC class II peptide presentation by antigen-presenting cells
name: MHC class II peptide presentation by antigen-presenting cells
rationale: Members are MHC class II exogenous peptide loading/regulation and the surface signatures of DCs, monocytes and other APCs; confusables carry CD1 lipid presentation/NKT, B cell identity or T cell costimulation instead.

qualifier: peptide antigen by dendritic cells, monocytes and B/plasma cells
name: MHC class II peptide antigen presentation by professional APCs
rationale: Members are MHC class II peptide loading and presentation plus surface signatures of dendritic cells, monocytes and plasma cells, distinguishing the theme from B cell identity, T cell costimulation and CD1/MHC Ib lipid antigen and NKT themes.

core: repulsive axon guidance and growth cone collapse
qualifier: semaphorin-plexin and EPH-ephrin signalling with their cytoskeletal effectors, not netrin, slit-ROBO or L1 family cues
name: Semaphorin and ephrin repulsive guidance with growth cone collapse
rationale: All members are repulsive guidance events driven by semaphorin-plexin or EPH-ephrin signalling and the RND1/CRMP/microtubule machinery that executes collapse, fasciculation, pruning and projection patterning; every confusable is distinguished by netrin-DCC, SLIT-ROBO, L1/DSCAM or RAC-CDC42 content that this theme lacks.

core: repulsive axon guidance and growth cone collapse
name: Semaphorin and ephrin repulsive axon guidance
rationale: Members are semaphorin/plexin and EPH-ephrin repulsion with the cytoskeletal collapse, pruning and defasciculation they cause, unlike confusables built on netrin and SLIT-ROBO cues, generic guidance direction terms or collateral sprouting.

qualifier: semaphorin-plexin and ephrin signalling, growth-cone collapse
name: Semaphorin-plexin and ephrin repulsive axon guidance
rationale: Members cover semaphorin-plexin and Eph-ephrin repulsion, growth-cone collapse, microtubule destabilisation and nerve branching/pruning, distinguishing them from netrin, Slit-Robo and L1-based guidance confusables.

qualifier: TRIF and TRAF6-TAK1 adaptor arms to inflammatory cytokines
name: Toll-like receptor TRIF and TRAF6-TAK1 signaling to inflammatory cytokines
rationale: Members are TRIF/TICAM1, IRAK2, TRAF6-TAK1 and RIP1-IKK TLR signaling, TRIF-mediated death and IL-6/IL-8/TNF induction, unlike broad NF-kB, negative cytokine regulation, inflammasome and TLR3-IRF deficiency neighbours.

core: Toll-like receptor signaling to inflammatory cytokines
name: TRIF- and IRAK2-mediated TLR signaling to inflammatory cytokines
rationale: Members are TLR3/4/7-9 signaling via TICAM1/RIP1 and IRAK2/TRAF6-TAK1 including TRIF cell death, plus induced IL-6/IL-8/TNF production, unlike confusables on inflammasomes, IRF3/7 activation, NF-kB broadly or cytokine suppression.

qualifier: TRIF and IRAK2-TRAF6 routes to TAK1, cytokines and cell death
name: TLR TRIF/IRAK2-TAK1 signaling driving inflammatory cytokines and cell death
rationale: Members are TRIF/TICAM1- and IRAK2-TRAF6-mediated TAK1/IKK activation, TRIF-induced cell death and positive regulation of IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, unlike confusables on broad NF-kB regulation, inflammasomes/LPS sensing, IRF3/7 endosomal TLR deficiencies or cytokine suppression.

qualifier: stress granule and PKR stress response
name: AU-rich element mRNA turnover and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members combine ARE-binding protein control of mRNA stability and translational silencing with stress granule assembly/disassembly, PKR and arsenite responses, which mRNA-decay confusables lack.

qualifier: stress granule dynamics under PKR/arsenite stress
name: AU-rich mRNA turnover and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members are ARE-binding protein mRNA stabilization/decay and translational silencing plus stress granule assembly/disassembly, PKR and arsenite response, the stress-granule part being absent from mRNA-decay confusables.

qualifier: stress granule dynamics and PKR/arsenite stress
name: AU-rich mRNA turnover and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members are ARE-binding proteins that stabilize or destabilize mRNAs and repress translation, and the stress granule assembly/disassembly, PKR and arsenite response members distinguish it from mRNA decay confusables.

qualifier: miRNA/ceRNA translational control of specific targets
name: MicroRNA silencing and translational control of target mRNAs
rationale: Members cover miRNA biogenesis, RISC and miRNA/ceRNA/RNA-binding-protein control of specific mRNAs (PTEN, CDH1, PD-L1, NPAS4), unlike confusables built on ARE-mediated decay, siRNA, decapping or 3'-end processing.

name: MicroRNA-mediated mRNA silencing and IGF2BP-mediated stabilization
rationale: Members cover miRNA biogenesis, RISC, miRNA/ceRNA/lncRNA silencing of specific targets and its counterpart IGF2BP/CRD-mediated mRNA stabilization, unlike confusables focused on ARE-binding decay, siRNA or mRNA 3'-end processing.

core: Post-transcriptional silencing by miRNAs and lncRNAs
name: Noncoding RNA control of mRNA translation and stability
rationale: Members cover miRNA biogenesis, RISC, miRNA/lncRNA/ceRNA-mediated silencing of specific transcripts and RNA-binding-protein stabilization of mRNA, distinguishing it from confusables focused on ARE-binding decay factors, siRNA, decapping or 3'-end processing.

qualifier: CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding and tubulin post-translational modification
name: CCT/TRiC cytoskeletal protein folding and tubulin modification
rationale: Members are prefoldin/CCT folding of actin, tubulin and G-beta plus tubulin glutamylation, acetylation and microtubule severing, which general chaperone and histone acetylation confusables lack.

name: TRiC chaperonin cytoskeletal folding and tubulin modification
rationale: Members are prefoldin/TRiC folding of tubulin, actin and G-beta plus tubulin glutamylation, acetylation and microtubule severing, distinct from confusables on general, ER or stress chaperone folding.

name: Chaperonin-mediated cytoskeletal protein folding and tubulin modification
rationale: Members cover TRiC/CCT and prefoldin folding of tubulin and actin plus tubulin glutamylation, acetylation and microtubule severing, unlike confusables on general chaperone refolding, ER folding or histone acetylation.

core: Apical epithelial membrane polarity and transport
qualifier: biliary phospholipid and bile acid secretion
name: Apical epithelial transport and biliary lipid secretion
rationale: Members concern apical/raft protein targeting, CFTR, microvilli and epithelial transport; phospholipid flipping and ABCB4/ABCB11 bile secretion distinguish it from the anion-transport and scrambling confusables.

core: Apical epithelial membrane polarity and transport
name: Apical epithelial transport with bile and phospholipid translocation
rationale: Members share apical/raft protein targeting and epithelial transmembrane transport (CFTR, water, microvilli), and unlike the confusables include canalicular bile salt export and lipid flippase/floppase translocation (ABCB11, ABCB4).

core: Apical epithelial membrane protein and lipid transport
qualifier: hepatobiliary lipid translocation and bile secretion
name: Apical epithelial membrane transport with hepatobiliary lipid translocation
rationale: Members concern polarized apical/raft protein localization, CFTR and phospholipid flipping in epithelia; bile acid secretion, ABCB4/ABCB11 defects, sphingolipid translocation and microvillus assembly distinguish it from the flippase/Golgi-export confusables.

name: p75 neurotrophin receptor signaling and axon regeneration
rationale: Members are p75NTR signaling branches (death, survival, RHOA axonal inhibition) plus regeneration of injured axons, distinguishing them from confusables on collateral sprouting, dependence receptors and TRK signaling.

name: p75NTR signaling in neuronal death and axon regeneration
rationale: Members describe p75NTR ligand binding, proteolysis and death/survival outputs alongside axon growth inhibition and regeneration, which the collateral-sprouting and Trk-signaling confusables each only partly cover.

qualifier: injured axon regeneration and neuron survival/death
name: p75 neurotrophin receptor signaling and injured axon regeneration
rationale: Members are p75NTR ligand binding, proteolysis and survival/death outputs plus axon growth, sprouting and regeneration after injury, separating the theme from Trk/dependence-receptor confusables and from collateral-sprouting confusables.

qualifier: iodide and sulfate handling linked to thyroid hormone
name: Thyroid hormone action and iodide/sulfate anion transport
rationale: Members combine iodide, sulfate, oxalate and SLC26 anion transport (with PAPS sulfate activation) and thyroid hormone generation and response, whereas confusables emphasize selenium metabolism, sulfonation or hydrogen peroxide.

name: Thyroid hormone action and sulfate-iodide anion transport
rationale: Members span thyroid hormone generation, transport and signaling together with SLC26/iodide/sulfate/PAPS anion handling, which the selenium- and peroxide-focused confusables lack.

qualifier: iodide and sulfate transport via SLC26 exchangers and PAPS activation
name: Thyroid hormone and iodide/sulfate anion transport
rationale: Members combine thyroid hormone generation, transport and signaling with iodide, sulfate and oxalate anion transport (SLC26, NIS, PAPS), while the confusables share the thyroid core but add peroxide, selenium or sulfonation instead of anion exchange.

name: Methionine and selenocompound metabolism
rationale: Members centre on methionine/SAM metabolism and salvage; the selenium compound metabolism members (SeMet, MeSeH, H2Se) are what no confusable has, while confusables add folate, choline/carnitine or MTR/MTRR defects.

name: Methionine cycle and selenium compound metabolism
rationale: Members cover methionine salvage/biosynthesis, SAM metabolism and its inborn errors plus dietary selenium (SeMet, selenite, MeSeH) processing that runs through the same enzymes; the selenium members are what the confusables (folate, choline/carnitine, MTR/MTRR defects) lack.

name: Methionine cycle, salvage and dietary selenium metabolism
rationale: Members centre on methionine/S-adenosylmethionine metabolism and methylthioadenosine salvage (MAT1A, AHCY defects, folate and neural tube links), and the selenomethionine/selenite metabolism members, absent from every confusable, distinguish it from folate-cycle, choline/carnitine and MTR/MTRR remethylation themes.

qualifier: oncogenic RAF mutants and ERK negative feedback
name: Oncogenic RAF–MAPK signaling and ERK negative feedback
rationale: Members cover BRAF/RAF1 mutant and fusion signalling, MAP2K/MAPK activation and ERK dephosphorylation/feedback suppression, whereas confusables emphasise upstream RAS/MRAS-SHOC2 activation and RAS GAPs.

qualifier: oncogenic RAF mutants and ERK negative feedback
name: Oncogenic RAF-MAPK signalling and ERK negative feedback
rationale: Members cover BRAF/RAF1 mutant and fusion signalling, MAP2K/MAPK activation and ERK dephosphorylation feedback, which RAS/MRAS-activation confusables lack.

qualifier: oncogenic RAF mutants and ERK negative feedback
name: Oncogenic RAF–MAPK signalling and ERK feedback inactivation
rationale: Members cover BRAF/RAF1 mutant and fusion signalling, MEK/ERK/RSK activation, and ERK dephosphorylation and negative feedback, which the MRAS/SHOC2 and RAS-GAP confusables lack.

qualifier: capping, severing, bundling and ILK-PINCH-parvin adhesion
name: Actin filament capping, severing, bundling and ILK adhesion
rationale: Members regulate actin filament ends, severing, crosslinking and networks along with IPP-complex focal adhesion and integrin signaling, unlike confusables driven by Rho-family GTPase cycles and protrusion formation.

qualifier: capping, severing and crosslinking by actin-binding proteins
name: Actin filament capping, severing and crosslinking
rationale: Members concern direct actin filament capping, severing, bundling and network assembly and adhesion-linked cytoskeleton remodeling, whereas confusables are Rho-family GTPase cycles and protrusion signaling.

qualifier: capping, severing and bundling rather than Rho GTPase signaling
name: Actin filament capping, severing and bundling
rationale: Members concern actin filament capping, severing, depolymerization, crosslinking and network/bundle assembly with focal adhesion IPP components, whereas confusables are dominated by Rho-family GTPase cycles and protrusion (lamellipodium, filopodium, ruffle) assembly.

qualifier: synapse assembly and presynaptic choline uptake
name: Neuromuscular junction assembly and cholinergic choline uptake
rationale: Members cover NMJ postsynaptic and terminal assembly (AChR clustering, dystrophin-glycoprotein complex, agrin proteoglycans) and SLC5A7 choline uptake for acetylcholine synthesis, while confusables center on nicotinic receptors and clostridial toxins.

qualifier: postsynaptic assembly and presynaptic choline/acetylcholine supply
name: Neuromuscular junction assembly and presynaptic acetylcholine supply
rationale: Most members concern neuromuscular synapse assembly (AChR clustering, DGC, ECM proteoglycans, terminal organization) and SLC5A7 choline uptake, acetylcholine synthesis and release; confusables center on nicotinic receptor subtypes, clostridial toxins or myasthenic glycosylation defects (bile acid transport is an outlier).

qualifier: synapse assembly (agrin proteoglycans, dystrophin complex) and presynaptic choline uptake
name: Cholinergic neuromuscular synapse assembly and choline uptake
rationale: Members concern acetylcholine supply (choline transport, SLC5A7) and neuromuscular junction assembly (AChR clustering, DGC, ECM proteoglycans), whereas confusables centre on nicotinic receptor channels, clostridial toxins or glycosylation-linked myasthenic syndromes.

name: Dolichol, UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid glycosylation precursor biosynthesis
rationale: Members mainly synthesize the lipid carrier and nucleotide-sugar donors (dolichyl phosphate, UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-glucose, CMP-sialic acid) for glycosylation, whereas confusables cover ALG/CDG glycan assembly, N-glycan processing and nucleotide-sugar transport.

name: Dolichol-phosphate and nucleotide sugar synthesis for glycosylation
rationale: Members synthesize dolichyl phosphate, UDP-GlcNAc, UDP-glucose and CMP-sialic acid donors and their disorders, feeding N-glycosylation and GPI anchoring; precursor synthesis distinguishes it from N-glycan processing, CDG enzyme and nucleotide-sugar transport confusables.

qualifier: UDP-GlcNAc, sialic acid and dolichol phosphate
name: UDP-GlcNAc, sialic acid and dolichol-phosphate glycosylation donor synthesis
rationale: Members are biosynthesis of sugar-nucleotide and lipid glycosylation donors (UDP-GlcNAc, CMP-sialic acid, dolichyl phosphate) and their defects, unlike neighbours centred on N-glycan processing, GDP-mannose and nucleotide-sugar transport.

name: BMP-SMAD regulation of vasculogenesis and endothelial differentiation
rationale: Members combine BMP/SMAD signalling regulation with vasculogenesis, arterial/venous vessel morphogenesis, endothelial differentiation and vessel maturation; confusables centre on cardiac conduction, heart chamber/valve morphogenesis or cardiomyocyte growth.

name: BMP-SMAD signaling in vasculogenesis and endothelial differentiation
rationale: Members combine BMP/SMAD signaling regulation with blood vessel formation and endothelial/vascular smooth muscle differentiation, unlike the myocardial, conduction and lymphatic confusables.

name: BMP-SMAD signalling in vasculogenesis and endothelial differentiation
rationale: Members pair BMP/SMAD signalling regulation with vessel formation, arterial/venous endothelial and vascular smooth muscle differentiation, distinguishing it from cardiomyocyte, conduction and valve development confusables.

core: Responses to drugs of abuse and reward learning
name: Nicotine, ethanol, opioid and psychostimulant responses and reward learning
rationale: Members are behavioral/cellular responses to addictive drugs and conditioning, with nicotinic, opioid and ethanol components that the dopamine-receptor, social-behavior and neuropeptide confusables lack.

core: Responses to drugs of abuse and reward learning
name: Nicotine, alcohol and psychostimulant responses and reward learning
rationale: Members are behavioral/cellular responses to nicotine, ethanol, cocaine, amphetamine and opioids plus conditioning/place preference, distinguished from confusables on neuropeptides, social behavior and dopamine receptor signaling by the nicotine and alcohol members.

name: Responses to addictive drugs and reward conditioning
rationale: Members are behavioural and cellular responses to cocaine, amphetamine, nicotine, ethanol and opioids plus conditioned place preference and operant learning, separating it from social behaviour, dopamine receptor and neuropeptide confusables.

qualifier: NADPH regeneration (pentose phosphate, isocitrate) and ferroptosis suppression
name: NADPH-producing metabolic redox control and ferroptosis suppression
rationale: Members link NADPH-generating pentose phosphate and isocitrate metabolism under NRF2, p53 and mTORC1 control to redox state, ROS and ferroptosis resistance, whereas confusables emphasize broad NRF2 targets, hypoxia/glycolysis or ROS detoxification.

name: NADPH-generating metabolism in oxidative stress and ferroptosis defense
rationale: Members link ROS, p53 and NFE2L2 regulation of pentose phosphate, TCA/isocitrate and glycolytic metabolism to NADPH regeneration and ferroptosis control, unlike confusables on other NFE2L2 targets, ROS detoxification or hypoxia-driven glycolysis.

name: NADPH regeneration and redox metabolism under NRF2 and p53 control
rationale: Members link pentose phosphate, isocitrate and NADPH regeneration, NRF2/p53 metabolic gene regulation, mTORC1, ROS and ferroptosis suppression, whereas confusables emphasize hypoxia/glycolysis, broader NRF2 targets or ROS detoxification.

qualifier: cAMP turnover plus phospholipase C-inositol phosphate arm
name: GPCR cAMP turnover and phospholipase C-inositol phosphate signaling
rationale: Members cover cAMP synthesis/degradation and adenylate cyclase regulation together with PLC-coupled GPCR, IP3/phosphoinositide and calcium signaling (LPA receptors), whereas confusables center on PKA activation or adrenergic adenylate cyclase inhibition.

name: GPCR cAMP and phosphoinositide-calcium second messenger signaling
rationale: Members cover cAMP synthesis/degradation and adenylate cyclase inhibition together with PLC, IP3/phosphoinositide and G protein calcium signalling (LPA receptors, PDE1), whereas confusables are restricted to cAMP-PKA/adrenergic effects or Wnt-calcium signalling.

name: GPCR second messenger signaling via cAMP and phosphoinositides
rationale: Members cover cAMP synthesis/degradation and PLC/inositol phosphate generation downstream of G protein-coupled receptors, the phosphoinositide arm distinguishing it from the adrenergic and PKA-focused confusables.

name: Rho GTPase-driven immunological synapse and T cell polarity
rationale: Members describe lymphocyte synapse formation, raft localization, polarity and aggregation via RHOH, Cdc42 and Rho effectors, unlike confusables on antigen presentation, integrin adhesion or homing.

name: Lymphocyte immunological synapse and polarity via Rho GTPases
rationale: Members concern immunological synapse and membrane raft organization, T cell polarity and lymphocyte aggregation through RHOH, CDC42 and CORO1A-DEF6 effectors, unlike integrin adhesion, homing or antigen-presentation confusables.

qualifier: Rho GTPase (RHOH, Cdc42) control of lymphocyte polarity
name: Rho GTPase-driven immunological synapse and lymphocyte polarity
rationale: Members concern immunological synapse formation, T cell polarity, raft localization and lymphocyte aggregation via RHOH/Cdc42 and CORO1A-DEF6, unlike confusables about lymphocyte homing, integrin adhesion or dendritic cell activation.

core: Integrin and Rho GTPase signaling in adhesion
name: Integrin-Rap1 and G12/13-Rho signaling linked to MAPK
rationale: Members combine integrin/Rap1 adhesion signaling, G12/13-Rho GPCR signaling and integrin-MAPK/ERK5 linkage, which platelet-agonist, focal-adhesion and shear-stress confusables lack.

qualifier: Rap1 and G12/13-Rho inputs to MAPK
name: Rap1 and G12/13-Rho signaling to integrin adhesion and MAPK
rationale: Members link Rap1, G12/13-Rho GPCR and GRB2/p130Cas-MAPK/ERK5 signaling to integrin adhesion, cytoskeletal remodeling and platelet activation, which the shear-stress, platelet-agonist and ILK/ROCK confusables lack.

name: Integrin, Rap1 and G12/13-Rho signaling to MAPK cascades
rationale: Members link integrin adhesion and cytoskeletal remodeling with Rap1, G12/13-Rho and RAS/ERK5 MAPK signaling, unlike ILK/ROCK, shear-stress or platelet-agonist confusables.

name: Misfolded protein aggregate clearance and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members cover aggrephagy, aggresome assembly, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy and misfolded protein responses, and uniquely include stress granule assembly, localization and disassembly absent from the ERAD/pexophagy confusables.

name: Protein aggregate autophagy and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members concern clearance of misfolded proteins by aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and micro-autophagy, together with stress granule assembly and disassembly, which the confusables lack.

name: Protein aggregate autophagy and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members cover aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy, aggresome assembly and misfolded protein response, and only this theme includes stress granule assembly, localization and disassembly, which confusables (ERAD, protein QC, pexophagy) lack.

name: Cation-chloride cotransporters, potassium channels and sodium transport regulation
rationale: Members are SLC12 cotransporters, K+ channel families and regulation of Na+/K+ flux, distinct from confusables on osmotic responses, magnesium/paracellular transport and Na+/H+ exchangers.

name: Cation-chloride cotransport and potassium channel ion homeostasis
rationale: Members comprise SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters and their diseases, potassium channels and regulation of sodium transport, while confusables focus on osmotic stress, sodium/proton exchange or magnesium and paracellular transport.

name: Cation-chloride cotransport and potassium channel ion homeostasis
rationale: Members are SLC12 cotransporters, K+ channels (KCa, TASK) and Na+/K+ transport regulation, distinguishing it from magnesium/paracellular and osmotic-stress/NHE neighbours.

name: Chylomicron and VLDL assembly with lipoprotein remodeling
rationale: All members concern assembly, remodeling and clearance of plasma lipoprotein particles, with assembly of chylomicrons/VLDL and HDL/LDL remodeling absent from the lipase- and LDL-clearance-focused confusables.

qualifier: assembly, remodelling and clearance of all lipoprotein classes
name: Plasma lipoprotein assembly, remodelling and clearance
rationale: Members cover chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL assembly, remodelling and clearance, whereas confusables emphasise lipase complexes, triglyceride catabolism or regulation of clearance and lack the assembly steps.

name: Plasma lipoprotein assembly, remodelling and clearance
rationale: All members concern assembly, remodelling or clearance of chylomicrons, VLDL, LDL and HDL; particle assembly and HDL/LDL remodelling are what the lipase- and clearance-focused confusables lack.

name: Rac-driven Arp2/3 actin polymerization and lamellipodia
rationale: Members center on RAC1/2/3 and RHOG cycles driving WAVE/Arp2/3 actin, lamellipodia and NADPH oxidase, unlike CDC42, RHOA-family or Fc-gamma phagocytosis confusables.

name: Rac and RhoG-driven lamellipodial actin polymerization
rationale: Members are RAC1/2/3 and RHOG cycles with their WAVE/Arp2/3, lamellipodium and NADPH oxidase outputs, distinguishing it from CDC42/RHOA cycle and Fc-gamma phagocytosis confusables.

qualifier: RAC1-3 and RHOG cycles driving Arp2/3 lamellipodia
name: RAC and RHOG GTPase cycles driving lamellipodial actin
rationale: Members are RAC/RHOG GTPase cycles and their WAVE/Arp2/3, lamellipodium and NADPH oxidase effectors, distinguishing the theme from CDC42/RHOA-centred confusables and from Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis.

name: Deoxyribonucleotide metabolism with nucleotide and deoxynucleoside catabolism
rationale: Members centre on deoxyribonucleotide and nucleoside monophosphate breakdown (dGMP, dUMP, dTMP, UMP catabolism, ADA/PNP deoxynucleoside defects), whereas confusables emphasise de novo synthesis, salvage and di/triphosphate interconversion.

name: Deoxynucleotide and pyrimidine catabolism with ADA/PNP deficiencies
rationale: Members cover breakdown and turnover of deoxyribonucleotides/deoxynucleosides and pyrimidine nucleotides, and the ADA and PNP deficiency members distinguish it from confusables dominated by de novo and salvage nucleotide biosynthesis.

name: Deoxynucleotide and pyrimidine nucleotide catabolism
rationale: Members are dominated by breakdown of deoxyribonucleotides/deoxynucleosides and pyrimidine nucleotides (including ADA and PNP defects), whereas confusables centre on de novo synthesis, salvage and interconversion.

qualifier: radiation response, apoptosis regulation, checkpoint and senescence
name: p53 DNA damage signaling after radiation: apoptosis and senescence
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulation of p53-mediated apoptosis and damage signaling, X-ray/gamma/UV responses, G2 checkpoint, replicative senescence and lifespan; confusables are p53 transcriptional target sets, p53 degradation/ARF or cell-cycle progression.

qualifier: radiation responses, checkpoint, senescence, apoptosis regulation
name: p53-mediated radiation damage checkpoint, senescence and apoptosis regulation
rationale: Members combine responses to gamma, X-ray and UV radiation, G2 checkpoint, senescence and lifespan with positive and negative regulation of p53-dependent apoptosis, unlike confusables that list specific p53 transcriptional targets.

qualifier: radiation-induced checkpoint, apoptosis control and senescence
name: p53-mediated DNA damage checkpoint and apoptosis control after irradiation
rationale: Members cover radiation responses, DNA damage checkpoint, p53 phosphorylation, bidirectional regulation of p53-mediated apoptosis and senescence, unlike confusables centred on p53 target transcription.

Members mix PRPP, creatine, inositol and fructose metabolism, mitochondrial ATP/ADP transport, magnesium homeostasis, protein oligomerization and calcium-independent adhesion with no shared biological process.

Members mix protein oligomerization, PRPP and fructose synthesis, creatine metabolism, mitochondrial ATP/ADP transport, magnesium and inositol transport and calcium-independent adhesion with no shared biological process.

Members mix fructose, PRPP, creatine and inositol metabolism, magnesium transport, mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport, protein oligomerization states and calcium-independent adhesion, with no shared biological theme.

qualifier: mating, aggression, parental, grooming and exploratory behaviour
name: Mating, social and exploratory behaviour
rationale: Members are mating, insemination, aggression, parental, grooming and locomotory/exploratory behaviours with amygdala development and relaxin receptors; confusables add vocal or observational learning, pheromone response, ethanol and drinking behaviour or sensory perception.

name: Reproductive, social and locomotor behaviour
rationale: Members are mating, parental, aggressive, grooming, exploratory and psychomotor behaviours plus reproductive physiology (erection, insemination, relaxin receptors), unlike confusables about sensory, drinking, ethanol or vocal-learning behaviour.

name: Reproductive, social and exploratory locomotor behaviour
rationale: Members are mating, parental, aggressive, grooming and exploratory/psychomotor behaviours with reproductive physiology, unlike learning, drinking/ethanol, parturition or sensory-behaviour confusables.

qualifier: Rab/ARF regulation and postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptors
name: Rab/ARF-regulated endosomal recycling of surface and postsynaptic receptors
rationale: Members regulate endocytosis and endosome-to-surface recycling of receptors via Rab/ARF signaling, including postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptor trafficking, unlike confusables on Golgi secretion, clathrin cargo recognition or presynaptic vesicle organization.

core: Endosomal receptor recycling to the cell surface
name: Rab/Arf-regulated endosomal recycling of surface and postsynaptic receptors
rationale: Members control endocytosis versus recycling of surface receptors through Rab/Arf GTPase signaling, including postsynaptic receptor trafficking; confusables are clathrin cargo recognition, presynaptic organisation or Golgi secretion.

core: Endosomal receptor recycling to the cell surface
qualifier: postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptors under Rab/ARF regulation
name: Rab/ARF-regulated endosomal recycling of postsynaptic receptors
rationale: Members govern endocytic internalization and endosome-to-surface recycling of receptors, notably postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptors, regulated by Rab GAPs and ARF signaling, distinguishing them from Golgi-secretory, presynaptic vesicle-cycle and clathrin cargo-recognition confusables.

name: GPI anchoring, Hedgehog lipidation and glycosphingolipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members combine GPI anchor synthesis/attachment, Hedgehog palmitoylation/autoprocessing and glycosphingolipid synthesis, distinguishing it from RAS processing, depalmitoylation and glycolipid transport confusables.

core: Lipid modification of proteins and glycolipid synthesis
name: GPI anchoring, protein palmitoylation and glycosphingolipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover GPI anchor synthesis/attachment, cysteine palmitoylation and Hedgehog lipidation, plus glycosphingolipid synthesis, combining what the confusables split (glycolipid transport vs Hh/RAS processing).

qualifier: palmitoylation, GPI anchoring and glycosphingolipid synthesis
name: Protein palmitoylation, GPI anchoring and glycosphingolipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members concern lipid attachment to proteins (cysteine palmitoylation, Hedgehog autoprocessing and lipidation, GPI anchor synthesis and attachment) together with glycosphingolipid synthesis, whereas confusables carry either only the Hedgehog/RAS processing side or glycolipid transport.

name: Replicative and base excision repair DNA synthesis
rationale: Members cover primer synthesis, polymerase switching, strand elongation and flap removal in replication and telomere C-strand synthesis plus long-patch and single-nucleotide base excision repair synthesis, distinguishing them from translesion synthesis and nucleotide excision repair confusables.

qualifier: lagging-strand polymerase switching and flap removal in replication, BER and telomeres
name: Lagging-strand DNA synthesis and flap removal in replication and repair
rationale: Members share primer synthesis, polymerase switching and flap removal in replication, long-patch base excision repair and telomere C-strand fill-in, unlike the translesion and NER gap-filling confusables.

core: Polymerase delta/PCNA strand synthesis and flap removal
qualifier: lagging strand, telomere C-strand and long-patch BER
name: Lagging-strand DNA synthesis and long-patch base excision repair
rationale: Members share primer synthesis, polymerase switching, strand elongation and flap removal in replication, telomere C-strand fill-in and long-patch BER gap-filling, unlike the NER and translesion-synthesis confusables.

name: Arginine, ornithine and proline metabolism and basic amino acid transport
rationale: Members span ornithine/citrulline/arginine and proline metabolism plus lysine/arginine/ornithine transporters, unlike confusables on the urea cycle enzymes proper, glutamate/glutamine or glycine metabolism.

name: Arginine–ornithine–proline interconversion and cationic amino acid transport
rationale: Members span ornithine, arginine, citrulline and proline synthesis/catabolism with arginine/lysine/ornithine transport (LPI, HHH), differing from confusables built on urea cycle enzyme defects, glutamate/glutamine and nitrogen handling, or glycine/threonine metabolism.

qualifier: ornithine-centred, with cationic amino acid transport
name: Ornithine-centred arginine and proline metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover ornithine, citrulline, arginine and proline metabolism plus arginine, lysine and ornithine transport, distinguishing it from neighbours on urea-cycle synthesis, glutamate/glutamine nitrogen handling or glycine conjugation.

name: Cation-chloride cotransporters and sodium/proton exchangers
rationale: Members center on SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters, SLC9 Na+/H+ exchangers and their disease variants plus potassium and vesicle acidification transport, unlike the SLC26/bicarbonate anion-exchange and osmotic/renal sodium confusables.

qualifier: cation-chloride cotransporters and Na+/H+ exchangers with inherited defects
name: Cation-chloride cotransport and sodium/proton exchange, including inherited defects
rationale: Members centre on SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters, SLC9 Na+/H+ exchangers, potassium channels and their disease variants plus related ion homeostasis, unlike the bicarbonate/SLC26 anion-exchange and renal sodium/osmotic confusables.

name: Cation-chloride cotransporters and sodium/proton exchangers
rationale: Members center on SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters, SLC9 Na+/H+ exchangers and potassium transport with their inherited disorders and vesicle acidification, unlike confusables built on SLC26/SLC4 anion exchange, renal sodium regulation or osmotic responses.

core: Post-translational maturation of developmental signaling proteins
qualifier: Notch O-glycosylation and Hedgehog autoprocessing and lipidation
name: Notch O-glycosylation and Hedgehog autoprocessing and lipidation
rationale: Members cover secretory-pathway modification of Notch/TSR proteins by O-fucose/O-glucose and Hedgehog autoprocessing, palmitoylation and release; the Hedgehog processing members separate it from N-glycan, somitogenesis and heparan sulfate confusables.

core: Secretory-pathway maturation of developmental signaling proteins
name: Hedgehog lipidation and Notch O-glycosylation maturation
rationale: Members cover Hedgehog autoprocessing, palmitoylation and release and O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation of Notch and TSR proteins in ER/Golgi, combining lipidation and O-glycosylation that the N-glycan, heparan sulfate and palmitoylation confusables each lack.

core: Secretory-pathway maturation of developmental signaling proteins
name: Notch O-glycosylation and Hedgehog autoprocessing and lipidation
rationale: Members are ER/Golgi O-fucosylation/glucosylation of Notch and TSR proteins plus Hedgehog autoprocessing, palmitoylation and release; this pairing separates it from N-glycan, heparan sulfate, palmitoylation-only and somitogenesis neighbours.

qualifier: regulated protein import/export and ribosomal subunit export
name: Regulated nuclear protein import/export and ribosomal subunit export
rationale: Members concern nuclear pore traffic of proteins, ribosomal subunits and Rev cargo plus its regulation; protein import/export regulation distinguishes it from mRNA export, NPC assembly, SUMOylation and inositol phosphate transport confusables.

qualifier: regulation of protein import and export
name: Nuclear pore transport and regulation of protein import-export
rationale: Members cover nuclear pore transport of NLS proteins, ribosomal subunits and Rev cargo with positive/negative regulation of protein import and export; confusables emphasize NPC assembly/disassembly, SUMOylation, inositol phosphate or mRNA export.

qualifier: regulated protein import/export and ribosomal subunit export
name: Nuclear pore protein and ribosomal subunit transport
rationale: Members concern NPC-mediated protein import/export and its regulation plus ribosomal subunit export, whereas confusables emphasise mRNA/IP export, NPC assembly and SUMOylation.

qualifier: with FLT3-STAT5 signaling and its CBL control
name: RUNX1 transcriptional programs and FLT3-STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members combine RUNX-family target-gene regulation in hematopoietic and other lineages with FLT3 signaling, STAT5 activation and CBL-mediated negative regulation; RUNX1-only confusables lack the FLT3/STAT5/CBL arm and FLT3-fusion or interleukin confusables lack the RUNX arm.

name: RUNX1 transcriptional programs with FLT3-CBL-STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members combine RUNX-family target-gene regulation in hematopoietic and other lineages with FLT3 receptor signaling, its CBL/SRC regulation and STAT5 activation; RUNX-only confusables lack the FLT3 arm and FLT3/interleukin confusables lack the RUNX arm.

qualifier: FLT3 signaling via CBL, SRC kinases and STAT5
name: RUNX transcription programs and FLT3–CBL–STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members are RUNX1/2/3-regulated hematopoietic and lineage transcription plus FLT3 receptor signaling and its CBL/SRC/STAT5 branches; the pairing distinguishes it from RUNX-only, FLT3-fusion-only and interleukin-receptor neighbours.

qualifier: ear, nose, taste and cranial nerves
name: Cranial sensory organ and nerve development (ear, nose, taste)
rationale: Members build the ear, nose/olfactory system, taste papillae and associated cranial nerves and ganglia, distinguishing it from face/skull morphogenesis, gland, hindbrain motor and hair-cell fate confusables.

qualifier: ear, olfactory and cranial sensory nerves
name: Ear, olfactory and cranial sensory nerve development

core: DNA damage and replication stress response

qualifier: in mesoderm specification and heart morphogenesis

qualifier: eye, inner ear and cranial sensory nerves

name: Cellular response to drugs, anesthetics and chemical toxicants

core: Inhibitory G protein regulation of cAMP

core: G protein regulation of cAMP and calcium second messengers
qualifier: alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz adenylate cyclase inhibition

name: Chromosome condensation and centromeric CENP-A chromatin assembly

name: Chromosome condensation and CENP-A centromere assembly

name: Mitotic chromosome condensation and CENP-A centromere assembly
rationale: Members are prophase/prometaphase and meiotic chromosome condensation and CENP-A nucleosome deposition at centromeres, setting it apart from cytokinesis, cohesion and spindle confusables.

name: IL-12–driven Th1 differentiation with IFN-γ–induced MHC expression

name: IL-12-driven Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma antigen presentation

qualifier: IL-12 drive and IFN-gamma-induced MHC expression
name: IL-12-driven Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma-induced MHC expression
rationale: Members cover IL-12/JAK-STAT-driven Th1 differentiation, IFN-gamma response, MHC class I/II regulation and antigen presentation, unlike IFNG-signaling regulation, DC IL-12 production or Treg confusables.

qualifier: responses to endogenous danger ligands with SIRP restraint

qualifier: to endogenous danger ligands with SIRP-restrained phagocytosis
name: Monocyte-macrophage inflammatory signaling to endogenous ligands and SIRP restraint
rationale: Members are myeloid/monocyte inflammatory programmes responding to endogenous signals (heme, oxidised LDL, endogenous TLR ligands) and SIRP-mediated restraint of phagocytosis and neutrophil activation, unlike confusables centred on LPS/TLR2/4 detection, Fc receptor effector functions or antigen presentation.

qualifier: endogenous danger ligands (heme, oxidised LDL) and SIRP-mediated restraint
name: Monocyte inflammatory signaling to endogenous ligands with SIRP restraint
rationale: Members describe myeloid inflammatory and TLR signaling triggered by endogenous ligands such as heme and oxidised LDL together with SIRP-mediated inhibition of phagocytosis and neutrophil activation, which separates it from confusables on bacterial LPS/lipopeptide sensing, antigen presentation and Fc receptor/neutrophil effector programmes.

qualifier: mature, naive and plasma cell surface markers
name: Mature B cell identity and surface signatures

qualifier: B cell surface signatures rather than activation or differentiation

name: Resting B lymphocyte identity and surface marker signatures

name: Oxidative and nitrosative stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis

qualifier: nitrosative stress, mitochondrial and neuronal death

name: Nitrosative and oxidative stress control of intrinsic apoptosis

name: Netrin-mediated axon guidance, extension and collateral sprouting

name: Netrin-mediated axon guidance and collateral sprouting

name: Netrin-mediated axon guidance and collateral sprouting

name: Phosphoinositide and serine-kinase signalling, including PAK-2p34 cell death

name: Phosphoinositide-AKT/PTEN and PAK-2p34 serine kinase signalling

name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis via Rac-WAVE Arp2/3 actin polymerization

name: Fc-gamma receptor and DAP12-driven phagocytic actin remodeling

qualifier: Fc-gamma receptor and DAP12 signaling to Rac/WAVE/Arp2/3

qualifier: GABA and choline uptake, vesicle loading

name: Fructose, polyol and glucuronate-xylulose pentose metabolism

name: Fructose, polyol and glucuronate-xylulose pentose metabolism

name: Fructose, polyol and glucuronate-xylulose metabolism
rationale: Members cover fructose catabolism, alditol metabolism and the glucuronate-to-xylulose pentose route, distinguishing it from galactose Leloir and pentose phosphate shunt neighbours.

core: Great artery and outflow tract development

core: Great artery and pulmonary vascular development

name: NADPH-supported reactive oxygen species detoxification and redox homeostasis

name: Reactive oxygen detoxification and isocitrate-linked NADPH supply

qualifier: synapse pruning and dendritic spine remodelling

qualifier: synapse pruning and dendritic spine remodeling

qualifier: synapse pruning and dendritic spine remodelling

name: Glutamate, GABA and glycine reuptake and vesicular loading

qualifier: promoter escape and early elongation pausing

qualifier: immediate-early AP-1 induction and negative feedback

qualifier: immediate-early AP-1/NR4A genes and ERK negative feedback

name: Cadherin transcription and morphogen signaling in mesenchymal progenitors
rationale: Members link regulation of CDH1/CDH11/CDH19 expression and FGFR2 splicing with TGF-beta/SMAD, BMP and Wnt signaling and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation/differentiation; confusables centre on osteoblast differentiation or transcriptional repression.

name: Cadherin transcription and TGF-beta-driven mesenchymal progenitor control
rationale: Members combine cadherin gene regulation (CDH1/11/19), TGF-beta/BMP/Wnt signaling and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation/differentiation, versus osteoblast- and TGFBR3-centred confusables.

name: Mesenchymal progenitor TGF-beta signaling and cadherin gene regulation
rationale: Members combine TGF-beta/SMAD, BMP and Wnt signaling in mesenchymal stem cells with transcriptional control of CDH1, CDH11, CDH19 and FGFR2 splicing; confusables center on osteoblast differentiation and bone formation or generic transcriptional repression.

qualifier: Fc-gamma phagocytosis and B cell receptor
name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis and B cell receptor signaling
rationale: Members are activating immunoreceptor pathways for Fc-gamma receptor-mediated phagocytosis and BCR second messenger/RAS signaling, versus confusables on Fc-epsilon/mast cells, inhibitory Fc signaling or CD22-mediated BCR regulation.

qualifier: BCR second messengers and Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis
name: BCR signaling and Fc-gamma receptor-mediated phagocytosis
rationale: Members are BCR-triggered second messenger/RAS/BTK signalling and Fc-gamma receptor activation driving phagocytic cup formation, distinct from confusables on CD22 BCR regulation, inhibitory Fc receptors, ADCC and Fc-epsilon mast cell responses.

qualifier: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis and B cell receptor
name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis and B cell receptor signaling
rationale: Members are activating Fc-gamma receptor phagocytic signaling and BCR second-messenger signaling via BTK/PLC, unlike confusables on inhibitory Fc signaling, Fc-epsilon/mast cell or CD22 regulation.

qualifier: endothelial morphogenesis with megakaryocyte-platelet and perivascular modules
name: Endothelial morphogenesis and megakaryocyte-platelet adhesion signalling
rationale: Most members concern endothelial morphogenesis, endothelial-matrix adhesion, perivascular stroma and platelet/myeloid adhesion signalling (plus several uncharacterised motif modules), distinguishing it from smooth-muscle, fibroblast-stroma and ER-secretory confusables.

qualifier: endothelial, perivascular and megakaryocyte-platelet gene modules
name: Endothelial, perivascular and platelet adhesion-signalling gene modules
rationale: Members are endothelial morphogenesis and cell-matrix/cadherin adhesion terms plus co-expression modules of endothelium, perivascular stroma and the megakaryocyte-platelet/myeloid lineage, distinguishing it from smooth-muscle SRF, fibroblast-stroma and ER confusables.

name: Endothelial, perivascular and platelet adhesion gene modules
rationale: The annotated members share endothelial morphogenesis, endothelial-matrix and cadherin adhesion, perivascular stroma and platelet/megakaryocyte signalling modules (several motif-only modules are uninformative), distinguishing it from smooth-muscle/shear-stress, ER and fibroblast confusables.

name: Responses to UV, genotoxic drugs and oxidative stress
rationale: Members are responses to UV, DNA-damaging drugs, peroxides, phorbol ester and hypoxic/oxidative stress, unlike confusables about liver regeneration, ethanol/anesthetics or osmotic stress.

qualifier: UV, genotoxic drugs and oxidative stress
name: Cellular response to UV, genotoxic drugs and oxidative stress
rationale: Members are responses to UV, bleomycin, cisplatin, hydroperoxide and related stressors, unlike ethanol/anesthetic xenobiotic and liver regeneration confusables.

name: Cellular response to UV, genotoxic drugs and oxidants
rationale: Members are responses to UV, cisplatin, bleomycin, hydroperoxide and related stress with their apoptotic and hypoxic regulation, whereas confusables concern ethanol/anesthetic xenobiotics, liver regeneration and osmotic or mitochondrial stress.

name: UCH- and USP-family deubiquitination regulating protein stability
rationale: Members concern UCH/USP deubiquitinases and regulation of proteolysis and protein stability, unlike confusables on ubiquitin chain types, aggrephagy, proteasome or ERAD.

name: Deubiquitinase control of protein stability and proteasomal degradation
rationale: Members are UCH and USP deubiquitinases and regulation of proteasomal catabolism and protein destabilization, unlike chain-linkage, proteasome-assembly and quality-control neighbours.

name: USP and UCH deubiquitinase control of protein degradation
rationale: Members concern USP/UCH deubiquitination and negative regulation of proteasomal degradation and protein stability, unlike confusables on E3 ligases, other DUB families, proteasome assembly, ERAD or autophagy.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell maintenance and restraint of lineage differentiation
rationale: Members regulate HSC proliferation, homeostasis and division and negatively regulate myeloid and B lineage differentiation, unlike confusables centred on RUNX1 programs, erythroid-megakaryocyte and granulocyte development.

qualifier: restraint of myeloid and B-lineage differentiation
name: Hematopoietic stem cell maintenance restraining myeloid and B-lineage differentiation
rationale: Members cover HSC homeostasis, proliferation and division plus negative regulation of macrophage, monocyte, granulocyte and B cell differentiation, whereas confusables emphasise RUNX1 programmes, erythroid/megakaryocyte lineages or bone marrow development.

qualifier: restraint of myeloid and B lineage differentiation
name: Hematopoietic stem cell maintenance and restraint of lineage differentiation
rationale: Members regulate HSC homeostasis, proliferation and division plus negative regulation of B, monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation (including VENTX), while confusables cover RUNX1-driven erythroid, megakaryocyte and granulocyte maturation or bone marrow development.

qualifier: choline, carnitine, creatine and lysophospholipid hydrolysis
name: Choline, carnitine, creatine and lysophospholipid metabolism
rationale: Members cover choline metabolism/transport, carnitine synthesis, creatine metabolism and LPC/LPE glycerophospholipid hydrolysis; the lysophospholipid and creatine members distinguish it from SAM-centred and acetylcholine/ATP-transport confusables.

name: Choline, carnitine and creatine metabolism with lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members share metabolism and transport of choline-derived and related amine nutrients (choline, carnitine, creatine, trimethylamine) plus LPC/LPE hydrolysis; the lysophospholipid and creatine content separates it from acetylcholine, SAM and FMO confusables.

name: Choline and carnitine metabolism with lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members cover choline transport/catabolism (incl. FMO3/TMAU), carnitine and creatine synthesis and LPC/LPE hydrolysis, distinguishing it from acetylcholine/phosphocreatine and SAM-centred neighbours.

core: Potassium channel control of membrane potential
qualifier: in touch, hearing and bladder smooth muscle
name: Potassium channel hyperpolarization in touch, hearing and bladder contraction
rationale: Members concern TREK, TRESK and calcium-activated potassium channels setting resting potential and hyperpolarization, with physiological outputs in touch, outer hair cells and micturition, unlike confusables on TASK/TWIK/KATP channels or action potential propagation.

core: Potassium channel control of membrane excitability
qualifier: TREK/TRESK and calcium-activated channels in mechanosensation and bladder
name: TREK/TRESK and calcium-activated potassium channels setting membrane excitability
rationale: Members are two-pore (TREK, TRESK) and Ca2+-activated K+ channels regulating resting potential, hyperpolarization and action potentials in touch, outer hair cells and urinary smooth muscle, unlike confusables centred on TASK/TWIK/THIK or KATP channels.

qualifier: TREK, TRESK and calcium-activated K+ channels
name: TREK, TRESK and calcium-activated K+ channels in excitability
rationale: Members concern TREK/TRESK and Ca2+-activated K+ channels setting resting potential and hyperpolarization in neurons, urinary smooth muscle, hair cells and touch, unlike TASK/TWIK/THIK or KATP channel confusables.

name: Atypical polyubiquitin chains and ISGylation in interferon antiviral response
rationale: Members combine non-K48/K63 ubiquitin chain formation (K6, K11, K27, K29, branched, free chains) with ISG15 conjugation and interferon-alpha antiviral restriction, unlike confusables centred on deubiquitinases, protein quality control or viral replication.

qualifier: atypical ubiquitin chain linkages and ISG15
name: Atypical ubiquitin chain and ISG15 conjugation in antiviral defense
rationale: Members combine non-K48/K63 ubiquitin chain assembly (K6, K11, K27, K29, branched, free chains) with interferon-induced ISG15 conjugation restricting viruses, while confusables are deubiquitinase sets or viral replication modulation.

name: Atypical ubiquitin chain assembly and ISG15 antiviral conjugation
rationale: Members cover non-K48/K63 (K6, K11, K27, K29, branched, free) ubiquitin chain formation plus ISG15 conjugation in interferon antiviral defence; the conjugation and ISG15 members separate it from the deubiquitinase confusables and from the viral-replication confusable.

qualifier: CDC42 and atypical members (RHOU/V/D/J, RND2/3), not RHOA/RAC
name: CDC42 and atypical Rho GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are CDC42, RHOU, RHOV, RHOD, RHOJ and RND2/3 GTPase cycles with their IQGAP/formin effectors and microvillus/Rac-antagonizing outputs, while confusables centre on RHOA/B/C and RAC1-3.

name: CDC42 and atypical Rho GTPase signaling
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles and effectors of CDC42 and atypical Rho GTPases (RND2/3, RHOD, RHOJ, RHOU, RHOV) acting via formins and IQGAPs, whereas confusables add the RAC and RHOA/B/C cycles and ROCK/PAK effectors.

name: CDC42-family and atypical Rho GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles and effectors (formins, IQGAPs, microvilli) of CDC42, RHOJ, RHOU, RHOV, RHOD and RND2/3, while confusables carry the RHOA/B/C and RAC cycles and their ROCK/PAK/WAVE effectors.

core: Epithelial anion and small solute transport
name: SLC26 inorganic anion exchange and epithelial solute transport
rationale: Members cover SLC26-mediated iodide, sulfate, oxalate and chloride exchange with aquaporin, gap junction and carboxylate transport, distinguishing it from bicarbonate/CFTR and cation-chloride cotransport confusables.

name: SLC26 anion exchange and epithelial small-solute transport
rationale: Members are transmembrane transport of inorganic anions via SLC26 (sulfate, oxalate, iodide, chloride) plus pyruvate, alpha-ketoglutarate, water and gap-junction transfer; these distinguish it from bicarbonate, CFTR and cation-chloride cotransporter confusables.

name: Epithelial anion and water transport via SLC26 exchangers
rationale: Members are SLC26 anion exchange (sulfate, oxalate, iodide, chloride), aquaporin water flux and organic anion (pyruvate, alpha-ketoglutarate) transport, distinguishing it from CFTR, bicarbonate and cation-chloride cotransporter neighbours.

qualifier: BAF complex assembly and apoptotic nuclear dismantling
name: BAF chromatin-remodeling complex assembly and apoptotic chromatin dismantling
rationale: Members combine assembly of SWI/SNF BAF chromatin-remodeling complex variants with apoptotic DNA fragmentation, chromosome condensation and lamina breakdown; the BAF members separate it from apoptosis/necroptosis and PAK-2p34 neighbours and the apoptotic members from nucleosome-assembly neighbours.

qualifier: BAF complex assembly plus apoptotic DNA fragmentation
name: BAF complex assembly and apoptotic chromatin dismantling
rationale: A composite of SWI/SNF BAF complex formation and apoptotic chromatin condensation, DNA fragmentation and lamina breakdown, distinct from nucleosome-assembly, necroptosis and PAK-2p34 neighbours.

qualifier: BAF complex assembly plus apoptotic nuclear dismantling
name: BAF chromatin remodeler assembly and apoptotic nuclear dismantling
rationale: Members fall into SWI/SNF BAF complex assembly variants and apoptotic DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation and lamina breakdown, united by large-scale chromatin reorganisation; the combination separates it from apoptosis-only and chromatin-assembly-only neighbours.

name: Glycine, threonine, alanine and creatine metabolism with gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members cover glycine/glyoxylate, threonine, alanine and creatine metabolism plus oxaloacetate/gluconeogenesis, while confusables centre on glutamate/aspartate, conjugation or choline/carnitine.

qualifier: threonine, alanine and glyoxylate metabolism feeding creatine synthesis and gluconeogenesis
name: Glycine-linked amino acid metabolism, creatine synthesis and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members link threonine, alanine and glyoxylate catabolism to glycine production, glycine use in creatine/phosphocreatine synthesis and carbon flow through oxaloacetate to gluconeogenesis; confusables lack creatine and instead hold carnitine/choline, glutamate/aspartate or glycine conjugation.

name: Glycine, threonine and alanine metabolism, creatine synthesis and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members cover glycine, threonine, alanine and glyoxylate metabolism feeding creatine synthesis and gluconeogenesis, distinguished from confusables by creatine/phosphocreatine and gluconeogenic oxaloacetate members.

name: PD-L1 turnover and HIV Nef/Vpu immune receptor downregulation
rationale: Members concern ubiquitin/ERAD-mediated removal of PD-L1, CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC I that tunes T cell responses, unlike antigen-presentation and proteasome-assembly confusables.

qualifier: PD-L1 turnover and HIV Nef/Vpu removal of CD4, CD8, CD28, MHC-I
name: Immune evasion via degradation of PD-L1, CD4 and MHC-I
rationale: Members concern ubiquitin/proteasome or lysosomal removal of immune surface proteins (PD-L1 regulation, Nef/Vpu targets), versus proteasome assembly and antigen-presentation confusables.

qualifier: PD-L1 turnover and HIV Nef/Vpu targets
name: PD-L1 turnover and HIV Nef/Vpu surface receptor downregulation
rationale: Members are PD-L1 glycosylation/degradation and HIV Nef/Vpu removal of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I with T cell anti-tumor regulation, unlike MHC-I presentation and proteasome confusables.

qualifier: antitumor T cell regulation and PD-L1
name: Liver regeneration, hepatocyte survival and antitumor T cell regulation
rationale: Members pair hepatocyte proliferation, differentiation and protection from death-receptor/TNF apoptosis with regulation of T cell immunity to tumors (PD-L1 degradation, STAT3); confusables are pro-apoptotic death-receptor or PD-L1-processing themes without the liver arm.

qualifier: with tumor immune evasion via PD-L1
name: Liver regeneration, hepatocyte survival and tumor immune evasion
rationale: Most members concern liver regeneration and hepatocyte proliferation protected from death-receptor apoptosis, while a minority covers PD-L1 and T cell anti-tumor regulation; confusables are pro-apoptotic death receptor signaling or PD-L1 processing alone.

qualifier: with PD-L1-linked anti-tumor T cell immunity
name: Liver regeneration, hepatocyte survival and PD-L1-linked tumor immunity
rationale: Members combine liver development/regeneration and suppression of death-receptor/TNF apoptosis with PD-L1 degradation and T cell responses to tumor cells, which the pro-apoptotic and PD-L1-transcription neighbours lack.

name: Thyroid hormone receptor signaling and liver development
rationale: Members are thyroid hormone/nuclear receptor transcription plus hepatocyte differentiation, proliferation and liver regeneration; neighbours share the thyroid receptor core but add retinoic acid, sex steroid or SREBP programs instead of liver.

name: Thyroid hormone receptor signalling and liver development
rationale: Members combine thyroid hormone/nuclear receptor transcription with hepatocyte differentiation, proliferation and liver regeneration, separating it from sex-steroid, retinoic acid, lipid-metabolic and SREBP nuclear-receptor neighbours.

qualifier: thyroid hormone receptor and liver development
name: Thyroid hormone receptor transcription and liver development
rationale: Members combine thyroid hormone receptor signaling and nuclear receptor transcription with hepatocyte proliferation, differentiation and liver regeneration; neighbours are sex steroid, metabolic or retinoic acid receptor programs without the liver terms.

name: Nitric oxide-cGMP signaling regulating renal sodium and water excretion
rationale: Members are NO/cGMP signaling with natriuresis, urine volume and glomerular filtration, unlike confusables on eNOS activation and vascular blood pressure control.

qualifier: renal sodium excretion and urine volume
name: Nitric oxide-cGMP signalling in renal natriuresis and diuresis
rationale: Members are NO/cGMP signalling and its renal effects on glomerular filtration, sodium excretion and blood volume, distinguishing it from endothelial eNOS and vascular tone confusables.

name: Nitric oxide-cGMP signaling in renal sodium and fluid excretion
rationale: Members are NO/cGMP signaling plus renal natriuresis, urine volume and glomerular filtration; the renal members distinguish it from eNOS and vascular blood-pressure confusables.

qualifier: ncRNA translational silencing, stabilization and splicing repression
name: ncRNA translational silencing, mRNA stabilization and splicing repression
rationale: Members concern miRNA/lncRNA/ceRNA translational silencing, IGF2BP/CRD mRNA stabilization and negative regulation of splicing, unlike confusables on small RNA biogenesis or mRNA decay machinery.

qualifier: stabilization, splicing repression and ceRNA silencing
name: mRNA stabilization, splicing repression and ceRNA–miRNA translational silencing
rationale: Members regulate mRNA fate by IGF2BP/CRD stabilization, splicing repression and lncRNA/ceRNA-miRNA translational silencing (PTEN), versus confusables on ARE-mediated decay, small RNA biogenesis or 3' processing.

qualifier: ncRNA silencing, mRNA stabilization and splicing repression
name: Post-transcriptional mRNA stabilization, ncRNA silencing and splicing repression
rationale: Members regulate mRNA fate via miRNA/lncRNA/ceRNA silencing, IGF2BP/CRD stabilization and negative regulation of splicing; confusables centre on small-RNA biogenesis, mRNA decay or 3'-end processing.

name: GDNF-RET and endothelin signalling in enteric nervous system development
rationale: Members combine RET/GDNF and endothelin receptor signalling with enteric neural crest migration, midgut development and peristalsis, unlike confusables about catecholaminergic sympathetic development or gastrointestinal smooth muscle and gastric function.

name: Enteric nervous system development via RET and endothelin
rationale: Members combine enteric/neural crest and midgut development and peristalsis with RET/GDNF-receptor and endothelin signalling (including vascular endothelin effects); confusables instead add catecholamine/adrenal development or GI smooth muscle contraction and lack RET/GDNF and endothelin blood-pressure members.

name: RET and endothelin signaling in enteric nervous system development
rationale: Members cover GDNF/RET and endothelin signaling, neural crest migration, midgut/enteric neuron development and peristalsis, plus endothelin vascular effects that the GI smooth-muscle and sympathetic/catecholamine confusables lack.

name: Recombination-based telomere maintenance and break-induced replication
rationale: Members cover telomere capping and recombination/D-loop/t-circle-based telomere maintenance plus break-induced replication and intra-S checkpoint; neighbours either lack the telomere processes or the break-induced replication and cell-division components.

name: Recombinational telomere maintenance and break-induced replication
rationale: Members concern telomere protection and recombination-based maintenance (D-loop, t-circles) together with break-induced replication and recombination-intermediate resolution, which the telomere-packaging and general DNA-repair neighbours lack.

name: Telomere maintenance by recombination and break-induced replication
