rationale: Members cover telomere capping, D-loop, t-circle and recombination-based telomere maintenance plus DNA unwinding; unlike the other telomere neighbours it includes break-induced replication, resolution of recombination intermediates and intra-S checkpoint.

qualifier: proteasome assembly and HIV Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation
name: Proteasome assembly and HIV Nef/Vpu-mediated immune receptor downregulation
rationale: Members combine proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-proteasome antigen processing with HIV Nef/Vpu degradation of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I, unlike confusables on MHC loading/cross-presentation or PD-L1 turnover.

qualifier: HIV Nef/Vpu downregulation of immune receptors
name: Proteasome function and HIV Nef/Vpu immune receptor downregulation
rationale: Members cover proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-proteasome antigen processing plus HIV Nef/Vpu-driven degradation of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I, unlike confusables on MHC peptide loading, cross-presentation or PD-L1 degradation.

qualifier: proteasome assembly and HIV Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation
name: Proteasome assembly and HIV Nef/Vpu receptor degradation
rationale: Members combine proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-proteasome antigen processing with HIV Nef/Vpu-driven degradation of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC I, unlike confusables on MHC peptide loading or PD-L1 degradation.

name: Proteasome-dependent MHC class I antigen processing and loading
rationale: Members are proteasome assembly and function together with endogenous and cross-presented peptide loading onto MHC class I; the class I loading arm separates it from the Nef/Vpu and PD-L1 neighbours and the proteasome arm from broader MHC class II neighbours.

name: Proteasome assembly and MHC class I antigen processing
rationale: Members combine proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-independent degradation with MHC-I peptide loading, ER transport and cross-presentation, unlike broader MHC-II, Nef/Vpu or PD-L1 confusables.

name: Proteasome-dependent MHC class I antigen processing and loading
rationale: Members link proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-independent degradation to MHC class I peptide loading, endogenous and cross-presentation; confusables either lack the MHC class I loading members (PD-L1, Nef/Vpu) or lack the proteasome members (broad antigen presentation).

qualifier: chemokine and integrin-mediated T cell homing
name: Chemokine and integrin-mediated leukocyte homing and T cell migration
rationale: Members share chemokine-guided, integrin-dependent leukocyte (especially T cell) migration and homing, versus confusables on monocyte, B cell or lymphoid-organ trafficking.

qualifier: chemokine- and integrin-guided T cell homing
name: Chemokine- and integrin-mediated T cell migration and homing
rationale: Members concern chemokine-receptor signalling, integrin adhesion and T cell/lymphocyte homing; the T cell and integrin focus distinguishes it from lymphoid organ/B cell, monocyte CCR2/CX3CR1 and NK/DC chemotaxis confusables.

qualifier: chemokine- and integrin-mediated T cell migration
name: Chemokine- and integrin-mediated T cell migration and homing
rationale: Members are chemokine-receptor signaling, integrin adhesion and T cell chemotaxis/homing, distinguished from monocyte CCR2/CX3CR1, lymphoid organ and B cell migration confusables.

qualifier: nuclear receptor transcription and vitamin D synthesis
name: SREBP and nuclear receptor control of sterol synthesis
rationale: Members are SREBP activation, cholesterol homeostasis and SREBF promoter-motif sets plus nuclear receptor transcription, receptor SUMOylation and vitamin D biosynthesis regulation; the nuclear receptor and vitamin members are what confusables (ER lipid transport, ATF6/CREB3, ChREBP) lack.

qualifier: SREBP activation and nuclear receptor transcription
name: SREBP- and nuclear receptor-driven cholesterol homeostasis transcription
rationale: Members combine SREBP activation and its promoter motifs, nuclear receptor transcription and positive regulation of cholesterol/vitamin D synthesis, whereas confusables add ChREBP glucose sensing, negative sterol feedback/ER transport, fatty acid response or ATF6.

qualifier: nuclear receptor and vitamin D regulation
name: SREBP cholesterol homeostasis with nuclear receptor/vitamin D regulation
rationale: Members combine SREBP target activation and cholesterol homeostasis with nuclear receptor transcription, receptor SUMOylation and vitamin D/vitamin metabolism regulation, the latter absent from the ATF6, ChREBP and fatty acid confusables.

name: Chromatin remodeler and corepressor regulation of transcription
rationale: Members involve NuRD, CHD6-9, ChAHP, Polycomb and CTCF/cohesin chromatin regulators, arginine methylation and SUMOylation of cofactors controlling genes such as PTEN and PD-L1, whereas confusables focus on BAF assembly, histone acetylation or lysine methylation/DNA methylation.

name: Chromatin remodeler and corepressor regulation of gene transcription
rationale: Members include NuRD, CHD6-9, ChAHP, Polycomb and CTCF modules, arginine methylation and SUMOylation of chromatin cofactors controlling PTEN and PD-L1 transcription, while confusables emphasize BAF assembly, histone acetylation or DNA/histone methylation.

name: Transcriptional co-regulation by NuRD/CHD remodelers and SUMOylation
rationale: Members involve chromatin co-regulators (NuRD, CHD6-9, ChAHP, arginine methyltransferases, Polycomb/CTCF modules, SUMOylated cofactors) controlling target genes such as PTEN and PD-L1, whereas confusables emphasise BAF assembly, histone acetylation, DNA methylation and retroelement silencing.

core: p53 regulation in the DNA damage response
qualifier: p53 stability, phosphorylation and DNA damage checkpoint control
name: p53 stabilization and activity after DNA damage
rationale: Members cover p53 degradation, phosphorylation and target transcription plus gamma-radiation response, G2 damage checkpoint and Cdc25A/CDK inhibition; unlike the confusables they centre on p53 control rather than G2/M mitotic progression, G1/S RB-E2F or APC/C cell-cycle machinery.

name: DNA damage checkpoint with p53 phosphorylation and turnover
rationale: Members cover radiation-induced G2 checkpoint signalling, CDK inhibition and p53 transcriptional outputs, distinguished from cell-cycle confusables by regulation of p53 through phosphorylation and degradation (TP53, COP1, Cdc25A turnover) and serine/threonine (de)phosphorylation.

qualifier: p53 and Cdc25A phospho-regulation and turnover
name: p53 phospho-regulation and turnover in DNA damage checkpoint
rationale: Members cover DNA damage checkpoint signaling via p53 phosphorylation, degradation and target transcription plus Cdc25A/CDK inhibition and (de)phosphorylation, unlike confusables centred on G1/S, G2/M cell-cycle machinery or replication.

name: Monocyte trafficking and inhibitory control of leukocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members regulate leukocyte migration, mostly negatively (monocyte, macrophage, T cell chemotaxis, integrin adhesion) with CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte modules, whereas confusables emphasize positive monocyte activation and chemokine clusters.

qualifier: CCR2/CX3CR1 axis and negative regulation of leukocyte migration
name: CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte chemotaxis and its negative regulation
rationale: Members combine CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte trafficking modules with mostly negative regulation of chemokine signaling and leukocyte migration, whereas confusables carry positive monocyte chemotaxis, activation and chemokine binding.

name: Monocyte trafficking and negative regulation of leukocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members combine CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte trafficking modules with inhibition of monocyte, macrophage and T cell migration and chemokine signaling, whereas neighbours emphasize chemokine ligands and positive monocyte recruitment.

qualifier: ICOS/Tfh help for germinal center B cell differentiation
name: Lymphocyte activation with ICOS-Tfh germinal center B help
rationale: Members cover T and B cell development/activation, ICOS costimulation, Tfh differentiation and germinal center B differentiation, distinguishing it from B-cell signature, BCR signaling, TCR/CD28 and thymic selection confusables.

core: T and B lymphocyte development and activation
qualifier: T follicular helper and germinal center B cell interaction
name: T-B lymphocyte activation and germinal center Tfh help
rationale: Members span thymocyte and T/B cell differentiation and activation, distinguished from BCR, thymic selection, B cell signature and TCR/CD28 confusables by ICOS costimulation, Tfh differentiation and germinal center B cell differentiation.

core: T and B lymphocyte development and activation
name: T and B lymphocyte activation in germinal centre responses
rationale: Members span T and B cell development and activation with Tfh differentiation, ICOS costimulation and germinal centre B differentiation, whereas neighbours are B-only signatures/BCR signalling or T-only TCR, thymic and CD28 programs.

qualifier: growth factor (TGFb/SMAD, PDGF, KRAS) and mechanoresponsive YAP/TAZ drive
name: Fibroblast activation by growth factors and mechanical cues
rationale: Members combine TGFb/SMAD2/3, PDGF, KRAS and FOSL signatures, fibroblast proliferation, paracrine signalling and mechanoresponsive stromal modules, whereas confusables are dominated by ECM composition, adhesion or PDGFR pathway regulation.

qualifier: by PDGF, TGF-beta and YAP/TAZ mechanical cues
name: Fibroblast activation by PDGF, TGF-beta and mechanical cues
rationale: Members are mechanoresponsive YAP/TAZ fibroblast modules, PDGF response, fibroblast proliferation, SMAD2/3, TGF-beta2 and paracrine VEGF production, whereas confusables focus on extracellular matrix components, adhesion and PDGFR pathway regulation.

qualifier: YAP/TAZ mechanoresponse and growth factor production
name: Mechanoresponsive fibroblast activation and growth factor output
rationale: Members are fibroblast/stromal programmes (YAP/TAZ-CCN targets, fibroblast proliferation, PDGF response, SMAD2/3, FOSL1/2, KRAS-up) with VEGF/TGFB2 paracrine output, whereas confusables centre on PDGF receptor regulation, adhesion or ECM/EMT modules.

name: Basement membrane assembly with collagen crosslinking and integrin–laminin binding
rationale: Members cover basement membrane assembly, collagen trimerization, crosslinking and anchoring fibrils, and integrin/laminin/DDR binding, unlike confusables on elastic fibres, hemidesmosomes, collagen biosynthesis or the dystrophin complex.

name: Basement membrane collagen crosslinking and laminin-integrin adhesion
rationale: Members concern collagen trimerization, oxidative crosslinking and anchoring fibrils with laminin/integrin and collagen-receptor interactions, distinguishing them from elastic fibre/fibronectin, hemidesmosome and dystroglycan confusables.

name: Basement membrane assembly and collagen-laminin-integrin interactions
rationale: Members cover basement membrane assembly, laminin and integrin interactions, collagen trimerisation, oxidative crosslinking and collagen receptor signalling, unlike elastic fibre, hemidesmosome, dystroglycan or collagen biosynthesis confusables.

name: Regulation of oxidative and hypoxic stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate intrinsic cell death and mitochondrial depolarization triggered by hydrogen peroxide, oxidative stress, hypoxia and oxygen-glucose deprivation; confusables instead centre on MOMP/cytochrome c, respiration or ferroptosis.

core: Oxidative and hypoxic stress-induced cell death
name: Regulation of oxidative and hypoxic stress-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate H2O2-, oxidative- and hypoxia-induced intrinsic apoptosis and mitochondrial depolarization, unlike confusables on respiration control, ferroptosis or MOMP.

name: Regulation of oxidative and hypoxic stress-induced intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate hydrogen peroxide-, oxidative stress- and hypoxia/oxygen-glucose deprivation-triggered intrinsic apoptosis and mitochondrial depolarization; confusables instead regulate respiration/OXPHOS, ferroptosis or MOMP/cytochrome c release.

qualifier: with GLUT4 translocation and RHOQ/RHOT GTPase cycles
name: Endosomal trafficking, GLUT4 translocation and RHOQ/RHOT GTPase cycles
rationale: Members concern early endosome sorting, transcytosis, pinocytosis and membrane targeting; the RHOQ/RHOT GTPase cycles and GLUT4 translocation distinguish it from neighbours focused on endocytic cargo recognition, macropinocytosis or recycling.

core: Endosomal and vesicle trafficking to membranes
qualifier: atypical RHOQ and RHOT GTPases, GLUT4 translocation
name: Endosomal trafficking and RHOQ/RHOT GTPase cycles
rationale: Members concern endosomal transport, pinocytosis, transcytosis and membrane targeting (including GLUT4 translocation) together with RHOQ and RHOT GTPase cycles, which the endocytosis and macropinocytosis neighbours lack.

core: Endosomal trafficking and membrane protein targeting
name: Early endosome trafficking and GLUT4 plasma membrane translocation
rationale: Members concern early endosome transport, pinocytosis, transcytosis and targeting of proteins to membranes, including GLUT4 translocation and RHOQ/RHOT GTPase cycles; unlike neighbours it lacks clathrin/caveolin endocytosis, receptor internalization and macropinocytosis terms.

name: Action potential regulation including sinoatrial pacemaking
rationale: All members regulate action potential generation or propagation, and the SA-node and HCN members distinguish the theme from confusables about resting membrane potential and two-pore K+ channels.

qualifier: HCN pacemaker and calcium-activated K+ channels
name: Action potential firing and SA node pacemaker currents
rationale: Members regulate action potential generation and propagation including SA node pacemaking via HCN and Ca2+-activated K+ channels, while confusables centre on resting membrane potential and K2P/KATP channels.

qualifier: SA-node pacemaker depolarization by HCN channels
name: Action potential regulation and SA-node pacemaker depolarization
rationale: Members regulate action potential firing, propagation and hyperpolarization including HCN-driven SA node depolarization, while confusables concern resting membrane potential and K2P or KATP leak channels.

name: Growth hormone–IGF and thyroid hormone control of growth
rationale: Members combine GH receptor/JAK-STAT and IGF signaling with thyroid hormone transport and action; confusables have only one arm or add leptin/prolactin.

qualifier: growth hormone JAK-STAT and thyroid hormone action
name: Growth hormone and thyroid hormone control of somatic growth
rationale: Members combine growth hormone receptor JAK-STAT signalling, IGF receptor potentiation and organismal growth with thyroid hormone transport, activity and response, distinguishing it from thyroid-receptor, leptin/prolactin and glucagon/somatostatin confusables.

name: Growth hormone and thyroid hormone control of somatic growth
rationale: Members combine GH receptor/JAK-STAT and IGF signalling for organism growth with thyroid hormone transport, activity and response, the thyroid arm being absent from leptin/prolactin confusables and the GH arm absent from the thyroid confusable.

name: Activin-FSH axis in Sertoli cell and testis development
rationale: Members combine activin/follistatin, AMH and FSH/LH secretion signalling with Sertoli cell proliferation and seminiferous tubule development, contrasting with the ovarian follicle and GnRH-response confusables.

name: Activin, AMH and FSH signaling in Sertoli cell development
rationale: Members combine activin/follistatin, AMH and FSH/LH glycoprotein hormone signaling with Sertoli cell proliferation and seminiferous tubule development, whereas neighbours concern ovarian follicle, LH and GnRH responses.

name: Activin and FSH signalling in testis Sertoli cell development
rationale: Members combine FSH/gonadotropin and activin/AMH signalling with Sertoli cell proliferation and seminiferous tubule development, whereas neighbours concern LH, GnRH and ovarian follicle biology.

core: Regulation of cytosolic nucleic acid sensing to interferon-beta
qualifier: negative regulators of RIG-I and cGAS–STING
name: Negative regulation of RIG-I and cGAS–STING interferon-beta induction
rationale: Members regulate IFN-beta/alpha production from RIG-I/MDA5 and cGAS–STING sensing, predominantly as negative regulators (TREX1, DDX58/IFIH1 inhibitors), unlike the confusables built on positive IRF3/TBK1 activation.

core: Regulation of type I interferon induction by cytosolic nucleic acid sensors
qualifier: negative regulation of RIG-I and cGAS-STING, TREX1
name: Regulation of IFN-beta production restraining RIG-I and cGAS-STING
rationale: Members tune IFN-alpha/beta production and response, with emphasis on negative regulators of RIG-I/MDA5 and cGAS-STING such as TREX1, whereas confusables cover the positive IRF3/TBK1 activation arm.

qualifier: negative control of RIG-I and cGAS-STING
name: Interferon-beta production control with RIG-I/cGAS-STING negative regulation
rationale: Members regulate type I IFN (mainly IFN-beta) induction by nucleic-acid sensors, dominated by negative regulation of RIG-I, cGAS-STING and TREX1; this restraint distinguishes it from neighbours that activate IRF3/RIG-I/MDA5 signaling.

core: Mitochondrial adenine nucleotide and NAD transport
qualifier: ANT-mediated viral apoptosis and nicotinate/NAD salvage
name: Mitochondrial adenine nucleotide translocation, viral permeabilization and NAD salvage
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial ADP/ATP and NAD transport, adenine transport, nicotinate/NAD salvage and catabolism, and viral apoptosis via outer-membrane permeabilization, unlike confusables on nucleotide interconversion, creatine or tryptophan-kynurenine NAD synthesis.

core: NAD and adenine nucleotide metabolism and transport
qualifier: mitochondrial adenine nucleotide translocase, viral apoptosis
name: NAD salvage and mitochondrial adenine nucleotide translocase transport
rationale: Members are nicotinate/NAD salvage and catabolism plus mitochondrial ATP/ADP/NAD transport, including viral apoptosis through the translocase; confusables are tryptophan-kynurenine NAD synthesis or nucleotide interconversion without the transport and viral apoptosis members.

core: Mitochondrial adenine nucleotide and NAD transport
qualifier: nicotinate/NAD salvage and virus-induced mitochondrial permeabilization
name: Mitochondrial adenine nucleotide transport, NAD salvage and viral apoptosis
rationale: Members concern mitochondrial ATP/ADP/NAD carriers, nicotinate/NAD salvage and catabolism, and viral (Vpr, influenza) apoptosis via outer-membrane permeabilization, the last being what distinguishes it from nucleotide interconversion, creatine and tryptophan-NAD confusables.

name: Nucleoside transport and mitochondrial membrane permeabilization
rationale: Most members are plasma-membrane purine/pyrimidine nucleoside and nucleobase transport, joined by mitochondrial depolarization/outer-membrane permeabilization in apoptosis, which the drug-transport and nucleotide-interconversion confusables lack.

name: Nucleoside transport and mitochondrial membrane permeabilization
rationale: Most members are purine/pyrimidine nucleoside and nucleobase transport across membranes, joined by mitochondrial depolarization/outer-membrane permeabilization and apoptosis terms that the drug-ADME and nucleotide-interconversion confusables lack.

name: Nucleoside-nucleobase transport and mitochondrial apoptotic depolarization
rationale: Most members are plasma-membrane purine/pyrimidine nucleoside and nucleobase transport, and unlike the confusables (nucleotide interconversion, ADP/ATP mitochondrial carriers, antiviral drug ADME) the theme adds mitochondrial depolarization and intrinsic apoptosis regulation.

qualifier: plasma membrane reuptake transporters and vesicular loading
name: Norepinephrine and dopamine transporter reuptake with vesicular loading
rationale: Members cover norepinephrine/dopamine transporter (SLC6A2/SLC6A3) uptake and their defects plus synaptic vesicle loading and acidification, while confusables add generic monoamine transport, catecholamine synthesis or degradation.

core: Catecholamine reuptake and synaptic vesicle loading
name: Norepinephrine reuptake and synaptic vesicle loading and acidification
rationale: Members cover norepinephrine/epinephrine plasma-membrane uptake (SLC6A2, SLC6A3 defects) and neurotransmitter loading into acidified synaptic vesicles; the vesicle acidification and epinephrine/organic cation transport members are what the dopamine/monoamine-transport and catecholamine-metabolism confusables lack.

name: Catecholamine reuptake and synaptic vesicle loading
rationale: Members cover norepinephrine/dopamine/epinephrine uptake by SLC6A2/SLC6A3 and their defects plus vesicular loading and lumen acidification, which the general catecholamine transport, biosynthesis, degradation and serotonin confusables lack.

core: Thyroid hormone and amino acid transport
qualifier: iodide and neutral amino acid carriers
name: Thyroid hormone, iodide and neutral amino acid transport
rationale: Members cover membrane transport of thyroid hormone and iodide (NIS) and of neutral amino acids (leucine, isoleucine, phenylalanine, glutamine, alanine), distinguishing it from confusables on cationic amino acid, polyamine or inositol transport.

core: Neutral amino acid and thyroid hormone transport
qualifier: with iodide uptake for thyroid hormone generation
name: Neutral amino acid, thyroid hormone and iodide transport
rationale: Members combine neutral amino acid transporters (which also carry thyroid hormone) with thyroid hormone transport, iodide uptake and hormone generation, distinguishing it from confusables on cationic amino acid, polyamine or inositol transport.

qualifier: with iodide and thyroid hormone transport
name: Neutral amino acid, iodide and thyroid hormone transport
rationale: Members cover membrane transport of large and small neutral amino acids alongside thyroid hormone and iodide transport and thyroid hormone generation, the thyroid component separating it from confusables on cationic amino acid, polyamine and inositol transport.

name: Circadian clock transcription and sleep/wake regulation
rationale: Members combine BMAL1:CLOCK/NPAS-driven and FOXO/NPAS4 transcription with sleep/wake, locomotor rhythm and clock-linked beta-cell regulation, distinguishing it from orexin/feeding and gluconeogenic confusables.

name: Circadian clock-driven transcription and sleep-wake regulation
rationale: Members cover BMAL1/CLOCK/NPAS-driven circadian transcription, locomotor rhythm and sleep/wake regulation with clock-linked beta-cell proliferation and FOXO outputs, distinguishing them from orexin/feeding and gluconeogenic confusables.

name: Circadian transcriptional control of sleep and beta-cell proliferation
rationale: Members link CLOCK/BMAL1, NPAS4 and FOXO transcription to sleep-wake cycles, locomotor rhythm and beta-cell proliferation, whereas confusables concern orexin feeding behaviour or gluconeogenesis.

core: Striated muscle calcium transport and excitability
qualifier: inhibitory control including SERCA and fiber-type switching
name: Inhibition of striated muscle calcium transport and excitability
rationale: Members are negative regulation of plasma-membrane and SR calcium flux, SERCA activity, K+ export and action potentials in muscle (a phospholamban/sarcolipin-like profile), unlike neighbours focused on cardiac action-potential phases, contraction force or Ca2+ release.

name: Muscle ion transport inhibition, including SERCA calcium uptake
rationale: Members are mostly negative regulation of calcium and potassium transport, action potentials and SERCA-mediated SR calcium import in striated muscle, unlike confusables about calcium release, heart rate or cardiac repolarization channels.

core: Inhibition of striated muscle ion transport
qualifier: calcium pump and membrane ion flux
name: Inhibition of striated muscle calcium pump and membrane ion flux
rationale: Members negatively regulate plasma-membrane calcium and potassium transport, action potentials and ATPase-coupled calcium uptake into sarcoplasmic reticulum in striated muscle; confusables centre on ryanodine-mediated release, cardiac contraction or repolarizing potassium channels.

name: Vitamin C-centred antioxidant defence and redox homeostasis
rationale: Members are ascorbate metabolism, transport and response, vitamin E and selenium responses, ROS detoxification and redox homeostasis, distinct from iron, BH4/NOS, thyroid-H2O2 and aldehyde/NADPH confusables.

qualifier: dietary antioxidants vitamin C, vitamin E and selenium
name: Vitamin C, vitamin E and selenium antioxidant redox defence
rationale: Members concern ROS detoxification and redox homeostasis together with ascorbate metabolism/transport and responses to vitamin E and selenium, distinct from confusables on BH4/NO synthase, thyroid H2O2, iron/oxygen sensing or NADPH-aldehyde detoxification.

name: Ascorbate and antioxidant micronutrient defence against oxidative stress
rationale: Members link vitamin C metabolism and transport, vitamin E and selenium responses with ROS detoxification and redox homeostasis, distinct from confusables on iron, BH4/NO, thyroid peroxide or NADPH/aldehyde detoxification.

name: Nuclear envelope remodeling and integrin-ILK cytoskeletal anchoring
rationale: Members cover nuclear envelope/lamina disassembly and reassembly and nuclear positioning, plus PINCH-ILK-parvin focal adhesion and actin capping that confusables on ESCRT sealing, cytokinesis and NPC lack.

name: Nuclear envelope-lamina dynamics and ILK-integrin cytoskeletal adhesion
rationale: Members join nuclear envelope/lamina disassembly, reassembly and positioning with PINCH-ILK-parvin integrin adhesion, unlike confusables on ESCRT sealing and cytokinesis or nuclear pore complex assembly.

name: Nuclear envelope remodeling and integrin-linked cytoskeletal adhesion
rationale: Members cover nuclear lamina/membrane disassembly and reassembly, nuclear positioning and enucleation together with ILK-PINCH-parvin focal adhesion, integrin signaling and actin capping, the latter absent from the ESCRT sealing, nuclear pore and cytokinesis confusables.

name: Rab GTPase cycle and prenylation in vesicle docking
rationale: Members concern Rab/Arf GEF, GAP and geranylgeranylation control together with vesicle docking and SNARE assembly; the docking/SNARE component distinguishes it from Rho/Ral GTPase and Golgi tethering confusables.

core: Rab GTPase regulation and vesicle docking
name: Rab GTPase cycle, geranylgeranylation and SNARE-dependent vesicle docking
rationale: Members concern Rab GEF/GAP cycling, Rab prenylation, ARF signalling and SNARE-dependent vesicle docking, distinct from confusables on Golgi tethering/organization and general GTPase activity.

core: Rab GTPase regulation in vesicle docking
qualifier: prenylation, GEF/GAP cycling and SNARE assembly
name: Rab GTPase prenylation and cycling in vesicle docking
rationale: All members concern small GTPase (Rab, ARF) regulation by geranylgeranylation, GEFs and GAPs and its role in vesicle docking, SNARE assembly and receptor delivery, distinguished from confusables on Golgi organization, vesicle tethering/targeting and Rho/Ral GTPase activity.

qualifier: S-adenosylmethionine use for choline, creatine and carnitine
name: S-adenosylmethionine methyl metabolism of choline, creatine and carnitine
rationale: Members cover SAM synthesis/hydrolysis defects and methyl-consuming choline, creatine and carnitine pathways, distinct from methionine salvage, acyl-CoA and choline transport confusables.

name: Methyl-donor metabolism of SAM, choline, creatine and carnitine
rationale: Members cover SAM metabolism and its defects (MAT1A, AHCY), choline catabolism and the methylation-dependent synthesis of creatine and carnitine, differing from methionine-salvage, phospholipid and short-chain acyl-CoA confusables.

name: Methyl-group metabolism of SAM, choline, creatine and carnitine
rationale: Members center on S-adenosylmethionine-linked methyl metabolism and its products creatine and carnitine plus choline/threonine catabolism, distinguishing it from methionine salvage, fatty acyl-CoA and gluconeogenic confusables.

name: Residue hydroxylation, oxidation, diphthamide and selenocysteine formation
rationale: Members are unusual residue modifications (lysine/proline hydroxylation, formylglycine oxidation in arylsulfatases, diphthamide on EEF2, selenocysteine insertion), separating them from hypusine/wybutosine, methylation and tRNA aminoacylation confusables.

name: Special amino acid residue modification and translational recoding
rationale: Members form unusual protein residues (diphthamide, selenocysteine, hydroxylysine/proline, formylglycine in arylsulfatases, oxidation) or recode stop codons, unlike confusables centred on hypusine, tRNA modification or collagen crosslinking/methylation.

name: Protein hydroxylation, diphthamide and selenocysteine residue modification
rationale: Members are unusual residue modifications (proline/lysine hydroxylation, diphthamide on EEF2 histidine, formylglycine activation of sulfatases, selenocysteine insertion), distinct from confusables centred on tRNA modification, hypusine or methylation.

name: mRNA polyadenylation, translation termination and nonsense-mediated decay
rationale: Members link mRNA 3'-end cleavage/polyadenylation with translation termination, non-stop ribosome release and NMD, while confusables cover mRNA stabilization/decapping, histone mRNA processing or splicing and nuclear export.

core: mRNA 3'-end processing and translation-termination quality control
name: mRNA polyadenylation and termination-coupled nonsense and non-stop decay
rationale: Members link mRNA cleavage/polyadenylation and intronless mRNA processing with translation termination and the NMD and non-stop decay pathways that monitor it, distinguishing it from confusables about histone mRNA processing, deadenylation/decapping decay, splicing or no-go decay.

name: mRNA polyadenylation, translation termination and nonsense-mediated decay
rationale: Members link mRNA cleavage/polyadenylation to translation termination, NMD and non-stop ribosome release, unlike confusables on deadenylation/decapping decay, histone mRNA or splicing.

qualifier: cGMP/nitric oxide vasodilation and renal natriuresis
name: Blood pressure lowering via cGMP vasodilation and natriuresis
rationale: Members concern reduction of systemic and pulmonary blood pressure through cGMP/NO signaling, reduced vasoconstriction and renal sodium and water excretion, unlike the renin-angiotensin pressor and smooth muscle contraction confusables.

core: Blood pressure lowering by cGMP signaling
name: Natriuretic peptide-cGMP blood pressure lowering and natriuresis
rationale: Members concern natriuretic peptide/NO-cGMP signaling that lowers systemic and pulmonary pressure, inhibits vasoconstriction and increases renal sodium and water excretion, unlike smooth-muscle contraction, renin-angiotensin or generic cyclic-nucleotide-response confusables.

name: Blood pressure lowering via cGMP, vasodilation and natriuresis
rationale: Members reduce arterial and pulmonary pressure through NO/cGMP signaling, inhibited vasoconstriction and renal sodium/water excretion, unlike renin-angiotensin pressor or smooth-muscle contraction confusables.

core: Intestinal epithelial homeostasis and antimicrobial defense
qualifier: intestinal epithelium development, stem cells and microbiota with defensins
name: Intestinal epithelium homeostasis and defensin antimicrobial defense
rationale: Members combine intestinal epithelial development, structure and stem cell maintenance with alpha/beta defensins and antimicrobial/anti-helminth responses, whereas confusables are generic mucosal antimicrobial peptide themes lacking the intestinal epithelial programme.

core: Intestinal epithelial barrier and antimicrobial defense
qualifier: intestinal epithelial development and stem cell homeostasis
name: Intestinal epithelial barrier development and antimicrobial defense
rationale: Members combine intestinal epithelial identity, development, stem cell homeostasis and microbiota modulation with defensin and anti-nematode defense; the epithelial development and maintenance terms are what the antimicrobial-only confusables lack.

name: Intestinal epithelial homeostasis and defensin-mediated antimicrobial defense
rationale: Members combine intestinal epithelial development, stem-cell and barrier maintenance with defensins, microbiota shaping and anti-nematode/chitin defense; confusables have antimicrobial peptides but lack the intestinal epithelial maintenance members.

name: Dendritic cell and macrophage chemokine production and recruitment
rationale: Members regulate CCL/CXCL chemokine and DC cytokine production and macrophage chemotaxis, unlike the Th1/IFN-gamma, inflammasome and neutrophil confusables.

qualifier: monocyte-macrophage recruitment and dendritic cell cytokine output
name: Myeloid chemokine production and monocyte-macrophage recruitment
rationale: Members regulate production of CCL2, CCL3, CCL5, CXCL1/2 and dendritic-cell cytokines and macrophage chemotaxis, distinguishing the theme from Th1/IFN-gamma, inflammasome and neutrophil-recruitment confusables.

name: Chemokine production by macrophages and dendritic cells
rationale: Members regulate CCL/CXCL chemokine and dendritic cell cytokine production and macrophage chemotaxis, distinguishing it from Th1, inflammasome and neutrophil-recruitment confusables.

qualifier: IL-5 signaling and restraint of Th2 cytokines
name: Eosinophil differentiation, activation and IL-5 signaling
rationale: Members centre on eosinophil (and related granulocyte/mast cell) development, migration and activation with IL-5 signaling and negative control of IL-4/IL-5/Th2, while confusables centre on positive Th2 differentiation, IL-4/13/33 signaling and IgE switching.

qualifier: with restraint of Th2 cytokine output
name: Eosinophil development, activation and migration with Th2 restraint
rationale: Members are eosinophil and mast cell differentiation, IL-5 signalling, eosinophil activation and chemotaxis plus negative regulation of IL-4/IL-5/Th2, whereas confusables are dominated by positive Th2, IL-13 and IL-33 programmes.

qualifier: IL-5-driven, with negative Th2 cytokine regulation
name: IL-5-driven eosinophil development with negative Th2 cytokine regulation
rationale: Members cover IL-5 signaling, eosinophil (and mast cell) differentiation, migration and activation plus restraint of Th2/IL-4/IL-5 production, whereas confusables are Th2 induction, IL-4/13/33 signaling and IgE switching.

name: DAP12-linked microglial activation and neuron remodeling
rationale: Members describe microglial/macrophage activation, proliferation, migration, cytotoxicity and fusion with DAP12 signaling and neuron remodeling; confusables instead centre on amyloid-beta and apoptotic cell clearance.

qualifier: DAP12 signaling, without amyloid-beta or apoptotic cell clearance
name: DAP12-mediated microglial activation, migration and cytotoxicity
rationale: Members describe microglial/macrophage activation, migration, proliferation, cytotoxicity, fusion and neuron remodeling with DAP12 signaling; confusables add amyloid-beta and apoptotic-cell clearance that this theme lacks.

qualifier: DAP12 signaling and macrophage fusion, without amyloid or apoptotic-cell clearance
name: Microglial activation, proliferation and DAP12 signaling
rationale: Members describe microglial activation, migration, proliferation, cytotoxicity and survival with DAP12 signaling and macrophage fusion; confusables are defined by amyloid-beta handling and apoptotic cell clearance.

core: Cyclic nucleotide control of blood pressure and natriuresis
name: Natriuretic peptide-cGMP control of natriuresis, heart rate and pressure
rationale: Members are cGMP synthesis and receptor guanylyl cyclase signaling, neuropeptide catabolism, sodium excretion, urine volume and heart rate, distinguishing the natriuretic arm from renin-angiotensin and vasoconstriction confusables.

core: Cyclic nucleotide control of fluid and blood pressure
name: Natriuretic peptide-cGMP control of sodium excretion and blood pressure
rationale: Members cover cGMP synthesis and receptor guanylyl cyclase signaling, natriuresis, diuresis, heart rate and neural blood pressure control, whereas confusables are dominated by renin-angiotensin, endothelin and vasoconstriction.

qualifier: in natriuresis, diuresis and heart rate
name: Cyclic nucleotide signaling in natriuresis, diuresis and heart rate
rationale: Members concern cGMP/cAMP responses, guanylyl cyclase signaling and neuropeptide catabolism linked to sodium excretion, urine volume, heart rate and neural blood pressure control, unlike renin-angiotensin and vasoconstriction confusables.

name: Receptor internalization, recycling and cell-surface localization control
rationale: Members regulate clathrin cargo recognition, GPCR/receptor internalization, endocytic recycling and protein levels at the cell surface, whereas the confusables add postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptor trafficking, Rab/ARF signaling and Golgi/secretory transport.

name: Regulation of receptor internalization and recycling to cell surface
rationale: Members regulate receptor (including GPCR) internalization, endocytic recycling and cell-surface protein localization, unlike confusables focused on postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptor trafficking or Rab/ARF signaling.

core: Regulation of receptor internalization and recycling
name: Regulation of receptor internalization, recycling and cell-surface localization
rationale: Members regulate endocytosis, endosome-to-plasma-membrane recycling and surface localization of receptors (including GPCRs and clathrin cargo recognition); neighbours instead emphasize postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptor trafficking, Rab/ARF signaling or endosome organization.

name: Definitive endoderm formation and early pancreatic progenitor lineages
rationale: Members span definitive endoderm specification, foregut morphogenesis, pluripotency-driven proliferation and multipotent/ductal/endocrine progenitor lineages; the pancreatic progenitor stage separates it from gastrulation neighbours and the endoderm stage from late pancreatic differentiation neighbours.

qualifier: definitive endoderm and early pancreatic progenitors
name: Definitive endoderm specification and early pancreatic progenitor lineages
rationale: Members run from pluripotency exit and definitive endoderm/foregut to multipotent, ductal and endocrine-progenitor pancreatic lineages, lacking the gastrulation or late endocrine content of confusables.

core: Endoderm specification and pancreatic progenitor lineages
name: Definitive endoderm specification and early pancreatic progenitor lineages
rationale: Members span definitive endoderm and foregut specification through multipotent, ductal and endocrine-mid pancreatic progenitors, separating it from late-stage endocrine/exocrine and gastrulation confusables.

name: Regulation of inflammatory cytokine output and TGF-beta1 production
rationale: Members concern control of cytokine output (TNF/IL-23 lymphocyte effectors, macrophage cytokine production, TGF-beta1 production, IL-37 and autocrine signalling), unlike confusables built on IL-10/IL-27/IL-35 signalling, IL-6-family receptors or myeloid NF-kB activation.

name: Regulation of inflammatory and TGF-beta1 cytokine production
rationale: Members control the output of inflammatory cytokines (macrophage cytokines, TNF/IL-23/IL-6 family, IL-37 restraint) and TGF-beta1, rather than downstream signalling of IL-10/IL-27/IL-6-family receptors or myeloid NF-kB activation in the confusables.

name: Regulation of macrophage cytokine and TGF-beta1 production
rationale: Members regulate cytokine output (macrophage cytokines, TGF-beta1, TNF/IL-23/IL-6-family effectors, IL-37 and autocrine signalling), distinguishing them from confusables centred on IL-10/IL-27 family receptor signalling, IL-6-type receptor signalling or myeloid NF-kB activation.

core: RNA polymerase I/III transcription elongation and termination
name: RNA polymerase I/III elongation, termination and early rRNA processing
rationale: Members are Pol I and Pol III elongation/termination (plus Pol II elongation) and 5'-ETS rRNA processing; confusables add promoter initiation, rDNA chromatin regulation and later ITS cleavages.

core: Transcription by RNA polymerases I and III
name: RNA polymerase I and III transcription elongation and termination
rationale: Members are Pol I/III elongation and termination with 5S and 5'-ETS rRNA steps, while confusables carry promoter opening, initiation and rRNA expression control.

core: RNA polymerase I and III transcription
name: Elongation and termination of RNA polymerase I and III transcription
rationale: Members are elongation and termination of Pol I (with 5'-ETS rRNA processing) and Pol III transcription, whereas confusables centre on promoter opening, initiation and rRNA expression control.

qualifier: UV damage response and secretory phenotype
name: Stress-induced premature senescence and UV damage response
rationale: Members link growth arrest, SASP and oxidative/stress-induced senescence with UV response signatures, distinguishing it from confusables on p53-driven senescence regulation or Polycomb silencing.

qualifier: UV and oxidative stress with SASP
name: UV and oxidative stress-induced senescence and SASP
rationale: Members describe growth arrest, premature senescence and SASP triggered by UV and oxidative stress, unlike confusables on oncogene-induced senescence, Polycomb silencing or p53 apoptosis regulation.

qualifier: UV and oxidative stress with SASP
name: UV and oxidative stress-induced premature senescence and SASP
rationale: Members describe UV and oxidative stress responses leading to growth arrest, premature senescence and the senescence-associated secretory phenotype, unlike neighbours centred on oncogene-induced senescence, Polycomb silencing or p53 apoptosis control.

name: Cellular senescence with heterochromatin foci and Polycomb silencing
rationale: Members span replicative, oncogene- and stress-induced senescence, SASP, SAHF/subtelomeric heterochromatin and BMI1 Polycomb modules, unlike confusables framed by p53/oxidative stress and G0 exit.

name: Cellular senescence with Polycomb heterochromatin silencing and SASP
rationale: Members span replicative, stress and oncogene-induced senescence with SAHF/subtelomeric heterochromatin, Polycomb (BMI1) modules and SASP, which the oncogene/oxidative-stress and p53 confusables lack.

name: Cellular senescence with heterochromatin and Polycomb silencing
rationale: Members are replicative, oncogene- and stress-induced senescence, SASP, SAHF/subtelomeric heterochromatin and BMI1 Polycomb modules, which the p53/G0-G1-centred senescence confusables lack.

qualifier: with chemokine and interferon response modules
name: IL-6-family STAT signaling with chemokine and interferon responses
rationale: Members centre on gp130 cytokines (IL-6, IL-11, CNTF, LIF/OSM) signaling via STAT in autocrine/paracrine loops, and unlike the closest IL-6/JAK-STAT3 neighbour also carry chemokine and interferon-alpha response modules.

qualifier: gp130 cytokines in autocrine and paracrine signaling
name: IL-6-family gp130 cytokine autocrine and paracrine STAT signaling
rationale: Members concern gp130 cytokines (IL-11, CNTF, LIF/OSM) and STAT-activating autocrine/paracrine signaling with inflammatory cytokine and chemokine modules, unlike IL-10/IL-12/IL-23 family and common-gamma-chain cytokine confusables.

qualifier: CNTF and IL-11 receptors, autocrine/paracrine STAT signaling
name: IL-6-family cytokine signaling via CNTF and IL-11 receptors
rationale: Members center on gp130 cytokine signaling (CNTF, IL-11, LIF/OSM) through STAT with autocrine/paracrine inflammatory output, distinguished from IL-6/LIF-only, IL-10/IL-27 and broad interleukin confusables by CNTF and IL-11.

name: Stromal matrix with complement and myeloid chemotaxis
rationale: Members describe fibroblast/stromal matrix, adhesion and secreted factors; distinct from EMT/collagen/KRAS and perivascular-endothelial neighbours by its complement modules and mast cell/macrophage chemotaxis and TGFB1 production.

name: Stromal fibroblast matrix with complement and myeloid chemoattraction
rationale: Members describe the fibroblast/stromal ECM and adhesion compartment; unlike KRAS/fibroblast-proliferation, endothelial IL-33 and collagen/EMT neighbours, it adds complement, TGF-beta1 production and macrophage/mast cell chemotaxis.

name: Stromal fibroblast matrix with complement and myeloid chemotaxis
rationale: Members describe fibroblast/stromal matrix, adhesion and complement-bearing secretory programmes; the theme adds macrophage and mast cell chemotaxis and TGF-beta1 production that the KRAS/fibroblast-proliferation and endothelial confusables lack.

Members mix uncharacterised transcription-factor motif sets, ER membrane protein and extracellular-region gene sets, endothelial-matrix adhesion and responses to heparin and glycoprotein, with no biological process true of all of them.

Members mix ER/membrane and extracellular compartment gene sets, three promoter-motif sets and unrelated responses to heparin and glycoprotein plus endothelial-matrix adhesion, with no single biological process shared by all.

Members mix promoter-motif gene sets, ER compartment and ER-membrane insertion sets, an extracellular-region set and unrelated responses to heparin, glycoprotein and endothelial-matrix adhesion, with no single biological process shared by all.

name: Cadherin junction remodeling in epithelial-mesenchymal transition
rationale: Members share control of cadherin cell-cell adhesion and adherens junctions in the context of EMT, delamination and Rho-restrained invasion, whereas confusables emphasise CDH gene transcription or apical junction assembly and polarity.

name: Cadherin adhesion regulation during epithelial-mesenchymal transition and delamination
rationale: Members regulate cadherin and adherens junction adhesion together with EMT, delamination and Rho-limiting invasion control, whereas confusables concern apical junction assembly, polarity or CDH gene transcription.

name: Cadherin adhesion remodelling in EMT and delamination
rationale: Members regulate cadherin adhesion and adherens junctions in the context of TGF-beta EMT, delamination and Rho-GTPase-limited invasion, whereas confusables cover apical junction assembly, polarity and CDH gene transcription.

qualifier: atypical MAPKs, TORC2 and serine phosphorylation
name: Growth kinase signaling: atypical MAPKs, TORC2, serine phosphorylation
rationale: Members share growth-factor/nutrient kinase signaling (ERK5, MAPK4/6, RAS, TORC2, serine phosphorylation, growth-control modules), distinct from confusables about ERK inactivation and MAPK negative feedback.

name: Growth-factor kinase signaling via ERK5, atypical MAPKs and mTOR
rationale: Members concern serine kinase signaling in growth control (RAS-MAPK, ERK5, MAPK6/4, TORC2, LKB1/TSC growth-control modules), whereas confusables centre on ERK inactivation and negative feedback.

qualifier: atypical MAPKs, serine phosphorylation and TORC2
name: Growth-control kinase signaling: atypical MAPKs, serine phosphorylation, TORC2
rationale: Members are Ras/MAPK, ERK5 and ERK3/4 cascades, serine phosphorylation regulation, TORC2 and growth-control modules (LKB1/TSC2, RASA2); confusables focus on ERK inactivation and phosphatase feedback.

qualifier: AP-site processing, gap filling and OGG1/MUTYH defects
name: Base excision repair: AP-site processing, gap filling, OGG1/MUTYH defects
rationale: Members are post-glycosylase BER steps (APEX1 displacement, single-nucleotide and long-patch repair, gap filling) plus defective OGG1/MUTYH variants, unlike confusables on lesion recognition and cleavage, NTHL1/NEIL defects or mitochondrial DNA repair.

name: Base excision repair AP-site resolution and OGG1/MUTYH defects
rationale: Members cover downstream BER steps (AP-site processing, short- and long-patch gap filling) and defective OGG1/MUTYH glycosylases, unlike neighbours on damaged-base recognition, NEIL/NTHL1 defects and mitochondrial DNA repair.

qualifier: AP-site repair synthesis and OGG1/MUTYH defects
name: Base excision repair synthesis and OGG1/MUTYH glycosylase defects
rationale: Members are post-incision BER steps (AP-site processing, short/long-patch gap filling) and defective OGG1/MUTYH processing of oxidized guanine lesions, whereas confusables cover damaged-base recognition and cleavage, NTHL1/NEIL defects or mitochondrial DNA repair.

qualifier: GLUT4 translocation driven by insulin, adiponectin and muscle activity
name: GLUT4 glucose uptake regulation by insulin, adiponectin and exercise
rationale: Members share regulation of glucose import via GLUT4 translocation (RHOQ, insulin sensitization, adiponectin, muscle activity/PGC-1alpha), distinct from confusables on glucagon/gluconeogenesis, insulin secretion, fatty acid handling or adipogenesis.

name: GLUT4-mediated glucose uptake, adiponectin and insulin sensitization
rationale: Members regulate GLUT4 translocation and glucose import, adiponectin signaling, insulin response and muscle activity/PGC-1alpha, unlike confusables on insulin secretion, fatty acid uptake, adipogenesis or glucagon signaling.

qualifier: GLUT4 translocation with adiponectin and muscle activity
name: GLUT4-mediated glucose uptake regulated by adiponectin and exercise
rationale: Members share regulation of plasma-membrane glucose import via GLUT4/RHOQ translocation, insulin sensitisation, adiponectin and muscle-activity/PGC-1alpha signals, unlike confusables on insulin secretion, glucagon/gluconeogenesis or adipogenic transcription.

name: Neural plate specification, regionalization and border formation
rationale: Members cover anterior/posterior neural plate formation, border specification, neural fold formation and early body patterning, while confusables emphasise neural crest and hindbrain or axial mesoderm and notochord.

name: Neural plate formation, regionalization and border specification
rationale: Members cover anterior/posterior neural plate formation, border specification, neural fold formation and early axial patterning, whereas confusables cover axial mesoderm/notochord or neural crest and hindbrain patterning.

name: Neural plate formation, regionalization and border specification
rationale: Members concern anterior/posterior neural plate formation, regionalization, border and neural fold, with early body-axis determination; confusables are axial mesoderm/notochord or hindbrain HOX and neural crest commitment.

qualifier: via dendritic cell IL-12 and IFN-gamma production
name: Th1 polarization via dendritic cell IL-12 and IFN-gamma production
rationale: Members promote Th1 differentiation, DC cytokine and IL-12, IFN-gamma, GM-CSF and MHC II production, whereas neighbours concern IFN-gamma receptor signaling, Treg/memory and CD8 responses.

qualifier: IFN-gamma and IL-12 production, Th1 differentiation
name: Th1 polarization and IFN-gamma/IL-12 production
rationale: Members promote Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma, IL-12, GM-CSF and MHC II/dendritic-cell cytokine output, distinguishing it from confusables about IFN-gamma signaling responses, Tregs or CD8/MHC I programs.

qualifier: driven by dendritic cell IL-12 and IFN-gamma
name: Th1 polarization via dendritic cell IL-12 and IFN-gamma
rationale: Members promote Th1 differentiation and responses through IL-12, IFN-gamma and GM-CSF production, dendritic cell cytokine output and MHC-II induction, unlike confusables on DC antigen presentation, downstream IFN-gamma/IL-12 JAK-STAT signaling or Treg/memory T cell fate.

name: BDNF-TrkB signalling and postsynaptic AMPA receptor trafficking
rationale: Members combine BDNF/NTRK2 signalling to RAC1/CDK5 with endosomal trafficking and internalisation of postsynaptic AMPA/neurotransmitter receptors, while each confusable has only one of these halves.

name: BDNF–TrkB signalling and postsynaptic receptor trafficking
rationale: Members combine BDNF/NTRK2 signalling with AMPA and neurotransmitter receptor trafficking at the postsynapse, which separates it from actin/dendrite, plasticity and presynaptic neighbours.

name: BDNF-TrkB signalling and postsynaptic receptor endosomal trafficking
rationale: Members combine BDNF/NTRK2 signalling (CDK5, RAC1) with AMPA and neurotransmitter receptor endocytic recycling at the postsynapse; confusables address dendrite arborisation, presynaptic structure or synaptic plasticity outputs.

qualifier: BCR tuning and B cell proliferation
name: B cell receptor signalling tuning and B cell proliferation
rationale: Members are BCR second-messenger signalling, CD22 and positive/negative BCR regulation, B cell proliferation and B-cell expression modules, unlike confusables centred on B cell development, RAS/BTK, or germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation.

qualifier: CD22 tuning and B cell proliferation
name: B cell receptor signalling tuning and B cell proliferation
rationale: Members cover antigen-triggered BCR second messengers, its positive and CD22-mediated negative regulation, B cell proliferation and B-1 cells with B cell modules, unlike neighbours on B cell development, RAS/BTK activation or germinal centre and plasma cell biology.

qualifier: positive and negative BCR tuning with B cell proliferation
name: BCR signalling regulation and B cell proliferation
rationale: Members are antigen-triggered BCR second messengers, CD22 and positive/negative BCR regulation, B cell proliferation and B-cell-enriched modules, unlike confusables centred on B cell subsets, germinal centres or RAS/BTK signalling.

name: CFTR-dependent epithelial anion and fluid secretion
rationale: Members centre on CFTR trafficking/defects, anion and transepithelial water transport and exocrine (saliva, pancreatic) secretion, separating the theme from apical-surface, TRP/acid-sensing and basolateral secretion neighbours.

name: CFTR-centred epithelial anion and fluid secretion
rationale: Most members concern anion-driven water secretion in exocrine and intestinal epithelia (CFTR defects/trafficking, saliva, pancreatic juice, infectious diarrhoea), which distinguishes it from TRP/pH-sensing, apical surface and basolateral secretion confusables.

name: CFTR-dependent epithelial anion and fluid secretion
rationale: Most members concern CFTR-mediated anion and water transport in secretory epithelia (cystic fibrosis, CFTR trafficking, saliva and pancreatic secretion, enterotoxin diarrhoea), with itch and prolactin secretion as outliers, distinguishing the theme from TRP/pH-sensing channels and apical/basolateral protein sorting confusables.

name: RIG-I-like receptor antiviral signaling and its negative regulation
rationale: Members are RIG-I/MDA5 sensing of dsRNA with downstream IRF3/NF-kB activation and its positive and negative regulation, whereas neighbours emphasize interferon production, cGAS-STING or TLR-driven IRF7.

qualifier: positive and negative regulation of RIG-I/MDA5
name: RIG-I-like receptor antiviral signaling and its regulation
rationale: Members cover cytosolic dsRNA sensing by RIG-I/MDA5, its positive and negative regulation and downstream IRF3 and NF-kB activation, while confusables emphasize interferon responses, cGAS/STING and TLR routes.

name: RIG-I-like receptor RNA sensing with feedback regulation
rationale: Members are RIG-I/MDA5 cytosolic dsRNA sensing to IRF3 and NF-kB plus positive and negative regulators of the pathway; confusables cover TBK1/IRF3, cGAS-STING, TLR or interferon-production themes lacking the negative regulation of RIG-I.

core: Cell cycle arrest and quiescence control
name: p53-driven transcriptional G1 arrest and G0/G1 transitions
rationale: Members are p53 (and FOXO, p75NTR) transcriptional control of G1 arrest and G0/G1 transitions, while confusables focus on p53-driven apoptosis, p14ARF defects or retinoic acid differentiation.

core: Transcriptional control of cell cycle arrest
qualifier: p53 and FOXO, G1 arrest and quiescence
name: p53- and FOXO-driven G1 arrest and quiescence entry
rationale: Members concern p53/FOXO regulation and transcription of cell cycle inhibitors such as p21 and G0/G1 transitions, unlike confusables on p53-driven apoptosis, p14ARF loss or retinoic acid signaling.

name: p53- and FOXO-driven G1 arrest and quiescence
rationale: Members concern TP53/FOXO transcription of cell cycle inhibitors like p21 and G0/G1 transitions, unlike neighbours on p53-driven apoptosis, p14ARF loss or retinoic acid signaling.

qualifier: migration and proliferation in vessel remodeling
name: Vascular smooth muscle migration and proliferation in vessel remodeling
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle migration, proliferation, dedifferentiation and vessel remodeling/wound healing, while confusables emphasise phenotypic switching, differentiation and apoptosis.

qualifier: migration and proliferation in vessel remodeling
name: Vascular smooth muscle migration and proliferation in vessel remodeling
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle migration, proliferation, matrix adhesion and dedifferentiation within vessel remodeling and endothelial activation, unlike confusables centred on smooth muscle differentiation, apoptosis and phenotypic switching.

name: Vascular smooth muscle migration, proliferation and vessel remodeling
rationale: Members regulate VSMC migration, chemotaxis, proliferation, matrix adhesion and vascular remodeling/wound healing; confusables focus on VSMC differentiation, phenotypic switching and apoptosis.

core: Membrane potential and Na+/K+ gradient maintenance
qualifier: P-type ATPases and calcium-activated/TRESK K+ channels
name: Na+/K+ gradient and resting membrane potential maintenance
rationale: Members maintain transmembrane Na+/K+ gradients and resting/action potentials via P-type ATPases (glycoside-sensitive) and Ca2+-activated and TRESK K+ channels, unlike confusables on other K2P/KATP channels or renal sodium transport.

name: Na+/K+-ATPase and potassium channel control of membrane potential
rationale: Members maintain Na+/K+ gradients, resting potential and action potentials via P-type ATPases (glycoside-sensitive) and Ca2+-activated and TRESK K+ channels, distinct from confusables on other K2P/KATP channels or sodium transport regulation.

name: Na+/K+ pump and potassium-channel control of membrane potential
rationale: Members span Na+/K+ homeostasis by P-type ATPases (glycoside-sensitive) and Ca2+-activated/TRESK K+ channels setting resting potential and action potentials, while confusables lack either the pump or the excitability side.

qualifier: inhibitory control of myeloid effector activity
name: CSF1 signaling and inhibitory control of macrophage effector activity
rationale: Members are M-CSF signaling and macrophage proliferation together with SIRP interactions and negative regulation of phagocytosis and neutrophil activation, which the IL-6, DAP12 and myeloid-differentiation confusables lack.

qualifier: and inhibitory control of phagocyte activation
name: CSF1 signaling and restraint of macrophage and neutrophil activation
rationale: Members centre on M-CSF signaling, macrophage proliferation, myeloid identity and SIRP-type inhibition of phagocytosis and neutrophil activation, which separate it from IL-6, DAP12 and CSF-production/differentiation confusables.

name: CSF1 signalling and restraint of myeloid phagocyte activation
rationale: Members centre on M-CSF/CSF1 signalling, macrophage proliferation and myeloid identity with SIRP, interleukin SHC signalling and negative regulation of phagocytosis and neutrophil activation, separating it from CSF production/differentiation, IL-6 and DAP12 confusables.

qualifier: betaglycan (TGFBR3), activin/follistatin and TGFBR1 cancer mutants
name: Betaglycan- and activin-centred TGF-beta superfamily receptor signaling
rationale: Members concern receptor-level events (TGFBR3 regulation, activin/follistatin, AMH receptor, TGFBR1 and SMAD2/3 phosphorylation-motif mutants), whereas confusables cover SMAD transcriptional output, TGFBR2/SMAD4 mutants or gonadotropin secretion.

qualifier: TGFBR3 co-receptor, activin/AMH and TGFBR1-SMAD2/3 cancer mutants
name: TGF-beta/activin receptor signaling via TGFBR3 co-receptor and TGFBR1 mutants
rationale: Members concern receptor-level TGF-beta superfamily signaling (TGFBR3 regulation, activin/follistatin, AMH, TGFBR1 and SMAD2/3 phosphorylation-site mutants), whereas confusables emphasize SMAD4/TGFBR2 mutants, downstream SMAD transcription or gonadotropin secretion.

qualifier: betaglycan co-receptor and TGFBR1 cancer mutants
name: Betaglycan and TGFBR1 receptor-level TGF-beta superfamily signaling
rationale: Members concern TGFBR3 regulation of TGF-beta/activin/FGF2, activin and AMH receptor signaling and TGFBR1/SMAD2/3 motif mutants, rather than SMAD transcription or TGFBR2/SMAD4 mutants in confusables.

qualifier: glycation damage repair and molybdenum cofactor enzymes
name: Methylglyoxal detoxification, glycation repair and molybdoenzyme metabolism
rationale: Members cover methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification with protein and DNA glycation repair, plus molybdenum cofactor biosynthesis and sulfite/sulfide oxidation (prosthetic group), which the ROS, glutathione and vitamin B6 confusables lack.

name: Aldehyde and methylglyoxal detoxification and glycation repair
rationale: Members cover aldehyde and methylglyoxal clearance, repair of glycated protein and DNA, and molybdenum-cofactor oxidases (aldehyde/sulfite oxidation), distinguishing it from the ROS, vitamin B6 and glutathione confusables.

name: Methylglyoxal and aldehyde detoxification and protein repair
rationale: Members centre on methylglyoxal/aldehyde removal plus protein repair, DNA protection and molybdenum-cofactor-dependent oxidation, unlike the glutathione, vitamin B6 and ROS-detoxification confusables.

core: Neuromuscular junction assembly and cholinergic transmission
name: Neuromuscular junction cholinergic transmission and myasthenic syndromes
rationale: Acetylcholine release, receptor clustering, NMJ assembly with DGC/ECM proteoglycans and ALG14/GFPT1 congenital myasthenic syndromes distinguish it from neighbours on choline transport, nicotinic receptor subtypes and myogenesis.

qualifier: cholinergic transmission, synapse assembly and congenital myasthenia
name: Neuromuscular junction cholinergic transmission, assembly and congenital myasthenia
rationale: Members cover acetylcholine synthesis/secretion, NMJ transmission, AChR clustering, DGC/ECM synapse assembly and congenital myasthenic syndromes, unlike confusables on choline transport, nicotinic receptor subtypes or myogenesis.

qualifier: assembly, cholinergic transmission and congenital myasthenia
name: Neuromuscular junction assembly, cholinergic transmission and congenital myasthenia
rationale: Members span acetylcholine synthesis/release, receptor clustering, synapse assembly with DGC and proteoglycans, and glycosylation-linked congenital myasthenic syndromes, the last being absent from all confusables.

core: p53 regulation in DNA damage and cell cycle
qualifier: p14ARF/TP53 loss in cancer and G2/M progression
name: p53 control, ARF loss in cancer and G2/M progression
rationale: Members regulate p53 stability, activity and apoptotic output, its cancer loss via p14ARF/TP53 defects, and G2/M progression; the ARF/TP53 loss members distinguish it from radiation-checkpoint and p21/G1-arrest confusables.

core: p53 regulation of apoptosis and cell cycle
name: Post-translational p53 control, p14ARF loss and G2/M progression
rationale: Members share p53 stability/activity control, p14ARF-defect evasion, p53-driven apoptosis and G2/M progression, unlike confusables on p53 co-factor/p21 transcription or radiation-induced checkpoint signaling.

core: p53 activation in DNA damage response
qualifier: p53 stability control and ARF loss
name: p53 stability control, ARF loss and DNA damage-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members concern p53 phosphorylation/degradation, p14ARF and TP53 defects, and p53-mediated apoptosis and G2/M checkpoint control, unlike confusables on p53 transcription of p21/G1 arrest or radiation responses.

name: TGF-beta SMAD2/3 transcription and RUNX3 target regulation
rationale: Members are SMAD2/3:SMAD4 transcription and its downregulation plus RUNX3 regulation of ARF, BIM, CDKN1A and YAP1, lacking the receptor-mutant, BMP/activin and TGFBR3 content of confusables.

name: TGF-beta SMAD2/3 transcription and RUNX3 target gene regulation
rationale: Members cover SMAD2/3:SMAD4 transcriptional regulation and its downregulation together with RUNX3-controlled targets, whereas confusables emphasise TGF-beta receptor cancer mutants, TGFBR3, activin and BMP signaling.

name: TGF-beta/SMAD transcription and RUNX3 target regulation
rationale: Members cover SMAD2/3:SMAD4 transcription and its downregulation alongside RUNX3-controlled targets (BIM, p21, ARF, YAP1), unlike confusables on BMP/activin or cancer receptor mutants.

core: epigenetic reprogramming of the germ line and zygote
qualifier: chromatin, imprinting and piRNA-directed retroelement silencing, not maternal mRNA turnover or zygotic genome activation
name: Germline chromatin reprogramming, imprinting and piRNA retroelement silencing
rationale: Every member is a heritable chromatin or genome-silencing event in germ cells or the zygotic pronuclei (X inactivation, imprinting, heterochromatin formation, piRNA-mediated retroelement silencing, protamine-nucleosome exchange); the confusables differ by adding maternal mRNA decay, oocyte construction and zygotic genome activation.

core: germline and early embryonic chromatin reprogramming
qualifier: imprinting, X inactivation and piRNA-directed transposon silencing
name: Germline chromatin reprogramming, imprinting and piRNA transposon silencing
rationale: Every member concerns heritable chromatin states set in germ cells or the zygotic pronuclei, which separates it from confusables built on maternal mRNA decay, zygotic genome activation and piRNA biogenesis per se.

qualifier: imprinting, X inactivation and piRNA heterochromatin
name: Germline chromatin reprogramming, imprinting and X inactivation
rationale: Members concern epigenetic resetting in germ cells and zygote (protamine exchange, sperm DNA condensation, PGC specification, piRNA transposon silencing, imprinting, X inactivation), whereas confusables centre on maternal-to-zygotic transition, oocyte and piRNA biogenesis.

qualifier: germinal center and T follicular helper co-stimulation
name: Germinal center B cell and T follicular helper differentiation
rationale: Members describe B cell activation, proliferation and germinal-center/memory differentiation with Tfh, ICOS and CD27 co-stimulation, which the B-1, naive B and humoral-response confusables lack.

name: Germinal centre B cell activation with Tfh co-stimulation
rationale: Members are B cell activation, proliferation and germinal centre/memory differentiation with ICOS, CD27 and Tfh help, distinguishing it from B-1, naive B cell and immune-memory neighbours.

qualifier: germinal center and T follicular helper co-stimulation
name: Germinal center B cell activation and T follicular helper co-stimulation
rationale: Members describe B cell activation, germinal center differentiation, memory B signatures and Tfh/ICOS/CD27 co-stimulation, distinguishing it from general B cell, B-1 and immune memory confusables.

name: Gland, thymus, spleen and trachea organogenesis
rationale: Members are development of endocrine and exocrine glands (thyroid, parathyroid, salivary, lacrimal, mammary), thymus, spleen, bile duct and trachea, while confusables are craniofacial, palate and inner/outer ear morphogenesis.

name: Gland, airway and lymphoid organ development
rationale: Members are development of exocrine and endocrine glands (salivary, lacrimal, mammary, thyroid, parathyroid), trachea, bile duct, thymus and spleen, while confusables are craniofacial, ear and limb morphogenesis.

qualifier: endocrine, exocrine and lymphoid glands and trachea
name: Endocrine, exocrine, lymphoid gland and trachea organogenesis
rationale: Members are development of thyroid, parathyroid, thymus, spleen, salivary, lacrimal and mammary glands, bile duct and trachea, whereas confusables are craniofacial, palate, ear and limb development.

qualifier: resting potential and hyperpolarization rather than cardiac repolarization
name: Potassium channels setting resting potential and hyperpolarization
rationale: Members are K+ channel families (Kir, KCa, TASK, Kv, KATP) and resting/hyperpolarizing membrane potential control, whereas confusables centre on cardiac plateau and repolarization phases.

core: Potassium channel control of membrane potential
name: Potassium channels setting resting potential and hyperpolarization
rationale: Members are K+ channel families (Kv, Kir, KCa, TASK, KATP/ABCC9) and their regulation of resting potential and hyperpolarization, whereas the confusables centre on cardiac action-potential plateau and repolarization phases.

core: Potassium channel control of membrane potential
name: Potassium channels setting resting potential and hyperpolarization
rationale: Members are K+ channel families (Kir, KCa, TASK, Kv, KATP) and regulation of resting potential and hyperpolarization, whereas confusables centre on cardiac action-potential repolarization phases.

core: Actin cytoskeleton remodeling in cell shape and repulsion
name: Rnd GTPase and semaphorin-plexin actin cytoskeleton remodeling
rationale: Members concern filopodia, cell polarity and growth-cone collapse, and the Rnd1-3 GTPase cycles and semaphorin-plexin repulsion distinguish it from dendrite arborization, cytokinesis and ephrin/Rac neighbours.

core: Rho-family cytoskeletal remodeling of filopodia and cell shape
name: Rnd/RhoF GTPase and semaphorin-plexin cytoskeletal remodeling
rationale: Members concern filopodium and cell-shape control by Rnd1-3 and RhoF GTPase cycles downstream of semaphorin-plexin and EphB, distinguishing it from cytokinesis, ephrin/RAC repulsion and dendrite-arborization confusables.

name: Rnd GTPase and semaphorin-plexin control of actin protrusions
rationale: Members regulate filopodia, cell shape and postsynaptic actin via Rnd/RhoF GTPase cycles, semaphorin-plexin and EphB signaling; the Rnd and semaphorin members are what confusables (citron, ephrin-A, dendrite branching) lack.

name: TCA cycle with glutamine, glutamate and alanine interconversion
rationale: Members link the TCA cycle and its intermediates (2-oxoglutarate, malate, oxaloacetate, pyruvate) to glutamine, glutamate and alanine metabolism, whereas confusables add aspartate, the malate-aspartate shuttle, pyruvate transport or gluconeogenesis.

name: Glutamine/glutamate and alanine anaplerosis of the TCA cycle
rationale: Members link glutamine, glutamate and alanine metabolism to 2-oxoglutarate, malate, oxaloacetate and pyruvate in the TCA cycle, whereas confusables emphasize the malate-aspartate shuttle, oxidative phosphorylation, aspartate and gluconeogenesis.

name: TCA cycle intermediates and glutamate-glutamine anaplerosis
rationale: Members link the TCA cycle and its intermediates (malate, oxaloacetate, 2-oxoglutarate, pyruvate) to glutamate, glutamine and alanine metabolism, while confusables add aspartate, the malate-aspartate shuttle, respiration or gluconeogenesis.

qualifier: with CD40, MHC class II and antigen presentation control
name: Myeloid TLR inflammatory signalling and antigen presentation control
rationale: Members combine monocyte and dendritic-cell receptor modules and TLR/MyD88 inflammatory signalling with regulation of CD40, MHC class II and T cell antigen presentation, unlike confusables focused on cytokine-production regulation or Fc receptor and neutrophil effector function.

core: innate receptor signalling in antigen-presenting myeloid cells
qualifier: TLR/MyD88 and CD40 input together with its negative tuning
name: Monocyte-dendritic TLR and CD40 signalling with negative feedback restraint
rationale: All members are TLR/MyD88, CD40 and complement receptor signalling in monocytes and dendritic cells together with the brakes on it and on MHC class II, while the confusables are Fc receptor/neutrophil degranulation modules or cytokine-production regulation.

core: regulation of innate pattern-recognition and costimulatory signalling in myeloid antigen-presenting cells
qualifier: toll-like receptor, MyD88 and CD40 signalling in monocytes and dendritic cells
name: Myeloid toll-like receptor and CD40 signaling regulation
rationale: Members are monocyte and dendritic cell modules together with regulation of TLR/MyD88, CD40 and MHC class II signalling, setting the theme apart from confusables built on Fc receptor and neutrophil effector signalling, on individual cytokine production control, or on myeloid lineage identity modules.

core: Integrin- and syndecan-mediated cell-matrix adhesion in migration
name: Cell-matrix adhesion turnover in migration and invadopodia formation
rationale: Members cover integrin/syndecan substrate adhesion, spreading, stress fibers and migration, and uniquely include focal adhesion disassembly, invadopodia and negative junction regulation, unlike confusables centred on MET-PTK2, fibronectin matrix assembly and fibroblast/EMT programmes.

name: Integrin-syndecan adhesion turnover in substrate-dependent cell migration
rationale: Members cover integrin and syndecan substrate adhesion, spreading and migration, with focal adhesion disassembly and invadopodia distinguishing it from neighbours centred on MET-PTK2, fibronectin matrix and focal adhesion assembly.

name: Cell-substrate adhesion turnover and invadopodia in migration
rationale: Members cover integrin/syndecan adhesion, cell spreading, stress fibers and substrate-dependent migration, and uniquely include focal adhesion disassembly, junction downregulation and invadopodia, whereas confusables center on MET-PTK2, fibronectin matrix and fibroblast/ECM programs.
